ref: When Job heard this, he tore his clothes and shaved his head because of his great sorrow. He knelt on the ground, then worshiped God
text: Denii Joob izi di lau u tagta jaŋ la uŋ laalɛɛ la, di piili ni biinichɔg, di gbaari u nyuu, ka chɔɔ pi, di ra jaami Kɔraawiizi,

text: di ŋɔ, “Ba lulimbuu ni chakpal, chakpallɛ ń kaa kpa kaali. Kɔraawiizii tɛɛwɛ, waabuu kaa lɛɛ, u dɛg dargaarɛ.”

text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kaa pɛɛzi Sitaani, “Ɛrɛɛ n balii Joob wia duɛi? Nɛr maa waa hoo hɛri lugɔu. U wia dɔɔ wibiire, u ɛɛ nɛnaniirɛ. U ra jaamimbuu, di ra du tau ni wichɔgaa ɛɛi. U wia haa dɔɔ wibiire, haali hiŋ bir n liize ń chɔg u wia pɛɛpɛɛ la gba.”

ref: Satan left and caused painful sores to break out all over Job's body—from head to toe.
text: Denii Sitaani lii Kɔraawiizi be kaali, di ga kpa ŋmɛrchɔgaa n na wii werge ha Joob ni, di haŋ chi u naapaala biini guŋŋ ga lii u nyubaaŋ maa.

ref: Then Job sat on the ash-heap to show his sorrow. And while he was scraping his sores with a broken piece of pottery,
text: Joob jaa so hul kɛrii, di kpa keŋlii ra kurgi u ŋmɛra hiŋ.

ref: his wife asked, “Why do you still trust God? Why don't you curse him and die?”
text: U haaŋ ŋɔ u be, “I haa dɔɔ yardaawaa? See Kɔraawiizi nua, ka siu!”

ref: Job replied, “Don't talk like a fool! If we accept blessings from God, we must accept trouble as well.” In all that happened, Job never once said anything against God. Job's Three Friends
text: Joob bir ŋɔ, “I ra ŋɔ wiarɛ lugɔ hahgɛnii. Di Kɔraawiizi wa ɛɛ yaa winanaa, yaa ɔɔ sɛɛu. Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ya ra nuumi, di u wa tɛɛ ya tɔɔrɔɔ waai?” Annii maa biini, ka Joob waa wichɔgii maa ɛɛwɛ, u wiŋɔzi biini. Joob dammuzi bahoro wia

ref: Eliphaz from Teman, Bildad from Shuah, and Zophar from Naamah were three of Job's friends, and they heard about his troubles. So they agreed to visit Job and comfort him.

ref: Finally, Job cursed the day of his birth
text: Annii naa tuna, Joob pilli u nua, di see hɔpizii la baŋ luluu la nua,

text: “Kɔraawiizi, dim hɔpizii la baŋ luliŋ ani hamuŋa la ge baŋ ŋɔwɛɛ, ‘Biibaallɛ ba lul la!’

ref: and send thick, gloomy shadows to fill it with dread.

text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n maa faa lɛɛŋ di dau u naazi ninɛi, di gil n ɔzi u ilai?

text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ banla n na di dɔgnya, du de ni miibɔɔi, di gil tɔɔrɔɔ diire du denei?

text: Ba ra nyiŋŋi siu, ka waa ba, di aah siwii ra nyiŋŋuu kaali daama.

text: Ba bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔni, di ra pur, di ba wa zuu ŋmama biine.

text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ba tɛɛ newee miibɔɔi, unla ŋmɛnɛɛ n suahwɛ, unla Kɔraawiizi n gottenei?

ref: I have no peace or rest— only troubles and worries.
text: Maa bampirsɔna ni heezaa dɔɔwɛ, n tɔɔrɔɔ ge waa tuŋ.”

ref: Eliphaz from Teman said:
text: Denii Tɛman hinuu Ɛlifaz la ŋɔ,

ref: Please be patient and listen to what I have to say. *
text: “Joob, di nɛr ŋɔ wia tɛi, i baaŋ daŋ fuuah? Ka anɛɛ n niŋ wer siigɛi?

ref: have guided and encouraged many in need.
text: Di hiini banla n lɔɔzi naazi, bá wer chi nɛnnɛ.

ref: But now you feel discouraged when struck by trouble.
text: Ka filaŋkeŋ, tɔɔrɔɔ huuziibuu, i bɔra huah, u chol i ninɛɛ, i nua kpu.

ref: You respect God and live right, so don't lose hope!
text: I Kɔraawiizi jaamaa lɛi niŋ ɛɛ i yarda, i wibii dɔɔi ge ɛɛ i tamiiyaa?

ref: In my experience, only those who plant seeds of evil harvest trouble,
text: N nawɔɔrɛ nɛra n na ta wichɔgaa jina, banla ge n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa ra di a tɔna.

ref: and then they are swept away by the angry breath of God.
text: Kɔraawiizi heeza ɔɔ chɔgi baabuu kakpaŋ, di u haŋ wa pozi ni baaŋ, ba ɔɔ siuzuu.

ref: They may roar and growl like powerful lions. But when God breaks their teeth,
text: Biinikpola hina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyinzi n na wii, di ra uuhri, ka Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ tɔɔgi a nuuzi, di kuugi a nyina.

ref: they starve, and their children are scattered. A Secret Was Told to Me
text: Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyinzi la n waa kummaa nawɛɛ lauri ra diu, di siu, a biizi maa yaari la.

ref: A secret was told to me in a faint whisper—
text: Wii bɛllɛ ba suahzi di wa munni tɛŋ, ka maa nuuwɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: I was overcome by sleep, but disturbed by dreams;
text: Alugɔ hamuŋa deezikuna, u chɔg n dɔɔrɛ.

ref: and my hair stood on end, as a wind blew past my face.
text: Peu bɛl ta n siwee ni wa kaali, n bɔra nyiiri.

ref: It stopped and stood still. Then a form appeared— a shapeless form. And from the silence, I heard a voice say,
text: U chi, ka maa zum kunla dee n ɛɛu. Kumbɛl chi n sibɔɔ, denii n nuu loobii bɛl n na ŋɔ bɔɔiih,

ref: “No humans are innocent in the eyes of God their Creator.
text: ‘Newee wia daŋ wer deŋli, kaali Kɔraawiizi, gɛɛ di ɛɛ nɛnaniinanii kaali u Taaria?

ref: He finds fault with his servants and even with his angels.
text: Di Kɔraawiizi waa u balaa yardɛɛ, di kpa chɔgri ra tɛɛ u mɛlikazi,

ref: Humans are formed from clay and are fragile as moths, so what chance do you have?
text: guŋwaa, banla n na zuu hɛɛhraa diini la zɛɛzi n chigɛ hɛɛhraa biini, banla ban niŋ pinti manaŋ, di kaali kunjigzi waa nyaŋŋɔɔrɛ!

ref: Born after daybreak, you die before nightfall and disappear forever.
text: Chɔɔzimpikke di ga hel duaniŋ barii, ba daŋ siu, di ba waa ba wia zummɛ, ba maa dee tuŋ kɔrai.

ref: Your tent pegs are pulled up, and you leave this life, having gained no wisdom.”
text: Ba lɛɛ kuna la maa baŋ dɔɔwɛnɛ, ba waa nunzuma dɔɔwɛ, ka siu.’ ”

ref: Job, call out for help and see if an angel comes!
text: Ɛlifaz bir ŋɔ, “Joob, di i ra nyiŋŋi, yir na, anɛɛ n niŋ sɛɛi? Mɛlikazi la bɛliirɛ niŋ sɛɛi?

ref: Envy and jealousy will kill a stupid fool.
text: Gɛniirɛ baan na kpu, zoma ge ra kpu faaza hiŋ.

ref: I have seen fools take root. But God sends a curse, suddenly uprooting them
text: N himmaa na gɛnii n na nyɛɛli, ka kakpaŋ, ba see u dia nua.

ref: Then hungry and greedy people gobble up their crops and grab their wealth.
text: Lɔzima daŋ di gɛnii pattikuna maa, haali anla gba n du sɔɔhri biini. Niinyɔgzi hina ge ra zom, dikuu u daama wia.

ref: Our suffering isn't caused by the failure of crops;
text: Wichɔgaa waa hɛɛhraa biini ra lii lugɔ kunduulaa, gɛɛ dɔgnya ni tɔɔrɔɔ dii ra lii hɛri lugɔ kooree.

ref: Job, if I were you, I would ask God for help.
text: Ka di minuu hiŋ, n daŋ vii kpa n wia tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi.

ref: God sends showers on earth and waters the fields.
text: U ɔɔ giluu dooŋ nɛɛ hɛri, di gil kooni sɔɔni.

ref: He protects the sorrowful and lifts up those who have been disgraced. *
text: U ɔɔ lalli banla n sɔɔni siwiire chiŋ, di tɛɛ banla maa n na wii bɔsɔna.

ref: God swiftly traps the wicked
text: U ɔɔ chɔgi biinikpola hina jinazii, ba nunzuma bir pɛɛ.

ref: in their own evil schemes, and their wisdom fails.
text: U ɔɔ lau nunzunnaa ba zumaa biini, ba jinazi chɔgi.

ref: Darkness is their only companion, hiding their path at noon.
text: Bɔr ɔɔ biruu ba be bɔchaaŋ saŋa, ba ra largi bɔra wibaŋkanchirii alugɔ hamuŋa.

ref: God rescues the needy from the words of the wicked and the fist of the mighty.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ lɛɛ anuula hinaa lii biinikpola hina wiŋɔɔlaa biini, di lɛɛ baa lii fɔŋŋa hina la n na sunni baa be.

ref: The poor are filled with hope, and injustice is silenced. Consider Yourself Fortunate
text: Awia, nyaari dɔɔ tamiirɛ, ka tɔ unla wia n waa wibii dɔɔwɛ nua.

ref: Consider yourself fortunate if God All-Powerful chooses to correct you.
text: Nɛr la maa Kɔraawiizi n na deŋli, nuu sumaa! Awia, gilɛɛ waa gbɛlli Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ dignitɛraa.

ref: He may cause injury and pain, but he will bandage and heal your cuts and bruises.
text: U ɔɔ du nɛttɛ pira, ka kaa vɔɔ u ŋmɛra, di du nɛr wiila, ka kaa chaau.

ref: God will protect you from harm, no matter how often trouble may strike.
text: U daŋ ɔɔ lɛɛi lii tɔɔrɔɔ biini, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: In times of war and famine, God will keep you safe.
text: Lɔchɔgii saŋa, u daŋ lɛɛi, hàá siu laal biini, u daŋ guui lii siu be.

ref: You will be sheltered, without fear of hurtful words or any other weapon.
text: U daŋ guui lii i chɔgri be, ɔnsii wàá lawii, di chɔgaa wa ballɔ.

ref: You will laugh at the threat of destruction and famine. And you won't be afraid of wild animals—
text: I daŋ mam chɔgaa ni lɔchɔgii, hàá ɔm pir sela.

ref: they will no longer be fierce, and your rocky fields will become friendly.
text: Hɛri la hin niŋ par wàá dɔɔ bia, pir sela ge wàá ɛɛi wiimaa.

ref: You will have more descendants than there are blades of grass on the face of the earth.
text: I biizi daŋ du kpil, i naanna du kpil lugɔ kooree.

ref: You will live a very long life, and your body will be strong until the day you die.
text: I daŋ dɔɔ miibɔɔjaŋ, di du kpeg mɔɔ ka siu, alugɔ mia n ɔɔ bii nɛnnɛ mɔɔ ka ba kumaa la.

ref: Our experience has proven these things to be true, so listen and learn.
text: Joob, yaa pessi gunnɛ nɛnnɛ, u ɛɛ wibii. Awia, nuu guŋ, di sɛɛ guŋ.”

ref: It's impossible to weigh my misery and grief!
text: “Di ba daŋ vii wer mɛgzi n dɔgnya ni n biinichɔg tɔgzi,

ref: They outweigh the sand along the beach, and that's why I have spoken without thinking first.
text: a tɔgzi daŋ vii kaali muuzenaa hɛɛhriichaa, aabuu gillɛ n yali siwee ŋɔ wia.

ref: The fearsome arrows of God All-Powerful have filled my soul with their poison.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ virgimbuu u hobee, a siri su n bɔra. Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ n tɔɔrɔɔzi ra hiŋzi dɔŋa.

ref: Do oxen and wild donkeys cry out in distress unless they are hungry?
text: Di kaukpoŋlii wa na koorii di ra di, u ɔɔ ra wiiu waa, gɛɛ navarga ra wii di u wa na kooriihilaa ra dia?

ref: What is food without salt? What is more tasteless than the white of an egg?
text: Ba ɔɔ weruu di diusɛba la n waa yazi dɔɔwɛɛa, gɛɛ hal bɔhuŋŋu la summɔɔwaa?

ref: That's how my food tastes, and my appetite is gone. *
text: Gunnɛ n diwee du, n na kɔɔa.

ref: How I wish that God would answer my prayer
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi wàá tɛŋ kunla miŋ suŋŋɛɛnɛi? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ wàá nuu n wiisuŋŋaai?

ref: and do away with me.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi vii pintiŋ, di teŋ n miibɔɔ!

ref: Then I would be comforted, knowing that in all of my pain I have never disobeyed God.
text: Denii ń vii dɔɔ keŋ bampirii tigaa, n bɔra sɔɔni, haali n bɔra n na waazi naa gba, maa Dɔɔrinaniinanii la wiŋɔzi hɔɔwɛ.

ref: Why should I patiently hope when my strength is gone?
text: Bɛɛ fɔŋŋaa n dɔɔ lugɔ n haa dɔɔ tammiiyɛi? Bɛɛ n kaa du de, ú gil n dɔɔ kanyittei?

ref: I am not strong as stone or bronze,
text: N kpekkoo lugɔ biiyaa? N bɔra ɛɛ danyɛɛwaa?

ref: and I have finally reached the end of my rope. My Friends, I Am Desperate
text: Maa kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa n lɛɛ n hiŋ, maa kaa dɔɔ bɔr la min niŋ ga di na hiinaa.

ref: My friends, I am desperate, and you should help me, even if I no longer respect God All-Powerful. *
text: Di baal tamii wa tunnɔ, a dɛkkɔ u na nɔŋŋaa ni hiinaa lii u dammuzi be, haali di u vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ ɔmaa gba.

ref: like streams that swell with melting snow,
text: Di dobia werge wa chollo, di ŋmɛɛri sua,

ref: then suddenly disappear in the summer heat.
text: ka a palaa ɔɔ teŋuu lumaŋa ni, wem maga, a maa ge hil.

ref: I am like a caravan, lost in the desert while searching for water.
text: Nɛkpila ni ba nyugmazi leu, di gaagi ra nyiŋŋi nii, di zuu hɛribɔduma siu.

ref: thought they would find water. But they were disappointed,
text: Ka ba biine chɔgi werge, dikuubɛɛwiai ba faa dɔɔ tamiirɛ, ka baŋ wa hel de, ba bɔra huah.

ref: just as I am with you. Only one look at my suffering, and you run away scared. What Have I Done Wrong?
text: Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ gɔŋa naa n be, ii waa hiinaa maa dɔɔwɛ. Ii na n duulaa, ɔnsii lau ia, ii bir har.

ref: Have I ever asked any of you to give me a gift
text: N ŋmɛnɛ haa ŋɔwɔɔ lugɔ ii tɛŋ kumbɛl gɛɛ ii turgi n kim, di lii ii daama biiniaa

ref: or to purchase my freedom from brutal enemies?
text: gɛɛ ii lɛɛŋ lii n dɔm ni sikpegii hiŋ bee?

ref: What have I done wrong? Show me, and I will keep quiet.
text: Ií bagliŋ wia, n siigi, ií ŋɔ wii la miŋ ɛɛwɛ leu.

ref: The truth is always painful, but your arguments prove nothing.
text: Wibii ɔɔ ra wiiu, ka ii mmɔri dii naa waa wiimaa ra bagli.

ref: Here I am desperate, and you consider my words as worthless as wind.
text: Ii ra nyiŋŋuu ii deŋli wia la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ laa, di binni n wiŋɔzi pɛɛ alugɔ peuwaa?

ref: Why, you would sell an orphan or your own neighbor!
text: Haali ii daŋ wer ta kuna di yoo lalbiizi, di kpa ii badɔŋa chɛr daama!

ref: Look me straight in the eye; I won't lie to you.
text: Jaande maa, ií ra binniŋ nɛnnɛ! N daŋ sɛɛ kanni kara ii sibɔɔa?

ref: I know right from wrong, and I am not telling lies.
text: Biinikpola wia du n wiŋɔzi biiniaa? Amɔ, maa zum winanaa ni wichɔgaa?”

ref: We are slaves in search of shade; we are laborers longing for our wages.
text: Gunla yom n ɔɔ ra kɛlli bɔr duani manaŋ gɛɛ paahdiiri n ɔɔ ra kpaŋ u kinturgaa ni manaŋ la,

ref: God has made my days drag on and my nights miserable.
text: gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi tɛŋ baagukpila la n waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ, di kaa tɛŋ biinichɔg hamuŋzi.

ref: I pray for night to end, but it stretches out while I toss and turn.
text: Di n haŋ wa chɔɔ, n ɔɔ ra fɛu, ‘Ɛrɛɛ a birgi mag, ka n izei?’ Hɔɔ waa ɔɔ ra pizi manaŋ, n chɔɔ di birgi guŋŋ chɔɔzinnua wa hel.

ref: My parched skin is covered with worms, dirt, and sores,
text: N bɔra maa ra lii sandule, wega tɔ u maa, n ŋmɛra maa ra lii nii.

ref: and my days are running out quicker than the thread of a fast-moving needle. Don't Forget!
text: N hɔpizaa gbaŋŋɔɔ kaali suahri gambo, di ɔɔ wa tuŋ, di maa tamii dɔɔwɛ.

ref: I beg you, God, don't forget! My life is just a breath, and trouble lies ahead.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a liizi lugɔ n miibɔɔ ɛɛ heeza kakpannɛ, n siwee ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka na bɔsɔna.

ref: I will vanish from sight, and no one, including you, will ever see me again.
text: Hinna naŋ filaŋkennaa, hàá ka naŋ maa. I daŋ nyiŋŋiŋ, ka màá kaa du de.

ref: I will disappear in the grave or vanish from sight like a passing cloud.
text: Gunla baama n ɔɔ leu kaali la, gunnɛ nɛr la maa baŋ hukke, waa ɔɔ kaa bir ba la.

ref: Never will I return home; soon I will be forgotten.
text: U ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka bir ba u dia, u nɛra wàá ka zumuu maa.

ref: And so, I cry out to you in agony and distress.
text: Awia, màá siigi, n daŋ ŋɔ wia n biinichɔg naa biini. N daŋ nuumi dikuu n tɔɔrɔɔ naa n kpolle wia.

ref: Am I the sea or a sea monster? Is that why you imprison me?
text: Minuu muuzeŋ gɛɛ u vil sechɔgii, i ra guuŋŋ?

ref: Leave me alone and let me die; my life has no meaning.
text: N hah n de duirɛ, maa nyiŋŋi n du de di hanna la. Giliŋ pɛrɛtɛ! N de dui waa zɛɛ dɔɔwɛ.

ref: What makes you so concerned about us humans?
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ newea ɛɛ kumpazɛi? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i ra du ba wiɛɛlaa tauwɛi?

ref: Why do you test us from sunrise to sunset?
text: Ɛɛ pessi baabuu chɔɔzi maa, di ɛɛ baa ra na saŋa maa.

ref: Won't you look away just long enough for me to swallow?
text: I ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá lizi siwii n nii, gɛɛ di giliŋ pɛrɛtɛ, n so bɔɔiih?

ref: Why do you watch us so closely? What's it to you, if I sin? Why am I your target and such a heavy burden?
text: Ee, newea binni, di n ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ, bɛɛ n ɛɛinɛi? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i lizi siwii sag n ninɛi? N ɛɛ buntɔgaa tɛi gɛɛ?

ref: Why do you refuse to forgive? Soon you won't find me, because I'll be dead.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ hàá gil n wichɔgaa tɛnnɛi? Dikuubɛɛwiai, a wàá birgi ka n chɔɔ ŋmam biini. I daŋ nyiŋŋi n bɔr, ka màá ka du de.”

ref: Bildad from Shuah said:
text: Denii Suua hinuu Bildad la ŋɔ,

ref: How long will you talk and keep saying nothing?
text: “Ɛrɛɛ i ŋɔ wia naa dɔŋa birgi magɛi? I wiŋɔzi ra kɔɔu alugɔ pekpeg, ka a ɛɛ wipɛɛrii.

ref: Does God All-Powerful stand in the way of justice?
text: Kɔraawiizi waa wibii dii ra birgi. Kɔraawiizi La N Ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ waa wideŋlaa ra birgi.

ref: and start living right? Then he will decide to rescue and restore you to your place of honor.
text: di i wia dɔɔ wibii di deŋli, haali filaŋkeŋ gba, u daŋ izi dikuu i wia, di bir gil i nyɛɛli.

ref: Your future will be brighter by far than your past. Our Ancestors Were Wise
text: I daama la maa n chɔkkɛ la daŋ ɛɛ pɛɛ, a wàá dugli anla Kɔraawiizi n niŋ kaa tɛi.

ref: Our ancestors were wise, so learn from them.
text: Yaa naabaala faa ɛɛ nunzunnaa, awia, helli lii ba be,

ref: Our own time has been short, like a fading shadow, and we know very little.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa waa binɛɛ, yaa waa wiimaa zummɛ, yaa hɔpizaa hɛri naa biini ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ laalii.

ref: But they will instruct you with great understanding.
text: Ba daŋ baglii wia la baŋ hellee. A nuu gunla ban niŋ baglii nɛnnɛ.

ref: and if the water dries up, they die sooner than grass.
text: Haali di a haa ra hel, di a mɔnnaa waa helle gba, ka aabuu ɔɔ feli koorii maa siu.

ref: Such is the hopeless future of all who turn from God
text: Banla maa n suuh Kɔraawiizi wia, gunnɛ ba laba du, bá tamii chɔgi, di tuŋ.

ref: and trust in something as frail as a spider's web—
text: Kunla baŋ yardɛɛ ɛɛ kumpuriire, kunla baŋ dɛllɛɛ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nandar kɛhkiah.

ref: they take hold and fall because it's so flimsy.
text: Ba ɔɔ dɛlluubuu, u kaari, di ɔɔ lawuu kpogli, u chah.

ref: Sinful people are like plants with spreading roots and plenty of sun and water.
text: Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kunla banna mizi nii nɛnnɛ, wiizi baaŋ, u lunne yaari a kambol biini maa.

ref: They wrap their roots tightly around rocks.
text: U lunne mil bia baŋ chaalɛɛ dau, di ra nyiŋŋi bɔr a biine.

ref: But once they are pulled up, they have no more place;
text: Ka di ba wa kpuzuu, waa ɔɔ kaa dɔɔ chignibɔr.

ref: their life slips away, and other plants grow there.
text: Wibii maa, u miibɔɔ ɔɔ tunuu, ka kuna aŋhina bir lii a hɛri.

ref: We know God doesn't reject an innocent person or help a sinner.
text: Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi waa ɔɔ vɛɛ nɛr la wia n deŋlee, waa wichɔgɛɛra ra hiini.

ref: And so, he will make you happy and give you something to smile about.
text: U daŋ haa gil i mam, di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna.

ref: But your evil enemies will be put to shame and disappear forever.
text: U daŋ kpa hiihzi kpu i dɔma, biinikpola hina ge diini wàá ka du de.”

ref: What you say is true. No human is innocent in the sight of God.
text: “Ɛɛh, n zummɔ lugɔ wii naa ɛɛ wibiire. Ka newee maa wia wàá wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: Not once in a thousand times could we win our case if we took him to court.
text: Haali di nɛbɛl ra nyiŋŋi ú diu mmɔri gba, ka wàá wer na u pɛɛzaazi kagboŋ bɛl maa zɛɛ tɛu.

ref: God is wise and powerful— who could possibly oppose him and win?
text: Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ nunzumaa, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge. U ni nɛr maa wàá wer naa.

ref: When God becomes angry, he can move mountains before they even know it.
text: U ɔɔ lalli bizenaare, di a waa zummɛ, di kpa baaŋ billaa, di purgaa.

ref: God can shake the earth loose from its foundations
text: U ɔɔ zigli hɛrii, di gil u zɛɛ ligee ra ziigi.

ref: or command the sun and stars to hold back their light.
text: U ɔɔ ŋɔ wiarɛ wiizi be, wàá ka chaani, di ɔɔ tɔ chinchiŋwilaa chaanaa.

ref: God alone stretched out the sky, stepped on the sea,
text: U bɛnnɛ yaa chiŋ, di ra vol muuzenaa ni.

ref: and set the stars in place— the Big Dipper and Orion, the Pleiades and the stars in the southern sky.
text: Kɔraawiizii ta chinchiŋwilaa, ba ra yir aŋhina Belimbetia, Naanyɔɔ ani anla n du wiifurii nodig wiikakag.

ref: Of all the miracles God works, we cannot understand a one.
text: U ɔɔ ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia la yaa n wàá wer zum a zɛɛ gɛɛ wizenaa la yaa n wàá wer kur.

ref: God walks right past me, without making a sound.
text: Di u wa bɛri n ni, maa ɔɔ nau, u ɔɔ ga n kɛraa kaali, ka maa zum.

ref: And if he grabs something, who can stop him or raise a question?
text: Di u wa foozi kuŋ, anɛɛ niŋ wer lawuuwɛi? Anɛɛ n niŋ wer ŋɔ u be, ‘Bɛɛ i ra ɛɛ gunnɛi?’

ref: When God showed his anger, the servants of the sea monster fell at his feet.
text: Kɔraawiizi baaŋ waa sɔɔni manaŋ, di u wa fuuhwo. Haali ɔɔ kpegli Rahab ni u harbɔɔ hiŋra gbaa.

ref: How, then, could I possibly argue my case with God? Though I Am Innocent
text: Ka ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ń wer diu mmɔrɛi? Ɛrɛɛ ń ɛɛ di wer na wiŋɔzi di diu mmɔrɛi?

ref: Even though I am innocent, I can only beg for mercy.
text: Haali miŋ waa bilchɔg dɔɔwɛ gba, ka maa wiŋɔɔlii dɔɔwɛ, suŋŋaa bɛnnɛ ń suŋŋi n Seriyadiiri, ú na n sinyɛna.

ref: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.
text: Haali di n samuu, u ba gba, ka maa tamii ɛɛwɛ lugɔ u daŋ nuu n be.

ref: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.
text: U daŋ kpa pekpeg di pintiŋ, di gil n ŋmɛra bir du kpil jaa pɛɛpɛɛ.

ref: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.
text: Wàá gil n bir na n heeza, ka dɔgnya werge bɛnnɛ ú kpa tɛŋ.

ref: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?
text: Di kpegzi wiarɛ, waabuu kpekke! Di a ɛɛ wibii dii wiarɛ, anɛɛ n niŋ samuuwɛi?

ref: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.
text: Haali n wia n deŋlee gba, ka n baga lɛi n hiŋ wia, n hah n himmaa de duirɛ.

ref: What difference does it make? God destroys the innocent along with the guilty.
text: A maa ɛɛ kpannɛ, awiarɛ n ŋɔ, ‘U ɔɔ chɔgi nɛra la n waa bilchɔg dɔɔwɛ ni biinikpola hina maanii.’

ref: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.
text: Di wiilchɔgii wa ba siupirgii ni, Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra ɛɛ nɛra la wia n deŋleere chɛɛtɛ.

ref: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth? My Life Is Speeding By
text: Di hɛri wa du biinikpola hina nonee, ɔɔ tɔɔgi ba sitɔɔra siweere. Di waa lɛi, anɛɛwɛi?

ref: My life is speeding by, without a hope of happiness.
text: N hɔpizaa gbaŋŋɔɔ kaali chɔchɔɔri. A ɔɔ kaaluu, bɛl maa waa ɔɔ ba bɔsɔna ni.

ref: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.
text: A ɔɔ kaaluu lugɔ muugbessi la n gbaŋŋɛ nii nyuu, alugɔ chigni n ɔɔ tuu gbaŋzi ni fiiu, di lau kuŋ la.

ref: Sometimes I try to be cheerful and to stop complaining,
text: Di n ŋɔ lugɔ n daŋ gil nuumaa, di suuh n anuula ka ra munzi,

ref: but my sufferings frighten me, because I know that God still considers me guilty.
text: ka n haa ra ɔm n tɔɔrɔɔzii werge, dikuubɛɛwiai, n zummɔ lugɔ i daŋ haŋ tɛmbuu chɔgri.

ref: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?
text: Hiŋ teŋ tɛŋ bilchɔg naa, ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ń kaa ra tɔɔri n hiŋ pɛɛi?

ref: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap,
text: Haali di n sɔ fanfanni, di kpa biikoo sam n nonee gba,

ref: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
text: ka i daŋ taaŋ du niichɔgaa biini, guŋ gil n laala gba kiiŋ werge.

ref: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.
text: Waa newee ɛɛwɛ lugɔŋ, n vii ŋɔ n hor, ya vii bil dɔŋa seriya diiribɔr.

ref: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?
text: Ka nɛr maa waa hoo ú kuari n ni Kɔraawiizi dɔŋa ni,

ref: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?
text: ú gil n viiraa, ni n ɔnzaa!

ref: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
text: Denii màá kaa ra ɔm wia ŋɔi, ka aŋ du kennaa, màá wer ŋɔ wia.”

ref: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.
text: Joob haa ŋɔ, “N de dui bazimbuu. Màá tɔ n nua, n daŋ nuumi, dikuubɛɛwiai, n biini chɔkkɔɔ werge.

ref: Why do you take such delight in destroying those you created and in smiling on sinners?
text: N sunnaa pariibuu, i hah kunla i himmaa n tawɛɛ? Ka ra munzi biinikpola hina jinachɔgaa wia.

ref: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
text: I ra binni wiarɛ alugɔ yaa? I ra na wiarɛ alugɔ neweaa?

ref: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
text: alugɔ i pigzi di ra nyiŋŋi n wileulaa ani n wichɔgaa,

ref: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?
text: haali hiŋ zummɛ lugɔ maa bilchɔg maa dɔɔwɛ gba, ani lugɔ nɛr maa wàá wer lɛɛŋ lii i nonee biiniaa?

ref: Will you now destroy someone you created?
text: I noneere maŋ, di kuariŋ. I daŋ kaa bir chɔgiŋ filaŋkeŋ?

ref: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
text: A liizi lugɔ hinuu kpa chuuri di maŋ, i daŋ kaa gil ń birgi hɛɛhraa filaŋkeŋ?

ref: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.
text: I tɛɛ n mɛɛrɛ fɔŋŋa u luliŋ, di gil n hel n maa hia biini.

ref: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.
text: Hinuu kpa hoga ni diah, di choŋŋi dɔŋa ni, di kpa ol ni hɔŋ di tɔ a ni, di kuari n bɔra.

ref: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
text: Hinuu tɛŋ miibɔɔ di ra ɛɛŋ winanaa, di ra binni n ni, n du de.

ref: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.
text: Di n ɛɛ wichɔgaa, i daŋ naŋ, di tɛr n digni.

ref: You never stop accusing me; you become furious and attack over and over again.
text: I gillɔɔ nɛfalaa ba di waa di n daansɛɛ, di gil i baaŋfuuih ra jaa, dikuu n wia, di gil i laallɔɔra waa lɔŋ digiidigii.

ref: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i gil ba lulinnɛi? A daŋ vii pariŋ di n faa siuwɔ mɔɔ ka nɛr maa naŋ.

ref: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
text: N hɔpizaa waa helle lɛi tunaa? Lii n be, ka n wer di suma tama,

ref: of darkness and despair, the place of no return.
text: hamuŋa ni bɔbiri ni basabasa werge hɛri la. Haali de bɔchaaŋ gba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bɔbiri.’ ”

ref: Zophar from Naamah said:
text: Denii Naama hinuu Zɔfar la ŋɔ,

ref: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
text: I wiŋɔpɛɛri naa daŋ wer gil nɛra siigia? Nɛr maa wàá nyɛg i ni, di i ra ɛɛ nɛra chɛɛtɛa?

ref: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
text: I ra ŋɔu lugɔ i wiŋɔzi maa ɛɛ wibiire, di ra fɛ lugɔ i ɛɛ nɛnaniirɛ.

ref: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.
text: di vii pilli zumaa wolli tɛi, dikuubɛɛwiai, zumaa du bɔra anɛɛrɛ. Zum keŋ, Kɔraawiizi teŋ suuh i wichɔgaa aŋhinaa.

ref: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
text: A la chinne kaali hɛri, bɛɛ i wer ɛɛi? A luŋŋoo kaali ŋmam, bɛɛ i wer zumɛi?

ref: and these mysteries outreach the earth and the ocean?
text: A jaŋŋɔɔ kaali hɛri, di du war kaali muuzeŋ.

ref: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
text: Di u ballɔ di wa lawii tɔ dia, di ŋɔ u dii seriya, anɛɛ n niŋ wer diu mmɔrɛi?

ref: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
text: Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi zum karkannaa, di u wa na wichɔgaa, waa ɔɔ zumaa?

ref: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
text: Gɛnaa daŋ faari nunzuma dɔɔi, di kaukpoŋlaa biizi wa pɛssɔɔ.

ref: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
text: Ka di i gillɔ i bampirii lawuu, di lalli i nonee suŋŋuu,

ref: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
text: di gil i wichɔgaa ta, di gil a ɛɛi, a waa kaa du i dia,

ref: Then you won't be ashamed; you will be confident and fearless.
text: guŋwaa, i daŋ lalli i nyuu chiŋ, ka hiihzi wàá lawii, i daŋ chi chigigi, hàá ra ɔm.

ref: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge,
text: Wibii maa, i daŋ suuh i tɔɔrɔɔzi, di ra liizii a wia, alugɔ nii n pallɛ wa kaali.

ref: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.
text: I de dui daŋ chaani kaali wiizi n na chaani wibaŋa ni, bɔbiri ge ɛɛ lugɔ chɔɔzi.

ref: You will rest safe and secure, filled with hope and emptied of worry.
text: I daŋ dɔɔ i hiŋ, di dɔɔ tamii. Kɔraawiizi daŋ guui, i so bɔɔiih.

ref: You will sleep without fear and be greatly respected.
text: I daŋ chɔɔ bɔɔiih, nɛr maa wàá gil ɔnsii lawii, nɛkpila maa ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa i be.

ref: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
text: Ka biinikpola hina nyuŋŋi, di nyiŋŋi ŋmɛnɛɛ huhzi bá chɔ. Ba tamii maanii lugɔ ba daŋ siu.”

ref: Job said to his friends:
text: Denii Joob bir ŋɔ,

ref: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
text: “Mmɔri maa waa hoo, iabuu ɛɛ a nɛra sichaana hina, ii ni nunzumaa niŋ kpau siu!

ref: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.
text: Ka n dɔɔ nfɛrɛɛ lugɔ ia, ii wan bɔwɛɛ. Anɛɛ n waa annii naa maa zummɛi?

ref: I have always lived right, and God answered my prayers; now friends make fun of me.
text: N birgi chɛɛtɛ kunnɛ n dammuzi be, haali miŋ yir Kɔraawiizi u sɛɛ, ka n haa ɛɛ chɛɛtɛ kunnɛ, haali n wia maa n deŋlee, maa bilchɔg dɔɔwɛ la gba!

ref: It's easy to condemn those who are suffering, when you have no troubles.
text: Banla n na di dɔgnya bilchɔg tɛɛi waa kpol, di ii haa waa dɔgnya diwee na.

ref: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
text: Ka ŋmɛɛna la n na kpu nɛra, diini waa koozi. Banla ge n na fuuh Kɔraawiizi baaŋ, ba himmaa kpegzii ba yatti, di kaali Kɔraawiizi.

ref: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
text: Ií pɛɛzi sela, a daŋ bagli ia gɛɛ zumbizi, a daŋ kali ia

ref: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
text: Annii maa, a bɛlaarɛ waa zummɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ gunnɛi?

ref: Every living creature is in the hands of God.
text: U nonii biinii kunnyinii maa miibɔɔ ani newee maa heeza du.

ref: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues,
text: Digni waa ɔɔ ɛɛ wiŋɔzi lɛi di ra na alugɔ nuuzuŋŋi n ɔɔ daŋ diwee na laa?

ref: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
text: Nɛbinaa lɛi dɔɔ nunzumaa? Miibɔɔjaŋ lɛi ra ba wia zɛɛ zumaa nii?

ref: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
text: Kɔraawiizi benii nunzuma ni fɔŋŋa du, baglaa ni wia zɛɛ zumaa ɛɛ u horaa.

ref: No one can rebuild what he destroys, or release those he has imprisoned.
text: Kunla uŋ purgee, ba wàá ka wer biruu ma, nɛr la Kɔraawiizi n tɔ dia, ba wàá wer lizuu.

ref: God can hold back the rain or send a flood,
text: Di u lau dooŋ, hil ɔɔ chiu, di u wa pilluu ge, u chɔgi hɛri.

ref: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
text: Waabuu dɔɔ kpegzi, di ra kpegli u dɔma. Banla banna dar ni banla n na dar baa, maa ɛɛ u horaa.

ref: God shames counselors, turns judges into fools,
text: U ɔɔ foozi koora nunzumaa, di gil sitɔɔra birgi gɛnaa.

ref: and makes slaves of kings.
text: U ɔɔ wir kooraa, ka gil ba birgi yoma.

ref: God removes priests and others who have great power—
text: U ɔɔ tuu u kizeehina ni nɛzenaare zɛɛ.

ref: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
text: U ɔɔ ŋmaabi nabɔnzenaare, di foozi fɔŋŋa hina dɔŋkuna.

ref: God strikes their rulers senseless, then leaves them to roam through barren deserts,
text: U ɔɔ giluu hɛssi hina sitɔɔra birgi gɛnaa, di ɔɔ gil ba bugmi, di ra juuri hɛribɔduma biini.

ref: lost in the dark, staggering like someone drunk.
text: Ba ɔɔ ra largi bɔbiri biini, di ra jiŋli alugɔ sinnyɔɔra.”

ref: I know and understand every bit of this.
text: Joob haa ŋɔ, “N siwee na wia naa maanii, n digna nuua, n zum a zɛɛ.

ref: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
text: Wia la hiŋ zummɛ, n gba zumaabuu, haŋ bɔwɛɛ.

ref: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
text: Ii kpa karaa tɔ wibii ni, ii maa ɛɛ tagzi hina la n wàá wer chaa nɛr maanii!

ref: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
text: Di ii maa daŋ vii siigi, guŋ daŋ vii ɛɛ nunzuma tɛɛ ia.

ref: and listen to my argument.
text: Ií siigi ka nuu n hor, di nuu n mmɔri.

ref: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
text: Ii daŋ wer lɛɛ u nuaa? Ii daŋ wer lɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hor di ŋɔ tɛuwaa?

ref: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?
text: Di u binni ii wia nɛnnɛ na, a daŋ du wer tɛɛ ia? Ii daŋ wer daruu gunla iin niŋ wer dar neweaa?

ref: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
text: U daŋ hau ii ni, wibii maa, di ii suahzɔɔ di ra lɛɛ u nua.

ref: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
text: Ii sɛɛliizi ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ lugɔ hɔɔhri, ii mmɔrizi ge ɛɛ lugɔ chuuri.

ref: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
text: Ií siigi, ka gil n ŋɔ wia, ií gil wii la maa n niŋ ba n be, bá.

ref: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ń tulmi, di kpa n miibɔɔ du n nonee biinei?

ref: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
text: Haali di u kpuŋ gba, ka n tamii du u ninɛɛ, n daŋ ŋɔ wia di lɛɛ n hiŋ u sibɔɔ.

ref: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
text: Wibii maa, kenne niŋ wer lɛɛŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, biinikpola hina waa, bɛl maa wàá kur ba u be!

ref: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
text: Miŋ jaa ɛɛ n wia sirya filaŋkennaa, n zummɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi wàá tɛŋ bilchɔg.

ref: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ tɛŋ bilchɔgɛi? Di gunnɛ, n daŋ siigi ka siu.

ref: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛŋ kuna anɛɛ naa bɛŋ, guŋ gil n gilɛɛ suah i ni.

ref: stop punishing and terrifying me!
text: Gil n dignitɛraa! Gilɛɛ kpa ɔnsii werge kpuŋ!

ref: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
text: Feli ŋɔ wia mɔɔ ka n ge ŋɔ gɛɛ gil n feli ŋɔ wia mɔɔ, ka i ŋɔ.

ref: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
text: Wileulaa ni wichɔgaa aŋmɛnɛɛ n ɛɛi? Bagliŋ wia la miŋ ɛɛwɛ leu ani n wichɔgaa.

ref: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i bir i har kpunnɛi, di ra fɛ lugɔ n ɛɛ i dɔmnɛi?

ref: Do you really enjoy frightening a fallen leaf?
text: I ra nyiŋŋi i ɔnzimbuu gɛɛ? Maa kummaa ɛɛwɛ, paŋhoohiliirɛ miŋ, kɔliirɛ i ra naa la.

ref: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
text: I kpa wiarɛ chugiŋ, di sɛbaa du hɔŋ biini, haali n bichal saŋa wichɔgaa gba.

ref: You have tied my feet down and keep me surrounded;
text: I du n naazii daa, di ra pessi gunla maa minna vol, di zum n naajaglaa nɛnnɛ.

ref: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
text: Awia, newee bɔra ɔɔ ra tunuu alugɔ kuŋ n pɔɔhwɛ, alugɔ chau n mugzi tagta.”

ref: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
text: Joob haa ŋɔ, “Nɛr la maa haaŋ n lullɛ, u hɔpizaa waa kpil, di kaa ɛɛ tɔɔrɔɔ bɛŋ.

ref: And so, I ask you, God, why pick on me?
text: I lizi siwiire sag a guŋ hiŋ nii? I daŋ yiruu ba i be, di wa diu seriyaa?

ref: Our time on earth is brief; the number of our days is already decided by you.
text: I dau newee hɔpizaa ni u baaguzi magaa, di dau magazi la uŋ wàá wer bɛri.

ref: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
text: Awia, lizi siwii u ni, di giluu bɔɔiih, di gil u hum u huma tuŋ alugɔ paahdiiri.

ref: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
text: Haali di ba teŋ daa gba ha, ka u dɔɔ tamiirɛ, u daŋ kaa fur, u bɔfuttaa la wàá ɛɛ huhzi.

ref: Its roots and stump may rot,
text: Aŋhinabe, u lunne daŋ bini, u zɛɛkantirii siu,

ref: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.
text: ka di u wa na nii tama gba, u daŋ fur, di izi lugɔ daapuza.

ref: Humans are different— we die, and that's the end.
text: Ka newee waa ɔɔ siwuu, u wia tuŋ, di u wa vɛɛ de dui, lee ɔɔ kaa duɛi?

ref: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
text: Gunla muuzeŋ nii n ɔɔ kaali la, gɛɛ gunla muuni n ɔɔ hiihzi di pergi la,

ref: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.
text: gunnɛ newee ɔɔ chɔɔ, wàá ka izi, di chiŋ waa haŋ kaali, newea wàá hassi izi lii ba dɔɔ biini.

ref: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, di i daŋ vii kpaŋ suah ŋmam biini guŋŋ i baaŋ wa sɔɔni, di dau saŋa tɛŋ, di wa liizi n wia, a daŋ vii pariŋ!

ref: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
text: Di newee siuwɔ, u daŋ kaa wer izi, di dɔɔ miibɔɔa? N humkpega hɔpizaa maa biini, n daŋ kpaŋ guŋŋ saŋananii wa hel.

ref: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
text: I daŋ yiriŋ, n sɛɛ, i daŋ kɛlli kunla hiŋ tawɛɛ ni.

ref: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
text: Wibii maa, denii i ra pessi n volaa, ka hàá ra binni n wichɔgaa.

ref: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
text: I daŋ gilaa tɛŋ, di gil a tuŋ, i daŋ kpa n wichɔgaa suah alugɔ nɛr n kpa kuna suah dakka biini. I daŋ tɔ n wichɔgaa.

ref: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
text: Gunla bizenaa zɛɛzi hɛɛhraa n ɔɔ ra mɔɔri, bia ra lalli di lii bɔr la aŋ chɔɔwɛ la

ref: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
text: ani gunla nii n ɔɔ ra hee bia, dozenaa ge paa hɛɛhraa kaali la, gunnɛ i ɔɔ chɔgi newee tamii.

ref: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
text: I ɔɔ kpegli neweere kakpaŋ, u wia tuŋ, i ɔɔ bir u siwee duulaa, di duŋŋuu u kaali.

ref: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
text: Di ba ra kpa u biizi girme gba, ka waa ɔɔ zum, di ba ra gbɛlli baa ge, ka waa ɔɔ na guŋ.

ref: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
text: U himmaa bɔra wiila wiarɛ ɔɔ zum, di wii ra tɛɛ u hiŋ.”

ref: Eliphaz from Teman said: *
text: Denii Tɛman hinuu Ɛlifaz la bir ŋɔ,

ref: you would stop spreading all of this hot air.
text: Nunzunni daŋ kpa wiŋɔpɛɛri di ra di mmɔri, di ra ŋɔ wia la n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛa?

ref: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
text: Ka i ra gbɛlli Kɔraawiizii, di ra tɔ u jaamaa ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
text: I wiŋɔzi ra bagli i biinikpolaa, daraa su i wiŋɔzi biini.

ref: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
text: I himmaa nua tɛibuu chɔgri, n hor lɛi, i himmaa wiŋɔzi di i daansɛɛrɛ.

ref: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
text: Hinuu nɛr la baŋ luglɛɛ di lulaa? Hinuu ba lul mɔɔ ka giŋgimee haa du dee?

ref: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
text: I ra nuu Kɔraawiizi jinaziiwaa? I bɛnnɛ dɔɔ nunzumaa?

ref: We have the benefit of wisdom older than your father.
text: Yaa helli nunzumaa lii nyuhuŋŋa hina be, banla n bini i mɛɛ gba.

ref: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
text: Gunla Kɔraawiizi n na tig i bampirii la wɛɛ kukkɛɛa, wia baŋ ŋɔwɛɛ bɔɔiih di tɛii?

ref: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
text: Ɛrɛɛ i gil i tɔɔrɔɔ dii ra fuuh i baannɛi, i siwii aah gunnɛi,

ref: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
text: guŋ wia, i baaŋ ra fuuh Kɔraawiizi ni werge, di gil wiŋɔzi naa dɔŋa ra lii i nuaa?

ref: No human is pure and innocent,
text: Newee daŋ wer nyaa doŋaa? Gɛɛ u wia deŋli Kɔraawiizi bee?

ref: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
text: Kɔraawiizi waa u mɛlikazi yardɛɛ, haali a gba doŋŋoo u be,

ref: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
text: ba kaa waa ŋɔ newee n chummɛ werge, di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa alugɔ unna nyɔɔ nii.

ref: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
text: Joob, a nuu n be, ń baglii, gil n ŋɔ i be wia la miŋ nawɛɛ,

ref: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
text: Banla bɛŋ baŋ faa kpa a hɛri tɛɛ, hɔɔhri maa faa waa ba baambaaŋ na ga.

ref: But suffering is in store each day for those who sin.
text: Biinikpola hiŋ la n na sunni nɛra, daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ di hanna la, u de dui maa biini.

ref: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
text: Ɔnsii ni bɔsai gbɔga su u digna, bampirsɔna saŋa biini ge, ŋmɛɛŋkpega ɔɔ wa tɔɔruubuu.

ref: Darkness, despair, and death are their destiny.
text: Waa bɔbiri biini lii tamii dɔɔwɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u zummɔ lugɔ nɛbɛl daŋ kpuu.

ref: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
text: U juurɔɔrɛ ra bar, di birgi diwee tɛɛ duuni. U zummɔ lugɔ u siu hɔpizii helloo.

ref: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
text: Biinichɔg werge ni bɔra waazaa, kpa ɔnsii wergee ta u ni, alugɔ koorizeŋ na nyiŋŋi ú wa lɔu laal,

ref: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, u zigli u nogurunne di ra du Kɔraawiizi, di ra gbɛlli Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ,

ref: They may be rich and fat,
text: Haali uŋ vuhwɛɛ, u loŋŋa lii gba,

ref: but they will live in the ruins of deserted towns.
text: ka u daŋ du diŋgelli ni diiwooni la n na chogli biine.

ref: Their property and wealth will shrink and disappear.
text: Wàá ka ɛɛ dɔɔŋ, u daama ge tuŋ, haali u kundɔɔlaa yaari a hɛri.

ref: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
text: Wàá wer chɔ a bɔbiri biini, ninlau daŋ fuuuh alugɔ niŋ n fuuh daazi kela. Kɔraawiizi nua peu kpau kaali.

ref: They have put their trust in something worthless; now they will become worthless
text: Ú gilɛɛ waa dar u hiŋ, di ra yardi kunla maa n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, wàá na kummaa.

ref: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
text: U daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ grepu daa la nɔna n waa aahwɛ ka war, alugɔ daa fiiri n hillɛ.

ref: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
text: Nɛr la n waa Kɔraawiizi ra ɔm, daŋ nyaa naanna. Nɛra la n nɔŋŋi kebee ni kuna lɛɛi, diini daŋ fuuh.

ref: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
text: Ba ɔɔ kpogli tɔɔrɔɔ hizii, di lul wichɔgaa, ba hizi suugi daraa.”

ref: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
text: “N nuu wikpilaa alugɔ annii, i waa zum nɛr bampirii tigaa! I gillɔɔ n biinichɔg nyaŋŋi!

ref: So why don't you keep quiet? What's bothering you?
text: I wiŋɔjaŋra naa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛa? Bɛɛ n kpogliinei, i ra di mmɔri gunnɛi?

ref: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.
text: N ge gba daŋ faa wer ŋɔ wia naa, di i faa du n duula naa, n gba daŋ faa wer ŋɔ wia nɛnnɛ, di du i ni, di viigi nyuu dui.

ref: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
text: Haali di n ŋɔ wia gba, ka n bɔra waazaa wàá giliŋ, di n kaa siigi ge, a wàá kaali.

ref: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ n bɔra huah werge, wibii maa, u kpu n diahina maanii tuŋ nyaamm.

ref: my shriveled up skin proves that I am his prisoner.
text: U vɔɔzimbuu, a guŋ di n daansɛɛ, n kɔgaa nyaŋŋi, di ra bagli n bilchɔg.

ref: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
text: U kpa baaŋ ni nyɛgzi wergee di ra naaŋ, di hee u nyina di ra duŋ, n haahri ra fiiliŋ ni hahzi.

ref: Everyone is against me; they sneer and slap my face.
text: Nɛra ra mamiŋ, di chɛ n lia gbɛlliŋ, di ɛɛ nuukpaŋ bá naaŋ.

ref: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
text: Kɔraawiizi gilimbuu tɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra, di kpaŋ du biinikpola hina nonee biini.

ref: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
text: N sogaa faa wessoo tɛŋ, ka u wa lau n wia chɔgi, di hanzi n baŋaa, di kpaŋ viiri hɛri. U kpambuu birgi kunla baŋ kpawɛɛ ra helli hoo tai,

ref: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
text: u hotaara bariŋ. Waa n ni sunne, ka tɔɔhzi n siga, di puri n kpol ta hɛri.

ref: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
text: N kpa gbɔglɔnnɛ nyɛr laala di laali, di so hɛɛhraa biini ni biinichɔg.

ref: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
text: N lɛɛzi aahwɔɔ dikuu wiraa wia, maa kaa ra na nɛnnɛ,

ref: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
text: ka maa chɔgri maa dɔɔwɛ dikuu kalu wia, n na suŋŋi wiizi ni biinihuŋŋu.

ref: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
text: Ee, hɛri, gilɛɛ waa tɔ n chal, gilɛɛ gil n wiraa waa suah!

ref: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
text: Haali filaŋkennaa gba, n daansɛɛ hiŋ du Kɔraawiizi bol, n hiini du chiŋ.

ref: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
text: N dammuzi ra mamimbuu, miŋ fug sinii di ra du Kɔraawiizi ni naa,

ref: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
text: u ɔɔ ra fɔrgi Kɔraawiizii dikuu nɛr wia, gunla nɛr n ɔɔ suŋŋi di ra tɛɛ u dammu la.

ref: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
text: Binni tama bɛnnɛ niŋ bɛri, ka ń vol ŋmɛnɛɛ la baŋ ɔɔ la, ba wàá kaa bir ba la.”

ref: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
text: Joob kaa ŋɔ, “N siu duglɔɔrɛ, maa wette ra heezi, maa kaa dɔɔ kummaa, di ŋmam bɛŋ lɛi.

ref: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
text: Wibii maa, chɛɛtɛ ɛɛra barimbuu, n na gunla banna mamiŋ.

ref: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n wia dɔɔ wibiire. A nuu n wiŋɔzi. Nɛr maa waa hoo un niŋ ŋɔ hiiniŋ.

ref: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
text: I tɔ ba nfɛssii, ba wàá wer zum wia zɛɛ, awia, hàá gil ba kpegliŋ.

ref: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
text: Faala maa sɛɛlii n ŋɔwɛɛ, dí nɛr ɔɔ ɛɛ u dammuzii sɔsɔgɔ dikuu kebee wia, u biizi di tɔɔrɔɔ, dikuu guŋ wia.

ref: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
text: Nɛra jaa kpa a sɛɛlii naa di ra taŋ, ba ɔɔ wa puuzi nuuhaarii di ra du n siwee.

ref: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
text: N dɔgnya werge gillɔɔ n nyuŋŋi tuŋ, n vaama ni n naazi du lugɔ chaanii.

ref: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
text: Nɛra la n fɛwɛɛ lugɔ ba wia deŋloore nuuzi kpu, dikuu keŋ wia, ba baana ra fuuh banla n waa Kɔraawiizi ra ɔm ni.

ref: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
text: Ama, banla wia n deŋlee, daŋ haa lau ba hiŋaazi kpogli. Banla ge n waa doŋa dɔɔwɛ, dɔɔ kpegzi jaa.

ref: But none of my friends show any sense.
text: Ka di ba maa wa chigɔ n see, màá na nunzunni ba biini.

ref: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
text: N hɔpizaa tunnɔɔ, n jinazi maa bir pɛɛ, gunnɛ n bampirii winyiŋŋaa maa gba du.

ref: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
text: N dammuzi naa kpa hamuŋaa di birgi hɔpizaa, di bɔr haŋ waa biri, ba ɔɔ ŋɔu, ‘Bɔchaaŋ duglɔɔrɛ.’

ref: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
text: Di bol la bɛŋ tamii min dɔɔwɛɛ ŋmam, di kpa n kunchɔɔrikuŋ dau bɔbiri biini,

ref: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
text: amɔ, n daŋ ŋɔ ŋmam be, ‘Hinuu n mɛɛ,’ di ŋɔ sandul be, ‘Hinuu n maa ni n niuhambie.’

ref: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
text: N ni tamii daŋ kpau siwaa? Yaa maa daŋ kpau zuu hɛɛhraa biiniaa?”

ref: Bildad from Shuah said:
text: Denii Suua hinuu Bildad la bir ŋɔ,

ref: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
text: “Saŋa bɛliirɛ í gil i wiŋɔzi naanɛi? Fɛ nfɛrɛ, ka yá ŋɔ wia.

ref: Or do you think that we are dumb animals?
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i ra yir yaa nauna, di ŋɔ yaa ɛɛ gɛnaarɛi?

ref: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
text: I kpa baannɛ ra du i hiŋ pira, bá kuu i wia di vɛɛ hɛri gɛɛ? Kɔ́raawiizi tuzi bizenaa a parii?

ref: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
text: Ba dinzi biinikpola hiŋ fintinaa, wàá ka lau maa.

ref: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
text: U naazi la n faa kpekke la daŋ gɛrgi, u himmaa jinazi taau ha.

ref: Before they know it,
text: U vol ga zuu sidɛɛ ni, u lawuu.

ref: they are trapped in a net,
text: Sidɛɛ lau u naalume, ŋmɛmbee ge lawuu kiŋkiŋ.

ref: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
text: Ɔnsii werge baruu, di ra di u naagbora.

ref: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
text: Wiilchɔgii tɔ u bɔra maa ni, di gil u vaama ni naazi ra pɔɔh.

ref: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
text: Ba lizuu lii u dia la biini uŋ faa duwɛɛ nɛnnɛ la, di tuuzuu la lalaa bol.

ref: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
text: Niŋ du u dia biini, ba fuuh jilbi yaari u duuribɔr.

ref: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
text: U ɛɛ lugɔ daa lunne ni u kela maa n siuwɛ di hil.

ref: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
text: Ba duŋŋuubuu lii bɔchaaŋ du bɔbiri biini, di lizuu lii durnya.

ref: without any children to carry on their name.
text: Waa biizi gɛɛ naanna dɔɔwɛ u nɛra biini, u nɛr maa waa kaa ka.

ref: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
text: Wibii maa, wichɔgɛɛri tunaa guŋ, gunnɛ nɛr la n waa Kɔraawiizi ra ɔm, laba du.”

ref: How long will you torture me with your words?
text: “Ɛrɛɛ ii kpa wiŋɔzi di tɔɔriŋ werge, di sunniŋ birgi magɛi?

ref: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
text: Iinna chagziŋ, a bufii keŋ. Amɔ, hiihzi waa ia lauwɛaa?

ref: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
text: Di n ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ wibii maa, ii wia lɛi, n nyuu wiarɛ.

ref: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
text: Haali di ii daŋ kpa iihinaa tɔgzi kaaliŋ, di kpa n tɔɔrɔɔ dii di ra chagziŋ,

ref: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
text: denii ii zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi ɛɛwɔɔ leu n ni, di kpa u asau lawiŋ.

ref: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
text: U tɔ n ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ, awia, màá na bɔr kaali, u kpa bɔbirii tɔ n ŋmɛnibee.

ref: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
text: U baaŋ ra fuuh n ninɛɛ werge, u kuriŋ di ra jaa u dɔma ni.

ref: His entire army advances, then surrounds my tent. I Am Forgotten *
text: U hum u laallɔɔraa bá wa lɔŋ, ba wa ki bɔɔni bar n dia, di fɔɔŋ.

ref: God has turned relatives and friends against me,
text: U gillɔɔ n diahina kiziŋ ta, di gil n birgi hɔɔhri banla n zumiŋ be.

ref: My guests and my servants consider me a stranger,
text: N hɔɔhra ni n balaa wan zummɛ, di ra ɛɛŋ lugɔ famaruu.

ref: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
text: N ɔɔ yir n balii, ka wàá sɛɛ, haali di n suŋŋuu gba.

ref: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
text: N heeza ra sɔɔhri n haaŋ be, n himmaa lulla ra kɔɔŋ.

ref: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
text: Haali bichalli maa ra gbɛlliŋ, di ra mamiŋ, di ba wa naŋ.

ref: My best friends and loved ones have turned from me.
text: N badɔŋa himmaa kiiŋ werge maa, banla min nɔŋŋɛɛ ge bir di ra chagziŋ.

ref: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
text: Maa kaa ɛɛ kummaa, see hɔŋ ni hoga bɛŋ, a ka tama n vii siu.

ref: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
text: N dammuzi, ií na n sinyɛna, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizii lɔŋ!

ref: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra tɔɔriŋ werge gunla Kɔraawiizi n na ɛɛŋ lai? N sunnaa haa waa ia kukkɛɛa?

ref: I wish that my words could be written down
text: A daŋ vii pariŋ, di nɛbɛl sɛbi n wiŋɔzi du hɔŋ biini

ref: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
text: N zummɔ lugɔ n Lɛɛri ra nyinuu, u daŋ ba a tuna di wa ŋɔ wia lɛɛŋ.

ref: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
text: Di n bɔrahɔŋ wa tunnɔ, ka miŋ haa du de naa, n daŋ na Kɔraawiizi.

ref: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
text: N himmaa siwee daŋ nau, a waa lugɔ nɛbɛl. N na kɛlluu a saŋa vii ba!

ref: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
text: Di ii ŋɔwɔɔ, ‘Yaa daŋ tɔɔruu, dikuu aŋ lii u be wia.’

ref: Zophar from Naamah said:
text: Denii Naama hinuu Zɔfar la bir ŋɔ,

ref: Your words are disturbing; now I must speak.
text: “Joob, i wiŋɔzi gillɔɔ n nfɛrɛ ra koozi, a dɛg lugɔ n ŋɔ wia tɛi.

ref: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
text: I hau n ninɛɛ di gbɛlliŋ, n nfɛrɛ tɛŋ lugɔ n ŋɔ wia di chemii.

ref: that sinful people are happy for only a while.
text: Biinikpola hiŋ bɔsɔna ni mamaa wàá birgi, unla ge n waa Kɔraawiizi ra ɔm, bɔsɔna maa keŋ tama.

ref: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
text: Haali u jigsi n ɔɔ du kaŋ werge, u nyuu gaa chug baama gba,

ref: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
text: ka peu daŋ kpau kaali alugɔ u bina. A tir banla n faa zumuu la, ba ra ŋɔ, ‘Lee u duɛi?’

ref: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.
text: Nɛra la n faa nau la, ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka nau, ú duuribɔr chɔɔ pɛɛ.

ref: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
text: Ú biizi bir turgi kuna la ba mɛɛ n foozee nyaara be la.

ref: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
text: U pɔlaa fɔŋŋa la uŋ dɔɔwɛ la, u ni a maa daŋ kpau birgi hɛɛhraa.

ref: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
text: Wichɔgaa summɔɔ u nua, u kpa aŋhina du u nua di ra mugzi,

ref: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
text: Ka u diwee daŋ bir du nyɛg u hia biini, di birgi lugɔ hɛrikuna siri u biini.

ref: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
text: U daŋ hɛɛhzi daama la maa uŋ liglee la. Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil u ug a maa ta.

ref: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
text: U daŋ suu hɛrikuna siri, buzu dumuu kpu.

ref: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
text: Wàá na kissaazi la n kannɛ werge, di lii Kɔraawiizi be alugɔ muu n suwee la.

ref: Their hard work will result in nothing gained,
text: U daŋ nyaa kunla maa uŋ kuuhwɛ na, wàá di u soochi tɔna suma.

ref: because they cheated the poor and took their homes.
text: Dikuu uŋ sunni nyaara, a ra nuu baa, di foozi diini la uŋ waa mawɛɛ wia.

ref: Greedy people want everything and are never satisfied.
text: Wibii maa, u kunyiŋŋichɔgaa wàá tuŋ, wàá wer kpa u daama lɛɛ u hiŋ.

ref: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
text: Kummaa wàá ka, ú di, u daama daŋ tuŋ.

ref: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
text: U daama saŋa, biinichɔg daŋ lawuu, dɔgnya werge chol u ni.

ref: and God will make them swallow his blazing anger.
text: Di u haŋ wa di piŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa baaŋ werge tɔɔruu.

ref: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
text: Haali un ninna chɔ, dikuu lugbii dɔŋkuna wia gba, ka danyɛ hobii nua n du chilachila, daŋ lawuu.

ref: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
text: U pamuu lii u harbɔɔ, u nuunyɛgzii la ge lii u hiah. Ɔnsii werge daŋ chol u ni, u bɔra ra sa,

ref: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
text: u daama leu bɔbiri limpiriŋ biini. Kɔraawiizi gil niŋ wa fuuuh, di di kunla maa n ka u dia biini.

ref: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
text: Chinchiŋ daŋ lizi u bilchɔg chaaŋ, hɛri ge di u daansɛɛ guŋ.

ref: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
text: U kundɔɔlaa maa daŋ chɔgi, Kɔraawiizi baaŋ hɔpizii la, alugɔ nii n suwee di paa kummaa kaali la.

ref: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
text: Laba la Kɔraawiizi n dauwɛ tɛɛ biinikpola hiŋ, ani kapɛttɛ la uŋ lizɛɛ dawuubuu guŋ.”

ref: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
text: “Ií ra nuu n wiŋɔzi nɛnnɛ, gil annii ɛɛ wia la iiŋ kpawɛɛ di ra tig n bampirii.

ref: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
text: Ií diŋ kanyitti ka n ŋɔ wia, di n wa ŋɔwɔɔ tuŋ, ií jaa ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ.

ref: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
text: Newee ninɛɛ n nuumi ra duaa? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ màá nyaa kanyittei?

ref: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
text: Ií gil ii nuuzi kpu, ií ra binniŋ, di fɔɔ ii nuuzi.

ref: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
text: Di n waa fɛ wia la n ɛɛŋ nfɛrɛ, n nua ɔɔ kpuu, ɔnsii lawiŋ, n bɔra ra sa.

ref: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ biinikpola hina du de di ra bini, ba fɔŋŋa ra jaai?

ref: Why are they allowed to see their children grow up?
text: Ba na ba biizi ni ba naanna, n birgi nɛra di bar baa.

ref: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
text: Ba diini kpekkoo, ɔnsii maa waa hoo ba be. Kɔraawiizi waa ba digna ra tɛr.

ref: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
text: Ba nabala waa deezee di ra huhzi, ba naniinazi ra lul nɛnnɛ, a waa mizi.

ref: their children play and dance safely by themselves.
text: Ba biizi sa di ra bar bɔr maa alugɔ pebizi.

ref: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
text: Biinikpola hina ɔɔ ra lɔ kemzi, di ra yigzi kuna, di ra yir yira, di ra huuh tiitoraa, di ra di bahinaa.

ref: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
text: Ba de dui dɔɔ tɔna, di ɔɔ siu ni bampirsɔna.

ref: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
text: Haali ba ɔɔ ŋɔ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ‘Gil yaa! Yaa waa nyiŋŋi yá zum i ŋmɛnizi.

ref: What do we gain from praying and worshiping you?
text: Anɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, lugɔ ya ra humuuwɛi? Bɛɛ tɔnaa ya na, di yaa ra jaamuuwɛi?’

ref: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
text: Ba fɛwɔɔrɛ lugɔ ba himmaa fɔŋŋaa gillɛ ba nyɛɛli. Awia, màá sɛɛ gunla biinikpola hina n na fɛ la.

ref: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
text: Saŋa kpila maa, biinikpola hina ɔɔ zɛŋuu mɔɔ ka siu. Buŋmɛnɛɛ dɔgnya ni tɔɔrɔɔ werge haa huuzi baa, laba la Kɔraawiizi n tɛɛ baa u baaŋ la biinei?

ref: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
text: Buŋmɛnɛɛ ba haa ɛɛ alugɔ kɔlaa peu benei, alugɔ pekpeg n wa paa zɔga kaalɛi?

ref: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
text: Ba ɔɔ ŋɔu, ‘Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ kpa dignitɛraarɛ, di dau ra kpaŋ ba biizi.’ Gil u turgi baa ba himmaa a kim, bá zum guŋ!

ref: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
text: Gil ba himmaa siwee na ba chɔgaa, di gil ba di Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ baaŋ tɔɔrɔɔ.

ref: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
text: Di ba miibɔɔni tunnɔ, ba baga lɛi kaa ba biizi bɔsɔna wia.

ref: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ wer bagli Kɔraawiizi la n na di nɛra la n du bɔzenaa seriya nunzumai?

ref: Some of us die prosperous,
text: Nɛbɛl ɔɔ siwuu, di u haa kpekko, di dɔɔ bɔsɔna,

ref: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
text: Bɛl ge siu ni biinichɔg werge, u ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa kunnanii maa suma diwee.

ref: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
text: Ka ba maa ɔɔ siwuu chɔɔ hɛɛhraa biini, sandule di baa.

ref: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
text: N zum wii la iinna fɛu nɛnnɛ, jinachɔgaa la iiŋ tawɛɛ ií wa chɔgiŋ.

ref: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
text: Ii ɔɔ ŋɔu, ‘Nɛzeŋ la dia du lee filaŋkennei, biinikpola hina n faa ra zuuu lai?’

ref: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
text: lugɔ a hɔl la Kɔraawiizi baaŋ n ɔɔ fuuh, u ra tɛr nɛra digna la, biinikpola hinnɛ u ɔɔ gilaa?

ref: No one points out their sin or punishes them.
text: Anɛɛ n ɔɔ hau biinikpola hiŋ ni u sibɔɔi? Anɛɛ n ɔɔ bir turguu u wiɛɛlaa kimɛi?

ref: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
text: Ba ɔɔ chiubuu ga hug, di gil nɛra chi ra guu u ŋmam hiŋ.

ref: But empty, meaningless words are the comfort you offer me.
text: Awia, ɛrɛɛ ii wer kpa ii wijagazi tig n bampiriiyei? Ii wiŋɔzi maa ɛɛ karaa!”

ref: Eliphaz from Teman said:
text: Denii Teman hinuu Ɛlifaz la bir ŋɔ,

ref: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
text: “Newee daŋ wer dɔɔ tɔna tɛɛ Kɔraawiizia? Haali nunzunni daŋ wer dɔɔ tɔna tɛuwaa?

ref: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
text: Bɛɛ bɔsɔnaa Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ dɔɔ, di i wia faa deŋlooi? Bɛɛ tɔnaa ú vii na, di i vii waa chɔgri maa dɔɔwɛi?

ref: Is he correcting you for worshiping him?
text: Hinna ɔmuu wiarɛ u hau i ni, di ra chugii wiaa?

ref: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
text: I biinikpola lɛi kannɛ wergea? I wichɔgaa lɛi waa maga dɔɔwɛɛa?

ref: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
text: I lɛɛ i lulla kunaa di dau talma pɛɛpɛɛ, di lɛɛ ba laala, ba waa kaa dɔɔ kummaa bá laali.

ref: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
text: I faa kpolli nɛra la n kuuhwɛɛ nii, di kpolli banla lɔzi n na kpuu diwee,

ref: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
text: I faa vɛɛ luhaana hiinaare, di kaa sunni lalbiizi ge.

ref: That's why you were suddenly trapped by terror,
text: Awiarɛ sidɛɛzi bar i maa, awiarɛ siaahmu huuzii, ɔnsii werge lawii,

ref: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
text: awiarɛ bɔr biri limpiriŋ, haa wette ra na, awiarɛ a ɛɛ lugɔ nii suwoore tɔ i ni.

ref: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
text: Kɔraawiizi duuribɔr waa chinchiŋ kuna ni bɛrɛɛ lɛiyaa? Ɔɔ willi ra binni chinchiŋwilaa, haali aŋ du chinchiŋ werge gba!

ref: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
text: Ka i ɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Bɛɛ Kɔraawiizi zumɛi? Baamazi tɔ u ninɛɛ. Ɛrɛɛ ú ɛɛ di yaa seriyai?

ref: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
text: Baama biŋŋe tɔubuu, awia, waa wette ra na yaa. U ɔɔ du chinchiŋ ni hɛri baambaannɛ di ra gaagi.’

ref: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
text: I haa aah siwiire, í ra hiŋ ŋmɛnibinii la wichɔgɛɛra n na hiŋ laa?

ref: They rejected God All-Powerful, feeling he was helpless,
text: Ba ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi benii, ‘Gil yaa pɛrɛtɛ! Bɛɛ hìŋ́ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ ɛɛ yaai?’

ref: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
text: Ka waabuu faa gillɛ kunnanaa suugi ba diini, awia, maa chigɛ guu biinikpola hina baglaa.

ref: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
text: ‘Wibii maa, ba chɔgi yaa dɔmaa, niŋ di ba daama maa.’

ref: Surrender to God All-Powerful! You will find peace and prosperity.
text: Joob, a sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dɔɔra, bampirsɔna du i nuu baambaaŋ, guŋ daŋ gil i nyɛɛli.

ref: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
text: A sɛɛ u baglaazi, di kpa u wiŋɔzi du i bampirii.

ref: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
text: Di i bittɔ ba Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ be, u daŋ lɛɛi, di i gil wichɔgaa ɛɛi i dia,

ref: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
text: di kpa i saliŋ ha hɛɛhraa biini, di kpa i salinnanaa ha gɔŋluŋe biine.

ref: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.
text: Wibii maa, denii i na bɔsɔna lii u be, di ra jaamuu ni biinihuŋŋu.

ref: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
text: I daŋ ɔɔ wii duu, u nuu tɛi, di hiŋ nuuzi la hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ.

ref: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
text: Wia la maa hin niŋ ɔɔ lau, daŋ na ɛɛi, i ŋmɛnizi maa chaani.

ref: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
text: Di nɛra wichɔgaa wa gillɔ ba sɔɔni siwii, i suŋŋi wiizi, u daŋ lalli baa chiŋ.

ref: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
text: Di n vii zum bɔr la min niŋ nau, di vii wer la u duuribɔr,

ref: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
text: Ń nuu gunla un niŋ ŋɔ, di zum wii la n du u be.

ref: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
text: U daŋ kpa u fɔŋŋazeŋ la di tɔɔriŋ? Akai, u daŋ keŋŋi digni di nuu gunla min niŋ ŋɔ.

ref: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
text: Denii nɛr la wia n deŋlee kpa u wia dau u see, ú lɛɛŋ lii n seriya diiri be, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
text: Ka miŋ la wiifurii, waa hoo de, di la wiicholii, mɔɔ nawɛɛ de.

ref: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
text: Di u wa du huma wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag, maa ɔɔ nau, di u wa bittɔ la wiifurii nodig wiikakag, maa ɔɔ na u laalii gba.

ref: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
text: Ka waabuu zum n vollibɔraa, di u wa ɛɛŋ na, n daŋ du wer alugɔ saliŋ.

ref: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
text: N na hiŋ u ŋmɛnizii ni wibii, maa bɛɛwɛ ga keŋkere maa.

ref: and I have always treasured his teachings.
text: N ɔɔ ra hiŋ u nuuzii, di ra ɛɛ u kipar kaali n hor.

ref: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
text: Ka waa birgaa dɔɔwɛ. Anɛɛ n niŋ wer karsuuwɛi? Gunla maa n paruu, gunnɛ u ra ɛɛ.

ref: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
text: Gunla un dauwɛ tɛŋ, gunnɛ ú ɛɛ, a guŋ jinazi haa kpillɔɔ u be.

ref: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
text: Ka bɔbiri waa wette gil n siigi, haali a bɔbiri limpiriŋ n gillɛ maa kaa wer di ra na gba.”

ref: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
text: Joob haa ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, waa seriya dii saŋazi dauwɛi? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ banla n na humuu, ɔɔ nyiŋŋi a guŋ hɔpizaa huhzɛi?

ref: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
text: Nɛra ɔɔ tuzi magbɔɔni biarɛ, bá hɛssi du kaŋ jaa, di ŋmɛɛ peeza di jaa ba hora ni, di ra dɛɛzi.

ref: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
text: Ba ɔɔ duŋŋi lalbie kaweere kaali, di lɛɛ luhaaŋ navarga dau talma.

ref: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
text: Nyaara ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kaukpoŋlaa n du hɛribɔduma, di bar di ra nyiŋŋi diwee. De bɛnnɛ bá wer na diwee tɛɛ ba biizi.

ref: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
text: Ba ɔɔ chaali diweere di lii kooni la n waa ba hora ɛɛwɛ biine, di du biinikpola hina grepu daazi kooni, di ra kuuni a nɔna.

ref: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
text: Ba ɔɔ kɔrgi bɔraa di chɔɔ hamuŋzi ni, dikuu baŋ waa laala dɔɔwɛ wia. Ba waa kummaa dɔɔwɛ, bá tɔ waari saŋa.

ref: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
text: Dooŋ la n ɔɔ nɛɛ bizenaa ni la ɔɔ gilluu ba bɔra pɔɔh, dikuu baŋ waa duuribɔra dɔɔwɛ wia.

ref: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
text: Biinikpola hina ɔɔ tɔri lalbiere lii u maa ila ni, di foozi nyaari bie, dikuu kim wia.

ref: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
text: Ka nyaara ɔɔ kɔrgi bɔra di ra vol, dikuu ba laala nyaai wia, di ɔɔ ra chi nɛra mia, ka ra chɔɔ lɔzi.

ref: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
text: Ba ɔɔ ra ɛɛ nuu, di daali siŋ di ra tɛɛ nɛra, ka niinyɔgzi ra kpu baa.

ref: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
text: Banla n na siu la hɛmaa nyaŋŋi a bolzeŋ biini. Banla baŋ du pira ge ra chɛɛhgi, di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa, ka Kɔraawiizi baga lɛi.

ref: Some rebel and refuse to follow the light.
text: Banla n na vɛɛ bɔchaaŋ du denii, ba waa u ŋmɛnizi zummɛ gɛɛ di ra hiŋaa.

ref: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
text: Di bɔr wa biroo, nɛkpuuri ɔɔ izuu, di ra kpu nyaara ni dɔgnya hina, ka ra ŋmɛɛ hamuŋa ni.

ref: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
text: Sɛnsɛnni ɔɔ ra kpaŋ bɔr siwee lauraarɛ, u ɔɔ fɛu, ‘Nɛr maa wàá naŋ,’ di kpa kuŋ tɔ u siwee.

ref: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
text: Nɛra ɔɔ ra kuugi gbessii, di ra zuu diini hamuŋa ni. Ka suahzi bɔchaaŋ saŋa, ba waa nyiŋŋi wiimaa ɛɛi bɔchaaŋ.

ref: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
text: Bɔbiri kilɛŋkilɛnnɛ ɛɛ ba maa chɔɔzi, ba ni bɔbiri kunchɔgaa ɔɔ ra di dammunaa.

ref: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
text: Ka ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ fufuu di sag nii nyuu, ba hɛri ɛɛ lugɔ baŋ seeu nua, guŋ gil nɛr maa wàá la di ga hum ba grepu daazi kooni.

ref: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
text: Gunla hil ni bɔwem n ɔɔ gil dobia ŋmɛɛri la, gunnɛ ŋmam ɔɔ keuzi wichɔgɛɛra kaali.

ref: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
text: Ba maawaa wàá kaa ra liizi ba wia, sandule di baa. Ba wàá ɔɔ ra liizi wichɔgɛɛra wia, ka ba kuugi lugɔ daa.

ref: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
text: Ba ɔɔ ra sunni hahbara ni haaŋ la n ɛɛ biinyaarii, ba waa luhaaŋ ge ra hiini.

ref: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ kpa u fɔŋŋaa tuuzi nɛzenaa kaali. Haali baŋ soge nɛnnɛ gba, ka ba waa miibɔɔ tamii dɔɔwɛ.

ref: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
text: Aŋhinabe, u daŋ gil bá so ni bampirsɔna, ka u lizi siwiire sag ba ni saŋa maa.

ref: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
text: Ba ɔɔ dɔɔ sɔnnɛ tama, ka ba wia tuŋ kɔrai. Ba ɔɔ tuu baa zɛɛ alugɔ ba dɔŋahina, di chaali baa alugɔ baŋ kum mia.

ref: If I haven't spoken the truth, then prove me wrong.
text: Di guŋ waa ɛɛwɛ, anɛɛ n niŋ wer bagli lugɔ kara hinnɛ miŋ, di gil ń wiŋɔzi bir pɛɛi?”

ref: Bildad from Shuah said:
text: Denii Suua hinuu Bildad la bir ŋɔ,

ref: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
text: “Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa, di dɛg ɔmaa werge, dikuubɛɛwiai, u gillɔɔ u bol dɔɔ bampirsɔna.

ref: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ wer kur mɛlikazi la n na humuuwɛi? Anɛɛ ninɛɛ Kɔraawiizi bɔchaaŋ waa chaanɛi?

ref: How can anyone be innocent in the sight of God?
text: Newee wia daŋ wer deŋli gɛɛ di du paratata Kɔraawiizi bee?

ref: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
text: U be, baagu waa chaani nɛnnɛ, chinchiŋwilaa ge waa paratata duwɛɛ,

ref: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
text: ba waa ŋɔ newee n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ nakɛɛh bina gɛɛ uŋ ɛɛwɛ lugɔ sandulaa?”

ref: You have really been helpful to someone weak and weary.
text: “Na gunla hiŋ hiini nɛr la n waa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ! Na gunla hiŋ lɛɛ mìŋ́ gɛrgi naa di ta!

ref: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
text: Na gunla hiŋ bagli nɛr la n waa nunzuma dɔɔwɛ, wia! Na gunla hiŋ bagli wia zɛɛ zumaa!

ref: How can anyone possibly speak with such understanding?
text: Anɛɛ n baglii, i ŋɔ wia naanɛi? Anɛɛ dumaa kpa i nua ŋɔ wia naanɛi?

ref: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
text: Lalaa bɔra ra sau hɛri zɛɛ niiri biine.

ref: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
text: Lalaa bol chɔɔwɔɔ kpantalaŋ Kɔraawiizi see. Chɔgaa bɔr chɔɔ chaaŋ boii, kummaa waa u ni tɔwɛɛ.

ref: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.
text: U yaa wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag chinne, di tɔ bɔduma. Di gil hɛri waa kummaa ni hɔŋŋɛ.

ref: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
text: U kpa u baamazii fɔɔzi niiri, ka a tɔgzi waa wette gil a pogzi.

ref: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
text: U yaa u baamazii tɔ baagu bir siwee.

ref: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
text: U tii bɔr la chiŋ ni hɛri n chem dɔŋaa dau niiri nyuuni, u ɛɛ bɔchaaŋ ni bɔbiri magbɔɔ.

ref: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
text: Chinchiŋ ligee zigli, ɔnsii lawaa, dikuu Kɔraawiizi n pozee wia.

ref: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
text: U kpa u fɔŋŋa di gil muuzeŋ chɔɔ bɔɔiih, di kpa u nunzuma ŋmuuri muuzeŋ biini sechɔgii Rahab.

ref: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
text: U heezaa gillɛ chiŋ chaani, di kpa u nonii kpu hɛrikuŋ la n na chɔ.

ref: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
text: Ka annii haa ɛɛ u fɔŋŋa wiɛɛlaa tamaa, yaa waa u wiɛɛlaa wia tama maa zummɛ! Anɛɛ n niŋ wer zum gunla u fɔŋŋa n mɛkkɛnɛi?”

ref: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
text: “N hɛɛhzi Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la n du de saŋa maa la, lugɔ wan tɛɛwɛ wibii, ka gil n di dɔgnya werge,

ref: and while he gives me breath,
text: ka miŋ haŋ na dɔɔ miibɔɔ, dikuu Kɔraawiizi n tɛŋ heeza wia,

ref: I will tell only the truth.
text: n nua wàá ŋɔ biinikpola wia, n nuuzuŋŋi wàá dar nɛr maa.

ref: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
text: N ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá sɛɛ lugɔ wibiire ii ra ŋɔ, di kpa ra ba n siu, ka màá hɔɔ lugɔ maa wibii dɔɔwɛ.

ref: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi gil n dɔma laba ɛɛ lugɔ biinikpola hina laba, ú tɛr n haahra digna alugɔ wibii nyaara!

ref: Such people are hopeless, and God All-Powerful will cut them down,
text: Bɛɛ tamiirɛ banla n waa Kɔraawiizi ra hiŋ dɔɔi, di u waa lizi ba miibɔɔnɛi?

ref: without listening when they beg for mercy.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra nuu ba wiraare, di biinichɔg werge wa lau baa?

ref: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
text: Ba daŋ na bɔsɔna, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ bee? Ba daŋ ɔɔ ra yir Kɔraawiizi saŋazi maa?

ref: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
text: N daŋ bagli ia Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa wia. Màá kpa Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ ŋmɛnizi suah ii ni.

ref: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
text: Ii himmaa na gunnɛ, ka ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra ŋɔ wia la n waa zɛɛ maa dɔɔwɛi?

ref: Here is how God All-Powerful treats those who are wicked and brutal.
text: Laba la Kɔraawiizi n dau biinikpola hinaa keŋ, sikpegii hina ge kapɛttɛɛ keŋ di lii Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ be.

ref: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
text: Haali di ba biizi kpillɔ gunla maa, ka ba maa daŋ mag laal biini. Ba dee ŋmɛnɛ wàá wer na diwee á hel baa maa.

ref: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
text: Banla ge n niŋ lii laal biini, wiilchɔgaarɛ niŋ kpu baa, ka ba luhaana wàá wii baa.

ref: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
text: Haali baŋ dɔɔ saliŋhuŋŋa, a du kaŋ werge alugɔ hɛɛhraa, di dɔɔ laala a chɔɔ kulululu,

ref: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
text: ka nɛnanaarɛ niŋ dɔɔa di ra laali, banla ge wia n dɔɔ wibii bɔnni a saliŋhuŋŋa.

ref: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
text: Diini la ge baŋ mawɛɛ, daŋ du lugɔ kunjigzi, alugɔ nɛr la n na guu bɔr lɔɔ.

ref: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
text: Ba chɔɔ ni daama hamuŋa ni, ka di ba haŋ wa izi chɔɔzi ni, ba waa ɔɔ kaa naa.

ref: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
text: Ɔnsii werge daŋ pirgi baa, di lɔ baa alugɔ nii n suwee, pekpeg ta hamuŋa ni, di kpa baa kaali.

ref: Then a scorching wind will sweep them away
text: Wiifurii pekpeg kpa baa lii ba diini kaali.

ref: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
text: U danna ta ba ni fufufufu, di lizi baa lii ba diini.”

ref: the same is done with iron and copper.
text: Ba ɔɔ ki lugbiarɛ lii hɛri, di ŋmɛɛri lugbiaahmu lii bia ni.

ref: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
text: Newee ɔɔ zuu bɔbiri kilɛŋkilɛnnɛ, di ra pigzi, di ra ki hɛri, di ra nyiŋŋi kuna naa, a bɔbiri biini.

ref: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
text: Hɛrii diwee ra lii, ka u zɛɛ ɛɛ lugɔ niŋ n koozi kummaa.

ref: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
text: Kɔlaa maa waa de ŋmɛnɛɛ ra na, duu maa ge wɔɔ ra na.

ref: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
text: Sechɔgaa naazi waa u ni ra jag, bunyiŋ maa waa de ra daazi.

ref: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
text: Newea ra ki bikpega, di ki bizenaa zɛɛzi, a lii chaaŋ.

ref: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
text: Ba furgi bɔɔni a bia ni, di na binanaa la yoola n kpolle.

ref: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
text: Ba pigzi di na bɔra la muuni n faarɛɛ, di gil wia la n suahwɛ lii chaaŋ.

ref: But where is wisdom found?
text: Ka lee nunzuma liiyɛi? Lee wia zɛɛ zumaa duɛi?

ref: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
text: Vil ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Waa hoo n biini.’ Muuzeŋ ŋɔ, ‘Waa hoo n be.’

ref: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
text: Ba wàá wer yau nunzuma ni saliŋ himmaa gɛɛ di kpa saliŋhuŋŋu yawuu.

ref: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
text: Hàá wer kpa saliŋ gɛɛ digii di mɛgzuu gɛɛ saliŋ kuŋkuaraa di chɛruu.

ref: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
text: Nunzuma tɔna kaali lɛgzi irizi la maa yoola n kpollee.

ref: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
text: U yoola kpolloo kaali kunnanaa la kɔkɔɔza n ɔɔ kpa lii bɔɔnɛɛ.

ref: Where then is wisdom?
text: Lee nunzuma liiyɛi? Lee wia zɛɛ zumaa duɛi?

ref: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
text: U suahwɔɔ, kunnyinii maa wàá wer nau, haali zumbizi maa n du chiŋ di ra zaah gba.

ref: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
text: Banla n du lalaa bol ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘U wia hunehune tama bɛnnɛ yaa nuu.’

ref: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
text: Kɔraawiizi bɛnnɛ zum u ŋmɛnɛɛ, u bɛnnɛ zum u duuribɔr,

ref: When God divided out the wind and the water,
text: Saŋa la uŋ tɛɛ peu u fɔŋŋa la, di mɛgzi niiri maa la,

ref: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
text: di du gbɔg tɛɛ dooŋ, di dau ŋmɛnɛɛ tɛɛ dooŋ pekpeg la,

ref: he also determined the truth and defined wisdom.
text: denii u binni nunzuma, di u ɛɛ kunzenne, di na lugɔ u wessoo, u ɛɛu na.

ref: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
text: Denii u ŋɔ newee be, ‘Kɔraawiizi ɔmaarɛ nunzuma, wichɔgaa vɛɛi genii wia zɛɛ zumaa.’ ”

ref: I long for the past, when God took care of me,
text: “A vii ɛɛ lugɔ n kaa du gunla miŋ faa duwɛɛ labuu, saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n faa ra binni n ni la,

ref: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
text: saŋa la u fintina n faa ra chaaniŋ, minna vol bɔbiri biini la!
