ref: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
text: Hoi, hɔpizaa la biini miŋ faa nyɛɛlɛɛ la, saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n faa ɛɛ n bádɔŋ, di kissi n dia la,

ref: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
text: n sela faa tɛŋ nail werge, n faa na nuu werge bia hɛssi biine la.

ref: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council,
text: Di n faa haŋ wa la a bol chaalibɔr, di ga so n sognibɔr,

ref: the young leaders stepped aside, *
text: biipɔllaa ɔɔ faa nambuu, di tuzi lii kɛrii, bazɛŋzi ge izi chi.

ref: and remained silent. Everyone Was Pleased
text: Nabɔnzenaa ge ɛɛ kirkirkir, di gil wiŋɔzi.

ref: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, n faa ɔɔ mɔgli nyaara la n ɔɔ wii di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaare ani lalbiizi la n faa waa nɛr maa dɔɔwɛ, ú hiini baa la.

ref: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
text: Nɛra la n faa ra siu la diboore tɛŋ, n gil luhaana dɔɔ bampirsɔna.

ref: Kindness and justice were my coat and hat;
text: N laali wideŋlaa alugɔ n laala. Wibii diire faa ɛɛ n tagtajaŋ ni n kahuro.

ref: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
text: Minuu faa ɛɛ nyuŋŋa siwee, di ɛɛ gbɛraa naazi.

ref: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
text: Minuu faa ɛɛ dɔgnya hina mɛɛ, di ɔɔ faa lɛɛ hɔɔhra wia ŋɔ ra tɛɛ baa.

ref: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
text: Minuu ɔɔ faa chɔgi biinikpola hina fɔŋŋazi, di ra lɛɛ banla baŋ ɔɔ ra sunni.

ref: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
text: N faa fɛwɔɔrɛ lugɔ n daŋ siu n himmaa dia biini, ń hɔpizaa du kpil alugɔ hɛɛhriichaa.

ref: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
text: N faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ daa la lunne n ɔɔ ra na nii, ŋmɛnii ɔɔ chol u paŋhoori ni saŋa maa.

ref: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
text: Ba ɔɔ faa ra kpaŋimbuu, alugɔ patta n na kpaŋ dooŋ, di sɛɛ n wiŋɔzi alugɔ sazau dooŋ.

ref: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
text: N ɔɔ bagli baabuu ŋmɛnizi, ka so lugɔ ba koori. N faa du ba biinii alugɔ koorizeŋ n du u laallɔɔra biini. N faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr la, n faa ra tig liwiire bampiree.”

ref: Young people now insult me, although their fathers would have been a disgrace to my sheep dogs.
text: Joob haa ŋɔ, “Ka baala la miŋ binɛɛ ra ɛɛmbuu chɛɛtɛ filaŋkeŋ. Banla miŋ faa wàá sɛɛ bá mɛɛwaa jaa n nuuzihina ni, di ra binni n peeza gba.

ref: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
text: Bɛɛ tɔnaa ba faa dɔɔ tɛnnɛi, dikuu baŋ faa waa kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa wiai?

ref: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
text: Ba siwee faa chogli di ziimi, dikuu nyaari ni lɔzi wia. Ba faa ra hee lunne la n hillɛ, pir ni diŋgelli biine, hamuŋa ni.

ref: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
text: Ba faa kpuzi daapussi hɛribɔduma biini, di ra hee, haali a lunne n sɛppɛ werge gba!

ref: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
text: Ba dɔŋahina duŋŋi baa ta, di pogzi ba ni alugɔ baŋ ɛɛ ŋmɛɛna.

ref: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
text: Ba fir baa, ba ga du gɔŋhilaa n du bia ni bɔɔni biine.

ref: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
text: Nɛra la n nyaa tɔna, ba waa sɔna dɔɔwɛ, ba duŋŋi baabuu lii a hɛri.

ref: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
text: Filaŋkeŋ, ba biibaala yir yiraa di ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ. N birgi mɔmɔsia kuŋ ba biini.

ref: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
text: Ba kiiŋ, ba waa kaa ra nyiŋŋi bá dugliŋ, haali di ɔɔ puuzi nuuhaari di ra du n siwee.

ref: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
text: Dikuu Kɔraawiizi n jaa gil n gɛrgi, di kpa tɔɔrɔɔ di ha n ni filaŋkeŋ wia, ba baana ra fuuh n ni werge maa.

ref: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
text: Nɛkpila chaali lii n nodig di waa lɔɔziŋ, di he sidɛɛzi bá lawiŋ, di wa fɔɔŋ, di ra nyiŋŋi bá kpuŋ.

ref: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
text: Ba tɔ n ŋmɛnɛɛ, bá na bɔr chɔgiŋ, ka nɛr maa waa ba ni nyɛkkɛ.

ref: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
text: Ɔnsii werge nyaŋŋimbuu, n nɛtti kaali alugɔ peu, n nyɛɛlaa maa leu alugɔ baama.

ref: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
text: N miibɔɔ ra tuŋ guŋ bɔɔiih filaŋkeŋ, n na di tɔɔrɔɔ hɔpizi biimaa.

ref: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
text: Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋazeŋ la biini, u lau n laalaa, di hanzi n tagta du n baŋaa.

ref: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
text: U kpambuu ha kpɛchɛgaa biini, maa hɛɛhraa ni hɔɔhri bɔwɛɛ.

ref: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n wiiwoo yirii, ka haa sɛɛwɛ. N izi chi, ka binnaa bɛnnɛ i binniŋ.

ref: stirring up a windstorm to toss me about.
text: I toombuu di la chiŋ, di ra duŋŋiŋ peu biini, di kpanna haazi dooŋ pekpeg biini.

ref: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
text: N zummɔ lugɔ siu biinii i ra la n ni, bɔr la hin lizɛɛ dau nɛnyinee maa la.

ref: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
text: Ka di n waa tami winanaa ni, wichɔgaarɛ ɔɔ ba, di n waa nyiŋŋi bɔchaaŋ, bɔbirii ɔɔ ba.

ref: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
text: N biinichɔg waa tuŋ, anna di tɔɔrɔɔrɛ hɔpizi biimaa.

ref: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
text: N na bar ni biinichɔg werge, wiizi waa n ni ra nyaazi tama maa. N chi nɛkpila biini, di wii ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa.

ref: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
text: N birgi hohobiazi lullii, di birgi kikiuzi badɔŋ.

ref: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
text: N bɔhɔŋ biri di ra fugzi. Sɔsɔŋ gil n bɔra wenzi bambambam.

ref: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
text: Joob kaa ŋɔ, “N ŋɔ nuarɛ lugɔ màá binni toloori, di ra kɛlli n nuu chɔɔ.

ref: In fact, God sends disaster on all who sin,
text: Biinikpola hina chɔgaa lɛiyaa, hɛhchɔg tɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra lɛiyaa?

ref: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
text: Waa n wiɛɛlaa maa zummɛ lɛi, di ra kur n naajaglaa maa?

ref: I am not dishonest or deceitful,
text: Di n wia nyaa wibiire, gɛɛ n hahzi di ra nyiŋŋi nɛdaraa,

ref: If I have disobeyed him or even wanted to,
text: Di n naazi leu ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ, di n siwee gillɔɔ n bampirii lau wichɔgaa, gɛɛ n nonee doŋ,

ref: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
text: guŋwaa, gil nɛra di kuna la min duuwe, di gil bá kpuzi n kunduulaa maa ta.

ref: If I have desired someone's wife and chased after her,
text: Di n bampirii faa lau nɛbɛl haaŋ, gɛɛ di faa suah pɛli n dɔŋhiŋ dominua,

ref: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
text: guŋwaa, gil n haaŋ nam baal bɛl mia, di gil baala baŋhina lawuu chɔɔ.

ref: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, guŋ daŋ faa ɛɛ hiihzi di ɛɛ wichɔgaa la ban niŋ kpa diŋ seriya.

ref: sending me to destruction and my crops to the flames.
text: Sɛnsɛŋ daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ niŋ di fuuhŋ, di chɔgi n kundɔɔlaa maa dee nyaamm.

ref: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
text: Di n faa di n balaa, baala ni haana seriya kara, saŋa la baŋ faa nuumɛɛ ra duŋ,

ref: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?
text: ɛrɛɛ ń ɛɛi, di Kɔraawiizi wa ba n benei? Ɛrɛɛ ń ŋɔ, di u wa yiriŋ lugɔ ń ŋɔ n nua wiai?

ref: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
text: Kɔraawiizi la n taŋ du n maa hia la lɛi ta baa? Waa lɛi unla himmaa n ta yaa maa dee du yaa maawaa hizi biinea?

ref: I have never cheated widows or others in need,
text: N faa waa nyaara hiinaa vɛɛwɛ gɛɛ di gil luhaana di dɔgnya.

ref: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
text: N faa waa diwee dɔɔwɛ, di dia n bɛŋ, ka kpolli lalbiizi,

ref: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
text: ka n faa dɛɛzi baabuu di lii n pɔlaa saŋa maa alugɔ ba mɛɛ, di guu luhaana di lii n lulaa saŋa maa.

ref: and I was praised for supplying woolen garments to keep them warm.
text: aŋ faa tɛubuu laala la baŋ kpa n himmaa peeza huna suauh. Denii u ɔɔ chɔliŋ u biini maa.

ref: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
text: Di n faa fini lalbiizii, dikuu miŋ zummɛ lugɔ n daŋ wer ŋɔ wia lii seriya diiribɔr wia,

ref: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
text: Dikuu minna ɔm Kɔraawiizi wia, màá sɛɛ ɛɛ a guŋ widizi maa.

ref: Neither have I sinned by asking God to send down on them the curse of death.
text: N faa waa sɛɛwɛ ŋɔ wiŋɔchɔgaa, dikuu miŋ suŋŋi wiizi ú siu wia.

ref: No one ever went hungry at my house,
text: N diahina maanii zummɛ lugɔ nɛr la maa n ba n be, ɔɔ diu kukki nɛnnɛ,

ref: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
text: Baŋhina ɔɔ ɛɛ aniaa di suah ba wichɔgaa, ka miŋwaa ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa n hora suahwɛ.

ref: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
text: N ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa gunla nɛra n niŋ ŋɔ ɔmmɛ, n ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa siigɛɛ gɛɛ di ɔm chaaŋ lii, dikuu ba chɛɛtɛ wia.

ref: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
text: Amɔ, nɛr maa wàá nuu gunla minna ŋɔa? N hɛɛhzɔɔ lugɔ n wiŋɔɔlii maa ɛɛ wibiire. Gil Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ sɛɛ n be, gil nɛr la n na pag n ni sɛbi n wia dau, ń na.

ref: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
text: Wibii maa, n daŋ vii kpa a sɛbaa di laali n vaampɛrɛ, gɛɛ di hiu alugɔ koorikahuro.

ref: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
text: N daŋ vii bagli Kɔraawiizi n wiɛɛlaa maa, di ba u be banni ni.

ref: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
text: Di n faa ŋmɛɛ hɛri la minna paruu, di foozuu lii u hina himmaa be,

ref: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
text: di n faa di de diweere, ka gil lɔzi kpu banla n paraa,

ref: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
text: guŋwaa, gil choŋgolli ni kooree lii de, ka gil huuti ni baali.” Joob wiŋɔzi tunaa guŋ.

ref: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
text: Awia, baala bahoro naa jaa gil Joob koozaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, u faa fɛwɔɔrɛ lugɔ u himmaa wia deŋloore u be.

ref: Elihu from Buz was there, and he had become upset with Job for blaming God instead of himself.
text: Denii Ɛlihu baaŋ faa fuuh Joob ni werge, dikuu uŋ waa wibii kpawɛɛ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ka kpau ra tɛɛ u hiŋ wia. Ɛlihu faa ɛɛ Buz hinuu Barakɛl n lii Ram domee biini biibaallɛ.

ref: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
text: U baaŋ ge kaa fuuh Joob dammuzi bahoro la ni werge maa, dikuu baŋ waa wette na wiimaa bá ŋɔ chem Joob, ka tɛu chɔgri wia.

ref: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
text: Ɛlihu faa gillɔɔ ba ŋɔ mɔɔ, ka u haa na bɔr di ŋɔ wia tɛɛ Joob, dikuu baŋ faa binuu wia.

ref: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
text: Ka uŋ wa nawɛɛ lugɔ a baala bahoro la waa kaa dɔɔ wiimaa bá ŋɔ la, u baaŋ fuuh.

ref: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
text: Awia, Barakɛl biibaal Ɛlihu ŋɔ, “Bichalaa miŋ, iabuu nabɔnzi. Awiarɛ n faa ra ɔm n ŋɔ gunla miŋ zummɛ tɛɛ ia.

ref: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;
text: N faa fɛwɔɔrɛ, ‘Nɛbinaarɛ ra bagli wia, nɛra la ge n di biŋkpilaa dɛkkɛ bá ra bagli nunzuma.’

ref: Age is no guarantee of wisdom and understanding.
text: Nɛbinaa bɛŋ lɛi dɔɔ nunzuma, nɛzɛŋzi ge bɛŋ lɛi ra zum wia la n deŋlee zɛɛzi.

ref: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
text: Awia, n na ŋɔ ii benii, ií ra nuu n be. Ií gil n ŋɔ ii be wii la miŋ zummɛ.

ref: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
text: Ií gilɛɛ waa ŋɔ, ‘Yaa na nunzumaa, newee lɛi niŋ ŋɔ guŋ, see Kɔraawiizi.’

ref: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
text: Ka Joob waa u wiŋɔzi kpawɛɛ ga n be, n gba wàá kpa ii bilaa la ŋɔ wia tɛu.

ref: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
text: Joob, ba wiŋɔzi tunnɔɔ, ba waa kaa dɔɔ wiŋɔɔlii maa ban niŋ ŋɔ.

ref: But am I to remain silent, just because you have stopped speaking?
text: Baŋ jaa siigi filaŋkennaa, ba waa kaa dɔɔ wiimaa ban niŋ ŋɔ naa, ń haa ra kpaŋaa?

ref: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
text: Wiŋɔzi su n nuarɛ, màá gil a ka n biini.

ref: I am like a swollen wineskin, and I will burst
text: Wiŋɔzi su n biinii, alugɔ siŋ n du lɔŋgɔŋfalii biini, ba tɔ u nua, u ra nyiŋŋi u pozi la.

ref: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
text: Màá chi bɛl maa har gɛɛ di dɔɔ nuusum nɛr maa be.

ref: if I did, my Creator would quickly destroy me!
text: Di n faa dɔɔ nuusunnɛ nɛra be nɛnnɛ, a faa wàá birgi ka Kɔraawiizi tɛr n digni.”

ref: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
text: Kɔraawiizi Dumaa taŋ, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ heezaa ra tɛŋ miibɔɔ.

ref: Now line up your arguments and prepare to face me.
text: Sɛɛ tɛŋ, di i daŋ wer, di ɛɛ sirya chem n ni.

ref: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
text: N nii maa ɛɛ kpannɛ Kɔraawiizi be, yaa maanii u kpa chuuri ma.

ref: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
text: Awia, gilɛɛ waa ɔmiŋ, maa ba i tɔɔraa.

ref: I have heard you argue
text: Ka i wiŋɔzi maanii n nuu. N nuuwɔɔ hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ,

text: Ka Kɔraawiizi na chɔgri n ni, di kpaŋ birgi u dɔm.

text: U kpa yɔlɔzii di vɔɔzi n naazi, di ra pessi n wiɛɛlaa maa.’

ref: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
text: Joob, n na ŋɔ i benii lugɔ i leuwoo annii biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi kaali neweere werge maa.

text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i nuumi ra du u ni, lugɔ waa newee maa wiŋɔzi ra nuuwɛi?

text: Haali Kɔraawiizi n ɔɔ ŋɔ wia, di kuari ŋɔ, ka nɛr maa waa ɔɔ keŋŋi digna di ra nuu u wiŋɔzi.

text: ú bir newee lii wichɔgaa ɛɛi biini, di lɛɛu jigsaa biini,

text: ú lɛɛu lii siu biini, bá gilɛɛ waa kpuu kalu biini.

ref: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
text: Gɛɛ u kpa wiila tɛr u digni, di gil u hoga wiiu werge,

text: guŋ gil u nua siu, wàá ka zum diwee suma, di kii diwee la n wesse werge.

text: A ka tama u siu, bá huguu, ú kaali lalaa bol.

text: Ka di Kɔraawiizi mɛlikazi kagboŋa la bɛl wa chigɔ u har ú ŋɔ wia hinuu, di ŋɔ wia la n deŋlee tɛu,

text: di na u sinyɛna, di ŋɔ, ‘Lɛɛu, ú gilɛɛ waa siu. N dɔɔ kunla min niŋ kpa chɛr u miibɔɔrɛ.’

ref: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
text: U ɔɔ ra suŋŋi wiizii, Kɔraawiizi nuu ra tɛu. U ɔɔ na Kɔraawiizii, di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna, Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ gil u wia deŋli.

ref: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
text: Denii u ŋɔ nɛra be, ‘N faa ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ, di leu, ka Kɔraawiizi gil tɛŋ.

ref: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
text: U lɛɛmbuu lii siu be, ń du de di ra di bɔchaaŋ suma.’

text: Annii maanii Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra ɛɛ, di ra tɛɛ newee digiidigii,

text: ú lɛɛu lii siu be, guŋ gil ú de dui du sum.

text: Di i dɔɔ wiimaa i ŋɔ, ŋɔ ń nuu, ŋɔa, dikuu minna nyiŋŋi i wia chaani wia.

text: Ka di guŋ lɛi, siigi ka ra nuu n be, ń baglii nunzuma.”

text: Digni ɔɔ ɛɛ wiŋɔbeere na alugɔ nuuzuŋŋi n ɔɔ daŋ diwee na la.

text: Ií gil ya pessi na wia la n deŋlee, ií gil ya kpau helli wia la n wesse.

text: Joob ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Maa chɔgri maa dɔɔwɛ, ka Kɔraawiizi vɛɛ wibii dii tɛŋ.

text: Anɛɛ n lugɔ Jooboi, di kpa Kɔraawiizi gbɛllaa birgi barai?

text: newea maa daŋ vii siu, di bir zuu hɛɛhraa biini.

ref: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
text: Waa nabɔnzenaa har ra chi, waa dɔɔna nɔŋŋɛɛ kaali nyaara, dikuu ba maa n ɛɛ u nonee huma wia.

ref: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do

text: Bɔbiri iri maa waa hoo, wichɔgɛɛra suah de.

text: Dikuu uŋ zum ba wiɛɛlaa wia, u ɔɔ lizi baabuu di ha hamuŋa ni, di pinti baa.

text: U ɔɔ tɛrgi ba dignaa, dikuu ba biinikpola wia, bɔr la nɛr maa n niŋ wer na baa,

text: Ba gillɔɔ nyaara wiraa heluu, guŋ gil u nuu anuula hina wiraa.

ref: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
text: ú gil nɛr la n wɔɔ ra jaami gilɛɛ di kora, di gilɛɛ waa he nɛra sidɛɛzi.

text: Bagliŋ kunla miŋ wàá wer na, di n faa ɛɛwɔɔ leu, màá ka ɛɛ guŋ.’

ref: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
text: A dɛkkɔɔ Kɔraawiizi turgii i wiɛɛlaa kim gunla hinna nyiŋŋi, dikuu hiŋ vɛɛ chɔgri sɛɛi wiaa? Hinuu dɛkkɛ hiŋ fɛ nfɛrɛ na, di ŋɔ wii la hiŋ zummɛ, min lɛi.

ref: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
text: ‘Joob waa zum wii la unna ŋɔ, u wiŋɔzi waa zɛɛ dɔɔwɛ.’

ref: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
text: Ee, bá vii ɛɛ Joob na, di ga nyaŋŋi, dikuu unna sɛɛ wia alugɔ biinikpola hiŋ wia!

ref: Elihu said:
text: Denii Ɛlihu kaa ŋɔ,

text: “Joob, i fɛ lugɔ keŋ deŋloorea? I ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Kɔraawiizi daŋ chaani n wia siwee tɛŋ.’

ref: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
text: N na nyiŋŋi ń ŋɔ i ni i dammuzi benii,

text: Di ii wia deŋloo, bɛɛ ii ra tɛuwɛi, gɛɛ bɛɛ u ra lɛɛ di ra lii ii nonee biinei?

text: Ii biinikpola wiɛɛlaa ra buu nɛr la n du lugɔ iabuu, ii wideŋlaa ra buu newea bɛŋ.

text: Di ba ra sunni nɛra, ba ra hɛm, ba ɔɔ wiiu ra nyiŋŋi nɛr ú lɛɛ baa lii fɔŋŋa hina be.

text: Waa ɔɔ sɛɛ, di newea waa yiruu di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa, dikuu biinikpola hina kpoŋaa wia.

ref: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,

text: Di kaa kpa jaa, dí waa baaŋfuuih kpawɛɛ di ra tɛr digni, waa biinikpola wia ra na tama maa.

text: Awia, wiŋɔpɛɛrii Joob ra ŋɔ, waa nfɛrɛ ra fɛ, ka ŋɔ wikpila di ra jaa.”

ref: Elihu said:
text: Ɛlihu kaa ŋɔ,

text: “Di kanyitti tɛŋ tama, ń baglii lugɔ wia haa du denii ń ŋɔ hiini Kɔraawiizi.

text: Zum lugɔ n wiŋɔzi waa kara ɛɛwɛ, nɛr la n zum wia nɛnnɛɛ chigɛ i see la.

ref: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
text: Waa ɔɔ gil biinikpola hina du de di ra la, ka di wibii ra tɛɛ dɔgnya hina.

ref: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
text: Waabuu ɔɔ ra guu banla wia n deŋlee, di ɔɔ tɔ baa kossi, di gil ba dɔɔ girme di hanna la.

ref: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
text: Ka di ba vɔɔzi nɛra ni yɔlɔzi, ba ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, dikuu gunla baŋ ɛɛwɛ wia,

ref: God points out their sin and their pride,
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ŋɔ ba benii wia la baŋ ɛɛwɛ, dí ba ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ bara ni.

text: Ka di ba wàá nuu tɛu, ba daŋ siu laal biini, ni bambugri.

text: Ba wiɛɛlaa ɔɔ giluu ba chɔgmi, di siuzi ni hiihzi ba pɔlaa saŋa.

text: A du tau, nɛr maa gilɛɛ wa kpa daama di waa bir i nfɛrɛ. Gilɛɛ waa gil ba kpa kunzenaa, di waa darii, i ra leu.

text: A du tau di gilɛɛ wa bir di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa. Kɔraawiizi tɛibuu tɔɔrɔɔ naa, guŋ gil i gilɛɛ waa ɛɛ wichɔgaa.

ref: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
text: Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa werge, anɛɛ n ɛɛ bagli lugɔuwɛi?

text: A liizi di ra chɔli u huma werge maa, anla nɛra n chɔlɛɛ yira yiraa biine.

ref: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
text: Newea maanii naa, di ra binnaa tiiih lii bɔɔnɛɛ.

text: Yaa wàá wer zum u zenni di ga tuŋ gɛɛ di wer zum u binni maga maa!

text: Waabuu ɔɔ tɛr nii lii hɛri, di gil a birgi dooŋ,

text: Joob, a nuu wia naa, gil ka pessi Kɔraawiizi nuukpuuri wia la unna ɛɛ.

ref: Can you explain why lightning flashes at the orders
text: I zum gunla Kɔraawiizi n ɔɔ ŋɔ, dooŋ ra nyɛgzi baamazi biiniaa?

ref: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
text: I zum gunla aŋ ɛɛwɛ baamazi sag chiŋ, di ra bagli Kɔraawiizi nuukpuuri wiɛɛlaa?

ref: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
text: Di peu wa lii wiifurii nodig wiikakag di ra ta bɛnnɛ, i bɔra bii bambambam.

ref: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
text: I daŋ wer hiini Kɔraawiizi u yaa chiŋ, di gil u du kpeg lugɔ lugbii baŋ kuarɛɛ u ra nyɛgzia?

ref: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
text: Bagli yaa gunla yaa n niŋ ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi be, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa nfɛssi waa kaŋ, yaa waa zum gunla yaa n niŋ ŋɔ.

ref: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
text: Ba daŋ wer ŋɔ ú be lugɔ yaa ra nyiŋŋi ya ŋɔ wiarɛaa? Anɛɛ n niŋ sɛɛ ŋɔ, ú chɔguuwɛi?

ref: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
text: Filaŋkeŋ, nɛr maa wàá wer binni wiizi, dikuu u chaanaa werge wia, saŋa la peu n ta chiŋ ni, u chaani nɛnnɛ la.

ref: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
text: Yaa wàá wer dugli Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, dikuu u fɔŋŋa n kannɛ werge wia. Waa nɛra ra sunni, dikuu u wibii dii ni u wideŋlaa werge wia.

ref: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
text: Awiarɛ newea ra kpau girme, di ra tɔgzuu werge, dikuu uŋ waa banla n na yir bahinaa nunzunna, ra yir kummaa wia.”

ref: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi faa ŋɔ wia Joob be, di lii dooŋ pekpeg biini. U faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,

ref: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
text: “Anɛɛ hiŋ, i ra aani n nunzuma ni i nfɛrnyaai wiŋɔzɛi?

ref: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
text: Chi lugɔ baal. N daŋ pɛɛzii wia, i ŋɔ n be.

ref: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
text: Saŋa la miŋ faa ra chiŋŋi hɛri zɛɛ la, lee i faa duɛi? Ŋɔ n be, di i zum a zɛɛ.

ref: Doubtless you know who decided its length and width.
text: Anɛɛ n bagli gunla u kanni n niŋ magɛi? Wibii maa, i zumaabuu! Anɛɛ n mɛgzi u wassɛi?

ref: What supports the foundation? Who placed the cornerstone,
text: Bɛɛ ninɛɛ u ligee chinɛi gɛɛ anɛɛ n chiŋŋi u zɛɛ lugli bikpeg,

ref: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries
text: Anɛɛ n dau muuzeŋ magazi, saŋa la nii n lii vile di pozi yaari hɛri lai?

ref: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
text: Minuu kpa baamazi tɔ u ni, di fɔɔzuu du bɔbiri limpiriŋ biini,

ref: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
text: di dau magbɔɔni tɛu, di kpa kuna tɔ u nua alugɔ gbessi.

ref: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
text: N faa ŋɔ u benii, ‘Keŋ maga bɛnnɛ i ɔɔ su di la, gilɛɛ waa bɛri de, i lɔi helli magaa keŋ la.’

ref: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
text: Joob, i ŋmɛnɛ haa ŋɔ duana birgi wibaŋaa?

ref: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
text: I daŋ wer gil hɛri maa chaani, guŋ gil biinikpola hina chɔ lii ba suahribɔra kaaliaa?

ref: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
text: Di bɔr wa chaanɔɔ, u ɔɔ giluu ba na giŋgimee ni walli, a du lugɔ baŋ lii wɛjɛ gɛɛ baŋ zɛuzi vii la.

ref: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
text: Di bɔr wa chaanɔɔ, biinikpola hina waa ɔɔ kaa dɔɔ bɔbiri, bá kaa wer dɔɔ fɔŋŋa tɔɔri nɛra.

ref: Job, have you ever walked on the ocean floor?
text: I la muuzeŋ zɛɛ bullia? I vol u zɛɛa?

ref: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
text: Ba bagliibuu lalaa bol dominuuzenaa? I haa na bɔbiri limpiriŋ dominuuzenaa?

ref: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
text: I zum gunla hɛri n kannɛ magaa? Ŋɔ n be, di i zum annii naa maa.

ref: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
text: I zum bɔr la bɔchaaŋ n duwɛɛ, bɔr la bɔbiri n liwɛɛɛ?

ref: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
text: Wibii maa, i zumaabuu, dikuu baŋ faa felee lulii wia! I di biŋkpilaa werge!

ref: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
text: I zum bɔr la miŋ gillɛ ŋmɛnii ni dobia dua,

ref: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
text: anla miŋ ɔɔ gil a ba tɔɔrɔɔ ni, laal saŋaa?

ref: Who carves out a path for thunderstorms? Who sends torrents of rain
text: Anɛɛ ɔɔ peri bɔr tɛɛ dozenaa ni dooŋ pozaa pekpeg ŋmɛnɛɛ,

ref: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
text: di gil dooŋ nɛɛ hɛri la nɛra n waa duwɛɛ, u pɔɔh, di gil kooree lii dee?

ref: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
text: Dooŋ dɔɔ mɛɛrɛa? Ŋmɛnii mɛɛrɛ anɛɛ?

ref: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
text: Anɛɛ n lul dobiai? Anɛɛ n lul chɔɔziŋkɔɔllɛi.

ref: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
text: Anɛɛ n gillɛ niiri du kpeg alugɔ dobii, di gil vile nyuuni kpamɛi?

ref: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
text: I daŋ wer vɔɔ chinchiŋwilaa la banna yir Asiko laa? I daŋ wer pur ŋmɛnni la n vɔɔzi Belinbetiaa?

ref: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
text: I daŋ wer bagli saŋazi la chinchiŋwilaa n ɔɔ ra liiyaa, gɛɛ di tɔ Naanyɔɔ ni u biizi see a lii a chignibɔraa?

ref: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
text: I zum chinchiŋ gbɔgniaa? I daŋ wer gil a hum huma hɛriaa?

ref: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
text: I daŋ wer pozi baamazi ni, di wer gil dooŋ nɛɛ werge i nii?

ref: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
text: Anɛɛ n kpa nunzuma di du newee nfɛrɛ biinei, di gil u ra zum wia zɛɛi?

ref: Can you count the clouds or pour out their water
text: Anɛɛ n dɔɔ nunzuma ú wer kur baamazɛi? Anɛɛ n niŋ wer fug chiŋ golaa niiyɛi,

ref: on the dry, lumpy soil?
text: di hɛɛhraa wa kpammɔ gɛɛ di a wa lau dɔŋai?

ref: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
text: Hinuu ɔɔ kpaani di ra tɛɛ bunyinniina, di gil bunyinzi di ra piŋ,

ref: Do you send an animal into their den?
text: di a wa chɔɔgi a chɔɔribɔra gɛɛ di chɔɔgi kasagzi biine, di ra guuwei?

ref: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
text: Anɛɛ n na tɛɛ dugli diweei, di u biizi wa wiiwo di ra du Kɔraawiizi, di ra bar, dikuu aŋ nyaa diwee wiai?”

ref: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “I zum saŋa la bizenaa buuna n ɔɔ ra lulaa? I haa na lau lulaa?

ref: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
text: A biizi du pir di ra hel, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa nɛnnɛ, di ɔɔ gil a maawaa, a wàá ka bir ba.

ref: I alone help them survive in salty desert sand.
text: Minuu tɛɛa hɛribɔduma, u ɛɛ a bol, a du hugzi.

ref: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
text: A waa ɔɔ sɛɛ á dugli bolzenaa dikuu kɔɔi wia, nɛr maa wàá wer dɛɛzaa á pɛssi, di gil a ra hum.

ref: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
text: Pir nabal daŋ sɛɛ hum tɛi? U daŋ sɛɛ chɔɔ i lig biini hamuŋaa?

ref: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
text: I daŋ wer lawuu duu ŋmɛŋ, ú paraa? U daŋ sɛɛ i kpogluu par i walli biiniaa?

ref: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
text: I daŋ sɛɛ salli u ni, dikuu u fɔŋŋa werge wiaa? I daŋ sɛɛ gil i humkpega tɛuwaa?

ref: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
text: Taitai ɔɔ ra lɔ u keerii manamanaŋ, ka wàá wer zaah lugɔ niilaaraa.

ref: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
text: U ɔɔ he u halaa dau hɛri, di gil hɛɛhriichaa wenzi lawaa,

ref: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
text: ka waa liizi lugɔ ba daŋ wer fɛrgaa purgi, gɛɛ pir sel bɛl daŋ wer purgaa.

ref: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
text: U ɔɔ du nyɛg u biizi ninɛɛ, alugɔ u hora lɛi, u baga lɛi lugɔ ú kuuhni ɛɛ pɛɛ,

ref: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
text: dikuu Kɔraawiizi n wɔɔ tɛɛwɛ nunzuma wia, gɛɛ di tɛu u nunzuma hor tama maa la.

ref: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
text: Ka di u wa yaa u keeri ú chɔ waa, u ɔɔ ra mam zagu ni u tinnii.

ref: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
text: Hinuu tɛɛ zagu u fɔŋŋa, gɛɛ di kpa gɔla di bɔg u baŋaaa?

ref: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
text: Hinuu gillɛ u ɔɔ ra zaahzi lugɔ lotorozi, di lɔ miizi ra ɔnzi nɛraa?

ref: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
text: Mɔɔ ka ba zinnuu di la laal, u ɔɔ kiizi hɛrii fɔŋŋa ni bɔsɔna ni, di ta zuu laal biini.

ref: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
text: Waa wiimaa ra ɔm, tokobi maa wàá wer biruu har.

ref: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
text: Dɔŋkuna sagzi u loŋŋi di ra kɔɔ, di ra nyɛgzi.

ref: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
text: U bɔra ɔɔ ra zagi, ú chɔ kaali, wàá wer chi diindiiŋ, di ba wa huuh nyigaa.

ref: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
text: Di nyigaa wa wiiwo, u ɔɔ lɔ miizii, di nuu laal sɔɔh lii bɔɔnɛɛ, di nuu laallɔɔra nabɔnzi pogzaa ani laal wile.

ref: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
text: I nunzumaa tɛɛ kɔlaa zaaih, u ɔɔ yaa u keeri di chaŋ wiifurii nodig wiikakagaa?

ref: where they can look down to spot their next meal?
text: Denii u ɔɔ du ka ra nyiŋŋi u diwee, u siwii ɔɔ naa lii bɔɔnɛɛ.

ref: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
text: Challɛ u biizi ɔɔ ra di, bɔr la baŋ kpu newea werge ha, denii u ɔɔ du.”

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ Joob be,

ref: but you have argued that I am wrong. Now you must answer me.
text: “Nɛr la n na karsi Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, daŋ wer bagliŋ? Gil unla n na pag Kɔraawiizi ni, ŋɔ chemuu!”

ref: Job said to the Lord:
text: Denii Joob ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi be,

ref: I did speak once or twice, but never again.
text: N feloore ŋɔ wia bɛri, awia, màá ka ŋɔ.”

ref: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wia lii pekpeg biini tɛɛ Joob,

ref: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
text: di ŋɔ, “Izi chi chigigi lugɔ baal. N daŋ pɛɛzii wia, í ŋɔ n be.

ref: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
text: I daŋ sɛɛ ŋɔ lugɔ maa wibii ra dia? I daŋ sɛɛ tɛŋ bilchɔg, ka tɛɛ i hiŋ wibiiyaa?

ref: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
text: I dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa lugɔŋŋ? I daŋ wer pozi alugɔ dooŋ lugɔŋŋ?

ref: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
text: Guŋwaa, bagli i girme ni i zenni, di bɔg i hiŋ di ra bagli i girme ni i nabɔmuu.

ref: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
text: Nyiŋŋi barabara hina, di gil i baaŋ fuuh ba ni, bá sɔɔni siwii,

ref: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
text: Hug ba maa ŋmama biine, di gbaari hɛɛhraa tɔ baa.

ref: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
text: Denii n himmaa sɛɛ lugɔ i banonii daŋ wer lɛɛi.

ref: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
text: Na gunla muunau n kannɛ, mìŋ́ ta ii maa, u ra di kooree alugɔ navarga.

ref: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
text: Na fɔŋŋa la dee uŋ dɔɔwɛ ni kpegzi la dee n du u hia!

ref: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
text: U diŋ ra viu lugɔ hɛriŋkpol, u hiah diah hanzi nɛnnɛ.

ref: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
text: U hoga du kpeg alugɔ danyɛ, u naazi ɛɛ lugɔ lugbidaazi.

ref: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
text: Waabuu dɔɔ fɔŋŋa kaali mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi kuntaalii maa, mìŋ́ u Taari bɛnnɛ niŋ wer kpegluu.

ref: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
text: Kooree la un niŋ di, ɔɔ heluu a giŋgimee nyuuni, bɔr la pir sela n ɔɔ ra dua.

ref: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
text: U ɔɔ chɔɔ tiitozi biinii, kooree baruu kpɛchɛgaa biini.

ref: or hides among reeds in the swamp.
text: A tiitozi ni daajaŋra, ɔɔ tɛubuu chunchugli gɔŋ nua.

ref: It remains calm and unafraid with the Jordan River rushing and splashing in its face.
text: Di muu waa pal werge, ɔnsii waa ɔɔ lawuu. Di Jɔɔdan muu gba haŋ wàá lɔ ú nua, ka u ɔɔ chɔɔu bɔɔiih.

ref: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ wer chɔg u siwee ka lawuuwɛi, gɛɛ di heu sidɛɛ lawuu, di fur u miizɛi?”

ref: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ Joob be, “I daŋ wer kpa gɔrga lau muuzeŋ sechɔgii gɛɛ di kpa ŋmɛŋ vɔɔ u nuaa?

ref: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
text: I daŋ wer fur u miizi du ŋmɛŋ gɛɛ di kpa gɔrga gori u giriiaa?

ref: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
text: U daŋ sɛɛ i nuu ɛɛ nuukpaŋ, ú birgi i yom di hanna laa?

ref: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
text: I daŋ wer lawuu alugɔ zumbee di du i dia gɛɛ u ɛɛ i biihaana sideŋŋa kuŋaa?

ref: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
text: Kɔkɔɔza daŋ sɛɛ di ú yoolaa? Ba daŋ sɛɛ bɔnnuua?

ref: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
text: Di i haŋ gbɔgzuu kakpaŋ, hàá ka jaa bunɛɛ!

ref: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
text: Nɛr maa waa bampirii dɔɔwɛ lugɔ ú lalluu dɔɔ biini. Di gunnɛ, anɛɛ n niŋ wer chi n seei?

ref: I am in command of the world and in debt to no one.
text: Nɛr maa wàá wer ŋɔ lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi di u kinnɛ. Kummaa n du hɛri naa ɛɛ n hotte.

ref: What powerful legs, what a stout body this monster possesses!
text: Gil n baglii gunla nyugaa naazi wia n duwɛɛ, ani gunla u fɔŋŋa ni u kanni n makkɛ.

ref: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ wer fugzi u hɔnɛi? Anɛɛ n niŋ wer kpa kabarga di wa chi u seei?

ref: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ kur haa u nuai, nyina la wia n dɔɔ ɔnsii, n bar u nua chemei?

ref: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
text: U harbɔɔ dɔɔ hɛgtɔgaa, di hiŋzi dɔŋa ni lugɔ pichɔŋzi, di zuu dɔŋa ni nɛnnɛ.

ref: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
text: A zuu dɔŋa ninɛɛ nɛnnɛ, di du kpeg, kummaa wàá wer lallaa dɔŋa ni.

ref: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
text: Di u haŋ lɔ miizi, niŋ ɔɔ liiu guŋ murmurmur, u siwee ɛɛ lugɔ wiizi n na fur, di ta naazi la.

ref: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
text: Ninlau ɔɔ ra lii u nuarɛ, di ra nyɛgzi, di ta ra lii pilpilpil.

ref: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
text: Nyɔɔzi ɔɔ ra lii u miibɔɔnii tugtugtug, alugɔ baŋ kpa kooree chem niŋ hɔŋ vii.

ref: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
text: U heeza ɔɔ gil hɔla lau niŋ, ninlau ge ra lii u nua guŋ balbalbal.

ref: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
text: U bɔrahɔŋ yemmaanii chiirɛɛ, di du kpeg alugɔ lugbii,

ref: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
text: Di u haŋ izi chiŋ, ɔnsii werge ɔɔ chol kpeglega gba ninɛɛ, ba ɔɔ bir har ni bɔsai, di u waa viu u diŋ.

ref: No sword or spear can harm it,
text: Tokobi maa waa hoo ú wer duu pira gɛɛ kandaa gɛɛ hobii.

ref: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
text: Lugbii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kɔlii u be, danyɛ ge ɛɛ lugɔ daapɔɔh.

ref: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
text: Hobii wàá wer gil u kɛɛhzi, bilori bii ge ɛɛ lugɔ zɔg u be.

ref: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
text: Gulii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kɔlii u be, u ɔɔ ra mamuu di ba waa taazuu kandaazi.

ref: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
text: Hɛga la n margi u hia la ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ keŋlaa, di u wa tuuzi kpɛchɛgaa biini, a ɔɔ dau lugee alugɔ baŋ tuuzi milɔɔri daa.

ref: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
text: U ɔɔ koozi ville u ra birgi alugɔ baŋ hɔŋ nii u ra bɔr, di koozi muuzeŋ alugɔ banna koozi nuu la.

ref: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
text: Di u peri nii ra kaali, u luge ɔɔ ra nyɛgzuu, muuzeŋ maa tɔ fufuu.

ref: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
text: Kummaa waa hoo hɛri naa lugɔu, u ɛɛ kunnyinii la n waa ɔmuu.

ref: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
text: Haali u ra gbɛlli sela la n na tɔgzi a hinaa wergee, di ra di kora pir sezenaa maa ni.”

ref: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
text: “N zummɔ lugɔ i daŋ wer ɛɛ wiimaa, nɛr maa wàá wer chɔg jina la hiŋ tawɛɛ.

ref: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
text: I pɛɛzɔɔrɛ, ‘Anɛɛ hiŋ, i ra aani n nunzuma ni i nfɛrnyaai wiŋɔzɛi?’ Wibii maa, n ŋɔ wia la miŋ waa a zɛɛ zummɛɛ, wia la n ɛɛ witittaa werge, màá wer zum a zɛɛ maa.

ref: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
text: I ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘A nuu n be, n daŋ pɛɛzii wia, i ŋɔ n be.’

ref: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
text: N nuu i wiarɛ saŋa maa, ka n himmaa naibuu ni siwii filaŋkeŋ.

ref: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
text: Kɔraawiizi n wa ŋɔ wia naa tɛɛ Joob tuŋ, u ŋɔ Tɛman hinuu Ɛlifaz be, “N baaŋ na fuuh i ni i dammuzi banɛɛ la ninɛɛ, dikuu iiŋ waa n wia ŋɔwɛɛ ni wibii wia, see n balii Joob bɛŋ.

ref: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
text: Awia, ií lauri nabala aniidaanɛɛ ni pebala aniidaanɛɛ, di la n balii Joob be, di ga lizi mbusu di fuuah, dikuu iihinaa wia. N balii Joob daŋ suŋŋi wiizi tɛɛ ia, ń nuu u wiisuŋŋaa hiŋ, di gilɛɛ waa tɔɔri ia gunla n dɛg ia, dikuu ii gɛnni wiɛɛlaa wia. Ii waa n wia ŋɔwɛɛ ni wibii, see Joob bɛŋ.”

ref: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
text: Awia, Tɛman hinuu Ɛlifaz, Suua hinuu Bildad ani Naama hinuu Zɔfar, ɛɛ gunla Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ ba be la. Kɔraawiizi nuu Joob wiisuŋŋaa la.

ref: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
text: Joob n wa suŋŋi wiizi tɛɛ u dammuzi la tuŋ, denii Kɔraawiizi bir gil u nyɛɛli, di tɛu kuna la uŋ faa dɔɔwɛ la guŋ bunɛɛ.

ref: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
text: U lulla ni u dammubinaa maa ba wa nau, u ni baa di diuzenaa u dia. Ba maa tig u bampirii, dikuu tɔɔrɔɔ la Kɔraawiizi n gillɛ u di la wia, ka bɛl maa tɛu saliŋhuŋŋu ni saliŋ nonibisig.

ref: whose names were Jemimah, Keziah, and Keren Happuch.
text: U dau a biihaana nabɔma Jɛmaima, di dau nɛɛhiŋ Kɛzia, horohiŋ di Kɛrɛn Hapuk.

ref: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
text: Kɔraawiizi faa kaa tɛu biibaala baniidaanɛɛ ani biihaana bahoro.

ref: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
text: Haaŋ maa wessi faa waa Joob biihaana la wessi duglɛɛ, a hɛri maa biini. Ba mɛɛ faa tɛɛ ba ni a biibaala maa kapɛttɛ.

ref: and when he finally died, he was very old.
text: Awia, u faa zɛŋŋɔɔ werge ka siu.

ref: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
text: Bɔsɔna hinnɛ nɛr la n waa biinikpola hina baglaa ra hiŋ, gɛɛ di ra chanzi wichɔgɛɛra wiɛɛlaa. Bɔsɔna hinnɛ unla ni banla n na ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi chɛɛtɛ n waa kpau.

ref: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
text: Ka u ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni la wiarɛ, di ɔɔ ra liizi u baglaazi la wia hɔpizaa ani hamuŋa maa.

ref: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
text: A guŋ hiŋ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ daa la baŋ chɔɔzɛɛ gɔŋ kɛrii, u ra nɔŋ, u nɔnaa saŋa. U paŋhoori ge waa waraa dɔɔwɛ. A guŋ hiŋ wiɛɛlii maanii ɔɔ nyɛɛli.

ref: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
text: Guŋ lɛi biinikpola hina waa du, ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ zɔga la peu n kpawɛɛ kaali.

ref: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
text: Dikuu guŋ wia, biinikpola hina daŋ chol seriya dii biini, wichɔgɛɛra ge wàá jaa Kɔraawiizi nɛnanaa la biini.

ref: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizii ra binni nɛnanaa ni, ka biinikpola hina waa, ra lau bá wia ga tuŋ.

ref: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ hɛssi hina izi di ra du dɔŋ, di ra ta jina bá kuuh pɛɛi?

ref: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
text: Hɛssi koora ra ɛɛ siryaa, ba nabɔnzi chaalɔɔrɛ, bá ni Kɔraawiizi ni u Kristo la naa.

ref: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
text: Ba ra ŋɔ, “Ií gil ya lɛɛ yaa hinaa lii ba be, di gilɛɛ gil ba kaa dɔɔ yaa fɔŋŋa.”

ref: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ la ra mamuu. U ra ɛɛ baabuu chɛɛtɛ.

ref: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
text: U daŋ karfi baa ni baaŋfuuih, di ɔnzi baa ni baaŋ, di ra ŋɔ,

ref: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
text: “N tɔ n koorii kora Bolzeŋ Ziɔn, n giŋgimiinaniinanii la nyuu.”

ref: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
text: A koori ŋɔ ú daŋ bagli Kɔraawiizi widaulaa la wia. U ŋɔ n benii, “N Biibaallɛ hiŋ, zinaabuu n lulii.

ref: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
text: Suŋŋiŋ, n daŋ gil hɛssi maa birgi i kapɛttɛ kuna, hɛri naa tunazi maa ɛɛ i daama kuna.

ref: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
text: I daŋ chɔgi baa ani kpegzi werge maa. I daŋ purgi baa alugɔ viini.”

ref: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
text: Awia, koora, ií dɔɔ nunzuma, ií ra du tau, hɛri naa nabɔnzi.

ref: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
text: Ií ra togni Kɔraawiizi Biibaal la, di guŋ lɛi u baaŋ daŋ fuuh, ú chɔg ii maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, u baaŋ ɔɔ weruu fuuh kakpaŋ. Bɔsɔna hinaa banla maa n kpa bahinaa tɛu.

ref: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n dɔma kpillɔɔ! Nɛkpila izoore chi n ni!

ref: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
text: Nɛkpila maa ra ŋɔ n wiarɛ, dí, “Kɔraawiizi wàá lɛɛu.”

ref: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
text: Ka hinuu n Lɛɛri, tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa. I tɛmbuu girme di lalliŋ chiŋ.

ref: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
text: N lɔ wilee tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, u nuu n be di lii u giŋgimiinaniinanii la nyuu.

ref: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
text: N chɔɔwɔɔ di chɔɔ dɔɔ, ka kaa izi, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizii ra binni n ni.

ref: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
text: Ɔnsii wàá lawiŋ, haali di nɛra kagboŋa bariŋ gba.

ref: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ! N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi lɛɛŋ! Chɛ n dɔma maa liizi, di kuugi biinikpola hina maa nyina.

ref: because you protect and bless your people.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i bɛnnɛ Lɛɛri, kissi i nɛra.

ref: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la wia n deŋlee, a nuu n be di n wa yirii. Tɛŋ heezaa lii n tɔɔrɔɔ biini, na n sinyɛna, ka nuu n suŋŋaa.

ref: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
text: N dɔma, ɛrɛɛ á birgi mag, ka ií gil ń girme birgi hiihzɛi? Ɛrɛɛ ii nɔŋŋi kuna la n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ di birgi magɛi, gɛɛ di ra hiŋ kara ŋmɛnizɛi?

ref: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
text: Ií zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ lizi banla wia n deŋleere tɛɛ u hiŋ. Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ nuuu tɛŋ, di n wa yiruu.

ref: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
text: Di ii baana wa fuuhwo gba, ka ii gilɛɛ waa ɛɛ wichɔgaa. Ií ɔɔ fɛ guŋ nfɛrɛ nɛnnɛ, ii chɔɔribɔra, di ɛɛ bɔɔiih.

ref: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
text: Ií ɔɔ lizi mbusuzi la n dɛkkɛ, di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ka yarduu.

ref: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
text: Nɛkpila maa ra ŋɔu, “Anɛɛ n niŋ gil yá na winanaai?” Kɔraawiizi, gil i siwee chaani yaa ni.

ref: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
text: I tɛmbuu bampirsɔna werge maa kaali banla n dɔɔ mia ni sinni werge la.

ref: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
text: N daŋ chɔɔ dɔɔ ni bampirsɔna. N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, dikuubɛɛwiai, i bɛnnɛ ra binni n ni.

ref: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, keŋŋi digna, di nuu n wiŋɔzi, a nuu n himaa nɛnnɛ.

ref: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
text: A nuu miŋ lɔ wile di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa i be wia, n koori ni n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu n na suŋŋi.

ref: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, chɔɔzi ni, i ɔɔ nuu n loobiire, chɔɔzimpikke ni, aŋ kpa n winyiŋŋaare dau i see, ka ra kpaŋii ni tamii.

ref: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i bɔra waa ɔɔ sɔɔni wichɔgaa wia, wichɔgɛɛra wàá wer du i be.

ref: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
text: Banla n na jigsi wàá wer chi i see. I hah banla maa n na ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ.

ref: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
text: I ɔɔ kpu banla maa n na kanni karaa, di hah nɛkpuura ni karkannaa.

ref: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
text: Ka miŋwaa, dikuu i nɛsunaa n kannɛ werge wia, n daŋ wer zuu i Dia. Minna tɔgzii wia, n daŋ togni chaŋ i Dia la di jaamii.

ref: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɔ n see, ń wer di ra ɛɛ i wideŋlaa la, dikuu n dɔma wia, gil i ŋmɛnɛɛ deŋli tɛŋ.

ref: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
text: Wiŋɔkpaŋ maa waa hoo ba nuuzi, hin niŋ wer yarduu, chɔgaa bɛŋ wiarɛ su ba nfɛssi biine. Ba nuuzi wiŋɔɔlaa ra kpuuzi nɛraa, di ra dar nɛra.

ref: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil bá chol ba wichɔgaa la biini, í tɔɔri baa. Gil ba himmaa wichɔgaa ŋmɛnizi la gil bá chol, kizi baa ta dikuu ba wichɔgaa werge la wia, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba vɛɛ i nua hiŋaarɛ.

ref: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
text: Ama, gil banla waa maa n na ba i be ŋɔ í lɛɛ baa la bɔra sɔɔni. Gil ba ɔɔ ra yir yira saŋa maa ani bɔsɔna. Gil i hiinaa la tɔ ba ni, banla n nɔŋŋii la wer dɔɔ bɔsɔna i be.

ref: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i ɔɔ kissi banla wia n deŋleere, wibii maa. I ɔɔ tɔ ba ninɛɛ ni i nɔŋŋaa la nɛnnɛ.

ref: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna, dikuubɛɛwiai, n fɔŋŋa maanii tunnɛ. Chaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n hoga maanii ra pergi.

ref: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
text: N biini chɔkkɔɔ werge, a ra nuuŋ. Ɛrɛɛ i birgi mag, ka hiininnei?

ref: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ba wa lɛɛŋ. Lɛɛŋ dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia.

ref: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
text: Nɛr maa wàá wer liizi i wia di u wa siuwɔ. Anɛɛ n niŋ chɔlii ŋmam biinei?

ref: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
text: N kuuhwɔɔ dikuu biinichɔg ni hɛmaa wia. Sinii ɔɔ sɔɔni n kunchɔɔrikunaa hamuŋa maa, n kaputti pɔɔh dikuu wiraa wia.

ref: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
text: Maa kaa ra na nɛnnɛ, n siwee ɔrgɔɔrɛ, dikuu n dɔma n gillɛ n na wii wia.

ref: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
text: Ií lii n be, wichɔgɛɛra, dikuu Kɔraawiizi n nuu n wiraa wia.

ref: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
text: Kɔraawiizi nuuwɔɔ miŋ wiiwe di ra suŋŋuu, ú hiiniŋ, u daŋ lɛɛ n suŋŋaa la.

ref: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
text: N dɔma maanii niŋ di hiihzi, á tir baa, ŋmaaba pirgii daŋ huuzi baa, bá bir har.

ref: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n ba i benii í guuŋ, di lɛɛŋ lii banla maa n na nyiŋŋi bá kpuŋ la be,

ref: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
text: di guŋ lɛi, ba daŋ chuuriŋ alugɔ bunyiŋ n chuuri kuŋ, di chuuriŋ ka nɛr maa wàá du de ú lɛɛŋ.

ref: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
text: gɛɛ di n ɛɛ n dɔmnɛ wichɔgaa, di waa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ, di n ɛɛ annii bɛl maanii,

ref: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
text: guŋwaa, gil n dɔma kpegliŋ, gil ba ŋmɛniŋ ha hɛri, di kpuŋ, di gil ń siu chɔɔ hɛɛhraa biini.

ref: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ ni i baaŋ la, izi huuzi n dɔma ni ba baaŋfuuih la. N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ, di di wibii.

ref: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
text: Chaali hɛssi hina maa i see. So i koorikara ni chiŋ, di ra di kora ba ni.

ref: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
text: Hinuu ɛɛ nɛr maa seriya diiri. Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, gil n hor du sum, i zummɔ lugɔ maa chɔgri dɔɔwɛ.

ref: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la wia n deŋlee, hinuu unla n zum nfɛssi ani bampiree biine wia, gil biinikpola hina wichɔgaa ɛɛi tuŋ, ka turgi nɛnanaa bá kim.

ref: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaanii ɛɛ n guuri, waabuu ɔɔ lɛɛ banla maa wia n deŋlee.

ref: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ seriya diiri la wia n deŋleere, ɔɔ ra tɛɛ biinikpola hinaa chɔgri, hɔpizi biimaa.

ref: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
text: Di nɛr maa waa gillɛ u wichɔgaa wia chɔg u biini, u gilaa ta, Kɔraawiizi daŋ sazi u tokobi, u daŋ gur u hodaa, di vɔɔu.

ref: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
text: Na gunla biinikpola hina n na fɛ nfɛrchɔgaa, ba ɔɔ ta wichɔgaa ɛɛi jinaa, di ra dar nɛra.

ref: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
text: Ba ɔɔ he nɛraa sidɛɛzi, ka a bir lauri ba himmaa.

ref: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
text: Ba wichɔgaa ɔɔ biruu laŋŋi ba ni, ba himmaa wichɔgaa bir du baa pira.

ref: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
text: N daŋ jaami Kɔraawiizi, dikuu u wideŋlaa wia. Di yir yira dargi Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la sɔŋ.

ref: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, i sɔŋ dɔɔ girmee werge hɛri naa maa biini! I girme bɛri chiŋ gba ninɛɛ.

ref: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
text: I kpa chɔlaarɛ du bichalli ni biifulli nuuzi, i na chɔlaarɛ dikuu i dɔma wia, di kpu i dɔma ani banla n na nyiŋŋi bá turgii wichɔgaa kim.

ref: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
text: Di n haŋ wa binni chiŋ la hiŋ kuarɛɛ, baagu ni chinchiŋwilaa la hiŋ duwɛɛ a chignibɔra la,

ref: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
text: I gillɔɔ mɛlikazi kaali baa tama, ka gil ba dɔɔ girme ni sɔŋ.

ref: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
text: I gillɔɔ ba ra di kora i kuŋkuaraa maa ni, di tɛɛ baa fɔŋŋa a maa ni.

ref: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
text: Aabuu peeza, nauna, pir sela maa,

ref: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
text: zumbizi, nyinni, ani nii biini kuna maa.

ref: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i sɔŋ dɔɔ girmee werge hɛri naa maa biini.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ chɔlii ani n biini maa. N daŋ ŋɔ i nuukpuuri wia la maa hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.

ref: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
text: N bɔra daŋ sɔɔni di ra pur, dikuu i wia. Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, n daŋ yir yira dargii.

ref: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
text: N dɔma bir hattɛ, di jiŋli chogli siuzi i see.

ref: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
text: I di wibiire tɛŋ, di so i koorikara ni di ra di seriya ni wibii.

ref: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
text: I di a hɛssi la hina seriyaa, ba chol, di kpu biinikpola hina, nɛr maa ŋmɛnɛ wàá ka liizi ba wia.

ref: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
text: Yaa dɔma wia tunnɔɔ, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. I chɔgi ba bolzenaare, ba wàá ka liizi ba wia maa.

ref: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
text: Kɔraawiizi di koraa di hanna la. U chiŋŋi u koorikaraa ú di seriya.

ref: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
text: U daŋ di durnya kossii seriya ani wibii, di di hɛssi hina maa seriya ani wibii.

ref: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
text: Kɔraawiizii banla banna tɔɔri ɔɔ chɔ di gaa zuu, u ɛɛ ba fɔŋŋa hinnɛ tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa.

ref: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, banla n zum i sɔŋ daŋ yardii, dikuubɛɛwiai, i ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa banla n ba i be vɛɛwɛ ta.

ref: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
text: Ií yir yira di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la n di kora Bolzeŋ Ziɔn la. Ií ŋɔ gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ di ra tɛɛ hɛssi hina maa.

ref: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra liizi banla n na di tɔɔrɔɔ wiarɛ, waa ba wiraa ra suuh, u ɔɔ tɛr banla n na ɛɛ baa wichɔgaa la dignaa.

ref: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na gunla n dɔma n na tɔɔriŋ! Na n sinyɛna ka lɛɛŋ siu be,

ref: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
text: gunnɛ ń wer chi Jɛrusalɛm hina be, di bagli baa wia la maa n gillɛ n na chɔlii la. N bɔra daŋ sɔɔni dikuu hiŋ lɛɛŋ wia.

ref: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
text: A hɛssi hina ki bɔɔrɛ, di chol u biini, sidɛɛ la baŋ hewee la lau baabuu.

ref: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
text: Nɛr maa zum Kɔraawiizi ni u wibii dii wiarɛ, biinikpola hina wiɛɛlaa, ɔɔ biruu laŋŋi ba ni.

ref: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
text: Biinikpola hina daŋ bir zuu ŋmam biini, gúnnɛ niŋ huuzi hɛssi la maa hina n vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wia la.

ref: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
text: Kɔraawiizi wàá suuh dɔgnya hina wia maa, gɛɛ nyaara tamii dɔɔi wàá bir pɛɛ maa.

ref: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ! Gilɛɛ gil nɛra kpeglii, chaali hɛssi hina í see, di di baa seriya.

ref: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
text: Kɔraawiizi, gil ɔnsii lau baa, bá bɔra ra sa. Gil hɛssi la hina zum lugɔ ba ɛɛ kunsiwaarɛ.

ref: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i chi bɔɔnɛɛi? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i kpa i hiŋ suah, tɔɔrɔɔ saŋai?

ref: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
text: Biinikpola hina jigsi biini, ba ra tɔɔri gɛrgaa, gil bá himmaa sidɛɛzi la baŋ hewee la lauri baa.

ref: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
text: Biinikpola hina ra jigsuu, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia, kpossiiri ge ra see Kɔraawiizi nua, di vɛɛu.

ref: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
text: Biinikpola hina baga lɛi Kɔraawiizi wia, dikuu ba jigsi wia, ba ɔɔ ra fɛu lugɔ Kɔraawiizi waa kummaa ɛɛwɛ.

ref: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
text: Ba wiɛɛlaa maanii ɔɔ kuari, Ba waa Kɔraawiizi seriya dii zɛɛ zummɛ, ba ɔɔ ra gbɛlli ba dɔmaa, di ra mam baa.

ref: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
text: Ba ɔɔ ŋɔu tɛɛ bahinaa, “Màá ɛɛ wiimaa huhzi, tɔɔrɔɔ ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá huuziŋ.”

ref: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
text: Ba wiŋɔɔlaa dɔɔ nuuseei, kara ani nɛfugzaarɛ werge, ba ɔɔ hahzuu di ra ŋɔ hahzi ni wichɔgaa wiŋɔzi.

ref: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
text: Ba ɔɔ chɔɔu guu alugɔ bunyiŋ, di ɔɔ chɔɔ ra kpaŋ bá lauri banla n waa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ la, ba ɔɔ lauri baabuu, di tuuzi baa kaali.

ref: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
text: U ɔɔ kpu u dɔma la n nyaa fɔŋŋaa ba chogli, u fɔŋŋa labuu u kpa kpegli baa.

ref: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
text: A biinikpola hiŋ ɔɔ ŋɔu u biini, “Kɔraawiizi suuhwɔɔ, u tɔ u siweere, u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá naŋ!”

ref: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛr biinikpola hina digna, gilɛɛ waa suuh dɔgnya hina wia.

ref: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ biinikpola hina ɔɔ hah Kɔraawiizɛi? Di ɔɔ ŋɔ ba biine, “Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɛr n dignia?”

ref: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i ɔɔ na newee tɔɔrɔɔ ni u dɔgnyaa, di ɔɔ ɛɛ sirya lugɔ i hiinuu. Banla n waa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ ɔɔ kpa bahinaarɛ tɛi, i ɔɔ ra hiini dɔgnya hinaa saŋa maa.

ref: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
text: Kuugi biinikpola hina ni wichɔgɛɛri la nonee, tɛr ba digna dikuu wichɔgaa la baŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia, di ra la saŋa la baŋ wàá kaa ra ɛɛa.

ref: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
text: Kɔraawiizii Koori di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. Banla n na kuari vuga daŋ siu u hɛri biini.

ref: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
text: I ɔɔ ra nuu dɔgnya hina suŋŋaarɛ, di ɔɔ ra du baa bɔkpega.

ref: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
text: I ɔɔ ra lɛɛ banla baŋ ɔɔ ra fir ani lalbiizii. Guŋ gil newee n ɛɛ kunsiwii la, wàá ka ra ɔnzi nɛra werge.

ref: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
text: Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ n diikpeg. Awia, gilɛɛ ŋɔ n be, “Zaah alugɔ zumbee di la bizeŋ nyuu.

ref: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
text: Na, biinikpola hina lalli ba hozii, ba kpa ba hobeere baŋzi, bá taazi nɛnanaa, bɔbiri biini.

ref: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
text: Ka di winanaa ŋmɛnizi wa chɔkkɔɔ kɔrai, ɛrɛɛ wibii hina kaa ɛɛi?”

ref: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
text: Kɔraawiizi du u Diinaniinanii la biinii, u sogo u koorikara ninɛɛ chiŋ di ra pessi newea biibaala wiɛɛlaa maa, di zum a maa.

ref: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
text: Kɔraawiizi ra pessi nɛra la wia n deŋlee wiɛɛlaarɛ, ka hah biinikpola hina ani u biini maa.

ref: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
text: U daŋ gil niŋhɔla ani jilbi n na di, chol ba ni alugɔ dooŋ, peu la n wemme werge, danna ta ba ni.

ref: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi wia deŋloore. U nɔŋŋi wibiire, banla wia n deŋlee daŋ na u siwee.

ref: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiini yaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, banla n zumii la waa kaa hoo, banla n na hiŋii ni wibii la, tunnɔɔ newea biini.

ref: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
text: Kɔ́raawiizi gil karkanna nuuzi tɔɔgi, di tɔɔgi jigsi hina nuuzi la n na ŋɔ,

ref: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
text: “Yaa daŋ kpa yaa wiŋɔɔlaa di na yaa kipar, di ŋɔ gunla n par yaa, ka nɛr maa wàá wer tɔ yaa ŋmɛnɛɛ.”

ref: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Dikuu banna fir gɛrga, nyaara ge ra wii la wia, n daŋ jaa izi chiŋ filaŋkeŋ, di lɛɛ baa lii banla n kanni kara di ra chug baa la be.”

ref: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
text: Kɔraawiizi nuuzi wessoo di dɛg yardaa, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ saliŋhuŋŋu baŋ ŋmɛɛrɛɛ ninzeŋ biini, naa buniidaanɛɛ, a doŋa lii nɛnnɛ.

ref: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛ yaa, di guu yaa saŋaa saŋa maa di lii a guŋ nɛdizi naa be.

ref: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
text: Biinikpola hina ɔɔ ra voluu ni jigsi, di ba wa na nɛra n na tɔgzi wichɔgaa.

ref: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i daŋ suuh n wiarɛ di hanna laa? Ɛrɛɛ í bir i luŋ kpuŋ, di bir magɛi?

ref: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
text: Ɛrɛɛ ń di dɔgnya di birgi magɛi? Ɛrɛɛ ń biini chɔgi di birgi mag, hɔpizaa ni hamuŋa maanɛi?

ref: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, binniŋ ka nuu n suŋŋaa. Bir tɛŋ n fɔŋŋa, di gilɛɛ gil n siu.

ref: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
text: N dɔm daŋ ŋɔ lugɔ u kpeglimbuu, ú bɔra sɔɔni di n wa chollo.

ref: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
text: Ka n yardi i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ labuu. N dɔɔ bampirsɔnaa hin lɛɛŋ la wia.

ref: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
text: N daŋ yir yira tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, dikuu uŋ wesse tɛŋ wia.

ref: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
text: Gɛnaa ɔɔ ŋɔu ba biine, “Kɔraawiizi waa hoo.” Ba waa wibii dɔɔwɛ, ba maa ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛraa, bɛl maa waa winanaa ra ɛɛ.

ref: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ du chinne, ka ra binni newea ú na, di baŋhina du denii di zum wia zɛɛ gɛɛ di ra nyiŋŋi u bɔrɛi.

ref: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ba waa zummɛa? Wichɔgɛɛra naa gɛnnɔɔwaa? Ba ra fini n nɛraa ka ba wanna jaami.”

ref: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
text: Na baa, ɔnsii werge n lau baa, dikuu Kɔraawiizi n du nɛra la wia n deŋlee be wia.

ref: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
text: Wichɔgɛɛra ɔɔ ra chɔgi sisɔna hina wiarɛ, ka Kɔraawiizii ra guu baa.

ref: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
text: N na suŋŋi wiizii Izrɛl hina na lɛɛi lii Bolzeŋ Ziɔn. Izrɛl hina bɔra daŋ sɔɔni di Kɔraawiizi wa gillɔ ba bir nyɛɛli.

ref: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
text: Kɔraawiizi, anɛɛ n niŋ wer du i Diai? Anɛɛ n niŋ du i giŋgimiinaniinanii la nyuuwɛi?

ref: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
text: Banla n na nuu Kɔraawiizi nua, di ra ɛɛ wideŋlaa, di ra ŋɔ wibii ni biinihuŋŋu,

ref: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
text: baabuu nɛra la n waa kara ra kanni, banla n waa ba dɔŋahina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa gɛɛ di ra yaari wia la n ɛɛ kara,

ref: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
text: baabuu nɛra la n hah wichɔgɛɛra, ka ra tɔgzi banla n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi la. Baabuu nɛra la n na hiŋ ba nuuzi, haali di a ra nuu baa gba,

ref: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
text: baabuu nɛra la n ɔɔ kpa bá kebee di ra kim nɛra, ka ba waa nii ra sag, ba waa kebee ra lɛɛ, ka di daansɛɛkara ra chug nɛr la n waa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ. Nɛr la n na ɛɛ annii maa, daŋ chi chigigi, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a guuŋ, hinuu n yardi lugɔ i daŋ lɛɛŋ.

ref: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
text: N ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi benii, “Hinuu Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, di hiŋ lɛi, maa kunnanii maa dɔɔwɛ.”

ref: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy,
text: Kɔraawiizi nɛra la n du hɛri naa la waa, baabuu dɔɔ girme, ba wia sɔɔni n bɔra.

ref: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
text: Banla n na kuari vuga ɔɔ ba tɔɔrɔɔ kpila ninɛɛ di wa tɛɛ bahinaa. Màá jaa ba mbusuzi lizaa biini gɛɛ di kuari ba vuga.

ref: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu kunla maa min dɔɔwɛ. Hinuu ra tɛŋ kunla maa minna nyiŋŋi, N kɛrɛbɛl wiimaa du i nonee biinii.

ref: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
text: Kuna la maa hiŋ tɛŋ wessoo werge, Wibii maa, a wessoo.

ref: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
text: N daŋ chɔli Kɔraawiizi la n na bagliŋ wia, haali hamuŋa gba, n nfɛrɛ ɔɔ ra baglimbuu guŋ.

ref: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
text: N gillɔɔ Kɔraawiizi tɔ n see saŋa maa, dikuu un du n be wia, n chigɔɔ chigigi.

ref: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
text: Awiarɛ n bɔra sɔɔni, n wiŋɔzi maa ɛɛ bɔsɔna wiŋɔzi, maa wiimaa ra ɔm,

ref: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, wàá giliŋ ta ŋmam biini, gɛɛ di gil u Dɔɔrinaniinanii bɔrahɔŋ pɔɔh.

ref: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
text: I ɔɔ ra baglimbuu gunla nɛra n ninna hiŋ di na miibɔɔ. Di n wa na i siwee ge, n bɔra daŋ sɔɔni saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu nɛr la wia n deŋlee wiisuŋŋaa. Keŋŋi digna di ra nuu suŋŋaa naa n na lii nɛr la wia n dɔɔ wibii nua.

ref: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
text: I daŋ di seriya lɛɛ bilii tɛŋ, gil i siwee na wia la n deŋlee.

ref: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
text: I zum n bampiriire, haali hiŋ pessiŋ na hamuŋa ni la gba, ka haa wichɔgii maa nawɛɛ n ni.

ref: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
text: Maa wichɔgaa ra ŋɔ alugɔ baŋhina n ɔɔ ra ŋɔa la, n hiŋ i widaulaarɛ, maa nɛfiraa ŋmɛnizi ra hiŋ.

ref: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na yiriibuu, dikuu hin niŋ nuu wia. Keŋŋi digna nuu n suŋŋaa.

ref: Show your wonderful love. Your mighty arm protects those who run to you for safety from their enemies.
text: Bagli i nɔŋŋaa la n kannɛ werge la, di lɛɛŋ, i kɛraa ń chi na n hiŋ, di lii n dɔma be.

ref: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
text: A guuŋ gunla hin niŋ guu i himmaa siwee la, di ra guuŋ alugɔ zal n ɔɔ yaa u keeri tɔ u biizi ni la,

ref: Don't let my brutal enemies attack from all sides and kill me.
text: di lii biinikpola hina la n na nyiŋŋi ba kpuŋ la be, n dɔma la n chummɛ werge di bariŋ la be.

ref: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
text: Ba waa sinyɛna ra na, ba nuuzi ge ɔɔ ra ŋɔ barabara wiŋɔzi bɛŋ.

ref: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
text: Ba sidɛɛ lawimbuu dau, ba jaa bariŋ, ba ra pessuu bá na bɔr di kpaŋ ta hɛri.

ref: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
text: Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyiŋ la lɔzi n na kpu, u ra daazi ú lau kuŋ la.

ref: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ huuzi baa, di gil bá chol. Kpa i tokobi lɛɛŋ lii biinikpola hina naa be,

ref: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
text: lɛɛŋ lii durnya hina naa n dɔɔ kuna la maa banna nyiŋŋi la be. Kpa tɔɔrɔɔ la hiŋ ɛɛ sirya dau baa la, di tɛr ba digna. Gil a yeŋ du de nɛnnɛ chɔɔ ba biizi, a yeŋ ge ka chɔɔ ba naanna.

ref: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
text: Ka minna ɛɛ winanaa wia, n daŋ na i siwee di n wa izoo, n bɔra daŋ sɔɔni, dikuu min niŋ na gunla hiŋ duwɛɛ wia.

ref: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n nɔŋŋiibuu, hinuu n fɔŋŋa.

ref: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
text: Kɔraawiizii n guuri, waabuu n kpegzi bɔr. Waabuu ra guuŋ, di n du u be, n daŋ na n hiŋ. U ra gberimbuu lugɔ laal pɛrɛtuzeŋ. Waabuu n Lɛɛri, waabuu ra guuŋ.

ref: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
text: N yir Kɔraawiizi la n dɛg chɔlaa labuu, awia, u lɛɛmbuu lii n dɔma be.

ref: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
text: Siu ŋmɛnni milimbuu, alugɔ muuzeŋ nii n na lɔ, di ra nyiŋŋi n dii.

ref: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
text: N biinichɔg biini, n yir Kɔraawiizii, di lɔ wile tɛu ú hiiniŋ. U nuu n loobiire lii u Dia biini, di nuu n wiraa.

ref: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
text: Denii hɛri ziigi, di zigli, bizenaa ge zɛɛzi zigli, a zigloore dikuu Kɔraawiizi baaŋ n fuuhwe wia!

ref: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
text: Nyɔɔzi faa ra lii u miibɔɔni, ninlau n na di kuna ra lii u nua, niŋhɔla ge ta ra lii de.

ref: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
text: U peri chiŋ tuu ba, baama biŋŋu du u naazi zɛɛ.

ref: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
text: U tinni chɛrubzi di ra zaah, di so peu keeri ni di ra kaali.

ref: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
text: U kpa bɔbirii tɔ u hiŋ, baama biŋŋe n dɔɔ nii werge baruu.

ref: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
text: Di lii u chachaaŋ la biini, baama biŋŋe lii ni dobee, dooŋ pogzi di ra nyɛgzi.

ref: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
text: Kɔraawiizi pozoore alugɔ dooŋ di lii chiŋ, ba nuu Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la loobii.

ref: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.
text: U taazi u hobeere, u dɔma yaari, u kpa nazaa di gil ba ra chɔ.

ref: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
text: Muuzeŋ zɛɛ lii chɔɔ. Hɛri zɛɛzi ge maa chɔɔ pɛɛ, dikuu hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n nyɛg i dɔma ni, di kpa baaŋfuuih di ra pogzi ba ni wia.

ref: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
text: U lii chinne tuu wa lawiŋ, di tɛriŋ lii niivile biini.

ref: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
text: U lɛɛmbuu lii n dɔma la n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge la be, di lɛɛŋ lii n haahra la n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge kaaliŋ la be.

ref: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
text: Ba faa fɔɔmbuu saŋa la min du siaahmu biini la, ka Kɔraawiizi lɛɛŋ.

ref: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
text: U lɛɛmbuu lii siaahmu biini, dikuu n wia n paruu wia.

ref: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
text: Kɔraawiizi turgimbuu dikuu n wideŋlaa ɛɛi wia. U kissimbuu dikuu miŋ waa wichɔgii maa ɛɛwɛ wia.

ref: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
text: N hiŋ Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni, maa wichɔgaa ɛɛwɛ, di bir har kpu Kɔraawiizi la minna hum la.

ref: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
text: U Gbɔgni maanii n hiŋ. Maa u widaulaa la ge vɛɛwɛ ta.

ref: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
text: Maa wichɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ u be, n ɔɔ lizi n hinnɛ lii wichɔgaa maa biini.

ref: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
text: Kɔraawiizi turgimbuu dikuu n wideŋlaa ɛɛi ni miŋ waa wichɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ wia.

ref: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
text: I wia dɔɔ wibiire banla wia n dɔɔ wibii be. I wia ge du wer banla n waa wichɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ be.

ref: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
text: I dɔɔ biinihuŋŋuu banla n dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu be, ka hah banla n ɛɛ biinikpola hina la.

ref: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
text: I ra lɛɛ banla n dɔɔ sisɔnaa, ka gil banla n na jigsi la ra tuu zɛɛ.

ref: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ fintina di ra chaaniŋ, di gil n bɔbiri birgi bɔchaaŋ.

ref: You help me defeat armies and capture cities.
text: Hinuu tɛŋ fɔŋŋa n lɔ n dɔma di kpegli baa.

ref: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
text: Kɔraawiizi waa, u ŋmɛnizi maanii deŋlee. U ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ laal pɛrɛtuzeŋ, tɛɛ banla maa n na nyiŋŋi ú guu baa.

ref: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
text: Anɛɛ n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di u bɛŋ lɛiyɛi? U bɛnnɛ ɛɛ yaa guuri.

ref: You give me strength and guide me right.
text: Kɔraawiizi tɛmbuu fɔŋŋa, di gil n ŋmɛnɛɛ chaani.

ref: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
text: U gillɔɔ n naazi ɛɛ lugɔ weema naazi, u ɔɔ giluu n chi bizenaa nyuuni, di na n hiŋ.

ref: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
text: U ra baglimbuu laal lɔi, ń ɔɔ wer ta hoo la gba n kpekke werge.

ref: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i guumbuu di lɛɛŋ, hinna binni n ni la gillɔɔ n dɔɔ sɔŋ, i fɔŋŋa gillɔɔ n na n hiŋ.

ref: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
text: I kuari ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ u du war tɛŋ, guŋ gil n gilɛɛ waa lɔ naa.

ref: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
text: N duŋŋi n dɔmaa ga lauri baa. Maa har bittɛ, di miŋ wa kpuuzi baa tuŋ la lɛi.

ref: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
text: N lɔ baabuu ta hɛri, ba waa kaa wer bá izi, ka chɔɔ n naazi zɛɛ.

ref: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
text: I tɛmbuu fɔŋŋa nɛnnɛ, n lɔ laal di kpegli n dɔma.
