ref: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
text: I gillɔɔ n dɔma chɔ lii n be, n kpu n haahra.

ref: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
text: Ba lɔ wilee di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa, ka nɛr maa waa baa lɛɛwɛ, di lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ka waa nuuwɛ tɛɛ baa.

ref: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
text: N nam baabuu ba ɛɛ lugɔ nyɔɔ peu n kpawɛɛ di ra kaali. N na fɛrgi baabuu alugɔ kpɛchɛgaa n chɔɔ ŋmɛnizenaa.

ref: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
text: I lɛɛmbuu lii nɛkpoŋlaa be, di gil n ɛɛ hɛssi maa koori. Nɛra la maa miŋ faa waa zummɛ, jaa birgi n balaarɛ.

ref: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
text: Ba maa bɔra huahwɔɔ, ba lii ba diikpega ba, ba bɔra ra sa.

ref: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
text: Kɔraawiizi du denii! Ií ra chɔli n Lɛɛri! Ií ra sii Kɔraawiizi la n lɛɛŋ la zenni.

ref: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
text: U ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n na lɛɛ n nuarɛ, u gillɔɔ hɛssi hina ra sɛɛ n dɔɔra,

ref: You protected me from violent enemies and made me much greater than all of them.
text: di lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma be. U gillɔɔ n kpegli n dɔma, di lɛɛŋ lii nɛchɔgaa be.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, awia, n daŋ chɔlii hɛssi maa hina be. N daŋ yir yira di ra dargii.

ref: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
text: I gillɔɔ i koori du kpeg, di bagli i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la, di ra tɛɛ unla baŋ waari nuu di lizi la, di ra tɛɛ Koori Deevid ni u naanna, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
text: Chiŋ maa ra bagli Kɔraawiizi girme wiarɛ, di ra bagli u kuntaalaa wia.

ref: Each day informs the following day; each night announces to the next.
text: Hɔpizii maa a ɔɔ ra ŋɔ u wiarɛ. Hamuŋa maa, a gil ba ra zum u wia.

ref: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
text: A waa nua pillɛɛ ra ŋɔ wia, gɛɛ di ra mɔɔ mɔɔri.

ref: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
text: Ka a loobee ra hel durnya naa yemmaanii, a wiŋɔzi ra hel durnya naa tunazi maa. Kɔraawiizi kuaribɔttɛ chiŋ tɛɛ wiizi,

ref: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
text: ɔɔ liiu chɔɔzi alugɔ haŋfalii jaari la bɔra n sɔɔnɛɛ, gɛɛ alugɔ chɔchɔɔri bɔra n na pur ú chɔ la.

ref: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
text: U ɔɔ furuu lii chiŋ keŋkere bɛl, di ga chol u keŋkere bɛl. Kummaa wàá wer suah lii u wenzaa biini.

ref: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
text: Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg deŋloore nɛnnɛ, di ra tɛɛ fɔŋŋafalii. Kɔraawiizi widaulaa dɔɔ wibiire, a ɔɔ ra tɛɛ banla n nyaa nunzumaa, nunzuma.

ref: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
text: Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni deŋloore, di ra tɛɛ bampirsɔna. Kɔraawiizi widaulaa la dɔɔ wibiire, di ra tɛɛ sichaana.

ref: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa wessoo, di du de di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa. Kɔraawiizi seriya diizi dɔɔ wibiire, a maa ɔɔ deŋluu.

ref: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
text: A dɔɔ tɔnaa kaali saliŋ, di du sum kaali huuhnuunanaa.

ref: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
text: A ɔɔ ra karfi i baliirɛ, a hiŋaa dɔɔ tɔnaa werge maa.

ref: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ wer zum n wichɔgaai? Gil n wichɔgaa la miŋ waa a wia zummɛ la tɛŋ.

ref: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii wichɔgaa kutti ɛɛi biini, gilɛɛ gil a dɔɔ n fɔŋŋa. Denii n wia deŋli, n na n hiŋ lii wichɔgaa ɛɛi biini.

ref: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil n nua wiŋɔzi ni wia la minna fɛ parii. N guuri ni n Lɛɛri, Kɔraawiizi!

ref: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ nuu i wilee, di i wa du siaahmu biini. Kɔ́raawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum la ra guui.

ref: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi tɛi hiinaa lii u Dia, di tɛi hiinaa lii Bolzeŋ Ziɔn.

ref: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
text: Ú ɔɔ ra lɛɛ i mbusuzi lizaa maa, di ra lɛɛ i mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa maa.

ref: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi tɛi i kipar, di gil i wiimaa kuari.

ref: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
text: Yaa danna chaasi ni bɔsɔna, di i wa lɔ laal lii, di lalli yaa tuutazi Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ biini. Kɔ́raawiizi lɛɛ i suŋŋaa maa.

ref: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
text: Filaŋkeŋ, n jaa zumuu lugɔ Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ lɛɛ nɛr la uŋ lizɛɛ labuu. U ɔɔ nuu u suŋŋaarɛ lii u chiŋ bɔnaniinanii la, di lɛɛu ni u fɔŋŋazeŋ la.

ref: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
text: Baŋhina yardi ba laal torkozii, baŋhina ge yardi ba zagra. Ka yaawaa, Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la sɔŋ labuu yaa yardi.

ref: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
text: A guŋ hina ɔɔ lɔɔzi naazii chogli, ka yaawaa daŋ izi chi nɛnnɛ.

ref: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛ yaa koori! Nuu tɛɛ yaa, di yaa wa yirii!

ref: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a koori bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ, dikuu fɔŋŋa la hiŋ tɛu wia. U bɔra kaa sɔɔni werge maa, dikuu uŋ kpegli u dɔma wia!

ref: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
text: I tɛubuu kunla u bampirii n lauwɛ, di tɛu kunla uŋ suŋŋɛɛ.

ref: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
text: I kissuubuu werge, di kpa salinnanii koorikahuro hiu.

ref: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
text: U suŋŋiibuu miibɔɔ, i tɛu, di tɛu miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
text: Dikuu hiŋ gillɛ u kpegli u dɔma la wia, u girme kannɔɔ werge maa, i tɛubuu sɔŋ ni zenni werge.

ref: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
text: I kissuubuu ni kissaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ, di gil u bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu hiŋ du u be la wia.

ref: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
text: A koori yardi Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la labuu, dikuu u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia, wàá chol.

ref: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
text: Awia, a koori daŋ kpegli u dɔma maa, u daŋ lauri banla maa n hauh la.

ref: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
text: Di hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi wa ballɔ, í daŋ chɔgi ba maa alugɔ ninzeŋ n fuuh baa la. I daŋ chɔgi ba maa ni baaŋfuuihchɔgaa, di gil niŋ fuuh ba maa.

ref: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
text: Ba naana bɛl maa wàá ka, bá wia tuŋ.

ref: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
text: Haali hìŋ́ koori dɔma n ta jina, di ra nyiŋŋi ba ɛɛi wichɔgaa gba, ka ba wàá na bɔr,

ref: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, i daŋ gil bá bir har, di i wa taazi baa i hobee.

ref: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, yaa ra chɔliibuu, dikuu i kpegzi wia! Yaa daŋ yir yira di ra dargi i fɔŋŋazeŋ la!

ref: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, ɛrɛɛ i giliŋ ta gunnɛi? N lɔ biinichɔg wilee, di uuri ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa, ka haŋ hiinee.

ref: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bɔchaaŋ maga, aŋ lɔ wilee tɛi, ka i siigi, di lɔu hamuŋa ni, maa ɔɔ siigi.

ref: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
text: Hinuu di kora di ɛɛ Dɔɔrinaniinanii, di ɛɛ unla Izrɛl hina n na chɔli.

ref: Our ancestors trusted you, and you rescued them.
text: Hinuu yaa naabaala faa yardi, ba dɛlliibuu, i lɛɛ baa.

ref: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
text: Ba faa lɔ wilee tɛi, i lɛɛ baa, hinuu ba faa yardi, haa gillɛ ba biine chɔgi.

ref: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
text: Ka miŋwaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ sandul, maa lugɔ newee, nɛr maa hahŋ di ra gbɛlliŋ.

ref: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
text: Banla maa n naŋ ɔɔ ra ɛɛmbuu chɛɛtɛ, di ra chagziŋ, ka ra viigi ba nyuuni,

ref: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
text: di ra ŋɔ, “I yardi Kɔraawiizii, awia, ú lɛɛi. Gil u hiinii, dikuu uŋ nɔŋŋii wia.”

ref: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
text: Ka hinuu hiini n maa u luliŋ, miŋ faa ɛɛ biifula la, i guumbuu.

ref: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
text: Hinuu n dɛlli di lii a hɔl la maa baŋ luliŋ la, i ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la minna humuu saŋa maa.

ref: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
text: Awia, gilɛɛ giliŋ ta, tɔɔrɔɔ duglɔɔrɛ, ka nɛr maa waa hoo ú hiiniŋ.

ref: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
text: N dɔma kpila maa barimbuu alugɔ nabala, ba barimbuu alugɔ Basan hɛri nabalkpega.

ref: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
text: Ba haa nuuzii alugɔ bunyinzi, di ra wii, di ra nyiŋŋi n lawaa.

ref: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
text: N fɔŋŋa tunnɔɔ, alugɔ baŋ fug nii ta hɛri. N bɔra huah, n bampirii ge ɛɛ lugɔ kel n ŋmɛɛrɛɛ.

ref: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
text: N loobii hillɔɔ alugɔ keŋlii, n nuuzuŋŋi ge mari n dasama. I gilimbuu ta bumburi biini ń siu.

ref: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
text: Wichɔgɛɛra barimbuu alugɔ nuuzihina, di ra chuuri n nonee ni n naapezi.

ref: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
text: N daŋ wer kur n hoga maa, n dɔma ra mamiŋ, di ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ.

ref: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
text: Ba kpa n laalaa bɔnni dɔŋa, ka ta kuna n tagtajaŋ wia.

ref: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ du bɔɔnɛɛ, hinuu n kpegzi, ba manaŋ wa lɛɛŋ!

ref: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma tokobi be, di lɛɛ n miibɔɔ lii nɛra n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ nuuzihina naa be.

ref: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
text: Lɛɛŋ lii bunyinzi naa be, di lɛɛŋ lii pirnauna naa nyigzi be.

ref: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
text: N daŋ bagli i wiɛɛlaa wia tɛɛ n lulla, di chɔlii bá chaalaa biini.

ref: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
text: “Ii banla n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi, ií ra chɔluu! Jekɔb dee maa, ií ra tɔgzuu! Izrɛl hina, ií ra ɔmuu!

ref: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
text: Waa unla n na di tɔɔrɔɔ la vɛɛwɛ gɛɛ di ra gbɛlluu, waa har bittɛ kpuu, ka u nuu u wile la uŋ lɔwɛɛ ŋɔ u hiinuu labuu.”

ref: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
text: I wiɛɛlaarɛ gillɛ n na chɔlii nɛkpila la n na jaamii la biini, banla n na ɔmii la seere, ń lizi mbusuzi lizaa kuna la miŋ ŋɔ nua lugɔ n daŋ tɛi la.

ref: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
text: Nyaara daŋ di di piŋ, banla n na jaami Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔluu. Gil ba nyɛɛli, saŋaa saŋa maa!

ref: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
text: Gil durnya hina maa ra liizi Kɔraawiizi wia, di ra chɔluu. Gil hɛssi maa hina ra jaamuu,

ref: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ koorii, di ra di kora hɛssi maa ni.

ref: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
text: Nɛra la maa n na jigsi daŋ giŋŋi u see jaamuu, newea maa daŋ giŋŋi u see jaamuu.

ref: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
text: Banla ban niŋ haa lul danna humuu, di bagli u wia tɛɛ ba ge har hina.

ref: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
text: Ba daŋ ŋɔ u wideŋlaa wia tɛɛ banla baŋ haa waa lullɛ, lugɔ Kɔraawiizii lɛɛ u nɛra.

ref: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ penɔɔni, di ra binniŋ, maa kummaa nyaawɛ.

ref: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
text: U gillɔɔ n chɔɔ kooriilɛɛri biini, di kpogliŋ la bɔr la niiri n chɔɔwɛ bɔɔiih.

ref: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
text: U tɛmbuu fɔŋŋafalii. Di gil n na ɛɛ wia la deŋlee, dikuu u sɔŋ wia.

ref: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
text: Haali minna vol bɔbiri limpiriŋ biini gba, ka maa wichɔgii maa ra ɔm, dikuu hiŋ du n be wia, i penɔɔni gulii ni daŋkpala ra guumbuu.

ref: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
text: I daali diuzenaare tɛŋ n dɔma see. I yiili nuu waari n nyuu, n libee ge su di ra ta.

ref: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
text: Wibii maa, winanaa ni nɔŋŋaa danna hiŋiŋ, n de dui biini saŋa maa, ń jaa du Kɔraawiizi Dia saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
text: Kɔraawiizii dɔɔ hɛri ni kuna la maa n du u biini. Haali newea maa,

ref: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, waabuu mau hɔŋ a muuni ni, di gil u zɛɛ chi a vile zɛɛzi.

ref: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ wer tinni Kɔraawiizi giŋgimii la nyuu, di zuu u Diinaniinanii lai?

ref: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
text: Waabuu unla n waa wichɔgaa dɔɔwɛ, u bampirii ge huuhzi paratata, waa vuga ra kuari gɛɛ di hɛɛhzi, ka ra kanni kara la.

ref: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ kissuu, ú na giltɛɛi lii u Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
text: Ií pilli dominuuzenaa la, á yaa, ií pilli faa maa dominuuzenaa la, Koori la n dɔɔ girme werge la wa zuu.

ref: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
text: Anɛɛ a koori naa n dɔɔ girme werge naanɛi? Waabuu Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa ni zenni maa hiŋ, di ɛɛ laallɔkpeg la.

ref: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
text: Ií pilli dominuuzenaa la, á yaa, ií pilli faa maa dominuuzenaa la, Koori la n dɔɔ girme werge la, wa zuu.

ref: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
text: Anɛɛ a Koori naa n dɔɔ girme werge naanɛi? Waabuu Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la n dɔɔ girme la.

ref: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, hinuu n suŋŋi,

ref: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
text: hinuu n yardi. Gilɛɛ gil n di hiihzi, di gil n dɔma dɔɔ fɔŋŋa n ni.

ref: Don't disappoint any of your worshipers, but disappoint all deceitful liars.
text: Nɛr la maa n yardii ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá di hiihzi, ka banla waa maa n dɔɔ dignikpega, daŋ di hiihzi.

ref: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagliŋ i ŋmɛnizi, di gil n zumaa.

ref: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
text: Bagliŋ, di gil n zum i wibii, di ra hiŋuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ n Lɛɛri, hinuu n yardi saŋa maa.

ref: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
text: Gilɛɛ ra liizi n pɔlaa saŋa wichɔgaa ni n dignikpega la wia. N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nɛnɔŋŋaa la wia, a liizi n wia, dikuubɛɛwiai, i wia wessoo.

ref: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
text: Kɔraawiizi wia wessoo, u wia deŋli, awia, ɔɔ ra bagli wichɔgɛɛraa u ŋmɛnizi.

ref: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
text: U ɔɔ hiini sisɔna hinaa ba ra ɛɛ wia la n deŋlee, di ɔɔ ra bagli baa u ŋmɛnizi.

ref: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋmɛnizi maanii ɛɛ nɔŋŋaa ni wibii tɛɛ banla n na hiŋ u ni baa nuukpaŋ widaulaa la.

ref: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, dikuu i sɔŋ la wia, gil n wichɔgaa tɛŋ, haali aŋ kannɛ werge gba.

ref: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
text: Banla n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi, daŋ helli lii u be, ŋmɛnizi la ban ninna hiŋ.

ref: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
text: Ba daŋ nyɛɛli ba de dui saŋa, ba naanna di a hɛri kapɛttɛ.

ref: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ lau banla n na hiŋ u nuuzii dammunaa, di gil ba zum u ni baa nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la wia.

ref: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
text: N dɛlli Kɔraawiizii saŋa maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, u bɛnnɛ niŋ wer liziŋ lii siaahmu biini.

ref: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bir n be di na n sinyɛna, dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛ n bɛnnɛ, maa fɔŋŋa maa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii n tɔɔrɔɔ biini, liziŋ lii n biinichɔg biini.

ref: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
text: Binni n tɔɔrɔɔ ni n dɔgnya, ka gil n wichɔgaa maa tɛŋ.

ref: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
text: Na gunla n dɔma n kpillɛ mag ni gunla baŋ hahŋ werge maa.

ref: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
text: A binni n ni di lɛɛŋ, gilɛɛ gil n di hiihzi, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu n guuri.

ref: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
text: Jaande maa, gil n winanaa ni n wideŋlaa lɛɛŋ ta, dikuubɛɛwiai, i benii n tamii du.

ref: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛ Izrɛl hina lii ba tɔɔrɔɔ maa biini.

ref: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagli lugɔ maa wichɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n na ɛɛ wia la n deŋleere. N yardiibuu nɛnnɛ.

ref: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛɛŋ na, di pessi n biini ni n nfɛrɛ na,

ref: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la ra baglimbuu ŋmɛnɛɛ, n na hiŋ i wibii ŋmɛnɛɛ saŋa maa.

ref: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
text: N ni karkanna waa so, gɛɛ n ni nɛfugze ra kpau.

ref: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n sam n noneere, di ra bagli lugɔ maa wichɔgii maa ɛɛwɛ, ka vol di ra bar i mbusu lizibɔr la, di ra jaamii,

ref: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n nɔŋŋi Dia la hin duwɛɛ labuu, denii i girme du.

ref: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
text: Gilɛɛ waa kpuŋ di ra jaa wichɔgɛɛra ni gɛɛ di waa kpuŋ di ra jaa nɛkpuura ni,

ref: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
text: Ka miŋwaa ra ɛɛ wia la n deŋleere, awia, na n sinyɛna, di lɛɛŋ.

ref: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n naazi chigɔ bɔnaniirɛ, nɛkpila la n ɔɔ chaali di ra jaami la biini, n daŋ chɔlii.

ref: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ fintina di ra chaaniŋ, di ɛɛ n Lɛɛri, anɛɛ ń kaa ra ɔmɛi? Kɔraawiizi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ n diikpeg ń de dui biini, anɛɛ seere ń kaa chi di ra ɔmɛi?

ref: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
text: Di wichɔgɛɛra waa nyiŋŋi ba fɔɔŋ, di kpuŋ, ba daŋ lɔɔzi naazi chogli.

ref: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
text: Haali laallɔɔra fɔɔŋ gba, ka n banchule wàá ra lɔ. Di ba kpa laal wa pigiŋ gba, aawaa saŋaa ń dɔɔ bɔkpega.

ref: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
text: N suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii wikpaŋ, waabuu keŋ, dí n na zuu u Dia ń de dui biini maa, di ɔɔ ra binni u wessi, ń nua kpu, di ra nyiŋŋi u bɔr, ú Dia biini.

ref: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, u daŋ tɔ n ni tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa, di kpaŋ du u Tanti Dia, di lɛɛŋ. Di kpaŋ chiŋŋi bɔr la min niŋ na n hiŋ.

ref: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
text: Awia, n daŋ kpegli n dɔma la n bariŋ la, di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna, di ra lizi mbusuzi u Tanti Dia biini, di yir yira di ra chɔluu.

ref: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu, di n wa lɔ wile yirii, na n sinyɛna, ka lɛɛ n wiisuŋŋaa.

ref: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
text: Hiŋ faa ŋɔwɛɛ, “Ba wa jaamiŋ.” N faa sɛɛwɔɔ, di ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ ba,

ref: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
text: gilɛɛ bir har kpuŋ! Gilɛɛ kpa baaŋ di duŋŋi i balii ta, hinuu ɛɛ n hiini. Gilɛɛ vɛɛŋ gɛɛ di kiziŋ ta, N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu n Lɛɛri.

ref: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
text: Di n mɛɛ ni n maa gba daŋ kiziŋ ta, ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ binni n ni.

ref: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagliŋ i ŋmɛnizi, tɔ n see ŋmɛnideŋlii biini, dikuu n dɔma wia.

ref: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
text: Gilɛɛ giliŋ tɛɛ n dɔma, dikuu baŋ kanni kara di ra chugiŋ, di kpa kalu ra huuziŋ wia.

ref: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
text: N zummɔ lugɔ n daŋ du de di na Kɔraawiizi winanaa ɛɛi, ń de dui naa biini.

ref: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
text: Ií gil ya yardi Kɔraawiizi, di dɔɔ bɔkpega, di gilɛɛ gil yaa bɔra ra huah. Ií gil ya yardi Kɔraawiizi.”

ref: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu ra guuŋ, a nuu n wile naa miŋ lɔwɛɛ ra tɛi naa. Di i siigɔɔ, n daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ banla baŋ hukke.

ref: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
text: A nuu n wile, di n wa yirii ŋɔ i hiiniŋ, di lalli n nonee chaŋ i Diinaniinanii la di ra suŋŋii.

ref: Treat them as they deserve! Punish them for their sins.
text: Turgi baa ba wiɛɛlaa ni ba wichɔgaa la kim, di turgi baa ba wiɛɛlaa la kim, gunla maa n dɛkkɛ.

ref: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
text: Baŋ waa Kɔraawiizi huma la uŋ hummɛ, gɛɛ kuna la uŋ tawɛɛ la ra tɔgzi wia, u daŋ tɔɔri baa, di chɔgi baa kɔrai.

ref: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
text: Ií gil ya chɔli Kɔraawiizi, dikuu uŋ nuu n wiraa di suŋ n ni wia.

ref: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
text: Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ n fɔŋŋa ani n guuri, waabuu n yardi. U hiinimbuu, n bɔra sɔɔni, n na chɔluu ni bɔsɔna yira.

ref: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
text: Kɔraawiizii ra guu u nɛra, waabuu ɔɔ guu, di lɛɛ koori la uŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ la.

ref: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛ i nɛra, di kissi banla maa n ɛɛ i hora la. A binni baa alugɔ penɔɔni, di ra du ba tau saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
text: Kuna la maa n du chiŋ, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, ií ra chɔli u girme ni u fɔŋŋa la.

ref: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
text: Ií ra sii lugɔ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ dɔɔ girmee, ií ra togni unla n ɛɛ Nɛnaniinanii la, di u wa ballɔ.

ref: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
text: Ba ra nuu Kɔraawiizi loobiire muuni ni, Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ girme hiŋ ra pogzuu lugɔ dooŋ, u loobii tɔ muuni ni.

ref: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
text: Kɔraawiizi loobii dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa, u loobii ra bagli u zenni ni u girmee.

ref: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
text: Kɔraawiizi loobii ɔɔ weruu kuugi hɛriŋkpola, haali Lɛbanɔn hɛriŋkpola gba.

ref: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
text: U gillɔɔ Lɛbanɔn bizenaa la ra zaahzi alugɔ nabizi, di gil Bizeŋ Hɛmɔn ra zaahzi alugɔ nabalee.

ref: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
text: Kɔraawiizi loobii ɔɔ giluu dooŋ ra nyɛgzi.

ref: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
text: U loobii ɔɔ giluu hɛribɔduma ra zigli, di gil Kadɛs hɛribɔduma ra zigli.

ref: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
text: Kɔraawiizi loobii ɔɔ giluu daakpega ra ziigi, di gil kɔr daazi paŋhoori maa war. Ka nɛra la maa n du Kɔraawiizi Dia la ra chaasi, di ra ŋɔ, “Ií ra tɔgzi Kɔraawiizi!”

ref: The Lord rules on his throne, king of the flood forever.
text: Kɔraawiizi ra di koraa muuni vile ni, u ra di koraa saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
text: Kɔraawiizi tɛɛ u nɛraa fɔŋŋa, di ra kissi baa, bá dɔɔ bampirsɔna.

ref: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na chɔliibuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, i lɛɛmbuu, haa gillɛ n dɔma bɔra sɔɔni dikuu n wia.

ref: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, n lɔ wilee tɛi ŋɔ i hiiniŋ, i ba wa chaaŋ,

ref: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
text: Kɔraawiizi nɛra maa, ií yir yira di ra tɛu, di ra chɔli u sɔnnaniinanii la.

ref: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
text: U baaŋ waa birgi ka ra sɔɔni, u winanaa ɛɛi waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ. I daŋ wer di ra wii hamuŋa ni, ka hɔɔ daŋ waa pizi, di bɔsɔna bɛnnɛ.

ref: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
text: Di n sogaa wa wesso, aŋ ŋɔu, “N ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá chol.”

ref: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiŋ faa ɛɛŋ nɛnnɛ la, i faa gillɔɔ n chi chigigi alugɔ bizeŋ, ka hiŋ wa bir har kpuŋ la, ɔnsii lawiŋ werge maa.

ref: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu n lɔ wile tɛɛ, di ra suŋŋii ŋɔ i hiiniŋ.

ref: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
text: “Beedee tɔnaa í na n siu biinei? Bɛɛ tɔnaa í na, di ba huginnei? Lalaa daŋ wer chɔlii? Ba daŋ wer sii i winanaa ɛɛi la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wiaa?

ref: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
text: Hinuu gillɛ n biinichɔg birgi bɔsɔna, n na sa. I lizi n biinichɔgrɛ, ka tɛŋ bɔsɔna.

ref: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
text: Awia, màá siigi, n daŋ yir yira di chɔlii. Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, n danna jaamii saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n ba i benii í guuŋ, gilɛɛ gil n ŋmɛnɛ maa waa di hiihzi, lɛɛŋ dikuu i wideŋlaa la wia.

ref: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
text: A nuu n be di lɛɛŋ manaŋ. Ɛɛ lugɔ n bɔsuahlii, di guuŋ, di ɛɛ lugɔ diikpeg, di lɛɛŋ.

ref: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
text: Hiŋ ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n bɔsuahlii ni n guuri la wia, tɔ n see di ra bagliŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ, dikuu i sɔŋ la wia.

ref: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii sidɛɛ la baŋ heŋ la ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n bɔsuahlii.

ref: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
text: N kpa n dumaa di ra du i nonee biini, n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i ɛɛ wibii hinnɛ, lɛɛŋ.

ref: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
text: N hah banla n na kuari vuga n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛɛ, ka yardii.

ref: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
text: N bɔra daŋ sɔɔni di ra pur, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la wia, i na n dɔgnyaa, di zum gunla minna di tɔɔrɔɔrɛ.

ref: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
text: Haŋ kpawɛɛ du n dɔma nonee biini, ka gil n na vol bɔr la maa n pariŋ.

ref: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna, dikuubɛɛwiai, n du siaahmu biinii, n siwee ra wiiu dikuu wiraa werge wia, n bɔra huah.

ref: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
text: N kuuhwɔɔ, dikuu n biini n chɔkkɛ wia, màá birgi, dikuu wiraa wia. N fɔŋŋa maanii tunnɛ, dikuu dɔgnya wia, n na kɔgi.

ref: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
text: N birgi chɛɛtɛ kunnɛ n dɔma be, haali n ni banla n duwɛɛ gba ra gbɛlliŋ. N dammuzi jaa ra ɔmiŋ, di ba wa naŋ ŋmɛnizenaa, a ba ra chɔu.

ref: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
text: Nɛr maanii jaa suuh n wia alugɔ miŋ siuwɛ, n jaa ɛɛ lugɔ kumpɛɛ.

ref: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
text: N na nuu n dɔma kpila maa n na munni n wiarɛ. Ɔnsii werge barimbuu, ba ra ta jina, di ra nyiŋŋi n kpui ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
text: Ka n yardiibuu, hinuu Kɔraawiizi la minna hum.

ref: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
text: N saŋazi du i nonee biinii, lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma ni banla n gillɛ n na di tɔɔrɔɔ la be.

ref: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
text: A suŋ i balii ni, di lɛɛŋ, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia.

ref: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ gil n di hiihzi, dikuubɛɛwiai, n wiiwoo tɛi. Gil biinikpola hina la di hiihzi, di gil ba chɔɔ sirititi, ba ŋmama biine.

ref: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
text: Gil karkanna naa nuuzi mar, baabuu banla n na jigsi di kpoŋ, di ɔɔ ŋɔ wia ra gbɛlli banla wia n deŋlee la.

ref: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
text: I winanaa kannɔɔ werge maa, i dau tɛɛ banla n na ɔmii. I ɛɛabuu nɛra see tɛɛ banla n na nyiŋŋi i guu baa la,

ref: You are their shelter from harmful plots, and you are their protection from vicious gossip.
text: I see ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ lɔɔ, i kpa baa suah lii nɛchɔgaa jinachɔgaa tai be. Ba na bahinaarɛ i duuribɔr, ba dɔma wàá ka wer kpa wia chug baa.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, dikuubɛɛwiai, u baglimbuu u nɔŋŋaa werge maa, saŋa la miŋ du bolzeŋ la baŋ fɔɔwɛ biini la.

ref: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
text: N ɔnsii werge la biini, n faa fɛwɔɔrɛ lugɔ u duŋŋimbuu ta, ka u nuu n wilee, saŋa la miŋ faa lɔ wile ŋɔ u hiiniŋ la.

ref: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
text: Ií nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi, ii banla maa n ɛɛ u nɛra la. Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ guu banla maa wia n dɔɔ wibiire, ka ɔɔ tɛrgi banla maa n na jigsi la dignaa, gunla n dɛg baa.

ref: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
text: Ií chi nɛnnɛ di dɔɔ bɔkpega, ii banla maa n dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi tamii la.

ref: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
text: Nɛr la maa Kɔraawiizi n gil u wichɔgaa tɛu, di lizaa u ni la, nuu sumaa.

ref: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
text: Nɛr la maa Kɔraawiizi n wàá pɛɛzuu u wichɔgaa wia, ani unla ge n waa daraa dɔɔwɛ, nuu sumaa.

ref: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
text: Di maa haŋ wa sɛɛ chɔgri dikuu n wichɔgaa wia, a ɔɔ ɛɛmbuu bɔhuaih, n na wii hɔpizaa maa biini.

ref: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
text: Hɔpizaa ni hamuŋa maa, ɛɛ ra tɔɔrimbuu. N fɔŋŋa maanii tunnɛ alugɔ lumaŋwiizi n gillɛ nii hiihzi la.

ref: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
text: Awiarɛ n bagli n wichɔgaa tɛi, màá kpawɛɛ suah i ni. N bagli n wichɔgaarɛ tɛi, i gil a maa tɛŋ.

ref: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
text: Awia, gil banla maa n nɔŋŋii la ra suŋŋii bá anuula saŋa, di tɔɔrɔɔ lugɔ niizenaa suwoo pal di ra ba, ka wàá hel baa.

ref: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
text: I ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ n bɔsuahlii, i daŋ guŋŋ lii tɔɔrɔɔ biini. Ń yir yira, dikuu hiŋ lɛɛŋ lii tɔɔrɔɔ biini wia.

ref: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ baglii ŋmɛnɛɛ la hin ninna hiŋ, di ŋɔ wia hiinii, di ra binni i ni.

ref: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
text: Gilɛɛ gɛni alugɔ zagu gɛɛ kawee la baŋ ɔɔ kpa kabarga du u nua, guŋ gil u ra sɛɛ dɔɔra la.”

ref: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
text: Biinikpola hina tɔɔrɔɔ kannɔɔ werge maa, ka banla waa n yardi Kɔraawiizi, u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la, ra guu baabuu saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
text: Ií banla wia n deŋlee, ií ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, a dɛkkɔɔ banla wia n deŋlee la n na chɔluu.

ref: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
text: Ií lɔ kem di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, ií lɔ janjalaŋ di yir yira di ra chɔluu.

ref: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
text: Ií yir yirfalii tɛu, di ra lɔ kem nɛnnɛ, di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna.

ref: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
text: Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii deŋloore, u wiɛɛlaa maa ge dɔɔ wibii.

ref: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
text: U nɔŋŋi wideŋlaa ni wibii dii wiarɛ, u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ yaari hɛri naa maanii.

ref: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wiarɛ, chiŋ du de, u wiŋɔɔliirɛ gillɛ wiizi, baagu ani chinchiŋwilaa maa du de.

ref: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
text: U chaali muuni niirii du bɔkpaŋ, di kpa a vile dau dia la biini unna dau kuna la.

ref: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
text: Ií gil durnya hina maa ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi! Ií gil ba maa ra tɔgzuu!

ref: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
text: Dikuu uŋ ŋɔ wia di ta durnya, di gil u chi chigigi wia.

ref: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
text: Kɔraawiizi chɔgi a hɛssi hina jinazii, di tɔ bá winyiŋŋaa ŋmɛnizi.

ref: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
text: Ka Kɔraawiiziwaa jinazi chigɔɔ chigigi, di hanna la, u kipar du denii, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
text: Hɛri la hina n na hum Kɔraawiizi, nuu sumaa, baabuu nɛra la uŋ lizɛɛ ba ɛɛ u hora la!

ref: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
text: U sogo ú koorikara ninɛɛ, ka ra binni hɛri naa zuura maa.

ref: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
text: Waabuu tɛɛ nɛr maa nfɛrɛ, di zum bɛl maa wiɛɛlaa.

ref: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
text: Laallɔɔrakpila lɛi niŋ wer lɛɛ koori, laallɔɔri ge himmaa fɔŋŋa werge lɛi niŋ wer lɛɛu.

ref: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
text: Gilɛɛ salli i laal zagu ni ú lɛɛi, haali un dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge gba, ka wàá wer lɛɛi.

ref: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
text: Kɔraawiizi ra binni banla maa n na hiŋ u nuarɛ, baabuu banla n dɔɔ u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ tamii la.

ref: He protects them from death and starvation.
text: Ú lɛɛ baa lii siu be, di tɛɛ baa miibɔɔ, lɔchɔgii saŋa.

ref: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
text: Kɔraawiizi ninɛɛ yaa tamii du, waabuu ɛɛ yaa guuri ni yaa hiini.

ref: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
text: Yaa bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ u wia, yaa yardi u sɔnnaniinanii labuu.

ref: I will always praise the Lord.
text: N danna jaami Kɔraawiizi saŋa maa, màá gil u chɔlaa maa.

ref: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
text: N danna jigsi dikuu Kɔraawiizi wia, ií gil banla maa banna sunni nuu guŋ, bá bɔra sɔɔni!

ref: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
text: N suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii, u nuu n wiisuŋŋaa, di lɛɛŋ lii ɔnsii maa biini.

ref: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
text: Banla maa n dɛlluu, bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔnuu, hiihzi ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá kpu baa.

ref: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
text: Dɔgnya hina ɔɔ lɔ wilee, Kɔraawiizi nuu ba be, di lɛɛ baa lii ba tɔɔrɔɔ maa biini.

ref: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
text: Kɔraawiizi mɛlika ɔɔ ra guu banla maa n na tɔgzuubuu, di lɛɛ baa lii siaahmu biini.

ref: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
text: Ií daŋ, di na gunla Kɔraawiizi wia n wesse. Nɛra la maa n chɔwɛɛ zuu Kɔraawiizi, nuu sumaa.

ref: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
text: Ií ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi, ii banla n ɛɛ u nɛra la, banla n na hiŋ u nua, waa kummaa nyaawɛ.

ref: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
text: Saŋa bɛl, bunyinzi ɔɔ nyaa diweere, lɔzi ra kpua, a ra bɛɛli, ka banlawaa n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nua, waa kunnanii maa nyaawɛ.

ref: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
text: N biizi, ií ba waa nuu n be, n daŋ bagli ia gunla Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa n duwɛɛ.

ref: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
text: Ii ra nyiŋŋi iihinaa diirea? Ii ra kɛlli miibɔɔjaŋ ani bɔsɔnaa?

ref: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
text: Guŋwaa, ií gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ wikuna, di gilɛɛ ra dar nɛra.

ref: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
text: Ií bir har kpu wichɔgaa, ka ra ɛɛ winanaa, di aah siwii di ra nyiŋŋi nuukpaŋ dɔɔi.

ref: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
text: Kɔraawiizi ra du nɛra la wia n deŋlee taurɛ, di ɔɔ ra nuu ba wile,

ref: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
text: ka ra naa banla n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa, di ba wa siuwɔ, bá suuh ba wia manaŋ.

ref: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
text: Di nɛra la wia n deŋlee wa lɔ wile, Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ nuuu, di lɛɛ baa lii ba tɔɔrɔɔzi maa biine.

ref: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
text: Kɔraawiizi dugli banla biine n chɔkkɛ labuu, di ɔɔ ra lɛɛ banla bɔra n huahwɛ.

ref: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
text: Nɛr la wia n deŋlee daŋ wer ra di tɔɔrɔɔ kpila, ka Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ lɛɛubuu lii a maa biine.

ref: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ guuubuu nɛnnɛ, ba wàá ku u hog maa.

ref: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
text: Wikunaa niŋ kpu biinikpola hina, Ba daŋ tɛr banla ge n hah nɛra la wia n deŋlee, digna.

ref: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ lɛɛ u nɛra ta, banla n niŋ chɔ ga zuuu, daŋ na bahinaa.

ref: Shield me and help me.
text: Kpa i laal kuna, di wa lɛɛŋ.

ref: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
text: Lalli i kandaa ni i laal kpaŋfɔ, di yoo banla n na duŋŋiŋ la. Ŋɔ nua tɛŋ lugɔ i daŋ lɛɛŋ.

ref: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
text: Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi bá kpuŋ la chol di di hiihzi! Gil banla n na ta n kpui jina la bir har di bugmi.

ref: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
text: Gil bá ɛɛ lugɔ zɔga, peu lɔa di ra kaali, Kɔ́raawiizi mɛlika duŋŋaa di ra kaali.

ref: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
text: Gil ba ŋmɛnibee biri, di ra hɛhrgi, saŋa la Kɔraawiizi mɛlika n na duŋŋi baa la.

ref: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, maa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ, ka ba heŋ sidɛɛ, di ki bɔɔluŋ ń chol u biini.

ref: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
text: Gil tɔɔrɔɔ chɔgii pirgi baa, di gil sidɛɛ la baŋ hewee la bir lau baa, bá chol a bɔɔluŋ biini, bá wia chɔgi.

ref: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
text: Denii ń bɔra jaa sɔɔni, dikuu Kɔraawiizi wia, n bɔra daŋ sɔɔni dikuu uŋ lɛɛŋ la wia.

ref: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
text: Awia, n daŋ ŋɔ ni n biini maa, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, anɛɛ n lugɔinɛi? I lɛɛ gɛrgaa lii kpeglega be, di lɛɛ nyaara ni anuula hina, lii banla n na fini baa la be.”

ref: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
text: Nɛchɔgaa kanni karaa chugiŋ, di ra pɛɛziŋ wia la miŋ waa zummɛ.

ref: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
text: Ba kpa wichɔgaarɛ turgi n winanaa kim, guŋ gil n biini chɔg werge.

ref: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
text: Ka miŋwaa, wiila n wa lau baa, n laali gbɔglɔnnɛ, di vɔɔ nua, di suŋŋi wiizi

ref: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
text: gunla min niŋ suŋŋi wiizi tɛɛ n dammu gɛɛ n kpɛɛma, di vol di ra bar alugɔ nɛr n na wii u maa lee la.

ref: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.
text: Ka miŋ wa du tɔɔrɔɔ biini, ba maa bɔra faa sɔɔnɔɔrɛ, ba chaali bariŋ, di ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ, hɔɔhra ra lɔɔziŋ.

ref: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.
text: Ba ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ alugɔ banla n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ, di hee nyina ra duŋ.

ref: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ magaa i binni guŋ birgi magɛi? Lɛɛŋ lii ba nonee biini, di lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ bunyinzi naa be!

ref: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
text: Denii n jaa jaamii, i nɛra n chaalɛɛ la biini, di chɔlii ba maa sibɔɔ.

ref: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
text: Gilɛɛ gil n dɔma bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu n tɔɔrɔɔ dii wia. Gilɛɛ gil banla n hahŋ pɛɛpɛɛ la ra gɛɛniŋ, dikuu n biinichɔg wia.

ref: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
text: Ba waa bampirsɔna wiŋɔzi ra ŋɔ, ka ɔɔ kanni kara di ra chug banla n du a hɛri, ba waa hagzi la.

ref: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
text: Ba ɔɔ aah siwiire kpa wia ra chugiŋ, di ra ŋɔ, “Ahaah! Ahaah! Yaa himmaa siwee nawɔɔrɛ!”

ref: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
text: Ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi na gunnɛ, awia, gilɛɛ siigi, gilɛɛ lii n be kaali bɔɔnɛɛ!

ref: Fight to defend me, Lord God,
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, izi chiŋ, di naa lɛɛŋ.

ref: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wia deŋloore, gilɛɛ gil n di bilchɔg, di gilɛɛ gil n dɔma ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ.

ref: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
text: Gilɛɛ gil bá ra ŋɔ, “Tibaarikala, yaa na yaa kipattɛ!” Gɛɛ di ŋɔ, “Yaa tuŋ u wiarɛ!”

ref: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
text: Gil banla bɔra n sɔɔnɛɛ n tɔɔrɔɔ dii wia la, di hiihzi di bugmi. Gil banla n na fɛ lugɔ ba ɛɛ nɛnanaarɛ kaaliŋ la, di hiihzi, di ŋmaabi.

ref: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
text: Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi lugɔ n lii bilchɔg biini la ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna, di ra ŋɔ saŋa maa, “Kɔraawiizi zenni kannɔɔ, u bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔnuu, di u balii bampirii wa chɔɔ bɔkpaŋ.”

ref: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
text: Denii ń jaa sii Kɔraawiizi wideŋlaa wia, di ra chɔluu hɔpizaa maa biini.

ref: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
text: Kɔraawiizi amaniye du n bampiriire, di ra bagli wichɔgɛɛra manni, ba waa Kɔraawiizi ra ɔm.

ref: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
text: Dikuu baŋ ɔɔ ra kpa bahinaa zenni werge wia, ba ɔɔ fɛu lugɔ Kɔraawiizi wàá na ba wichɔgaa, di ŋmaabi baa.

ref: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
text: Ba wiŋɔzi maa ɔɔ ɛɛ kara ni biinikpola wiŋɔzii, awia, ba gil nunzuma ni winanaa ɛɛirɛ.

ref: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
text: Haali ba ɔɔ chɔɔ ba chɔɔribɔraa, di ra ta wichɔgaa ɛɛi jina, di ɛɛ wichɔgaa ɛɛi sirya, ba waa wichɔgaa maa ɛɛi ra vɛɛ.

ref: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la, kannɔɔ werge kaali kummaa, gunnɛ i wibii dɔɔi gba du.

ref: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
text: I wideŋlaa kannɔɔ alugɔ bizenaa, i wibii dii ge du luŋ alugɔ muuzenaa vile. Hinuu ra binni newea ni sela maa ni.

ref: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
text: I nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la dɔɔ tɔnaa werge! I ra guu yaabuu alugɔ zal n ɔɔ yaa u keeri tɔ u biizi ni la.

ref: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
text: Ba ɔɔ ra di i dia diuzenaa labuu, i winanaa ɔɔ ra paluu alugɔ muu, ba ra nyɔɔ.

ref: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
text: I benii miibɔɔ du, i bɔchaaŋ biinii yaa ra na bɔr.

ref: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
text: Gil i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la du banla n na hiŋii la be, di ɛɛ winanaa ra tɛɛ banla wia n deŋlee la.

ref: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
text: Gilɛɛ gil banla n na jigsi la waa fɔɔŋ, gɛɛ di gil biinikpola hina waa duŋŋiŋ.

ref: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
text: Na gunla wichɔgɛɛra n choglee chɔɔgi, ba chogloore, ba wàá ka wer izi.

ref: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
text: Ií gilɛɛ gil biinikpola hina wia tir ia, gɛɛ di gil ii bɔra ra wii dikuu wichɔgɛɛra wia.

ref: They will soon disappear like grass without rain.
text: A wàá birgi ka bá siuzi alugɔ kooree, di siuzi alugɔ paŋhoori n ɔɔ war la.

ref: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
text: Ií yardi Kɔraawiizi, di ra ɛɛ winanaa, di du a hɛri, di dɔɔ iihinaa.

ref: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
text: Ii ra nyiŋŋi bɔsɔna Kɔraawiizi be, gunnɛ ú tɛɛ ia ii kipar kuna.

ref: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
text: Ií kpa iihinaa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di yarduu, u daŋ hiini ia.

ref: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
text: U daŋ gil ii wideŋlaa ra chaani lugɔ hɔpizaa, ii wibii dii ge ra chaani lugɔ wibaŋwiizi.

ref: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
text: Ií dɔɔ kanyitti di ra kpaŋ Kɔraawiizi, di gilɛɛ gil banla n na nyɛɛli wia tir ia gɛɛ banla wichɔgaa jinazi n ɔɔ wa ɛɛ wibii la.

ref: Don't be angry or furious. Anger can lead to sin.
text: Ií gil baaŋfuuih ni biinichɔg wia, a ra ba tɔɔrɔɔ ninɛɛ.

ref: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
text: Banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi la, baabuu niŋ dɔɔ a hɛri, ka bá duŋŋi biinikpola hina waa.

ref: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
text: Ka banla n dɔɔ sisɔna labuu niŋ dɔɔ a hɛri, di dɔɔ daama ni bɔsɔna werge.

ref: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
text: Biinikpola hiŋ ɔɔ ra ta nɛra la wia n deŋlee chɔgri jinaa, di ra fiili baa ani hahzi.

ref: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra mam biinikpola hinaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, u zummɔɔ lugɔ ba chɔgaa hɔpizii helloo.

ref: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
text: Biinikpola hina panzi ba tokobizii, di lalli ba hozi, bá kpu nyaara, anuula hina ni banla n na ɛɛ wideŋlaa,

ref: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
text: ka ba himmaa tokobizii niŋ bir kpu baa, bá hozi ge kuugi.

ref: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
text: Tama la nɛnanii n dɔɔwɛɛ bɔ daama werge la biinikpola hina n dɔɔwɛ,

ref: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔgi biinikpola hina fɔŋŋa, ka guu nɛnanaa waa.

ref: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
text: Kɔraawiizi ra du banla maa n waa chɔgri dɔɔwɛ taurɛ, ba hɛri daŋ du de di hanna la.

ref: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
text: Ba wàá di tɔrɔɔ hɛhchɔg saŋa, lɔchɔgii ge saŋa, ba daŋ dɔɔ diwee werge.

ref: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
text: Ka biinikpola hina waa wia daŋ tuŋ, banla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dɔma wia daŋ tuŋ alugɔ fiiri n wattɛ chogli, di kaali alugɔ nyɔɔzi n kaali chiŋ la.

ref: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
text: Biinikpola hiŋ ɔɔ kimuu, ka vɛɛ turgaa, ka nɛnanii waa dɔɔ bunyaa.

ref: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
text: Banla Kɔraawiizi n kisseere niŋ dɔɔ a hɛri, ka duŋŋi banlawaa uŋ see nua lii de.

ref: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra bagli nɛraa ŋmɛnizi la ban ninna hiŋ, di ra guu banla wia n paruu.

ref: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
text: Di ba lɔɔzi naazi gba, ka ba wàá chogli, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi lauri ba noneere kpogli.

ref: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
text: N ɛɛ bazɛŋaa filaŋkeŋ, di di biŋkpila, ka n ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa nawɛɛ Kɔraawiizi n vɛɛ nɛnanaa ta, gɛɛ di na ba biizi n na suŋŋi diwee.

ref: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
text: Ba ɔɔ dɔɔ bunyaa saŋa maa, di kpa kuna ra kim nɛra pɛɛpɛɛ, ba biizi daŋ nuu suma.

ref: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
text: Ií gil wichɔgaa ɛɛi, ka ra ɛɛ winanaa, denii ii du a hɛri di hanna la,

ref: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋi wia la n deŋleere, wàá vɛɛ u wibii hina ta. U daŋ guu baa di hanna la, ka u daŋ duŋŋi biinikpola hina waa lii a hɛri biini.

ref: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
text: Banla wia n deŋlee daŋ dɔɔ a hɛri, di ra zuu de saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
text: Nunzuma wia ɔɔ ra lii nɛra la wia deŋlee nuuzii, ba nuuzi ge ɔɔ ra di wibiire.

ref: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
text: Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la gbɔg du ba bampireere, ba waa har bittɛ ra kpuu.

ref: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
text: Biinikpola hina ɔɔ chɔɔu guu nɛra la wia n deŋleere, di ra nyiŋŋi ba kpui,

ref: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
text: ka Kɔraawiizi wàá gil baa du ba nonee biine, gɛɛ di gil bá di baa seriya bá chol.

ref: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
text: Ií yardi Kɔraawiizi, di ra hiŋ u widaulaa. U daŋ kpa tɔgzi, di gil ii dɔɔ a hɛri, di u waa duŋŋi biinikpola hina, ii siwee daŋ na.

ref: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
text: N ŋmɛnɛ faa zum biinikpola hiŋ bɛl n waa nɛra ni ra suŋ, ka u sogaa faa du wer lugɔ daa n chigɛ hɛrnanii di lɔɔ nɛnnɛ,

ref: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
text: ka a harbɔɔ, n faa ga de di u siuwɔ, n binni u bɔr, ka mɔɔ nawɛɛ.

ref: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
text: Ií ra fɛ banla n waa wichɔgaa dɔɔwɛ la wia, di ra binni banla wia n deŋlee, bampirsɔna hina daŋ dɔɔ naanna,

ref: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
text: ka wichɔgɛɛra maa daŋ siuzi, bá naanna dim.

ref: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
text: Kɔraawiizii ɔɔ lɛɛ nɛra la wia n deŋleere, di ɔɔ ra guu baa tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa.

ref: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
text: U ɔɔ hiini baabuu di lɛɛ baa, di lɛɛ baa lii biinikpola hina be, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba ɔɔ la u benii ŋɔ ú guu baa.

ref: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ hau n ni i baaŋfuuih, gɛɛ di wàá tɛr n digni ni i baaŋfuuih werge la!

ref: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
text: I virimbuu i hobee duŋ pira, di lɔŋ ta.

ref: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
text: Dikuu i baaŋfuuih werge la wia, n bɔra waa sum, n hoga ra wii, dikuu n wichɔgaa wia.

ref: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
text: N gɛnni wia, n ŋmɛra ra lii niirɛ, di ra sɔɔhri werge.

ref: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
text: N bɔdaabii wiila nyaŋŋɔɔrɛ, màá ka wer chi chiŋ, hɔpizaa maanii anna wii alugɔ nɛr n na wii lee la.

ref: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
text: N fuuh ra wii, di ra baari, maa alaanfia dɔɔwɛ.

ref: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
text: N fɔŋŋa maanii tunnɛ, n bɔra maa ɛɛ vɔlkɔti, n biini chɔgi, n na him.

ref: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i zum wii la minna nyiŋŋuu, n himaa waa suahwɛ i be.

ref: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
text: N banchule ra lɔu, n fɔŋŋa maa ge tuŋ, n siwee waa kaa du a duula, a waa kaa ra na nɛnnɛ.

ref: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
text: N dammuzi ani n nɛra kizimbuu ta, dikuu n wiila hiŋ wia, haali n lulla himmaa gba vɛɛmbuu ta.

ref: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
text: Banla n na nyiŋŋi bá lizi n miibɔɔ la hembuu sidɛɛzi. Banla ge n na nyiŋŋi ba duŋ pira la ra ŋɔ n chɔgaa wiarɛ, di ɔɔ ra ta n chɔgaa jina saŋa maa.

ref: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
text: N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ gɛnii, n waa wia ra nuu, n wàá wer haa nua.

ref: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
text: N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr la n waa wia ra nuu, n nua ge wàá wer haa.

ref: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, n daŋ yardii, dikuubɛɛwiai, i daŋ nuu n be.

ref: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
text: N na suŋŋiibuu, gilɛɛ gil n dɔma bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu n biinichɔg wia, gilɛɛ gil ba ra di bahinaa, di n wa lɔ naa.

ref: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
text: N cholaa helloo, n bɔra wiila ge waa tuŋ.

ref: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
text: N sɛɛ chɔgrii, dikuu n wichɔgaa wia, n biini chɔgi a wia.

ref: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
text: Banla n kpa wichɔgaa di ra turgi n winanaa kim labuu kii n wia, dikuu minna nyiŋŋi winanaa ɛɛi wia.

ref: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, gilɛɛ giliŋ ta, gilɛɛ kaali bɔɔnɛɛ ka kaŋ!

ref: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
text: N Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi, ba manaŋ wa hiiniŋ!

ref: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
text: N ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N danna du n wiɛɛlaa tau, ń wiŋɔzi gilɛɛ wa gil n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa. N daŋ lau n nua, di nɛchɔgaa wa dugliŋ.”

ref: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
text: Ka miŋ faa siigɛɛ di ɛɛ kirkir, maa wiimaa ra ŋɔ gba, ka n biinichɔg faa ra nyaŋŋuu.

ref: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
text: N biini faa jaa ra di niŋ werge maa, minna fɛ nfɛrɛ la, aawaa saŋaa a nyaŋŋi. Denii n faa jaa ŋɔ,

ref: “Please, Lord, show me my future. Will I soon be gone?
text: “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil n zum n saŋa ni n hɔpizaa maga, di gil n zum lugɔ n miibɔɔ waa jaŋ.

ref: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
text: I gillɔɔ n miibɔɔ du kpurii! N de dui ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ waa kummaa ɛɛwɛ i be. Wibii maa, newee maa miibɔɔ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ heeza kakpaŋ,

ref: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
text: di ɛɛ lugɔ laalii, ba wiɛɛlaa maa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ. Ba ɔɔ chaali daamaa di ra dau, ka ba waa zum nɛr la n niŋ wa dia!

ref: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bɛɛ tamiirɛ n jaa dɔɔ filaŋkennei? I benii n tamii du.

ref: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii n wichɔgaa maa biini, gilɛɛ gil n birgi gɛnaa chɛɛtɛkuŋ.

ref: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
text: N daŋ siigi, màá haa nua, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu gillɛ n na di tɔɔrɔɔ keŋ.

ref: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
text: Gil n viiraa, i nonii siili n ninɛɛ.

ref: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
text: I ɔɔ hau nɛra ninɛɛ di tɛr ba digna, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia, di ɔɔ chɔgi ba kundɔɔlaa alugɔ kunjigzi. Wibii maa, newee maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ heeza kakpaŋ!

ref: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa, keŋŋi digni di ra nuu n wiraa, wa hiiniŋ di n waa wii. Dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hɔɔhri i be, hɛri naa biini, gunla n naabaala n faa ɛɛwɛ la.

ref: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
text: Giliŋ pɛrɛtɛ, ka n wer dɔɔ bɔsɔna, mɔɔ ka siu, n wia tuŋ.”

ref: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
text: N di kanyittii, di kpaŋ Kɔraawiizi, u nuu n wiraa, di na n sinyɛna.

ref: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
text: U lizimbuu lii siaahmu biini, di lɛɛŋ lii siu n faa lugɔ bɔɔchuma biini, di tɛŋ bɔsɔna n dɔɔ n hiŋ, n na bɔnanii chi nɛnnɛ.

ref: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
text: U kpa yirfaliirɛ du n nua, Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la chɔlaa yittɛ. Nɛkpila maa daŋ na guŋ, di bir ba nfɛssi, di yardi Kɔraawiizi.

ref: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
text: Banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi, ba waa vuga ra kuari, gɛɛ di ra hiŋ banla n na kuari vuga la, nuu sumaa.

ref: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
text: Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, i ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia kpilaa tɛɛ yaa. Nɛr maa waa hoo lugɔi! I ta nuukpuuri wia kpila jinaa tɛɛ yaa, n ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá wer bagli a wia maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, a kpillɔɔ werge!

ref: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
text: Mbusu lizaa kuna ni kuna fuuih lɛi i ra nyiŋŋi, ka i furgi n dignaa. Haa mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa ni wichɔgaa mbusuzi lizaa kuna kaa ra nyiŋŋi.

ref: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
text: Denii n ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, minuu keŋ, n ballɔɔ. Ba sɛbi i widaulaarɛ i Gbɔg Hɔŋ la biini tɛŋ.

ref: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na nyiŋŋuu ń na ɛɛ i kipar, i Gbɔg la du n bampiriire.”

ref: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
text: N sii i lɛɛi amaniyesuma la wiarɛ tɛɛ nɛkpila la n chaalɛɛ la. N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i zummɔɔ miŋ waa n nua tɔwɛɛ.

ref: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
text: Maa i lɛɛi amaniyesuma la wia kpoglee n bɛŋ, ka n ɔɔ ra ŋɔ i wibii dɔɔi ni i nɛra lɛɛi la wiarɛ saŋa maa. Maa i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ ni i wibii la wia kpawɛɛ suah nɛkpila la n chaalɛɛ la ni.

ref: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ n ni sunaa, gil i nɔŋŋaa ni i wibii dɔɔi la guuŋ. Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia

ref: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
text: Tɔɔrɔɔkpila barimbuu, n wichɔgaa ge nyaŋiŋ, maa kaa ra na. A kpillɔɔ werge kaali n nyuhuna, awia, n bɔra jaa huah.

ref: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ! Jaande maa, ba manaŋ wa hiiniŋ!

ref: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
text: Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi ba kpuŋ la, di hiihzi di bugmi. Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi ba duŋ pira la, bir har di di hiihzi.

ref: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil banla n na ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ la hɔrmi, dikuu hiŋ kpegli baa, ba di hiihzi wia.

ref: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
text: Ama, gil banla waa maa n na jaamii la, dɔɔ bɔsɔna i be, di gil banla n nɔŋŋi i nɛra lɛɛi wia la ɔɔ ra ŋɔ saŋa maa, “Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!”

ref: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
text: Miŋwaa ɛɛ anuula hiŋ ni nyaarii, a liizi n wia. Hinuu ɛɛ n hiini ni n Lɛɛri, Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, gilɛɛ waa birgi!

ref: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
text: Nɛr la n na du anuula hina tau, nuu sumaa. Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ lɛɛubuu tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa.

ref: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ guu a hiŋ, di gil ú dɔɔ miibɔɔ, u daŋ kissuu a hɛri biini, waa kpau du u dɔma nonee biini, bá ɛɛu ba kipar.

ref: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ hiinuu, di u wàá wii, di chaau.

ref: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
text: N ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna ka chaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛibuu wichɔgaa.”

ref: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
text: N dɔma kpa hahzii ra ŋɔ n wia, di ra ŋɔ, “Saŋa bɛɛ ú siu, u sɔŋ dimei?”

ref: When visitors come, all they ever bring are worthless words, and when they leave, they spread gossip.
text: Di bɛl haŋ wa ba u wa naŋ, u wia waa ɔɔ dɔɔ wibii, ɔɔ liiu di ŋɔ wichɔgaa di ra du n ni, di ra tɛɛ nɛr maa.

ref: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
text: Ba ɔɔ ra ŋɔu, “Wiilchɔgii dawuubuu, wàá ka piri u chɔɔi naa biini.”

ref: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
text: Haali n badɔŋ la miŋ yardɛɛ werge, n nuu kpau di ra di la gba bittɔɔ chɔɔ hɛri, di vir hɛɛhraa du n siwee.

ref: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna ka tɛŋ alaanfia, ń wer turgi n dɔma bá wichɔgaa kim.

ref: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
text: N zummɔ lugɔ n wia pariibuu, dikuu n dɔm n waa wette kpegliŋ wia.

ref: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
text: Minna hiŋii ni wibii la wia, i lɛɛmbuu, di gil n du i be saŋa maa.

ref: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la, di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami! Ami!

ref: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gunla chɛɛh n ɔɔ hɛg, di ra nyiŋŋi nii la, gunnɛ n na nyiŋŋi i wia.

ref: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
text: N siniire birgi n diwee, hɔpizaa ni hamuŋa maa. Saŋa maa, n dɔma ɔɔ ra pɛɛzimbuu, “Lee Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la duɛi?”

ref: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
text: A ɔɔ ɛɛmbuu biinichɔg, di n wa liizi a wia naa. Gunla n ni nɛkpila n ɔɔ faa la i Dia, n tɔ ba see, ba ra yir yira di ra chaasi, ba bɔra sɔɔni, ba ra chɔlii la.

ref: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
text: Bɛɛ wiarɛ n biini chɔgi wergei? Bɛɛ wiarɛ n na di tɔɔrɔɔ wergei? N daŋ kpa n tamii du i ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, n daŋ haa ra chɔlii, hinuu n Lɛɛri

ref: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
text: ni Kɔraawiizi la minna hum. N biini chɔkkɔɔ werge, awia, n daŋ liizi i wia, Bizenaa Hɛmɔn ni Miza nyuuni, Jɔɔdan muu n faarɛɛ la.

ref: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
text: I gillɔɔ n biini chɔgi lugɔ nii n suwee di ra lɔŋ, di ra kɔɔ lugɔ chuurunchu, di pal fɔŋŋa ni, di ra nyiŋŋi n dii.

ref: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
text: Hɔpizaa saŋa, Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ bagli u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛɛ, guŋ gil hamuŋa ni, n na yir yira, di ra suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ n miibɔɔ la.

ref: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
text: N ŋɔwɔɔrɛ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ n guuri, “Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i suuh n wiai? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ń na di dɔgnya dikuu n dɔma biinikpola wiai?”

ref: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
text: N hoga maanii ra wii, dikuu, n dɔma chɛɛtɛ wia, ba ɔɔ ra pɛɛziŋ saŋa maa, “Lee Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la duɛi?”

ref: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n biini chɔgi wergei? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n na di tɔɔrɔɔ wergei? N daŋ kpa n tamii du Kɔraawiizi ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, n daŋ haa ra chɔluu, waabuu n Lɛɛri ni Kɔraawiizi la minna hum.

ref: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hɔɔ n nua tɛŋ, ka hiiniŋ lii banla n wɛɛ zummɛ la be, di lɛɛŋ lii karkanna ni wichɔgɛɛra be.

ref: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
text: Hinuu n guuri, Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i giliŋ tai? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n vol di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, dikuu n dɔma n na firiŋ wiai?

ref: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
text: Gil i bɔchaaŋ ni i wibii la, wa tɔ n see, di kpogliŋ la i bizennaniinanii la nyuu, bɔr la hiŋ duwɛɛ la.

ref: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
text: Denii ń jaa la i mbusu lizibɔr la, hinuu ra tɛŋ bɔsɔna werge. N daŋ lɔ kem di yir yira chɔlii, Kɔraawiizi la minna hum.

ref: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n biini chɔgi wergei? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n biini ra koozinnei? N daŋ kpa n tamii du i ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, n daŋ kaa ra chɔlii, hinuu n Lɛɛri ni Kɔraawiizi la minna hum.

ref: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, yaa himmaa digna nuabuu, yaa naabaala ŋɔ yaa benii, hunzenaa la hiŋ hummɛ ba saŋa la ni faala maa,

ref: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
text: gunla i himmaa n duŋŋi a hɛssi la hina ba lii, ka gil i himmaa nɛra so ba hɛri, gunla hiŋ tɛr a hɛssi hina digna, ka gil i nɛra nyɛɛli la.

ref: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
text: A waa lugɔ ba kpegli a hɛri hinaa ni ba tokobizi gɛɛ di kpegli baa ni ba himmaa fɔŋŋa. Ka i fɔŋŋa, i kpegzi ani hiŋ ŋɔ nua lugɔ i daŋ du ba be labuu baglɛɛ lugɔ i nɔŋŋi baabuu.

ref: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
text: Hinuu ɛɛ n Koori ni Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, hinuu gillɛ Izrɛl hina kpegli ba dɔma.

ref: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
text: I benii yaa ga kpegli yaa dɔma, i sɔŋ biinii yaa fɛrgi baa ni naazi.

ref: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
text: Maa n hoo gɛɛ n tokobi yardɛɛ a lɛɛŋ,

ref: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
text: ka i lɛɛ yaabuu lii yaa dɔma be, di gil yaa haahra ge di hiihzi.

ref: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, yaa daŋ ɔɔ ra chɔlii, di ra jaamii saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
text: Ka filaŋkeŋwaa, i bir hattɛ kpu yaa, ba kpegli yaa, haa kaa du yaa laallɔɔra di ra la laal.

ref: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
text: I gillɔɔ yaa chɔ lii yaa dɔma be, haali ba foozi kuna la maa yaa n dɔɔwɛ laal biini.

ref: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
text: I gillɔɔ ba kpu yaa lugɔ peeza, di gil yaa yaari hɛrdumazi biine.

ref: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
text: I kpa i himmaa nɛraa yoo harha, alugɔ baŋ waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
text: Yaa dɔŋahina na gunla hiŋ ɛɛ yaabuu, ba ra ɛɛ yaa chɛɛtɛ di ra mam yaa.

ref: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
text: Hɔpizii maa, hiihzi ɔɔ ra kpumbuu, n willi n nyuu,

ref: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
text: dikuu n chɛɛtɛ ɛɛra chagzaa ni n dɔma hahzi wia.

ref: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
text: Annii maanii wa huuzi yaa, haali yaa n haa waa i wia suuhwɛ gɛɛ di chɔgi nuukpaŋ la yaa nii n ɛɛwɛ la.

ref: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
text: Yaa bampiree haa lawiibuu, yaa waa i widaulaa vɛɛwɛ ta.

ref: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
text: Ka i vɛɛ yaabuu ta hohobiazi biini, di gil bɔbiri kilɛŋkilɛŋ tɔ yaa ni.

ref: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
text: Di yaa vii vɛɛ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la wiarɛ, ka ra kuari hɛrduma hina vug,

ref: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
text: i daŋ faa zum, dikuubɛɛwiai, i zum wia la maa n du yaa biinee.

ref: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
text: Yaa ɔɔ du siu biinii saŋa maa, dikuu i wia, yaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ peeza la, baŋ lizɛɛ bá kɔrgaa la.

ref: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ! Gilɛɛ ra chɔɔ dɔɔ. Kazi bɔra! Gilɛɛ vɛɛ yaa ta kɔrai!

ref: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i bir har kpu yaai? Gilɛɛ suuh yaa dɔgnya ni yaa tɔɔrɔɔ wia!

ref: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
text: Ba lɔ yaabuu ta hɛri, yaa gɛrgi chɔɔ hɛɛhraa biini.

ref: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
text: Izi wa hiini yaa! Lɛɛ yaa, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia.

ref: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
text: Wiŋɔnanaa su n nuarɛ, min niŋ kpaa yir yir naa tɛɛ koori. N nuuzuŋŋi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr la n zum sɛbaa nɛnnɛ kunsɛbii.

ref: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
text: Hinuu ɛɛ bunɔɔŋ kaali baal maa, i zum wiŋɔzii nɛnnɛ, Kɔraawiizi kissiibuu saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Mighty king, glorious ruler, strap on your sword
text: Koorizeŋ, ɛɛ i tokobi sirya, i dɔɔ girme ni zennii.

ref: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
text: Tinni i zagu ni i zenni, di kpegli i dɔma, dikuu wibii ni wideŋlaa ɛɛi wia, í fɔŋŋa werge la gil i kpegli i dɔmaa nɛnnɛ.

ref: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
text: I hobee ra diu nɛnnɛ, a yagzi i dɔma bampireere furgi, hɛssi hina chogli i see.

ref: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
text: Kora la Kɔraawiizi n tɛi la, daŋ ɔɔ chi di hanna la saŋa maa. Wibiire i kpa di ra binni i nɛra ni.

ref: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
text: I nɔŋŋi wideŋlaare ka hah wichɔgaa, awiarɛ Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la lizii, di tɛi bɔsɔna kaali i dɔŋahina la.

ref: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
text: I laala maanii ra sɔɔhri mɛr, alozi ani kasia la. Yiryitta ra deŋŋi i siwee kooridiini la baŋ kpa bala nyina bɔg la biine.

ref: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
text: Koora biihaana jaa haana la n du i dia biini ninɛɛ, ka haŋfalii la chi i koorikara nodig barii, di laali salinnanaa bɔmbɔga.

ref: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
text: Koori haŋfalii, keŋŋi digni di ra nuu gunla min niŋ ŋɔ, suuh i nɛra ni i mɛɛ lulla wia.

ref: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
text: I toloorii niŋ gil a koori ra nyiŋŋii, waabuu ɛɛ i dɔɔri, a tɔgzuu.

ref: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
text: Bolzeŋ Taaya hina daŋ wa sunzii kuna, dɔɔna kpila danna nyiŋŋi ba wia parii.

ref: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
text: A koori haŋfalii du u kooridiarɛ, u toloori dɔŋ waa hoo, saliŋ koozi gessi la baŋ kpawɛɛ suah u tagtajaŋ la ninɛɛ.
