ref: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
text: U bɔg kunnanaarɛ, baŋ tɔɔhzɛɛ ba duu di ra ba koori be. U dɔŋahina suŋgure la hiŋuu di ra ba, ba kpogli ba maa di wa tɛi.

ref: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
text: Bɔsɔna ni biinihuŋŋuu ba kpa di wa zuu i dia.

ref: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
text: Jara, i daŋ dɔɔ biizi, bá ɛɛ nabɔnzi, di ra binni hɛri naa maa ni.

ref: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
text: N yir naa daŋ gil i dɔɔ sɔŋ jiminizi maa biine, nɛr maa ge ra chɔlii saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
text: Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ yaa guuri ni yaa fɔŋŋa, u ɔɔ ɛɛ siryaa saŋa maa, ú hiini yaa tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa.

ref: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
text: Awia, ɔnsii wàá lau yaa, haali di hɛri naa ra zigli, bizenaa purgi di ra chogli muuzeŋ biini gba,

ref: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
text: haali muuni niiri gba ra lɔ, di ra kɔɔ, bizenaa ra ziigi, dikuu a muuni koozaa wia gba.

ref: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
text: Muu bɛl gɔŋa gillɔɔ bɔsɔna du Kɔraawiizi bolzeŋ, bɔnaniinanii la Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la n duwɛɛ la.

ref: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
text: Kɔraawiizi du a bolzenne, u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá wer puri, chɔɔzimpikke ni, u daŋ wa hiini a bol hina.

ref: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ giluu ɔnsizeŋ chol hɛssi ni, kossi chogli, u pozi, hɛri ge ŋmɛɛri.

ref: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ du yaa benii, Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum labuu ɛɛ yaa guuri.

ref: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
text: Ií ba wa na huma la Kɔraawiizi n hummɛ, di na nuukpuuri wia la uŋ ɛɛwɛ hɛri naa biini.

ref: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
text: U gillɔɔ laal lɔi tuŋ durnya maa biini, u kuugi hozi ni kandaazii, ka fuuh laal pɛrɛtuzenaa.

ref: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií gil naari, ka zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi. Minuu kaali kummaa hɛssi maa biine, di kaali kummaa durnya naa biini.”

ref: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la du yaa benii, Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum labuu ɛɛ yaa guuri.

ref: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
text: Nɛra maa, ií ra lɔ kpaa ni bɔsɔna! Ií ra yir yira bombombom, di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la dɛkkɔɔ banna ɔmuu werge, waabuu ɛɛ koorizeŋ durnya maa biini!

ref: God has put every nation under our power,
text: U gillɔɔ yaa kpegli hɛssi hina, di ra di kora ba ni.

ref: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
text: U lizi a hɛrii u ɛɛ yaa kapɛttɛ kuŋ, u nɛra Izrɛl hina un nɔŋŋɛɛ la yɛɛzi kunnɛ.

ref: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
text: Kɔraawiizi ra lau ú ga so u koorikara ni, unna la la, ba ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna, di ra huuh bensunozi.

ref: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ durnya maa koorii, ií yir yira di ra darguu!

ref: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
text: Kɔraawiizi sogo u koorikarnaniinanii ninɛɛ, di ra di kora hɛssi hina maa ni.

ref: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
text: A hɛssi koora ni Kɔraawiizi la Abraham n na hum la nɛra chaalɔɔrɛ. U fɔŋŋa kaali laallɔɔra maanii, waabuu ra di kora kummaa ni.

ref: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
text: Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ sɔnnɛ werge, di dɛg chɔlaa werge maa, u bolzeŋ la biini, u Bizennaniinanii la nyuu.

ref: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
text: Kɔraawiizi Bizeŋ Ziɔn la chinne, di du wer werge maa, a koorizeŋ bolzeŋ la ɔɔ ra tɛɛ durnya maanii bɔsɔna.

ref: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
text: Kɔraawiizi baglɔɔrɛ lugɔ hinnai du u benii, u bolzeŋ diikpega la biini.

ref: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
text: Koora ni ba laallɔɔra chaalɔɔrɛ ra ba, bá wa fɔɔ Bizeŋ Ziɔn la.

ref: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
text: Ka baŋ wa nau, ba nuuzi kpu kakpaŋ, ɔnsii chol ba ni, ba bir chɔ.

ref: They trembled all over like women giving birth
text: Bɔsai ani bɔwiila chol ba ni alugɔ hilula n lɔ haaŋ,

ref: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
text: di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ pekpeg n lii wiifurii la, di wa lɔ muugberzenaa, di chɔgaa.

ref: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
text: Gunla yaa n nuuwɛ la, gunnɛ yaa na, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la yaa n na hum, bolzeŋ la biini. U daŋ gil u bolzeŋ hiŋ chi nɛnnɛ saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, yaa ɔɔ ra fɛ i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la nfɛrɛɛ, i Dia biini.

ref: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
text: Gunla i sɔŋ n kannɛ la, gunnɛ ba ra chɔlii hɛri naa maa biini. I ra di koraa ni wibii.

ref: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
text: Gil Bizeŋ Ziɔn nɛra bɔra sɔɔni, di gil Juda boljigzi nɛra bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu hinna di seriyazi ni wibii wia!

ref: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
text: Kɔraawiizi nɛra, ií vol di bar Bolzeŋ Ziɔn, di kur u diijaŋra la,

ref: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
text: di pessi u koŋlaa, di binni u diikpega la, gunnɛ ii wa wer bagli a wia tɛɛ jiminizi la n niŋ haa ba nɛra.

ref: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
text: Kɔraawiizii yaa ra hum, saŋaa saŋa maa, waabuu ninna tɔ yaa see, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
text: Nɛra maa, ií ra nuu! Durnya hina,

ref: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
text: nɛzenaa, banla banna sunni, dɔɔna ani nyaara maa, ií ra nuu!

ref: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
text: N daŋ ŋɔ nunzuma wia, wia la min niŋ ŋɔ daŋ chaani nɛnnɛ.

ref: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
text: N daŋ bir n laakal du sɛɛliizi ni, di lɔ kem bagli a zɛɛzi.

ref: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
text: Di tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa wa ballɔ, di biinikpola hina ni

ref: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
text: banla n yardi ba daama, di ra jigsi a wia la, wa bariŋ, ka maa ɔm.

ref: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
text: Nɛr maa wàá wer turgi di lɛɛ u dɔŋhiŋ gɛɛ di wer turgi Kɔraawiizi u miibɔɔ kim,

ref: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, u miibɔɔ yoola kpolloo werge maa, kunla un niŋ kpa turgi wàá hel,

ref: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
text: á wer gil u dɔɔ miibɔɔ di hanna la, wàá siu.

ref: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
text: Nɛr maanii zummɛ lugɔ nunzunna ni bambugee maanii ɔɔ siu, ka gil ba daama tɛɛ nɛra baŋhina.

ref: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
text: Ba ŋmama daŋ birgi ba diini, di ɛɛ ba duuribɔra saŋa maa, haali baŋ faa dɔɔ ba himmaa hɛssi la gba.

ref: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
text: Kenne niŋ huuzi banla n na tɔgzi bahinaa ni banla maa n na hiŋ baa, di ra nuu ba wiŋɔzi la.

ref: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
text: Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ peeza n niŋ siu, bá hug baa, bá pɔɔh. Di Kɔraawiizi wa lɛɛ banla wia deŋlee, ba daŋ di kora ba ni, ka bá pɔɔh ŋmama biine, ba wàá ka dugli ba kooridiizenaa la.

ref: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ lɛɛŋ, u daŋ lɛɛŋ lii siu fɔŋŋa be.

ref: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
text: Gilɛɛ gil a tirii, di nɛbɛl wa birgi daama hiŋ gɛɛ di u daama ra wazi,

ref: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, di u wa siuwɔ, wàá kpa kummaa kaali, u daama wàá hiŋuu tuu bɔɔ.

ref: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
text: Saŋa la uŋ du de la, u ra yir u hinnɛ bɔsɔna hiŋ, ba ra chɔluu, dikuu uŋ nyɛɛlɛɛ wia,

ref: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
text: u daŋ la ga jaa u naabaala ni, bɔr la u ŋmɛnɛ maa n wàá ka na bɔchaaŋ.

ref: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la n kpekke werge la, chaali durnya hina maanii lii wiifurii di ga chug wiicholii.

ref: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
text: Kɔraawiizi girme ra chaanuu alugɔ niŋ, di lii u Bolzeŋ Ziɔn la n wesse werge la biini.

ref: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
text: Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la ra bau, waa suahwɛ di ra ba, ninlauzeŋ du u seere, pekpeg baruu.

ref: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
text: U ɔɔ yir chiŋ ni hɛri maanii alugɔ nɛra, á di daansɛɛ, ka ú di u nɛra seriya,

ref: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
text: di ŋɔ, “N nɛnanaa, ií chaali n see. Ii banla n lizi mbusu lizaa kuna tɛŋ, n ni ia ɛɛ nuukpaŋ la.”

ref: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
text: Chinchiŋ kuna maa baglɔɔrɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi wia deŋloore, dí u himmaanii ɛɛ seriya diiri.

ref: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Ií ra nuu, n nɛra Izrɛl hina, ka n ŋɔ wia, n daŋ tɛɛ ia bilchɔg. Minuu ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum.

ref: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
text: Maa ii liga nabala ra nyiŋŋi gɛɛ ii lonni buuna,

ref: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, sela la maa n du kɔr biini ani nauna la maa n du giŋgimee kagboŋa nyuuni la, ɛɛ n horaa.

ref: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
text: Zumbizi maa ni kunnyinee maa, n du kooni, ɛɛ n horaa.

ref: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
text: Di lɔzi faa ra kpuŋ, ka maa ŋɔ ii tɛŋ diwee, dikuubɛɛwiai, durnya ani kuna la maa n du u biini ɛɛ n horaa.

ref: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
text: N na hee nabala olaa gɛɛ di ra nyɔɔ buuna challia?

ref: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
text: Ií kpa jaaŋ ú ɛɛ ii mbusu lizaa kuna, di ra tɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi, ií ra ɛɛ gunla iiŋ ŋɔ nua la, di ra tɛɛ Miŋ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la,

ref: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
text: di ra yir n sɔŋ, di ii wa du tɔɔrɔɔ biini, n daŋ lɛɛ ia, ii jaa ra tɔgziŋ.”

ref: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ biinikpola hina waa benii, “Bɛɛ ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ ii dɔɔi, ií ra kurgi n Gbɔgnɛi? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra ŋɔ yaa nuukpaŋ dɔɔi wiai?

ref: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
text: Ii hah n baglaarɛ, di vɛɛ n wiŋɔzi la ge ta.

ref: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
text: Ii birgi ŋmɛɛŋ la maa iiŋ nawɛɛ dammuu, ii ni sɛnsɛnna ge ra kpau.

ref: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
text: Ii ɔɔ ɛɛ siryaa saŋa maa ii ŋɔ wichɔgaa, di yali siwee ra kanni kara.

ref: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
text: Saŋa maanii ii ɔɔ kpa wia ra chug ii lulla, di ra chɔgi ii himmaa maa biizi sɔna.

ref: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
text: Annii maanii ii ɛɛ, ka n sigli, awia, ii ra fɛu lugɔ n ni ia ɛɛ kpannɛ. Ka filaŋkeŋwaa, n daŋ jaa hau ii ni, ka chaani a wia siwee tɛɛ ia.

ref: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
text: Ií ra du tau, ii banla n suuh n wia la, di guŋ lɛi, n daŋ chuuri ia alugɔ bunyiŋ n chuuri sel, ka nɛr maa wàá du de di lɛɛ ia.

ref: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
text: Nɛr la n kpa jaaŋ u ɛɛ mbusu lizaa kuŋ di ra tɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi, ra tɔgzimbuu. Nɛr la n na hiŋ n ŋmɛnizi nɛnnɛ, n daŋ lɛɛu.”

ref: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ ani i nɛsunaa werge la wia, dinzi n wichɔgaa ta.

ref: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
text: Sɔ n wichɔgaa maa ta, di gil á lii n ni.

ref: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
text: N zum n wichɔgaarɛ, a ɔɔ chɔɔ n seere saŋa maa.

ref: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
text: Hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi bɛnnɛ n ɛɛ wichɔgaa, di ɛɛ wia la n ɛɛ wichɔgaa i be. Awia, i hor summɔɔ hin diŋ seriya, i hor ɔɔ deŋluu, di i waa di seriya.

ref: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
text: Wibii maa, ba lulimbuu ni wichɔgaa, di lii saŋa la maa, n maa n kpogli n hia la.

ref: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
text: Na, wibii dii ni biinihuŋŋuu i ra nyiŋŋi, awia, tɛŋ nunzuma n nfɛrɛ biini.

ref: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
text: Sɔŋ, n wichɔgaa lii, n ɛɛ nɛnanii, sɔŋ, n huuhzi kaali gonni.

ref: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
text: Gil n nuu bɔsɔna ni bɔpuraa wia, haali hiŋ lɔŋ ta n hoga kuugi la gba, ka n daŋ kaa dɔɔ bɔsɔna.

ref: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
text: Bir i har kpu n wichɔgaa, ka dinzi a maa.

ref: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛŋ biinihuŋŋu, di tɛŋ mananaa.

ref: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
text: Gilɛɛ duŋŋiŋ lii i be gɛɛ di lizi i Duma lii n ni.

ref: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
text: Kaa gil i lɛɛi bɔsɔna la du n be, di gil n sɛɛ di ra hiŋ i nua.

ref: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
text: Denii ń jaa bagli wichɔgɛɛra i widaulaa, bá bir ba i be.

ref: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
text: N dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ lii nɛkpui bilchɔg biini! Hinuu ɛɛ n Lɛɛri, n danna yir i wideŋlaa wia yira.

ref: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, pilli n nua, ń wer di ra dargii.

ref: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, mbusu lizaarɛ sisɔna dɔɔi, hàá vɛɛ nɛr la n dɔɔ sisɔna, di ra sɛɛ chɔgri, dikuu u wichɔgaa wia.

ref: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, suŋ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina ni, di hiini baa, kaa bir ma Jɛrusalɛm koŋlaa la n faa baruu la.

ref: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
text: Denii i bɔra sɔɔni mbusu lizaa la n deŋlee ni yaa mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa wia, bá jaa kpa nabala di lizi mbusu, i mbusu lizibɔr la ni.

ref: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
text: Fɔŋŋa hiŋ, ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i ra jigsi dikuu i wichɔgaa wiai? Kɔraawiizi wia dɔɔ wibiire, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
text: I ɔɔ ra ta nɛra chɔgaa jinaa, i wiŋɔzi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ fuŋ, hinla n na dar nɛra.

ref: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
text: I nɔŋŋi wichɔgaarɛ kaali winanaa, di nɔŋŋi kara kaali wibii.

ref: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
text: I nɔŋŋi wiŋɔzi la n na chɔgi nɛraa, nɛdattii hiŋ!

ref: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔgii di hanna la, u daŋ lawii, di vɛzii lii i dia, di lizii lii nɛnyinee biini.

ref: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
text: Banla wia n deŋlee daŋ na guŋ, ɔnsii lau baa, ba danna mamii, di ra ŋɔ,

ref: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
text: “Na, baal naabuu waa Kɔraawiizi dɛllɛɛ ú lɛɛu, ka dɛlli u daama un dɔɔwɛ werge ni, di chɔgi nɛra, di ra na fɔŋŋa!”

ref: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
text: Ka miŋwaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ɔlivi daa, n na hel Kɔraawiizi Dia biini. N yardi u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ labuu, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n danna chɔlii saŋa maa, dikuu gunla hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia. Di dɔɔ tamii, dikuu i sɔnnanii la wia, di ɔɔ chi i nɛra see di ra chɔlii.

ref: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
text: Gɛnaa ɔɔ ŋɔu ba biine, “Kɔraawiizi waa hoo.” Ba waa wibii dɔɔwɛ, ba maa ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛraa, bɛl maa waa winanaa ra ɛɛ.

ref: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ du chinne, ka ra binni newea ú na, di baŋhina du denii di zum wia zɛɛ gɛɛ di ra nyiŋŋi u bɔrɛi.

ref: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
text: Ba maa leuwoo. Ba maanii ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra, bɛl maa waa hoo di ra ɛɛ winanaa. Akai! Kpaŋkpaŋ maa waa hoo.

ref: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ba waa zummɛa? Wichɔgɛɛra naa gɛnnɔɔwaa? Ba ra fini n nɛraa ka ba wanna jaami.”

ref: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
text: Ka ɔnsii werge la, ba ŋmɛnɛ maa n haa waa nawɛɛ, daŋ lau baa, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi daŋ yaari u nɛra dɔma hoga. U vɛɛ baabuu, awia, Izrɛl hina daŋ kpegli baa nɛnnɛ.

ref: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
text: N na suŋŋi wiizii Izrɛl hina na lɛɛi lii Bolzeŋ Ziɔn. Izrɛl hina bɔra daŋ sɔɔni di Kɔraawiizi wa gillɔ ba bir nyɛɛli.

ref: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ ni i fɔŋŋa, di gil n dɔɔ n hiŋ i kpegzi la wia!

ref: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n suŋŋaa, keŋŋi digni di ra nuu n wiŋɔzi!

ref: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
text: Hɔɔhra ra bau bá wa fɔɔŋ, sikpegii hina ge ra nyiŋŋi ba kpuŋ, nɛra la baga n waa hoo i ni la.

ref: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
text: Wibii maa, hinuu n hiini, hinuu ra guuŋ.

ref: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil n dɔma wichɔgaa laŋŋi ba ni, di chɔgi baa dikuu i wibii wia.

ref: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ sunzii, di dargii, dikuu hiŋ wesse wia.

ref: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
text: I lɛɛmbuu lii tɔɔrɔɔzi maa biini, n siwee na n dɔma cholaa.

ref: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa, di gilɛɛ bir luŋ kpuŋ!

ref: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
text: A nuu n be, di sɛɛ tɛŋ, n biini ra tɔɔrimbuu, n ɛɛ kinchaŋ,

ref: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
text: dikuu n dɔma wiŋɔzi ni biinikpola hina sunnaa wia. Ba ra tɔɔrimbuu werge, ba baana ra fuuh n ni, ba hahŋ.

ref: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
text: N biini chɔgimbuu werge maa, n banchule ra lɔ dikuu siu wia.

ref: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
text: Ɔnsii ni bɔsai chol n ni, ɔnsii werge lawiŋ.

ref: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
text: N ŋɔ, “Di n vii dɔɔ keerii lugɔ komma, n daŋ vii zaah kaali yembɛl, di ga heezi.

ref: I would go and live in some distant desert.
text: N daŋ vii zaah kaali bɔɔnɛɛ, di ga du hɛribɔduma biini.

ref: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
text: N daŋ vii yali siwee ga nyiŋŋi duuribɔr, n ni pekpeg ni dooŋ peu gilɛɛ dugli dɔŋa.”

ref: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil n dɔma bugmi ba wiŋɔzi biini! N na naari ni kaluzii a bolzeŋ biini,

ref: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
text: wibaŋzi ni hamuŋzi maa. Ba ɔɔ ra guuzi u koŋlaa ni, di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa ni tɔɔrɔɔ wia u biini.

ref: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
text: Dɔŋa chɔgaa du bɔr maanii, nɛsunnaa ni finaa su a bolzeŋ ŋmɛnizi.

ref: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
text: Di n haahri faa ra gbɛlliŋ di ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ, n daŋ vii wer di kanyitti, gɛɛ di kpa n hiŋ suah u ni.

ref: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
text: Ka hìŋ́ n badɔnnɛ, nɛr la miŋ yardɛɛ werge.

ref: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
text: Waabuu nɛr la n nuu n na ta jina, di kpau ra jaami Kɔraawiizi, u Dia biini.

ref: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil n dɔma siu di ba saŋa haa waa helle, di gil hɛri di baa di ba haa ra nyiŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, wichɔgaa du ba diini ni ba bampireere.

ref: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
text: Ka n daŋ yir hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi, í lɛɛŋ.

ref: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
text: Chɔɔzi, wibaŋa ani hamuŋa maanii aŋ nuumi di ra tɛi, i ɔɔ nuu.

ref: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
text: I daŋ bir kpogliŋ ba ni bɔsɔna, di lii laalzi la maa n ni n dɔma kpila n na yoo la biini.

ref: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
text: Ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n na di kora saŋa maa la, daŋ nuu tɛŋ, di kpegli baa, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba waa nyiŋŋi ba bir ba nfɛssi, ba wɛɛ ra ɔm.

ref: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
text: U nua faa summɔɔ lugɔ yazi, ka hahzi faa du u bampirii. U wiŋɔzi faa pɛssɔɔrɛ lugɔ nuu, ka ra mɔŋ ge lugɔ tokobidiilii.

ref: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
text: Awia, wia la maa n na tir ia, ii kpaa ra bagli Kɔraawiizi, u daŋ guu ia, u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá gil banla wia n deŋlee la chol.

ref: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
text: Ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi waa daŋ gil biinikpola hina tuu ba ŋmama biine. Nɛkpuura ni karkanna saŋa wàá hel, ka ba siu. Ka miŋwaa daŋ yardii.

ref: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba fɔɔmbuu, n dɔma ra tɔɔrimbuu saŋa maa.

ref: Many of them are pursuing and attacking me,
text: N chɔgra ɔɔ ra duŋŋimbuu hɔpizii maa, bakpila kpa jigsii di ra fɔɔŋ.

ref: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
text: Di ɔnsii wa lawiŋ, n daŋ yardii.

ref: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
text: N yardiibuu, awia maa ɔm, n na chɔliibuu, dikuu nua la hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ wia. Bɛɛ newee wer ɛɛnnɛi?

ref: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
text: Hɔpizii maanii n dɔma ɔɔ ra koozi wia di ra du n ni, ba ɔɔ ra ta jinaa gunla ban niŋ ɛɛ duŋ pira!

ref: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
text: A ba suahzuu ra ta jinachɔɔgaa, di ra kpaŋ, di ra binni wia la maa minna ɛɛ, di ra nyiŋŋi ba kpuŋ.

ref: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
text: Awia, n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛr ba digna, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia. Kpa i baaŋfuuih kpegli baa!

ref: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
text: I na gunla n tɔɔrɔɔ n makkɛɛ, di zum gunla miŋ wiiwe mag. Guŋ waa hoo i hɔŋ biiniaa?

ref: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
text: A hɔl la min niŋ yirii, n dɔma daŋ bir har. N zum gunnɛ, i chigɔ n hattɛ.

ref: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
text: Hinuu n yardi, maa kaa ra ɔm, awia, bɛɛ newee, wer ɛɛnnɛi?

ref: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ lizi nuuzi la miŋ lɛɛwɛ la tɛi, n daŋ lizi jaaŋ kunsunzaa tɛi,

ref: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, i lɛɛmbuu lii siu be, haa gillɛ n dɔma kpegliŋ. Awia, n danna vol i see, bɔchaaŋ la n na tɛɛ newea miibɔɔ la biini.

ref: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna, dikuubɛɛwiai, n ba i benii ŋɔ i lɛɛŋ. A guuŋ alugɔ zal n ɔɔ yaa u keeri tɔ u biizi ni la, di ra ba saŋa la hɛhchɔg la n niŋ wa bɛri.

ref: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
text: I daŋ nuu lii chiŋ di lɛɛŋ, di kpegli banla n na sunniŋ la. I daŋ bagliŋ i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la ani i wibii dɔɔi.

ref: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
text: N dɔma barimbuu, ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyinzi la lɔzi n na kpu, a ra nyiŋŋi nɛra a hee. Ba nyina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kandaazi ni hobee, ba nuuzuŋŋa ɛɛ lugɔ tokobizi n na di nɛnnɛ.

ref: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a bagli i zenni chiŋ, di gil i girme la su hɛri ge maa.

ref: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
text: N dɔma he sidɛɛrɛ bá lawiŋ, bɔhuaih lawimbuu werge maa. Ba ki bɔɔlunne n ŋmɛnɛɛ, ka ba himmaa bir chogli u biini.

ref: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n bampirii lauwɔɔ nɛnnɛ, n daŋ yir yira di chɔlii!

ref: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
text: N daŋ feli izi, di lɔ n kem ni janjalaŋ mɔɔ, ka wiizi fur.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n danna chɔlii hɛssi maa biine, di yir yira di ra chɔlii nɛra maa biini.

ref: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
text: I nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la kannɔɔ werge di bɛri chiŋ, i wibii dɔɔi la gba gaa chug chiŋ wia.

ref: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagli i zenni lii chiŋ, di gil i girme la su hɛri ge maa.

ref: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
text: Koora, ii ra ŋɔ wiarɛ ni wibiia? Ií ra di nɛra seriyaa ni wibiia?

ref: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
text: Wichɔgɛɛra ra lewuu ba de dui biini saŋa maa, di ra kanni kara lii a hɔl la baŋ lul baa la.

ref: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
text: Ba wiŋɔzi ɛɛwɔɔ alugɔ hɛrikuŋ siri, di ɛɛ lugɔ dundugu digna n tɔɔgɛɛ la,

ref: that refuses to listen to the snake charmer.
text: ba waa kaa ra nuu hɛrikuŋ tagzi hiŋ loobii gɛɛ u yirsuma gba.

ref: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, kuugi n dɔma naa nyina n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ bunyinzi nyinvazi naa!

ref: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
text: Gil ba leu alugɔ nii n pallɛ kaali, di ba wa kpa ba hozi, gil ba hobee gbul.

ref: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
text: Gil ba hil lugɔ konti, gɛɛ lugɔ biifula la baŋ lullɛ u bir, di waa wiizi nawɛɛ la.

ref: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
text: Ba daŋ waa hassi, di ba ŋmɛnni baa ta alugɔ kooree. N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i daŋ kpa i baaŋ la heuzi baa ta, di ba haa ra nyiŋ.

ref: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
text: Banla wia n deŋlee bɔra daŋ sɔɔni, di ba wa na banna tɛr wichɔgɛɛra digna, ba daŋ vol biinikpola hina challi biini.

ref: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
text: Denii nɛra ra ŋɔ, “Wibii maa, banla wia n deŋlee na ba kinturgaare. Kɔraawiizi du denii wibii maa, di ra di durnya seriya.”

ref: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii a wichɔgɛɛra be, di lɛɛŋ lii a nɛkpuura be!

ref: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
text: Na! Ba sogo n sagaa! Nɛchɔgaa suahwɔɔ di ta jinachɔgaa n wia, ka a waa lugɔ wichɔgaa gɛɛ wii bɛllɛ n ɛɛ leu.

ref: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
text: Maa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ leu, ka ba ɛɛ sirya bá pigiŋ, izi wa lɛɛŋ, na n dɔgnya!

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, izi wa hiiniŋ, í himmaa na, Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum! Izi chiŋ, di tɛr nɛra la n wɛɛ ra hum la digna, gilɛɛ waa suŋ biinikpola hina la n ɛɛ sɔsɔgɔ hina la ni!

ref: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
text: Duana maa, ba ɔɔ biruu ba di waa uuhri, alugɔ nuuzihina di ra bar a bolzeŋ.

ref: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
text: A nuu huuhni ani ba nɛɔnzaa wiŋɔzi. Ba nuuzuŋŋa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ tokobizi, ka ba ra fɛ lugɔ nɛr maa waa ba wia ra nuu.

ref: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
text: Ka n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiŋwaa ra mam baabuu, di ra ɛɛ banla n wɛɛ ra jaami la chɛɛtɛ.

ref: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, i siweere n na binni, hinuu ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n diikpeg, Kɔraawiizi la n nɔŋŋiŋ.

ref: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
text: I daŋ tɔ n see, di gil n na n dɔma cholaa, n bɔra sɔɔni.

ref: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ waa kpuuzi baa, di guŋ ɛɛwɔ, n nɛra daŋ suuh. Kpa i fɔŋŋa di gil ba yaari, di kpegli baa, hinuu ɛɛ yaa guuri.

ref: My enemies are liars! So let them be trapped by their boastful lies.
text: Wichɔgaa du ba nuuzii, ba wiŋɔzi maa ɛɛ wichɔgaa, gil ba jigsi la laŋŋi ba ni! Dikuu banna see nɛra nuuzi di ra kanni kara wia,

ref: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
text: kpa baaŋfuuihchɔgaa di chɔgi baa, bá wia tuŋ kɔrai. Denii nɛr maa zum lugɔ hinuu di Izrɛl hina kora, i kora ge yaari durnya maa.

ref: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
text: Duana maa, ba ɔɔ biruu ba di waa uuhri, alugɔ nuuzihina di ra bar a bolzeŋ,

ref: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
text: di ra nyiŋŋi diwee, di ba waa haŋ wa piŋ, ba ɔɔ ra wozuu lugɔ nuuzihina.

ref: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
text: Ka miŋwaa daŋ yir yira dikuu i kpegzi wia, chɔɔzi maa, n daŋ ɔɔ yir yira, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ wia. Dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n diikpeg ni n suahribɔr, tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa.

ref: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, n yir yiraa di ra chɔlii, hinuu ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n diikpeg, Kɔraawiizi la n nɔŋŋiŋ.

ref: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i baaŋ fuuh yaa ninɛɛ werge maa, i bir har kpu yaa, di vɛɛ yaa ta, ka filaŋkeŋwaa, kaa bir ba yaa be!

ref: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
text: I gillɔɔ yaa hɛri zigli, di pergi, bir tɔɔgi u bɔpergaa la, dikuubɛɛwiai, u maanii ra zigli.

ref: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
text: I gillɔɔ i nɛra di tɔɔrɔɔ werge maa, yaa ra jiŋli alugɔ yaa n nyɔɔ siŋ di ra dɛɛzi.

ref: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
text: I karfi banla n na tɔgzii labuu, bá chɔ lii siu be.

ref: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
text: Kpa i fɔŋŋazeŋ la lɛɛ yaa, guŋ gil banla hiŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ la na bahinaa.

ref: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
text: Kɔraawiizi du u Dia la biinii, di ŋɔ, “N kpegloore, awia, n daŋ bargi bolzeŋ Sɛkɛm, di kpa Sukɔf Waluu bɔnni n nɛra.

ref: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
text: Giliad ni Manasɛ maa ɛɛ n horaa, Ɛfram ɛɛ lugɔ n lugbii kahuro, Juda ɛɛ lugɔ n koori daŋkpala.

ref: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
text: Moab ɛɛ n niisannileere, n daŋ kpa n gawa ta Ɛdɔm ni, di ra bagli lugɔ u ɛɛ n hotte. Ka chaasi du Filisti hina ni, dikuu miŋ kpegli baa wia.”

ref: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, anɛɛ n niŋ kpogliŋ, ba bolzeŋ la baŋ ma koŋlii bar lai? Anɛɛ n niŋ tɔ n see la Ɛdɔmɛi?

ref: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
text: Hiini yaa yá kpegli yaa dɔma, newee waa hiinaa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ.

ref: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
text: Hiŋ du yaa be la wia, yaa daŋ kpegli baa, i daŋ kpegli yaa dɔma tɛɛ yaa.

ref: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nuu n wiraa, di nuu n wiisuŋŋaa!

ref: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
text: Biinichɔg lawimbuu werge maa, n du hɛri tunazi di ra yirii! Wa tɔ n see, di ga kpaŋ chiŋŋi bɔr la min niŋ na n hiŋ,

ref: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ɛɛ n guuri, di ɛɛ lugɔ n diijaŋ la n kpekke, n dɔma be.

ref: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
text: Gil n du i Dia la biini, n de dui maa biini, di ra guŋŋ alugɔ zal n ɔɔ yaa u keeri tɔ u biizi ni la.

ref: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nuu n nuuzi la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛi labuu, di tɛŋ kuna la n ɛɛ banla n na tɔgzii hora la.

ref: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
text: Tɛɛ a koori miibɔɔjaŋ, di gil u di biŋkpila werge maa!

ref: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil ú di a kora i see di hanna la, di kpa i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la ani i wibii dɔɔi la, di ra binni u ni.

ref: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
text: Gunnɛ ń jaa ra yir yira saŋa maa di ra chɔlii, gunla miŋ ŋɔ nua di ra ɛɛ hɔpizi biimaa la.

ref: Only God can save me, and I calmly wait for him.
text: N na kpaŋ Kɔraawiizii ú wa lɛɛŋ, u bɛŋ ninɛɛ n dɛlli.

ref: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
text: U bɛnnɛ ra binniŋ di ra lɛɛŋ, waabuu ɛɛ n guuri, awia màá chol maa.

ref: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
text: Ɛrɛɛ ii maa pig nɛr di birgi mag, unla n gɛrgɛɛ alugɔ koŋlii n gɛrgɛɛnɛi?

ref: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
text: Ii ɔɔ ra ta jinaa ii ɛɛu, ú lii u girme bɔr chol, kara kannaa ɔɔ par iabuu. Ii ɔɔ kpa ii nuuzii di ra kissi nɛra, ka ra see baa nuuzi ii biine.

ref: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
text: Kɔraawiizi bɛŋ ninɛɛ n dɛlli, n tamii maa du u ninɛɛ.

ref: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
text: U bɛnnɛ ra binniŋ di ra lɛɛŋ, waabuu ɛɛ n guuri, awia, màá chol maa.

ref: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
text: N lɛɛi ni n girme du Kɔraawiizi benii, waabuu ɛɛ n guurikpeg, di jaari n ni.

ref: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
text: Awia, n nɛra, ií yarduu saŋa maa, di kpa ii witittaa maa di ra bagluu, dikuubɛɛwiai, waabuu ɛɛ yaa suahribɔr.

ref: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
text: Newee maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ heeza kakpaŋ! Ba maanii ɛɛ kumpɛɛri. Di ba ŋɔ ba mɛgzi ba tɔgzi, ba maa fukkɔɔ kaali heeza.

ref: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
text: Ií gilɛɛ yardi nɛfoozaa, di gilɛɛ kpa ii tamii ra du ŋmɛɛri ni. Haali di ii daama wa wazɔɔ gba, ka ii gilɛɛ waa dɛllaa.

ref: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
text: N nuuwɔ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ bukpila maa lugɔ, hinuu dɔɔ fɔŋŋa,

ref: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
text: dí i nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ. Wibii maa, hinuu niŋ turgi nɛr maa, u wiɛɛlaa kim.

ref: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, n na nyiŋŋi i nairɛ siaahmu maa ni. Di ra nyiŋŋii alugɔ niinyɔgzi hiŋ n na nyiŋŋi nii la gɛɛ n du hɛribɔduma la, nii waa hoo de la.

ref: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
text: Gil ń nai, i Dia la biini, di na gunla i fɔŋŋa ani i girme la n duwɛɛ.

ref: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
text: Dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la n kaali miibɔɔ wia, n danna chɔlii.

ref: As long as I live, I will pray to you.
text: Awia, n danna chɔlii n de du maa biini, di lalli n nonee chiŋ di ra suŋŋii.

ref: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
text: N daŋ yir bɔsɔna yira, n bɔra ra pur alugɔ nɛr n di diuzenaa piŋ, di yir bɔsɔna yira di ra chɔlii.

ref: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
text: Di n wa chɔɔ n kunchɔɔrikuŋ ni, anna liizi i wiarɛ, hamuŋa maa, i wia ɔɔ du n bampiriire,

ref: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ɛɛ n hiini, a guuŋ alugɔ zal n ɔɔ yaa u keeri tɔ u biizi ni gunla, ń na yir yira ni bɔsɔna.

ref: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
text: N faamiibuu kiŋkiŋ, i banonii la lawiŋ kpogli.

ref: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
text: Ka banla waa, n na nyiŋŋi bá kpuŋ la, ba daŋ kpu baa, bá tuu kaali lalaa bol.

ref: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
text: Ba daŋ kpu baa laal biini, hohobiazi hee baa.

ref: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
text: Ama, a koori waa daŋ dɔɔ bɔsɔna Kɔraawiizi be, banla ge maa n kpa Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ hɛɛhzi la, danna chɔluu, ka ba daŋ tɔɔgi karkanna waa nuuzi.

ref: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa, ɔnsii lawimbuu n dɔma wia, lɛɛŋ lii ba be!

ref: Keep me safe from secret plots of corrupt and evil gangs.
text: Kpaŋ suah lii jinachɔgaa la biinikpola hina n na ta la ni ani wichɔgɛɛra la n chaalɛɛ di ra kɔɔ la be.

ref: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
text: Ba nuuzi ra diu alugɔ tokobizi baŋ sazɛɛ, ba wiŋɔzi ge chum lugɔ hobichɔgaa.

ref: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
text: Ba ɔɔ ra du dɔŋaa bɔkpega wichɔgaa ɛɛi jinazi tai biini, di ɔɔ ra ŋɔ bɔra la ban niŋ he ba sidɛɛzi wia. Di ɔɔ ra ŋɔ, “Anɛɛ n niŋ na yaai?”

ref: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
text: Ba ɔɔ ta wichɔgaa jinazii di ra ŋɔ, “Yaa ta jinaa, u du wer nɛnnɛ!” Wibii, newee nfɛrɛ ani u biini dɔɔ daraarɛ.

ref: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ taazi baa u hobee, ba na pira kakpaŋ.

ref: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
text: U daŋ chɔgi baa, dikuu ba wiŋɔzi wia, banla maa n niŋ na baa danna gbɛlli baa.

ref: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
text: Denii newea maa jaa ra ɔm, bá sii Kɔraawiizi huŋhunnaa wia, di ra fɛ gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ wia.

ref: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
text: Gil banla maa wia n deŋlee dɔɔ bɔsɔna Kɔraawiizi be, di na bahinaa, di gil banla maa wia n deŋlee ra chɔluu!

ref: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a dɛkkɔɔ yaa n na chɔlii Bolzeŋ Ziɔn biini, di ra hiŋ nuuzi la yaa n ŋɔwɛɛ tɛi la,

ref: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ra nuu nɛra wiisuŋŋaa. Nɛra daŋ lii yemmaa di ra ba i be,

ref: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
text: dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia. Yaa wichɔgaa n wa nyaŋŋi yaa, hinuu gilaa tɛɛ yaa.

ref: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
text: Banla hiŋ lizɛɛ, di gil ba wa du i Dia la, nuu sumaa! I Dia kunnanaa la n ɛɛ kissaa la, daŋ gil yaa bɔra sɔɔni.

ref: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i ɔɔ nuu yaa wiisuŋŋaarɛ, di gil yaa kpegli, di ɔɔ ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia lɛɛ yaa. Durnya nɛra maa ani banla n du muuni baŋgizi bɔɔnɛɛ maa, yardiibuu.

ref: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
text: I fɔŋŋaa i kpa chiŋŋi bizenaa a chignibɔra, di ra bagli i kpegzi la n kannɛ werge la.

ref: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
text: I gillɔɔ muuni niiri ni a nii a lɔi, kɔɔi siigi kirkirkir, di gil hɛssi hina ge gil kɔɔi.

ref: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
text: Guŋ gil durnya hina maa banchulli ra lɔ, dikuu nuukpuuri wia la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia. I wiɛɛlaa gillɔɔ nɛra la maa n du hɛri yemmaa, ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna.

ref: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
text: Hɛri naa wia tiriibuu, i ɔɔ giluu dooŋ ba u ni, u du sum. I gillɔɔ gɔŋa suugi niiri, i tɛɛ nɛra pattikuna. Kenne i ra ɛɛ,

ref: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
text: i ɔɔ giluu dooŋ ba kooni werge, di gil a maa sɔɔni nɛnnɛ. I ɔɔ giluu donii pɛssi hɛri nɛnnɛ, di gil pattikuna ra hel.

ref: Wherever your footsteps touch the earth, a rich harvest is gathered.
text: I winanaa ɔɔ giluu pattikuna pur, bɔr la maa hiŋ laŋŋɛ, kuna ɔɔ pur denii.

ref: Desert pastures blossom, and mountains celebrate.
text: Sela diiribɔra maanii suugi sela, bɔsɔna du a giŋgimee kɛraa.

ref: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
text: A pire maanii suugi peeza, a walli maa ge suugi mia. Kummaa bɔra sɔɔni, a ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna, alugɔ newea.

ref: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
text: Nɛra maa, ií ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna di ra yir yira, di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
text: Ií ra yir u sɔŋ tɔgzaa yira, ií gil u chɔlaa dɔɔ girme.

ref: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
text: Ií ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi be, “I wiɛɛlaa wia ra kpu nuarɛ! I fɔŋŋa ge kannɔɔ werge, ɔnsii werge ɔɔ lau i dɔma, ba giŋŋi i see.

ref: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
text: Durnya nɛra maanii ra jaamii, di yir yira ra chɔlii, di yir yira ra dargii.”

ref: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
text: Ií wa na gunla Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛwɛ, uŋ kuu newea wia di ɛɛ wizenaa.

ref: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
text: U faa gillɔɔ muuzeŋ birgi hɛrhilii, yaa naabaala vol giu. Ií ba, yaa bɔra sɔɔni werge, dikuu gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.

ref: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
text: U di koraa saŋaa saŋa maa ani u fɔŋŋa, di ra binni hɛssi hina maa ni, nɛra gilɛɛ waa dɔɔ dignikpega u be.

ref: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
text: Hɛssi maa hina, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la, ií gil ba ra nuu u chɔlaa.

ref: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
text: Waabuu gillɛ yaa ra nyiŋ, waa sɛɛwɛ yaa chol.

ref: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i ɛɛ yaabuu na gunla baŋ ɔɔ kpa niŋ ŋmɛɛri saliŋhuŋŋu, u doŋa lii la.

ref: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
text: I gillɔɔ sidɛɛ lau yaa, di kpa buntɔga sagzi yaa nyaŋa.

ref: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
text: I gillɔɔ yaa dɔma fɛrgi yaa ni naazi, di gil yaa di tɔɔrɔɔ alugɔ banla niŋ ni nii n chɔgi ba kuna la. Ka filaŋkeŋwaa, i jaa biruu kpa yaa ba bɔr la n dɔɔ bɔsɔna.

ref: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
text: N daŋ kpa mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa wa zuu i Dia, di lizi nuuzi la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛi la.

ref: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
text: N daŋ kpa peeza lizi mbusu, di fuuah tɛi, i mbusu lizibɔr la ni. N daŋ kpu nabala ni buuna, lizi mbusu i be, á nyɔɔzi kaali chiŋ.

ref: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
text: Ií banla maa n na tɔgzi Kɔraawiizi, ií ba wa nuu, ń bagli ia gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛŋ.

ref: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
text: N lɔ wilee tɛu ŋɔ ú hiiniŋ, n yir yiraa chɔluu.

ref: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
text: Di n faa kpa wichɔgaarɛ suah n biini, Kɔraawiizi vii wàá nuu tɛŋ.

ref: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi nuuwɔɔ tɛŋ, wibii maa, u nuu n wiisuŋŋaarɛ.

ref: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
text: N na chɔli Kɔraawiizii, dikuu uŋ waa n wiisuŋŋaa vɛɛwɛ gɛɛ di vɛɛ n nɔŋŋaa wia.

ref: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, suŋ yaa ni di kissi yaa, di ra hiini yaa ni winanaa,

ref: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
text: gúnnɛ durnya hina maa wer zum i kipar, hɛssi maa hina ge wer zum i nɛlɛɛi wia.

ref: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil nɛra ra chɔlii, gil bá maa ra chɔlii, wibii maa.

ref: Let the nations celebrate with joyful songs, because you judge fairly and guide all nations.
text: Gil hɛssi hina bɔra sɔɔni, bá ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna, dikuubɛɛwiai, i ɔɔ ra di nɛra seriyaa ni wibii, di ra tɔ durnya naa hɛssi hina maa see.

ref: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil nɛra ra chɔlii, gil ba maa ra chɔlii, wibii maa.

ref: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
text: Gunnɛ a hɛri pattikuna lɛɛ, Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la daŋ kissi yaa.

ref: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ kissi yaa, durnya hina maa danna jaamuu.

ref: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ, di gil i dɔma yaari, banla maa n haih, chɔ yaari.

ref: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.
text: Gunla peu n ɔɔ lɔ nyɔɔzi a kaali la, gunnɛ í duŋŋi baa, bá kaali. Gunla kel n ɔɔ dugli niŋ di ŋmɛɛri la, gunnɛ biinikpola hina wia tuŋ i see.

ref: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
text: Ama, gil banlawaa wia n deŋlee, dɔɔ bɔsɔna i be, bá bɔra sɔɔni, bá ra chaasi.

ref: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
text: Ií yir yira di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ií yir yira di ra chɔluu. Ií kuari ŋmɛnɛɛ di ra tɛu, waabuu unla n tinni baamazi di ra ba, u sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni u see!

ref: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
text: Kɔraawiizi la n du u Diinaniinanii labuu ra binni lalbiizi ni luhaana ni.

ref: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
text: Kɔraawiizii ra tɛɛ nɛr la n nyaa nɛra zuuribɔr, di ra lizi banla baŋ tɔɔgɛɛ diini, ba ra dɔɔ bɔsɔna, ka banla digna n kpekke waa, u gillɔɔ ba ra zuu hɛribɔduma biini.

ref: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, saŋa la hiŋ faa tɔ i nɛra see la, ba vol di wa ga hɛribɔduma la,

ref: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
text: hɛri faa zigloore, baamazi ge faa ra bizi dooŋ Bizeŋ Sinaai Kɔraawiizi la see, Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la see.

ref: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
text: I gillɔɔ dooŋ nɛɛ nɛnnɛ, di gil i hɛri la n siuwɛ la bir du sum.

ref: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
text: I nɛra sogo u biinii, dikuu i wia n wesse la wia, i tɛɛ nyaaraa ba kunnyiŋŋaa.

ref: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wiarɛ, hahkpila maa siia, di ra ŋɔ,

ref: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
text: “Koora ni laallɔɔra hahzoore chɔ ra kaali, ka haana la n du bol kpa kuna la baŋ foozee laal biini, di ra bɔnni dɔŋa.

ref: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
text: Banla n chɔɔwɛ di ra binni peeza la, na lugbia kommazi baŋ kpa, saliŋhuŋŋu tɔ a ni, saliŋ ge tɔ a huna ni, di ra nyɛgzi la.”

ref: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la n wa duŋŋi koora a hɛri la, a faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ dobia n chol Bizeŋ Zalmɔn ni.

ref: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
text: Basan hɛri bizeŋ la kannɔɔ werge maa, di dɔɔ nyukpila, a la chiŋ werge!

ref: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
text: Kɔraawiizi lii Bizeŋ Sinaairɛ di ra ba u Dia la ni torkozenaa kagboŋa,

ref: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
text: di tinni chiŋ ra kaali. U lauri laal yomaa hiŋ u hiŋ, di ra na sunzaazi kpila ra lii dignikpega hina be. Kɔraawiizi daŋ so de.

ref: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ yaa Lɛɛri la, waabuu lɛɛ yaa buntɔga di ra chi hɔpizi biimaa.

ref: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
text: Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi daŋ purgi u dɔma nyuuni, u daŋ purgi banla n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa la nyuuni.

ref: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ kpogli ii dɔma lii Basan hɛri bir ba, n daŋ kpogli baa lii muuzeŋ vile bir ba,

ref: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
text: guŋ gil ii ra vol ba challi ni, ii nuuzihina ge lennaa piŋ.”

ref: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nɛra maanii ra na i volaa, Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ n Koorizeŋ ni u nɛra n ta chɔŋ di ra zuu u Dia la.

ref: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
text: Yiryitta tɔ see, kunlɔɔra du harbɔɔ, ka suŋgure du ba baambaaŋ di ra yigzi kuna.

ref: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi bɔr la u ni u nɛra n chemme, ií ra chɔluu, Izrɛl hina maa!

ref: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
text: Bɛnjamin dee la n du tama a dizi maa biinii tɔ see, Juda dee sitɔɔra hiŋ, ka Zɛbulɔn ni Naftali ge dizi sitɔɔra ra hiŋ.

ref: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagli i fɔŋŋa, fɔŋŋa la hiŋ faa bagli yaa la.

ref: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
text: Dikuu i Dia la n du Jɛrusalɛm wia, koora daŋ kpa kuna wa sunzii.

ref: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
text: Izi hau Ijip hina la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ sechuma, n du nii nua kooree biini la ni. Tɛr hɛssi la hina la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ nabalkpila ni nabizi la digna, di ra ba saŋa la ba maa n niŋ wa togni i see, di kpa ba saliŋhuŋŋa sunzii! Duŋŋi banla maa n nɔŋŋi laal la, bá yaari.

ref: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
text: Nabɔnzi la n chigɛ tɛɛ Ijip hina daŋ ba, Itiopia hina ge kpa bahinaa wa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi.

ref: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
text: Durnya kossi maa, ií yir yira di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ií yir yira di ra chɔluu,

ref: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
text: waabuu soge baamazi ni faala maa la. Ií keŋŋi digna di ra nuu u pogzaa.

ref: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
text: Ií ra sii Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa wia, u zenni tɔ Izrɛl hina ninɛɛ, u fɔŋŋa ge du chiŋ.

ref: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
text: Di Kɔraawiizi wa lii u Dia la di ra ba, u wia ɔɔ dɔɔ ɔnsiirɛ werge. Waabuu Izrɛl hina ra hum, u ra tɛɛ baa kpegzi. Ií ra chɔluu!

ref: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ! N tɔɔrɔɔ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nii n suwee hel n baŋaa.

ref: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
text: A ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ minna nir kpɛchɛgaa la n luŋŋe biinii, bɔhilii waa hoo ń chi. N hel ville, nii lɔ di ra nyiŋŋi u diŋ.

ref: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
text: N wiiwoo nyiŋŋi hiinaa guŋŋ wa kuuh, n loobii maa hil, n siwee waa kaa ra na nɛnnɛ, dikuu miŋ wiiwe di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa i be wia.

ref: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
text: Banla n hahŋ pɛɛpɛɛ, kpillɔɔ di kaali n nyuhuna. N dɔma kanni karaa chugiŋ, ba dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi ba kpuŋ. Kuna la miŋ waa ŋmɛɛwɛ, ka ba ɔɔ firimbuu n turgaa.

ref: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i zum n gɛnaa wiarɛ, n wichɔgaa waa i ni suahwɛ.

ref: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
text: I wiarɛ ba ra chagziŋ, hiihzi ge ra kpuŋ.

ref: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
text: N jaa ɛɛu lugɔ famaruu n mɛɛ biizi be, di birgi lugɔ hɛrduma hinuu n maa biizi be.

ref: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
text: I Dia wiarɛ aah n siwii werge maa, chagzaa la banna chagzii la ge bir di ra chugiŋ.

ref: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
text: Di n waa wii, di vɔɔ nua, nɛra ɔɔ ra chagzimbuu, ka n lau n hiŋ.

ref: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
text: Di n wa laali gbɔglɔŋ, n ɔɔ birgi chɛɛtɛ kunnɛ.

ref: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
text: Banla n ɔɔ so a bol dominuuzi, ɔɔ ra ɛɛmbuu chɛɛtɛ, banla n nyɔɔ siŋ di ra dɛɛzi ge kpaŋ birgi ba yira kuŋ.

ref: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ka miŋwaa ra suŋŋiibuu, nuu n suŋŋaa, saŋa la n parii, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n kannɛ werge ani hiŋ ŋɔ nua lugɔ i daŋ lɛɛŋ la wia.

ref: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii n tɔɔrɔɔ n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ kpɛchɛgaa n luŋŋe, n na nyiŋŋi n nir a biini la. Lɛɛŋ lii banla n hahŋ be, di gilɛɛ gil niivile diŋ.

ref: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
text: Gilɛɛ gil a niizenaa wa tɔ n ni, di gilɛɛ gil a niivile diŋ gɛɛ ŋmama diŋ.

ref: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nuu n suŋŋaa, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia, i nɛsunaa n kannɛ la wia, nuu n be.

ref: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
text: Gilɛɛ bir i har kpu i balii, dikuubɛɛwiai, n du tɔɔrɔɔ werge biinii, nuu n wiisuŋŋaa manaŋ!

ref: Come and save me from my enemies.
text: Ba n be wa lɛɛŋ, wa lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma be.

ref: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
text: I zum gunla nɛra n na ɛɛmbuu chɛɛtɛ, gunla miŋ di hiihzi, di nyaa girme. I ra na n dɔma ge maanii.

ref: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
text: Chɛɛtɛ gillɔɔ n biini chɔgi, n bɔra maa ge huah. N na ɛɛ bampirtigaa tamiirɛ, ka maa nawɛɛ, di ra nyiŋŋi banla n niŋ tig n bampirii, ka maa bɛl maa nawɛɛ.

ref: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
text: Lɔzi n waa kpuŋ, ba kpa kpolle du n diwee biini, niinyɔgzi ge n wa lawiŋ, ba kpa sinnyɛgrɛ tɛŋ.

ref: Blind them with darkness and make them tremble.
text: Gil ba siwee biri, bá na bɔr huhzi. Gil ba gɛrgi di hanna la!

ref: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
text: Gil i baaŋ fuuh ba ni werge, di kpa i baaŋfuuih la wia n dɔɔ ɔnsii la di chɔgi baa.

ref: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
text: Gil ba diini birgi diiwooni, nɛr maa wàá ka du a biine,

ref: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ba ra sunni banla hiŋ du pira labuu, di ra ŋɔ ba bɔra wiila wia.

ref: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
text: Sɛbi ba wichɔgaa maa dau, di gilɛɛ gil ba waa jaa i nɛra lɛɛi la biini.

ref: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
text: Dinzi ba sɔna lii banla sɔna baŋ sɛbɛɛ du miibɔɔ hɔŋ biini, di gilɛɛ gil ba waa jaa banla wia n deŋlee la biini.

ref: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n bɔra ra wiiu, n tamii tuŋ, lalliŋ chiŋ, di lɛɛŋ!

ref: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
text: N daŋ yir yir darguu, di kpa jaaŋ tɛu girme.

ref: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
text: Gunnɛ niŋ par Kɔraawiizi, kaali miŋ kpa navarga lizi mbusu u be gɛɛ miŋ kpa nabal n helle werge lizi mbusu u be.

ref: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
text: Di banla banna sunni la wa na guŋ, ba bɔra daŋ sɔɔni, banla ge n na jaami Kɔraawiizi la daŋ dɔɔ bɔkpega.

ref: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra nuu nyaara wiisuŋŋaarɛ, waa ɔɔ ra suuh u nɛra la baŋ tɔɔgɛɛ diini wia.

ref: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
text: Gil kuna la maa n du chiŋ, hɛri ani muuni biine ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi,

ref: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi daŋ lɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm hina, di bir ma Juda bolzenaa la maa. U nɛra daŋ du de, di dɔɔ a hɛri.

ref: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
text: U balaa biizi daŋ kpau birgi ba kuŋ, banla maa n nɔŋŋuu la jaa du de.

ref: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ! Jaande maa, ba manaŋ wa hiiniŋ!

ref: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
text: Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi ba kpuŋ la, di hiihzi di bugmi. Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi ba duŋ pira la, bir har di di hiihzi.

ref: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
text: Gil banla n na ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ la hɔrmi, dikuu hiŋ kpegli baa, ba di hiihzi wia.

ref: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
text: Ama, gil banlawaa maa n na jaamii la, dɔɔ bɔsɔna i be, di gil banla n nɔŋŋi i nɛra lɛɛi wia la ɔɔ ra ŋɔ saŋa maa, “Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!”

ref: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, miŋwaa ɛɛ anuula hinnɛ, di ɛɛ nyaari, ba n be manaŋ. Hinuu ɛɛ n hiini ani n Lɛɛri, Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, gilɛɛ waa birgi!

ref: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ! Jaande maa, ba manaŋ wa hiiniŋ!

ref: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
text: Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi ba kpuŋ la, di hiihzi di bugmi. Gil banla n na nyiŋŋi ba duŋ pira la, bir har di di hiihzi.

ref: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
text: Gil banla n na ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ la hɔrmi, dikuu hiŋ kpegli baa, ba di hiihzi wia.

ref: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
text: Ama, gil banlawaa maa n na jaamii la, dɔɔ bɔsɔna i be, di gil banla n nɔŋŋi i nɛra lɛɛi wia la ɔɔ ra ŋɔ saŋa maa, “Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!”

ref: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, miŋwaa ɛɛ anuula hinnɛ, di ɛɛ nyaari, ba n be manaŋ. Hinuu ɛɛ n hiini ani n Lɛɛri, Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, gilɛɛ waa birgi!

ref: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n chɔwɔɔrɛ wa zuui, ŋmɛnɛ maa, gilɛɛ wa gil n na di hiihzi!

ref: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
text: I wia n deŋlee la wia, hiiniŋ di lɛɛŋ, nuu n be, di lɛɛŋ!

ref: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
text: Ɛɛ lugɔ bikpeg la min niŋ ɔɔ chɔ ga suah u biini saŋa maa. Ŋɔ bá lɛɛŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n bii ni n diikpeg.

ref: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, lɛɛŋ lii biinikpola hina be, di lɛɛŋ lii sikpegii hina la n ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra la be.

ref: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, n kpa n tamiirɛ du i ni, n pɔlaa saŋa maanii n yardii.

ref: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
text: Hinuu n dɛlli lii n lulaa saŋa maa, hinuu gillɛ n maa luliŋ. N danna chɔlii saŋa maa.

ref: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
text: N de dui ɛɛ daansɛɛrɛ tɛɛ nɛkpila maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ɛɛ n guuri.

ref: and I praise and honor you all day long.
text: Hɔpizii maanii n na chɔlii, di ra sii i girme wia.

ref: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
text: Gilɛɛ waa vɛɛŋ di ra ta, di n wa zɛŋŋɔ, gilɛɛ wa vɛɛŋ di ra ta, di n wa gɛrgɔɔ,

ref: My enemies are plotting because they want me dead.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, n dɔma ra ŋɔ n wiarɛ, banla n suahzɛɛ di ra ta n kpui jina.

ref: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
text: Ba ra ŋɔu, “Kɔraawiizi vɛɛubuu ta, ya duŋŋuu di lawuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛr maa waa hoo ú lɛɛu.”

ref: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ vɛɛŋ ta ka kaali bɔɔnɛɛ, ba manaŋ wa lɛɛŋ!

ref: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
text: Chɔgi banla n kpa wia di ra chugiŋ la, bá di hiihzi, di gil banla n na nyiŋŋi ba duŋ pira la, birgi chɛɛtɛ kuna, di ŋmaabi.

ref: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
text: Ka miŋwaa daŋ kpa n tamii maa du i ni saŋa maa, di ra chɔlii werge maa.

ref: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
text: N danna ŋɔ i wideŋlaa wia, di ra ŋɔ i nɛlɛɛi wia hɔpizii maa, haali miŋ waa u zɛɛ zummɛ di ga tuŋ gba.

ref: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la, n daŋ zuu i Dia di sii i nuukpuuri wia ɛɛi wia, di sii i bɛmbɛŋ wideŋlaa wia.

ref: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n pɔlaa saŋa maanii i bagliŋ wia, n haa ra ŋɔ i nuukpuuri wia la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wiarɛ.

ref: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, haali miŋ zɛŋŋɛ, n nyuu huuhzi naa gba, gilɛɛ wa vɛɛŋ di ra ta, guŋŋ n wa bagli i fɔŋŋa wia tɛɛ banla ban niŋ haa lul la, i zenni wia tɛɛ banla maa ban niŋ haa ba la.

ref: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wideŋlaa kannɔɔ werge, i ɛɛ wizenaare werge maa, nɛr maa waa hoo lugɔi.

ref: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
text: Haali hiŋ gillɛ n na tɔɔrɔɔkpila n kpolle gba, ka i daŋ bir kuari n de dui wia, hàá gil n zuu ŋmam biini.

ref: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
text: I daŋ bir gil n dɔɔ girme jaa, di kaa tig n bampirii.

ref: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, n daŋ lɔ kem chɔlii, dikuu i wibii dɔɔi wia. N daŋ kpa janjalaŋ yir yira chɔlii, Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la.

ref: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
text: N danna chaasi ni bɔsɔna, di n wa yir yira di ra chɔlii, dikuu hiŋ lɛɛŋ la wia.

ref: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
text: N danna ŋɔ i wideŋlaa wia, hɔpizii maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, banla n na nyiŋŋi ba duŋ pira la, cholloo di hiihzi.

ref: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagli a koori gunla hinna di seriya ni wibii, bagluu i himmaa wibii dii la,

ref: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
text: guŋ gil u wer di ra di kora i nɛra ni, ni wibii, di ra binni banla banna sunni la, ni wideŋlaa.

ref: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
text: Gil a hɛri dɔɔ tɔna tɛɛ a nɛra, di gil ba wia deŋli a hɛri biini.

ref: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
text: Gil a koori ra di nyaara seriya ni wibii, di ra hiini dɔgnya hina, ka chɔgi banla ge n na sunni baa la.

ref: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
text: Gil a koori du de saŋa maa, alugɔ wiizi ni baagu.

ref: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
text: Gil a koori ɛɛ lugɔ dooŋ n na nɛɛ kooni, di ɛɛ lugɔ donii n na chol hɛri.

ref: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
text: Gil wideŋlaa du de, u de dui saŋa, di gil daama du de di hanna la, saŋa la maa baagu n ninna chaani.

ref: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
text: U kora daŋ chi muuzeŋ bɛl di ga hel bɛlhiŋ, di lii Muu Yufretis ga hel hɛri tuna.

ref: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
text: Gil hɛribɔduma dizi maa wa giŋŋi u see, ú dɔma ge wa chɔɔ hɛri.

ref: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
text: Taasis hɛri koora ni koora la n du muu baaŋ hɛssi la daŋ lizi hɛri kuna di waa tɛu. Siiba ni Sɛba hɛssi koora waa sunzuu kuna.

ref: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
text: Koora maa daŋ waa sɛɛu dɔɔra, hɛssi hina maa waa humuu.

ref: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, u daŋ waa lɛɛ anuula hina la n niŋ waa wii di ra du u ni, di ra lɛɛ dɔgnya hina la n waa hiini maa dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
text: U danna suŋ gɛrga ni dɔgnya hina ni, di ɔɔ ra lɛɛ dɔgnya hina di ra lii siu be.

ref: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
text: U daŋ ɔɔ lɛɛ baa lii tɔɔraa ni firaa werge biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba miibɔɔni ɛɛ kumpazii tɛu.

ref: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛɛ a koori miibɔɔjaŋ! Gil ba kpa saliŋ lii Siiba wa tɛu. Gil nɛra suŋŋi wiizi di ra tɛu saŋa maa, di ra kissuu saŋaa saŋa maa!

ref: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
text: Gil mia su a hɛri, pattikuna tɔ giŋgimee nyuuni, di lɛɛ lugɔ Lɛbanɔn hɛri pattikuna la. Gil nɛra wazi a bolzenaa biine, alugɔ pir n ɔɔ su ni kooree la.

ref: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
text: Gil a koori sɔŋ du de di hanna la, di gil u dɔɔ nyuu, gunla wiizi n du de saŋa maa la. A hɛssi hina maa danna suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi, dí u kissi baa gunla uŋ kissi a koori la.

ref: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
text: Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la dɛg chɔlaarɛ! U bɛnnɛ ra ɛɛ wizenaa.

ref: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
text: Ií ra dargi u sɔŋ la n dɔɔ girme saŋa maa la! Gil u girme la su durnya naa maa. Ami! Ami!

ref: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
text: Jɛssɛ biibaal Koori Deevid suŋŋaa tunaa keŋ.

ref: ) God Is Good
text: ) Kɔraawiizi wibii dii yir Asaf yir

ref: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
text: Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi wia wessoo tɛɛ Izrɛl hina, di tɛɛ banla n dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu.

ref: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, n bɔra faa ra wiiu banla n na jigsi ni biinikpola hina la wia n na kuari la wiarɛ.

ref: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
text: Ba waa tɔɔrɔɔ ra di, ka dɔɔ alaanfia ni fɔŋŋa.

ref: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
text: Awia, ba jigsi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ba baŋaa kuna, kalu ge ɛɛ lugɔ ba tagtazenaa.

ref: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
text: Wichɔgaa ra lii ba bampiree biinii, ba nfɛrchɔgaa ge waa maga dɔɔwɛ.

ref: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
text: Ba ɔɔ ra mam nɛraa, di ŋɔ wichɔgaa di ra du ba ni, di ra jigsi, di ra ta jina bá sunni nɛra.

ref: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
text: Guŋ wia, Kɔraawiizi nɛra ɔɔ biruu di ra chɔli baa, di yardi ba wiŋɔzi maa manaŋ.

ref: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
text: Ba ɔɔ ra ŋɔu, “Kɔraawiizi wàá zum, Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la wàá na.”

ref: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
text: Gunnɛ biinikpola hina du la, ba ɔɔ dɔɔ kunaa werge, ka ɔɔ haa na aŋhina di ra jaa.

ref: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
text: Pɛɛpɛɛrɛ n gil n biini huuhzi, wibii maa, pɛɛpɛɛrɛ miŋ waa wichɔgaa ge ra ɛɛ.

ref: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ giluu n na di tɔɔrɔɔ hɔpizii maa, chɔɔzi maanii u ɔɔ tɛr n digni.

ref: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
text: Di n vii ŋɔ a guŋ widɔŋaa, guŋwaa, n faa waa u biizi wiɛɛlaa la ra ɛɛ.

ref: It was hard for me to understand all this!
text: N ɛɛ aniaa ń zum a wia naa zɛɛ, ka a faa du kpol tɛŋ,

ref: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
text: ka miŋ wa zuu u Dia biini labuu, n jaa zum wia la n niŋ wa huuzi biinikpola hina.

ref: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
text: Wibii maa, u daŋ kpa baa du bɔra la n na hɛhrgi, di gil ba chogli, bá wia chɔgi!

ref: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
text: Ba daŋ kpu baa kakpaŋ, ba laba chum.

ref: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
text: Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ deeza la hɔɔ n ɔɔ pizi ba suuah la, di Kɔraawiizi wa izi chiŋ, ba ɔɔ lewuu.

ref: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
text: Saŋa la n biini n wa chɔkkɛ, n bɔra huah la,

ref: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
text: n faa gɛnnɔɔ lugɔ sel, maa u wiɛɛlaa zɛɛ zummɛ.

ref: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
text: Ka n haa du u benii saŋa maa, u lau n nodig kpogli.

ref: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
text: U ra baglimbuu gunla min ninna hiŋuu, a tuna, ú jaa lɛɛŋ ni girme.

ref: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
text: U bɛnnɛ n dɔɔ chiŋ, maa kaa dɔɔ kummaa de, maa kummaa ra nyiŋŋi hɛri naa, di waa lɛi.

ref: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
text: N nfɛrɛ ni n bɔra daŋ wer gɛrgi, ka Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ n kpegzi, u bɛnnɛ ɛɛ kunla miŋ dɔɔwɛ, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
text: Banla n vɛɛu la daŋ siu, bá wia tuŋ, u daŋ chɔgi banla ge wia n waa wibii dɔɔwɛ u be la.

ref: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
text: Ka miŋwaa, a wessoo miŋ dugluu. N kpa Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu ɛɛ lugɔ n diikpeg, n daŋ sii u wiɛɛlaa maa wia.

ref: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i gil yaa ta kennei? I baaŋ danna fuuh i nɛra ninɛɛ di hanna la gɛɛ?

ref: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
text: A liizi nɛra la hiŋ lɛɛwɛ faa maa la wia, dee la hiŋ lizɛɛ, ba ɛɛ i himmaa nɛra la. A liizi Bizeŋ Ziɔn la n faa ɛɛ i duuribɔr la wia.

ref: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
text: Vol koŋlaa naa baŋ purgee nyaamm naa ni na, yaa dɔma chɔgi i Dia biini kuna la maanii.

ref: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
text: I dɔma ra chaasuu werge i Dia biini, di kpa ba tuutazi baŋzi de, guŋ ɛɛ kpeglaa daansɛɛ.

ref: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
text: Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ daateŋra n du kɔr biini, di lalli ba kpaŋfɔzi bá teŋri daazi.

ref: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
text: Ba kpa kpaŋfɔzi ni silaarɛ, di ra chɔgi daapiahni la maa, baŋ kpawɛɛ mɛɛri u biini la.

ref: They burned down your temple and badly disgraced it.
text: Ba fuuh i Dia labuu, di doŋ bɔr la banna jaamii la.

ref: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
text: Ba ŋɔwɔɔrɛ ba biine, “Yaa daŋ chɔgi baa nyaamm!” Ba fuuh bɔra la maa banna jaamii labuu, a hɛri biini.

ref: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
text: Yaa waa kaa ra na i wizenaa daansɛɛ maa, i dɔgtɛɛ maa waa kawɛɛ. Yaa bɛl maa waa zum gunla a kennaa wia naa n niŋ birgi mag.

ref: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ yaa dɔma mamii di birgi magɛi? Gunnɛ ba ra chɔgi i sɔŋ di hanna laa?

ref: Why don't you punish them? Why are you holding back?
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i vɛɛ yaa hiinaai? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i kpa i nonee di bar i harɛi?

ref: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
text: Ka hinuu yaa koori faala maa, di lɛɛ yaa saŋa kpila maa.

ref: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
text: I fɔŋŋazeŋ la biini, i faa gillɔɔ a muuzeŋ bargi bɔra anɛɛ, di faa purgi a nii biini sechɔgii nyuuni.

ref: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
