text: I faa purgi muuzeŋ sechɔgii Lɛviatan la nyuunii, di kpau tɛɛ hɛribɔduma sela a di.

ref: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
text: Hinuu faa gillɛ bulli ni gɔŋa ra pal, di gil muuni la n na pal saŋa maa la hiihzi.

ref: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
text: Hinuu dɔɔ hɔpizaa ni hamuŋa maa, di chigni wiizi ni baagu a chignibɔra.

ref: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
text: Hinuu dauri hɛri magbɔɔni maa, di dau yuu ni lumaŋa saŋazi.

ref: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a liizi gunla i dɔma n na mamii ni gunla gɛnaa n na chɔgi i sɔŋ.

ref: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
text: Gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ i nɛra la n gɛrgɛɛ, di ra du ba dɔma la n dɔɔ sikpegii la nonee biini. Gilɛɛ waa suuh i nɛra la banna tɔɔri la wia.

ref: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
text: A liizi nuukpaŋ la i ni yaa n ɛɛwɛ la wia. Nɛfiraa werge su a hɛri naa bɔbiri maanii.

ref: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
text: Gilɛɛ gil banla banna sunni la bir har di hiihzi, gil nyaara ni dɔgnya hina ra chɔlii.

ref: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ, di bagli i dɔma lugɔ i hor summɔɔ! A liizi gunla gɛnaa n na mamii hɔpizii maa.

ref: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, yaa ra tɛibuu jaaŋ! Yaa ra sii gunla i zenni n kannɛ maguu, di ra ŋɔ nuukpuuri wia la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.

ref: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
text: I ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N dau seriya dii saŋaa, minuu ra di seriya ni wibii.

ref: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
text: Di hɛri waa zigli, nɛra bɔra ra sa, n daŋ lau u zɛɛ ligee di kpogli kiŋkiŋ.

ref: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
text: N ŋɔ jigsi hina benii, ‘Ií gilɛɛ ra jigsi,’ di ŋɔ biinikpola hina ge be, ‘Ií gilɛɛ ra bagli ii kpegzi.

ref: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
text: Nɛra seriya dii waa wiifurii gɛɛ wiicholii gɛɛ hɛribɔduma liwɛɛ.

ref: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizii ra di seriya, u ɔɔ tɛɛ baŋhinaa bilchɔg, ka tɛɛ baŋhina wibii.

ref: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
text: Kɔraawiizi kpogli u libeere, u su ni u baaŋfuuih alugɔ siŋkpeg. Ú fugaa tɛɛ, biinikpola hina maa, bá nyɔɔa, a wa tuŋ kɔrai.

ref: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
text: Ka miŋwaa wàá gil Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum la wia sii, n daŋ yir yira di ra chɔluu.

ref: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
text: U daŋ chɔgi biinikpola hina fɔŋŋa, ka gil banla waa wia n deŋlee, fɔŋŋa jaa.

ref: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
text: Juda hina zum Kɔraawiizii, u sɔŋ ge du kaŋ Izrɛl hina biini.

ref: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
text: U dia du Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuurɛ, Jɛrusalɛm biini.

ref: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
text: Denii u kuugi u dɔma hobee, ba laal pɛrɛtuzenaa, ba tokobizi ani ba laal kuna maa.

ref: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
text: Ba foozi ba laallɔkpega kuna maanii, ka ba siu chɔɔ, ba bɛl maa wàá ka wer lalli u nonii.

ref: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
text: Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum, saŋa la hiŋ hau ba ni la, ba zagra ni a tinna maanii choglee, di siu.

ref: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i bɛnnɛ dɛg ɔmaa, anɛɛ n niŋ wer chi i see, di i baaŋ wa fuuhwoi?

ref: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
text: Chinne i du ka di seriya, ɔnsii lau durnya hina, ba siigi,

ref: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
text: dikuu hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n izee í di seriya, di lɛɛ banla maa banna sunni la wia.

ref: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
text: Wibii maa, i baaŋ fuuih nɛra ni gillɔɔ ba ra chɔlii. Banla n lii a baaŋfuuih biini ɔɔ lau bahinaarɛ.

ref: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
text: Ií ŋɔ nuuzi tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la, di hiŋaa. Ií gil hɛssi la maa hina n bar ia la, kpa kuna wa sunzi unla n dɛg ɔmaa la.

ref: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
text: Waabuu ɔɔ gil hɛri nabɔnzi hɔrmi, durnya koora ge ra ɔmuu.

ref: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
text: N ɔɔ lɔ wilee tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ú hiiniŋ, n ɔɔ lɔ wilee tɛu, ú nuu n be.

ref: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
text: Tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa, n ɔɔ suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii, hamuŋa maanii n ɔɔ lalli n nonee di ra suŋŋuu, ka maa ɔɔ wer dɔɔ bɔsɔna.

ref: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
text: U gillɔɔ màá wer chɔɔ dɔɔ, n biini chɔgi werge maa, màá ka wer ŋɔ wia.

ref: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
text: Anna liizi hɔpizaa aŋhina n bɛrɛɛ wiarɛ, di ra liizi faala maa binni wia.

ref: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
text: “Kɔraawiizi daŋ vɛɛ yaa di hanna laa? U ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka suŋ yaa nii?

ref: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
text: Kɔraawiizi suuh u nɛsunaa dɔɔi la wiarɛ gɛɛ? U baaŋfuuih gillɔɔ waa kaa ra na nɛra sinyɛnaa?”

ref: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
text: Denii n ŋɔ, “Wii la n chɔgi n biini wergee keŋ, Kɔraawiizi waa kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa ú lɛɛ yaaa?”

ref: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
text: N danna liizi Kɔraawiizi wiɛɛlaa wia, n danna liizi wizenaa la uŋ ɛɛwɛ, faala maa la wia.

ref: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, wia la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ ɛɛ winanaananaarɛ. Vug maa waa hoo di du kpeg lugɔi.

ref: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
text: Hinuu ra ɛɛ wizenaa, i bagli i fɔŋŋaa hɛssi hina biini.

ref: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
text: I kpa i fɔŋŋaa lɛɛ i nɛra, Jekɔb ni Joosɛf naanna.

ref: The ocean looked at you, God, and it trembled deep down with fear.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, saŋa la niiri n wa nai la, ɔnsii faa lawaabuu, muuzeŋ vile maa ge ra ziigi.

ref: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
text: Baamazi nɛɛ doonne, nazaa pozi chiŋ, ka dooŋ na nyɛgzi bɔr maa.

ref: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
text: Ba nuu i nazaa pozaare vem biini, u nyɛgzaa ge faa chaani durnya maa, hɛri maa faa ziigi, di zigli.

ref: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
text: I dau ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ muuzeŋ biini, di dau ŋmɛnɛɛ niizenaa biine, ka nɛr maa waa i naazi nawɛɛ.

ref: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
text: I faa ga Moosis ni Aarɔn ninɛɛ, di tɔ i nɛra see alugɔ penɔɔni.

ref: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
text: N nɛra, ií ra nuu n baglaa, ií keŋŋi digna di ra nuu n wiŋɔzi.

ref: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
text: N wiŋɔzi daŋ ɛɛ sɛɛliizi. N daŋ ŋɔ wia aŋhina n faa suahwɛ durnya luglaa guŋŋ di wa hel zinaa.

ref: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
text: Wia la yaa n nuuwɛ di zumaa, wia la yaa naabaala n ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ yaa.

ref: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
text: Yaa wàá kpaa suah yaa biizi ni, yaa daŋ ŋɔa tɛɛ banla ban niŋ haa lul, Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa ni u nuukpuuri wia uŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.

ref: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
text: U du Gbɔgni ni nuuzii tɛɛ Izrɛl hina, n ɛɛ Jekɔb dee la. U tɛɛ yaa naabaalaa loobii, dí ba ra bagli ba biizi u Gbɔgni,

ref: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
text: guŋ gil banla ban niŋ wa lul la zumaa, di ge bagli ba biizi.

ref: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
text: Gunnɛ niŋ gil ba wer yardi Kɔraawiizi, di gilɛɛ waa suuh u wiɛɛlaa wia, ka wer di ra hiŋ u nuuzi,

ref: They would be different from their ancestors, who were stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful to God.
text: di gilɛɛ kaa wàá du lugɔ ba naabaala la n faa ɛɛ dignikpega hina ani nɛkpoŋlaa la. Ba faa waa Kɔraawiizi yardɛɛ, di kpa bahinaa tɛu.

ref: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
text: Ɛfram laallɔɔra faa vɔɔ laallɛ ani hozi, ka bir chɔ a laal lɔi hɔpizii la.

ref: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
text: Ba faa chɔgi ba ni Kɔraawiizi nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la wiarɛ, di faa vɛɛ u Gbɔgni hiŋaa.

ref: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
text: Ba faa suuh wia la uŋ ɛɛwɛ ani nuukpuuri wia la uŋ ɛɛwɛ la wiarɛ.

ref: he did for their ancestors near Zoan in Egypt.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa ɛɛ wizenaare ba naabaala see, Zoan lɛl n du Ijip hɛri biini.

ref: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
text: U faa bargi muuzenne bɔra anɛɛ, di gil ba ga hɛrhilii gi, u faa gillɔɔ a muuzeŋ nii maa chi bɔra anɛɛ alugɔ koŋlaa.

ref: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
text: Hɔpizaa saŋa, u ɔɔ faa giluu baama tɔ ba see, hamuŋa ge u gil ninlau tɔ ba see, di ra chaani baa.

ref: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
text: U pergi biarɛ hɛribɔduma biini, di tɛɛ baa nii werge alugɔ muuni.

ref: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
text: U gillɔɔ nii lii bii ni, di ra pal alugɔ muuni.

ref: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
text: Ka ba haa vɛɛ di ra ɛɛu wichɔgaa, di ra vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la nua, a hɛribɔduma biini.

ref: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
text: Di kutti ɛɛu ra na, di ra suŋŋi diwee la banna kɛlli werge.

ref: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
text: Di ŋɔ wia ra du Kɔraawiizi ni, di ra ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi daŋ wer tɛɛ yaa diwee hɛribɔduma naa?

ref: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
text: U yag biirɛ, nii pozi lii, gɔŋa ra pal werge. Ka u daŋ wer tɛɛ yaa diwee gɛɛ di wer tɛɛ yaa olaa?”

ref: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
text: Kɔraawiizi n wa nuu guŋ, u baaŋ faa fuuh ba ni alugɔ niŋ, u baaŋfuuihchɔgii nyaŋŋi ba ni,

ref: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ba wɔɔ yardɛɛ, di sɛɛ lugɔ u daŋ wer lɛɛ baa.

ref: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
text: Haali annii naa maa n ɛɛwɛ gba, ka u ŋɔ wiarɛ tɛɛ chiŋ, u pilli lugɔ gbera,

ref: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
text: diwee aŋhina, lii chiŋ chol, ba di. Kɔraawiizi bol miarɛ guŋ.

ref: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
text: Awia, ba faa di mɛlikazi diweere, u faa tɛɛ baabuu ba di piŋ.

ref: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
text: U faa gillɔɔ wiifurii peu lii chiŋ di ta, di kpa u fɔŋŋa tɔ wiikakag keŋkere bɛl peu see.

ref: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
text: U faa tɛɛ u nɛraa ol alugɔ hɛɛhraa, di tɛɛ baa zumbizi alugɔ muu nua hɛɛhriichaa.

ref: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
text: U faa gillɔɔ a chogli ba chɔɔribɔr biini, di yaari ba tanti diini kɛraa maa.

ref: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
text: Denii a nɛra di di piŋ nɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u tɛɛ baabuu diwee la banna kɛlli werge.

ref: But before they had swallowed the last bite,
text: Ka ba faa haa waa diwee, ba kɛkɛluu tuŋ, ba faa haa ra diu,

ref: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
text: ka Kɔraawiizi baaŋ faa fuuh ba ni, u kpu ba fɔŋŋa hina, Izrɛl hina biipɔllaa la.

ref: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
text: Awia, u faa gillɔɔ ba hɔpizaa tuŋ alugɔ heeza kakpaŋ, ba laba chum.

ref: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
text: Di Kɔraawiizi haŋ wa kpu baŋhina, banla n kawɛɛ la ɔɔ biruu di ra nyiŋŋi u bɔr. Ba ɔɔ giluu ba wichɔgaa wia chɔgi ba biine, ba ra suŋŋuu nɛnnɛ.

ref: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
text: Ba ɔɔ liizuu lugɔ Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ ba guuri, di liizi lugɔ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu ɛɛ ba Lɛɛri.

ref: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
text: Ka ba faa ra daruubuu ni ba nuuzi, ba wiŋɔzi ɛɛ kara.

ref: they were unfaithful and broke their promises.
text: Ba bampiree faa wɔɔ lauwɛ, ba waa u ni baa nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la yardɛɛ.

ref: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi faa na u nɛra sinyɛnaa, di gil ba wichɔgaa tɛɛ baa, waa baa kpuwɛɛ. Saŋa kpila maanii u ɔɔ lau u hiŋ, waa ɔɔ gil u baaŋ maa izi.

ref: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
text: U faa liizoore lugɔ ba ɛɛ kuna la n niŋ siwuu, di ɛɛ lugɔ pechule n kaalɛɛ, wàá ka bir ba la.

ref: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
text: Saŋa kpila maa, ba ɔɔ faa ɛɛ dignikpega hinaa hɛribɔduma biini, di gil u biini chɔgi!

ref: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
text: Ba ɔɔ tuuzuubuu, di ɛɛu ra na, di gil Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la baaŋ ɔɔ ra fuuh.

ref: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
text: Ba faa suuh u fɔŋŋa ani hɔpizii la uŋ lɛɛ baa lii ba dɔma nonee biini

ref: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
text: ani nuukpuuri wia uŋ ɛɛwɛ Zoan lɛl n du Ijip hɛri la wiarɛ.

ref: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
text: U faa gillɔɔ ba muuni birgi chal, Ijip hina faa waa kaa dɔɔ niinyɔɔlii.

ref: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
text: U faa gillɔɔ nakɛɛhzi su ba hɛri maa, di ra tɔɔri baa, sampussi ge chɔgi ba hɛri.

ref: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.
text: U faa gil lotorozi wa chɔgi ba pattikuna ni ba kooni.

ref: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
text: U faa gillɔɔ dobia wa chɔgi ba grepu ni ba fig daazi.

ref: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
text: Di faa gil dobia kpu ba nauna, nazaa ge kpu ba peeza.

ref: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
text: Kɔraawiizi baaŋ faa fuuhwoo werge, u ra fuuri, di gil mɛlikazi kpa tɔɔrɔɔzeŋ wa kpu baa.

ref: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.
text: U faa waa u hiŋ lauwɛ, u baaŋfuuih hiŋ biini, di lɛɛ baa lii siu be, ka gil wiilchɔgii kpu baa.

ref: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.
text: U faa kpu Ijip hina dia maa biibambiluglii.

ref: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
text: Ka jaa kpogli u nɛra, lii alugɔ penɔɔni, di tɔ ba see di ga hɛribɔduma biini.

ref: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
text: U faa guu baabuu nɛnnɛ, awia, ɔnsii faa waa baa lauwɛ, ka a muuzeŋ faa di ba dɔma waa maa.

ref: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
text: Ka faa jaa kpogli baa ba u hɛrnaniinanii la, giŋgimee hɛri hina la u himmaa n kpeglee, ka lɛɛ la.

ref: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
text: U faa duŋŋi a hɛssi hinaa ba lii, saŋa la u nɛra n faa ra ba la, ka kpa ba hɛri bɔnni Izrɛl hina dizi, di kpa ba diini tɛɛ u nɛra.

ref: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
text: Ka ba faa kpoŋŋoo, di ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la na. Ba faa waa u nuuzi la ra hiŋ,

ref: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
text: ka faa dɔɔ dignikpega, di nyaa wibii alugɔ ba mɛɛwaa. Hàá wer dɛlli ba ni alugɔ hoo la n chɔkkɛ.

ref: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
text: Ba vuga kuaribɔra faa gillɔɔ Kɔraawiizi baaŋ fuuh, di gil u zoma izi dikuu a wia.

ref: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
text: Kɔraawiizi n wa na ba wiɛɛlaa, u baaŋ faa fuuh, u vɛɛ Izrɛl hina kɔrai.

ref: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
text: U faa lii u Tanti Dia la n du Silo, bɔr la uŋ faa duwɛɛ ba biini la.

ref: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
text: Di faa gil yaa dɔma wa foozi, u ni yaa Nuukpaŋ Dɔɔi Dakka la, n faa ra bagli u fɔŋŋa ni u girme la.

ref: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
text: U baaŋ faa fuuh u nɛra ninɛɛ, u gil ba dɔma kpu baa.

ref: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
text: Ba faa kpu ba biipɔllaarɛ laal biini, guŋ wia, ba suŋgure wàá ka na baala yuu.

ref: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
text: Ba faa kpu Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, ka ba waa sɛɛwɛ ba luhaana wii.

ref: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi faa jaa izi alugɔ uŋ izi dɔɔ, di ɛɛ lugɔ nɛr n nyɔɔ siŋ di dɛɛzi, ka u siwee jaa ra chaani la.

ref: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
text: Di duŋŋi u dɔma, di kpa hiihzi la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ kpu baa.

ref: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
text: U faa vɛɛ Joosɛf naannaa, u faa waa Ɛfram dee lizɛɛ,

ref: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
text: ka faa lizi Juda dee ni Bizeŋ Ziɔn la un nɔŋŋɛɛ werge la.

ref: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
text: Denii u faa ma u Dia la u du alugɔ u bol n du chiŋ, di gil u chi nɛnnɛ, waa ziigi lugɔ hɛri, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
text: Denii u faa lizi u balii Deevid, di lizuu lii peeza diiribɔr,

ref: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
text: bɔr la uŋ faa ra nɔɔni peeza, u waa binni u nɛra Izrɛl hina la n ɛɛ u kapɛttɛ kuna la ni lugɔ penɔɔni.

ref: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
text: Deevid faa ra binni a nɛra ninɛɛ ni biinihuŋŋu, di tɔ ba see nɛnnɛ.

ref: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nɛra la n wɛɛ zummɛ ballɔɔ, di wa foozi i hɛri. Ba chɔg i Diinaniinanii labuu, di puri Jɛrusalɛm.

ref: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
text: Ba kpu i balaarɛ ta, di tɛɛ duuni á di, i nɛra bɔra di tɛɛ pir sela á di.

ref: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
text: I nɛra hiŋ challi ra pal alugɔ nii Jɛrusalɛm biini maa, ka nɛr maa waa hoo, ú hug baa.

ref: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i baaŋ daŋ fuuuh di hanna la gɛɛ? I baaŋ danna diu lugɔ ninlau gɛɛ?

ref: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
text: Gil i baaŋ la izi hɛssi la hina n wɛɛ zummɛ, kossi ani nɛra la n wɛɛ ra jaami la ni,

ref: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ba kpu i nɛraa di chɔgi i hɛri.

ref: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
text: Gilɛɛ kpa yaa naabaala wichɔgaa kim, di turgi yaa. Na yaa sinyɛna filaŋkeŋ, yaa waa kaa dɔɔ tamii maa.

ref: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiini yaa di lɛɛ yaa, lɛɛ yaa, di gil yaa wichɔgaa tɛɛ yaa, dikuu i himmaa girme la wia.

ref: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ a hɛssi hina ra pɛɛzi, “Lee Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la duɛi?” Gil ya na gunla hin niŋ tɛr a hɛssi hina digna, dikuu baŋ kpu i balaa wia.

ref: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
text: A nuu banla baŋ tɔwɛɛ dia uuraa. I fɔŋŋazeŋ la biini, gil banla baŋ di seriya ba dɛg lugɔ ba siu la, bir na bahinaa.

ref: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bir turgi a hɛssi hina naa buniidaanɛɛ, dikuu baŋ chagzii la wia.

ref: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
text: Denii yaa banla n ɛɛ i nɛra, di ɛɛ lugɔ i peeza, jaa ra jaamii, saŋaa saŋa maa. Di lii jimini bɛl di ra la bɛl, yaa danna chɔlii.

ref: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
text: Izrɛl hina Penɔɔni, keŋŋi digni di nuu yaa be, hinla n ɛɛ i nɛra sitɔɔri alugɔ penɔɔni la, hìŋ́ unla n soge i koorikara ni chɛrubzi baambaaŋ la.

ref: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
text: Kpa i hiŋ bagli Ɛfram, Bɛnjamin ani Manasɛ dizi. Bagli yaa i fɔŋŋa, di wa lɛɛ yaa!

ref: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bir wa lɛɛ yaa! Suŋ yaa ni, yá wer na lɛɛi!

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, ɛrɛɛ i baaŋ ra fuuh di birgi mag, i nɛra wiisuŋŋaa la wiai?

ref: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
text: I gillɔɔ biinichɔg birgi lugɔ yaa diwee, sinii ge birgi lugɔ yaa niinyɔɔlii.

ref: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
text: I gillɔɔ hɛssi la n bar yaa la, ra naa dikuu yaa hɛri wia, yaa dɔma jaa ra chagzi yaa.

ref: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, bir kuari yaa soŋŋi! Suŋ yaa ni, ya wer na lɛɛi!

ref: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
text: I kpogli i nɛraa lugɔ grepu daa lii Ijip ba, di wa duŋŋi hɛssi la hina, ka kpau chɔɔzi.

ref: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
text: I par bɔruu di tɛu ú wer hel, di du lunne, di talmi tɔ a hɛri maa.

ref: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
text: U talmi bizenaa nyuuni, u bɔsɔŋ tɔ a maa, di talmi tɔ hɛriŋkpola daazenaa la maa ni.

ref: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
text: U talmɔɔrɛ ga hel Muuzeŋ Mɛditerenɛn la, di kaa kpa guŋŋ ga hel Muu Yufretis gba.

ref: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i purgi koŋlii la n baruu chem, guŋ gil nɛr la maa n ga de ra kaali, jaa ra tɔrgi u nɔnai?

ref: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
text: Heri lii kɔr biinii di waa chɔguu, pir sela ge waa diu.

ref: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, bir ba yaa be! Binni yaa di lii chiŋ! A binni grepu daa naa n chigɛ tɛɛ Izrɛl hina naa ni,

ref: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
text: daa la hiŋ kpa i himmaa fɔŋŋa di chɔɔzi, u ɛɛ lugɔ biibaal la hiŋ dɛɛzɛɛ tɛɛ i hiŋ la!

ref: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
text: Yaa dɔma ŋmɛnnuubuu ta, di duu niŋ, hau ba ni, di chɔgi baa!

ref: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
text: A guu nɛra la hiŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ i hiŋ, di gil ba du kpeg la.

ref: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
text: Yaa ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka bir har kpui, bir tɛɛ yaa fɔŋŋa, ya ra dargii.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, bir kuari yaa soŋŋi. Suŋ yaa ni, ya wer na lɛɛi.

ref: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
text: Ií ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna, di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ yaa fɔŋŋa la. Ií ra chaasi werge, di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum!

ref: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
text: Ií faari di ra yir yira, di ra yigzi kuna. Ií kpa janjalanzi ni kem, di lɔ yirsuma ra tɛu.

ref: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
text: Ií huuh bensunoniina, di faari Baagufalii Hɔpizizeŋ dii, di kaa huuuh, di a baagu wa ɛɛ bir.

ref: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
text: Izrɛl hina widauliirɛ keŋ, Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum, labuu dau a wii naa.

ref: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
text: Saŋa la uŋ faa pig Ijip hina, di lɔ baa labuu, u faa dawuu tɛɛ Izrɛl hina. Denii n nuu loobii bɛl n na ŋɔ,

ref: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
text: “Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi lɛɛ ii buntɔgaa lii ii baŋaazi, di gil ii nonee heezi.

ref: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
text: Iiŋ faa du tɔɔrɔɔ biini di lɔ wile tɛŋ, n wa lɛɛ iabuu. N faa lii n suahribɔr nazaa biinii, di nuu ii be, di faa ɛɛ ia na Mɛriba bulli la bɔr.

ref: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
text: N nɛra, ií ra nuu n karfaa, Izrɛl hina, n bɔra daŋ vii sɔɔni, di ii vii nuuwɔ tɛŋ!

ref: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
text: Ií gilɛɛ kaa wàá dɔɔ vug maa ii biini, ií gilɛɛ waa tognaa.

ref: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
text: Minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum, unla n kpogli ia lii Ijip hɛri la. Di ii wia dɔɔ wibii, n daŋ kissi ia.

ref: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
text: Ka n nɛra faa waa nuuwɛ tɛŋ, Izrɛl hina faa waa sɛɛwɛ, bá ra hiŋ n ŋmɛnizi la.

ref: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
text: Awia, n faa gil baabuu, ba ra ɛɛ ba dignikpega wiɛɛlaa, di ra ɛɛ ba kipar.

ref: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
text: Di n nɛra daŋ vii nuu ra tɛŋ, di Izrɛl hina daŋ vii ra hiŋ n ŋmɛnizi,

ref: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
text: n daŋ vii kpegli ba dɔma manaŋ, di tɔɔri baa!

ref: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
text: Banla n hah mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la, daŋ wa togni n see ni ɔnsii. Ba dignitɛraa daŋ du de, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
text: Ka n daŋ kpa huutinanaa dɛɛzi iawaa, di gil ii ɔɔ di huuhnuunanaa piŋ.”

ref: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
text: Kɔraawiizi sogo u nabɔmbɔttɛ chiŋ, a chaalizeŋ biini, di ra di u balaa seriya, di ra ŋɔ,

ref: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
text: “Ɛrɛɛ ii lɛɛ nɛra la wia n waa deŋlee nuuzi, di birgi magɛi, di lɛɛ ra jaa biinikpola hina ninɛi?

ref: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
text: Ií ra lɛɛ nyaara ani lalbiizi nuuzi, di lɛɛ wibii ra tɛɛ dɔgnya hina ni banla banna sunni.

ref: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
text: Ií ra lɛɛ baa di ra lii biinikpola hina nonee biini.

ref: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
text: Ii waa wiimaa zummɛ! Ii gɛnnɔɔ! Ii ɔɔ ra lɛɛ kunaa, wibii dii tuŋ durnya biini.

ref: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
text: N ŋɔ, ‘Ii bɛl maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi, ii maa ɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la biizii.’

ref: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
text: Ka ii maanii niŋ siuzi alugɔ newea, ii maa miibɔɔni tuŋ alugɔ koora gba n ɔɔ wa siuzi la.”

ref: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ di di durnya maa seriya, dikuubɛɛwiai, hɛssi hina maa ɛɛ i horaa.

ref: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ siigi, gilɛɛ sigli, gilɛɛ ɛɛ kirkir!

ref: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
text: Na! I dɔma ra ta jinaa, banla ge n haih la birgi nɛkpoŋlaa.

ref: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
text: Ba suahzɔɔrɛ di ra ta, i nɛra la hinna guu la jina.

ref: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
text: Ba ra ŋɔu, “Ií ba ya chɔgi baa, bá dim, nɛra wàá ka liizi Izrɛl sɔŋ ŋmɛnɛ maa.”

ref: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
text: Ba ta jinaa, di ɛɛ nuukpaŋ bá yooi,

ref: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
text: baabuu, Ɛdɔm, Ismɛl, Moab ani Hagri hina,

ref: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
text: di kaa kpa Gɛbal, Ammɔn, Amalɛk, Filisti ani Taaya hina.

ref: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
text: Asiiria hina gba jaa ba ninɛɛ, bá tɛɛ Lɔt naanna Ammɔn ni Moab hina, fɔŋŋa di jaa.

ref: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
text: Ɛɛ baa gunla hiŋ faa ɛɛ Midian hina ani Sisɛra ni Jabin la n faa ɛɛ ba laallɔɔra nabɔnzi, Muu Kisɔn la.

ref: near Endor, and let their bodies rot.
text: Ba faa siu Ɛndɔ biinii di ɛɛ lugɔ kpaga.

ref: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
text: n faa ŋɔwɛɛ, “Ií gil ya lɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hɛri la, ú birgi yaa hor.”

ref: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil ba yaari lugɔ paŋhoohilaa, lugɔ zɔga peu n kpawɛɛ.

ref: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil hiihzi kpu baa werge maa, di gil ba zum i fɔŋŋa wia.

ref: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
text: Gil ba kpegli baa, ɔnsii lau baa, saŋaa saŋa maa, di gil ba siu ni hiihzi werge.

ref: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
text: Gil ba zum lugɔ i bɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi, di ɛɛ durnya naa maa Koorizeŋ.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, i Dia wia du n bampiriire werge maa.

ref: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
text: N bɔra daŋ sɔɔni di n vii du de! N na nyiŋŋuu n du i Dia la biini, di yir bɔsɔna yira di ra tɛɛ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n du de saŋa maa, n de dui biini maa.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
text: Jooga dɔɔ daŋaa, koŋkoroŋbizi gba dɔɔ a diini di ɔɔ du a biizi dugli i mbusu lizibɔr. Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la minna hum, hinuu n koori.

ref: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
text: Banla maa n du i Dia, di ɔɔ yir yira ra chɔlii, nuu sumaa.

ref: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
text: Banla maa fɔŋŋa n lii Kɔraawiizi be, ba aah siwii bá la ga na Bizeŋ Ziɔn, nuu sumaa.

ref: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
text: Baŋ waa ga Baka Waluu biini la, guŋ faa gillɔɔ u birgi bulli, yuuliŋ dooŋ ge faa gil u vile suugi.

ref: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
text: Ba fɔŋŋa danna jaau guŋŋ, ka bɛl maa wa chi Kɔraawiizi see, Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa. Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum, keŋŋi digni di nuu n be.

ref: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, kissi koori la hiŋ lizɛɛ ŋɔ u ra guu yaa la.

ref: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
text: Nɛr n du i Dia hɔpizikpannɛ bɔ, uŋ di hɔpizaa kagboŋ yembɛl. Miŋ ɛɛ i Dia dominua binnii bɔ, min du biinikpola hina diini.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
text: Kɔraawiizii koori la n ɛɛ girme hiŋ, di ra guu yaa. U ɔɔ ra kissi yaabuu ni winanaa ni girme, wàá sɛɛ kpolli banla maa n na ɛɛ wideŋlaa u be, winanii maa.

ref: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, banla maa n yardii, nuu sumaa.

ref: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i faa suŋ i hɛri hina ninɛɛ, di gil ba wia kaa kuari.

ref: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
text: I gil i nɛra wichɔgaarɛ tɛɛ baa, di gil wia la maa baŋ ɛɛwɛ leu la tɛɛ baa.

ref: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
text: I gillɔɔ i baaŋ waa kaa ra fuuh ba ni, i di baa kanyitti.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ yaa Lɛɛri, bir wa lɛɛ yaa, di gilɛɛ ka gil yaa wia ra chɔgi i biini.

ref: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
text: I baaŋ daŋ fuuh yaa ninɛɛ di hanna la gɛɛ? I baaŋ ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá sɔɔniaa?

ref: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
text: Kaa bir tɛɛ yaa fɔŋŋa, guŋ gil ya ra chɔlii.

ref: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
text: N na nuu gunla Kɔraawiizi n na ŋɔu, u ŋɔ nuarɛ bampirsɔna wia, di ra tɛɛ yaa banla n ɛɛ u nɛra, di yaa wàá ka bir har di gaa ɛɛ gɛnni wia.

ref: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
text: Wibii maa, u ɛɛ siryaa, ú lɛɛ banla n na tɛu girme, ú girme su yaa hɛri.

ref: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
text: Nɔŋŋaa ani wibii daŋ kpau alugɔ dammuzi, wideŋlaa ge ni bampirsɔna ɛɛ kpaŋ.

ref: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
text: Wibii dii daŋ lii durnya hina be, di la Kɔraawiizi be, wideŋlaa ge lii Kɔraawiizi be, di ba durnya hina be.

ref: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil ya nyɛɛli, di gil yaa hɛri du sum, kuna lɛɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
text: Kɔraawiizi wideŋlaa daŋ tɔ u see, alugɔ nɛr, di wa kuari ŋmɛnɛɛ dawuu.

ref: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, keŋŋi digni di nuu n wiisuŋŋaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, n nyaawɔɔ di ɛɛ anuula hiŋ.

ref: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii siu be, dikuubɛɛwiai, n kpa n hinnɛ tɛi. Hinuu Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, lɛɛ i balii la n yardii.

ref: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na n sinyɛna, dikuubɛɛwiai, hɔpizaa maanii anna suŋŋii.

ref: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil i balii bɔra sɔɔni, dikuubɛɛwiai, n na suŋŋiibuu ni biinihuŋŋu.

ref: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
text: I wia wessoo, i ɔɔ gil yaa wichɔgaarɛ ra tɛɛ yaa. I nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la du banla maa n na suŋŋii benii.

ref: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa, a nuu n wile di na n sinyɛna.

ref: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
text: N tɔɔrɔɔ hɔpizii, n daŋ yirii, dikuu hin niŋ nuu tɛŋ wia.

ref: No other gods are like you; only you work miracles.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, vug maa waa hoo di du kpeg lugɔi. I bɛnnɛ ra ɛɛ wizenaa.

ref: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
text: Hɛssi la maa hiŋ tawɛɛ la hina, daŋ ba i see di waa jaamii, ba daŋ waa dargii,

ref: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, i ɛɛ nɛzenne. I bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi di ra ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia.

ref: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagliŋ i ŋmɛnɛɛ, n na hiŋ i wibii la, tɛŋ bampirkpaŋ, n na tɔgzii.

ref: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n danna chɔlii ni n biini maa, n danna dargii saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
text: Dikuu i nɔŋŋaa hiŋ nɔŋŋiŋ saŋa maa, n kannɛ werge maa wia, i lɛɛmbuu lii siu be.

ref: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, banla n na jigsi izoore chi n ni, sikpegii hina ra nyiŋŋuu ba kpuŋ, ba baga lɛi i wia.

ref: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
text: Ka hìŋ́ N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi waa ra suŋ nɛra ninɛɛ di nɔŋŋi baa. I baaŋ waa fuuh manaŋ, i nɔŋŋaa ni i wibii dɔɔi ge du kaŋ.

ref: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
text: Bir n be di na n sinyɛna, tɛɛ mìŋ́ i balii fɔŋŋa, di lɛɛŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n humiibuu gunla n maa n humii la.

ref: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
text: Gil n na i winanaa daansɛɛ wii, ń dɔma na guŋ, hiihzi kpu baa, dikuubɛɛwiai, hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi hiinimbuu, di tig n bampirii.

ref: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
text: Kɔraawiizi ma u bolzenne Jɛrusalɛm, bizennaniinanii la nyuu.

ref: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
text: U nɔŋŋuubuu kaali Izrɛl hɛri bolzenaa maa.

ref: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
text: Kɔraawiizi bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm, ba ra ŋɔ i girme wiarɛ.

ref: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Di n waa kur hɛssi la hina n na sɛɛ n nuuzi, Ijip ni Babilɔn hina daŋ jaa. Filisti, Taaya ani Itiopia hina ge gba daŋ jaa, ka ń jaa ŋɔ, ‘Bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛmnɛ ba lul unnii.’ ”

ref: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
text: Wibii maa, ba daŋ ŋɔ bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm wia “Denii hɛssi maa hina lii, Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la daŋ gil u du kpeg.”

ref: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ sɛbi hɛssi maa nɛra sɔna hɔŋ biini, dí, ba maa ɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm hinaa.

ref: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
text: Ba danna sa di ra yir yira, di ra ŋɔ, “Bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm biinii yaa kissaa maa lii.”

ref: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
text: Kɔraawiizi la n na lɛɛŋ, hɔpizaa ni hamuŋa maa, anna wiiu í see.

ref: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
text: Gil n wiisuŋŋaa helii, keŋŋi digni di ra nuu n wiraa, di hiiniŋ.

ref: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
text: Tɔɔrɔɔzi huuzimbuu werge maa, haali n dugli siu.

ref: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
text: Ba kurimbuu jaa lalaa ni, n ɛɛ lugɔ nɛr la n waa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
text: Ba gilimbuu ta lalaa biini, n ɛɛ lugɔ nɛra la baŋ kpuwɛɛ, ba chɔɔ ba ŋmama biine, banla hiŋ suuh ba wia kɔrai, ba wàá ka na i hiinaa la.

ref: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
text: I dawimbuu ŋmam la n luŋŋe biini, bɔɔluŋ la n biree werge biini.

ref: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
text: I baaŋ siili n ninɛɛ, u duwɔɔrɛ lugɔ nii lɔi n wa tɔ n ni.

ref: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
text: I gillɔɔ n badɔŋa vɛɛŋ ta, di gil n birgi kuŋkiilii ba be. N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr baŋ tɔ dia, màá wer chɔ.

ref: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
text: Maa na nɛnnɛ, dikuu n sinii ni n biinichɔg wia. N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hɔpizi biimaanii n na yirii, di ɔɔ lalli n nonee chiŋ di ra suŋŋii.

ref: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
text: I ɛɛ nuukpuuri wiarɛ di ra bagli lalaa? Ba ɔɔ weruu izi chiŋ di ra chɔliii?

ref: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?
text: Ba ra ŋɔ i nɔŋŋaa wiarɛ ŋmam biini gɛɛ di ra ŋɔ i wibii dɔɔi wia lalaa bolaa?

ref: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
text: Ba ra zum i nuukpuuri wiarɛ bɔbiri, gɛɛ di ra zum i wideŋlaa ɛɛi wia, bɔr la baŋ suuh wiimaa wiaa?

ref: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i vɛɛŋ tai? Ɛrɛɛ i bir i har kpunnɛi?

ref: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
text: Di lii n bichalli saŋa maa, n di tɔɔrɔɔrɛ di dugli siu. N bɔra maanii huahwɛ, maa kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa dikuu i dignitɛraa wia.

ref: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
text: I baaŋ la nyaŋŋimbuu, i tɔɔrichɔgaa la chɔgiŋ kɔrai.

ref: that strike each day and from every side.
text: Hɔpizaa maa, ba fɔɔmbuu alugɔ nii n suwee lii keŋkere maa.

ref: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
text: I gillɔɔ n badɔŋa ni n nɔŋŋa vɛɛŋ ta, bɔbiri bɛnnɛ ɛɛ n dammu.

ref: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ ɔɔ yir yira, di ra bagli i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia. N danna sii i wibii dɔɔi wia, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
text: N danna ŋɔ i nɔŋŋaa la n du de, waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia saŋa maa. I wibii dɔɔi ge du de, alugɔ chiŋ n du de saŋa maa la.

ref: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
text: I faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N ni nɛra la miŋ lizɛɛ la ɛɛ nuukpannɛ, n ŋɔ nuarɛ tɛɛ n balii Koori Deevid, di ŋɔ,

ref: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, chiŋ kunnyinee maa, ra chɔli nuukpuuri wia la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ labuu, mɛlikazi ge ra bagli i wibii dɔɔi wia.

ref: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.
text: Nɛr maa waa hoo chiŋ lugɔ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi. I ni bɛl maa waa mɛgzɛɛ.

ref: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
text: Mɛlikazi maa chaalɛɛ i be, ra ɔmiibuu werge, i wiarɛ dɔɔ ɔnsii werge kaali a maa.

ref: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, bɛl maa waa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ lugɔi, i wia dɔɔ wibiire wiimaa biini.

ref: You rule the roaring sea and calm its waves.
text: Hinuu ra di kora muuzeŋ fɔŋŋa ni, di ɔɔ gil u nii lɔi siigi.

ref: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
text: I faa chɔgi muuzeŋ biini sechɔgii Rahab labuu, di kpuu, di kpa i fɔŋŋazeŋ la di kpegli i dɔma.

ref: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
text: Chiŋ ni hɛri maanii ɛɛ i hora, hinuu ta durnya ni kuna la maa n du u biini.

ref: You are strong and mighty!
text: I dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa werge maa! I kpegzi kannɔɔ werge!

ref: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
text: I kora chigɔ wideŋlaa ani wibii dii ninɛɛ, nɔŋŋaa ani wibii dɔɔi ge du i wiɛɛlaa maa biini.

ref: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
text: Banla maa n yir yira di ra jaamii, di du i see bɔchaaŋ la biini, nuu sumaa!

ref: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
text: Hɔpizaa maanii ba bɔra ɔɔ ra pur i sɔŋ wia, ba ra chɔlii dikuu i wideŋlaa wia.

ref: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
text: Hinuu gillɛ yaa ra kpegli yaa dɔma laalkpega biini, i nɔŋŋaa wia, i gillɔɔ yaa ra kpegli baa.

ref: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu lizi yaa guuri tɛɛ yaa, Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la banna hum, hinuu tɛɛ yaa koori. Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ nua tɛɛ Koori Deevid wia

ref: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
text: Saŋa la, i faa ŋɔ wiarɛ lugɔ deeza biini tɛɛ i nɛra la wia n dɔɔ wibii, di ŋɔ, “N tɛɛ laallɔɔrii fɔŋŋa, di kpa a kora tɛɛ nɛr la miŋ lizɛɛ lii a nɛra biini.

ref: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
text: N lizi n balii Deevidii u ɛɛ koori, n yiili nuunaniirɛ waari u nyuu, di lizuu.

ref: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
text: N fɔŋŋa daŋ du u be saŋa maa, wibii maa, n daŋ tɛu fɔŋŋa ú du kpeg.

ref: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
text: U dɔm maa wàá wer gil u turgi hɛri kuna, biinikpola hiŋ maa ge wàá wer sunnuu.

ref: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
text: N daŋ nɔŋŋuu ni wibii, di gil u du kpeg, dikuu n fɔŋŋa wia.

ref: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
text: N daŋ gil u kora diiribɔr wazi, di lii Muuzeŋ Mɛditerenɛn guŋŋ di ga hel Muu Yufretis.

ref: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
text: Koori Deevid daŋ yiriŋ di ŋɔ, ‘Hinuu ɛɛ n mɛɛ ni Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, di ɛɛ n guuri ni n Lɛɛri.’

ref: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
text: N daŋ gil u ɛɛ n biilugli, di ɛɛ koorizeŋ di kaali durnya naa koora maa.

ref: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
text: N daŋ hiŋ nua la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛu la, yaa nuukpaŋ la daŋ du de di hanna la.

ref: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
text: U domee daŋ haŋ du de di hanna la, u kora ge du de gunla chiŋ n du de la.

ref: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
text: Ka di u naanna waa kaa wàá hiŋ n Gbɔg, ba waa kaa wàá hiŋzi n ŋmɛnizi la ge,

ref: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
text: di ba wa vɛɛ n baglaa ani n widaulaa hiŋaa,

ref: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
text: n daŋ tɛrgi ba digna dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia, di gil ba di tɔɔrɔɔ dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.

ref: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
text: Ka màá gil Deevid nɔŋŋaa gɛɛ di vɛɛ nuuzi la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛu la di ta.

ref: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
text: Màá gil n nuu nuukpaŋ la chɔgi gɛɛ di vɛɛ nuuzi la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛu la kpaŋkpaŋ maa.

ref: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
text: Kakpannɛ n kpa n sɔnnanii la di hɛɛhzi, awia, n ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá kanni kara tɛɛ Koori Deevid.

ref: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
text: U domee daŋ du de di hanna la, ú kora ge du n see, gunla wiizi n du de saŋa maa la.

ref: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
text: Ka i baaŋ fuuh koori la hiŋ lizɛɛ la ninɛɛ, i vɛɛubuu di giluu ta.

ref: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
text: I vɛɛ i ni i balii nuukpaŋ labuu ta, di pilli u koorikahuro ha hɛri.

ref: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
text: I purgi u bolzeŋ koŋlaare, di purgi u diikpega,

ref: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
text: banla maa n na ga de ɔɔ ra ŋmɛɛ u kunaa, u birgi u dɔŋahina chɛɛtɛkuŋ.

ref: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
text: I gillɔɔ u dɔma kpegluu, ba bɔra jaa sɔɔni.

ref: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
text: I gillɔɔ u dɔŋkuna bir pɛɛ, di gil ba kpegluu laal biini.

ref: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
text: I lɛɛ u koori daŋkpalaa lii u nonee, di taa u kora ha hɛri.

ref: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
text: I gillɔɔ biinichɔg gil u zɛŋ kakpaŋ, di gil u di hiihzi. Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi lɛɛi wia

ref: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i daŋ bir i har kpu yaa di hanna laa? Ɛrɛɛ i baaŋ fuuh yaa ni, alugɔ niŋ, di birgi magɛi?

ref: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
text: A liizi lugɔ n miibɔɔ waa jaŋ, i ta newea maanii, ba ɛɛ kunsiwaa!

ref: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
text: Anɛɛ n du de, u ŋmɛnɛ wàá siwɛi? Anɛɛ n niŋ wer lɛɛ u hiŋ lii ŋmam biinei?

ref: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lee i nɔŋŋaa werge la duɛi? Unla hiŋ faa kpa i wibii dɔɔi, di hɛɛhzi tɛɛ Koori Deevid lai?

ref: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
text: A liizi gunla baŋ ɛɛ i balii chɛɛtɛ, ni gunla miŋ di kanyitti, dikuu hɛssi hina chɛɛtɛ ɛɛi wia.

ref: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i dɔma ra chagzi koori la hiŋ lizɛɛ labuu, di ra ɛɛu chɛɛtɛ, bɔr la maa uŋ laŋŋɛ.

ref: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, saŋaa saŋa maa! Ami! Ami!

ref: ) God Is Eternal
text: ) Kɔraawiizi balii Moosis wiisuŋŋaa wia

ref: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu yaa duuribɔr, di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
text: Mɔɔ ka i ta bizenaa ni durnya, hinuu Kɔraawiizi la n waa luglaa ani tunaa dɔɔwɛ, hinuu Kɔraawiizi, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
text: I ɔɔ giluu newee bir birgi hɛɛhraa, di ɔɔ ŋɔ, “Newea biizi, ií bir zuu hɛɛhraa biini.”

ref: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
text: Binni kagboŋ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hɔpizikpaŋ i be, gɛɛ hamuŋa karfizi n na bɛri di i waa chɔɔ dɔɔ la.

ref: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
text: I ɔɔ gbaari neweare kaali saŋa la banna chɔɔgi siu dɔɔ, ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ chɔɔzi kooriifalaa,

ref: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
text: di ɔɔ ra fur chɔɔzi ni di ɛɛ afalaa, ka di bɔr waa duani a hil di siu.

ref: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
text: I kpa yaa wichɔgaarɛ dau i see, anla yaa n suahwɛ ɛɛ, di dau bɔr la hin niŋ wer naa.

ref: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
text: Yaa miibɔɔni kpussoo, dikuu i baaŋfuuih wia, a ɔɔ tunuu alugɔ himaa.

ref: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
text: Yaa miibɔɔni jaŋzi maa ɛɛ binni tokkoahoro ni fii. Banla n dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa ra di binni tokkoanaazu, ka a maa biini, tɔɔrɔɔ ni biinichɔg bɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, a ɔɔ kaaluu manaŋ, yaa wia tuŋ.

ref: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
text: Anɛɛ n zum i baaŋ fɔŋŋa magai? Dikuu i baaŋfuuihchɔgii la wia, i dɛg ɔmaarɛ.

ref: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
text: Awia, bagli yaa, ya zum yaa hɔpizaa maga, di wer dɔɔ nunzuma.

ref: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ i baaŋ fuuh yaa ni di birgi magɛi? Na i balaa sinyɛna!

ref: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
text: Chɔɔzi maa, ɔɔ́ gil i nɔŋŋaa la, n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la kukki yaa, guŋ gil ya wer yir yira di dɔɔ bɔsɔna, yaa de dui biini maa.

ref: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
text: Gil yaa bɔra sɔɔni, alugɔ hɔpizaa la maga hiŋ tɔɔri yaa, ani biŋkpila la maa yaa n di tɔɔrɔɔ la.

ref: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
text: Gil i balaa na i wizenaa, bá biizi ge na i girme.

ref: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, kissi yaa, di gil yaa wiɛɛlaa maa kuari.

ref: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
text: Nɛr la maa n du Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la lɔɔ biini, daŋ na heezaa Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ chunchugli biini.

ref: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
text: U daŋ wer ŋɔ u be, “Hinuu ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n suahribɔr ani n diikpeg. Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, hinuu n yardi.”

ref: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
text: U daŋ lɛɛi lii tɔɔrɔɔzi alugɔ sidɛɛzi, baŋ suahzɛɛ he la be ani wiilchɔgaa maa biini.

ref: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
text: U daŋ guui, alugɔ zal n ɔɔ yaa u keeri tɔ u biizi ni la, i dɔɔ suahribɔr u be, u wibii dɔɔi daŋ guui di lɛɛi.

ref: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
text: Hàá kaa ra ɔm wiimaa hamuŋa ni gɛɛ hobii la ban niŋ ta bɔchaaŋ

ref: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
text: gɛɛ wiilchɔgaa la n niŋ lawii bɔbiri gɛɛ anla n na kpu wibaŋa ni.

ref: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
text: Nɛra kagboŋ daŋ chogli i kɛra di siu, nɛra kagboŋa fi chogli di siu barii, ka hiŋwaa wàá na pira tama maa.

ref: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
text: I daŋ binni di na gunla banna tɛr biinikpola hina digna.

ref: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
text: I kpa Kɔraawiizii di birgi i Lɛɛri, Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ɛɛ i guuri.

ref: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
text: Awia, hɛhchɔg maa, wàá chol i ni kaluchɔgii maa ge wàá zuu i dia.

ref: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil u mɛlikazi du i tau, di ra binnii bɔr la maa hinna la.

ref: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
text: A daŋ lallii chiŋ, í gilɛɛ wa kpa i naa di ra lɔ bii.

ref: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
text: N tɛibuu fɔŋŋa i wer fɛrgi hɛrikuna, di kpegli bunyinzi, haali hɛrikuna la n dɔɔ siri werge ani bunyinchɔgaa gba.

ref: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ lɛɛ banla maa n nɔŋŋiŋ, di guu banla maa n zummɛ lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi.

ref: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
text: Di ba wa lɔ wile tɛŋ, n daŋ nuu tɛɛ baa. Di ba wa du tɔɔrɔɔ biini, n daŋ du ba be, n daŋ lɛɛ baa di kpa baa girme.

ref: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
text: N daŋ gil ba dɔɔ miibɔɔjaŋ, n daŋ lɛɛ baa.”

ref: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a wessoo ya ra chɔlii, di yir yira di ra dargi Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la,

ref: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
text: di ɔɔ ra ŋɔ i nɔŋŋaa la wia chɔɔzi ni, di ra ŋɔ i wibii dɔɔi ge wia hamuŋa ni,

ref: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
text: di kpa janjalaŋ ni kem di ra yir yira.

ref: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi hunzenaa la gillɔɔ n bɔra sɔɔni, n na yir yirsuma.

ref: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wiɛɛlaa kannɔɔ werge, wia la hinna fɛ ge, zɛɛ zumaa du kpol!

ref: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
text: Nfɛrnyaari wàá wer zumaa, gɛnii ge wàá wer zum a zɛɛzi.

ref: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
text: Biinikpola hina daŋ wer fur alugɔ kooree, wichɔgɛɛra ge nyɛɛli, ka ba daŋ chɔgi baa, ba wia tuŋ.

ref: But you will rule over all of us forever,
text: Ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ girmee saŋa maa.

ref: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
text: Yaa zummɔ lugɔ i dɔma maa daŋ siu, wichɔgɛɛra maa yaari.

ref: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
text: I gillɔɔ n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa alugɔ pir nabal, di kissiŋ, di gil n dɔɔ bɔsɔna.

ref: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
text: N siwee nawɔɔrɛ n dɔma n cholle, n digna ge nuu biinikpola hina n na chɛɛhgi.

ref: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
text: Banla wia n deŋlee daŋ hel alugɔ kube daa, di hel alugɔ Lɛbanɔn hɛriŋkpol daa.

ref: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
text: Ba ɛɛwɔɔ alugɔ daazi baŋ chɔɔzɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia, a lɔɔ nɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la Dia biini.

ref: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
text: A ɔɔ haa ra nɔŋ nɔna, haali di a wa binɔɔ, a paŋhoori ɔɔ haa biri, a dɔɔ fɔŋŋa.

ref: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
text: Kenna bagluu lugɔ Kɔraawiizi wia dɔɔ wibiire, n guuri waa wichɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
text: Kɔraawiizii koori, u bɔkkɔɔ alugɔ koori, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge. U gillɔɔ hɛri chi chigigi, waa ziigaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: The ocean is roaring, Lord! The sea is pounding hard.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, muuzenaa vile ra lɔu, a ra lɔu, di ra kɔɔ werge, di lalli a nii lɔi la.

ref: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
text: Kɔraawiizi di koraa chiŋ, u fɔŋŋa kaali muuzenaa lɔi, di du kpeg kaali u nii lɔɔlaa.

ref: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i Gbɔgni du denii di hanna la. I Dia ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la n na turgi nɛra wichɔgaa kim, gil i baaŋ lii chaaŋ!

ref: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
text: Izi chiŋ, hɛri naa Seriya Diiri, di turgi banla n na jigsi gunla n dɛg baa!

ref: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ magaa biinikpola hina birgi mag, ɛrɛɛ bá di bahinaa di birgi magɛi?

ref: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
text: Wichɔgɛɛra ra ŋɔ barabara wiŋɔzii, di ra jigsi.

ref: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
text: Ba du i nɛraa pira, di ra sunni banla n ɛɛ i hora.

ref: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
text: Ba ra ŋɔu, “Kɔraawiizi waa yaa ra na, Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la waa yaa ra hagzi.”

ref: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
text: Kɔraawiizii tɛɛ yaa digna, waa wia ra nuuwaa? Waabuu tɛɛ yaa siwee, waa naa?

ref: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
text: Waabuu nyɛgi a hɛssi hina ni, wàá tɛr ba dignaa? Waabuu ɛɛ nɛr maa bagli, waa wia zummɛaa?

ref: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
text: Kɔraawiizi zum newee nfɛssii, a ɛɛ wipɛɛrii.

ref: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nɛr la maa hiŋ tɛr u digni, nɛr la hiŋ bagli wia di lii i Gbɔg biini, nuu suma.

ref: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
text: I ɔɔ lizuubuu lii tɔɔrɔɔ biini, guŋŋ ka ba wa ki bɔɔ dau biinikpola hina.

ref: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
text: Kɔraawiizi wàá vɛɛ u nɛra ta, u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá vɛɛ baa ta.

ref: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
text: Seriya dii ni wibii dii daŋ kaa du de, banla maa wia n deŋlee la ra hiŋ guŋ.

ref: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ lɛɛ n nua di huuzi biinikpola hinai? Anɛɛ n niŋ lɛɛ n nua di huuzi wichɔgɛɛrai?

ref: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
text: Di Kɔraawiizi faa wan hiinee, keŋ n vii siuwɔ.

ref: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
text: Miŋ wa ŋɔ, “N hɛhrɔɔrɛ,” hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa lawimbuu.

ref: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
text: Di kafɔŋ wa lawiŋ werge, i bampirii tigaa ɔɔ tɛmbuu bɔsɔna.

ref: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ n diikpeg, Kɔraawiizi la minna hum la ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bii miŋ chɔwɛɛ ga waa.

ref: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
text: U daŋ turgi baa ba wichɔgaa kim, di chɔgi baa dikuu ba biinikpola wia. Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la daŋ chɔgi baa.

ref: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
text: Ií ba ya yir yira ni bɔsɔna di chɔli Kɔraawiizi, ií gil ya chaasi werge tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n na guu yaa.

ref: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
text: Ií gil ya ba u see di yir yira, di ra tɛu jaaŋ, di yir yirsuma di ra chɔluu.

ref: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ fɔŋŋa maa hinnɛ, di ɛɛ Koorizeŋ kaali vuga maa.

ref: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
text: Hɛri bɔluŋe du u noneere, bizenaa nyuuni ge ɛɛ u hora.

ref: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
text: Waabuu dɔɔ muuzeŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, waabuu tau, waabuu ta hɛri gba.

ref: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
text: Waabuu ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, yaabuu ɛɛ u nɛra, u ra binni yaa, alugɔ penɔɔni n na binni u peeza. Ii ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi n na ŋɔ ii be zinaa.

ref: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
text: “Ií gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ, di ɛɛ dignikpega hina, alugɔ ii naabaala n faa ɛɛwɛ Mɛriba, gunla baŋ faa ɛɛwɛ, Massa n du hɛribɔduma, a hɔl la.

ref: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
text: Denii ba faa ɛɛŋ di na, haali baŋ faa na wia la miŋ ɛɛwɛ gba.

ref: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
text: Binni tokkoanɛɛrɛ n baaŋ faa fuuh ba ni, n ŋɔ, ‘Ba bampiree ɔɔ dar baabuu ba ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa, ba waa n ŋmɛnizi zummɛ.’

ref: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
text: N baaŋ n faa fuuhwe la wiarɛ n ŋɔ, ‘Ba wàá na heezaa la dee min niŋ faa tɛɛ baa la.’ ”

ref: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
text: Ií yir yirfalii tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi! Durnya hina maa, ií yir yir tɛu, di ra darguu!

ref: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
text: Ií ra sii hɔpizi biimaa, amaniyesuma la n na bagli ii lɛɛi wia la.

ref: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
text: Ií ra sii u girme la wia ra tɛɛ hɛssi maa hina ani u nuukpuuri wia la wia, di ra tɛɛ nɛra maa.

ref: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
text: Kɔraawiizi zenni kannɔɔ, di dɛg chɔlaa werge maa. Waabuu dɛg ɔmaa kaali vuga maa.

ref: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
text: A hɛssi maa vuga ɛɛ kuna la baŋ kuarɛɛnɛ, ka Kɔraawiizii ta chiŋ.

ref: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
text: Girme ni zenni du u benii, fɔŋŋa ni girme su u Dia.

ref: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
text: Hɛri naa hina maa, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi. Ií ra chɔli u girme ani u fɔŋŋa la.

ref: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
text: Ií ra dargi Kɔraawiizi la n dɔɔ girme la. Ií kpa sunzaa kuna di wa zuu u Dia la.

ref: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
text: Ií ŋɔ hɛssi maa hina be, “Kɔraawiizii koori! Waabuu gillɛ hɛri chi nɛnnɛ, waa ziigi la, u daŋ di nɛr maa seriya ni wibii.”

ref: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
text: Chiŋ ni hɛri, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni! Muuzeŋ ni kunnyinee la maa n du i biini la, ií ge gba ra ɛɛ guŋ,

ref: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
text: kooni ni kuna la maa n du ii biine, ií ra di iihinaa! Kɔr daazi maa ge daŋ yir yira ni bɔsɔna,

ref: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
text: a daŋ yir yira Kɔraawiizi see, di u wa ballɔ. U ra bau ú wa di durnya naa seriya. U daŋ di durnya hina maa seriya ni wibii gunla n dɛkkɛ.

ref: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
text: Kɔraawiizii koori, gil hɛri hina bɔra sɔɔni! Gil muuzenaa baambaana hɛssi hina ge bɔra sɔɔni!

ref: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
text: Baamazi ani bɔbiri werge baruubuu chem, u kora chigɔ wideŋlaa ani wibii ninɛɛ.

ref: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
text: Ninlau tɔ u seere, di ra fuuh u dɔma la n baruu la.

ref: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
text: U nyɛgzaa chaani durnya maanii, hɛri hina na, ba bɔra ra sa.

ref: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
text: Bizenaa ra ŋmɛɛruu alugɔ kel, Kɔraawiizi la n na di kora hɛssi maa nɛra ni la see.

ref: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
text: Chinchiŋ kuna maa baglɔɔrɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi wia deŋloore, hɛssi hina maa ge na u girme.

ref: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
text: Banla maa n na kuari vuga di hiihzii, banla n na jigsi dikuu vuga wia, ií ra jaamuu, vuga maa, ií ra jaamuu!

ref: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
text: Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina nuuwɔɔ, ba bɔra sɔɔni, Juda bolzenaa maa bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi seriya dii wia.

ref: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
text: Hinuu du chiŋ di kaali kummaa, di dɔɔ zenni di kaali vuga maa.

ref: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
text: Gil banla n nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi hah wichɔgaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, u ɔɔ ra guu banla wia n dɔɔ wibiire, di ɔɔ ra lɛɛ baa di ra lii biinikpola hina nonee biini.

ref: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
text: Bɔchaaŋ ɔɔ ra chaani banla wia n deŋlee ninɛɛ, biinihuŋŋu hina ge dɔɔ bɔsɔna.

ref: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
text: Ii banla maa wia n deŋlee, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni Kɔraawiizi wia, di ra dargi u sɔnnaniinanii la.

ref: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
text: Ií yir yirfalii tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, u ɛɛ wizenaare werge maa! Kɔraawiizi himmaa fɔŋŋa ani u kpegzi biini, u kpegli u dɔmaa.

ref: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
text: Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ ba zum u nɛra lɛɛi wia, di pilli u wideŋlaa wia bagli hɛssi hina.

ref: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
text: U liizi u nɔŋŋaa ani u wibii dɔɔi wiarɛ Izrɛl hina be. Hɛssi hina maa na Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la nɛra lɛɛi wiarɛ.

ref: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
text: Hɛri naa hina maa, ií ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ií ra yir yira ni bɔpuraa, di ra sa.

ref: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
text: Ií yir yira, di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ií lɔ kem di ra yir yira.

ref: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
text: Ií huuh bensunozi, di ra chaasi ani bɔsɔna, di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ koori la.

ref: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
text: Muuzeŋ ani kunnyinee la maa n du i biini, ií ra kɔɔ werge, hɛri hina ani kuna la maa n du u ni la, ií ra yir yira.

ref: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
text: Muuni, ií ra lɔ kpaa, bizenaa, ií ge ra yir yira guŋ ani bɔsɔna,

ref: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
text: gil a ra yir yira Kɔraawiizi see, dikuubɛɛwiai, u ra bau ú wa di hɛri seriya. U daŋ wa di durnya nɛra seriya ni wibii gunla n dɛkkɛ.

ref: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
text: Kɔraawiizii koori, gil nɛra maa bɔra ra sa. U sogo u koorikara ninɛɛ chɛrubzi baambaaŋ, di gil hɛri ra zigli.

ref: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
text: Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa kannɔɔ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn biini, waabuu kaali durnya hɛssi hina maa.

ref: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
text: Nɛr maa danna dargi u sɔnzeŋ la n dɔɔ girme la. U ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ!

ref: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
text: U ɛɛ Koorizenne, di nɔŋŋi wideŋlaa. U gillɔɔ wibii dii du Izrɛl, di gil wideŋlaa ani gunla n dɛg ɛɛi du de.

ref: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la, ií ra jaamuu, u koorikara la see! U ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ!

ref: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
text: Moosis ni Aarɔn faa ɛɛ u kizeehinaa, Samuɛl faa ɛɛ nɛr la bɛl n suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii, ba faa yir Kɔraawiizii, u nuu tɛɛ baa.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
text: Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, i nuu i nɛra wiisuŋŋaarɛ. I bagli gunla hiŋ gil nɛra wichɔgaarɛ ra tɛɛ baabuu, haali hiŋ ɔɔ ra tɛr ba digna, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia gba.

ref: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la, di ra jaamuu u bizennaniinanii la nyuu. Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
text: Durnya hina maa, ií yir yira ni bɔsɔna, di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi!

ref: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
text: Ií ra jaami Kɔraawiizi ni bɔsɔna, ií ɔɔ ba u be di waa yir bɔsɔna yira!

ref: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
text: Ií zum lugɔ waabuu Kɔraawiizi. Waabuu ta yaa, yaa ɛɛ u hora, yaa ɛɛ u nɛraa, di ɛɛ lugɔ u peeza.

ref: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
text: Kɔraawiizi wia wessoo, u nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ, u wibii dɔɔi ge du de, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ yir yir di ra bagli i nɔŋŋaa ni i wibii dii wia, di yir di ra chɔlii.

ref: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
text: N danna du tau, n gilɛɛ waa dɔɔ chɔgri, saŋa bɛɛ i ba n benei? N daŋ dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu n dia biini,

ref: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
text: N wia daŋ dɔɔ wibii, màá ra nyiŋŋi wichɔgaa wia.

ref: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
text: N daŋ duŋŋi nɛr la maa n suahzɛɛ, ra chɔg u dɔŋhiŋ sɔŋ n be. Màá sɛɛ nɛr la maa n na jigsi di kpoŋ wia.

ref: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
text: N daŋ nɔŋŋi Izrɛl hina la wia n dɔɔ wibii hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi be, di gil ba du n kooridia. Banla wia n dɔɔ wibii nɛnnɛ, daŋ ɛɛ n huŋhunna.

ref: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
text: Karkanni maa, wàá du n dia, nɛfugzi maa ge wàá ka du n be.

ref: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
text: Hɔpizii maanii ń na kpu biinikpola hina, a hɛri biini. Di ra kpu wichɔgɛɛra, i bolzeŋ la biini.

ref: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
text: Di n wa du tɔɔrɔɔ biini, gilɛɛ wa bir har di ra kpuŋ! Keŋŋi digna di ra nuu, di n wa yirii, nuu n be manaŋ!

ref: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
text: N miibɔɔ ra tunuu manaŋ alugɔ nyɔɔzi n na kaali, n bɔra ra baari alugɔ niŋ n na fuuhŋ.

ref: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
text: N cholloo di chɔɔ alugɔ kooriihilaa, diwee gba waa kaa ra kɛlliŋ.

ref: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
text: Dikuu n uuraa werge wia, n kɔkkɔɔ di jaa ka hoga ani hɔŋ bɛŋ.

ref: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
text: N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hɛribɔduma kikiu, di ɛɛ lugɔ kikiu n du diŋgela.

ref: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
text: N chɔɔwɔɔ di ra nyiŋ, di ɛɛ lugɔ zumbikpaŋ n togni sal.

ref: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
text: Hɔpizaa maanii n dɔma ra chagziŋ, banla n na ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ ge, kpa n sɔŋ di birgi nuuseerikuŋ.

ref: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
text: Hɔɔhrii jaa birgi n diwee, n sinii ge koozi n niinyɔɔlii ni,

ref: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
text: dikuu i baaŋfuuih werge la wia, i lallimbuu di kpaŋ ta kɛrii.

ref: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
text: N miibɔɔ ra tunuu manaŋ, alugɔ wiicholii laalii n na kaali la, n na yɔl ge alugɔ kooree.

ref: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
text: Ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ koorii saŋa maa, i sɔŋ du jiminizi maa biine.

ref: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
text: I daŋ izi di wa suŋ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina ni, ba sinyɛna nai saŋa helloo, saŋa la hiŋ dauwɛ la helloo.

ref: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
text: I balaa nɔŋŋi a bolzenne, haali uŋ chɔkkɛ la gba, ba ra suŋ u ninɛɛ, haali uŋ puree la gba.

ref: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
text: A hɛssi maa hina danna ɔm hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi, hɛri naa koorizenaa maa ra tɔgzii.

ref: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
text: Saŋa la hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n niŋ kaa bir ma Bolzeŋ Ziɔn la, i daŋ bagli i zenni.

ref: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
text: I daŋ nuu dɔgnya hina wiisuŋŋaa, hàá vɛɛ baa ta.

ref: Future generations must also praise the Lord, so write this for them:
text: A dɛkkɔɔ jimini maa hina ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, awia, ií sɛbi u wiɛɛlaa dau tɛɛ baa.

ref: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
text: “Kɔraawiizi du u duuribɔr labuu ka liŋŋi hɛri, u du chinne ka binni hɛri,

ref: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
text: ú nuu banla baŋ tɔ dia uuraa, di lɛɛ banla baŋ di ba seriya, ba chol, ba ŋɔ ba kpu baa la.”

ref: All Jerusalem should praise you, our Lord,
text: Awia, ba danna yir Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn biini, di ra chɔluu de,

ref: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
text: saŋa la a hɛssi hina ni kossi maa n niŋ chaali, di ra chɔluu la.

ref: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
text: Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ n gɛrgi, di n haa waa zɛŋŋɛ, di gil n miibɔɔ ɛɛ kpurii.

ref: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
text: Awia, n ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ waa teŋ n miibɔɔ, di n haa waa zɛŋŋɛ. N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i du denii, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
text: A lugli la maanii i chiŋŋi hɛri zɛɛ, chiŋ gba ɛɛ i nonee humaa.

ref: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
text: A chiŋ ni hɛri daŋ ŋmɛnɛ chɔgi, ka hiŋwaa du denii di ra la. A daŋ siuzi alugɔ wɛjɛ n ɔɔ siu la, í chɛraa alugɔ laala, di kpaa ta.
