ref: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
text: Ka hiŋwaa daŋ ɔɔ du gunla hiŋ faa duwɛɛ la, i binni wàá dɔɔ maga.

ref: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
text: Yaa biizi daŋ du ni bɔsɔna, i guu ba naanna, bá chi nɛnnɛ.”

ref: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
text: N na chɔli Kɔraawiizii! N kpa n biini maanii di ra dargi u sɔnnanii la!

ref: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
text: N na chɔli Kɔraawiizii, màá suuh u winanaa la maa wia.

ref: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
text: U ɔɔ gil n wichɔgaa maanii ra tɛŋ, di chaa n wiila ge maa.

ref: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
text: U lɛɛmbuu lii ŋmam biini, di tɛŋ nɛnɔŋŋaa ni sisɔna.

ref: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
text: U ra tɛmbuu kunnanaa n de dui saŋa, guŋ gil n ɛɛ biipɔllii, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa alugɔ chig.

ref: For all who are mistreated, the Lord brings justice.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ di seriyaa, di kpa wibii ra tɛɛ banla banna sunni.

ref: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
text: U kpa u ŋmɛnizii di bagli Moosis, di gil Izrɛl hina na u wiɛɛlaa.

ref: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
text: Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ nɛsunaa ni sinyɛnaa werge. U baaŋ waa fuuh manaŋ, u nɔŋŋaa ge waa tuŋ.

ref: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
text: Waa ɔɔ ra hau nɛra ni di hanna la, u baaŋ ge waa fuuhwe di hanna la.

ref: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
text: Gunla chiŋ ni hɛri n nɛɛwɛ dɔŋa ni la, gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la du kaŋ, banla n na ɔmuu la be.

ref: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
text: Gunla wiifurii ani wiicholii n nɛɛwɛ dɔŋa ni la, gunnɛ ɔɔ lizi yaa wichɔgaa, a wàá ka dugli yaa la.

ref: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
text: Gunla bie mɛɛ n ɔɔ ra suŋ u ni la, gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra suŋ banla maa n na ɔmuu ni.

ref: because he knows we are made of dust.
text: U zum kunla uŋ kpawɛɛ kuari yaabuu, u ra liizuu lugɔ yaa ɛɛ hɛɛhraarɛ.

ref: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
text: Newee ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kooree. U wessi maa ɛɛ alugɔ kooree nyuuni,

ref: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
text: di peu wa ta a ni, a yɔl di siu, a nyuuni chogli, nɛr maa wàá ka naa.

ref: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la waa, du denii di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa, di tɛɛ banla n na ɔmuu la. U wideŋlaa ge du denii tɛɛ jiminizi maa,

ref: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
text: Kɔraawiizi di koraa chiŋ, di ra di kora kummaa ni.

ref: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
text: Kɔraawiizi mɛlikazi, ií ra chɔluu, iabuu fɔŋŋazeŋ hina la n na humuu, di ra hiŋ u wiŋɔzi la.

ref: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
text: Ii banla maa n du chiŋ, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, ii banla n ɛɛ u balaa di ra ɛɛ u kipar la.

ref: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
text: Kuna la maa Kɔraawiizi n tawɛɛ, a du bɔr la maa uŋ di kora, ií ra chɔluu. N danna chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
text: N na chɔli Kɔraawiizii! N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i zenni kannɔɔ werge. I dɔɔ girme ani zennii alugɔ koorizeŋ,

ref: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
text: i kpa bɔchaannɛ tɔ i hiŋ alugɔ wɛjɛ, di yaa chiŋ alugɔ tanti dia,

ref: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
text: di ma i bol u bɛri chiŋ ni. I gillɔɔ baamazi ɛɛ alugɔ i torko, peu kpai ra kaali.

ref: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
text: I gillɔɔ i mɛlikazi ɛɛ lugɔ, peu ni ninlau.

ref: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
text: I gillɔɔ hɛri chi u zɛɛ ni chigigi, u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá wer ziigi.

ref: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
text: I kpa muuzenne tɔ u ni lugɔ tagtajaŋ, niiri ge tɔɔgi bizenaa ni.

ref: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
text: A pallɔɔ lii a bizenaa nyuuni, di tuu walli, bɔra la hiŋ kuarɛɛ tɛɛa la.

ref: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
text: I dau magaa tɛɛa, a wàá wer gilluu, di kaa wa tɔ hɛri maa ni.

ref: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
text: I gillɔɔ bulli pogzi a faalime biine, di ra pal a giŋgimee baambaana.

ref: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
text: Aabuu ra tɛɛ pir sela maa niinyɔɔlii, di ra kpu pir kauzi niinyɔgzi.

ref: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
text: A kɛraa daazi nyuunii zumbizi ra du a daŋa, di togni a kela ni ra wii.

ref: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
text: I ɔɔ giluu dooŋ nɛɛ a giŋgimee nyuuni, di gil hɛri du sum.

ref: You let the earth produce grass for cattle, plants for our food,
text: I gillɔɔ kooree fur tɛɛ nauna, di tɛɛ newee ge pattikuna, u ɔɔ par di ra na diwee,

ref: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
text: siŋ, a ra tɛu bɔsɔna, ɔlivi nuu, a ra kuari u siwee ani diwee, a ra tɛu fɔŋŋa.

ref: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
text: Lɛbanɔn hɛriŋkpol daazi la Kɔraawiizi himmaa n duuwe a ɛɛ u hora la, na doniirɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
text: A ninɛɛ zumbizi du a daŋa, niilaaraazi ge du a daŋa daananaa nyuuni.

ref: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
text: A bizenaa nyuunii sejigzi du, kachazi ge ra zuu a bia bɔɔni.

ref: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
text: Hinuu kuari baagu, u ra bagli saŋazi, wiizi ge zum saŋa la unna chol.

ref: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
text: Hinuu kuari hamuŋa, bɔr ɔɔ biri, kɔr biini sechɔgaa maa ɔɔ lii di ra di.

ref: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.
text: Bunyinzi ɔɔ ra wiiu, di ra nyiŋŋi kunla an niŋ lau, di ra nyiŋŋi a diwee hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
text: Di wiizi wa futtɔ, a ɔɔ biruu la a chɔɔribɔra, di ga chɔɔgi.

ref: then we go out to work until the end of day.
text: Denii newea ɔɔ jaa la ba huma bɔra, di ga hum guŋŋ bɔr wa duani.

ref: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i ta kuŋkpilaa werge maa! Nunzumaa i kpa di ta a maa! I kuntaalaa su hɛri naa maanii.

ref: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
text: Muuzeŋ du denii di du kaŋ, di du war werge maa, kunnyinee kpila maa du u biini, a zenaa ni a jigzi maanii du de.

ref: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
text: Muugberzenaa ra vol u ninɛɛ, muuzeŋ sechɔgii la ge hiŋ tawɛɛ la, du u biini di ra dua.

ref: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
text: Annii maanii dɛlli i ni, i ra tɛɛa diwee saŋa la anna nyiŋŋaa.

ref: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
text: Di hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi wa tɛɛa diwee, a ɔɔ chaalaabuu, di i wa pilli i nonii tɛɛa, a ɔɔ piŋuu nɛnnɛ.

ref: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
text: Di i wa bir i har kpua, ɔnsii werge ɔɔ lawaabuu. Di i wa lɛɛ a heeza lii a be, a ɔɔ siuzuu di birgi hɛɛhraa.

ref: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
text: Ka di i wa tɛɛa heeza, a falaa ɔɔ liiu du de, di gil hɛri naa birgi ufalii.

ref: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi girme du de, di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa. Ú bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu u kuntaalaa wia.

ref: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
text: U ɔɔ binni hɛrii, u zigli, di u wa gbɔgzi bizenaa ge, a ra lii nyɔɔzi.

ref: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
text: N daŋ yir yira ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ń de dui biini maa, di yir yira di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la minna hum.

ref: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
text: Gil gunla minna lɔ u wiŋɔzi fasani la paruu, dikuubɛɛwiai, u benii n dɔɔ bɔsɔna.

ref: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
text: Gil ba chɔgi wichɔgɛɛra maa, durnya naa biini, di gil biinikpola hina ge dim kɔrai. N na chɔli Kɔraawiizii! Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, di ra sii u zenni wia. Ií gil hɛssi maa hina zum u wiɛɛlaa wia.

ref: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
text: Ií yir yira di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, di ra bagli wizenaa la uŋ ɛɛwɛ.

ref: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
text: Ií dɛlli Kɔraawiizi ni u fɔŋŋazeŋ la, di ra binni u siwee saŋa maa.

ref: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
text: Ií ra liizi nuukpuuri wia la uŋ ɛɛwɛ. Aabuu u wizenaa ani seriyazi la uŋ diwee wia.

ref: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
text: Kɔraawiizi balii Abraham naanna, Jekɔb biibaala la uŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ la.

ref: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
text: Waabuu Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, u widaulaa ɛɛ durnya maa horaa.

ref: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
text: U ra liizi u ni newea nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la wiarɛ saŋa maa. U ŋɔ nuarɛ tɛɛ jiminizi kagboŋa nɛra.

ref: when he said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan.”
text: U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ kpa Keenan hɛri tɛi, ú ɛɛ i kapɛttɛ.”

ref: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
text: Kɔraawiizi nɛra n faa haa waa kpil, di ɛɛ hɔɔhra du Keenan hɛri la,

ref: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
text: ba faa ra juuruu, di ɔɔ lii hɛri naa di ga lii unnii, di lii kora naa di ga zuu bɛl biini.

ref: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi faa waa gillɛ nɛr maa sunni baa. Uŋ faa ra nyiŋŋi u guu baa la wia, u hau koora ninɛɛ,

ref: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
text: di ŋɔ, “Ií gilɛɛ waa gbɔgzi banla miŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ n hiŋ la, di gilɛɛ waa du n dɔgtɛɛ maa pira.”

ref: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa gillɔɔ lɔchɔgii chol ba hɛri, di chɔg ba diwee maa.

ref: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
text: Ka u faa gillɔɔ baal bɛl tɔ ba see, u sɔnnɛ faa Joosɛf, ba faa yooubuu, u birgi yom.

ref: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
text: Ba faa kpa yɔlɔzii du u naazi, ni u baŋaa,

ref: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
text: guŋŋ wii la Joosɛf n ŋɔwɛɛ la wa ɛɛ wibii. Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii la ge wa gil u wia dɔɔ wibii.

ref: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
text: U faa gillɔɔ u ɛɛ u hɛri nabɔma, di ra binni u kundɔɔlaa maa ni.

ref: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
text: U ra di nabɔmuu u nabɔnzi ni, di ra bagli u nabɔnzi nunzuma.

ref: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
text: Denii Jekɔb la Ijip hɛri, di faa ga so de, di ɛɛ hɔɔhri.

ref: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa gil u nɛra wazi, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa kaali ba dɔma.

ref: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
text: U faa gillɔɔ Ijip hina hah u nɛra, di faa ra sunni baa.

ref: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
text: Denii u faa hum u balii Moosis ni Aarɔn la uŋ faa lizɛɛ la.

ref: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
text: Ba faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wizenaare, di ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia gba, Ijip hɛri.

ref: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa gillɔɔ bɔbiri werge limpiriŋ chol a hɛri, ka a Ijip hina faa vɛɛ u nua hiŋaa.

ref: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
text: U faa gillɔɔ ba niiri birgi chal, a biine nyinni maa siu.

ref: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
text: Ba hɛri maanii faa su sampussi, haali a faa su ba kooridia gba.

ref: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
text: U faa ŋɔ wiarɛ, a hɛri maa su nakɛɛhzi ni kundunzaa.

ref: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
text: Di gil dooŋ birgi dobia, dooŋ na nyɛgzi, di ra pogzi, ba hɛri maa.

ref: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
text: U faa chɔgi ba grepu ni fig daazi kooni, di kuugi ba hɛri daazi maa.

ref: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
text: U faa gillɔɔ lotorozi ba, a waa maga dɔɔwɛ,

ref: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
text: di wa di ba hɛri kunlɛɛri ni ba pattikuna maa.

ref: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
text: U faa kpuuzi Ijip hina dia maa biibambiluglii.

ref: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi jaa tɔ Izrɛl hina see, ba lii Ijip hɛri, di chi ba saliŋhuŋŋa ni saliŋ, ba maa faa dɔɔ alaanfia ani fɔŋŋa.

ref: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
text: A Ijip hina faa jaa ra ɔm baabuu, baŋ liwɛɛ la, ba bɔra jaa sɔɔni.

ref: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa gillɔɔ baama tɔ u nɛra ni hɔpizaa saŋa, di gil niŋ ge ra chaani baa hamuŋa ni.

ref: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
text: Ba faa suŋŋuubuu diwee, u faa tɛɛ baabuu zaahra ba hee, di tɛɛ baa diwee ge lii chiŋ, ba di piŋ.

ref: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
text: U faa gillɔɔ bii peri, nii pozi di ra lii, di ra pal a hɛribɔduma biini alugɔ muu.

ref: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
text: Dikuu uŋ faa ra liizi nuuŋɔɔlinaniinanii la, uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ u balii Abraham la wia.

ref: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
text: U faa kpa nɛdumazi hɛrii tɛɛ baa, ba kooni birgi ba kundɔɔlaa,

ref: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: guŋ wer gil á nɛra ra hiŋ u baglaazi, di ra hiŋ u Gbɔgni. Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia wessoo. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ wer bagli Kɔraawiizi hunzenaa la wia, gɛɛ di wer chɔluu gunla n dɛkkɛnɛi?

ref: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
text: Banla n na hiŋ u baglaa, di ra ɛɛ wideŋlaa saŋa maa, nuu sumaa.

ref: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a liizi n wia, di i waa suŋ i nɛra ni, di hiiniŋ, di i waa lɛɛ baa.

ref: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
text: Gil n na i nɛra nyɛɛlaa, ń bɔra sɔɔni dikuu i hɛri wia. N ni banla n ɛɛ i hora, bɔra sɔɔni, ya ra jigsi.

ref: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.
text: Yaa ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ lugɔ yaa naabaala. Yaa dɔɔ biinikpolaa di ɛɛ nɛchɔgaa.

ref: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
text: Saŋa la yaa naabaala n faa du Ijip la, ba faa waa nuukpuuri wia la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la zɛɛ zummɛ, ba faa waa i nɔŋŋŋaa la hiŋ bagli baa saŋakpila maa la wia ra liizi, ka dɔɔ dignikpega, Muuzeŋaahmu la kɛrii.

ref: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
text: Ka i faa lɛɛ baabuu, dikuu hiŋ ŋɔ nua di tɛɛ baa la wia, í bagli i fɔŋŋazeŋ la hiŋ dɔɔwɛ la wia.

ref: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
text: I faa hau a Muuzeŋaahmu ninɛɛ, u hil kakpaŋ, i tɔ ba see di ga hɛrhilii gi.

ref: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
text: Denii i nɛra hiŋ faa jaa yardi i nuuŋɔɔlaa la, di yir yira di ra chɔlii.

ref: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
text: A waa birgee, ka ba faa suuh i wiɛɛlaa la, ba waa kaa ra nuu i baglaa.

ref: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
text: Awia, ba faa dɔɔ kɛkɛluurɛ, di ɛɛ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi na, a hɛribɔduma biini,

ref: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
text: i faa tɛɛ baa kunla baŋ suŋŋɛɛ, ka faa gil wiila la n na kɔgi nɛr werge chol ba ni.

ref: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
text: Denii hɛri faa peri, di di Datan, di kaa di Abiram ge ni u harbɔɔhiŋra maa.

ref: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
text: Niŋ ge lii chiŋ, di wa chol ba harbɔɔhiŋra ni, di fuuh a guŋ biinikpola hina.

ref: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
text: Ba faa kpa saliŋ di kuari nabii, Bizeŋ Sinaai zɛɛ, u ɛɛ ba vug ba ra kuaruu.

ref: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
text: Ba faa kpa i girmee ra chɛr vug n li nabalee n na di kooree.

ref: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
text: Ba faa suuh hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ wizenaa, di lɛɛ baa Ijip hɛri la wiarɛ.

ref: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
text: I faa ɛɛ wizenaare a de! Di ɛɛ ɔnsii werge wia Muuzeŋaahmu la kɛrii.

ref: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
text: Guŋ wia, i faa ŋɔ lugɔ i daŋ chɔgi baa. Ka i balii Moosis la hiŋ faa lizɛɛ la izi chi, di suŋŋii, i baaŋ sɔɔni, haa kaa chɔgi baa.

ref: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
text: Denii ba faa vɛɛ hɛrnanii la ta, dikuu baŋ waa hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi nuuŋɔɔlii la yardɛɛ wia.

ref: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
text: Ba faa du ba tanti diini biini di ra nuumi, di faa vɛɛ i nua hiŋaa.

ref: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
text: Awia, i faa hɛɛhzi di ŋɔ lugɔ, i daŋ gil ba siu a hɛribɔduma biini,

ref: I'll scatter your children everywhere in the world.”
text: di duŋŋi ba dee, ba yaari hɛrdumazi hina biine, di siuzi hɛhjaŋa.

ref: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
text: Baŋ wa hel Bizeŋ Pɛɔ, ba ra kuari vug Baal la, di ra di kuna la baŋ kpawɛɛ lizi mbusu ra tɛɛ vuga la n waa miibɔɔ dɔɔwɛ.

ref: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
text: Ba wiɛɛlaa faa gillɔɔ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi baaŋ fuuh, awia, i faa gil wiilchɔgaa chol ba ni.

ref: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
text: Denii Finɛhas faa izi tɛr a wichɔgɛɛra digna, a wiilchɔgaa tuŋ.

ref: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
text: Baŋ wa hel Mɛriba bulli la, ba kaa fuuh i baaŋ de, Moosis faa di tɔɔrɔɔ werge maa, dikuu ba wia.

ref: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
text: Ba faa gillɔɔ Moosis baaŋ fuuh werge maa, u ŋɔ wia di waa zummɛ.

ref: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
text: Ba faa waa a hɛssi la hina kpuwɛɛ gunla hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n faa ŋɔ ba ɛɛ la,

ref: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
text: ka ba ni baa faa ra paa dɔŋa haana, di ra ɛɛ a nɛra naana wia.

ref: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
text: I nɛra faa ra kuari a hɛssi hina vuga, a guŋ birgi lugɔ sidɛɛzi tɛɛ baa.

ref: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
text: Ba faa lauri ba biibaala ni ba biihaanaa di lizi mbusuzi ra tɛɛ Keenan hina vuga.

ref: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
text: Ba faa kpu ba biizi n waa chɔgri maa dɔɔwɛɛ, di lizi mbusu tɛɛ Keenan hina vuga, ba chal chɔgi a hɛri maa.

ref: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
text: Ba wiɛɛlaa faa gillɔɔ ba chɔgi bahinaa, ba wia waa kaa dɔɔ wibii tɛɛ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi.

ref: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
text: Denii i baaŋ faa fuuh i nɛra ni, i kii ba wia.

ref: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
text: Ba dɔma faa ra fir baa werge maa, ba birgi ba balaa di ra hum baa.

ref: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
text: Saŋa kpila maanii i ɔɔ faa lɛɛ baa, ka ba ra gbɛllii, ba wichɔgaa gil ba ra siuzi.

ref: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
text: Ka i ɔɔ faa nuu ba wilee, di na ba sinyɛna.

ref: that their enemies had pity on them.
text: I faa gillɔɔ banla maa n na sunni baa, bir na ba sinyɛna.

ref: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
text: Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, chaali yaa, di lɛɛ yaa lii hɛssi hina nonee biine, ya kaa waa jaamii, di ra dargi i sɔnnaniinanii la, yaa bɔra sɔɔni i chɔlaa biini.

ref: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
text: Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la dɛg chɔlaarɛ! Ií ra chɔluu filaŋkeŋ, di ra chɔluu saŋaa saŋa maa! Ií gil nɛr maa ŋɔ, “Ami!” Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: ) The Lord Is Good to His People
text: ) Kɔraawiizi winanaa ɛɛi chɔlaa yir

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
text: Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia wessoo, u nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
text: Ii banla maa Kɔraawiizi n lɛɛwɛ la, ií ra ŋɔ wia naa, ii banla uŋ lɛɛwɛ lii ii dɔma be,

ref: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
text: di chaali ia lii hɛhjaŋa, wiifurii, wiicholii, wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag ani wiifurii nodig wiikakag la.

ref: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
text: Baŋhina faa juuri hɛribɔduma biinii guŋŋ, ka ba waa ŋmɛnɛɛ nawɛɛ bá la ga so bolzeŋ.

ref: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
text: Lɔzi ni niinyɔgzi faa lau baabuu, ba tamii maa tuŋ.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Denii ba faa lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, bá tɔɔrɔɔ hiŋ biini, u lɛɛ baa lii a biinichɔg hiŋ biini.

ref: At once he brought you to a town.
text: U kpa baa di ga ŋmɛnideŋlii ga hel bolzeŋ la ban niŋ wer so.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: A dɛkkɔɔ ba ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuu u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ ani nuukpuuri wia la uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ baa la wia.

ref: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
text: U ɔɔ tɛɛ banla niinyɔgzi n na kpuu nii ba nyɔɔ, di tɛɛ lɔzima ge diunanaa ba di piŋ.

ref: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
text: Baŋhina faa du biinichɔg ni bɔbiri biinii, ba tɔ baa dia, di du baa yɔlɔzi,

ref: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
text: dikuu baŋ faa dɔɔ dignikpega, Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la be ani baŋ vɛɛ u baglaa wia.

ref: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
text: Ba faa gɛrgɔɔrɛ, dikuu humkpega wia, di chogli hɛri, ka nɛr maa faa waa hoo, ú hiini baa.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Denii ba faa lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, bá tɔɔrɔɔ hiŋ biini, u lɛɛ baa lii a biinichɔg biini,

ref: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
text: di faa kaa lizi baa lii a biinichɔg ani bɔbiri werge biini, ka chaahzi ba yɔlɔzi la.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: A dɛkkɔɔ ba ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuu u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ ani nuukpuuri wia la uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ baa la wia.

ref: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
text: U faa kuugi danyɛ gbessii, di kuugi lugbidaazi la ge baŋ kpawɛɛ karaa la.

ref: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
text: Baŋhina faa ɛɛ gɛnaarɛ di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.

ref: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
text: Ba faa kii diwii maanii, di dugli siu.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Denii ba faa lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, bá tɔɔrɔɔ hiŋ biini, u lɛɛ baa lii a biinichɔg biini.

ref: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
text: U faa ŋɔ wiarɛ ba na alaanfia, di lɛɛ baa lii ŋmam biini.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: A dɛkkɔɔ bá ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuu u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la, ani nuukpuuri wia la uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ baa la wia.

ref: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
text: A dɛkkɔɔ baŋ lizi jaaŋ kuna di ra tɛu, ka yir bɔsɔna yira di ra bagli u wiɛɛlaa maa wia.

ref: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
text: Baŋhina faa du muugberzenaa biinii, a muuzenaa ni, di ra yoo kuna.

ref: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
text: Ba na Kɔraawiizi wiɛɛlaa ni u nuukpuuri wiarɛ a muuzenaa ni.

ref: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, u faa ŋɔ wiarɛ pezeŋ izi, di gil a muuzeŋ nii ra lɔ werge.

ref: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
text: A nii lɔi faa gillɔɔ a muugbessi ra la chiŋ, di ra tuu zɛɛ, siaahmu faa zuu a nɛra, ba tamii maa tuŋ.

ref: You staggered like drunkards and gave up all hope.
text: Ba faa ra jiŋli alugɔ sinnyɔɔra, ba zumaa maa tuŋ.

ref: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
text: Denii ba faa lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, bá tɔɔrɔɔ hiŋ biini, u lɛɛ baa lii a biinichɔg biini.

ref: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
text: U faa gillɔɔ a pezeŋ teŋ, a nii lɔi ge siigi.

ref: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
text: Ba bɔra faa sɔɔnɔɔrɛ, dikuu aŋ teŋŋe wia, u faa kpogli baa gi, di la bɔr la banna nyiŋŋi.

ref: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
text: A dɛkkɔɔ ba ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuu u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ, ani nuukpuuri wia la uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ baa la wia.

ref: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ giluu muuni hiihzi, di gil bulli ge birgi bɔhilaa.

ref: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
text: U ɔɔ giluu hɛrsum sɛbzi, dikuu banla n du u biini la biinikpola wia.

ref: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
text: U ɔɔ kaa giluu poljigzi chɔɔ hɛribɔduma, di gil bulli ge chɔɔ hɛrhilii.

ref: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
text: Denii u gil lɔzima so, di ma ba bolzeŋ de di ra zuu,

ref: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
text: di par daazi la n na nɔŋ kooni, di kum kuna werge maa.

ref: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
text: U faa kissi baabuu ba wazi werge maa, waa gillɛ ba nauna ge ra tuŋ.

ref: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
text: Baŋ faa kpegli Kɔraawiizi nɛra, di ra sunni baa, ba faa ra di tɔɔrɔɔ ni mɔmɔsia la,

ref: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
text: u faa hah ba dɔma hinnɛ, di gil ba ra juuri hɛribɔdumazi, ba faa waa ba nyuu chaŋribɔr zummɛ.

ref: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
text: Ka u ɔɔ lizi nyaaraa lii ba dɔgnya biini, di gil ba domeezi wazi alugɔ peeza.

ref: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
text: Banla wia n deŋlee ɔɔ na gunnɛ, ba bɔra sɔɔni, biinikpola hina ge maa nuuzi tɔɔgi.

ref: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n bampirii chɔɔ bɔkpannɛ! N daŋ yir yira di chɔlii ni n biini maa!

ref: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
text: N daŋ feli izi, di lɔ n kem ni janjalaŋ mɔɔ, ka wiizi fur.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n danna chɔlii hɛssi maa biine, di yir yira di ra chɔlii nɛra maa biini.

ref: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
text: Dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la n ga bɛri chiŋ, i wibii dɔɔi la gba gaa chug chiŋ wia.

ref: Our God, may you be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a bagli i zenni chiŋ, di gil i girme tɔ hɛri naa maa ni.

ref: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
text: Kpa i fɔŋŋazeŋ la lɛɛ yaa, guŋ gil banla hiŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ la na bahinaa.

ref: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
text: Kɔraawiizi du u Diinaniinanii la biinii, di ŋɔ, “N kpegloore, awia, n daŋ bargi bolzeŋ Sɛkɛm, di kpa Sukɔf Waluu bɔnni n nɛra.

ref: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
text: Giliad ni Manasɛ maa ɛɛ n horaa, Ɛfram ɛɛ lugɔ n lugbii kahuro, Juda ɛɛ lugɔ n koori daŋkpala.

ref: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
text: Moab ɛɛ n niisannileere, n daŋ kpa n gawa ta Ɛdɔm ni, di ra bagli lugɔ u ɛɛ n hotte. Ka chaasi du Filisti hina ni, dikuu miŋ kpegli baa wia.”

ref: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, anɛɛ n niŋ kpogliŋ ba bolzeŋ la baŋ ma koŋlii bar lai? Anɛɛ n niŋ tɔ n see di la Ɛdɔmɛi?

ref: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiŋ lɛi vɛɛ yaa, haa kaa du yaa laallɔɔra di ra la laal bɔr laa?

ref: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
text: Hiini yaa ya kpegli yaa dɔma, newee waa hiinaa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ.

ref: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
text: Hiŋ du yaa be la wia, yaa daŋ kpegli baa, i daŋ kpegli yaa dɔma tɛɛ yaa.

ref: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na chɔliibuu, gilɛɛ siigi,

ref: Destructive and deceitful lies are told about me,
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, biinikpola hina ani karkanna ra ŋɔ n wiarɛ, di kanni kara ra chugiŋ.

ref: and hateful things are said for no reason.
text: Ba ŋɔ wichɔgaarɛ ra du n ni, di ra yooŋ pɛɛpɛɛ.

ref: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
text: Ba kpa chɔgrii di ra turgi n winanaa kim, haali miŋ nɔŋŋi baa, di suŋŋi wiizi di ra tɛɛ baa la gba.

ref: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
text: Ba kpa chɔgrii di ra turgi n winanaa kim, di kpa hahzi di ra turgi n nɔŋŋaa kim.

ref: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
text: Ba ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Lizi biinikpola hiŋ, ú diu seriya, di gil u himmaa haahri kpa wia chuguu.

ref: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
text: Di ba wa diu seriya, gil u chol, di gil u wiisuŋŋaa gba birgi wichɔgaa!

ref: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
text: Gil u miibɔɔ ɛɛ kpurii, nɛduma kpa u huma!

ref: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
text: Gil u biizi ɛɛ lalbiizi, u haaŋ ge birgi luhaaŋ!

ref: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
text: Gil u biizi gaagi di ra suŋŋi, di gil ba duŋŋi baa lii ba diikɔgni biine!

ref: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
text: Gil nɛr la kim un diwee foozi u kundɔɔlaa maa, di gil hɔɔhra wa foozi u kuuhni kuna maa.

ref: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
text: Gilɛɛ gil nɛr maa wàá ɛɛu winanaa gɛɛ di wàá suŋ u lalbiizi ni.

ref: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
text: Gil u dee dim, di gil ba suuh u sɔŋ jimini maa biini.

ref: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi ra liizi u naabaala wichɔgaa, di ŋmɛnɛ maa gilɛɛ wa gil u maa wichɔgaa ra tɛu.

ref: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi ɔɔ ra liizi ba wichɔgaa wia saŋa maa, di gil nɛra suuh ba wia kɔrai!

ref: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
text: U ŋmɛnɛ maa faa waa liizee lugɔ ú ɛɛ winanaa, ka faa ra tɔɔri, di ra kpu nyaara, anuula hina ani dɔgnya hina.

ref: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
text: U faa nɔŋŋi nɛra nuuzi seeire, gil nuuseei diu. U faa hah nɛra kissaare, gilɛɛ waa kissuu.

ref: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
text: U faa kpa nuuseeire birgi lugɔ u laala, a pɔɔh u bɔra alugɔ nii, di zuu u hoga biini alugɔ nuu.

ref: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
text: Gil a ɔɔ tɔ u ni alugɔ uŋ tɔ wɛjɛ, di ɔɔ vɔɔu alugɔ kirsɔɔ, saŋa maa!”

ref: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛr n dɔma digna guŋ, banla maa n ŋɔ a guŋ wichɔgaa di ra du n ni la.

ref: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, wa hiiniŋ gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la, di lɛɛŋ, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa winanaa wia.

ref: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
text: N nyaawɔɔ, maa kummaa dɔɔwɛ, n biini chɔgi werge maa.

ref: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
text: N na nyiŋŋuu ń leu alugɔ duaniŋ chunchugli, peu kpaŋ di ra kaali alugɔ fɛfɛgɛ.

ref: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
text: N naahiine yɔɔrɔɔrɛ, dikuu nuuvɔɔi wia, n ka hoga bɛŋ.

ref: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
text: N birgi mɔmɔsia kunnɛ tɛɛ n dɔma, ba ɔɔ nambuu di ra mamiŋ.

ref: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, wa hiiniŋ, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia, wa lɛɛŋ!

ref: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
text: Gil n dɔma zum lugɔ hinuu ra lɛɛŋ.

ref: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
text: Ba danna seeŋ nua, ka hiŋwaa ra kissiŋ, di ba waa yooŋ, ba daŋ di hiihzi, ka i balii waa dɔɔ bɔsɔna.

ref: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
text: Gil n dɔma di hiihzi werge, gil ba di hiihzi alugɔ baŋ laali tagtajaŋ.

ref: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n danna jaamii werge, n danna chɔlii nɛra chaalaa biini,

ref: You help everyone in need, and you save them from death.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, i ɔɔ hiini nyaarii, di lɛɛu lii banla n na nyiŋŋi ba kpuu be.

ref: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n Dɔɔri be, “So n nabɔmbɔr naa, ka ń gil i dɔma birgi i yoma.”

ref: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
text: N daŋ gil i kora chi Bolzeŋ Ziɔn, di ra yaa, í du i dɔma baambaaŋ di ra di kora.

ref: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
text: A hɔl la hin niŋ ŋɔ i lɔ i dɔma laal, a daŋ par i laallɔɔra, bá lii. Gunla ŋmɛnii n ɔɔ chol chɔɔzimpikke ni la, gúnnɛ i biipɔllaa ba i be, a bizennanaananaa la nyuuni.

ref: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
text: Kɔraawiizi hɛɛhzɔɔrɛ, wàá ka bir u nua, “I daŋ ɛɛ n kizeehiŋ di hanna la saŋa maa lugɔ Mɛlkizɛdɛk ni u naanna.”

ref: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
text: Kɔraawiizi du i nodig keŋkeree, u daŋ kpegli koora u baaŋ hɔpizii.

ref: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
text: U daŋ di hɛssi hina seriya, di kpu nɛra yaari bɔr maa, di kpegli durnya maa koora.

ref: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
text: A koori daŋ nyɔɔ ŋmɛnikɛraa gɔŋa niiri, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa di wer kpegli u dɔma.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! N danna jaami Kɔraawiizi werge ni n biini maa, u nɛra chaalaa biini.

ref: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
text: Kɔraawiizi wiɛɛlaa ɛɛ wizenaare werge maa, banla maa bɔra n sɔɔnɛɛ a wia, ɔɔ aah siwiire di ra nyiŋŋi ba zum a zɛɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
text: U wiɛɛlaa dɔɔ girme ani zennii werge, u wideŋlaa ge waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
text: Kɔraawiizi wàá gil nɛra suuh u nuukpuuri wia, u dɔɔ winanaarɛ di ra na nɛra sinyɛna.

ref: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
text: U ɔɔ ra tɛɛ banla n na kpaubuu girme diwee, di ra liizi u ni baa nuukpaŋ la wia.

ref: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
text: U bagli u nɛraa u wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋa, di lii uŋ kpa hɔɔhra hɛssi tɛɛ baa la biini.

ref: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
text: U wiɛɛlaa maa deŋloore di dɔɔ wibii, u widaulaa ge dɛg yardaa.

ref: They are true and right and will stand forever.
text: A du denii di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa, u dawaabuu a deŋli di dɔɔ wibii.

ref: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
text: U gillɔɔ u nɛra na bahinaa, u ni baa ɛɛ nuukpaŋ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ. U sɔŋ ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ, di dɛg ɔmaa werge!

ref: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
text: Nunzuma dɔɔi faaraarɛ Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa, banla maa n na hiŋ u widaulaa, dɔɔ wia zɛɛ zumaarɛ nɛnnɛ. Ií ra chɔluu saŋa maa.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Nɛr la maa n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi nuu sumaa, unla bɔra n ɔɔ sɔɔni werge, dikuu u widaulaa wia.

ref: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
text: U biizi daŋ dɔɔ fɔŋŋa hɛri naa biini, ú naanna na kissaa.

ref: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
text: U domee daŋ dɔɔ kuna, di ɛɛ daama hina, ú nyɛɛli, di ra la saŋa maa.

ref: They will be so kind and merciful and good, that they will be a light in the dark for others who do the right thing.
text: Haali bɔbiri biini, bɔr ɔɔ chaanuu tɛɛ banla wia n deŋlee ni banla n na ɛɛ winanaa, di ra suŋ nɛra ni, di dɔɔ wibii.

ref: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
text: Nɛr la n na kim nɛra ni bunya, di ra hum u huma ni wibii, nuu sumaa.

ref: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
text: Nɛr la wia n deŋlee, ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá leu, ba daŋ ɔɔ ra liizi u wia saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
text: U banchule wàá lɔ, di u wa nuu amaniyechɔgaa. U bampirii lau Kɔraawiizii, u yarduu nɛnnɛ.

ref: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
text: Wia wɔɔ titte gɛɛ u ra ɔm, u zummɔɔ nɛnnɛ lugɔ u daŋ na u dɔma cholaa.

ref: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
text: U bɔnni u kunaa ra tɛɛ nyaara. U winanaa wàá tuŋ maa. U daŋ dɔɔ fɔŋŋa ni girme.

ref: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
text: Biinikpola hina na guŋ, bá baana ra fuuh, bá ra binnuu tiiih ni hahzi, bá wia tuŋ, bá tamii tuŋ saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Ií banla n ɛɛ u balaa, ií ra chɔluu, ií ra darguu!

ref: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
text: Ií ra darguu filaŋkeŋ ani saŋa maa.

ref: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
text: Di lii wiifurii di wa kaali wiicholii, ií ra dargi Kɔraawiizi!

ref: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
text: Waabuu ra di kora hɛssi maa ni, u girme bɛri chinchiŋ gba ninɛɛ.

ref: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
text: Anɛɛ n lugɔ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na humɛi, unla n soge ú koorikara ni chinchiŋ lai,

ref: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
text: di ɔɔ willi, ú binni chiŋ ani hɛri maa lai?

ref: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
text: U ɔɔ giluu nyaara wia kuari, di lizi baa lii dɔgnya biini,

ref: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
text: di gil ba ni sitɔɔra ra kpau, sitɔɔra la n ɛɛ ú himmaa nɛra.

ref: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: U ɔɔ tɛɛ hahbaraa girme u dia, di tɛu biizi, u dɔɔ bɔsɔna. Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
text: A hɔl la Izrɛl hina n lii Ijip, a hɔl la Jekɔb naanna n lii hɛrduma la,

ref: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
text: Juda hinaa faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nɛnanaananaa, Izrɛl hina ge ɛɛ u himmaa kundɔɔlaa.

ref: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
text: A Muuzeŋaahmu faa bargi, ba sibɔɔ, Jɔɔdan muu ge palaa faa teŋ.

ref: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
text: Bizenaa faa ra zaahzi alugɔ pebala, giŋgimee gba ra zaahzi alugɔ pebizi.

ref: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
text: Muuzeŋaahmu, bɛɛ ɛɛi, i bargɛi? Jɔɔdan muu, bɛɛ n baani i gil palaai?

ref: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
text: Bizenaa, ɛrɛɛ ii ra zaahzi alugɔ pebalai? Giŋgimee, ɛrɛɛ ii ge ra zaahzi alugɔ pebizei?

ref: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
text: Hɛri, zigli Kɔraawiizi see, Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum la see,

ref: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
text: U ɔɔ giluu bii birgi pol, di gil bikpega birgi bulli.

ref: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa ani i wibii dɔɔi wia, a dɛkkɔɔ banna tɛi girme. Yaa lɛi dɛkkɛ.

ref: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ hɛssi hina ra pɛɛzi yaa, “Lee Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la duɛi?”

ref: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
text: Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la du chinne, di ra ɛɛ gunla maa n paruu.

ref: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
text: Saliŋhuŋŋa ni salinnɛ ɛɛ baawaa vuga, neweare kuaraa.

ref: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
text: A dɔɔ nuuzii, ka a wàá ŋɔ wia, di dɔɔ siwee, ka a wàá wer na.

ref: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
text: Di dɔɔ digna, ka a wàá nuu wia, di dɔɔ miizizi, ka a wàá nuu sɔɔh.

ref: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
text: Di dɔɔ nonee, ka a wàá wer gbɔgzi kummaa, di dɔɔ naazi, ka a wàá wer vol, a waa gbɔgza maa ge dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
text: Nɛra la maa n kuaraa daŋ ɛɛ lugɔa, gunnɛ banla maa n yardaa gba du.

ref: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
text: Izrɛl hina, ií yardi Kɔraawiizi, waabuu ra hiini ia, di ra guu ia.

ref: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
text: Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, ií yardi Kɔraawiizi, waabuu ra hiini ia, di ra guu ia.

ref: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
text: Ii banla maa n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi la, ií yarduu, waabuu ra hiini ia, di ra guu ia.

ref: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra liizi yaa wiarɛ, u daŋ kissi yaa. U daŋ kissi Izrɛl hina ni u kizeehina maa.

ref: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ kissi banla maa n na ɔmuu, nɛzenaa ni nɛdumazi maa.

ref: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi gil ii wazi, ii ni ii biizi maa!

ref: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi kissi ia, unla n ta chiŋ ni hɛri la.

ref: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
text: Chinchiŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi bɛŋ hotte, ka u kpa hɛri ge tɛɛ newea.

ref: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
text: Nɛr maa wàá wer chɔlii, di u siuwɔ, nɛr maa wàá chɔlii ŋmam biini.

ref: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Ka yaa banla n na nyiŋ la, danna chɔli Kɔraawiizi, di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa. Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
text: N nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizii, dikuubɛɛwiai, u nuu n loobii ani n wiisuŋŋaarɛ.

ref: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
text: U ɔɔ keŋŋi dignii di ra nuu n be, awia, n danna yiruu n de dui maa biini.

ref: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
text: Siu ŋmɛnni faa gargimbuu, ɔnsii chol n ni, ɔnsii faa lawiŋ werge, n bɔra ra sa.

ref: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
text: Denii n lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ!”

ref: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra hiini gɛrgaa, miŋ faa du siaahmu biini, u lɛɛmbuu.

ref: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
text: Awia, n daŋ kaa bir dɔɔ bɔkpega, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi ɛɛmbuu nɛnnɛ.

ref: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
text: U lɛɛmbuu lii siu be, di fiizi n sinii. Waa gillɛ n na lɔɔzi naazi.

ref: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
text: Awia, n danna hiŋ u nua, durnya naa biini.

ref: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
text: N yardɔɔrɛ. Awiarɛ n ŋɔ, “N biini chɔkkɔɔ werge maa.”

ref: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
text: N ɔnsii werge biini, n faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Nɛr maa ɛɛ karkannii.”

ref: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
text: Bɛɛ ń wer kpa turgi Kɔraawiizi, dikuu u winanaa la maa uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛŋ wiai?

ref: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
text: N daŋ ta siŋ tɛu, di jaamuu dikuu uŋ lɛɛŋ wia.

ref: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
text: N daŋ lizi nuuzi la maa miŋ lɛɛwɛ la tɛu, u nɛra maa see.

ref: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
text: A ɔɔ wii Kɔraawiizi ninɛɛ, di u nɛr siuwɔ.

ref: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n ɛɛ i baliirɛ, n danna humii gunla n maa n humii la. Hinuu lɛɛŋ lii siu be.

ref: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
text: N daŋ lizi jaaŋ kuna tɛi, ka ra suŋŋii.

ref: I will keep my promise to you when your people
text: Di lizi nuuzi la maa miŋ lɛɛwɛ la tɛi, i nɛra maa see,

ref: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: i Dia la n du Jɛrusalɛm biini. Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
text: Hɛssi hina maa, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Nɛra maa, ií ra chɔluu.

ref: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: U nɔŋŋaa kannɔɔ tɛɛ yaa, u wibii dɔɔi ge waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ. Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
text: Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia wessoo, u nɔŋŋaa ge waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
text: Izrɛl hina, ií ŋɔ, “U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.”

ref: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
text: Gil Kɔraawiizi kizeehina la n ɛɛ Aarɔn naanna ŋɔ, “U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.”

ref: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
text: Banla maa n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi, ií ŋɔ, “U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.”

ref: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
text: N biinichɔg werge saŋa, n yir Kɔraawiizii, u nuu, di lɛɛŋ ta.

ref: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
text: Kɔraawiizi du n benii, awia, maa ɔm. Bɛɛ newee kaa wer ɛɛnnɛi?

ref: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
text: Waabuu ra hiiniŋ, awia, n daŋ kpegli n dɔma.

ref: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
text: Hiŋ yardi Kɔraawiizi, aabuu bɔmbɔ hiŋ dɛlli newee.

ref: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
text: N dɔma kpila faa barimbuu, ka Kɔraawiizi tɛŋ fɔŋŋa, n chɔgi ba maa!

ref: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
text: Ba faa barimbuu alugɔ huuh, ka Kɔraawiizi tɛŋ fɔŋŋa, n chɔgi ba maa!

ref: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
text: Ba faa milimbuu alugɔ huuh, ka siuzi manaŋ alugɔ niŋ n fuuh sɔɔhri la, Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋaa n kpa di chɔgi baa.

ref: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
text: Ba faa taambuu n la har, di ra nyiŋŋi bá kpegliŋ, ka Kɔraawiizi hiiniŋ.

ref: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
text: Kɔraawiizi tɛmbuu kpegzi ani fɔŋŋa, waabuu lɛɛŋ.

ref: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
text: Ií ra nuu Kɔraawiizi nɛra n kpegli ba dɔma, di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna, ba tanti diini biine. “Kɔraawiizii kpa u banonii di ɛɛ guŋ!

ref: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
text: U lalli u banoniire chiŋ, yaa kpegli yaa dɔma, laal biini!”

ref: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
text: Màá siu, n daŋ du de, di ra sii wia la Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛwɛ.

ref: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
text: Kɔraawiizi tɛr n dignii werge maa, ka waa gillɛ n siu.

ref: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
text: Ií pilli Kɔraawiizi Dia dominuuzi tɛŋ, ń zuu jaami Kɔraawiizi!

ref: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
text: Kɔraawiizi Dia dominuarɛ keŋ, banla wia n deŋlee bɛnnɛ niŋ wer ga de zuu.

ref: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na chɔliibuu, dikuu hiŋ nuu n wiisuŋŋaa, di gil n kpegli n dɔma wia.

ref: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
text: Bii la maara n faa vɛɛwɛ ha labuu jaa ɛɛ bikpeg la baŋ kpawɛɛ di ra faari dia zɛɛ.

ref: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
text: Kɔraawiizi wiɛɛliirɛ guŋ. A tir yaabuu werge.

ref: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
text: A hɔpizii naabuu Kɔraawiizi lizi di bagli u kpegzi, ií gil yaa bɔra sɔɔni, ya ra di yaa hinaa.

ref: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛ yaa! Gil yaa wia kuari!

ref: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
text: Tibaarikala! Unla n kpa Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ di ra ba la, nuu sumaa! Ii banla maa ge n du Kɔraawiizi Dia, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni.

ref: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
text: Kɔraawiizi kpaŋkpaŋ bɛnnɛ du de, waabuu ɛɛ winanaa di ra tɛɛ yaa. Ií kpogli abɛ paŋhoori di ra di iihinaa, di ta gɔɔri di bar mbusu lizibɔr la.

ref: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
text: I bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, n danna tɛi jaaŋ, di ra sii i zenni wia.

ref: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
text: Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia wessoo, u nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
text: Banla n waa chɔgri maa dɔɔwɛ, baabuu ra hiŋ Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg la, ba nuu sumaa.

ref: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
text: Banla maa n na hiŋ u widaulaa, di ra sɛɛ u wia ani ba biine maa, ba nuu sumaa.

ref: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
text: Ba waa wichɔgaa ra ɛɛ, ka ra hiŋ u ŋmɛnizi.

ref: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i tɛɛ yaabuu i Gbɔgni, di ŋɔ ya ra hiŋaa ni wibii.

ref: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
text: A vii ɛɛ lugɔ n wettoo di ra hiŋ i widaulaa la nɛnnɛ!

ref: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
text: Gunnɛ maa wer di hiihzi, di n na hiŋ i widaulaa nɛnnɛ.

ref: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
text: Minna helli i seriyazi dii n deŋlee la wia, n daŋ chɔlii ani biinihuŋŋu.

ref: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
text: N danna hiŋ i Gbɔgni la! Gilɛɛ wa vɛɛŋ ta kɔrai! Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg hiŋaa wia

ref: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
text: Ɛrɛɛ biipɔllii wia wer ɛɛ di deŋlei? See unna hiŋ i widaulaa.

ref: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
text: N kpa n biini maanii ra hiŋii, gilɛɛ gil n waa leu, i widaulaa la hiŋaa biini.

ref: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
text: N kpa i Gbɔgrɛ du n biini, ń gilɛɛ kaa wàá ɛɛ wichɔgii maa di ra zuu i ni.

ref: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ chɔlii, bagliŋ i ŋmɛnizi.

ref: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
text: N daŋ kuari ŋɔ i Gbɔgni la maa hiŋ tɛɛ yaa la wia.

ref: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
text: N bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ minna hiŋ i Gbɔgni la, di kaali daama werge dɔɔi.

ref: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
text: N daŋ helli i widaulaa la, di ra pessi i baglaa la ge nɛnnɛ.

ref: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
text: I Gbɔgni wia ra parimbuu werge, màá suuh i widaulaa ge wia. Bɔsɔna la n du Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg biini wia

ref: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
text: Ɛɛŋ winanii, mìŋ́ i balii wer dɔɔ miibɔɔ, guŋ gil ń wer hiŋ i nua.

ref: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
text: Pilli n siwee ń wer na nuukpuuri wia la n du i Gbɔg biini la.

ref: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
text: N ɛɛ hɔɔhrii hɛri naa biini, awia, gilɛɛ kpa i widaulaa la suah n ni.

ref: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
text: N na kɛlli i Gbɔgni ninɛɛ di ra nyiŋŋi n zumaa saŋa maa.

ref: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
text: I ɔɔ hau banla n na jigsi ninɛɛ, di see banla n vɛɛ i widaulaa hiŋaa nua.

ref: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii ba huuhni ni ba chɛɛtɛ ɛɛi be, dikuubɛɛwiai, n na hiŋ i widaulaarɛ.

ref: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
text: Haali koora n soge di ra ta n jina gba, ka n danna helli i baglaazi la.

ref: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
text: I baglaa labuu ra pariŋ, aabuu ra biriŋ liize. Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg hiŋaa siaahmu ni wia

ref: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
text: N na nyiŋŋi siwaarɛ, bir tɛŋ fɔŋŋa gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.

ref: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
text: N bagli wia la maa miŋ ɛɛwɛɛ tɛi, i nuu tɛŋ, awia, bagliŋ i widaulaa.

ref: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
text: Bagliŋ n zum i Gbɔgni la zɛɛzi, di wer a lɔ i nuukpuuri wia fasani.

ref: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
text: N bɔra maanii huahwɛ ni biinichɔg, gil n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.

ref: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
text: Gilɛɛ gil n waa leu, suŋ n ni, di bagliŋ i Gbɔg la.

ref: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
text: N sɛɛ wibii ŋmɛnɛɛ hiŋaarɛ, n bampirii ge lau i Gbɔgni la.

ref: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n hiŋ i baglaa labuu, gilɛɛ gil n waa di hiihzi!

ref: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
text: N daŋ aah siwii di ra hiŋ i baglaazi, dikuubɛɛwiai, i daŋ gil n dɔɔ wia zɛɛ zumaa werge. Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi wia zɛɛ zumaa

ref: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagliŋ i Gbɔgni la zɛɛzi, ń wer ra hiŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
text: Tɛŋ wia zɛɛ zumaa, ń zum i Gbɔg la, di wer a hiŋaa ni n biini maa.

ref: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
text: Bagliŋ i widaulaa ŋmɛnɛɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, aabuu ra tɛŋ bɔsɔna.

ref: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
text: Bir n bampirii du i Gbɔgni ni, ka u gilɛɛ waa du kundɔɔi ni.

ref: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
text: Lizi n laakal lii kumpɛɛri ni, ka ra guuŋ n de dui biini, gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.

ref: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
text: Hiŋ nua la hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ i balii la, guŋ gil bá ra ɔmii.

ref: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii hiihzi la minna ɔm la biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, i Gbɔgni wessoo.

ref: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
text: N na kɛlli i nuuzi ninɛɛ werge! Awia, guu n miibɔɔ, dikuu i wideŋlaa wia. Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg yardaa wia

ref: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bagliŋ gunla hiŋ nɔŋŋiŋ mag, ka lɛɛŋ gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.

ref: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
text: Denii n jaa wer ŋɔ wia tɛɛ banla n na chagziŋ la, dikuu miŋ yardi i wiŋɔzi wia.

ref: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
text: Hiiniŋ, ń wer di ra ŋɔ wibii saŋa maa, dikuu n tamii maa n du i widaulaa la ni wia.

ref: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
text: N daŋ ɔɔ ra hiŋ i Gbɔg, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
text: N daŋ jaa so ni bampirsɔna nɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛ aniaa di hiŋ i baglaazi.

ref: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
text: N daŋ sii i widaulaa la koora see, ka màá di hiihzi.

ref: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
text: I widaulaa hiŋaa parimbuu, dikuu min nɔŋŋaa wia.

ref: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
text: N na tɔgzi i widaulaa labuu, di nɔŋŋaa n danna fɛ a wia. Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni yardaa wia

ref: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a liizi nua la hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ i balii la, u gillɔɔ n dɔɔ tamii.

ref: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
text: Haali n tɔɔrɔɔ dii gba biini, ka n dɔɔ bɔsɔnaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, i nuuŋɔɔlii la tɛmbuu miibɔɔ.

ref: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
text: Banla n kpoŋŋe la ra ɛɛmbuu chɛɛtɛ, ka maa i Gbɔg la vɛɛwɛ ta.

ref: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, di n wa liizi i faala maa Gbɔgni la wia, a ɔɔ ra tɛmbuu bɔsɔna.

ref: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
text: Di n wa na biinikpola hina n na chɔgi i Gbɔg la, n baaŋ ɔɔ fuuuh werge maa.

ref: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
text: N durnya biini de dui saŋa, n yir yiraa di bagli i widaulaa la wia.

ref: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, anna liizi i wiarɛ hamuŋa ni, di ra fɛ i Gbɔg la wia.

ref: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
text: N na n bɔsɔnaa lii i widaulaa la hiŋaa biini. Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni hiŋaa siaahmu ni wia

ref: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu kunla maa min dɔɔwɛ, n ŋɔ nuarɛ lugɔ n danna hiŋ i Gbɔgni la.

ref: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
text: N na suŋŋiibuu ni n biini maa lugɔ i na n sinyɛna, gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.

ref: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
text: N pessi n wiɛɛlaarɛ, di ŋɔ nua lugɔ n danna hiŋ i baglaazi la.

ref: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
text: N daŋ yali siwee, di ra hiŋ i widaulaa la.

ref: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
text: Biinikpola hina hembuu sidɛɛzi, ka maa i Gbɔg la wia suuhwɛ.

ref: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
text: Aŋ izuu hɛhhɛɛhzi ni di ra chɔlii, dikuu i widaulaa n deŋlee wia.

ref: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
text: Banla maa n na ɔmii ani banla maa n na hiŋ i Gbɔgni la ɛɛ n dammuzii.

ref: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la, su hɛri naa maanii, awia, bagliŋ i widaulaa. Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg tɔna wia

ref: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i hiŋ i nuuŋɔɔlii labuu, i wia wessoo tɛɛ mìŋ́ i balii.

ref: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
text: Tɛŋ nunzuma ni sichaana, dikuubɛɛwiai, n yardi i widaulaarɛ.

ref: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
text: N faa ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ, i tɛr n digni, ka filaŋkeŋwaa, n jaa ra hiŋ i widaulaarɛ.

ref: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
text: I wia wessoo, i wiɛɛlaa ge du wer, awia, bagliŋ i widaulaa.

ref: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
text: Banla n kpoŋŋe kanni karaa di ra chugiŋ, ka n na hiŋ i baglaazii ni n biini maa.

ref: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
text: Ba waa wia zɛɛ zumaa dɔɔwɛ, ka i Gbɔg wia parimbuu.

ref: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
text: Hiŋ faa tɛr n digni la, guŋ wessoo tɛŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, guŋ gillɔɔ n helli i widaulaa la.

ref: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
text: I Gbɔg la wessoo tɛŋ, di kaali saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋa kagboŋa. Gunla Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg wia n dɔɔ wibii

ref: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
text: Hinuu taŋ di ra guuŋ, awia, tɛŋ wia zɛɛ zumaa ń helli i widaulaa.

ref: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
text: Banla n na tɛi girme la daŋ naŋ, bá bɔra sɔɔni, dikuubɛɛwiai, n yardi i nuuŋɔɔlii labuu.

ref: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n zummɔ lugɔ i seriya dii deŋloore. I faa tɛr n dignii, dikuu i wia n dɔɔ wibii wia.

ref: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
text: Gil i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la tɛŋ bɔsɔna, gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua tɛɛ mìŋ́ i balii la.

ref: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
text: Suŋ n ni n wer du de, dikuubɛɛwiai, i Gbɔg labuu ra tɛŋ bɔsɔna.

ref: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
text: Gil banla n na gbɛllii la di hiihzi, dikuu baŋ kanni kara di ra chugiŋ pɛɛpɛɛ wia, ka miŋwaa danna lɔ i baglaazi la fasani.

ref: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
text: Gil banla maa n na ɔmii ani banla maa n zum i widaulaa zɛɛzi ba n be.

ref: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
text: Gil n na hiŋ i widaulaa la nɛnnɛ, gunnɛ màá di hiihzi. Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi lɛɛi wia

ref: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n bɔra maanii huahwɛ, dikuu minna kpaŋii i lɛɛŋ wia. I wiŋɔzi ninɛɛ n tamii maa du.

ref: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
text: N siwee waa kaa ra na nɛnnɛ, dikuu minna binni i nuuŋɔɔlii la ŋmɛnɛɛ wia. Anna pɛɛzi, “Saŋa bɛɛ í hiininnei?”

ref: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
text: Haali miŋ ɛɛwɛ lugɔ nyɔɔzi n kussi lɔkkɔ gba, ka maa i widaulaa la wia suuhwɛ.

ref: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
text: Ɛrɛɛ n kpaŋii birgi magɛi? Saŋa bɛliirɛ í tɛr banla n na sunniŋ la dignai?

ref: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
text: Banla n kpoŋŋe ki bɔɔnii bá lawiŋ, ba waa i Gbɔg ra hiŋ.

ref: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
text: I widaulaa maa dɛg yardaarɛ nɛnnɛ, nɛra kanni karaa di ra chugiŋ, hiiniŋ!

ref: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
text: A ka tama ka ba tuŋ n wia durnya naa biini, ka maa i widaulaa la vɛɛwɛ ta.

ref: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
text: Dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia, lɛɛŋ, ń wer di ra hiŋ i baglaazi la. Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg yardaa wia

ref: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wiŋɔɔlii du denii saŋa maa, u du chinne chigigi.

ref: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
text: I wibii dɔɔi du denii di ra la jimini maa. Hinuu ta hɛri, u chi u chignibɔr chigigi.

ref: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
text: Hinuu gillɛ kummaa du de di wa lii ni zinaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, a maanii ra humii.

ref: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
text: Di i Gbɔg la faa wanna tɛɛ bɔsɔna, keŋ n vii siuwɔ n tɔɔrɔɔ biini.

ref: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
text: N ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá suuh i baglaazi la wia, dikuubɛɛwiai, aabuu i kpa di ra guuŋ.

ref: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
text: N ɛɛ i hotte, lɛɛŋ! N ɛɛ aniaa ń zum i widaulaa la.

ref: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
text: Biinikpola hina sogo sagaa, bá chɔgi n wia, ka n daŋ fɛ i Gbɔgni la nfɛrɛ.

ref: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
text: N nɔŋŋi i Gbɔg labuu nɛnnɛ! Anna fɛ u nfɛrɛɛ hɔpizii maa.

ref: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
text: I widaulaa la gillɔɔ n dɔɔ nunzuma di kaali n dɔma, dikuu aŋ du n be saŋa maa wia.

ref: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
text: N dɔɔ wia zɛɛ zumaarɛ di kaali n bagla, dikuubɛɛwiai, anna lɔ i baglaazi la fasanii.

ref: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
text: N dɔɔ nunzumaa kaali nɛbinaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, n na hiŋ i baglaazii.

ref: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
text: N na ɛɛ aniaa n gilɛɛ waa lɔ naachɔgii maa, dikuu minna nyiŋŋi n hiŋ i wiŋɔɔlii wia.

ref: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
text: Maa i widaulaa la vɛɛwɛ ta, dikuubɛɛwiai, i himmaanii ɛɛ n bagli.

ref: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.
text: I wiŋɔzi hiŋaa summɔɔ tɛŋ, a summɔɔ kaali huuhnuu.

ref: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
text: N dɔɔ nunzumaa di lii i baglaazi la biini, awia, n hah machɔgaa maanii. Bɔchaaŋ du Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg biinii

ref: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
text: I wiŋɔɔlii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ fintina, di ra chaani n ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
text: N hɛɛhzɔɔrɛ di ŋɔ nua lugɔ n danna hiŋ i Gbɔgni la n deŋlee la.

ref: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n tɔɔrɔɔ kannɔɔ werge, tɛŋ miibɔɔfalii gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.

ref: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛ n wiisuŋŋaa, ka bagliŋ i Gbɔgni la.

ref: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
text: Maa ɔɔ suuh i baglaazi la wia, haali miŋ ɔɔ du siaahmu biini gba.

ref: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
text: Biinikpola hina hembuu sidɛɛ, ka maa i widaulaa la hiŋaa vɛɛwɛ.

ref: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
text: I Gbɔgni la ɛɛ n daamaa saŋaa saŋa maa, aabuu ra tɛŋ bɔsɔna n biini.

ref: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
text: N aah siwiire ń hiŋ i widaulaa, di ra ba hɔpizii la min niŋ siu. Hindɔɔi n du Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg biini wia

ref: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
text: N hah banla n wɛɛ ra hiŋ ni wibii labuu, ka miŋwaa nɔŋŋi i Gbɔgrɛ.

ref: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
text: Hinuu n duuribɔr ni n guuri, n tamii du i nuuŋɔɔlii la ninɛɛ.

ref: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
text: Wichɔgɛɛra, ií lii n be, ka giliŋ n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi la minna hum la widaulaa!

ref: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
text: Tɛŋ fɔŋŋa gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la, ń dɔɔ miibɔɔ, gilɛɛ gil n tamii bir pɛɛ.

ref: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
text: Lawiŋ, ń wer na lɛɛi, di ɔɔ ra hiŋ i widaulaa la.

ref: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
text: I ɔɔ vɛɛ banla maa n waa i Gbɔgni ra hiŋ labuu ta, ba nɛdaraa la maa bir pɛɛ.

ref: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
text: I ɔɔ ra ɛɛ hɛri naa biinikpola hina maanii alugɔ zɔga, guŋ wia, n nɔŋŋi i baglaazii.

ref: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
text: N bɔra ra sau dikuu minna ɔmii wia, ɔnsii lawiŋ werge maa, dikuu i Gbɔgni wia. Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg hiŋaa wia

ref: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
text: N ɛɛ wideŋlaa ani winanaarɛ, awia, gilɛɛ giliŋ tɛɛ n dɔma.

ref: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
text: Ŋɔ nua lugɔ i daŋ hiini mìŋ́ i balii, gilɛɛ gil banla n kpoŋŋe la ra sunniŋ.

ref: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
text: N siwee waa kaa ra na nɛnnɛ, dikuu minna binni i lɛɛi ni i wideŋlaa nuuŋɔɔlii ŋmɛnɛɛ wia.

ref: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
text: Ɛɛŋ gunla i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ n na bagli, di bagliŋ i widaulaa la.

ref: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
text: N ɛɛ i baliirɛ, awia, tɛŋ wia zɛɛ zumaa, ń wer zum i baglaazi la.

ref: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
text: Ka miŋwaa nɔŋŋi i widaulaa labuu kaali saliŋ, di kaali salinnanaa himmaa.

ref: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
text: Awia, n na hiŋ i baglaazi maanii, ka hah wichɔgii maa ŋmɛnɛɛ. Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg hiŋaa nyiŋŋaa wia

ref: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
text: I baglaazi la ɛɛ wizenaare, awia, n na hiŋaabuu ni n biini maa.

ref: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
text: I baglaazi wia zɛɛ pillaa ra ba bɔchaaŋ ninɛɛ, di ra tɛɛ bambuguu wia zɛɛ zumaa.

ref: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
text: N na hɛguu dikuu i widaulaa wia.

ref: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
text: A nuu n be, di na n sinyɛna, gunla hiŋ ɔɔ ra ɛɛ banla n nɔŋŋii la.

ref: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
text: Gilɛɛ gil n wàá lɔ naa, gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la, di gilɛɛ gil wichɔgii maa wàá di kora n ni.

ref: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii nɛra la n na sunniŋ be, ń wer di ra hiŋ i widaulaa la.

ref: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
text: Bir i siwee chaŋ n be, di bagliŋ i Gbɔgni.

ref: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wia deŋloore, i Gbɔgni ge dɔɔ wibii.

ref: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
text: I widaulaa la deŋloore, a waa bilaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
text: N baaŋ na fuuuh werge, dikuubɛɛwiai, n dɔma suuh i wiŋɔɔlaarɛ.

ref: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
text: I nuuŋɔɔlii waa ɛɛwɛ ra huhzi! Na gunla miŋ nɔŋŋaa!

ref: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
text: Nɛdumaa miŋ, ba ra gbɛlliŋ, ka maa i baglaazi la vɛɛwɛ.

ref: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
text: I wideŋlaa du denii ra la, i Gbɔg ge dɔɔ wibii.

ref: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
text: Tɔɔrɔɔ ni biinichɔg werge lawimbuu, ka i widaulaa la ɛɛ n bɔsɔna kunaa.

ref: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
text: I baglaazi ɔɔ deŋluu saŋa maa, awia, tɛŋ wia zɛɛ zumaa, ń wer dɔɔ miibɔɔ. Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi lɛɛi wia

ref: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na yiriibuu ni n biini maa, a nuu n be, ka n jaa ra hiŋ i widaulaa la!

ref: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
text: N lɔ wilee tɛi, lɛɛŋ, ka n jaa ra hiŋ i baglaazi la.

ref: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
text: Aŋ izuu chɔɔzimpikke ni, di lɔ wile di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa, n tamii maa du i nuuŋɔɔlii la ninɛɛ.

ref: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
text: Hamuŋa maa, n siwii waa ɔɔ tɔ, ka n ɔɔ ra lɔ i nuuŋɔɔlaa la fasanii.

ref: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nuu n be, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia, bagliŋ i nɛsunaa dɔɔi la, di ra guuŋ!

ref: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
text: Banla n na ta jinachɔgaa la duglɔɔrɛ, ka ba ni i Gbɔg la waa nɛɛwɔɔ dɔŋa ni.

ref: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i duglimbuu, i widaulaa la maa ge ɛɛ wibii.

ref: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
text: N helli i baglaazi la wiarɛ birgi, di jaa zum lugɔ i dawaabuu, á du de di ra la. Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia

ref: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
text: Binni n tɔɔrɔɔ ka lɛɛŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, maa i Gbɔg la wia suuhwɛ.

ref: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
text: Ŋɔ wia lɛɛŋ, a guuŋ gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.

ref: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
text: Biinikpola hina wàá wer na lɛɛi, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba waa i Gbɔgni la ra hiŋ.

ref: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nɛsunaa dɔɔi kannɔɔ werge. Awia, na n sinyɛna di lɛɛŋ.

ref: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
text: N dɔɔ dɔma kpila n na sunnimbuu, ka maa i Gbɔgni la hiŋaa vɛɛwɛ.

ref: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
text: Anna binni yarda nyaara ni hahzii, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba waa i wiŋɔɔlii la ra hiŋ.

ref: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na gunla minna nyiŋŋi i baglaazi la wia, i nɔŋŋaa waa birgaa dɔɔwɛ, awia, lɛɛŋ!

ref: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
text: I wiŋɔɔlaa maa ɛɛ wibiire, i Gbɔgni la n deŋlee la ge du denii di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa. Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni hiŋaa ni wibii wia

ref: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
text: Fɔŋŋa hina ra tɔɔrimbuu gunla n waa dɛkkɛ, ka n na tɔgzi i Gbɔg labuu.

ref: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
text: N bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ i nuuŋɔɔlii la wia alugɔ nɛr n kpaani daama kuŋ.

ref: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
text: N hah karaa, di kii a wia, ka n nɔŋŋi i Gbɔg labuu.

ref: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
text: Hɔpizii maa, aŋ jaamiibuu buniidaanɛɛ, dikuu i widaulaa n deŋlee wia.

ref: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
text: Banla n nɔŋŋi i Gbɔg la dɔɔ bampirsɔnaa werge maa, kummaa wàá wer gil ba lɔ naa.

ref: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na kpaŋiibuu lugɔ i lɛɛŋ, n na hiŋ i widaulaarɛ.

ref: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
text: N na hiŋ i baglaazi labuu, dikuu miŋ nɔŋŋaa ni n biini maa wia.

ref: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
text: N na hiŋ i widaulaa ni i baglaazi labuu, i zum n wiɛɛlaa maanii. Wiisuŋŋaa di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia
