ref: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil n wile naa helii, í tɛŋ wia zɛɛ zumaa gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la.

ref: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
text: A nuu n wiisuŋŋaa, di lɛɛŋ gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la!

ref: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
text: N danna chɔlii saŋa maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, i ra baglimbuu i Gbɔgni la hiŋaa.

ref: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
text: N danna yir i Gbɔgni la wia yira, dikuubɛɛwiai, i widaulaa deŋloore.

ref: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
text: Ɛɛ sirya di ra hiiniŋ saŋa maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, n na hiŋ i baglaazi labuu.

ref: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na kpaŋiibuu lugɔ i lɛɛŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, i Gbɔg labuu ra tɛŋ bɔsɔna.

ref: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
text: Tɛŋ miibɔɔ, ń wer di ra chɔlii, gil i baglaazi la tɛŋ fɔŋŋa.

ref: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
text: N leuwoo di ra juuri alugɔ peezi n leuwe, n ɛɛ i baliirɛ, nyiŋŋiŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, maa i Gbɔgni vɛɛwɛ ta.

ref: When I am in trouble, I pray,
text: N tɔɔrɔɔ biini, n yir Kɔraawiizii, u nuu n wiisuŋŋaa.

ref: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ lii karkanna ni nɛdatta be.

ref: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
text: Karkanna, ɛrɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dau iai? Ɛrɛɛ ú tɛr ii dignai?

ref: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
text: Laallɔɔra hobidiilaa ni niŋhɔlaa u kpa tɔɔri ia!

ref: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
text: Ii be sogaa chummɔɔ alugɔ miŋ soge Mɛsɛk ni Kɛda hina n ɛɛ biinikpola hina biini.

ref: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
text: N zuu nɛra la n hah bampirsɔna benii di birgi werge.

ref: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
text: Di n waa ŋɔ bampirsɔna wia, laal wiarɛ ba ge ɔɔ ra ŋɔ.

ref: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
text: N lalli n siweere di ra binni bizenaa nyuuni. Lee n hiinaa lii banɛi?

ref: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
text: N hiinaa daŋ lii Kɔraawiizi be, waabuu ta chiŋ ni hɛri.

ref: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
text: Wàá sɛɛ i chol, i guuri waa dɔɔ ra chɔɔ.

ref: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
text: Unla n na binni Izrɛl hina ni waa daari gɛɛ di ra chɔɔ dɔɔ.

ref: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
text: Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ ii guuri. U du ii benii di ra binni ia.

ref: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
text: Wiizi wàá baari ia hɔpizaa saŋa, baagu gba wàá ɛɛ ia wiimaa hamuŋa ni.

ref: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ lɛɛ ia lii wichɔgii maa biini. U daŋ kpa u nonii tɔ ii ni.

ref: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ guu ia, di ii waa lii gɛɛ di ii waa zuu, di lii filaŋkeŋ, di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
text: N bɔra faa sɔɔnɔɔrɛ, saŋa la baŋ wa ŋɔ n be, “Gil ya la Kɔraawiizi Dia la.”

ref: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
text: Yaa naazi jaa chi Jɛrusalɛm dominuuzenaa labuu filaŋkeŋ!

ref: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
text: Ba ma bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛmnɛ nɛnnɛ, u diini far dɔŋa, di du wer werge.

ref: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
text: Denii a nɛra dizi la maa ɔɔ ra ba, Izrɛl hina dizi la, di waa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, di ra darguu, gunla uŋ bagli baa la.

ref: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.
text: Denii Koori Deevid domee koora ɔɔ faa so, di ra di nɛra seriya.

ref: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
text: Ií suŋŋi bampirsɔna ra tɛɛ bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm, di ra ŋɔ, “Gil banla maa n nɔŋŋii nyɛɛli!

ref: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
text: Gil bampirsɔna du i biini, koozaa ge gilɛɛ du i kooridiini.”

ref: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
text: Dikuu n lulla ni n dammuzi wia, n ŋɔ Jɛrusalɛm benii, “Bampirsɔna du i biini.”

ref: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi Dia wiarɛ n suŋŋi nyɛɛlaa di ra tɛi la.

ref: Our Lord and our God, I turn my eyes to you, on your throne in heaven.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu n na binni chiŋ, bɔr la hiŋ di kora la.

ref: Servants look to their master, but we will look to you, until you have mercy on us.
text: Gunla balii n ɔɔ ra dɛlli u dɔɔri bɛŋ ni la, gúnnɛ n dɛllii, di ra ba saŋa la hin niŋ wa na yaa sinyɛna.

ref: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, suŋ yaa ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛra hah yaabuu birgi.

ref: and we can't take more abuse from those proud, conceited people.
text: Dɔɔna lɔ yaabuu mɔmɔsia birgi, banla n na jigsi ge gbɛlli yaa birgi.

ref: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
text: Di Kɔraawiizi faa waa yaa be duwɛɛ, ɛrɛɛ ii ŋɔi, Izrɛl hina?

ref: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
text: Di Kɔraawiizi lɛi faa du yaa be, yaa dɔma n faa izi yaa ni la,

ref: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
text: ba daŋ faa lil yaa nyinee, saŋa la ba baana n faa fuuh yaa ni la,

ref: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
text: a niizenaa daŋ faa paagi yaa kaali, a niilɔkpega daŋ faa wa tɔ yaa ni,

ref: of high and roaring waves.”
text: a niilɔkpega hiŋ daŋ faa paa yaa kaali.

ref: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
text: Ií gil ya ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuu uŋ waa yaa kpawɛɛ tɛɛ yaa dɔma ba chuuri wia.

ref: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.
text: Yaa foozoore alugɔ sidɛɛ n lau zumbee u foozi. A sidɛɛ kuwoore, yaa na yaa hinaa.

ref: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
text: Yaa hiinaa lii Kɔraawiizi la n ta chiŋ ni hɛri benii.

ref: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
text: Banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi la ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Bizeŋ Ziɔn n waa ziigaa dɔɔwɛ, ka chi chigigi saŋa maa la.

ref: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
text: Gunla a bizenaa n bar Jɛrusalɛm, di guuu la, gúnnɛ Kɔraawiizi bar u nɛra saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
text: Biinikpola hina wàá di kora, banla wia n deŋlee hɛri ni, di gunna ɛɛ, aŋhinabe, banla wia n deŋlee la gba daŋ birgi wichɔgɛɛra.

ref: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛɛ winanaa tɛɛ banla wia n wesse ni banla n ɛɛ biinihuŋŋu hina.

ref: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
text: Ka di i waa tɛr biikpola hina digna, tɛr banla ge n vɛɛ i ŋmɛnizi hiŋaa la digna. Izrɛl hina, Kɔ́raawiizi tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna!

ref: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
text: Saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n bir yaa ni ba Jɛrusalɛm la, a faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ deeza.

ref: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
text: Yaa faa mammɔɔ, di yir bɔsɔna yira. Denii hɛrdumazi nɛra faa ŋɔ yaa wia keŋ, “Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ wizenaare tɛɛ baa.”

ref: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
text: Wibii maa, u ɛɛ wizenaare tɛɛ yaa, yaa bɔra sɔɔni werge maa!

ref: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, kaa gil ya nyɛɛli, gunla dooŋ n ɔɔ ba, nii su gɔmbɔɔhilaa la.

ref: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
text: Gil banla n na duu ka ra wii la, kpa ba kuna ni bɔsɔna.

ref: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
text: Banla n chigɛ kundee di lii ra la bá ga duu, ka ra wii la, daŋ bir ba, di ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna, dikuu kuna la baŋ kpawɛɛ di ra ba la wia.

ref: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
text: Di Kɔraawiizi waa dia mawɛɛ, u maara ra kuuuh pɛɛ. Di waa bolzeŋ ge guuwe, u guure chigɔɔ pɛɛ.

ref: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
text: Wipɛɛrii lugɔ i ra kpu i hiŋ, di ra hum huma ra binni i hiŋ, di feli izaa, di waa chɔɔ saŋkara, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizii ɔɔ ra tɛɛ banla uŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ kuna, haali banna chɔɔgi dɔzi gba.

ref: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
text: Biizi ɛɛ sunzaarɛ lii Kɔraawiizi be, ba ɛɛ kissaa himmaanii.

ref: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
text: Baal la dee n dɔɔ a hobee naa kpila, nuu sumaa. Di u wa chem u dɔma ni, ba wàá wer kpegluu maa.

ref: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
text: Banla n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi, di ra hiŋ u widaulaa, nuu sumaa.

ref: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
text: I huma daŋ tɛi kuna la wia n tirii, í nyɛɛli, i bɔra sɔɔni.

ref: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
text: I haaŋ daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ daa la n na nɔŋ nɛnnɛ, í biibaala ɛɛ alugɔ daapɔla n na nɔŋ, di bar i diiribɔr.

ref: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
text: Baal la maa n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nua, u daŋ kissuu guŋ.

ref: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi kissii lii Ziɔn! Ú gil i na Jɛrusalɛm nyɛɛlaa, i de dui saŋa,

ref: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
text: di gil i dɔɔ miibɔɔjaŋ, di na i naanna! Izrɛl hina, Kɔ́raawiizi tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna!

ref: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
text: Ba sunnimbuu werge di lii n pɔlaa saŋa maa. Gil Izrɛl ŋɔ,

ref: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
text: “Di lii n pɔlaa saŋa maa, n dɔma sunnimbuu werge, ka ba waa wette kpegliŋ.

ref: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
text: Ba faa ŋmɛnni n harbɔɔrɛ, a ŋmɛra du luŋ alugɔ tiraata n par bɔr.

ref: The Lord always does right, and he has set me free from the ropes of those cruel people.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi la wia n deŋlee la lɛɛmbuu lii yonni biini.”

ref: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
text: Gil ba kpegli banla maa n hah Ziɔn, bá bir har.

ref: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi gil ba ɛɛ lugɔ sal kooree n waa ɔɔ hel, ka siu la.

ref: Don't let them be like wheat gathered in bundles.
text: Nɛr maa waa ɔɔ chaalaa gɛɛ di vɔɔzaa chi kaali.

ref: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
text: Nɛr la maa n ga de di ra kaali, wàá ŋɔ, “Kɔ́raawiizi kissii gɛɛ yaa ra kissiibuu Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ biini!”

ref: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n biini chɔkkɔɔ lugɔ miŋ chol vil biini, di wii ra yirii.

ref: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
text: A nuu n wile, keŋŋi digna nuu, ka suŋ n ni.

ref: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, di i faa sɛbi newee wichɔgaa ra dau, anɛɛ n wàá di bilchɔgɛi?

ref: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
text: Ka i gil yaa wichɔgaarɛ tɛɛ yaa, guŋ gil ya ra ɔmii werge.

ref: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
text: N na kɛlli Kɔraawiizi hiinaa ninɛɛ werge, n yardi u wiŋɔɔlaarɛ.

ref: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
text: Izrɛl hina, ií yardi Kɔraawiizi, dikuubɛɛwiai, u nɔŋŋaa waa tuŋ, u ɛɛ siryaa saŋa maa ú lɛɛ ia.

ref: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
text: U daŋ lɛɛ u nɛra Izrɛl hina di lii ba wichɔgaa maa biini.

ref: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n gil n jigsaa labuu, di bir har kpu n kpoŋaa la. Wizenaa gɛɛ witittaa wia lɛi tiriŋ.

ref: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
text: Ka n siwii suwoore, n bampirii sɔɔni. Gunla bichala n ɔɔ chɔɔ u maa naazi ni bɔɔiih la, gunnɛ n banchule waa kaa ra lɔ la.

ref: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
text: Izrɛl hina, ií yardi Kɔraawiizi filaŋkeŋ ani saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ waa suuh Koori Deevid ani dɔgnya la maa un diwee la wia.

ref: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
text: “Màá la dia gɛɛ di waa chɔɔ dɔɔ,

ref: or close my eyelids,
text: màá heezi gɛɛ di chɔɔ dɔɔ,

ref: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
text: di maa bɔr mawɛɛ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ú ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Hiŋ la Jekɔb n na hum la Dia.”

ref: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
text: Yaa faa nuu Kɔraawiizi Ni U Nɛra Nuukpaŋ Dɔɔi Dakka la wiarɛ lii Bɛtlihɛm, di wa nau Jiarim hina kooni.

ref: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
text: Denii yaa ŋɔ, “Ií gil ya la Kɔraawiizi Dia, di ga chi u koorikara see di jaamuu.

ref: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
text: Awia, n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi í ni i Nɛra Nuukpaŋ Dɔɔi Dakka la n na bagli i fɔŋŋa la, wa du i Dia naa biini.

ref: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
text: Gil i kizeehina ra ɛɛ wideŋlaa, di gil i nɛra ra chaasi, dikuu ba bɔra n sɔɔnɛɛ wia!”

ref: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
text: Dikuu i balii Koori Deevid wia, gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ koori la hiŋ lizɛɛ, ba waaruu nuu la.

ref: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
text: I faa ŋɔ nuarɛ tɛɛ i balii Koori Deevid, nua la hiŋ ŋmɛnɛ maa n wàá bir la, di ŋɔ, “N daŋ gil i biibaal bɛl, kpa i gawa, di di kora, di i wa siuwɔ.

ref: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
text: Di ba ra hiŋ n ni baa nuukpaŋ ni widaulaa la miŋ tɛɛ baa la, ba biibaala gba danna di a kora, saŋaa saŋa maa.”

ref: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
text: Kɔraawiizii lizi Ziɔn, ú kpau birgi u bol.

ref: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
text: U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ɛnnɛ ń so di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa, ɛnnɛ n na nyiŋŋi n so di ra di kora.

ref: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
text: N daŋ tɛɛ Ziɔn hina ba kunnyiŋŋaa maa nɛnnɛ, di tɛɛ ba nyaara diwee bá di piŋ.

ref: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
text: N daŋ kissi ba kizeehina, ba wiɛɛlaa maa biini. Ú nɛra ra yir yira, di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna.

ref: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
text: Denii ń gil Koori Deevid naanna la bɛl di kora, di ɛɛ koorizeŋ, di gil koori la miŋ lizɛɛ la kora chi, di hanna la.

ref: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
text: N daŋ gil u dɔma di hiihzi werge, ka u kora lawaa daŋ nyɛɛli, di yaa.”

ref: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
text: A wessoo werge maa di ɛɛ bɔsɔna, di Kɔraawiizi nɛra du dɔŋa be, di dɔɔ nuukpaŋ!

ref: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
text: Guŋ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nuu la yoola n kpolle, baŋ kpawɛɛ waari Aarɔn nyuu, a pal ra tuu u taŋhuna, di gaa zuu u tagta baŋaa ni.

ref: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
text: U ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Bizeŋ Hɛmɔn nyuu ŋmɛnii, n pallɛ tuu Ziɔn giŋgimee ni. Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ nua lugɔ u daŋ kissi baa ni miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
text: Kɔraawiizi balaa, ií ra chɔluu, ii banla maa n na hum u Dia biini hamuŋa ni la, ií ra chɔluu.

ref: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
text: Ií lalli ii nonee, Kɔraawiizi Dia la biini, di chɔluu!

ref: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi la n ta chiŋ ni hɛri, kissi ia lii Ziɔn!

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Kɔraawiizi balaa, ií ra darguu,

ref: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
text: ii banla n na hum Kɔraawiizi Dia la, ií ra chɔluu.

ref: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
text: Ií ra chɔluu, dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia wessoo. Ií yir yira di ra darguu, dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia wessoo.

ref: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.
text: Waabuu lizi Jekɔb naanna, Izrɛl hina, bá ɛɛ u hora.

ref: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
text: N zummɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa kaali vuga maa.

ref: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
text: Wii la maa n paruu, waabuu u ra ɛɛ chiŋ ni hɛri ani muuni vile maa biine.

ref: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
text: Ɔɔ giluu baamazi la n na ba dooŋ ni la lii bɔr maa, di gil a ra nyɛgzi. Dia la biini unna dau kuna la, denii ɔɔ gil peu lii.

ref: The Lord killed the first-born of people and animals in the land of Egypt.
text: U faa kpu Ijip hɛri newea ni sela maa biiluglaa.

ref: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
text: U faa ɛɛ wizenaa ni nuukpuuri wiarɛ de, ú tɛr ba koori ni u nabɔnzenaa maa digna.

ref: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
text: U faa chɔgi durnya hɛssi kpilaa, di kpu koora la n faa dɔɔ fɔŋŋazi werge la.

ref: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
text: Baabuu, Amɔri hina Koori Sihɔn, Basan hina Koori Ɔɔg ani koora la maa n faa du Keenan hɛri la.

ref: and gave their property to his people Israel.
text: Ka faa kpa ba hɛssi tɛɛ u nɛra Izrɛl hina, á ɛɛ ba kapɛttɛ kuna.

ref: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i sɔŋ waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ, jimini maa hina danna liizi i wia.

ref: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ ŋɔ wia lɛɛ u nɛra, di suŋ u balaa ni.

ref: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
text: Saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋaa ɛɛ hɛssi hina vuga, neweare kuaraa.

ref: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
text: A dɔɔ nuuzii, ka a wàá wer ŋɔ wia, di dɔɔ siwee, ka a wàá na.

ref: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
text: Di dɔɔ digna, ka a wàá wer nuu wia, a wàá heezi gba.

ref: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
text: Nɛra la maa n kuaraa daŋ ɛɛ lugɔa, gúnnɛ banla maa n yardaa gba du.

ref: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
text: Izrɛl hina, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Ii banla n ɛɛ u kizeehina, ií ra chɔluu!

ref: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
text: Levi dee, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, ií banla maa n na jaamuu, ií ra chɔluu!

ref: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi Ziɔn biini, u bol Jɛrusalɛm biini. Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
text: Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia wessoo. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
text: Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa kaali vuga maa la jaaŋ. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
text: Ií ra tɛɛ dɔɔra maa Dɔɔri la jaaŋ. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Only God works great miracles. God's love never fails.
text: U bɛnnɛ ra ɛɛ wizenaa. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
text: U nunzumaa u kpa ta chiŋ. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu yaa hɛri pɛ niiri ni. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu ta wiizi ni baagu. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
text: U gillɔɔ wiizi ra chaani hɔpizaa. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
text: Baagu ni chinchiŋwilaa ra chaani hamuŋa. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu faa kpu Ijip hina biibambilugla la. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu kpogli Izrɛl hina lii Ijip hɛri. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
text: U fɔŋŋazenne u kpa lɛɛ baa. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu gillɛ Muuzeŋaahmu bargi. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
text: U kpogli u nɛra giu. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
text: U faa gillɔɔ u nii di Ijip koori ni u laallɔɔra. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu kpogli u nɛra ga hɛribɔduma. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu kpu koorikpega la. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu kpu koora la n dɔɔ sɔŋ la. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu kpu Amɔri hina Koori Sihɔn. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu kpu Basan Koori Ɔɔg. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu kpa ba hɛssi tɛɛ u nɛra. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
text: U kpaabuu tɛɛ u balaa Izrɛl hina. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
text: U faa waa yaa wia suuhwɛ yaa tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
text: U faa lɛɛ yaabuu lii yaa dɔma nonee biini. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
text: Waabuu ra tɛɛ kunnyinii maa diwee. U nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
text: Babilɔn hɛri muuni kɛraarɛ yaa faa so di wii, saŋa la yaa n liizi Ziɔn wia la.

ref: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
text: Daajaŋra la n faa chigɛ de la ninɛɛ, yaa faa kpa yaa kemzi sagzi.

ref: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
text: Banla n faa kpegli yaa di lauri yaa, la ŋɔ, “Ií yir yira di deŋŋi yaa siwee. Ií yir di ra bagli Ziɔn wia!”

ref: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
text: Ɛrɛɛ ya ɛɛ yir yir tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, hɛrduma biinei?

ref: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
text: Jɛrusalɛm, di n wa suuh i wia, Kɔ́raawiizi gilɛɛ gil n kaa waa lɔ kem,

ref: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
text: di gilɛɛ kaa wàá yir yira maa, di maa kaa waa liizi i wia, lugɔ hinuu ra tɛŋ bɔsɔna werge!

ref: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a liizi wia la Ɛdɔm hina n ɛɛwɛ, a hɔl la Babilɔn hina n kpegli Jɛrusalɛm hina la, ba faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií purguu, di wigzi u zɛɛ maa!”

ref: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
text: Ba daŋ chɔgi ia, Babilɔn hina. Banla n niŋ turgi ia yaa kim, dikuu wii la iiŋ kpawɛɛ dau yaa la wia, nuu sumaa.

ref: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
text: Baabuu banla n niŋ wa kpa ii biifulli viiri bia.

ref: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na jaamiibuu ni n biini maa, n yir yiraa di ra chɔlii vuga see.

ref: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
text: Aŋ chiu, di bir n siwee chaŋ i Diinaniinanii la, di willi n nyuu di ra dargii, dikuu i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ ani i wibii dɔɔi la wia, dikuu hiŋ baglɛɛ lugɔ i sɔŋ ni i widaulaarɛ kaali kummaa la wia.

ref: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
text: Miŋ faa yirii, i sɛɛwɔɔ, di kpa i fɔŋŋa duŋ bɔkpega.

ref: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
text: Durnya koora maa daŋ dargii, dikuu baŋ nuu i nuuŋɔɔlaa wia.

ref: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
text: Ba danna yir yira di ra bagli i wiɛɛlaa ani i girme la n kannɛ werge wia.

ref: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
text: Haali hiŋ du chinchiŋ werge maa la gba, ka i ra du banla n ɛɛ nɛsunne taurɛ, banla n na jigsi ge, wàá wer suah i ni.

ref: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
text: Di n dɔma wa bariŋ, ɛɛ giluu n na n hiŋ. Ɛɛ jugmi n dɔma la baana n na fuuh n ninɛɛ, ka kpa i fɔŋŋazeŋ la lɛɛŋ.

ref: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
text: Wia la maa hiŋ ŋɔ nua lugɔ i daŋ ɛɛ, i daŋ ɛɛa. N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ. Huma la hiŋ faarɛɛ la, ɛɛa tuŋ!

ref: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i pessimbuu, di zumiŋ.

ref: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
text: Wia la maa minna ɛɛ, i zumaabuu. I du bɔɔnɛɛrɛ, ka zum n biini wia maa.

ref: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
text: Di n na humuu gɛɛ di n na heezuu, ka i ra na n wiɛɛlaa maanii.

ref: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
text: Mɔɔ ka n ŋɔ wia gba, di i teŋ zum wia la minna nyiŋŋi n ŋɔu.

ref: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
text: I gombuu di ra guuŋ ni i fɔŋŋa.

ref: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
text: I zumimbuu di ga bɛri, a guŋ tiriŋ werge.

ref: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
text: Lee ń la, hàá wer lawinnɛi? Lee ń la, di suah i ninɛi?

ref: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
text: Di n la chiŋ, i du denii, di n chɔɔ lalaa bol gba, ka i du denii.

ref: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
text: Di n kaali wiifurii bɔɔnɛɛ, gɛɛ di ga du wiicholii bɔɔnɛɛ,

ref: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
text: ka i daŋ du de, di tɔ n see hiiniŋ.

ref: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
text: N daŋ wer ŋɔ bɔr biri n suah, gɛɛ bɔchaaŋ birgi hamuŋa n suah,

ref: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
text: ka bɔbiri gba waa biree i be, hamuŋa ge ɛɛ lugɔ bɔchaaŋ, bɔbiri ni bɔchaaŋ maa ɛɛ kpannɛ i be.

ref: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
text: Hinuu kuari n yemmaa, di kpaa choŋŋi dɔŋa ni, n maa hia biini.

ref: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
text: N na chɔliibuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, i dɛg ɔmaarɛ. I wiɛɛlaa maa ge ɛɛ witittaa ni wizenaa. A maanii n zum nɛnnɛ.

ref: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
text: Hiŋ faa ra kuari n hoga, di kpaa choŋŋi dɔŋa ni bɔɔiih, n maa hia biini, n faa suah di ra hel de la, i faa zum n wiarɛ de.

ref: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
text: I faa nambuu ka ba luliŋ, hɔpizaa la maga hiŋ dauwɛ tɛŋ, a maanii ba sɛbi du i hɔŋ biini, ka a hɔpizii bɛl maa haa faari.

ref: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i biini wia zumaa kpolloo! A kpillɔɔ werge!

ref: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
text: Di n kuraa, a daŋ kaali hɛɛhriichaa. Di n wa izi dɔɔ, ka n haa du i benii.

ref: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a daŋ faa pariŋ, di i kpu biinikpola hina! Di pariŋ, di banla n na nyiŋŋi wichɔgaa ɛɛi la, giliŋ pɛrɛtɛ!

ref: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
text: Ba ŋɔ biinikpola wiarɛ di ra du i ni, di ra ŋɔ wichɔgaa di ra chɔgi i sɔŋ.

ref: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n hah banla n haih labuu! Banla n na dii mmɔri la, n kii ba wiarɛ!

ref: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
text: N hah baabuu ni n biini maa, di kpa baa birgi n dɔma.

ref: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, pessiŋ nɛnnɛ, di zum n biini wia, ɛɛŋ na, di zum wia la n du n biini.

ref: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
text: Binniŋ na, di n dɔɔ wichɔgii n biini, ka bagliŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ, n na la i be la.

ref: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ lii wichɔgɛɛra be, di lɛɛŋ lii banla n na nyiŋŋi kalu be.

ref: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
text: Saŋa maa, wichɔgaa ɛɛi jinaa ba ɔɔ ra ta, di chugzi nɛra ra du dɔŋa ni, saŋa maa.

ref: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
text: Ba nuuzuŋŋa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ duŋkpola siri, ba wiŋɔzi ge ɛɛ lugɔ dundugu siri.

ref: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ lii biinikpola hina nonee biini. Guuŋ lii banla n na nyiŋŋi kalu, di ra ta jina, bá taaŋ ta la be.

ref: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
text: Banla n na jigsi la hembuu sidɛɛ, ba he ba sidɛɛzii hiŋzi dɔŋa ni n ŋmɛnɛɛ, bá lawiŋ.

ref: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
text: N na ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi benii, “Hinuu Kɔraawiizi la minna hum.” A nuu n wile, di hiiniŋ!

ref: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, hinuu n Lɛɛrikpeg, i guumbuu laal biini.

ref: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gilɛɛ waa tɛɛ biinikpola hina bá winyiŋŋaa. Gilɛɛ gil ba jinazi la banna ta la, wa ɛɛ wibii, bá ra jigsi.

ref: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
text: Gilɛɛ gil n dɔma kpegliŋ. Gil ɔnzaa la banna ɔnziŋ la, laŋŋi ba ni.

ref: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
text: Gil niŋhɔla chogli ba ni, di kpa baa ta bɔɔ la baŋ wàá wer lii maa la biini.

ref: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n zummɔ lugɔ i ɔɔ lɛɛ wibiire di ra tɛɛ nyaara, di ra hiini anuula hina.

ref: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
text: Banla wia n deŋlee, danna chɔlii wibii maa, di du i see.

ref: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na yiriibuu, hiiniŋ filaŋkeŋ! Di n wa yirii, nuu n be.

ref: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
text: Lɛɛ n wiisuŋŋaa alugɔ daahɛgsɔɔhsuma, gil n nonee la miŋ lallɛɛ chiŋ la, ɛɛ lugɔ duana mbusu lizaa.

ref: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiiniŋ, ń wer di ra lau n nua, di gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ wichɔgaa.

ref: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
text: Hiiniŋ, ń gilɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi wichɔgaa ɛɛi, gɛɛ di waa jaa nɛchɔgaa ni, di ra ɛɛ biinikpola wia. Gilɛɛ gil n waa jaa ba ni, di ra di ba diuzenaa.

ref: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
text: Nɛnanaa daŋ wer tɛrgi n digna, di jugmiŋ ni nɔŋŋaa, ka màá sɛɛ nɛchɔgaa waa ra tɔgziŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɔɔ ra suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii, bá wichɔgaa gilɛɛ waa na bɔr.

ref: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
text: Di ba chigɔ bizenaa nyuuni, ka lauri ba sitɔɔra di ha hɛri, a nɛra daŋ sɛɛ lugɔ n wiŋɔɔlaa ɛɛ wibiire.

ref: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
text: Gunla baŋ ɔɔ pergi daa, di ŋmɛnnuu jigzi jigzi la, gúnnɛ ba yaari ba hoga, ŋmam nua.

ref: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la, n haa yardiibuu, di ra nyiŋŋi i guuŋ, gilɛɛ gil n siu.

ref: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
text: Lɛɛŋ lii sidɛɛzi la baŋ heŋ la be, aabuu wichɔgɛɛra sidɛɛzi la.

ref: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
text: Gil wichɔgɛɛra sidɛɛzi bir lauri ba himmaa, ka ń na bɔr kaali, di wiimaa waŋ ɛɛwɛ.

ref: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
text: N yir Kɔraawiizii di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa. N na suŋŋuubuu.

ref: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
text: N witittaa maanii aŋ kpa ba u be, di bagli n tɔɔrɔɔzi la minna di tɛu.

ref: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
text: Di n wa ɛɛ sirya ń ŋɔ lugɔ a nyaŋŋimbuu, u ɔɔ baglimbuu gunla min niŋ ɛɛ. N dɔma suahzɔɔrɛ heŋ sidɛɛ, ŋmɛnɛɛ la minna vol la biini.

ref: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
text: Di n binni n kɛra, nɛr maa waa hoo, ú hiiniŋ gɛɛ di guuŋ. Nɛr maa baga lɛi n wia.

ref: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu n wii ra du, í hiiniŋ, hinuu n guuri. I bɛnnɛ n na nyiŋŋi í ɛɛ n hor, n de dui naa biini.

ref: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
text: Lɛɛŋ lii n biinichɔg biini, denii ń wer chɔlii i nɛra biini, di ba wa chaalɔɔ, dikuu hiŋ ɛɛ winanaa tɛŋ wia.

ref: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa! Dikuu i wideŋlaa wia, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa, nuu tɛŋ, dikuu i wibii wia!

ref: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
text: Gilɛɛ waa di mìŋ́ i balii seriya, dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛr maa wia waa deŋlee i be.

ref: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
text: N dɔma duŋŋi n lugee, di kpeliŋ. Ba tɔmbuu diibiri, n ɛɛ lugɔ banla n siuwɛ saŋa maa la.

ref: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
text: Awia, n ɛɛ siryaa n ta n hiŋ. N biini chɔkkɔɔ werge.

ref: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
text: N na liizi hɔpizaa la n bɛrɛɛ la wiarɛ, di ra liizi wia la maa hiŋ ɛɛwɛ. I wiɛɛlaa maa wia du n nyuurɛ.

ref: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
text: Aŋ lalli n noneere di ra suŋŋii, gunla bɔhilii n ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi nii la, gunnɛ n na nyiŋŋii.

ref: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nuu tɛŋ! N tamii maa tunnɔɔ. Gilɛɛ kpa i hiŋ suah n ni, guŋ gil n waa jaa banla n na la lalaa bol la ni.

ref: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
text: Ɛɛ́ ra liiziŋ chɔɔzi maa, i nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu n yardi. N wiisuŋŋaazi ra la i benii, bagliŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ la min ninna hiŋ.

ref: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i benii aŋ ba, i guuŋ, lɛɛŋ lii n dɔma be.

ref: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
text: Hinuu Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, bagliŋ, n na ɛɛ i kipar. A ɛɛŋ nɛnnɛ, di bagliŋ, ń na hiŋ ŋmɛninanii.

ref: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lɛɛŋ gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua la, dikuu i winanaa wia, lɛɛŋ lii n tɔɔrɔɔ biini.

ref: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
text: Dikuu hiŋ nɔŋŋiŋ wia, kpu n dɔma, di chɔgi banla maa n na sunniŋ la, dikuubɛɛwiai, i baliirɛ miŋ.

ref: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ n guuri! Waabuu ɔɔ ra bagliŋ laal lɔi wia, di ɛɛŋ sirya, ń yoo laal.

ref: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
text: Waabuu n guuri ni n Lɛɛri ani n duuribɔr la miŋ yardɛɛ, ń wer na n hiŋ. Waabuu ɔɔ kpegli hɛssi hina tɛŋ.

ref: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, beedee newee i ra liizi u wiai, kunsiwii naa, i ra du u tauwɛi?

ref: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
text: U ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ heeza kakpaŋ, u hɔpizaa ge ɛɛ lugɔ laalii n na kaali.

ref: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil chiŋ peri, í ga de tuu ba, di wa gbɔgzi bizenaa, nyɔɔzi ra lii a ni.

ref: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
text: Kpa nazaa duŋŋi i dɔma yaari, di ta baa i hobee, bá ra chɔ.

ref: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
text: Gil i nonii lii chiŋ di wa laaŋ lii niivile biini, ń na n hiŋ. Lɛɛŋ di lii hɔɔhra fɔŋŋa be,

ref: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
text: banla n waa ɔɔ ra ŋɔ wibii, di ɔɔ hɛɛhzi, ka ra kanni kara la.

ref: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ yir yirfalii tɛi. N danna lɔ kem, di yir yira ra chɔlii.

ref: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
text: Hinuu ɔɔ gil Izrɛl koora kpegli ba dɔma, di ɔɔ lɛɛ i balii Koori Deevid.

ref: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
text: Lɛɛŋ lii hɔɔhra fɔŋŋa be, banla n waa ɔɔ ra ŋɔ wibii, di ɔɔ hɛɛhzi, ka ra kanni kara la.

ref: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi gil yaa biipɔllaa ɛɛ lugɔ daazi la baŋ chɔɔzɛɛ, di binnaa nɛnnɛ, a hel di du kpeg la. Yaa biihambizi ge ɛɛ lugɔ baŋ ɔɔ zɛuzi kooridia silminti ligee, a gil u du wer la.

ref: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
text: Kɔ́raawiizi gil yaa buugazi su ni mia maa iri. Yaa peeza lul biizi kagboŋa fifi yaa laŋgarazi biine.

ref: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
text: Gil yaa nauna lul werge, di gilɛɛ waa mizi gɛɛ a biizi waa siuzi. Gilɛɛ gil biinichɔg wiraa waa du yaa ŋmɛnizenaa.

ref: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
text: Hɛri la maa hina annii n na ɛɛ ba biini, nuu sumaa. Nɛra la n na hum Kɔraawiizi, nuu sumaa.

ref: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, ɛɛ n koori, n daŋ sii i zenni wia. N daŋ chɔlii, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
text: Hɔpizi biimaa, n danna jaamii, di ra chɔlii saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i dɛg chɔlaarɛ, dikuu i zenni wia, i zenni kaali yaa nfɛssii.

ref: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
text: Jimini maa hina danna chɔlii, dikuu i wiɛɛlaa wia. Ba daŋ sii i wizenaa la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.

ref: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
text: Ba danna ŋɔ i girme ni i zenni wia, ń ge ra lɔ i wizenaa la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la fasani.

ref: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
text: Nɛra daŋ ŋɔ i wizenaa la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia, ń ge sii i zenni wia.

ref: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
text: Nɛra daŋ ŋɔ i winanaa maa wia, di yir yira di ra bagli i nɛsunaa dɔɔi wia.

ref: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
text: Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ nɔŋŋaa ni nɛsunaare. U baaŋ waa fuuh manaŋ, di dɔɔ nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
text: Nɛr maanii u ra ɛɛ winanaa, di ra na kuna la maa uŋ tawɛɛ la sinyɛna.

ref: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i kuntaalaa maa daŋ chɔlii, í nɛra maa ge ra tɛi jaaŋ.

ref: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
text: Ba danna ŋɔ i kora girme ani i fɔŋŋa wia,

ref: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
text: nɛr maa wer zum i wizenaa la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ ani i kora girmezeŋ la la wia.

ref: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
text: I kora waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ, i ɛɛ koorii saŋaa saŋa maa. I dɔɔ wibiire ni i nuuŋɔɔlaa maa, di dɔɔ nɛsunaa i wiɛɛlaa maa biini.

ref: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
text: I ɔɔ ra hiini banla maa n du tɔɔrɔɔ biinii, di ra lalli banla n choglee chiŋ.

ref: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
text: Kunyinee maa ra binni i siweere ni tamii, í ra tɛɛa diwee saŋa la anna nyiŋŋaa.

ref: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
text: I ɔɔ tɛɛabuu, a kukkaa, a maa kuŋnyiŋŋaare ɛɛ tɛɛa.

ref: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i wiɛɛlaa maa deŋloore, i dɔɔ nɛsunaa i wiɛɛlaa maa biini.

ref: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
text: I dugli banla maa n na yirii ni biinihuŋŋuu,

ref: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
text: di ra tɛɛ banla maa n na kpai girme, ba kunyiŋŋaa, di ɔɔ nuu ba wile, di lɛɛ baa.

ref: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
text: Nɛr la maa n nɔŋŋii, ɛɛ guuubuu, ka biinikpola hina waa, i daŋ chɔgi baa.

ref: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
text: N daŋ ɔɔ ra chɔlii. Gil i kuntaalaa maa ra dargii, dikuu i sɔnnaniinanii la wia, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! N danna chɔli Kɔraawiizi ni n biini maa!

ref: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
text: N danna chɔli Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, ń de dui biini maa, di yir yira di ra chɔluu saŋa maa.

ref: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.
text: Gilɛɛ yardi newea sitɔɔra, newee maa wàá wer lɛɛi.

ref: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
text: Di ba wa siuzɔɔ, ba ɔɔ biruu zuu hɛɛhraa biini. A hɔl hiŋ, ba jinazi maa baŋ tawɛɛ ɔɔ bir pɛɛrɛ.

ref: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
text: Banla maa n dɛlli Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum la, nuu sumaa.

ref: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
text: Waabuu ta chiŋ, hɛri, muuzeŋ ani kuna la maa n du a biine. U ɔɔ ɛɛ wii la maa uŋ ŋɔ nua lugɔ u daŋ ɛɛu.

ref: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
text: U ɔɔ di seriyaa tɛɛ banla banna sunni la bilii, di ɔɔ tɛɛ banla lɔzi n na kpu la diwee. Kɔraawiizii ɔɔ lizi banla baŋ tɔɔgɛɛ diinii,

ref: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
text: di ra pilli nyuŋŋa siwee. Waabuu ɔɔ lalli banla n choglee chiŋ, u nɔŋŋi u nɛra la wia n deŋleere.

ref: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
text: U ɔɔ ra guu hɔɔhra la n du yaa hɛrii, di ra hiini luhaana ni lalbiizi, ka u ɔɔ giluu biinikpola hina wia chɔgi.

ref: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ koorii saŋaa saŋa maa, Ziɔn Koori Kɔraawiizi di koraa saŋaa saŋa maa. Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! A wessoo ya yir yira di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum. U chɔlaa parimbuu, di dɛg guŋ.

ref: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa biruu ra ma Jɛrusalɛm, di bir gil Izrɛl hina la baŋ laurɛɛ kaali hɛrdumazi la, bir di ra ba.

ref: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
text: U ra tig banla biine n chɔkkɛ bampireere, di ra chag ba ŋmɛra.

ref: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
text: Waabuu dau chinchiŋwilaa maga, di zum bɛl maa sɔŋ.

ref: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
text: Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la zenni ni u fɔŋŋa kannɔɔ werge, u nunzuma waa maga dɔɔwɛ.

ref: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
text: U ɔɔ lalli sisɔna hinaa chiŋ, ka lɔ biinikpola hina ha hɛri.

ref: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
text: Ií yir yira ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, ií lɔ kem ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la.

ref: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
text: Waabuu ɔɔ yaa baamazi tɔ chiŋ, di gil dooŋ nɛɛ, hɛri na nii, kooree fur giŋgimee nyuuni.

ref: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
text: Waabuu ra tɛɛ sela a diwee, di ra dɛɛzi gaaliŋgaa biizi, di a wa yittɔ.

ref: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
text: Zagkpega wia lɛi ra sɔɔni u bɔra gɛɛ laallɔkpega wia lɛi ra paruu,

ref: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
text: see banla n na tɔgzuu, di dɔɔ u nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la tamii.

ref: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
text: Banla maa n du Jɛrusalɛm, ií wa chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Ziɔn hina, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la!

ref: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
text: Waabuu ɔɔ gil ii dominuuzenaa du kpeg, di ra kissi nɛra la n du ii biini.

ref: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
text: Waabuu ɔɔ guu ii magbɔɔni, ɔnsii waa kaa hoo, di kpa huuti la n wesse di ra dɛɛzi ia.

ref: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
text: Waabuu ɔɔ dau wii tɛɛ hɛri, guŋ ɛɛ manaŋ.

ref: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.
text: Waabuu ɔɔ gil dobia pɛ hɛri lugɔ kita, di gil kɔɔl tɔ lugɔ nyɔɔ.

ref: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
text: U ɔɔ giluu dobia ra chogli lugɔ muu loglogbia. Nɛr maa waa ɔɔ wer ú dɔɔ u hiŋ, dikuu waari la uŋ ɔɔ bɔɔni la wia!

ref: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
text: Denii u ŋɔ wia, a dobia ŋmɛɛri, peu ɔɔ ta, a nii pal di ra kaali.

ref: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
text: U kpa u amaniyee tɛɛ Jekɔb naanna, u widaulaa ni u Gbɔgni ge tɛɛ u nɛra Izrɛl hina.

ref: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Waa guŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ hɛssi hina la n kawɛɛ, ba waa u Gbɔgni zummɛ. Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Chiŋ kuna maa, ií ra chɔluu de!

ref: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
text: Mɛlikazi maa, ií ra chɔluu! U laallɔɔra maa n du chiŋ, ií ra chɔluu!

ref: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
text: Wiizi ni baagu, ií ra chɔluu! Chinchiŋwilaa la maa n na nyɛgzi, ií ra chɔluu!

ref: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
text: Kɔraawiizi bol tuna ni niiri la n du chiŋ, ií ra chɔluu!

ref: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
text: Ií gil a maa ra dargi Kɔraawiizi! Waabuu ŋɔ wia, a lii di du de.

ref: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
text: U wiŋɔɔlaarɛ gillɛ a maa du a duuribɔra, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. A wàá wer vɛɛ u nua.

ref: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
text: Hɛri naa kuna, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Sechɔgaa la maa n du muuzeŋ vile biine,

ref: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
text: nazaa, dobia, baamazi, ani dooŋ pekpega la maa n na hiŋ u nua, ií ra chɔluu!

ref: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
text: Bizenaa, giŋgimee, daazi la n na nɔŋ ani kɔrni, ií ra chɔluu!

ref: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
text: Bol sela, pir sela, kuntuuzaa ani zumbizi, ií ra chɔluu!

ref: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
text: Koora, nɛra maa, sitɔɔra maa,

ref: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
text: suŋgure, biipɔllaa, nɛzɛŋzi ani bichalli gba, ií ra chɔluu!

ref: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
text: Ií gil a maa ra dargi Kɔraawiizi! U sɔnnɛ kaali sɔna maa, u girme ge guali hɛri ni chiŋ maa ni.

ref: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: U gillɔɔ u hɛri nɛra du kpeg, guŋ gil u nɛra maa ra chɔluu, baabuu Izrɛl hina la n ɛɛ u siwii la. Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Ií yir yirfalii tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi! Ií ra chɔluu u nɛra la wia n dɔɔ wibii chaalaa biini!

ref: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
text: Izrɛl hina, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu ii Taari Kɔraawiizi wia! Ziɔn hina, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu ii koori wia!

ref: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
text: Ií sa di ra darguu, di yigzi kuna di lɔ kem, di ra chɔluu.

ref: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
text: Kɔraawiizi nɛra wia ra paruubuu, u ɔɔ ra tɔgzi banla n dɛlli u ni, di kpegli ba dɔma ra tɛɛ baa.

ref: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
text: Gil Kɔraawiizi nɛra bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu baŋ kpegli ba dɔma wia. Bá chɔɔgi ba kunchɔɔrikuna ni, di ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna.

ref: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
text: Gil ba ra chaasi, di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, ka kpogli ba tokobizi la n dɔɔ nuuzi anɛɛgaa, di ra di werge,

ref: Take revenge and punish the nations.
text: bá kpegli hɛssi hina, di tɛr ba nɛra digna,

ref: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
text: di kpa yɔlɔzi di vɔɔzi ba koora ni ba sitɔɔra,

ref: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: bá tɛrgi hɛssi hina digna, gunla Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔwɛɛ la. Kɔraawiizi nɛra dɔma kpeglaarɛ guŋ. Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
text: Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Ií ra chɔluu u Dia biini! Ií ra chɔli u fɔŋŋa la un dɔɔwɛ chiŋ la!

ref: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
text: Ií ra chɔluu dikuu wizenaa la uŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia. Ií ra chɔli u zenni la n waa dɔŋ dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
text: Ií huuh bensunozi di ra chɔluu. Ií lɔ janjalanzi ni kemzi di ra chɔluu.

ref: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
text: Ií lɔ sia di sa, di ra chɔluu. Ií lɔ kemzi, di huuh tiitoraa di ra chɔluu.

ref: Praise God with cymbals, with clashing cymbals.
text: Ií kpa kuŋyigzaa di ra yigzi, á ra wii werge, di ra chɔluu!

ref: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
text: Kunnyinee maa, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi!

ref: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
text: Koori Deevid biibaal Solomɔn la n faa di kora Izrɛl hɛri labuu ta sɛɛliizi naa.

ref: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
text: A sɛɛliizi tɔnaa lugɔ á ra tɛɛ nɛra nunzuma ni baglinanaa, di hiini baa ba zum nunzunna wiŋɔzi zɛɛzi.

ref: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
text: Sɛɛliizi naa daŋ gil nɛr la nfɛrɛ n waa kaŋ, dɔɔ nunzuma. A daŋ tɛɛ biipɔllaa ni suŋgure nfɛrɛ ni sichaana.

ref: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
text: A daŋ gil banla n dɔɔ nunzuma keŋŋi digna di nuua, di dɔɔ nunzuma jaa, di gil banla n na nuu wia zɛɛ wer na baglaa,

ref: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
text: bá wer zum sɛɛliizi zɛɛzi, nunzunna wiŋɔzi ani daraa.

ref: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
text: Nunzuma dɔɔi faaraarɛ Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa. Gɛnaa bɛnnɛ ra gbɛlli nunzuma ani baglinanaa. Mɛɛ baglaa n na tɛɛ nunzuma

ref: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
text: N bie, a nuu i mɛɛ ni i maa baglaa.

ref: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
text: Ba baglaa hiŋ daŋ gil i manni du wer alugɔ namunanii n bɔɔri i nyuu, gɛɛ saliŋ baŋaa kunnanii ge n du i baŋaa, i du wer la.

ref: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
text: N bie, gilɛɛ waa nuu wichɔgɛɛra daraa.

ref: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
text: Aŋhinabe, ba daŋ ŋɔ, “Ba ya suah guu di kpu nɛr la n waa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ!

ref: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
text: Haali baŋ dɔɔ alaanfia di du nɛnnɛ gba, ka yaa daŋ chɔgi baa gunla hɛri n ɔɔ ra di nɛra la.

ref: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
text: Yaa daŋ paagi ba kundɔɔlaa maa, di ga suugi yaa diini lugɔ baŋ lɔ baa laal.

ref: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
text: Wa jaa yaa ni, yaa nii bɔnni kuna la yaa n paagɛɛ la.”

ref: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
text: N bie, gilɛɛ waa hiŋ baa, di wàá ɛɛ ba wiɛɛlaa.

ref: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
text: Ba ɔɔ hahzuu ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa, di du gbaŋ ni nɛkpui.

ref: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
text: Di i ra nyiŋŋi zumbee lawaa, haa sidɛɛ ra he u sibɔɔ.

ref: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
text: Ka guŋ hina ra he bahinaarɛ sidɛɛ, ka waa niŋ lau baa, bá siuzi.

ref: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
text: Gunnɛ niŋ huuzi banla maa n na ɛɛ guŋ, ba wichɔgaa daŋ kpu baa. Ba hah bahinaarɛ. Nunzuma vɛɛi wia

ref: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
text: Nunzuma ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr n chigɛ ŋmɛnɛɛ ni bossibaana di gbooli di ra yirgi nɛra.

ref: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
text: U ra siiu bol biini ŋmɛnizenaa ni bolzeŋ dominuuzenaa, bɔra la nɛra n ɔɔ ra chaali la, di ra ŋɔ,

ref: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
text: “Nfɛrnyaara! Ɛrɛɛ ií nyaa nfɛrɛ di birgi magɛi? Ɛrɛɛ chɛɛtɛ ɛɛra ɛɛ chɛɛtɛ di birgi magɛi? Gɛnaa hah nunzuma di birgi magɛi?

ref: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
text: Ii vɛɛ n nua ni n baglaa maanii.

ref: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
text: Di siaahmu chɔgii wa chol ii ni alugɔ dooŋ peu, hɛhchɔg chol ii ni alugɔ vem, denii biinichɔg ni tɔɔrɔɔ werge jaa chol ii ni.

ref: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
text: Denii ii yiriŋ, ka màá sɛɛ, di nyiŋŋi n bɔr yemmaa. Ka ii wàá naŋ.

ref: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
text: Dikuu iiŋ hah nunzuma di vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa wia.

ref: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
text: Ii vɛɛ n nua ni n baglaa maanii.

ref: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
text: Awia, ii daŋ na wii la iinna nyiŋŋi, ii himmaa wiɛɛlaa laŋŋi ii ni.

ref: Sin and self-satisfaction bring destruction and death to stupid fools.
text: Gɛnaa daŋ siu dikuu baŋ vɛɛ nunzuma wia, bá bambugri chɔgi baa.

ref: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
text: Ka banla n na nuu n be, daŋ du de ni bɔsɔna, tɔɔrɔɔ maa wàá huuzi baa.”

ref: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
text: N bie, di i ra nuu n baglaa, di kpaa du ii biini,

ref: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
text: di keŋŋi digna ra nuu nunzuma wia, di ra ɛɛ ania, í zum a zɛɛ,

ref: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
text: di i suŋŋi hiinaa ni wia zɛɛ zumaa,

ref: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
text: pigzi di nyiŋŋaa alugɔ kebee n leuwe gɛɛ daama n suahwɛ,

ref: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
text: denii í zum gunla Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa zɛɛ n na bagli, di dɔɔ u nunzuma.

ref: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
text: Kɔraawiizii ra tɛɛ nunzuma! U benii sichaana ni wia zɛɛ zumaa ra lii.

ref: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
text: Waabuu ra hiini nɛra la wia n deŋlee, ba dɔɔ wibii. Waabuu ra guu baa.

ref: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
text: Waabuu ra binni nɛra la n na ɛɛ ba dɔŋahina nɛnnɛ, di ra guu banla wia n dɔɔ wibii u be.

ref: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
text: Denii í zum wideŋlaa, wibii dii ani wia la n dɛkkɛ zɛɛ, di wer zum gunla n dɛkkɛ í ra ɛɛ saŋa maa.

ref: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
text: I daŋ dɔɔ nunzuma, í sichaana tɛi bɔsɔna.

ref: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
text: I wia zɛɛ zumaa ani i nunzuma daŋ guui.

ref: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
text: Nunzuma daŋ lɛɛi lii biinikpola hina be, di lɛɛi lii nɛra la n na koozi wia be.

ref: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
text: Nɛra naa bir ba haraa kpu wideŋlaa, ka ra vol bɔbiri di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa.

ref: Most of all they enjoy being mean and deceitful.
text: Wileulaa ɛɛi ra pur ba bɔraa, wijagazi ɛɛi ge ra sɔɔni ba bɔra.

ref: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
text: Ba wiɛɛlaa ni ba hiŋaazi waa ɔɔ deŋli, di ɛɛ nɛra la baŋ wàá wer yardi.

ref: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
text: Nunzuma daŋ lɛɛi lii hahjaga ni hahsɛnsɛnni nuusum be.

ref: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
text: U vɛɛ u jaari ni nuukpaŋ la u nuu n ɛɛwɛ Kɔraawiizi be labuu.

ref: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
text: Haaŋ naa dee dia zuui ra ba siu ninɛɛ, de ɛɛ lalaa bol ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ.

ref: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
text: Baal la n na la u be wia chɔkkɔɔ. U ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá na miibɔɔ.

ref: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
text: Awia, a hiŋ nɛnanaa ni nɛra la wia n deŋlee wiɛɛlaa.

ref: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, banla wia n deŋlee ni banla wia n dɔɔ wibii bɛnnɛ niŋ du a hɛri.

ref: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ lizi biinikpola hina a hɛri biini, di kpu nɛchɔgaa.

ref: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
text: N bie, gilɛɛ waa suuh gunla miŋ baglii la ŋmɛnɛ maa. Gil a du i bampirii nɛnnɛ,

ref: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, a daŋ tɛi miibɔɔjaŋ, í nyɛɛli.

ref: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
text: Dɔɔ nɛnɔŋŋaa ni wibii dii! Laalaa lugɔ baŋaakuŋ, di gil a du i bampirii.

ref: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
text: Denii í wia par Kɔraawiizi ni newea, í dɔɔ sɔnnanii.

ref: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
text: Yardi Kɔraawiizi ni i biini maa, ka gilɛɛ waa salli i himmaa zumaa ni.

ref: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
text: A liizi u wia í wiɛɛlaa maa biini, u daŋ baglii ŋmɛnizi la n dɛkkɛ.

ref: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
text: Gilɛɛ waa tɔgzi i hiŋ, a ɔm Kɔraawiizi, di gil wichɔgaa ɛɛi.

ref: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
text: Denii i dɔɔ alaanfia ni fɔŋŋa nɛnnɛ.

ref: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
text: Ɛɛ kpa i daama ni i pattikuna la n wesse nɛnnɛ, di ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di ra tɔgzuu.

ref: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
text: Denii ú gil i buugazi suugi ni mia, í golaa ge suugi ni siŋ, di ra ta.

ref: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
text: N bie, di Kɔraawiizi tɛr i digni, gilɛɛ waa binni guŋ pɛɛ, gɛɛ di u wa hau i ni, gilɛɛ gil i bɔra wàá huah,

ref: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, banla un nɔŋŋɛɛ dignaa u ra tɛrgi alugɔ mɛɛ n ɔɔ tɛrgi u biinɔŋŋaa digna la.

ref: God blesses everyone who has wisdom and common sense.
text: Nɛr la n dɔɔ nunzuma ni wia zɛɛ zumaa, nuu sumaa.

ref: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
text: Nunzuma tɔnaa bɔ saliŋhuŋŋu, u kinturgaa ge du wer kaali saliŋ.

ref: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
text: U wesso kaali rubizi la, hàá wer kpa kunla maa hinna nyiŋŋi di mɛgzuu.

ref: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
text: Nunzuma ra tɛibuu miibɔɔjaŋ, di ra tɛi daama ni zenni.

ref: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
text: U ɔɔ giluu i de dui du sum, di tɔ i see, i na i hiŋ.

ref: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
text: Banla n dɔɔ nunzuma, ɔɔ dɔɔ bɔsɔna ni miibɔɔjannɛ.

ref: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
text: Nunzumaa Kɔraawiizi kpa ta hɛri, di kpa wia zɛɛ zumaa kuari chiŋ.

ref: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
text: U nunzumaa gillɛ muuni ra pal, di gil baamazi ra ba dooŋ ni.

ref: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
text: N bie, kpogli nunzuma ni wia zɛɛ zumaa, gil a du i biini saŋa maa,

ref: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, a daŋ tɛi miibɔɔjaŋ, di gil i de dui du wer.

ref: You will walk safely and never stumble;
text: A daŋ gil i ra vol nɛnnɛ, hàá ra lɔɔzi naazi.

ref: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
text: Ɔnsii wàá lawii, di i wa chɔɔwɔ, i daŋ ɔɔ ra deezi deezinanaa.

ref: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
text: Ɔnsii wàá lawii di wipirgaa gɛɛ hɛhchɔg wa chol biinikpola hina ni,

ref: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
text: dikuu Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛ i guuri wia, wàá gil i zuu wia biini.

ref: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
text: Gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ banla n dɛg winanaa, winanaa ɛɛi, di i wa dɔɔ guŋ fɔŋŋa.

ref: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
text: Di i daŋ wer hiini i dɔŋhiŋ filaŋkeŋ, gilɛɛ waa ŋɔ, “Bir ba kɛrɛ ń hiinii.”

ref: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
text: Gilɛɛ waa fɛ nfɛrɛ lugɔ i ɛɛ banla n soge duglii wichɔgaa, ba yardiibuu.

ref: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
text: Gilɛɛ wa kpa wia di ra sag nɛr la n wɛɛ ɛɛwɛ wiimaa ni.

ref: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
text: Gilɛɛ waa zom nɛchɔgaa ni gɛɛ di wàá ɛɛ ba wiɛɛlaa,

ref: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi hah nɛchɔgaarɛ, ka banla wia n deŋlee ɛɛ ú dammuzii.

ref: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
text: U ɔɔ see biinikpola hiŋ diarɛ nua, ka kissi nɛr la wia n deŋlee hor.

ref: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
text: U ɔɔ giluu chɛɛtɛ ɛɛra di hiihzi, ka ra hiini sisɔna hina waa.

ref: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
text: N biizi, ií nuu n be, di ra nuu ii mɛɛ baglaa. Ií keŋŋi digna, di dɔɔ wia zɛɛ zumaa.

ref: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
text: Winanaarɛ n na bagli ia la. Ií gilɛɛ waa suuh gunla minna bagli ia naa.

ref: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
text: Miŋ faa ɛɛ bichala, di faa ɛɛ biikpaŋ n maa be la,

ref: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
text: n mɛɛ ɔɔ faa baglimbuu di ŋɔ, “Gil n wiŋɔzi naa du i bampirii, di i hiŋaa, i daŋ dɔɔ miibɔɔ.

ref: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
text: Dɔɔ nunzuma ni wia zɛɛ nuui, di gilɛɛ waa suuh gɛɛ di waa vɛɛ n wiŋɔzi naa.

ref: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
text: Gilɛɛ wa bir luŋ di ra kpu nunzuma, dikuu un niŋ guui wia. Nɔŋŋuu, u daŋ guui.

ref: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
text: Nunzuma dɔɔirɛ ɛɛ kunzeŋ werge maa di kaali kummaa. Wii la maa hin niŋ ɛɛ, dɔɔ wia zɛɛ zumaa.

ref: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
text: Di i ra tɔgzi nunzuma werge, u daŋ lallii chiŋ. Faamuu, u daŋ tɛi girme.

ref: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
text: Nunzuma daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ kahuronanii tɛi, í du wer di dɔɔ girme.”

ref: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
text: N bie, aah siwii di ra nuu n be, di dɔɔ miibɔɔjaŋ.

ref: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
text: Di i waa vol, hàá gargi kuna, di i waa chɔ ge, hàá lɔ naa di jiŋli.

ref: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
text: Ɛɛ ra liizi wia naa miŋ baglii naa, di gilɛɛ waa suuah. Gil a du i bampirii, aabuu i miibɔɔ.

ref: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
text: Gilɛɛ waa la bɔr la biinikpola hina n na la gɛɛ di wàá hiŋzi ba ŋmɛnizi.

ref: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
text: Gil a hiŋaa ka ra hiŋ i hor,

ref: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, di wichɔgɛɛra waa wichɔgaa ɛɛwɛ, ba wàá chɔɔ. Di ba waa gillɛ nɛbɛl lɔ naa di jiŋli, ba wàá heezi.

ref: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
text: Biinikpolaa ba diwee, nɛfiraa werge ge ɛɛ ba niinyɔɔlii.

ref: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
text: Nɛra la wia n deŋlee ŋmɛnɛɛ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bɔr n na chaani chɔɔzi ni, di ra chaani werge guŋŋ di ra ba hɔpizaa nɛnnɛ.

ref: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
text: Ka biinikpola hina ŋmɛnɛɛ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bɔbiri himmaa. Ba waa ɔɔ zum kuna la n gillɛ ba ra lɔɔzi naazi.

ref: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
text: N bie, a nuu gunla minna ŋɔ naa nɛnnɛ. Keŋŋi digna di nua nɛnnɛ.

ref: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
text: Gilɛɛ waa suuh n wiŋɔzi naa. Gil a du i bampirii nɛnnɛ,

ref: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, a ra tɛɛ nɛra la maa n nuuabuu miibɔɔ ni alaanfiarɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
text: A du i biini wia tau nɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, aabuu niŋ buu i de dui wiɛɛlaa maa.

ref: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
text: Gilɛɛ waa ŋɔ wia la n waa wibii ɛɛwɛ gɛɛ di wàá dar nɛr.

ref: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
text: Ɛɛ vɔɔ i wiɛɛlaa maa jina nɛnnɛ, guŋ daŋ gil i wiɛɛlaa maa deŋli.

ref: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
text: Gilɛɛ waa leu, di wàá ɛɛ wichɔgaa.

ref: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
text: N bie, a nuu nunzuma wiŋɔzi naa nɛnnɛ. A nuu n sichaana wibaglaa naa nɛnnɛ.

ref: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
text: Denii í dɔɔ mananaa, í wiŋɔzi ra bagli lugɔ i dɔɔ sichaanaa.

ref: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
text: Hahsɛnsɛnni wiŋɔzi summɔɔ lugɔ huuhnuu, u nua pɛssi kaali nuu.

ref: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
text: Ka a tuna du kpol alugɔ kpol, di ra di alugɔ tokobi n dɔɔ nuuzi anɛɛ.

ref: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
text: U ŋmɛnivollaa ɛɛ siu ŋmɛnizii, di deŋli ra la ŋmam biini.

ref: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
text: U baga lɛi miibɔɔ ŋmɛnɛɛ wia. U ŋmɛnizi waa deŋlee, ka waa zummɛ.

ref: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
text: Ií chɔ lii u be! Ií gilɛɛ waa dugli u dia dominua gba!

ref: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
text: Ka di guŋ lɛi, ii daŋ nyaa girme la iiŋ faa dɔɔwɛ la, sikpegii hina kpu ia, ii pɔlaa saŋa.

ref: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
text: Wibii maa, hɔɔhra daŋ di ii daama kuna, nɛbɛl ge di kuna la maa iiŋ keeni wem di na la suma.

ref: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
text: A guŋ tuna, ii danna uuri di kɔgi ii miibɔɔni tunaa saŋa.

ref: and shout, “I hated advice and correction!
text: Denii ii ŋɔ, “N faa vɛɛ baglaarɛ! Ka ra hiŋ n himmaa kipar wiɛɛlaa!

ref: I paid no attention to my teachers,
text: N faa vɛɛ n bagla nuarɛ. Maa digna keŋŋee nuu ba be.

ref: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
text: Kakpaŋ, n jaa di hiihzi nɛra maa see.”

ref: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
text: A chɔɔ i haaŋ bɛŋ, gunla hiŋ ɔɔ ra nyɔɔ i himmaa dia niinyɔɔrivii biini nii la.

ref: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
text: Gilɛɛ ɛɛ lugɔ gɔŋ la haaŋ maa n niŋ tuu di ra dɔɔ.

ref: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
text: Gil i ni i haaŋ bɛŋ ra chɔɔ. Gilɛɛ kpa i hiŋ di ra tɛɛ hahdumazi.

ref: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
text: Gil i haaŋ wia su i siwii. Gil i bɔra sɔɔni i bichalhaaŋ wia.

ref: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
text: U wessoo alugɔ wiluu, nɔŋŋuu, di gil u wia du i bampirii.

ref: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ í ra chugli dikuu baal bɛl haaŋ wia n waa wibii dɔɔwɛi?

ref: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra na gunla maa newee n na ɛɛu, di zum u ŋmɛnivollaa maa.

ref: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
text: Wichɔgɛɛri himmaa wichɔgaarɛ ɔɔ vɔɔzuu. A ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ŋmɛnni di ɔɔ vɔɔzuu kiŋkiŋ.

ref: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
text: U daŋ siu dikuu uŋ waa wette ra lau u hiŋ wia, di leu dikuu u gɛnaa wia.

ref: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
text: N bie, di i wa sɛɛwɔ di daansɛɛ di tɛɛ nɛr la hiŋ waa zummɛ u di kim, di u wa turgoo ra huhzi,

ref: Then you are trapped by your own words,
text: i wiŋɔzi ni i nuuŋɔɔlaa waa dii,

ref: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
text: guŋwaa, n bie, ɛɛ keŋ manaŋ! Hiŋ chol i dɔŋhiŋ wia biini wia, la ga chol u naazi di suŋŋuu ú gil tɛi.

ref: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
text: Gilɛɛ waa chɔɔ dɔɔ, di gilɛɛ waa daari gba.

ref: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
text: Lɛɛ i hiŋ alugɔ sel gɛɛ zumbee n chɔwɛɛ di ra lii kpaaŋ be la.

ref: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
text: Yaara hina, ií la minni be di ga helli nunzuma, di dɔɔu.

ref: but they store up food during harvest season.
text: ka a ɔɔ aah siwiire di chaali diwee lumaŋa ni di dau ra kpaŋ yuu.

ref: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
text: Yaara hiŋ, ɛrɛɛ í chɔɔ dɔɔ di birgi magɛi? Saŋa bɛɛ í izei?

ref: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
text: I daŋ ŋɔ, “N daŋ daari di chɔɔ dɔɔ tama, di kɔrgi n bɔra heezi tama.”

ref: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
text: Ka hinna chɔɔ dɔɔ la, nyaari daŋ chol i ni alugɔ ŋmɛɛŋchɔgii.

ref: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
text: di ra ta wichɔgaa ɛɛi jina ni daraa bá biine, di koozi wia ra du saŋa maa.

ref: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
text: Ka hɛhchɔg daŋ chol ba ni kakpaŋ, di chɔgi baa, ba wàá dɔɔ nyaagaa tamii maa.

ref: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
text: Kuna anumbɛl gɛɛ aniidaanɛɛrɛ du de, Kɔraawiizi n kiiwe werge,

ref: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
text: nɛr la n na jigsi, di ra kanni kara, di ra kpu nɛnanaa,

ref: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
text: ni nɛr la n na fɛ wichɔgaa ɛɛi nfɛrɛ, di hahzi ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa,

ref: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
text: ni nɛr la n na di daansɛɛkara, ani nɛr la n kpa lulla nyuuni di ra lɔ dɔŋa. Sɛnsɛŋ karfaa wia

ref: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
text: Gil a du i bampirii saŋa maa, di laalaa lugɔ baŋaakuna.

ref: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
text: Ba baglaa daŋ tɔ i see di i waa la ŋmɛnɛɛ, di i waa chɔɔ, a daŋ guui, di i wa izoo chɔɔzi ni, a daŋ baglii wia.

ref: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
text: Ba baglaa naa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ fintina, di ra chaanii. Ba liize biraa di baglii wia ge, ɛɛ miibɔɔ ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
text: A daŋ lizii hahsɛnsɛnni be, di lizii lii nɛbɛl haaŋ la n dɔɔ nuusum be.

ref: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
text: Gilɛɛ waa gil u wessi ra darii, di gilɛɛ waa gil u siyazi waa lawii,

ref: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, sɛnsɛnni daŋ dui nyaari biini, di i lau baal bɛl haaŋ nyiŋŋi, guŋ daŋ wer gil i nyaa i miibɔɔ.

ref: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
text: I daŋ wer kpa niŋ pɛli i bampirii ka i laala waa fuuah?

ref: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
text: I daŋ wer vol niŋhɔla ni ka i naazi waa pooria?

ref: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
text: Guŋ himmaanii di baal lau ú dɔŋhiŋ haaŋ nyiŋŋi, ba daŋ tɛr u digni.

ref: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
text: Di nɛr ŋmɛɛwɔ dikuu lɔzi n na kpuu wia, nɛra wàá pag u ni.

ref: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
text: Ka di ba lawuu, u daŋ bir turgi kunla uŋ ŋmɛɛwɛ la guŋ buniidaanɛɛ jaa, haali di a ɛɛwɔ lugɔ ú yoo u dia kummaa gba.

ref: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
text: Baal la maa n lau hahdumazi di ra chɔɔ, gɛnnɔɔ werge, unla n na ɛɛ guŋ ra chɔg u hinnɛ.

ref: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
text: Lɔɔzaa ni hiihzii u hora saŋa maa, u hiihzi dii waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
text: A haaŋ jaari zoma baaŋ daŋ chum, wàá dɔɔ nɛsunaa di u ŋɔ ú turgi a kim.

ref: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
