text: Wàá lɛɛ kinturgaa maa, kummaa waa hoo un niŋ su u siwii.

ref: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
text: N bie, a hiŋ n wiŋɔɔlaa, di gil a du i nfɛrɛ biini saŋa maa.

ref: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
text: A hiŋaa, di dɔɔ miibɔɔ! A du n baglaazi naa tau gunla hinna du i siwii tau la,

ref: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
text: lawaa kpogli nɛnnɛ, di gil a du i bampirii.

ref: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
text: Nɔŋŋi nunzuma alugɔ i niuhambie, di gil wia zɛɛ nuui ɛɛ i badɔŋ,

ref: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
text: a daŋ lɛɛi lii hahsɛnsɛnni ni hahjaga nuusum be.

ref: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
text: A hɔl bɛl miŋ ga n dia tokoro di ra binni baŋgia,

ref: It was late in the evening, sometime after dark.
text: di u ra vol ŋmɛnɛɛ la n dugli hahsɛnsɛnni bɛl dia, di deŋli de ra la,

ref: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
text: Denii haaŋ bɛl chem u ni, di bɔg lugɔ sɛnsɛnni di ra murguu.

ref: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
text: U faa dɔɔ bampiriire di nyaa hiihzi, u faa waa dia ra so.

ref: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
text: Ba ɔɔ faa naubuu ŋmɛnizi, yauzi ani fɔɔliizi maa biine, saŋa maa.

ref: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
text: A haaŋ faamuu di jaamuu, di binnuu tiiih, ka ŋɔ,

ref: “I had to offer a sacrifice, and there is enough meat left over for a feast.
text: “N lizi n dɔŋa be chaalaa mbusuzii tuŋ zinaa, a ola du dia.

ref: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
text: Hinuu n faa lii ń nyiŋŋi la, di jaa nai.

ref: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
text: N kpa pɛɛŋhuŋŋunanii la baŋ liiwe nɛnnɛɛ lii Ijip hɛri, di yaa tɔ n kunchɔɔrikuŋ ni.

ref: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
text: N kpa mɛr, alozi ani sinamɔnnɛ di mizi n kunchɔɔrikuŋ.

ref: “Let's go there and make love all night.
text: Ba ya nyiŋŋi dɔŋa guŋŋ hɔɔ wa pizi. Gil ya di dɔŋa suma,

ref: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, n jaari waa hoo bol, u vol ŋmɛnijannɛ.

ref: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
text: U kpa kebee wergee kaali, wàá du bol lugɔ yauzi anɛɛ.”

ref: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
text: Awia, u murguu di kpu u nfɛrɛ, di kpa wiŋɔsuma daruu lau.

ref: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
text: U hiŋuu kakpaŋ alugɔ baŋ lau nabal di ra la bá ga kpu gɛɛ chɛɛh n zaahwɛ chiiri sidɛɛ ni,

ref: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
text: denii hobii wa yag u bampirii, alugɔ zumbee n yali siwee zuu ŋmɛmbee ni, waa zummɛ lugɔ guŋ daŋ tuŋ u miibɔɔ.

ref: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
text: Awia, n biizi, ií keŋŋi di ra nuu n be, di ra du n wiŋɔɔlaa tau.

ref: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
text: Ií gilɛɛ wa gil ii bampiree ra lau a haaŋ naa dee, di gilɛɛ wa leu di ra hiŋzi u ŋmɛnizi.

ref: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
text: Waabuu baala kpila maa chɔgri, baala kpilakpila maanii u kpu.

ref: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
text: U dia ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ŋmam ŋmɛnɛɛ. U diichɔɔlii ɛɛ lugɔ siu duuribɔr.

ref: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
text: Ií ra nuu, nunzuma ra yiruu, wia zɛɛ zumaa ge ra gbooli!

ref: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
text: U chigɔ giŋgimee nyuuni ni ŋmɛnichechemazii.

ref: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
text: U chigɔ bolzeŋ dominuuzi kɛraarɛ di ra gbooli, di ra yirgi,

ref: “I am calling out to each one of you!
text: di ra ŋɔ, “Nɛr maanii n na yir! N gbooloore di ra yir nɛr maa.

ref: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.
text: Banla n waa wia zummɛ, ií helli nunzuma nɛnnɛ. Gɛnaa, ií helli wia zɛɛ zumaa.

ref: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
text: wibiire n na ŋɔ, n hah karaa.

ref: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
text: N baglaa maa dɔɔ wibiire di du wer. Bɛl maa waa kara ni daraa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
text: N wiŋɔɔlaa chaanɔɔrɛ tɛɛ nɛr la maa n na nuu wia zɛɛ, di chaani tɛɛ banla ge maa n dɔɔ nunzuma.

ref: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
text: Ií lizi n baglaa ka gil saliŋhuŋŋa, di kpa nunzuma ka gil salinnanii,

ref: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, nunzumaa dɔɔ tɔna kaali rubizi, hàá wer kpa kunla maa hinna nyiŋŋi di mɛgzuu.

ref: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
text: Minuu nunzuma, di zum wia biini, di dɔɔ nfɛrɛ, di ra ŋɔ wia ni wibii.

ref: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔmaarɛ wichɔgaa haih. N hah barabara, dignikpega wia, wichɔgaa ɛɛi ani kara kannaarɛ.

ref: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
text: Liize biraa ni seriya dinanaa ɛɛ n horaa, di dɔɔ wia zɛɛ zumaa ni fɔŋŋa.

ref: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
text: Minuu ra hiini koora ba ra di kora, sitɔɔra ge ra du gbɔgni la wia n dɔɔ wibii.

ref: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
text: N nɔŋŋi banla maa n nɔŋŋimbuu, banla n na nyiŋŋi n bɔr daŋ naŋ wibii maa.

ref: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
text: N benii daama, girme, nyɛɛlaa ani winanaa ɛɛi maa fɔŋŋa du, n na bɔnni.

ref: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
text: N kunsunzaa bɔ salinnanii ni saliŋhuŋŋa la n wesse nɛnnɛ!

ref: I always do what is right,
text: N wiɛɛlaa maa deŋloore, n na hiŋ wibii dii ŋmɛnizi.

ref: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
text: N ɔɔ ra tɛɛ banla n nɔŋŋimbuu daama, di ɔɔ gil ba diini ra suugi ni kundɔɔlaa.

ref: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
text: Minuu Kɔraawiizi feli ta mɔɔ, ka haa ta kummaa.

ref: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
text: Minuu Kɔraawiizi feli ma lugli la, mɔɔ ka durnya haa faari.

ref: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
text: Kɔraawiizi lulimbuu mɔɔ ka ta muuzenaa, mɔɔ ka bulli faari niiri bulaa.

ref: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
text: Mɔɔ ka u chiŋŋi bizenaa ni giŋgimee a chignibɔra, di n du de,

ref: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
text: mɔɔ ka u ta hɛri ni kooni gɛɛ durnya hɛɛhraa iri maa.

ref: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
text: N faa du denii ka u ta chiŋ, di tii muuzeŋ ni chiŋ maga.

ref: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
text: N faa du denii ka u chiŋŋi baamazi chiŋ, di ta niiri, a pal gaa zuu muuni.

ref: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
text: N faa du denii ka u tii muuni magbɔɔni, di ŋɔ á gilɛɛ waa yaa di ra gillaa. Kɔraawiizi n waa tii hɛri zɛɛ,

ref: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
text: minuu faa nɛr la n zum nonee huma di chi u kɛra, minuu faa u sideŋŋa kuŋ saŋa maa, n bɔra ɔɔ faa sɔɔnuu u be saŋa maa.

ref: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
text: N bɔra ge faa sɔɔni werge dikuu kuna la uŋ tawɛɛ la ani newea dee maa wia!

ref: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
text: Awia, n biizi, ií ra nuu n be, banla n na hiŋ n ŋmɛnizi, nuu sumaa.

ref: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
text: Ií ra nuu n baglaa di dɔɔ nunzuma. Ií gilɛɛ waa vɛɛu.

ref: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
text: Banla n na nuu n be, di ɔɔ so n dominuuzi di ra du n tau hɔpizi biimaa, nuu sumaa.

ref: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
text: Unla maa naŋ, u na miibɔɔrɛ, ú wia par Kɔraawiizi.

ref: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
text: Ka banla n nyiŋŋiŋ huhzi la, du bahinaarɛ pira, banla maa n hahŋ, nɔŋŋi siurɛ.”

ref: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
text: Nunzuma ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ haaŋ n ma u dia, di chigzuu silminti ligee aniidaanɛɛ.

ref: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
text: U kpu selle daali diuzenaa, di kpa siŋ jaa, di chiŋŋi diiribɔr.

ref: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
text: U hum suŋgure la n ɛɛ u balaarɛ, bá ga chi bɔr la n la chiŋ zelelee, di ra yirgi, di ra ŋɔ,

ref: “Everyone who is ignorant or foolish is invited!
text: “Banla maa n ɛɛ bambugee, ií wa zuu n be!” Di ŋɔ gɛnaa ge be,

ref: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
text: “Ií wa di n diwee, di nyɔɔ siŋ la min daalɛɛ.

ref: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
text: Ií gil ii bichal wia la, ka dɔɔ miibɔɔ, di ra hiŋ wia zɛɛ zumaa ŋmɛnizi.”

ref: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
text: Nɛr la maa n na deŋli chɛɛtɛ ɛɛri, ɔɔ ra na chagzaarɛ, nɛr la maa ge n ɔɔ nyɛgi biinikpola hiŋ ni, ɔɔ na piraa.

ref: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
text: Gilɛɛ waa hau chɛɛtɛ ɛɛri ni, di guŋ lɛi, u daŋ haih. Hau nunzunni ni, u daŋ nɔŋŋii.

ref: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
text: Bagli nunzunni wia, ú nunzuma jaa. Bagli unla ge wia n deŋlee, ú helli jaa.

ref: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
text: Nunzuma dɔɔi faaraarɛ Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa. Dɔɔrinaniinanii zumaa ge ɛɛ wia zɛɛ zumaa.

ref: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
text: Nunzuma daŋ jaai biŋkpila, í de dui saŋa.

ref: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
text: Di i dɔɔ nunzuma, i daŋ di tɔna, di i ra ɛɛu chɛɛtɛ ge, i daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ.

ref: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
text: U ɔɔ so u dominuarɛ gɛɛ kara la n chigɛ bolzeŋ bɔr la n la chiŋ zelele ninɛɛ,

ref: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
text: “Ií ba n dia, ii banla n ɛɛ bambugee!” Di ŋɔ gɛnaa ge be,

ref: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
text: Ka u hɔɔhra waa zummɛ lugɔ u hɔɔhribinaa du lalaa bolle filaŋkeŋ.

ref: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
text: Koori Solomɔn sɛɛliizii keŋ, bie la n zum wia ɔɔ giluu u mɛɛ bɔra sɔɔni, ka bie la n gɛnnɛ waa, ɔɔ giluu u maa biini chɔgi.

ref: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
text: Daama la hiŋ ga ŋmɛnichuma na, waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ, ka wideŋlaa daŋ wer lɛɛ i miibɔɔ.

ref: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
text: Kɔraawiizi waa ɔɔ gil lɔzi ra kpu nɛr la wia n deŋlee, ka waa ɔɔ gil biinikpola hina na ba kipar.

ref: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.
text: Yaara hina daŋ birgi nyaara, ka banla n aah siwii di ra hum waa, daŋ birgi daama hina.

ref: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
text: Banla wia n deŋlee ɔɔ na kissaare, ka wichɔgɛɛra waa wiŋɔɔlaa, ɔɔ ra suah ba machɔgaarɛ.

ref: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
text: Ba wàá wer suuh nɛnanii wia, ka ba daŋ suuh nɛchɔgii waa sɔŋ manaŋ.

ref: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
text: Nunzunni ɔɔ sɛɛ baglaarɛ, ka unla n na ŋɔ gɛnni wia waa, wia daŋ chɔgi.

ref: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
text: Nɛr la wia n dɔɔ wibii ɔɔ ra voluu ni bɔsɔna, ka unla wia n waa wibii dɔɔwɛ waa, ba daŋ lawuu.

ref: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
text: Nɛr la wia n deŋlee wiŋɔɔlaa ra tɛɛ miibɔɔrɛ, ka wichɔgɛɛra waa wiŋɔɔlaa, ɔɔ ra suah ba nfɛrchɔgaarɛ.

ref: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
text: Hahzii ra izi kalu, ka nɔŋŋaa ra ba giltɛɛi ni.

ref: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
text: Nunzunna ɔɔ dɔɔ nfɛrɛɛ di jaa, ka gɛnaa wiŋɔzi ra ba tɔɔrɔɔ ni.

ref: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
text: Daama hina daama ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bolzeŋkpeg ba be, nyaari ge ra chɔgi nyaara.

ref: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
text: Nɛra la wia n deŋlee kinturgaare miibɔɔ, ka biinikpola hina waa kinturgaare tɔɔrɔɔ.

ref: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
text: Nɛra la n na nuu baglaa du miibɔɔ ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ, ka banla n na vɛɛu daŋ dar ba dɔŋahina, bá leu.

ref: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
text: Nɛr la maa n na suahzi hahzi, ɛɛ karkannii, unla ge n na zɔɔzi nɛra ɛɛ gɛnii.

ref: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
text: Wiŋɔbala werge gillɔɔ nɛr ra ŋɔ wichɔgaa, ka unla n na lau u nua ɛɛ nunzunnii.

ref: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
text: Nɛr la wia n deŋlee wiŋɔzi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ saliŋhuŋŋu himmaa, ka biinikpola hiŋ wifɛɛlaa waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
text: Nɛr la wia n deŋlee wiŋɔzi ra hiini nɛkpilaa, ka gɛnaa daŋ siu.

ref: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
text: Kɔraawiizi kissaa ra ba daama ninɛɛ, waa ɔɔ gil biinichɔg jaa a ni.

ref: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
text: Wichɔgaa ɛɛi summɔɔ gɛnii be, ka nunzumaa ra par nɛr la n zum wia.

ref: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
text: Wia la biinikpola hina n na ɔm daŋ huuzi baa, ka banla waa wia n deŋlee daŋ na bá winyiŋŋaa.

ref: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
text: Di dooŋ pekpeg wa ballɔ, ɔɔ paagi biinikpola hinaa kaali, ka banla wia n deŋlee chi chigigi di hanna la.

ref: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
text: Gilɛɛ waa kpa yaarahiŋ huma, di i ɛɛ guŋ, u daŋ tɛi tɔɔrɔɔ lugɔ sinnyɛg n ɔɔ gil nyina ra nyiiri la gɛɛ nyɔɔzi n ɔɔ zuu siwee la.

ref: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa ɔɔ ra tɛɛ miibɔɔjannɛ, ka biinikpola hiŋ waa, saŋa waa ɔɔ hel.

ref: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
text: Banla wia n deŋlee tamii ɔɔ lii bɔsɔnaa, ka biinikpola hina waa tamii ɔɔ ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ.

ref: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
text: Kɔraawiizi ra guu nɛra la wia n deŋleere, ka ra chɔgi wichɔgɛɛra.

ref: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
text: Banla wia n deŋlee daŋ so ni bɔsɔna, ka biinikpola hina wàá du a hɛri birgi.

ref: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
text: Nɛr la wia n deŋlee wiŋɔzi ra ba nunzuma ninɛɛ, ka karkanni wia daŋ tuŋ.

ref: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
text: Banla wia n deŋlee zum wiŋɔɔlaa la n dɛkkɛɛ, ka biinikpola hina waa, wiŋɔɔlaa ɛɛ karaa.

ref: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
text: Kɔraawiizi hah nɛra la n na mɛgzi kuna di ra finuu, ka a mɛgzaa nɛnnɛ ra sɔɔni u bɔraa.

ref: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
text: Jigsi ra ba hiihzi ninɛɛ, ka sisɔna ra tɛɛ nunzuma.

ref: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
text: Nɛnanaa wibii ra guu baabuu, ka wibii nyaara ge wibii nyaai ra chɔg baa.

ref: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
text: Daama wàá wer hiinii Kɔraawiizi seriya dii hɔl, ka wideŋlaa daŋ wer lɛɛi lii siu be.

ref: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
text: Wibii dɔɔi ɔɔ giluu de dui pɛssi tɛɛ nɛnanii, ka biinikpola hina himmaanii ɔɔ taa bahinaa ta.

ref: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
text: Nɛra la wia n deŋlee, ba wibii ɔɔ lɛɛ baabuu, ka wibii nyaara waa, wichɔgaa nyiŋŋaa ɔɔ lau baabuu.

ref: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them.
text: Di biinikpola hina haŋ siuzi, ba tamii maa ɔɔ tunuu, dikuu baŋ dɛlli ba himmaa fɔŋŋazi ni wia.

ref: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ lɛɛ banla wia n deŋleere lii tɔɔrɔɔ biini, ka gil a huuzi biinikpola hina waa.

ref: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
text: Biinikpola hiŋ ɔɔ ŋɔ wiarɛ chɔgi u dɔŋhiŋ, ka nɛr la wia n deŋlee nunzuma ɔɔ lɛɛ nɛttɛ.

ref: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
text: Di nɛr la wia n deŋlee wa nyɛɛlɔɔ, bɔsɔna ɔɔ du a bolzenne, di biinikpola hiŋ wa siuwɔ, bɔsɔna chaasaa ge ɔɔ su denii.

ref: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
text: Nɛra la wia n deŋlee kissaa ɔɔ giluu bolzeŋ dɔɔ sɔŋ, ka biinikpola hina wiŋɔzi ɔɔ chɔguubuu.

ref: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
text: Nɛr la maa n na gbɛlli u dɔŋhiŋ nyaa nfɛrɛɛ, ka nɛr la n na nuu wia zɛɛ ɔɔ siiguu.

ref: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.
text: Nɛr la n na zɔɔzi nɛra ra pilli wollii, ka unla wia n dɔɔ wibii ra tɔ wollii.

ref: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
text: Di nunzunni waa haŋ du de, hɛri ɔɔ chɔguu, ka di bagla kpila wa du de, bampirsɔna ɔɔ du denii.

ref: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
text: Di i chigɔ tɛɛ hɔɔhri ka ú di kim, i daŋ wa di tɔɔrɔɔ, hiŋ vɛɛwɛɛ bɔ.

ref: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
text: Hahpaa ba ra tɔgzi, ka baala la n dɔɔ sikpegii ɔɔ na daama bɛnnɛ.

ref: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
text: Baal la n dɔɔ bunya ra hiini u hinnɛ, ka nɛchuma ra tɔɔri u hinnɛ.

ref: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
text: Wichɔgɛɛra daama waa ɔɔ lii tɔna tɛɛ baa, ka nɛnanaa kinturgaa wàá tuŋ.

ref: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
text: Nɛr la maa n aah siwii, ú ɛɛ winanaa daŋ na miibɔɔ, ka unla waa n aah siwii di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa, daŋ siu.

ref: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
text: Kɔraawiizi hah biinikpola hinaa, ka banla n waa wiimaa dɔɔwɛ wia paruubuu.

ref: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
text: Wibii maa, zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɛr wichɔgɛɛra digna, ka banla wia n deŋlee daŋ na bahinaa.

ref: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
text: Di haaŋ wesso ka waa mananaa dɔɔwɛ, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ saliŋ nonibisig n du pereku miizi.

ref: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
text: Nɛnanaa winyiŋŋaa tuna ɔɔ ɛɛ winanaarɛ, ka di biinikpola hina waa wa na ba winyiŋŋaa, nɛra baana ɔɔ ra fuuuh.

ref: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
text: I daŋ wer dɔɔ bunya ka ɛɛ dɔɔŋ werge, ka nɛbɛl ge nonii du kpeg, ka u nyaa.

ref: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
text: Bunya hiŋ daŋ nyɛɛli, unla ge n na hiini nɛra daŋ na hiinaa.

ref: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
text: Nɛra ɔɔ ra see unla n na dau kuna di ra kpaŋ yoolkpol saŋaa nua, ka ra kissi unla n ɔɔ yoo di ra tɛɛ baa, bá anuula saŋa.

ref: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
text: Di i nyiŋŋi nɛnnɛ, i daŋ na nɛnnɛ, ka di i nyiŋŋi chumaa, i daŋ na chumaa.

ref: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
text: Banla maa n yardi ba daama daŋ chogli alugɔ hɛhchaaŋ daazi n wattɛ. Ka banla maa wia n deŋlee, daŋ nyɛɛli alugɔ yuuliŋ daazi n lɔɔwɛ.

ref: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
text: Nɛr la n na tɔɔri u diahina, peu bɛnnɛ ú kapɛttɛ. Gɛnii ge daŋ ɛɛ nunzunni balii.

ref: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
text: Nɛr la wia n deŋlee wiɛɛlaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ daa n na nɔŋ nɔna la n na tɛɛ miibɔɔ, unla ge n na lɛɛ nɛra, ɛɛ nunzunnii.

ref: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
text: Di nɛra la wia n deŋlee daŋ na ba kinturgaa hɛri naa biini, bɛɛ n niŋ baani banla n na gbɛlli Kɔraawiizi, di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa wàá na ba kinturgaai?

ref: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
text: Nɛr la maa n sɛɛ baglaa, nɔŋŋi nunzumaa ka unla ge n hah baglaa ɛɛ gɛniirɛ.

ref: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
text: Nɛnanii wia ɔɔ par Kɔraawiizii, ka nɛr la n dɔɔ nfɛrchɔgaa waa, ɔɔ jugmuubuu.

ref: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
text: Biinikpola hiŋ wàá wer chi, ka nɛr la wia n deŋlee waa, daŋ chi chigigi.

ref: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
text: Hahpa ɔɔ giluu ba ra tɔgzi u jaari, ka hahjaga ge ɔɔ ra du u jaarii hiihzi alugɔ nɛr n na wii wiilnɔɔraa.

ref: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
text: Nɛra la wia n deŋlee jinazi ɔɔ dɔɔ wibiire, ka biinikpola hina baglaa dɔɔ daraa.

ref: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
text: Biinikpola hina wiŋɔzi ra kpuu, ka nɛra la wia n deŋlee wiŋɔzi ra lɛɛ nɛra.

ref: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
text: Biinikpola hina ɔɔ chɔguu, ba naanna ge wia tuŋ, ka banla n wia deŋlee naanna ɔɔ chiu chigigi.

ref: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
text: Nfɛrɛ hiŋ wia ɔɔ par nɛr maanii, ka ba ɔɔ ra gbɛlli bambuguu waarɛ.

ref: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
text: Hiŋ ɛɛ nɛsunni di ra humuu bɔ, hinna yir i hiŋ nɛzeŋ ka ra chɔɔ lɔzi.

ref: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
text: Banla maa wia n deŋlee, ɔɔ ra binni ba selaa nɛnnɛ, ka biinikpola hina waa, ɔɔ ra tɔɔri ba horaa.

ref: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
text: Patti la n aah siwii di ra hum, daŋ na diwee werge di ra di, ka gɛnii waa, ɔɔ ra chɔgi u saŋaa humpɛɛri ni.

ref: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
text: Wii la maa biinikpola hina n ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋuu, bá na wichɔgaa di ra ɛɛ, ka banla wia n deŋlee waa, ɔɔ chiu chigigi.

ref: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
text: Biinikpola hina wiŋɔzi ɛɛ sidɛɛrɛ tɛɛ baa, ka banla wia n deŋlee ɔɔ lii tɔɔrɔɔ biinii.

ref: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
text: I kinturgaa daŋ wer lii i wiŋɔzi ni i wiɛɛlaa biini, í na wia la n dɛgii.

ref: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
text: Gɛnii ɔɔ fɛu lugɔ u wiɛɛlaa deŋloore, ka nunzunni waa, ɔɔ ra nuu baglaarɛ.

ref: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
text: Gɛnii baaŋ waa birgi fuuih, ka nunzunni waa, ɔɔ lau u hinnɛ, di ba wa chagzuu gba.

ref: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
text: Daansɛɛ diiri la wia n dɔɔ wibii, ɔɔ ra ŋɔ wibiire, ka unla wia n waa wibii dɔɔwɛ, ɔɔ ra kanni karaa.

ref: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
text: Nfɛrnyaai wiŋɔzi ɔɔ ra tɔɔuh alugɔ tokobi, ka nunzuma wiŋɔzi waa, ɔɔ ra chaau.

ref: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
text: Wibii du denii saŋa maa, ka kara waa dɔɔ magaa.

ref: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
text: Wichɔgii maa wàá wer huuzi nɛra la wia n deŋlee, ka biinikpola hina waa, tɔɔrɔɔ bɛnnɛ ba hor.

ref: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
text: Kɔraawiizi hah karkannaa, ka nɔŋŋi banla wia n dɔɔ wibii.

ref: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
text: Nunzunna waa ɔɔ ra jigsi ba nfɛrɛ dɔɔi wia, ka gɛnaa ɔɔ ra yaari ba gɛnni wiarɛ.

ref: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
text: Huma humaa werge daŋ gil i dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, ka yaara daŋ gil i ɛɛ yom.

ref: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
text: Biinichɔg ɔɔ ɛɛu lugɔ buntɔga chigaa, bɔkpega ge dui wiŋɔzi ra pur bɔraa.

ref: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
text: Nɛr la wia n deŋlee ɔɔ ra bir u dammuu liizinanaa, ka biinikpola hiŋ waa, ɔɔ giluu u ra leu.

ref: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
text: Yaara hiŋ wàá wer na ú kipar, ka di i aah siwii di ra hum, i daŋ di tɔna werge.

ref: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
text: Wideŋlaa ŋmɛnɛɛ ɛɛ miibɔɔrɛ, ka biinikpola wiɛɛlaa ge ŋmɛnɛɛ ɛɛ siu.

ref: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
text: Bie la n zum wia ɔɔ sɛɛ u mɛɛ ni u maa baglaarɛ, ka chɛɛtɛ ɛɛri ɔɔ vɛɛ nuuirɛ.

ref: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
text: Nɛnanaa ɔɔ di ba wiŋɔzi sumaa, ka wibiinyaara ɔɔ nɔŋŋi kaluu werge.

ref: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
text: Nɛr la maa n zum u nua kpoglaa ra du u miibɔɔ taurɛ, ka nɛr la n waa u nua kpoglaa zummɛ ra kpu u hinnɛ.

ref: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
text: Yaara hina ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi kunaa werge, ka na tama, ka banla n aah siwii di ra hum daŋ nyɛɛli, di na ba kipar nɛnnɛ.

ref: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
text: Banla wia n deŋlee hah karaa, biinikpola hina ge ra di hiihzi ni ŋmaaba.

ref: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
text: Banla wia n deŋlee ɔɔ na hiinaare bá de dui maa biini, ka biinikpola hina wiɛɛlaa ɔɔ chɔgi baabuu.

ref: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
text: Baŋhina ɔɔ ɛɛ nyaara ka ra ɛɛ lambaara lugɔ ba ɛɛ dɔɔnaa, baŋhina ge ɛɛ dɔɔna ka ra ɛɛ lambaara lugɔ ba ɛɛ nyaaraa.

ref: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
text: Daama hina daŋ wer kpa kebee di lɛɛ bahinaa, ka nɛr maa wàá tɔɔri nyaara waa.

ref: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
text: Nɛr la wia n deŋlee, u de dui maa ɔɔ chaanuu alugɔ bɔchaaŋ, ka biinikpola hina hora ɔɔ ɛɛu lugɔ baŋ dinzi fintina kakpaŋ.

ref: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
text: Barabara ra ba hɔɔzi ninɛɛ, banla n na nuu baglaa ɛɛ nunzunnaa.

ref: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
text: Di i ga ŋmɛnichɔgaa na daama, a ɔɔ tunuu manaŋ, ka humkpega humaa na daama ɔɔ ra jaau.

ref: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
text: Tamii n waa ballɛ manaŋ ra ba bɔhuaih ninɛɛ, ka kipar nai ra tɛɛ miibɔɔ ni bɔsɔnaa.

ref: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
text: Nɛr la maa n na gbɛlli baglaa ra chɔg u hinnɛ, ka unla maa ge n na tɔgzaa daŋ di tɔna.

ref: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
text: Nunzunni baglaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bule la n na tɛɛ miibɔɔ, di ra lɛɛ nɛr siu be.

ref: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
text: Ba ɔɔ ra tɔgzi nɛra la n dɔɔ nfɛrnanaarɛ, ka wibiinyaara ɔɔ ra vol ŋmɛnizi la n dɔɔ biarɛ.

ref: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
text: Nunzunna ɔɔ fɛ nfɛrɛɛ mɔɔ ka ɛɛ wia, ka gɛnaa waa, ɔɔ ra bagli ba bambugrii.

ref: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
text: Balii la wia n nyaa wibii ra zuu wia biinii, ka unla wia n dɔɔ wibii ra ba bampirsɔna ninɛɛ.

ref: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
text: Nɛr la n na vɛɛ baglaa daŋ nyaa, di di hiihzi, ka unla n na nuu baglaa, ba danna tɔgzuu.

ref: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
text: Kipar wii nai summɔɔ, ka gɛnaa hah wichɔgaa ɛɛi gilaarɛ.

ref: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
text: Di i dammu ɛɛ nunzunni, i daŋ dɔɔ nunzuma, ka di i ra hiŋ gɛnaa, gɛnni kizee daŋ mɔnii.

ref: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
text: Tɔɔrɔɔ ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi wichɔgɛɛra bɔttɛ, ka kissaa ge ra nyiŋŋi banla wia n deŋlee bɔr.

ref: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
text: Nɛnanaa ɔɔ gil kapɛttɛɛ dau ba naanna, ka wichɔgɛɛra hora daŋ la nɛra la wia n deŋlee be.

ref: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
text: Nyaari koo daŋ wer lii diwee werge, ka banla n waa wibii ra di, ɔɔ gbaaraabuu kaali.

ref: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
text: Di i vɛɛ i biizi digna tɛraa, haa baa nɔŋŋɛɛ, ka di i nɔŋŋi baa, i daŋ tɛr ba digna.

ref: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
text: Nɛra la wia n deŋlee ɔɔ nau di di piŋ ba kipar, ka biinikpola hina waa, ɔɔ kpogli lɔzii.

ref: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
text: Hahnunzunni ɔɔ ra ma u diarɛ, hahgɛnii ge ra puri u hor.

ref: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
text: Nɛr la wia n deŋlee ra ɔm Kɔraawiizii, ka unla n na gbɛlluu ge ra hiŋ ŋmɛnichɔgaa.

ref: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
text: Gɛnii wiŋɔzi ɔɔ giluu ba tɛr u digni, ka nunzunni wiŋɔzi ra guuubuu.

ref: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
text: Di nabala waa hoo a par, diwee ɔɔ nyaau, ka di a du de, diwee ɔɔ puruu.

ref: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
text: Wibii daansɛɛ diiri waa kara ra kanni, ka kara hor waa, kara bɛnnɛ ɔɔ su u nua.

ref: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
text: Chɛɛtɛ ɛɛri ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi nunzumaa, ka wàá nau, ka banla n na nuu wia zɛɛ ɔɔ na nfɛrɛɛ manaŋ.

ref: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
text: Gilɛɛ gil i ni gɛnaa ra kpau, dikuubɛɛwiai, hàá wer na nunzuma maa lii ba be.

ref: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
text: Nunzunni ɔɔ zum wii la n dɛkkɛ lugɔ u ɛɛu, ka gɛnii ɔɔ ra dar u hinnɛ lugɔ u zummɔɔ.

ref: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
text: Gɛnii baga lɛi wichɔgaa ɛɛi wia, ka nɛr la wia n deŋlee, ɔɔ ra suŋŋi u wichɔgaa giltɛɛirɛ.

ref: No one else can really know how sad or happy you are.
text: Nɛr maa zum u himmaa tɔɔrɔɔrɛ u biini, gunnɛ nɛr maa ge wàá wer hiinuu di u bɔsɔna.

ref: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
text: Biinikpola hiŋ dia daŋ puri, ka nɛr la wia n deŋlee hor chi.

ref: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
text: Ŋmɛnɛɛ bɛl ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ uŋ wesse tɛɛ newee, ka u tuna ɛɛ siu.

ref: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
text: Mamaa daŋ wer suah biinichɔg, ka di mamaa la wa tunnɔ, a biinichɔg haa du denii.

ref: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
text: Nɛchɔgaa daŋ na gunla n dɛg baa, nɛnanaa ge na ba kinturgaa la n wesse.

ref: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
text: Nfɛrnyaari ɔɔ yardi wiimaanii, ka nunzunni ɔɔ lɔ nfɛrɛɛ nɛnnɛ u wiɛɛlaa maa biini.

ref: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
text: Nunzunni ɔɔ ra du u hiŋ taurɛ, ú gilɛɛ waa zuu siaahmu biini, ka gɛnii waa ɔɔ yali siweere, di ra ɛɛ wia di ra zuu wia biini.

ref: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
text: Nɛr la n na na baaŋ manamanaŋ ɔɔ ra ɛɛ gɛnni wiarɛ, ka nunzunni ɔɔ ra lau u hinnɛ.

ref: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.
text: Nfɛrnyaari ɔɔ di u gɛnni wia tɔnaa, ka nunzunna waa ɔɔ na nfɛrɛɛ jaa.

ref: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
text: Nyaari waa dammu dɔɔwɛ, ka dɔɔna waa ɔɔ dɔɔ baabuu kpila.

ref: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
text: Di i gbɛlli i dɔŋhiŋ, i ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ, ka nɛr la waa n na hiini nyaara, nuu sumaa.

ref: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
text: Di i ta wichɔgaa ɛɛi jina, i daŋ leu, ka di i ta winanaa ɛɛi jina, i daŋ na nɔŋŋaa ni wibii dɔɔi la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
text: Huma humaa dɔɔ tɔnaa, ka so pɛɛ ni wiŋɔbala waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
text: Nunzunni kinturgaare daama, gɛnaa ge hor ɛɛ gɛnni.

ref: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
text: Wibii daansɛɛ diiri ra mɔgli miibɔɔrɛ, ka kara hor ra ɛɛ sɔsɔgɔɔ.

ref: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
text: Baal la n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi bɔra daŋ sɔɔnuu. U daŋ kpa nonee tɔ a baal haaŋ ni u biizi ni.

ref: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bule la n na tɛɛ miibɔɔ, di ra lɛɛ nɛr siu be.

ref: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
text: Nɛraa kora. Di nɛra waa hoo, kora ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ.

ref: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
text: Bampirsɔna ra du bɔkpegaa, ka zoma ge ra tɛɛ wiila.

ref: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
text: Nɛr la n na sunni nyaara, ra chagzi Kɔraawiizi la n ta baabuu, ka unla n na hiini baa ra tɔgzuubuu.

ref: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
text: Wichɔgɛɛri wichɔgaa ɔɔ chɔguubuu, ka unla n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ zuuribɔttɛ, di u wa siuwɔ.

ref: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
text: Nunzuma ɔɔ du nɛr la n na nuu wia zɛɛ nfɛrɛ biinii, hàá wer na nunzuma gɛnaa be.

ref: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
text: Wideŋlaa ɛɛi ɔɔ giluu hɛri kuari, ka wichɔgaa ɛɛi kpa hiihzii, di ra kpu nɛra maa.

ref: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
text: Koori maa ɔɔ dɔɔ bɔsɔnaa di u balii zum wia la unna ɛɛu, ka u ɔɔ na baannɛ du unla n na gba wia.

ref: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
text: Nuupɛr ra sɔɔni baannɛ, ka nuunyɛg ge ra izi baaŋ.

ref: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
text: Nunzunni wiŋɔzi ɔɔ ra tɛɛ nfɛrɛɛ, ka gɛnii ɔɔ ra ŋɔ gɛnni wiarɛ.

ref: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
text: Yemmaanii Kɔraawiizi siwee du, di ra na wichɔgɛɛra ni banla n na ɛɛ winanaa.

ref: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
text: Wiŋɔnanaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ tagzi, ka kara wiŋɔzi ra ba biinichɔg ninɛɛ.

ref: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
text: Gɛnii ɔɔ vɛɛ u mɛɛ baglaarɛ, ka unla n ɔɔ nuu ɛɛ nunzunnii.

ref: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
text: Daama ɔɔ su nɛr la wia n deŋlee diarɛ, ka biinikpola hiŋ kunnaalaa ɔɔ ra ba tɔɔrɔɔ ninɛɛ.

ref: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
text: Nunzunni wiŋɔzi ra tɛɛ nfɛrɛɛ, gɛnii waa wiŋɔzi wàá wer ɛɛ guŋ.

ref: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
text: Kɔraawiizi kii biinikpola hiŋ mbusuzi lizaarɛ, ka unla wia n deŋlee wiisuŋŋaa ra paruubuu.

ref: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
text: Kɔraawiizi hah biinikpola hiŋ wiɛɛlaarɛ, ka nɔŋŋi banla n na nyiŋŋi wideŋlaa hora.

ref: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
text: Nɛr la maa n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa daŋ na dignitɛraa werge, ka unla ge n hah baglaa daŋ siu.

ref: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
text: Kɔraawiizi ra na wia la maa n du lalaa bolle, ɛrɛɛ newea bampiree biini wia wer suah u ninɛi?

ref: Happiness makes you smile; sorrow can crush you.
text: Bɔsɔna ra ba siwee puraa ninɛɛ, ka biinichɔg waa, ɔɔ giluu nɛr nyɛm.

ref: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
text: Wibii lɔzi ɔɔ ra kpu nunzunnii, ka gɛnaa ɔɔ piŋ ni gɛnni wiarɛ.

ref: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
text: Nyaari waa be, hɔpizii maa ra ba tɔɔrɔɔ ninɛɛ, ka bɔsɔna hina waa, ɔɔ ra di de dui sumaa.

ref: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
text: Hiŋ dɔɔ tama ka ra ɔm Kɔraawiizii bɔ, hiŋ dɔɔ kuna werge ni tɔɔrɔɔ.

ref: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
text: Hin di kelaa ni nɔŋŋaarɛ bɔ, hin di yoma ni hahzi.

ref: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
text: Nɛr la baaŋ n na fuuh manamanaŋ, chugzi kaluu di ra du, ka kanyitti hiŋ ra laafi kaluu.

ref: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
text: Yaara hiŋ ɔɔ dɔɔ tɔɔrɔɔrɛ ú de dui maa biini, ka nɛr la waa wia n deŋlee, waa ɔɔ dɔɔ tɔɔrɔɔ maa.

ref: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
text: Bie la n zum wia ɔɔ giluu u mɛɛ bɔra sɔɔni, ka bie la n gɛnnɛ waa, ɔɔ giluu u maa biini chɔgi.

ref: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
text: Gɛnaa bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔni ba gɛnni wiarɛ, ka nunzunni ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wia la n deŋleere.

ref: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
text: Di baglaa nɛnnɛ waa hoo, jina taizi ɔɔ chɔguu, ka di bagla kpila du de, a ɔɔ kuaruu.

ref: Giving the right answer at the right time makes everyone happy.
text: Nɛr bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔnuu di u ŋɔ wii chem saŋa la n dɛkkɛ!

ref: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
text: Nunzunna ɔɔ ra vol ŋmɛnɛɛ la n dɔɔ miibɔɔ di ra la chinne, ka gil siu ŋmɛnɛɛ la n na tuu zɛɛrɛ.

ref: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ chɔgi barabara hiŋ diarɛ, ka guu luhaaŋ kundɔɔlaa nɛnnɛ.

ref: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
text: Kɔraawiizi hah wia la biinikpola hina n ɔɔ ra fɛu, ka nɛnanaa waa wifɛɛlaa ɔɔ paruubuu.

ref: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
text: Nɛr la n fini nɛra di na kebee ɔɔ ba biinichɔg ninɛɛ u diahina ni, ka unla n hah murgaa kuna daŋ di miibɔɔ.

ref: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
text: Nɛnanii ɔɔ fɛ nfɛrɛɛ mɔɔ ka ra ŋɔ wia, ka biinikpola hiŋ waa, ɔɔ ra ŋɔ wichɔgaa wiŋɔzii.

ref: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
text: Kɔraawiizi ni biinikpola hina nɛɛwɔɔ dɔŋa ni, ka u ɔɔ ra nuu banla wia n deŋlee wiisuŋŋaarɛ.

ref: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
text: Di i ra binni nɛra la bɔra n na pur, i bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔnuu, amaniyesuma ge ra tɛɛ alaanfia.

ref: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
text: Nɛr la n na sɛɛ jugmaa, daŋ dɔɔ miibɔɔ, di du nunzunna biini.

ref: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
text: Nɛr la maa n na vɛɛ baglaa ra tɔɔri u hinnɛ, ka unla n sɛɛ baglaa waa, ra zum wia zɛɛrɛ.

ref: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa ɛɛ baglaa ni nunzumaa. Ɛɛ sɔɔni siwiire, di na tɔgzaa.

ref: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
text: Newee ɔɔ ta wia jinaa, ka Kɔraawiizii ɔɔ bagli wia la un niŋ ŋɔ a deŋli.

ref: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
text: Newee ɔɔ fɛ lugɔ u wiɛɛlaa maanii deŋlee, ka Kɔraawiizii ra di u biini wia seriya.

ref: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
text: Kpa i wiɛɛlaa maa du Kɔraawiizi nonee, í jinazi maa wer na ɛɛi.

ref: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
text: Kɔraawiizi kuari kummaanii u himmaa wiɛɛlaa wia, haali biinikpola hiŋ gba, dikuu hɛhchɔg hɔpizii wia.

ref: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
text: Kɔraawiizi hah barabara hinnɛ, zum lugɔ u daŋ tɛr nɛra la n pɔɔhwɛ digna.

ref: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
text: Nɔŋŋaa ni wibii dɔɔi nɛnnɛ, ɔɔ lizi Kɔraawiizi baannɛ nɛr ni, u gil u wichɔgaa tɛu. Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa ge ɔɔ gil nɛr vɛɛ wichɔgaa ɛɛi.

ref: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
text: Di nɛr wiɛɛlaa par Kɔraawiizi, u ɔɔ giluu u ni u dɔma gba du ni bɔsɔna.

ref: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
text: Hiŋ dɔɔ wibii ka nyaarɛ bɔ, hiŋ ɛɛ dɔɔŋ ka nyaa wibii.

ref: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
text: Newee ɔɔ ta u himmaa jinazii, ka Kɔraawiizii ɔɔ bagli u wiɛɛlaa.

ref: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.
text: Koori nunzuma wiŋɔzi ɔɔ lii Kɔraawiizi benii, a dɛkkɔ unna di wibii.

ref: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
text: Kɔraawiizi waa nyiŋŋi lugɔ ya ra fini dɔŋa kɔɔzaa biini. Awiarɛ u gil mɛgzaa kuna du de.

ref: Justice makes rulers powerful. They should hate evil
text: Koori kii wichɔgaarɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, wibii diire ɔɔ gil kora chi.

ref: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
text: Koori baaŋ ɛɛ siu baliirɛ, ka nunzunni ɔɔ weruu laafuu.

ref: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
text: Di koori haŋ wa munzi, miibɔɔ ɔɔ du denii, i wia n paruu ge ɛɛ lugɔ sazau dooŋ.

ref: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
text: Hiŋ dɔɔ nunzumaa bɔ hiŋ dɔɔ saliŋ, di dɔɔ wia zɛɛ zumaarɛ bɔ hiŋ dɔɔ kebee.

ref: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
text: Nɛra la wia n deŋlee ŋmɛnɛɛ waa wichɔgaa dɔɔwɛ, nɛr la maa n na hiŋ a guŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ dɔɔ u hinnɛ.

ref: Too much pride will destroy you.
text: Jigsi ra ba chɔgaa ninɛɛ, kpoŋaa ra ba cholaa ni.

ref: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
text: Hiŋ dɔɔ sisɔna ka nyaarɛ bɔ, hiŋ jaa nɛkpoŋlaa ni di ra foozi.

ref: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
text: Nɛr la maa n na nuu baglaa daŋ nyɛɛli, unla maa ge n yardi Kɔraawiizi daŋ na bɔsɔna.

ref: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
text: Ba zum nunzunnii, dikuu u wia zɛɛ zumaa wia, u wiŋɔzi sunzi wia, nɛra ɔɔ sɛɛu tɛu.

ref: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
text: Wia zɛɛ zumaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bule la n na tɛɛ miibɔɔ di tɛɛ nɛr la n dɔɔu, ka gɛnaa ge baglaa ɛɛ saŋa chɔgaa.

ref: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
text: Nunzunni ɔɔ lɔ nfɛrɛɛ mɔɔ ka ŋɔ wia, di wer ra bir nɛra nfɛssi.

ref: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
text: Wiŋɔnanaa summɔɔ lugɔ huuhnuu, di ra tɛɛ bɔsɔna ni alaanfia.

ref: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
text: Ŋmɛnɛɛ bɛl ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ uŋ wesse tɛɛ newee, ka u tuna ɛɛ siu.

ref: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
text: Lɔzii ɔɔ gil balii ra hum, dikuu unna nyiŋŋi diwee wia.

ref: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
text: Nɛchɔgii ɔɔ ra ta wichɔgaa ɛɛi jinaa, u wiŋɔzi ɛɛ lugɔ ninzeŋ n na haahri werge.

ref: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
text: Biinikpola hiŋ ra izi kaluu, nɛzɔɔzaa ra bargi dammuzii.

ref: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
text: Kalu nyiŋŋe ɔɔ ra dar ba dɔŋa hinaa, di gil ba ra na tɔɔrɔɔ.

ref: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
text: Nɛr la n na kamzi siwee ra ta wichɔgaa ɛɛi jina. Nɛr la n na mir nua ra nyiŋŋi chumaa ɛɛirɛ.

ref: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
text: Nyuhuŋhuŋŋa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ koorikahuro n dɔɔ girme, nɛr la wia n deŋleere ra dɔɔa.

ref: Controlling your temper is better than being a hero who captures a city.
text: Hiŋ dɔɔ kanyittii bɔ, hiŋ ɛɛ baal, laal lɔi biini. Hinlawaarɛ bɔ, hiŋ wette kpegli bolzeŋ hina.

ref: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
text: Ba ɔɔ ta kunaa bá zum wii la n du de, ka a wibaglaa maa ɔɔ lii Kɔraawiizi benii.

ref: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
text: Yom la n zum wia daŋ di kora u dɔɔri biijaga ni, u nuu bɔnni u kapɛttɛ.

ref: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
text: Ninne ba ɔɔ kpa di ŋmɛɛri saliŋhuŋŋu ni saliŋ, bá zum a wessi, gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ɛɛ newee bampirii na.

ref: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
text: Wichɔgɛɛra ɔɔ ra nuu biinikpola wiŋɔzii, karkanna ge keŋŋi digna di ra nuu chɔgaa wiŋɔzi.

ref: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
text: Banla n na ɛɛ nyaara chɛɛtɛ ra chagzi Kɔraawiizi la n ta baabuu, banla ge bɔra n ɔɔ sɔɔni dikuu baŋhina cholaa wia, daŋ na dignitɛraa.

ref: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
text: Nɛzɛŋzi girmee ba naanna, gunnɛ biizi ge girme ɛɛ ba maawaa ni mɛɛwaa.

ref: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
text: Nuusuma waa dɛg gɛnii, gunnɛ a waa dɛg koori n na kanni kara.

ref: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.
text: Nɛra baŋhina fɛwɔɔrɛ lugɔ kuna kpai tɛɛ nɛr, daŋ wer gil ba nyɛɛli.

ref: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
text: Nɛr la maa n gil wia ra tɛɛ u dɔŋhiŋ, ra nyiŋŋi nɔŋŋaarɛ, ka nɛr la nua n waa tɔ, u dɔŋhiŋ n ɛɛu wia ni, ra bargi dammuzii dɔŋa ni.

ref: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
text: Hiŋ hau nunzunni ni kakpaŋ, ɔɔ hiinuubuu di kaali hiŋ lɔɔzi gɛnii bukalfa.

ref: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
text: Wichɔgɛɛra ɔɔ ra di mmɔrii, ka ba daŋ tɛr ba digna werge.

ref: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
text: Hiŋ chem amani la biizi baŋ paawɛɛ dɔɔ alaanfia kaali hiŋ chem gɛnii, u gɛnni wiɛɛlaa biini.

ref: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
text: Di i kpa wichɔgaa di turgi winanaa kim, wichɔgaa ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá nyaa i dia.

ref: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
text: Kalu faaraa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hinna peri dampu, awia gil a wii mɔɔ, ka kalu izi.

ref: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
text: Kɔraawiizi hah banla n ɔɔ lɛɛ wibiire di ra tɛɛ biinikpola hina ni banla n ɔɔ kpa bilchɔg di ra tɛɛ banla wia n deŋlee maanii.

ref: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ í kpa kebee turgi gɛnii sukuru laŋaa, uŋ wàá wer helli nunzumai?

ref: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
text: Dammu ɔɔ dɔɔ nɔŋŋaarɛ saŋa maa, tɔɔrɔɔ wiarɛ ba ra lul lulli ge.

ref: It's stupid to guarantee someone else's loan.
text: Nfɛrnyaairɛ nɛr n chigɛ tɛɛ u dɔŋhiŋ u di kim.

ref: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
text: Nɛr la maa n nɔŋŋi naari, nɔŋŋi wichɔgaarɛ, barabara hiŋ ge ra ba tɔɔrɔɔ ni.

ref: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
text: Nfɛrchɔgaa hiŋ waa nyɛɛli, wichɔgɛɛri ge ɔɔ zuu tɔɔrɔɔ biinii.

ref: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
text: Nɛr la n lul gɛnii, tɛɛ u hinnɛ biinichɔg, gɛnii ge mɛɛ waa bɔsɔna ra dɔɔ.

ref: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
text: Bɔsɔna ɛɛ tagzi la n wessee, ka biinichɔg ge ra chɔgmi nɛttɛ.

ref: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
text: Biinikpola hiŋ ɔɔ suahzuu di lɛɛ kuna, ú chɔgi wibii dii ŋmɛnizi.

ref: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
text: Nunzunni ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi nunzuma wiɛɛlaarɛ saŋa maa, ka gɛnii waa ɔɔ dɔɔ wilaulii.

ref: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
text: Biigɛnii ra chɔgi u mɛɛ biinii, di ɛɛ kuŋkpol ge tɛɛ u maa la n luluu.

ref: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
text: A waa dɛkkɛ bá gil nɛnanii turgi bilchɔg kim, dikuu u winanaa wia, gɛɛ di tɛr nabɔnzenaa digna dikuu ba wibii dɔɔi wia.

ref: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
text: Nunzunni himmaa waa wia ra ŋɔ werge, ka nɛr la n zum wia zɛɛ ɔɔ lau u hinnɛ.

ref: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
text: Nɛr la n waa nɛra ra nyiŋŋi, ka ra nyiŋŋi u bɛŋ kuaraa, waa wibii maa ra nuu.

ref: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
text: Wia zɛɛ zumaa waa gɛnii ra par, ka ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi u bagli u nunzuma.

ref: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
text: Nɛr wiŋɔzi daŋ wer du luŋ lugɔ muuzeŋ, nunzuma wiŋɔzi ɛɛ lugɔ gɔŋ niifalii n na pal.

ref: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
text: A waa dɛkkɛ hiŋ lɛɛ bilii tɛɛ biinikpola hiŋ, ka kpa bilchɔg tɛɛ nɛr la n waa wichɔgii maa ɛɛwɛ.

ref: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
text: Gɛnii wiŋɔɔlaa ɔɔ ɛɛ kalu nyiŋŋaare, guŋ ɔɔ gil ba ra lɔɔzuu.

ref: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
text: Gɛnii nuarɛ ra kpuu, u wiŋɔzi ge ɛɛ lugɔ sidɛɛ tɛu.

ref: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
text: Zɔɔza wiŋɔzi summɔɔ alugɔ lɔgmɛnanaa nɛr n ɔɔ ligli, a zuu u bɔra nɛnnɛ.

ref: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
text: Yaara hiŋ ɛɛ nɛr la n na chɔgi kuna lullii.

ref: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
text: Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ diijaŋ la n kpekke, nɛr la wia n deŋlee ɔɔ chɔu ga zuu u biini di na u hiŋ.

ref: Pride leads to destruction; humility leads to honor.
text: Kpoŋaare ɔɔ tɔ chɔgaa see, sisɔna ge tɔ tɔgzaa see.

ref: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
text: Hiihzi ni gɛnaarɛ hiŋ bagli nɛr wia mɔɔ, ka haa nuu wii la n ɛɛwɛ.

ref: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
text: Newee miibɔɔ nyiŋŋaa wergee gillɛ u ra yoo wiila, ka di u wa nyaau, u tamii maa ɔɔ tunuu.

ref: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
text: Nfɛrɛ hina ɔɔ aah siwiire bá helli wifalaa, nunzunni ge ra nuu nfɛrɛ wia.

ref: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
text: Di i ra nyiŋŋi i na nɛzeŋ, kpa kumbɛl ga sunzuu, a wàá du kpol.

ref: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
text: Ba waa nɛkpaŋ amaniye ra nuu, di ra tɛu bilii.

ref: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
text: Di nɛkpega banɛɛ kpogli wia, ií ta kuna, Kɔraawiizi lizi a wibii hiŋ.

ref: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.
text: Dammu ni zuui kuaraarɛ kpolle kaali diikpeg kpeglaa. Mmɔri dii ra bargi dammuzii alugɔ baŋ kpa lugbidaazi kar dominua.

ref: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
text: Wiŋɔnanaa ra piŋuu lugɔ diunanaa, di ra ba bɔsɔna ni.

ref: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
text: Nuarɛ ra kpu, waabuu kaa ra lɛɛ. Awia, wiŋɔbala werge ra ba wia ninɛɛ.

ref: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
text: Baal la n na haaŋ, na kumpaa, a baal wia ra par Kɔraawiizii.

ref: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
text: Nyaara ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋuu bá ra suŋ ba ni, ka dɔɔna ge ɔɔ ra chagzi baa.

ref: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
text: Dammukpila daŋ wer chɔgii, ka badɔŋ waa, ɔɔ pɛliibuu kaali i maabie.

ref: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
text: Hiŋ nyaawɛ ka ɛɛ wibii hiŋ, aabuu bɔ hiŋ gɛnnɛ, di nyaa wibii.

ref: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
text: Nɛr la n aah siwii u ɛɛ wii, ka nyaa nfɛrɛ, guŋ waa wer gɛɛ nɛr la n na hahzi werge daŋ wer leu.

ref: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
text: Di newee gɛnni wa chɔguu, u ɔɔ ra pag Kɔraawiizi ninɛɛ.

ref: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
text: Daama ra ba dammukpila ninɛɛ, ka nyaari waa ra duŋŋi baabuu.

ref: Dishonest witnesses and liars won't escape punishment.
text: Kara daansɛɛ diiri daŋ na dignitɛraa, gunnɛ karkanni gba.

ref: Everyone tries to be friends of those who can help them.
text: Nɛkpila maa ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋuu ba wia par hɛri nabɔma, ka nɛr maa ge dammu ɛɛ nɛr la n na sunzi kuna.

ref: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
text: Di nyaari lulla vɛɛu, u dammuzi waa nyaŋŋɔɔrɛ. U ɔɔ ra hiŋzi di ra fɔrgi baa, ka ba ra kaali.

ref: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
text: Nɛr la maa n na nunzuma nɔŋŋi u hinnɛ, banla wia zɛɛ zumaa n par baa daŋ nyɛɛli.

ref: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
text: A waa dɛkkɛ gɛnii n na di u hiŋ gɛɛ yom di kora kooribiizi ni!

ref: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
text: Nɛr la n dɔɔ nfɛrɛ baaŋ waa fuuh manaŋ. Ba ɔɔ ra tɔgzuubuu, dikuu uŋ ɔɔ gil wia di ra tɛɛ nɛra wia.

ref: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
text: Koori baaŋ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyiŋ wiraa, ka u nɛsunaa ɛɛ lugɔ ŋmɛnii n sag kooree ni.

ref: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
text: Bie la n gɛnnɛ ra tɛɛ u mɛɛrɛ tɔɔrɔɔ, haaŋ la n nɔŋŋi kalu, ge wia ra fuuh baaŋ alugɔ domarima.

ref: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
text: Mɛɛwaa ni maawaa daŋ wer gil diini ni daama dau ba biibaala, ka Kɔraawiizi bɛnnɛ niŋ wer tɛɛ baal haaŋ la n na nuu wia zɛɛ.

ref: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
text: Yaara hiŋ ɔɔ chɔɔ dɔɔrɛ nɛnnɛ, ka chɔɔ lɔzi.

ref: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
text: A hiŋ Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni la, di dɔɔ miibɔɔjaŋ, a vɛɛi ra ba siu ninɛɛ.

ref: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
text: Di i ra hiini nyaara, i ra du Kɔraawiizii kim, u daŋ bir turgii a kim.

ref: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
text: Tɛr i biizi digna, di ba haa ɛɛ bichalli. Di haa guŋ ɛɛwɛ, i daŋ chɔgi ba de dui.

ref: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
text: Nɛr la n dɔɔ baaŋ werge daŋ turgi u kim. Di i lɛɛ a hiŋ lii wia biini, i daŋ kaa kuari lɛɛu lii aŋhina biini.

ref: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
text: Di i ra nuu baglaa, di ɛɛ sirya í helli, i daŋ wa dɔɔ nunzuma ŋmɛnɛbɛl.

ref: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
text: Newee ɔɔ kpa u nfɛrɛɛ ta wikpila jina, ka Kɔraawiizi kipattɛ niŋ ɛɛ.

ref: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
text: Nɛr har chigaa ɛɛ wizenne, nyaari ge bɔ wibii nyaai.

ref: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa ra tɛɛ miibɔɔ ni hiŋ dɔɔirɛ, di ra guui.

ref: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
text: Diwee dii gba ɔɔ ra huah yaara hiŋ bɔraa.

ref: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
text: Di i tɛr chɛɛtɛ ɛɛri digni, laakal nyaara daŋ helli wia, di i hau nunzunni ni, u nunzuma ɔɔ jaau.

ref: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
text: N bie, di i haŋ wa vɛɛ baglaa nuui, i bir hattɛ kpu nunzuma la.

ref: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
text: Kara daansɛɛ diiri ra ɛɛ wibii dii chɛɛtɛɛ, wichɔgaa ɛɛi du sum tɛɛ biinikpola hina lugɔ diwee.

ref: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
text: Ba daŋ tɔɔri chɛɛtɛ ɛɛra, di lɔɔzi gɛnaa ge.

ref: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
text: Siŋ nyɔɔi werge ɔɔ giluu nɛr ra ŋɔ wia di ra kɔɔ, di birgi gɛnii. Nɛr la maa n kpa siŋ nyɔɔi su siwii, wàá dɔɔ nfɛrɛ.

ref: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
text: Koori baaŋ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyiŋ wiraa, di nɛr fuuh u baaŋ, u miibɔɔrɛ u kpa di ra chɛr siu.

ref: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
text: Ba ɔɔ ra tɔgzi nɛr la n waa kalu ra nyiŋŋuu, ka gɛnii waa maa ɔɔ hahzuu ra nyiŋŋi kalu.

ref: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
text: Nɛr la n ɛɛ yaara hiŋ paraa saŋa, wàá na diwee kuna kpai saŋa.

ref: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
text: Newee nfɛrɛ wia luŋŋoo lugɔ kɔlɔŋ nii, ka nunzunni daŋ lizaa baŋgia.

ref: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
text: Nɛkpila daŋ wer ŋɔ lugɔ ba dɔɔ nɔŋŋaarɛ saŋa maa, ka anɛɛ n niŋ wer na nɛr la wia n dɔɔ wibii nɛnnɛi?

ref: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
text: Nɛr wia n deŋlee de dui waa ɔɔ dɔɔ wichɔgii maa, u biizi ɔɔ nuu sumaa, ú siu har.

ref: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ wer ŋɔ, “Maa wichɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ n biinei?”

ref: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
text: Kɔraawiizi kii banla n kpa fintime mɛgzi kunaa, di ra mɛgzaa kuna.

ref: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
text: Bichala wiɛɛlaarɛ niŋ bagli lugɔ u wia deŋloore gɛɛ a wessoo.

ref: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord.
text: Kɔraawiizii tɛɛ yaa siwee ni digna, ya ra na, di ra nuu wia.

ref: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
text: Nɛr la n nɔŋŋi dɔɔ, hotte nyaari. Aah siwii di ra hum, denii i na diwee di, ka ka.

ref: Sensible words are better than gold or jewels.
text: Nunzuma wiŋɔzi waa puttɛ ka dɔɔ tɔna, di kaali saliŋ ni rubizi.

ref: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
text: Di nɛr gɛnnɔ, di chi tɛɛ hɔɔhri u di kim, u himmaa kunnɛ bá lɛɛ dau talma.

ref: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
text: Diuŋmɛɛlaa kpissɔɔ nua, ka a harbɔɔ, a ɔɔ birgi kuŋkpolaa i nua biini.

ref: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
text: Di i ŋɔ i ta jina, gil ba birii liize nɛnnɛ a wer na ɛɛi, gilɛɛ waa lɔ laal, di haa baglaa nuuwɛ lii nɛra be.

ref: Stay away from gossips— they tell everything.
text: Nɛzɔɔzaa ra pilli woloo, awia, gilɛɛ gil i ni wiŋɔbalahiŋ wàá kpau.

ref: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
text: Di i see i mɛɛ gɛɛ i maa nua, i hinnɛ i ra kpu alugɔ fintina n dimme bɔbiri.

ref: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
text: Di i feloo di kapɛttɛ i de dui biini, guŋwaa, hàá nuu suma i de dui tuna.

ref: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
text: Gilɛɛ waa kpa wichɔgaa di ra turgi wichɔgaa kim. Kpa i wiimaa du Kɔraawiizi nonee, u daŋ lɛɛi.

ref: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
text: Kɔraawiizi kii banla n kpa fintime mɛgzaa kunaa, di ra mɛgzi kuna.

ref: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
text: Kɔraawiizii bagli yaa naazi kpai wia, awia, ɛrɛɛ ya ɛɛ zum yaa ŋmɛnivollaa zɛɛi?

ref: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
text: Ɛɛ fɛ nfɛrɛ nɛnnɛ mɔɔ ka ra lɛɛ nua Kɔraawiizi be, di guŋ lɛi, i daŋ ŋmɛnɛ wii, n faa zummɔ.

ref: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
text: Kɔraawiizi tɛɛ neweere nfɛrɛ alugɔ fintina, u ra chaanuu, ú wer zum u biini wifɛɛlaa.

ref: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
text: Koori la maa n dɔɔ nɔŋŋaa ni wibii saŋa maa, ɔɔ dɔɔ u hinnɛ. U ɔɔ di koraa birgi werge.

ref: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
text: Biipɔllaa girmee ba fɔŋŋa, ka bazɛŋzi ge wessii ba nyuhuŋhuŋŋa.

ref: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
text: Dignitɛraa ra lizi wichɔgaarɛ di ra ha, ka ra tɛɛ mananaa.

ref: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
text: Koori bampirii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ gɔŋ nii Kɔraawiizi nonii biini, u ɔɔ biruubuu u ra la bɔr la maa n paruu.

ref: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
text: Newee ɔɔ fɛ lugɔ u wiɛɛlaa maanii deŋlee, ka Kɔraawiizii ra di u biini wia seriya.

ref: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
text: Hinna ɛɛ wideŋlaa di ra di wibiire ra par Kɔraawiizi kaali mbusu lizaa.

ref: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
text: Kpoŋaa, barabara ani biinikpola maa ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ.

ref: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
text: Nɛr la n na ta wia jina nɛnnɛ, di aah siwii ra hum daŋ nyɛɛli, ka siyala werge ra ba nyaari ninɛɛ.

ref: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
text: Hiŋ kpa kara di dɔɔ kuna, a waa birgi ka tuŋ, ka kaa ɛɛ siu sidɛɛ tɛi.

ref: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
text: Biinikpola hina ɔɔ siuzuu, dikuu ba kalu wia, dikuu baŋ waa sɛɛwɛ bá ɛɛ wia la n deŋlee wia.

ref: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
text: Bilchɔg hina ɔɔ ra hiŋ ŋmɛnizi la n waa deŋleere, ka banla ge n waa bilchɔg dɔɔwɛ ra vol a deŋlaa.

ref: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
text: Sakɛrii sogaare bɔ, i ni hahkalu hiŋ n kpau dia.

ref: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
text: Biinikpola hiŋ ɔɔ ra kɛlli wichɔgaarɛ, waa u dɔŋhiŋ ni ra suŋ.

ref: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
text: Di i tɛr chɛɛtɛ ɛɛri digni, laakal nyaara daŋ helli wia, di ba wa bagli nunzunni wia, u ɔɔ dɔɔ nunzumaa jaa.

ref: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
text: Kɔraawiizi wia deŋloore. U ɔɔ pessi biinikpola hiŋ dia wiarɛ, ka kpau ta, u wia tuŋ.

ref: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
text: Nɛr la n tɔɔgi u digna, saŋa la nyaara n na wii la, ba wàá nuu u ge wiraa, u anuula saŋa.

ref: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
text: Hiŋ suahzɛɛ sunzi kuŋ ra sɔɔni baannɛ, suahzaa tɛɛ kuŋ ge ra pɛssi baaŋfuuih werge.

ref: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
text: Wibii dii ɔɔ ɛɛ bɔsɔnaa tɛɛ banla n ɛɛ nɛnanaa, ka ɛɛ tɔɔrɔɔ werge tɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra.

ref: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
text: Nɛr la maa n vɛɛ nfɛrnanaa daŋ siu.

ref: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
text: Banla n nɔŋŋi sideŋŋa wia ɔɔ birgi nyaaraa, siŋ, diunanaa ani hindii lɛi, daama ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
text: Hiŋ du hɛribɔduma biini i bɛnnɛ bɔ, i ni haaŋ la n nɔŋŋi nuumaa ni kalu n kpau dia.

ref: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
text: Nunzunni ɔɔ dɔɔ daamaa di ra di u hiŋ, ka gɛnii ɔɔ di u horaa manaŋ, di u wa naa.

ref: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
text: Nɛr la maa n ɛɛ nɛnanii, di nɔŋŋi nɛra, daŋ na miibɔɔ, di nyɛɛli di na tɔgzaa.

ref: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
text: Nunzunni ɔɔ lɔ nɛra la n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa bolzenne, di puri u koŋliikpega baŋ yardɛɛrɛ.

ref: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
text: Nɛr la maa n zum u nua kpoglaa, ɔɔ lɛɛ u hinnɛ lii tɔɔrɔɔ biini.

ref: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
text: Chɛɛtɛ ɛɛri dɔɔ barabaraa, di ra ɛɛ kpoŋri wia.

ref: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
text: Yaara hiŋ kipar wiarɛ niŋ chɔguu, dikuu uŋ vɛɛ huma humaa wia.

ref: But people who obey God are always generous.
text: U hotte ú ɔɔ na werge, ka unla n ɛɛ nɛnanii waa, ɔɔ ra sunzuu.

ref: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
text: Kɔraawiizi kii wichɔgɛɛra mbusu lizaazii, fɔŋfɔŋ di ba waa lizaa ni nfɛrchɔgaa.

ref: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
text: Kara daansɛɛ diiri wàá kaali pɛɛ, di ba waa u digni tɛttɛ, ka gil unla n na di wibii, ŋɔ wia.

ref: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
text: Biinikpola hiŋ ɔɔ ra ta barabaraa, ka nɛr la wia n deŋlee ɔɔ fɛ nfɛrɛɛ ka ra ɛɛ u wiɛɛlaa.

ref: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
text: Gunla maa newee jinazi ni u wia zɛɛ zumaa n duwɛɛ, ka a wàá wer nyaŋŋi Kɔraawiizi.

ref: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
text: A ba ɛɛ zaguu sirya laal hɔpizii, ka Kɔraawiizii dɔɔ laal lɔi kpeglaa fɔŋŋa.

ref: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
text: Aah siwii di ra bagli bie ŋmɛnizi la n deŋlee, di u wa binnɔ, ka u daŋ haa ra hiŋaa.

ref: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
text: Gunla dɔɔŋ n ɔɔ ra di fɔŋŋa nyaara ni la, gunnɛ nɛr la n volle di ra kim, ɛɛ unla be unna kim la, balii.

ref: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
text: Nɛr la n duu biinikpola ra kum tɔɔrɔɔrɛ, bá chɔgi u baaŋfuuih werge lugbidaa.

ref: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
text: Nɛr la n dɔɔ kisassa, nuu sumaa, dikuu uŋ bɔnni u diwee di ra tɛɛ nyaara wia.

ref: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
text: Duŋŋi chɛɛtɛ ɛɛri, denii hɔɔzi, naari ani nɛchagzaa tuŋ.

ref: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
text: Nɛr la maa n nɔŋŋi biinihuŋŋu ni wiŋɔnanaa, daŋ ɛɛ koori dammu.

ref: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra du nunzunni taurɛ, ka u ɔɔ chɔgi sɔsɔgɔ hiŋ waa jinazi tairɛ.

ref: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
text: Yaara hiŋ ɔɔ ra ɛɛ dawarii lugɔ di u lii baŋgia, bunyiŋ daŋ lawuu.

ref: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
text: Hahsɛnsɛnni wiŋɔzi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bɔɔluŋ, banla Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuih n du ba ni daŋ chol u biini.

ref: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
text: Bichala maanii gɛnɛɛ, ka dignitɛraa daŋ duŋŋi guŋ lii u be.

ref: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
text: Nɛr la n kpa nyaara sunnaa di gil u daama ra jaa, gɛɛ di ra sunzi dɔɔna, nyaarii niŋ ɛɛ u tuna. Nunzuma wiŋɔɔlaa tokko ni kpɔrgɔ wia

ref: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
text: Keŋŋi digna di ra nuu nunzunni wiŋɔzi, di gil i bampirii lau n baglaazi,

ref: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, a wessoo di i kpaa du i biini, di gil a du i nua saŋa maa.

ref: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
text: N na bagliibuu zinaa, guŋ gil í yardi Kɔraawiizi.

ref: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
text: N sɛbi nunzunni wiŋɔzi tokko ni kpɔrgɔɔ tɛi, nunzuma ni baglaa su a biinee.

ref: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
text: Gunnɛ niŋ gil i ɔɔ zum wibii, di ɔɔ ba amaniye la n dɔɔ wibii ni, di wa tɛɛ banla n humii la. Luglihiŋ

ref: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
text: Gilɛɛ waa fini nyaari dikuu u nyaari wia, gɛɛ di wàá fini dɔgnya hina seriya diiribɔr,

ref: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizii niŋ ŋɔ lɛɛ baa. U daŋ piri nɛr la maa n du baa pira. Anɛɛhiŋ

ref: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
text: Gilɛɛ waa lau nɛr la baaŋ n na fuuh manamanaŋ dammu, gɛɛ i nuu waa kpau,

ref: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
text: di guŋ lɛi, i daŋ helli u wiɛɛlaa, di zuu siaahmu biini. Ahorohiŋ

ref: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
text: di haa haŋ wa wer turguu, ba daŋ foozi i kunchɔɔrikuŋ gba himmaa. Anaazuhiŋ

ref: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
text: Ŋmɛnɛ maa gilɛɛ waa fini i dɔŋhiŋ, di wàá tuzi faala maa magbɔɔ bii la ii naabaala n baŋŋɛ. Anuehiŋ

ref: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
text: Huŋhunni la n zum huma nɛnnɛ, danna hum koora huma, ka a waa lugɔ nɛsunne humaa ú ra hum.

ref: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
text: Gilɛɛ waa di kposiiri diwee, gilɛɛ waa kɛlli u diunanaa ni.

ref: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
text: Di i ni hɛri nabɔma waa di, a du tau nɛnnɛ,

ref: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
text: di i ɛɛ dibala hiŋ, a lau i hiŋ,

ref: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
text: di gilɛɛ waa kɛlli u diunanaa la maa n chigɛ de la ni, aŋhinabe, u danna nyiŋŋi u murgii. Aniidaanɛɛhiŋ

ref: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
text: U ɔɔ ŋɔ i benii, “Di ka nyɔɔ!” Ka u biini maa lɛi u ra ŋɔ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u ɔɔ ra liizi gunla a kim n makkɛɛ.

ref: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
text: Gilɛɛ waa kpa kunyiŋŋichɔgaa di waa chɔgmi i hiŋ, dɔɔ nunzuma, di ra lau i hiŋ.

ref: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
text: Daama ɔɔ weruu kaali kakpaŋ alugɔ an dɔɔ keeri di zaah kaali la. Ŋmantannaazihiŋ

ref: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
text: I daŋ hɛɛhzi u diunanaa hiŋ ta, ka i wiŋɔnanaa la hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛu la ɛɛ pɛɛ. Kabɛlhiŋ

ref: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
text: Di i ra bagli gɛnii wia, i hinnɛ i ra kuuh, dikuubɛɛwiai, u baaŋ daŋ fuuh. Fihiŋ

ref: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
text: Gilɛɛ wàá tuzi faala maa magbɔɔ bii la ii naabaala n baŋŋɛ, di waa foozi lalbiizi hɛri,

ref: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
text: A nuu n bie, di dɔɔ nunzuma, di ra hiŋ ŋmɛninanii.

ref: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
text: Gilɛɛ i ni sinnyɔɔri ni dibala hina ra kpau,

ref: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ba nyaari ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ ba ra vol la. Dɔɔ chɔɔi werge gillɔɔ nɛr a laali yakɔssi. Fidaanumbɛlhiŋ

ref: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
text: A nuu i mɛɛ wiŋɔzi, di zum lugɔ waabuu lulii, di gilɛɛ waa gbɛlli i maa ú zɛŋaa saŋa.

ref: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
text: Nyiŋŋi wibii, di lawuu kpogli nɛnnɛ, di kaa nyiŋŋi nunzuma, mananaa ani wia zɛɛ zumaa.

ref: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
text: Bie la n na ɔm Kɔraawiizi mɛɛ ɛɛ bɔsɔna hinnɛ. Bɔsɔnaa biinunzunni dɔɔi.

ref: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
text: N bie, gil i bampirii lawiŋ, di ra hiŋ n wiɛɛlaa.

ref: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
text: Sɛnsɛnni ni hahyuuri la n na sɛm, ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ sidɛɛ chuma.

ref: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
text: U ɔɔ suah di ra kpaŋ alugɔ ŋmɛɛŋ, di gil baala kpilakpila nyaa wibii ba haana be. Fidiŋmantannaazihiŋ

ref: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
text: Anɛɛ dɔɔ wiai? Anɛɛ dɔɔ biinichɔgɛi? Anɛɛ ɔɔ ra lɔ kalu saŋa maanɛi? Anɛɛ ra nuumɛi? Anɛɛ bɔraa yigli chal pɛɛi? Anɛɛ sibeere yigli chalɛi?

ref: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
text: A hinnɛ nɛr la n ɔɔ mari sindiini birgi, di nyɔɔ siŋ di ra koozi dɔŋa ni.

ref: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
text: Gilɛɛ gil siŋ waa darii, haali uŋ aahwɛ nɛnnɛ, di ra nyɛgzi gilaasi biini, u nyɔɔi du sum, u ra tuu yɔmmmm.

ref: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
text: A tuna maa, u daŋ ɛɛi alugɔ dum n dumii, alugɔ duŋkpola siri.

ref: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
text: I danna na wikuna, hàá ka wer di ra fɛ nfɛrɛ di ra ŋɔ wia nɛnnɛ.

ref: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
text: I danna jiŋli alugɔ nɛr n du muugberzeŋ biini, di sag u ŋmɛnni ni muuzeŋ.

ref: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
text: Denii i ŋɔ, “Aŋhinabe, ba lɔmbuu ka a waa n ni zuuwɛ! Maa zummɛ baŋ lɔɔziŋ gba! Saŋa bɛɛ ń izi di kaa nyɔɔ sinɛi?”

ref: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
text: Gilɛɛ waa gil wichɔgɛɛra wia ra tɔɔrii, di gilɛɛ waa zom biinikpola hina ni,

ref: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
text: Gilɛɛ ra zom wichɔgɛɛra ni, gilɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi ba bɔkpau,

ref: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
text: dikuu baŋ ɔɔ ra ta kalu jina wia, ba wiŋɔzi ge ra ba tɔɔrɔɔ ni wia. Tokkohiŋ

ref: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, wichɔgɛɛri waa tamii dɔɔwɛ, u wia daŋ tuŋ manaŋ. Tokko ni kpɔrgɔhiŋ

ref: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
text: Nfɛrɛ dɔɔi ɔɔ giluu u diini maa suugi ni daama kunnanaa maa iri. Tokko ni kpaŋhiŋ

ref: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
text: N bie, a ɔm Kɔraawiizi, di ra tɔgzi koori. Gilɛɛ waa gil i ni nɛra la n ɛɛ dignikpega hina ra kpau wiimaa biini,

ref: Wisdom brings strength, and knowledge gives power.
text: Hiŋ dɔɔ nunzumaa bɔ, hiŋ dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, nfɛrɛ hiŋ ge fɔŋŋa ra jaau.

ref: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
text: Awia, di haa haŋ wa na baglaa nɛnnɛ, gilɛɛ waa la laal, dikuubɛɛwiai, laal lɔi kpegli ra lii bagla kpila benii. Tokko ni anɛɛhiŋ

ref: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, a wàá birgi, ka hɛhchɔg chol keŋ hina ni. Anɛɛ n zum bɔr la Kɔraawiizi gɛɛ koori dignitɛraa n niŋ tunɛi? Nunzuma wiŋɔzi aŋhina

ref: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
text: Nunzuma wiŋɔzi luŋŋoo werge tɛɛ gɛnii. Awia, di sitɔɔra wa chaalɔɔ, waa ɔɔ dɔɔ wiŋɔɔlii maa. Tokko ni ahorohiŋ

ref: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
text: Nunzunna wiŋɔzi aŋhinaa keŋ. Di i binni nɛr siwee ka di seriya, guŋ waa wer.

ref: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
text: Nɛr la maa n na ta wichɔgaa jina, daŋ di a guŋ sɔnchɔgii.

ref: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
text: Gɛnaa jina tai ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ, nɛra maa ge hah chɛɛtɛ ɛɛri. Tokko ni anaazuhiŋ

ref: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
text: Di seriya diiri la n ŋɔ biinikpola hiŋ be lugɔ waa bilchɔg dɔɔwɛ, nɛkpila daŋ seeu nua, hɛssi hina maa ŋɔ waa nɛnnɛ ɛɛwɛ.

ref: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
text: Di wia nyaŋŋii tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa, i fɔŋŋa waa kaŋ. Tokko ni anuehiŋ
