text: Awia, a liizi i Taari wia i pɔlaa saŋa, ka hɔpizaa ni binni la n wàá du sum i be la ba. A saŋaa i jaa ŋɔ lugɔ de dui waa sum.

ref: Someday the light of the sun and the moon and the stars will all seem dim to you. Rain clouds will remain over your head.
text: A saŋaa wiizi, bɔchaaŋ, baagu ani chinchiŋwilaa wàá kaa ra chaani nɛnnɛ i be. Baama daŋ ɛɛu lugɔ dooŋ n na nyiŋŋi balaa saŋa maa i be.

ref: The noisy grinding of grain and the voices of singers will be shut out by your deaf ears, but even the song of a bird will keep you awake.
text: I digna wàá ka ra nuu ŋmɛnizenaa kɔɔi. Tama tamaa i ra nuu manika kɔɔi ani banna yir yira. Ka zumbee wiraa gba daŋ lallii dɔɔ biini.

ref: You will be afraid to climb up a hill or walk down a road. Your hair will turn as white as almond blossoms. You will feel lifeless and drag along like an old grasshopper. We each go to our eternal home, and the streets here are filled with those who mourn.
text: Bɔra la n du chiŋ wia daŋ dɔɔi ɔnsii, volaa ɛɛ wii la hin ninna ɔm. I nyuhuna daŋ huuhzi, i ra guuzi. Wiimaa wàá ka ra kɛllii. A hɔl la yaa n niŋ la yaa tuna heezaa bɔr la, wiraa daŋ su ŋmɛnizenaa.

ref: The silver cord snaps, the golden bowl breaks; the water pitcher is smashed, and the pulley at the well is shattered.
text: A liizi i Taari wia mɔɔ ka saliŋhuŋŋu yɔlɔ la chah, saliŋ fintina la chol purgi. Jaayir ŋmɛŋ chah, hàá ka wer dɔɔ nii lii kɔlɔŋ biini.

ref: So our bodies return to the earth, and the life-giving breath returns to God.
text: Awia, yaa bɔrahɔna daŋ bir zuu hɛɛhraa la biini aŋ liwɛɛ la, ka heeza la Kɔraawiizi n kpawɛɛ dua la, bir kaali u be.

ref: Nothing makes sense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense. Respect and Obey God
text: Nunzunni la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Annii naa maa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ. A maa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ.” A wia tuna

ref: I was a wise teacher with much understanding, and I collected a number of proverbs that I had carefully studied.
text: Ka Nunzunni la n faa dɔɔ nunzuma la wia, u faa aah siwiire di ra bagli a nɛra wii la maa uŋ zummɛ. U faa helli sɛɛliizii, di ɛɛa na, ú zum a wibii.

ref: Then I tried to explain these things in the best and most accurate way.
text: A Nunzunni faa ra nyiŋŋi bampirii tigaa wiŋɔɔlaarɛ, awia, u wiŋɔlaa la uŋ sɛbɛɛ la ɛɛ wibiire.

ref: Words of wisdom are like the stick a farmer uses to make animals move. These sayings come from a shepherd, and they are like nails that fasten things together.
text: Nunzunni wiŋɔɔlaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ penɔɔni daŋkpala. Sɛɛliizi la baŋ chaalɛɛ la ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ lugbia baŋ kpaahzɛɛ, a zuu nɛnnɛ. Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ yaa Nɔɔnikpaŋ labuu kpaa tɛɛ yaa.

ref: My child, I warn you to stay away from any teachings except these. There is no end to books, and too much study will wear you out.
text: N biibaal, wii bɛl haa du de hin ninna du u tau. Hɔna sɛbaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ. Hellaa werge daŋ gil i kuuh.

ref: Everything you were taught can be put into a few words: Respect and obey God! This is what life is all about.
text: Annii naa maa har, wikpaŋ bɛnnɛ du de ń ŋɔ, á ɔm Kɔraawiizi, di ra tɔgzuu, di ra hiŋ u widaulaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, a bɛŋ wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi ta newea.

ref: God will judge everything we do, even what is done in secret, whether good or bad.
text: Wia la maa yaa n niŋ ɛɛ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ dia seriya, di ananaarɛ gɛɛ achɔgaarɛ, haali anla yaa n suahzɛɛ ɛɛ gba.

ref: Kiss me tenderly! Your love is better than wine,
text: Koriŋ, di bagliŋ i nɔŋŋaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, i nɔŋŋaa summɔ kaali siŋ.

ref: and you smell so sweet. All the young women adore you; the very mention of your name is like spreading perfume. *
text: I sɔɔh summɔɔ lugɔ tulaale, i sɔŋ ɛɛ lugɔ baŋ mizi tulaale. Awiarɛ suŋgure maa ra nyiŋŋii.

ref: Hurry, my king! Let's hurry. Take me to your home. The Young Women Speak: We are happy for you! And we praise your love even more than wine. She Speaks: Young women of Jerusalem, it is only right that you should adore him.
text: Lawiŋ ya chɔ kaali, a ɛɛ manaŋ! Ɛɛ n koori, di kpogliŋ zuu i dia. Dammuzi Yaa bɔra daŋ sɔɔni, i wia daŋ par yaa, yaa daŋ chɔli i nɔŋŋaa di kaali siŋ. Haŋfalii Awia, suŋgure maanii ra nyiŋŋii!

ref: My skin is dark and beautiful, like a tent in the desert or like Solomon's curtains.
text: Jɛrusalɛm biihaana, n biroore ka du wer, di biri lugɔ Kɛda Hɛribɔduma tantizi, ka du wer alugɔ Koori Solomɔn kooridia patiisazi.

ref: Don't stare at me just because the sun has darkened my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they made me work in the vineyard, and so I neglected my complexion.
text: Ií gilɛɛ ra gbɛlliŋ dikuu n biraa wia, dikuu wiizi n gillɛ n biri wia. N niubambinaa faa na baannɛ duŋ, di gil n hum huma grepu daazi koo biini. N faa waa n hiŋ kossaa saŋa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: My darling, I love you! Where do you feed your sheep and let them rest at noon? Don't let the other shepherds think badly of me. I'm not one of those women who shamelessly follow after shepherds. He Speaks:
text: N sɛnni, ŋɔ n be, lee i nɔɔni i peeza la á ga dei? Lee a chɔɔ heezi wibaŋai? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ń gaagi di ra nyiŋŋii penɔɔna baŋhina peeza biinei? Haŋfalii jaari

ref: My dearest, if you don't know, just follow the path of the sheep. Then feed your young goats near the shepherds' tents.
text: Haa de zummɛa, haana biini maa toloori? La gaa hiŋ a peeza luge, di nyiŋŋi kooree tɛɛ i bupɔla n dugli penɔɔna tantizi la.

ref: You move as gracefully as the pony that leads the chariot of the king.
text: N sɛnni, baala ra nyiŋŋiibuu alugɔ Ijip koori zagra n na tɛrgi torkozi, n na nyiŋŋi zagniina.

ref: Earrings add to your beauty, and you wear a necklace of precious stones.
text: I nyuhuna wessoo di tɔ i giraa, di chɔɔ i baŋaa lugɔ baŋaakuna la n wesse werge, a yoola du kpol.

ref: Let's make you some jewelry of gold, woven with silver. She Speaks:
text: Ka yaa daŋ kuari saliŋ dignikuna, di kpa saliŋhuŋŋu margi a ni tɛi. Haŋfalii

ref: My king, while you were on your couch, my aroma was a magic charm.
text: N koori faa chɔɔ u karjaŋ ninɛɛ, n tulaale sɔɔh tɔ bɔr maa.

ref: My darling, you are perfume between my breasts;
text: N sɛnni ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ tulaale, di chɔɔ n bampirii.

ref: you are flower blossoms from the gardens of En-Gedi. He Speaks:
text: N sɛnni ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ pir daazi n na fii Ɛn Gɛdi grepu daazi kooni biini. Haŋfalii jaari

ref: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— your eyes are those of a dove. She Speaks:
text: N sɛnni, i wessoo, i ɛɛ suŋguruu werge, i siwee ra nyɛgzi lugɔ komma siwee. Haŋfalii

ref: My love, you are handsome, truly handsome— the fresh green grass will be our wedding bed
text: N sɛnni, i ɛɛ bunɔɔnnɛ werge! I wia ra parimbuu! Kooriilɛɛrii niŋ ɛɛ yaa kunchɔɔrikuŋ.

ref: in the shade of cedar and cypress trees.
text: Hɛriŋkpol daazi niŋ ɛɛ yaa dia dolli, daananaa ɛɛ u saŋa ni daabii.

ref: I am merely a rose from the land of Sharon, a lily from the valley. He Speaks:
text: N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Sarɔn pir daa fii di ɛɛ yuuga n du walli biine. Haŋfalii jaari

ref: My darling, when compared with other young women, you are a lily among thorns. She Speaks:
text: Gunla yuuga n chigɛ sɔɔhri biini la, gunnɛ n sɛnni du suŋgure biini. Haŋfalii

ref: And you, my love, are an apple tree among trees of the forest. Your shade brought me pleasure; your fruit was sweet.
text: Gunla soom daa la n na nɔŋ nɔnsuma n chigɛ kɔr biini la, gunnɛ n sɛnni wia ra pariŋ di kaali bunɔɔna maa.

ref: You led me to your banquet room and showered me with love.
text: U kpoglimbuu ba u diuzenaa diiribɔr, di kpa u kotowia tɔŋ, di bagliŋ u nɔŋŋaa werge.

ref: Refresh and strengthen me with raisins and apples. I am hungry for love!
text: Tɛŋ huu la n summɛ, di gil n bir dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, di tɛŋ sooma n bir dɔɔ alaanfia! I nɔŋŋaa werge gillɔɔ n bɔra siu vɛlɛɛ.

ref: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
text: N sil u nomɛɛl ninɛɛ, u nodig ge koriŋ.

ref: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles never to awaken love before it is ready. Winter Is Past She Speaks:
text: Jɛrusalɛm haana, ií kpa chaŋkpalŋa ani weema gbaŋzi di ŋɔ nua tɛŋ lugɔ ii wàá kpa ii nuuzi di hau yaa nyiŋŋaa wia biini, ka yaa saŋa haa hel. Yir nɛɛhiŋ Haŋfalii

ref: I hear the voice of the one I love, as he comes leaping over mountains and hills
text: N nuu n sɛnni loobiire. Uŋ chɔwɛɛ lii bizenaa nyuuni di ra ba, di chɔ gilgi giŋgimee di ra ba n be.

ref: like a deer or a gazelle. Now he stands outside our wall, looking through the window
text: N sɛnni ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ weema, alugɔ chɛɛh. Na! U chigɔ koŋlii zɛɛrɛ, di ga tokoro di ra liŋŋi, di ga u bɔɔjigzi di ra binni tiiih.

ref: and speaking to me. He Speaks: My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
text: N sɛnni ŋɔ wiarɛ n be, “Izi, n sɛnni, n sɛnninanii, ba n nii ra la.

ref: Winter is past, the rain has stopped;
text: Na! Yuu tunnɔɔ, dooŋ kponnoo.

ref: flowers cover the earth, it's time to sing. The cooing of doves is heard in our land.
text: Kuna fiiwɔɔ, yira yiraa saŋa helloo, yaa ra nuu kommazi wiraa yaa hɛri.

ref: Fig trees are bearing fruit, while blossoms on grapevines fill the air with perfume. My darling, I love you! Let's go away together.
text: Fig nɔna faari aaihrɛ, grepu daazi fiiri sɔɔh tɔ bɔr maa. Awia, izi n sɛnni, n sɛnninanii, a ba n nii ra la.” Haŋfalii jaari

ref: You are my dove hiding among the rocks on the side of a cliff. Let me see how lovely you are! Let me hear the sound of your melodious voice.
text: I ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ komma n suah bii bɔɔ. Gil n na i toloosiwee la, di nuu i loobisum la.

ref: Our vineyards are in blossom; we must catch the little foxes that destroy the vineyards. She Speaks:
text: Ií lauri nyɛgɛzi la, biljigzi la, mɔɔ ka a chɔgi yaa grepu daazi n na fii. Haŋfalii

ref: My darling, I am yours, and you are mine, as you feed your sheep among the lilies.
text: N sɛnni ɛɛ n hotte, n ge ɛɛ u hor. U ra tɛɛ u peezaa diwee yuugazi biini,

ref: Pretend to be a young deer dancing on mountain slopes until daylight comes and shadows fade away.
text: guŋŋ hɔɔ wa pizi chɔɔzi ni, hamuŋa kaali. Bir ba alugɔ weema, n sɛnninanii, alugɔ chɛɛh n du bizenaa n du kpurmakpurma nyuuni.

ref: While in bed at night, I reached for the one I love with heart and soul. I looked for him, but he wasn't there.
text: Hamuŋa maa, n ɔɔ chɔɔ n kunchɔɔrikuŋ ninɛɛ, di ra fɛ n sɛnninanii wia, di ra nyiŋŋi u bɔr, ka mɔɔ nawɛɛ.

ref: So I searched through the town for the one I love. I looked on every street, but he wasn't there.
text: Awia, n daŋ izi gaagi di bar a bolzeŋ, u ŋmɛnizenaa ni fɔɔliizi. N daŋ nyiŋŋi unla min nɔŋŋɛɛ. Denii n binni, ka mɔɔ nawɛɛ.

ref: I even asked the guards patrolling the town, “Have you seen the one I love so much?”
text: Tauduura la n na bar a bolzeŋ naŋ. N pɛɛzi baa, “Ií waa n sɛnni nawɛɛa?”

ref: Right after that, I found him. I held him and would not let go until I had taken him to the home of my mother.
text: Miŋ haŋ waa gil baa, di n nau. N lawuu, maa kaa gil u kaali, ka kpogluu ba n maa dia, dia la biini baŋ luliŋ la.

ref: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles, never to awaken love before it is ready. The Groom and the Wedding Party Their Friends Speak:
text: Jɛrusalɛm haana, ií kpa chaŋkpalŋa ani weema gbaŋzi, di ŋɔ nua tɛŋ lugɔ ii wàá kpa ii nuuzi di hau yaa nyiŋŋaa wia biini, ka yaa saŋa haa hel. Yir horohiŋ Haŋfalii

ref: What do we see approaching from the desert like a cloud of smoke? With it comes the sweet smell of spices, including myrrh and frankincense.
text: Anɛɛ n lii hɛribɔduma biini di ra ba alugɔ nyɔɔzi n tɔwɛɛ, di ra sɔɔhri daahɛgsɔɔhsuma ni tulaale la kɔkɔɔza n na yooi?

ref: It is King Solomon carried on a throne, surrounded by sixty of Israel's best soldiers.
text: Na! Koori Solomɔnnɛ soge u koorikara ni, ba chiu di ra ba, Laallɔɔra tokkoahoroo ɛɛ u guure, Izrɛl hina laallɔkpegaa.

ref: Each of them wears a sword. They are experts at fighting, even in the dark.
text: Ba maanii zum tokobi kpai lɔ laal nɛnnɛ, di zum laal lɔi siwee werge. Bɛl maanii vɔɔwɛ di kpogli tokobi, di ra guu hamuŋa wilezi.

ref: The throne is made of trees from Lebanon.
text: Koori Solomɔn sogo u koorikara ninɛɛ, ba chiu. Daazi la n wesse nɛnnɛɛ ba kpa sɛɛuh.

ref: Its posts are silver, the back is gold, and the seat is covered with purple cloth. You women of Jerusalem have taken great care to furnish the inside.
text: Saliŋhuŋŋuu ba kpa tɔ u daazi la baŋ kpawɛɛ di ra chiu, di kpa saliŋ tɔ u sognibɔr ni. Wɛjɛ la n aahwɛ alugɔ zagbiiŋ niirɛ, ba kpa tɔ u kaputtizi ni, Jɛrusalɛm haanaa kpa kunnanaa la baŋ suahwɛɛ tɔ u biini ni u har maa nɛnnɛ.

ref: Now come and see the crown given to Solomon by his mother on his happy wedding day.
text: Bolzeŋ Ziɔn haana, ií ba wa na Koori Solomɔn. U hi koorikahuro la u maa n kpawɛɛ hiubuu, a hɔl la uŋ kpa haaŋ la, u bɔsɔna ni u bɔpuraa hɔpizii la.

ref: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— as you look through your veil, your eyes are those of a dove. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.
text: N sɛnni, na gunla hiŋ wesse! Na gunla i siwee n na nyɛgzi i saata biini! I nyuhuna pɛ lugɔ bukpila n lii Giliad bizeŋ nyuu di ra tuu.

ref: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.
text: I nyina huuhzi alugɔ baŋ fuŋ peeza huna ka sɔa nii. Bɛl maa waa foŋŋe, a maa chigɔɔ di hiŋzi dɔŋa ni nɛnnɛ.

ref: Your lips are crimson cords, your mouth is shapely; behind your veil are hidden beautiful rosy cheeks.
text: I nuuhɔna aah yorototo alugɔ ŋmɛŋaahmu. Di i haŋ waa ŋɔ wia, a wessi ɔɔ nyaŋŋuu. I giraa du wer di suah i saata biini.

ref: Your neck is more graceful than the tower of David, decorated with thousands of warriors' shields.
text: I baŋaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Koori Deevid diijaŋ la, n wesse werge maa la. I laali baŋaakuŋ u ɛɛ lugɔ laal pɛrɛtuzi kagboŋ, di bar.

ref: Your breasts are perfect; they are twin deer feeding among lilies.
text: I ila ɛɛwɔɔ alugɔ weembizi anɛɛ alugɔ chaŋkpalŋa biinɛɛri n du yuugazi biini di ra di.

ref: I will hasten to those hills sprinkled with sweet perfume and stay there till sunrise.
text: N daŋ so tulaale giŋgimii nyuu, daahɛgsɔɔhsuma gindalee nyuu, guŋŋ di ra ba saŋa la hɔɔ niŋ wa pizi, hamuŋa jaa tuŋ la.

ref: My darling, you are lovely in every way.
text: N sɛnni, na gunla hiŋ wesse, di du kpeg nɛnnɛ!

ref: My bride, together we will leave Lebanon! We will say goodbye to the peaks of Mount Amana, Senir, and Hermon, where lions and leopards live in the caves.
text: N haŋfalii, gil ya lii Lɛbanɔn bizenaa nyuuni tuu, yá lii Lɛbanɔn nyuu tuu. Yá lii Bizeŋ Amana nyuu tuu, Bizenaa Sɛnir ani Hɛmɔn nyuuni, bɔra la bunyinzi ni amanizi n duwɛɛ.

ref: My bride, my very own, you have stolen my heart! With one glance from your eyes and the glow of your necklace, you have stolen my heart.
text: N bampirii kuŋ ni n haŋfalii, i sibinnaa ani i baŋaa kuŋ lau n bampiriire.

ref: Your love is sweeter than wine; the smell of your perfume is more fragrant than spices.
text: N bampirii kuŋ ni n haŋfalii! I nyiŋŋaa ra pur n bɔraa. I nyiŋŋaa bɔ siŋ, i tulaale sɔɔhri kaali kunsɔɔhrisum maa.

ref: Your lips are a honeycomb; milk and honey flow from your tongue. Your dress has the aroma of cedar trees from Lebanon.
text: N sɛnni, huuhnuu kpissi du i nuuhɔna ninɛɛ, i nuuzuŋŋi ɛɛ ilanii ni huuhnuu tɛŋ. I bɔmbɔga ra sɔɔhri lugɔ Lɛbanɔn bɔmbɔga.

ref: My bride, my very own, you are a garden, a fountain closed off to all others.
text: N bampirii kuŋ ni n haŋfalii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ wolo kambol, kambol la baŋ ma koŋlii bar, i ɛɛ lugɔ nɛkpaŋ bule.

text: Gil kóori dɔɔ wichezi tokkoahoro, hahjigzi tokkoanaazu ani suŋgure la n waa maga dɔɔwɛ!

ref: You would be my only choice, my flawless dove, the favorite child of your mother. The young women, the queens, and all the others tell how excited you are as they sing your praises:
text: Ka kpaŋkpaŋ bɛnnɛ n na nyiŋŋi, u wessoo alugɔ komma. U bɛnnɛ ɛɛ u maa biihaaŋ ani u biinɔŋŋii. Haana maanii ɔɔ binnuu di ra chɔluu, wichezi ni u hahjigzi yir yira di ra chɔluu. Dammuzi

ref: “You are as majestic as the morning sky— glorious as the moon— blinding as the sun! Your charms are more powerful than all the stars above.” She Speaks:
text: Anɛɛ n na ba alugɔ hɔɔ n na pizi kennei? U ɛɛ suŋguruu di wermi, di du wer alugɔ baagu, di ra chaani alugɔ wiizi, alugɔ chinchiŋwilaa n hiŋ dɔŋa. Haŋfalii jaari

ref: I went down to see if blossoms were on the walnut trees, grapevines, and fruit trees.
text: N lii almɔn daazi biinii tuu ba, ń wa na kuna la n faarɛɛ di fur waluu biini, ń wa na grepu ni pomegranet daazi fiiri.

ref: But in my imagination I was suddenly riding on a glorious chariot. Their Friends Speak:
text: N bɔra ra zaguu, i gillɔɔ màá wer di i nyiŋŋaa kanyitti alugɔ zagu ni u torko zuuri n na la laal. Dammuzi

ref: Dance! Dance! Beautiful woman from Shulam, let us see you dance! She Speaks: Why do you want to see this woman from Shulam dancing with the others?
text: Bir ba, bir ba, Sulam hinuu. Bir ba, bir ba, ya kaa nai! Haŋfalii jaari Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra nyiŋŋi n binnaa gunla nɛra n na nyiŋŋi saara binnaa lai?

ref: You are a princess, and your feet are graceful in their sandals. Your thighs are works of art, each one a jewel;
text: I ɛɛ toloorii werge maa! Na gunla i naazi ni gawa n wesse! I napɔga chol dɔŋa ni nɛnnɛ alugɔ nɛr la n zum nonii huma huŋhunnaa.

ref: your navel is a wine glass filled to overflowing. Your body is full and slender like a bundle of wheat bound together by lilies.
text: I ulee ɛɛ gulegulee lugɔ tassa biini n waa siŋ la n koozi dɔŋa ni nɛnnɛ ra nyaa. I hia du lugɔ baŋ kum huuti dau kululu, yuugazi baraa.

ref: Your breasts are like twins of a deer.
text: I ila ɛɛwɔɔ alugɔ weembizi anɛɛ alugɔ chaŋkpalŋa biinɛɛri.

ref: Your neck is like ivory, and your eyes sparkle like the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath-Rabbim. Your nose is beautiful like Mount Lebanon above the city of Damascus.
text: I baŋaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ diijaŋ la baŋ kpa bala nyina ma. I siwee ɛɛ lugɔ bolzeŋ Hɛsbɔn polni la n dugli a bolzeŋ dominuuzeŋ la banna yir Baf Rabim la. I miizi wessoo lugɔ Lɛbanɔn diijaŋ la n chigɛ chaŋ Damaskus la.

ref: Your head is held high like Mount Carmel; your hair is so lovely it holds a king prisoner.
text: I lalli i nyuurɛ chiŋ lugɔ Bizeŋ Kamɛl. I nyuhumpɛttaa ra nyɛgzuu lugɔ agoonanii, a wessi ɔɔ lau koori bampiriire alugɔ baŋ lɔ laal di lau nɛr la.

ref: You are tall and slender like a palm tree, and your breasts are full.
text: I ɛɛwɔɔ zɔrɔmm lugɔ kakubkpaŋkpargu daa, i ila ɛɛ lugɔ u nɔna n mari dɔŋa chuppu.

ref: I will climb that tree and cling to its branches. I will discover that your breasts are clusters of grapes, and that your breath is the aroma of apples.
text: N daŋ zinnuu di tɔrgi u nɔna. I ila ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ grepu nɔna nyuu n be, i heeza sɔɔh du sum alugɔ maŋgozi sɔɔh,

ref: Kissing you is more delicious than drinking the finest wine. How wonderful and tasty! She Speaks:
text: i nua lugɔ sinnanii. Haŋfalii A siŋ vii pal deŋli la n sɛnni be, di gaa pal u nuuhɔna ni u nyina ni guŋ bɔɔiih.

ref: My darling, I am yours, and you desire me.
text: N ɛɛ n sɛnni hotte, n wia ra kɛlluu.

ref: Let's stroll through the fields and sleep in the villages.
text: N sɛnni, a ba, gil ya lii la a bolzeŋ nua, di ga chɔɔ de hamuŋa naa.

ref: At dawn let's slip out and see if grapevines and fruit trees are covered with blossoms. When we are there, I will give you my love.
text: Yaa daŋ feli izi di binni grepu daazi kooni, di na, di a ra fiiwɔ gɛɛ di a fiiri pillɔɔ gɛɛ di pomegranet daazi ra fii, denii ń jaa nyiŋŋii.

ref: Perfume from the magic flower fills the air, my darling. Right at our doorstep I have stored up for you all kinds of tasty fruits.
text: I daŋ nuu daa lunne la n na hiini haana ba ra lul ni nɔnsuma la maa, n dugli yaa gbera la sɔɔh. N sɛnni, afalaa ni abinaa maanii n dawii.

ref: If you were my brother, I could kiss you whenever we happen to meet, and no one would say I did wrong.
text: Kunla faa ŋɔ lugɔ n niubambiere hiŋ, alugɔ n maa illɛ i ɔzi. Di n faa huuzii bossee, n daŋ faa korii, ka a wàá tir nɛr maa.

ref: I could take you to the home of my mother, who taught me all I know. I would give you delicious wine and fruit juice as well.
text: N daŋ vii kpoglii di la n maa dia, unla n dɛɛziŋ la. N daŋ tɛi siŋ la sɔɔh n summɛ alugɔ pomegranet siŋ, í nyɔɔ.

ref: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.
text: N sil u nomɛɛl ninɛɛ, u nodig ge koriŋ.

ref: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me never to awaken love before it is ready. Their Friends Speak:
text: Jɛrusalɛm haana, ií ŋɔ nua tɛŋ, lugɔ ii wàá kpa ii nuuzi di hau yaa nyiŋŋaa wia biini, ka yaa saŋa haa hel. Yir numbɛlhiŋ Dammuzi

ref: Who is this young woman coming in from the desert and leaning on the shoulder of the one she loves? She Speaks: I stirred up your passions under the apple tree where you were born.
text: Anɛɛ n lii hɛribɔduma biini di ra ba, u ni u sɛnni lau dɔŋa nonee kennei? Haŋfalii N lalliibuu dɔɔ, soom zɛɛ, bɔr la baŋ lulii la.

ref: Always keep me in your heart and wear this bracelet to remember me by. The passion of love bursting into flame is more powerful than death, stronger than the grave.
text: Lizi i bampirii lii nɔŋŋaa maa ni, see n hor, gilɛɛ kaa wàá kor nɛr maa, see n bɛŋ. Dɔŋa nɔŋŋaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa alugɔ siu, u zoma du kpeg alugɔ ŋmam. Dɔŋa nɔŋŋaa ɔɔ lau ninne, di ra haahri alugɔ ninzeŋ.

ref: Love cannot be drowned by oceans or floods. It cannot be bought— any offer would be scorned no matter how great. Their Friends Speak:
text: Nii wàá wer dinzuu, nii la maa n suwee wàá wer diu. Ka di nɛr la maa ra nyiŋŋi ú kpa daama yau nɔŋŋaa, hiihzii ú di. Niubambinaa

ref: We have a little sister whose breasts are not yet formed. If someone asks to marry her, what should we do?
text: Yaa dɔɔ niuhambijigaa, u ila haa waa suwee. Bɛɛ yá ɛɛ tɛu di biipɔllii waa nyiŋŋuuwei?

ref: She isn't a wall that we can defend behind a silver shield. Neither is she a room that we can protect behind a wooden door. She Speaks:
text: Di u vii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ koŋlii, yaa daŋ ma saliŋhuŋŋu diijaŋra di hɔŋ u ni. Di u vii kaa ɛɛu lugɔ dominua, yaa daŋ kpa hɛriŋkpol daapiahni mɛɛruu. Haŋfalii

ref: I am a wall around a city, my breasts are towers, and just looking at me brings him great pleasure.
text: N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ koŋlii, n ila ɛɛ lugɔ diijaŋra. N sɛnni zummɔ lugɔ u benii n na na bɔsɔna werge.

ref: Solomon has a vineyard at Baal-Hamon, which he rents to others for a thousand pieces of silver each.
text: Koori Solomɔn dɔɔ koonaniirɛ, u du bɔr la banna yir Baal Hamɔn. Patta lɛɛu ra par, ka ra turguu, bɛl maa ra turgi saliŋhuŋŋa kebisau kagboŋ.

ref: My vineyard is mine alone! Solomon can keep his silver and the others can keep their share of the profits. He Speaks:
text: Gil Koori Solomɔn dɔɔ saliŋhuŋŋa kebisau kagboŋ, patta la ge dɔɔ kalfaanɛɛ, a ɛɛ ba hora, ka miŋwaa dɔɔ n himmaa grepu daazi koore! Haŋfalii jaari

ref: You are in the garden with friends all around. Let me hear your voice! She Speaks:
text: N sɛnni, gil n nuu i loobii a kambol biini, n dammuzi ra kpaŋuu í ŋɔ wia! Haŋfalii

ref: Hurry to me, my darling! Run faster than a deer to mountains of spices.
text: Ba n be, n sɛnni, alugɔ weema, alugɔ chɛhbalee n du bizenaa nyuuni, bɔr la kunsɔɔhrisuma n duwɛɛ.

ref: I am Isaiah, the son of Amoz. And this is the message that I was given about Judah and Jerusalem when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah: A Guilty Nation
text: Baa bɛllɛ faa du de, u sɔnnɛ Amɔz. U biibaal sɔnnɛ faa Aizaaya. Aizaaya faa na Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm wia naabuu lugɔ deeza biini saŋa la Koora Uzzia, Jɔtam, Ahaz ani Hɛzɛkia n hiŋzi dɔŋa ni, di faa di Juda hɛri kora la. Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ u nɛra wichɔgaa wia

ref: The Lord has said, “Listen, heaven and earth! The children I raised have turned against me.
text: Chiŋ ni hɛri maa, ií ra nuu! Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Biizi la n himmaa n dɛɛzɛɛ birgi dignikpega hinaa, di vɛɛ n nua.

ref: Oxen and donkeys know who owns and feeds them, but my people won't ever learn.”
text: Nabal zum u dɔɔrii, kawee gba zum bɔr la u dɔɔri n na dɛɛzuu, ka n nɛra Izrɛl hina wan zummɛ, ba waa wia zɛɛ zummɛ.”

ref: Israel, you are a sinful nation loaded down with guilt. You are wicked and corrupt and have turned from the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
text: Aa! Nɛchɔgaa! Ii bilchɔg siili ii ninɛɛ. Ii ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra biizii di nyaa wibii, ii vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wiarɛ. Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii labuu ii hah, di bir ii hara kpuu.

ref: Why be punished more? Why not give up your sin? Your head is badly bruised, and you are weak all over.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ba kaa lɔɔzi iai? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii haa kpogli dignikpega di ra vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nuai? Ii nyuuni maanii na pira, ii bampiree maa ge chɔgizi.

ref: From your head to your toes there isn't a healthy spot. Bruises, cuts, and open sores go without care or oil to ease the pain. A Country in Ruins
text: Di chi ii naapaala biine di ra la ii nyuuni maanii ɛɛ ŋmɛra di ɔrgi, ka ba wàá chakkɛ, ba wàá duwɛɛ nuu, ba waa kaa vɔɔzaa ge.

ref: Your country lies in ruins; your towns are in ashes. Foreigners and strangers take and destroy your land while you watch.
text: Ii hɛri maanii chɔkkɛ, ii bolzenaa fuuh, di birgi diŋgelli. Ii kaa ra binni ka hɔɔhra wa foozi ii pattikuna maa nyaamm.

ref: Enemies surround Jerusalem, alone like a hut in a vineyard or in a cucumber field.
text: Bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm bɛnnɛ kawɛɛ, di jaa ɛɛ lugɔ koolinlɔɔ n chigɛ grepu daazi koo, di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ pampanni n chigɛ kiime koo, di ɛɛ lugɔ bolzeŋ baŋ fɔɔwɛ.

ref: Zion would have disappeared like Sodom and Gomorrah, if the Lord All-Powerful had not let a few of its people survive. Justice, Not Sacrifices
text: Di Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la faa waa yaa baŋhina gillɛ, yaa maa daŋ vii tuŋ nyaamm alugɔ Sɔdɔm ni Gɔmɔra hina n faa tunnɛ la.

ref: You are no better than the leaders and people of Sodom and Gomorrah! So listen to the Lord God:
text: Jɛrusalɛm nabɔnzi, ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Sɔdɔm hina. Ií ra nuu Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii. Dignikpega hina lugɔ Gɔmɔra hina, ií ra nuu Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg la.

ref: “Who asked you to bring all this when you come to worship me? Stay out of my temple!
text: Iiŋ ɔɔ wa ba n jaamaa la, minuu ŋɔ ii ba waa ginzi naazi n diŋŋee di ra duŋŋ?

ref: Your sacrifices are worthless, and your incense disgusting. I can't stand the evil you do on your New Moon Festivals or on your Sabbaths and other times of worship.
text: A guŋ waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ tɛŋ. Haali daahɛgsɔɔhsuma iiŋ fuuhwe lizi mbusu di ra tɛŋ la sɔɔh chummɔɔ werge n be. Ii Baagufalaa Hɔpizizenaa maa, Heezaa Hɔpizii ani jaamaa hɔpizizenaa dii la iiŋ ɔɔ chaali dɔŋa la, a maa waa wer, di ɛɛŋ lɔgɔ lii.

ref: I hate your New Moon Festivals and all others as well. They are a heavy burden I am tired of carrying.
text: N hah ii diuzenaa la iiŋ ɔɔ ra di Baagufalaa ni ii hɔpizizenaa biini labuu. A wia bazimbuu di ɛɛ buntɔgaa tɛŋ.

ref: and learn to live right. See that justice is done. Defend widows and orphans and help the oppressed.” An Invitation from the Lord
text: ka ra ɛɛ wideŋlaa. Ií ra nyiŋŋi wibii dii, di ra du banla banna tɔɔri la bɔkpega, di ra lɛɛ lalbiizi nuuzi, di kaa yoo ra kuari luhaana wia.”

ref: I, the Lord, invite you to come and talk it over. Your sins are scarlet red, but they will be whiter than snow or wool.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “Ií ba ya lɔ nfɛrɛ. Haali ii wichɔgaa n kannɛ ii ni, di ɛɛ lugɔ kuŋ n kpoŋŋe di aah lugɔ chal gba, ka n daŋ gil ii huuhzi alugɔ gonni.

ref: If you willingly obey me, the best crops in the land will be yours.
text: Di ii daŋ sɛɛ ra hiŋ n nuuzi lawaa, ii daŋ na diwee nɛnnɛ lii ii kooni di ra di.

ref: But if you turn against me, your enemies will kill you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Condemns Jerusalem
text: Ama, di ii dɔɔ dignikpega di ra vɛɛ n nuuzi hiŋaa waa, ii dɔma daŋ wa yoo ia laal di kpu ia nyaamm. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔzii guŋ!”

ref: Jerusalem, you are like an unfaithful wife. Once your judges were honest and your people lived right; now you are a city full of murderers.
text: Bolzeŋ la nɛra wia n faa dɔɔ wibii la, jaa ɛɛu lugɔ hahsɛnsɛnni! Wibii hina faa su u biinii, wideŋlaa faa du de, ka filaŋkeŋ, nɛkpuura bɛnnɛ du de!

ref: Your leaders have rejected me to become friends of crooks; your rulers are looking for gifts and bribes. Widows and orphans never get a fair trial.
text: Ii nabɔnzi ɛɛ dignikpega hina di ɛɛ ŋmɛɛna dammuzi. Ba aah siweere di ra nyiŋŋi kundizi, di kpa ba siwii sag a ni. Ba wàá sɛɛ lɛɛ lalbiizi nuuzi, ba wàá sɛɛ yoo di ra kuari luhaana wia.

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the mighty ruler of Israel, and I make you a promise: You are now my enemy, and I will show my anger by taking revenge on you.
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la, Fɔŋŋa Hiŋ la Izrɛl hina n na hum la kaa ŋɔu, “N daŋ turgi n dɔma ba wichɔgaa kim ka n baaŋ jaa sɔɔniŋ.

ref: I will punish you terribly and burn away everything that makes you unfit to worship me.
text: N daŋ du ia siaahmu ka wer lizi ii widoŋa ni ii wikuna maa ii ni ha.

ref: Jerusalem, I will choose judges and advisors like those you had before. Your new name will be “Justice and Faithfulness.” The Lord Will Save Jerusalem
text: Di n wa ɛɛ guŋ tuŋ, n daŋ bir tɛɛ ia nabɔnzi la wia n deŋlee alugɔ banla iiŋ faa felee dɔɔ la. Denii bá kaa ra yir Jɛrusalɛm ‘Wibii ni Wideŋlaa Bolzeŋ.’ ”

ref: Jerusalem, you will be saved by showing justice; Zion's people who turn to me will be saved by doing right.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ bir lɛɛ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina ni wibii, banla n bittɛ lii ba wichɔgaa biinii ú lɛɛ ni wideŋlaa.

ref: But those rebellious sinners who turn against me, the Lord, will all disappear.
text: Ama dignikpeg hina ni wichɔgɛɛra maa daŋ tuŋ, banla n vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la siu.

ref: You will be made ashamed of those groves of trees where you worshiped idols.
text: Hiihzi daŋ kpu ia dikuu daazenaa la zɛɛzi iiŋ faa ra kuari vuga, a par ia la. Ii daŋ ŋmaabi dikuu kambola la iiŋ lizɛɛ wia.

ref: You will be like a grove of trees dying in a drought.
text: Awia, ii daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ daazeŋ la n siuwɛ, u paŋhoori ra war, di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ kambol la n hillɛ.

ref: Your strongest leaders will be like dry wood set on fire by their idols. No one will be able to help, as they all go up in flames.
text: Nɛkpeg daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ kɔlii, u wiɛɛlaa ge ɛɛ alugɔ niŋ di fuuh u maa. Nɛr maa wàá wer dinzi a niŋ.

ref: This is the message I was given about Judah and Jerusalem:
text: Jɛrusalɛm ni Juda hɛri wii bɛl Amɔz biibaal Aizaaya n faa nawɛɛ lugɔ deeza biinii keŋ.

ref: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills; every nation will rush to it.
text: Saŋa bɛl n na ba, a bizeŋ la baŋ ma Kɔraawiizi Dia hɔŋ u nyuu la, daŋ ɛɛ bizenzeŋ kaali anla maa n baruu la, durnya hɛssi nɛra maa waa nyiŋŋi u bɔr.

ref: Many people will come and say, “Let's go to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
text: Nɛkpila maa daŋ ba de, di wa ŋɔ, “Ií ba ya tinni Kɔraawiizi bizeŋ la, di la Kɔraawiizi la Jekɔb n na hum la Dia. U daŋ bagli yaa u ŋmɛnizi, guŋ gil ya wer di ra vol u ŋmɛnibizi.” U Gbɔg daŋ lii Ziɔn, u wiŋɔɔlii lii Jɛrusalɛm.

ref: He will settle arguments between nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never make war or attack one another.
text: U daŋ di hɛssi hina seriyazi, di laafi nɛkpila kaluzi. A hɛssi hina maa daŋ kpa ba tokobizi luu para, di kpa ba kandaazi ge luu daazi kɛuraa kizizi. Laalzi maa daŋ tuŋ. Ba ge wàá kaa ra ɛɛ laal sirya.

ref: People of Israel, let's live by the light of the Lord. Following Sinful Customs
text: Izrɛl hina, ií ba ya ra vol Kɔraawiizi bɔchaaŋ la biini. Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii wia

ref: Our Lord, you have deserted your people, Israel, because they follow customs of nations from the east. They worship Philistine gods and are close friends of foreigners.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i vɛɛ i nɛraa, Jekɔb diahina. Ba ra hiŋ wiifurii hina naana wiarɛ, di ra vug lugɔ Filisti hina, ba ni banla n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ kpau ra ɛɛ wia.

ref: They have endless treasures of silver and gold; they have countless horses and war chariots.
text: Ba hɛri dɔɔ saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋaa werge, ba daama waa maga dɔɔwɛ. Zagra su ba hɛri, ba laal torkozi waa maga dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Everywhere in the country they worship the idols they have made.
text: Ba hɛri maanii su vuga. Ba kuŋkuaraa sezii ba ɔɔ gaa giŋŋi, kuna la ba himmaa nonee n kuarɛɛ.

ref: And so, all of them will be ashamed and disgraced. Don't forgive them! A Day of Judgment
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ tuu newea zɛɛ, bá di hiihzi. Gilɛɛ wa gil ba wichɔgaa di ra tɛɛ baa.

ref: Every one of you, go hide among the rocks and in the ground, because the Lord is fearsome, marvelous, and glorious.
text: Ií zuu bia bɔɔni. Ií zuu suah hɛri, dikuu Kɔraawiizi baaŋ ani u zenni ni u girme n kannɛ werge wia!

ref: When the Lord comes, everyone who is proud will be made humble, and the Lord alone will be honored.
text: Hɔpizii bɛl ra bau, ii jigsi ni ii barabara la maa tuŋ. Denii bá jaa ra tɔgzi Kɔraawiizi bɛŋ.

ref: The Lord All-Powerful has chosen a day when those who are proud and conceited will be put down.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ dau hɔpiziirɛ tɛɛ banla maa n na jigsi di ra tɔgzi bahinaa la ni kuna la maa banna chɔli, bá di hiihzi.

ref: The tall and towering cedars of Lebanon will be destroyed. So will the oak trees of Bashan,
text: Lɛbanɔn hɛriŋkpol daazi la n jaŋŋɛ werge la ni Basan daazenaa la maanii ú chɔgi.

ref: When that day comes, everyone who is proud will be put down. Only the Lord will be honored.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil newea jigsi maa tuŋ, bá barabara la maa tuŋ. U bɛnnɛ bá tɔgzi a guŋ hɔpizii.

ref: Idols will be gone for good.
text: Ba vuga la maa leu nyaamm.

ref: You had better hide in caves and holes— the Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth.
text: Newea daŋ chɔ suahzi bia bɔɔni ni hɛri bɔɔni, dikuu Kɔraawiizi baaŋ wia, di chɔ suah dikuu u zenni ni u girme n kannɛ werge wia, di u wa izoo ú zigli hɛri.

ref: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, ba daŋ paa ba saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋa vuga la baŋ kuarɛɛ la ta daŋgboŋzi ni tuŋŋizi.

ref: The Lord will be fearsome, marvelous, and glorious when he comes to terrify people on earth— they will hide in caves and in the hills.
text: Di Kɔraawiizi baaŋ wa fuuhwo, u izi zigli hɛri, newea danna ɔmuu, di chɔ zuu bia ni hɛri bɔɔzenaa n luŋŋe werge biine, dikuu u girme ni u zenni n wesse werge la wia.

ref: Stop trusting the power of humans. They are all going to die, so how can they help?
text: Ií gilɛɛ kpa ii yarda du newea ni. Bɛɛ tɔnaa ba dɔɔi?

ref: The mighty Lord All-Powerful is going to take away from Jerusalem and Judah everything you need— your bread and water, *
text: Ií na! Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ ra nyiŋŋuu u teŋ kuna la maa n na hiini Jɛrusalɛm ni Juda hina maa. U daŋ teŋ ba diwee ni nii maa.

ref: soldiers and heroes, judges and prophets, leaders and army officers,
text: U daŋ kpu ba hɛri laallɔkpega ni laallɔɔra maa, ba sitɔɔra ni ba dɔgtɛɛzi, ba vugra ni ba nabɔnzi,

ref: officials and advisors, fortunetellers and others who tell the future.
text: ba laallɔɔra tokkoanɛɛ ni fi nabɔnzi, hɛri nabɔnzi, banla n zum nonee huma ani vugra.

ref: He will let children and babies become your rulers.
text: U daŋ jaa lizi biipɔllijigzi bá ɛɛ ba nabɔnzi, di gil bichalli ra binni ba ni.

ref: You will each be cruel to friends and neighbors. Young people will insult their elders; no one will show respect to those who deserve it.
text: Nɛra danna sunni dɔŋa, baal ni baal, nɛr ni u dɔŋhiŋ. Bichalli ra gbɛlli nɛzɛŋzi, nɛdumazi ra gbɛlli nɛtɔga.

ref: Some of you will grab hold of a relative and say, “You still have a coat. Be our leader and rule this pile of ruins.”
text: Baal daŋ lau u lulli bɛl u mɛɛ dia, di ŋɔ, “Hiŋ dɔɔ laala wia, ɛɛ yaa nabɔma, di ra binni bolpurii naa ni.”

ref: But the answer will be, “I can't do you any good. Don't make me your leader. There's no food or clothing left in my house.”
text: Ka u daŋ ŋɔ siaahmu ni, “Akai! Màá wer hiini ia. Maa diwee gɛɛ laala dɔɔwɛ n dia. Ií gilɛɛ kpaŋ ɛɛ a nɛra sitɔɔri.”

ref: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord— your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina ra jiŋluu, Juda hina ge ra chogli. Ba wiŋɔɔlaa ni wiɛɛlaa ra zuu Kɔraawiizi ninɛɛ, di ra gbɛlli u girme la n du ba baaŋ la.

ref: The look on your faces shows that you are sinful as Sodom, and you don't try to hide it. You are in for trouble, and you have brought it all on yourselves. The Wrong Kind of Leaders
text: Haali di i binni ba siwee, a ra bagluu lugɔ ba ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ lugɔ Sɔdɔm hina, ba wàá ra suah. Wia daŋ huuzi baa! Ba kpa hɛhchɔgrɛ ta bahinaa ni.

ref: Tell those who obey God, “You're very fortunate— you will be rewarded for what you have done.”
text: Ama, ŋɔ banla waa wia n deŋlee be lugɔ ba wia daŋ kuari. Ba daŋ di ba winanaa tɔna.

ref: Tell those who disobey, “You're in big trouble— what you did to others will come back to you.”
text: Wia daŋ huuzi wichɔgɛɛra! Hɛhchɔg chol ba ninɛɛ! Ba daŋ na ba wiɛɛlaa kinturgaa.

ref: Though you are God's people, you are ruled and abused by women and children. You are confused by leaders who guide you down the wrong path.
text: Biipɔllaa ra sunni n nɛraa. Haana ge ra di kora ba ni. Ee, n nɛra! Ií sitɔɔra gillɔɔ ii leu, di gil ii waa kaa ra hiŋ a ŋmɛnibee.

ref: The Lord is ready to accuse and judge all nations.
text: Kɔraawiizi sogo u seriya diiribɔttɛ. U izoore ú di nɛra seriya.

ref: He will even judge you rulers and leaders of his own nation. You destroyed his vineyard and filled your houses by robbing the poor.
text: U nɛra nabɔnzi ni ba sitɔɔra seriyaa u ra di, di ŋɔ, “Iabuu chɔgi n grepu daazi koo. Nyaara la kuna iin foozee ba be la su ii diinii.

ref: The Lord All-Powerful says, “You have crushed my people and rubbed in the dirt the faces of the poor.” The Women of Jerusalem
text: A zɛɛrɛ ɛrɛɛ ii ra sunni n nɛrai, di ra foozi nyaarai? Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hinnɛ pɛɛzi ia guŋ.”

ref: The Lord says: The women of Jerusalem are proud and strut around, winking shamelessly. They wear anklets that jingle and call attention to the way they walk.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina haana ra tɔgzi bahinaarɛ werge, di ra vol jigsi ni, di kpa gba siwee ge ra sɛm, di ra vol, ba naachawaa gbittizi ra gbɔgzi.

ref: But I, the Lord, will cover their heads with sores, and I will uncover their private parts.
text: Awia, n daŋ gil a haana nyuuni mɔnni ŋmɛra, di gba.”

ref: In place of perfume, there will be a stink; in place of belts, there will be ropes; in place of fancy hairdos, they will have bald heads. Instead of expensive clothes, they will wear sackcloth; instead of beauty, they will have ugly scars.
text: Ban niŋ ɔɔ mizi ba tulaalenanaa la, ka ba danna hɛhzi, ŋmɛnni lɛɛ kirsɔɔzi bɔr, nyugbaalaa lɛɛ nyuhuna bɔr, gbɔglɔŋ lɛɛ wɛjɛnanaa bɔr, niŋ pɛla lɛɛ toloori bɔr.

ref: The fighting men of Jerusalem will be killed in battle.
text: Ba daŋ kpa tokobizi kpu ii baala. Ii laallɔɔra siu laal biini.

ref: The city will mourn and sit in the dirt, emptied of its people.
text: Nɛra daŋ so Bolzeŋ Ziɔn dominuuzenaa ni biinichɔg, di ra wii. A bolzeŋ daŋ jaa ɛɛu lugɔ haaŋ baŋ dilgɛɛ u so hɛri.

ref: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, “I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.” The Lord Will Bless His People Who Survive
text: A hɔl hiŋ, haana baniidaanɛɛ daŋ lau bakpaŋ, di ŋɔ, “Yaa danna di yaa himmaa diwee, di nyiŋŋi yaa himmaa laala. Ka hiŋwaa sɛɛ í sɔŋ sag yaa ni, ya gilɛɛ ka di hiihzi!” Ba daŋ bir ma Jɛrusalɛm

ref: The time is coming when the Lord will make his land fruitful and glorious again, and the people of Israel who survive will take great pride in what the land produces.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil u Daa Kel lii, di du wer di dɔɔ girme. A hɛri daazi nɔna daŋ tɛɛ banla n kawɛɛ Izrɛl biini la girme ni sɔŋ.

ref: after the Lord sends a fiery judgment to clean the city and its people of their violent deeds.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ sɔ Jɛrusalɛm haana doŋa ha. U daŋ kpa seriya ni niŋ dunzi lizi challi la maa n bizi Jɛrusalɛm hɛri la ha.

ref: Then the Lord will cover the whole city and its meeting places with a thick cloud each day and with a flaming fire each night. God's own glory will be like a huge tent that covers everything.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi jaa gil baama wa tɔ Bizeŋ Ziɔn ni banla maa n chaali de la ni. Hɔpizaa saŋa, u daŋ ɔɔ ɛɛ lugɔ nyɔɔzi, hamuŋa ge ú ɛɛ lugɔ ninlau. Kɔraawiizi girme daŋ jaari Jɛrusalɛm maa ni.

ref: It will provide shade from the heat of the sun and a place of shelter and protection from storms and rain.
text: U daŋ ɛɛ bɔsɔŋ tɔ ba ni, wibaŋa wem wia, di guu baa lii pekpeg ni dooŋ ni.

ref: I will sing a song about my friend's vineyard that was on the side of a fertile hill.
text: N daŋ yir yir tɛɛ unla miŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ, di ra bagli u grepu daazi koo wia. N nɔŋŋi dɔɔ grepu daazi koore giŋgimii la n summɛ ni.

ref: My friend dug the ground, removed the stones, and planted the best vines. He built a watchtower and dug a pit in rocky ground for pressing the grapes. He hoped they would be sweet, but bitter grapes were all it produced.
text: U wigzi de bia maanii, di paagaa ga ha, ka duu grepu daananaa de, di ma tauduura dia u biini, di ki bɔɔ bá ɔɔ ra fɛrgi a nɔna de, á nii ra lii. Denii u faa jaa ra kpaŋ ú wa tɔrgi a grepunanaa, ka a faa waa wer.

ref: Listen, people of Jerusalem and of Judah! You be the judge of me and my vineyard.
text: “Filaŋkeŋ, Jɛrusalɛm ni Juda hina, ií binni n ni n koo naa wia na.

ref: What more could I have done for my vineyard? I hoped for sweet grapes, but bitter grapes were all that grew.
text: Ɛrɛɛ n faa kaa ɛɛ n grepu daazi koo naa di kaali kennaa miŋ ɛɛwɛ naanɛi? N faa ra tami grepunanaa ninɛɛ, Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ a nɔŋ achɔgaa bɛnnɛi?

ref: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.
text: Awia, n daŋ ŋɔ ii be gunla min niŋ ɛɛ n koo hiŋ. N daŋ purgi koŋlaa la miŋ mawɛɛ baruu la, ka gil pir sela fɛrgi u maa chɔgi.

ref: It will turn into a desert, neither pruned nor hoed; it will be covered with thorns and briars. I will command the clouds not to send rain.
text: N daŋ gil de birgi hɛribɔduma, ba wàá ka kɛuri de daazi kela gɛɛ di kaa par de gba. Ka choŋgolaa ni sɔɔhri bɛnnɛ niŋ lii de. Màá ka gil dooŋ gba kaa nɛɛ de.”

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful! Israel is the vineyard, and Judah is the garden I tended with care. I had hoped for honesty and for justice, but dishonesty and cries for mercy were all I found. Isaiah Condemns Social Injustice
text: Too, Izrɛl hinaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la grepu daazi koo hiŋ. Juda hina ɛɛ lugɔ kambolnanii la daazi uŋ duuwe ú bɔra sɔɔni a wia la. U ra tami lugɔ ba wia daŋ dɔɔ wibii, ka ba wia maa ɛɛ nɛkpui. U ra tami lugɔ ba danna ɛɛ wideŋlaa, ka u ra nuu biinichɔg wiraa. Wichɔgaa la nɛra n na ɛɛ wia

ref: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.
text: Wia daŋ huuzi ii banla maa n na yauzi diini ni kooni di ra jaa anla iin dɔɔwɛ ni, guŋ gil baŋhina wàá ka na zuuribɔra, ii bɛmbɛŋ jaa so a hɛri.

ref: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.
text: N nuuwɔɔ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la n ŋɔwɛɛ, “Wibii maa, diizenaa la maa daŋ wa birgi diiwooni, nɛr maa wàá ka du a biine.

ref: None of them are tired. They don't sleep or get drowsy, and they run without stumbling. Their belts don't come loose; their sandal straps don't break.
text: Ba bɛl maa waa kuuh gɛɛ di ra jiŋli, ba bɛl maa waa daari gɛɛ di ra chɔɔ dɔɔ gba. Bɛl maa kirsɔɔ gba waa putte gɛɛ u gau chɛh.

ref: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.
text: Wia daŋ huuzi ia, dikuubɛɛwiai, wichɔgaa vɔɔzi iabuu, ii waa wette lɛɛ iihinaa lii a biini.

ref: You are in for trouble! You get up early to start drinking, and you keep it up late into the night.
text: Wia daŋ huuzi ii banla n ɔɔ feli izi chɔɔzi ni di chɔ ra nyiŋŋi siŋ ií nyɔɔ la, di nyɔɔu guŋŋ hɛuh wa hɛɛhzi, ii dɛɛzi werge maa la.

ref: At your drinking parties you have the music of stringed instruments, tambourines, and flutes. But you never even think about all the Lord has done,
text: Ii diuzenaa bɔra, ii ɔɔ kpogli kemzi, janjalanzi, kunyigzaa, kaloopezi ani sinnii, ka ii baga lɛi Kɔraawiizi wiɛɛlaa wia, di ra gbɛlli u kuŋkuaraa.

ref: and so his people know nothing about him. That's why many of you will be dragged off to foreign lands. Your leaders will starve to death, and everyone else will suffer from thirst.
text: Awia, ba daŋ lauri n nɛra kaali hɛrdumazi, dikuu baŋ waa wia zɛɛ zummɛ wia. Lɔzi daŋ kpu ba nabɔnzi, niinyɔgzi ge nyaŋŋi banla n kawɛɛ, bá siuzi.

ref: The world of the dead has opened its mouth wide and is eagerly waiting for the leaders of Jerusalem and for its noisy crowds, especially for those who take pride in that city.
text: Awia, lalaa bol chɔɔwɔɔ ra kpaŋ baa. U haa u nuarɛ werge, ú ligli Jɛrusalɛm nɛzenaa ni banla n ɔɔ chaali di ra kɔɔ, di ra naa dɔŋa la.

ref: Its citizens have been put down, and its proud people have been brought to shame.
text: Nɛr maa daŋ di hiihzi, bá siwii sɔɔni, nɛkpoŋlaa gba siwii sɔɔni.

ref: But the holy Lord God All-Powerful is praised, because he has shown who he is by bringing justice.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la daŋ na girme, dikuu unna di seriya ni wibii wia. Dɔɔrinaniinanii la daŋ bagli lugɔ u wia deŋloore.

ref: His people will be like sheep grazing in their own pasture, and they will take off what was left by others.
text: Peeza ra di koorii a diŋgelli alugɔ a himmaa diiribɔr, pebizi ra di koorii de.

ref: And you say, “Let the holy God of Israel hurry up and do what he has promised, so we can see it for ourselves.”
text: Ii banla n na ŋɔ, “Gil Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ manaŋ, ú hahzi hum u huma, ya na. Gil a ba, di gil wii la Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii jina ɛɛ, ya zumuu.”

ref: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.
text: Wia daŋ huuzi banla n dɔɔ sɔŋ sinnyɔɔi biini, di ɔɔ ra jigsi gunla baŋ ɔɔ kpa sinni koozi dɔŋa ni, di ra nyɔɔ la,

ref: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.
text: di ɔɔ ra lɛɛ kebee ka lɛɛ bilii ra tɛɛ bilchɔg hina, ka gil bilii hina ra chol la.

ref: You will go up in flames like straw and hay! You have rejected the teaching of the holy Lord God All-Powerful of Israel. Now your roots will rot, and your blossoms will turn to dust.
text: Dikuu guŋ wia, ba maa daŋ tuŋ kpɛlɛŋ lugɔ niŋ n ɔɔ fuuh kɔlaa ni kooriihilaa, gunnɛ bá du lugɔ daa lunne n ɔɔ pɔɔh, u fiiri war, peu kpaa kaali lugɔ nyɔɔ la, dikuu baŋ vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la Gbɔg wia, di gbɛlli Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la Wiŋɔɔlii la wia.

ref: You are the Lord's people, but you made him terribly angry, and he struck you with his mighty arm. Mountains shook, and dead bodies covered the streets like garbage. The Lord is still angry, and he is ready to strike you again. Foreign Nations Will Attack
text: Guŋ wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi baaŋ na fuuh u nɛra ni la. U lalli u nonii lɔ baa ta hɛri. Bizenaa zigli, nɛra siuzi chɔɔ bol ŋmɛnizi bɔr maa alugɔ kpaga. Haali guŋ n ɛɛwɛ gba, ka u baaŋ haa waa sɔɔnɛɛ. U haa lalli u noniire ú kpu baa.

ref: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.
text: U lalli tuutaa di ra yir hɛssi la n du bɔɔnɛɛ nɛra. Gunla nɛra n ɔɔ fooli di ra yir nuuzihina la, gunnɛ u fooli di yir banla n du a hɛri tuna bá ba. Baabuu hahzee ra ba la.

ref: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.
text: Ba hobee ra di nɛnnɛ, ba ɛɛ ba hozi tai sirya. Ba zagra naafiraa ge du kpeg lugɔ bia, ba laal torkozi anna tɛrgi la ge naazi ra birgi manamanaŋ alugɔ vem.

ref: They roar and growl like fierce young lions as they grab their victims and drag them off where no one can rescue them.
text: Ba danna kɔɔ alugɔ bunyiŋ, di kaa ra uuhri alugɔ bunyimpɔla. Ba daŋ lauri nɛra kaali, ka nɛr maa wàá wer foozi baa lii ba be.

ref: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, a laallɔɔra danna kɔɔ werge maa alugɔ muuzeŋ n ɔɔ izi di ra kɔɔ la. Di nɛr binni a hɛri, u daŋ na bɔbiri ni biinichɔg, baama ge daŋ tɔ bɔchaaŋ ni, ú biri.

ref: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord. He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.
text: Bina la Koori Uzzia n siuwɛ la, mìŋ́ Aizaaya faa na Kɔraawiizii lugɔ deeza biini, di u sogo u koorikara la n la chiŋ di dɔɔ girme werge, tagtazeŋ un laalɛɛ faa tɔ u Dia biini maa.

ref: Flaming creatures with six wings each were flying over him. They covered their faces with two of their wings and their bodies with two more. They used the other two wings for flying,
text: Kuna aŋhina banna yir sɛrafzi faa guali u ni. Bɛl maa faa dɔɔ keeri anumbɛl, di ɔɔ kpa anɛɛ tɔ u siwee di kaa kpa anɛɛ ge tɔ u naazi, ka kpa anɛɛ ge di ra zaah.

ref: as they shouted, “Holy, holy, holy, Lord All-Powerful! The earth is filled with your glory.”
text: A maa faa ŋɔ ra tɛɛ dɔŋa, “Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ, u girme su hɛri maa.”

ref: As they shouted, the doorposts of the temple shook, and the temple was filled with smoke.
text: A loobee gil Kɔraawiizi Dia la zigli, nyɔɔzi faa su u biini maa.

ref: Then I cried out, “I'm doomed! Everything I say is sinful, and so are the words of everyone around me. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.”
text: Denii n lɔ wile, di ŋɔ, “Wiarɛ huuziŋ! N wia chɔkkɔɔ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛ nɛr la n waa zum winanaa ŋɔirɛ, di kaa du nɛra la nuuzi n waa winanaa ra ŋɔ ge be. N siwii na Koorizeŋ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu.”

ref: One of the flaming creatures flew over to me with a burning coal that it had taken from the altar with a pair of metal tongs.
text: Denii a sɛrafzi la bɛl faa zaah di ba n be, di kpogli niŋhɔl uŋ kpa nyɔga lizi mbusu lizibɔr la.

ref: It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, “This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.”
text: Denii u kpau di gbɔgzi n nuuhɔna, ka ŋɔ, “Na, niŋhɔl naa gbɔgzi i nuuhɔnaa, awia, Kɔraawiizi baaŋ lii i ninɛɛ, u gil i wichɔgaa tɛi.”

ref: After this, I heard the Lord ask, “Is there anyone I can send? Will someone speak for us?” “I'll go,” I answered. “Send me!”
text: Denii n nuu Kɔraawiizi n na pɛɛzi, “Anɛɛ n humɛi? Anɛɛ n niŋ lɛɛ yaa naazi lanɛi?” Denii n ŋɔ, “Minuu keŋ. Humiŋ!”

ref: Then the Lord told me to go and speak this message to the people: “You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.” The Lord also said,
text: U ŋɔ, “La ga ŋɔ wia naa nɛra naa be, ‘Ba daŋ ŋɔ wia á zuu ii digna, ka ii wàá wer zum a zɛɛ. Ii daŋ aah siwii ii na a wia ŋmɛnɛɛ, ka ii wàá wer zum a zɛɛ.’

ref: “Make these people stubborn! Make them stop up their ears, cover their eyes, and fail to understand. Don't let them turn to me and be healed.”
text: Gil nɛra naa dɔɔ dignikpega werge, di gil ba digna taŋzi, di kaa tɔɔgi ba siwee ge. Di guŋ lɛi ba siwee daŋ vii na, bá digna ge nuu, bá bampiree bir, bá zum a zɛɛ di ra hiŋiŋ ń chaa baa.”

ref: Then I asked the Lord, “How long will this last?” The Lord answered: Until their towns are destroyed and their houses are deserted, until their fields are empty,
text: Denii n ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ a birgi magɛi?” U ŋɔ, “See bolzenaa la maa n purgee chɔɔ, nɛr maa wàá ka du a biine, a diini maa birgi diiwooni, a kooni maa chɔgi ta,

ref: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.
text: guŋŋ ń wa duŋŋi nɛr maa kaali bɔɔnɛɛ, ka Izrɛl hɛri birgi diŋgela.

ref: If only a tenth of the people are left, even they will be destroyed. But just as stumps remain after trees have been cut down, some of my chosen ones will be left.
text: Haali di a nɛra bɔra fi bɔkpaŋ ka a hɛri biini gba, ka ba daŋ wa fɔɔ baa di kaa kuari chɔg a hɛri jaa. Ka n nɛra Izrɛl hina daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ daazeŋ baŋ teŋŋe ka ka u zɛɛtirii, a zɛɛtirii naa du hɛri di kaa wa fur.” A zɛɛtirii chigɔɔ tɛɛ n nɛra dufalii wia.

ref: When news reached the royal palace that Syria had joined forces with Israel, King Ahaz and everyone in Judah were so terrified that they shook like trees in a windstorm.
text: Baŋ wa ŋɔ Juda Koori Ahaz be lugɔ Siiria ni Ɛfram hina ɛɛ nuukpannɛ bá wa lɔ baa laal, ɔnsii faa lau Koori Ahaz ni u nɛra werge, ba bɔra ra sa alugɔ pezeŋ n ɔɔ ra ta kɔr daazi ni a ra ziigi gunla.

ref: Then the Lord said to me: Take your son Shearjashub and go see King Ahaz. You will find him on the road near the cloth makers' shops at the end of the canal that brings water from the upper pool.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Aizaaya be, “Í ni i biibaal Sɛɛr Jasub lii di ga chem Koori Ahaz ni. Ií daŋ ga huuzuu bɔr la baŋ peree, nii ga de di gaa zuu Chiŋ Pol la, denii du ŋmɛnɛɛ la n chɔɔwɛ di ra la Wɛjɛ Suahra Bɔr la.

ref: Tell Ahaz to stop worrying. There's no need for him to be afraid of King Rezin and King Pekah. They are very angry, but they are nothing more than a dying fire. Ahaz doesn't need to fear
text: Kaluu lugɔ ú ra du tau, di lau u hiŋ di gilɛɛ gil u banchule ra lɔ. Ú gilɛɛ gil u bɔra huah dikuu Siiria Koori Rɛzin ni Rɛmalia biibaal Koori Pɛka baana n na fuuh wia. Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nindaazi n ɔɔ chɔɔ di ra di tama tama la.

ref: to invade and defeat Judah and Jerusalem and to let the son of Tabeel be king in his place.
text: ‘Ií gil ya ga lɔ Juda hina di kpegli baa, ka bɔnni ba hɛri hiŋ tɛɛ dɔŋa, ka jaa tɔ Tabiil biibaal kora, ú ɛɛ Juda hɛri maa koori.’

ref: I, the Lord, promise that this will never happen.
text: Ama, kenne mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ, ‘Màá gil guŋ ɛɛ,

ref: Damascus is just the capital of Syria, and King Rezin rules only in Damascus. Samaria is just the capital of Israel, and King Pekah rules only in Samaria. But in less than
text: Izrɛl hɛri bolzenne Samaria, bolzeŋ Samaria ge Koori Rɛmalia biibaal Pɛka, waa fɔŋŋa maa dɔɔwɛ. Di ii wan yardɛɛ di chi chigigi, ii wàá wer chi maa.’ ”

ref: Once again the Lord God spoke to King Ahaz. This time he said,
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ Koori Ahaz be,

ref: “Ask me for proof that my promise will come true. Ask for something to happen deep in the world of the dead or high in the heavens above.”
text: “Ŋɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum be lugɔ ń ɛɛ wii bɛl í na, di lalaa bolle gɛɛ chinchinne.”

ref: “No, Lord,” Ahaz answered. “I won't test you!”
text: Ka a koori faa vɛɛ, di ŋɔ, “Màá ɛɛi na.”

ref: Then I said: Listen, every one of you in the royal family of David. You have already tried my patience. Now you are trying God's patience by refusing to ask for proof.
text: Denii Aizaaya ŋɔ, “Koori Deevid diahina, ií ra nuu nɛnnɛ. Di ii ra ɛɛ nɛra guŋŋ ba lɔgɔ wa lii, guŋ waa ia kukkɛɛa? Ií daŋ bir ra nyiŋŋi ii ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la minna hum la ge di naa?

ref: But the Lord will still give you proof. A virgin is pregnant; she will have a son and will name him Immanuel.
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi himmaanii niŋ ɛɛ wii bɛl, di bagli gunla un niŋ ɛɛ. Toloori bɛl, n waa baal zummɛ, daŋ kpogli hia di lul biibaal, bá ra yiruu Imanuɛl.

ref: Even before the boy is old enough to know how to choose between right and wrong, he will eat yogurt and honey, and the countries of the two kings you fear will be destroyed.
text: Mɔɔ ka a saŋa wa hel, koora banɛɛ la iinna ɔm werge maa la hɛssi daŋ birgi diŋgelli.

ref: But the Lord will make more trouble for your people and your kingdom than any of you have known since Israel broke away from Judah. He will even bring the king of Assyria to attack you. The Threat of an Invasion
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil biinichɔg chol ii ni ii hɛri ani ii lulla maa ni, di kaali tɔɔrɔɔ la iin diwee, saŋa la Izrɛl n bargɛɛ lii Juda hɛri be guŋŋ di wa lii zinaa la. U daŋ gil Asiiria koori ba di wa du ia a keŋ tɔɔrɔɔ naa.

ref: When that time comes, the Lord will whistle, and armies will come from Egypt like flies and from Assyria like bees.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ fooli yir Ijip laallɔɔra, bá lii gɔŋa nuuzi bɔɔnɛɛ ba alugɔ nakɛɛhzi, laallɔɔra ge lii Asiiria hɛri ba miiih lugɔ huuhbee.

ref: They will settle everywhere—in the deep valleys and between the rocks, on every thornbush and all over the pastureland.
text: Ba maa daŋ ba wa yaari a hɛri maa. Ba daŋ du faalime ni bizenaa bɔɔni maa, di du sɔɔhri bɔra ni gɔŋa maa biine.

ref: The Lord will pay the king of Assyria to bring a razor from across the Euphrates River and shave your head and every hair on your body, including your beard.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil Asiiria koori ɛɛ lugɔ u fuŋ, di lii Muu Yufretis baŋgia di wa fuŋ ii nyuuni, ii naagballi huna ani ii taŋhuna maa.

ref: Anyone who is able to save only one young cow and two sheep,
text: A hɔl hiŋ, napɔl ni buuna anɛɛ bɛnnɛ baal wer dɛɛzi.

ref: will have enough milk to make yogurt. In fact, everyone left in the land will eat yogurt and honey.
text: Nail n niŋ du de werge wia, naillɛ niŋ ɛɛ ba diwee. Banla maa n ka a hɛri la, huuhnuu ni nailsiwaarɛ bá ra di.

ref: You will go there to hunt with your bow and arrows, because the whole country will be covered with thornbushes.
text: Nɛra daŋ ɔɔ kpa ba hozi ni hobee di gaa kpaani de, dikuu choŋgolaa ni sɔɔhri n niŋ tɔ a hɛri maa wia.

ref: The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.
text: Nɛr maa wàá ka la a giŋgimii kɛraa la baŋ faa ra par la, dikuu de maa n niŋ birgi choŋgolaa ni sɔɔhri bɔr wia. Nauna, peeza ani buunaa niŋ jaa ra di koorii de.”

ref: The Lord said, “Isaiah, get something to write on. Then write in big clear letters the name, MAHER-SHALAL-HASH-BAZ.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi faa kaa ŋɔ mìŋ́ Aizaaya be, “Kpa hɔŋ sɛbi sɔŋ naa dau u ni. Waabuu, Maha Salal Has Baz.

ref: I will tell Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah to serve as witnesses to this.”
text: N daŋ yir Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Yuria ni Zɛkaria biibaal Jɛbɛrɛkia la n ɛɛ wibii hina, bá di wia la hin niŋ sɛbi la daansɛɛ.”

ref: Sometime later, my wife and I had a son, and the Lord said, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.
text: Too, denii n ni n haaŋ chɔɔ, u kpogli hia lul biibaal. Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Dau u sɔŋ Maha Salal Has Baz.

ref: Because before he can say ‘Mommy’ or ‘Daddy,’ the king of Assyria will attack and take everything of value from Damascus and Samaria.”
text: Mɔɔ ka a bie zum u maa ni u mɛɛ yiraa, Asiiria koorizeŋ daŋ wa fɔɔ Damaskus ni bolzeŋ Samaria, di paagi ba kundɔɔlaa maa kaali.”

ref: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be,

ref: These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah.
text: “Dikuu nɛra naa n vɛɛ Silowa nii n na pal bɔɔiih, ka gil ba bɔra ra sa Koora Rɛzin ni Pɛka wia,

ref: Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks.
text: N daŋ gil Asiiria koorizeŋ ni u laallɔɔra wa fɔɔ baa, di tɔ ba ni gunla Muu Yufretis nii n ɔɔ su werge, di tɔ kuna ni la.

ref: Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck. But God is with us. He will spread his wings and protect our land.
text: A koori ni u laallɔɔra daŋ ba wa gbaari Juda hɛri maa alugɔ nii n suwee, haali di wa hel ba baŋaazi. U yaa u keerii tɔ yaa hɛri ni. Ee, Immanuɛl!”

ref: Get together and make plans, but you will fail because God is with us.
text: Ií ta jinaa di lau wii bɛl, ka u daŋ wa chɔgi, ii wilaulii wàá wer chi, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi du yaa benii. Ií ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi

ref: The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said: I'm warning you! Don't act like these people.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n benii ni u banonii, di ra karfiŋ lugɔ ń gilɛɛ ra hiŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ la nɛra naa na hiŋ la. U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ,

ref: Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are.
text: “Gilɛɛ ra jaa banla n ɔɔ suahzi di ra ta jinachɔgaa ni. Gilɛɛ waa ɔm wia la banna ɔm, gilɛɛ waa ɔmaa werge.

ref: I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful!
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la bɛnnɛ í ra yir naniinanii, u bɛnnɛ í ra ɔm werge,

ref: My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers.
text: N hiŋra, ií gil n amaniyezi ni n gbɔg du ii be nɛnnɛ.

ref: Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord, even though he is no longer pleased with Israel.
text: N daŋ kpaŋ Kɔraawiizi la n bir u har kpu Izrɛl hina la. N daŋ yarduu.

ref: My children and I are warning signs to Israel from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion.
text: N ni n biizi la Kɔraawiizi n tɛŋ labuu keŋ. Yaa ɛɛ nɛra la n ɛɛ daansɛɛ kunaa Izrɛl hɛri di lii Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la be. Waabuu du Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu la.

ref: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
text: Di nɛra wa ŋɔ ií la ga pɛɛzi vugra ni ijɔzi la n na munni wia, a waa dɛkkɛ nɛra n na pɛɛzi Kɔraawiizi la banna humaa? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii gaa pɛɛzi lalaa nyinee wiai?

ref: what it should do.” None of those who talk like that will live to see the light of day!
text: Ií gilɛɛ ra nuu gunla banna ŋɔ, dikuubɛɛwiai, wibii waa hoo a biine. Ka ií ra nuu gunla Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlaa n na bagli ia.

ref: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven
text: Ba daŋ kpa biinichɔg werge ni lɔzi di ra bar a hɛri biini. Di lɔchɔgii waa kpu baa, ba baana danna fuuh werge maa, ba ra see ba koori ni Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la nua.

ref: But those who have suffered will no longer be in pain. The territories of Zebulun and Naphtali in Galilee were once hated. But this land of the Gentiles across the Jordan River and along the Mediterranean Sea will be greatly respected. War Is Over
text: Ama, biinichɔg werge wàá du de tɛɛ banla biine n chɔkkɛ la di hanna la. Akai. Kɔraawiizi faa gillɔɔ Zɛbulɔn ni Naftali hɛssi hina siwii sɔɔni, ka ŋmɛnɛbɛl, u daŋ tɔgzi Galilii hina la n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, di du muuzeŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ di hiini Jɔɔdan muu la.

ref: Those who walked in the dark have seen a bright light. And it shines upon everyone who lives in the land of darkest shadows.
text: Nɛra la n na vol bɔbiri, jaa na ninzeŋ bɛllɛ unna chaani. Siurɛ faa tɔ baa bɔbiri la, ka bɔchaaŋ ge jaa bau waa chaani ba ni.

ref: Our Lord, you have made your nation stronger. Because of you, its people are glad and celebrate like workers at harvest time or like soldiers dividing up what they have taken.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i gillɔɔ a hɛri nɛra wazi, di kaa jaa baa bɔsɔna, gunla nɛra n ɔɔ ra kum ba kuna, ba bɔra sɔɔni baa la. Ba danna chaasi ni bɔsɔna gunla laallɔɔra n ɔɔ kpegli ba dɔma di paagi ba kuna di ra bɔnni ka ra ɛɛ la.

ref: You have broken the power of those who abused and enslaved your people. You have rescued them just as you saved your people from Midian.
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi chaahzi ŋmɛnni la n vɔɔzi u nɛra ni bulaali la baŋ kpawɛɛ di ra viiri baa labuu, gunla uŋ faa kpegli Midian hɛri laallɔɔra, di kuugi ba nɛsunnaa daŋkpala la.

ref: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire. A Child Has Been Born
text: Laallɔɔri maa gauhure la uŋ kpawɛɛ lɔ laal ni tagtazi la maa chal n fɔgaa maanii bá fuuh.

ref: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.
text: Ba lul biere tɛɛ yaa, biibaallɛ ba lul tɛɛ yaa, waabuu ninna binni a nɛra maa ni. Ba danna yiruu, Liize Biraa Hiŋ, N Waa Dɔŋ Dɔɔwɛ, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, Mɛɛ La N Du De Saŋa Maa, Bampirsɔna Kooribie.

ref: His power will never end; peace will last forever. He will rule David's kingdom and make it grow strong. He will always rule with honesty and justice. The Lord All-Powerful will make certain that all of this is done. God Will Punish Israel
text: U kora daŋ ɔɔ yaa di ra jaa bampirsɔna du de, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. U daŋ so Koori Deevid koorikara ni, di ra di kora, u kora diiribɔr ni, di gil u chi nɛnnɛ, dikuu wibii ni wideŋlaa wia di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu niŋ aah siwii, guŋ ɛɛ. Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɛr Izrɛl hina digna

ref: The Lord had warned the people of Israel,
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wia la n niŋ wa huuzi Izrɛl hinaa.

ref: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
text: Izrɛl hina maa, banla n du bolzeŋ Samaria, daŋ zum lugɔ waabuu ɛɛ guŋ. Ba ra jigsi di ra ta barabara, di ra ŋɔ,

ref: “Houses of brick and sycamore have fallen to the ground, but we will build houses with stones and cedar.”
text: “Yaa birkissi diini maanii purgee, ka yaa daŋ sɛɛhzi bia di bir maa, ba teŋri fig daazi la maanii, ka yaa daŋ chɔɔzi hɛriŋkpola du a bɔɔ.”

ref: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
text: Siiria hina n lii wiifurii ni Filisti hina n lii wiicholii, ɛɛ siryaa bá kpu Izrɛl hina maa nyaamm. Haali guŋ gba n niŋ ɛɛ la, ka Kɔraawiizi baaŋ haa wàá sɔɔni. U haa lalli u noniire ú tɔɔri baa.

ref: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
text: Ka a nɛra waa bittɛ ba unla n tɔɔri baa la be, gɛɛ di nyiŋŋi Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la bɔr.

ref: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
text: Dikuu guŋ wia, hɔpizi kpannɛ Kɔ́raawiizi tɛr Izrɛl hina sitɔɔra ni u nɛra maa digna. U daŋ teŋri ba nyuuni ni ba diŋre.

ref: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
text: Izrɛl hina nabɔnzi ni ba nɛtɔgaa ɛɛ a nyuu, dɔgtɛɛzi la ge n kpa kara di ra bagli nɛra la ge ɛɛ a diŋ.

ref: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.
text: Ba sitɔɔra la gillɔɔ ba leu, banla ge banna bagli la bugmi.

ref: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
text: Guŋ wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi bɔra waa sɔɔnɛɛ a biipɔllaa wia gɛɛ ú na lalbiizi ni luhaana sinyɛna. Dikuubɛɛwiai, ba maanii ɛɛ biinikpola ni sɔsɔgɔ hina, ba waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ. Awia, u baaŋ haa waa sɔɔnɛɛ ba wia, u haa lalli u noniire ú tɔɔri baa.

ref: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
text: Dikuu Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ baaŋ wia, a hɛri daŋ fuuh, a nɛraa niŋ ɛɛ a nindaazi, nɛr maa wàá gil u lulli.

ref: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
text: Ba daŋ ɔɔ di diwee ba nodig keŋkere, ka ba wàá piŋ, di kaa di ba nomɛɛl keŋkere ge, ka lɔzi haa ra kpu baa. Bɛl maa daŋ ɔɔ hee u himmaa bie ol.

ref: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
text: Manasɛ dee daŋ lɔ Ɛfram dee, ba ge dee la bir lɔ Manasɛ dee la. A tuna, ba maa daŋ chaali lɔ Juda dee la. Haali guŋ gba n niŋ wa ɛɛ la, ka Kɔraawiizi baaŋ la haa wàá sɔɔni, u nonii haa lallɔɔrɛ, ú tɔɔri baa.

ref: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
text: Wia daŋ huuzi nɛra la n na du gbɔgni la n waa deŋlee, ni banla n na dau nɛsunnaa widaulaa,

ref: that let you cheat the poor and needy and rob widows and orphans.
text: bá kpolli nyaara wibii, di kpolli n nɛra la banna sunni la wibii, di ra foozi luhaana kundiwee, di ra ŋmɛɛ lalbiizi kuna!

ref: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
text: Ɛrɛɛ ii ɛɛ a hɔl la min niŋ tɔɔri ia, di hɛhchɔg wa lii bɔɔnɛɛ banɛi? Anɛɛ benii ii chɔ la ú ga hiini iai? Lee ii kpa ii daama dawɛi?

ref: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet! The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
text: Wiimaa wàá ka du de di nɛra la baŋ la laurɛɛ biini tognaa ni biinichɔg gɛɛ di chogli chɔɔ lalaa biini bɛŋ lɛi. Ka Kɔraawiizi baaŋ haa waa sɔɔni, u haa lalli u noniire, ú tɔɔri ia. Asiiria hina seriya dii wia

ref: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Wia daŋ huuzi Asiiria hina la n ɛɛ n baaŋfuuih daŋkpala, ba noniire n baaŋfuuihchɔgii gulii du!

ref: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
text: N hum Asiiria hinaa bá ga lɔ nɛra la n wan zummɛ laal, n hum baabuu bá ga lɔ nɛra la n gillɛ n baaŋ fuuh la laal. Ba daŋ ga paagi ba daama kuna maa, ka fɛrgi baa dau alugɔ ŋmɛnizenaa kpɛchɛgaa.

ref: He has even bigger plans in mind, because he wants to destroy many nations.
text: Ama, keŋ lɛi Asiiria koorizeŋ ra fɛ, keŋ lɛi du u nyuu, u horuu lugɔ ú chɔgi nɛra di gil hɛrkpila hina maa tuŋ.

ref: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
text: U ra ta barabara, di ŋɔ, ‘N laallɔɔra nabɔnzi maa lɛi kooraa?

ref: They have already captured the cities of Calno, Carchemish, Hamath, Arpad, Samaria, and Damascus.
text: N kpegli bolzenaa Kalnɔ ni Kakɛmis, Hamaf ni Aapad, bolzeŋ Samaria ani Damaskusii.

ref: The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.
text: Màá dau Jɛrusalɛm hina ni ba vuga gunla miŋ faa dau bolzeŋ Samaria hina ni ba vuga laa?’ ”

ref: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
text: Di Kɔraawiizi wa tuŋ u huma la maa un niŋ ɛɛ Bizeŋ Ziɔn ni Jɛrusalɛm, u daŋ jaa ŋɔ, “N daŋ tɛr Asiiria koorizeŋ la digni, dikuu u jigsi, u barabara ani u sikpegii wia.”

ref: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
text: U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N himmaa fɔŋŋaa gillɛ n ɛɛ keŋ ani n nunzuma miŋ dɔɔwɛ ni n wia zɛɛ zumaa wia. N lizi hɛssi magbɔɔnii, n paagi ba kunaa lii ba daamaa kuna dauribɔra, n kpegli ba kooraa lugɔ laallɔkpeg.

ref: I have conquered the whole world! And it was easier than taking eggs from an unguarded nest. No one even flapped a wing or made a peep.
text: Durnya hɛssi hina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ zumbee daŋ, n paagi ba daama maa alugɔ miŋ paagi hala. Bɛl maa waa keeri lɔwɛɛ ɔnziŋ gɛɛ di haa nua wii!”

ref: King of Assyria, can an ax or a saw overpower the one who uses it? Can a wooden pole lift whoever holds it?
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Siah daŋ wer ŋɔ lugɔ u fɔŋŋaa kaali u dɔɔria? Kizee daŋ wer dɔɔ fɔŋŋa di ra mɔnni kuna u hiŋ nii? Virma waa ɔɔ lalli u hiŋ, nɛttɛ ɔɔ lalluu.”

ref: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
text: Awia, ií jaa ra nuu filaŋkeŋ! Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la daŋ kpa wiila ta Asiiria koorizeŋ laallɔkpega ni, bá gɛrgi gunla niŋ n ɔɔ ra fuuh kuna la.

ref: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
text: Izrɛl hina Bɔchaaŋ Hiŋ la daŋ birgi niŋ, ba Dɔɔrinaniinanii la birgi ninlau. U daŋ fuuh u sɔɔhri ni u choŋgolaa hɔpizikpaŋ, nyaamm.

ref: The Lord will make your beautiful forests and fertile fields slowly rot.
text: U kɔrni daazi la n wesse ani u hɛrsuma la maanii ú chɔgi lugɔ wiila n ɔɔ lau nɛr di chɔguu la.

ref: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
text: U kɔrni daazi la ge n niŋ ka la wàá ka du kpil. Awia, bichala gba daŋ wer kuraa. Izrɛl hina la n kawɛɛ wia

ref: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Izrɛl hina la n niŋ ka wàá ka dɛlli Asiiria hina la n faa ra nyiŋŋi bá chɔgi baa la ni. Ba daŋ jaa yardi Kɔraawiizi bɛŋ ni wibii, waabuu ba Dɔɔrinaniinanii la.

ref: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
text: Haali Izrɛl hina n kpillɛ werge alugɔ muunua hɛɛhriichaa la, ka ba tama bɛnnɛ niŋ ka, di bir ba. N daŋ chɔgi n nɛra, ba dɛg gunnɛ.

ref: The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.
text: Ɛɛh, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la daŋ chɔgi a hɛri maa gunla uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la.

ref: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ, “Ee, n nɛra la n du Bolzeŋ Ziɔn, ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm Asiiria hina, haali banna sunni ia gunla Ijip hina n faa ɛɛ ia la gba.

ref: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
text: N baaŋ la n na fuuh ii ni la daŋ sɔɔni manaŋ, ka ú jaa bir di ra fuuh Asiiria hina ni werge, ń chɔgi baa.”

ref: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la daŋ viiri baa ni u virma, gunla uŋ faa kpu Midian hina bizeŋ Ɔrɛb la. U daŋ lalli u daŋkpala guali niiri ni, gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ Ijip la.

ref: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, u daŋ lizi a tɔɔrɔɔ la baŋ faa ra tɔɔri ia la lii ii be. U daŋ lalli ba buntɔga la lii ii baŋaazi, ba bunni hiŋ daŋ wa chɔgi dikuu iiŋ vuhwɛɛ werge wia.

ref: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
text: Ií na, Asiiria laallɔɔrakpila la ra bau! Ba zuu Ayafuu, ba ga Migrɔn biinii, ba dau ba bunnii Mikmas.

ref: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
text: Ba ra gi gɔŋ, ka ra ŋɔ, “Yaa daŋ chɔɔ Gɛba saŋkara ni.” Rama hina jaa ra ɔm, Sɔɔl bol Gibia hina ge ra chɔ.

ref: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
text: Galim hina biihaana, ií ra wii! Layisa hina, ií ra nuu! Anatɔf hina wia dɔɔ sinyɛnaa!

ref: No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim.
text: Madmɛna hina ra chɔu siaahmu maa. Gɛbim hina, ií ra fɔɔ ii nyuuni!

ref: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
text: Zinaa, ba daŋ wa chi Nɔb, ba daŋ zigli ba nogurme di ra du Bizeŋ Ziɔn ni, Jɛrusalɛm giŋgimii ni.

ref: But the Lord All-Powerful will use his fearsome might to bring down the tallest trees and chop off every branch.
text: Ií na! Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la daŋ kpa u fɔŋŋazeŋ di ŋmuuri baa alugɔ baŋ teŋri daazi kela, a ra chogli la! Ba barabara hina ni ba nabɔnzenaa daŋ chol di ŋmaabi.

ref: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
text: Fɔŋŋa Hiŋ la daŋ kpu baa gunla baŋ ɔɔ teŋri kɔr baambaaŋ daazi la. Haali Lɛbanɔn daananaa la chogli!

ref: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
text: Kɔraawiizi Duma daŋ du u ni, Duma la n na bir nɛra laakal, Duma la n na tɛɛ fɔŋŋa, zumaa ani Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa.

ref: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
text: U bɔra daŋ sɔɔni dikuu unna hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nua wia. U ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá binni nɛr gɛɛ kummaa duula ka diu seriya gɛɛ di di kara seriya gɛɛ di nuu ba ŋɔ.

ref: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
text: Ka u daŋ kpa u wideŋlaa di di anuula hina ni nyaara wia, u daŋ kpa u nua wiŋɔzi lugɔ daŋkpala di viiri a hɛri, biinikpola hina siuzi.

ref: Honesty and fairness will be his royal robes.
text: Wideŋlaare niŋ ɛɛ u kurhɔŋ, u wibii ge ɛɛ u kirsɔɔ.

ref: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
text: A guŋ saŋa, munu ni pebii daŋ chɔɔ bɔkpaŋ, amani ge ni buuŋ chɔɔ dɔŋa be. Nabizi ni bunyinzi danna di bɔkpaŋ, ka bichala lɛɛ a maa see á ra hiŋuu.

ref: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
text: Nau ni lɔɔl maa daŋ kpau ra di, a biizi kpau chɔɔ. Haali bunyiŋ ra di kooree alugɔ nabal.

ref: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
text: Bichala la n na gɔŋŋi daŋ ɔɔ dua dugli dundugu bɔɔ, bɛl ge ɔɔ kpa u nonii hau dumkpola chɔɔribɔr.

ref: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
text: Gunnɛ kummaa wàá tɔɔri gɛɛ di chɔgi mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi bizennaniinanii la nyuu. Gunla muuni n suugi niiri la, gunnɛ hɛri naa ge su nɛra la n zum Kɔraawiizi.

ref: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Koorifalii daŋ lii Koori Deevid dee biini, di ɛɛ lugɔ tuuta tɛɛ nɛra ni ba dizi. Hɛssi nɛra daŋ chaali u be, dikuubɛɛwiai, hɛri la un niŋ du di ra heezi la daŋ dɔɔ girme.

ref: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ kaa chaali u nɛra la n kawɛɛ bunɛɛhiŋ. U daŋ gil ba lii Asiiria, Ijip, Patrɔs hɛssi, Itiopia, Ɛlam, Babilɔn, Hamaf ani hɛssi la maa n du muuzeŋ baaŋ la, di bir ba Izrɛl hɛri.

ref: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
text: U daŋ lalli u tuuta chiŋ, di chaali Izrɛl hina la, baŋ laurɛɛ kaali hɛrdumazi la. U daŋ chaali Juda dee la n yaari durnya hɛssi maa la.

ref: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
text: A tuna maa, Izrɛl hina wàá kaa ra zom Juda hina ni, Juda hina ge wàá ka ɛɛ Izrɛl hina dɔma.

ref: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
