text: Ba daŋ hiini dɔŋa lɔ Filisti hina la n du wiicholii la, di hiini dɔŋa paagi wiifurii hina kuna. Ba daŋ kaa hiini dɔŋa lɔ Ɛdɔm ni Moab hɛssi di kpegli baa, Ammɔn hina sɛɛ ba dɔɔra.

ref: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil Ijip muuzeŋ hiihzi, U daŋ lalli u nonii guali Muu Yufretis ni. Pewem ba wa barguu u birgi gɔŋa aniidaanɛɛ, u gii wàá ka du kpol.

ref: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
text: U daŋ kuari ŋmɛnizeŋ tɛɛ u nɛra la n kawɛɛ Asiiria hɛri la, gunla uŋ faa ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ Izrɛl hina, saŋa la baŋ faa lii Ijip hɛri di ra kaali la.

ref: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, i daŋ ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n na chɔliibuu, i baaŋ faa ra fuuh n ninɛɛ, ka filaŋkeŋwaa, u sɔɔnɔɔrɛ, i ra tig n bampirii.

ref: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
text: Wibii maa, hinuu n Lɛɛri. N daŋ yardii, màá kaa ra ɔm. Hinuu n fɔŋŋa, n daŋ yir yira di ra chɔlii. Hinuu n Lɛɛri.”

ref: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.
text: Gunla nɛr n ɔɔ dɔɔ nii lii kɔlɔŋ biini nyɔɔ u bɔra sɔɔni la, gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi nɛra bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔni, di u wa lɛɛ baa.

ref: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, i daŋ ŋɔ, “Ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ. Ií ra yir u sɔŋ. Ií gil durnya hɛssi nɛra maa zum gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ, di ra tɔgzi u sɔŋ.

ref: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
text: Ií yir yira tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dikuu wizenaa la uŋ ɛɛwɛ wia. Ií gil durnya hɛssi nɛra maa zum gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ di ra tɔgzuu.

ref: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
text: Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina, ií chaasi di yir yira ni bɔsɔna, Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la n du ii be la dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa werge maa.”

ref: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
text: Amɔz biibaal Aizaaya faa na Babilɔn wia naabuu lugɔ deeza biini.

ref: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
text: Lalli tuuta giŋgimii la n waa daazi dɔɔwɛ nyuu! Gbooli baa. Kamzi baa bá zuu nɛzenaa dominuuzenaa la.

ref: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u nɛra benii lugɔ u yir u laallɔɔraa bá hum u baaŋfuuhri huma, banla bɔra n ninna pur dikuu uŋ yoo u dɔma kpegli wia.

ref: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.
text: Ií ra nuu kɔɔi bizenaa nyuuni lugɔ nɛkpila! Ií kaa nuu kossi kɔɔi alugɔ hɛssi nɛra n na chaali dɔŋa! Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hinnɛ ra chaali laallɔɔra bá ga yoo laal la.

ref: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
text: Ba lii hɛhjaŋa ni hɛri magazii di ba. Ba ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuihchɔgii dɔŋkunaa, bá wa chɔgi a hɛri maa.

ref: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
text: Ií ra chɛɛhgi, dikuu Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ hɔpizii la n helle, un niŋ chɔg kummaa wia.

ref: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
text: Dikuu guŋ wia, nɛr maa nonee daŋ siu, u bɔra ge huah.

ref: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
text: Ɔnsii werge daŋ nyaŋŋi baa, bá bɔra ra wii, bá biine chɔgi werge, bá ra gbargi lugɔ haaŋ n ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi lulaa di ra ɛɛ la. Ba daŋ binni dɔŋa, bá nuuzi kpu, bá siwee ge aah dikuu ɔnsii wia.

ref: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
text: Ama, ii ra nuu! Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la ra bau. U daŋ ɛɛ hɔpizichɔgii, Kɔraawiizi baaŋ fuuh werge maa, ú chɔgi a hɛri ni wichɔgɛɛra la maa n du de la.

ref: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
text: Chinchiŋwilaa daŋ bir biri, bɔchaaŋ wàá ka du de. Wiizi daŋ fur di biri, baagu ge wàá ka chaani.

ref: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N daŋ tɔɔri durnya hina dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia. Biinikpola hina daŋ na ba wichɔgaa kinturgaa. N daŋ chɔgi banla maa n na jigsi ani banla n waa nɛra ni ra suŋ di gil barabara hina siwee sɔɔni.

ref: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
text: Awia, n daŋ zigli chiŋ, hɛri ge zigli lii u chignibɔr la. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ daŋ bagli n baaŋfuuih, a hɔl hiŋ.

ref: Everyone will run to their homelands, just as hunted deer run, and sheep scatter when they have no shepherd.
text: Hɔɔhra la n du Babilɔn daŋ chɔ kaali ba himmaa hɛssi, di yaari alugɔ kpaaŋ n na nyiŋŋi sejigzi pir a ra chɔ, gɛɛ peeza n waa nɔɔni dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
text: Nɛra la maa ban niŋ lau, ba daŋ chugzi baa kaari, ba daŋ kpa tokobi kpu baa.

ref: They will see their children beaten against rocks, their homes robbed, and their wives abused.
text: Ba daŋ lauri ba bichalli di kpa baa viiri hɛri ba sibɔɔ, ba siuzi, ka zuu ba diini di paagi ba kuna ka punzi ba haana.”

ref: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Ií ra nuu! N daŋ gil Mɛdi hina la yoo Babilɔn hina, ba baga waa hoo saliŋhuŋŋa be, hàá wer kpa saliŋ gba murgi baa.

ref: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
text: A laallɔɔra daŋ taazi biipɔllaa hozi di kpuuzi, ba wàá suŋ biifulli gba ni, ba wàá na bichalli gba sinyɛna.

ref: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
text: Babilɔn kora n wesse kaali kossi maa la, di kaa ɛɛ a Babilɔn hina girme la, ka mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔguu gunla miŋ faa chɔgi Sɔdɔm ni Gɔmɔra la.

ref: No one will live in Babylon. Even nomads won't camp nearby, and shepherds won't let their sheep rest there.
text: Ba ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka ma, Babilɔn maa, nɛr maa wàá ka de maa, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. Lɔrbizi wàá ka chɔɔ de, penɔɔna wàá ka nɔɔni ba peeza la de a ga heezi.

ref: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
text: Ka hɛribɔduma selaa niŋ du de, di wa su a diŋgela hiŋ. Hohobiazi danna zuu de, de birgi kukuballi zuuribɔr, haali sejigzi gba du de di zaahzi ra bar.

ref: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!
text: Munuzi daŋ ɔɔ du a koŋlii kɛraa di ra wii, hohobiazi ge du ba kooridiini biine la, baŋ faa ra di suma. U saŋa helloo, a wàá ka birgi.”

ref: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
text: Ama, Kɔraawiizi daŋ suŋ Izrɛl dee la ni, u daŋ kaa lizi baa bá ɛɛ u himmaa nɛra, di gil ba bir ba wa so ba himmaa hɛri la. Nɛra daŋ lii hɛrdumazi wa jaa ba ni.

ref: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
text: Hɛssi hina daŋ hiini Izrɛl hina ba bir ba ba himmaa hɛri. Nɛra la ge n niŋ wa so ba be la daŋ birgi ba balaa di ra hum baa lii hɛri la Kɔraawiizi n kpawɛɛ tɛɛ baa la. Banla n faa lauri Izrɛl hina birgi ba yoma la daŋ bir birgi Izrɛl hina yoma, ka Izrɛl hina jaa dɔɔ banla n faa ra fir baa werge la maa fɔŋŋa.

ref: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.
text: A hɔl la Kɔraawiizi n niŋ lizi u nɛra lii tɔɔrɔɔ, biinichɔg ani sunnaa biini, ka jaa tɛɛ baa heezaa la,

ref: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
text: di u wa ɛɛ guŋ, ba daŋ jaa ra ɛɛ Babilɔn koori la chɛɛtɛ, di ra ŋɔ, “Ií na nɛr la n faa ra sunni yaa la wia n chɔkkɛ! Gunla u baaŋfuuih la maa n bir pɛɛ.

ref: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
text: Kɔraawiizi chɔgi biinikpola hina fɔŋŋaa, ba kora dii tuŋ.

ref: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
text: Ka filaŋkeŋwaa, a hɛssi hina jaa heezuu, bampirsɔna du de, ba maa ra yir yira.

ref: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
text: Haali Lɛbanɔn daananaa ni hɛriŋkpola danna jigsi di ra ŋɔ, ‘Hiŋ cholle filaŋkennaa, nɛr maa wàá ka ba di waa teŋri yaa.’

ref: The world of the dead eagerly waits for you. With great excitement, the spirits of ancient rulers hear about your coming.
text: Lalaa maa daŋ ɛɛ sirya di ra kpaŋ i balaa. Ba daŋ izi jaamii. Banla maa n faa ɛɛ sitɔɔra durnya hɛssi biini, ni banla maa n faa ɛɛ hɛssi koora, ba maanii niŋ izi jaamii.

ref: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
text: Ba maa daŋ kpau ni loobikpaŋ di ŋɔ, ‘Filaŋkeŋwaa, yaa ni i maa gɛrga ɛɛ kpannɛ, i jaa ɛɛu lugɔ yaa.’

ref: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
text: Baŋ hugii la, i kora ni i fɔŋŋa la maa tunnɔɔ. Janjalanzi la baŋ faa ra lɔ i see la maa tunnɔɔ. Filaŋkeŋwaa, sandulee jaa birgi i kunchɔɔrikuŋ, di birgi i wɛjɛ.

ref: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
text: Ee, Babilɔn koori, chɔɔzimpikke chinchiŋwilii! Na gunla hiŋ chol hɛri! Hinla n faa wette kpegli durnya hɛssi nɛra la, hinuu ba kpa ha hɛri la.

ref: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
text: I ŋɔwɔɔrɛ i biini, ‘N daŋ tinni la chiŋ di ga bɛri Kɔraawiizi chinchiŋwilaa la ni, di ga di n kora de. N daŋ so n koorikara ni, vuga chaalibɔr giŋgimii nyuu.

ref: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.”
text: N daŋ tinni ga bɛri a baamazi nyubaaŋ, di birgi lugɔ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la.’

ref: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
text: Ka ba biriibuu i tuu la lalaa bol, bɔluŋ.

ref: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
text: Lalaa n niŋ nai danna fiilii. Ba ra fɛ nfɛssi ba biine ka ra pɛɛzi dɔŋa, ‘Baal naa lɛi faa ra koozi hɛri ni durnya kossi, nɛra bɔra ra sa laa?

ref: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
text: A baal naa lɛi chɔgi durnya di gil u maa birgi hɛribɔduma laa? A koori naa lɛi purgi durnya bolzenaa, waa sɛɛwɛ ú pilli u yoma ge ha, bá la ba bola laa?’

ref: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.
text: A hɛssi koora maa chɔɔgi ŋmama biinee ni girme, bɛl maa dɔɔ u ŋmam.

ref: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
text: Ka ba waa hiŋwaa hukke, ka lizii di ta alugɔ kelchuma baŋ teŋŋe ta. Ba kpau i ni banla maa baŋ kpuwɛɛ ni tokobi laal biini, di ga ta bɔɔzeŋ bɛl bia n du u biini, i chɔɔ ba maa zɛɛ, alugɔ lalii la banna fɛrgi ni naazi.

ref: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
text: Ba wàá hugii koora hugribɔra, dikuubɛɛwiai, i chɔgi i hɛrii di kpuuzi i nɛra kpila maa. Ba ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá yir i ni i dee maa sɔnnanii.

ref: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
text: Ií ɛɛ sirya kpu u biibaala, dikuu ba naabaala wichɔgaa wia, bá gilɛɛ wazi di dɔɔ a hɛri di ma bolzenaa su u maa.”

ref: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ, “N daŋ izi yoo Babilɔn hina, di gil ba sɔŋ dinzi. N daŋ kpu ba biizi ni ba naanna. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals. Assyria Will Be Punished
text: N daŋ gil Babilɔn hɛri birgi kikiuzi duuribɔr, di gil ú birgi sɔɔhri ni kpɛchɛgaa bɔr. N daŋ gil kummaa wàá ka du de alugɔ baŋ chaazuu. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hinnɛ ŋɔ guŋ!” Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpu Asiiria hina

ref: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu hɛɛhzɛɛ, di ŋɔ, “Wibii maa, gunla miŋ ta jina la, guŋ himmaanii niŋ wa ɛɛ, gunla miŋ dauwɛ, gunnɛ niŋ ɛɛ.

ref: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
text: N daŋ kpu Asiiria hina la n du n hɛri la, di fɛrgi baa ni naazi n bizenaa la nyuuni. N daŋ lɛɛ baa lii Asiiria hina fɔŋŋa biini, di lɛɛ baa lii ba sunnaa biini.

ref: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
text: Kenne n dau di ra nyiŋŋi ń ɛɛ durnya maa.” N tɛr n noniire ń du durnya hɛssi nɛra maa siaahmu.

ref: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have made these plans. No one can stop me now! The Philistines Will Be Punished
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu dau guŋ. Anɛɛ n niŋ wer teŋ guŋ ŋmɛnɛɛi? Di u wa tɛr u nonii, anɛɛ n niŋ wer lawuuwɛi? Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpu Filisti hina

ref: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
text: Amaniye la miŋ faa nuuwɛ lii Kɔraawiizi be, bina la Koori Ahaz n siuwɛ labuu keŋ,

ref: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
text: Filisti hina maa, ii gilɛɛ gil ii bɔra sɔɔni ia werge, ii dɔma fɔŋŋa n tunnɛ wia. Haali guŋ n ɛɛwɛ la gba, ka biinichɔg daŋ ba kaali anla, di chum lugɔ duŋkpola.

ref: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
text: N daŋ tɛɛ nyaara diwee bá di, banla ge n ɛɛ anuula hina la daŋ chɔɔ ni bɔsɔna. Ka iawaa, lɔchɔgii daŋ chol ii ni, di kpu ii banla n niŋ ka la maa.

ref: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.
text: Filisti bolzenaa hina, ií ra chɛɛhgi! Ií gil ɔnsii werge lau ia! Laallɔɔrakpila werge lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakagrɛ di ra ba, nyɔɔ tɔ kuull, bɛl maa ɛɛ laal lɔi siryaa, ɔnsiiri waa hoo ba biini.

ref: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
text: Ɛrɛɛ ya ŋɔ banla Filisti hina n hummɛ bá wa pɛɛzi Jɛrusalɛm wia benei? Ií ŋɔ ba be lugɔ Kɔraawiizii ma Jɛrusalɛm, ú nɛra wer du de di na lɛɛi lii ba sunnaa la biini.

ref: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!
text: N faa nuu amaniye naabuu lii Kɔraawiizi be, u ra bagli Moab hɛri wia. Hamuŋkpannɛ ba purgi bolzenaa Aa ni Kir maa burburbur!

ref: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
text: Dibɔn hina tinni la ba vuga dia giŋgimee nyuuni bá ga wii. Moab hina ge chɛɛhgi ra tɛɛ Nɛbɔ ni Mɛdɛba. Ba fuŋ ba nyuuni ni ba taŋhunazi dikuu biinichɔg wia.

ref: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.
text: Ba laali gbɔglɔnzi ŋmɛnizenaa. Ba ra chɛɛhgi salli ni chaali bɔra maa, ba chɔɔgi pi di ra wii.

ref: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear. Pity Moab
text: Bolzenaa Hɛsbɔn ni Ɛlialɛ hina ra chɛɛhgi, haali Jahaz hina gba ra nuu ba chɛɛhgaa! Guŋ wia, Moab laallɔkpega gba ra chɛɛhgi, ba bɔra huah.

ref: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.
text: N biini chɔkkɔɔ werge, dikuu Moab wia! U nɛra maanii chɔwɛɛ kaali Zoa ni Ɛglaf Sɛlisiya. Ba kpa Luhif ŋmɛnɛɛ tinni ra kaali, di wii ra la. Haali banla n kpa Hɔrɔnam ŋmɛnɛɛ, wii di ra nuumi ba chɔgaa wia.

ref: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
text: Nimrim gba niiri maanii hiihzɛɛ, u kooree maa hil. Kunlɛɛ maa waa kaa ka.

ref: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
text: Awia, ba paagi ba daama kuna baŋ faa nyiŋŋee dau, di ga Daajaŋra Gɔmbɔɔluŋe la di gi ra kaali.

ref: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
text: Moab hɛri magbɔɔ maanii a chɛɛhgaa hel, haali di ga hel Ɛglam, ba nuumaa ga hel Bɛɛ Ɛlim.

ref: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
text: Dimɔn niiri maanii birgi chal, ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil ba wia haa nyaŋŋi kaali guŋ. Banla n na chɔ ba lɛɛ bahinaa, ni banla n kawɛɛ Moab hɛri la maanii bá kpu alugɔ bunyiŋ n ɔɔ lau sel ú di la.

ref: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
text: Ií banla n chɔ laal ga du bolzeŋ Sɛla la n du hɛribɔduma biini la, ií lau pepɔla ga tɛɛ Juda hɛri koori n du Jɛrusalɛm.

ref: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.
text: Gunla baŋ ɔɔ duŋŋi zumbizi a lii a daŋa biine di zaah ra bar la, gunnɛ Moab haana du Muu Aanɔn bɔdɛrɛdɛrɛzi di ra nyiŋŋi ba gi.

ref: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
text: Ba ra wiiu di ra ŋɔ Jɛrusalɛm hina be, “Ií hiini yaa, di bagli yaa, ya zum wii la yaa n niŋ lau. Ií gil wibaŋkanchirii ɛɛ lugɔ hamuŋa tɔ yaa ni, di kpa yaa banla n lii yaa hɛri chɔ ba la suah, yaa dɔma gilɛɛ waa na yaa.

ref: Let our people live in your country and find safety here.” Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.
text: Ií gil Moab hina la n chɔwɛɛ du ii be. Ií guu baa lii ba chɔgri la be.” Nɛr la n na sunni nɛra wia daŋ tuŋ, chɔgaa tuŋ, chɔgri leu a hɛri.

ref: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
text: Denii Koori Deevid naana bɛl ɛɛ́ koori. U daŋ kpa nɔŋŋaa ni wibii di ra di a kora. U siwii daŋ aah ni wideŋlaa wia, di gil wibii dii ge du de.

ref: We have heard of Moab's pride. Its people strut and boast, but without reason.
text: Yaa nuu Moab hina karambani, ba jigsaa werge ani ba nɛgbɛllaa wiarɛ. Ka ba ra ta barabara pɛɛ.

ref: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.
text: Awia, Moab hɛri hina maanii ra lɔɔgi wilezi dikuu Moab wia. Ba daŋ wii, di ba wa liizi diunanaa la baŋ faa ra di bolzeŋ Kir Harɛsɛf la wia, guŋ gil ba tamii tuŋ.

ref: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
text: Hɛsbɔn kooni kuna maanii hillɛ, Sibma grepu daazi ge hil. Hɛssi koora ŋmɛnni a grepu daananaa maa chɔgi. A faa chigɔɔ guŋŋ di ga lii Jaza, di talmi ra la hɛribɔduma la n du wiifurii la. A faa ta lunne guŋŋ ga hel Muuzensiwii la n du wiicholii la.

ref: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations
text: Awiarɛ n hiini Jaza hina di ra wii, dikuu Sibma grepu daazi chɔgaa la wia. Ee, Hɛsbɔn! Ee, Ɛlialɛ! N sinii ra paluu ii wia. Ií wàá kaa ra zaahzi di ra chiiri ani bɔsɔna dikuu ii daanɔŋaahma ni ii pattikuna kpai wia.

ref: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
text: Bɔsɔna waa hoo ii kooni huŋhunna be, nɛr maa waa kaa ra yir yira gɛɛ di ra chaasi, ii grepu daazi kooni biine, nɛr maa ge waa kaa ra fɛrgi grepu nɔna, ú lizi siŋ. Bɔsɔna chaasaa la maa tunnɔɔ.

ref: Deep in my heart I hurt for Moab and Kir-Heres.
text: N wiiwoo ra tɛɛ Moab. N biinichɔg min dɔɔwɛ tɛɛ Kir Harɛsɛf kannɔɔ werge.

ref: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
text: Moab hina danna suŋŋi ba vuga, ba vuga kuaribɔra siaahmu ni, ka ba ra kuuh pɛɛ. Ba danna wii di ra dua, ka a wàá wer hiini baa.

ref: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
text: Wii naabuu Kɔraawiizi faa ŋɔ lii Moab wia biini.

ref: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
text: Ka filaŋkeŋ ge, Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Gunla paahdiiri n ɔɔ kur u hɔpizaa a tuŋ la, gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi kur binni ahoro tɛɛ Moab ni u nɛkpila, bá girme tuŋ kɔrai. U nɛra tama bɛnnɛ niŋ ka, banla n kawɛɛ la ge gɛrgi.”

ref: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.
text: Bolzeŋ Damaskus amaniye n lii Kɔraawiizi benii keŋ, “Na! Damaskus wàá ka ɛɛ bolzeŋ. U maa daŋ birgi diŋgela.

ref: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
text: Bolzenaa la n du Aroa hɛri la nɛra maa daŋ chɔ. Bol sela danna di a biine, haali di ɔɔ chɔɔgi de. Nɛr maa wàá gil ɔnsii lawaa.

ref: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
text: Izrɛl bolzeŋkpega daŋ purgi. Damaskus wàá ka dɔɔ u hiŋ. Siiria hina la n kawɛɛ la daŋ di hiihzi alugɔ Izrɛl hɛri hina.” Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “A hɔl hiŋ, Izrɛl hina girme daŋ tuŋ, ba ɛɛ lugɔ nɛvuuhlii n bittɛ kɔgi.

ref: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
text: Ba nɛkpaŋkpaŋa bɛnnɛ niŋ ka gunla baŋ ɔɔ wa tɔrgi ɔlivizi nɔna ka a kpaŋkpaŋa haa sagzi a daazi nyuuni, anɛɛ gɛɛ ahoro bɛŋ sagzi a chiŋ kela ni, anaazu gɛɛ anue ge sagzi a zɛɛ kela ni la.” Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum labuu ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, nɛra daŋ dɛlli ba Taari ni, di bir ba siwee tɛɛ Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la.

ref: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
text: Ba wàá ka dɛlli mbusu lizibɔra la ba himmaa n mawɛɛ ni. Ba ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka yardi ba vughaaŋ Asɛra daazi la ni ba daahɛgsɔɔhsuma fuuhribɔra la ba himmaa n mawɛɛ la.

ref: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, a bolzenaa la n faa kpekke, daŋ birgi kɔrni gunla Izrɛl hina n faa lɔ Hivi ni Amɔri hina laal, ba chɔ ka ka ba bolzenaa, a birgi kɔrni la. A maa daŋ birgi diŋgelli.

ref: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
text: Izrɛl hina, ii suuh ii Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi wiarɛ. U ɛɛ Bizeŋ n guali ii ninɛɛ, ka ii waa u wia liizee. Awia, haali iin niŋ chɔɔzi daananaa ni grepu daananaa la, iiŋ kpawɛɛ lii hɛrdumazi la,

ref: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
text: a hel di fii, chɔɔzi la iiŋ chɔɔzaa la, ka ii wàá na a nɔna tɔrgi ŋmɛnɛ maa. Tɔna la iin niŋ na daŋ ɛɛ tɔɔrɔɔ ni wiila la n waa chaai dɔɔwɛ bɛŋ.

ref: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
text: Ama, nɛra la n na ba kpegzi ni alugɔ niizenaa n na pal gunla, ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ hau ba ni bá bir chɔ alugɔ peu n na kpa zɔga giŋgimee bɔr gɛɛ pekpeg n ɔɔ ra kpa nyɔɔ gunla.

ref: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
text: Duana ni, yaa dɔma ɔɔ giluu, ɔnsii werge chol yaa ni yaa ra fɔŋ, ka di bɔr wa chaanɔɔ, ba ɔɔ chɔu kaali bɔɔnɛɛ. Banla n na tɔɔri yaa di ra paagi yaa kuna la kinturgaare guŋ.

ref: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.
text: Wiarɛ huuzi Itiopia hɛri hina, ba daŋ nuu keeri gbɔga lii hɛri bɛl n du ba hɛri muuni baŋgia,

ref: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
text: n hum balaa ba kpa muugberjigzi la, baŋ kpa kooriikpega kuaraa di ra saa a muuni ni. Ií ra la, balaa la n gbaŋŋɛ! Ií kpa amaniye la nɛra la n jaŋŋɛ, ba bɔra vɔgli be, hɛri la hina n na nyiŋŋi kalu, ba ra mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi, muuni bargi ba hɛri la.

ref: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
text: Durnya nɛra maa, ií ra nuu! Di ba wa lalli ba laal tuuta chiŋ, bizenaa nyuuni, ii daŋ nau. Di ba wa huuh bensunoniina, ii daŋ nuu.

ref: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “N danna du ii tau bɔɔiih di lii n duuribɔr alugɔ wiliŋ n ɔɔ ra lii winyɛgii ni, kɔɔl ge tɔ chɔɔzi ni kuna kumaa saŋa la.”

ref: Before the blossoms can turn into grapes, God will cut off the sprouts and hack off the branches.
text: Mɔɔ ka a kumaa hel, di fii di nɔŋ di waa aah la, a saŋaa n kpa n kizee kɛuri a kelfuttaa la ni anla n taazi nonee di yɛl la ha.

ref: Ethiopians will be food for mountain vultures during the summer and for wild animals during the winter.
text: Gunnɛ ya ɛɛ Itiopia laallɔɔra la maa bá siu, di birgi diwee tɛɛ a bizenaa nyuuni zumbizi ni pir sela. Zumbizi daŋ di a lalaa lumaŋa, pir sela ge kegzi a hoga yuu.

ref: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ daŋ na kunsunzaa lii nɛra la maa n ɛɛ nɛjaŋra, ba bɔra vɔgli, ba wia dɔɔ ɔnsii tɛɛ nɛra bɔr maa, ba ɛɛ kalunyiŋŋe di ra mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi, muuni bargi ba hɛri la be. Ba daŋ kpa ba kunsunzaa di wa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la, Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu, bɔr la banna jaamuu la.

ref: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
text: Kɔraawiizi amaniye bɛllɛ keŋ n faa kaa nuu, u ra bagli Ijip hɛri wia, Ií na! Kɔraawiizi tinni baama n na chɔ wergee di ra ba Ijip. Ɔnsii lau Ijip vugaa, a bɔra ra sa u see, Ijip hina ge maa bɔra huah.

ref: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
text: Ijip hina maa bɔra daŋ huah, bá wilaulaa maa ge ɛɛ pɛɛ. Ba danna pɛɛzi ba vuga ni lalaa, bá zum wii la n na ɛɛ, di ra la vugra ni ijɔzi be, di gaa pɛɛzi bá na wii la n du de.

ref: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
text: N daŋ jaa kpa Ijip hina du koorichɔgii bɛl nonee biini, ú kpa nɛsunnaa di ra binni baa.” Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
text: Muu Naal daŋ hil, u gɔmbɔɔ maa pergi.

ref: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
text: Bɔra la baŋ pergee niiri danna sɔɔhri puihpuihpuih, Ijip gɔŋa niiri daŋ ka tama di hiihzi. A kɛraa kooree maa daŋ siu.

ref: Fields along the Nile will be completely barren; every plant will disappear.
text: A muunua pattikuna maa daŋ siu, peu paa kaali.

ref: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
text: Nɛra la n na suah wɛjɛhuŋŋunanaa wàá ka dɔɔ tamii maa.

ref: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
text: Wɛjɛsuahra maa daŋ sɛu ba nuuzi so, huŋhunna maa ge so ni biinichɔg.

ref: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
text: Zoan nabɔnzi ɛɛ gɛnaarɛ. Ijip koori nunzunna baglaa la ɛɛ gɛnni baglaarɛ. Ɛrɛɛ ii ra ŋɔ Ijip koori be, “N ɛɛ nunzunna la bɛllɛ, di faa ɛɛ faala koora hiŋrɛi?”

ref: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
text: Ijip koori, lee i nunzunna la duɛi? Gil bá baglii gunla Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la n niŋ dau Ijip.

ref: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
text: Zoan nabɔnzi birgi gɛnaarɛ, ba dar Mɛmfis ge nabɔnzii. Baabuu niŋ faa bagli Ijip hina ba chi nɛnnɛ, ka ba gillɔɔ ba leu.

ref: The Lord has confused Egypt; its leaders have made it stagger and vomit like a drunkard.
text: Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ ba siwee ra biri, ba wiŋɔzi gil Ijip hina wiɛɛlaa maa waa deŋlee, ka ra jiŋli alugɔ sinnyɔɔri, n ɔɔ ra hɛhrgi u hɛɛhzaa biini la.

ref: No one in Egypt can do a thing, no matter who they are.
text: Nɛr maa waa hoo Ijip hɛri, di dɔɔnnɛ gɛɛ nyaarii gɛɛ nɛzeŋ gɛɛ nɛduma, ú wer hiini baa.

ref: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Ijip hina daŋ gɛrgi alugɔ haana. Ɔnsii daŋ lau baa, ba bɔra ra sa, dikuu Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la n lalli u banonii, ú tɔɔri baa wia.

ref: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
text: Di ba ŋɔ bá ŋɔ Juda hina wia, guŋ daŋ gil ɔnsii werge lau Ijip hina, dikuu biinichɔg la Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ n dauwɛ, ú chol ba ni wia.

ref: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Ijip bolzenaa anue nɛra danna mɔɔ Izrɛl hina mɔɔri, di sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la dɔɔra. A bolzeŋ bɛl sɔŋ daŋ ɛɛ ‘Wiizi Bol.’

ref: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, ba daŋ ma mbusu lizibɔr Ijip hɛri baambaaŋ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di kaa baŋ bii bɛl a hɛri magbɔɔ tɛu.

ref: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
text: A daŋ ɛɛ kuna la n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la daansɛɛ kuna, Ijip hɛri. Di a nɛra wa wiiwo du Kɔraawiizi lugɔ ú hiini baa, dikuu ba dɔma n na sunni baa wia, u daŋ tɛɛ baa Lɛɛri, ú lɛɛ baa.

ref: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa u hiŋ bagli Ijip hina, bá zumuu. Wibii maa, a hɔl hiŋ, ba daŋ sɛɛ tɛu, di kpa ba mbusu lizaa kuna ni ba mia sunzaazi wa jaamuu, ka kpa tɛu. Ba daŋ ŋɔ nuuzi tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di ra hiŋaa ni wibii.

ref: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa tɔɔrɔɔ ta Ijip hina ni. U daŋ lɔ baa ka bir chaa baa. Ba daŋ bir ba u be, ú nuu ba suŋŋaa di chaa baa.

ref: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, ŋmɛninanii bɛl daŋ lii Ijip hɛri di ra la Asiiria hɛri, Ijip ni Asiiria hina ɔɔ jaa ga de di ra la dɔŋa hɛssi, di kpau ra jaami Kɔraawiizi.

ref: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth,
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Izrɛl, Ijip ani Asiiria hina daŋ dɔɔ nuukpaŋ, durnya hɛssi nɛra maa na hiinaa lii ba be.

ref: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la daŋ kissi baa, di ŋɔ, “Ijip hina, miŋ gillɛ ii ɛɛ n nɛra, Asiiria hina la, miŋ tawɛɛ, Izrɛl hina, miŋ lizi ia tɛɛ n hiŋ.”

ref: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
text: Bina la Asiiria Koorizeŋ Sagɔn, n hum u laallɔɔra nabɔnzeŋ, ú la ga lɔ Filisti hina laal, di kpegli bolzeŋ Asdɔd la,

ref: About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot
text: Kɔraawiizi faa ŋɔ Amɔz biibaal Aizaaya be, “Wir i gbɔglɔŋ laala la, di lizi i gawa ge.” Aizaaya faa ɛɛ gunla Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ u be la, ka faa ra vol chakpal ni naadumazi.

ref: for three years. Then the Lord said: What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi faa ŋɔ, “N balii Aizaaya n vol chakpal ni naadumazi binni ahoro naa, gunna bagli tɔɔrɔɔ la dee min niŋ gil ú wa chol Ijip ni Itiopia hina ninɛɛ.

ref: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
text: Asiiria koorizeŋ daŋ lauri baa, bá birgi u yoma. U daŋ gil Ijip ni Itiopia nabɔnzi, ba biipɔllaa ani suŋgure maa ra vol chakpalli ni naadumazi, ba wàá tɔɔgi ba zɛɛpume tama maa. Guŋ daŋ ɛɛ hiihzi Ijip hina be werge maa.

ref: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.
text: Banla n yardi Ijip ni Itiopia hina, di ra jigsi lugɔ baabuu niŋ wer lɛɛ baa la, ɔnsii daŋ wa lau baa, bá di hiihzi.

ref: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
text: Di a hɔl wa hello, banla n du Filisti muuzeŋ nua la danna ŋɔ, ‘Di wia naa dɔŋa wetto huuzi Ijip hina, beedee ya ge kaa wer ɛɛ di lɛɛ yaa hinaanɛi? Yaa faa dɛlli ba ninɛɛ lugɔ ba hiini yaa, Asiiria koorizeŋ la gilɛɛ wa wer ra ɛɛ yaa wiimaa.’ ”

ref: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
text: Kɔraawiizi amaniye naabuu n faa nuu, u ra bagli Babilɔn wia. Nɛra ra bau alugɔ vem n lii wiifurii nodig wiikakag hɛribɔduma, di gbaari kuna ra ba. Hɛri bɛl hina wia n dɔɔ ɔnsii wergee, ba lii ra ba.

ref: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
text: N na wia aŋhinaa lugɔ deeza biini, a waa wer. Sɔsɔgɔ hiŋ ra ɛɛ sɔsɔgɔ, kumpaaga ra paagi kuna. Ɛlam hina, ií lii lɔ baa laal! Mɛdi hina, ií fɔɔ baa! N daŋ gil tɔɔrɔɔ ni nuumaa la Babilɔn hina n bɔɔni la jaa tuŋ.

ref: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
text: Wia naa gillɔɔ n bɔra ra wiiŋ, di ra baari werge maa, di ra wii werge lugɔ hiwiila n ɔɔ lɔ haaŋ gunla. Miŋ wa nuu gunla n na ɛɛ la, n bɔra maa huah, wia la minna na la ɛɛŋ witittii.

ref: My head spins; I'm horrified! Early evening, my favorite time, has become a nightmare.
text: N laakal maa leu, n bɔra ra sa. Wiizi cholaa n faa zuuŋ suma, n chɔɔ ra heezi la, jaa ɛɛŋ banchullɔi.

ref: In Babylon the high officials were having a feast. They were eating and drinking, when someone shouted, “Officers, take your places! Grab your shields.”
text: Ií na! Ba daali diuzenaare, di kuari ba diiribɔr, di so ra di, ka ra nyɔɔ sinni. Laal nabɔnzi, ií izi kpa ii laal pɛrɛtuzi!

ref: The Lord said to me, “Send guards to find out what's going on.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “La ga lizi tauduuri, ú so ra du tau. Kunla maa uŋ wa nawɛɛ ú ŋɔ i be.

ref: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready!”
text: Di u wa na zagra n na tɛrgi torkozi, laallɔɔra ge tinni kauzi ni nyugmazi, ú ra du tau nɛnnɛ, di gilɛɛ wa ta u hiŋ.”

ref: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
text: Ií na baal bɛl n du torko biini, zagra tɛrguu di ra ba! U amaniyee keŋ, “Babilɔn cholloo! U vuga ge maa chogli purgi.”

ref: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
text: N nɛra Izrɛl hina, iiŋ ɛɛwɛ lugɔ mia baŋ lɔwɛɛ, di hɛlaa la, ií gil n ŋɔ ii be gunla miŋ nuuwɛ lii Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la be, Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la be. Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ Ɛdɔm chɔgaa wia

ref: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
text: Kɔraawiizi amaniyee keŋ, di ra bagli Ɛdɔm wia. Nɛbɛl yirimbuu lii Ɛdɔm, di ŋɔ, “Tauduuri, hɔpizaa daŋ haa birgiaa? Saŋa bɛɛ bɔ́r chaanɛi?”

ref: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
text: A tauduuri sɛɛ, di ŋɔ, “Hɔɔ ra pizuu, ka bɔr ge wàá ka birgi ka biri. Ama, di i kaa ra nyiŋŋi ŋɔ i pɛɛzi guŋ, kaa bir ba wa pɛɛzi.” Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ Lɔrbizi hɛri chɔgaa wia

ref: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
text: N faa kaa nuu amaniye naa lii Kɔraawiizi be, u ra bagli Lɔrbizi hɛri wia. Dɛdan hina n kpogli nyugmazi di wa chɔɔ Lɔrbizi hɛri daazi biine,

ref: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
text: ií kpa nii wa tɛɛ banla niinyɔgzi n na kpu, Tɛma hina, ií kpa diwee wa tɛɛ banla n na chɔ laal.

ref: They are worn out and weary from being chased by enemies with swords and arrows.
text: Ba chɔwɔɔrɛ ra lii tokobi be, tokobi la baŋ pammɛ be, hoo la baŋ ɛɛ sirya bá ta, ani laal bɔwem be.

ref: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ tɛŋ, “Gunla paahdiiri n na kur u hɔpizaa maga la, ií ge kur guŋ biŋkpaŋ biini, Kɛda zenni ni u girme la maa daŋ tuŋ.

ref: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
text: Kɛda hotaara la n na lɔ laal la tama bɛnnɛ niŋ ka.” Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum labuu ŋɔ guŋ!

ref: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
text: Amaniye naabuu n faa nuu Kɔraawiizi be, u ra bagli Wia Nai Lugɔ Deeza Biini Waluu wia. Beedee n na ɛɛ iai, ii maa chɔ tinni salɛi?

ref: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
text: A bolzeŋ maa ra kɔɔu, dɔm izi bɔr maa. Bɛɛwiarɛ a bolzeŋ naa hina ra kɔɔ di ra di bahinaa kennei? Ii nɛra siuwɔɔ chɔɔ bɔr maa, ka laal biini lɛi ba siu. Tokobi lɛi kpu baa.

ref: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
text: Ii sitɔɔra maa chɔwɔɔrɛ. Ba dɔma haa waa hozi gba tawɛɛ, ka lauri baa. Ii banla maa baŋ laurɛɛ maanii ba kpogli kaali, haali iiŋ faa chɔwɛɛ di ii dɔma haa du bɔɔnɛɛ la gba.

ref: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
text: Awia, n ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií giliŋ bɔɔiih, ń wii werge, ií gilɛɛ ra tig n bampirii, dikuu n nɛra siu wia.”

ref: The Lord All-Powerful had chosen a time for noisy shouts and confusion to fill Vision Valley, and for everyone to beg the mountains for help.
text: Ee, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ lizi hɔpiziirɛ, nɛra n niŋ chɔ ra bar di ra kɔɔ di bugmi Wia Nai Lugɔ Deeza Biini Waluu biini. A hɔl la ban niŋ furgi koŋlaa, di wii ra du bizenaa, á lɛɛ baa.

ref: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.
text: Ii walsuma maanii su laal torkozi, zagtinna ge ga du Jɛrusalɛm dominuuzenaa la.

ref: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.
text: Koŋlaa ni kuna la maa n na lɛɛ Juda hɛri la maanii chɔkkɛ. Guŋ n ɛɛwɛ, ii chɔwɔɔrɛ la ii dɔmkuna dauri bɔr, di ga paagi laal kuna la.

ref: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.
text: Ii na gunla Jɛrusalɛm koŋlii n baruu la bɔkpila maa n purgee laal biinii, ii chi nii du Zɛɛ Pol la biini.

ref: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.
text: Ii kur Jɛrusalɛm diinii, di purgi aŋhinaa, di lizi a binanaa ií kuari a koŋlii ma, u du kpeg.

ref: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
text: Ii ma nii bɔr bɛllɛ koŋlaa anɛɛ la baambaaŋ, nii lii Polbinii la di waa zuu u biini. Ii ɛɛ annii naa maanii tuŋ, ka ii faa waa Kɔraawiizi la n dau annii maa saŋa maa uŋ ŋɔ u daŋ ɛɛ la.

ref: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la yir iabuu di ŋɔ ii be a saŋa hiŋ, dí ií ra wii, di ra chɛɛhgi, dí ií fuŋ ii nyuuni, di laali gbɔglɔnzi, guŋ bagli lugɔ ii biine chɔkkɔɔ ii wichɔgaa wia.

ref: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
text: Ka guŋ lɛi, ii ra sau di ra dua, di kpuuzi nauna ni peeza di ra hee, di ra nyɔɔ siŋ. Ii ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií gil ya ra di, di ra nyɔɔ siŋ, di kɛrɛ yaa daŋ siu, yaa waa zum!”

ref: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ pilli wii naabuu bagliŋ di ŋɔ, “Màá gil ii wichɔgaa naa tɛɛ ia di ra la ii siuri hɔpizii.” Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “La ga na Sɛbna, unla n ɛɛ kooridiahina nabɔma la, di lizi amaniye naa tɛu,

ref: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
text: ‘Bɛɛ i ra ɛɛ ɛnnɛi? Anɛɛ n tɛi ŋmɛnɛɛ lugɔ í kuari i ŋmam bɔnnaa, di ra tug bii, girme bɔr naa, di ra kuaruu nɛnnɛ, de wa ɛɛ i hugribɔrɛi?

ref: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
text: I ra yir i hinnɛ nɛzeŋ, a du tau! Kɔraawiizi ra nyiŋŋuu ú kpai ha.

ref: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
text: U daŋ kpai lugɔ bɔɔl, di tai i ga chol hɛrzeŋ bɛl. Denii i siu, í laal torkonanaa la ka de. I gillɔɔ i dɔɔri diahina di hiihzi.

ref: The Lord is going to take away your job!
text: N daŋ duŋŋii lii i huma biini. N daŋ lizii lii i nabɔmbɔr la.’

ref: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
text: N daŋ kpa i nabɔnlaala la laaluu, di kpa i kirsɔɔ kirsuu, di kpa fɔŋŋa la hiŋ faa dɔɔwɛ la tɛu. U daŋ jaa birgi Jɛrusalɛm ni Juda hina maa mɛɛ.

ref: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
text: N daŋ kpa nabɔmuu tɛu, Koori Deevid naana kora dii biini, di kaa tɛu nabɔmuu saafiibii, di u wa pillɔɔ, nɛr maa wàá wer tɔ, di u kaa tɔ ge, nɛr maa wàá wer pilli.

ref: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
text: N daŋ gil u chi u chignibɔr nɛnnɛ alugɔ baŋ kpa daasirii di kpaahzi koŋlii ni, waa ziigaa dɔɔwɛ la. Nɛra daŋ kuu girme la un dɔɔwɛ wia, di ra tɔgzi u diahina maa.

ref: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
text: U nɛra maa tɔɔrɔɔ daŋ sag u ni, alugɔ baŋ kpa hɛnni, tassazi ani viini maa sag daasirii ni la.”

ref: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Di a hɔl wa hello, daasirii la baŋ kpaahzɛɛ du koŋlii ni, waa ziigaa dɔɔwɛ la daŋ chol hɛri, kunla maa n faa sag u ni la gba chol.” Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ!

ref: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
text: Ií banla n soge muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛri ni Saidɔn kɔkɔɔza, ií maa chi surumm. Muugberzenaa saara gillɔɔ ii dɔɔ daama.

ref: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
text: Ií ɔɔ ga muuzenaa biinii la Ijip hɛri ka ra ba, di kpa Sihɔ mia ni pattikuna la baŋ kpawɛɛ lii Muu Naal kɛraa di ba Taaya. Taaya faa ɛɛ durnya hɛssi maa yawaa.

ref: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
text: Saidɔn hina, ií gil hiihzi kpu ia. Muuzeŋ la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ diikpeg, ii dɛlli u ni la, ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Lulaa hiwiila haa wan lɔwɛɛ maa, n ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa biibaala gɛɛ biihaana dɛɛzɛɛ.”

ref: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.
text: Di Ijip hina wa nuuwɔ lugɔ ba chɔg Taayaa, ba biine daŋ chɔgi werge maa.

ref: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
text: Awia, ii banla maa n soge a muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛri, ií ra chɛɛhgi, di chɔ gi ra la Taasis!

ref: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu ɛɛ guŋ, ú gil Taaya hina siwii sɔɔni, dikuu ba jigsi wia, di faa kaa gil banla banna tɔgzi ge, durnya maa biini siwii sɔɔni.

ref: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
text: Taasis hina, ií gaa par ii hɛri gunla Ijip hina n na par Muu Naal kɛraa la, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii waa kaa dɔɔ muugberzenaa chignibɔr.

ref: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
text: Kɔraawiizi tɛr u noniire guali muuzeŋ ni, di gil u kossi nɛra bɔra ra sa. U dau Fonisia hɛri wiarɛ lugɔ bá chɔgi u diikpega.

ref: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
text: U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ee, Saidɔn hina, iihinaa dii tunnɔɔ. Haali di ii chɔwɔɔ la Saiprɔs gba, ka ii wàá ga na heezaa.”

ref: Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins.
text: Ií binni Babilɔn hɛri na, u nɛra waa kaa dɔɔ tɔna! Asiiria hina gillɔɔ a bolzeŋ birgi hɛribɔduma sela duuribɔr. Ba faa fɔɔubuu, di ma diijaŋra n la chiŋ werge, di pɛgli u koŋlaa, di purgi u diikpega maa, u birgi diŋgela.

ref: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
text: Taasis muugberzenaa saara, ií ra chɛɛhgi! Ba chɔg ii diikpegre.

ref: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
text: “Hahsɛnsɛnni la baŋ suuh i wia, kpa kem lɔ ra bar a bol biini. A lɔu nɛnnɛ, di ra yir yirsuma, bá kaa liizi i wia.”

ref: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
text: Ka a saŋa, u humazi la maa tɔna daŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hor. Ba wàá tɔ u daama la chiŋŋi, ka ba daŋ kpaa yau diwee werge ni laalinanaa di ra tɛɛ banla n na jaami Kɔraawiizi la.

ref: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
text: Ií ra nuu! Kɔraawiizi ra nyiŋŋuu ú chɔgi a hɛri naa maa ú puri chɔɔ burburbur. U daŋ chɔgi a hɛri di gil u nɛra chɔ yaari.

ref: including ordinary people and priests, slaves and slave owners, buyers and sellers, lenders and borrowers, the rich and the poor.
text: Guŋ himmaanii niŋ huuzi Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni nɛra maa, gɛɛ dɔɔra ni balaa maa, gɛɛ banla n na yoo kuna ani banla ge n na yawaa, gɛɛ banla ge n na di kima ani banla be banna kim.

ref: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
text: Hɛri la maa daŋ chɔgi kɔrai, kummaa wàá ka ka u biini. Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ!

ref: The earth wilts away; its mighty leaders melt to nothing.
text: A hɛri hillɔɔ, pattikuna maa siuzi, a hɛri maa chɔgi. Durnya nabɔnzenaa tuu zɛɛ.

ref: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.
text: A hɛri hinaa chɔguu. Ba vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nuarɛ, di chɔgi u Gbɔgni, di kaa chɔgi u ni baa nuukpaŋ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: The earth is under a curse; its people are dying out because of their sins.
text: Awiarɛ u nuuseei chɔgi hɛri naa ni u nɛra maa la. Ba wichɔgaa kinturgaare guŋ. Awiarɛ niŋ fuuh baa la, ba tama bɛnnɛ kawɛɛ.

ref: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
text: Grepu daazi yɔllɔ, a nɔna la nii baŋ ɔɔ kpa ra ɛɛ siŋ la hiihzi, Awia, banla bɔra n ɔɔ sɔɔni, ba ra chaasi la, jaa ra him,

ref: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
text: lɔŋgɔma yigzaa tuŋ, nɛra la n na di bahinaa la kɔɔi tuŋ, kemzi la n ɔɔ faa gil nɛra bɔra sɔɔni la siigi.

ref: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
text: Ba waa kaa ra yir yira ka ra nyɔɔ ba siŋ, siŋkpega ge jaa du kpol a nyɔɔra nuuzi.

ref: Towns are crushed and in chaos; houses are locked tight.
text: A bolzeŋ puri, nɛr maa tɔ u dominua kiŋkiŋ.

ref: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
text: Nɛra du ŋmɛnizi di ra wii siŋ wia. Bɔsɔna tunnɔɔ, ka biinichɔg du de werge maa. Suma maa waa kaa hoo a hɛri.

ref: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
text: A bolzeŋ puroore di chɔgi, ba lɔ a dominuuzenaa maa kuugi.

ref: Nations will be stripped bare, like olive trees or vineyards after the harvest season. Praise the God of Justice
text: Gunnɛ niŋ ɛɛ durnya hɛssi hina maa biine, alugɔ baŋ ɔɔ zagi ɔlivi daa u nɔna chogli la, gɛɛ baŋ ɔɔ ra kuuni grepuzi kpaŋkpaŋa la baŋ tɔrgɛɛ ka ka la.

ref: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
text: Banla n kawɛɛ ge danna yir yira ni bɔsɔna. Banla n du wiicholii barii la danna chɔli Kɔraawiizi zenni la.

ref: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
text: Wiifurii barii hina ge, ií ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi girme. Banla n soge muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛri la, ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la.

ref: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
text: Yaa ra nuu gunla banna yir yiraa lii durnya naa yemmaa, di ra ŋɔ, “Ií ra chɔli Wideŋlaa Hiŋ la.” Ka n ŋɔ, “N maanii ra tuŋ dikuu biinichɔg werge wia, wibii maa! Wiarɛ huuziŋ. Nɛchɔgaa ra ɛɛ sɔsɔgɔɔ bɔr maa. Ba sɔsɔgɔ wiɛɛlaa la jaa ra nyaŋŋuu.”

ref: Terror, traps, and pits are waiting for everyone.
text: Durnya hina, ɔnsii werge, bɔɔ ani sidɛɛ bɛnnɛ chɔɔwɛ, di ra kpaŋ ia.

ref: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
text: Banla maa n ninna chɔ dikuu ɔnsii werge wia, daŋ chol bɔɔ biini, banla ge n niŋ lii a bɔɔ biini, sidɛɛzi daŋ lauri baa. Chiŋ daŋ pilli, dozeŋ chol, durnya zigli.

ref: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.
text: A durnya hɛri daŋ pergi, di purgi, di zigli werge maa.

ref: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
text: A hɛri daŋ jiŋli alugɔ sinnyɔɔri, di kaa ra zigli alugɔ peu n na ta pampanni ni. U wichɔgaa kannɔɔ werge maa, awia, u daŋ chol, wàá ka izi maa.

ref: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɔɔri fɔŋŋazi la n du chiŋ ni koora la n du hɛri.

ref: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
text: Ba daŋ lauri baa tɔ dia, gunla baŋ ɔɔ tɔ nɛra la, ba du de hɔpizikpila, ka ú wa tɔɔri baa.

ref: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la jaa di u kora la Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu. Jɛrusalɛm biinii ú di a kora hiŋ a nɛra nabɔnzi la maa see, haali u girme la gil hiihzi kpu wiizi ni baagu, dikuu u girme la n niŋ gil ba wàá ka zum a chaanaa wia la.

ref: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu n na hum. N danna tɔgzii di ra chɔli i sɔŋ. Hiŋ ɛɛ wibii hiŋ la wia, i ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia la hiŋ dauwɛ saŋa maa labuu.

ref: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
text: I gillɔɔ bolzenaa purgi, a hembugle chɔɔgi kulululu, bolzeŋkpega la maa purgi. Hɛhjaŋa bolzenaa puroore, ba wàá ka wer maa maa.

ref: Now strong and cruel nations will fear and honor you.
text: Awia, fɔŋŋa hina danna tɔgzii, hɛssi hina bolzenaa nɛra la n dɔɔ sikpegii hina danna ɔmii.

ref: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
text: I ɛɛ bɔr la nyaara ni anuula hina n na suauh, di kaa ɛɛ suahribɔr tɛɛ nɛra dooŋ peu n na yag baa, wiizi ge ra kpuu baa labuu. Sikpegii hina ra bau bá wa lɔ baa lugɔ dooŋ pekpeg n na yag koŋlii,

ref: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
text: di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ wiliŋ n ɔɔ ra lii hɛribɔduma biini. I gillɔɔ hɔɔhra la n na kɔɔ la siigi kakpaŋ alugɔ baama n ɔɔ wa guali bɔwem ni u bir sɔɔni la. Gunnɛ sikpegii hina yira la teŋ.

ref: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la daŋ chi Bizeŋ Ziɔn naa nyuu, di daali diuzenaa, olnanaa ani sinnanaa himmaa, tɛɛ hɛssi hina maa.

ref: Here the Lord will strip away the burial clothes that cover the nations.
text: Bizeŋ naa nyuurɛ ú pilli kasaŋa n tɔ durnya nɛra maa ni la,

ref: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
text: di chɔgi siu, di hanna la, saŋaa saŋa maa. Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la daŋ fiizi nɛr maa sinii lii nɛra maa siwee. U daŋ lizi hiihzi la u nɛra n faa diwee la, durnya naa biini. Kɔraawiizi himmaanii ŋɔ guŋ!

ref: At that time, people will say, “The Lord has saved us! Let's celebrate. We waited and hoped— now our God is here.”
text: A hɔl hiŋ, u nɛra daŋ ŋɔ, “Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi la ya n na hum labuu keŋ. Yaa yarduubuu, u lɛɛ yaa. Kɔraawiizi la yaa n yardɛɛ labuu keŋ, ií gil yaa bɔra sɔɔni, dikuu uŋ lɛɛ yaa wia!”

ref: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
text: Kɔraawiizi nonii daŋ ɔɔ guali Bizeŋ Ziɔn naa ni. Ka u daŋ fɛrgi Moab hɛri hinawaa lugɔ baŋ ɔɔ fɛrgi kɔlaa a zuu nabina biini di pɔɔh gunla.

ref: They will struggle to get out, but God will humiliate them no matter how hard they try.
text: Ba daŋ ɛɛ wiimaa bá lɛɛ bahinaa ka pɛɛrɛ. Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil ba nunzuma ni ba jigsi la maa tuŋ.

ref: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
text: U daŋ gil koŋliikpega la baŋ mawɛɛ bar ba bola purgi burburbur, chɔɔ hɛri di birgi nyɔɔ.

ref: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, nɛra la n du Juda hɛri daŋ yir yir naa, yaa dɔɔ bolzeŋkpegre, Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa bar yaabuu alugɔ koŋlii.

ref: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
text: Ií pilli a bolzeŋ dominuuzenaa, tɛɛ hɛri la nɛra wia n deŋlee di dɔɔ wibii la zuu!

ref: The Lord gives perfect peace to those whose faith is firm.
text: Hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil nɛr la maa n dɛllii dɔɔ bɔsɔna nɛnnɛ, dikuu uŋ yardii wia.

ref: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
text: Ií yardi Kɔraawiizi saŋaa saŋa maa. Waabuu Bikpeg la n na guu yaa di du de saŋaa saŋa maa la.

ref: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.
text: U gillɔɔ nɛra la n faa ra kpa bahinaa zenni la siwii sɔɔni, di purgi ba bolkpeg. U maanii u purgi dau hɛri,

ref: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
text: nyaara ra vol u ni, nɛra la baŋ faa ra sunni la ra fɛrguu.

ref: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
text: Ama, nɛra la wia n deŋlee la, ba ŋmɛnɛɛ chɔɔwɔɔ kpantalaŋ. Kɔraawiizi, Wideŋlaa Hiŋ, i gillɔɔ ba ŋmɛnɛɛ du wer chɔɔ.

ref: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, yaa ra hiŋ i widaulaa ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ. Hinuu yaa ra binni. Yaa kipattɛ lugɔ i sɔŋ dɔɔ girme.

ref: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
text: Maa dɔɔ ra chɔɔ hamuŋa ni, dikuu n bampirii n lawii wia, n nfɛrɛ ge du i ni chɔɔzi ni. Di i wa di hɛri seriya, guŋ ɔɔ giluu durnya nɛra helli wideŋlaa ɛɛi.

ref: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
text: Haali hinna suŋ biinikpola hina ni gba, ka guŋ waa gillɛ ba ra ɛɛ winanaa. Haali di ba du nɛra la wia n deŋlee hɛri gba, ka ba ɔɔ haa vɛɛu ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa. Ba waa hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi zenni ra tɔgzi.

ref: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i lalli i noniire chiŋ í tɛr nɛra digna, ka ba wɔɔ nawɛɛ. Gil ba na gunla hiŋ aah siwii i nɛra wia, hiihzi lau baa. Gil niŋ la hiŋ chemme dau i dɔma la fuuh baa.

ref: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu gillɛ bɔsɔna du yaa be. Wia la maa yaa n wette ɛɛ la lii i benii.

ref: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
text: Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, nɛra baŋhina faa di koraa yaa ni. Ka i bɛŋ sɔnnɛ yaa ra tɔgzi.

ref: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
text: Banla yaa n faa hummɛ di ra tɛɛ la jaa siuzuu. Ba dunzi ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka bir ba. I tɔɔri baabuu di chɔgi baa, nɛr maa jaa suuh ba wia.

ref: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i gillɔɔ yaa hɛri yaa, u nɛra du kpil. I gillɔɔ i sɔŋ dɔɔ girme, di yaa yaa hɛri magbɔɔni.

ref: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nɛra biinichɔg saŋa la, ba nyiŋŋi i bɔttɛ. Hiŋ tɛr ba digna la, ba ba i benii wa suŋŋii biinichɔg ni.

ref: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
text: Yaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hilula n lɔ haaŋ, u ra birgi di ra wii. Gunnɛ yaa faa du i be, yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi.

ref: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
text: Hilula lɔ yaabuu, yaa ra gbargi dikuu yaa bɔra n na waazi wia, ka yaa waa wette lul kummaa, di peu bɛŋ lɛi. Yaa waa wette lɛɛ durnya naa, yaa waa wette lul nɛra bá su hɛri naa gba.

ref: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.
text: I nɛra la n siuwɛ la daŋ bir wa dɔɔ miibɔɔ, ba bɔrahɔna daŋ izi siu biini. Ii banla baŋ hukke, ií izi ra yir yira werge ni bɔsɔna! Dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɛɛ lalaa miibɔɔ lugɔ chɔɔzinŋmɛnii n ɔɔ sɔɔni hɛri la.

ref: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
text: Awia, n nɛra, ií maa ra la ii diini, di ga zuu ka tɔɔgi ii dominuuzi! Ií suahzi iihinaa tama, di ra la saŋa la Kɔraawiizi baaŋ n niŋ wa sɔɔni la.

ref: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
text: Kɔraawiizi lii u duuribɔttɛ chiŋ di ra ba ú wa tɛr durnya nɛra digna, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia. Hɛri wàá ka wer suah nɛra la baŋ kpuuzɛɛ ba challi lii la. Ba daŋ lii baŋgia, nɛr maa na baa.

ref: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa u tokobi, u tokobi la n chummɛ werge la, di tɛr muuzeŋ sechɔgii la n gbaŋŋɛ di ra goomi la digni, u daŋ kpu muuzeŋ biini sechɔgii la.

ref: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ ŋɔ u grepu daazi koonanii bɛl wia,

ref: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
text: “N danna binni u ni, di ra duu nii saŋa maa, di ra du u tau bɔchaaŋ ni hamuŋa maa, nɛr maa gilɛɛ wàá chɔguu.

ref: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
text: N baaŋ waa a grepu daazi koo ni ra fuuh. Di nɛbɛl duu choŋgolaa ni sɔɔhri u biini, n daŋ izi ga lɔu laal, ka fuuh a maa.

ref: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
text: Ama, di ba wa sɛɛwɔ ba n be di ŋɔ ń guu baa, guŋwaa, bá ba wa di kuu.”

ref: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.
text: Saŋa bɛl ra bau, Izrɛl hina n ɛɛ Jekɔb naanna, daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ daa n du lunne, di lɔɔ di fii nɔŋ, u nɔna su durnya naa maa.

ref: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
text: Kɔraawiizi waa Izrɛl hina lɔwɛɛ alugɔ uŋ lɔ ba dɔma la. Waa baa kpuwɛɛ alugɔ uŋ kpu nɛra la n faa ra kpu baa la.

ref: I carefully measured out Israel's punishment and sent the scorching heat to chase them far away.
text: U tɛr ba dignaa, di gil ba lauri baa kaali hɛrdumazi. U kpa fɔŋŋa alugɔ wiifurii pekpeg n chummɛnɛ di kpa baa kaali.

ref: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
text: Gunla ban niŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi gil ba wichɔgaa tɛɛ baa labuu keŋ, bá purgi ba vuga mbusu lizibɔra la maa, di namaa a birgi sau, di chɔg ba vughaaŋ Asɛra daazi ni daahɛgsɔɔhsuma fuuhribɔra la maa.

ref: Fortress cities are left like a desert where no one lives. Cattle walk through the ruins, stripping the trees bare.
text: Bolzeŋkpeg la daŋ birgi diŋgela, de ɛɛ lugɔ hɛribɔduma, nauna ra di de, di chɔɔ de ra heezi, di di u daazi ge paŋhoori a maa tuŋ nyaamm.

ref: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
text: A nɛra ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ daazi kela n hillɛ, ba kuugaa ha, haana paagaa birgi nindaazi. Dikuu Izrɛl hina n waa wia zɛɛ zummɛ wia, ba Taari Kɔraawiizi wàá na ba sinyɛna, gɛɛ di suŋ ba ni.

ref: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, di lii Muu Yufretis guŋŋ di ga hel Ijip hɛri magbɔɔ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ bargi u nɛra, di chaali baa kpaŋkpaŋa lii hɛssi alugɔ banna hɛl mia a ra lii a zɔga ni la.

ref: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, ba daŋ nuu baŋ huuh bensunoniina bɛl. Banla n faa ra siuzi Asiiria ni banla n du Ijip la daŋ bir ba Jɛrusalɛm, di waa jaami Kɔraawiizi, u bizennaniinanii la nyuu.

ref: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
text: Tɔɔrɔɔ daŋ huuzi Izrɛl hina bolzeŋ la n chigɛ walsum baŋgia la. U nɛra maanii ɛɛ sinnyɔɔra di ra jigsi u wia, ka u fɔŋŋa ni u girme ra tuŋ alugɔ fiiri n na siu la.

ref: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
text: Ií ra nuu! Kɔraawiizi lizi nɛbɛllɛ, di ɛɛu sirya, u dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge maa, ú wa lɔ baa. U daŋ ba lugɔ dobee ni dozeŋ n gillɛ nii taali bɔr maa, di ra chɔ gbuŋgbuŋgbuŋ, di chɔg a hɛri.

ref: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
text: Izrɛl hina bolzeŋ la u nɛra n ɛɛ sinnyɔɔra di ra jigsi u wia la, u daŋ chol, nɛra kpa naazi di ra fɛrguu.

ref: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
text: Ba sitɔɔra girme daŋ tuŋ lugɔ fig nɔŋlugla n haŋ waa aah, di ba tɔrgaa di la.

ref: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ koorikahuro la n dɔɔ girme, u nɛra la n kawɛɛ la be.

ref: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
text: U daŋ gil ba sitɔɔra nɔŋŋi wibii wia, di kpa fɔŋŋa tɛɛ ba laallɔɔra la n ɔɔ chi a bol dominuuzenaa di ra yoo ba dɔma, bá gilɛɛ wa wer di ra zuu a bol la.

ref: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
text: Ba ɔɔ hɛɛhzuu di ra chɔgi ba diiribɔra maa, de maa ɔɔ doŋ.

ref: You drunken leaders are like babies! How can you possibly understand or teach the Lord's message?
text: Kenne nɛra ɔɔ ra ŋɔ mìŋ́ Aizaaya wia, “Anɛɛ u ra bagli wiai? Anɛɛ u ra bagli u amaniye zɛɛi? Bichalli la baŋ teŋ illɛ u ra bagli wiaa?

ref: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
text: U ɔɔ haŋ mari wikpaŋ ninɛɛ di ra dammi, ií ra ɛɛ keŋ, ií ra ɛɛ keŋ! Tama ɛŋ, tama ende!”

ref: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
text: Guŋ wia, Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa nɛra n na mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi ŋɔ wia tɛɛ u nɛra.

ref: He promised you perfect peace and rest, but you refused to listen.
text: U faa ŋɔ ba benii, “Heezaa bɔttɛ keŋ tɛɛ banla n kuuhwɛ. Ií ba wa heezi!” Ka ba waa sɛɛwɛ bá nuu.

ref: Now his message to you will be senseless sound after senseless sound. Then you will fall backwards, injured and trapped. False Security Is Fatal
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii la un niŋ ŋɔ tɛɛ baa maanii lugɔ, Ií ra ɛɛ keŋ, ií ra ɛɛ keŋ! Tama ɛŋ, tama ende! Gunnɛ bá jaa bir la har ga chogli, ba dɔma he baa sidɛɛzi di lauri baa kaali.

ref: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
text: Awia, ii banla n dɔɔ Jɛrusalɛm di ra gbɛlli nɛra la, ií ra nuu gunla Kɔraawiizi n na ŋɔ.

ref: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
text: Ií ra ta barabaraa di ra ŋɔ lugɔ ii ni siu ni lalaa bol ɛɛ nuukpannɛ. Di hɛhchɔg maa wa chol a nɛra ni, ka wàá wer ɛɛ iawaa wiimaa. Ií dɛlli kara ni nɛdaraa ninɛɛ alugɔ aabuu niŋ wer lɛɛ ia.

ref: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
text: Guŋ wia, kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ, “Ií ra nuu ɛŋ! N kpa binanii bɛllɛ dau Ziɔn. N lizuubuu u ɛɛ binanii, u kpekkoo nɛnnɛ, ií wer ma hɔŋ u ni. ‘Nɛr la maa n niŋ yarduu, wiimaa wàá ka tiruu.’

ref: Justice and fairness will be the measuring lines that help me build.” Hailstones and floods will destroy and wash away your shelter of lies.
text: N daŋ kpa wibii ni wideŋlaa birgi n ŋmɛŋ la miŋ kpawɛɛ ra mɛgzi kuna, di mɛgzi koŋlaa la iin niŋ ma hɔŋ a bii ni la.” Iiŋ kpa kara ni nɛdaraa di maa la wia, dobia daŋ wa huraa ta, nii ge taali ii suahribɔra.

ref: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.
text: Nuukpaŋ la ii ni siu n dɔɔwɛ la daŋ bir pɛɛ, ii ni lalaa bol nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la wàá ka du de. Di hɛhchɔg haŋ wa chol, u daŋ wa hurgi ia ha.

ref: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ izi fɔŋŋa ni gunla uŋ faa izee Bizeŋ Pɛrazim nyuu la, di yoo u dɔma ni baaŋ, gunla uŋ faa ɛɛwɛ Gibiɔn Waluu la. U wiɛɛlaa daŋ kur, di ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia werge maa.

ref: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
text: Awia, ii gilɛɛ ra ɛɛ n wiŋɔzi naa chɛɛtɛ, ii tɔɔrɔɔ gilɛɛ wa du kaŋ jaa. N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ n benii lugɔ u ɛɛ siryaa ú chɔgi hɛri naa maa.

ref: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
text: Ií ra nuu n be! Ií keŋŋi digna di ra nuu gunla min niŋ ŋɔ.

ref: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
text: Di u haŋ wa kossi u koo tuŋ, u ɔɔ wa mizi u kundee la n dɛg mizaarɛ, di duu huuti ni baali, bɛl maa ni u bɔr.

ref: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.
text: Waa ɔɔ kpa kapɛrɛ di ra lɔ a dɔzi tiuzaa kuna a bee ra lii, ka daa la n kukkɛɛrɛ u ɔɔ kpa ra lɔa, a bee gilɛɛ chɔgi.

ref: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
text: Huutii ba ɔɔ nam kuari paanuu, awia, ba waa ɔɔ lɔa di hanna la. Haali u torko n ɔɔ vol a ni, ka u zagra waa ɔɔ namaa.

ref: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
text: Annii maa ge lii Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la benii. U bɛnnɛ zum nɛra liize biraa. U nunzuma ge kaa du kaŋ werge maa.

ref: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
text: Ee, Jɛrusalɛm, Kɔraawiizi mbusu lizibɔr la, bolzeŋ la Koori Deevid n faa soge la, wia daŋ huuzii! Binaa bina maanii nɛra ɔɔ ra lizi mbusukpila i biini, di ra di ba hɔpizizenaa.

ref: I will still make you suffer, and your people will cry when I make an altar of you.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil hɛhchɔg chol bolzeŋ la banna yir Kɔraawiizi Mbusu Lizibɔr la ni. Wiraa ni chɛɛhgaa daŋ du de, a bolzeŋ maa ɛɛ lugɔ chal n tɔ mbusu lizibɔr ni.

ref: I will surround you and prepare to attack from all sides.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil u dɔma wa fɔɔu di lɔu.

ref: From deep in the earth, you will call out for help with only a faint whisper.
text: A saŋa, u wiŋɔzi daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ koguu n na fir u ŋɔ wia lii hɛrii, hɛɛhraa biinii a ra lii lugɔ munnaa.

ref: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
text: Kakpaŋ, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la daŋ huuzi baa ni nazaa, hɛri ziglaa, kɔɔi werge, pechuma ani niŋ n niŋ fuuh baa.

ref: Every brutal nation that attacks Jerusalem and makes it suffer will disappear like a dream when night is over.
text: Denii hɛrkpila laallɔɔra la n na lɔ Jɛrusalɛm laal, di fɔɔ u diikpeg la daŋ leu alugɔ deeza alugɔ kuŋ baŋ nawɛɛ lugɔ deeza biini hamuŋa ni.

ref: Those nations that attack Mount Zion will suffer from hunger and thirst. They will dream of food and drink but wake up weary and hungry and thirsty as ever. Prophets Who Fool Themselves
text: A daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ lɔzi n na kpu nɛr, u chɔɔ deezi unna di diwee, ka wa izi lɔzi haa ra kpuu la. Di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ niinyɔgzi n lau nɛr, u chɔɔ deezi unna nyɔɔ nii, ka wa izi zɛɛɛ, a niinyɔgzi haa lawuu la. Gunnɛ niŋ ɛɛ hɛrkpila nɛra la maa n na lɔ Jɛrusalɛm laal la.

ref: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.
text: Wia naa gil ii nuuzi kpu, ií birgi nyuŋŋa. Ií ra dɛɛzi, ka a wàá lii siŋ be, di kaa ra jiŋli, ka a wàá lii siŋ be.

ref: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
text: Kɔraawiizi kpa dɔzeŋ bɛllɛ du ii ni, ii nfɛssi du tɔg werge. U tɔɔgi u dɔgtɛɛzi siwee ni ba nyuunii, ba waa wia ra na deeza biini.

ref: Others say, “We can't read it, because we don't know how to read.”
text: Di i kaa kpau tɛɛ nɛr la ge n waa zum karmaa ŋɔ ú karmi, u daŋ ŋɔ waa karmaa zummɛ.

ref: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Nɛra naa, ba nuuzii ba kpa ra tɔgziŋ, ka ba bampiree wan lauwɛ tama maa. Baŋ ɔɔ ra jaamiŋ la ɛɛ newea baglaarɛ baŋ bagli baa ba helli di ra ŋɔa labuu.

ref: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
text: Dikuu guŋ wia, n daŋ bir ra ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia a nɛra naa be a tir baa werge maa. N daŋ gil ba nunzunna nunzuma bir pɛɛ, bá sichaana ge tuŋ.”

ref: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
text: Wia daŋ huuzi banla n aah siwii di kpa ba jinazi di ra suahzi Kɔraawiizi ni la, di ra hum ba huma bɔbiri la, ka ra fɛ ba biine, “Anɛɛ ra na yaai? Anɛɛ n niŋ zumɛi?”

ref: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, “You didn't make me. You don't even know how.” Hope for the Future
text: Ií bir wiarɛ chig. Viimaari ni chuuri ɛɛ kpannɛaa? Vii daŋ wer ŋɔ u maari be lugɔ waa lɛi mauwaa? Vii daŋ wer ŋɔ u maari wia lugɔ waa wiimaa zummɛaa?

ref: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.
text: A wàá birgi, ka Lɛbanɔn kɔr birgi koo, a koo ge ɛɛ lugɔ kɔr.

ref: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, dignitaŋa hina danna nuu banna karmi lii hɔŋ biini, nyuŋŋa la ge n ɔɔ ra vol bɔbiri ge siwee daŋ pilli bá wer di ra na.

ref: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
text: Banla n waa bahinaa ra tɔgzi la daŋ jaa dɔɔ bɔsɔna Kɔraawiizi be. Nyaara bɔra daŋ sɔɔni werge maa dikuu Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la wia.

ref: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
text: Sikpegii hina wia daŋ tuŋ, banla ge maa n na ɛɛ nɛra chɛɛtɛ wàá ka du de, banla ge maa n dɔɔ nfɛrchɔgaa di ra nyiŋŋi wichɔgaa ɛɛi la

ref: together with everyone who tells lies in court and keeps innocent people from getting a fair trial.
text: ni banla n ɔɔ wer kanni kara chug nɛra, baabuu ɔɔ gil sitɔɔra di nɛra la hora n summɛ seriya ba chol la.

ref: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
text: Guŋ wiarɛ Abraham Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi bagli Izrɛl hina wia, di ŋɔ, “Hiihzi wàá ka kpu baa, ɔnsii wàá ka lau baa.

ref: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.
text: Di ba wa na n wiɛɛlaa gunla miŋ gillɛ ba biizi du kpil la, ba danna tɔgzi n sɔŋ nɛnnɛ. Ba danna tɔgzi mìŋ́ Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la werge maa, ba danna ɔm mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la.

ref: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.”
text: Banla n faa leuwe daŋ jaa zum wia zɛɛ nɛnnɛ, banla ge n faa ɔɔ ra nuumi werge la, daŋ jaa sɛɛ di ra nuu baglaa.”

ref: This is the Lord's message for his rebellious people: “You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Wia daŋ huuzi n biizi la n du Juda hɛri, di ɛɛ dignikpega hina werge la. Banla n ɔɔ vɔɔ jinazi la n waa n be liwɛɛrɛ, ba ni nɛra ɛɛ nuukpaŋ n Duma n waa baa baglɛɛ ŋɔ bá ɛɛ. Gunnɛ ba ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa di ra sag dɔŋa ni.

ref: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
text: Ba wan pɛɛzɛɛ wiimaa, ka ra la Ijip koori be, di ra nyiŋŋi u lɛɛ baa lii ba tɔɔrɔɔ biini, di gil u bɔsɔŋ tɔ ba ni.

ref: “You will be disappointed, completely disgraced for trusting Egypt.
text: Too, baŋ yardi Ijip koori ú guu baa naa, ba daŋ di hiihzi, wàá wer guu baa.
