text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi, Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la, n ta baa di dau wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ la ra ŋɔu, “Ii daŋ wer pɛɛziŋ n biizi wiaa? Ii daŋ wer bagliŋ gunla min niŋ hum n humaa?

ref: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
text: Minuu ta hɛri ni newea maa. N fɔŋŋaa n kpa yaa chiŋ, minuu dɔɔ chinchiŋwilaa ni chiŋ kuna maa fɔŋŋa.

ref: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
text: Minuu kpa n wia du Sairus bampirii, ú hum n huma, di kuari wia a deŋli. U daŋ bir ma n bolzeŋ la, di lɛɛ n nɛra la baŋ lauri yoma la. U daŋ ɛɛ guŋ, ka wàá ŋɔ kinturgaa maa wia. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Ijip kuŋkuaraa ni Itiopia soochi kuna maa daŋ birgi ii kuna. Saba nɛjaŋra la daŋ ba ii be, di wa birgi ii yoma. Ba daŋ du baa yɔlɔzi, ba hiŋ ia ba. Ba danna togni ia, di ra sɛɛ ii dɔɔra, di ra ŋɔ, ‘Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi du ii benii, dɔɔri maa waa kaa hoo.’ ”

ref: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
text: Izrɛl Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi, wibii maa, i ɛɛ Dɔɔri la n na suah i hinnɛ.

ref: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
text: Banla maa n na kuari vuga daŋ di hiihzi, di ŋmaabi.

ref: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
text: Ama, Izrɛl hinawaa daŋ na lɛɛi la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ Kɔraawiizi be. Ba ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka di hiihzi di ŋmaabi, di hanna la, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ waabuu ta chiŋ, waabuu Kɔraawiizi, waabuu unla n kuaruu kennaa uŋ duwɛɛ naa, di gil u chi. Wɔɔ kuarɛɛ ú chɔɔ pɛɛ, u kuaruubuu nɛ́ra du u ni. Waabuu ŋɔwɛɛ, “Minuu Kɔraawiizi, bɛl maa waa kaa hoo.

ref: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
text: N wiŋɔɔlii maa waa suahwɛ. Maa hɛri naa yemmaa suahwɛ ŋɔ wia. Maa kaa ŋɔ Jekɔb naanna ge be lugɔ bá ra nyiŋŋi n bɔr pɛɛpɛɛ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ra ŋɔ wia la n deŋleene, di ra ŋɔ wibii bɛŋ.

ref: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
text: Hɛssi la maa hina n chɔwɛɛ, ií chaali dɔŋa ba. Banla maa n chigɛ ba daazi vuga, ɛɛ gɛnaarɛ, di ra kuari vuga la n wàá wer lɛɛ baa.

ref: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
text: Ií chaali dɔŋa ya ŋɔ wia nuu dɔŋa be! Anɛɛ n faa ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ guŋ daŋ wa ɛɛ lai? Anɛɛ n faa pilli guŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ saŋa maa n bɛrɛɛ lai? Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi lɛi faa? Kɔraawiizi maa waa hoo di n bɛŋ lɛi. Wideŋlaa hiŋ ni Lɛɛri maa waa hoo di mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi bɛŋ lɛi.

ref: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
text: Durnya hina maa, ií ba n be di wa na lɛɛi. N bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, bɛl maa waa kaa hoo.

ref: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
text: N himmaa sɔnnɛ n kpa hɛɛhzi, n wiŋɔzi deŋloore, a ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá bir pɛɛ, Nɛr maa daŋ wa giŋŋi n see di hɛɛhzi lugɔ u daŋ sɛɛŋ dɔɔra.

ref: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
text: Nɛra maa daŋ ŋɔ n wia lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi bɛŋ benii wideŋlaa ni fɔŋŋa du. Banla maa n faa hahŋ, daŋ ba n be, di wa di hiihzi.”

ref: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
text: Kɔraawiizi benii Izrɛl hina maa ga, bá wia deŋli, bá ra chɔli u sɔŋ.

ref: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
text: Babilɔn vuga tunaa keŋ. Ba faa ra kuari Bɛɛl ni Nɛbɔɔ, ka filaŋkeŋ, ba kpaabuu chug kauzi. A ɛɛ buntɔgaa tɛɛ sela la n kuuhwɛ.

ref: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
text: A vuga wàá wer lɛɛ a hiŋ, ba kpeglaabuu di chia ra kaali. Babilɔn vuga tunaa guŋ!

ref: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
text: “Ií ra nuu n be, Jekɔb naanna, ii banla n ka Izrɛl hɛri la. N binni iabuu guŋŋ di lii ii lulaa saŋa maa.

ref: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
text: N daŋ haa ra binni ia di ra la ii zɛŋaa saŋa. Minuu Kɔraawiizi. Minuu ma ia, n daŋ kpogli ia, di hiini ia, di lɛɛ ia.

ref: Can anyone compare with me? Is anyone my equal?
text: Anɛɛ ii wer kpaŋ mɛgzɛi? Anɛɛ n dɔŋhinɛi?

ref: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
text: Baŋhina lizi salinnɛ ba hure biine, di mɛgzi saliŋhuŋŋa ge jaa. Ba kpaa suŋŋi luuri u luu vug tɛɛ baa, ba giŋŋi u see di ra jaamuu.

ref: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
text: Ba lalluubuu sag ba baŋaazi, di chiu ra vol, ka jaa wa kpau baŋ bɔr la un niŋ chi. U chi de, u himmaa wàá ka wer lii de. Nɛr la maa n suŋŋuu, ka wàá nuu di lɛɛu lii u tɔɔrɔɔzi biine.

ref: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
text: Ií ra liizi keŋ, di gil a du ii nyuuni. Nɛkpoŋlaa, ii gil a du ii bampiree.

ref: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
text: Ií ra liizi wia la n faa ɛɛwɛ saŋa maa la. N bɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi, bɛl maa waa kaa hoo. N dɔŋ maa ge waa hoo.

ref: From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word
text: Lugli maanii aŋ zum wii tuna. Wii la maa miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ daŋ wa ɛɛ. Wii la miŋ dauwɛ, n daŋ ɛɛu.

ref: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
text: N daŋ yir baal bɛl lii wiifurii, u daŋ ba alugɔ kɔlaa n ɔɔ tuu kpa kuŋ la, di ɛɛ wii la miŋ ta u jina. Wii la maa miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ, n daŋ ɛɛu.

ref: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
text: Ií ra nuu n be, dignikpega hina, ii banla ni wideŋlaa n nɛɛwɛ la.

ref: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
text: N wideŋlaa ɛɛi ra dugluu, a waa kaa du nɛɛ. Min niŋ lɛɛ ia la wàá ka birgi. N daŋ lɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm hina, di gil Izrɛl hɛri dɔɔ n girme.”

ref: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Babilɔn n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ suŋguru la n waa baal zummɛ, tuu ga so hɛri! Izi i koorikara la ni di ga so hɛri, Babilɔn hina biihaaŋ! Ba wàá ka yirii biipɔɔh, ba wàá ka yirii bunya hiŋ kunjɛgɛkɛ.

ref: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
text: Kpa nam di nam sau, di wir i saata. Kossi i wondoŋ, ka ka i naazi, ka gi gɔŋa.

ref: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
text: I daŋ vol chakpal di di hiihzi. N daŋ turgii i nɛtɔɔraa la kim, nɛr maa wàá wer laafiŋ.”

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
text: Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii labuu lɛɛ yaa, u sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ.

ref: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Babilɔn hina biihaaŋ benii, “So bɔbiri biini di tɔ i nua. Nɛr maa ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka yirii hɛssi wiche.

ref: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
text: N baaŋ faa fuuh n nɛra ninɛɛ, n faa vɛɛ baa, di kpa baa du i nonee biini. Ka i faa waa ba ni sunne tama maa. Haali i faa sunni ba nɛzɛŋzii werge maa.

ref: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
text: I faa ɛɛ tamiirɛ lugɔ i daŋ ɛɛ wichee di hanna la. I faa waa nfɛrɛ ra fɛ wiimaa wia, gɛɛ a wia laba.

ref: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
text: Filaŋkeŋ, jaa ra nuu, hìŋ́ unla n na di i hiŋ, di ra fɛ lugɔ wiimaa wàá wer huuzii la. I ɔɔ ra ŋɔu i biini, ‘N bɛnnɛ, n dɔŋ waa hoo. N ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá birgi luhaaŋ gɛɛ n biini chɔgi, dikuu biizi siu wia.’

ref: Your magic powers and charms will suddenly fail, then you will be a widow and lose your children.
text: Ka ŋmɛnɛ bɛl, a wia anɛɛ naa maa daŋ wa pirgii hɔpizikpaŋ, í chol, í wia tuŋ. Haali i ni i hiri la maa, ka i daŋ birgi luhaaŋ, i biizi ge siuzi.

ref: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
text: Hiŋ yardi biinikpola wiɛɛlaa wia, i ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Nɛr maa wanna na.’ Ka i nunzuma ni i sichaana faa dariibuu, i ŋɔ i biini, ‘N bɛnnɛ, n dɔŋ waa hoo.’

ref: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
text: Haa ra ɛɛ i ziŋgaabo wiɛɛlaa ni i hiri dii la, hiŋ faa aah siwii di ra ɛɛ lii i bichalli saŋa la. Aŋhinabe, a daŋ hiinii, aŋhinabe, i wia daŋ dɔɔ ɔnsii.

ref: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
text: I bɔra yɔɔrɔɔrɛ, haali nɛkpila n birii liize gba! Gil i nɛra la n zum chinchiŋwilaa wia, di ɔɔ binnaa ka ra bagli gunla n niŋ wa ɛɛ baagu maa biini la, ba wa lɛɛi lii wia la n niŋ wa huuzii biini.

ref: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
text: Wibii maa, ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kooriihilaa, niŋ daŋ fuuh baa. Ba wàá wer lɛɛ bahinaa lii a niŋ be. A niŋhɔla waa kunla hin niŋ ŋmaani ɛɛwɛ.

ref: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
text: Gunnɛ nɛra naa i ni baa n hummɛ i bichalli maa la wer ɛɛ tɛi. Bɛl maa daŋ leu, di ga u ŋmɛnɛɛ ra kaali. Bɛl maa wàá wer lɛɛi.”

ref: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií ra nuu, Jekɔb diahina, banla banna yir Izrɛl, ii lii Juda dee biini la, ii banla n ɔɔ kpa n sɔŋ di ra hɛɛhzi, di ra yiriŋ, ka ii waa wibii ni wideŋlaa wia ra ɛɛ la.

ref: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
text: Ii ra yir iihinaa bolzennaniinanii hina, di dɛlli mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la ni. N sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ.

ref: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
text: N faa bagli wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛu. Kakpaŋ, n gil a ɛɛ.

ref: And I told you these things, so that when they happened you would not say, “The idols we worship did this.”
text: Awiarɛ n feli ŋɔ ii be, wia naa faala maa mɔɔ ka a wa ɛɛ la, n sii a wiarɛ. Ii wàá ka wer ŋɔ lugɔ ii vugaa gillɛ guŋ ɛɛ, ii vuga la n ɛɛ lugbia ni daazi la.

ref: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
text: Ii nuu n wiŋɔɔlaarɛ, di kaa naa aŋ ɛɛwɛ. Ii wàá sɛɛ dí wibiireaa? Filaŋkeŋ, n daŋ ŋɔ wifalaa tɛɛ ia, wisuahlaa la iiŋ haa waa nuuwɛ.

ref: Today I am doing something new, something you cannot say you have heard before.
text: Miŋ ta a widizi, a waa birgee. Di zinaa lɛi, ii haa waa a wia nuuwɛ ŋmɛnɛ maa. Awia, ii wàá wer ŋɔ, ‘Ɛɛh, yaa zumaabuu.’

ref: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
text: Akai, ii waa wiimaa nuuwɛ, ii waa wiimaa ge gba zummɛ, ii waa felee nuu a wia saŋa maa. N zum ii wiarɛ lugɔ ii ɛɛ sɔsɔgɔ hinaa, di ɛɛ dignikpega hina lii saŋa la baŋ lul ia la maa.

ref: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
text: Minna nyiŋŋi nɛra chɔli n sɔŋ wia, n di kanyittii, maa sɛɛwɛ n kpa baaŋ chɔgi ia di dim ii dee maa.

ref: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
text: N du iabuu niŋ biini, ka a waa lugɔ gunla baŋ ɔɔ du saliŋhuŋŋa niŋ biini, u doŋa lii la. N kpa tɔɔrɔɔrɛ ɛɛ ia na.

ref: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi himmaa wiarɛ n ɛɛ guŋ. A dɛkkɔ n sɔŋ n chɔkkɛɛ? Màá gil kundumazi na girme la nɛra n niŋ vii tɛŋ.” Izrɛl hina n na bahinaa wia

ref: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina miŋ lizɛɛ di tɛɛ n hiŋ la, ií ra nuu n be! N bɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi. Minuu lugli, minuu tuna.

ref: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
text: Minuu chiŋŋi hɛri naa zɛɛ, n fɔŋŋaa n kpa yaa chiŋ. Di n wa yiraa, a maa ɔɔ bau kakpaŋ.

ref: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
text: Ií maa chaali di waa nuu! Vug bɛliirɛ ŋmɛnɛ haa ŋɔ keŋ wia naanɛi? Baal la min lizɛɛ lugɔ ú ɛɛ n kipar di lɔ Babilɔn laal la daŋ ɛɛ guŋ.

ref: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
text: N himmaanii ŋɔ u wia, minuu yiruu, minuu ba u ni. Awia, wiimaa waa hoo ú tɔu ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
text: Ií tuzi heliŋ di nuu wia la min niŋ ŋɔ, di lii lugli la maa, n haa waa wiimaa ŋɔwɛɛ suah. Wii la maa n ɛɛwɛ, n du denii ka u ɛɛ.” Filaŋkeŋ, Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu hum n ni u Duma.

ref: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi, ii Lɛɛri, Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la ŋɔ, “Minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum, unla n na bagli ia wia la n wesse tɛɛ ia, di ra bagli ia ŋmɛnizi la iin ninna hiŋ.

ref: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
text: Di ii faa ra hiŋ n nuuzi labuu, ii daŋ faa dɔɔ bɔsɔna lugɔ muu n suwee di ra pal guŋ sɛlɛlɛlɛ. Ií wideŋlaa ge daŋ faa ɛɛ lugɔ muuzeŋ n na lɔ.

ref: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
text: Ii naanna daŋ faa ɛɛ lugɔ hɛɛhriichaa, ii biizi du kpil alugɔ hɛɛhriichaa. Ií dɔma ŋmɛnɛ maa faa wàá chɔgi baa, bá sɔŋ dim.”

ref: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
text: Ií lii Babilɔn! Ií chɔ lii Babilɔn hina be! Ií sii guŋ, di chaasi ni bɔsɔna! Ií gil durnya hina maa nuu guŋ! Ií ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi lɛɛ u balii Izrɛl labuu.”

ref: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
text: Banla uŋ faa kpoglee ga hɛribɔduma la, niinyɔgzi faa waa baa kpuwɛɛ. U faa gillɔɔ nii pal lii bii ni. U faa peri a biirɛ, nii pozi lii.

ref: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Biinikpola hina waa, ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá dɔɔ bɔsɔna.”

ref: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
text: Muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛssi, ií maa ra nuu n be, ii banla maa n du bɔɔnɛɛzi, ií maa ra nuu! Kɔraawiizi yirimbuu, di n haa du n maa hia. U dau n sɔnnɛ mɔɔ ka ba luliŋ.

ref: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
text: U gillɔɔ n nua wiŋɔzi ɛɛ lugɔ tokobidiilii. U kpa u noniire tɔ n ni. U kuarimbuu lugɔ baŋ sazi hobii, bá tau la.

ref: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
text: U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ tɛŋ, “Izrɛl, i ɛɛ n baliirɛ, i benii ń ga na girme.”

ref: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
text: Ka n ŋɔ, “N wiɛɛlaa maa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ. N kuuhwɔɔ pɛɛ, tɔna maa waa liwɛɛ. Ama, n gil a maanii tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di kaa yardi ge lugɔ n kinturgaa du u benii.”

ref: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
text: Ka filaŋkeŋ, Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wiarɛ tɛŋ. Waabuu maŋ, di n haa du n maa hia, ń wa ɛɛ u balii, ú gil n bir Izrɛl hina maa, di ba u be, bá wa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ. N na girme Kɔraawiizi be, n fɔŋŋa lii u benii.

ref: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
text: U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N balii, n dɔɔ wizenne ń tɛi. A waa lugɔ Izrɛl hina la n kawɛɛ bɛnnɛ, n lizii í lɛɛ, dí gil ba bir dɔɔ sɔŋ la baŋ faa dɔɔwɛ la. N daŋ gil i ɛɛ lugɔ bɔchaaŋ hɛssi hina maa be, guŋ gil durnya hina maa na lɛɛi.”

ref: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
text: Izrɛl Lɛɛri ni ba Dɔɔrinaniinanii Kɔraawiizi la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ di ra tɛɛ unla hɛssi hina maa n na gbɛlli, di vɛɛu ta, u ɛɛ koora maa balii la, “Koora daŋ nai di izi chi, kooribiizi nai di ra tognii. A maa daŋ ɛɛ dikuu Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la wia n dɔɔ wibii, u lizii la wia.” Izrɛl hina bir kuari sogaa wia

ref: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N nuuwɔɔ tɛɛ ia, saŋa la miŋ suŋ ii ni la, di hiini ia ii na lɛɛi la. N daŋ binni ia di guu ia, di ga ii ni, n ni nɛra maa ɛɛ nuukpaŋ. N daŋ kaa gil ii bir la ga so ii hɛri la baŋ chɔkkɛ la, di bir ga dɔɔ ii kapɛttɛ hɛssi iiŋ gillɛ ta la.

ref: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
text: Di ŋɔ banla baŋ tɔ diini be, ‘Ií wa lii!’ Ii banla ge n du bɔbiri biini, ‘Ií wa lii bɔchaaŋ!’ Ba daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ peeza, di ra di ŋmɛnikɛraa, di kaa na diwee ge giŋgimee n faa waa kummaa dɔɔwɛ a nyuuni.

ref: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
text: Lɔzi ni niinyɔgzi ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka kpu baa, hɛribɔduma wiliŋ ni wiinyɛgii wàá ka kpu baa. Unla n na ba sinyɛna la daŋ tɔ ba see, di ra la bulli bɔra.

ref: I will level the mountains and make roads.
text: N daŋ bul n bizenaa maa, á birgi ŋmɛnizi, di dau ŋmɛnizenaa.

ref: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
text: Na! N nɛra daŋ lii bɔɔnɛɛ ba, baŋhina lii wiicholii ni wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag, baŋhina ge lii Aswan ba.”

ref: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
text: Chiŋ ni hɛri, ií ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna! Bizenaa, ií ra yir yira! Kɔraawiizi daŋ du u nɛra bɔkpega, di ra suŋ banla n na di dɔgnya ni.

ref: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina faa ra ŋɔu, “Kɔraawiizi gil yaabuu ta, Kɔraawiizi suuh yaa wiarɛ.”

ref: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Haaŋ daŋ wer suuh u bie la n na ɔzi wiaa? Gɛɛ di vɛɛ u biilullii sinyɛna naiyaa? Haali di guŋ daŋ ɛɛ gba, ka miŋwaa wàá suuh ii wia!

ref: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
text: Na, n sɛbi Jɛrusalɛm sɔnnɛ dau n nopaala ni. I wia du n bampiriire saŋa maa.

ref: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
text: Nɛra la n niŋ bir mai la, ra yali siweere bá bir ba, banla waa n purii la daŋ kaali.

ref: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
text: Lalli i nyuu binni kɛraa na, i nɛra maanii chaalɛɛ di ra ba i be. Miŋ du de saŋa maa wia, ba daŋ du i be di gil i du wer alugɔ hiŋ du nonibisiga gɛɛ haŋfalii n bɔkkɛ.

ref: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
text: Haali i dɔma n faa purii, i hɛri maa chɔgi, di birgi diŋgela la, filaŋkeŋ i daŋ bir du jiga, i nɛra maa wàá na bɔr so, ka i dɔma la n purii la, chɔ kaali bɔɔnɛɛ.

ref: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
text: Biizi la baŋ lullɛ i dɔgnya dii saŋa, danna ŋɔ i be, ‘Bɔr naa fattɔɔ, nyiŋŋi bɔr tɛɛ yaa.’

ref: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
text: I daŋ bir pɛɛzi i hiŋ, ‘Anɛɛ n lul biizi naa tɛnnɛi? N biizi maa faa siuzɔɔrɛ, ka ka n bɛŋ. Ba lawiŋ yom kaali hɛrduma bɛl. Ka anɛɛ n jaa dɛɛzi banniinɛi? N bɛnnɛ faa kawɛɛ, ka lee bannii ge kaa liiyɛi?’ ”

ref: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la kaa ŋɔ, “Na, n daŋ kamzi banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la, di lalli n tuuta bagli nɛra, ba daŋ kpa i biibaala pɛgli, di kpa i biihaana ge sagzi ba baŋaazi di wa tɛi.

ref: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
text: Koora daŋ ɛɛ ii mɛɛwaa, wichezi ɛɛ ii maawaa. Ba daŋ ɔɔ giŋŋi ii sezi, di ra lenni ii naazi. Denii ii jaa zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi. Banla maa n yardiŋ ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá di hiihzi.”

ref: But the Lord has promised to fight on our side and to rescue our children from those strong and violent enemies.
text: Ama, kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Laallɔɔri kuŋfoozaa ni biinikpola hina yoma daŋ lii ba nonee biini. N daŋ naa banla ni ia n na naa la, ń lɛɛ ii biizi ta.

ref: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
text: N daŋ gil i dɔma la bir di ra hee dɔŋa, di ra nyɔɔ ba himmaa challi di dɛɛzi alugɔ baŋ nyɔɔ siŋkpega. Denii durnya nɛra maa jaa zum lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii i Lɛɛri, di gil ii dɔɔ iihinaa, di kaa ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la Jekɔb n na hum la.”

ref: The Lord says, “Children, I didn't divorce your mother or sell you to pay debts; I divorced her and sold you because of your sins.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Lee hahvɛɛri hɔŋ la miŋ kpawɛɛ vɛɛ ii maa duɛi? Gɛɛ n kpa iabuu turgi kimaa? Akai! Ii himmaa wichɔgaa wiarɛ ii birgi yoma. Ii wichɔgaa wiarɛ n faa vɛɛ ii maa.

ref: I came and called out, but you didn't answer. Have I lost my power to rescue and save? At my command oceans and rivers turn into deserts; fish rot and stink for lack of water.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ nɛr maa faa waa hoo de, saŋa la miŋ ballɛ lai? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ nɛr maa faa waa n yiraa sɛɛwɛi? N nonii siuwɔɔ, màá wer lɛɛ ia gɛɛ? Gɛɛ maa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ min niŋ wer lɛɛ iai? Ií na, n daŋ wer ŋɔ wikpaŋ, ka muuzeŋ hiihzi, gɛɛ di gil muuni hiihzi, a biine nyinni siu, di pɔɔh.

ref: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
text: N daŋ wer gil chiŋ biri, di gil u ɛɛ lugɔ lubol.”

ref: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la baglimbuu gunla min niŋ ŋɔ, di du nɛra la bɔra n huahwɛ bɔkpega. Chɔɔzi maa, u ɔɔ lallimbuu, di pilli n digna n na nuu wia nɛnnɛ alugɔ balii la unna bagli wia.

ref: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la pilli n dignaa, n sɛɛ tɛu, maa vɛɛwɛ.

ref: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
text: N bir n hattɛ tɛɛ nɛra ba viiriŋ, di bir n taŋhuna tɛɛ nɛra ba kpuzaa. Maa n siwee kpawɛɛ suah banla n na ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ, di puuzi nuuhaari di ra du n ni la ni.

ref: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ra hiinimbuu, awia, màá di hiihzi. N ɛɛ siryaa nɛnnɛ, dikuu miŋ zummɛ lugɔ màá di hiihzi wia.

ref: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu ra hiiniŋ! Anɛɛ n niŋ kur ka ŋɔ n cholloowei? Ba maanii ra mɔɔri alugɔ wɛjɛ, chau n mugzɛɛ.

ref: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
text: Ii biini u bɛliirɛ ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi, di ra nuu u balii wiŋɔzɛi? Gil unla n na vol bɔbiri biini, ka waa niŋ dɔɔwɛ, yardi Kɔraawiizi, di dɛlli u ni.

ref: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
text: Too, ii banla maa n kpogli fintinazi ni kacheela, ií ra vol a nine ii himmaa n choŋŋee la bɔchaaŋ. Ama, kenne ii na lii n be. Ii daŋ chɔɔ di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ werge.

ref: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
text: Ií ra liizi ii naabaal Abraham ni Saara la n lul ia wia. Abraham faa ɛɛ u bɛnnɛ, ka n yiruu, di kissuu, di gil u dee wazi werge maa.

ref: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
text: Wibii maa, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ kaa tig Jɛrusalɛm hina bampiree, di suŋ u diŋgelli la ni. N daŋ gil u hɛribɔdumazi du alugɔ Ɛdɛn kambol, u du lugɔ Kɔraawiizi kambol. Bɔsɔna ni bampirsɔna daŋ du de, ba ra yir yirsuma di ra chɔliŋ.

ref: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
text: N nɛra, ií ra nuu n be! N hɛri hina, ií ra nuu! N daŋ du Gbɔgni, nɛ́ra ra hiŋaa, n wibii dii ge ɛɛ bɔchaaŋ tɛɛ hɛssi hina maa.

ref: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
text: N wideŋlaa ra dugluu, n nɛlɛɛi saŋa ra hel. N daŋ di kora hɛssi hina maa ni, ni wibii. Muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛssi hina maa ra kpaŋ n balaarɛ, di dɔɔ n tamii lugɔ n daŋ lɛɛ baa.

ref: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
text: Ií lalli ii nyuuni binni chiŋ, di kaa binni hɛri ge. A chiŋ daŋ leu kakpaŋ alugɔ nyɔɔzi, hɛri ge mɔɔri alugɔ wɛjɛbinii, u nɛra siuzi alugɔ nakɛɛhzi. Ama, n nɛlɛɛi la waa daŋ haŋ du denii di hanna la, n wideŋlaa ge waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
text: Ií ra nuu n be, ii banla n zum wideŋlaa, n Gbɔg du ii bampiree la! Ií gilɛɛ kaa ra ɔm nɛra la n na chagzi ia. Ií gilɛɛ gil ii banchulli ra lɔ dikuu banna chɔgi ii sɔna wia.

ref: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
text: Ba wia daŋ tuŋ lugɔ chau n mugzi wɛjɛ, gɛɛ sandule n di gonni. Ama, n wideŋlaa lawaa daŋ du de di hanna la, n nɛlɛɛi la ge du de jimini maa.”

ref: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, izi chiŋ di bagli i fɔŋŋa gunla hiŋ faa ɛɛwɛ faala la. Hiŋ lɛi faa tɔɔh muuzeŋ biini sechɔgii Rahab n chummɛ werge di mɔnnuu laa?

ref: Didn't you dry up the deep sea and make a road for your people to follow safely across?
text: Hiŋ lɛi faa gillɛ muuzeŋ la n luŋŋe werge nii hiihzi, di dau ŋmɛnihilii u baaŋ, i nɛra la hiŋ lɛɛwɛ lii tɔɔrɔɔ biini gi laa?

ref: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
text: Awia, banla hiŋ turgi ba kim, di lɛɛ baa ha la, daŋ bir ba. Ba daŋ bir ba Bolzeŋ Ziɔn di ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna. Ba daŋ dɔɔ bɔsɔna la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ. Ba daŋ dɔɔ bampirsɔna, ka biinichɔg ni himaawaa chɔ lii ba be, saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Minuu ra tig ii bampiree. Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii kaa ra ɔm neweai, ba biibaala n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ kooreei?

ref: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
text: Ii suuh Kɔraawiizi la n ta ia la wiarɛ. Waabuu yaa chiŋ di chiŋŋi hɛri zɛɛ. Ɛrɛɛ ii gil ii bɔra ra sa hɔpizi biimaa, ɔnsii lau ia dikuu nɛra la n na sunni ia baaŋfuuih, banla n na nyiŋŋi ii chɔgaa wiai? Lee a nesunne baaŋfuuihchɔgii la duɛi?

ref: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
text: A ka tama banla n na di dɔgnya nɛra tɔi diini biine, na bahinaa. Ba wàá siuzi a diini biine, gɛɛ di nyaa diwee.

ref: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
text: Minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum, unla n ɔɔ ra koozi muuzeŋ, u nii ra lɔ di ra kɔɔ werge maa la. N sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ.

ref: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
text: Minuu kpa n wiŋɔzi du ii nuuzi, di kpa nonii tɔ ii ni. Minuu ta chiŋ, di chiŋŋi hɛri zɛɛ, di ŋɔ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina be, ‘Iabuu n nɛra.’ ” Jɛrusalɛm hina dɔgnya dii tunaa wia

ref: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
text: Jɛrusalɛm, izi dɔɔ! Izi chi chiŋ! I nyɔɔ Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuih libee biini kunaa alugɔ siŋ di ra jiŋli. A tɔɔrɔɔ ni dɔgnya libee la maanii i nyɔɔ, kpɛlɛŋŋ.

ref: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
text: Biibaala la maa hiŋ lullɛ, di dɛɛzi baa la, bɛl maa waa kaa ka ú lau i nonii di baglii ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: You have been destroyed by war and by famine; I cannot comfort you.
text: Tɔɔrɔɔ werge bunɛɛrɛ huuzii, anɛɛ n niŋ wer tig i bampiriiyei? A tɔɔrɔɔzii, chɔgaa, lɔchɔgii ani laal. Anɛɛ n niŋ wer tig i bampiriiyei?

ref: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
text: I biibaala maanii huahgɛɛ chɔɔgi a bol ŋmɛnikɛraa lugɔ sidɛɛ n lau wiluu. Kɔraawiizi baannɛ fuuh ba ni, u hau ba ni gunla.

ref: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
text: Awia, hinla n na di dɔgnya, a nuu, i dɛɛzɔɔrɛ, ka haa siŋ nyɔɔwɛ!

ref: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, di ɛɛ u nɛra Guuri, i ra humuu la ŋɔ, “Na, n na lɛɛ dɔgnya libee la n gillɛ i ra jiŋli labuu, di ra lii i nonee biini. I ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka nyɔɔ lii n baaŋfuuih libee hiŋ biini.

ref: Instead I will give it to your brutal enemies, who treated you like dirt and walked all over you.”
text: N daŋ jaa kpau tɛɛ banla n faa ra sunnii, di ɔɔ ŋɔ i be, ‘Chɔɔ hɛri ya ra vol i ni.’ I chɔɔ pi ba ra vol i ni alugɔ ŋmɛnɛɛ la.”

ref: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
text: Bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm, izi chiŋ! Izi bagli i fɔŋŋa! Bolzennaniinanii Jɛrusalɛm, kpa i laala la n wesse di bɔg. Nɛra la n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ di doŋ, wàá ka zuu i biini maa.

ref: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
text: Jɛrusalɛm, izi di zigli i nyɔɔ la ta, ka ga so i koorikara ni. Jɛrusalɛm, baŋ tɔi dia, chaahzi yɔlɔzi la n vɔɔzi i baŋaa la.

ref: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ, “Ba faa yooibuu ka ba waa kummaa lɛɛwɛ, ba wàá turgi kummaa ka bir lɛɛi.”

ref: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ, “N nɛra faa ga sogo Ijip hɛrii. Denii Asiiria hina faa wa sunni baa.

ref: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
text: Bɛɛ n dɔɔ bɔnnaa filaŋkennei? Dikuu baŋ lauri n nɛra pɛɛpɛɛ di kaali wia, banla n na di kora ba ni ɔɔ ra ɛɛ baabuu chɛɛtɛ, di ɔɔ ra gbɛlli n sɔŋ hɔpizi biimaa.

ref: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
text: Dikuu guŋ wia, n daŋ gil n nɛra zum n sɔŋ. A saŋa n niŋ wa hel, ba daŋ jaa zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi. Minuu ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
text: Na gunla nɛra la n ɔɔ ra vol bizenaa nyuuni, di ra lizi amaniyesuma la naazi n wesse, banla n na sii bampirsɔna wia, banla n na ŋɔ winanaa, banla n na sii nɛlɛɛi wia, banla n ŋɔ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn be, “Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la di koraa.”

ref: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
text: Ií ra nuu! Nɛra la n na du i tau la ra chaasuu, di ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna. Di Kɔraawiizi wa bittɔ ba Bolzeŋ Ziɔn, ba himmaa daŋ nau.

ref: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
text: Jɛrusalɛm diŋgelli, ií maa ra yir yira ni bɔsɔna! Kɔraawiizi tig u nɛra bampireere, u mɔgli Jɛrusalɛmnɛ.

ref: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ bagli u fɔŋŋananiinanii la, hɛssi hina maa na, hɛri tuna hina maa na Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la nɛlɛɛi.

ref: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
text: Awia, ií lii de, ií lii de! Ií gilɛɛ waa gbɔgzi kundoŋ maa. Ii banla n chigɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia hɛnni la, ií lii de, di ɛɛ nɛnanaa.

ref: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
text: Ka ií gilɛɛ waa yali siwee di ra lii de, gɛɛ di waa chɔ dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɔ ii see. Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la, daŋ tɔ ii har. Balii la n na di dɔgnya wia

ref: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Na, n balii danna ɛɛ nunzuma wia, ba daŋ lalluu chiŋ, di ra tɔgzuu werge.

ref: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
text: A faa tir nɛkpila maanii, baŋ wa nau, gunla u duula n faa bittɛ chum, waa kaa li newee gba.

ref: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
text: Gunnɛ ú wia tir hɛrkpila maa hina, koorizenaa nuuzi kpu. Anla baŋ faa waa ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ baa la, ba daŋ naa, anla ge baŋ faa waa nuuwɛ, ba daŋ zum a zɛɛ.”

ref: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
text: Denii nɛra la ŋɔ, “Anɛɛ n yardi yaa amaniye, anɛɛ n na Kɔraawiizi banonii lai?

ref: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
text: Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ u balii hel u be alugɔ daapɔl n futtɛ lugɔ lunni n lii hɛrhilii. U faa waa bunɔɔŋ ɛɛwɛ, waa kaa dɔɔ girme ge ya ra kɛlli u ni, gɛɛ u duula ge gil ú wia ra par yaa.

ref: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
text: Nɛra binnuubuu pɛɛ, di vɛɛu ta. U ra di dɔgnya di zum bɔwiila wia. Nɛra ɔɔ nau di bir ba siwee ta bɔduma. Gunnɛ yaa ge gba binnuu pɛɛ, yaa wɔɔ ra tɔgzi.

ref: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.
text: Wibii maa, u lizi yaa gɛrga ni yaa biinichɔgrɛ yaa ni. Ka yaa fɛwɔɔrɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizii ra tɔɔruu, di gil u di a dɔgnya.

ref: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
text: Ka yaa waa zummɛ lugɔ yaa dignikpega wiarɛ ba duu pira, di lɔɔzuu dikuu yaa wichɔgaa wia. Waabuu na dignitɛraa la n gillɛ yaa dɔɔ alaanfia, pira la baŋ duu wiarɛ yaa nyaagi.

ref: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
text: Yaa maa leuzoore alugɔ peeza, bɛl maa kpa u kipar ŋmɛnɛɛ. Waabuu Kɔraawiizi gil u turgi yaa bɛl maa wichɔgaa kim.

ref: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
text: Ba tɔɔruubuu di sunnuu werge maa, ka waa u nua haawɛ. U siigɔɔrɛ lugɔ peezi baŋ tɛrgɛɛ ra la bá ga kpu gɛɛ peezi n chigɛ banla n na fuŋ u huna see.

ref: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
text: Ba tɔɔruubuu di diu seriya, ka kpuu. Anɛɛ n niŋ kaa wer ŋɔ u naanna wiai? Ba lizuubuu nɛnyinee biini. N nɛra wichɔgaa wiarɛ ba kpuu.

ref: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
text: U ni wichɔgɛɛra ni dɔɔna maanii ba kpau hug, haali uŋ waa wichɔgii maa ɛɛwɛ, u wiŋɔzi waa daraa maa dɔɔwɛ gba.”

ref: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ama, a faa parimbuu lugɔ ú di tɔɔrɔɔ di siu. N kpaubuu lizi bilchɔg mbusu. Uŋ wette ɛɛ gunla, u daŋ dɔɔ dee, ú miibɔɔ du jaŋ. N daŋ ga u be di na n kipar.

ref: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
text: Di u wa di a dɔgnya naa maa wa tuŋ, u daŋ bir na miibɔɔ, di zum lugɔ wia la uŋ ɛɛwɛ la dɔɔ tɔnaa. N balii hiŋ wia n deŋlee la, u daŋ gil nɛkpila maa ge wia deŋli n be, dikuu uŋ siuwɛ turgi ba wichɔgaa kim wia.

ref: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
text: Awia, n daŋ tɛu sɔŋ nɛzenaa biini, u daŋ dɔɔ girme dikuu uŋ kpa u hiŋ tɛɛ siu, di sɛɛ ba kpuu, dikuu uŋ du wichɔgɛɛra biini la wia. U turgi nɛkpila wichɔgaa kinnɛ di suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi, ú gil ba wichɔgaa tɛɛ baa.”

ref: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Hahbara, a yir yira ni bɔsɔna! A yir werge ni bɔsɔna, hinla hilula ŋmɛnɛ maa n haa wɛɛ lɔwɛɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, haaŋ la u jaari n faa vɛɛwɛ la, daŋ haa lul biizi kaali unla n haa du u jaari dia.

ref: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
text: I daŋ yaa di la i nodig ni i nomɛɛl keŋkerezi maa. I naanna daŋ bir lɛɛ hɛssi la i dɔma n faa foozee la, di bir ga so bolzenaa la maa n chɔɔ diŋgelli la.

ref: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
text: Gilɛɛ ra ɔm. Hàá ka di hiihzi ŋmɛnɛ maa. Gilɛɛ ra ɔm, nɛr maa ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka ŋmaabii. I daŋ suuh i bichalli saŋa hiihzi la. I ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka liizi girme la hiŋ faa nyaawɛ, i luhanni saŋa la.

ref: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
text: I Taari ɛɛ i jaarii. Waabuu Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la. Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii labuu ɛɛ i Lɛɛri. Waabuu ba ra hum durnya maa biini la.

ref: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ bir yirii, í ba u be, gunla baal n ɔɔ vɛɛ u bichalhaaŋ, u biini chɔgi werge, u bir yiruu la.” Gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la ŋɔ.

ref: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
text: “N faa vɛɛibuu tama, ka miŋ na i sinyɛna werge wia, n daŋ bir kpai.

ref: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
text: Baaŋfuuih faa gillɔɔ n lizi n siwee i ni tama guŋ, ka n nɔŋŋaa n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ wia, n daŋ bir na i sinyɛnaa. Mìŋ́ i Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
text: Gunla miŋ faa ŋɔ nua, Noowa saŋa la lugɔ nii ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka chɔgi durnya la, guŋ dɔnnɛ niŋ kaa ɛɛ. N kaa hɛɛhzuu di ra ŋɔ lugɔ n baaŋ ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka fuuh i ni, ń kaa tɛr i digni.

ref: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
text: Haali bizenaa n niŋ zigli, giŋgimee ge izi, ka n nɔŋŋaa lawaa ŋmɛnɛ maa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ i be, n nii bampirsɔna nuukpaŋ la ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá tuŋ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n suŋ i ni labuu ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
text: Jɛrusalɛm, tɔɔrɔɔ n wɛɛ ra gil, pechɔgaa ge ra ta i ni, nɛr maa waa i bampirii ra tig la, na, n daŋ kpa binanaa la yoola n kpolle chiŋŋi i zɛɛ, di bir mai.

ref: Your fortresses will be built of rubies, your gates of jewels, and your walls of gems.
text: N daŋ kpa rubizi ma i diini la n jaŋŋɛ di la chiŋ, di kpa binyɛgzaa kuari i dominuuzenaa, di kpa binanaa la yoola n kpolle ma i koŋlaa.

ref: I will teach your children and make them successful.
text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii niŋ bagli i biibaala wia, bá dɔɔ bampirsɔna werge maa.

ref: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
text: Wideŋlaa daŋ gil i wer chi nɛnnɛ, i dɔma wàá ka ra firii, ɔnsii werge maa wàá ka duglii, i ra ɔm wiimaa.

ref: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
text: Di nɛr maa daŋ kaa wa fɔɔi ni laal, amɔ, miŋ lɛi gillɛ guŋ ɛɛ. Nɛr la maa ge n niŋ wa fɔɔi ni laal, i daŋ kpegluu.

ref: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
text: Minuu ta luuri n ɔɔ viu niŋ u mazi, u luu dɔŋkuŋ n dɛg u huma humaa, di kaa ta laallɔɔri u kpa a dɔŋkuŋ di ra kpu.

ref: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
text: Dɔŋkuŋ maa waa hoo, bá wer kpau kpeglii. Di ba kpa doŋa chugii, i daŋ ɔɔ wer di baa wibii, bá chol. Kɔraawiizi balaa tɔnaa guŋ, ba bilii dɔɔi lii n benii. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ii banla maa niinyɔgzi n na kpu, ií ba wa nyɔɔ nii. Haali di ii waa kebee dɔɔwɛ gba, ka ií ba di wa yau diwee di. Ií ba di wa yau siŋ ni nail pɛɛpɛɛ, a waa kim dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra di kebee kuna la n wàá wer piŋ ia ninɛi? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra kuuh kuna la n wàá wer hiini ia ninɛi? Ií ra nuu n be nɛnnɛ, di wer na diunanaa ra di, ii bɔra sɔɔni ia.

ref: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
text: Na, n gillɔɔ u ɛɛ n daansɛɛ hiŋ tɛɛ hɛssi hina, di kaa ɛɛ ba sitɔɔri ni ba nabɔma.

ref: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
text: Wibii, i daŋ yir hɛssi hina bá chaali i be di lii hɛssi la hiŋ waa zummɛ. Hɛssi hina la ge n wɛɛ zummɛ daŋ hahzi ba, di wa nuu wia lii i be. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la, n ɛɛ Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii wiarɛ bá ba i be, dikuu miŋ gillɛ i dɔɔ girme wia.”

ref: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
text: Aah siwii di ra nyiŋŋi Kɔraawiizi bɔr saŋa naa hin niŋ haa wer nau naa! A yiruu di u haa duglɔɔ.

ref: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
text: Gil biinikpola hiŋ gil u ŋmɛnɛɛ la, nɛchuma ge gil u nfɛrchɔgaa la. Gil u bir ba Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la be, ú suŋ u ni. U gil nɛra wichɔgaarɛ di ra tɛɛ baa.

ref: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Gunla iinna fɛ, guŋ lɛi n na fɛ, ii ŋmɛnizi ge waa n ŋmɛnizi ɛɛwɛ.

ref: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
text: Gunla chiŋ n la chiŋ kaali hɛri la, gunnɛ n ŋmɛnizi kaali ii hora, n nfɛrɛ ge kaali ii hora.

ref: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
text: Gunla dooŋ ni sɔsɔŋ n ɔɔ lii chiŋ chol hɛri, a waa ɔɔ kaa bir la de, ka gil hɛri pɛssi di lii kundee, a hel di du bee tɛɛ a duuri, di kaa lii diwee tɛɛ a diiri la,

ref: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
text: gunnɛ wiŋɔɔlii la maa n niŋ lii n nua, wàá ka bir ba n be pɛɛ, di waa n kipar ni wia la miŋ ŋɔ ú ga ɛɛ la ɛɛwɛ.

ref: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
text: Nɛra daŋ tɔ ii see ii ra lii ni bɔsɔna, bampirsɔna ge du ii be. Bizenaa ni giŋgimee daŋ lau a hina huhzi, ka ra yir bɔsɔna yira, daazi maa ge ra lɔ kpaa ii see.

ref: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
text: Daananaa daŋ lɛɛ sɔɔhri bɔr lii, mɛrtil daazi lɛɛ choŋgolli bɔr lii. Guŋ daŋ ɛɛ girme werge tɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi, di kaa ɛɛ daansɛɛ la n niŋ du de saŋaa saŋa maa, waa chɔgaa dɔɔwɛ.”

ref: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u nɛra benii, “Ií ra hiŋ wideŋlaa ni wibii ŋmɛnizi. N daŋ ba manaŋ di wa lɛɛ ia, nɛ́ra maa na gunla n nɛlɛɛi n duwɛɛ.

ref: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
text: Nɛr la maa n ɛɛ hɔɔhri Izrɛl hina biini, ka wa jaa ba ni di ra jaami Kɔraawiizi, ú gilɛɛ waa ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi daŋ bargiŋ lii u nɛra biini, wibii maa.” Gɛɛ baal la maa baŋ varɛɛ waa ŋɔ, “Na, miŋwaa ɛɛ daakɔɔllɛ.”

ref: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Banla maa baŋ varɛɛ ka ba ra tɔgzi n Heezaa Hɔpizii la, di kaa ra ɛɛ n kipar wia, di ra sɛɛ n ni nɛra nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la nɛnnɛ,

ref: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
text: n daŋ tɛɛ baa bɔr n Dia la banna jaamiŋ biini, á ɛɛ liize ni sɔŋ di kaali ban niŋ faa lul biibaala ni biihaana. N daŋ tɛɛ baa sɔŋ la n niŋ du de di hanna la, u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá dinzi.

ref: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
text: Hɔɔhra la n kpa bahinaa tɛŋ, di ra hum n bɛŋ, di nɔŋŋiŋ, di ra jaamiŋ, di ra tɔgzi n Heezaa Hɔpizii la, ba waa n kiizi ra chɔgi, ka sɛɛ n ni n nɛra nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la wia nɛnnɛ,

ref: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
text: n daŋ kpogli baa ba n Bizennaniinanii Ziɔn nyuu, di wa gil ba dɔɔ bɔsɔna n Dia la biini. N daŋ lɛɛ ba mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa ni ba mbusuzi lizaa kuna n mbusu lizibɔr la ni. Ba daŋ yir n Dia wiijaami Dia, hɛssi hina maa wer zuu de di ra jaamiŋ.”

ref: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la, unla n chaali Izrɛl hina la baŋ laurɛɛ kaali hɛrdumazi la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ haa chaali baŋhina di wa jaa banla miŋ teŋ chaalɛɛ la ni.” Kɔraawiizi n kpa wia sag biinikpola hina ni wia

ref: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
text: Pir sela, ií maa ba! Kɔr biini sela, ií maa ba wa lauri baa di!

ref: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
text: Izrɛl tauduura la nyuŋŋɔɔrɛ, ba waa wiimaa zummɛ. Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nuuzihina n waa wozi, ka ɔɔ chɔɔ di ra deezi, di nɔŋŋi dɔɔ chɔɔi werge maa.

ref: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
text: Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nuuzihina n na di werge, a waa piŋ. Ba kaa ɛɛu lugɔ penɔɔna n waa wia zɛɛ ra nuu. Bɛl maanii ɔɔ ra ga u bɛŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ, di ra nyiŋŋi u bɛŋ tɔna.

ref: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
text: Ba ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií ba ya nyɔɔ siŋ! Ya nyɔɔ siŋkpega werge a kukki yaa. Kɛrɛ gba daŋ dɔɔ sideŋŋa, di kaali zinaa.”

ref: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
text: Banla n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ ka siuzi daŋ dɔɔ bampirsɔna di heezi.

ref: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
text: Ka iawaa, hila, sɛnsɛnna ani tuutuuzi biizi, ií ba ɛŋ!

ref: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
text: Anɛɛ ii ra ɛɛ chɛɛtɛi, di lɛgli nuuzuŋŋa ra du u ninɛi? Ii dee lɛi ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛraa? Karkanna biizi lɛi iaa?

ref: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
text: Ii ɔɔ ra sɛmuu vugkuaribɔr daalɔɔlii maa zɛɛ, ka ɔɔ kpu ii biizi ra lizi mbusuzi bia bɔɔni n dugli walli biine.

ref: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
text: A loglogbia la n du a gɔmbɔɔluŋe labuu ii kpa birgi vuga. Aabuu ii ra tɔgzi, di yiili sinni ra taa, di lizi mbusuzi lizaa mia ra tɛɛa. Iinna ɛɛ annii naa maa, a parimbuu waa?

ref: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
text: Bizenaa nyuunii ii chɔɔribɔra, ii ra sɛm, di ɔɔ tinni de di gaa lizi ii mbusuzi.

ref: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
text: Ii chiŋŋi vugaa ii dominuuzi biine, di sagzi aŋhina ii dominuuzi daazi ni. Ii vɛɛmbuu, ka nɔŋŋi vuga lugɔ ii sɛnna, di lawaa ra sɛm. Ii ɔɔ dilgi chɔɔ ii kunchɔɔrikuna ni, di ra binni dɔŋa.

ref: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
text: Ii kpa ɔlivi nuu ni tulaalezii di la ga tɛɛ vug Mɔlɛk la ka jaamuu, di faa hum ii nabɔnzi ba la bɔɔnɛɛzi werge maa, haali di ga tuu lalaa bol gba bá nyiŋŋi vugfalaa tɛɛ ia.

ref: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
text: Ii faa kuuhwɔɔ werge di vol ra nyiŋŋi vuga, ka ii bɔra faa waa huahwɛ. Ii fɛ lugɔ ii vugkuna la miŋ kiiwe la daŋ tɛɛ ia fɔŋŋa, awia, ii waa kuuh maa.

ref: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Anɛɛ ii faa ra ɔm werge di kaaliŋ, ii waa kaa ra liizi n wiai? N faa siigi ii ninɛɛ birgi, a wia lɛi ii faa waa kaa ra ɔmiŋ?

ref: You think you're so good, but I'll point out the truth.
text: Filaŋkeŋwaa, n daŋ pilli ii wiɛɛlaa la iiŋ ŋɔ a deŋloore la ii na lugɔ a bɛl maa wàá wer hiini ia.

ref: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
text: Di ii kaa waa wii di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa, ií gil ii vuga la n bar ia la hiini ia. Peu daŋ wa kpa a maa kaali. Heeza bɛŋ gba daŋ wer kpaa kaali. Ama, nɛr la maa n yardiŋ daŋ so a hɛri, n bizennaniinanii la daŋ ɛɛ u hor.” Sisɔna hina bampirii tigaa wia

ref: The Lord says, “Clear the road! Get it ready for my people.”
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi jaa ŋɔ, “Ií kuari bɔr, ii pilli ŋmɛnɛɛ tɛɛ n nɛra! Ií ligzi kuna la maa n tɔ baa ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii dɔɔ sɔnzeŋ kaali kummaa, di du de saŋaa saŋa maa, di kaa dɔɔ sɔnnaniinanii. N du chiŋ bɔnaniinaniirɛ, di kaa du banla maa biine n chɔkkɛ dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia, ba sɔɔni siwee be, di ɔɔ ra du baa bɔkpega.

ref: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
text: Maa nyiŋŋi lugɔ saŋa maa n ɔɔ ra pag nɛra ni, gɛɛ n baaŋ ɔɔ ra fuuh ba ni saŋa maa. Di guŋ lɛi, ba daŋ chɔgi baa ba chɔɔ n be vɛlɛɛ. Minuu ta baa.

ref: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
text: N baaŋ faa fuuhwoo dikuu ba kɛkɛluu ni ba wichɔgaa wia, n tɛr ba digna di bir n har kpu baa dikuu a baaŋfuuih wia, ka ba faa vɛɛ ka haa ra hiŋ ba himmaa ŋmɛnizi.

ref: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
text: N faa na gunla ba manni n duwɛɛnɛ, ka n daŋ chaa baa di tɔ ba see, di tig banla maa biine n chɔkkɛ, ba ra wii la bampiree.

ref: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
text: Ba daŋ jaa ra chɔli mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi. Bɔsɔna du banla n duglɛɛ ni banla n du bɔɔnɛɛ maa be. N daŋ chaa baa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
text: Biinikpola hina wàá dɔɔ bɔsɔna maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií sii wia naa. Ií gilɛɛ siigi, ka lalli ii loobee lugɔ banna huuh bensunozi, di ra ŋɔ n nɛra Izrɛl hina be ba kpoŋaa ni wichɔgaa banna ɛɛ la wia.

ref: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
text: Ba ra nyiŋŋimbuu hɔpizi biimaa, di aah siwii bá zum n ŋmɛnizi, di kaa ɛɛ bahinaa lugɔ nɛra n na ɛɛ wideŋlaa, ba waa mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la nuuzi ra vɛɛ, ka guŋ lɛi. Ba ɔɔ ŋɔ n bagli baa wibii ŋmɛnizi, di kaa aah siwii lugɔ n dugli baa.

ref: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
text: Ba ɔɔ pɛɛzimbuu, ‘Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ yaa vɔɔ nuuzi ka haa guŋ nawɛɛi? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ yaa sɔɔni siwii ka i baga waa hoonei?’ Ií na, haali iiŋ ɔɔ vɔɔ nuuzi la gba, ka ii kipar wiarɛ ii ra ɛɛ, di kaa ra fini ii huŋhunna.

ref: You even get angry and ready to fight. No wonder God won't listen to your prayers!
text: Ii ɔɔ vɔɔ nuuzii ka ra ɛɛ dɔŋa wichɔgaa, di ra lɔ kalu di ra naa. Kennaa iinna vɔɔ nuuzi filaŋkennaa, ii ɛɛ tamiirɛ lugɔ n daŋ nuu ii wiisuŋŋaa?

ref: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
text: Ii ɔɔ vɔɔ nuuzii di ra tɔɔri iihinaa, di kutti willi ii nyuuni lugɔ kooree n ɔɔ willi gunla, di kpa ii gbɔglɔnzi di laali di so hɔɔhri biini. Kenne baa vɔɔ nuaa? Guŋ daŋ par mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizia?

ref: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord. Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!
text: A nuuvɔɔi naa dɔŋ lɛi ɛɛ n kipar la. N kipar nuuvɔɔirɛ lugɔ ii lizi banla baŋ kpa kara daansɛɛ di tɔ dia, di ra lɛɛ banla banna sunni, bá dɔɔ bahinaa, di chɔgi kunla maa n gillɛ nɛra ɛɛ yoma.

ref: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
text: Di tɛɛ lɔzima diwee bá di, di lɛɛ banla n waa diini dɔɔwɛ di ra dau ii diini. Di ii na nɛbɛl n na vol chakpal, ii tɛu laala ú laali, di gilɛɛ ra vɛɛ ii lulla ge hiinaa.

ref: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
text: Denii n ba wa hiini ia, ii wia chaani alugɔ bɔchaaŋ n ballɛ chɔɔzimpikke ni, denii ii na alaanfia manaŋ, ii wideŋlaa jaa tɔ ii see, n girme ge tɔ ii har di ra guu ia.

ref: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
text: Denii ii jaa wii tɛŋ, ń chɔ ii wile. Ii daŋ yiriŋ n sɛɛ, di ŋɔ, ‘Minuu keŋ.’ Di ii wa gil nɛra sunnaa, nɛzɔɔzaa, kara kannaa ani nuuseei,

ref: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
text: di ɔɔ kpu iihinaa di ra tɛɛ lɔzima diwee, di kaa ra hiini banla banna sunni ge, guŋwaa, ii daŋ ɛɛ alugɔ niŋ n na chaani bɔbiri, ii hamuŋa ge ɛɛ lugɔ wibaŋkanchirii.

ref: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɔ ii see, di ra bagli ia ŋmɛnɛɛ saŋa maa, haali di ii du hɛrhilii gba, ka n daŋ tɛɛ ia kunla maa iiŋ nyaawɛ, di tɛɛ ia fɔŋŋa. Ii daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ kambol la baŋ ɔɔ mizi nii u sɔɔni nɛnnɛ, di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ bule la n waa hiihzaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: You will rebuild those houses left in ruins for years; you will be known as a builder and repairer of city walls and streets.
text: Ii diŋgelbinaa la maanii ii nɛra bir ma, di ma hɔŋzi a diini zɛɛbinaa la ni. Ba jaa ra yir ia nɛra la n bittɛ ma ba koŋlaa. Banla n bittɛ kuari ŋmɛnizenaa ni diini.

ref: But first, you must start respecting the Sabbath as a joyful day of worship. You must stop doing and saying whatever you please on this special day.
text: Di ii waa Heezaa Hɔpizii la kiizi ra chɔg, di gil ii himmaa kipar wiɛɛlaa n hɔpizinaniinanii naa hɔl, di u wia ra par ia, u ɛɛ hɔpizinaniinanii la iinna tɔgzi, di ra vɛɛ ŋmɛnɛɛ volaa dikuu iinna tɔgzuu wia, di kaa ra vɛɛ ii himmaa ŋmɛnizi hiŋaa ni ii kipar, ni wiŋɔpɛɛri,

ref: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
text: guŋwaa, ii daŋ dɔɔ bɔsɔna, wibii maa, di lii mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi be. N daŋ jaa gil ii dɔɔ sɔŋ hɛri la miŋ ŋɔ nua lugɔ n daŋ tɛɛ ii naabaal Jekɔb la. N daŋ dɛɛzi ia nɛnnɛ de. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi labuu ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord hasn't lost his powerful strength; he can still hear and answer prayers.
text: A waa lugɔ Kɔraawiizi nonii siuwɔɔ, wàá wer lɛɛ ia. Akai! Gɛɛ a waa lugɔ u digna taŋzɔɔrɛ, waa kaa ra nuu wia nɛnnɛ.

ref: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
text: Ka ii wichɔgaarɛ gillɛ ii ni Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la bargi dɔŋa ni. Ii wichɔgaarɛ gillɛ u bir har kpu ia, waa kaa ra nuu ii be.

ref: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
text: Ii nonee ɛɛ nɛkpuura noneere, wichɔgaa gil a doŋ. Ii maa ni kara kannaa ni biinikpola wiŋɔzi bɛŋ.

ref: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.
text: Nɛr maa baga lɛi wibii dii wia, ba ra kanni kara seriya diiribɔr. Ba ɔɔ dɛlli wiŋɔpɛɛrii hɔɔzi dii biini, di ra kanni kara. Ba nfɛrchɔgaa gil ba ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa bɛŋ.

ref: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs,
text: Ba wiɛɛlaa maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ duŋkpola hala n teezee, di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ nandar kɛhkiah. Di nɛr haŋ hee a hal bɛl maa, u ra siwuu. Di bɛl maa ge kaa puri, duŋkpola ɔɔ lii u biinii.

ref: but you can't make clothes with those webs or hide behind them. You're sinful and brutal.
text: Ba wiɛɛlaa maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baŋ kpa nandar kɛhkiah suah wɛjɛ. Waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ lugɔ bá kpau tɔ. Wichɔgaa bɛnnɛ ɛɛ ba huma, ba kaa gil kalu wia ɛɛ ba siaahmu.

ref: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
text: Ba ɔɔ ra chɔu saŋa maa, bá ga ɛɛ wichɔgaa, di ɔɔ ra yali siwee, bá lɛɛ nɛra haahkɛ. Wichɔgaa bɛŋ nfɛrɛɛ ba dɔɔ. Bɔr la maa baŋ ɔɔ ga, nɛkpui ni bolpuri wia bɛnnɛ ba ɔɔ ra ɛɛ.

ref: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
text: Ba waa nuukpaŋ dɔɔi ŋmɛnɛɛ zummɛ, ba waa seriya ge ra di ni wibii. Ba wiɛɛlaa ŋmɛnizi baŋ daurɛɛ golgoore, nɛr la maa n na hiŋaa, waa bampirsɔna wia zummɛ.

ref: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
text: Awia, a nɛra ŋɔ, “Wibii ni wideŋlaa nɛɛwɔɔ yaa be. Yaa ra nyiŋŋi bɔchaaŋ ka du bɔbiri. Yaa ra nyiŋŋi ya ra vol bɔchaaŋ, ka ra vol bɔbiri werge biini.

ref: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
text: Yaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nyuŋŋa, di largi koŋlaa ra vol, di ra lɔɔzi naazi wibaŋa ni alugɔ hamuŋa. Kpeglega ge biini, yaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛsiwaa.

ref: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
text: Kɔraawiizi yaa n na hum la, yaa wichɔgaa kannɔɔ werge i be, a ɔɔ biruu di yaa daansɛɛ, yaa chol. Yaa zum a wiarɛ, di sɛɛ lugɔ yaa ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛraa.

ref: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
text: Yaa dɔɔ dignikpegaa di ra vɛɛi, di bir yaa hara kpui. Yaa ra sunni nɛra, di ra du dɔm, di kaa dɔɔ nfɛrchɔgaa ge di ra kanni kara werge maa.

ref: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
text: Yaa duŋŋi wibii dii lii yaa be, yaa ni wideŋlaa ge du nɛɛ. Wibii lɔ naarɛ yaa ŋmɛnizi, biinihuŋŋu ge waa bɔr nawɛɛ yaa be.

ref: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
text: Wibii waa kaa hoo yemmaa, guŋ wia, tɔɔrɔɔ ɔɔ huuzi nɛr la maa n na vɛɛ wichɔgaa ɛɛirɛ.” Kɔraawiizi na gunnɛ, u bɔra waa sɔɔnɛɛ, dikuu wibii dii n waa hoo wia.

ref: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
text: A tiruubuu un nawɛɛ lugɔ nɛr maa waa hoo, ú di wibii di lɛɛ nɛra la banna sunni la. Awia, u himmaa faa izi chi, di kpa u fɔŋŋa lɛɛ baa, u himmaa wideŋlaa lawuu kpogli.

ref: Justice was the Lord's armor; saving power was his helmet; anger and revenge were his clothes.
text: U kpa wideŋlaare laali alugɔ kaali, di tɔ u see ni u har, di kpa nɛlɛɛi hi alugɔ kahuro, di kpa wichɔgaa kinturgaa laali alugɔ banaaga, di kpa siaahmu laali alugɔ tagtazeŋ.

ref: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
text: U daŋ turgi u dɔma bɛl maa gunla n dɛkkɛ. U baaŋfuuih daŋ du ba ni dikuu gunla baŋ tɔɔri u nɛra la wia. Muuzenaa baana hɛssi hina maanii ú turgi gunla n dɛg baa.

ref: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
text: Nɛra la n du wiicholii ni wiifurii maa, danna ɔm Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ ni gunla u girme n duwɛɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u daŋ bau fɔŋŋa ni alugɔ nii n suwee di ra pal gbuŋgbuŋgbuŋ la.

ref: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u nɛra benii, “Mìŋ́ i Lɛɛri daŋ jaa ba Jɛrusalɛm di wa lɛɛ banla maa n gil ba wichɔgaa ta la.

ref: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
text: N ni ia nuukpannɛ keŋ, n Duma la miŋ kpawɛɛ du ii ni la daŋ du ii ni di hanna la. N wiŋɔzi ge miŋ kpawɛɛ du ii nuuzi la daŋ du ii ni ii biizi ani ii naanna nuuzi, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
text: Jɛrusalɛm, izi chiŋ, di ra chaani lugɔ wiizi. Kɔraawiizi girme ra chaani i ninɛɛ.

ref: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
text: Na! Haali bɔbiri n haa tɔ hɛri naa ni u nɛra maa ni la, ka Kɔraawiizi girme du i benii di ra chaani i ni.

ref: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
text: Hɛssi hina ni koora maa daŋ ba i bɔchaaŋ la, n na chaani i ni la biini.

ref: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
text: Lalli i nyuu chiŋ di binni na. Ba maanii chaalɛɛ di ra ba i be. Ii biibaala la lii hɛhjaŋaa di ra ba, ba kpa i biihaana genii pɛgli ra ba.

ref: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
text: Di i wa na guŋ, i bɔra daŋ sɔɔni, i bɔra ra pur. Kɔkɔɔza daŋ zuu muugbessi di chi daama ba wa tɛi, a hɛssi daama ba i be.

ref: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
text: Nyugmakpila daŋ wa su i hɛri maa. Nyugmapɔla daŋ lii Midian ni Efa hɛssi maa ba. Siiba hina maa daŋ kpogli saliŋ ni daahɛgsɔɔhsuma ba. Ba danna bagli gunla Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛwɛ, di ra chɔluu.

ref: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
text: Ba daŋ chaali Kɛda peeza maa wa tɛi. Nɛbayɔf pebala maa daŋ ɛɛ i hora di ra hiinii. Aabuu í kpa di lizi mbusu tɛŋ n mbusu lizibɔr la ni, ń lɛɛa. N daŋ jaa gil n Dia la dɔɔ girme werge maa.

ref: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
text: Bɛɛ kunaa waa kaali lugɔ baamazi gɛɛ kommazi n zaahzɛɛ ra la a daŋa naanɛi?

ref: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
text: A ɛɛ muugberzenaa n lii hɛhjaŋaa di chi Kɔraawiizi nɛra ra ba bolle. Saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋaa a chi ra ba, a wa chɔli Kɔraawiizi, Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la sɔŋ. Waabuu gillɛ hɛssi hina maa ra tɔgzi u nɛra.

ref: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Jɛrusalɛm, hɔɔhra daŋ lii hɛhjaŋa di wa bir ma i koŋlaa, ba koorizenaa ge birgi i balaa. Haali mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi baaŋ n faa fuuhwe n tɔɔrii werge la, ka n daŋ bir suŋ i ni, di na i sinyɛna.

ref: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
text: I dominuuzenaa daŋ ɔɔ pilluu saŋaa saŋa maa, a wàá tɔ hɔpizaa gɛɛ hamuŋa gba, guŋ gil hɛssi hina koora tɔ ba nɛra see di chi ba daama zuu i biini.

ref: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
text: Hɛri gɛɛ kora la maa hina n niŋ vɛɛ i dɔɔra sɛɛi, n daŋ chɔguu, ú wia tuŋ nyaamm.

ref: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
text: Lɛbanɔn girme la daŋ ba i be, ú kɔr daananaa irizi maa wa kuari n Dia, ú du wer. N daŋ gil n Dia du wer di gil n naazi chignibɔr dɔɔ girme.

ref: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
text: I dɔɔra la n faa ra sunnii la biibaala daŋ ba i be di wa giŋŋi i see. Banla ge maa n faa ra gbɛllii la daŋ giŋŋi i see. Ba danna yirii, ‘Kɔraawiizi bolnanii, Ziɔn, Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii la bol.’

ref: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
text: Jɛrusalɛm, baŋ faa vɛɛi ta, nɛr maa haih, nɛr maa waa kaa ra ga i biini di ra la ŋmɛnɛɛ la, ka filaŋkeŋ, n daŋ gil i dɔɔ sɔŋ di du wer, bɔsɔna du i biini di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
text: Hɛssi hina ni koora daŋ kpa ba daama di ba waa binni i ni nɛnnɛ, alugɔ haaŋ n na ɔzi bie. Denii i zum lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la, Jekɔb n na hum labuu, i Lɛɛri.

ref: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
text: N daŋ gil danyɛ ka tɛi saliŋ, di gil lugbia ka tɛi saliŋhuŋŋa, di kaa gil daazi ge ka tɛi danyɛ, di gil bia ka tɛi lugbia. N daŋ gil bɔsɔna ɛɛ i nabɔma, wideŋlaa ge ɛɛ i koori.

ref: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
text: Nɛr maa ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka nuu laal wia i hɛri biini, gɛɛ bolpuraa ni hɛhchɔg i hɛri biini. N daŋ guui alugɔ koŋlii, i ra chɔliŋ dikuu miŋ mɔglii wia.

ref: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
text: A waa lugɔ wiizii niŋ ɔɔ kaa ra chaanii hɔpizaa saŋa, gɛɛ baagu ra chaanii hamuŋa. Akai, Kɔraawiizii ninna chaanii, saŋaa saŋa maa. Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum labuu niŋ ɛɛ i girme.

ref: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
text: I wiizi ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka chol gɛɛ i baagu zuu biri. Akai, Kɔraawiizii ninna chaanii, saŋaa saŋa maa, i biinichɔg la jaa tuŋ.

ref: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
text: I nɛra maa wia daŋ deŋli, bá dɔɔ a hɛri naa di hanna la. Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ daa n himmaa n chɔɔzɛɛ, ú du de di ra bagli n girme.

ref: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
text: Banla maa domeezi n waa kaŋ, daŋ wazi di du kaŋ, di birgi hɛrzeŋ hina. Di a saŋa wa hello lugɔ guŋ ɛɛ, n daŋ gil guŋ ɛɛ manaŋ. Minuu Kɔraawiizi.”

ref: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la Duma izimbuu werge, dikuubɛɛwiai, u lizimbuu ń lizi amaniyesuma tɛɛ nyaara. U humimbuu ń tig banla biine n chɔkkɛ la bampiree, di ŋɔ hindɔɔi wia tɛɛ yoma ni banla baŋ tɔ dia,

ref: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
text: di ŋɔ nɛr maa be lugɔ saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n niŋ hiini baa la helloo ani u baaŋ n niŋ fuuh ú turgi ba dɔma ba kim la wia, di tig banla n na wii bampiree.

ref: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
text: Di ŋɔ bɔsɔna wia, di tig banla maa n du Ziɔn, di ra wii la bampiree, di lizi ba gbɔglɔŋ laala char bɔsɔna laala, bá wiraa birgi bɔsɔna, bá dɔgnya dii birgi chɔlaa. Ba daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ daazenaa Kɔraawiizi n chɔɔzɛɛ, bá ra ɛɛ wideŋlaa. Ba ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi, dikuu u wiɛɛlaa wia.

ref: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
text: Hɔɔhraa niŋ waa dɛɛzi ii sela, di birgi ii patta, di ra par ii grepu daazi kooni.

ref: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
text: Ba danna yir iawaa Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, ba daŋ ɔɔ bagli ii wia lugɔ ii ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi huŋhunnaa. A hɛssi la daama biinii ii ra di, di lɛɛ a maa dɔɔ.

ref: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N na nyiŋŋi seriya dii ni wibiire, ka hah foozaa ni wichɔgaa ɛɛi. Dikuu n wibii wia, n daŋ ɛɛ baa winanaa, di gil n ni baa ɛɛ nuukpaŋ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
text: Ba naanna la daŋ dɔɔ sɔŋ hɛssi maa hina be. Nɛra maanii ninna tɔgzi baa, banla ge maa n niŋ na baa daŋ sɛɛ lugɔ baabuu ɛɛ nɛra la Kɔraawiizi n kissee.”

ref: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
text: N bɔra sɔɔnimbuu werge Kɔraawiizi wia, n bɔra ra pur Kɔraawiizi la minna hum la wia. U bɔgimbuu lɛɛi bɔmbɔga, di bɔgiŋ ni wideŋlaa tagtazeŋ, alugɔ haŋfalii jaari n ɔɔ bɔg lugɔ Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ la, gɛɛ lugɔ haŋfalii n ɔɔ bɔg di du u dignikuna ni u baŋaakuna n wesse werge la.

ref: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
text: Gunla baŋ ɔɔ duu kuna bee kambol, a lii di ra hel la, gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la gil wideŋlaa ni chɔlaa lii, hɛssi maa hina na.

ref: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
text: Ziɔn, i wia, màá siigi, Jɛrusalɛm, i wia, màá siigi. Di i wideŋlaa waa haŋ waa chaani, alugɔ chɔzimpikke, i lɛɛi ge waa chaani alugɔ kacheel n na lau lɛi, màá siigi.

ref: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
text: Denii hɛssi maa hina jaa na i wideŋlaa la, koorizenaa maa ge na i girme la. Ba daŋ yirii sɔŋfalii bɛl Kɔraawiizi himmaa n niŋ tɛi.

ref: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
text: I daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ koorikahuro n wesse werge, Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la nonii biini.

ref: Your name will no longer be “Deserted and Childless,” but “Happily Married.” You will please the Lord; your country will be his bride.
text: Ŋmɛnɛ maa, ba wàá ka yirii ‘Bol la baŋ vɛɛwɛ ta’, gɛɛ di kaa yir i hɛri ‘Diŋgela’. Ka ba daŋ jaa ra yirii, ‘Hɛpziba’, di kaa yir i hɛri ‘Unla n yuuwɛ’, dikuubɛɛwiai, i wia daŋ par Kɔraawiizi, ú kpai ɛɛ u haaŋ.

ref: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
