text: Gunla biipɔllii n ɔɔ kpa toloori la, gunnɛ i taari kpai la. Too, gunla haŋfalii ge jaari bɔra n ɔɔ sɔɔni u haŋfalii wia la, gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi bɔra sɔɔni i wia.

ref: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
text: Jɛrusalɛm, n soŋŋi tauduuraa i koŋlaa nyuuni, ba ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá siigi hɔpizaa saŋa gɛɛ hamuŋa saŋa. Banna yir Kɔraawiizi di ra liizuu u nuuzi la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ baa la wia, bá gilɛɛ waa heezi.

ref: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
text: Ií gilɛɛ waa gil Kɔraawiizi ra heezi, di waa gillɛ Jɛrusalɛm bir chi nɛnnɛ, di ɛɛ durnya maa kunchɔlii.

ref: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
text: Kɔraawiizi kpa u fɔŋŋazeŋ labuu di hɛɛhzi lugɔ u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka kpa i mia gɛɛ i diwee dɛɛzi i dɔma. Hɛrduma maa hina ge ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka nyɔɔ siŋ la hiŋ kuuhwɛ na.

ref: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
text: Ka banla n niŋ ɔɔ kum a mia la, baabuu niŋ ɔɔ dia ka chɔli Kɔraawiizi. Banla ge n ɔɔ chaali grepu nɔna a wa lii siŋ la, baabuu niŋ ɔɔ nyɔɔa, Kɔraawiizi Dia diŋŋee la biini.

ref: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
text: Ií lii, ií ga dominuuzenaa la lii, di kuari ŋmɛnɛɛ tɛɛ nɛra la n bittɛ ra ba la. Ií tɔɔgi a ŋmɛnɛɛ bɔɔni, di wigzi u bia maa, ú du wer. Ií baŋ tuuta a hɛssi hina maa na.

ref: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ ra tɛɛ hɛri naa yɛmmaa hina, “Ŋɔ Ziɔn hina be lugɔ ba Lɛɛri ra bau, di kpogli u kinturgaa.”

ref: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
text: Ba danna yir baa ‘Kɔraawiizi nɛnanaa,’ di yir baa ‘Nɛra la Kɔraawiizi n lɛɛwɛ,’ ka ra yir Jɛrusalɛm ge, ‘Bolzeŋ la Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋɛɛ,’ di kaa ra yiruu ‘Bolzeŋ la baŋ wàá ka vɛɛ ta.’

ref: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
text: Anɛɛ n lii Ɛdɔm hɛri bolzeŋ Bɔzra di ra ba naanɛi? Anɛɛ n laali kuŋaahma a du wer werge, di vol ra ba fɔŋŋa ni werge naanɛi? “Minuu Kɔraawiizi, di ra ŋɔ wideŋlaa, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge n lɛɛ ia.”

ref: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i laala aah lugɔ nɛr la n na fɛrgi grepu nɔna, a nii ra liiyɛi?

ref: “I alone trampled the grapes! None of the nations helped. I trampled nations in my anger and stained my clothes with their blood.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N bɛnnɛ fɛrgi hɛssi hina gunla baŋ ɔɔ fɛrgi grepu nɔna, a nii ra lii la, nɛr maa waŋ hiinee. Awiarɛ n kpa baaŋfuuih fɛrgi n dɔma, ba challi yaari n laala ni, a maa aah gunla.

ref: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
text: A hɔl la min niŋ turgi n nɛra kim la du n bampiriire. Bina la min niŋ lɛɛ baa la helloo.

ref: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
text: N faa binnɔɔrɛ, ka maa hiini maa nawɛɛ. N nua faa kpuwɔɔrɛ, nɛr maa n waŋ hiinee wia. Awia, n himmaa banoniire n faa kpa di kpegli n dɔma, n himmaa baaŋfuuih gil n du kpeg.

ref: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
text: N kpa baaŋfuuihchɔgiirɛ fɛrgi hɛssi hina, ba challi waari hɛri.” Chɔlaa ni wiisuŋŋaa wia

ref: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
text: N daŋ ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la wia, di yir yira chɔluu, dikuu wia la maa uŋ ɛɛwɛ tɛɛ yaa wia, di chɔluu dikuu uŋ suŋ Izrɛl hina ni, di nɔŋŋi baa werge maa wia.

ref: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
text: U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ba ɛɛ n nɛraa, wibii maa, ba ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka dariŋ.” Awia, u birgi ba Lɛɛrii.

ref: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
text: Ba dɔgnya dii gillɔɔ u biini chɔgi, u lɛɛ baa. A waa lugɔ mɛlika gɛɛ u balii bɛllɛ lɛɛ baa, u himmaanii lɛɛ baa. U nɔŋŋaa ni u nɛsunaa dɔɔi la wia, u lɛɛ baabuu ta, u faa ra binni ba ninɛɛ biŋkpila maa n bɛrɛɛ.

ref: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
text: Ka ba faa wa vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wia, u Dumnaniinanii biini chɔgi werge maa. A wia, u faa birgi ba dɔm, di lɔ baa laal.

ref: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
text: Denii u nɛra faa liizi Moosis ni u nɛra wia, lee unla n faa kpogli baa ni u penɔɔni gi muuzeŋ la duɛi? Lee unla n faa kpa u Dumnaniinanii du u nɛra ni,

ref: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
text: unla n kpa u banonii du Moosis nodig, unla n faa bargi muuzeŋ nii ba sibɔɔ, ú na sɔŋ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ,

ref: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
text: Ba faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nauna baŋ tigaa ra kaali lɛl, a waa tɔɔrɔɔ maa ra di la, gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi Duma tɛɛ baa heezaa. Kenne u tɔ u nɛra see, nɛ́ra maa wer u sɔŋ tɔgzi.

ref: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, lii chiŋ i sogni bɔnaniinanii la n dɔɔ girme werge la di binni yaa na. Hiŋ faa aah siwii yaa wia la tunnɔɔ gɛɛ? Haa kaa nɔŋŋi yaa gɛɛ di ra suŋ yaa ni.

ref: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
text: Gunla maa an duwɛɛ, ka hinuu yaa mɛɛ. Haali di yaa naabaala Abraham ni Jekɔb vɛɛ yaa ta gba, ka hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii yaa mɛɛ. Hinuu yaa Lɛɛri faala maa di wa lii ni zinaa.

ref: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bɛɛ n baani i gil yaa gil i ŋmɛnizi ka ra juuri, di dɔɔ dignikpega werge, yaa waa kaa ra ɔmiinɛi? Bir ba, dikuu i balaa wia, dizi la n ɛɛ i kapɛttɛ kuna la.

ref: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
text: I nɛnanaa faa dɔɔ i Dia labuu tama. Ama, filaŋkeŋwaa, yaa dɔma jaa purguubuu nyaamm.

ref: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
text: Yaa jaa duu lugɔ i ŋmɛnɛ maa n haa waa kora diwee yaa ni, yaa jaa du lugɔ haa yaa lizɛɛ yaa ɛɛ i nɛra.

ref: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord; make the mountains tremble.
text: Hoi, yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, haa yaa chiŋ, di tuu baa? Di i wa ballɔ, bizenaa danna zigli i sibɔɔ!

ref: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
text: Tuu alugɔ niŋ, daazi ra fuuh, niiri ge ra bɔr. Denii i dɔma zum i fɔŋŋa, a hɛssi hina maa bɔra ra sa i see.

ref: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
text: I faa tuuwoo di wa ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia la yaa n waa tami, i bizenaa nai, ɔnsii werge lawaa, a ra zigli i see.

ref: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
text: I ɛɛ siryaa í hiini banla wideŋlaa ɛɛi n na pur ba bɔra, ba ra hiŋ i ŋmɛnizi. Ka yaa haa vɛɛwɔɔ ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa, i baaŋ na fuuh yaa ni. Awia, ɛrɛɛ ya ɛɛ di na lɛɛiyɛi?

ref: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
text: Yaawaa maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kundoŋa, haali yaa wideŋlaa maa gba ɛɛ lugɔ yakɔssi n doŋŋe. Yaa ɔɔ waruu lugɔ paŋhoori, yaa wichɔgaa kpa yaa kaali alugɔ peu.

ref: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
text: Nɛr maa waa i sɔnna yir, gɛɛ di ra ɛɛ ania ú lawii kpogli nɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, i bir i hattɛ kpu yaa, di gil yaa wichɔgaa ra chɔgi yaa.

ref: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu haa yaa mɛɛ. Yaabuu chuurii, i ɛɛ maari. Yaa maa ɛɛ i nonee kummaalaarɛ.

ref: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
text: Gilɛɛ gil i baaŋ fuuh di ga bɛri, di gilɛɛ ra liizi yaa wichɔgaa la ge saŋaa saŋa maa. Jaande maa, zum lugɔ yaa ɛɛ i nɛraa, di suŋ yaa ni.

ref: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
text: I bolzennanaananaa la maanii purgee di birgi lugɔ hɛribɔduma. Jɛrusalɛm gba puroore di birgi diŋgela.

ref: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
text: Hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Dia la n waa doŋa maa dɔɔwɛ, di dɔɔ girme, yaa naabaala ɔɔ faa zuu de di ra chɔlii la gba maanii niŋ fuuh, u zuu hɛri. Yaa kunnanaa maanii chɔkkɛ nyaamm.

ref: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, haali annii naa maa gba n ɛɛwɛ, ka i daŋ haa vɛɛ yaa hiinaa di ra tɔɔri yaa? I daŋ siigi ka haa tɛr yaa digna di ga bɛriaa?

ref: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Banla n faa waa n bɔr a nyiŋŋi, baabuu naŋ. Banla n faa waa n wia ra pɛɛzi, baabuu n bagli n wia tɛɛ. N ŋɔwɔɔrɛ tɛɛ hɛri la hina n waa n sɔnna yir, ń lɛɛ baa la be, ‘Minuu keŋ.’

ref: All day long I have reached out to stubborn and sinful people going their own way.
text: N yaa n noneere chɔɔzi guŋŋ bɔr wa duani, ń lɛɛ banla n na vɛɛ n wiŋɔzi, ka ra hiŋ ŋmɛnizi la n waa wer ni ba nfɛssi.

ref: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
text: Ba kuttɔɔrɛ di ra gbɛlliŋ, di ra fuuh n baaŋ ni mbusuzi la banna lizi kambola biine, ni daahɛgsɔɔhsuma banna fuuh birkissizi mbusu lizibɔra ni, di ra tɛɛ vuga.

ref: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
text: Ba ra la bɔra la banna hug lalaa hamuŋzi, di ga suahzi ra ɛɛ ba wiɛɛlaa, di ra hee pereku ola, ba viini suugi kuŋkiilaa baŋ kpuwɛɛ tɛɛ vuga yoma.

ref: And then they say to others, “Don't come near us! We're dedicated to God.” Such people are like smoke, irritating my nose all day.
text: Ka ba ɔɔ ra ŋɔ, ‘Gilɛɛ wàá gbɔgzi yaa. I daŋ chɔgi yaa nanni.’ Guŋ nɛra ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nyɔɔzi, di ra zuu n miibɔɔni, di ɛɛ niŋ n na lau waa dinzaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
text: Ií na, n sɛbi ba wichɔgaa kinturgaare dau n see. Màá siigi di maa baa turgee ba wichɔgaa kim, a su a maga.

ref: I, the Lord, will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.
text: N daŋ tɔɔri baa dikuu ba ni ba naabaala maa wichɔgaa wia. Ba gbɛllimbuu dikuu baŋ fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma ba vuga kuaribɔra la wia. N daŋ turgi baa a kim a su.”

ref: Here is what the Lord says: A cluster of grapes that produces wine is worth keeping! So, because of my servants, I won't destroy everyone.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Gunla grepu nɔna n ɔɔ haa dɔɔ nii, ba wàá sɛɛ chɔgaa la, gunnɛ màá chɔgi Izrɛl hina, dikuubɛɛwiai, n haa dɔɔ nɛnanaarɛ ba biini.

ref: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
text: N daŋ gil Jekɔb ni Juda naanna baŋhina ka, di dɔɔ n bizenaa hɛri. Banla min niŋ lizi labuu niŋ di a kapɛttɛ di so de ra humiŋ.

ref: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
text: Sarɔn lɛl labuu niŋ ɛɛ ba peeza diiribɔr, Akɔ Waluu ge ɛɛ ba nauna heezibɔr. Banla n nyiŋŋiŋ ni ba bampiree labuu ń ɛɛ guŋ tɛɛ.

ref: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
text: Ama, ii banla waa n vɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi, di suuh n binanii nyuu jaamibɔr wia la, ka kuari diiribɔr tɛɛ ba vug Gaad, di kaa yiili sinni koozi dɔŋa ni tɛɛ ba vug Mɛni lawaa,

ref: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
text: ii zum lugɔ ii ni tokobii. Ba daŋ gurgi ia di teŋri ii nyuuni. Dikuubɛɛwiai, n yir iabuu, ka ii waa sɛɛwɛ, di ŋɔ wia tɛɛ ia ka ii waa nuuwɛ. Ii ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ n sibɔɔ, di lizi wia la n wanna par.”

ref: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ, “N balaa danna di diwee, ka lɔzi ra kpu ia, n balaa danna nyɔɔ nii, ka niinyɔgzi ra kpu ia. N balaa bɔra daŋ sɔɔni, ka iawaa di hiihzi.

ref: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
text: N balaa danna yir yira ni bɔsɔna, ka iawaa ra chɛɛhgi ni biinichɔg werge maa.

ref: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
text: N nɛra la miŋ lizɛɛ daŋ kpa ii sɔŋ di ra see nuuzi. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la daŋ kpuuzi ia, ka bir tɛɛ n balaa sɔŋfalii.

ref: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
text: Nɛr la maa n niŋ kissi u dɔŋhiŋ hɛri naa biini, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛ wibii maa hiŋ la sɔŋ biinii ú ɛɛ guŋ, nɛr la maa ge n niŋ du gbɔg, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛ wibii maa hiŋ la sɔŋ biinii ú hɛɛhzi guŋ. Dikuubɛɛwiai, n daŋ suuh tɔɔrɔɔzi la maa n bɛrɛɛ, n siwee wàá kaa ra naa.” Chiŋfalii ni hɛrfalii wia

ref: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií na! N daŋ kaa ta chiŋfalii ni hɛrfalii. Nɛr maa wàá ka ra liizi faala hora la wia kɔrai.

ref: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
text: N bɔra daŋ sɔɔni werge dikuu Jɛrusalɛm ni n nɛra la wia. Wiraa waa ka du de gɛɛ nɛra yirgi ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa.

ref: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
text: Biifulli ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka siu, ba nabɔnzi ge daŋ ɔɔ di ba binni maga ka haa siu. Di nɛr wa di binni kalfa ka siu, biipɔlliirɛ bá yiruu. Banla ge n waa binni kalfa helle ka siu, amɔ, ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baŋ see baa nua.

ref: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
text: A guŋ saŋa, nɛra daŋ ma diini di ra zuu, di chɔɔzi daazi di ra di a nɔna.

ref: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.
text: Nɛra wàá ka ma diini, bá dɔŋahina lɛɛa ra zuu, gɛɛ di duu kuna nɛbɛl wa lɛɛa ra di. A guŋ saŋa, n nɛra daŋ ɔɔ bini gunla daa n ɔɔ bini la. Banla miŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ n hiŋ la danna di ba huma tɔna.

ref: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
text: Ba kuuhni wàá ɛɛ pɛɛ. Biizi la ge ban niŋ lul wàá dɔɔ nyuchɔgii. Ba ni ba naanna daŋ ɛɛ nɛra Kɔraawiizi n kisseere.

ref: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Munu ni pebii daŋ kpau di ra di, bunyiŋ ra di koorii alugɔ navarga, nyɔɔ ge ɛɛ hɛrikuŋ diwee. Kummaa wàá ka du u dɔŋ pira gɛɛ di chɔguu n bizennaniinanii la nyuu. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Chinne n kara, hɛri genii n naazi chignibɔr, awia, lee dia la hin niŋ ma tɛŋ la duɛi? N heezi bɔttɛ lee?

ref: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
text: Miŋ lɛi ta kuna naa maa, a du dee?” Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ! Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “N ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi banla n sɔɔni siwiire, ba ɔɔ nuu n wiŋɔzii, ba bɔra ra sa.

ref: You sacrifice oxen to me, and you commit murder; you sacrifice lambs to me and dogs to other gods; you offer grain to me and pigs' blood to idols; you burn incense to me and praise your idols. You have made your own choice to do these disgusting things that you enjoy so much.
text: Ka banla waa n kpa ba himmaa ŋmɛnizi di ra nyiŋŋi wia la miŋ kiiwe, di ba bɛl kpa nabal lizi mbusu tɛŋ, guŋ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ uŋ kpu newee, unla maa ge n kpu pebii lizi mbusu tɛŋ, ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ uŋ ku nuahiŋ baŋaa, unla maa ge n kpa mia di wa lizi mbusu tɛŋ, ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ uŋ kpa pereku chal di waari n mbusu lizibɔr ni, unla maa ge n fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma tɛŋ, ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ unna kuari vuga.

ref: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
text: Awia, n ge kipattɛ, ń kpa hɛhchɔg ta ba ni, di gil wii la baŋ kiiwe chol ba ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, n yir baabuu, ka nɛr maa waa sɛɛwɛ, di ŋɔ wia tɛɛ baa, ka ba vɛɛ nuui. Ba ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ n sibɔɔ, di lizi wia la n wanna par.”

ref: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
text: Ii banla bɔra n na sa Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii wia, ií ra nuu, “Ii lulla la n hah ia, di vɛɛ ia ta dikuu n sɔŋ wia la, ŋɔwɔɔrɛ chɛɛtɛ ni, ‘Gil Kɔraawiizi bagli u girme, yá na. Ú gil ya na ii bɔsɔna!’ Ka ba daŋ di hiihzi.

ref: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
text: Ií ra nuu! A bolzeŋ maanii tɔ kɔɔi! Ií ra nuu kɔɔi Kɔraawiizi Dia la biini. Kɔraawiizii ra turgi u dɔma ba wichɔgaa kim.

ref: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
text: N bolzennaniinanii la ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ haaŋ n lullɛ manaŋ, mɔɔ ka hilula lɔu.

ref: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
text: Anɛɛ ŋmɛnɛ n haa nuu kennei? Gɛɛ anɛɛ ŋmɛnɛ n haa na gunnɛi? Ba daŋ wer lul hɛri bɛl nɛra hɔpizikpaŋaa? Ka Bolzeŋ Ziɔn waa, hilula daŋ haŋ waa lɔu, di u teŋ lul biizi.”

ref: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ gil u lul, di wàá lulaa? Di u lulaa wa hello, màá gil u lul huhzi.

ref: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
text: Ii banla maa n nɔŋŋi Jɛrusalɛm, ií gil ii nuu maa bɔra sɔɔni. Ii banla gba n wiiwe di ra tɛu la, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni u wia werge maa.

ref: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
text: Ii daŋ di u daama suma gunla bie n ɔɔ ɔzi u maa il di piŋ la. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum labuu ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N daŋ gil bampirsɔna suu alugɔ muu, hɛssi maa ge daama suu alugɔ gɔŋ n suwee. U daŋ gil u biizi ɔzi, di lau baa kpogli, di kpa baa sag u naazi.

ref: I will comfort you there like a mother comforting her child.”
text: Gunla haaŋ n ɔɔ tig u bie bampirii la, gunnɛ ń tig ii bampiree Jɛrusalɛm wia.

ref: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
text: Di ii wa na guŋ, ii bɔra daŋ sɔɔni, ii dɔɔ alaanfia nɛnnɛ. Nɛra la maa n ɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi balaa daŋ na n hiinaa, ka n baaŋ daŋ fuuh n dɔma waa ni werge maa.”

ref: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.
text: Na, Kɔraawiizi ra bau ni niŋ, u torkozi ra chɔ manamanaŋ alugɔ vem. U baaŋ daŋ ba tɔɔrɔɔ ni ninlau ni di wa chɔgi banla maa n vɛɛ u wia la.

ref: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa niŋ ni tokobi di di nɛra maa seriya. Banla ge n niŋ chol u seriya dii biini daŋ du kpil, ú kpu baa.

ref: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Banla baŋ lizi ba doŋa ha, ka ba wer zuu ba vuga kɔrni biini, di ra hee perekuzi, massi ani kuŋkiilaa la waa wia daŋ tuŋ nyaamm.

ref: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
text: N zum ba nfɛssi ni ba wiɛɛlaa maanii. Awia, n daŋ chaali durnya mɔɔrizi ni hɛssi maa nɛra, bá wa na n girme.

ref: by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
text: N daŋ ɛɛ wii bɛl bagli baa bá zum, ka bir hum ba banla n niŋ haa dɔɔ miibɔɔ la baŋhina, bá la Taasis, Libia ani Lidia hina la n dɔɔ sɔŋ hozi tai biini ni Tubal, Giris ani muu baaŋ hɛssi la maa n haa waa n wia nuuwɛ gɛɛ di na n girme werge wia la be. Ba daŋ ga ŋɔ n girme wia tɛɛ a hɛssi naa hina maa.

ref: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
text: Ba daŋ kpogli i nɛra maa lii a hɛssi biine, di ba n bizennaniinanii la nyuu Jɛrusalɛm, bá ɛɛ lugɔ sunzaa tɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi. Ba daŋ tinni zagra, kauzi ani nyugmazi, baŋhina ge zuu torkozi ni anla zagra n na tɛrgi di ba. Ba daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ Izrɛl hina n kpa ba mbusu lizaa mia kuna du kuna baŋ lizi a doŋa ha biine, di ra ba Kɔraawiizi Dia la.

ref: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
text: N daŋ kpa baŋhina birgi n kizeehina ni Levi dee.” Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Gunla chiŋfalii ni hɛrfalii min niŋ ta á du n be di hanna la la, gunnɛ ii naanna ni ii sɔŋ du n be, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
text: Baagufalii lugli hɔpizii maa ni Heezaa Hɔpizii maa, newea maa daŋ ɔɔ ba n be, di wa giŋŋi ra jaamiŋ.

ref: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
text: Di ba wa ɛɛ guŋ ka bir di ra lii, ba daŋ na banla n vɛɛ n wia la n birgi lalaa chɔɔgi. Sandule la n ninna di baa la ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá siu, niŋ la ge n ninna fuuh baa la ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá dim. Newea maa danna kɔɔ baa.”

ref: My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say.
text: Baal bɛllɛ ba faa ra yir Hilkia, u ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ di lii Anatɔf n du Bɛnjamin hɛri. U biibaal Jɛrɛmia wiŋɔzii keŋ.

ref: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wiarɛ tɛu Juda Koori Amɔn biibaal Jɔsia kora dii binni fidaahorohiŋ biini.

ref: and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners. The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ wia tɛu di lii Juda Koori Jɔsia biibaal Jɛhɔyakim kora dii saŋa guŋŋ di ga hel Koori Jɔsia biibaal Zɛdɛkia kora dii binni fidikpaŋ, baaguzi anuehiŋ biini. A saŋaa ba faa lauri Jɛrusalɛm hina kaali hɛrduma la. Kɔraawiizi n yir Jɛrɛmia wia

ref: The Lord said:
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ mìŋ́ Jɛrɛmia be,

ref: “Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.”
text: “Mɔɔ ka n mai di du i maa hia, n zumiibuu. N liziibuu tɛɛ n hiŋ, mɔɔ ka ba lulii, N liziibuu í ɛɛ n dɔgtɛɛ tɛɛ hɛssi hina maa.”

ref: I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
text: Denii n ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, n ɛɛ bichalaa, maa wiŋɔzi zummɛ.”

ref: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Gilɛɛ ŋɔ lugɔ bichalaa hiŋ. A dɛkkɔɔ í la nɛr la maa be minna humii, di ga ŋɔ gunla maa miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la.

ref: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
text: Gilɛɛ ra ɔm baa, dikuubɛɛwiai, n du i benii, n daŋ lɛɛi. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi tɛr u nonii di gbɔgzi n nua, ka ŋɔ n be, “Filaŋkeŋwaa, n kpa n wiŋɔzii di du i nua.

ref: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
text: Na, n liziibuu zinaa, í dɔɔ hɛssi hina ni kossi maa fɔŋŋa, í wer kpuzaa, di purgaa, di chɔgaa di wigzaa, di kaa maa gɛɛ di gil a chi lugɔ kunduulaa.”

ref: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
text: Kɔraawiizi pɛɛziŋ, “Jɛrɛmia, bɛɛ i ra na naanɛi?” N ŋɔ, “Daa bɛl banna yir almɔn kelle n na.”

ref: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “I nawɔɔrɛ nɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n na nyiŋŋuu ń na lugɔ n wiŋɔzi su a magaa.”

ref: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be, “Bɛɛ i ra na naanɛi?” N bir ŋɔ, “N na viire wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag, uŋ hɔŋŋɛ di ra bɔr, di kuli ba yaa be.”

ref: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be, “Hɛhchɔg daŋ lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag di wa chol nɛra la maa n du hɛri naa ni.

ref: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
text: N na nyiŋŋuu ń chaali kossi la maa n du wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag. Ba koora daŋ ba di wa chiŋŋi ba koorikassi, Jɛrusalɛm dominuuzenaa. Ba daŋ wa bar u koŋlaa ani Juda bolzenaa maa.

ref: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.
text: N daŋ tɛr n nɛra digna, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia. Ba vɛɛmbuu ta, ka lizi mbusuzi ra tɛɛ vuga, di ra jaami kuna la ba himmaa n kuarɛɛ.

ref: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
text: Izi ɛɛ sirya di ga ŋɔ ba be gunla maa miŋ ŋɔ i be naa. Gilɛɛ gil ba wia dɔɔi ɔnsii, i bɔra ra sa. Di guŋ lɛi, n himmaa daŋ kpa ɔnsii ni bɔsai ha i ni, ba see.

ref: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.
text: Zinaa n gillɔɔ i ɛɛ lugɔ bolzeŋkpeg, di du kpeg lugɔ lugbii ligii ani danyɛ koŋlii, í wer chi yoo Juda koora, ba nabɔnzi, ba kizeehina ani a hɛri hina maa.

ref: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
text: Ba daŋ wa fɔɔi ni kalu, ka ba wàá wer kpeglii, dikuubɛɛwiai, n du i benii, n daŋ lɛɛi. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord told me
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be,

ref: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.
text: “Izi la ga sii tɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm hina, di ŋɔ, ‘N na liizi gunla ii wia n faa dɔɔ wibii ii toloo saŋaa, gunla iiŋ faa nɔŋŋiŋ saŋa la yaa n luglɛɛ kpa dɔŋa, ii hiŋiŋ hɛribɔduma biini, hɛri la baŋ waa kummaa duuwe u biini la.

ref: You belonged to me alone, like the first part of the harvest, and I severely punished those who mistreated you.
text: Izrɛl hina, ii faa ɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi nɛnanaananaarɛ, di ɛɛ lugɔ n lugli pattikuna. Banla maa n faa ra tɔɔri ia la di bilchɔgrɛ, aŋ faa tɛr ba dignaa, ka kpa hɛhchɔg ta ba ni. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.’ ”

ref: and I, the Lord, will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Bɛɛ wichɔgiirɛ ii mɛɛwaa na n ni, guŋ gil ba bir har kpunnɛi? Ba ra kuari vuga la n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛɛ, guŋ gil ba ge himmaa nyaa tɔna.

ref: Your ancestors refused to ask for my help, though I had rescued them from Egypt and led them through a treacherous, barren desert, where no one lives or dares to travel.
text: Ba waa wette pɛɛzi, ‘Lee Kɔraawiizi la n lizi yaa lii Ijip hɛri la duɛi, unla n kpogli yaa ga hɛribɔduma biini, hɛri la n dɔɔ hɛɛhriichaa werge, hɛrhilii ni bɔbiri werge la, bɔr la nɛr maa n waa zuu, haali nɛr maa n wàá sɛɛ ga de gba lai?’

ref: I brought you here to my land, where food is abundant, but you made my land filthy with your sins.
text: N kpogli iabuu ba hɛri la n summɛ biini, ii wa di u daanɔna ni diunanaa. Ka ii ba wa lawuu chɔgi, di gil n kapɛttɛ kuna maa birgi kuŋkiilaa.

ref: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
text: N kizeehina waa pɛɛzɛɛ, ‘Lee Kɔraawiizi duɛi?’ Banla n na bagli n Gbɔgni la, wan zummɛ. Sitɔɔra la gba vɛɛ n nua di ra gbɛlliŋ, N dɔgtɛɛzi kpa vug Baal sɔŋ di ra ŋɔ wia, di ra kuari vuga la n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ.

ref: I will take you to court and accuse you and your descendants *
text: Awia, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa wia chug ia. N daŋ kpa wia chug, ii ni ii naanna maa.

ref: of a crime that no nation has ever committed before. Just ask anyone, anywhere, from the eastern deserts to the islands in the west.
text: Izi gi di la Saiprɔs n du wiicholii muuzeŋ baambaaŋ hɛri nua, di ga chi ka binni na, di hum bá la Kɛda hɛri n du wiifurii, di ga pessi na, i daŋ na lugɔ a keŋ ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa ɛɛwɛ.

ref: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.
text: Hɛri maa hina ŋmɛnɛ maa waa sɛɛwɛ gil ba vuga kuaraa, haali aŋ waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ gba. Ka n nɛra kpa n girme chɛr vuga la n waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.
text: Wichɔgaa anɛɛrɛ n nɛra ɛɛ, Ba vɛɛ miŋ unla n na tɛɛ bule la n dɔɔ miibɔɔrɛ, ka ki ba himmaa kɔlɔnzi, kɔlɔnzi la n pergee, nii wàá wer chɔɔ a biine.

ref: People of Israel, you weren't born slaves; you were captured in war.
text: Izrɛl hina, ii ɛɛ balaarɛ gɛɛ ba lul iabuu yomai? Ka ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ii dɔma wa lauri ia gunnɛi?

ref: Enemies roared like lions and destroyed your land; towns lie burned and empty.
text: Ii dɔma ra pogzi ii ninɛɛ alugɔ bunyinzi. Ba gillɔɔ ii hɛri birgi hɛribɔduma, ii bola purgi chɔɔgi, di birgi diŋgelli.

ref: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.
text: Haali Mɛmfis ni Tapanɛs hina laallɔɔra, gba faa fir iabuu di gbaari ii nyuuni, ii di hiihzi.

ref: It's all your own fault! You stopped following me, the Lord your God,
text: Ii himmaa lɛi gillɛ wia naa wa huuzi ia, dikuu iiŋ vɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum wia, haali miŋ faa tɔ ii see laa?

ref: Your own sins will punish you, because it was a bitter mistake for you to reject me without fear of punishment. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
text: Ii daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ, dikuu ii biinikpola wia, iiŋ bir har kpuŋ la genii niŋ tɛɛ ia bilchɔg. Ii daŋ na gunla aŋ kpolle di chum, dikuu iiŋ vɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la ta wia, ii waa kaa dɔɔ wibii n be. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
text: Izrɛl hina, faala maa, ii vɛɛ n dɔɔra sɛɛirɛ, di vɛɛ n nua hiŋaa ni n jaamaa. Ka ra kuari vuga la n na tɛɛ lulaa, giŋgimiizeŋ maa nyuu ni daazeŋ maa zɛɛ.

ref: You were a choice grapevine, but you have become a wild, useless vine. Israel Is Stained with Guilt
text: Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ grepu daa la n wesse, n kpa ia chɔɔzi, ií nɔŋ nɔnnanaa. Ka bɛɛ wiarɛ ii bir har kpuŋ, di birgi lugɔ daachɔgaa n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛi?

ref: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.
text: Haali di ii kpa biikoo gɛɛ fanfanni werge gba, di sɔ lugɔ i bɔra lii nɛnnɛ, dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia, ka ii haa dɔɔ bilchɔgrɛ n be. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.
text: Ii daŋ wer ŋɔ lugɔ ii waa doŋŋe, ii waa vug Baala kuarɛaa? Na gunla iiŋ ɛɛwɛ waluu biini, ií binni ii wiɛɛlaa hiŋ na. Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nyugmaniina, n chɔwɛɛ di ra bar.

ref: You are a female donkey sniffing the desert air, wanting to mate with just anyone. You are an easy catch!
text: Ii kaa ɛɛu lugɔ pir kauniina n mani hɛribɔduma. Di u waa deezi, anɛɛ n niŋ wer lawuuwɛi? U bal la maa n na nyiŋŋi u deezuu, waa ɔɔ kaa di dɔgnya, dikuu uŋ teŋ ɛɛ sirya wia.

ref: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. “Stop!” I shouted, but you replied, “No! I love those gods too much.”
text: Izrɛl hina, ií gilɛɛ chɔ ra nyiŋŋi vuga, ií naapezi di tuŋ, ií loobee ge maa hil. Ka ii ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Yaa wàá ka wer bir har, yaa nɔŋŋi hɛrdumazi vugaa, a bɔttɛ ya nyiŋŋi.’

ref: You and your leaders are more disgraceful than thieves— you and your kings, your priests and prophets
text: Gunla ŋmɛɛŋ n ɔɔ di hiihzi di ba wa lawuu la, gunnɛ Izrɛl hina ni ba koora, ba nabɔnzenaa, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi maa, di hiihzi.

ref: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.
text: Ba ŋɔ daa benii, ‘Hinuu yaa mɛɛ,’ di kaa ŋɔ bii ge be, ‘Hinuu yaa maa.’ Ba bir hattɛ kpuŋ, ka di ba wa du siaahmu biini waa, ba ɔɔ ŋɔ dí n wa lɛɛ baa.

ref: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns. Israel Rebels against the Lord
text: Lee vuga la iiŋ kuarɛɛ tɛɛ iihinaa la duɛi? Di ii wa du siaahmu biini, ií gil a ba wa lɛɛ ia, di a daŋ wer. Juda hina, ii vuga kpillɔɔ gunla iiŋ dɔɔ bolzenaa kpila la.

ref: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.
text: Bɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra pag n ninɛi? Ii ɛɛ dignikpega hinaa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I tried punishing you, but you refused to come back to me, and like fierce lions you killed my prophets.
text: N tɛr ii dignaa, ka guŋ waa ia hiinee, di gil ii wia deŋli. Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyinzi lɔzi n na kpu, di lau n dɔgtɛɛzi kpu.

ref: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, “We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you!”
text: Izrɛl hina, ií ra nuu gunla mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n na ŋɔ. N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hɛribɔduma tɛɛ ia gɛɛ hɛri la n biree di chum wergei? Ka bɛɛwiarɛ ii ŋɔ ii wàá ka bir ba n be, ka ra ɛɛ ii kiparɛi?

ref: A bride could not forget to wear her jewelry to her wedding, but you have forgotten me day after day.
text: Toloori haa suuh u baŋaa kuŋ, nonibisig ani u gbitti dui wia gɛɛ haŋfalii n suuh u bɔmbɔga laalaa? Ka n nɛra waa suuh n wiarɛ, hɔpizikpila n waa maga dɔɔwɛ gba.

text: Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baala ni haana n zum dɔŋa nyiŋŋaare werge! Haali hahchɔgaa gba helli di ra lii ii be.

ref: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes,
text: Nyaara ni banla n waa chɔgri dɔɔwɛ, challi fɔg ii laalaa. Haali iiŋ waa baa lauwɛ di ba ra ŋmɛɛ kummaa gba. Ka annii maa biini,

text: Ii daŋ willi ii nyuuni ni hiihzi, Ijip hɛri, dikuubɛɛwiai, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi vɛɛ banla iiŋ yardɛɛrɛ. Ii wàá na hiinaa maa ba be.”

ref: The Lord said to the people of Israel: If a divorced woman marries, can her first husband ever marry her again? No, because this would pollute the land. But you have more gods than a prostitute has lovers. Why should I take you back?
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Di baal vɛɛ u haaŋ, u la ga yuu baduma, a dɛkkɔ u jaabinii kaa bir la u bee? Guŋ wàá chɔgi a hɛriaa? Ka ii duwɔɔrɛ lugɔ sɛnsɛnna, di dɔɔ sɛnnikpila. Ii daŋ kaa wer biruu ba n be naa?

ref: Just try to find one hilltop where you haven't gone to worship other gods by having sex. You sat beside the road like a robber in ambush, except you offered yourself to every passerby. Your sins of unfaithfulness have polluted the land.
text: Ií binni giŋgimee nyuuni na. Yembɛl du de ii waa sɛnsɛŋ wia ɛɛwɛaa? Ii ɔɔ so ŋmɛnikɛraarɛ di ra kpaŋ baala, di kaa du ŋmɛnikɛraa maa alugɔ Lɔrbi n du hɛribɔduma. Ii kpa sɛnsɛŋ ni biinikpolaa, di chɔgi a hɛri maa.

ref: When Josiah was king, the Lord said: Jeremiah, the kingdom of Israel was like an unfaithful wife who became a prostitute on the hilltops and in the shade of large trees.
text: Koori Jɔsia kora dii saŋa, Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ mìŋ́ Jɛrɛmia benii, “I na Izrɛl hina wibii nyaairɛ naa? Ba tinni giŋgimee nyuunii, di so daazenaa zɛɛzi, di ra kuari vuga.

ref: I knew that the kingdom of Israel had been unfaithful and committed many sins, yet I still hoped she might come back to me. But she didn't, so I divorced her and sent her away. Her sister, the kingdom of Judah, saw what happened, but she wasn't worried in the least, and I watched her become unfaithful like her sister.
text: N tɛɛ Izrɛl hinaa hahvɛɛri hɔŋ, dikuu ba wibii nyaai wia, di duŋŋi baa lugɔ ba ra la, dikuu ba sɛnsɛŋ wia. Ka n nawɔɔrɛ lugɔ ba lulla Juda hina la gba wia n waa wibii dɔɔwɛ la waa ɔm. Ba ge gba haa vɛɛwɔɔ ra sɛm.

ref: The kingdom of Judah wasn't sorry for being a prostitute, and she didn't care that she had made both herself and the land unclean by worshiping idols of stone and wood.
text: Dikuu Izrɛl hina sɛnsɛŋ la n waa wizeŋ ɛɛwɛ ba be wia, ba chɔgi a hɛrii, di ɛɛ sɛnsɛŋ wia, di ra kuari bia ni daazi.

ref: Even the people of Israel were honest enough not to pretend.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Haali Izrɛl hina n nyaa wibii la gba, ka ba wiarɛ deŋlee kaali wibiinyaara Juda hina.

ref: Jeremiah, shout toward the north: Israel, I am your Lord— come back to me! You were unfaithful and made me furious, but I am merciful, and so I will forgive you.
text: La ga sii wia naa tɛɛ Izrɛl hina la n du wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag, di ŋɔ, ‘Wibiinyaara Izrɛl hina, ií bir ba n be, n baaŋ wàá ka fuuh ii ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, n na suŋ nɛra ninɛɛ. Màá na baaŋ di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: You are unfaithful children, but you belong to me. Come home! I'll take one or two of you from each town and clan and bring you to Zion.
text: Wibiinyaara, ií bir ba n be, dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ii jaari, ii ɛɛ n horaa. N daŋ lizi nɛkpaŋ lii bol maa biini, di kaa lizi banɛɛ lii domee maa biini, di kpogli ia bir ba Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu.

ref: Then I'll appoint wise rulers who will obey me, and they will care for you like shepherds.
text: N daŋ tɛɛ ia sitɔɔra la n ninna ɛɛ n kipar, bá ra tɔ ii see ni nunzuma ni wia zɛɛ zumaa.”

ref: The whole city of Jerusalem will be my throne. All nations will come here to worship me, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
text: A guŋ saŋa, ba daŋ yir Jɛrusalɛm Kɔraawiizi Koorikara. Denii hɛssi hina maa chaali ba Jɛrusalɛm, di waa jaamiŋ, di ra dargiŋ. Ba wàá ka dɔɔ dignikpega, di ra hiŋ ba nfɛrchɔgaa la.

ref: Then, in countries to the north, you people of Judah and Israel will be reunited, and you will return to the land I gave your ancestors.
text: A saŋa, Juda hina daŋ ba wa jaa Izrɛl hina ni, ba maa kpau izi lii a hɛri wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag, di la hɛri la miŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ ii naabaala, u ɛɛ ba kapɛttɛ kuŋ la.” Kɔraawiizi nɛra vuga kuaraa wia

ref: I have always wanted to treat you as my children and give you the best land, the most beautiful on earth. I wanted you to call me “Father” and not turn from me.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina, n na nyiŋŋuu ń kpogli ia nɛnnɛ alugɔ n biibaala, di tɛɛ ia hɛri la n summɛ di du wer kaali hɛssi hina maa kapɛttɛ kuna. N na nyiŋŋuu ií ra yiriŋ ii Mɛɛ, di gilɛɛ kaa bir har kpuŋ.

ref: But instead, you are like a wife who broke her wedding vows. You have been unfaithful to me. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People Confess Their Sins The Lord said:
text: Gunla haaŋ bɛl wia n waa ɔɔ dɔɔ wibii u jaari be la, gunnɛ Izrɛl hina wia waa wibii dɔɔwɛ n be la. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: Listen to the noise on the hilltops! It's the people of Israel, weeping and begging me to answer their prayers. They forgot about me and chose the wrong path.
text: Wile ra lɔu a giŋgimee nyuuni maa, Izrɛl hinaa ra wii di ra suŋŋiŋ, dikuu baŋ ɛɛ wichɔgaa, di suuh mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la banna hum wia.

ref: I will tell them, “Come back, and I will cure you of your unfaithfulness.” They will answer, “We will come back, because you are the Lord our God.
text: Ii banla maa n vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hiŋaa la, ií bir ba u be. U daŋ chaa ia, di gil ii wia deŋli, di dɔɔ wibii. Ií ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ɛɛh, yaa ra ba Kɔraawiizi benii, dikuubɛɛwiai, waabuu ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum.

ref: On hilltops, we worshiped idols and made loud noises, but it was all for nothing— only you can save us.
text: Yaa waa hiinaa maa nawɛɛ lii a vuga kuaraa biini, saŋa la yaa n na kuaraa giŋgimee nyuuni la. Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la bɛŋ benii, Izrɛl hina hiinaa ra lii.

ref: Since the days of our ancestors when our nation was young, that shameful god Baal has taken our crops and livestock, our sons and daughters.
text: Di lii yaa pɔlaa saŋa, vuga chɔgi yaa naabaala huma tɔnaa, ba sela, ba biibaala ani biihaana maa.

ref: The Lord said: Israel, if you really want to come back to me, get rid of those disgusting idols.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina, di ii daŋ bir, guŋwaa, ií bir ba n be. Di ii sɛɛwɔ paa ii vuga la miŋ kiiwe la ha n sibɔɔ, ii wàá ka leu,

ref: Make promises only in my name, and do what you promise! Then all nations will praise me, and I will bless them.
text: di ii kpa n sɔŋ hɛɛhzi, ii wia dɔɔ wibii di deŋli, guŋwaa, hɛssi hina maanii niŋ ŋɔ ń kissi baa, bá ra chɔliŋ.”

ref: People of Jerusalem and Judah, don't be so stubborn! Your hearts have become hard, like unplowed ground where thornbushes grow.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm hina be, “Ií gil ii bampiree la n lugɔ hɛri la baŋ waa buglee la du pɛr, ii duu wideŋlaa tɛɛ iihinaa, ka gilɛɛ waa duu kuna ra du sɔɔhri biini.

ref: With all your hearts, keep the agreement I made with you. But if you are stubborn and keep on sinning, my anger will burn like a fire that cannot be put out. Disaster Is Coming The Lord said: *
text: Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií ra hiŋ n ni ia nuukpaŋ la di kpa iihinaa du n nonee. Di guŋ lɛi, n baaŋ daŋ fuuh ii ni, dikuu wichɔgaa la iiŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia, U danna fuuh, ka nɛr maa wàá wer sɔɔnuu.” Hɛhchɔg n lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag ra ba wia

ref: Head for Jerusalem or another walled town!’ “Jeremiah, tell them I'm sending disaster from the north.
text: Ií lalli tuuta di bagli lugɔ ii chɔ la Jɛrusalɛm manaŋ, di ga lɛɛ iihinaa! Dikuubɛɛwiai, n kpa hɛhchɔgrɛ lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag di ra ba, a hɛhchɔg daŋ chum werge maa.”

ref: An army will come out, like a lion from its den. It will destroy nations and leave your towns empty and in ruins.”
text: Alugɔ bunyiŋ n lii u suahribɔr, hɛssi chɔgri liwɔɔrɛ. U liwɔɔrɛ ra ba, ú wa chɔgi Juda. U bolzenaa maanii niŋ purgi chɔɔ burburbur, nɛr maa wàá ka du a biine.

ref: Then I told the people of Israel, “Put on sackcloth! Mourn and cry out, ‘The Lord is still angry with us.’ ”
text: Awia, ií kpa gbɔglɔnzi tɔ, di ra chɛɛhgi werge maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuihchɔgii la haa waa yaa ni liwɛɛ.

ref: The Lord said, “When all this happens, the king and his officials, the prophets and the priests will be shocked and terrified.”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “A hɔl hiŋ, koori ni u zɛɛsogna bɔra daŋ huah, ɔnsii lau Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi nua kpu.”

ref: I said, “You are the Lord God. So why have you fooled everyone, especially the people of Jerusalem? Why did you promise peace, when a knife is at our throats?” The Coming Disaster
text: Denii n ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la, i dar Jɛrusalɛm hinaa werge! I ŋɔ lugɔ ba daŋ dɔɔ bampirsɔna, ka tokobizii baŋzi ba baŋaazi.”

ref: Look! The enemy army swoops down like an eagle; their cavalry and chariots race faster than storm clouds blown by the wind.” Then you will answer, “We are doomed!”
text: Ií na! Yaa dɔm ra bau alugɔ baamazi, u laal torkozi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ vem, u zagra ge du gbaŋ kaali chigni. Wiarɛ huuzi yaa! Yaa wia tunnɔɔ!

ref: But Jerusalem, there is still time for you to be saved. Wash the evil from your hearts and stop making sinful plans,
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií lizi ii wichɔgaa maa lii ii bampiree ha, ka na lɛɛi. Ɛrɛɛ ii ra nyiŋŋi ii kpa wichɔgaa du ii biine, di birgi magɛi?

ref: before a message of disaster arrives from the hills of Ephraim and the town of Dan.
text: Loobii bɛl lii bolzeŋ Dan n du wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakagrɛ, di ra sii hɛhchɔg wia lii Ɛfram giŋgimee nyuuni,

ref: The Lord said, “Tell the nations that my people have rebelled against me. And so an army will come from far away to surround Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. I, the Lord, have spoken.
text: Ba daŋ wa baruu gunla baala n na kpaŋ koo la, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba vɛɛ n nuarɛ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: “People of Judah, your hearts will be in pain, but it's your own fault that you will be punished.” Jeremiah's Vision of the Coming Punishment
text: Ii manni ni ii wiɛɛlaarɛ gillɛ keŋ wa huuzi ia. Ii digna tɛraarɛ guŋ, dikuu wichɔgaa la iiŋ ɛɛwɛ wia. Tɔɔrɔɔ werge maa daŋ gil ii biine chɔgi!”

ref: I can't stand the pain! My heart pounds, as I twist and turn in agony. I hear the signal trumpet and the battle cry of the enemy, and I cannot be silent.
text: Denii mìŋ́ Jɛrɛmia ŋɔ, “N biini chɔkkɔɔ werge di ra tɔɔriŋ. N bɔra ra waaziŋ werge, n na miŋŋi. N banchule ra lɔu werge maa, màá wer siigi. N nuu bensunoniina wiraa ni laal wilee.

ref: I see the enemy defeating us time after time, leaving everything in ruins. Even my own home is destroyed in a moment.
text: Hɛhchɔgni hiŋzi dɔŋaa, a hɛri maa birgi diŋgela. N tanti diini maa chɔgi kakpaŋ, n duuribɔr gba guŋ.

ref: How long will I see enemy flags and hear their trumpets?
text: Ɛrɛɛ ń na laal tuutazi, di nuu bensunoniina wiraa, di birgi magɛi?”

ref: I heard the Lord say, “My people ignore me. They are foolish children who do not understand that they will be punished. All they know is how to sin.”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N nɛra gɛnnɔɔ, ba wan zummɛ. Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ biizi la n waa nunzuma dɔɔwɛ, ba waa wia zɛɛ zummɛ. Wichɔgaa bɛŋ ɛɛirɛ ba zum, ba waa winanaa ɛɛi zummɛ.”

ref: After this, I looked around. The earth was barren, with no form of life. The sun, moon, and stars had disappeared.
text: N binni hɛrii, di u duula dɔɔwɛ, di chɔɔ woo, di kaa binni chiŋ ge, di bɔchaaŋ waa hoo.

ref: no people could be seen, and all the birds had flown away.
text: N binni, di nɛra waa hoo, zumbizi maa ge zaahzi kaali.

ref: Farmland had become a desert, and towns were in ruins. The Lord's fierce anger had done all of this. The Death of Jerusalem
text: N binni, di hɛrsum la birgi hɛribɔduma, u bolzenaa maa birgi diŋgelli, dikuu Kɔraawiizi baaŋ wia.

ref: The Lord said: I have made my decision, and I won't change my mind. This land will be destroyed, although not completely. The sky will turn dark, and the earth will mourn.
text: Awia, a hɛri nɛra daŋ wii, chiŋ ge maa biri, dikuubɛɛwiai, minuu ŋɔ guŋ, màá ka bir n nua, n teŋ lau gunnɛ kpogli, màá kaa bir har.”

ref: Enemy cavalry and archers shout their battle cry. People run for their lives and try to find safety among trees and rocks. Every town is empty.
text: Di nɛra wa nuu zagtinna ni hotaara gbɔga, ba maa danna chɔ. Baŋhina chɔ zuu kɔrni, baŋhina ge chɔ ga tinni bia nyuuni. Á bola maa chɔɔ pɛɛ, nɛr maa wàá kaa ra zuu a biine.

ref: Jerusalem, your land has been wiped out. But you act like a prostitute and try to win back your lovers, who now hate you. You can put on a red dress, gold jewelry, and eye shadow, but it's no use— your lovers are out to kill you!
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina, ii hɛri chɔkkɔɔ. Ka ii ra ɛɛ lugɔ sɛnsɛnna, n na ɛɛ ania bá bir na ba sɛnna la n hah baa la. Ii daŋ wer laali tagta aahma, di du saliŋ digna ni baŋaakuna ni nonibisiga, di du kalu, ka pɛɛrɛ. Ii sɛnna ra nyiŋŋi ii kpuirɛ.

ref: I heard groaning and crying. Was it a woman giving birth to her first child? No, it was Jerusalem, gasping for breath and begging for help. “I'm dying!” she said. “They have murdered me.”
text: N nuu wilee alugɔ haaŋ n na nyiŋŋi lulaa, di nuu hɛmaa lugɔ haaŋ n na lul u toloobie. Jɛrusalɛm hina heezaa ra sig guŋ, ba yaa ba nonee di ra ŋɔ, “Yaa wia chɔkkɔɔ! Ba ra bau bá wa kpu yaa!”

ref: I answered, “I know that you look for truth. You punished your people for their lies, but in spite of the pain, they became more stubborn and refused to turn back to you.”
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, wibii lɛi i ra nyiŋŋia? I tɛr ba dignaa, ka ba bɔra waa wiiwɛ, i sunni baa werge, ka ba waa baglaa nuuwɛ. Ba dɔɔ sikpegiire alugɔ bii, ba waa sɛɛwɛ gil ba biine chɔgi, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia, di gilaa ta.

ref: Then I thought to myself, “These common people act like fools, and they have never learned what the Lord their God demands of them.
text: N faa fɛwɔɔrɛ, “Nɛra naa ɛɛ nyaara bɛnnɛ, ba ɛɛ gɛnaarɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba waa Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la ŋmɛnizi zummɛ, ba waa kaa zum u winyiŋŋaa gba.

ref: So I'll go and talk to the leaders. They know what God demands.” But even they had decided not to obey the Lord.
text: Awia, n daŋ la ba sitɔɔra be, di ga ŋɔ wia tɛɛ baa, wibii maa, ba zum Kɔraawiizi ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ, Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la winyiŋŋaa.” Ka ba maa ɛɛ nuukpaŋ, di vɛɛ u dɔɔra sɛɛi, di vɛɛ u nua hiŋaa.

ref: The people have rebelled and rejected the Lord too many times. So enemies will attack like lions from the forest or wolves from the desert. Those enemies will watch the towns of Judah, and like leopards they will tear to pieces whoever goes outside. Enemies Will Punish Judah The Lord said:
text: Awia, bunyiŋ daŋ lii kɔr biini wa pig baa, munu ge lii hɛribɔduma wa lauri baa. Amani daŋ chɔɔ ba bola nuuzi di guu baa, ú chuuri unla maa n niŋ ŋɔ ú lii chaaŋ, dikuu ba dignikpega n nyaŋŋɛɛ, ba ɔɔ bir har kpuu saŋa kpila maa wia.

ref: People of Judah, how can I forgive you? I gave you everything, but you abandoned me and worshiped idols. You men go to prostitutes and are unfaithful to your wives.
text: Kɔraawiizi pɛɛzi, “Juda hina, bɛɛ wiarɛ ń gil tɛɛ iai? Ii biizi vɛɛ n nua hiŋaarɛ, ka ra kuari vuga la n ɛɛ kumpɛɛri. N tɛɛ n nɛraa kummaa, ka ba ra ɛɛ sɛnsɛŋ wia, ba ni sɛnsɛnna ra chɔɔ.

ref: You are no better than animals, and you always want sex with someone else's wife.
text: Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ zagbala baŋ dɛɛzɛɛ nɛnnɛ, ba ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋuu ba lauri ba dɔŋahina haana, di ra nyiŋŋi saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I will tell their enemies, “Go through my vineyard. Don't destroy the vines, but cut off the branches, because they are the people who don't belong to me.”
text: N daŋ ŋɔ ba dɔma be, ‘Ií ga zuu ba grepu daazi kooni di chɔgaa, ka ií gilɛɛ waa chɔgaa nyaamm. Ií kɛuri a kela waa ha, dikuubɛɛwiai, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ n nɛra la n waa n hora ɛɛwɛ.

ref: In every way, Judah and Israel have been unfaithful to me. *
text: Izrɛl ni Juda hina maa wia waa wibii dɔɔwɛ n be. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.’ ”

ref: Their prophets lie and say, “The Lord won't punish us. We will have peace and plenty of food.”
text: Ba kanni karaa, di ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi wàá ɛɛ yaa wiimaa. Tɔɔrɔɔ maa wàá huuzi yaa, laal ni lɔchɔgii ge wàá chol yaa ni maa.

ref: They tell these lies in my name, so now they will be killed in war or starve to death.
text: Ba ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ peu, u Wiŋɔɔlii waa hoo ba be. Awia, gil gunla baŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la laŋŋi ba ni.”

ref: I am the Lord God All-Powerful. Jeremiah, I will tell you exactly what to say. Your words will be a fire; Israel and Judah will be the fuel.
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ, “Dikuu a nɛra naa n ŋɔ kennaa wia, n daŋ kpa n wiŋɔzi du i nua, a ɛɛ lugɔ niŋ, di fuuh baa alugɔ daazi.

ref: People of Israel, I have made my decision. An army from a distant country will attack you. I've chosen an ancient nation, and you won't understand their language.
text: Izrɛl hina, n kpa nɛraa lii hɛhjaŋa, bá wa lɔ ia. Hɛri la hina n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, di ɛɛ faala hina, iiŋ waa ba mɔɔri ra nuu.

ref: All of them are warriors, and their arrows bring death.
text: Ba hotaara ɛɛ laallɔkpegaa, ba waa nɛra ni ra suŋ.

ref: This nation will eat your crops and livestock; they will leave no fruit on your vines or fig trees. And although you feel safe behind thick walls, your towns will be destroyed and your children killed. Israel Refused To Worship the Lord
text: Ba daŋ di ii diwee maa, di kpu ii biibaala ni ii biihaana. Ba daŋ kpu ii sela, di chɔgi ii fig ni ii grepu daazi maa. Ba daŋ kpa laal di chɔgi ii bolzeŋkpega la maa iiŋ yardɛɛ la.”

ref: The Lord said: Jeremiah, the enemy army won't kill everyone in Judah.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “A guŋ saŋa gba, màá dim ia.

ref: And the people who survive will ask, “Why did the Lord our God do such terrible things to us?” Then tell them: I am the Lord, but you abandoned me and worshiped other gods in your own land. Now you will be slaves in a foreign country.
text: Di ba wa pɛɛzɔɔ lugɔ bɛɛ n baani mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ baa kennei? Ŋɔ ba be lugɔ ba bir hattɛ kpuŋ, ka ra kuari hɛrdumazi vuga ba himmaa hɛri. Awia, ba daŋ birgi yoma, di ra hum nɛra hɛrduma biini.”

ref: Tell these things to each other, you people of Judah, you descendants of Jacob.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Sii wia naa tɛɛ Juda hina la n ɛɛ Jekɔb naanna.

ref: You fools! Why don't you listen when I speak? Why can't you understand
text: Gɛnaa ni nfɛrnyaara, ií keŋŋi digna ra nuu. Ii dɔɔ siweere, ka ii waa na, di dɔɔ digna, ka ii waa wia ra nuu.

ref: that you should worship me with fear and trembling? I'm the one who made the shore to hold back the ocean. Waves may crash on the beach, but they can come no farther.
text: Minuu Kɔraawiizi. Bɛɛ wiarɛ ii wanna ɔmɛi? Bɛɛ n baani ii bɔra waa sa ń seei? N gillɔɔ hɛri ɛɛ muuzeŋ magbɔɔ, magbɔɔ la uŋ wàá wer gilli maa. A muuzeŋ nii danna lɔ ka wàá wer gilli u ni. Haali a nii danna lɔ werge, ka wàá na bɔr kaali.

ref: You stubborn people have rebelled and turned your backs on me.
text: Ka a nɛra naa ɛɛ dignikpega hinaa, di kpoŋ. Ba bir hattɛ kpuŋ, di vɛɛ n humaa.

ref: You refuse to say, “Let's worship the Lord! He's the one who sends rain in spring and autumn and gives us a good harvest.”
text: Ba waa ɔɔ ŋɔ bahinaa be, ‘Ií gil ya ra tɔgzi Kɔraawiizi. Waabuu ɔɔ tɛɛ yaa sazau ni yuuliŋ dooŋ, yaa pattikuna lɛɛ, yaa na diwee werge kuna kpai saŋa.’

ref: A hunter traps birds and puts them in a cage, but some of you trap humans and make them your slaves.
text: Biinikpola hina du n nɛra biinii, di ɛɛ lugɔ nɛra n ɔɔ he ŋmɛmbizi, bá lauri zumbizi la.

ref: You are evil, and you lie and cheat to make yourselves rich. You are powerful
text: Gunla baŋ ɔɔ lauri zala su zagbɛrɛ la, gunnɛ ba ɔɔ foozi kuna su ba diini, di birgi dɔɔna, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge,

ref: and prosperous, but you refuse to help the poor get the justice they deserve.
text: di ra di nɛnnɛ, di vuh nɛnnɛ la. Ba wichɔgaa ɛɛi waa maga dɔɔwɛ, ba waa lalbiizi ra tɛɛ bilii gɛɛ di di wibii ra tɛɛ nyaara.

ref: Look at the terrible things going on in this country. I am shocked!
text: Wia la n na lɔ banchule, di dɔɔ ɔnsii werge, ɛɛ a hɛri biinii.

ref: Prophets give their messages in the name of a false god, my priests don't want to serve me, and you—my own people— like it this way! But on the day of disaster, where will you turn for help?
text: N dɔgtɛɛzi waa wibii ra ŋɔ, n kizeehina ge ra ɛɛ wia ni ba himmaa fɔŋŋa. Guŋ ge ɛɛ n nɛra kipar, ka ɛrɛɛ bá ɛɛ a tunai?”

ref: Run for your lives, people of Benjamin. Get out of Jerusalem. Sound a trumpet in Tekoa and light a signal fire in Beth-Haccherem. Soon you will be struck by disaster from the north.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Bɛnjamin dee, ií chɔ ra nyiŋŋi ii miibɔɔni! Ií chɔ lii Jɛrusalɛm biini! Ií huuh bensunoniina Tɛkua biini, di chem niŋ Bɛf Hakɛrɛm biini, di ra bagli lugɔ siaahmuu! Dikuubɛɛwiai, hɛhchɔg lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakagrɛ di ra ba, di chum werge maa.

ref: Jerusalem is a lovely pasture,
text: Bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm wessoo werge, ka ba daŋ chɔguu.

ref: but shepherds will surround it and divided up, then let their flocks eat all the grass.
text: Laallɔɔra daŋ ba lugɔ penɔɔna ni ba peeza, di wa lɔ a bolzeŋ, di baŋzi ba tanti diini bar u maa. Bɛl maa daŋ so bɔr la unna nyiŋŋi.

ref: Kings will tell their troops, “If we reach Jerusalem in the morning, we'll attack at noon. But if we arrive later,
text: Ba daŋ ŋɔ, ‘Ií ɛɛ laal sirya yá ga lɔ baa, ií izi ya ga yoo baa wibaŋa ni!’ Ka ba daŋ ŋɔ, ‘Saŋa kaalɔɔrɛ, wiizi ge zuu tuŋ.

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ, “Ií teŋri daazi ta, di ta pizenaa bar Jɛrusalɛm koŋlii maa, di wer tinni zuu u biini. N daŋ tɛr a bolzeŋ naa hina digna, dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛsunnaa su u biinii werge maa.

ref: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.
text: Gunla kɔlɔŋ n ɔɔ ra bul nii la, gunnɛ Jɛrusalɛm hina wichɔgaa ɛɛi du. N nuu naari ni chɔgaarɛ a bolzeŋ biini, wiila ni dɔŋa pira dui bɛnnɛ n na na.

ref: Listen to me, you people of Jerusalem and Judah. I will abandon you, and your land will become an empty desert.
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií ra nuu n wiŋɔzi naa nɛnnɛ, di guŋ lɛi, n daŋ kizi ia ha, di gil ii hɛri naa maa birgi diŋgela, nɛr maa wàá ka du de.”

ref: I will tell your enemies to leave your nation bare like a vine stripped of grapes. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah's Anger
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ, “N daŋ gil Izrɛl hina dɔma gbaari baa gunla baŋ ɔɔ kaari daanɔna maa lii u ni la. Awia, a dɛkkɔ ii lɛɛ nɛr la maa iin niŋ wer lɛɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, saŋa haa du denii.”

ref: Your anger against Judah flames up inside me, and I can't hold it in much longer. The Lord's Anger Will Sweep Everyone Away The Lord answered: Don't hold back my anger! Let it sweep away everyone— the children at play and all adults, young and old alike.
text: Gunla i baaŋ n na fuuh ba ni la, gunnɛ n gba baan na fuuh ba ni, màá ka wer lau n hiŋ.” Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Gil n baaŋ fuuh bichalli la n du ŋmɛnizenaa ni biipɔllaa la maa n chaalɛɛ ni. Ba daŋ lauri baala ni ba haana kaali, haali nabɔnzi la maa n zɛŋŋɛ werge maa gba.

ref: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord, have spoken.
text: Di n waa tɛr banla n du hɛri naa digna, ba diini daŋ birgi nɛra baŋhina hora, haali ba kooni ni ba haana maa gba. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
text: Ii nɛdumazi ni ii nɛzenaa maanii ra fini nɛraa bá nyɛɛli. Haali n dɔgtɛɛzi ni n kizeehina maa gba ra dar nɛra.

ref: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
text: Ba ɔɔ na n nɛra ŋmɛraa, ka ra yiraa bɔforgaa, Ba ɔɔ ŋɔu, ‘Bampirsɔna du denii, bampirsɔna du denii,’ ka bampirsɔna waa hoo.

ref: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
text: Hiihzi ɔɔ lau baabuu, dikuu ba wikuna naa wiaa? Akai, a guŋ waa baa ra ɛɛ hiihzi, ba baga lɛi. Awia, ba daŋ chol gunla baŋhina n cholle la. Di n wa tɛr ba digna, ba wia maa daŋ tuŋ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, “Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace.” But you refused.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Ií chi ŋmɛnichechema ka binni na, di pɛɛzi faala ŋmɛnizi bɔr. Ií pɛɛzi unla n wesse bɔr, di ra hiŋuu, ii daŋ na heezaa. Ka ii ŋɔ, ‘Yaa wàá hiŋuu.’

ref: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
text: N hum n dɔgtɛɛzii lugɔ tauduura, bá wa karfi ia lugɔ siaahmu ra bau, ka ii waa nuuwɛ.

ref: So I tell all nations on earth, “Watch what I will do!
text: Awia, hɛssi hina, ií ra nuu! Ií pessi gunla n niŋ wa huuzi n nɛra.

ref: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
text: Hɛri, a nuu! N kpa hɛhchɔgrɛ di ra ba ń wa ta nɛra naa ni, dikuu ba jinachɔgaa ni baŋ vɛɛ n baglaa ni n wiŋɔzi wia.

ref: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
text: N baga lɛi ii daahɛgsɔɔhsuma la iiŋ kpawɛɛ lii Siiba hɛri ba gɛɛ dɔzi tiuzaa kuna la iiŋ kpawɛɛ lii hɛhjaŋa ba la. Màá lɛɛ ii mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa, awia wan pattɛ.

ref: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends. An Army from the North
text: Awia, n daŋ gil nɛra naa lɔɔzi naazi chogli. Mɛɛwaa ni maawaa ani biizi daŋ siuzi. Gunnɛ bá dammuzi ni ba dɔŋahina gba siuzi.”

ref: The Lord said, “Look toward the north, where a powerful nation has prepared for war.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií na, laallɔɔra lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag hɛrii di ra ba. Ba du hɛrkpeg hina n du bɔɔnɛɛrɛ bɔkpega.

ref: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
text: Ba kpogli hozi ni kandaazii, ba dɔɔ sikpegiire werge, ba waa nɛra ni ra suŋ. Ba tinni ba zagraa a ra gbɔgzi lugɔ muuzeŋ n na kɔɔ, ba ra bau alugɔ laallɔɔra n ɛɛ laal sirya, bá wa lɔ ia.”

ref: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina ŋɔ, “Yaa nuu ba wiarɛ, yaa bɔra huah. Biinichɔg werge lau yaa lugɔ hilula n lɔ haaŋ.

ref: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
text: Ií gilɛɛ wa lii ra la kooni gɛɛ di waa vol ŋmɛnizi, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii dɔma kpogli dɔŋkunaa, ɔnsii werge su bɔr maa.”

ref: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u nɛra be, “Ií kpa gbɔglɔnzi laali, di lii chɔɔ hɔɔhri biini di ra billi. Ií ra chɛɛhgi werge, sinii ra lii, alugɔ iin niŋ wii biibambikpaŋ siu, dikuubɛɛwiai, unla n na ba ú wa kpu ia la, daŋ wa pirgi ia, di lɔ ia.

ref: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
text: Ba maa ɛɛ nɛkpoŋlaare, di ra chɔgi nɛra sɔna. Ba kpekkoo lugɔ danyɛ ni lugbii, di vol ra fini nɛra.

ref: Silver can be purified in a fiery furnace, but my people are too wicked to be made pure, and so I have rejected them.
text: Nɛra ra yir baabuu saliŋhuŋŋa la baŋ vɛɛwɛ tau, dikuu mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n vɛɛ baa ta wia.”

ref: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
text: Ka n nɛra waa sɛɛwɛ bá nuu tɛŋ, ka dɔɔ dignikpega, di ɛɛ wichɔgaa werge maa kaali ba naabaala.

ref: Stop taking advantage of foreigners, orphans, and widows. Don't kill innocent people. And stop worshiping other gods.
text: di ii waa hɔɔhra, lalbiizi ani luhaana ra fini, di ii waa kpu nɛra la n waa bilchɔg dɔɔwɛ, di ii waa kuari vuga la n niŋ chɔg ia,

ref: Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you.
text: Ií gilɛɛ waa yardi daraa wiŋɔzi, di ra ŋɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi Diarɛ keŋ, Kɔraawiizi Diarɛ keŋ!’

ref: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
text: Wibii maa, di ii char ii manni ni ii wiɛɛlaa, di ra di dɔŋa wibii,

ref: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
text: guŋwaa, n daŋ gil ii du a hɛri naa miŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ ii naabaala ni bampirsɔna, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
text: Ií ra nuu, ii yardi kara wiŋɔzi la n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛɛ.

ref: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
text: Ii ra ŋmɛɛu, di ra kpu nɛra, di ra sɛm, di ra hɛɛhzi ka ra kanni kara, di ra fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma ra tɛɛ vug Baal, di ra kuari vuga la iiŋ faa waa zummɛ.

ref: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?
text: Wia la miŋ kiiwee ii ra ɛɛ, ka ɔɔ wa chi n see, n himmaa Dia biini di ra ŋɔ lugɔ wiimaa wàá huuzi ia.

ref: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
text: Ií ra fɛu lugɔ n Dia ɛɛ ŋmɛɛna suahribɔttɛa? Ka n na pessi ii wiɛɛlaarɛ! Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
text: Ií la Silo la miŋ faa felee lizi, bá ra jaamiŋ de la, di ga na gunla miŋ chɔguu, dikuu n nɛra Izrɛl hina wichɔgaa wia.

ref: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
text: Iinna ɛɛ annii naa maa la, n faa karfi iabuu digiidigii, ka ii waa nuuwɛ. N yir ia ka ii waa sɛɛwɛ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
text: Awia, gunla miŋ ɛɛ Silo la, gunnɛ n kpa ɛɛ n Dia naa iiŋ dɛllɛɛ, n Sɔŋ sag u ni naa, bɔr la miŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ ii ni ii mɛɛwaa la.

ref: And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes. Punishment for Worshiping Other Gods
text: N daŋ duŋŋi ii Juda hina lii n be gunla miŋ duŋŋi ii lulla Izrɛl hina la n du wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag la. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.” A nɛra dignikpega wia

ref: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
text: Haa gunla banna ɛɛ Juda bolzenaa ni Jɛrusalɛm ŋmɛnizenaa biine nawɛɛa?

ref: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
text: Bichalli paagi daazii, ba mɛɛwaa chem ninzeŋ, haana ŋmir sau di ɔɔzi paanuuzi tɛɛ vug la banna yir Chiŋ Wiche. Ba yiili sinnɛ ta vuga, di chagziŋ.

ref: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
text: Ka n baannɛ ba ra fuuhwaa? Akai! Ba himmaanii ba ra tɔɔri, bá ŋmaabi. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
text: Awia, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la daŋ gil n baaŋ fuuh werge bɔnnaa ni newea, sela, kooni daazi ani a hɛri pattikuna ni alugɔ niŋ. U daŋ fuuh, ba wàá wer sɔɔnuu.

ref: The Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, but I won't accept sacrifices from you. So don't even bother bringing them to me. You might as well just cook the meat for yourselves.
text: N nɛra Izrɛl hina, màá lɛɛ ii mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa maa. Awia, di ii ɔɔ wa daali a ola, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ ií ra hee a maa!

ref: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
text: Miŋ faa lizi ii naabaala lii Ijip hɛri di ŋɔ wia tɛɛ baa la, mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa ni mbusuzi lizaa bɛŋ wia lɛi,

ref: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
text: ka kenne n ŋɔ tɛɛ baa, ‘Ií ra hiŋiŋ, ń ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la iin ninna hum, ii ge ɛɛ n nɛra. Ií ra hiŋ ŋmɛnizi la maa miŋ bagli ia la, ii wiimaa kuari.’

ref: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
text: Ka ba waa sɛɛwɛ bá nuu gɛɛ di hiŋ guŋ, ka kpa ŋmɛnɛɛ la n waa dɛkkɛ, di kpoŋ di dɔɔ dignikpega, di ra ɛɛ ba kipar. Di bir la har ka gil see laŋaa.

ref: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
text: Di lii saŋa la ii naabaala n lii Ijip hɛri di wa lii ni zinaa, hɔpizi biimaa, aŋ hum n dɔgtɛɛzii ii be digiidigii.

ref: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
text: Awia, ŋɔ ba be lugɔ ba hɛri naa hina waa sɛɛwɛ bá hiŋ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la nua gɛɛ di nuu baglaa. Wibii tunnɔɔ, ba waa kaa ra ŋɔ u wia gba.

ref: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií gbaari ii nyuhuna, di kpaa ta. Ií tinni giŋgimee nyuuni di ra yir lee yira. N vɛɛ n nɛraa, dikuu n baaŋ n na fuuh ba ni wia. Nɛkpui Werge Waluu wia

ref: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
text: Juda hina ɛɛ wikunaa n sibɔɔ, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ. Ba kpa ba vuga la miŋ kiiwe labuu wa chiŋŋi n Dia la n sɔŋ n sag u ni la biinii, di chɔguu.

ref: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
text: Ba ma mbusu lizibɔttɛ Bɛn Hinɔm Waluu biini, di ra yiruu Tɔfɛf, bá kpa ba biibaala ni biihaana di ra lizi mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa u ni. Miŋ lɛi ŋɔ bá ra ɛɛ guŋ. N faa waa gunna fɛ gba.

ref: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
text: Awia, ii zum nɛnnɛ lugɔ saŋa ra bau, nɛra wàá kaa waa yiruu Tɔfɛf gɛɛ Bɛn Hinɔm Waluu, ka ba daŋ jaa ra yiruu Nɛkpui Werge Waluu, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba daŋ hug nɛra de guŋŋ bɔr wàá kaa wa du de.

ref: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
text: Ba bɔrahɔna daŋ birgi diwee tɛɛ zumbizi ni pir sela. Nɛr maa wàá du de di duŋŋaa.

ref: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
text: A hɛri maa daŋ birgi hɛribɔduma. N daŋ tɔ bɔsɔna ni hindii Juda bolzenaa ni Jɛrusalɛm ŋmɛnizenaa biini. Haŋfalaa diuzenaa dii bɔsɔna kɔɔi wàá ka du de.”

ref: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “A saŋa, ba daŋ wigzi Juda koora, u nabɔnzi, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, u dɔgtɛɛzi ani nɛra la maa n faa du Jɛrusalɛm biini hoga lii ba ŋmama biine.

ref: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
text: Wiizi ra lɔ a ni. Baagu ni chinchiŋwilaa la baŋ faa nɔŋŋɛɛ di ra humaa, di ra hiŋaa, di ra pɛɛzaa, di ra kuaraa la ge ra chaani a ni. Ba wàá chaalaa gɛɛ di hugaa, ka a daŋ chɔɔ lugɔ kpaga di yaari hɛri maa.

ref: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
text: Hɛrchɔgii naa nɛra la n niŋ ka, di du bɔra la maa miŋ duŋŋi baa du la, danna nyiŋŋi lugɔ bá siuzi kaali ba de dui. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hinnɛ ŋɔ guŋ.” Wichɔgaa ni dignitɛraa wia

ref: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ mìŋ́ Jɛrɛmia ŋɔ tɛɛ u nɛra, “Di baala chollo, ba waa ɔɔ kaa izaa? Di baal leuwo, waa ɔɔ kaa biraa?

ref: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ nɛra naa bir har kpunnɛi? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ Jɛrusalɛm hina ɔɔ ra bir ba hara di ra kpunnɛi? Ba dɛlli vugaa, di vɛɛ lugɔ ba bir ba n be.

ref: I listen carefully, but none of you admit that you've done wrong. Without a second thought, you run down the wrong road like horses running blindly into battle.
text: N keŋŋi dignaa di nuu ba be nɛnnɛ, ka ba waa wibii ra ŋɔ. Bɛl maa biini waa chɔkkɛ u wichɔgaa wia ka ra ŋɔ, ‘Bɛɛ n ɛɛi?’ Bɛl maa kpa u kipar ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ, di ra ɛɛ wia la n paruu alugɔ zagu n ɔɔ chɔ gaa zuu laal biini gunla.

ref: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
text: Niilaaraazi gba zum saŋazii, kommazi, koŋkoroŋbizi ani kagchagaa zum saŋazi la an niŋ la bɔfalaa. Ka n nɛra waa, waa zum wii la minna nyiŋŋi.

ref: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
text: Ɛrɛɛ ii wer ŋɔ lugɔ ii dɔɔ nunzumaa, di zum n Gbɔgnɛi? Ii na, karchizi la wia n waa wibii dɔɔwɛ, lawaabuu birgi.

ref: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
text: Nunzunna daŋ di hiihzi. Ba bugmoore, di ɛɛ kinchaŋ, dikuu baŋ vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii wia. Bɛɛ nunzumaa ba kaa dɔɔi?

ref: I'll give their wives and fields to strangers. Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
text: Awia, n daŋ kpa ba kooni tɛɛ nɛfalaa, di kpa ba haana ge tɛɛ badumazi. Ba nɛzenaa ni nɛdumazi maanii ra fini nɛra bá na kebee. Haali n dɔgtɛɛzi ni n kizeehina maanii ra fini nɛra.

ref: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
text: Ba ɔɔ na n nɛra ŋmɛraa, ka ra yiraa bɔforgaa, Ba ɔɔ ŋɔu lugɔ bampirsɔna du denii, bampirsɔna du denii, ka bampirsɔna waa hoo.

ref: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
text: Hiihzi ɔɔ lau baabuu dikuu ba wikuna naa wiaa? Akai, a guŋ waa baa dɔɔwɛ hiihzi, ba baga lɛi, ba waa ɔɔ willi ba nyuuni gba. Awia, di n wa tɛr ba digna, ba daŋ chol gunla baŋhina n cholle la, ba wia maa daŋ tuŋ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
text: N daŋ chɔgi ba pattikuna maa, grepu daazi wàá nɔŋ. Fig daazi wàá nɔŋ, a paŋhoori maa ge hil. Anla miŋ tɛɛ baa la maanii ń bir lɛɛ ba be. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
text: Kɔraawiizi nɛra ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ yaa so ɛnnɛi? Ií chaali, ya chɔ kaali a bolzeŋkpega, yaa wia ga tuŋ de! Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la chɔgi yaa wiimaanii, yá siuzi, u tɛɛ yaabuu nii la n dɔɔ siri, yaa nyɔɔ, dikuu yaa n ɛɛ wichɔgaa zuu u ni wia.

ref: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
text: Yaa faa dɔɔ bampirsɔna tamiirɛ, ka winanii maa waa ballɛ, yaa dɔɔ chaai ge tamii, ka guŋ saŋaa ɔnsii werge du de.

ref: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
text: Yaa dɔma la teŋ zuu Dan bolzeŋ la biinii tuŋ, yaa ra nuu ba zagra n na lɔ a miizizi. Ba zagra ra wii, ɔnsii lau a hɛri nɛra maa. Yaa dɔma ballɔɔ bá wa chɔgi yaa hɛri ni bolzenaa ni a nɛra maa nyaamm.”
