ref: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Ií ra du tau, n daŋ gil ii dɔma la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ hɛrikuna la n dɔɔ siri, a waa pɛssaa dɔɔwɛ la, wa lɔ ia.” Jɛrɛmia biini n chɔkkɛ dikuu u nɛra wia

ref: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
text: N biinichɔg waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ, n tamii tuŋ, n bɔra huah.

ref: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
text: A nuu n nɛra naa n du hɛhjaŋa n na chɛɛhgi, “Kɔraawiizi waa hoo Ziɔnnɛ gɛɛ? U koori waa kaa du de gɛɛ?” Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ ba koori ŋɔ, “Ka ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ba fuuh n baaŋ ni ba nonee kuŋkuaraa ni ba vuga la miŋ kiiwe, baŋ kpawɛɛ lii hɛrdumazi ba lai?”

ref: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
text: A nɛra wii di ra ŋɔ, “Kuna kumaa saŋa bɛrɔɔrɛ, lumaŋa ge tuŋ, di yaa haa waa lɛɛi nawɛɛ.”

ref: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
text: Awia, Jɛrɛmia ŋɔ, “N biini chɔkkɔɔ, dikuu n nɛra biine n chɔkkɛ wia. N na wiiu ni biinichɔg werge.

ref: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
text: Di tagzi ni tagɛɛra du Giliadii, ka bɛɛ n baani n nɛra waa chaai nawɛɛi?”

ref: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
text: Jɛrɛmia bir ŋɔ, “N nyuu faa ɛɛ lugɔ bule, n sinii ge ɛɛ lugɔ nii n na pal! N daŋ vii wii bɔchaaŋ ni hahmuŋa maa, dikuu baŋ kpu n nɛra wia.

ref: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
text: N vii wettoo na duuribɔr hɛribɔduma biini, n daŋ vii lii n nɛra naa be, di ga du de. Ba maa wia waa wibii dɔɔwɛ, ba ɛɛ vugkuara ni sɔsɔgɔ hinaa.

ref: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
text: A ba ɛɛ siryaa bá kanni kara, kara bɛnnɛ su a hɛri maa, wibii waa hoo.” Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N nɛra ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii, ba waa zummɛ lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi la ban ninna hum.

ref: Jeremiah, all your friends and relatives tell lies about you, so don't trust them.
text: Jɛrɛmia, a du i dammuzi tau, gilɛɛ waa yardi ii lulla gba. Ba bɛl maa ɛɛ nɛdattii, i dammu maa ge ɛɛ nɛzɔɔzi.

ref: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
text: I du kara baambaannɛ, dikuu ba nɛdaraa wia, ba vɛɛ n tɔgzaarɛ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: And so I will purify the hearts of my people just as gold is purified in a furnace. I have no other choice.
text: Awia, Kenne Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ, “N daŋ lizi ba doŋa, di ɛɛ baa na, alugɔ baŋ ɔɔ du lugbii niŋ, bá lizi u doŋa la. Di guŋ lɛi, ɛrɛɛ ń kaa ɛɛ n nɛra naa, dikuu ba wichɔgaa naa wiai?

ref: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
text: Ba nuuzuŋŋa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hobichɔgaa, ba ɔɔ ra kanni karaa saŋaa saŋa maa. Nuusum bɛnnɛ ba dɔɔ tɛɛ dɔŋa, ka ba wiŋɔzi maa ɔɔ ɛɛ sidɛɛzii, ba ra he dɔŋa.

ref: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
text: A waa dɛkkɛ miŋ tɛr ba digna dikuu keŋ wiaa? A waa dɛkkɛ miŋ turgi keŋ hɛri naa hina a kimaa?”

ref: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
text: Denii Jɛrɛmia ŋɔ, “N daŋ lɔ wile, di wii tɛɛ bizenaa ni sela diiribɔra maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, a maanii hillɛ. Nɛr maa ge waa kaa ra vol a biine, haa ɔɔ kaa nuu sel maa gbɔga. Zumbizi maa zaah kaali, pir sela ge maa chɔ kaali.”

ref: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N daŋ gil Jɛrusalɛm purgi chɔɔ kulululu, di birgi hohobiazi duuribɔr, di gil Juda bolzenaa purgi chɔɔ burburbur, nɛr maa wàá kaa ra zuua.”

ref: I said to the Lord, “None of us can understand why the land has become like an uncrossable desert. Won't you explain why?”
text: Denii n pɛɛzi, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ a hɛri chɔgi, di hil lugɔ hɛribɔduma, nɛr maa wàá kaa ra vol u biinei? Anɛɛ n dɔɔ nunzuma ú zum keŋ zɛɛi? Anɛɛ i bagli u zɛɛ tɛɛ, ú bagluu tɛɛ nɛrai?”

ref: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Kennaa ɛɛwɔɔ, dikuu n nɛra n vɛɛ n baglaa la miŋ bagli baa la. Ba waa n nua hiŋŋɛ gɛɛ di hiŋ n Gbɔg.

ref: They were stubborn and worshiped Baal, just as their ancestors did.
text: Ka ba kpoŋŋoo di ra kuari vug Baala, gunla ba mɛɛwaa n bagli baa la.

ref: So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink.
text: Awia, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la Izrɛl hina n na hum la daŋ gil a nɛra naa di diukpola, di nyɔɔ nii la n dɔɔ siri.

ref: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
text: N daŋ duŋŋi baa yaari hɛssi la, ba ni ba naabaala n waa zummɛ, di kpa tokobi duŋŋi baa guŋŋ di wa kpu baa.” Jɛrusalɛm hina n wiiwe ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa wia

ref: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
text: Wia naabuu Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la kaa ŋɔ, “Lɔ nfɛrɛ na di lii wii naa n na ɛɛ naa biini! Yir haana la n zum lee wiraa, banla n zum wiraa nɛnnɛ.”

ref: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
text: Denii a nɛra ŋɔ, “Ií ŋɔ ba be bá hahzi wa yir liyir tɛɛ yaa, di ra ba saŋa la yaa sinii n niŋ waa pal.”

ref: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
text: Ií ra nuu Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina wiraa, “Yaa wia chɔkkɔɔ! Yaa di hiihzii werge! A dɛkkɔ yaa n lii yaa hɛri naa biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba purgi yaa diini maanii.”

ref: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
text: Denii n ŋɔ, “Haana, ií keŋŋi digna di ra nuu Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔzi. Ií bagli ii biihaana gunla banna wii lee, di kaa bagli ii dammuzi liyir.

ref: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
text: Siu ga tokorozii zuu yaa diikpegaa, di kpu yaa bichalli la n du ŋmɛnizenaa, di kaa kpu yaa biipɔllaa la n du bossibaana.

ref: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, ‘Lalaa yaari bɔr maanii, di chɔɔ kulululu lugɔ baŋ paa nabina dau koo, di kaa chɔɔ lugɔ baŋ kuugi sɔgmia yaari, nɛr maa waa hoo u chaalaa.’ ”

ref: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
text: Ka nɛr la maa n na jigsi, ú ra jigsi dikuu uŋ zum wia zɛɛ, di zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi. Gunla miŋ nɔŋŋi nɛra, di ra ɛɛ winanaa, di ra di wibii, di ra ɛɛ wideŋlaa hɛri naa biini. Wia naabuu ra pariŋ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
text: Ijip, Juda, Ɛdɔm, Ammɔn, Moab hina ani banla maa n du hɛribɔduma, di du hɛhjaŋa. A hɛssi naa hina maa wia waa wibii dɔɔwɛ n be, haali baŋ teŋri ba hɛna, di ra bagli n ni baa nuukpaŋ la, ka ba ni Izrɛl hina maa waa a nuukpaŋ hiŋŋɛ.”

ref: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
text: U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Ií gilɛɛ ra hiŋ a hɛssi hina wiɛɛlaa. Ií gilɛɛ gil ii bɔra ra sa, dikuu wizenaa la iinna na chiŋ la wia, haali a hɛssi hina bɔra n na sa, dikuu guŋ wia gba.

ref: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
text: A nɛra naa naana wia waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ. Ba ɔɔ ga mɔŋ daarɛ lii kɔr biini, sɛɛhri sɛɛuh.

ref: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
text: Ba ɔɔ kpa saliŋhuŋŋu ni salinnɛ bɔguu, di kpaahzuu chiŋŋi, ú gilɛɛ waa chol.

ref: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
text: A keŋ vuga naa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baŋ kuari kuŋ lugɔ newee chiŋŋi koo, u ra ɔnzi kuna. Ba vuga wàá wer ŋɔ wia, a wàá wer vol, see baŋ chigaa. Ií gilɛɛ ra ɔmaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, a wàá wer ɛɛ ia wichɔgii gɛɛ winanii maa.’

ref: Our Lord, great and powerful, you alone are God.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nɛr maa waa lugɔi. I kpekkoo di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge, di dɔɔ sɔŋ werge.

ref: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.
text: Anɛɛ n wàá tɔgzii wergei, hɛssi maa Kooria? I dɛkkɔɔ banna tɔgzii. Hɛssi maa nunzunna ni ba koora bɛl maa, wàá wer kpa u nyuu lɔi.

ref: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!
text: Ba maa ɛɛ gɛnaarɛ, ba waa nunzuma maa dɔɔwɛ. Bɛɛ ba wer helli lii daazi la n ɛɛ vuga benei?

ref: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
text: Nɛr la n zum nonee huma ni luuri ge ɔɔ kpa saliŋhuŋŋaa lii bolzeŋ Taasis gɛɛ saliŋ lii Ufaz paga, di luu margi a ni. Suahra la ge n zum suahri nɛnnɛ, suah pɛɛmburgu ni pɛɛŋ aahmu lugɔ zagbiiŋ nii, di bɔguu chiŋŋi.

ref: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
text: Ka n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i bɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa, la n du de saŋa maa, di ɛɛ koori la n waa luglaa ni tunaa dɔɔwɛ. Di i baaŋ wa fuuhwo, durnya hina bɔra ɔɔ ra sau, hɛssi hina wàá wer chi.

ref: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be, ‘Ŋɔ ba be lugɔ vuga naa n waa chiŋ ni hɛri tawɛɛ naa maa wia daŋ chɔgi.’ ” Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa yir

ref: With your wisdom and power you created the earth and spread out the heavens.
text: Kɔraawiizi ta hɛrii ni u fɔŋŋa, di ta durnya ni u nunzuma, di yaa chiŋ ni u wia zɛɛ zumaa.

ref: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
text: Di u wa pozoo lugɔ nazaa, niiri la n du chiŋ ɔɔ wiiu. U ɔɔ giluu baamazi izi bɔr maa. U ɔɔ giluu dooŋ nyɛgzaa ni dooŋ maa kpau ba, di gil peu lii u kuna dauribɔr, di waa ta.

ref: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
text: Nɛr maa ɛɛ gɛniirɛ, di nyaa nunzuma! Vugkuari maa daŋ di hiihzi, dikuu u vuga wia. U vuga ɛɛ kumpɛɛrii, a waa heezi.

ref: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
text: A ɛɛ kumpɛɛrii, di ɛɛ chɛɛtɛ kuna. Di a seriya dii saŋa wa hello, Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔgaa.

ref: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi la yaa naabaal Jekɔb naanna n na hum la, waa lugɔ annii. Waabuu ta kummaa, di lizi Izrɛl hina, ba ɛɛ u himmaa nɛra. U sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ. Hɛhchɔg n na ba wia

ref: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina, ba fɔɔ iabuu! Ií chaali ii kundɔɔlaa lii a hɛri.

ref: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N daŋ duŋŋi nɛra la n soge hɛri naa biini ta. N daŋ gil biinichɔg lau baa, guŋ gil bá wer lauri baa.”

ref: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina lɔ wile werge, di ŋɔ, “Na gunla yaa n na pira werge maa! Yaa ŋmɛra wàá wer tuŋ. Yaa faa zummɔɔ lugɔ u ɛɛ wii la yaa n niŋ wer di u kanyittii!

ref: Our homes are destroyed; our children are dead. No one is left to help us find shelter.”
text: Yaa tanti diini maanii chɔkkɛ, a ŋmɛnni maa chaazi. Yaa biizi maa siu. Nɛr maa waa ka hoo ú bir baŋaa tɛɛ yaa.

ref: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
text: Yaa sitɔɔra nyaa nfɛrɛɛ, ba waa ɔɔ pɛɛzi Kɔraawiizi na. Awia, ba waa ɔɔ nyɛɛli, ba sela maa yaari.

ref: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
text: Ií ra nuu! Amaniye ballɔɔ. Kɔɔi werge lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag hɛrii ba. U laallɔɔra daŋ wa purgi Juda bolzenaa maa, a birgi diŋgelli, di ɛɛ hohobiazi duuribɔra.” Jɛrɛmia wiisuŋŋaa wia

ref: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n zummɔ lugɔ newee lɛi dɔɔ u miibɔɔ. Newee hor lɛi lugɔ ú ra bagli u kipar.

ref: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, kpa i wibii dii la di deŋliŋ, ka gilɛɛ waa kpa baaŋ, di ra birgiŋ pɛɛ.

ref: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
text: Gil i baaŋ fuuh hɛssi hina la n wɛɛ ra hum la ni werge, banla n waa i sɔŋ na yir la ni. Ba kpu i nɛraa, ba dim yaabuu, di gil yaa hɛri birgi diŋgela.

ref: The Lord God told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord, am warning you that I will put a curse on anyone who doesn't keep the agreement I made with Israel. So pay attention to what it says.
text: Ŋɔ ba be, dí kenne mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la ŋɔ, ‘Núuseei di baal la maa n waa sɛɛwɛ ú hiŋ gunla n ni n nɛra nuukpaŋ naa n na bagli.

ref: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
text: Wia la miŋ dauwɛ tɛɛ ii naabaala, saŋa la miŋ lizi baa lii Ijip hɛri la n faa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ zugzizeŋ niŋ la.’ N faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Ií ra hiŋiŋ, di ra ɛɛ wia la maa miŋ ŋɔ ií ra ɛɛ la, denii ii ɛɛ n nɛra, ń ge ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la iin ninna hum.

ref: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. “Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
text: Denii nua la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ ii naabaala la jaa su u maga lugɔ n daŋ kpa hɛri la n summɛ, di dɔɔ diwee ni kunnanaa werge la tɛɛ baa, ú ɛɛ ba kundɔɔlii.’ ” Denii n jaa sɛɛ, di ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, Ami.”

ref: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Sii wia naa maa Juda bola ni Jɛrusalɛm ŋmɛnizenaa biine, di ŋɔ, ‘Ií ra nuu n ni n nɛra nuukpaŋ dɔɔi widaulaa naa, di ra hiŋaa nɛnnɛ.

ref: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
text: Di lii saŋa la miŋ lizi ii naabaala lii Ijip hɛri di wa lii ni zinaa, n karfi baabuu digiidigii, di ŋɔ lugɔ bá ra hiŋiŋ.

ref: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
text: Ka ba waa sɛɛwɛ bá nuu tɛŋ gɛɛ di ra du tau, ka dɔɔ dignikpega, di ra hiŋ ba nfɛrchɔgaa wiɛɛlaa. Awia, n faa gil n ni baa nuukpaŋ nuuseezi la miŋ karfi baa ŋɔ bá ra hiŋ, ka ba vɛɛ la di baa.’ ”

ref: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Jɛrusalɛm ni Juda hina ra ta n jinachɔgaarɛ.

ref: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
text: Ba bittɔɔ ra hiŋ ba naabaala wichɔgaa ŋmɛnizi la baŋ faa ra hiŋ, di vɛɛ n nua hiŋaa la. Ba ra kuari vugaa, di ra sɛɛ a dɔɔra. Izrɛl ni Juda hina maanii chɔgi nuukpaŋ la n ni ba naabaala n ɛɛwɛ la.

ref: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
text: Awia, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ra karfi baabuu lugɔ n daŋ kpa hɛhchɔg la baŋ wàá wer lii u biini, ta ba ni. Haali baŋ wiiwe tɛŋ gba, ka màá ka nuu.

ref: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
text: Hoi, Juda hina, ii dɔɔ vugkpilaa werge gunla iin dɔɔ bolkpila la. Mbusu lizibɔra la iiŋ mawɛɛ, ií ra fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma, di ra tɛɛ vug Baal la miŋ kiiwe la, kpillɔɔ werge lugɔ Jɛrusalɛm ŋmɛnizenaa.

ref: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
text: Awia, Jɛrɛmia, gilɛɛ wa suŋŋi wiizi di ra tɛɛ a nɛra naa gɛɛ di wa lɛɛ ba nua di ra sɛɛ chɔgri maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, màá nuu tɛɛ baa bá biinichɔg werge saŋa.

ref: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
text: Nɛra la miŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ ra ɛɛ wikunaa. Anɛɛ n tɛɛ baa ŋmɛnɛɛ lugɔ ba du n Dia biinei? Ba zummɔɔ lugɔ nuuzi la banna lɛɛ, di ra kpu sela, di ra lizi mbusuzi labuu niŋ wer lɛɛ baa lii a hɛhchɔg naa biiniaa? Guŋ daŋ wer tɛɛ baa bɔsɔnaa?

ref: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi faa ra yir baabuu ɔlivi daa n lɔɔwɛ di nɔŋ nɛnnɛɛ. Ka filaŋkeŋ, n daŋ pozi werge lugɔ nazaa ni niŋ, di wa fuuh u paŋhoori, di kuugi u kela maa.

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la n gillɛ ii ɛɛ lugɔ daa la miŋ duuwe labuu kpa a hɛhchɔg ta ii ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, wichɔgaa la Izrɛl ni Juda hina n ɛɛwɛ, di fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma di ra tɛɛ vug Baal labuu gillɛ n baaŋ fuuh ii ni la.” Baŋ ta Jɛrɛmia jinachɔgii wia

ref: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
text: Kɔraawiizi pilli ba jinachɔgaa labuu bagliŋ, wia la banna nyiŋŋi bá ɛɛ.

ref: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.
text: N faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ peezi la n pɛssɛɛ, ba tɛrguu di ra la bá ga kɔrgi. Ka maa zummɛ lugɔ ba ta n kpui jinaa, di ra ŋɔ, “Ií gil ya chɔgi a daa ni u nɔna maa, ií gil ya teŋuu lii nɛra biini, ba ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka liizi u sɔŋ.”

ref: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
text: Denii n suŋŋi wiizi di ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, hinuu ra di seriya ni wibii, di ɛɛ nɛra biine ni nfɛssi di ra na. Gil n na kim la hin niŋ turgi baa. N wiimaanii n kpa du i nonee.”

ref: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Jɛrɛmia, Anatɔf hina ra nyiŋŋi i miibɔɔ lizaarɛ, di ra ŋɔ, ‘Gilɛɛ waa ŋɔ wia Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ biini, di guŋ lɛi, yaa daŋ kpui.’ ”

ref: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ, “N daŋ tɛr ba digna. Tokobii bá kpa kpu ba biipɔllaa, lɔchɔgii ge kpu ba biizi maa.

ref: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
text: N dau saŋaa min niŋ kpa hɛhchɔg wa ta Anatɔf hina ni. Di a guŋ saŋa wa hello, ba bɛl maa wàá ka ka.”

ref: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
text: Jɛrɛmia ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, saŋa maanii i wia maa ɔɔ deŋli, di n haŋ wa kpa wia ba i be. Ka n daŋ ŋɔ i wibii dii wia. Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ biinikpola hina ra nyɛɛlɛi? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ yarda nyaara du ni bampirsɔnai?

ref: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
text: Hinuu duu baa lugɔ daa, di gil ba nyɛɛli, di ra nɔŋ. Ba ɔɔ ra chɔliibuu, ka ba baga lɛi i wia.

ref: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ka i zumimbuu, i ra na n wiɛɛlaa ni gunla miŋ nɔŋŋiibuu. Tɛrgi wichɔgɛɛra naa kaali alugɔ peeza banna nyiŋŋi bá kpu. A binni baa guŋŋ bá kpui saŋa wa hel.

ref: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
text: Ɛrɛɛ yaa hɛri hil, kooree la n du kooni siu di birgi magɛi? Dikuubɛɛwiai, banla maa n du de la ɛɛ biinikpola hinaa, Sela ni zumbizi maanii siuwɛ. Haali guŋ gba, a nɛra ra ŋɔu, ‘Kɔraawiizi wàá na wii la n na ɛɛ yaa.’ ” Gunla Kɔraawiizi n bittɛ ŋɔ Jɛrɛmia be wia

ref: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi bir ŋɔ, “Jɛrɛmia, di i ni nɛra chɔwɔɔ, ba gil i kuuh, ɛrɛɛ i ni zagra wer chɔi? Hinna jiŋli bɔr la n chaanɛɛ biini, ɛrɛɛ i ɛɛ vol, kɔr la n du Jɔɔdan muu kɛrii la biinei?

ref: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
text: I lulla, haali i diahina gba, ra chɔgi i sɔnnɛ. Ba ɛɛ nuukpannɛ bá naai. Gilɛɛ waa yardi baa, haali banna ŋɔ i wia nɛnnɛ gba.”

ref: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “N vɛɛ Izrɛl hinaa ta. N vɛɛ hɛri la nɛra miŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ n hinnɛ. N kpa nɛra la miŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ wergee du ba dɔma nonee biini.

ref: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
text: Nɛra la miŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ n hiŋ la, bittɔɔ chi n ni alugɔ bunyiŋ n du kɔr biini, di wii ra duŋ, awia, n hah baabuu.

ref: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
text: Nɛra la miŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ n hiŋ la, ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ zumbee, kɔlli n gowee, á lau. Ií yirgi pir sela, á ba wa di diuzenaa.

ref: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
text: Hɛrdumazi koorikpila ballɔɔ di wa chɔgi n nɛra alugɔ grepu daazi koo, di fɛrgi n kooni, di gil n hɛrsum la birgi hɛribɔduma.

ref: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
text: A hɛribɔduma giŋgimee nyuuni maanii, chɔgra kpila wa yaari, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa u tokobi, wa chi a hɛri tuna bɛl, di chɔguu ga lii bɛl, nɛr maa wàá na u hiŋ.

ref: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
text: N nɛra daŋ duu mia, ka kum kooree. Ba daŋ kuuh werge, ka ba wàá na kummaa. Awia, ií di ii kuna kumaa hiihzi, dikuu Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuihchɔgii la wia.”

ref: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Hɛssi la hina biine n kpolle, ba so bar hɛri la miŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ n nɛra Izrɛl hina la chɔguubuu. N daŋ duŋŋi baa lii ba hɛssi, di lizi Juda hina maa lii ba biini.

ref: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
text: Ka di n wa duŋŋi baa de tuŋ, n daŋ kaa na ba sinyɛna, di gil bɛl maa bir ba u himmaa hɛri, di kaa wa dɔɔ u kapɛttɛ kuna.

ref: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
text: Di ba wa helli n nɛra ŋmɛnizi nɛnnɛ, di kpa n sɔŋ hɛɛhzi, di ŋɔ, ‘N hɛɛhzi Kɔraawiizi la n du de,’ haali baŋ faa bagli n nɛra, ba kpa vug Baal sɔŋ hɛɛhzi la gba, ka ba daŋ so n nɛra biini.

ref: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
text: Ka di hɛri la maa hina waa haŋ wa nuu tɛŋ, n daŋ lizi baa, di dim baa nyaamm. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ mìŋ́ Jɛrɛmia be, “La ga yau pɛɛŋhuŋŋunanii kirsɔɔ di kirsi, ka gilɛɛ wa gil nii ra gbɔgzuu.”

ref: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
text: Awia, n ga yawuu, di kpau kirsi, gunla Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ n ɛɛ la.

ref: Then the Lord said,
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be,

ref: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
text: “Kpa a kirsɔɔ la Muu Yufretis nua, di ga suah bii bɔɔ biini de.”

ref: Some time later the Lord said, “Go back and get the shorts.”
text: Saŋa bɛl n wa helle, Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “La Muu Yufretis ga kpa kirsɔɔ la miŋ ŋɔ i kpa suah la, di ba.”

ref: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
text: Awia, n la Muu Yufretis, bɔr la miŋ kpau suah. Miŋ ga nau, di u siuwɔ, waa kaa dɔɔ tɔna maa.

ref: Then the Lord said:
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be,

ref: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
text: “Keŋ himmaanii n chɔgi Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm hina barabara werge la.

ref: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
text: A biinikpola hina naa vɛɛ n nua hiŋaarɛ, ka dɔɔ dignikpega, di ra ɛɛ ba kipar, di la gaa kuari vuga, di ra sɛɛ a dɔɔra. Awia, ba daŋ ɛɛ alugɔ a kirsɔɔ naa n waa kaa dɔɔ tɔna naa.

ref: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
text: Gunla kirsɔɔ n ɔɔ lau baal chara nɛnnɛ la, gunnɛ n lau Juda ni Izrɛl hina maa nɛnnɛ. N ɛɛ gunnɛ bá ɛɛ n nɛra, ń sɔŋ na chɔlaa ni girme. Ka ba waŋ hiŋŋɛ.” Siŋ hure wia

ref: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Jɛrɛmia, ŋɔ Izrɛl hina be lugɔ bá fɛɛni siŋ su siŋ hur maa. Ba daŋ ŋɔ i be lugɔ ba zummɔ lugɔ a dɛkkɔɔ siŋ hur maa n niŋ su siŋ.

ref: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
text: Denii í ŋɔ ba be, ‘Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ lugɔ n daŋ gil nɛra la maa n du hɛri naa ɛɛ sinnyɔɔra, koora la n soge Koori Deevid koorikara ni, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi ani banla maa n du Jɛrusalɛm biini.

ref: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
text: N daŋ lau mɛɛwaa ni biibaala maa lɔ dɔŋa alugɔ baŋ purgi viini. Màá na ba sinyɛna, di gil ba kpui. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.’ ” Jɛrɛmia n karfi Izrɛl hina ba jigsi wia

ref: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
text: Denii n ŋɔ Izrɛl hina be, “Ií keŋŋi digna di ra nuu nɛnnɛ. Ii gilɛɛ kpoŋ di ra jigsi! Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
text: Ií ra tɔgzi Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la, mɔɔ ka u gil bɔbiri chol ii ni, ii ra lɔɔzi naazi giŋgimee nyuuni, di ra chogli. Ii dɔɔ bɔchaaŋ tamiirɛ, ka u daŋ lauwuu birgi bɔbiri limpiriŋ, di birguu biinichɔg werge.

ref: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
text: Ka di ii waa nuuwɛ, n daŋ suah wii dikuu ii jigsi wia. N daŋ wii werge, sinii ra lii, dikuu ban niŋ lɔ Kɔraawiizi nɛra laal, di lauri baa kaali wia.”

ref: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Ŋɔ a koori ni u maa be lugɔ bá izi ba koorikassi ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba saliŋ kahuronanaa la daŋ lii ba nyuuni chogli.”

ref: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
text: Nɛgɛv bolzenaa maanii bá wa fɔɔ, nɛr maa wàá wer zuu gɛɛ di lii. Juda hina maanii bá wa lɔ laal di lauri kaali hɛrduma.

ref: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií na, ii dɔma lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakagrɛ di ra ba! Lee nɛra la baŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ ia ŋɔ ií ra binni la duɛi, banla iiŋ faa kuu ba wia di ra jigsi lai?

ref: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
text: Ɛrɛɛ ii ŋɔi, di nɛra la iinna yir ii dammuzi wa lɔ ia di kpegli ia, di ra di kora ii ninɛi? A danna wii ii ni werge maa alugɔ hilula n ɔɔ lɔ haaŋ la.

ref: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
text: Di ii wa pɛɛzi iihinaa, “Bɛɛ n baani kennaa wia huuzi yaai?” Ii wichɔgaa wiarɛ tɔɔrɔɔ naa huuzi ia ii bɔra nyɛgi la.

ref: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
text: Itiopia hinuu daŋ wer chɛr u bɔrahɔŋ duula gɛɛ amani daŋ wer dinzi u bɔra chɛssaa? Gunnɛ ii wàá wer ɛɛ winanaa, dikuu wichɔgaa ɛɛi n mani ia wia.

ref: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
text: “N daŋ yaari ia gunla peu n ɔɔ lɔ zɔga yaari la.

ref: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
text: Ii hotte guŋ, n lizi dau ia, dikuu iiŋ suuh n wia, ka ra kuari vuga wia. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
text: N na iinna ɛɛ wia la miŋ kiiwee, gunla iinna sɛm giŋgimee nyuuni ni kooni la, di ra hiŋ vuga alugɔ baal n nyiŋŋi u dɔŋhiŋ haaŋ gɛɛ zagbal n na nyiŋŋi zagniina la. Jɛrusalɛm hina, wia daŋ wa huuzi ia! Ɛrɛɛ ii doŋ di birgi magɛi?”

ref: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
text: Daama hina hum ba balaa, bá ga dɔɔ nii ba. Ba la kɔlɔnzi di ga nyiŋŋi nii huhzi, ka bir chi ba keudumazi ba. Ba bɔra huah, ba ɛɛ kinchaŋ. Ba jaa fɔɔzi ba nyuuni.

ref: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
text: Dikuu donii n waa hoo a hɛri, u maa hil wia. Patta ɛɛ kinchaŋ, di fɔɔzi ba nyuuni.

ref: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
text: Haali weenniina n lul u biifula, ka kooree n waa hoo wia, u vɛɛu ta.

ref: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
text: Pir kauzi tinni giŋgimee nyuunii di ra hɛg alugɔ hohobiazi. A siwee waa kaa ra na nɛnnɛ, dikuu aŋ waa diwee nawɛɛ wia.”

ref: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
text: Denii n nɛra wii di ra ŋɔ, “Haali yaa wichɔgaa n na tɛɛ yaa bilchɔg gba, yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛɛ wiibɛl dikuu i sɔŋ wia. Dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa bir hattɛ kpui saŋa kpila maa. Yaa ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ zuu i ni.

ref: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.
text: I bɛŋ benii Izrɛl hina dɔɔ tamii. Hinuu ɔɔ lɛɛ yaa ra lii hɛhchɔg biini. Bɛɛ wiarɛ i kaa ɛɛ lugɔ hɔɔhri a hɛrɛi alugɔ famaruu n volle, di wa hel yembɛl, di chɔɔ de hahmuŋkpaŋ bɛnnɛi?

ref: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
text: Ɛrɛɛ i ɛɛ lugɔ baŋ wa pirgi nɛrɛi? Di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ laallɔɔri la n waa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ ú lɛɛ nɛrɛi? Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i du yaa biinii, i sɔŋ sag yaa ni, gilɛɛ vɛɛ yaa ta!”

ref: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u nɛra wia, “Ba nɔŋŋi gaagaarɛ, ba waa ɔɔ ra lau bahinaa. Awia, ba wia wanna par. N daŋ liizi wichɔgaa la baŋ ɛɛwɛ, di tɛr ba digna dikuu guŋ wia.”

ref: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Gilɛɛ waa suŋŋi winanaa ra tɛɛ nɛra naa.

ref: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
text: Haali banna vɔɔ nuuzi di wii ra duŋ gba, ka màá nuu. Haali baŋ haa ra lizi mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa ni mbusuzi lizaa mia gba, ka màá lɛɛa. Ka laal, lɔchɔgii ani wiilchɔgaarɛ ń kpa kpu baa.”

ref: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
text: Ka n ŋɔ, “Hoi, Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, i dɔgtɛɛzi ɔɔ ra ŋɔ ba benii, ‘Laal gɛɛ lɔchɔgii wàá chol ii ni. Wibii maa, Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ bɔnnaa.’ ”

ref: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Karaa a dɔgtɛɛzi kpa n sɔŋ di ra kanni. Miŋ lɛi hum baa gɛɛ di lizi baa gɛɛ di ŋɔ wia tɛɛ baa. Ba himmaa winaalaa la n waa wibii ɛɛwɛ, ba vugaa, ba vuga kuaraa ani wia la n lii ba nfɛssi biinii ba ra ŋɔ.

ref: Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger.
text: Awia, kenne mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ ra tɛɛ dɔgtɛɛzi la n kpa n sɔŋ di ra ŋɔ wia la be, miŋ lɛi hum baa, ka ba ŋɔ, ‘Laal gɛɛ lɔchɔgii wàá chol hɛri naa ni.’ Awia, a dɔgtɛɛzi naa himmaanii ń kpa lɔchɔgii ni laal kpu.

ref: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
text: Nɛra la ge baŋ ŋɔ a wia ra tɛɛ la, ba daŋ yaari Jɛrusalɛm ŋmɛnizenaa maa biine, dikuu a lɔchɔgii ni a laal wia. Nɛr maa wàá du de hug baa. Ba haana ni biizi maanii ń kpa wiila la n dɛg baa, di kpu.”

ref: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be lugɔ ń ŋɔ n biinichɔg wia naa tɛɛ baa, “Gil n sinii ra pal hamuŋa ni bɔchaaŋ maa, di gilɛɛ waa teŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, a hɛssi hina na piraa werge maa, a zuu ba ni.

ref: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
text: Di n haŋ wa lii ra bar kooni, n ɔɔ na nɛra baŋ kpuwɛɛ laal biini, yaari bɔr maanii. Di n haŋ wa zuu bolzeŋ biini ge, n ɔɔ na lɔzi n na kpu nɛra, ba ra nyiŋŋi siuzaa. Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni u dɔgtɛɛzi ra hum huma la, baŋ waa a zɛɛ zummɛ a hɛri biini.”

ref: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
text: A nɛra pɛɛzi Kɔraawiizi, di ŋɔ, “Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i vɛɛ Juda hina wiarɛ kɔrai gɛɛ? I hah Jɛrusalɛm hinaa gɛɛ? Bɛɛ wiarɛ i du yaa pira naa keŋ, yaa wàá ka wer na chaaiyɛi? Yaa dɔɔ bampirsɔna tamiirɛ, ka yaa haa waa winanii maa nawɛɛ. Yaa dɔɔ chaai tamiirɛ, ka ɔnsii werge bɛŋ du de.

ref: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
text: A liizi nuuzi la hiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la wia, ka gilɛɛ vɛɛ yaa ta. Gilɛɛ waa kpa hiihzi ra kpu Jɛrusalɛm, bɔr la i girme koorikara n duwɛɛ la. Gilɛɛ waa chɔgi nuukpaŋ la i ni yaa n ɛɛwɛ la.

ref: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
text: A hɛssi naa vug bɛl maa wàá wer gil dooŋ ba. Chiŋ gba himmaa wàá wer gil dooŋ ba. Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, i bɛnnɛ niŋ wer gil guŋ ɛɛ. Awia, yaa tamii maa du i ninɛɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu niŋ wer ɛɛ wiimaa.”

ref: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Haali di ii naabaala Moosis ni Samuɛl gba haŋ wa chi n see, dikuu nɛra naa wia, ka màá suŋ ba ni. Gil ba kaali, gil ba leu n siwee!

ref: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
text: Di ba wa pɛɛzii, ‘Lee yá lanɛi?’ Ŋɔ ba be lugɔ kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, ‘Baŋhina hotte bá wii di siu, ba kaali bɔttɛ guŋ! Baŋhina ge hotte lugɔ bá siu laal biini, denii ba kaali! Lɔchɔgiirɛ niŋ kpu baŋhina ge, ba kaali bɔttɛ guŋ! Baŋhina ge hotte ban niŋ lauri baa kaali hɛri bɛl, ba kaali bɔttɛ guŋ!’

ref: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
text: Wichɔgaa anaazuu ń kpa chɔgi baa, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ. Laal biinii bá kpu baa, nuuzihina tuuzi baa kaali, zumbizi ni pir sela ge di baa.

ref: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
text: N daŋ gil hɛssi hina maa hah baa, dikuu wia la Juda Koori Hɛzɛkia biibaal Manasɛ, n kpawɛɛ dau Jɛrusalɛm hina la wia.”

ref: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Jɛrusalɛm hina, anɛɛ n niŋ na ii sinyɛnai? Anɛɛ n niŋ wii tɛɛ ia? Anɛɛ n niŋ chi pɛɛzi gunla iiŋ duwɛɛnɛi?

ref: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
text: Ii vɛɛmbuu, di bir har kpuŋ. Awia, n daŋ kpa n fɔŋŋa chɔgi ia. Màá ka suŋ ii ni.

ref: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
text: N daŋ chi a hɛri bolzeŋ dominuuzenaa, di hɛl ia alugɔ mia. N daŋ kpa biinichɔg ni siu ta n nɛra ni, dikuu baŋ waa ba wiɛɛlaa chɛttɛ wia.

ref: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.
text: N daŋ gil ii luhaana du kpil, di kaali muuzeŋ nua hɛɛhriichaa. N daŋ kpa wichɔgaa ta ii biipɔllaa maawaa ni, wibaŋa ni, di gil biinichɔg ni ɔnsii werge lau ia kakpaŋ.

ref: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jeremiah Complains
text: Haaŋ la n dɔɔ biizi baniidaanɛɛ daŋ huahgi, ú heeza teŋ. U bɔchaaŋ daŋ birgi bɔbiri, u daŋ di hiihzi di ŋmaabi. N daŋ gil ba dɔma kpa tokobi di kpu banla maa n kawɛɛ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
text: Ee, n ma! Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i lulunnɛi? N ni nɛr maanii ra naa, di ra di mmɔri hɛri naa biini. N ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa kuŋ kpawɛɛ kim nɛr gɛɛ di kim nɛr maa kuŋ, ka nɛr maa ra seeŋ nua.

ref: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Wibii maa, n daŋ lɛɛi, dikuu winanii bɛl ɛɛi wia. Wibii maa, n daŋ gil i dɔma wa suŋŋii, di tɔɔrɔɔzeŋ, hɛhchɔg ani biinichɔg wa chol ba ni.

ref: People of Judah, just as you can't break iron mixed with bronze, you can't defeat the enemies that will attack from the north.
text: Juda hina, gunla iiŋ wàá wer ku lugbii ni danyɛ n koozi dɔŋa ni la, gunnɛ ii wàá wer kpegli laallɔɔra la n lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag la.

ref: I will give them everything you own, because you have sinned everywhere in your country.
text: N nɛra, n daŋ hum ii dɔma, bá wa chi ii daama ni ii kundɔɔlaa maa kaali, dikuu wichɔgaa la iiŋ ɛɛ a hɛri biini wia.

ref: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
text: N daŋ gil ii ɛɛ ii dɔma yoma, hɛri la iiŋ waa zummɛ biini. Dikuubɛɛwiai, n baaŋ daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ ninlau, di fuuh ia.”

ref: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
text: Denii n ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i zum wia zɛɛrɛ, a liizi n wia, di ra du n tau. Turgi nɛra la n na tɔɔriŋ la kim. I baaŋ waa fuuh manamanaŋ. Gilɛɛ wàá kpuŋ, a liizi gunla miŋ di hiihzi dikuu i wia la.

ref: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, hiŋ ŋɔ wia tɛŋ la, n hiŋaabuu, a ɛɛŋ bɔsɔna, di ɛɛ n kipar, dikuubɛɛwiai, i sɔnnɛ sag n ni.

ref: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.
text: N ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa nɛra la n ɔɔ ra di bahinaa, di ra chaasi la be soge. N sogo n bɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu dɔɔŋ, di gil n baaŋ ra fuuh werge.

ref: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
text: Bɛɛ n baani n bɔra waazaa waa tunɛi? Bɛɛ n baani n ŋmɛra chum, a waa chaai dɔɔwɛi? I ra nyiŋŋuu i kpa hiihzi kpuŋ alugɔ gɔŋ n hillɛ yuu biini gɛɛ?”

ref: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Di i bir i liize, n daŋ kaa lɛɛi, di gil i ra humiŋ. Di i ra ŋɔ winanaa ka gil wikuna, i daŋ ɛɛ n dɔgtɛɛ. Gil a nɛra naa bir ba i be, ka hiŋwaa gilɛɛ wa bir di ra la ba be.

ref: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
text: N daŋ lɛɛi lii biinikpola hina nonee biini, di kaa lizii lii kaluzi maa biine.”

ref: The Lord said to me:
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be,

ref: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
text: “Gilɛɛ waa kpa haaŋ di ra lul biizi bɔnnaa dɔŋ.”

ref: I'll tell you what's going to happen to children and their parents here.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ biizi la maa baŋ lullɛ hɛri naa biini, ba maawaa ani ba mɛɛwaa wia,

ref: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
text: “Wiilchɔgaarɛ niŋ lau baa, bá siuzi, ka ba wàá wii ba lee gɛɛ di hug baa. Ba daŋ chɔɔgi lugɔ baŋ dau kpaga. Laal biinii ba kpu baa gɛɛ lɔchɔgiirɛ niŋ kpuuzi baa, bá bɔrahɔna ɛɛ diwee tɛɛ zumbizi ni pir sela.”

ref: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Gilɛɛ waa zuu dia la lee diwee n duwɛɛ. Gilɛɛ waa la de di gaa wii, di waa suŋ ba ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, màá ka kissi baa. Màá nɔŋŋi baa gɛɛ di suŋ ba ni. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
text: Dɔɔna ni nyaara maa daŋ siu a hɛri naa biini, ka nɛr maa wàá hug baa gɛɛ di wii ba lee. Nɛr maa wàá du u hiŋ pira gɛɛ di fuŋ u nyuu gba, dikuu ba siu hiŋ wia.

ref: No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.
text: Nɛr maa wàá lizi diwee, di tig banla n na wii bampiree. Ba wàá ɛɛ guŋ tɛɛ mɛɛ gɛɛ maa. Nɛr maa wàá tɛɛ baa siŋ, di tig ba bampiree.

ref: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.
text: Gilɛɛ waa zuu dia la banna di diuzenaa, di so de ra di, di ra nyɔɔ.

ref: Warn the people of Judah that I, the Lord All-Powerful, will put an end to all their parties and wedding celebrations.
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la Izrɛl hina n na hum la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘I de dui saŋa, n daŋ gil bɔsɔna kɔɔi tuŋ i sibɔɔ. Ba wàá ka nuu haŋfalii ni u jaari loobee bɔnnaa.’

ref: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
text: Di i wa ŋɔ a wia naa maa tɛɛ nɛra naa, ba pɛɛzii, ‘Bɛɛwiarɛ Kɔraawiizi dau a keŋ hɛhchɔgzeŋ naa tɛɛ yaai? Bɛɛ wideere yaa ɛɛ leuwei? Bɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ yaa ɛɛ zuu Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum ninɛi?’

ref: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
text: Ŋɔ ba be, ‘Guŋ ɛɛwɔɔ dikuu ii naabaala n vɛɛŋ, ka ra kuari vuga, di sɛɛ a dɔɔra wia. Ba vɛɛmbuu ta di vɛɛ n Gbɔg hiŋaa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
text: Ka ii ɛɛ biinikpola wiɛɛlaarɛ werge maa, di kaali ii mɛɛwaa gba. Ii bɛl maa kpoŋŋoo, di ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛri, di vɛɛ n nua hiŋaa.

ref: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
text: Awia, n daŋ duŋŋi ia di ga du hɛri la ii ni ii naabaala n waa zummɛ. Denii ii ra kuari vuga saŋa maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, màá suŋ ii ni maa.’ ”

ref: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “Saŋa bɛl ra bau, nɛr maa wàá ka ŋɔ, ‘N hɛɛhzi Kɔraawiizi la n du de saŋa maa, unla n lizi Izrɛl hina lii Ijip hɛri la.’

ref: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
text: Ka ba daŋ ŋɔ, ‘N hɛɛhzi Kɔraawiizi la n du de, unla n lizi Izrɛl hina lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag hɛri ni hɛssi la maa uŋ faa yaari baa la.’ N daŋ bir ba ba ni hɛri la miŋ faa kpawɛɛ tɛɛ ba naabaala, ba wa so la.”

ref: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “N daŋ yir ba dɔma lugɔ nyinlaura kpila, bá ba wa lauri nɛra naa. Ń kaa yir dɔma lugɔ kpaana ge, bá wa nyiŋŋi ia bizenaa ni giŋgimee nyuuni ni bia bɔɔni maa biine, di kpuuzi.

ref: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
text: Ba wiɛɛlaa maanii n na na, ba wàá wer ɛɛ wiimaa di bar n har. Ba wichɔgaa maanii n zum.

ref: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
text: N daŋ bir kpa ba biinikpola wiɛɛlaa ni wichɔgaa la maa banna ɛɛ la, di turgi baa a kim, guŋ bunɛɛ. Dikuubɛɛwiai, ba kpa vuga la miŋ kiiwee, di chɔgi n hɛri.”

ref: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
text: Ee, n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hinuu ra guuŋ di ra tɛŋ fɔŋŋa. Hinuu ra hiiniŋ tɔɔrɔɔ saŋa. Hɛssi hina daŋ lii bɔr maa di ba i be, di waa ŋɔ, “Yaa naabaala faa waa kummaa dɔɔwɛ, see vuga la n na kanni kara, di ɛɛ kumpɛɛri.

ref: worthless idols made by human hands.”
text: Newea daŋ wer ma ba himmaa vugaa? Ɛɛh, ka a ɛɛ kumpɛɛrii!”

ref: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N daŋ bagli baa, filaŋkeŋ, n daŋ bagli baa n fɔŋŋa ni n zenni. Denii ba jaa zum lugɔ n sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi.”

ref: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Juda hina, ba kpa lugbii la nua n du chilachilaa di sɛbi ii wichɔgaa dau. A kaa ɛɛ lugɔ baŋ kpau sɛbaa du ii bampiree, di sɛbaa dau ii mbusu lizibɔra siraa ni.

ref: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
text: Haali ii biizi gba ra liizi ii mbusu lizibɔra ni vughaaŋ Asɛra daazi, baŋ baŋzɛɛ daazeŋ maa zɛɛ, giŋgimee nyuuni

ref: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
text: Iiŋ ɛɛwɛ leu wia, ii daŋ nyaa kapɛttɛ la miŋ tɛɛ ia la. N daŋ gil ii birgi ii dɔma yoma, hɛri la iiŋ waa zummɛ biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, i fuuh n baannɛ, u daŋ hanna fuuuh saŋaa saŋa maa.”

ref: I, the Lord, have put a curse on those who turn from me and trust in human strength.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N daŋ see nɛr la maa n yardi newee gɛɛ di dɛlli u himmaa fɔŋŋa, di bir har kpuŋ nua.

ref: They will dry up like a bush in salty desert soil, where nothing can grow.
text: U daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ kooree n du hɛribɔduma, wàá nyɛɛli. U daŋ du hɛrhilii werge, hɛribɔduma biini. Hɛri la n dɔɔ yazi, nɛr maa n waa de duwɛɛ.

ref: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord.
text: Ka unla n yardiŋ, di dɛlliŋ, nuu sumaa.

ref: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
text: U daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ daa baŋ chɔɔzɛɛ gɔŋ nua, u lunne ta gaa zuu nii. Di wem wa liwɔɔ, waa ɔɔ ɛɛu wiimaa, ka u paŋhoori ɔɔ ɛɛ a lɛɛrii saŋa maa. Di hil wa chigɔ bina la, ka a waa ɔɔ tiruu, waa ɔɔ nɔŋ huhzi.

ref: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
text: Nɛdaraa bɛnnɛ su newee bampirii, di kaali kumaa, waa chaai dɔɔwɛ. Anɛɛ n niŋ wer zum newee biinei?

ref: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ pigzi newee biinii, di ɛɛ u nfɛrɛ na, di turguu u wiɛɛlaa kim, gunla an dɛkkɛ.”

ref: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
text: Nɛr la maa n fini nɛra di na kebee, ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ zumbee la n waa hala hewee ka teezaa. Mɔɔ ka u zɛŋ, u daŋ nyaa a kebee, ka a tuna maa, ú ɛɛ gɛnii.

ref: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
text: Denii mìŋ́ Jɛrɛmia ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi Dia la n chigɛ bizeŋ nyuu di birgi la, ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ koorikara la n dɔɔ girme werge la, u ɛɛ yaa bɔnaniinaniirɛ.

ref: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, Izrɛl hina tamii, banla maa n vɛɛ i wia, daŋ di hiihzi. Ba daŋ sɛbi banla n bir har kpui la sɔna dau hɛɛhraa biini, dikuu baŋ vɛɛi ta wia, hinla n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ bule la.

ref: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, chaaŋ, ń nyaagi nɛnnɛ. Lɛɛŋ, n na n hiŋ nɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu n na chɔli.

ref: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
text: A nɛra ɔɔ ra pɛɛzimbuu, ‘Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii la du lee? Gil u su u maga filaŋkeŋ!’

ref: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa vɛɛwɛ lugɔ màá binni i nɛra ni. I zummɔ lugɔ tɔɔrɔɔ hɔpizii haa wan pattɛ. I zum wia la maa miŋ ɔɔ ra ŋɔu.

ref: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
text: Gilɛɛ ra ɔnziŋ, hinuu ń ɔɔ chɔ zuu, ɔnsii werge hɔl.

ref: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
text: Gil hiihzi kpu nɛra la n na tɔɔriŋ, ka liziŋ lii hiihzi biini. Gil ɔnsii werge lau baa, ka liziŋ lii ɔnsii maa biini. Kpa hɛhchɔg ta ba ni, di chɔg baa nyaamm.” Heezaa Hɔpizii la hiŋaa wia

ref: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
text: Ŋɔ ba be, ‘Ií keŋŋi digna di ra nuu gunla Kɔraawiizi n na ŋɔ, Juda koora, Juda hina ani nɛra la n du Jɛrusalɛm, di ra ga dominuuzenaa naa,

ref: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
text: Awia, ŋɔ ba be lugɔ ba ra hiŋ n nua nɛnnɛ, di gilɛɛ waa chi bunni maa di ra ga a bolzeŋ dominuuzenaa ra zuu a Heezaa Hɔpizii hɔl. Ka ba ɔɔ kpa a hɔpizii, ú ɛɛ hɔpizizeŋ, di gilɛɛ waa hum huma maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
text: Ba koora ni ba sitɔɔra daŋ ga a dominuuzenaa zuu Jɛrusalɛm, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa la Koori Deevid n faa dɔɔwɛ la. Jɛrusalɛm hina ni Juda hina maa daŋ kpau zuu torkozi, baŋhina ge tinni zagra. Bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm daŋ ɔɔ su nɛra saŋa maa.

ref: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
text: Nɛra daŋ lii Juda bola ni boljigzi la n bar Jɛrusalɛm la. Ba daŋ lii Bɛnjamin paga, giŋgimee zɛɛzi ni Juda wiifurii nodig wiikakag. Ba daŋ kpa mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa, mbusuzi lizaa mia kuna, daahɛgsɔɔhsuma ani jaaŋ tɛɛi mbusuzi lizaa kuna, di ba n Dia.

ref: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
text: Ka di ba waa sɛɛwɛ bá nuu n nua, di hiŋ a Heezaa Hɔpizii kiizi hiŋ lugɔ u ɛɛ hɔpizinaniinaniirɛ, ka chi bunni ga a Jɛrusalɛm dominuuzenaa hiŋ bɛl maa, di zuu a Heezaa Hɔpizii hɔl hiŋ, guŋwaa, n daŋ kpa niŋ la n waa dinzaa dɔɔwɛ du Jɛrusalɛm dominuuzenaa ni, ú di u diikpega maa.’ ”

ref: The Lord told me,
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi faa ŋɔ tɛɛ mìŋ́ Jɛrɛmia,

ref: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.
text: Awia, n kpa ga zuu a viimaari dia, di u ra hum.

ref: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
text: Di kunla unna ma la waa haŋ wa du gunla unna nyiŋŋi, ɔɔ purguubuu ka kaa kuaruu ma gunla unna nyiŋŋi.

ref: Then the Lord told me to say:
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi jaa ŋɔ n be,

ref: If I threaten to uproot and shatter an evil nation,
text: Di n haŋ wa ŋɔ saŋa maa lugɔ n daŋ chɔgi gɛɛ di purgi hɛri maa gɛɛ kora maa,

ref: and that nation turns from its evil, I will change my mind.
text: di hɛri la hina miŋ karfɛɛ la haŋ wa sɛɛ chɔgri dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia, di gilaa ha, guŋwaa, màá ka kpu baa.

ref: If I promise to make a nation strong,
text: Di n wa ŋɔ lugɔ bá ma hɛri bɛl gɛɛ kora bɛl chi,

ref: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
text: di ba haŋ wa vɛɛ n nua di ɛɛ wichɔgaa, guŋwaa, màá ka ɛɛ baa winanaa la miŋ faa fɛwɛɛ lugɔ n daŋ ɛɛ baa la.

ref: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
text: Awia, ŋɔ Juda hina ni banla maa n du Jɛrusalɛm be lugɔ kenne mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, ‘N na ɛɛ hɛhchɔg siryaa, di ra ta jina, ń kpau ta ii ni. Awia, ií bir lii ii wichɔgaa biini, di gil ii bɛl maa wia deŋli.’

ref: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
text: Ka ba daŋ bir ŋɔ, ‘Yaa baga lɛi. Yaa bɛl maa danna ɛɛ wichɔgaa la u bampirii n lauwɛ.’ ”

ref: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Pɛɛzi hɛssi hina maa na, a wii naa dɔŋ ŋmɛnɛ haa ɛɛwɔa? Izrɛl hina ɛɛ wikunaa werge!

ref: The snow on Lebanon's mountains never melts away, and the streams there never run dry.
text: Lɛbanɔn bizenaa nyuuni dobia ŋmɛnɛ haa ŋmɛɛrɔɔa? U niisɔna la n lii bɔɔnɛɛzi ŋmɛnɛ haa gil palaa?

ref: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
text: Ka n nɛra suuh n wiarɛ. Ba fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsumaa, di ra tɛɛ vuga, guŋ gil ba ra lɔɔzi naazi, ba ŋmɛnizi biine. Ba waa kaa ra hiŋ faala maa ŋmɛnizi la. A gil ba ra vol ŋmɛnibizi, ba waa zum bɔr la banna la.

ref: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.
text: Ba hɛri maa daŋ chɔɔ pɛɛ, di ɛɛ chɛɛtɛkuŋ saŋa maa. Banla maa n niŋ ga de, ba nuuzi daŋ kpu, ba ra viigi ba nyuuni.

ref: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
text: N daŋ gil n nɛra yaari ba dɔma see alugɔ wiifurii peu n lɔ nyɔɔ la. N daŋ bir har kpu baa, màá hiini baa, di a hɛhchɔg wa chol ba ni.”

ref: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
text: Denii ba ŋɔ, “Ií ba ya ta Jɛrɛmia jinachɔgaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ gbɔg baglaa la, nunzunna baglaa ani Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii la u dɔgtɛɛzi n na sii la kaa leu. Awia, ií ba ya ga hau u ni, di gilɛɛ waa nuu wia la unna ŋɔ.”

ref: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
text: Awia, mìŋ́ Jɛrɛmia suŋŋi wiizi, di ŋɔ, “Hoi, n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, nuu n be, a nuu gunla n dɔma n na ŋɔ!

ref: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
text: A dɛkkɔɔ ba kpa wichɔgaa turgi winanaa kimaa? Ka ba ki bɔɔrɛ dawiŋ. A liizi lugɔ n faa chigɔ ba naazii, di suŋŋii lugɔ i lizi i baaŋ la ba ni.

ref: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
text: Awia, gil lɔchɔgii chol ba biizi ni, di gil ba kpu baa laal biini. Gil ba haana nyaa biizi ni janna, di gil ba kpa tokobi kpu ba baala ani ba biipɔllaa laal biini.

ref: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
text: Di i haŋ wa kpa nɛra la n niŋ wa lɔ baa di ra ba, gil nɛra nuu ba wiraa ba diini biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba ki bɔɔrɛ bá lawiŋ, haali di heŋ sidɛɛ gba.

ref: You know they plan to kill me. So get angry and punish them! Don't ever forgive their terrible crimes.
text: Ka n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i zum ba jinazi la maa baŋ tawɛɛ, bá kpumbuu. Gilɛɛ wa gil ba wichɔgaa hiŋ di ra tɛɛ baa. Gil ba kpegli baa i see. Tɔɔri baa werge maa, i baaŋfuuih saŋa.”

ref: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “La viimaari be di ga yau vii. Lau a nɛra nabɔnzi baŋhina ni Kɔraawiizi kizeehina jaa.

ref: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
text: I ni baa la Bɛn Hinɔm Waluu n dugli Jɛrusalɛm Kpaga Dominuuzeŋ la. Denii í sii wia la miŋ ŋɔ i be la tɛɛ baa,

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
text: di ŋɔ, ‘Juda koora ni Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií ra nuu gunla Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la Izrɛl hina n na hum la n ŋɔwɛɛ. Ií ra nuu! N daŋ kpa hɛhchɔg ta bɔnnaa ni, nɛr la maa n niŋ nuu guŋ, u nua daŋ kpu.

ref: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
text: Awia, a du tau, ŋmɛnɛbɛl, nɛra wàá ka yir bɔnnaa Tɔfɛf gɛɛ Bɛn Hinɔm Waluu, ba daŋ jaa ra yiruu Nɛkpui Werge Waluu.

ref: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
text: Bɔnnaabuu n chɔgi Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm hina jinazi maa. N daŋ gil ba kpu baa ni tokobi, ba dɔma la n na nyiŋŋi ba kpui la see. Denii ń gil ba bɔra birgi diwee tɛɛ zumbizi ni pir sela maa.

ref: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
text: N daŋ chɔgi bolzeŋ naa. Nɛr la maa n niŋ ga de nua daŋ kpu, u ra ŋɔ u wia, dikuu u chɔgaa wia.

ref: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
text: N daŋ gil ba hee ba biibaala ni biihaana ola, di kaa hee ba dɔŋahina ola, saŋa la ba dɔma n niŋ wa fɔɔ baa ni laal, dikuu lɔzi n ninna kpu baa werge wia.’ ”

ref: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be, “Purgi vii la hiŋ kpoglee la a nɛra la maa n du ii be la see, bá na,

ref: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
text: ka ŋɔ ba be, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la daŋ kpu nɛra naa di chɔg bolzeŋ naa, gunla viimaari n ɔɔ purgi vii, waa kaa dɔɔ kuaraa la. Ba daŋ hugzi lalaa Tɔfɛf guŋŋ u maa wa su, ba wàá ka na bɔr hug baŋhina.

ref: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
text: Jɛrusalɛm diini ni Juda koora hora ani diini la maa salli la baŋ fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma di tɛɛ chinchiŋwilaa ni bɔra la baŋ ta siŋ tɛɛ vuga la, a maa daŋ doŋ lugɔ Tɔfɛf.”

ref: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
text: Denii n bir lii Tɔfɛf, bɔr la Kɔraawiizi n humiŋ, ń ga ŋɔ wia la n niŋ wa huuzi nɛra du ba ni la, di ba wa chi Kɔraawiizi Dia diŋŋee, di ŋɔ a nɛra maa be,

ref: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
text: “Kenne Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la Izrɛl hina na hum la ra ŋɔ, ‘Ií ra nuu! N daŋ kpa hɛhchɔgni la maa miŋ ŋɔ lugɔ n daŋ kpa ta bolzeŋ naa ni boljigzi la n baruu la ni, dikuu baŋ dɔɔ dignikpega, ba waa sɛɛwɛ bá nuu n wiŋɔzi wia ta ba ni.’ ”

ref: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
text: Ima biibaal Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Pasur, n kaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia guure nabɔma la, n wa nuuwɛ Jɛrɛmia n ŋɔ wia la n niŋ wa huuzi a nɛra, di ra du ba ni la,

ref: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
text: u gil ba lɔɔzi Jɛrɛmia werge maa, ka du u nonee, u naazi ani u baŋaa daa, bɔr la n dugli Bɛnjamin Chiŋ Dominuuzeŋ n du Kɔraawiizi Dia la.

ref: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
text: Hɔɔŋ wa pizɛɛ, Pasur gil ba lizuu. Jɛrɛmia jaa ŋɔ u be, “Kɔraawiizi wàá ka yirii Pasur. U daŋ jaa ra yirii Magɔ Misabib

ref: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, ‘N daŋ kpa ɔnsii werge ta i ni i dammuzi maa ni. Ba dɔma daŋ wa kpu baa ni tokobizi i sibɔɔ. N daŋ kpa Juda hina maa du Babilɔn koori nonee, ú kpu baŋhina ka lauri baŋhina kaali Babilɔn n du bɔɔnɛɛ.

ref: He will clean out the royal treasury and take everything else of value from Jerusalem.
text: N daŋ kpa bolzeŋ naa daama maa, u kuŋkuaraa, kunnanaa ani Juda koora daama maa tɛɛ ba dɔma. Ba daŋ chi kuna la maa baŋ foozee kaali Babilɔn.

ref: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
text: Ka hìŋ́ Pasur ni i diahina maanii, bá lauri kaali Babilɔn. Denii i ni i dammuzi la maa hiŋ faa ŋɔ wia di kanni kara tɛɛ baa la maa ga siu, bá hug ia de.’ ” Jɛrɛmia nuumaa wia

ref: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, i darimbuu, ba dariŋ. I dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa kaaliŋ, di kpegliŋ. Nɛr maa ra wooriŋ, di ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ saŋa maa.

ref: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.
text: Di n haŋ waa ŋɔ wia maa, kalu ni chɔgaa wiarɛ anna sii. Ba ra woorimbuu di ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ saŋa maa, dikuu minna sii i amaniye wia.

ref: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
text: Ka di n haŋ wa ŋɔ lugɔ n daŋ suuh i wia, màá ka kpa i sɔŋ di sii i amaniye tɛɛ nɛra, i wiŋɔzi hiŋ ɔɔ ɛɛu lugɔ niŋ n du n bampirii biinii. Aŋ ɛɛ aniaa lugɔ n kpaa du n biini, ka ɔɔ kpoglaa huhzi.

ref: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
text: N ɔɔ nuu nɛra n na munnuu di ra ŋɔ, “Ɔnsii werge du bɔr maanii! Ya ga ɛɛu sɔsɔgɔ tɛɛ nabɔnzi!” Haali n badɔŋa himmaa gba ra nyiŋŋi n chollibɔttɛ, di ra ŋɔ, “Aŋhinabe, yaa daŋ wer daruu, di lawuu, di turgi yaa kim.”

ref: But you, Lord, are a mighty soldier, standing at my side. Those troublemakers will fall down and fail— terribly embarrassed, forever ashamed.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi du n benii alugɔ laallɔɔrikpeg, awia, banla maa n na tɔɔriŋ la, daŋ jiŋli di chogli. Ba daŋ ɛɛ huhzi ka di hiihzi werge. Ba ŋmɛnɛ wàá suuh ba hiihzi dii hiŋ wia maa.

ref: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, hinuu ɛɛ nɛr maa ra na ni wibii, di zum nɛr maa biini. Awia, gil n na kim la hin niŋ kpa turgi n dɔma naa, dikuubɛɛwiai, n kpa n wiimaanii du i nonee biini.

ref: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
text: Ií yir yira di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! Ií ra chɔluu! Waabuu ra lɛɛ anuula hina ni banla banna sunni, di ra lii biinikpola hina nonee biini.

ref: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
text: Nuuseei di hɔpizii la baŋ luliŋ la! Hɔpizii la n maa luliŋ la gilɛɛ waa na kissaa!

ref: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
text: Nuuseei di baal la n lizi amaniye tɛɛ n mɛɛ, di gil u bɔra sɔɔnuu, uŋ ŋɔ, “Biibaallɛ ba lul la!”

ref: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
text: Gil a baal ɛɛ lugɔ bolzenaa la Kɔraawiizi n chɔkkɛ, waa a ni sunne la. Gil u nuu laal wile chɔɔzi ni, di kaa nuu wiraa wibaŋa ni.

ref: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
text: A dɛkkɔ uŋ faa siuwɛ dikuu uŋ waŋ kpuwɛɛ mɔɔ ka ba luliŋ wia. N maa hiarɛ niŋ faa ɛɛ n ŋmam.

ref: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ ba lulinnɛi? Ba lulimbuu ń di tɔɔrɔɔ ni biinichɔg bɛŋ, di di hiihzi ń de dui tunaa?

ref: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
text: Juda Koori Zɛdɛkia faa hum Malkija biibaal Pasur ni Maasɛya biibaal Zɛfania la n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ labuu n be, ba wa ŋɔ,

ref: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
text: “Jaande maa, ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi be tɛɛ yaa lugɔ Babilɔn Koorizeŋ Nɛbukadnɛɛza ni u laallɔɔra ballɔɔ wa fɔɔ yaa. Aŋhinabe, Kɔraawiizi daŋ ɛɛ u wizenaa la bɛl, di fir Nɛbukadnɛɛza ú bir har.”

ref: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ mìŋ́ Jɛrɛmia be, dí n ŋɔ a nɛra be, “Ií ra nuu, n kpa miibɔɔ ŋmɛnɛɛ ni siu ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ dau ii see.

ref: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
text: Unla maa n niŋ du bolzeŋ naa biini, laal, lɔchɔgii ani wiilchɔgii daŋ kpuu. Ka unla maa n niŋ chɔ la Babilɔn hina naa n fɔɔ yaa naa be di ga di kuu, daŋ na u hiŋ. U miibɔɔrɛ u chɔ lɛɛ gunla.

ref: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
text: N ɛɛ nfɛrɛɛ lugɔ n chɔgi a bolzeŋ naa, màá giluu. N daŋ kpau du Babilɔn koorizeŋ nonee, ú fuuh u maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: Each new day, make sure that justice is done, and rescue those who are being robbed. Or else my anger will flame up like a fire that never goes out.
text: Koori Deevid diahina, ‘Ií gil wibii dii du de chɔɔzi maa, ií ɔɔ lɛɛ unla banna sunni, di lii nɛr la n na sunnuu be. Di guŋ lɛi, n baaŋ daŋ fuuh lugɔ niŋ, dikuu wichɔgaa la iiŋ ɛɛwɛ wia, u ra fuuh, ka nɛr maa wàá wer sɔɔnuu.

ref: Jerusalem, from your mountaintop you look out over the valleys and think you are safe. But I, the Lord, am angry,
text: Ií Jɛrusalɛm hina sogoo guali a walli ni, gunla bii n ɔɔ la chiŋ kaali waluu la. Ka n daŋ yoo ia. Ii ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ nɛr maa wàá wer lɔ ia gɛɛ di wer purgi ii diikpega zuu.

ref: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.
text: N daŋ tɛr ii digna dikuu ii wiɛɛlaa wia. N daŋ kpa niŋ du ii kɔrni, ú fuuh ii kuna la maa n bar ia la nyaamm. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.’ ”

ref: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ra ŋɔ Juda kooridia la wia, “Miŋwaa be, Juda kooridia wessoo alugɔ Giliad hɛri, alugɔ Lɛbanɔn bizenaa. Ka n daŋ gil u chɔɔ diŋgela.

ref: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.
text: N daŋ gil laallɔɔra ba di wa chɔguu. Bɛl maa daŋ kpa u kpaŋfɔ, di ba wa teŋri u hɛriŋkpol dolnanaa la maa, di kpaa ha niŋ biini, a fuuh.

ref: People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?”
text: Hɛrkpila hina maa daŋ ɔɔ wa ga a bolzeŋ naa kɛrii di ra kaali, ka ra pɛɛzi dɔŋa, ‘Bɛɛ n baani Kɔraawiizi kpa a wii naa dau a bolzeŋ naa kennei?’

ref: Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.” King Jehoahaz The Lord said:
text: Baŋhina ŋɔ, ‘Dikuu baŋ vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la banna hum, ni u nɛra nuukpaŋ la, ka ra kuari hɛrdumazi vuga, di ra sɛɛ a dɔɔra wiarɛ guŋ ɛɛ.’ ”

ref: King Josiah is dead, so don't mourn for him. Instead, mourn for his son King Jehoahaz, dragged off to another country, never to return.
text: Juda hina, ií gilɛɛ ra wii Koori Jɔsia lee, ka ii wii ra tɛɛ u biibaal Joahaz. Ba lawuubuu ra kaali hɛrduma, u ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka bir ba, dikuubɛɛwiai, u siwii ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka na u himmaa hɛri.

ref: You put in big windows and used cedar paneling and red paint. But you were unfair and forced the builders to work without pay. *
text: Ka ɔɔ ŋɔ, “N daŋ ma kooridiizeŋ tɛɛ n hiŋ, di ma diiwara kpila hɔŋ u ni.” Awia, u kuari tokorzenaa duu, di kpa hɛriŋkpol daapiahni mɛɛruu, di kpa penti aahma pentuu.

ref: More cedar in your palace doesn't make you a better king than your father Josiah. He always did right— he gave justice to the poor and was honest.
text: “Di i kpa hɛriŋkpol daazi ma i diini, a du wer kaali baŋhina hora, gunnɛ niŋ gil i ɛɛ koori kaali i mɛɛa? I mɛɛ faa di u de dui sumaa. U wia maa faa dɔɔ wibiire di deŋli, u faa nyɛɛli u wiɛɛlaa maa biini.

ref: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
text: U ɔɔ faa lɛɛ nyaara ni dɔgnya hina nuarɛ, awiarɛ u wiimaa faa nyɛɛli la. Gunnɛ ra bagli lugɔ u zumimbuu.

ref: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.
text: Ka i kpa i siwee ni i bampiriire du kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa ni, di ra kpu nɛra la n waa chɔgri dɔɔwɛ, di ra sunni nɛra, di ra foozi baa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: Jehoiakim, no one will mourn at your funeral. They won't turn to each other and ask, “Why did our great king have to die?”
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Jɔsia biibaal Juda Koori Jɛhɔyakim wia, “Nɛr maa wàá wii u lee gɛɛ di ŋɔ, ‘N dammu, a waa wer, a waa wer!’ Nɛr maa wàá wiiu, di ŋɔ, ‘N dɔɔri! N koori!’

ref: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií lii la Lɛbanɔn di gaa lɔɔgi wile. Ií la Basan hɛri, di gaa chɛɛhgi Moab bizenaa nyuuni, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii ni nɛra la n dɔɔ nuukpaŋ la maanii ba kpegli.

ref: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.
text: N karfi iabuu, saŋa la iiŋ soge nɛnnɛ la, ka ii ŋɔ, ‘Yaa wàá nuu!’ Kenne ii du ií pɔlaa saŋa maa, ii haa waa sɛɛwɛ hiŋiŋ maa.

ref: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
text: Peu daŋ wa paa ii sitɔɔra maa kaali, nɛra la ii ni baa n dɔɔ nuukpaŋ la ge maanii, bá lauri laal biini kaali hɛrdumazi. Denii ii di hiihzi di ŋmaabi, dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia.

ref: Those who live in the palace paneled with cedar will groan with pain like women giving birth.
text: Lɛbanɔn hina, ii sogo hɛriŋkpol daazi diinii ni alaanfia. Ka ii na gunla ii wia n niŋ wa dɔɔ dɔgnya. Bɔra waazaa daŋ wa chol ii ni, alugɔ hilula!”

ref: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “Miŋ du de saŋa maa wia, haali hìŋ́ Jɛhɔyachin n ɛɛ Juda Koori Jɛhɔyakim biibaal, di i faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nonibisig la n du nodig, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, n kpa ra jag kuna ni la gba, ka n daŋ lizii ta.

ref: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
