ref: Everyone in Israel and Judah is guilty. But I, the Lord All-Powerful, their holy God, have not abandoned them.
text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ waa Izrɛl ni Juda hina vɛɛwɛ ta. Haali baŋ ɛɛ wichɔgaa di zuu mìŋ́ Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii ni gba.

ref: Get out of Babylon! Run for your lives! If you stay, you will be killed when I take revenge on the city and punish it for its sins.
text: Ií chɔ lii Babilɔn! Ií chɔ ra nyiŋŋi ii miibɔɔni bɔra! Ií gilɛɛ gil ba kuu Babilɔn hina wichɔgaa wia kpu ia. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi jaa ra nyiŋŋuu ń bir kpa ba wichɔgaa kim turgi baa, di tɛr ba digna gunla n dɛkkɛ.

ref: Babylon was my golden cup, filled with the wine of my anger. The nations of the world got drunk on this wine and went insane.
text: Babilɔn faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ saliŋ libee di du n nonii. N gil durnya hina maa nyɔɔ u biini siŋ, di ra dɛɛzi. Hɛssi hina maa ɔɔ nyɔɔ u biini siŋ, di jaa ra chugli.

ref: But suddenly, Babylon will fall and be destroyed. I, the Lord, told the foreigners who lived there, “Weep for the city! Get medicine for its wounds; maybe they will heal.”
text: Babilɔn daŋ chol di purgi kakpaŋ. Ií wii ra tɛu! Ií nyiŋŋi nuu faa u bɔra wiila, aŋhinabe, u daŋ nyaagi.

ref: The foreigners answered, “We have already tried to treat Babylon's wounds, but they would not heal. Come on, let's all go home to our own countries. Nothing is left in Babylonia; everything is destroyed.”
text: Famaraa la n du Babilɔn la jaa ŋɔ, ‘Yaa ɛɛ aniaa ya hiini Babilɔn hina, ka a teŋ bɛri. Ií gil ya gil baa filaŋkeŋ, ka bir kaali yaa bola. Kɔraawiizi kpa u fɔŋŋazenne tɛr Babilɔn hina digna, di chɔg ba hɛri nyaamm.’ ”

ref: I, the Lord, want Babylon destroyed, because its army destroyed my temple. So, you kings of Media, sharpen your arrows and pick up your shields.
text: Denii a laallɔɔra nabɔnzi ŋɔ, “Ií sazi ii hobee, di kpa ii laal pɛrɛtuzi! Kɔraawiizi du Mɛdi hina kooraa bɔkpega, dikuubɛɛwiai, u dauwɔɔ lugɔ ú chɔgi Babilɔn hina. Kɔraawiizi daŋ bir turgi baa ba kim, dikuu u Dia wia.

ref: People of Babylon, you live along the Euphrates River and are surrounded by canals. You are rich, but now the time has come for you to die.
text: Ii banla n soge gɔŋa kɛraa, di dɔɔ daama werge, ii saŋa helloo bá chɔgi ia nyaamm.

ref: I, the Lord All-Powerful, swear by my own life that enemy soldiers will fill your streets like a swarm of locusts. They will shout and celebrate their victory. A Hymn of Praise (Jeremiah
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la hɛɛhzi u hinnɛ lugɔ u daŋ gil baala kpila ba, di wa su ii biini lugɔ lotorozi, ba daŋ kpegli ia di chaasi du ii ni.” Kɔraawiizi chɔlaa yir

ref: The waters in the heavens roar at his command. He makes clouds appear; he sends the wind from his storehouse and makes lightning flash in the rain.
text: Di u wa pozoo lugɔ nazaa, niiri la n du chiŋ ɔɔ ra kɔɔu, ɔɔ giluu baamazi izi bɔr maa, di gil dooŋ nyɛgzaa ni dooŋ maa kpau di ba. U ɔɔ giluu peu lii u kuna dauribɔra, di waa ta.

ref: God used his wisdom and power to create the earth and spread out the heavens.
text: Kɔraawiizi kpa fɔŋŋaa ta hɛri, di kpa u nunzuma ta durnya, di kpa u wia zɛɛ zumaa yaa chiŋ.

ref: People who make idols are stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods cannot breathe.
text: Nɛr maa ɛɛ gɛniirɛ Kɔraawiizi be, di nyaa nunzuma! Vugkuari maa daŋ di hiihzi, dikuu u vuga wia. U vuga ɛɛ kumpɛɛrii, a waa heezi.

ref: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
text: A ɛɛ kumpɛɛrii, di ɛɛ chɛɛtɛ kuna. Di a seriya dii saŋa wa hello, Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔgaa.

ref: But the Lord, Israel's God, is all-powerful. He created everything, and he chose Israel to be his very own. God's Hammer The Lord said:
text: Kɔraawiizi la yaa naabaal Jekɔb naanna n na hum la, waa lugɔ annii. Waabuu ta kummaa, di lizi Izrɛl hina, ba ɛɛ u himmaa nɛra. U sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ.

ref: Babylonia, you were my hammer; I used you to pound nations and break kingdoms,
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Babilɔn hina, ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ n gulii laal biini. N ɔɔ faa kpa di ra chɔgi hɛssi hina, di kpa ia ra chɔgi kossi,

ref: as well as men and women, young and old,
text: di ra kpu baala ni haana, di ra kpu bazɛŋzi ni biipɔllaa, di ra kpu biibaala ni biihaana,

ref: shepherds and their flocks, farmers and their oxen, and governors and leaders.
text: di ra kpu penɔɔna ni ba peeza, di ra kpu patta ni napattaa, di ra kpu hɛri nabɔnzi ni nabɔnzenaa.

ref: But now, my people will watch, while I repay you for what you did to Zion.
text: N daŋ bir turgi Babilɔn hina ba wiɛɛlaa kim, ii himmaa siwii na, dikuu wichɔgaa la baŋ kpawɛɛ dau bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm hina la wia. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: You destroyed the nations and seem strong as a mountain, but I am your enemy. I might even grab you and roll you off a cliff. When I am finished, you'll only be a pile of scorched bricks.
text: Babilɔn, i ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bizeŋ la n na chɔgi durnya maa, ka mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ i dɔmnɛ. N daŋ fuuih, í birgi hɔɔhri.

ref: Your stone blocks won't be reused for cornerstones or foundations, and I promise that forever you will be a desert. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Nations Will Attack Babylon The Lord said:
text: Nɛr maa ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka kpa i bia di ma dia. I daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ hɛribɔduma di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Signal the nations to get ready to attack. Raise a flag and blow a trumpet. Send for the armies of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz. Choose a commander; let the cavalry attack like a swarm of locusts.
text: Ií lalli tuuta a hɛri biini! Ií huuh bensunoniina a hɛssi biine! Ií ɛɛ hɛssi hina sirya bá ga lɔ baa, ií yirgi kossi naa, Ararat, Minni ani Askɛnaz hina, bá ga lɔ baa. Ií lizi laallɔɔra nabɔma ú tɔ ba see, di gil zagra lii lugɔ lotorozi miiih.

ref: Tell the kings and governors, the leaders and the people of the kingdoms of the Medes to prepare for war!
text: Ií ɛɛ hɛssi hina sirya, bá ga lɔ Babilɔn hina. Ií yir Mɛdi hɛri koora, ba hɛssi nabɔnzi, ba nabɔnzenaa ani hɛssi la maa banna di kora a ni la.

ref: The earth twists and turns in torment, because I have decided to make Babylonia a desert where no one can live, and I won't change my mind.
text: Hɛri zigloore, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi jina la uŋ tawɛɛ Babilɔn wia la chigɔɔ. U daŋ gil Babilɔn hɛri birgi diŋgela, guŋ gil nɛr maa wàá ka du de.

ref: The Babylonian soldiers have lost their strength and courage. They stay in their fortresses, unable to fight, while the enemy breaks through the city gates, then sets their homes on fire.
text: Babilɔn laallɔɔra jaa gil laal lɔirɛ, ka du ba diikpega biine. Ba fɔŋŋa tunnɔɔ, ba jaa ɛɛ lugɔ haana. Ba diini maanii ba du niŋ, di kuugi ba bolzeŋ dominuuzenaa.

ref: The enemy now controls the river crossings! The marshes are on fire! Your army has panicked!”
text: Bɔra la baŋ gawɛɛ di ra gi a muu maanii ba teŋri, di du a muu kɛraa fotogozi bɔra maa kooree niŋ, ɔnsii lau a laallɔɔra, ba bɔra ra sa.”

ref: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I make this promise— “Soon Babylon will be leveled and packed down like a threshing place at harvest time.” Babylonia Will Pay!
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la Izrɛl hina n na hum la ŋɔ, “A wàá birgi ka ba dɔma kpu baa, di fɛrgi baa alugɔ banna lɔ mia pila.”

ref: The people of Jerusalem say, “King Nebuchadnezzar made us panic. That monster stuffed himself with us and our treasures, leaving us empty— he gobbled up what he wanted and spit out the rest.
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Babilɔn koori kpu yaabuu, guŋ gil yaa ɛɛ kinchaŋ, di gil yaa du lugɔ keuwoo. U ɛɛ lugɔ hɛrikuŋ n lau yaa lil, yaa du sum, u hia su, u bir ug yaa ha.

ref: The people of Babylonia harmed some of us and killed others. Now, Lord, make them pay!” The Lord Will Take Revenge on Babylon
text: Gil Babilɔn hina wichɔgaa laŋŋi ba ni, dikuu wii la baŋ kpawɛɛ dau yaa la wia! Gil Babilɔn hina wichɔgaa laŋŋi ba ni, dikuu baŋ tɔɔri yaa la wia!”

ref: My people, I am on your side, and I will take revenge on Babylon. I will cut off its water supply, and its stream will dry up.
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N daŋ lɛɛ ii nua, di gil ii dɔma turgi wia la maa baŋ kpawɛɛ dau ia la kim. N daŋ gil u muuzeŋ hil, di gil u bulli maa hil.

ref: Babylon will be a pile of rubble where only jackals live, and everyone will be afraid to walk among the ruins.
text: Babilɔn daŋ purgi chɔɔ kulululu, di ɛɛ pir sela duuribɔr, de wia dɔɔ ɔnsii werge, ú ɛɛ chɛɛtɛkuŋ. Nɛr la maa n niŋ ɔɔ wa na de, ɔnsii daŋ lawuu werge maa.

ref: The Babylonians roar and growl like young lions.
text: Babilɔn hina ra wiiu lugɔ bunyimpɔla, di ra uuhri lugɔ bunyimbizi.

ref: And since they are hungry, I will give them a banquet. They will celebrate, get drunk, then fall asleep, never to wake up!
text: Ba ɛɛ kpossiiree gɛɛ? N daŋ daali diuzenaa tɛɛ baa bá di, di nyɔɔ siŋ dɛɛzi, bá bɔra ra pur. Ba daŋ chɔɔgi dɔzi, ba wàá ka izi maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I will lead them away to die, like sheep, lambs, and goats being led to the butcher.
text: N daŋ gil ba kɔrgi baa alugɔ pebizi, pebala ani buuna. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: All nations now praise Babylon, but when it is captured, those same nations will be horrified.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Babilɔn wia, “Ba kpegli bolzeŋ la durnya hina maa n na chɔli labuu! Na gunla Babilɔn wia n dɔɔ ɔnsii werge hɛssi hina maa biine!

ref: Babylon's enemies will rise like ocean waves and flood the city.
text: Muuzeŋ daŋ su wa tɔ Babilɔn ni, ú niilɔɔlaa wa tɔ u ni.

ref: Horrible destruction will strike the nearby towns. The land will become a barren desert, where no one can live or even travel.
text: De bolzenaa daŋ birgi diŋgelli, di ɛɛ hɛribɔduma, nii wàá du de, hɛri la nɛr maa n wàá du de, nɛr maa wàá ra vol de.

ref: I will punish Marduk, the god of Babylon, and make him vomit out everything he gobbled up. Then nations will no longer bring him gifts, and Babylon's walls will crumble. The Lord Offers Hope to His People
text: N daŋ tɔɔri Babilɔn hina vug la banna yir Bɛl la, di gil u ug kuna la maa uŋ liglee la. Hɛssi hina wàá ka chɔ ba u be. Babilɔn koŋlii daŋ chol.

ref: Get out of Babylon, my people, and run for your lives, before I strike the city in my anger!
text: N nɛra, ií lii u biini! Ií chɔ lɛɛ ii miibɔɔni! Ií chɔ lii Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuihchɔgii biini.

ref: Don't be afraid or lose hope, though year after year there are rumors of leaders fighting for control in the city of Babylon.
text: Ií gilɛɛ wa gil ɔnsii waa lau ia, ii bɔra ra huah, dikuu iiŋ ɔɔ ra nuu wia hunehune wia. Bina maa biini, hunehune ɔɔ du denii naari wia, koori bɛl n na lɔ koori bɛl laal.

ref: The time will come when I will punish Babylon's false gods. Everyone there will die, and the whole nation will be disgraced,
text: Awia, saŋa bɛl ra bau, min niŋ tɔɔri Babilɔn hina vuga. A hɛri hina maa daŋ di hiihzi. Ba daŋ kpu u nɛra maa ha u biini.

ref: when an army attacks from the north and brings destruction. Then the earth and the heavens and everything in them will celebrate.
text: Chiŋ ni hɛri ani kuna la maa n du a biine, daŋ chaasi ni bɔsɔna di du Babilɔn ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛra daŋ lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag di wa lɔu laal.

ref: Babylon must be overthrown, because it slaughtered the people of Israel and of many other nations.
text: Babilɔn daŋ chol, dikuu u nɛra n kpu Izrɛl hina ani gunla baŋ gillɛ ba kpu durnya hina maa la wia.” Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: My people, you escaped death when Jerusalem fell. Now you live far from home, but you should trust me and think about Jerusalem. Leave Babylon! Don't stay!
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u nɛra benii Babilɔn biini, “Ii chɔwɔɔrɛ lii siu biini! Filaŋkeŋ, ií ra la! Ií gilɛɛ waa kpaŋ! Haali iiŋ waa bol duglɛɛ gba, ka ii ra liizi mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum ni Jɛrusalɛm wia.

ref: You feel ashamed and disgraced, because foreigners have entered my sacred temple.
text: Ii ra ŋɔu, ‘Yaa di hiihzii, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba chagzi yaabuu, hiihzi kpu yaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, famaraa zuu Kɔraawiizi Dia bɔnanaananaa labuu.’

ref: Soon I will send a war to punish Babylon's idols and leave its wounded people moaning everywhere.
text: Awia, n na ŋɔu lugɔ hɔpizaa aŋhina ra bau, min niŋ chɔgi Babilɔn vuga. Banla n na pira, ra hɛm a hɛri maa biini.

ref: Although Babylon's walls reach to the sky, the army I send will destroy that city. I, the Lord, have spoken. Babylon Will Be Destroyed The Lord said:
text: Haali di Babilɔn ga chug chiŋ, ba ma koŋlii bar u diikpega gba, ka n daŋ gil nɛkpuura wa lɔu laal. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: Listen to the cries for help coming from Babylon. Everywhere in the country the sounds of destruction can be heard.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “Ií ra nuu gunla wiraa n na lii Babilɔn hina biini, chɔgaa werge gbɔga, n du Babilɔn hɛri.

ref: The shouts of the enemy, like crashing ocean waves, will drown out Babylon's cries as I level the city.
text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔgi Babilɔn nyaamm, bá chɛɛhgaa la tuŋ. Ba dɔma daŋ hiihri ba ni alugɔ nii n na lɔ, ba wiraa wàá tuŋ.

ref: An enemy will attack and destroy Babylon. Its soldiers will be captured and their weapons broken, because I am a God who takes revenge against nations for what they do.
text: Nɛkpuuri daŋ ba wa lɔ Babilɔn, di lauri u laallɔɔra maa, bá hozi kuugi. Dikuubɛɛwiai, minuu ra tɛr nɛra digna, di ra turgi baa bá wichɔgaa kim, a ra su a maga.

ref: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the true King, promise that the officials and advisors, the governors and leaders, and the soldiers of Babylon will get drunk, fall asleep, and never wake up.
text: N daŋ gil u nabɔnzenaa ni u nunzunna dɛɛzi, haali di kpa u hɛri nabɔnzi, karchizi ani laallɔɔra maa. Ba daŋ chɔɔ dɔɔ di hanna la, ba wàá izi, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ Koori, n sɔŋ di Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The thick walls of that city will be torn down, and its huge gates burned. Everything that nation worked so hard to gain will go up in smoke. Jeremiah Gives Seraiah a Scroll
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ, “Ba daŋ purgi Babilɔn koŋliizeŋ la maa burburbur, di du u dominuuzenaa maa niŋ. A nɛra ra kuuh bahinaarɛ pɛɛ, durnya hɛssi nɛra kuuhni maa ɛɛ nindaazii.”

ref: During Zedekiah's fourth year as king of Judah, he went to Babylon. And Baruch's brother Seraiah went along as the officer in charge of arranging for places to stay overnight.
text: Amaniye naabuu mìŋ́ Jɛrɛmia faa tɛɛ Nɛria biibaal Sɛraaya la naabaal n faa ɛɛ Masɛya la. Waabuu faa ra hiini Juda Koori Zɛdɛkia, saŋa la uŋ la Babilɔn, u kora dii binni anaazuhiŋ biini la.

ref: Before they left, I wrote on a scroll all the terrible things that would happen to Babylon.
text: N faa sɛbi hɛhchɔgni la maa n niŋ wa chol Babilɔn hina ni ani wia la maa baŋ faa sɛbɛɛ dikuu ba wia labuu dau hɔŋ ni.

ref: I gave the scroll to Seraiah and said: When you get to Babylon, read this scroll aloud,
text: N ŋɔ Sɛraaya benii, “Di i haŋ ga hel Babilɔn, ɛɛ ania ka karmi wia naa maa, á lii chaaŋ nɛr maa nuu.

ref: then pray, “Our Lord, you promised to destroy this place and make it into a desert where no people or animals will ever live.”
text: Ka ŋɔ, ‘N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ i daŋ chɔgi bɔnnaa, newee gɛɛ sel maa wàá ka du de. U daŋ birgi diŋgela, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.’

ref: When you finish praying, tie the scroll to a rock and throw it in the Euphrates River. Then say,
text: Di i wa karmi a hɔnnaa tɛɛ baa tuŋ, piŋŋuu di kpau vɔɔ mari bii, di kpau ga ta Muu Yufretis biini,

ref: “This is how Babylon will sink when the Lord destroys it. Everyone in the city will die, and it won't have the strength to rise again.” The End of Jeremiah's Writing Jeremiah's writing ends here.
text: ka ŋɔ, ‘Kenne Babilɔn muzi, u ŋmɛnɛ wàá ka lii maa, dikuu hɛhchɔg la Kɔraawiizi n niŋ kpa ta u ni la wia. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ Jɛrɛmia wiŋɔzi tunaa ɛŋ.’ ”

ref: Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials.
text: A koori guure nabɔma faa lauri Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Maa Nabɔma Sɛraaya ni u harbɔɔhiŋri Zɛfania ni a Dia dominua tauduura bahoro la maa yoma.

ref: then his eyes were poked out. He was put in chains, then dragged off to Babylon and kept in prison until he died.
text: Uŋ wa ɛɛ guŋ tuŋ, u foŋzi Zɛdɛkia sibee, ka gil ba kpa danyɛ yɔlɔzi duu, di kpogluu kaali Babilɔn, di ga tɔu dia, u du de di ra ba a hɔl la uŋ siuwɛ.

ref: meters around. They were hollow, but the bronze was about
text: Ba faa fɔɔubuu guŋŋ di wa hel Koori Zɛdɛkia kora dii binni fidikpaŋhiŋ biini.

ref: After a year and a half, all the food in Jerusalem was gone. Then on the ninth day of the fourth month,
text: A baaguzi anaazuhiŋ biini, hɔpizaa kabɛl hɔl, lɔchɔgii la n du bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm la jaa nyaŋŋi, a nɛra waa kaa dɔɔ kummaa bá di.

ref: the Babylonian troops broke through the city wall. That same night, Zedekiah and his soldiers tried to escape through the gate near the royal garden, even though they knew the enemy had the city surrounded. They headed toward the Jordan River valley,
text: Haali Babilɔn laallɔɔra n faa bar a bolzeŋ gba, ka a laallɔɔra maa ga dominuuzeŋ la n du a koŋlaa anɛɛ baambaaŋ, di dugli koori kambol la hamuŋa ni, di lii chɔ kaali Jɔɔdan Waluu barii.

ref: Zedekiah was taken to Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty.
text: Ba kpogluu ba Babilɔn koorizeŋ be, bolzeŋ Ribla n du Hamaf, u di u seriya de, u chol.

ref: Zedekiah's sons and the officials of Judah were killed while he watched,
text: A Riblaa Babilɔn koori faa kpu Koori Zɛdɛkia biibaala u sibɔɔ, di kaa kpu Juda hina nabɔnzenaa maa ge de jaa.

ref: Jerusalem was captured during Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year as king of Babylonia. About a month later, Nebuchadnezzar's officer in charge of the guards arrived in Jerusalem. His name was Nebuzaradan,
text: Babilɔn Koorizeŋ Nɛbukadnɛɛza kora dii binni fidikabɛlhiŋ, baaguzi anuehiŋ hɔpizaa fi hɔllɛ, u laallɔɔra nabɔma Nɛbuzaradan la n faa ra binni banla n na guuu la, zuu Jɛrusalɛm,

ref: Then he ordered the Babylonian soldiers to break down the walls around Jerusalem.
text: Babilɔn laallɔɔra la maa koori guure nabɔma n faa ra binni ba ni la, purgi koŋlaa la maa n bar Jɛrusalɛm la.

ref: He led away the people left in the city, including everyone who had become loyal to Nebuchadnezzar, the rest of the skilled workers, and even some of the poor people of Judah.
text: Koori guure nabɔma Nɛbuzaradan jaa lauri ba nyaara la baŋhina ni banla n ka a bolzeŋ biini, di kpa banla maa n zum nonee huma nɛnnɛ jaa banla ge n chɔwɛɛ zuu Babilɔn koori ni la, di kaali Babilɔn.

ref: Only the very poorest were left behind to work the vineyards and the fields.
text: Ama, Nɛbuzaradan faa gil banla n ɛɛ nyaara werge la baŋhinaa a hɛri, bá ra binni ba grepu daazi kooni ni ba kooni ni.

ref: Evil Merodach was kind to Jehoiachin and honored him more than any of the other kings held prisoner there.
text: Denii u faa ŋɔ wia ni sisɔna tɛɛ Koori Jɛhɔyachin, ka tɛu nabɔmuu kaali koora la maa n du u be, Babilɔn la.

ref: Jehoiachin was allowed to wear regular clothes instead of a prison uniform, and he even ate at the king's table every day.
text: Awia, Koori Jɛhɔyachin faa wir u nɛra tɔi dia laala ta, ka kpa u himmaa laala laali. U ni a koori ɔɔ jaa kpau di ra di, u de dui maa biini.

ref: As long as Jehoiachin lived, he was paid a daily allowance to buy whatever he needed.
text: Hɔpizibii maanii Babilɔn Koori Ɛvil Mɛrɔdak ɔɔ faa ra tɛɛ Koori Jɛhɔyachin kebee, ú wer ra yau u kunnyiŋŋaa, guŋŋ di wa hel u siu hɔpizii.

ref: Jerusalem, once so crowded, lies deserted and lonely. This city that was known all over the world is now like a widow. This queen of the nations has been made a slave.
text: Na gunla bolzeŋ la n faa dɔɔ nɛra werge la n jaa chɔɔ woo! Na, u jaa ɛɛu lugɔ luhaaŋ. U faa dɔɔ sɔnnɛ hɛssi hina maa be! Unla n faa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ wiche hɛssi la maa biine la jaa birgi yonne.

ref: Each night, bitter tears flood her cheeks. None of her former lovers are there to offer comfort; her friends have betrayed her and are now her enemies.
text: Hamuŋa maa, u ɔɔ ra wiiu werge, sinii ra pal. U sɛnni maa waa hoo ú tig u bampirii. U dammuzi maa daruubuu, di jaa birgi u dɔma.

ref: The people of Judah are slaves, suffering in a foreign land, with no rest from sorrow. Their enemies captured them and were terribly cruel.
text: Juda hina ɛɛ yoma la n waa hiini dɔɔwɛɛ, ba fir baa, ba ga du hɛrdumazi biine, ba waa bol dɔɔwɛ. Ba dɔma go baa, ba wàá na bɔr chɔ.

ref: The roads to Zion mourn because no one travels there to celebrate the festivals. The city gates are deserted; priests are weeping. Young women are raped; Zion is in sorrow!
text: Nɛr maa waa kaa ra ba Kɔraawiizi Dia la filaŋkeŋ, ú wa jaami hɔpizinanaananaa hɔla la. Suŋgure la n faa ra yir yira de la jaa ra di tɔɔrɔɔrɛ, Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ra hɛm. Nɛr maa waa hoo a bolzeŋ dominuuzenaa, Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina ra di dɔgnyaa werge.

ref: Enemies now rule the city and live as they please. The Lord has punished Jerusalem because of her awful sins; he has let her people be dragged away.
text: Ba dɔma na bɔttɛ, di dɔɔ ba fɔŋŋa. Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ ba ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, dikuu ba wichɔgaa n kpillɛ werge wia, ba dɔma lauri ba biizii kaali.

ref: Zion's glory has disappeared. Her leaders are like deer that cannot find pasture; they are hunted down till their strength is gone.
text: Jɛrusalɛm wessi tunnɔɔ, u sitɔɔra ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ chɛhzi n waa fɔŋŋa kaa dɔɔ dikuu lɔzi wia, di chɔ ra lii kpaana be ni gɛrga.

ref: Her people recall the good life that once was theirs; now they suffer and are scattered. No one was there to protect them from their enemies who sneered when their city was taken.
text: Jɛrusalɛm jaa purguu chɔɔ siriti, u nɛra jaa ra liizi gunla uŋ faa wesse la wia. Nɛr maa faa waa hoo ú hiini baa, saŋa la ba dɔma n kpegli baa la. Banla n kpegli baa la faa ra mam baabuu, dikuu baŋ cholle wia.

ref: Jerusalem's horrible sins have made the city a joke. Those who once admired her now hate her instead— she has been disgraced; she groans and turns away.
text: Jɛrusalɛm ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr la n ɛɛ wichɔgaa, di doŋ, nɛr maa waa kaa ra kpau girme la. U ra hɛm, di kpa u siwee suah, dikuu hiihzi wia. Jɛrusalɛm faa kpa wichɔgaa wergee doŋ u hiŋ.

ref: Her sins had made her filthy, but she wasn't worried about what could happen. And when Jerusalem fell, it was so tragic. No one gave her comfort when she cried out, “Help! I'm in trouble, Lord! The enemy has won.”
text: U doŋa faa waa suahwɛ, ka u baga faa waa hoo u laba ni. U cholaa faa chummɔɔ werge, nɛr maa wàá wer tig u bampirii. U dɔma kpegluubuu, u wii ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ú suŋ u ni.

ref: Zion's treasures were stolen. Jerusalem saw foreigners enter her place of worship, though the Lord had forbidden them to belong to his people.
text: U dɔma faa paagi u daama kuna maanii. U na banna zuu Kɔraawiizi Dia la himmaa. Bɔr la Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ gilɛɛ ra zuu la.

ref: Everyone in the city groans while searching for food; they trade their valuables for barely enough scraps to stay alive. Jerusalem Speaks: Jerusalem shouts to the Lord, “Please look and see how miserable I am!”
text: U nɛra ra hɛm di ra nyiŋŋi diwee bá di, di kpa ba daama chɛr diwee bá di, di dɔɔ miibɔɔ. A bolzeŋ nɛra wii di ra ŋɔ, “Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, na gunla yaa n na di dɔgnya.”

ref: No passerby even cares. Why doesn't someone notice my terrible sufferings? You were fiercely angry, Lord, and you punished me worst of all.
text: U wii di ra kali nɛra la maa n ga u be di waa kaali, “Ií binniŋ na! Nɛr maa bɔra wɔɔ ra waazi kennaa alugɔ n hor.” Bɔwaazaa la Kɔraawiizi n gillɛ a chol n ni, u baaŋfuuih saŋa la.

ref: From heaven you sent a fire that burned in my bones; you set a trap for my feet and made me turn back. All day long you leave me in shock from constant pain.
text: “U faa gillɔɔ niŋ lii chiŋ ba, di waa di n biini. U he sidɛɛ lawiŋ, n chol hɛri, denii u giliŋ ta, n bɔra ra waaziŋ saŋa maa.

ref: You have tied my sins around my neck, and they weigh so heavily that my strength is gone. You have put me in the power of enemies too strong for me.
text: U zum n wichɔgaa maanii, di chaalaa bɔkpaŋ, di vɔɔzaa laaliŋ, a gil n gɛrgi. Kɔraawiizi faa kpambuu du n dɔma la n kpekke kaaliŋ nonee, n faa waa wette ń lɛɛ n hiŋ.

ref: You, Lord, have turned back my warriors and crushed my young heroes. Judah was a woman untouched, but you let her be trampled like grapes in a wine pit.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa ra ɛɛ n laallɔkpegaa chɛɛtɛ. U faa gillɔɔ laallɔɔra ba wa kpu n biipɔllaa, di nam baa alugɔ banna nam grepu nɔna siŋ kuaribɔr.

ref: Because of this, I mourn, and tears flood my eyes. No one is here to comfort or to encourage me; we have lost the war— my people are suffering. The Prophet Speaks:
text: Awiarɛ n siwee taali sinii di ra pal la. Nɛr maa wàá wer tig n bampirii gɛɛ di duŋ bɔkpega. N dɔma kpeglimbuu, n nɛra waa kaa dɔɔ kummaa.

ref: Zion reaches out her hands, but no one offers comfort. The Lord has turned the neighboring nations against Jacob's descendants. Jerusalem is merely a filthy rag to her neighbors. Jerusalem Speaks:
text: N yaa noneere, ka nɛr maa wàá hiiniŋ. Kɔraawiizi yir dɔmaa lii bɔr maa, bá wa lɔŋ. Ba ra ɛɛŋ lugɔ kundoŋ.

ref: The Lord was right, but I refused to obey him. Now I ask all of you to look at my sufferings— even my young people have been dragged away.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi wia dɔɔ wibiire, dikuubɛɛwiai, minuu vɛɛ u nua. Nɛra n du yemmaa, ií ra nuu n be, ií binni na gunla n bɔra n na waazi. Ba lauri n biipɔllaa ni n suŋguree kaali.

ref: I called out to my lovers, but they betrayed me. My priests and my leaders died while searching the city for scraps of food.
text: N yir la nɛra la n ni baa n dɔɔ nuukpannɛ, ka ba vɛɛ n hiinaa. Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ni sitɔɔra siuzɔɔrɛ, bolzeŋ ŋmɛnizenaa biine, di ba ra nyiŋŋi diwee bá di, di dɔɔ miibɔɔni.

ref: Won't you look and see how upset I am, our Lord? My stomach is in knots, and my heart is broken because I betrayed you. In the streets and at home, my people are slaughtered.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, binni dɔgnya la minna di! N biini chɔkkɔɔ, dikuu n wichɔgaa wia. Nɛkpui su ŋmɛnizenaa, haali diini biine maa, siu du denii.

ref: Everyone heard my groaning, but no one offered comfort. My enemies know of the trouble that you have brought on me, and it makes them glad. Hurry and punish them, as you have promised.
text: A nuu n hɛmaa. Nɛr maa waa hoo, ú tig n bampirii. N dɔma bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ, dikuu hiŋ gillɛ hɛhchɔg chol n ni wia. Gil hɔpizii la hiŋ ŋɔ nua u wia la ba, di gil n dɔma di tɔɔrɔɔ naa minna di naa.

ref: Don't let their evil deeds escape your sight. Punish them as much as you have punished me because of my sins. I never stop groaning— I've lost all hope!
text: Gil ba di bilchɔg dikuu ba biinikpola wia. Tɛr ba digna gunla hiŋ tɛr n digna, dikuu n wichɔgaa wia la. N na hɛmuu ni biinichɔg, n bɔra huah.”

ref: The Lord was angry! So he disgraced Zion though it was Israel's pride and his own place of rest. In his anger he threw Zion down from heaven to earth.
text: Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuih la biini, u gillɔɔ bɔbiri tɔ bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni, di gil u daama maa bir pɛɛ. Haali u baaŋfuuih hɔpizii hiŋ gba, u vɛɛ u Diarɛ ta.

ref: The Lord had no mercy! He destroyed the homes of Jacob's descendants. In his anger he tore down every walled city in Judah; he toppled the nation together with its leaders, leaving them in shame.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa waa Juda boljiga maa ni sunne, ka chɔgaa, di purgi diikpega la maa, n na guu a hɛri la. U faa gillɔɔ hiihzi kpu u kora ni u sitɔɔra.

ref: The Lord was so furiously angry that he wiped out the whole army of Israel by not supporting them when the enemy attacked. He was like a raging fire that swallowed up the descendants of Jacob.
text: U baaŋfuuihchɔgii la biini, u faa chɔgi Izrɛl hina fɔŋŋaa. U faa vɛɛ ba hiinaare, saŋa la ba dɔma n pig baa la. Ka faa lɔ baa lugɔ ninzeŋ, di chɔgi ba kummaa.

ref: He attacked like an enemy with a bow and arrows, killing our loved ones. He has burned to the ground the homes on Mount Zion.
text: U faa ta baabuu u hobee alugɔ u dɔma, di kpu banla maa n faa ra tɛɛ baa bɔsɔna werge la. U gillɔɔ u baaŋ fuuh ba ni lugɔ niŋ, Jɛrusalɛm biini.

ref: The Lord was like an enemy! He left Israel in ruins with its palaces and fortresses destroyed, and with everyone in Judah moaning and weeping.
text: Kɔraawiizi kpu Izrɛl hinaa lugɔ ba dɔma, di purgi ba diikpega ni kooridiini. U gillɔɔ biinichɔg la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ lau Juda hina.

ref: He shattered his temple like a hut in a garden; he completely wiped out his meeting place, and did away with festivals and Sabbaths in the city of Zion. In his fierce anger he rejected our king and priests.
text: U faa purgi u Dia la baŋ ɔɔ ra jaamuu u biini labuu, di gil hɔpizinanaananaa ni Heezaa Hɔpizaa la tuŋ. Koori ni Kɔraawiizi kizeehina maa faa zummɔ lugɔ u baaŋ fuuh ba ninɛɛ.

ref: The Lord abandoned his altar and his temple; he let Zion's enemies capture her fortresses. Noisy shouts were heard from the temple, as if it were a time of celebration.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa vɛɛ u mbusu lizibɔr ni u Diinaniinanii labuu ta. U faa gillɔɔ dɔma purgi u koŋlaa, di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna, bɔr la baŋ faa ra jaamuu la.

ref: The Lord had decided to tear down the walls of Zion stone by stone. So he started destroying and did not stop until walls and fortresses mourned and trembled.
text: Kɔraawiizi siwii faa aahwɔɔ lugɔ Bolzeŋ Ziɔn koŋlii la n baruu la chol. U faa mɛgzaabuu, di zum a maga, á yemmaa gilɛɛ waa ka wia. U diijaŋra ni a koŋlii maanii jaa purgi kpau dɔŋa chɔɔ.

ref: Zion's gates have fallen facedown on the ground; the bars that locked the gates are smashed to pieces. Her king and royal family are prisoners in foreign lands. Her priests don't teach, and her prophets don't have a message from the Lord.
text: A bolzeŋ dominuuzenaa hug hembugle biinii, a daazi maa kuugi nyaamm. A koori ni nabɔnzenaa maanii ba lauri kaali hɛrduma. Ba waa kaa ra bagli a nɛra Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg la wia. Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi ge waa kaa ra na wia lugɔ deeza biini, di ra lii Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: Zion's leaders are silent. They just sit on the ground, tossing dirt on their heads and wearing sackcloth. Her young women can do nothing but stare at the ground.
text: Jɛrusalɛm bazɛŋzi sogo hɛrii di ɛɛ surumm, hɛɛhraa tɔ ba nyuuni, ba kpa gbɔglɔŋ laala laali. Suŋgure ge giŋŋi willi ba nyuuni.

ref: My eyes are red from crying, my stomach is in knots, and I feel sick all over. My people are being wiped out, and children lie helpless in the streets of the city.
text: N siwee maanii ɔrgɛɛ dikuu wiraa wia, n biini chɔgi di ra tɔɔriŋ werge. N biini chɔkkɔɔ werge maa, n bɔra huah dikuu n nɛra kpui wia. Bichalli ni biifulli ra huahgi a bolzeŋ ŋmɛnizenaa biine.

ref: A child begs its mother for food and drink, then blacks out like a wounded soldier lying in the street. The child slowly dies in its mother's arms.
text: Lɔzi ni niinyɔgzi n na kpu baa wia, ba wii ra du ba maawaa. Di ra chogli a bolzeŋ ŋmɛnizenaa baana lugɔ baŋ na pirazi, di ɔɔ ra siuzi ba maawaa nonee biine bɔɔiih.

ref: Zion, how can I comfort you? How great is your pain? Lovely city of Jerusalem, how can I heal your wounds, gaping as wide as the sea?
text: N nɔŋŋi Jɛrusalɛm, ɛrɛɛ ń ŋɔi? Ɛrɛɛ ń ɛɛ tig i bampiriiyei? Nɛr maa haa waa keŋ tɔɔrɔɔ naa diwee. I hɛhchɔg kannɔɔ werge alugɔ muuzeŋ n waa maga dɔɔwɛ la, i tamii maa tunnɔɔ.

ref: Those who pass by shake their heads and sneer as they make fun and shout, “What a lovely city you were, the happiest on earth, but look at you now!”
text: Nɛra la maa n ga a bolzeŋ kɛrii di waa kaali, ɔɔ ra ɛɛibuu chɛɛtɛ. Ba ɔɔ ra viigi ba nyuunii, di ra mam Jɛrusalɛm chɔgaa wia, di ra ŋɔ, “Bolzennanii labuu kennaa? U wiarɛ durnya hina ra jigsi laa?”

ref: Zion, your enemies curse you and snarl like wild animals, while shouting, “This is the day we've waited for! At last, we've got you!”
text: I dɔma maa ɔɔ ra mamiibuu, di ra fiilii ni hahzi. Ba ɔɔ mir ba nuuzii di ra mamii, di ra ŋɔ, “Yaa chɔguubuu! A hɔpizii naabuu yaa ra kpaŋ la!”

ref: The Lord has done everything that he had planned and threatened long ago. He destroyed you without mercy and let your enemies boast about their powerful forces.
text: Kɔraawiizi jaa ɛɛ wii la uŋ ta jina lugɔ u daŋ ɛɛ labuu. Waa i ni sunne ka chɔgii, gunla uŋ karfii faala maa la. U faa gillɔɔ i dɔma kpeglii, di tɛɛ baa bɔsɔna, hiŋ cholle wia.

ref: Zion, deep in your heart you cried out to the Lord. Now let your tears overflow your walls day and night. Don't ever lose hope or let your tears stop.
text: Jɛrusalɛm, wii ra du Kɔraawiizi! Gil i sinii ra pal alugɔ muuni, hamuŋa ni hɔpizaa maa. A wii ni biinichɔg, saŋa maa.

ref: Get up and pray for help all through the night. Pour out your feelings to the Lord, as you would pour water out of a jug. Beg him to save your people, who are starving to death at every street crossing. Jerusalem Speaks:
text: Hamuŋa maa, ɔɔ izi digiidigii, di wii ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. Ɔɔ ra suŋŋuu kpegzi ni, ni i biini maa, di ra tɛɛ i biizi, ú suŋ ba ni. I biizi la lɔzi n na kpu baa, ba ra siuzi ŋmɛnizenaa biine la.

ref: Think about it, Lord! Have you ever been this cruel to anyone before? Is it right for mothers to eat their children, or for priests and prophets to be killed in your temple?
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, binni yaa! Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i ra tɛrgi yaa digna gunnɛi? Haana ra hee ba biizi la baŋ nɔŋŋɛɛrɛ! Ba ra kpuuzi i kizeehina ni i dɔgtɛɛzii i Dia la biini himmaa!

ref: My people, both young and old, lie dead in the streets. Because you were angry, my young men and women were brutally slaughtered.
text: Bichalli ni nabɔnzi maanii siuzɛɛ chɔɔ ŋmɛnizenaa baana! Biipɔllaa ni haana ba dɔma n kpuuzɛɛ ni tokobizi. I faa waa ba ni sunne, ka kpuuzi baa werge i baaŋfuuih hɔpizii la.

ref: When you were angry, Lord, you invited my enemies like guests for a party. No one survived that day; enemies killed my children, my own little ones.
text: I faa yir n dɔmaa ba wa chaali alugɔ diuzenaa dii hɔpizii hɔl. Ba wa bariŋ, di kpa ɔnsii werge ta n ni. Nɛr maa faa waa wette ú na bɔr chɔ, i baaŋfuuih hɔpizii la. Ba faa kpuuzi n biizi la miŋ dɛɛzɛɛ di nɔŋŋi baa labuu.

ref: I have suffered much because God was angry.
text: Minuu zum gunla Kɔraawiizi dignitɛraa n duwɛɛ.

ref: He chased me into a dark place, where no light could enter.
text: U faa duŋŋimbuu du bɔbiri werge biini.

ref: I am the only one he punishes over and over again, without ever stopping.
text: Di lɔɔziŋ digiidigii, waa n ni sunne.

ref: God caused my skin and flesh to waste away, and he crushed my bones.
text: U faa gillɔɔ n zɛŋ, n bɔrahɔŋ ziimi, u kuugi n hoga.

ref: He attacked and surrounded me with hardships and trouble;
text: U faa gillɔɔ n du dɔgnya ni biinichɔg biini lugɔ baŋ tɔŋ dia.

ref: he forced me to sit in the dark like someone long dead.
text: U faa firimbuu n du siu bɔbiri la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la biini.

ref: God built a fence around me that I cannot climb over, and he chained me down.
text: U vɔɔzimbuu yɔlɔzi, n ɛɛ lugɔ baŋ tɔ nɛr dia, maa tamii dɔɔwɛ min niŋ na bɔr chɔ.

ref: Even when I shouted and prayed for help, he refused to listen.
text: N lɔ wilee di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa, ka Kɔraawiizi vɛɛ nuui.

ref: God put big rocks in my way and made me follow a crooked path.
text: N na voluu di ra jiŋli, koŋlaa la baŋ kpa bia ma ra tɔŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ, bɔr la maa miŋ bittɛ ń ga.

ref: God was like a bear or a lion waiting in ambush for me;
text: U faa guumbuu lugɔ amani, di jirgiŋ lugɔ bunyiŋ.

ref: he dragged me from the road, then tore me to shreds.
text: U faa tuuziŋ lii ŋmɛnɛɛ, di chuuriŋ, ka giliŋ de, nɛr maa waŋ hiinee.

ref: God took careful aim and shot his arrows
text: U faa kpa u hobee du u hoo, di taaziŋ.

ref: I am a joke to everyone— no one ever stops making fun of me.
text: Nɛra ra mamiŋ a hɔl hiŋ guŋŋ wiizi wa chol, n birgi mɔmɔsia kuŋ ba be.

ref: God has turned my life sour.
text: Tɔɔrɔɔkpola bɛnnɛ u tɛŋ, a ɛɛ lugɔ n diwee ni nii.

ref: He made me eat gravel and rubbed me in the dirt.
text: U faa lawimbuu di kpa n siwee tuuri hɛri, di kuugi n nyina nyaŋŋaa biini.

ref: I cannot find peace or remember happiness.
text: N suuh gunla alaanfia bampirsɔna ani bɔsɔna n duwɛɛnɛ.

ref: I tell myself, “I am finished! I can't count on the Lord to do anything for me.”
text: N saŋa waa kaa du kaŋ, n tamii Kɔraawiizi ni tunnɔɔ.

ref: Just thinking of my troubles and my lonely wandering makes me miserable.
text: Di n wa fɛ n bɔra waazaa ni n bol nyaai wia, a ɔɔ ɛɛu lugɔ siri n kpolle.

ref: That's all I ever think about, and I am depressed.
text: N na liizi gunnɛ saŋa maa, n biini chɔgi werge.

ref: Then I remember something that fills me with hope.
text: Ama, aŋ biruu dɔɔ tamii, di n wa liizi wii naa.

ref: The Lord's kindness never fails! If he had not been merciful, we would have been destroyed.
text: Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa ni u nɛsunaa dɔɔi la waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: The Lord can always be trusted to show mercy each morning.
text: A ɛɛ a falaarɛ alugɔ chɔɔzi, di ɛɛ lugɔ wiizi furaa n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: Deep in my heart I say, “The Lord is all I need; I can depend on him!”
text: Kɔraawiizi bɛnnɛ n dɔɔ, awia, u ninɛɛ n tamii du.

ref: The Lord is kind to everyone who trusts and obeys him.
text: Kɔraawiizi wia wessoo nɛr la maa n yarduu be.

ref: It is good to wait patiently for the Lord to save us.
text: Awia, a wessoo werge maa, yaa n dɔɔ kanyitti di ra kpaŋuu, ú lɛɛ yaa.

ref: When we are young, it is good to struggle hard
text: Saŋa la n dɛkkɛ yá helli kanyitti diire, yaa pɔlaa saŋa.

ref: and to sit silently alone, if this is what the Lord intends.
text: Di yaa waa di tɔɔrɔɔ, a dɛkkɔɔ ya so yaa bɛnaa kirkir ni kanyitti.

ref: Being rubbed in the dirt can teach us a lesson;
text: A dɛkkɔɔ ya willi yaa nyuuni, aŋhinabe, tamii daŋ haa du de.

ref: we can also learn from insults and hard knocks.
text: Haali baŋ lɔɔzi yaa di chagzi yaa gba, ka a dɛkkɔɔ ya sɛɛ a maa.

ref: The Lord won't always reject us!
text: Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ nɛsunaare, wàá vɛɛ yaa ta di hanna la.

ref: He causes a lot of suffering, but he also has pity because of his great love.
text: Aŋhinabe, u daŋ gil yaa biine chɔgi, ka gunla un nɔŋŋi yaa la ɛɛ wibiire, di du kpeg.

ref: The Lord doesn't enjoy sending grief or pain.
text: U kipar lɛi ú gil ya dɔɔ biinichɔg gɛɛ bɔra waazaa.

ref: Don't trample prisoners under your feet
text: Wàá sɛɛ sunni banla maa baŋ tɔ dia.

ref: or cheat anyone out of what is rightfully theirs. God Most High sees everything,
text: U zum saŋa la baŋ ɔɔ kpolli yaa wia la n dɛg yaa, ú tɛɛ yaa labuu.

ref: and he knows when you refuse to give someone a fair trial.
text: Di ba wa bir wibii dii seriya diiribɔr, Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ zumuu.

ref: No one can do anything without the Lord's approval.
text: Kɔraawiizi kipar bɛnnɛ ɔɔ wer ɛɛ saŋa maa.

ref: Good and bad each happen at the command of God Most High.
text: U wiŋɔzi ɔɔ weruu gil winanaa ni achɔgaa maa ɛɛ.

ref: We're still alive! We shouldn't complain when we are being punished for our sins.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ yaa ɔɔ ra nuumi, di ba wa tɛr yaa digna dikuu yaa wichɔgaa wiai?

ref: Instead, we should think about the way we are living, and turn back to the Lord.
text: Ií gil ya pessi yaa wiɛɛlaa nɛnnɛ, ka bir ba Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: When we lift our hands in prayer to God in heaven, we should offer him our hearts and say,
text: Ií gil ya huuhzi yaa biine tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n du u bol, ka suŋŋuu, di ŋɔ,

ref: “We've sinned! We've rebelled against you, and you haven't forgiven us!
text: “Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, yaa ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ di vɛɛ i nua, haa gillɛ tɛɛ yaa.

ref: Anger is written all over you, as you pursue and slaughter us without showing pity.
text: I dau yaa lugee di kpuuzi yaa. I baaŋfuuih la faa gillɔɔ i nɛsunaa la suah.

ref: You are behind a wall of clouds that blocks out our prayers.
text: Yaa wiisuŋŋaa faa waa wette a helii, dikuu i baaŋfuuih la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ baama n tɔkkɛ, di tɔ ŋmɛnɛɛ wia.

ref: You allowed nations to treat us like garbage;
text: I gillɔɔ yaa birgi durnya hul, hɛssi hina be.

ref: We are terrified and trapped, caught and crushed.”
text: Hɛhchɔg ni chɔgaa chol yaa ninɛɛ, yaa du siaahmu ni ɔnsii biini.

ref: My people are destroyed! Tears flood my eyes,
text: N sinii ra paluu alugɔ muuni, dikuu n nɛra kpui wia.

ref: until the Lord looks down from heaven and helps.
text: di ra ba saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n du u bol ka na yaa.

ref: I am horrified when I see what enemies have done to the young women of our city.
text: Biinichɔg lawimbuu werge maa, dikuu wia la miŋ nawɛɛ baŋ kpawɛɛ dau a bolzeŋ haana la wia.

ref: No one had reason to hate me, but I was hunted down like a bird.
text: N dɔma la n hahŋ pɛɛpɛɛ la hembuu sidɛɛ, di lawiŋ lugɔ zumbee.

ref: Then they tried to kill me by tossing me into a pit and throwing stones at me.
text: Ba ra nyiŋŋi n kpui, di kpaŋ ha bɔɔ biini, di paa bia ra lɔɔziŋ.

ref: Water covered my head— I thought I was gone.
text: Nii faari di ra nyiŋŋi u tɔ n ni, n fɛ lugɔ siu duglɔɔrɛ.

ref: From the bottom of the pit, I prayed to you, Lord.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a bɔɔ biinii n du ka faa wii tɛi.

ref: I begged you to listen. “Help!” I shouted. “Save me!” You answered my prayer
text: Miŋ wa suŋŋii lugɔ í nuu n wiraa, i nuuwɔɔ.

ref: and came when I was in need. You told me, “Don't worry!”
text: I sɛɛ, di ŋɔ ń gilɛɛ ra ɔm.

ref: You rescued me and saved my life.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i ba wa hiiniŋ, di lɛɛŋ ta.

ref: You saw them abuse me, Lord, so make things right.
text: Di seriya, di tɛŋ bilii, i zum wichɔgaa la maa baŋ ɛɛmbuu.

ref: You know every plot they have made against me.
text: I zum gunla n dɔma n hahmbuu, di ra ta n jinachɔgaa.

ref: Yes, you know their insults and their evil plans.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i nuuwɔɔ banna chagziŋ, di zum ba jinachɔgaa la maa banna ta n wiarɛ.

ref: All day long they attack with words and whispers.
text: Hɔpizii maa, ba ɔɔ ra zɔɔzimbuu, di ra ta ba jinazi guŋŋ wiizi wa chol.

ref: No matter what they are doing, they keep on mocking me.
text: Di lii chɔɔzi di ra la hamuŋa, ba ɔɔ ra mamimbuu, di ra ɛɛŋ chɛɛtɛ.

ref: Pay them back for everything they have done, Lord!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, tɛr ba digna, dikuu wia la baŋ ɛɛwɛ la wia.

ref: Put your curse on them and make them suffer.
text: See baa nua, di gil ba tamii tuŋ.

ref: Get angry and go after them until not a trace is left under the heavens.
text: Dau ba luge, di dim baa, hɛri naa biini nyaamm!”

ref: The purest gold is ruined and has lost its shine; jewels from the temple lie scattered in the streets.
text: Na, yaa saliŋ waa kaa ra nyɛgzi! Kɔraawiizi Dia bia yaari ŋmɛnizenaa la maa baana.

ref: These are Zion's people, worth more than purest gold; yet they are counted worthless like dishes of clay.
text: Bolzeŋ Ziɔn biipɔllaa faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ saliŋ la n wesse werge yaa be. Ka filaŋkeŋ, ba ra ɛɛ baabuu lugɔ viini.

ref: Even jackals nurse their young, but my people are like ostriches that abandon their own.
text: Hohobia gba ɔɔ giluu u biizi ra ɔzi, ka n nɛra waa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ taitaizi n ɔɔ dɔɔ sihilii a biizi ni.

ref: Babies are so thirsty that their tongues are stuck to the roof of the mouth. Children go begging for food, but no one gives them any.
text: Ba ɔɔ giluu ba biifulli ra siuzi, dikuu lɔzi ni niinyɔgzi wia. Bichalli ra suŋŋi diwee la nɛr maa n wàá tɛɛ baa.

ref: All who ate expensive foods lie starving in the streets; those who grew up in luxury now sit on trash heaps.
text: Nɛra la n faa ra di diunanaa labuu jaa ra siuzi ŋmɛnizenaa baana, dikuu lɔzi wia. Banla baŋ dɛɛzɛɛ daama biini labuu jaa ra pigzi hul, di ra nyiŋŋi diwee.

ref: My nation was punished worse than the people of Sodom, whose city was destroyed in a flash without the help of human hands.
text: Kɔraawiizi tɛr n nɛra dignaa kaali Sɔdɔm hina n faa cholle kakpaŋ, saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n hau ba ni la.

ref: The leaders of Jerusalem were purer than snow and whiter than milk; their bodies were healthy and glowed like jewels.
text: Jɛrusalɛm sitɔɔra faa waa doŋa maa dɔɔwɛ, ka huuhzi lugɔ gonni, di faa wermi di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, di ra nyɛgzi dikuu baŋ dɔɔ alaanfia wia.

ref: Now they are blacker than tar, and no one recognizes them; their skin clings to their bones and is drier than firewood.
text: Baabuu chɔɔgi ŋmɛnizenaa, ba zumaa du kpol, ba siwee paga biri, dikuu siu wia. Ba bɔrahɔna hil lugɔ daazi, di margi ba hoga.

ref: Being killed with a sword is better than slowly starving to death.
text: Banla n siuzɛɛ laal biini labuu bɔmbɔ banla n siu harbɔɔ ni la. Baabuu lɔchɔgii faa kpu bɔɔiih la.

ref: Life in the city is so bad that loving mothers have boiled and eaten their own children.
text: Hɛhchɔg la n faa chol n nɛra ni la, faa gillɔɔ ɔnsii ni nuukpui werge du de. Maawaa faa daali ba biinɔŋŋaa ra hee.

ref: The Lord was so fiercely angry that he burned the city of Zion to the ground.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa kpa u baaŋfuuihchɔgiirɛ, di du Bolzeŋ Ziɔn niŋ, u maa fuuh.

ref: Not a king on this earth or the people of any nation believed enemies could break through her gates.
text: Nɛr maa, haali hɛhjaŋa koora gba, faa waa yardɛɛ lugɔ nɛr maa daŋ wer ga Jɛrusalɛm dominuuzenaa zuu u biini.

ref: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.
text: Ka guŋ ɛɛwɔɔ dikuu u dɔgtɛɛzi n ɛɛ wichɔgaa, u kizeehina di bilchɔg la baŋ gillɛ nɛra la n waa wichɔgaa maa ɛɛwɛ siuzi wia.

ref: Yes, her prophets and priests were covered with blood; no one would come near them, as they wandered from street to street.
text: A dɔgtɛɛzi ni a kizeehina faa du ŋmɛnizenaa di ra juuri lugɔ nyuŋŋa. Chal faa fɔg ba bɔra maa, nɛr maa wàá sɛɛ gbɔgzi baa.

ref: Instead, everyone shouted, “Go away! Don't touch us! You're filthy and unfit to belong to God's people!” So they had to leave and become refugees. But foreign nations told them, “You can't stay here!”
text: Nɛra ɔɔ ra pogzi, di ra ŋɔ, “Ií lii yaa be! Ií doŋŋoo, ií gilɛɛ waa gbɔgzi yaa!” Awia, ba faa juuri ra bar hɛssi maa, nɛr maa waa sɛɛwɛ ú lɛɛ baa dau.

ref: The Lord is the one who sent them scattering, and he has forgotten them. No respect or kindness will be shown to the priests or leaders.
text: Ba wia faa waa kaa tir Kɔraawiizi, u himmaanii faa yaari baa. U faa waa kaa ra tɔgzi u kizeehina ni sitɔɔra.

ref: Enemies hunted us down on every public street. Our time was up; our doom was near.
text: Yaa dɔma faa ra du yaa taurɛ, haali yaa faa waa wette ya vol ŋmɛnizenaa biine gba. Yaa hɔpizaa faa tunnɔɔ, yaa tuna hel.

ref: They swooped down faster than eagles from the sky. They hunted for us in the hills and set traps to catch us out in the desert.
text: Ba faa gbaŋŋɔɔ kaali chigni n lii chiŋ di ra tuu, di duŋŋi yaa tuu. Ba faa dau yaa lugee lii giŋgimee nyuuni tuu, di pirgi yaa hɛribɔduma biini.

ref: The Lord's chosen leader was our hope for survival! We thought he would keep us safe somewhere among the nations, but even he was caught in one of their traps.
text: Ba faa lau koori la Kɔraawiizi n lizɛɛ labuu, unla n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ nɛr la n na tɛɛ yaa miibɔɔ la. Unla la yaa n faa dɛllɛɛ lugɔ u daŋ lɛɛ yaa lii nɛra la maa n niŋ ba wa lɔ yaa la be la.

ref: You people of Edom can celebrate now! But your time will come to suffer and stagger around naked.
text: Ɛdɔm ni Uz hina, ií ra mam. Ií ra deŋŋi siwee saŋa la iin niŋ wer. Ii ge hɛhchɔg ra bau, ii ge daŋ jiŋli ni chakpalli, hiihzi kpu ia.

ref: The people of Zion have paid for their sins, and the Lord will soon let them return home. But, people of Edom, you will be punished, and your sins exposed.
text: Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina turgi ba wichɔgaa kinnɛ, Kɔraawiizi wàá ka gil ya du hɛrduma biini. Ɛdɔm hina, Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɛrgi ii digna, di gil ii wichɔgaa lii chaaŋ.

ref: Our Lord, don't forget how we have suffered and been disgraced.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, a liizi wia la n huuzi yaa la. Na gunla yaa n di hiihzi.

ref: Foreigners and strangers have taken our land and our homes.
text: Yaa kundɔɔlaa du hɔɔhra noneere, famaraa foozi yaa diini dɔɔ.

ref: We are like children whose mothers are widows.
text: Yaa dɔma kpuuzi yaa mɛɛwaarɛ, yaa maawaa jaa birgi luhaana.

ref: The water we drink and the wood we burn cost far too much.
text: A ɛɛ firaa lugɔ ya ra turgi yaa niinyɔɔlii kim, di yau daazi ra chem niŋ.

ref: We are terribly mistreated; we are worn out and can find no rest.
text: Ba gillɔɔ yaa ra hum lugɔ kauzi gɛɛ nyugmazi, di kuuh werge, ka ba wàá gil ya heezi.

ref: We had to surrender to Egypt and Assyria because we were hungry.
text: Diwee la yaa n niŋ di, di dɔɔ miibɔɔ la, Ijip ni Asiiria hɛssii yaa la gaa suŋŋaa.

ref: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
text: Yaa naabaala faa ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ, ka ba waa kaa du de, ka yaa ra di ba wichɔgaa tɔɔrɔɔ.

ref: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
text: Banla n waa yoma bɔwɛɛ labuu dɔɔ yaa di ra fir. Nɛr maa waa hoo ú lɛɛ yaa lii ba fɔŋŋa biini.

ref: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
text: Nɛkpuura du pitte di ra gaagi, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ tulmaa, di yaa wa gaagɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi diwee.

ref: Our skin is scorched from fever and hunger.
text: Lɔzi faa gillɔɔ yaa bɔra wenzi, di ɛɛ lugɔ paanuu ɔɔzibɔra.

ref: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
text: Ba punzi yaa haana Bizeŋ Ziɔn himmaa nyuu, di fir yaa biihaana di nyiŋŋi baa, Juda boljiga maa biini.

ref: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
text: Ba faa lauri yaa sitɔɔraa di sagzi baa ŋmɛnni, ba faa waa yaa nabɔnzi ra tɔgzi.

ref: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.
text: Ba fir yaa biipɔllaa, ba ra nam sɔgmia lugɔ yoma. Biibaala chi daazi, a tɔgzi gil ba ra jiŋli.

ref: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
text: Bazɛŋzi waa kaa ra so a bolzeŋ dominuuzeŋ. Biipɔllaa ni suŋgure ge waa kaa ra yir yira.

ref: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.
text: Bɔsɔna waa kaa hoo yaa be, yaa waa kaa wer ra sa, dikuu biinichɔg wia.

ref: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
text: Kuna la maa n faa gillɛ yaa ra jigsi la, bɛl maa waa kaa hoo. Yaa ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ, awiarɛ yaa wia chɔgi.

ref: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;
text: Yaa biine chɔkkɔɔ werge maa, di ɛɛ lugɔ wiila. Yaa waa kaa ra na nɛnnɛ, dikuu sinii wia,

ref: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ka hinuu koori saŋa maa, i daŋ di kora jiminizi maa ni.

ref: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
text: Gɛɛ i vɛɛ yaabuu ta di hanna lanɛi? I baaŋ waa tunaa dɔɔwɛa?

ref: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal,
text: Guŋ n na ɛɛ la, n ŋɔ n binni wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag di pekpeg bɛl ra ta di taa baamazenzeŋ bɛl di ra ba, u biini maa ra nyɛgzi, chiŋ maa ge ra chaani. Ninlau ge du a baama baambaaŋ di aah guŋ muimui alugɔ baŋ kpa lugbii du niŋ la.

ref: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,
text: Denii n na kuna lugɔ kunnyinee anaazu aŋhina n du a niŋ baambaaŋ, a du lugɔ newea.

ref: except that each one had four faces and four wings.
text: Bɛl maa dɔɔ siwee bɔra anaazu, di kaa dɔɔ keeri anazaa ge jaa.

ref: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.
text: A naazi ge faa deŋloozii alugɔ newea naazi, ka a naapezi ge du lugɔ nau naafiraa di ra nyɛgzi lugɔ danyɛ baŋ vɔglɛɛ.

ref: Under each of their wings, these creatures had a human hand.
text: N kaa na newee nonee a keeri anaazu la bɛl maa ge zɛɛ di jaa a siwee anazaa la ni,

ref: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
text: a maa keeri ra gbɔgzi dɔŋa. A maa ge ɔɔ kpau zaah di ra la bɔr la maa anna nyiŋŋi, di a waa bittɛ.

ref: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.
text: Kenne bɛl maa siwee bɔra anaazu la du, newee siwee bɔr du u see, bunyiŋ siwee bɔr ge du u nodig barii, nabal siwee bɔr du u nomɛɛl barii, chig siwee bɔr ge du u harbɔɔ.

ref: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
text: Gunnɛ a siwee bɔra du. Bɛl maa keeri anɛɛ la yaa la chiŋ di chug dɔŋa hora wa kaali, ka anɛɛ ge tɔ u bɔrahɔŋ.

ref: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.
text: A kunnyinee anaazu maa dɔɔ siwee bɔra anaazu, di chaŋ bɔra anaazu. A wer zaah di ra la bɔr la maa a duma n baglaa, di a waa bittɛ.

ref: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
text: A kunnyinee naa duula ɛɛwɔɔ alugɔ niŋhɔla gɛɛ kacheela n na chaani nɛnnɛ. A niŋ du a kunnyinee baambaaŋ di ra nyɛgzi, di ɔɔ ra la see ka ra ba har.

ref: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
text: A kunnyinee ɔɔ la see ka ra ba har alugɔ dooŋ n na nyɛgzi.

ref: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
text: Minna binni a kunnyinee anaazu la, n na di chir chigɔ bɛl maa kɛra.

ref: shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
text: Kenne a chira du, bɛl maa ra nyɛgzuu lugɔ binanii bɛl banna yir krisolait. A chira anaazu maanii li dɔŋa. A bɛl maa ge biini kaa dɔɔ chir, di ɛɛ lugɔ chira anɛɛ n suu dɔŋa ni di kaŋli.

ref: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
text: A chira bɛl maa du jeŋgereŋ, di dɔɔ siwee bar u maa, a wia dɔɔ ɔnsii werge.

ref: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
text: Di a kunnyinee la haŋ waa la bɔr la maa, a chira ge ɔɔ ra la denii, di a kaa wa chi ge, a chira ge ɔɔ chiu. Di a wa izoo di ra la chiŋ ge a ni a chira maanii ɔɔ kpau ra la, dikuubɛɛwiai, a duma faa du a maa ninɛɛ.

ref: Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body.
text: A kunnyɛgzii naa zɛɛrɛ a kunnyinee naa du, di yaa a keeri anɛɛ di ra chug dɔŋa hora, ka anɛɛgaa ge tɔ a bɔrazi.

ref: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
text: Di a haŋ wa izi di ra la bɔr la maa, a keeri ɔɔ ra gbɔgzi werge maa alugɔ niizeŋ n na pal di ra kɔɔ gɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ n na ŋɔ wia gɛɛ laallɔɔrakpila n na kɔɔ. Di a wa chigɔ ge, a kaa lau a keeri fɔɔzi.

ref: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
text: Aŋ ɔɔ chi di fɔɔ a keeri la, loobii bɛl ɔɔ ra ŋɔ wia lii kunla n guali a ni la chinne.

ref: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
text: Kunla n guali a ni la ge chiŋ bir ɛɛ lugɔ koorikara, di ɛɛ lugɔ binanii bɛl n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ burgu, ba ra yiruu safaaya. Kumbɛl ge so a kara ni lugɔ newee.

ref: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
text: Nɛr la n soge a koorikara ni la, di chi u chara di ra tinni aah guŋ muimui alugɔ baŋ kpa lugbii du niŋ la, di ra nyɛgzi werge maa. Di kaa chi u chara ge di ra tuu ge ra chaani werge alugɔ ninlau,

ref: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
text: di ɛɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi kizee n liwɛɛ dooŋ balli hɔpizii. Kennaabuu n faa na gunla Kɔraawiizi girme n na chaani werge alugɔ ninlau n duwɛɛ la. Miŋ wa na guŋ, n chol pi, ka ra nuu loobii bɛl n ŋɔ wia di ra tɛŋ.

ref: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “Newee biibaal, izi chiŋ. N na nyiŋŋuu ń nii ŋɔ wia.”

ref: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
text: Unna ŋɔ wia la, u Duma iziŋ werge maa, di lalliŋ chiŋŋi, n nuu gunla unna ŋɔ n be la.

ref: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
text: U kaa ŋɔ, “Newee biibaal, n na humiibuu Izrɛl hina la n dɔɔ dignikpega, di vɛɛŋ la be. Lugli la, ba ni ba naabaala feloore vɛɛ n wia, haali di haa kpogli guŋ di wa lii ni zinaa.

ref: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
text: Ba digna kpekkoo werge maa, ba ra gbɛlliŋ. Awia, n na humiibuu í ga ŋɔ ba be, dí Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ

ref: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
text: haali di ba daŋ nuu tɛi gɛɛ ba wàá nuu gba, ka ba ni ba dignikpega la maa, ba daŋ zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ faa du ba biinii.

ref: Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave
text: Ka hìŋ́ newee biibaal, gilɛɛ waa ɔm baa gɛɛ ba wiŋɔzi. Gilɛɛ gil i bɔra ra sa, haali aŋ ɛɛwɛ lugɔ choŋgolaa ni sɔɔhri n barii gba, i kaa du nuunzi biini gba. Gilɛɛ waa ɔm baa i bɔra ra sa, ba ɛɛ dignikpega hinaa.

ref: and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not.
text: Di ba daŋ nuu gɛɛ ba wàá nuu, ka í lizi n loobii naa tɛɛ baa, dikuu baŋ ɛɛ dignikpega hina wia.

ref: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
text: Newee biibaal, ra nuu gunla minna ŋɔ i be, gilɛɛ waa dɔɔ dignikpega lugɔ baa. Haa i nua di lɛɛ kunnaa miŋ ŋɔ n tɛi naa di.”

ref: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
text: Denii n kaa ŋɔ n binni, di nonii bɛl tɛttɔ di ra ba n be, di kpogli hɔnsɛbii bɛl baŋ piŋŋee.

ref: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
text: Uŋ wa dugliŋ, u lawuu yaa. N na u keŋkerezi anɛɛ maa baŋ sɛbi biinichɔg yira, liyira ani wia la n niŋ wa dɔɔ biinichɔg werge maa u ni.

ref: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
text: U ŋɔ n be, “Newee biibaal, hee hɔnnaa piŋ.” N heeu, u du sum n nua alugɔ huuhnuu.

ref: The Lord said: Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people.
text: U ŋɔ, “Newee biibaal, la ga lizi n loobii naa tɛɛ Izrɛl hina.

ref: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
text: A waa lugɔ n na humiibuu hɛri la nɛra n kpillɛ werge mɔɔri n kpolle be, akai, di n ɛɛ guŋ, ba daŋ nuu tɛi.

ref: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
text: Ka n na humiibuu Izrɛl hina be, ba wàá nuu tɛi, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba waa nyiŋŋi ba nuu tɛŋ, ba maa kpoŋŋoo di dɔɔ dignikpega.

ref: so I will make you as stubborn as they are.
text: Ama, n daŋ gil i dɔɔ dignikpega alugɔ baa.

ref: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
text: La i hɛri hina la baŋ lauri i ni baa ba Babilɔn hɛri la be, di ga ŋɔ, kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa La ra ŋɔ, di ba daŋ nuu gɛɛ ba wàá nuu.”

ref: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi Duma la wa lalliŋ chiŋ, n nuu loobizeŋ bɛl lugɔ dooŋ n na pogzi, di ra kɔɔ n harbɔɔ, di ra ŋɔ, “Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi girme u duuribɔr.”

ref: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
text: N nuu a kunnyinee keeri n na siigi dɔŋa, chira la n du a naazi kɛraa la faa ra birgi di ra kɔɔ werge alugɔ dooŋ n na pogzi.

ref: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi Duma kaa iziŋ, di lalliŋ chiŋ, di kpaŋ ra kaali, biinichɔg ni baaŋfuuih lawiŋ. Ka Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa faa du n ni werge.

ref: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
text: Denii n ba Juda hina la baŋ laurɛɛ ba hɛri di ba Babilɔn la be, ba wa so Muu Kɛbar nua yembɛl banna yir Tɛl Abib la. N du ba be hɔpizaa aniidaanɛɛ, a tiriŋ werge. Kɔraawiizi n karfi Izrɛl hina wia

ref: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
text: A hɔpizaa aniidaanɛɛ n wa bɛrɛɛ, Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be,

ref: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
text: “Newee biibaal, n liziibuu ŋɔ í ra du Izrɛl hina tau. Awia, di i ɔɔ haŋ wa nuu wiimaa lii n be, ɛɛ karfi baa manaŋ.

ref: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
text: Di n waa karfi biinikpola hiŋ, di ra ŋɔ u daŋ siu, ka i vɛɛ, haa sɛɛwɛ í karfuu ú lii u wichɔgaa hiŋ biini di lɛɛ u hiŋ, u daŋ siu ni u wichɔgaa. Di guŋ wa ɛɛwɔ, hinuu n kpa u sɔnchɔgii chug.

ref: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
text: Ama, di i karfi biinikpola hiŋ, ka u vɛɛ, waa sɛɛwɛ ú gil u wichɔgaa ta, u daŋ siu dikuu a wia. Ka hiŋwaa na i hiŋ.

ref: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
text: Di nɛnanii himmaa faari wichɔgaa ɛɛi, n kpau du siaahmu biini, u daŋ siu di hɔɔ karfɛɛ. U daŋ siu dikuu u wichɔgaa wia. Màá ka liizi u winanaa la uŋ felee ɛɛ la wia, ka n daŋ kpa u sɔnchɔgii chugii.

ref: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
text: Ama, di i karfi nɛnanii ŋɔ u gil wichɔgaa ɛɛi, u sɛɛ, u daŋ na u hiŋ, í ge gba na i hiŋ.”

ref: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa iziŋ, u ŋɔ n be, “Izi la lɛl naa, ń ga ŋɔ wia tɛi de.”

ref: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
text: N izi la de, di ga na Kɔraawiizi girme gunla miŋ felee nau Muu Kɛbar nua la. Denii n chol pi.

ref: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
text: Kɔraawiizi Duma la kaa iziŋ werge maa, di lalliŋ chiŋŋi, di ŋɔ n be, “La ga tɔ i hiŋ du i dia.

ref: You will be tied up to keep you inside,
text: Newee biibaal, ba daŋ kpa ŋmɛnni vɔɔzii, hàá ka wer lii a nɛra be.

ref: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
text: N daŋ kaa gil i nua mar, hàá ka wer karfi dignikpega naa hina.

ref: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
text: Ama, di n ɔɔ waa nyiŋŋi ŋɔ í ŋɔ wia tɛɛ baa waa, n daŋ ɔɔ pilli i nua, í weraa ŋɔ wia ba be. Kenne mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ, ‘Baŋhina daŋ ɔɔ ra nuu, ka baŋhina ge vɛɛ, dikuu baŋ ɛɛ dignikpega hina wia.’ ”

ref: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ mìŋ́ Ɛzɛkiɛl be, “Newee biibaal, nyiŋŋi birkissi chiŋŋi i see, di sɛɛuh u du gunla bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm n duwɛɛ la.

ref: Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city.
text: Ka ta pizenaa, di baŋzi tanti diini, di nyiŋŋi dolli la ban niŋ kpa di purgi a bolzeŋ koŋlii baruu, di ra bagli gunla ban niŋ wa lɔ Jɛrusalɛm.

ref: Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
text: Di i wa ɛɛ guŋ tuŋ, kpa lugbii pɛrɛtuzeŋ chiŋŋi, ú teŋ i ni a bol baambaaŋ alugɔ koŋlii. Ka jaa bir i lɛɛzi chaŋuu di ra bagli gunla hin niŋ fɔɔ a bolzeŋ ni laal. A guŋ daŋ ɛɛ daansɛɛ wii, di ra karfi Izrɛl hina.

ref: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
text: Kpa huuti, baali, siga, cheeku ani zule, koozi dɔŋa ni kuari paanuu. Waabuu í ra hee guŋŋ hɔpizaa kalfaahoro ni tokkoanaazu ni fi la hin niŋ chɔɔ i nomɛɛl keŋkere ni la.

ref: Eat only a small loaf of bread each day
text: Mɛgzi i hɔpizi biimaa diwee, a tɔgzi hel saliŋhuŋŋa kebisau tokko mia.

ref: and drink only two large cups of water.
text: Ɔɔ nyɔɔ nii pirintua ni keza hɔpizi biimaa.

ref: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
text: Ɔɔ kpa newee biŋhilaa chem niŋ, di ɔɔzi paanuu heeu a nɛra maa see.”

ref: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Gunnɛ Izrɛl hina la waa di diudoŋa, saŋa la mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n niŋ wa duŋŋi baa n be, bá ga du durnya hɛssi nɛra be la.”

ref: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
text: Denii n ŋɔ, “Ee, Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, màá chɔg n hiŋ. N ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa n hiŋ chɔkkɛ. Haali di chi n bichalli saŋa maa, n haa waa sesiwii gɛɛ sel la pir sela n lauwɛ heewe. Haali n haa waa yaa sekiilii maa diwee.”

ref: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Too, amɔ guŋwaa, ɛɛ kpa nabina di ra ɔɔzi a paanuu ka gil newee biŋhilaa la.”

ref: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
text: diwee ni nii daŋ nyaa werge maa. Haali nɛra ɔɔ na dɔŋa, ba biine chɔgi, ɔnsii lau baa werge maa. Nɛkpila daŋ kɔgi di ra tuŋ werge maa, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.”

ref: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ mìŋ́ Ɛzɛkiɛl be, “Newee biibaal, pam tokobi la n na di werge, di kpau birgi fuŋ di fuŋ i nyuu ni i taŋkulo huna maa. Di i wa fuŋ a maa, í karaa di bɔnnaa bɔra ahoro.

ref: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
text: Di i wa fɔɔ a bol tuŋ, kpa a bɔkpaŋ dau a bol baambaaŋ di fuuh, di kaa kpa a tokobi teŋri a bɔkpaŋ bar a bolzeŋ. Ka jaa kpa a bɔra ahorohiŋ la ge n kawɛɛ la ta, peu lɔa yaari, dikuubɛɛwiai, n daŋ kpa tokobi duŋŋi n nɛra maa yaari.

ref: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
text: Gil a tama, di kpaa vɔɔ i tagta nua.

ref: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
text: Di kaa kpa a tama ge lii du niŋ, á fuuh. Niŋ daŋ lii a bɔtama hiŋ ni, di fuuh Izrɛl hina maa.”

ref: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ, “Jɛrusalɛmnɛ keŋ. N kpaubuu chiŋŋi durnya hɛssi maa baambaaŋ, a baruu.

ref: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
text: Ka u nɛra vɛɛ n nuuzi la miŋ dauwɛ la hiŋaarɛ, di kaali hɛssi hina la maa n baruu la, dikuu ba biinikpola werge wia. Di kaa vɛɛ n Gbɔgni ni n widaulaa la miŋ ŋɔ bá ra hiŋ la, hiŋaa.

ref: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
text: Awia, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ra ŋɔu lugɔ iiŋ vɛɛ n widaulaa ni n Gbɔgni hiŋaa naa wia, ii manni chummɔɔ werge maa kaali hɛssi hina la maa n soge bar ia la. Ii ra hiŋ hɛrdumazi hina la wiɛɛlaarɛ.

ref: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.
text: Iinna kuari vuga la miŋ kiiwe la wia, n daŋ tɔɔri ia kaali gunla miŋ faa tɔɔri ia la. N ŋmɛnɛ maa ge wàá ka tɔɔri ia guŋ.

ref: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
text: Awia, mɛɛwaa ni maawaa daŋ hee ba biizi, biizi ge gba hee ba mɛɛwaa ni ba maawaa. N daŋ gil ii banla n wàá siuzi a tɔɔrɔɔ dii biini la, yaari hɛri naa kɛraa maa.

ref: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la hɛɛhzɔɔrɛ ŋɔ lugɔ n daŋ kpuuzi ia, màá suŋ ii ni tama maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii kpa vuga ni wikuna la miŋ kiiwe ɛɛirɛ chɔg n Dia.

ref: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
text: Lɔzi ni wiilchɔgaa daŋ kpu ii bɔkpaŋ a bolzeŋ biini. Ii dɔma ge kpu ii bɔkpaŋ ge maa a bolzeŋ kɛraa. Ka ń kpa tokobi di keezi duŋŋi ii bɔkpaŋ la n kawɛɛ yaari.

ref: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience.
text: Di guŋ wa ɛɛwɔ, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuihchɔgii la daŋ jaa sɔɔni. Di n baaŋ wa sɔɔnɔɔ, ii Izrɛl hina maa daŋ zum lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ wia tɛɛ ia ni baaŋfuuih werge, dikuu ii wibii nyaai wia.

ref: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
text: Ii daŋ birgi sɔkpassi kuna hɛssi hina la maa n bar ia la be, bá ra ɛɛ ia chɛɛtɛ, ii wia dɔɔ ɔnsii werge, di n baaŋ wa fuuhwo, n tɛr ii digna la. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows.
text: N daŋ gil lɔchɔgii chol ii ni, anuula zuu ia, lɔzi ra kpu ia alugɔ hobee n na chugzi ia, á kpu.

ref: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
text: Awia, n daŋ gil lɔzi ni pir sela ra tɔɔri ia, haali di lauri ii biizi ra kpu, di gil wiilchɔgaa ni laal ba, di wa kpuuzi ii maa. Denii ń jaa gil ii dɔma kpu ia di tɔɔri ia werge maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord God said:
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ mìŋ́ Ɛzɛkiɛl be,

ref: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
text: “Newee biibaal, bir i siwee chaŋ bizenaa naa n du Izrɛl hɛri naa, ka ŋɔ a be wia la n niŋ wa huuzaa.

ref: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
text: Lizi mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la amaniye naa tɛɛ Izrɛl hɛri bizenaa, á nuu lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ra ŋɔ a bizenaa, giŋgimee, faalime ani walli benii lugɔ n daŋ kpa tokobi wa lɔ ia laal, di chɔgi ii vuga ni a kuaribɔr maa.

ref: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
text: N daŋ purgi ii mbusu lizibɔra ni ii daahɛgsɔɔhsuma fuuhribɔra maa, di kpu ii nɛra maa ii vuga sezi.

ref: Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars.
text: N daŋ kpa Izrɛl hina lalaa dauri ba vuga sezi, di kaa gil bá hoga ge yaari mbusu lizibɔra la maa.

ref: Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins.
text: Ba bolzenaa maa daŋ birgi diŋgelli. N daŋ chɔgi ba vuga, ba mbusu lizibɔra ani ba daahɛgsɔɔhsuma fuuhribɔra. Kuna la maa baŋ kuarɛɛ wia tuŋ.

ref: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
text: Di ba wa nawɔɔ lugɔ lalaa chɔɔgi ba duuribɔra maa la, denii bá jaa zum lugɔ Minuu Kɔraawiizi.

ref: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
text: Ama, n daŋ gil baŋhina waa na bahinaa, di gil ba yaari durnya naa maa biini.

ref: where they will be prisoners. And when they think of me, they will realize that they disgraced me by rebelling and by worshiping idols. They will hate themselves for the evil things they did,
text: Di ba waa kaa wa du ba himmaa hɛri, ka du hɛrdumazi la, ba danna liizi n wia. Ba daŋ kaa zum lugɔ n bɔra waa sɔɔnɛɛ dikuu baŋ vɛɛŋ ka ra kuari vuga, di nɔŋŋaa kaaliŋ wia. Di guŋ wa ɛɛwɔ, ba daŋ bir hah bahinaa, dikuu ba wichɔgaa ni ba wiɛɛlaa la miŋ kiiwe wia.

ref: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
text: Ba daŋ zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi. Miŋ ŋɔ n daŋ tɔɔri baa la, a waa kara ɛɛwɛ.”

ref: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ mìŋ́ Ɛzɛkiɛl be, “Lɔ i nonee di ra ginzi naazi ni biinichɔg, ka ra koobi, di ra ŋɔ, ‘Gooŋga! Gooŋga!’ Dikuu biinikpola ni wichɔgaa la Izrɛl hina n ɛɛwɛ la wia, ba daŋ siu laal biini, lɔzi ge ni wiila kpuuzi baa.

ref: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
text: Haali banla gba n niŋ chɔ ga du bɔɔnɛɛzi gba, ka wiilchɔgii daŋ kpuuzi baa de. Ama, laallɛ niŋ tuŋ banla ge n duglɛɛ la. Banla ge n niŋ lii a laal biini, lɔchumaa niŋ kpuuzi ba ge. Di guŋ wa ɛɛwɔ, ba daŋ zum lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi baaŋ fuuh ba ninɛɛ.

ref: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
text: Di ba wa na lalaa n chɔɔwɛ bar ba vuga kɛraa ni ba mbusu lizibɔra, di yaari giŋgimee, bizenaa nyuuni, daazenaa zɛɛzi ani bɔra la maa baŋ ɔɔ ra fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma ra tɛɛ ba vuga la, denii ba jaa zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi.

ref: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
text: N daŋ kpuuzi baa, ka chɔgi ba hɛri maa, ú birgi diŋgela, di lii hɛribɔduma la n du wiifurii nodig wiikakag di ra la Dibla la n du wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag la gɛɛ bɔr la maa baŋ duwɛɛ. Denii bá zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi.”

ref: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
text: “Newee biibaal, Izrɛl hɛri tunaa helloo! A hɛri siraa anaazu la maa tunaa helloo.

ref: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
text: Màá gilii, màá suŋ i ni ge, ka n daŋ tɛr i digni dikuu i wikuna la miŋ kiiwe wia. Denii í zum lugɔ Minuu Kɔraawiizi.”

ref: There's never been anything like the coming disaster.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Hɛhchɔgni n hiŋzi dɔŋa ra ba i ninɛɛ!

ref: And when it comes, your life will be over.
text: Too, wiimaa jaa tunuu. A tunaa guŋ. I wia tunnɔɔ!

ref: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
text: A ka tama ka n baaŋ jaa fuuh ii ni werge maa, denii ń di ia seriya di tɛr ii digna dikuu ii wikuna la miŋ kiiwe la wia.

ref: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
text: Màá suŋ ii ni, di gil ia. N daŋ kaa bir turgi ia ii wichɔgaa la maa kim. Denii ii maa jaa zum lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ra tɔɔri ia.

ref: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
text: Ii kaluzi ni ii laal wia la daŋ bir chug wichɔgɛɛra la, di ɛɛ biinichɔg tɛɛ baa. Nɛr maa wàá dɔɔ miibɔɔ lii a tɔɔrɔɔ naa biini. Ba daama maa ni ba girme wàá ka du de.

ref: The time is coming when everyone will be ruined. Buying and selling will stop,
text: A saŋa helloo, a hɔpizii ge ba. Awia, kunyaura gilɛɛ ra mam, kunyoora ge gilɛɛ ra wii. Dikuubɛɛwiai, biinichɔg daŋ wa huuzi ba maa.

ref: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
text: Kunyoori maa wàá ka wer lɛɛ kunla uŋ teŋ yoowe, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi baaŋ du nɛr maa ninɛɛ. Wichɔgɛɛri maa wàá dɔɔ miibɔɔ.

ref: A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel. Israel Is Surrounded The Lord said to the people of Israel:
text: Bensunozi wiiwoo ra karfi Izrɛl laallɔɔra, ií ɛɛ sirya. Ka bɛl maa waa izee ú la laal bɔr, dikuubɛɛwiai, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuihchɔgii du ba maa ninɛɛ.

ref: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
text: Ba ra lɔ dɔŋaa a bolzeŋ baŋgia, wiilchɔgaa ni lɔchɔgii ge du a bolzeŋ biinii. Unla maa n du koo ge daŋ siu a laal biini. Unla maa ge n niŋ du a bolzeŋ biini, wiilchɔgii ni lɔchɔgiirɛ niŋ kpuu.

ref: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
text: Banla n niŋ ka, di chɔ tinni bizenaa nyuuni la ge, daŋ di a tɔɔrɔɔ de, di ra nuumi werge maa lugɔ kommazi n du walli di ra wii, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.

ref: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
text: Nɛr maa nonee daŋ huah, bá naazi ra sa.
