text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu ŋɔ guŋ. Pilli i saliŋ koorikahuro di pur i namu la. Gunla aŋ faa duwɛɛ i be la, guŋ lɛi a kaa du filaŋkeŋ. Banla n sɔɔni siwii labuu ń tɔgzi. Ka banla ge n na tɔgzi bahinaa labuu ń tuu zɛɛ.

ref: I will leave Jerusalem in complete ruins like no one has ever seen until my chosen one comes to punish this city. Judgment against Ammon
text: Chɔgaa! Chɔgaa bɛŋ! Wibii maa, n daŋ chɔgi a bolzeŋ, ba wàá ka wer mau di ra ba saŋa la unla n dɛg u dɔɔi la n niŋ wa ba. Di u wa ballɔ, n daŋ jaa kpau tɛu.’

ref: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, the Ammonites have insulted Israel, so condemn them and tell them I am saying: A sword is drawn, ready to slaughter; it is polished and prepared to kill as fast as lightning.
text: Newee biibaal, ŋɔ wia la maa mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la n ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ Ammɔn hina la n na chagzi Izrɛl hina la. Ŋɔ ba be, ‘Ba pam tokobii ba kpu baa. Ba billuubuu ba kpu baa, u ra nyɛgzuu alugɔ dooŋ n ɔɔ ra nyɛgzi gunla.

ref: Others of you accept money to murder someone. Your own people charge high interest when making a loan to other Israelites, and they get rich by cheating. Worst of all, you have forgotten me, the Lord God.
text: Ba ɔɔ kaa kpa kebeere tɛɛ nɛra baŋhina ba ra kpuuzi nɛra, baŋhina kpa kebee ra kim nɛra, di ra sag baa nii werge, baŋhina ge ra fini ba dɔŋahina. Ii suuh n wiarɛ. Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I will shake my fist in anger at your violent crimes.
text: A guŋ wia, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɛr ia nonii dikuu ii fintime kuna dɔɔi ni ii nɛkpui la wia.

ref: When I'm finished with you, your courage will disappear, and you will be so weak that you won't be able to lift your hands. I, the Lord, have spoken and will not change my mind.
text: Ii daŋ wer dɔɔ fɔŋŋa ni bɔkpega ń tɔɔrɔɔ balaa hɔpizii laa? Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ ɛɛ gunla maa miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ naa.

ref: I will scatter you throughout every nation on earth and put a stop to your sinful ways.
text: N daŋ gil ii Jɛrusalɛm hina yaari hɛrdumazi maa nɛra biine, di gil ii biinikpola wia la tuŋ.

text: Di ii wa nyaa girme a hɛssi hina be, ii daŋ zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi.’ ”

ref: The Lord said:
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be,

ref: Ezekiel, son of man, I consider the people of Israel as worthless as the leftover metal in a furnace after silver has been purified.
text: “Newee biibaal, Izrɛl hina waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ, ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ lugbiaahmu gɛɛ danyɛ gɛɛ kpana n ɛɛ saliŋhuŋŋa bina n ka zugzi.

ref: I will be like a metalworker who collects that metal from the furnace and melts it down. I will collect the Israelites and blow on them with my fiery anger. They will melt inside the city of Jerusalem
text: N daŋ chaali ii maa Jɛrusalɛm biini, di gil n baaŋfuuih la gil ii maa ŋmɛɛri alugɔ niŋ n ɔɔ ŋmɛɛri lugbia la.

ref: like silver in a furnace. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have punished them in my anger. Everyone in Jerusalem Is Guilty
text: Di gil ii maa ŋmɛɛri gunla saliŋhuŋŋu n ɔɔ ŋmɛɛri ninzeŋ biini la. Denii ii zum lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la baannɛ fuuh ii ni.’ ”

ref: The Lord said:
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ n be,

ref: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that their country is full of sin, and that I, the Lord, am furious!
text: “Newee biibaal, lizi amaniye naa tɛɛ Izrɛl hina lugɔ ba hɛri wàá kaa dɔɔ dooŋ, á tɔɔrɔɔ hɔpizii, dikuu n baaŋ n niŋ fuuh ba ni werge maa wia.

ref: Their leaders are like roaring lions, tearing apart their victims. They put people to death, then steal everything of value. Husbands are killed, and many women are left as widows.
text: Ba sitɔɔra ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyiŋ n ɔɔ lau sel di ra pogzi la. Ba kpuuzi nɛraa, di ra paagi nɛra daama kuna ni ba kumpazi, guŋ gil hahkpila maa birgi luhaana a hɛri.

Not only do they refuse to respect any of my sacred things, but they don't even teach the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary or between what is clean and what is unclean. They treat my Sabbath like any other day, and so my own people no longer honor me.
text: N kizeehina la chɔgi n Gbɔgnii, di ra gbɛlli n kunnanaananaa la! Ba waa zum kunnanaananaa ni anla n waa nanaananaa ɛɛwɛ. Awia, ba waa n nɛra baglɛɛ kuna la n doŋŋe ni anla n waa doŋŋe n be. Ba waa Heezaa Hɔpizii la ra tɔgzi, dikuu guŋ wia, Izrɛl hina ra gbɛlli n sɔŋ werge maa.

ref: Israel's officials are like ferocious wolves, ripping their victims apart. They make a dishonest living by injuring and killing people.
text: Izrɛl nabɔnzi la ɛɛwɔɔ alugɔ hohobiazi n na chuuri sela. Ba ra chuuri nɛraa dikuu ba himmaa tɔnazi wia.

ref: And then the prophets in Israel cover up these sins by giving false visions. I have never spoken to them, but they lie and say they have a message from me.
text: Haali ba dɔgtɛɛzi ɔɔ kpa kara deeza ni vugaarɛ di ra tɔ ba nabɔnzi wichɔgaa. Ba ɔɔ ra ɛɛ gunnɛ ka ra ŋɔ, ‘Yaa amaniye naa lii Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la benii,’ haali miŋ waa ɔɔ ŋɔ wiimaa tɛɛ baa gba.

ref: The people themselves cheat and rob; they abuse the poor and take advantage of foreigners.
text: A hɛri hina gba ra foozi nɛraa di ra ŋmɛɛ baa, di ra fir nyaara, di ra sunni hɔɔhra ka ra vɛɛ ba wibii dii.

ref: I looked for someone to defend the city and to protect it from my anger, as well as to stop me from destroying it. But I found no one.
text: Denii n faa ra nyiŋŋi nɛbɛl ú kaa kuari ma koŋlii la, di chi a koŋlii bɔra la n choglee la, di guu a hɛri di n baaŋ wa fuuhwo, ń kuu u wia màá ka chɔgi a hɛri, ka maa nɛr maa nawɛɛ.

ref: So in my fierce anger, I will punish the Israelites for what they have done, and they will know that I am furious. I, the Lord, have spoken.
text: Awia, n baaŋ daŋ fuuh ba ni werge maa, ń kpu baa lugɔ niŋ n ɔɔ fuuh kuna gunla. N daŋ tɔɔri baa dikuu ba wichɔgaa la maa wia. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord said:
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ mìŋ́ Ɛzɛkiɛl be,

ref: Ezekiel, son of man, listen to this story about two sisters.
text: “Newee biibaal, biihaana banɛɛ baŋhinaa faa du de, di ɛɛ hahkpaŋ biizi.

ref: The older one was named Oholah, which stands for Samaria; the younger one was Oholibah, which stands for Jerusalem. They became my wives and gave birth to my children.
text: A biihambinabɔma hiŋ sɔnnɛ faa Ɔhɔla, u niwee la ge sɔŋ ɛɛ Ɔhɔliba. Denii n faa kpa baa ɛɛ n haana, ba faa lul biibaala ni biihaana tɛŋ. Ɔhɔla labuu faa chigɛ tɛɛ Samaria, Ɔhɔliba la ge chi tɛɛ Jɛrusalɛm.

ref: Even though Oholah was my wife, she continued to be a prostitute and chased after Assyrian lovers.
text: Denii Ɔhɔla la faa ra sɛm badumazi, haali uŋ ɛɛ n haaŋ gba. Di faa ra nyiŋŋi u sɛnna n lii Asiiria.

ref: She offered herself to soldiers in purple uniforms: handsome, high-ranking officers and cavalry troops.
text: Ba maa faa ɛɛ bunɔɔnaa di kaa ɛɛ laallɔɔra ni a hɛri nabɔnzi, di ɔɔ laali kunnanaa, a biri lugɔ burgu, di ra tinni ba zagra.

ref: She had sex with all the important Assyrian officials and even worshiped their disgusting idols.
text: Ɔhɔla faa ɛɛ sɛnsɛnnii Asiiria nabɔnzi la be, di faa sɛɛ ra kuari ba vuga di ra ɛɛ sɛnsɛŋ wia di ra doŋ u hiŋ werge maa.

ref: Once she started doing these things in Egypt, she never stopped. Men slept with her, and she was always ready for sex.
text: U haa ra ɛɛ a sɛnsɛŋ wia la uŋ faarɛɛ Ijip hɛri labuu. U haa nɔŋŋi a sɛnsɛŋ wiarɛ werge maa gunla saŋa la uŋ faa ɛɛ toloori Ijip hina muu, di chɔguu la.

ref: So I gave Oholah to the Assyrian lovers she wanted so badly.
text: Awia, n faa vɛɛu tɛɛ u Asiiria sɛnna la unna nyiŋŋi werge la.

ref: They ripped off her clothes, then captured her children and killed her. Women everywhere talked about what had happened to Oholah.
text: Denii ba dilguu ka kpa tokobi kpuu, ka lauri u biizi la maa yoma. Awia, haaŋ la maa n du a hɛri faa zum u sɔnnɛ nɛnnɛ alugɔ wichɔgɛɛrii, awiarɛ tɔɔrɔɔ wa huuzuu la.

ref: Oholibah saw all this, but she was more sinful and wanted sex more than her sister Oholah ever did.
text: Haali Ɔhɔliba n faa na gunla u kpɛɛma Ɔhɔla n duwɛɛ la gba, ka u ge haa vɛɛ ra hiŋ u naazi. Waabuu sɛnsɛnnɛ faa jaa nyaŋŋi.

ref: But Oholibah behaved worse than her sister. Oholibah saw images of Babylonian men carved into walls and painted red.
text: U sɛnsɛŋ la faa ra nyaŋŋuu. U faa ra nyiŋŋi Babilɔn hina laallɔɔra footozi baŋ sɛɛhzɛɛ du koŋlaa ni di, kpa kuŋaahma hamaa.

ref: They had belts around their waists and large turbans on their heads, and they reminded her of Babylonian cavalry officers.
text: Ba faa kirsi belentinanaarɛ, ka kpa namuzi bɔɔri ba nyuuni. Ba maa faa li Babilɔn hina nabɔnzenaa la n ɔɔ faa zuu torkozi zagra n na tɛrguu.

ref: As soon as she looked at them, she wanted to have sex with them. And so, she sent messengers to bring them to her.
text: Uŋ wa na ba footozi la, u ra nyiŋŋi ba wia, di hum nɛra ba ga yir baa.

ref: Men from Babylonia came and had sex with her so many times that she got disgusted with them.
text: Denii a Babilɔn hina ba wa lawuu ra nyiŋŋi, di chɔguu. Ka ba wia bir wa bazuu, u kaa vɛɛ baa.

ref: She let everyone see her naked body and didn't care if they knew she was a prostitute. That's why I turned my back on her, just as I had done with her older sister.
text: Nɛr maa n faa zum Ɔhɔliba sɛnsɛŋ wia la, n faa vɛɛu gunla miŋ vɛɛ u kpɛɛma Ɔhɔla la.

ref: Oholibah didn't stop there, but became even more immoral and acted as she had back in Egypt.
text: U sɛnsɛŋ la faa nyaŋŋɔɔrɛ alugɔ saŋa la uŋ faa ɛɛ toloori, di ra sɛm Ijip hɛri la.

ref: She eagerly wanted to go to bed with Egyptian men, who were famous for their sexual powers.
text: U faa ra sɛm sɛnsɛnchɔgaa hina la hɛna n kannɛzi alugɔ kauzi gɛɛ zagra hɛnaa.
