text: I ɛɛ wia la hiŋ faa ŋɔwɛɛ du yaa ni yaa koora ni labuu, di gil hɛhchɔg chol yaa ni. Wia la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ Jɛrusalɛm naa, ŋmɛnɛ maa haa waa durnya naa yemmaa ɛɛwɛ.

ref: We have not escaped any of the terrible curses written by Moses, and yet we have refused to beg you for mercy and to remind ourselves of how faithful you have always been.
text: Hɛhchɔg la baŋ faa sɛbi u wia du Moosis Gbɔgni Hɔŋ biini la, chol yaa ninɛɛ. Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, ka yaa haa waa sɛɛwɛ ya ɛɛ i kipar, di lii yaa wichɔgaa biini, ka sɛɛ i wibii la.

ref: And when you finally punished us with this horrible disaster, that was also the right thing to do, because we deserved it so much.
text: I faa ɛɛ siryaa i tɛr yaa digna, di ge ɛɛ guŋ ɛnɛ maa, dikuu hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum wia n deŋlee i wiɛɛlaa maa biini, ka yaa waa nuuwɛ tɛi wia.

ref: Our Lord God, with your own mighty arm you rescued us from Egypt and made yourself famous to this very day, but we have sinned terribly.
text: Awia, filaŋkeŋ, Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, hinuu kpa i fɔŋŋazeŋ lizi i nɛra lii Ijip hɛri, di nyiŋŋi sɔŋ la n du de saŋa maa, di wa lii ni zinaa tɛɛ i hiŋ. Yaa ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ, yaa ɛɛ wiarɛ leu.

ref: In the past, you treated us with such kindness, that we now beg you to stop being so terribly angry with Jerusalem. After all, it is your chosen city built on your holy mountain, even though it has suffered public disgrace because of our sins and those of our ancestors.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, dikuu i wideŋlaa ɛɛi wia, jaande maa, gil i baaŋ lii i bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm, n ɛɛ i giŋgimiinaniinanii la ni. Yaa ni yaa mɛɛwaa wichɔgaa gillɔɔ Jɛrusalɛm ni i nɛra birgi chɛɛtɛ kuna, nɛra la n bar yaa la be.

ref: I am your servant, Lord God, and I beg you to answer my prayers and bring honor to yourself by having pity on your temple that lies in ruins.
text: Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, a nuu n wiisuŋŋaa ni n suŋŋaazi. Kɔraawiizi, kuu i hiŋ wia di kuari ma i Dia la baŋ chɔkkɛ la. Bir kuaruu ma, nɛr maa zum lugɔ hinuu Kɔraawiizi.

ref: Forgive us! Hurry and do something, not only for your city and your chosen people, but to bring honor to yourself. The Seventy Weeks Daniel wrote:
text: N Dɔɔri, a nuu n be! Gil tɛɛ yaa! A nuu di ɛɛa ge! Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, dikuu i himmaa wia, gilɛɛ waa birgi, dikuu i Sɔŋ n sag i bolzeŋ ni i nɛra ni wia.” Gebrɛl n bagli a winaalii zɛɛ wia

ref: I was still confessing my sins and those of all Israel to the Lord my God, and I was praying for the good of his holy mountain,
text: Miŋ faa ra jaami di ra suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi, di ra sɛɛ n ni n nɛra maa wichɔgaa chɔgri, di suŋŋi ra tɛɛ u Dia la n chigɛ giŋgimiinaniinanii nyuu la,

ref: when Gabriel suddenly came flying in at the time of the evening sacrifice. This was the same Gabriel I had seen in my vision,
text: a saŋaa mɛlika Gebrɛl la miŋ faa nawɛɛ n lugli winaalii la biini zaah manaŋ, di tuu ba n be. Duaniŋ mbusu lizaa saŋaa faa.

ref: and he explained: Daniel, I am here to help you understand the vision.
text: U bagliŋ wia, di ŋɔ, “Daniɛl, n ballɔɔ ń wa hiinii, í zum wia la n niŋ ŋmɛnɛ wa ɛɛ la zɛɛ.

ref: God thinks highly of you, and at the very moment you started praying, I was sent to give you the answer.
text: Hiŋ haŋ wa faari wiisuŋŋaa la, di Kɔraawiizi teŋ nuuwɔ. Aabuu n ba ń wa ŋɔ tɛi, dikuubɛɛwiai, i wia paruubuu werge maa. Awia, keŋŋi digna di ra nuu n be nɛnnɛ, ń bagli i winaalii hiŋ zɛɛ tɛi.

ref: For one week this foreigner will make a firm agreement with many people, and halfway through this week, he will end all sacrifices and offerings. Then the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction will be put there. And it will stay there until the time God has decided to destroy this one who destroys.
text: A koorikpeg ni nɛkpila maa daŋ dɔɔ nuukpaŋ binni aniidaanɛɛ. Di a guŋ saŋa keza wa bɛrɔɔ, u daŋ duŋŋi mbusuzi ni a lizaa, ka chiŋŋi kunchɔgiichɔgii la n na ba chɔgaa ni tɔɔrɔɔ werge ni la Kɔraawiizi Dia biini, bɔr la n la chinchiŋ werge la. U daŋ chi de guŋŋ di ra ba saŋa la wia la Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛ sirya dau unla n ɛɛ guŋ, n niŋ wa huuzuu la.”

ref: In the third year of Cyrus the king of Persia, a message came to Daniel from God, and it was explained in a vision. The message was about a dreadful war, and it was true.
text: Pɛsia Koorizeŋ Sairus kora dii binni ahorohiŋ biinii, Kɔraawiizi faa pilli wia naa bagli Daniɛl, baŋ faa kaa ra yir Bɛltisaaza la. Amaniye hiŋ faa ɛɛ wibiire, di ra bagli laalzeŋ wia. U faa na a amaniye zɛɛ zumaarɛ a winaalii biini.

ref: Daniel wrote: For three weeks I was in sorrow.
text: A guŋ saŋa, mìŋ́ Daniɛl biini faa chɔg guŋŋ yauzi ahoro.

ref: I ate no fancy food or meat, I drank no wine, and I put no olive oil on my face or hair.
text: N faa waa diunanaa diwee, ol gɛɛ siŋ faa waa n nua zuuwɛ. Nuufɔglii maa faa waa n bɔrahɔŋ gbɔgzɛɛ guŋŋ a yauzi ahoro wa tuŋ.

ref: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the banks of the great Tigris River,
text: A lugli baagu hɔpizaa tokko ni anaazuhiŋ hɔl, di n faa chigɔ Muu Tigris la n kannɛ werge la nua.

ref: when I looked up and saw someone dressed in linen and wearing a solid gold belt.
text: Denii n ŋɔ n binni di na baal bɛl n laali gessihuŋŋunanaa pɛɛŋ laala, u belenti ɛɛ salinnanii himmaa.

ref: His body was like a precious stone, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming fires, his arms and legs like polished bronze, and his voice like the roar of a crowd.
text: U bɔra faa ɛɛ lugɔ binanii bɛl n na nyɛgzi lugɔ digii. U siwee faa chaani alugɔ dooŋ nyɛgzaa, u sibee faa ɛɛ lugɔ kacheela, u vaama ni u naazi faa vɔgli lugɔ baŋ vɔgli danyɛ u ra nyɛgzi. U loobii ge gbɔgza faa ɛɛ lugɔ nɛkpila werge hora.

ref: Although the people who were with me did not see the vision, they became so frightened that they scattered and hid.
text: Mìŋ́ Daniɛl bɛnnɛ faa na wii naa lugɔ deeza biini. Banla n faa du n be la waa wɔɔ nawɛɛ, ka ɔnsii faa lau baabuu werge, ba chɔ ga suahzi.

ref: and at the sound of his voice, I fell facedown in a deep sleep.
text: Denii n nuu a baal n na ŋɔ wia. Minna nuu u be la, dɔɔ lawiŋ werge, n chɔɔ pi di ra chɔɔ dɔɔ.

ref: He raised me to my hands and knees
text: Nonii bɛl gbɔgziŋ di lalliŋ giŋŋi, n nonee jaa jag hɛri, n bɔra maa ra sa.

ref: and then said, “Daniel, your God thinks highly of you, and he has sent me. So stand up and pay close attention.” I stood trembling, while the angel said:
text: U ŋɔ n be, “Daniɛl, Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋiibuu werge. Izi chi nuu wii la min niŋ ŋɔ i be nɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba humimbuu i be.” Uŋ wa ŋɔ keŋ n be, n izi chi ka n bɔra haa ra sa guŋ yogyogyog.

ref: Daniel, don't be afraid! God has listened to your prayers since the first day you humbly asked for understanding, and he has sent me here.
text: Denii u haa ra ŋɔ, “Daniɛl, gilɛɛ ra ɔm. Kɔraawiizi nuu i wiisuŋŋaarɛ di haŋ lii hɔpizii la hiŋ sɔɔni siwii, di ra nyiŋŋi ŋɔ i dɔɔ wia zɛɛ zumaa la. N ballɔɔ dikuu Kɔraawiizi n nuu i wiisuŋŋaa hiŋ wia.

ref: I will tell you what is written in The Book of Truth. But first, you must realize that no one except Michael, the guardian angel of Israel, is on my side.
text: ka n daŋ feli kalii wii la baŋ sɛbɛɛ du Wibii Hɔŋ la biini. Nɛr maa wanna hiini, ń wer naa baa, di mɛlikazeŋ Maikil la n ɛɛ Izrɛl guuri la bɛŋ lɛi.”

ref: Now I have come here to give you another vision about what will happen to your people in the future.
text: Awia, n ballɔɔ ń wa baglii wii la n niŋ wa huuzi i nɛra ŋmɛnɛ bɛl. Winaalii naa ra bagli wia la n niŋ haa wa ɛɛu.”

ref: While this angel was speaking to me, I stared at the ground, speechless.
text: Unna ŋɔ wia naa di ra tɛŋ la, n willi n nyuu, n nua kpu.

ref: Then he appeared in human form and touched my lips. I said, “Sir, this vision has brought me great pain and has drained my strength.
text: Denii unla n li newee la gbɔgzi n nuuhɔna, n pilli n nua, di faari ra ŋɔ wia. Denii n ŋɔ unla n chigɛ n be la be, “N dɔɔri, a winaalii gillɔɔ n bɔra yɔɔri werge, màá ka wer ɛɛ wiimaa.

ref: I am merely your servant. How can I possibly speak with someone so powerful, when I am almost too weak to get my breath?”
text: N dɔɔri, ɛrɛɛ mìŋ́ i balii nii wer ŋɔ wiai? N bɔra yɔɔrɔɔrɛ, n heeza ra sig.”

ref: The angel touched me a second time and said, “Don't be frightened! God thinks highly of you, and he intends this for your good, so be brave and strong.” At this, I regained my strength and replied, “Please speak! You have already made me feel much better.”
text: U jaa ŋɔ n be, “Gilɛɛ ra ɔm, Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋiibuu. Bámpirsɔna du i be! Dɔɔ fɔŋŋa filaŋkeŋ!” Uŋ wa ŋɔ guŋ tɛŋ, fɔŋŋa ba n be, n ŋɔ, “N dɔɔri, a ŋɔ, hiŋ jaa tɛŋ fɔŋŋai.”

ref: Then the angel said: Now do you understand why I have come? Soon I must leave to fight against the guardian angel of Persia. Then after I have defeated him, the guardian angel of Greece will attack me.
text: Denii u ŋɔ, “I zum wii la wia miŋ ba i bee? A wàá birgi, ka ń bir la ga naa mɛlika la n guu Pɛsia hɛri la. Di n ga kpegluu, mɛlika la n na guu Giris hɛri la ge daŋ ba,

ref: You also need to know that I protected and helped Darius the Mede in his first year as king. The Angel's Message to Daniel Part One: The Four Kings and Their Successors
text: Mɛdi hinuu Dariɔs kora dii lugli bina hiŋ biinii, n faa lii chi u har, di guuu. Ijip ni Siiria kossi wia

ref: What I am going to tell you is certain to happen. Four kings will rule Persia, one after the other, but the fourth one will become much richer than the others. In fact, his wealth will make him so powerful that he will turn everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
text: Denii mɛlika la ŋɔ n be, “Filaŋkeŋ, wibiire n ŋɔ ra tɛi. Koora bahoro daŋ haa lii Pɛsia hɛri, ka naazuhiŋ ge wa lii, di ɛɛ dɔɔŋ kaali ba maa. Di u daama wa gillɔ u dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, u daŋ chugzi nɛkpila maa du Giris kora ni.

ref: Then a mighty king will come to power and will be able to do whatever he pleases.
text: Denii koori la n niŋ dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge wa lii, di ra di kora fɔŋŋa ni werge, di ɛɛ gunla maa n paruu.

ref: But suddenly his kingdom will be crushed and scattered to the four corners of the earth, where four more kingdoms will rise. But these won't be ruled by his descendants or be as powerful as his kingdom.
text: Di u wa liwɔɔ tuŋ, u kora daŋ bargi bɔra anaazu. U naanna wàá ka nau di gɛɛ di kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa la uŋ faa dɔɔwɛ la, dikuu ban niŋ kpa u kora hiŋ bɔnni nɛdumazi wia.

ref: The king of the south will grow powerful. Then one of his generals will rebel and will rule an even larger kingdom.
text: Ijip koori daŋ dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, ka u laallɔɔra nabɔma bɛl daŋ wa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge maa kaaluu, ú kora diiribɔr du kaŋ werge kaali u hor.

ref: Years later the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom will make a treaty, and the daughter of the king of the south will marry the king of the north. But she will lose her power. Then she, her husband, their child, and the servants who came with her will all be killed. After this,
text: Binni tama n niŋ wa bɛri, Ijip koori ni Siiria koori daŋ ɛɛ nuukpaŋ. Ijip koori kpa u biihaaŋ tɛɛ Siiria koori, ú ɛɛ u haaŋ, ka a nuukpaŋ wàá chi. A guŋ saŋa, ba daŋ kpu u ni u jaari, u bie ani u balaa la maa n duu la la.

ref: one of her relatives will become the ruler of the southern kingdom. He will attack the army of the northern kingdom and capture its fortresses.
text: Denii ú lulli bɛl birgi koori, di lɔ Siiria koori laallɔɔra, di zuu u diikpega lɔ baa, di kpegli baa.

ref: Then he will carry their idols to Egypt, together with their precious treasures of silver and gold, but it will be a long time before he attacks the northern kingdom again. Some years later
text: U daŋ paagi ba vuga, ba saliŋhuŋŋa ani saliŋ kuna la n dɔɔ tɔna, di chi a maa kaali Ijip hɛri, ka gil Siiria koori du ni bampirsɔna, biŋkpila.

ref: the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom, but he will be forced back to his own country.
text: Denii Siiria koori la vɔɔ laal, di wa fɔɔ Ijip koori, ka ú biruu har fɔŋŋa ni, ú bir kaali u himmaa hɛri.

ref: The sons of the king of the north will gather a huge army that will sweep down like a roaring flood, reaching all the way to the fortress of the southern kingdom.
text: U biibaala daŋ ɛɛ laal sirya, di chaali laallɔɔrakpila werge maa, di chaazi bɔr alugɔ nii n suwee di gi, di gbaari bɔr kaali la, di lɔ a laal guŋŋ di ga zuu ba dɔm diikpeg.

ref: But this will make the king of the south angry, and he will defeat this large army from the north.
text: Denii Ijip koori vɔɔ laal ni baaŋ, di lii ga chem Siiria koori la n niŋ chaali laallɔɔrakpila maa la ni, di kpegluu.

ref: The king of the south will feel proud because of the many thousands he has killed. But his victories won't last long,
text: Di ba wa kpegli a laallɔɔrakpila hiŋ, Ijip koori daŋ dɔɔ barabara, di kpu baa werge maa, ka wàá kpegli baa di hanna la.

ref: because the king of the north will gather a larger and more powerful army than ever before. Then in a few years, he will start invading other countries.
text: Denii Siiria koori kaa bir ga chaali laallɔɔra baŋhina, bá du kpil kaali lugli hora la, di kpa biŋkpila ɛɛ sirya nɛnnɛ, di ba wa lɔ baa.

ref: At this time many of your own people will try to make this vision come true by rebelling against the king of the south, but their rebellion will fail.
text: A guŋ saŋa, nɛkpila maa daŋ izi Ijip koori la ni. Daniɛl, kalu nyiŋŋe la n du i himmaa nɛra biini la daŋ izi bá naau, á ɛɛ lugɔ winaaliirɛ ba na, ka ba wàá weruu.

ref: Then the army from the north will surround and capture a fortress in the south, and not even the most experienced troops of the southern kingdom will be able to make them retreat.
text: Denii Siiria koori ba di wa ta pizenaa mari koŋliizeŋ la, bá wer tinnuu tuu di kpegli bolzeŋ la baŋ ma koŋlii bar la. Ijip laallɔɔra wàá dɔɔ fɔŋŋa bá kaa wer lɔ laal, haali ba laallɔɔra la n kpekke werge fɔŋŋa daŋ tuŋ.

ref: The king who invaded from the north will do as he pleases, and he will even capture and destroy the holy land.
text: Unla n wa fɔɔ a bolzeŋ ni laal la daŋ ɛɛ u kipar. Nɛr maa wàá wer biruu har. U daŋ so Izrɛl Hɛrnanii la biini, di dɔɔ u fɔŋŋa.

ref: In fact, he will decide to invade the south with his entire army. Then he will attempt to make peace by giving the king of the south a bride from the northern kingdom, but this won't be successful.
text: U danna nyiŋŋi lugɔ u kpa u kora fɔŋŋa maa ba de. Dikuu guŋ wia, u ni Ijip koori daŋ ɛɛ nuukpaŋ u kpa u biihaaŋ tɛu, ú wer ga de kpegluu wia. Ka a wàá hiinuu.

ref: Afterwards, this proud king of the north will invade and conquer many of the nations along the coast, but a military leader will defeat him and make him lose his pride.
text: Denii ú bir di ra lɔ banla n soge muuzeŋ nua la, di kpegli bakpila maa. Ka laallɔɔra nabɔma bɛl daŋ wa lii kpegluu, ú barabara la tuŋ, ú di hiihzi.

ref: He will retreat to his fortresses in his own country, but on the way he will be defeated and never again be seen.
text: A guŋ tuna, u daŋ bir di ra la u himmaa hɛri diikpega, ka bá kpegluu di kpuu, ú wia tuŋ.

ref: The next king of the north will try to collect taxes for the glory of his kingdom. However, he will come to a sudden end in some mysterious way, instead of in battle or because of someone's anger. Part Two: The Evil King from the North
text: Koori la n niŋ kpa u gawa, daŋ hum lampolɛɛri, ú fir nɛra di lɛɛ baa lampoo, guŋ gil u kora daama jaa. Ka a wàá birgi ka bá kpuu. Guŋ wàá ɛɛ nɛra baaŋ gɛɛ laal biini.

ref: The successor of this king of the north will be a worthless nobody, who doesn't even come from a royal family. He will suddenly appear and gain control of the kingdom by treachery.
text: Siiria koori la ge n niŋ kaa wa kpa u gawa, daŋ ɛɛ nɛchɔgii. Wàá dɛg lugɔ u di kora, ka u daŋ kpa dawari di foozi a kora.

ref: Then he will destroy armies and remove God's chosen high priest.
text: Denii ú kpu nɛr la maa n ninna diu mmɔri gɛɛ di ra karsuu, haali di kpu Kɔraawiizi kizeehina nabɔma gba.

ref: He will make a treaty, but he will be deceitful and break it, even though he has only a few followers.
text: U daŋ dar hɛssi aŋhina nɛra lugɔ u ni baa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ, guŋ gil u dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge maa, haali un ninna di deejiga kora gba.

ref: Without warning, he will successfully invade a wealthy province, which is something his ancestors never did. Then he will divide among his followers all of its treasures and property. But none of this will last very long.
text: De barii bɔra la daama n duwɛɛ hina wa fɛwɔɔ lugɔ wiimaa waa baa titte, u daŋ zuu de di lɔ baa, di kpegli baa, di ɛɛ wia la u mɛɛwaa gɛɛ u naabaala n haa waa ɛɛwɛ. Di paagi ba kundɔɔlaa bɔnni u hiŋra. U daŋ ta jina lugɔ u lɔ bola la maa baŋ ma koŋlaa bar laal, ka u saŋa wàá birgi.

ref: He will gather a large and powerful army, and with great courage he will attack the king of the south. The king of the south will meet him with a much stronger army, but he will lose the battle, because he will be betrayed
text: U daŋ chaali laallɔɔrakpila la n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge, ú ga lɔ Ijip koori laal. Ka Ijip koori daŋ lii ni u laallɔɔrakpila n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge, di chem u ni, ka u nyaŋŋuu, dikuu ban niŋ ɛɛu sɔsɔgɔ wia.

ref: by members of the royal court. He will be ruined, and most of his army will be slaughtered.
text: A koori nabɔnzi danna nyiŋŋi bá chɔgi u wia ú zuu tɔɔrɔɔ biini. Ba daŋ kpu u laallɔɔrakpila maa laal biini, ba wia tuŋ.

ref: The two kings will meet around a table and tell evil lies to each other. But their plans will fail, because God has already decided what will happen.
text: Denii a koora banɛɛ kpau so di di diwee, di kpa wichɔgaa ɛɛi dar dɔŋa. Ka ba wàá na ba kipar, dikuubɛɛwiai, a guŋ saŋa haa waa helle.

ref: Then the king of the north will return to his country with great treasures. But on the way, he will attack the religion of God's people and do whatever else he pleases.
text: Siiria koori la daŋ bir kaali u himmaa hɛri ni daama werge, di gaa fɛ Kɔraawiizi ni u nɛra nuukpannaniinanii la chɔgaa wia. U daŋ ɛɛ gunla maa n paruu, ka bir kaali u himmaa hɛri.

ref: At the time God has decided, the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom again, but this time, things will be different.
text: U daŋ kaa wa fɔɔ Ijip koori ni laal, ka a tuna daŋ kur lugli hor la ni.

ref: Ships from the west will come to attack him, and he will be discouraged. Then he will start back to his own country and take out his anger on the religion of God's faithful people, while showing kindness to those who are unfaithful.
text: Nɛra la n soge muuzeŋ wiicholii daŋ kpa muugberzenaa ba wa karsuu, ɔnsii werge lawuu, ú bir har ni baaŋfuuih werge di ga paani Kɔraawiizi ni u nɛra nuukpannaniinanii la ni. Denii ú bir ba, di wa suŋ banla n vɛɛ a nuukpaŋ la ni.

ref: He will send troops to pollute the temple and the fortress, and he will stop the daily sacrifices. Then he will set up that “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction.
text: U laallɔɔra daŋ izi ni ba dɔŋkuna di doŋ Kɔraawiizi Dia bɔkpeg, di duŋŋi hɔpizi biimaa mbusu lizaa la. Denii ba jaa chiŋŋi kunchɔgiichɔgii la n na ba chɔgaa ni tɔɔrɔɔ werge ni la.

ref: The king will use deceit to win followers from those who are unfaithful to God, but those who remain faithful will do everything possible to oppose him.
text: U daŋ kpa nuusum di dar banla n teŋ vɛɛ ba ni Kɔraawiizi nuukpaŋ la, ka banla waa n haa ra hiŋ Kɔraawiizi la, daŋ aah siwii di ra naau.

ref: Wise leaders will instruct many of the people. But for a while, some of these leaders will either be killed with swords or burned alive, or else robbed of their possessions and thrown into prison.
text: Ba sitɔɔra la n dɔɔ nunzuma la daŋ bagli nɛkpila. Ka bá kpu ba tama laal biini gɛɛ di fuuh baŋhina nyinee, di foozi baŋhina kuna, di lauri baŋhina ge yoma.

ref: They will receive only a little help in their time of trouble, and many of their followers will be treacherous.
text: Ban ninna kpu baa la, ka Kɔraawiizi nɛra waa daŋ na hiinaa tama, haali banla n waa biinihuŋŋa hina ɛɛwɛ gba, daŋ jaa ba ni.

ref: Some of those who are wise will suffer, so that God will make them pure and acceptable until the end, which will still come at the time he has decided.
text: Nunzunna la baŋhina daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ, guŋ gil ba ɛɛ nɛnanaananaa, di du kpeg nɛnnɛ guŋŋ di ra ba hɛri tunaa saŋa, dikuubɛɛwiai, guŋ daŋ ɛɛ, saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n dauwɛ la. Koori la n na tɔgzi u hiŋ wia

ref: This king will do as he pleases. He will proudly claim to be greater than any god and will insult the only true God. Indeed, he will be successful until God is no longer angry with his people.
text: Siiria koori la daŋ ɛɛ gunla n paruu. U danna tɔgzi u hiŋ kaali vuga maa, di ŋɔ wia la n waa dɛg nuui du Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ni. U daŋ ɛɛ u kipar guŋŋ di ra ba saŋa la, Kɔraawiizi n niŋ wa tɛr u digni. Kɔraawiizi daŋ haŋ ɛɛ gunla uŋ dauwɛnɛ.

ref: This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods
text: Koori naa daŋ vɛɛ u naabaala vuga, di kaa vɛɛ vug la haana n nɔŋŋɛɛ. U daŋ vɛɛ vuga maa, dikuu un niŋ fɛ lugɔ waabuu kaali a bɛl maa wia.

ref: and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts.
text: Ka u danna tɔgzi vug la n na guu bolzenaa la baŋ ma koŋlaa bar la, unla u naabaala n waa zummɛ. U daŋ kpa saliŋ, saliŋhuŋŋa, binanaa ani kuna la yoola n kpolle, di gaa tɔgzuu.

ref: With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land. Part Three: The Time of the End
text: U daŋ kpa hɛrduma nɛra n na kuari vuga, bá hiinuu lɔ bolzenaa la baŋ ma koŋlaa bar la laal. U danna tɔgzi banla n niŋ sɛɛu dɔɔra, di gil ba ra binni nɛkpila ni, di bɔnni hɛri tɛɛ baa, á ɛɛ ba kinturgaa.

ref: At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another,
text: A tuna saŋa, Ijip koori daŋ vɔɔ laal di wa chem Siiria koori ni, ú ge vɔɔ laal u fɔŋŋa maa ni, u laal torkozi, zagra, a tinna ani muugberzenaa kpilakpila. U daŋ chɔgi hɛrkpila alugɔ nii n suwee di gbaari bɔr la.

ref: and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.
text: U daŋ zuu Izrɛl Hɛrnanii la gba. Hɛrkpila maanii u kpegli, ka Ɛdɔm ni Moab hina ani Ammɔn sitɔɔra bɛnnɛ niŋ na lɛɛi lii u nonee biini.

ref: The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt,
text: U daŋ di fɔŋŋa hɛrkpila maa ni. Ijip hina gba wàá lii.

ref: and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia.
text: U daŋ paa Ijip hina saliŋ, daama la maa n suahwɛ, saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋa ani ba daamaa maa kaali, di kpegli Libia ni Nubia hina maa.

ref: But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction.
text: Ka amaniye la n niŋ lii wiifurii ni wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag la daŋ kpa ɔnsii werge ta u ni, ú kpa baaŋfuuih werge di ra naa, di kpu nɛkpila werge.

ref: After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.
text: Haali u daŋ baŋ u koori tantizi diizenaa muuzeŋ ni bizeŋ la Kɔraawiizi Dia n chigɛ u ni la baambaaŋ. Denii ú siu, ka nɛr maa wàá du de hiinuu.”

ref: Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace.
text: Nɛkpila werge maa n teŋ siuzɛɛ daŋ bir izi, baŋhina na miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ, baŋhina ge di hiihzi la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
text: Banla n dɔɔ nunzuma danna nyɛgzi alugɔ chiŋ chaanaa, banla ge n bagli nɛra ba ɛɛ wideŋlaa ge ra chaani alugɔ chinchiŋwilaa, di hanna la.

ref: Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it. The End of Time
text: Ka hìŋ́ Daniɛl, tɔ a hɔŋ, di kpa kuŋ maruu guŋŋ di ra ba hɛri tunaa saŋa. A saŋa, nɛkpila maa daŋ chɔgi ba saŋazi, di ra nyiŋŋi bá zum wii la n na ɛɛ zɛɛ.”

ref: Daniel wrote: I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side.
text: Denii mìŋ́ Daniɛl binni di na nɛra banɛɛ baŋhina n chigɛ n see, bɛl chi muu baŋgia bɛl, bɛl ge chi unla hiŋ.

ref: The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, “How long before these amazing things happen?”
text: Bɛl ŋɔ mɛlika la n laali pɛɛŋhuŋŋunanii laala di guali a muu ni la be, “Ɛrɛɛ a birgi mag, ka a keŋ nuukpuuri wia naa wa ɛɛi?”

ref: The angel then raised both hands toward heaven and said, “In the name of the God who lives forever, I solemnly promise that it will be a time, two times, and half a time. Everything will be over, when the suffering of God's holy people comes to an end.”
text: A mɛlika lalli u nonee chiŋ, di kpa Kɔraawiizi la n du de saŋa maa la sɔŋ hɛɛhzi, di ŋɔ, “A daŋ ɛɛ binni ahoro ni keza, di Kɔraawiizi nɛra kpui wa teŋŋo, a saŋaa annii maa jaa ɛɛ.”

ref: I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?” The angel in my vision then replied:
text: N nuu guŋ, ka maa a zɛɛ zummɛ. Awia, n faa pɛɛzi, “N dɔɔri, ɛrɛɛ annii maa tuna wa duɛi?”

ref: Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time.
text: U bir ŋɔ n be, “Daniɛl, a la, dikuubɛɛwiai, a wiŋɔzi naa ɛɛ wolo wiarɛ, di suah ra ba wia tuna saŋa.

ref: Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand.
text: Ba daŋ lizi nɛkpila maa doŋa ha, bá ɛɛ nɛnanaananaa ka biinikpola hina waa daŋ haŋ dɔɔ biinikpolaa di hanna la. Biinikpola hina bɛl maa wàá zum a zɛɛ, ka nunzunna waa zum a zɛɛ.

ref: So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
text: Ka hìŋ́ Daniɛl waa, dɔɔ yarda guŋŋ di ga hel a tuna. Denii í siu, ka bir izi di na i kinturgaa, wia tuna saŋa.”

ref: I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me. Hosea's Family
text: Wia la Kɔraawiizi n pillɛɛ tɛɛ Bɛɛri biibaal Hozia, saŋa la Uzzia, Jɔtam, Ahaz ani Hɛzɛkia n faa di kossi di hiŋzi dɔŋa Juda hɛri la ani Jehoas biibaal Jeroboam n faa ɛɛ Izrɛl koori labuu keŋ. Hozia haaŋ ni u biizi wia

ref: So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.
text: Awia, u faa kpa Diblam biihaaŋ Goma. U kpogli hia di lul biibaal tɛu.

ref: Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom,
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Hozia be, “Dau u sɔŋ Jɛzriil, dikuubɛɛwiai, a wàá birgi ka ń tɛr Jehu diahina digna, dikuu baŋ faa kpu nɛra werge Jɛzriil Waluu biini wia. N daŋ dim Jehu dee kora.

ref: and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.”
text: A hɔl hiŋ, n daŋ chɔgi Izrɛl hina fɔŋŋa Jɛzriil Waluu biini.”

ref: Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, “Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel.
text: Goma kaa kuari kpogli hia di lul biihaaŋ. Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Hozia be, “Dawuu Lo Ruhama, dikuubɛɛwiai, màá ka nɔŋŋi Izrɛl hina, di waa gil ba wichɔgaa di ra tɛɛ baa.

ref: But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
text: Ka n daŋ nɔŋŋi Juda diahina waa di lɛɛ baa, di maa hoo gɛɛ tokobi gɛɛ laal gɛɛ zagra ni a tinna kpawɛɛ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la fɔŋŋa biinii guŋ ɛɛ.”

ref: After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son.
text: Goma n waa teŋ Lo Ruhama il, u kaa kpogli hia di lul biibaal.

ref: Then the Lord said, “Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.” Hope for Israel
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Dawuu Lo Ami, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii waa n nɛra ɛɛwɛ, n ge waa Kɔraawiizi la iinna huma la ɛɛwɛ.

ref: Someday it will be impossible to count the people of Israel, because there will be as many of them as there are grains of sand along the seashore. They are now called “Not My People,” but in the future they will be called “Children of the Living God.”
text: Ka Izrɛl hina daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ muuzeŋ kɛrii hɛɛhriichaa la baŋ wàá wer mɛgzaa gɛɛ di kuraa. Ka filaŋkeŋ, Kɔraawiizi ra ŋɔ ba benii, ‘Ií waa n nɛra ɛɛwɛ’, ka u daŋ ŋmɛnɛ yir ia ‘Kɔraawiizi la n du de saŋa maa la biizi.’

ref: Israel and Judah will unite and choose one leader. Then they will take back their land, and this will be a great day for Jezreel.
text: Juda ni Izrɛl hina daŋ kaa bir dɔɔ nuukpaŋ di lizi nabɔŋkpaŋ, di wazi di nyɛɛli ba hɛri biini. Wibii maa, Jɛzriil hɔpizii la daŋ ɛɛ hɔpizizeŋ.”

ref: So let your brothers be called “My People” and your sisters be called “Shown Mercy.” The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wia Hozia be, “I daŋ yir i dɔŋa hina Izrɛl hina, ‘Kɔraawiizi nɛra’ ni ‘Kɔraawiizi nɛnɔŋŋaa.’ ” Izrɛl hina digna tɛraa ni ba kuaraa soŋŋi wia

ref: Accuse! Accuse your mother! She is no longer my wife, and now I, the Lord, am not her husband. Beg her to give up prostitution and stop being unfaithful,
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ Izrɛl hina be, “Ií hau ii maa ni, ií hau u ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, waa n haaŋ ɛɛwɛ, n ge waa u jaari ɛɛwɛ. Ií kaluu ú gil u siyazi ani u sɛnsɛŋ wia la.

ref: or I will strip her naked like the day she was born. I will make her barren like a desert, and she will die of thirst.
text: Di guŋ lɛi, n daŋ wiruu, di gil u du alugɔ a hɔl la baŋ luluu la. N daŋ gil u ɛɛ lugɔ hɛribɔduma, di gil u ɛɛ lugɔ hɛrhilii la n waa kummaa dɔɔwɛ, niinyɔgzi kpuu.

ref: You children are the result of her unfaithfulness, and I'll show you no pity.
text: Màá nɔŋŋi u biizi, dikuu baŋ ɛɛ sɛnsɛŋ biizi wia.

ref: Your mother was unfaithful. She was disgraceful and said, “I'll run after my lovers. Everything comes from them— my food and drink, my linen and wool, my olive oil and wine.”
text: Ba maa faa waa wibii dɔɔwɛ, di kpogli ba hizi ni hiihzi. U faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘N daŋ hiŋzi n sɛnna, banla n na tɛŋ n diwee, nii ani n peezi huna laala ni pɛɛŋhuŋŋunanaa ani nuu ni siŋ la.’

ref: I, the Lord, will build a fence of thorns to block her path.
text: Awia, n daŋ kpa sɔɔhri di goruu, wàá ka wer na ú ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: She will run after her lovers, but not catch them; she will search, but not find them. Then she will say, “I'll return to my first husband. Life was better then.”
text: U daŋ chɔ ra duŋŋi u sɛnna, ka wàá wer lau baa, di nyiŋŋi ba bɔra, ka wàá na baa. Denii ú ŋɔ, ‘N daŋ bir la n lugli jaari be, a guŋ saŋaa n faa bɔ kaali n filaŋkeŋ duula naa.’

ref: She didn't know that her grain, wine, and olive oil were gifts from me, as were the gold and silver she used in worshiping Baal.
text: U faa waa sɛɛwɛ lugɔ minuu tɛu mia, siŋfalii ani nuu la, di kpa saliŋhuŋŋa ni saliŋ la baŋ faa kpawɛɛ di ra kuari vug Baal la.

ref: So I'll hold back the harvest of grain and grapes. I'll take back my wool and my linen that cover her body.
text: Awia, di mia kumaa saŋa wa hello, n daŋ bir lɛɛ n mia, ni n siŋfalii, di ba wa daalaa. N daŋ bir lɛɛ n peezi huna laala ani n pɛɛŋhuŋŋunanaa la miŋ faa kpawɛɛ tɛu, a ɛɛ u laala la.

ref: Then I'll strip her naked in the sight of her lovers. No one can rescue her.
text: Awia, n daŋ wiruu ú sɛnna see filaŋkeŋ, nɛr maa wàá wer lɛɛu lii n nonee biini.

ref: I'll stop Israel's celebrations— no more New Moon Festivals, Sabbaths, or other feasts.
text: N daŋ tɔ u hindiizi maa, u bina maa hɔpizizenaa, u Baagufalaa, u Heezaa Hɔpizaa dii ani u diuzenaa dii saŋazi maa.

ref: She said, “My lovers gave me vineyards and fig trees as payment for sex.” Now I, the Lord, will ruin her vineyards and fig trees; they will become clumps of weeds eaten by wild animals.
text: N daŋ chɔgi u grepu ni fig daazi la n na nɔŋ, anla uŋ faa ŋɔ lugɔ u sɛnnaa kpaa turguu la. N daŋ gil grepu ni u fig daazi kooni maa birgi pir, pir sela dia nyaamm.

ref: I'll punish her for the days she worshiped Baal and burned incense to him. I'll punish her for the times she forgot about me and wore jewelry and rings to attract her lovers. I, the Lord, have spoken! The Lord Will Help Israel
text: N daŋ kuu hɔpizaa la uŋ kpawɛɛ fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma tɛɛ vug Baala la wia, di tɛr u digni. U kpa saliŋhuŋŋa, saliŋ yɔlɔzi, nonibisiga ani digni kunaa bɔg u hiŋ, di ra hiŋ u sɛnna ka suuh n wia, Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Israel, I, the Lord, will lure you into the desert and speak gently to you.
text: Awia, n daŋ daruu filaŋkeŋ, di kpogluu zuu hɛribɔduma biini di ga fɔrguu.

ref: I will return your vineyards, and then Trouble Valley will become Hopeful Valley. You will say “Yes” to me as you did in your youth, when leaving Egypt.
text: Denii ń bir kpa u grepu daazi kooni tɛu, di gil Akɔ Waluu birgi tamii bɔr. Denii ú yir yira alugɔ u toloo saŋa la, alugɔ hɔpizii la uŋ faa lii Ijip hɛri biini la.

ref: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, u daŋ yiriŋ ‘n jaari,’ ka wàá ka yiriŋ ‘n dɔɔri,’ gunla uŋ faa ra yir vug Baal la.

ref: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.”
text: N daŋ lizi vug Baala sɔna lii u nua, wàá kaa yir a sɔna maa.

ref: And I will agree to let you live in peace—you will no longer be attacked by wild animals and birds or by weapons of war.
text: N ni pir sela, zumbizi ani kuntuuzaa daŋ ɛɛ nuukpaŋ a hɔl hiŋ tɛɛ baa. Di lizi hozi, tokobizi ani laal lii u hɛri, guŋ gil u du ni bɔsɔna.

ref: I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness,
text: N daŋ kpau ɛɛ haaŋ di hanna la, di dɔɔ wibii ni yarda u be, di dɔɔ nɔŋŋaa ni nisunaa saŋa maa u be.

ref: and faithfulness. Then you will truly know who I am.
text: N daŋ kpau di dɔɔ wibii u be, ú zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi.

ref: I will command the sky to send rain on the earth,
text: A hɔl hiŋ, n daŋ nuu u jaamaa, di gil dooŋ ba,

ref: and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley.
text: mia, grepu ani ɔlivi nɔna lɛɛ u hɛri nɛnnɛ, Jɛzriil Waluu biini.

ref: I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
text: N daŋ soŋŋi n nɛra Izrɛl hina a hɛri tɛɛ n hiŋ, di nɔŋŋi banla miŋ faa ra yir, ‘N haahra,’ di ŋɔ banla miŋ faa ra yir, ‘N nɛra lɛi’ la, ‘Ií ɛɛ n nɛraa,’ bá ŋɔ, ‘I ɛɛ Kɔraawiizii la yaa n na humuu.’ ”

ref: Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ mìŋ́ Hozia be, “Bir la i haaŋ be di kaa ga nɔŋŋuu, haali nɛbɛl n na nyiŋŋuu di ra sɛmuu gba. Nɔŋŋuu gunla mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋi Izrɛl hina la, haali baŋ bittɛ gaa kuari vuga, di kpa grepu nɔŋhilaa baŋ ɛhzɛɛ di ra tɛɛa la gba.”

ref: Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
text: Denii n faa ŋɔ u be, “A dɛkkɔɔ ya du dɔŋa be birgi, a waa dɛkkɛ i kaa waa sɛm gɛɛ di waa nyiŋŋi baal maa.”

ref: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
text: Gunnɛ Izrɛl hina du de birgi, di ba waa koori gɛɛ sitɔɔri dɔɔwɛ, ba wàá ra lizi mbusuzi gɛɛ di dɔɔ bia la baŋ baŋzɛɛ tɛɛ ba vuga gɛɛ tagtakpurii ani vug.

ref: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
text: A guŋ har, Izrɛl hina daŋ bir di ra nyiŋŋi mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la ni ba Koori Deevid bɔr. Ba daŋ ba n be ni ɔnsii, ba bɔra ra sa, ba na kissaa n be.

ref: Israel, listen as the Lord accuses everyone in the land! No one is faithful or loyal or truly cares about God.
text: Hozia ŋɔ, “Izrɛl hina, ií ra nuu Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii banla n soge a hɛri la, nuu dɔɔ wiarɛ. U ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Ii waa wibii ni nɔŋŋaa dɔɔwɛ, ii waa zummɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n du de gba.

ref: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish. The Lord Warns the Priests
text: A guŋ wia, a hɛri ra hiluu, nɛra ni kuna la maa n du u ni la siuzi, sela, zumbizi ani muuzeŋ biini nyinni maa ra siuzi.’ ”

ref: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Nɛr maa gilɛɛ ra tɛɛ u dɔŋhiŋ bilchɔg gɛɛ di wàá pag u dɔŋhiŋ ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛra la n na pag n kizeehina ninɛɛ.

ref: You priests have rejected me, and my people are destroyed by refusing to obey. Now I'll reject you and forget your children, because you have forgotten my Law.
text: N nɛra wia chɔkkɔɔ dikuu baŋ waa nunzuma dɔɔwɛ wia. Dikuu n kizeehina n vɛɛŋ wia, n gba vɛɛ baabuu lugɔ ba waa kaa ɛɛ n kizeehina. Baŋ vɛɛ n Gbɔgni wia, n gba daŋ vɛɛ ba biizi.

ref: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.
text: Gunla n kizeehina n na wazi la, gunnɛ ba wichɔgaa ɛɛi n be ra wazi, ba ɔɔ kpa ba girmee di ra chɛr hiihzi.

ref: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.
text: Ba ga n nɛra wichɔgaa ɛɛi ninɛɛ di ra birgi dɔɔna, di ra nyiŋŋi ba ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa saŋa maa.

ref: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.
text: N kizeehina daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ alugɔ n nɛra. N daŋ tɛr ba maa digna, di turgi baa bá wiɛɛlaa kim.

ref: Their food won't satisfy, and having sex at pagan shrines won't produce children. My people have rebelled
text: Ba daŋ ɔɔ di, ka ba wàá piŋ, di ra sɛm, ka ba wàá wazi, dikuu baŋ vɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi, ka ra sɛm

ref: and have been unfaithful to me, their Lord. God Condemns Israel's Idolatry My people, you are foolish because of too much pleasure and too much wine.
text: ni simbinii ani u falii nyɔɔi wia, anla n ɔɔ kpu ba nfɛssi, ba waa kaa ra zum

ref: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.
text: n nɛra wia zɛɛzi la. Ba ɔɔ jaa la vuga la baŋ sɛɛhwɛ benii di gaa pɛɛzi bá zum ba wia zɛɛzi, daarɛ ɔɔ bagli baa a zɛɛzi. Ba kpa bahinaarɛ tɛɛ vuga, ba waa wibii dɔɔwɛ tɛŋ.

ref: You offer sacrifices on mountaintops and hills, under oak trees, and wherever good shade is found. Your own daughters and daughters-in-law sell themselves for sex.
text: Ba ɔɔ ra lizi mbusuzii bizenaa nyuuni, di ra fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma di ra lizi mbusuzi giŋgimee nyuuni ni daazenaa la n dɔɔ bɔsɔna nɛnnɛ zɛɛzi. Awiarɛ ba biihambizi birgi sɛnsɛnna, ba biibaala haana ra sɛm la.

ref: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
text: Màá tɛr ba biihaana digna di ba birgi sɛnsɛnna gɛɛ di tɛr ba biibaala digna di ba sɛmmɔ, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba baala himmaa ra chɔɔ sɛnsɛnnaa, ba ni vuga kuaribɔra sɛnsɛnna kpau ra lizi mbusuzi, nɛra la n waa wia zɛɛ zummɛ daŋ siu.

ref: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
text: Izrɛl hina, haali iin na sɛm gba, ka ií gilɛɛ gil Juda hina waa di bilchɔg. Ií gilɛɛ waa la Gilgal, ií gilɛɛ waa la bol la banna yir Bɛf Avɛn la. Di gilɛɛ wa kpa mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ di ra ŋɔ nuuzi.

ref: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
text: Izrɛl hina kpoŋŋoo lugɔ nalor n kpoŋŋe. Ɛrɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi jaa ɛɛ di dɛɛzi baa alugɔ pebizi n du kooree biini di ra dei?

ref: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
text: Izrɛl hina kpa bahinaarɛ tɛɛ vuga, ií suuh ba wia!

ref: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
text: Saŋa la baŋ haŋ wa nyɔɔ siŋ werge, ba sɛnsɛŋ ɔɔ nyaŋŋuu, ba koora nɔŋŋi hiihzi wiɛɛlaa werge kaali girme wiɛɛlaa.

ref: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
text: Vem daŋ wa paa baa kaali, hiihzi kpu baa dikuu mbusuzi la baŋ lizɛɛ ra tɛɛ vuga la wia.”

ref: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N kizeehina, ií ra nuu! Izrɛl hina, ií keŋŋi digna nɛnnɛ! Kooridiire, ií ra nuu! Seriya naabuu ń di ia. Ii faa ɛɛ sidɛɛrɛ Mizpa, di faa ɛɛ asau baŋ yaazɛɛ Bizeŋ Tabɔ nyuu.

ref: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
text: Dignikpega hina ra kpuuzi nɛraa werge. N daŋ tɛrgi ba maa digna.

ref: Israel, I know all about you, and because of your unfaithfulness, I find you unacceptable.
text: N zum Izrɛl hina wiimaanii, ba wiimaa waa suahwɛ n ni. Izrɛl hina jaa birgi sɛnsɛnnaa, di chɔg n be.

ref: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
text: Dikuu ba wiɛɛlaa wia, ba wàá ka wer bir ba mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la be. Ba bampiree lau sɛnsɛnnɛ werge, ba waa kaa zum lugɔ n du denii.

ref: Israel, your pride testifies to your guilt; it makes you stumble, and Judah stumbles too.
text: Izrɛl hina barabara ra di ba himmaa daansɛɛrɛ. Ba wichɔgaa gil ba ra lɔɔzi naazi di ra chogli, Ba ni Juda hina kpau di ra chogli.

ref: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
text: Di ba wa kpa ba nauna ni peeza ba, bá wa lizi mbusu n be, ba wàá naŋ, dikuu miŋ lii ba be wia.

ref: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
text: Ba waa wibii dɔɔwɛ n be, sɛnsɛŋ biizii ba ra lul. Awia, filaŋkennaa, ba Baagufalaa Hɔpizizenaa dii daŋ chɔgi ba ni ba kooni maa nyaamm.

ref: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
text: Ií huuh bensunoniina lii bolzeŋ Gibia! Ií huuh bensuno lii bolzeŋ Rama! Ií lɔ laal wile lii Bɛf Avɛn! Ií tɔ see, Bɛnjamin dee baala!

ref: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
text: Izrɛl hɛri daŋ chɔɔ pɛɛ di lii hɔpizii la min niŋ tɛr ba digna la. N daŋ sii gunla n niŋ ɛɛ Izrɛl hina dizi biini, wibii maa.

ref: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
text: Juda sitɔɔra ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ŋmɛɛna, di ra tuzi hɛssi magbɔɔni bia. N daŋ kpa n baaŋ la di tɛr ba digna alugɔ niizeŋ n ɔɔ wa chɔgi bɔr guŋ la.

ref: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
text: Ba ra sunni Izrɛl hinaa, di ra fini baa seriya dii biini, dikuu baŋ faa aah siwii di ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa vuga be wia.

ref: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
text: N daŋ kpu Izrɛl hina, di tuŋ Juda hina ge.

ref: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.
text: Izrɛl hina n wa na ba wiila, Juda hina ge na ba ŋmɛra la, denii Izrɛl hina bir la Asiiria koorizeŋ be di gaa nyiŋŋi hiinaa. Ka waa wette chaa baa, gɛɛ di gil ba ŋmɛra tuŋ.

ref: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
text: N daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ bunyiŋ Izrɛl ni Juda hina be. N daŋ chuuri baa ka kaali. N daŋ lauri baa kaali, ka nɛr maa wàá wer mɔgli baa ha.

ref: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
text: Ka ń jaa bir kaali n duuribɔr, guŋŋ di ga hel saŋa la ban niŋ sɛɛ chɔgri. Denii bá jaa aah siwii di nyiŋŋi n bɔr, ba dɔgnya hiŋ dii biini.”

ref: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
text: Izrɛl hina ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ií gil ya bir la Kɔraawiizi be. U tɔɔri yaabuu, ka u daŋ chaa yaa. U du yaabuu pira, ka u daŋ vɔɔzi yaa ŋmɛra.

ref: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
text: U daŋ bir gil ya dɔɔ alaanfia hɔpizaa anɛɛ har, hɔpizaa ahoro hɔl, ú bir lɛɛ yaa, ya du u be.

ref: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
text: Ií gil ya zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi du denii, ií gil ya fir yaa hinaa di zumuu. Gunla wiizi n haŋ du de di ra fur la, gunnɛ ú ba. U daŋ ba yaa be alugɔ sazau dooŋ, di ba alugɔ yuuliŋ dooŋ n ɔɔ wa sɔɔni hɛri nɛnnɛ la.”

ref: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina, bɛɛ ń kpa ia ɛɛi? Juda hina, bɛɛ ń kpa ia ɛɛi? Ii nɔŋŋaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ chɔɔzinkɔɔl, di ɛɛ lugɔ chɔɔzinŋmɛnii n waa ɔɔ birgi ka hil la.

ref: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
text: Awiarɛ n kpa n amaniye tɛɛ n dɔgtɛɛzi, bá wa di ia seriya, di kpu ia la. Wii la minna nyiŋŋi ii be la chaanɔɔrɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: I'd rather for you to be faithful and to know me than to offer sacrifices.
text: Nɛsunaa dɔɔi wiarɛ n na nyiŋŋi kaali mbusu lizaa, di ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ n nɛra zumiŋ kaali mbusu lizaa kuŋfuuhlaa.

ref: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
text: Ba chɔgi n ni baa nuukpaŋ labuu lii Andama hɛri, ba faa waa wibii dɔɔwɛ n be de.

ref: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
text: Biinikpola hina ni nɛkpuura bɛnnɛ su bolzeŋ Giliad biini maa.

ref: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
text: Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ŋmɛɛna n ɔɔ ga suah ŋmɛnikɛraa, di ra so nɛra saga. Haali ba ra kpu nɛra ŋmɛnɛɛ la n chɔɔwɛ di ra la bolzeŋ Sɛkɛm, di kutti ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa la n ɛɛ hiihzi wia.

ref: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
text: N na wichumaa Izrɛl hina biini. Ba ra kuari vugaa di chɔg bahinaa mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
text: N dau saŋaa ń tɛr Juda hina gba digna, dikuu wia la banna ɛɛ la wia.”

ref: No one realizes that I have seen their sins surround them like a flood.
text: Ba waa zummɛ lugɔ n na liizi ba wichɔgaa maanii. Ba wichɔgaa tɔ ba ninɛɛ, N ɔɔ ra naabuu saŋa maa.

ref: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
text: Ba kpa biinikpolaa di ra dar koori, di kpa kara di ra dar ba nabɔnzi.

ref: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
text: Yaa koori hindii hɔpizii hɔl, u ni a nabɔnzi maa nyɔɔ sinnɛ dɛɛzi, di birgi chɛɛtɛ kuna.

ref: Their anger is a fire that smolders all night, then flares up at dawn.
text: Ba wiɛɛlaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ paanuu ɔɔzi bɔr, ba suah ta ba koori jina. Ba baana ra lau niŋ hamuŋa maa, di ra lau alugɔ ninlau chɔɔzi ni.

ref: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
text: Ba maa kpa ba baaŋfuuihchɔgaarɛ kpu ba nabɔnzi, di kpuuzi ba koora maa kpaŋkpaŋa, ka bɛl maa wan suŋŋɛɛ lugɔ ń hiinuu.

ref: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
text: Izrɛl hina koozi hɛssi la n bar baa la hina ninɛɛ. Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baŋ ɔɔzi paanuu ka waa biiwɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
text: Hɔɔhra ni dɛllaa gillɔɔ ba nyaa fɔŋŋa, ka ba waa guŋ zummɛ. Ba hɔpizaa waa kaa du kpil, ka ba waa zummɛ.

ref: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
text: Izrɛl hina barabara ra di ba daansɛɛrɛ, ka annii maa waa gillɛ ba bir ba mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la be gɛɛ di nyiŋŋi n bɔr gba.

ref: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
text: Di ba ra kaali, n daŋ ta asau tɔ ba ni, di tɛr baa ha alugɔ zumbizi. Di n wa nuuwɔ banna chaali, n daŋ lau baa.

ref: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
text: Tɔɔrɔɔrɛ huuzi baa, dikuu baŋ leuwe lii n be wia! Ba daŋ kpu baa, dikuu ba dignikpega wia! N na nyiŋŋuu ń lɛɛ baa, ka ba ra ŋɔ kara wiŋɔzi di ra du n ni.

ref: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
text: Ba wanna suŋŋi ni biinihuŋŋu, ka chogli di ra wii alugɔ nɛra la n waa mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi zummɛ. Di ba suŋŋi mia ni siŋ, ba ɔɔ ra mɔnni bahinaarɛ alugɔ vugkuara, ka bir har kpuŋ.

ref: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
text: N dɛɛzi baabuu, di tɛɛ baa fɔŋŋa, ka ba ta n wichɔgaa ɛɛi jina.

ref: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
text: Ba waa bittɛ ba mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la be, ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hoo la n kuwee. Ba sitɔɔra daŋ siu laal biini, dikuu ba barabara wiŋɔzi wia. Dikuu keŋ wia, ba daŋ ɛɛ baa chɛɛtɛ, Ijip hɛri biini.”

ref: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Izrɛl hina be, “Ií huuh bensunoniina! Ii dɔma ra tuu n hɛrii alugɔ chigni n lii chiŋ di ra tuu! N nɛra chɔgi n ni baa nuukpaŋ labuu, di ra di n Gbɔgni mmɔri.

ref: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
text: Izrɛl hina wiiwoo ra duŋ, di ra ŋɔ, ‘Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, yaa zumiibuu!’

ref: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
text: Ka ba vɛɛ kunla n wessene, ba dɔma danna duŋŋi baa.

ref: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
text: Ba tɔ ba koora di maa zummɛ, di ligzi nabɔnzi di maa sɛɛwɛ. Ba kpa ba saliŋhuŋŋa ni salinnɛ kuari vuga tɛɛ bahinaa, guŋ gil ba chɔg bahinaa.

ref: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
text: Bolzeŋ Samaria hina, ií kpa ii vug la n li nabii la ha! N baaŋ na fuuh ii ninɛɛ werge. Ɛrɛɛ a birgi mag ka ii gil vuga kuaraai?

ref: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
text: Izrɛl hinuu la n zum nonii humaa kuari a vug, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi lɛi. Ba daŋ purgi bolzeŋ Samaria hina vug la n li nabii la, burburbur.

ref: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
text: Ba duu peure, di kum vem. Di mia waa lullɛ, a wàá dɔɔ sau. Di a faa lullɔ gba, ka hɔɔhraa niŋ dia.

ref: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
text: Izrɛl hina wia tunnɔɔ. Filaŋkeŋ, ba du hɛrdumazi biinee alugɔ nɛra la n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ.

ref: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
text: Ba la Asiiria hɛrii alugɔ kawee la n kpoŋŋe di ra gaagi u bɛŋ. Izrɛl hina la Asiiria hina benii di gaa nyiŋŋi hiinaa.

ref: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
text: Haali baŋ kpa bahinaa tɛɛ hɛrdumazi hina gba, ka n daŋ jaa chaali baa filaŋkeŋ. Ba bɔra danna wii, ba ra kɔgi, dikuu koorizeŋ n na sunni baa wia.

ref: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
text: Gunla Izrɛl hina n na ma mbusu lizibɔra, bá ra lizi wichɔgaa mbusuzi la, gunnɛ ba wichɔgaa ɛɛi ra nyaŋŋi.

ref: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
text: N sɛbi n Gbɔgni wikpoglaa kpilaa tɛɛ baa, ka a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ wihɔɔhra ba be.

ref: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
text: Ba ɔɔ lizi mbusu kunaa ra tɛŋ, di hee a ola, ka ba wia waa mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi bɔra sɔɔnɛɛ. N daŋ liizi ba wichɔgaa wia filaŋkeŋ, di tɛr ba digna dikuu a wia. Ba daŋ bir kaali Ijip hɛri.

ref: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
text: Izrɛl hina suuh mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n ta baa la wiarɛ, ka ma kooridiini. Juda hina ma koŋliikpegaa bar ba bola kpila. Ka n daŋ kpa niŋ du ba bolzenaa ni, ú fuuh a koŋliikpega.”

ref: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
text: Hozia ŋɔ Izrɛl hina be, “Ií gilɛɛ ra di ii hɔpizizenaa alugɔ vugkuara. Ii bir hattɛ kpu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la, di nyaa wibii u be. Ii yoo iihinaarɛ a hɛri maa biini alugɔ sɛnsɛnna di tɛɛ vug Baal, di ra nyiŋŋi mia la iin tamɛɛ lugɔ u turgi ia la.

ref: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
text: Izrɛl hina wàá ka du Kɔraawiizi hɛri la, a dɛkkɔɔ bá bir kaali Ijip hɛri di gaa di diwee la n doŋŋe Kɔraawiizi be, Asiiria hɛri.

ref: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
text: Ba wàá ka lizi siŋ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi be, gɛɛ ba mbusu lizaa sela kaa paruu. Guŋ mbusuzi daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ nɛra n na wii lee diwee tɛɛ baa, banla maa n niŋ dia daŋ doŋ Kɔraawiizi be. A diwee daŋ ɛɛ ba himmaa horaa, a wàá zuu Kɔraawiizi Dia biini.

ref: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
text: Di Kɔraawiizi diuzenaa dii hɔpizaa la wa hello, ɛrɛɛ bá dia di chɔluuwɛi?

ref: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
text: Haali di ba chɔwɔɔ lii a hɛhchɔg biini gba, ka Ijip hina daŋ chaali baa, Mɛmfis hina ge hug baa. Kooree daŋ lɛɛ ba saliŋhuŋŋa bɔr, sɔɔhri ge lii ba bola.

ref: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
text: Ba dignitɛraa hɔpizaa ra bau, gunla n dɛg bɛl maa hɔpizaa duglɔɔrɛ. Izrɛl hina daŋ zum guŋ. Dikuubɛɛwiai, ba wichɔgaa kannɔɔ werge, ba chumaa ge nyaŋŋi, ba ra yir Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛrɛ gɛnii, di ra yir nɛr la n zum u wia nɛnnɛ chugla hiŋ.

ref: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
text: Kɔraawiizi hum mìŋ́ u dɔgtɛɛrɛ, ń wa karfi u nɛra Izrɛl hina. Ka bɔr la maa minna la, ba ɔɔ hembuu bá lawiŋ lugɔ zumbee. Haali Kɔraawiizi Dia biini gba, nɛra ɛɛ a dɔgtɛɛ dɔmaa.

ref: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
text: Ba zuu dɔŋa wichɔgaa ɛɛi biinii werge alugɔ Gibia saŋa la. Kɔraawiizi daŋ liizi ba biinikpola wia, di tɛr ba digna dikuu a wia.”

ref: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Miŋ faa luglɛɛ na Izrɛl hina la, a faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ miŋ na grepuzi hɛribɔduma biini. Miŋ faa na ii naabaala, a faa ɛɛwɔɔ alugɔ fig lugli nɔna. Ka baŋ wa ba Bizeŋ Pɛɔ, ba faa luglɔɔrɛ di ra kuari vug Baal, di chum lugɔ a vug la ban nɔŋŋɛɛ la.

ref: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
text: Izrɛl hina girme daŋ lii ba ni kaali alugɔ zumbee n zaahwɛ kaali, biizi lulaa wàá ka du de, haana wàá ka kpogli hizi, ba hizi ge wàá ka chi.

ref: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
text: Haali di ba ra dɛɛzi biizi gba, ka n daŋ gil ba maa siuzi. Di n wa bir har kpu baa, wia daŋ huuzi baa werge maa!

ref: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
text: N nawɔɔrɛ Izrɛl n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ Taaya, di du hɛrnanii. Ka Izrɛl hina daŋ kpa ba biizi lii tɛɛ nɛkpuuri.”

ref: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
text: Denii Hozia ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi, bɛɛ ń suŋŋii tɛɛ baai? Gil ba haana fir, di gil ba nyaa ilanii.”

ref: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Ba wichɔgaa ɛɛi faarɔɔrɛ ba chɔɔribɔr Gilgal, n faa hah baa de. Dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia, n daŋ duŋŋi baa n hɛri. Màá ka nɔŋŋi baa, ba sitɔɔra maa ɛɛ nɛkpoŋlaare.

ref: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
text: Izrɛl hina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ daa lunne n hillɛ, waa kaa ra nɔŋ. Ba wàá ka lul biizi, haali di ba ra lul biizi di nɔŋŋi baa gba, ka n daŋ kpuuzi baa.”

ref: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
text: Kɔraawiizi la minna hum la daŋ vɛɛ baa, dikuu baŋ waa nuuwɛ tɛu wia. Ba danna juuri hɛssi biine.

ref: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
text: Hozia ŋɔ, “Izrɛl hina faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ grepu daa n nɔnnɛ werge. Gunla banna nyɛɛli la, gunnɛ ba ma mbusu lizibɔra di ra jaa. Gunla ba hɛri n na lii diwee werge la, gunnɛ ba bɔg ba vuga la n ɛɛ bia di ra jaa.

ref: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
text: Ba wia waa wibii dɔɔwɛ, awia, a dɛkkɔɔ bá di ba chɔgri tɔɔrɔɔ. Kɔraawiizi daŋ purgi ba mbusu lizibɔra, di chɔgi ba vuga la n ɛɛ bia la.

ref: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
text: Denii ba ŋɔ, ‘Yaa waa koori dɔɔwɛ dikuu yaa n waa Kɔraawiizi ɔmmɛ wia. Ka di yaa faa dɔɔ koori gba, bɛɛ ú faa wer ɛɛ tɛɛ yaai?’

ref: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
text: Ba ɔɔ ŋɔ nuukpilaa, di hɛɛhzi kanni karazi, di ɛɛ nuukpaŋ. Wibii dii birgi kara di ra jaa, lugɔ toguu n lii koo.

ref: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
text: Ɔnsii daŋ lau nɛra la n du bolzeŋ Samaria dikuu Bɛf Avɛn hina vug la n lii nabii la wia. U hina daŋ wii dikuu u wia, guŋ himmaanii ú kizeehina ɛɛ ni banla n faa di suma u wessi wia la, dikuu baŋ kpau lii ba be di kaali hɛrduma wia.

ref: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
text: Ba daŋ kpau kaali Asiiria hɛri, ú ɛɛ girme kinturgaa tɛɛ koorizeŋ la. Ba daŋ ŋmaabi Izrɛl hina, hiihzi kpu baa dikuu ba vuga la n ɛɛ daazi wia.

ref: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
text: Ba daŋ lauri bolzeŋ Samaria hina ni ba koori kaali lugɔ daabee n zaali nii nyuu di ra kaali.

ref: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
text: Ba daŋ chɔgi giŋgimee nyuuni vuga kuaribɔra la baŋ ɔɔ ra ɛɛ biinikpola wia la. Izrɛl hina wichɔgaarɛ guŋ. Sɔɔhri ni kooree daŋ lii tɔ ba mbusu lizibɔra maa. Denii bá ŋɔ bizenaa be, ‘Ií tɔ yaa ni!’ Di ŋɔ giŋgimee be, ‘Ií chogli yaa ni!’ ”

ref: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “Izrɛl hina haa waa wichɔgaa ɛɛi gillɛ di haŋ lii Gibia saŋa la maa. Laal faa waa wichɔgɛɛra ni cholle Gibiaa?

ref: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
text: Di a wa pariŋ, n daŋ tɛr ba digna, di gil hɛssi nɛra chaali wa lɔ ba laal, di tɛrgi ba digna dikuu ba wichɔgaa werge wia.

ref: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
text: Izrɛl hina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nalor la baŋ dɛɛzɛɛ nɛnnɛɛ, u nɔŋŋi mia fɛrgaa, awia, n daŋ kpa daa du u baŋaa u ra par. N daŋ kpogli Izrɛl hina, a dɛkkɔɔ Juda hina ra par, Izrɛl hina ge dɛkkɔɔ banna bugli hɛri.

ref: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
text: Ií duu wideŋlaa tɛɛ iihinaa, di tɔrgi nɔna la n dɔɔ nɔŋŋaa la n waa tuŋ, di gil ii bampiree pɛssi lugɔ hɛri la baŋ buglee, dikuubɛɛwiai, saŋa la iin niŋ nyiŋŋi mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la helloo, mɔɔ ka n ba wa kissi ia werge.

ref: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
text: Ka a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ iin duu biinikpola, di kum wichɔgaa, di di kara nɔna, dikuu iin dɛlli ii himaa fɔŋŋa ni ii laallɔɔrakpila ni wia.

ref: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
text: Guŋ wia, laal daŋ chol ii ni, bá purgi ii bola diikpega la n baraa la, alugɔ a hɔl la Koori Salman n faa puri bolzeŋ Bɛf Aabɛl laal biini la, di lauri maawaa ni ba biizi vaari hɛri ba siuzi.

ref: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
text: Ee, Bɛtɛl hina, gunnɛ niŋ ɛɛ ii be, dikuu ii biinikpola n kannɛ werge wia. Di a guŋ hɔpizii wa hello, ba daŋ kpu Izrɛl koori.”

ref: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Saŋa la Izrɛl n faa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ bichala la, n faa nɔŋŋuubuu, di yiruu lugɔ n biibaal di lii Ijip hɛri.

ref: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
text: Ka saŋa la miŋ haŋ wàá yiruu la, a guŋ saŋaa u ɔɔ chɔ ra lii n be. N nɛra ɔɔ ra lizi mbusuzii ra tɛɛ vug Baala, di fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma ra tɛɛ vuga.

ref: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
text: Minuu bagli baa volaa, di ɔɔ kpa baa pɛgli, ka ba waa zummɛ lugɔ minuu dɛɛzi baa.

ref: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
text: N faa kpa nɔŋŋaa ni winanaarɛ tɔ ba see. N faa lizi tɔɔrɔɔ la n lugɔ nau baŋaa daa labuu ba ni, di bugni tɛɛ baa diwee.

ref: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
text: Ba waa sɛɛwɛ bá bir ba n be, awia, a dɛkkɔɔ baŋ bittɛ kaali Ijip hɛri, Asiiria hina di kora ba ni.

ref: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
text: N nɛra siwii aahwɔɔ lugɔ bá bir har kpuŋ. Haali di ba yiriŋ gba, ka màá lɛɛ baa.

ref: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
text: Izrɛl hina, ɛrɛɛ ń ɛɛ gil ia tai? Ɛrɛɛ ń ɛɛ di vɛɛ iai? Ɛrɛɛ ń ɛɛ kpu ia alugɔ bolzeŋ Adma hinai? Gɛɛ di ɛɛ ia alugɔ bolzeŋ Zɛbɔyim hinai? N bampirii wàá sɛɛ ń ɛɛ guŋ, N nɔŋŋi iabuu werge.

ref: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
text: Màá kpa n baaŋ la tɔɔri ia gɛɛ di bir kpu Izrɛl hina. Dikuubɛɛwiai, n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizii, maa newee ɛɛwɛ. Minuu ii Dɔɔrinaniinanii la, n du ii biinii. Màá ba ii be ni baaŋfuuih.

ref: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
text: Ba daŋ hiŋ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi, n daŋ wii alugɔ bunyiŋ. Di n wa wiiwo, n biizi daŋ lii wiicholii ba ni bɔsai.

ref: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
text: Ba daŋ ba ni bɔsai alugɔ zumbizi n lii Ijip hɛri, alugɔ kommazi n lii Asiiria hɛri. N daŋ soŋŋi baa ba bola. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.” Izrɛl hina wichɔgaa wia

ref: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina kpa karaa di bariŋ, di ra dariŋ. Juda hina haa ra diŋ mmɔri, haali mìŋ́ Izrɛl Dɔɔrinaniinanii wia n dɔɔ wibii gba.”

ref: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
text: Izrɛl hina wiɛɛlaa maa, di lii chɔɔzi di ra la hamuŋa, ɛɛ wipɛɛrii di ra chɔg wia. Wibii nyaai ni naari wia ra wazuu ba biini. Ba gillɔɔ ba ni Asiiria hina ɛɛ nuukpaŋ, di chi ɔlivi nuu di ra la Ijip hɛri.

ref: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
text: Kɔraawiizi ni Juda hina dɔɔ wiarɛ, u daŋ tɛr Izrɛl hina digna dikuu ba wiɛɛlaa wia, di bir turgi baa a kim.

ref: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
text: Ba naabaal Jekɔb ni u cheeŋ Ɛsau faa yoowoo, di ba faa haa du ba maa hia, uŋ wa hel baal, u ni Kɔraawiizi yoo.

ref: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
text: U ni mɛlika yoowoo u kpegluu, u wii di suŋŋi a mɛlika lugɔ u suŋ u ni. U ga nau Bɛtɛl, u nuu ŋɔ wia de.

ref: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hinnɛ faa, waabuu Kɔraawiizi la ban ninna jaami!

ref: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
text: Izrɛl hina ra ta baraa di ra ŋɔ, ‘Yaa ɛɛ daama hinaa werge, yaa birgi dɔɔnaa. Yaa daama hiŋ wia, nɛra maa wàá wer ŋɔ lugɔ wibii nyaai wiarɛ yaa dɔɔ daama.’

ref: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
text: Ka minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la, unla n faa lizi ia lii Ijip hɛri la. N daŋ kaa gil ii gaa zuu tanti diini biine gunla iiŋ faa du a biine, di lii saŋa la miŋ faa ba ii be, hɛribɔduma biini la.

ref: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
text: N ŋɔ wiarɛ tɛɛ n dɔgtɛɛzi, di pilli wikpila tɛɛ baa, di ga ba be ta sɛɛliizi tɛɛ ia.

ref: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
text: Giliad hina dɔɔ biinikpolaa. U nɛra ɛɛ nɛjagazii! Ba kpa nabalaa di ra lizi mbusuzi Gilgal biini. Ba mbusuzi lizibɔra daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ baŋ chaali bia, di dauri kulululu, koo biini.”

ref: Jacob escaped to Syria where he tended sheep to earn himself a wife.
text: Hozia ŋɔ, “Yaa naabaal Jekɔb faa chɔwɔɔrɛ la Mɛsɔpɔtemia hɛri, di ga hum ú na haaŋ, di nɔɔni peeza ú turgi a haaŋ kim.

ref: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa gillɔɔ u dɔgtɛɛ Moosis kpogli Izrɛl hina lii Ijip hɛri, di faa ga u be di binni baa.

ref: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
text: Di Ɛfram diahina haŋ wa ŋɔ wia, nɛra bɔra ɔɔ ra sau. Kɔraawiizi faa tɛɛ baabuu nabɔmuu Izrɛl biini, ka ba faa kuu vug Baal jaamaa wia di di bilchɔg di siu.

ref: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
text: Ba jaa ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ werge maa, di kpa ba saliŋhuŋŋa kuari vuga ra tɛɛ bahinaa. Ba kuaraabuu nɛnnɛ maa, nɛra la n zum nonii huma nɛnnɛɛ kuaraa. Kenne ba ra ŋɔ nɛra naa wia, “Ba kpa neweare di ra lizi mbusuzi, di ra jaami vuga la baŋ kuarɛɛ lugɔ nabizi.”

ref: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
text: Awia, ba daŋ ɛɛ alugɔ chɔɔzinkɔɔl, alugɔ chɔɔzinŋmɛnii n ɔɔ feli diizaa, alugɔ peu n na kpa zɔga pila, alugɔ nyɔɔzi n ga chum di ra lii.

ref: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum, unla n lizi ia lii Ijip hɛri la. Ii wàá zum Kɔraawiizi maa di min lɛi, Lɛɛri maa waa hoo di miŋ lɛi.

ref: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
text: Minuu faa binni ia hɛribɔduma la biini, hɛri la n wenzee di ra haahri werge la biini.

ref: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
text: Minuu faa tɛɛ ia diwee ii di piŋ, iiŋ wa piŋŋɛ, ii jaa ra jigsi, di suuh n wia.

ref: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
text: A wia, n daŋ pig ia alugɔ bunyiŋ, di chɔɔ ii ŋmɛnikɛraa guu ia alugɔ amani.

ref: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
text: N daŋ pig ia lugɔ amani la biizi n leuwe, di kaari ii hizi, di di ia alugɔ bunyiŋ, gunla sechɔgii n ɔɔ chuuri sel la.

ref: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
text: Izrɛl hina, n daŋ kpu ia. Anɛɛ n niŋ wer hiini iai?

ref: You wanted a king and rulers. Where is your king now? What cities have rulers?
text: Ii koori du lee ú wer lɛɛ iai? Ii bola nabɔnzi maa du lee, banla wia iiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ, ‘Tɛɛ yaa koori ni sitɔɔra lai’?

ref: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
text: Awia, n faa kpa baaŋ tɛɛ ia koori, di kpa n baaŋfuuihchɔgaa di kpau kaali.

ref: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
text: N kpa Izrɛl bilchɔgrɛ dau, di sɛbi ba wichɔgaa dau.

ref: You are like a senseless child who refuses to be born at the proper time.
text: Izrɛl hina dɔɔ tamiirɛ lugɔ ba dɔɔ miibɔɔ, ka ba waa nunzuma dɔɔwɛ. Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bie la banna nyiŋŋi lulaa, ka waa sɛɛ ú lii.

ref: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
text: N daŋ lɛɛ baa lii ŋmam fɔŋŋa biini. N daŋ lɛɛ baa lii siu be. Siu, lee i wiilchɔgaa la duɛi? Ŋmam, lee i chɔgaa la duɛi? Màá suŋ ba ni,

ref: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
text: haali Izrɛl hina n na hel nɛnnɛ ba lulla biini gba, ka mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil peu lii wiifurii hɛribɔduma, di wa ta ba ni, bá bulli ni ba kɔlɔnzi hil. Bá paa ba kundɔɔlaa maa lii ba diini.

ref: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
text: A dɛkkɔɔ bolzeŋ Samaria hina di ba bilchɔg tɔna, dikuu baŋ di Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la mmɔri wia. Ba daŋ kpa tokobi kpu baa, di lauri ba bichalli vaari hɛri, di yalli ba haana la n kpogli hizi la hizi.”

ref: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
text: Izrɛl hina, ií bir ba Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la be. Ii wichɔgaarɛ hur ia ta!

ref: Return to the Lord and say, “Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.
text: Ií kpa wiisuŋŋaa naa di bir ba Kɔraawiizi be. Ií ga ŋɔ u be, “Jaande maa, gil yaa wichɔgaa tɛɛ yaa, ka suŋ yaa ni di lɛɛ yaa, ya wer chɔlii gunla yaa n ŋɔ nua la.

ref: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
text: Asiiria hina wàá wer lɛɛ yaa, yaa wàá tinni laal zagra. Yaa ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka ŋɔ vuga la yaa himmaa n kuarɛɛ be lugɔ aabuu yaa dɔɔra, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ɔɔ ra suŋ lalbiizi ni.”

ref: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ bir n nɛra ni ba n be, di nɔŋŋi baa ni n biini maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, n baaŋ wàá kaa ra fuuh ba ni.

ref: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
text: N daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ ŋmɛnii tɛɛ Izrɛl hina, bá du wer alugɔ fiiri. Ba lunne daŋ zuu hɛri nɛnnɛ alugɔ Lɛbanɔn hɛriŋkpol daazi,

ref: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
text: bá biizi wazi. Bá wessi ɛɛ alugɔ ɔlivi nuu daa, di ra sɔɔhri sumaii lugɔ Lɛbanɔn hɛriŋkpol daa.

ref: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
text: Ba daŋ kaa so n na guu baa. Izrɛl hina daŋ nyɛɛli alugɔ mia n lɛɛwɛ nɛnnɛ, di lul biizi alugɔ grepu daazi n nɔnnɛ nɛnnɛ, di dɔɔ sɔŋ alugɔ Lɛbanɔn siŋ.

ref: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
text: Izrɛl hina ni vuga wàá ka dɔɔ wiimaa. N daŋ nuu ba wiisuŋŋaa di ra binni ba ni. N daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ daananii n lɔɔwɛ di biri nɛnnɛ, di tɔ ba ni. N benii bá kissaa maa lii.”

ref: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
text: Anɛɛ dɔɔ nunzumai? U daŋ zum wia naa zɛɛ. Anɛɛ n na pessi wiai? U daŋ zum a zɛɛ. Kɔraawiizi ŋmɛnizi maa deŋloore, nɛra la wia n deŋleere ra vol a ni, ka mmɔri diire waa ra lɔɔzi naazii di ra jiŋli a biine.

ref: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
text: Wia la Kɔraawiizi n pillɛɛ bagli Pɛtuɛl biibaal Jowɛllɛ keŋ. Lotorozi wia

ref: Listen, you leaders and everyone else in the land. Has anything like this ever happened before?
text: Ií ra nuu, ii banla n ɛɛ nabɔnzi, ií ra nuu, nɛra la maa n du Juda hɛri. Wii naa dɔŋ haa ɛɛwɔ ii saŋa gɛɛ ii naabaala saŋaa?

ref: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
text: Sinnyɔɔra, ií izi di ra wii! Ií ra lɔɔgi wile, ii banla n na nyɔɔ siŋ, dikuu iiŋ wàá ka na siŋfalii nyɔɔ wia.

ref: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
text: Lotorozi lugɔ laallɔkpega ballɔɔ á wa chɔgi yaa hɛri maa, a dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa werge maa, a waa maga dɔɔwɛ, a nyina ra diu lugɔ bunyiŋ nyina.

ref: Our grapevines and fig trees are stripped bare; only naked branches remain.
text: A chɔgi yaa grepu daazii, di hee yaa fig daazi. A po a hɛga maanii ha, ka ka a kela, a huuhzi chi.

ref: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
text: Mbusuzi lizaa mia gɛɛ siŋ waa hoo bá kpa ba Kɔraawiizi Dia. Kɔraawiizi kizeehina ra wiiu, dikuu baŋ waa kuna dɔɔwɛ, bá kpa lizi mbusuzi Kɔraawiizi be wia.

ref: Barren fields mourn; grain, grapes, and olives are scorched and shriveled.
text: A kooni maanii chɔkkɛ, a hɛri maa hil, mia maa chɔgi, grepu nɔna maa hil, ɔlivi daazi ge maa hil.

ref: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
text: Patta, ií gil ii bɔra huah, grepu patta, ií ra lɔɔgi wile, ií gil ii biine chɔgi dikuu huuti ni baali wia, dikuubɛɛwiai, pattikuna maanii chɔkkɛ.

ref: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
text: A grepuzi daazi maanii hillɛ, fig daazi maa yɔl, pomegranet, abɛ, huu daazi ani kooni daazi maanii hillɛ. Wibii maa, newea bɔsɔna tunnɔɔ. Wichɔgaa gilaa ta wia

ref: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
text: Kɔraawiizi kizeehina, ií kpa gbɔglɔnzi tɔɔgi di ra wii, ii banla n na hum mbusu lizibɔr la! Ií zuu Kɔraawiizi Dia la di ra wii hamuŋa maa! Mia gɛɛ siŋ waa hoo ii kpa ra lizi mbusuzi Kɔraawiizi Dia.

ref: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
text: Ŋɔ bá vɔɔ nua, chaali nɛra maa! Chaali nabɔnzi ni nɛra la maa n du a hɛri, di ba Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la Dia, di wa wii tɛu.

ref: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.
text: Gooŋga! Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la duglɔɔrɛ! Hɔpizii la Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ n niŋ gil chɔgaa ba. Ɔnsii werge daŋ du de a hɔl hiŋ.

ref: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
text: Yaa chigɔɔ haa nuuzi di ra binni, ka yaa pattikuna maa chɔgi. Bɔsɔna ge waa kaa hoo Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la Dia biini.

ref: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
text: Kunduulaa maanii siuwɛ dikuu a hɛri n hillɛ wia. Mia waa hoo bá kaa du buugazi biine, awia, a buugazi maanii purgee.

ref: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
text: Nauna ra wiiu, dikuu kooree n waa hoo á di wia, haali peeza gba ra di dɔgnya.

ref: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
text: Kɔraawiizi, hinuu n wii ra tɛɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, kooree ni daazi maanii hillɛ, alugɔ niŋ n fuuah la.

ref: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
text: Haali pir sela maa wii ra tɛɛ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi, dikuubɛɛwiai, muuni ni gɔŋa maanii hiihzɛɛ, niŋ ge fuuh sela diiribɔra maa.

ref: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
