text: Ií huuh bensunoniina la Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu, ií lɔ kpɛlŋa n bizennaniinanii la nyuu. Ií gil Juda hina maa bɔra ra sa, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la ra bau, u duglɔɔrɛ.

ref: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
text: U hɔpizii hiŋ daŋ biri, di ɛɛ biinichɔg hɔpizii, di ɛɛ baamazi ni bɔbiri werge hɔpizii. U daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ lotorozi n tɔ bizenaa nyuuni, di ɛɛ lugɔ laallɔkpega, a ŋmɛnɛ maa ge wàá dɔɔ dɔŋ, di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: Fiery flames surround them; no one escapes. Before they invaded, the land was like Eden; now only a desert remains.
text: A daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ niŋ n fuuh kuna a see, ka a har chɔɔ alugɔ nindiu. A see hɛri ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Ɛdɛn kambol la, ka a harbɔɔ ge hɛri ɛɛ lugɔ hɛribɔduma.

ref: They look like horses and charge like cavalry.
text: A duula ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ zagra, di ra chɔ alugɔ laal zagra.

ref: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
text: A gbɔgza ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ laal torkozi, a zaahzi ra gilli bizenaa. Di ra pogzi alugɔ niŋ n na di kooree, di chi nɛnnɛ ge alugɔ laallɔɔra n ɛɛ sirya, bá lɔ laal.

ref: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.
text: A ɔɔ pig nɛraa lugɔ laallɔɔra, di ra tinni koŋlaa alugɔ laallɔɔra. A ɔɔ deŋli a seere ra la, a waa bɛɛwɛ ra ga yemmaa.

ref: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
text: A bɛl maa waa u dɔŋhiŋ na gargi. A ɔɔ taau lii kunla maa n niŋ teŋaa be, kummaa waa hoo ú wer teŋaa ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
text: A hahzoore di pig a bolzeŋ, di ra chɔ koŋlaa ni. Di ra zuu diini biine, di ga a tokorozi zuu alugɔ ŋmɛɛna.

ref: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
text: A ɔɔ ra bau hɛri ra zigli, chiŋ ge ra sa, A tɔ wiizi ni baagu, bɔr biri, chinchiŋwilaa ge waa kaa ra chaani.

ref: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
text: Kɔraawiizi ra pogzi u laallɔɔra ninɛɛ. Banla n na sɛɛ u wia kpillɔɔ werge, di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa. U Hɔpizii hiŋ chummɔɔ werge. Anɛɛ n niŋ pirei? Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ bá gil ba wichɔgaa ta wia

ref: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Haali filaŋkeŋ gba, ií bir ba n be ni ii biine maa, ni nuuvɔɔi ni wiraa ani biinichɔg.”

ref: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
text: Ií gil ii biine chɔgi, gunnɛ bɔ iiŋ piili ii bɔmbɔga. Ií bir ba Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la be, dikuu unna ɛɛ nɛra nɛnnɛ, di ra na ba sinyɛna wia. U baaŋ pɛssɔɔrɛ, u nɔŋŋaa ge waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ, ka u ɔɔ kaa gil nɛra ge wichɔgaarɛ ra tɛɛ baa.

ref: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
text: Aŋhinabe, Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la daŋ bir u nfɛrɛ, di kaa kissi ia, di tɛɛ ia pattikuna werge. Denii ii jaa wer kpa mia ni siŋ di ra lizi mbusuzi u be.

ref: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
text: Ií huuh bensunoniina Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu, di gil ba vɔɔ nua, ka yir a nɛra maa, bá chaali.

ref: Make sure that everyone is fit to worship me. Bring adults, children, babies, and even bring newlyweds from their festivities.
text: Ií chaali a nɛra, di lizi ba doŋa ha, bá ɛɛ nɛnanaananaa Kɔraawiizi be. Chaali nabɔnzi ni bichalli maa, haali banla gba n ɛɛ biifulli. Ií gil haŋfalaa ni ba janna maa lii ba diini ba.

ref: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
text: A dɛkkɔ Kɔraawiizi kizeehina la n na humuu, u Dia dominua ni mbusu lizibɔr la baambaaŋ, di ra wii, di ra suŋŋuu. Gil ba ra ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi, suŋ i nɛra ni, di gilɛɛ gil i nɛra ɛɛ chɛɛtɛ kuna, banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la be. Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ hɛssi hina ra ŋɔ, ‘Lee Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la duɛi?’ ” Kɔraawiizi n gillɛ a hɛri kaa bir du sum

ref: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi faa kaa gil u hɛri wia tiruu, u suŋ u nɛra ni.

ref: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa bir ŋɔ u nɛra be, “N daŋ tɛɛ ia mia, siŋfalaa ani ɔlivi nuufalaa, á kukki ia. Hɛrdumazi hina wàá ka gbɛlli ia.

ref: An army attacked from the north, but I will chase it into a scorching desert. There it will rot and stink from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean.” The Lord works wonders
text: N daŋ duŋŋi lotorozi la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ laallɔkpega, di lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag ba la, á kaali bɔɔnɛɛ di ga du hɛribɔduma. N daŋ duŋŋi a sitɔɔra ga du Muuzensiwii la, anla ge n tɔ a har la ge ga zuu Muuzeŋ Mɛditerenɛn. Anla n siuzɛɛ la danna sɔɔhri. N daŋ kpua, dikuu gunla maa aŋ ɛɛ ia la wia.

ref: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
text: Pir sela, ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm, dikuu ii diiribɔra n na fur kooree, daazi ge ra nɔŋ wia. Fig ni grepu daazi ra nɔnuu.

ref: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
text: Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni ia werge maa, dikuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la wia. U tɛɛ iabuu sazaudooŋ, di tɛɛ ia yuulindooŋ gba nɛnnɛ.

ref: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
text: Ii pilli maanii niŋ suugi mia, sinni ni ɔlivi nuu kuaribɔra maa ge suugi di taali.

ref: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
text: N daŋ gil ii bir na kuna la maa a lotorozi n faa chɔkkɛ, binni la maa n bɛrɛɛ la. Minuu faa gillɛ a ba ii be la.

ref: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
text: Ii daŋ na diwee werge, di di piŋ, di chɔli Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la, dikuubɛɛwiai, u ɛɛ nuukpuuri wiarɛ werge ii be. N nɛra ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka di hiihzi.

ref: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
text: Izrɛl hina, ii daŋ zum lugɔ n du ii benii, di zum ge lugɔ n bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum, bɛl maa waa kaa hoo. N nɛra ŋmɛnɛ maa ge wàá ka di hiihzi.” Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii wia

ref: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “Di guŋ wa ɛɛwɔ tuŋ, n daŋ kpa n Duma du nɛra maa ni. Ii biibaala ni ii biihaana maa daŋ ŋɔ wia n fɔŋŋa biini, ii bazɛŋzi danna deezi, ii biipɔllaa ge ra na wia lugɔ deeza biini.

ref: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
text: Haali n daŋ kpa n Duma du n balaa gba ni, baala ni haana maa ni.

ref: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
text: N daŋ ɛɛ nuukpuuri wia chiŋ ni hɛri maa biine, nɛkpui, niŋ ani nyɔɔzi daŋ tɔ bɔr maa.

ref: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
text: Wiizi daŋ bir biri, baagu ge bir aah lugɔ chal mɔɔ, ka mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la wia n dɔɔ ɔnsii werge la jaa ba.

ref: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
text: Nɛr la maa n niŋ yir Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ, ú lɛɛu, u daŋ lɛɛu. Baŋhina daŋ na lɛɛi lii Jɛrusalɛm biini, banla miŋ lizɛɛ daŋ na bahinaa.”

ref: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Saŋa bɛl daŋ wa hel, ń kaa gil Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm bir nyɛɛli.

ref: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
text: N daŋ chaali hɛssi maa hina, di kpa baa ba Jɛhɔsafat Waluu la. Denii ń wa di baa seriya dikuu gunla baŋ ɛɛ n nɛra Izrɛl hina la wia. Ba duŋŋi baabuu ba yaari hɛhjaŋa, ka kpa n hɛri bɔnni.

ref: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
text: Ba ta kunaa bá na unla n niŋ dɔɔ n nɛra bá ɛɛ u yoma. Ba yoo biibaala ni biihaanaa, di turgi sɛnsɛnna ni siŋ kim.

ref: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
text: Taaya, Saidɔn ani Filisti hɛssi maa, beedee ii ra nyiŋŋi ii ɛɛi? Ii ra nyiŋŋuu ií turgiŋ wiibɛl kim gɛɛ? Di gunnɛ, n daŋ bir turgi ia manaŋ,

ref: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ii chigɔ n saliŋhuŋŋa, n saliŋ ani n daama kunaa ga du ii vuga diini biine.

ref: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
text: Ii yoo Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm hinaa tɛɛ Giris hina, guŋ gil ba du nɛɛ ni ba himmaa hɛri.

ref: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
text: Awia, n daŋ lizi baa lii hɛssi la iiŋ yoo baa tɛɛ la biine. N daŋ ɛɛ ia gunla iiŋ ɛɛ baa la.

ref: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
text: N daŋ gil ba yoo ii biibaala ni ii biihaana tɛɛ Juda hina, ba ge bir yoo baa tɛɛ Saba hina, bɔr la n waa duglɛɛ tama maa la. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
text: Ií sii guŋ tɛɛ hɛssi hina. Ií ɛɛ laal sirya! Ií du a laallɔɔra bɔkpega! Ií gil ba maa lii ga pig baa!

ref: Make swords out of plows and spears out of garden tools. Strengthen every weakling.”
text: Ií kpa ii para luu tokobizi, di kpa ii daazi kɛuraa kizizi luu kandaazi. Ií gil banla gba n waa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ ŋɔ, ‘N kpekkoo!’

ref: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.
text: Hɛssi la maa n du kɛraa, ií ba manaŋ, ií ba manaŋ wa chaali de.” Hoi, n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, gil i laallɔɔra tuu ba!

ref: You must come now to Judgment Valley, where the Lord will judge the surrounding nations.
text: “Du hɛssi hina bɔkpega, gil ba chaali Jɛhɔsafat Waluu. Denii ń so di hɛssi hina maa seriya.

ref: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
text: Ba ɛɛ biinikpola hinaa, ií ŋmɛnni baa dau lugɔ banna kum mia la. Ií fɛrgi baa lugɔ gunla baŋ ɔɔ fɛrgi grepuzi n su a kuaribɔr, guŋŋ a nii waa lii la.”

ref: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—
text: Nɛkpila werge du a Seriya Dii Waluu la biini. Denii Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la ba manaŋ.

ref: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
text: Wiizi ni baagu daŋ biri, chinchiŋwilaa ge wàá kaa ra chaani.

ref: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ wii lugɔ bunyiŋ lii Bolzeŋ Ziɔn, di pozi lugɔ dooŋ lii Jɛrusalɛm, guŋ gil chiŋ ni hɛri maa zigli. Ama, Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ suahribɔttɛ tɛɛ u nɛra, di ɛɛ diikpeg tɛɛ Izrɛl hina.

ref: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
text: Awia, ii daŋ zum lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum. N du Bolzeŋ Ziɔnnɛ, n bizennaniinanii la nyuu. Jɛrusalɛm daŋ ɛɛ bolzennaniinanii, hɔɔhra wàá ka wer kpegluu maa.

ref: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
text: Di a saŋa wa hello, grepu daazi daŋ tɔ bizenaa nyuuni, nauna su giŋgimee maa nyuuni, Juda gɔŋa maa suugi niiri. Gɔŋ pal lii Kɔraawiizi Dia la biini di ga pɛssi Akeesia Waluu.

ref: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
text: Ijip hɛri daŋ birgi diŋgela, Ɛdɔm hɛri ge birgi hɛribɔduma, dikuu gunla baŋ kpu Juda hina, di kpuuzi banla n waa wichɔgii maa ɛɛwɛ wia.

ref: but Judah and Jerusalem will always have people.
text: Ka nɛra daŋ du Juda ni Jɛrusalɛm, jiminizi maa.

ref: I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion. I will punish the guilty and defend the innocent.
text: Miŋ faa waa gillɛ tɛɛ baa dikuu baŋ kpu nɛra wia la, n daŋ jaa gil tɛɛ baa.

ref: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
text: Baal bɛllɛ ba faa ra yir Emɔs, u ɛɛ penɔɔni di lii Tɛkua. U wiŋɔzii keŋ. Izrɛl wia la Kɔraawiizi n faa pillɛɛ bagluu binni anɛɛ mɔɔ, ka hɛri faa zigli werge labuu keŋ. A saŋa di Uzziaa faa Juda koori, Koori Jehoas biibaal Jeroboam ge faa di Izrɛl kora.

ref: and I said: When the Lord roars from Jerusalem, pasturelands and Mount Carmel dry up and turn brown. Judgment on Syria
text: Emɔs faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Kɔraawiizi baaŋ ra fuuuh, u ra pogzi Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu, di ra pogzi lugɔ dooŋ, Jɛrusalɛm biini. Sela diiribɔra maanii hillɛ, Bizeŋ Kamɛl ge nyuu kooree maa yɔl.” Kɔraawiizi daŋ di Izrɛl hina dɔŋahina seriya

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Bolzeŋ Damaskus hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii. Awia, n daŋ haŋ tɛr ba dignaa, dikuu baŋ tɔɔri Giliad hina sikpegii ni werge wia.

ref: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
text: Awia, n daŋ gil niŋ fuuh kooridia la Koori Hazɛl n mawɛɛ ni Koori Bɛn Hadad diikpega la.

ref: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
text: N daŋ chɔgi bolzeŋ Damaskus domininuuzeŋ la, di lalli nɛra la n soge Avɛn Waluu ni Bɛf Ɛdɛn koori. Ba daŋ lauri Siiria hina kaali Kir hɛri.”

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Bolzeŋ Gaza hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii, awia, n daŋ haŋ tɛr ba dignaa, dikuu baŋ lauri hɛri bɛl nɛra maa, di yoo tɛɛ Ɛdɔm hina wia.

ref: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
text: N daŋ kpa niŋ du bolzeŋ Gaza koŋlaa ni, ú fuuh u diikpega maa.

ref: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
text: N daŋ lizi bolzenaa Asdɔd ni Askɛlɔn koora. N daŋ tɛr bolzeŋ Ɛkrɔn hina digna, guŋŋ Filisti hina la maa n kawɛɛ la wa siuzi.”

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Bolzeŋ Taaya hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii, awia, n daŋ haŋ tɛr ba dignaa, dikuu baŋ lauri hɛri bɛl nɛra maa, di yoo tɛɛ Ɛdɔm hina, di chɔgi ba ni baa nuukpaŋ la wia.

ref: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
text: N daŋ kpa niŋ du bolzeŋ Taaya hina koŋlaa ni, ú diikpega maa fuuh.”

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Ɛdɔm hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii, awia, n daŋ haŋ tɛr ba dignaa, dikuu baŋ dau ba lulla Izrɛl hina luge, di kpu baa, ba waa ba ni sunne wia. Ba baaŋfuuih waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ, ba waa gillɛ u sɔɔni.

ref: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
text: Awia, n daŋ kpa niŋ du bolzeŋ Tɛman ni, di fuuh bolzeŋ Bɔzra diikpega.”

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Ammɔn hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii, awia, n daŋ haŋ tɛr ba dignaa, dikuu baŋ faa lɔ laal, di ra nyiŋŋi hɛri ba jaa, haali di yalli Giliad hina haana la n kpogli hizi la, hizi wia.

ref: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
text: N daŋ kpa niŋ di du bolzeŋ Raba koŋlaa ni, di fuuh u diikpega. Ba daŋ lɔ wile, laal hɔpizii, a laal du kpeg alugɔ dooŋ pekpeg.

ref: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Ba daŋ lau ba koori ni u nabɔnzi kaali hɛrduma. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Moab hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii, awia, n daŋ haŋ tɛr ba dignaa. Ba faa waa Ɛdɔm koori hoga tɔgzɛɛ, dikuu baŋ fuuah, a birgi hɔɔhri wia.

ref: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
text: N daŋ du Moab hɛri niŋ, di fuuh bolzeŋ Kɛriɔf diikpega. Moab hina daŋ siu laal kɔɔi biini, saŋa la laallɔɔra n ninna chaasi, ka bensunozi ge ra wii la.

ref: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
text: N daŋ kpu Moab koori ni a hɛri sitɔɔra maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Juda hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii, awia, n daŋ haŋ tɛr ba dignaa, dikuu baŋ vɛɛ n Gbɔgni hiŋaa, di kaa vɛɛ n widaulaa gba hiŋaa wia. Vuga la himmaa ba naabaala n faa ra kuari la, dar baabuu ba leu.

ref: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
text: Awia, n daŋ kpa niŋ du Juda, ú fuuh diikpega la n du Jɛrusalɛm la.” Kɔraawiizi n di Izrɛl hina seriya wia

ref: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Izrɛl hina ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ digiidigii, awia, n daŋ haŋ tɛr ba dignaa, dikuu baŋ yoo nɛra la wia n deŋlee di lɛɛ saliŋhuŋŋa wia. Di kpa nyaara la ge n di kima yoo, haali a kima n wàá wer yau gawa gba.

ref: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
text: Ba ɔɔ ra fɛrgi nyaaraa, alugɔ hɛɛhraa, di vɛɛ wibii dii tɛɛ nɛsunne. Mɛɛ ni u biibaal maa ɔɔ kpau haannɛ, a gunna chɔgi n Sɔnnaniinanii la.

ref: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
text: Ba ɔɔ chɔɔgi talma laala ninɛɛ, bá vuga kuaribɔra. Di ra nyɔɔ siŋkpega la baŋ foozee lii ba kindiire be, n Dia biini.

ref: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
text: N nɛra, ii wiarɛ n kuu dim Amɔri hina, haali baŋ faa ɛɛ nɛjaŋra lugɔ hɛriŋkpol daazi, di du kpeg lugɔ daazeŋ gba.

ref: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
text: N lizi iabuuu lii Ijip hɛri, di tɔ ii see hɛribɔduma biini, binni tokkoanɛɛ, di wa kpa Amɔri hina hɛri tɛɛ ia.

ref: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: N kaa lizi ii biibaala baŋhina ba ɛɛ n dɔgtɛɛzi, di gil ii biipɔllaa baŋhina ge birgi Nazirizi. Izrɛl hina, guŋ waa wibii ɛɛwɛa? Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ!

ref: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
text: Ka ii gillɔɔ a Nazirizi nyɔɔ siŋ. Di ŋɔ n dɔgtɛɛzi ge gilɛɛ ka lizi n amaniye.

ref: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
text: Awia, filaŋkeŋ, n daŋ taagi ia ha gunla mia n ɔɔ su torko di ga bɛri, u naazi ɔɔ tuu la.

ref: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
text: Banla n gbaŋŋɛ chɔi biini wàá lii, banla ge n kpekke la bɔra daŋ huah. Laallɔɔra gba wàá piri.

ref: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
text: Hotaara gba daŋ bir har. Laallɔɔra la ge n na chɔ werge wàá lii. Banla n tinni zagra ge gba, wàá na bahinaa.

ref: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: A hɔl hiŋ, laallɔɔra la n dɔɔ bampiree werge, daŋ kpa ba dɔŋkuna ha, ka chɔ ra nyiŋŋi ba nyuuni bɔr. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
text: Izrɛl hina, ií ra nuu Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii naa uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ di ra du ii ni naa. Iabuu u kpogli lii Ijip hɛri la.

ref: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ii bɛnnɛ n lizi lii durnya nɛra maa biini. Awia, n daŋ tɛr ii digna, dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia.

ref: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
text: Nɛra banɛɛ daŋ wer kpau vol, di ba waa nuukpaŋ dɔɔwɛa?

ref: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
text: Bunyiŋ ɔɔ ra pogzuu kɔr biini, di waa kuŋ lauwɛaa? U ɔɔ ra uuhruu, ú chɔɔribɔr di waa kumbɛl lauwɛaa?

ref: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
text: Sidɛɛ haa lau zumbee, di ba wɔɔ hewee lɛiyaa? Sidɛɛ ɔɔ tau, di kummaa wɔɔ fɛrɛɛa?

ref: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
text: Ba haa lɔ kantimantɔ bolzeŋ, di a bol hina bɔra waa saa? Di hɛhchɔg chol bolzeŋ ni, Kɔraawiizi lɛi ba u nii?

ref: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la haa waa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ, di waa a widee lizɛɛ bagli u balaa dɔgtɛɛzi.

ref: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
text: Di bunyiŋ pozoo, anɛɛ n wàá ɔmɛi? Di Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ wia, anɛɛ n wàá lizi u amaniyei?

ref: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
text: Ií ŋɔ Asdɔd ni Ijip koori diikpega be, ‘Ií chaali giŋgimee la n bar bolzeŋ Samaria la nyuuni, di na gunla a bolzeŋ n na koozi ani nɛsunnaa la n su de.’ ”

ref: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “A nɛra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ, di foozi kuna wa su ba diini, ba wia waa wibii dɔɔwɛ.”

ref: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
text: Awia, kenne mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔ, “Gunnɛ ba dɔma ba, di wa gor ba hɛri, di purgi ba diikpega, ka paagi ba diizenaa kuna.”

ref: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Gunla penɔɔni n ɔɔ wer, lɛɛ peezi la bunyiŋ n lauwɛ di ra di, naazi anɛɛ gɛɛ u digni bɛŋ la, gunnɛ bolzeŋ Samaria hina la, n chɔɔgi bá karnanaa ni la, tama wa ka.”

ref: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “A nuu n be, di karfi Jekɔb dee.

ref: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
text: A hɔl la min niŋ tɛrgi Izrɛl hina digna, dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia la, n daŋ chɔgi mbusu lizibɔra la n du Bɛtɛl la, di purgi mbusu lizibɔra maa nyigzi ta.

ref: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: N daŋ chɔgi waari saŋa ni wem saŋa diini la, di purgi diini la baŋ kpa bala nyina bɔg la, di chɔgi diizenaa maa. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
text: Emɔs kaa ŋɔ, “Samaria haana, ií ra nuu wii naa, ii banla n na pɔl lugɔ Basan hɛri nauna la n na di nɛnnɛ, banla n na tɔɔri gɛrga, di ra sunni nyaara, di ra nyiŋŋi ii janna ra tɛɛ ia siŋ la!

ref: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, di ɛɛ naniinanii la hɛɛhzɔɔrɛ, di ŋɔ, ‘Saŋa bɛl daŋ wa hel, bá kpa gɔrgazi lauri ia di ra tɛrgi, ii bɛl maa daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ nyiŋ, gɔrga n lauwɛ.

ref: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
text: Ba daŋ tɛrgi ia guŋŋ di ga kpa ia ga koŋlii bɔperii, di ha bossee. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.’ ”

ref: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
text: Ií kpa paanuu la n dɔɔ yiisi di lizi mbusu ra tɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ, di ra jigsi dikuu ii sunzaazi wia! Wia naa dɔŋaa ii ɔɔ nɔŋŋi ɛɛi. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
text: Minuu faa gillɛ lɔzi chol ii bolzenaa maa biine, diwee nyaa bol maa biini, ka ii waa sɛɛwɛ bir ba n be. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
text: Minuu faa gillɛ dooŋ chi, saŋa la ii pattikuna n na nyiŋŋi dooŋ werge la. Minuu faa gillɛ dooŋ ba bolzeŋ bɛl, ka gil bɛl, di gil u ba koo bɛl, ka gil bɛl, u hil.

ref: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Niinyɔgzi faa lau nɛra, ba ra bɛɛli, di ra gaagi bolzenaa, di ra nyiŋŋi nii bá nyɔɔ, ka ba waa nii nawɛɛ, a kukki baa, ka ii waa bittɛ ba n be. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: N faa gillɔɔ peu la n na haahri, wa chɔgi ii pattikuna. Lotorozi di ii kambola, ii grepu daazi kooni, fig ni ɔlivi daazi maa. Ka ii waa sɛɛwɛ bir ba n be. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: N faa kpa wiilchɔgaarɛ ta ii ni, alugɔ unla miŋ faa kpawɛɛ ta Ijip hina ni la. N faa kpu ii biipɔllaa laal biini, ka lauri ii zagra kaali. Lalaa sɔɔh lii ii chɔɔribɔra maa biine, di su ii miibɔɔni, ka ii waa bittɛ ba n be. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: N faa kpu ii baŋhinaa, gunla miŋ faa kpu Sɔdɔm ni Gɔmɔra hina la. Ii banla n kawɛɛ lii a laal biini ɛɛ lugɔ daa la baŋ lizɛɛ niŋ biini, ka ii waa bittɛ ba n be. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!
text: Awia, Izrɛl hina, n daŋ tɛr ii digna, dikuu guŋ wia, ií ɛɛ sirya ń di ia seriya.”

ref: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
text: Kɔraawiizii ta bizenaa ni peu, di ɔɔ gil newee zum u nfɛrɛ, di gil hɔpizaa birgi hamuŋa, di ra vol bizenaa nyuuni. U sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ!

ref: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
text: Izrɛl hina, ií ra nuu maaraa yira naa minna yir, dikuu ii wia naa.

ref: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
text: “Izrɛl hɛri la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ toloori cholloo, wàá ka izi maa. U chɔɔ hɛrii, ba vɛɛu ta, nɛr maa waa hoo, ú lalluu.”

ref: The Lord God has warned, “From every ten soldiers only one will be left; from a thousand troops, only a hundred will survive.”
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina bolzeŋ la maa laallɔɔra kagboŋ n niŋ la laal, kalfa bɛnnɛ niŋ ka. Di laallɔɔra kalfa genii, fi bɛnnɛ niŋ ka.”

ref: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ tɛɛ Izrɛl hina, “Ií ba n be di wa na miibɔɔ.

ref: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.”
text: Ií gilɛɛ waa la Bɛtɛl, di gilɛɛ waa la Gilgal, di gilɛɛ waa la bolzeŋ Bɛɛsiba, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba daŋ lauri Gilgal hina kaali hɛrduma, Bɛtɛl hina ge dim.”

ref: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
text: Emɔs ŋɔ, “Ií la Kɔraawiizi be, di ga na miibɔɔ. Di ii waa laŋŋɛ, u daŋ tuu ba Joosɛf diahina ni alugɔ niŋ. A niŋ daŋ fuuh Bɛtɛl hina, nɛr maa wàá wer dinzuu.

ref: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
text: Hinla maa n waa wibii ŋmɛnɛɛ ra hiŋ, ka ra fini nɛra, wiarɛ huuzii.

ref: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
text: Kɔraawiizii ta chinchinwilaa, ba ra yir aŋhina Kuzenibalaa, aŋhina ge Belimbetia. U ɔɔ giluu hamuŋa birgi hɔpizaa, di gil hɔpizaa birgi hamuŋa. U ɔɔ ɛɛ muuzenaa niirii, di bizaa ta hɛri ni. U sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi.

ref: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
text: U ɔɔ kpu nɛkpegaa, di chɔgi ba diikpega.

ref: You people hate judges and honest witnesses;
text: Ii hah nɛra la n na di wibiire.

ref: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.
text: Ii fir nyaaraa, di foozi ba mia. Guŋ wia, ii wàá zuu diizenaa la iiŋ kpa bia ma la biine gɛɛ di nyɔɔ grepu koonanaa la iiŋ pattɛ la siŋ.

ref: I am the Lord, and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.
text: N zum gunla ii wichɔgaa n chummɛnɛ, di zum a maga. Ii sunni nɛra la n waa bilchɔg maa dɔɔwɛɛ, di lɛɛ kuna, ka gil nyaara di bilchɔg, seriya diiribɔr.

ref: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
text: Awia, nunzunna ɔɔ tɔɔgi ba nuuzii, a saŋa hiŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, a guŋ saŋa waa wer.

ref: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
text: Ií ra nyiŋŋi winanaa ɛɛi, ka gil wichɔgaa, gunnɛ niŋ gil ii dɔɔ miibɔɔni. A guŋ ge daŋ gil Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ du ii be, gunla iiŋ ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ u du ii benii la.

ref: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
text: Ií hah wichɔgaa ka nɔŋŋi winanaa, di gil ba ra di wibii seriya diiribɔra. Aŋhinabe, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ daŋ suŋ Joosɛf dee la n kawɛɛ la ni.”

ref: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ba danna lɔɔgi wilee ŋmɛnizi maa, di ra wii ni biinichɔg bossibaana maa. Ba daŋ yir koola, bá wa wii, ka liwiire ge ra chɛɛhgi.

ref: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
text: Ba danna wii grepu daazi kooni maa biine, dikuu min niŋ ga ii biini wa kaali wia. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.” Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii wia

ref: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
text: Emɔs ŋɔ, “Wia daŋ huuzi nɛr la maa n na nyiŋŋi lugɔ Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la hel. Bɛɛwiarɛ i ra nyiŋŋi u helei? A hɔl daŋ ɛɛ bɔbiri, wàá ɛɛ bɔchaaŋ.

ref: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
text: A daŋ ɛɛu lugɔ nɛr n chɔwɛɛ lii bunyiŋ be, di ga chem amani ni, gɛɛ nɛr n zuu dia, di kpa u nonii sag koŋlii ni, hɛrikuŋ dumuu.

ref: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
text: Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la daŋ ɛɛ bɔbirii, bɔr waa chaani, u daŋ ɛɛu limpiriŋ, bɔchaaŋ kilakila maa wàá du de.”

ref: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Maa ii hɔpizizenaa ra nyiŋŋi, n kii a wiarɛ, maa chigɛ ra guua.

ref: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
text: Ií gil ii kɔɔi yira la yiraa! Maa nyiŋŋi n nuu ii janjalanzi wiraa.

ref: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
text: Izrɛl hina, binni tokkoanɛɛ la biini, iiŋ du hɛribɔduma la, ii faa lizi mbusuzi lizaa ni sunzaazi kunaa tɛŋŋ?

ref: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
text: Dikuu iinna jaami ii vuga maa koori Sakuf ni vug Kaiwan la iinna tɔgzi ii daŋ kpaa chi,

ref: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
text: di n wa duŋŋi ia bɛri Damaskus ni, di kaali hɛhjaŋ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hinnɛ, ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
text: Wia daŋ huuzi ii banla n na faazi bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm biini ni ii banla n du Samaria, di fɛ lugɔ wiimaa wàá huuzi ia la. Ii ɛɛ nɛzenaare, di du Izrɛl naa n dɔɔ sɔŋ, nɛra ba ii be, di waa nyiŋŋi hiinaa la!

ref: Look what happened to the cities of Calneh, powerful Hamath, and Gath in Philistia. Are you greater than any of those kingdoms?
text: Ií la bolzeŋ Kalnɛ ga na, di lii de la bolzeŋ Hamaf la n dɔɔ sɔŋ, di lii de la Filisti hina bolzeŋ Gaf. Aabuu faa bɔ Juda ni Izrɛl kossi diiribɔraa? Ba hɛssii faa kaali ii horaa?

ref: You are cruel, and you forget the coming day of judgment.
text: Ii waa ɔɔ sɛɛ lugɔ hɛhchɔg hɔpizii ra bau, ka ii wiɛɛlaa gil u ra dugli.

ref: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
text: Ii ɔɔ so ii karnanaa ninɛɛ, di dɛlli di ra di iihinaa. Di ra hee pepɔla ni napɔla la n vuhwɛɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
text: Ii ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi ii ra yir yirfalaarɛ, gunla Koori Deevid n ɔɔ faa ra ɛɛ la, di yiraa, di ra lɔ janjalanzi.

ref: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
text: Ii sinlibizi ɔɔ suuguu ii ra nyɔɔ, ka ra lɔ tulaale nanaa, ka ii waa ɔɔ ra wii Izrɛl puraa wia.

ref: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.
text: Awia, iabuu bá feli lauri kaali hɛrdumazi, ii diuzenaa dii ni ii chaalizenaa maa tuŋ. Kɔraawiizi n hah Izrɛl hina jigsi wia

ref: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la, hɛɛhzi u hinnɛ. Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N hah Izrɛl hina jigsii, di kii ba diizennanaa la. N daŋ kpa ba bolzeŋ la ni kuna la maa n du u biini, tɛɛ ba dɔma.

ref: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
text: Di baala fii kawɛɛ du dia, ba maa daŋ siu.

ref: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
text: Di ba lulli bɛl wa ballɔ, ú wa paa baa di ga fuuh, u daŋ pɛɛzi nɛr la maa n haa suah de, ‘I ni nɛbɛllɛ du a dia gɛɛ?’ U daŋ ŋɔ, ‘Akai!’ Denii bá lulli la bir ŋɔ, ‘Siigi! A waa dɛkkɛ yaa n yir Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ.’

ref: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
text: Dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ u daŋ purgi diizenaa ni a jigzi maa burburbur.

ref: Horses can't gallop on rocks; oceans can't be plowed. But you have turned justice and fairness into bitter poison.
text: Zagra ra chɔ bia nyuuniiwaa? Nɛra kpa naunaa di ra par dee? Ka ii kpa wibii birgi kɔrtɔ, di kpa wideŋlaa birgi wikara.

ref: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
text: Ii ta barabaraa lugɔ ii kpegli Lo Dɛba hinaa, di ta barabara lugɔ ii fɔŋŋaa, ii kpa kpegli Kanam hina.”

ref: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina, n daŋ gil hɛrduma hina laallɔɔra wa lɛɛ ii hɛri dɔɔ. Ba daŋ sunni ia lii Hamaf Ŋmɛnɛɛ n du wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag guŋŋ di ga hel Jɔɔdan Waluu n du wiifurii nodig wiikakag.”

ref: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la pilli bagliŋ, lugɔ deeza biini. A winaalii biini, n nawɔɔrɛ unna ɛɛ lotorozi sirya, saŋa la baŋ felee kuuri koori kooree, ka a kaa faari furaa la.

ref: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
text: A lotorozi n wa di a hɛri kuna maa tuŋ nyaamm, n wii di ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, gil i nɛra wichɔgaa tɛɛ baa. Ɛrɛɛ bá ɛɛ du denei? Ba waa kpil, di ɛɛ gɛrga!”

ref: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi na ba sinyɛna, di ŋɔ, “Gunla hiŋ nawɛɛ la wàá ɛɛ.”

ref: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la kaa pilli wia naa bagliŋ. N na unna ɛɛ sirya ú kpa niŋ, di di u nɛra seriya. A niŋ fuuh muuzeŋ maa, ka kaa faari di ra fuuh hɛri ge.

ref: Then I said, “Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive?”
text: Denii n kaa ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, gil guŋ! Ɛrɛɛ i nɛra ɛɛ du denei? Ba waa kpil tama maa, di kaa ɛɛ gɛrga!”

ref: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa na ba sinyɛna, di ŋɔ, “Màá gil guŋ ge gba ɛɛ.”

ref: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa pilli wia naa di bagliŋ. N na Kɔraawiizi n chigɛ pɛli koŋlii la baŋ kpa ŋmɛŋ mɛgzi, di ma. U faa kpogli a ŋmɛnnɛ.

ref: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
text: Denii u pɛɛziŋ, “Emɔs, beedee i nai?” N ŋɔ, “Maari ŋmɛŋ baŋ kpawɛɛ ra mɛgzi, di ra ma.” Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “N kpa a kunnaabuu di ra bagli lugɔ n nɛra Izrɛl hina ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ koŋlii la n waa deŋlee. Awia, màá ka na ba sinyɛna. N daŋ haŋ tɛr ba dignaa.

ref: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.” Amos and Amaziah
text: Bɔra la maa Aizik naanna n faa ra jaami la maanii niŋ chɔgi, bɔnanaananaa la maa banna tɔgzi Izrɛl hɛri la maanii ń purgi. N daŋ kpa n tokobi izi dim Koori Jeroboam diahina.” Emɔs ni Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Amazia wia

ref: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Amazia la n faa du Bɛtɛl la tili, di ŋɔ Izrɛl Koori Jeroboam be, “Emɔs ni nɛra baŋhina suahzɔɔrɛ ra ta jina, bá ɛɛi wii bɛl hɛri naa biini. U wiŋɔzi hiŋ daŋ chɔgi a hɛri.

ref: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
text: Kennaabuu u ŋɔ, ‘Koori Jeroboam daŋ siu laal biini, bá lauri Izrɛl hina maa kaali hɛrduma.’ ”

ref: Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kizeehiŋ Amazia bir ŋɔ Emɔs be, “Kaali de, Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ! Bir di ra la Juda hɛri, di gaa hum de, di na diwee ra di. La gaa ŋɔ i Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ wiŋɔzi la de.

ref: Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.”
text: Gilɛɛ kaa ra ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wia Bɛtɛl biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, u ɛɛ koori jaami bɔttɛ, di ɛɛ a hɛri maa jaami dia.”

ref: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
text: Emɔs ŋɔ Amazia be, “Maa Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ ɛɛwɛ, maa kaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ ge biibaal. N ɛɛ penɔɔnii, di kaa ra binni fig daazi ge ni.

ref: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizii liziŋ lii a peeza nɔɔnaa biini, di ŋɔ ń la gaa ŋɔ u wia di ra tɛɛ u nɛra Izrɛl hina.

ref: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, ‘I haaŋ daŋ birgi sɛnsɛnni, a bolzeŋ biini, i biibaala ni i biihaana maanii bá kpu laal biini. Ba daŋ kpa i hɛri di bɔnni nɛra, i himmaa ge daŋ siu, vugkuara hɛri, ba daŋ haŋ lauri Izrɛl hinaa kaali hɛrduma.’ ”

ref: The Lord God showed me a basket of ripe fruit
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la kaa pilli bagli mìŋ́ Emɔs, n na nɔŋaahma n du kɛɛgɔ biini.

ref: and asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied. Then he said, “This is the end for my people Israel. I won't forgive them again.
text: Kɔraawiizi pɛɛziŋ, “Beedee i nai?” N ŋɔ, “N na nɔŋaahma n du kɛɛgɔ biinii.” Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ n be, “N nɛra Izrɛl hina saŋa helloo. Màá ka suŋ ba ni.”

ref: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord, have spoken!” Israel Is Doomed The Lord said:
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Di a hɔl wa hello, a jaamaa dia biini yira daŋ birgi wiraa, dikuubɛɛwiai, lalaa daŋ chɔɔgi bɔr maa. Bɔr maa ɛɛ surumm.”

ref: You people crush those in need and wipe out the poor.
text: Ií ra nuu, ii banla n ɔɔ ra fini anuula hina, di kaa ra kpu nyaara la n du hɛri naa biini,

ref: You say to yourselves, “How much longer before the end of the New Moon Festival? When will the Sabbath be over? Our wheat is ready, and we want to sell it now. We can't wait to cheat and charge high prices for the grain we sell. We will use dishonest scales
text: di ra ŋɔ, “Saŋa bɛliirɛ Baagufalii Hɔpizizeŋ tuŋ, ka ya yoo yaa miai? Saŋa bɛliirɛ Heezaa Hɔpizii la bɛri, ka ya kaa faari di ra yoo kunai? Denii ya wer jaa kuna yoola, di ra mɛgzi kuna fintime ni, di kpa mɛgzaa kuna la n waa dɛkkɛ di ra fini nɛra.

ref: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.”
text: Yaa daŋ kpa saliŋhuŋŋa yau nyaara, di kpa gawa kebee yau anuula hina, di yoo huuti ni a zɔga.”

ref: I, the Lord, won't forget any of this, though you take great pride in your ancestor Jacob.
text: Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la, hɛɛhzɔɔrɛ di ŋɔ, “Màá suuh ba wichɔgaa la baŋ ɛɛwɛ wia.

ref: Your country will tremble, and you will mourn. It will be like the Nile River that rises and overflows, then sinks back down.
text: Awia, a hɛri daŋ zigli, nɛr la maa n du u biini, biini chɔgi. A hɛri maa daŋ zigli di chɔgi, alugɔ Muu Naal n ɔɔ su tinni, ka kaa bir wa tuu la.”

ref: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Ŋmɛnɛ bɛl, n daŋ gil wiizi chol wibaŋkanchirii ni, di gil bɔr biri wibaŋa ni.

ref: Your festivals and joyful singing will turn into sorrow. You will wear sackcloth and shave your heads, as you would at the death of your only son. It will be a horrible day.
text: N daŋ gil ii hɔpizizenaa dii, birgi liizi hɔpizaa, ii yira maa birgi wiraa. N daŋ gil ii maa fuŋ ii nyuuni, ka kpa gbɔglɔŋ laala laali. Ka ra wii lugɔ nɛr biibambikpaŋ n siuwɛ la, a hɔpizii daŋ ɛɛ hɔpizichuma.”

ref: I, the Lord, also promise you a terrible shortage, but not of food and water. You will hunger and thirst to hear my message.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Saŋa bɛl ra heluu, min niŋ gil lɔchɔgii chol a hɛri. A lɔzi wàá ɛɛ diwee gɛɛ niinyɔgzi lɔzi, u daŋ ɛɛ n wiŋɔzi nuui nyiŋŋaa wiarɛ.

ref: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord. But you won't find one.
text: Nɛra daŋ lii muuzeŋ bɛl di wa kaali bɛl, di lii wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag, di wa kaali wiifurii, di ra nyiŋŋi mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii nuui, ka ba wàá naa nuu.

ref: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, suŋgure ni biipɔlkpega daŋ huahgi, dikuu niinyɔgzi wia.

ref: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
text: Banla n niŋ hɛɛhzi Samaria, Dan ani bolzeŋ Bɛɛsiba vuga, daŋ chol, ba wàá ka izi maa.”

ref: I saw a vision of the Lord standing by the temple altar, and he said, “Shake the columns until the tops fall loose, and the doorposts crumble. Then make the pieces fall on the people below. I will take a sword and kill anyone who escapes.
text: Mìŋ́ Emɔs na Kɔraawiizi n chigɛ mbusu lizibɔr, ka ŋɔ, “Yag n Dia ligee nyuuni fɔŋŋa ni, guŋ gil a jaŋgal maa zigli. Purgaa, a chogli a nɛra nyuuni, ka n kpu nɛra la maa n kawɛɛ la, laal biini. Bɛl maa wàá wer chɔ lii a biine.

ref: “If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.
text: Haali di ba ki bɔɔ di ga lii lalaa bol gba, ka n daŋ lau baa. Di ba zinnɔɔ kaali chiŋ gba, ka n daŋ lau baa tuu hɛri.

ref: If they escape to the peaks of Mount Carmel, I'll search and find them. And if they hide from me at the bottom of the ocean, I'll command a sea monster to bite them.
text: Di ba suah Bizeŋ Kamɛl nyuu gba, ka n daŋ sɛu di lau baa. Di ba kaa ga suah muuzeŋ zɛɛ ge, n daŋ gil muuzeŋ sechɔgii la dunzi baa.

ref: I'll send a sword to kill them, wherever their enemies drag them off as captives. I'm determined to hurt them, not to help them.” His Name Is the Lord
text: Di ba dɔma genii lau baa kaali hɛri bɛl, n daŋ gil ba kpu baa de. N siaahmuu lugɔ n chɔgi baa, maa nyiŋŋi ba hiinaa.”

ref: When the Lord God All-Powerful touches the earth, it melts, and its people mourn. God makes the earth rise and then fall, just like the Nile River.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa, di ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ɔɔ gbɔgzi hɛrii, u zigli, banla maa n du u biini ra wii. Hɛri maa ɔɔ tinni ka bir tuu, alugɔ Muu Naal n ɔɔ su tinni, ka bir tuu la.

ref: He built his palace in the heavens and let its foundations rest on the earth. He scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth. His name is the Lord. The Lord Is God
text: Kɔraawiizi ma u bolle chinchiŋ, di gil u zɛɛ chi hɛri. U ɔɔ ɛɛ muuzenaa niirii, di bizaa ta hɛri. U sɔnnɛ Kɔraawiizi!

ref: Israel, I am the Lord God, and the Ethiopians are no less important to me than you are. I brought you out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Izrɛl hina, n na fɛ Itiopia hina wiarɛ werge alugɔ ia. N lizi Filisti ni Siiria hinaa lii Krit hɛri, gunla miŋ lizi ia lii Ijip hɛri la.

ref: My eyes have seen what a sinful nation you are, and I'll wipe you out. But I will leave a few of Jacob's descendants. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la ra na Izrɛl hina wichɔgaarɛ. N daŋ kpu baa, ka màá dim Jekɔb naanna durnya naa biini.

ref: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.
text: N daŋ ŋɔ wia di zigli Izrɛl hina, alugɔ baŋ kpa jeeraa di ra je sau la durnya hɛssi maa biine, di lizi banla maa n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed. The Lord's Promise to Israel
text: Ba daŋ kpu n nɛra la maa n ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra laal biini. Baabuu banla n ɔɔ ra ŋɔ, ‘Kɔraawiizi wàá gil wichɔgii maa huuzi yaa.’ ” Kɔraawiizi n niŋ bir kuari Izrɛl hina wia soŋŋi wia

ref: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Hɔpizii bɛl, n daŋ kaa bir kuari ia soŋŋi, di wa ma Koori Deevid dia la n cholle la. N daŋ bir kuari u koŋlaa ma, a chi gunla aŋ faa chigɛ la.

ref: Then you will capture Edom and the other nations that are mine. I, the Lord, have spoken, and my words will come true.
text: Awia, Izrɛl hina daŋ lɔ laal, di foozi Ɛdɔm hɛri la n kawɛɛ ni hɛssi la maa n faa ɛɛ n hora la.” Kɔraawiizi la n niŋ gil guŋ ɛɛ labuu ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: You will have such a harvest that you won't be able to bring in all of your wheat before plowing time. You will have grapes left over from season to season; your fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Hɔpizaa aŋhina ra bau, sɔgmia daŋ ɔɔ lɛɛ werge, bá kpɛllaa guŋŋ paraa saŋa kaa wa hel. Grepuzi ɔɔ hel di lɛɛ werge, bá ɔɔ kpaa daali siŋ guŋŋ a falaa kaa wa lii jaa. Siŋfalaa daŋ ɔɔ lii bizenaa nyuuni, di ra toŋzi giŋgimee nyuuni, di ra pal.

ref: I'll make Israel prosper again. You will rebuild your towns and live in them. You will drink wine from your own vineyards and eat the fruit you grow.
text: N daŋ bir kpogli n nɛra la baŋ laurɛɛ kaali hɛrdumazi la ba. Ba daŋ bir wa kuari ba bolzenaa ma, di du a biine. Ba daŋ duu grepu daazi kooni, di nyɔɔ a siŋ, di kuari kambola duu kuna, di dia.

ref: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!
text: N daŋ gil n nɛra na bɔr, di chi a hɛri la miŋ tɛɛ baa la, nɛr maa wàá ka wer lizi baa lii de. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum labuu ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: The Lord God gave Obadiah a message about Edom, and this is what we heard: “I, the Lord, have sent a messenger with orders for the nations to attack Edom.”
text: Wia la Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la n pillɛɛ bagli Obadia di ra bagli Ɛdɔm wiarɛ keŋ. Yaa nuu amaniyee lii Kɔraawiizi be. U faa hum u baliirɛ ú ba wa ŋɔ hɛssi maa hina be, “Ií izi ya ga lɔ Ɛdɔm hina laal.”

ref: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ Ɛdɔm hina benii, “N daŋ gil ii gɛrgi hɛssi hina maa be, ba maa danna gbɛlli ia werge.

ref: You live in a mountain fortress, because your pride makes you feel safe from attack, but you are mistaken.
text: Ii barabara dar iabuu, ii banla n du bia la n jaŋŋɛ di la chiŋ werge nyuuni, di ra zuu a fɔɔliizi, di ra ŋɔ iihinaa be, ‘Anɛɛ n niŋ wer hel yaa di ba yaa ni hɛrɛi?’

ref: I will still bring you down, even if you fly higher than an eagle or nest among the stars. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: Haali iiŋ la chiŋ alugɔ chig, di ma ii diini chinchiŋwilaa biini gba, ka n daŋ gil ii lii de ba hɛri. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: If thieves break in at night, they steal only what they want. And people who harvest grapes always leave some unpicked. But, Edom, you are doomed!
text: Di ŋmɛɛna gɛɛ nɛfooza ba ii be hahmuŋa ni, hɛhchɔg daŋ chol ii ni. Ba wàá ŋmɛɛ ia lɛi ba kiparaa? Di banla n na tɔrgi grepuzi faa wa tɔrgaa, ba wàá gil aŋhinaa?

ref: Everything you treasure most will be taken from you.
text: Ɛsau naanna, ba daŋ wa paagi ii daama kuna maa nyaamm, haali ii kunnanaananaa la iiŋ suahwɛ gba.

ref: Your allies can't be trusted. They will force you out of your own country. And your best friends will trick and trap you, even before you know it.
text: Nɛra la ii ni baa n dɔɔ nuukpaŋ la daŋ duŋŋi ia lii ii hɛri, ii dammuzi daŋ dar ia di kpegli ia. Banla ii ni baa n ɔɔ kpau ra di la daŋ he ia sidɛɛ, ka ii wàá zum.”

ref: Edom, when this happens, I, the Lord, will destroy all your marvelous wisdom.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ kpu Ɛdɔm nunzunna maa, a keŋ hɔpizii naa, nɛra la n na nuu wia zɛɛ daŋ lii Ɛsau bizenaa nyuuni.

ref: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out. The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
text: Tɛman hina, ɔnsii ni bɔsai daŋ chol ii laallɔɔra maa ni, banla maa n du Ɛsau bizenaa nyuuni la maanii bá kpu.

ref: You were cruel to your relatives, the descendants of Jacob. Now you will be destroyed, disgraced forever.
text: Iiŋ ga foozi ii lulla Jekɔb dee kuna, di kaa kpu baa jaa la wia, ii maanii bá kpu, ii wàá ka dɔɔ girme di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: You stood there and watched as foreigners entered Jerusalem and took what they wanted. In fact, you were no better than those foreigners.
text: Ii chigɔɔ ra binni, ka ba dɔma wa chɔgi ba dominuuzi a hɔl hiŋ. Ii ɛɛ nɛchunzii lugɔ a keŋ nɛra naa n ballɛ di wa chi Jɛrusalɛm hina kundɔɔlaa maa kaali, di ga bɔnni dɔŋa la.

ref: Why did you celebrate when such a dreadful disaster struck your relatives? Why were you so pleased when everyone in Judah was suffering?
text: A faa waa dɛkkɛ ii bɔra n sɔɔnɛɛ dikuu hɛhchɔg n chol ii lulla ni wia, di ra di iihinaa Juda hina ni, ba anuula saŋa la gɛɛ di ra ta barabara werge, ba tɔɔrɔɔ dii hiŋ biini.

ref: They are my people, and you were cruel to them. You went through their towns, sneering and stealing whatever was left.
text: A faa waa dɛkkɛ iiŋ zuu n nɛra bolzeŋ, di ra di iihinaa ba ni, ba anuula saŋa gɛɛ di paagi ba kundɔɔlaa a hɛhchɔg hɔpizii hiŋ.

ref: In their time of torment, you ambushed refugees and handed them over to their attackers. The Lord Will Judge the Nations
text: A faa waa dɛkkɛ iiŋ chigɛ ŋmɛnichechema di ra lauri banla n ga de chɔ ra kaali la. A faa waa dɛkkɛ iiŋ kpa baa du ba dɔma nonee biini, ba biinichɔg hɔpizii hiŋ.

ref: The day is coming when I, the Lord, will judge the nations. And, Edom, you will pay in full for what you have done.
text: Hɔpizii la mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi n niŋ di durnya hɛssi hina seriya duglɔɔrɛ. Ɛdɔm hina, wii la iiŋ kpawɛɛ ɛɛ ii dɔŋahina la, guŋ himmaanii bá kpa ɛɛ ii ge. Ii wiɛɛlaa la daŋ bir laŋŋi ii ni.

ref: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace. Victory for Israel
text: N nɛra nyɔɔ n tɔɔrɔɔ niirɛ werge n giŋgimiinanii la nyuu. Ka hɛssi la maa n baruu la daŋ haa nyɔɔ n tɔɔrɔɔ nii werge maa, ba daŋ nyɔɔu kpɛlɛŋŋ, ka siu.

ref: The Lord's people who escape will go to Mount Zion, and it will be holy. Then Jacob's descendants will capture the land of those who took their land.
text: Ka Jekɔb domee daŋ na lɛɛi Bizeŋ Ziɔn nyuu, ú ɛɛ kunnaniinanii, di ɛɛ ba kapɛttɛ bá ra di.

ref: Israel will be a fire, and Edom will be straw going up in flames. The Lord has spoken!
text: Jekɔb ni Joosɛf domeezi maa daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ niŋ. Ba daŋ chɔgi Ɛsau domee gunla niŋ n ɔɔ di kɔlaa bɛl maa wàá ka ka la. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.
text: Nɛra daŋ lii Nɛgɛv, di wa lɛɛ Ɛdɔm hɛri bizenaa nyuuni, di so. Nɛra kaa lii wiicholii giŋgimee nyuuni di wa lɛɛ Filisti hɛri maa so. A Izrɛl hina daŋ wa lɛɛ Ɛfram ni Samaria hina hɛssi maa. Ka Bɛnjamin domee ge lɛɛ Giliad hɛri di so.

ref: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.
text: Izrɛl hina la baŋ laurɛɛ ba ga so Keenan hɛri la, daŋ lɛɛ a hɛri haali di ga lii Zarɛfaf, banla ge n lii Jɛrusalɛm di wa so Sɛfarad la daŋ lɛɛ Nɛgɛv bolzenaa waa maa.

ref: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
text: Jɛrusalɛm laallɔɔra la n lɔ laal lii, daŋ ga lɔ Ɛdɔm hina, di lɛɛ ba hɛri, di ra di kora ba ni. Ka de hɛri kossi maa jaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hora.”

ref: One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai,
text: Kɔraawiizi faa ŋɔ wiarɛ tɛɛ Amitai biibaal Joona, di ŋɔ,

ref: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
text: “Izi la bolzeŋ Ninɛvɛ, di ga ŋɔ wia du u nɛra ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba wichɔgaa kannɔɔ werge n be.”

ref: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
text: Ka Joona di nyiŋŋi ŋmɛnɛɛ ú la Taasis, ú faa wer chɔ lii Kɔraawiizi be. Uŋ ga hel Jɔpa muu nua, u na muugberzeŋ bɛl n na la Taasis. U turgi u chaaji, ka zuu ú la Taasis, di chɔ lii Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.
text: Uŋ zuuwɛ ba ra la la, Kɔraawiizi gil pezeŋ izi ra ta ba ni fuufuu, a muugberzeŋ ra nyiŋŋi u pergi.

ref: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.
text: Ɔnsii jaa lau a muugberzeŋ biini hina maa, bɛl maa ra yir u vug ú wa lɛɛu. Ba jaa ligzi ba bunni di ra ha a nii biini, ka a gberzeŋ wer du fug di kpa baa la. A saŋa di Joona waa tuuwo ga chɔɔ a muugberzeŋ zɛɛ, di ra chɔɔ dɔɔ werge maa, haali di waa zum wii la n na ɛɛ gba.

ref: The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
text: Denii a muugberzeŋ nabɔma tuu la bɔr la uŋ chɔɔwɛ, di ga lalluu di ŋɔ, “Izi! Ɛrɛɛ i ra chɔɔ dɔɔ werge saŋa naa dɔŋɛi? Izi suŋŋi i vug. Aŋhinabe, u daŋ na yaa sinyɛna di lɛɛ yaa, yaa wàá siuzi.”

ref: Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
text: Denii a muugberzeŋ biini huŋhunna maa ŋɔ, “Ií gil ya nyiŋŋi nɛr la n gillɛ siaahmu naa huuzi yaa keŋ.” Ba jaa ga ta kuna, bá zum a hiŋ, a chol Joona ni.

ref: They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
text: Ba ŋɔ u be, “Bagli yaa wii la n baani wia naa huuzi yaa keŋ. Anɛɛ hinnɛi? Bɛɛ humaa i ra hummɛi? Lee i liiyɛi? Hɛrbɛliirɛ i liiyɛi? Nɛbɛlii deere hinnɛi?”

ref: Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
text: Denii u ŋɔ ba be, “Hibru hinuurɛ miŋ, n na jaami Kɔraawiizi La N Na Di Kora Chiŋ la. Waabuu du chiŋ, di ta muuzeŋ ni hɛri la.”

ref: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
text: Uŋ wa ŋɔ guŋ, ɔnsii lau baa werge maa, ba pɛɛzuu, “Ɛrɛɛ i ɛɛ gunnɛi?” Ba teŋ zummɔ lugɔ u chɔwɔɔrɛ, Kɔraawiizi gilɛɛ wer nau hum, dikuu gunla uŋ teŋ ŋɔ ba be la wia.

ref: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
text: Ka pekpeg haa ra ta werge maa. Ba pɛɛzuu, “Ɛrɛɛ ya ɛɛi, ka a pekpeg siigɛi?”

ref: Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
text: U ŋɔ, “Ií kpaŋ ha a muu biini, ka bɔr chaani tɛɛ ia. N zummɔ lugɔ n benii a tɔɔrɔɔ naa lii di ra huuzi ia la.”

ref: The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute.
text: Ka a huŋhunna ɛɛ ania maa bá faa wer saa a muugbera di la a muunua di ga chi. Ka ba waa wette, dikuu a pekpeg n nyaŋŋɛɛ wia.

ref: So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.”
text: Denii ba suŋŋi wiizi, di ŋɔ, “Hoi, Kɔraawiizi, jaande maa, gilɛɛ gil ya siu dikuu baal naa kpui wia. Gilɛɛ gil ya di bilchɔg dikuu biinihuŋŋu hiŋ naa kpui wia. I kipar wiarɛ i ra duu siaahmu naa.”

ref: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.
text: Denii a nɛra jaa lau Joona, di kpau ta a nii biini. Baŋ wa tau tuŋ, a nii siigi kakpaŋ!

ref: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
text: Ɔnsii lau baa, ba ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi werge maa, di lizi mbusu lizaa kuna tɛu, di kaa hɛɛhzi lugɔ ba danna jaamuu.

ref: The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi jaa gil nyinzeŋ bɛl ba, di wa lau Joona lil. U du a nyiŋ hia hɔpizaa ahoro ni hamuŋzi ahoro.

ref: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
text: Joona n du a nyiŋ hia la, u suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi la unna hum la,

ref: When I was in trouble, Lord, I prayed to you, and you listened to me. From deep in the world of the dead, I begged for your help, and you answered my prayer.
text: di ŋɔ, “N anuula biinii n yir hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi, i nuu tɛŋ. Miŋ du lalaa bol la n luŋŋe werge biini, n lɔ wilee tɛi, i nuu n wile hiŋ.

ref: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.
text: I faa kpambuu ta niizeŋ biini, a muuzeŋ zɛɛ himmaa, bɔr la niiri maa n bariŋ, nii tɔ n ni di ra lɔŋ werge maa la.

ref: I thought I was swept away from your sight, never again to see your holy temple.
text: Denii n ŋɔ, ‘Hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi duŋŋimbuu lii i be. Ka n daŋ haa bir n siwee chaŋ i Diinaniinanii la.’

ref: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.
text: A nii tɔ n ni di ra nyiŋŋi u kpuŋ, di bariŋ vil biini, nii biini kooree ge wa tɔ n nyuu maa ni.

ref: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.
text: N tuu la bizenaa zɛɛzi maa, a ɛɛ lugɔ baŋ tɔŋ dia, màá ka lii maa. Ka i lizimbuu a vil biini, n haa dɔɔ miibɔɔ, Kɔraawiizi la minna hum!

ref: When my life was slipping away, I remembered you— and in your holy temple you heard my prayer.
text: Miŋ faa waa kaa dɔɔ tamii maa n miibɔɔ wia la, n liizi i wia. N wiisuŋŋaa helii, i nuu n be lii i Diinaniinanii la biini.

ref: All who worship worthless idols turn from the God who offers them mercy.
text: Banla n na kuari vuga n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ la, vɛɛ i hiŋaarɛ.

ref: But with shouts of praise, I will offer a sacrifice to you, my Lord. I will keep my promise, because you are the one with power to save.
text: Ka miŋwaa, n daŋ yir yira di ra chɔlii, di kaa ra lizi mbusuzi kuna ra tɛi. Wii la maa miŋ hɛɛhzɛɛ ŋɔ nua lugɔ n daŋ ɛɛ tɛi, n daŋ ɛɛu. Lɛɛi lii hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi bɛŋ benii.”

ref: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi gil nyiŋ la ug Joona ha a muuzeŋ baŋgia.

ref: Once again the Lord told Jonah
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ wia Joona be bunɛɛ, di ŋɔ,

ref: to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
text: “Izi la bolzeŋ Ninɛvɛ, di ga lizi n amaniye tɛɛ baa.”

ref: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.
text: Denii Joona jaa hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nua, di izi la bolzeŋ Ninɛvɛ. Ninɛvɛ faa kannɔɔ werge, hɔpizaa ahoroo í kpa vol lii u tuna bɛl di ga hel bɛl.

ref: After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
text: Joona n ga zuu a bol, u jaa faari di ra ŋɔ wia kpegzi ni, di ŋɔ, “A ka hɔpizaa tokkoanɛɛ, ka Ninɛvɛ maa purgi!”

ref: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
text: Denii Ninɛvɛ hina maa yardi Kɔraawiizi. Ba gil nɛr maa, nabɔnzi ni bichalli maa vɔɔ nua, di tɔ gbɔglɔnzi, guŋ bagli lugɔ ba biine chɔkkɔɔ dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.

ref: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.
text: Ninɛvɛ koori n wa nuu guŋ, u izi u koorikara ni kakpaŋ, di wir u koori tagtazi, ka la ga kpa gbɔglɔŋ tɔ, di ga so hɔɔhri biini, dikuu u biini n chɔkkɛ wia.

ref: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
text: Kɔraawiizi n wa na gunla baŋ ɛɛwɛ, di gil ba wichɔgaa ɛɛi la, u suŋ ba ni. Waa kaa tɛr ba digna gunla uŋ faa ŋɔ u daŋ ɛɛ baa la.

ref: So he prayed: Our Lord, I knew from the very beginning that you wouldn't destroy Nineveh. That's why I left my own country and headed for Spain. You are a kind and merciful God, and you are very patient. You always show love, and you don't like to punish anyone.
text: U suŋŋi wiizi, di ŋɔ, “Hoi, Kɔraawiizi, miŋ faa du bol la, keŋ lɛi n faa ŋɔaa? Awiarɛ n faa hahzi chɔ kaali Taasis la. N zummɔ lugɔ i ɔɔ ra na nɛra sinyɛnaa, di ra suŋ ba ni. I baaŋ waa fuuh manaŋ. I kaa nɔŋŋi nɛra werge maa. I daŋ wer gil nɛra wichɔgaa tɛɛ baa, di gil wii la hiŋ faa dauwɛ lugɔ i ɛɛ di kpu baa.

ref: Now let me die! I'd be better off dead.
text: Awia, n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, hiŋ gillɛ n siu, gunnɛ bɔ miŋ du de.”

ref: The Lord replied, “What right do you have to be angry?”
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi bir pɛɛzuu, “A dɛkkɔɔ i baan na fuuhwaa?”

ref: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
text: Joona jaa izi lii ga so a bol wiifurii, di du pampanni so u biini, ka ra kpaŋ wii la n niŋ wa ɛɛ a bolzeŋ hina.

ref: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine,
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi gil laalinla lii tinni wa tɔ a pampanni ni, u chunchugli wa tɔ Joona ni, wiizi waa kaa ra kpuu. Joona bɔra jaa sɔɔni werge maa dikuu guŋ wia.

ref: but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up.
text: Hɔɔŋ wa pizɛɛ, Kɔraawiizi gil sandul ba wa di a laalinla, u siu.

ref: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
text: Wiizi n wa baŋŋɛ, Kɔraawiizi gil pewem lii wiifurii di waa ta Joona ni, wiizi ra kpuu werge maa, u ra bɛɛli di ra nyiŋŋi u siu. U ŋɔ, “Amɔ, n siu waa bɔ n de dui naa?”

ref: But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?” “Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
text: Kɔraawiizi pɛɛzuu, “A dɛkkɔ hiŋ na baaŋ dikuu a laalinla naa siu wiaa?” Joona ŋɔ, “Ɛɛh! A dɛkkɔɔ n na baaŋ di siu gba!”

ref: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi kaa pɛɛzuu, “I biini chɔkkɔɔ dikuu a laalinla siu wiaa? Haa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ ka u lii. U liwɔɔrɛ di hel hɔpizikpaŋ biini, di kaa siu hɔpizikpaŋ ge.

ref: I am Micah from Moresheth. And this is the message about Samaria and Jerusalem that the Lord gave to me when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah. Judgment on Samaria
text: Kɔraawiizi faa pilli Samaria ni Jɛrusalɛm wiarɛ lugɔ deeza biini, di bagli mìŋ́ Maika n lii Mɔrɛsɛf. A saŋaa Jɔtam, Ahaz ani Hɛzɛkia faa di kossi, Juda hɛri la.

ref: Listen, all of you! Earth and everything on it, pay close attention. The Lord God accuses you from his holy temple.
text: Durnya hɛssi hina maa, ií ra nuu! Kuna la maa n du hɛri, ií ra nuu! Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la daŋ hau ii ni, u Diinaniinanii la biini,

ref: And he will come down to crush underfoot every pagan altar.
text: Kɔraawiizi lii u duuribɔttɛ tuu ra ba. U tuuwoo ra ba, ú wa vol bizenaa nyuuni.

ref: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.
text: Denii bizenaa ŋmɛɛri u naazi zɛɛ, walli maa pergi alugɔ kel n dugli niŋ di ra ŋmɛɛri la gɛɛ gunla nii n ɔɔ pal di ra tuu bɔwillii la.

ref: This will happen because of the terrible sins of Israel, the descendants of Jacob. Samaria has led Israel to sin, and pagan altars at Jerusalem have made Judah sin.
text: Annii maa daŋ ɛɛu, dikuu Izrɛl hina wichɔgaa wia. Izrɛl hina wichɔgaarɛ a bɛlaai? Samaria hina wichɔgaa lɛiyaa? Juda hina vuga kuaribɔttɛ lee? Jɛrusalɛm lɛiyaa?

ref: So the Lord will leave Samaria in ruins— merely an empty field where vineyards are planted. He will scatter its stones and destroy its foundations.
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ u daŋ gil bolzeŋ Samaria puri, di chɔɔ kulululu, di birgi grepu daazi pattibɔr. U daŋ chɔgi a bolzeŋ, di paa u bia maa ga ha waluu biini, ka gil a bolzeŋ zɛɛ maa chɔɔ.

ref: Samaria's idols will be smashed, and the wages of temple prostitutes will be destroyed by fire. Silver and gold from those idols will then be used by foreigners as payment for prostitutes. Judah Is Doomed
text: Samaria hina vuga maanii bá purgi burburbur, di fuuh ba vuga dia kuna maa ani ba vuga maa. Dikuu baŋ naa di lii sɛnsɛnna kinturgaa biinii wia, gunnɛ bá kaa kpaa ga turgi sɛnsɛnna yembɛl. Wiraa ni biinichɔg wia

ref: Because of this tragedy, I go barefoot and naked. My crying and weeping sound like howling wolves or ostriches.
text: Dikuu keŋ wia, mìŋ́ Maika daŋ lɔ wile, di ra wii, di ra vol ni n naadumazi ni chakpal, di ra bar. N danna uuli alugɔ hohobia n na wii, di kaa ra wii alugɔ kikiu.

ref: Don't tell it in Gath! Don't even cry. Instead, roll in the dust at Beth-Leaphrah.
text: Ií gilɛɛ waa ŋɔ Gaf hina be, di gilɛɛ waa wii de gba. Bɛf Ɔfra hina, ií chɔɔ bumburi biini di ra billi, dikuu ii biinichɔg wia.

ref: Depart naked and ashamed, you people of Shaphir. The town of Bethezel mourns because no one from Zaanan went out to help.
text: Safir hina, ba daŋ wa lauri ia ni ii chakpalli, di kaali hɛrduma, ii di hiihzi. Zaanan hina wàá kur lii ba bolzeŋ. Di ii wa nuu Bɛf Ɛzɛl hina n na wii, ii daŋ zum lugɔ suahribɔr waa hoo de.

ref: Everyone in Maroth hoped for the best, but the Lord sent disaster down on Jerusalem.
text: Marɔf hina chigɔɔ, ba bɔra ra waazi, di ra kpaŋ ba na lɛɛi, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ hɛhchɔg chol ba ni, haali di ga hel Jɛrusalɛm dominuuzeŋ la gba.

ref: Get the war chariots ready, you people of Lachish. You led Jerusalem into sin, just as Israel did.
text: Ii banla ge n du Lakis, ií lauri ii zagra vɔɔzi a laal torkozi ni. Ii chanzi Izrɛl hina wichɔgaarɛ, di gil Jɛrusalɛm hina ɛɛ wichɔgaa.

ref: Now you will have to give a going-away gift to Moresheth. Israel's kings will discover that they cannot trust the town of Achzib.
text: Awia, filaŋkeŋ, Juda hina, ií ta Mɔrɛsɛf Gaf hina ŋmɛnɛɛ. Izrɛl koora wàá ka na hiinaa, lii Akzib hina be maa.

ref: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.
text: Marɛsa hina, Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa ia du ii dɔma nonee, bá ba wa foozi ii bol dɔɔ. Izrɛl hina sitɔɔra daŋ la ga suah Adulam bia bɔɔni.

ref: Judah, shave your head as bald as a vulture and start mourning. Your precious children will be dragged off to a foreign country.
text: Juda hina, ií gbaari ii nyuuni alugɔ duuni, dikuu ii biine n chɔkkɛ, ii bichalli la iin nɔŋŋɛɛ wia. Ba daŋ wa lauri baa yoma, di kaali hɛrduma.

ref: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.
text: Wia daŋ wa huuzi banla n ɔɔ chɔɔ hamuŋa ni, di ra ta wichɔgaa ɛɛi jina la! Di hɔɔ wa pizɔɔ, ba ɔɔ na bɔttɛ, di jaa ra ɛɛ a wichɔgaa la jina baŋ tawɛɛ la.

ref: You grab any field or house that you want; you cheat families out of homes and land.
text: Di koonii ba ra nyiŋŋi, ba ɔɔ foozaabuu. Di diini genii ba ra nyiŋŋi, guŋ himmaanii ba ɔɔ ɛɛ. Nɛr maa waa ɔɔ dɔɔ u diahina gɛɛ u kundɔɔlaa fɔŋŋa.

ref: But here is what the Lord says: “I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.”
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N na ta hɛhchɔg jinaa ń wa ta ii ni, ii bɛl maa wàá wer lii u biini. Ii wàá ka wer na bɔr di ra vol barabara ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, a saŋa daŋ ɛɛ saŋa chuma.

ref: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: “Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.”
text: Di a hɔpizii wa hello, nɛra danna ɛɛ ia chɛɛtɛ, di ɔɔ yir biinichɔg yir naa, di ra ɛɛ ia chɛɛtɛ, di ra ŋɔ, ‘Yaa wiimaa chɔkkɔɔ tuŋ! Kɔraawiizi lɛɛ yaa hɛrii, tɛɛ nɛra la n wa lauri yaa kaali la.’ ”

ref: “Enough of your preaching!” That's what you tell me. “We won't be disgraced, so stop preaching!”
text: Ba dɔgtɛɛzi ŋɔ, “Gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ wia la n niŋ wa huuzi yaa, di ra du yaa ni, hiihzi wàá kpu yaa.

ref: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?
text: I fɛwɔɔrɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi see Izrɛl hinaa nuaa? Kɔraawiizi kanyitti dii tunnɔɔwaa? Wibii maa, wàá sɛɛ ɛɛ wia naa dɔŋa. U ɔɔ ra ŋɔ wiarɛ bɔɔiih di ra tɛɛ banla n na ɛɛ wideŋlaa.”

ref: My people, you have turned against one another! You have even stolen clothes right off the backs of innocent neighbors who pass by in peace.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi bir ŋɔ, “Ii ballɔɔ wa lɔ n nɛra alugɔ ba dɔma. N nɛra ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baala n lii laal di ra ba, di ra fɛ lugɔ ba dɔɔ bampirsɔnaa bol, ka ii du de di ra kpaŋ, ii foozi ba laala lii ba be.

ref: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord.
text: Ii duŋŋi n nɛra haanaa lii ba diinanaa la baŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ werge maa biine. Ii tɔ ba biizii ŋmɛnɛɛ lugɔ ba ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá na n kissaa.

ref: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord's people, and you will be destroyed.
text: Ií izi bɔnnaa kaali, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii heezi bɔr lɛi ɛŋ! De doŋŋoo di puri, waa kaa dɔɔ kuaraa maa.

ref: The only prophet you want is a liar who will say, “Drink and get drunk!” A Promise of Hope
text: Nɛra naa ra nyiŋŋi dɔgtɛɛ la n na kanni karaa di ra dar nɛra, di ɔɔ ra ŋɔ, ‘N na ŋɔu lugɔ siŋ iri maa daŋ pur tɛɛ ia.’

ref: I, the Lord, promise to bring together the people of Israel who have survived. I will gather them, just as a shepherd brings sheep together, and there will be many.
text: Wibii maa, n daŋ chaali ii maa, Izrɛl hina. Wibii maa, n daŋ chaali Izrɛl hina la n kawɛɛ. N daŋ chaali baa alugɔ peeza n du a loŋ, alugɔ peeza n du a diiribɔr, nɛkpila werge daŋ su a bɔr.”

ref: I will break down the gate and lead them out— then I will be their king.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ pilli ŋmɛnɛɛ tɛɛ baa, di kpogli baa lii hɛrduma. Ba daŋ kuugi a bolzeŋ dominuuzenaa, di lii kaali. Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ ba koori la, daŋ tɔ ba see.

ref: Listen to me, you rulers of Israel! You know right from wrong,
text: Denii mìŋ́ Maika ŋɔ, “Izrɛl sitɔɔra, ií ra nuu! A dɛkkɔɔ iinna di wibii,

ref: but you prefer to do evil instead of what is right. You skin my people alive. You strip off their flesh,
text: ka ii hah winanaarɛ, ka nɔŋŋi wichɔgaa. Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ iiŋ lalli n nɛra bɔrahɔna, di sih ba ola lii ba hoga ni alugɔ sechɔgaa.

ref: break their bones, cook it all in a pot, and gulp it down.
text: Ii hee n nɛraa, di sih ba hɔna, di purgi ba hoga maa. Di mɔnni baa alugɔ ol, bá kpa du gbɛɛrɛɛ.”

ref: Someday you will beg the Lord to help you, but he will turn away because of your sins.
text: Denii bá lɔ wile tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, ka wàá hagzi baa. A saŋa hiŋ, u daŋ bir luŋ kpu baa, dikuu ba wichɔgaa la baŋ ɛɛwɛ wia.

ref: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:
text: Kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Dɔgtɛɛzi la waa, n ɔɔ ra dar n nɛra ba ra leu la, di nɛr haŋ waa tɛɛ baa diwee, ba ɔɔ ra sii bampirsɔna wiarɛ. Ka di guŋ waa haŋ wa du de, ba ɔɔ ra ɔnzuubuu ni laal.

ref: “You will live in the dark, far from the sight of the sun, with no message from me.
