text: Awia, dɔgtɛɛzi, hamuŋa daŋ ba, ii wàá ka wer ra na wia lugɔ deeza biini. Bɔr biri, ii wàá ka wer vug. Wiizi daŋ chol tɛɛ dɔgtɛɛzi, hɔpizaa biri tɛɛ baa.

ref: You prophets and fortunetellers will all be disgraced, with no message from me.”
text: Hiihzi daŋ kpu sinaara, vugra ge di hiihzi. Ba maa daŋ tɔɔgi ba siwee, dikuu baŋ waa wiimaa nuuwɛ lii Kɔraawiizi be wia.”

ref: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.
text: Ka miŋwaa, Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ u Duma iziŋ, di tɛŋ fɔŋŋa, n dɔɔ bɔkpega, ń di wibii tɛɛ Izrɛl hina, di bagli baa ba wichɔgaa.

ref: So listen to my message, you rulers of Israel! You hate justice and twist the truth.
text: Izrɛl hina sitɔɔra, ií ra nuu ɛŋ! Ii hah wibii diire, ka kpa kara birgi wibii.

ref: You make cruelty and murder a way of life in Jerusalem.
text: Ii kpa nɛkpui ni biinikpolaa, di ma Jɛrusalɛm.

ref: You leaders accept bribes for dishonest decisions. You priests and prophets teach and preach, but only for money. Then you say, “The Lord is on our side. No harm will come to us.”
text: Ii sitɔɔra ɔɔ lɛɛ kunaa, ka ra di seriya, kizeehina ɔɔ bagli nɛra, ka ra lɛɛ kebee. Dɔgtɛɛzi ge ɔɔ ŋɔ wia tɛɛ nɛra, ka ra lɛɛ baa kebee. Ka ba dɛlli Kɔraawiizi di ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi waa yaa be duwɛɛ lɛiyaa? Awia, hɛhchɔg maa wàá chol yaa ni.”

ref: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.
text: Dikuu ii wia. Ba daŋ par Ziɔn alugɔ koo, Jɛrusalɛm birgi hembugle di chɔɔ kulululu, Kɔraawiizi Dia giŋgimii ge birgi kɔr.

ref: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills, and every nation will rush to it.
text: Saŋa bɛl n na ba, a bizeŋ la baŋ ma Kɔraawiizi Dia chiŋŋi u nyuu la daŋ la chiŋ kaali anla maa n baruu la. Durnya hɛssi nɛra maa waa nyiŋŋi u bɔr.

ref: People of many nations will come and say, “Let's go up to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
text: Hɛrkpila hina maa daŋ ɔɔ ba de di wa ŋɔ, “Ií ba ya tinni Kɔraawiizi bizeŋ, di ga zuu Kɔraawiizi la Izrɛl hina n na hum la Dia biini. Kɔraawiizi daŋ bagli yaa u widaulaa, guŋ gil ya ra hiŋ u ŋmɛnizi.” U Gbɔg daŋ lii Ziɔn, u wiŋɔzi lii Bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm.

ref: He will settle arguments between distant and powerful nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never again make war or attack one another.
text: U daŋ di hɛssi hina maa seriya, hɛssi la hina n kpekke werge kaluzii ú laafi. A hɛssi maa hina daŋ kpa ba tokobizi luu para, di kpa ba kandaazi ge luu daazi kɛuraa kizizi. Laal maa daŋ tuŋ, ba wàá kaa ra helli laal lɔi.

ref: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.
text: Baal maa daŋ so u himmaa grepu ni u fig daa zɛɛ chunchugli, ka nɛr maa wàá ka ɔnzuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hinnɛ ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
text: Aŋhinabe, hɛssi hina maanii ninna hiŋ ba vuga, ka yaawaa danna hiŋ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. Kɔraawiizi jina wia

ref: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “A hɔl hiŋ, n daŋ chaali gbɛraa, di chaali banla maa baŋ laurɛɛ kaali hɛrdumazi ani banla miŋ gillɛ ba biine chɔgi la.

ref: Then the lame and the outcasts will belong to my people and become a strong nation. I, the Lord, will rule them from Mount Zion forever.
text: N daŋ gil banla n ɛɛ gbɛraa ka, banla baŋ duŋŋɛɛ la ge birgi hɛrkpeg hina. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii niŋ ɛɛ ba koori, di lii Bizeŋ Ziɔn, di lii a hɔl hiŋ, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.”

ref: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?
text: Bɛɛwiarɛ i ra chɛɛhgi gunnɛi? Haa koori dɔɔwɛ gɛɛ? I bagli siuwɔɔ, guŋ gil bɔwiila lawii alugɔ hilula n lɔ haaŋ laa?

ref: Keep on groaning with pain, you people of Jerusalem! If you escape from your city to the countryside, you will still be taken as prisoners to Babylonia. But later I will rescue you from your enemies.
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií ra miŋŋi di ra hɛm, gunla hilula n ɔɔ lɔ haaŋ la, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii daŋ lii a bolzeŋ naa filaŋkeŋ, di ga chɔɔ a bol laŋgara. Ii daŋ la Babilɔn, ka denii Kɔraawiizi ga lɛɛ ia lii ii dɔma be.

ref: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, “We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.”
text: Ka filaŋkeŋ, hɛrkpila hina maanii chaalɛɛ, bá lɔ ia laal. Ba ra ŋɔu, “Jɛrusalɛm dɛg chɔgaarɛ! Yaa daŋ na a bolzeŋ naa puraa!”

ref: But they don't know that I, the Lord, have gathered them here to grind them like grain.
text: Ka ba waa Kɔraawiizi nfɛrɛ zummɛ, ba waa kaa zum u wilauraa ge ŋmɛnizi. Ba waa zummɛ lugɔ u chaali baabuu, ú tɛr ba digna gunla baŋ ɔɔ chaali mia dau, bá lɔ la.

ref: Smash them to pieces, Zion! I'll let you be like a bull with iron horns and bronze hoofs. Crush those nations and bring their wealth to me, the Lord of the earth.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií izi di la ga tɛr ii dɔma digna! N daŋ tɛɛ ia fɔŋŋa, ii du kpeg alugɔ nabal n dɔɔ lugbia nyigzi ani danyɛ naafiraa. Ii daŋ kpegli hɛrkpila hina, di foozi ba daama maa, baŋ lɔ laal paagi, di wa tɛɛ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la n na di kora durnya maa ni la.”

ref: Jerusalem, enemy troops have surrounded you; they have struck Israel's ruler in the face with a stick.
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií chaali ii laallɔɔra! Ba fɔɔ yaabuu! Ba daŋ kpa lugbidaa chɛ Izrɛl koori lia. Koori daŋ lii Bɛtlihɛm

ref: Bethlehem Ephrath, you are one of the smallest towns in the nation of Judah. But the Lord will choose one of your people to rule the nation— someone whose family goes back to ancient times.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Juda hɛri bola maa boljiga Bɛtlihɛm naa n du Ɛfrata paga, haali hiŋ du jiga Juda hina domeezi maa biini gba, ka i biinii ń lizi sitɔɔri, ú ɛɛ Izrɛl koori. U zɛɛ lii faa maanii.”

ref: The Lord will abandon Israel only until this ruler is born, and the rest of his family returns to Israel.
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi daŋ vɛɛ Izrɛl hina tɛɛ ba dɔma, di ra ba saŋa la a haaŋ n niŋ lul a keŋ biibaal naa. Denii u lulla la n kawɛɛ, jaa bir ba, di wa jaa Izrɛl hina ni.

ref: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness,
text: Di u wa ballɔ, u daŋ kpa Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa ni u girme di ra binni u nɛra ni. Ba daŋ du ni bampirsɔna, dikuubɛɛwiai, durnya nɛra maa daŋ sɛɛ u zenni,

ref: because he will bring peace. Assyria Will Be Defeated Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers
text: waabuu niŋ ba bampirsɔna ni. Lɛɛi ni dignitɛraa wia Di Asiiria hina wa zuu yaa hɛri, di zuu yaa diikpega biine, yaa daŋ lizi yaa sitɔɔra la n kpekke werge, bá lɔ baa.

ref: whose strong army will defeat the nation of Assyria. Yes, our leaders will rescue us, if those Assyrians dare to invade our land. The Survivors Will Be Safe
text: A sitɔɔra daŋ kpa dɔŋkuna, di kpegli Asiiria n ɛɛ Nimrɔd hɛri, di lɛɛ yaa lii Asiiria hina be, di ba wa zuu yaa hɛri.

ref: A few of Jacob's descendants survived and are scattered among the nations. But the Lord will let them cover the earth like dew and rain that refreshes the soil.
text: Izrɛl hina banla n kawɛɛ, daŋ du nɛra biini alugɔ ŋmɛnii n lii Kɔraawiizi be, alugɔ dooŋ n ballɛ du kooree ni. Ba daŋ dɛlli Kɔraawiizi ni, ka gil newea.

ref: At present they are scattered, but later they will attack, as though they were fierce lions pouncing on sheep. Their enemies will be torn to shreds, with no one to save them;
text: Banla n kawɛɛ a hɛssi biine, daŋ ɛɛ gunla bunyiŋ n ɔɔ du kɔr ni sela diiribɔr biine, di ra nyiŋŋi diwee la. U ɔɔ zuu peeza biinii, di ra lauraa, di ra chuuraa, di gil a waa ɔɔ dɔɔ lɛɛi tamii.

ref: they will be helpless, completely destroyed. Idols Will Be Destroyed in Israel
text: Guŋ himmaanii Izrɛl hina kpegli ba dɔma, di kpu ba maa nyaamm.

ref: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots,
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “A hɔl hiŋ, n daŋ kpu ii zagra, di chɔgi ii laal torkozi.

ref: as well as your cities and your fortresses.
text: N daŋ chɔgi ii hɛri bolzenaa, di kaa purgi ii diikpega maa.

ref: I will stop you from telling fortunes and practicing witchcraft.
text: N daŋ chɔgi ii hiri, ii wàá ka wer kpa ii hiri ra bugmi nɛra.

ref: You will no longer worship the idols or stone images you have made— I will destroy them,
text: N daŋ chɔgi ii vugsɛɛhlaa ani anla n ɛɛ bia, ii wàá kaa ra togni kuna la iiŋ kuarɛɛ.

ref: together with the sacred poles and even your towns.
text: N daŋ wigzi ii vughaaŋ Asɛra daazi lii ii hɛri, di chɔgi ii bolzenaa maa.

ref: I will become furious and take revenge on the nations that refuse to obey me.
text: Hɛssi la hina maa n wàá sɛɛ hiŋ n nua, n daŋ kpa n baaŋfuuih turgi baa ba wichɔgaa kim werge maa.”

ref: The Lord said to his people: Come and present your case to the hills and mountains.
text: Ií ra nuu gunla Kɔraawiizi n na ŋɔ ra du Izrɛl hina ni, “Ií izi chi, di bagli ii wia bizenaa ni giŋgimee maa nuu.

ref: Israel, I am bringing charges against you— I call upon the mountains and the earth's firm foundation to be my witnesses.
text: Bizenaa, ií ra nuu gunla Kɔraawiizi n na ŋɔ. Hɛri zɛɛzi la n waa chɔgaa dɔɔwɛ, di du de saŋa maa la, ií ra nuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi ni u nɛra dɔɔ wiarɛ, u ra nyiŋŋuu ú di baa seriya.”

ref: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa ŋɔ, “N nɛra, bɛɛ n ɛɛ iai? Bɛɛ wiarɛ n wia zuu ii nyuunɛi? Ií ŋɔ n nuu!

ref: I rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to be your leaders.
text: N lizi iabuu lii Ijip hɛri, di lɛɛ ia, ii waa kaa ɛɛ yoma. N hum Moosis ni Aarɔn ani Miriamnɛ, bá tɔ ii see.

ref: Don't forget the evil plans of King Balak of Moab or what Balaam son of Beor said to him. Remember how I, the Lord, saved you many times on your way from Acacia to Gilgal. True Obedience
text: N nɛra, ií liizi gunla Moab Koori Balak n faa ta jina ú ɛɛ ia ani gunla Bɛɔ biibaal Balaam ge n faa bittɛ ŋɔ u be. Ií ra liizi saŋa la iiŋ lii Sitim, di ra la Gilgal la. Guŋ gil ii wer ra liizi wia la miŋ ɛɛwɛ di lɛɛ ia la.”

ref: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?
text: Bɛɛ ń kpa wa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n du u bol chiŋ, di n wa ballɔ n wa jaamuuwɛi? Ń kpa napɔla la n wesse werge di wa lizi mbusu, di fuuah tɛu gɛɛ?

ref: Will thousands of sheep or rivers of olive oil make God satisfied with me? Should I sacrifice to the Lord my first-born child as payment for my terrible sins?
text: Kɔraawiizi bɔra daŋ sɔɔni, di n kpa pebala kagboŋa di wa tɛu gɛɛ nuu la n niŋ su muuni kagboŋa fiaa? Gɛɛ ń kpa n biinabɔma, di wa lizi mbusu tɛu, dikuu n wichɔgaa wiaa?

ref: The Lord God has told us what is right and what he demands: “See that justice is done, let mercy be your first concern, and humbly obey your God.” Cheating and Violence
text: Akai, Kɔraawiizi bagli yaabuu gunla n wesse. Wii la unna nyiŋŋi yaa be maanii lugɔ ya ra di wibii, di nɔŋŋi nɛra ni sunaa, di ra hiŋuu ni sisɔna. Izrɛl hina chɔgri ni ba dignitɛraa wia

ref: I am the Lord, and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:
text: Nunzumaa Kɔraawiizi ɔmaa. U yir Jɛrusalɛm hinaa di ŋɔ ba be, “Ií ra nuu, ii banla n chaalɛɛ bolzeŋ naa biini!

ref: But I, the Lord, will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.
text: Ɛrɛɛ ń ɛɛ gil tɛɛ banla n na mɛgzi kuna fintime ninɛi?

ref: You rich people are violent, and everyone tells lies.
text: Ii daama hina la ɔɔ ra foozi nyaaraa, ii maa ɛɛ karkannaa.

ref: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.
text: Awia, n ɛɛ siryaa ń kpu ia, ii wia tuŋ, dikuu ii wichɔgaa hiŋ wia.

ref: You will eat, but still be hungry; you will store up goods, but lose everything— I, the Lord, will let it all be captured in war.
text: Ii daŋ ɔɔ di, ka ii wàá piŋ, ii hizi haa woo. Ii daŋ chaali ii kuna dau, ka a maa bir pɛɛ. N daŋ kpa laal, di wa chɔgi kuna la maa iiŋ chaalɛɛ dau la.

ref: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.
text: Ii daŋ duu kuna, ka ii wàá naa kum, ii daŋ ɔɔ lizi ɔlivi nuu, ka ii wàá naa fɔgli. Ii daŋ ɔɔ purgi grepu nɔna di lizi a siŋ, ka ii wàá nyɔɔa.

ref: Jerusalem, this will happen because you followed the sinful example of kings Omri and Ahab. Now I will destroy you and your property. Then the people of every nation will make fun and insult you.
text: Ii hiŋ Koori Ɔmri wichɔgaa widaulaa ani u biibaal Koori Ahab biinikpola wiɛɛlaarɛ, di kaa hiŋ ba naana wiɛɛlaa gba. Awia, n daŋ chɔg ii wia, dikuu guŋ wia. Nɛr maa ra gbɛlli ia, di hah ia.”

ref: I feel so empty inside— like someone starving for grapes or figs, after the vines and trees have all been picked clean.
text: N biini chɔkkɔɔ werge maa! N ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr la n ɔɔ ra tɔrgi daazi nɔna, á bii saŋa, ka màá naa di. Grepuzi waa hoo ń di, haali lugli figzi la minna kɛlli gba.

ref: No one is loyal to God; no one does right. Everyone is brutal and eager to deceive everyone else.
text: Nɛr maa waa hoo a hɛri naa biini, u wia dɔɔ wibii. Nɛr maa ge gba waa hoo, u wia deŋli. Bɛl maanii ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi ú na bɔr kpu nɛr. Bɛl maa ra he u lulli sidɛɛ.

ref: People cooperate to commit crime. Judges and leaders demand bribes, and rulers cheat in court.
text: Ba maanii zum wichɔgaa ɛɛi werge. Ba nabɔnzi ni sitɔɔra ɔɔ ra lɛɛ kunaa. Nɛtɔga ra bagli ba kipar, awia, ba ni baa jaa ɛɛ nuukpaŋ, di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa.

ref: The most honest of them is worse than a thorn patch. Your doom has come! Lookouts sound the warning, and everyone panics.
text: Haali ba nɛnanaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ sɔɔhri, banla wia n dɔɔ wibii ge du guŋ. Hɔpizii la Kɔraawiizi n niŋ tɛr u nɛra digna helloo gunla uŋ ga u dɔgtɛɛzi la n ɛɛ ba guure be, di ŋɔ la. Filaŋkeŋ, ba jaa bugmuu.

ref: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.
text: Gilɛɛ waa yardi i dɔŋhiŋ, gilɛɛ waa dɛlli i dammu. Haali i haaŋ gba be, a du i wiŋɔzi tau.

ref: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
text: Biibaal ra gbɛlli u mɛɛrɛ, biihaaŋ kpa u maa birgi u dɔm, haaŋ kpa u hilahaaŋ birgi u dɔm, baal ge dɔma ɛɛ u himmaa diahina.

ref: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer. The Nation Turns to God
text: Ka miŋwaa, Kɔraawiizii n na binni ni tamii. N danna kpaŋ Kɔraawiizi la minna hum n ɛɛ n Lɛɛri labuu. Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, daŋ nuu n be. Kɔraawiizi n niŋ lɛɛ u nɛra wia

ref: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.
text: N dɔma, ií gilɛɛ gil ii bɔra sɔɔni! Haali miŋ cholle naa gba, ka n daŋ kaa izi. Haali miŋ soge bɔbiri biini naa gba, ka Kɔraawiizii niŋ ɛɛ n bɔchaaŋ.

ref: I have sinned against the Lord. And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.
text: Dikuu miŋ ɛɛ wichɔgaa, di zuu Kɔraawiizi ni wia, n daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ dikuu u baaŋfuuih wia guŋŋ u wa lɛɛŋ, di gil n wia deŋli. U daŋ liziŋ du bɔchaaŋ biini, ń na u wideŋlaa.

ref: You, my enemies, said, “The Lord God is helpless.” Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street. A Bright Future
text: N dɔm daŋ na guŋ, hiihzi kpuu. Unla n ŋɔ n be, “Lee Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la duɛi?” N daŋ na u cholaa. Haali filaŋkeŋ gba, ba daŋ fɛrguu ni naazi alugɔ kpɛchɛgaa, ŋmɛnizenaa biine.

ref: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
text: Jɛrusalɛm hina, saŋa la iin niŋ bir kuari ii bolzeŋ koŋlaa ma la daŋ ba. Hɔpizii la iin niŋ yaa ii hɛri jaa la.

ref: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did. Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
text: Ka a hɛri daŋ chɔɔ pɛɛ, nɛr maa wàá ka du de, dikuu banla n du de la wichɔgaa wia. Kɔraawiizi n suŋ Izrɛl hina ni wia

ref: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, kpa i daŋkpala alugɔ penɔɔni, di ra binni i nɛra la n lugɔ peeza ni. Ba ɛɛ i kapɛttɛ kunaa, ka du kɔr biini ba bɛŋ, sela diiribɔr la n summɛ biini. Gil ba du Basan ni Giliad sela diiribɔra la n summɛ, di ra di bahinaa gunla baŋ faa du de, faala maa la.

ref: I, the Lord, will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛɛ wizenaa tɛɛ yaa gunla hiŋ faa ɛɛwɛ, saŋa la hiŋ lizi yaa lii Ijip la.

ref: Nations will see this and be ashamed because of their helpless armies. They will be in shock, unable to speak or hear,
text: Hɛssi hina daŋ na guŋ, hiihzi kpu baa, ba wàá ka dɔɔ fɔŋŋa. Ba daŋ kpa ba nonee fɔɔ ba nuuzi, bá digna ge taŋzi.

ref: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
text: Ba danna lenni hɛɛhraa, alugɔ hɛrikuŋ gɛɛ kuntuuzaa. Ba daŋ lii ba chɔɔribɔra ni ɔnsii ani bɔsai, di bir ba hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la yaa n na hum la be.

ref: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity
text: Nɛr maa waa hoo lugɔ hìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi. Hinla n ɔɔ gil i nɛra la n kawɛɛ wichɔgaa di ra tɛɛ baa la. Haa ɔɔ na baaŋ di hanna la, ka nɔŋŋi nɛra ni sunaa.

ref: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.
text: I daŋ kaa suŋ yaa ni, di fɛrgi yaa wichɔgaa ni naazi, di gbaaraa ga ha muuzeŋ vile biine!

ref: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.
text: I daŋ bagli i wibii dɔɔi ni i nɛsunaa dɔɔi, tɛɛ Jekɔb ni Abraham naanna, gunla hiŋ ŋɔ nua tɛɛ yaa naabaala, di lii faala maa la.

ref: I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh. The Fierce Anger of the Lord
text: Bolzeŋ Ninɛvɛ wia la Kɔraawiizi n pillɛɛ bagli Ɛlkɔs hinuu Nahum lugɔ deeza biini, u sɛbi dawuu keŋ. Kɔraawiizi baaŋ n fuuh Ninɛvɛ hina ni wia

ref: The Lord God demands loyalty. In his anger, he takes revenge on his enemies.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ zoma hinnɛ, di ɔɔ ra turgi u dɔma ba wichɔgaa kim, di ɔɔ ra tɔɔri banla n na karsuu ni baaŋfuuih werge maa.

ref: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
text: Kɔraawiizi baaŋ waa ɔɔ ra fuuh manamanaŋ, ka u ɛɛ fɔŋŋa hinnɛ werge, waa ɔɔ gil banla n dɔɔ bilchɔg pɛɛ, di waa ba digna tɛttɛ. U vollibɔr maa ɔɔ dɔɔ vem ni dooŋ pekpegre, baamazi ge ɛɛ u naazi nyɔɔ.

ref: At the Lord's command, oceans and rivers dry up. Bashan, Mount Carmel, and Lebanon wither, and their flowers fade.
text: U ɔɔ ŋɔ wiarɛ fɔŋŋa ni, muuzeŋ hil, di gil muuni maa hil. Basan ni Bizeŋ Kamɛl hɛssi kuna maa yɔl, Lɛbanɔn hɛri ge fiiri maa sizi.

ref: At the sight of the Lord, mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.
text: Bizenaa ɔɔ ra zigluu u see, giŋgimee ge ŋmɛɛri kaali. Hɛri ɔɔ ra zigluu kpikpikpi, di u wa ballɔ, haali durnya ni kuna la maa n du u biini.

ref: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones. The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
text: Di u baaŋ wa fuuhwo werge, anɛɛ n niŋ wer chi u seei? U ɔɔ ra diu alugɔ niŋ, bia ɔɔ purguu burburbur u see.

ref: The Lord is good. He protects those who trust him in times of trouble.
text: Kɔraawiizi wessoo, di ra guu u nɛra tɔɔrɔɔ saŋazi. U ɔɔ ra binni banla n yarduubuu.

ref: But like a roaring flood, the Lord chases his enemies into dark places and destroys them.
text: U daŋ chɔgi bolzeŋ Ninɛvɛ nyaamm alugɔ nii n suwee di ra lɔ werge, di ɔɔ chɔgi kuna la. U daŋ duŋŋi u dɔma du bɔbiri biini.

ref: So don't plot against the Lord! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.
text: Wia la maa baŋ vɔɔwɛ bá ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la, u daŋ gil a maa tuŋ. Tɔɔrɔɔ wàá ka ba bunɛɛhiŋ.

ref: They are like drunkards overcome by wine, or like twisted thornbushes burning in a fire.
text: Ba daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ sɔɔhri n mil baa, di nyɔɔ siŋ dɛɛzi, niŋ fuuh baa alugɔ kɔlhilaa.

ref: But the Lord says, “Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.
text: Awia, kenne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u nɛra Izrɛl hina be, “Haali Asiiria hina n dɔɔ nɛra werge di du kpeg, ka n daŋ kpu baa bá wia tuŋ. Hoi, Juda hina, haali miŋ tɔɔri ia la gba, màá ka ɛɛ ia guŋ maa.

ref: I'll snap your chains and set you free from the Assyrians.”
text: Filaŋkeŋ, n daŋ chɔgi fɔŋŋa la baŋ dɔɔwɛ ii ni la, di chaahzi yɔlɔzi la n vɔɔzi ia la ha.”

ref: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ wiŋɔkpeg bɛllɛ dikuu ii Ninɛvɛ hina wia, “Ií wàá dɔɔ naanna bá ra liizi ii wia. N daŋ chɔgi ii vugsɛɛhlaa ni a luulaa la n du ii vuga diini biine la. N daŋ ki ii bɔɔni dau, dikuu iiŋ chummɛ werge wia.”

ref: Look toward the mountains, people of Judah! Here comes a messenger with good news of peace. Celebrate your festivals. Keep your promises to God. Your evil enemies are destroyed and will never again invade your country.
text: Ií binni bizenaa nyuuni na, nɛbɛllɛ kpogli amaniyesuma di vol ra ba, unla n na sii bampirsɔna wia! Juda hina, ií ra di ii hɔpizizenaa, di kpa kuna la maa iiŋ ŋɔ nuuzi lugɔ ii daŋ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la tɛu. Biinikpola hina wàá ka zuu ii hɛri di lɔ ia laal maa, n daŋ kpu baa nyaamm.

ref: Nineveh, someone is coming to attack and scatter you. Guard your fortresses! Watch the road! Be brave! Prepare for battle!
text: Ninɛvɛ hina, nɛbɛl ra bau ú wa lɔ ia laal. Ií ra guu ii diikpega, ií ra binni ŋmɛnɛɛ di ra du tau nɛnnɛ, ií ɛɛ laal lɔi sirya.

ref: Judah and Israel are like trees with branches broken by their enemies. But the Lord is going to restore their power and glory. *
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ kaa gil Izrɛl wessi ni u girme la bir ba, haali chɔgra n wa chɔgi u maa, di chɔgi ba kundɔɔlaa maa alugɔ baŋ kaari grepu daa nɔna la gba.

ref: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
text: Ninɛvɛ hina nabɔma chaali ú laallɔɔra la n kpekke nɛnnɛɛ, ka ba du ŋmɛnɛɛ di ra lɔɔzi naazi. Ba kiiri hel a bolzeŋ koŋliizeŋ, bá kuari kuŋ di gber bahinaa.

ref: The river gates fly open, and panic floods the palace.
text: Ba pilli muugberzenaa la, ba kooridia chol purgi burburbur.

ref: Nineveh is disgraced. The queen is dragged off. Her servant women mourn; they moan like doves, and they beat their breasts in sorrow.
text: Hiihzi kpu Ninɛvɛ hinaa, ba lau ba wichee kaali. U balaa ra wii lugɔ kommazi, di ra lɔɔzi ba bampiree ni biinichɔg.

ref: Nineveh is like a pond with leaking water. Shouts of “Stop! Don't go!” can be heard everywhere. But everyone is leaving.
text: Ninɛvɛ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ gbatar, u nii ra hiihzi. U nɛra wii di ra ŋɔ, “Ií chi! Ií chi!” Ka nɛr maa waa har bittɛ.

ref: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
text: Ií paagi ba saliŋhuŋŋa, di paagi ba salma! Ba kundɔɔlaa waa maga dɔɔwɛ, daamaa su a bol maa.

ref: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.
text: Ninɛvɛ hina faa du ba bolzeŋ biinii alugɔ bunyinzi n du a duuribɔr, di ra dɛɛzi a biizi. Denii bunyiŋ bal ni u niina ɔɔ la, a biizi faa waa kaa ra ɔm kummaa.

ref: These are the same lions that ferociously attacked their victims, then dragged away the flesh to feed their young.
text: Ba faa duwɔɔrɛ alugɔ bunyiŋ n ɔɔ kpu sela nɛnnɛ di ra tɛɛ u biizi, di piili a sela ra tɛɛ u haaŋ, ola su ú chɔɔribɔr maa.

ref: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ ŋɔ Ninɛvɛ hina benii, “N chigɔ ii ninɛɛ. N daŋ fuuh ii laal torkozi, nyɔɔzi tɔ bɔr maa, bá kpu ii laallɔɔra maa laal biini. N daŋ paa kuna la maa iiŋ faa paawɛ lii nɛra be la. Ba wàá ka nuu i balaa loobee á ra du baa ɔnsii.”

ref: Doom to the crime capital! Nineveh, city of murder and treachery,
text: Wiarɛ huuzi kara ni nɛkpuura bolzeŋ la daama n suwee, bá wa ŋmɛɛ di foozi la!

ref: here is your fate— cracking whips, churning wheels; galloping horses, roaring chariots;
text: Ií ra nuu virinzi gbɔgza, chira kɔɔi, zagra n na chɔ di zaahzi ra chiiri, ani laal torkozi gbɔga!

ref: You were nothing more than a prostitute using your magical charms and witchcraft to attract and trap nations.
text: Annii maa ɛɛwɔɔ dikuu Ninɛvɛ n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ sɛnsɛnni wia, di gil vugra kpa kabirɛzi di ra vɔɔzi nɛra, di gil u sɛnsɛŋ ni hiri birgi hɛssi hina yoma.

ref: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N chigɛ i ninɛɛ. N daŋ wirii, di gil hɛssi hina na i chakpal ani i hiihzi dii.

ref: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.
text: N daŋ kpa doŋa werge ta i ni, màá ka kpai su siwii, di gil nɛra ra kɔɔi.

ref: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
text: Banla maa n niŋ nai daŋ chɔ lii i be, ka ŋɔ, ‘Ninɛvɛ puroore, anɛɛ n niŋ wii tɛuwɛi?’ Anɛɛ ń na u tig u bampiriiyei?”

ref: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.
text: Hinuu bɔ Tɛbɛs la n chɔɔ Muu Naal nua, nii baruu laa? A muurɛ faa gberuu u nii faa ɛɛ lugɔ koŋlii la.

ref: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
text: Itiopia ni Ijip hinaa faa ɛɛ Tɛbɛs fɔŋŋazeŋ. Put ni Libia hina faa jaa u ni banla n ɛɛ nuukpaŋ biinii.

ref: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
text: Ka ba faa wa kpegli Tɛbɛs, di lau u nɛra kaali hɛrduma. Ba faa kpu ba biizii ha ŋmɛnichechemazi maa. Ba ta kuna lugɔ bee di bɔnni ba nabɔnzenaa, di kpa yɔlɔzi vɔɔzi ba nɛzenaa maa.

ref: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
text: Ninɛvɛ hina ge gba daŋ dɛɛzi, di chɔ ga suah, di suŋŋi ba dɔma bá lau baa suah.

ref: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.
text: I diikpega la maa n na gberii la ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ fig daazi la nɔna n luglɛɛ ra aah. Di ba wa zagaa, a ɔɔ chogli a diiri nua biinii.

ref: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
text: Binni i laallɔɔra na, ba maa birgi haanaa! I hɛri dominuuzenaa pillɔɔrɛ chɔɔ tɛɛ i dɔma. Niŋ di a dominuuzi lugbidaazi maa.

ref: Your city is under attack. Haul in extra water! Strengthen your defenses! Start making bricks! Stir the mortar!
text: Ií dɔɔ nii tɛɛ iihinaa, dikuu ii fɔɔi wia, di kuari ii diikpega a du kpeg nɛnnɛ! Ií gbɛr hɛɛhraa, di fɛrgaa á lau nɛnnɛ, di ɛɛ birkissi dakkazi sirya, di mɔnni birkissizi.

ref: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
text: Denii niŋ wa di ia, ba daŋ kpa tokobi kpu ia, di di ia alugɔ huuhni. Ií gil ii nɛra wazi lugɔ huuhni, di gil ii nɛra wazi lugɔ lotorozi!

ref: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
text: Ii gillɔɔ ii kɔkɔɔza wazi di ra jaa, di du kpil kaali chinchinwilaa, ka ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ lotorozi n di hɛri kuna maa nyaamm, ka zaah kaali la.

ref: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
text: Ii guure ni ii nabɔnzi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ lotorozi kpila werge maa n zuu koŋlaa fɔɔliizi waari hɔpizii, ka di wiizi wa futtɔ, a ɔɔ zaah kaali, nɛr maa waa ɔɔ zum bɔr la aŋ kaalɛɛ.

ref: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
text: Asiiria koorizeŋ, i senɔɔna gɛɛ koora chɔɔ dɔɔrɛ, i nabɔnzenaa chɔɔ di ra heezi. I nɛra yaari bizenaa nyuuni, ka nɛr maa waa hoo ú chaali baa.

ref: You're fatally wounded. There's no hope for you. But everyone claps when they hear this news, because your constant cruelty has caused them pain.
text: Kummaa wàá wer chaa i ŋmɛr, i pira la daŋ kpui. Nɛr la maa n niŋ nuu i wia, daŋ lɔ kpaa dikuu i cholaa wia. Nɛr maa di tɔɔrɔɔrɛ dikuu i sihilii werge wia.

ref: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me. Habakkuk Complains to the Lord
text: Wia la Kɔraawiizi n pillɛɛ bagli u dɔgtɛɛ Habakuk labuu keŋ. Habakuk nuumaa wia

ref: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, ɛrɛɛ ń yirii di birgi mag lugɔ i hiiniŋ, ka i haa nuuwɛi? Ɛrɛɛ ń chɛɛhgi dui birgi mag lugɔ í mɔgli yaa lii nɛra la n na sunni yaa werge la be, ka i haa mɔgli yaai?

ref: Why do you make me watch such terrible injustice? Why do you allow violence, lawlessness, crime, and cruelty to spread everywhere?
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i gil n na wibii nyaaiyɛi? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ nɛra ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa ka haa ra hagzɛi? Kalu ni naari bariŋ bɔr maa, di ra chɔgi kuna.

ref: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around. The Lord Answers Habakkuk
text: Awia, gbɔg maa waa kaa ra hum, wibii dii wàá ka wer kpegli wichɔgaa. Biinikpola hina ra tɔ nɛra la wia n deŋleere ŋmɛnɛɛ, guŋ gil ba waa kaa ra di wibii. Kɔraawiizi n bittɛ ŋɔ wia tɛɛ Habakuk wia

ref: Look and be amazed at what's happening among the nations! Even if you were told, you would never believe what's taking place now.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u nɛra be, “Ií binni hɛssi hina, di pessi baa na, ii nuuzi daŋ kpu. N daŋ ɛɛ wii bɛl ii de dui saŋa naa iiŋ wàá yardi, haali di ba kali ia gba.

ref: I am sending the Babylonians. They are fierce and cruel— marching across the land, conquering cities and towns.
text: N na lizi Babilɔn hinaa bá ɛɛ n kipar, ba ɛɛ sihilii hinaa, ba waa nɛra sinyɛna ra na, ba gbaŋŋɔɔ di ra yoo durnya maa, bá foozi nɛra duuribɔra la n waa ba hora ɛɛwɛ.

ref: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
text: Ba ɛɛ nɛra la wia n dɔɔ ɔnsiirɛ werge maa. Ba himmaa gbɔgnii ba ra hiŋ, di ra tɔgzi bahinaa.

ref: They make fun of rulers and laugh at fortresses, while building dirt mounds so they can capture cities.
text: Ba ra ɛɛ kooraa chɛɛtɛ, di ra lɔ hɛssi nabɔnzi mɔmɔsia. Ba ra gbɛlli bolkpega la baŋ ma koŋlaa baraa maanii, di ta pizenaa pɛli a koŋlaa, di wer tinnaa tuu, di lauri a bol nɛra.

ref: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
text: Denii ba ɔɔ lii de kaali fɔŋŋa ni alugɔ peu n tawɛɛ ra kaali. Ba ɛɛ nɛra la n dɔɔ chɔgrii, di ra tɔgzi bahinaa alugɔ baŋ ɛɛ vuga.” Habakuk nuumaa nɛɛhiŋ wia

ref: Holy Lord God, mighty rock, you are eternal, and we are safe from death. You are using those Babylonians to judge and punish others.
text: Kɔraawiizi, saŋa maa lɛi i du dee? Kɔraawiizi la minna hum, i ɛɛ Naniinaniirɛ, haa luglaa ni tunaa dɔɔwɛ, hàá gil ya siu. N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, i lizi Babilɔn hinaa, bá wa di yaa seriya. I ɛɛ Bikpegre tɛɛ yaa. I lizi baabuu bá wa tɛr yaa digna.

ref: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.
text: I ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ, hàá sɛɛ binni wichɔgaa. Hàá wichɔgaa wia ra sɛɛ. Ka ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i ra sɛɛ biinikpola hina wiai? Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i siigi ka biinikpola hina ra chɔgi nɛra la wia n deŋlee kaali baai?

ref: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.
text: I gillɔɔ nɛra du lugɔ nyinni n du muuzeŋ biini, lugɔ muuzeŋ biini kunnyinee n waa binni dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy
text: Ba dɔma Babilɔn hina kpa gɔrgazii lauri ba maa alugɔ nyinni, di kpa ba asauzi lauri baa, di ra chaasi ni bɔsɔna.

ref: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
text: Awia, ba kpu kunaa lizi mbusu di ra tɛɛ ba asauzi, di fuuh daahɛgsɔɔhsuma ra tɛɛa, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba asauzii ra tɛɛ baa ba kunnyiŋŋaa maa, ba ra di ba kipar diusuma.

ref: Will he keep hauling in his nets and destroying nations without showing mercy?
text: I daŋ gil ba hanna kpu nɛra alugɔ nyinni, di ra kpu hɛssi hina sikpegii nii?

ref: While standing guard on the watchtower, I waited for the Lord's answer, before explaining the reason for my complaint.
text: N daŋ izi tinni n diijaŋ chi, di ra du tau, di ra kpaŋ wii la Kɔraawiizi n niŋ ŋɔ tɛŋ ani gunla min niŋ ŋɔ tɛu, n nuumaa hiŋ wia. Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ wia tɛɛ Habakuk wia

ref: Then the Lord told me: “I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi bir ŋɔ n be, “Sɛbi wia la min niŋ pilli tɛi dau bipɛntɛnzi ni, di gil a chaani nɛnnɛ, guŋ gil siiri wer karmaa nɛnnɛ manaŋ.

ref: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!
text: A wipillaa hɔpizii daŋ haa ba, ń bagli wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ harbɔɔ ni, a wàá ɛɛ kara. Haali aŋ wàá ɛɛ manaŋ gba, ka ií ra kpaŋ, a guŋ daŋ haŋ bau, a wàá birgi.

ref: “I, the Lord, refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.” Trouble for Evil People
text: A wipillaarɛ keŋ, Babilɔn hina ra tɔgzi bahinaarɛ werge, ba kipar wia waa deŋlee, ka nɛr la wia n deŋlee, u yardaa niŋ ɛɛ u miibɔɔ.

ref: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
text: Babilɔn hina daama ra dar baabuu, ba ra jigsi werge, ba siwii waa su, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba dɔɔ kpossiire alugɔ siu siwii n waa su la, di chaali hɛssi hina maa ra tɛɛ u hiŋ, di lauri baa ra ɛɛ yoma.

ref: But they will be mocked with these words: You're doomed! You stored up stolen goods and cheated others of what belonged to them.
text: Nɛra la maa Babilɔn hina n kpeglee daŋ bir ɛɛ baa mɔmɔsia, di ra ŋɔ, ‘Wia daŋ huuzi ia dikuu iiŋ paagi kuŋŋmɛɛlaa sagzi dɔŋa ni wia, di paagi kuna ii wer birgi dɔɔna! Saŋa bɛliirɛ ii gil guŋ ɛɛiyɛi?’

ref: But without warning, those you owe will demand payment. Then you will become a frightened victim.
text: Nɛra la kima iin diwee daŋ izi kakpaŋ, di du ia siaahmu, ii bɔra ra sa. Denii ii bir ɛɛ lugɔ nɛra la kuna iiŋ faa paagɛɛ la.

ref: You robbed cities and nations everywhere on earth and murdered their people. Now those who survived will be as cruel to you.
text: Ii paagi hɛrkpila hina daamaa, ka filaŋkeŋ, banla n kawɛɛ la daŋ paagi ii ge kuna, dikuu iiŋ kpu hɛssi nɛra werge maa, di chɔgi hɛssi, bolzenaa ani a nɛra la maa wia.

ref: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, “I'm above the law.”
text: Wia daŋ huuzi ii Babilɔn hina, dikuu iiŋ nyiŋŋi daama gunla n waa deŋlee tɛɛ iihinaa, di ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ ii du bɔnanaa, nɛr maa gilɛɛ wer hel ii be di kpu ia wia!

ref: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.
text: Ií vɔɔ nɛkpila kpui jinaa, guŋ gil chɔgaa ba ii be, guŋ gil ii himmaa diini hina ge di hiihzi, di nyaa ii miibɔɔni.

ref: The very stones and wood in your home will testify against you.
text: Bia la iiŋ kpawɛɛ ma koŋlaa la wiraa daŋ lii chaaŋ, á dolli ge hiini, á wiraa jaa.

ref: You're doomed! You built a city on crime and violence.
text: Wia daŋ huuzi nɛr la maa n kpa nɛkpui gɛɛ wichɔgaa ŋmɛnizi di ra ma bol!

ref: But the Lord All-Powerful sends up in flames what nations and people work so hard to gain.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la dauwɔɔ lugɔ hɛssi hina kuuhni maa daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ daazi baŋ du niŋ biini a ra fuuh. U dauwɔɔ lugɔ ba ra kuuuh pɛɛ.

ref: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
text: Hɛssi hina maa daŋ zum gunla Kɔraawiizi n duwɛɛ, u girme su hɛri gunla nii n su muuzeŋ la.

ref: Now you will be disgraced instead of praised. The Lord will make you drunk, and when others see you naked, you will lose their respect.
text: Girme la hiŋ faa dɔɔwɛ la daŋ birgi hiihzi werge. I saŋaa filaŋkeŋ! Nyɔɔ di wir i hiŋ! Kɔraawiizi kpa libee la n du u fɔŋŋa nonii biinii di ra ba i be, ú wa tɛr i digni, í girme birgi ŋmaaba.

ref: You destroyed trees and animals on Mount Lebanon; you were ruthless to towns and people everywhere. Now you will be terrorized. Idolatry Is Foolish
text: Chɔgaa la hiŋ faa chɔg Lɛbanɔn hɛri la daŋ bir dii ani gunla hiŋ faa kpu sela werge la daŋ dui ɔnsii werge. I faa kpu nɛraa werge, di faa chɔgi hɛssi, bola ani nɛra la maa n du a biine.

ref: What is an idol worth? It's merely a false god. Why trust a speechless image made from wood or metal by human hands?
text: Neweere sɛɛh vug, bɛɛ tɔnaa u dɔɔi? U wia maa ɛɛ karaa. Nɛr la n sɛɛuh yardi u himmaa kuŋkuariirɛ, vuga la uŋ sɛɛhwɛ la wàá wer ŋɔ wia.

ref: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
text: Wia daŋ huuzi nɛr la maa n ŋɔ daa be, ‘Dɔɔ miibɔɔ!’ Gɛɛ bii n waa miibɔɔ dɔɔwɛ be, ‘Izi!’ U daŋ wer baglii wiaa? Saliŋ ni saliŋhuŋŋaa ba ŋmɛɛri tɔ u maa, waa heeza dɔɔwɛ kɔrai!

ref: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi du u Diinaniinanii biinii. Gil nɛr la maa n du durnya naa ba u see di wa ɛɛ surumm.”

ref: This is my prayer:
text: Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ Habakuk wiisuŋŋaarɛ keŋ.

ref: I know your reputation, Lord, and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, n nuu i nuukpuuri wia la hiŋ ɛɛwɛ labuu. I wiɛɛlaa hiŋ kpu n nuarɛ. Bir ɛɛa yaa de dui saŋa naa biini, gil yaa ge zumaa filaŋkeŋ. Di yaa wa ɛɛi wichɔgaa i baaŋ fuuh gba, ka í na yaa sinyɛna.

ref: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
text: Kɔraawiizi lii Ɛdɔm hɛrii ba, Paran bizenaa nyuurɛ Dɔɔrinaniinanii la lii ba. U girme su chiŋ maanii. Durnya hina maa ra chɔluu.

ref: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
text: U wessi faa du lugɔ wiizi n na fur, kuna lii u nonii di ra nyɛgzi pilpilpil, di lii bɔr la u kpegzi n faa suahwɛ la.

ref: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
text: Wiilchɔgaa tɔ u see, wiilbuulaa ge hiŋ u naajaglaa, di ra kpuuzi nɛra.

ref: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
text: Di u wa izoo chi, hɛri ɔɔ zigluu, di u wa binni hɛssi hina, ba bɔra ɔɔ ra sau. Bizenaa la n du de faala maa la purgi, giŋgimee la ge n du de saŋa maa la chogli. U wiɛɛlaa ŋmɛnizi waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
text: Ɔnsii chol Kusan hina la n du tanti diini biinii werge, Midian hina ge bɔra ra sa.

ref: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
text: I lizi i hoore chaaŋ, di ŋɔ ba tɛi hobee kpila. I kpa muunii peri hɛri,

ref: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.
text: bizenaa nai di ra zigli. Dooŋ ba, nii pal fɔŋŋa ni di waa kaali, muuzeŋ ra gbɔgzi, di gil u ra lɔ werge, di ra izi chiŋ.

ref: The sun and moon stood still, while your arrows and spears flashed like lightning.
text: Wiizi ni baagu chi chinchiŋ diindiindiiŋ, dikuu hiŋ ta hobee, i kandaa ge ra nyɛgzi pilpilpil wia.

ref: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.
text: I liwɔɔrɛ í wa lɛɛ i nɛra, di lɛɛ unla hiŋ lizɛɛ ú ɛɛ koori la ta. I chɔgi hɛri la hina n dɔɔ biinikpola sitɔɔrii, di chɔgi u fɔŋŋa maa.

ref: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
text: I faa kpa u himmaa kandaarɛ di yag u nyuu, di lii saŋa la u laallɔɔra n faa chɔwɛɛ ba, bá wa lɔ yaa di yaari la, di ɛɛ yaa chɛɛtɛ di ra mam lugɔ banna nyiŋŋi ba ligli gɛrga la n chɔwɛɛ suahzi la.

ref: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
text: I kpa i zagra naazi di fɛrgi muuzeŋ, di vuugi u niizenaa a ra izi fufuu.

ref: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
text: N nuu guŋ n banchule ra lɔ, n nuuhɔna ra lɔ dɔŋa dikuu gbɔga la wia. N bɔra huah di zuu n hoga biini, n naazi ra sa. Ka n daŋ di kanyitti di ra kpaŋ saŋa la hɔpizichɔgii n niŋ wa huuzi hɛri la hina n na yoo yaa la.

ref: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—
text: Haali fig daa n wàá fii gba, grepu daazi ge waa grepuzi nɔnnɛ, haali ɔlivizi n vɛɛ nɔnaa, pattikuna vɛɛ gba, haali peeza n waa hoo lumbol, nauna ge waa hoo liga gba,

ref: but I will still celebrate because the Lord God is my Savior.
text: ka n bɔra danna pur Kɔraawiizi wia, n bɔra sɔɔni werge n Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi la wia.

ref: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
text: Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa labuu ɛɛ n fɔŋŋa, u gillɔɔ n naapezi ɛɛ lugɔ chaŋkpalŋa naafiraa, di gil n wer di ra tinni bizenaa. N sɛbi wia naabuu di ra tɛɛ yira nabɔma, ú kpa n janjalaŋ lɔa.

ref: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message. Judgment on Judah
text: Wia la Kɔraawiizi n faa kpawɛɛ bagli Zɛfania saŋa la Amɔn biibaal Jɔsia n faa ra di Juda koraa keŋ. Zɛfania mɛɛrɛ faa Kusi, Kusi ge mɛɛ ɛɛ Gɛdalia, Gɛdalia ge mɛɛ ɛɛ Amaria, Amaria ge mɛɛ ɛɛ Hɛzɛkia. Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii seriya dii wia

ref: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ chɔgi hɛri naa kummaa.

ref: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
text: N daŋ kpu newea ni sela maa, di kpu zumbizi ani muuzeŋ biini nyinni maa. Biinikpola hina maa wia daŋ tuŋ, di n wa dim newea maa hɛri naa biini. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
text: N daŋ tɛr Juda hina ani banla maa n du bolzeŋ Jɛrusalɛm biini digna. N daŋ chɔgi de, di dim Baal wikpoglaa ni u kizeehina maa, nɛr maa wàá ka liizi ba wia

ref: Not a trace will be found of those who worship stars from their rooftops, or bow down to the god Milcom, while claiming loyalty to me, the Lord.
text: ni banla maa n ɔɔ tinni sal di ra jaami wiizi, baagu ani chinchiŋwilaa, banla n ɔɔ ra jaamiŋ di ra hɛɛhziŋ, ka ɔɔ ra hɛɛhzi vug Mɔlɛk ge la,

ref: Nothing will remain of anyone who has turned away and rejected me.
text: banla n bir har di vɛɛ n hiŋaa, ba wàá kaa nyiŋŋi n bɔr gɛɛ di pɛɛzi n wia gba.”

ref: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.
text: Ií ɛɛ surumm Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la see, dikuu u Hɔpizii la n duglɛɛ wia. U ɛɛ siryaa ú kpa u nɛra lizi mbusu, di yir ba dɔma bá wa paagi ba kuna.

ref: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “A hɔl la min niŋ kpu nɛra werge la, n daŋ tɛrgi koori biibaala, nabɔnzenaa ani banla maa n na hiŋ hɔɔhra naana wia la digna.

ref: I will punish worshipers of pagan gods and cruel palace officials who abuse their power.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, n daŋ tɛr banla maa n na jaami lugɔ vugkuara digna ni banla n na ŋmɛɛ, di ra kpu nɛra, bá vuga diini suugi wia.

ref: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
text: A hɔl hiŋ, ii daŋ nuu chɛɛhgaa lii Nyiŋ Dominuuzeŋ la, chɛɛhgaa su a bolzeŋ bɔfalii la ani kuna n na chogli, di ra lɔɔzi dɔŋa gbɔga werge, giŋgimee nyuuni.

ref: Everyone in Lower Hollow will mourn loudly, because merchants and money changers will be wiped out.
text: Ii banla n du yawa barii la, ií ra chɛɛhgi. Ii kɔkɔɔza maanii niŋ dim, banla n na yoo saliŋhuŋŋa maanii niŋ tuŋ.

ref: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, “The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.”
text: A guŋ saŋa, n daŋ kpa fintinazi di pigzi Jɛrusalɛm, di tɛrgi banla maa n na faazi digna, baabuu ra fɛ lugɔ màá ɛɛ wiimaa, haali di a nanaarɛ gɛɛ achɔgaarɛ gba la.

ref: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
text: Ba daŋ wa paagi ba daama di chɔgi ba diini. Ba daŋ ma diini ka ba wàá du a biine. Ba daŋ duu grepu daazi ba kooni, ka ba wàá nyɔɔ a siŋ.” Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizizeŋ la wia

ref: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
text: Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizizeŋ la duglɔɔrɛ di ra ba manamanaŋ. Ií ra nuu! A Hɔpizii, daŋ ɛɛ hɔpizichuma, laallɔkpega chaasaa su bɔr maa.

ref: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
text: A Hɔpizii daŋ ɛɛ baaŋfuuih werge hɔpizii, di ɛɛ biinichɔg ni lɔgɔ lii werge hɔpizii, di ɛɛ tɔɔrɔɔ ni chɔgaa hɔpizii, di ɛɛ bɔbiri ni tamii tunaa hɔpizii di ɛɛ baamazi ni bɔbiri limpiriŋ hɔpizii,

ref: of trumpet calls and battle cries against fortified cities and mighty fortresses.
text: di ɛɛ nyigzi ni laal wiraa hɔpizii di ra lɔ bolzenaa la baŋ ma koŋlaa bar ni a siraa diijaŋra.

ref: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, “I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ kpa dɔgnya werge di wa ta a nɛra ni, ba ra vol lugɔ nyuŋŋa, dikuu baŋ ɛɛŋ wichɔgaa wia. Ba daŋ fug ba chal lugɔ nii, bá bɔra chɔɔ hɛri pɔɔh.”

ref: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
text: Ba saliŋhuŋŋa gɛɛ ba saliŋ wàá wer lɛɛ baa ta Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuihchɔgii Hɔpizii hiŋ hɔl. U zoma niŋ daŋ di durnya maa, dikuu un niŋ gil nɛra maa n du durnya naa biini dim kakpaŋ wia.

ref: You disgraceful nation, gather around,
text: Ií chaali dɔŋa be, ií chaali dɔŋa be, hoi, hiihnyaara.

ref: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
text: Mɔɔ ka Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la uŋ lizɛɛ la ba, a hɔpizii daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ peu n paa nɔɔri, mɔɔ ka Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuihchɔgii la fuuh ii ni, mɔɔ ka u baaŋ werge hɔpizii la chol ii ni.

ref: If you humbly obey the Lord, then come and worship him. If you do right and are humble, perhaps you will be safe on that day when the Lord turns loose his anger. Judgment on Philistia
text: A hɛri hina la n sɔɔni siwii, ií nyiŋŋi Kɔraawiizi bɔr, ii banla n na ɛɛ gunla unna ŋɔ la. Ií ra nyiŋŋi wideŋlaa, di ra nyiŋŋi sisɔna. Aŋhinabe, ba daŋ tɛɛ ia duuribɔra Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la hɔl. Filisti hina seriya dii wia

ref: Gaza and Ashkelon will be deserted and left in ruins. Ashdod will be emptied in broad daylight, and Ekron uprooted.
text: Nɛr maa wàá du Gaza biini, Askɛlɔn ge chɔɔ diŋgela. Ba daŋ tuŋ Asdɔd hina ge wibaŋkanchirii ni, di dim Ɛkrɔn hina ge.

ref: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
text: Wiarɛ huuzi Filisti hina la n soge muuzeŋ nua la. Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii sag ii ninɛɛ, u daŋ dim ia, ii bɛl maa wàá ka ka.

ref: Your seacoast will be changed into pastureland and sheep pens.
text: Ii hɛri la n du muuzeŋ nua la, daŋ birgi senɔɔna duuribɔra ni peeza lumbola.

ref: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
text: U daŋ ɛɛ Juda hina la n kawɛɛ la hor, de ɛɛ ba sela diiribɔr. Duana ni, ba daŋ chɔɔgi Askɛlɔn hina diini biine. Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la danna du ba tau. U daŋ gil ba bir nyɛɛli. Moab ni Ammɔn hina seriya dii wia

ref: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I've heard Moab and Ammon insult my people and threaten their nation.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N nuu gunla Moab ni Ammɔn hina n chagzi n nɛra di ra ɛɛ baa chɛɛtɛɛ, di ra ta barabara lugɔ ba daŋ foozi ba hɛri.

ref: And so, I swear by my very life that Moab and Ammon will end up like Sodom and Gomorrah— covered with thornbushes and salt pits forever. Then my people who survive will take their land.
text: Awia, miŋ haŋ na du de waa, Moab daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ Sɔdɔm wibii maa, Ammɔn hina ɛɛ lugɔ Gɔmɔra hina. Di lii kooriichɔgaa, di ɛɛ yazi bɔɔni, di chɔɔ pɛɛ di hanna la. N nɛra la n kawɛɛ la daŋ paagi ba kuna. N hɛri hina banla n niŋ di miibɔɔ la daŋ di ba hɛri kapɛttɛ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa Izrɛl hina ra hum labuu ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
text: Kunla ban niŋ na ú ɛɛ ba barabara kinturgaare guŋ, dikuu baŋ chagzi Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa nɛra di ɛɛ baa chɛɛtɛ wia.

ref: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia
text: Kɔraawiizi wia daŋ dɔɔ ɔnsii saŋa la un niŋ chɔgi ba hɛri vuga la. Hɛssi hina la n du muuni kɛraa daŋ jaamuu, bá himmaa hɛssi. Itiopia hina seriya dii wia

ref: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you! Judgment on Assyria
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpu Itiopia hina gba. Asiiria hina seriya dii wia

ref: The Lord will reach to the north to crush Assyria and overthrow Nineveh.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ tɛr wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag nonii, di kpu Asiiria hina, di gil Ninɛvɛ chɔɔ diŋgela, di hil lugɔ hɛribɔduma.

ref: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
text: Peeza ni nauna kpilakpila daŋ chɔɔ de, kunnyinee iri maa dee du de. Hɛribɔduma kikiu ni kukubalee daŋ du de hamuŋa ni di ra wii. Ba tokorozi daŋ hiini, di gil a wiraa jaa, hembugle puugi ba dominuuzi, bá hɛriŋkpol dolli nyiizi.

ref: This is the glorious city that felt secure and said, “I am the only one!” Now it's merely ruins, a home for wild animals. Every passerby simply sneers and makes vulgar signs.
text: N baga waa hoo hina bolzenne la, ba faa sogoo, wiimaa waa baa titte. Ba ɔɔ ŋɔ bahinaa benii, “Yaa bolzenne kaali bolzeŋ maa.” Na gunla ba bolzeŋ n chɔkkɛ, di birgi pir sela duuribɔr! Nɛr la maa n ga de kɛrii ɔɔ ra ɛɛubuu chɛɛtɛ, di zigli noguruŋ di ra du u ni.

ref: Forever rebellious and rejecting correction, Jerusalem refuses to trust or obey the Lord God.
text: U nɛra waa nɛr maa ra tɔgzi, ba waa baglaa ra nuu. Ba waa Kɔraawiizi yardɛɛ, ba waa tuzɛɛ ra dugli Kɔraawiizi.

ref: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.
text: Ba nabɔnzi ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyinzi n na wii, Ba koora ɛɛ munuzi la lɔzi n na kpu werge, a waa ɔɔ di kummaa ka ka u yeŋ ka hɔpizi la.

ref: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.
text: A bolzeŋ dɔgtɛɛzi kpoŋŋoo. Ba ɛɛ nɛchɔgaarɛ. U kizeehina ɔɔ ra chɔg Kɔraawiizi Diarɛ, di ɔɔ kpa Gbɔgni la ra sunni nɛra.

ref: All who do evil are shameless, but the Lord does right and is always fair. With the dawn of each day, God brings about justice.
text: Kɔraawiizi haa du a bolzeŋ biinii, di ra ɛɛ wia la n deŋlee, waa wiimaa ɛɛwɛ ra leu. Chɔɔzi maa, u ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wibii wiarɛ, waa wia ɛɛwɛ ra huhzi hɔpizifalii maa biini, ka banla wia n waa deŋlee waa hiihzi.

ref: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N chɔgi hɛssi ni a nɛra maanii. N gillɔɔ ba diikpega maa purgi, di gil ba ŋmɛnizi maa chɔɔ pɛɛ, nɛr maa waa kaa ra ga u biini. Ba bolzeŋkpega maa chɔgi, nɛr maa wàá kaa ka.

ref: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again. Nations Will Turn to the Lord
text: N ŋɔ a bolzeŋ hina benii, ‘Ií danna ɔmiŋ wibii maa, di ra sɛɛ n baglaa!’ Denii ii duuribɔr wàá chɔgi, gɛɛ màá tɛrgi ii digna. Ka ba haa aah siwii di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa ba wiɛɛlaa maa biini.”

ref: The Lord said: Just wait for the day when I accuse you nations. I have decided on a day, when I will bring together every nation and kingdom and punish them all in my fiery anger. I will become furious and destroy the earth.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Awia, ií chi kpaŋiŋ, dikuu hɔpizii la min niŋ chi di wibii la wia. N na nyiŋŋuu ń chaali hɛssi hina maa, di chaali kossi maa, di gil n baaŋ fuuh ba ni werge maa, n baaŋchɔgii la maa. N zoma baaŋ niŋ daŋ di durnya maa.

ref: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord.
text: Denii ń bir kuari nɛra nuuzi á du wer, bá maa ra yir mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ, di chaali ra hum n bɛŋ.

ref: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.
text: N nɛra la n yaarɛɛ ga du Itiopia muuni baŋgizi la daŋ kpa kuna di wa sunziŋ.

ref: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
text: Ba wàá du ia hiihzi a hɔl hiŋ, dikuu wichɔgaa la maa iiŋ faa ɛɛŋ la wia, dikuubɛɛwiai, n daŋ lizi banla maa n faa ra di suma di pɔɔh la, di lii bol naa biini. Ií ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka kpoŋ n giŋgimiinaniinanii la nyuu.

ref: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
text: Ka n daŋ du ii banla n waa iihinaa ra tɔgzi, di dɔɔ bunya, di yardiŋ la biini.

ref: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration
text: Izrɛl hina la n niŋ ka la wàá kaa ra ɛɛ wileulaa, ba wàá kaa ra kanni kara gɛɛ di kaa ra dar nɛra. Ba daŋ ɔɔ di, di chɔɔgi, ka nɛr maa wàá ka ɔnzi baa.”

ref: Everyone in Jerusalem and Judah, celebrate and shout with all your heart!
text: Izrɛl hina, ií ra yir yira! Jɛrusalɛm hina, ií ra chaasi werge! Ií gil ii bɔra ni ii bampiree maa sɔɔni!

ref: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.
text: Kɔraawiizi lizi iabuu tɔɔrɔɔ biini, u bir ii dɔmaa har. Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ Izrɛl koorizeŋ la du ii benii, ii ŋmɛnɛ maa wàá ka ɔm tɔɔrɔɔ maa.

ref: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: “Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!
text: A hɔl hiŋ ba daŋ ŋɔ Jɛrusalɛm hina be, “Bolzeŋ Ziɔn hina, ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm. Ií gilɛɛ gil ii nonee yɔɔri.

ref: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.” The Lord's Promise to His People
text: Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la du ii benii, u kpekkoo di ra lɛɛ. Ii wia daŋ paruu werge, u daŋ tɛɛ ia miibɔɔfalii dikuu uŋ nɔŋŋi ia wia, u daŋ yir bɔsɔna yir dikuu ii wia.”

ref: The Lord has promised: Your sorrow has ended, and you can celebrate.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Biinichɔg diuzenaa la baŋ ɛɛ sirya dau la, n daŋ lizaa ii be, di lizi hiihzi ii ni.

ref: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.
text: A guŋ saŋa, n daŋ tɔɔri banla maa n faa ra sunni ia la. N daŋ lɛɛ banla naazi ni nonee n siuzɛɛ, di chaali banla maa n yaarɛɛ la. N daŋ chɔli baa, di ra tɔgzi baa, hɛssi la maa baŋ faa kpa hiihzi kpu baa la biine.

ref: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord, have spoken!
text: A guŋ saŋa, n daŋ chaali ia ba bol. N danna tɔgzi ia, di ra chɔli ia, hɛri nɛra maa be, di n wa bittɔ tɛɛ ia ii kundɔɔlaa ii sibɔɔ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest. So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua
text: Pɛsia Koorizeŋ Dariɔs kora dii binni anɛɛhiŋ, baaguzi anumbɛlhiŋ, lugli hɔpiziirɛ Kɔraawiizi pilli wia naa tɛɛ u dɔgtɛɛ Hagai, di ŋɔ lugɔ u baglaa tɛɛ Sɛɛltiɛl biibaal Zɛrubabɛl, n ɛɛ Juda nabɔma ni Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Maa Nabɔma Jɛhɔzadak biibaal Josua.

ref: You harvest less than you plant, you never have enough to eat or drink, your clothes don't keep you warm, and your wages are stored in bags full of holes.
text: Ii duu kunaa werge, ka kum tama. Ii ra di, di ra nyɔɔ, ka ii waa kukki, di ra laali kuna, ka waari ra kpu ia. Ii hummɔɔ di ra na kinturgaa, ka a waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ tɛɛ ia. A ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ii kebee hure n furgɛɛ.”

ref: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.
text: Ií tinni bizenaa nyuuni, di ga tee daazenaa ba, di wa ma n Dia, ń bɔra jaa sɔɔni, bá ra jaamiŋ de, ń na girme. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: You expected much, but received only a little. And when you brought it home, I made that little disappear. Why have I done this? It's because you hurry off to build your own houses, while my temple is still in ruins.
text: Ii faa ra tami wergee, ka ii na tama. Kuna la iiŋ ɔɔ kpa lii ii kooni maanii aŋ gil a chɔgi. Bɛɛ n baani n na ɛɛ gunnɛi? N na ɛɛ gunnɛ, dikuu n Dia n purgee, ka ii bɛl maa dia wia aah u siwii wia.

ref: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.
text: Awiarɛ dooŋ waa ba, kummaa wàá wer hel la.

ref: And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.
text: N gillɔɔ hil chi. Awiarɛ, mia, siŋfalii, nuu ani kuna la maa n na lii hɛri, nyaa la. Newea ni sela waa kaa ra lul, ii huma maa ɔɔ bir pɛɛ la.”

ref: Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord.
text: Denii Sɛɛltiɛl biibaal Zɛrubabɛl ni Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Maa Nabɔma Jɛhɔzadak biibaal Josua sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔzi la ni u dɔgtɛɛ Hagai amaniye la uŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ baa la, dikuu Kɔraawiizi la banna hum la, n humuu wia. Kɔraawiizi wia faa jaa dɔɔ a nɛra ɔnsii.

ref: Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them.
text: Denii Hagai faa kpa Kɔraawiizi amaniye naa tɛɛ baa, di ŋɔ, “N du ii benii. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: And the work began on the twenty-fourth day of that same month.
text: Koorizeŋ Dariɔs kora dii binni anɛɛhiŋ, baaguzi anumbɛlhiŋ, hɔpizaa tokko ni anaazu hɔllɛ, ba faari a Dia mai.

ref: On the twenty-first day of the next month, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak this message to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and everyone else:
text: “Ŋɔ wia tɛɛ Juda hina nabɔma Sɛɛltiɛl biibaal Zɛrubabɛl ni Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Maa Nabɔma Jɛhɔzadak biibaal Josua ani Izrɛl hina la n kawɛɛ la, di pɛɛzi baa,

ref: But cheer up! Because I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be here to help you with the work,
text: Ka filaŋkeŋ, Zɛrubabɛl, Josua ani ii banla maa n du hɛri naa, ií chiiri zɛɛ, di hum a huma, dikuubɛɛwiai, n du ii benii. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ labuu ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: just as I promised your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt. Don't worry. My Spirit is right here with you.
text: Nua naabuu n faa ŋɔ tɛɛ ia, saŋa la iinna lii Ijip hɛri la. N Duma du ii benii. Ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm.’ ”

ref: Soon I will again shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
text: Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “A wàá birgi tama maa, ka ń kaa zigli chiŋ ni hɛri ani muuzenaa maa.

ref: I will shake the nations, and their treasures will be brought here. Then the brightness of my glory will fill this temple.
text: N daŋ kpegli hɛssi hina maa, di gil n Dia su ni ba daama kuna, di dɔɔ girme werge.

ref: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace. The Past and the Future
text: Filaŋkeŋ, n Dia naa girme daŋ kaali n Diibinii la girme. Denii ń gil bampirsɔna lii, di ba ii be. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hinnɛ ŋɔ guŋ.” Nɛra la n doŋŋe Kɔraawiizi be kissaa wia

ref: to ask the priests for their opinion on the following matters:
text: “Pɛɛzi n kizeehina bá bagli gunla mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Gbɔg la n na ŋɔ.

ref: Suppose meat ready to be sacrificed to God is being carried in the folds of someone's clothing, and the clothing rubs against some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or any other food. Would those foods that were touched then become acceptable for sacrifice? “Of course not,” the priests answered.
text: Di nɛr kpa ol la n waa doŋŋe n be di fɔɔ u wɛjɛ nua, de wa gbɔgzi paanuu gɛɛ dɔzi gɛɛ siŋ gɛɛ nuu gɛɛ diwee waa iri maa, a kundee ge ɔɔ birgi kunnaniinaniirɛ n bee?” Kɔraawiizi kizeehina la ŋɔ, “Akai.”

ref: Then Haggai said, “Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean?” “Of course they would,” the priests answered.
text: Denii Hagai kaa ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ di nɛr doŋŋo u be, dikuu uŋ gbɔgzi lalii wia, ka gbɔgzi annii bɛl maa, u daŋ doŋaa?” Ba ŋɔ, “Ɛɛh, u daŋ doŋ.”

ref: So the Lord told Haggai to say: That's how it is with this entire nation. Everything you do and every sacrifice you offer is unacceptable to me.
text: Hagai kaa ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ gunnɛ a nɛra naa ni ba hɛri naa wia du u be la. Ba wiɛɛlaa ni kuna la maa baŋ kpawɛɛ ra tɛu mbusu lizibɔr ni la doŋŋoo. Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: But from now on, things will get better. Before you started laying the foundation for the temple,
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ, “Awia, ií fɛ wia naa nfɛrɛ nɛnnɛ, di lii zinaa di ra la. Ií pessi nɛnnɛ gunla wia n faa duwɛɛ, ka ii faari n Dia naa mai la.

ref: That same day the Lord spoke to Haggai again and said:
text: Kɔraawiizi kaa pilli wia naa tɛɛ u dɔgtɛɛ Hagai bunɛɛhiŋ, a baagu hɔpizaa tokko ni anaazuhiŋ hɔl, di ra ŋɔ,

ref: I made all of your hard work useless by sending mildew, mold, and hail—but you still did not return to me, your Lord.
text: N faa gillɔɔ peu la n wenzee werge ni kɔɔla ani dobia chɔgi ii pattikuna maa, ka ii faa haa waa sɛɛwɛ ii biine chɔgi, ii gil ii wichɔgaa ha. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Today you have completed the foundation for my temple, so listen to what your future will be like.
text: Zinaa n ɛɛ baagu kabɛl hɔpizaa tokko ni anaazuhiŋ hɔl, iiŋ chiŋŋi n Dia naa zɛɛ tuŋ naa, ií ra nuu gunla ii kɛrɛbɛl wia n niŋ du.

ref: Although you have not yet harvested any grain, grapes, figs, pomegranates, or olives, I will richly bless you in the days ahead. God's Promise to Zerubbabel
text: Midee maa waa kaa hoo buuga biini. Di filaŋkeŋ lɛi, grepu, fig, pomegranet ani ɔlivi daazi faa waa nɔŋ, ka haŋ lii zinaa di ra la, n daŋ kissi ia.” Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ nua tɛɛ Zɛrubabɛl wia

ref: Tell Governor Zerubbabel of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth
text: “Ŋɔ Juda hina nabɔma Zɛrubabɛl be lugɔ n daŋ zigli chiŋ ni hɛri.

ref: and wipe out kings and their kingdoms. I will overturn war chariots, and then cavalry troops will start slaughtering each other.
text: N daŋ kpegli hɛrdumazi hina kossi ni ba fɔŋŋazi. N daŋ kaa kpegli laal zagra ni a torkozi ani a zuura. Laal zagra ni a tinna daŋ chogli, dikuu ba lulla n niŋ kpa tokobizi di kpuuzi baa wia.

ref: I am the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah and the grandson of Iddo. In the eighth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told me to say:
text: Pɛsia Koorizeŋ Dariɔs kora dii binni anɛɛhiŋ baaguzi ŋmantannaazi biinii, Kɔraawiizi kpa u amaniye tɛɛ Ido biibaal Bɛrɛkia ge biibaal Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ Zɛkaria.

ref: Israel, I, the Lord All-Powerful, was very angry with your ancestors. But if you people will return to me, I will turn and help you.
text: Ka filaŋkeŋ, n na ŋɔ ii benii, ií bir ba mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ be, n ge bir ba ii be.

ref: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. They were warned by the earlier prophets to give up their evil and turn back to me, but they paid no attention.
text: Ií gilɛɛ ɛɛ lugɔ ii naabaala. Faala la, n dɔgtɛɛzi faa feloore ŋɔ ba be lugɔ mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Ií bir lii ii wichɔgaa ŋmɛnizi la, di gil ii wichɔgaa wiɛɛlaa la.’ Ka ba waa sɛɛwɛ nuu n be gɛɛ di du n wiŋɔɔlaa tau. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Where are your ancestors now? Not even prophets live forever.
text: Ii naabaala la du lee filaŋkennei? Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi la ge gba waa kaa hoo.

ref: But my warnings and my words spoken by the prophets caught up with your ancestors. So they turned back to me and said, “Lord All-Powerful, you have punished us for our sins, just as you had planned.” First Vision: Horses and Riders
text: Ii naabaala faa vɛɛ n widaulaa ni n karfaazi la n dɔgtɛɛzi n faa ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ baa labuu. Awiarɛ tɔɔrɔɔ faa chol ba ni.
