text: Nɛr la maa n na hee n bɔrahɔŋ, di ra nyɔɔ n chal la, u du n benii, n ge du u be.

ref: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
text: N Mɛɛ la n dɔɔ miibɔɔ la humimbuu, n ge gba dɔɔ a miibɔɔ dikuu u wia. Gunnɛ nɛr la maa n na hee n bɔrahɔŋ naa, u ge daŋ na miibɔɔ dikuu n wia.

ref: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
text: Paanuu la n lii chiŋ himmaanii keŋ. Anla ii naabaala n heewe la faa waa miibɔɔ dɔɔwɛ. Ba maa faa siuzi. Ka banla maa n na hee paanuu naa, ba miibɔɔ wàá tuŋ maa.”

ref: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
text: Kapɛniɔm jaamaa dia biinii Yeesu faa du di ra bagli wia naa. Miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ wia

ref: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
text: U hiŋra n wa nuu u baglaa la, bakpila maa ŋɔ, “U baglaa naa kpollo yaa be werge. Yaa wàá wer sɛɛ guŋ.”

ref: Jesus knew that his disciples were grumbling. So he asked, “Does this bother you?
text: Yeesu teŋ zum lugɔ u wiŋɔzi labuu waa baa pattɛ wiarɛ ba ra ŋɔ a wia guŋ. U pɛɛzi baa, “N wiŋɔzi naa tir iabuu gɛɛ?

ref: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
text: Ka di ii ŋmɛnɛ wa na Mìŋ́ Newee Biibaal, n tinnɛɛ ra la bɔr la miŋ faa liwɛɛ ba la, ɛrɛɛ ií jaa ŋɔi?

ref: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
text: Ka ií zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii benii miibɔɔ lii. Bɔrahɔŋ waa kummaa ɛɛwɛ. Wia la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ ii be la, a ɛɛ duma wiarɛ, di kaa dɔɔ miibɔɔ.

ref: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
text: Ka ii baŋhina wan yardɛɛ.” Saŋa maanii Yeesu ɔɔ zum banla n wɔɔ yardɛɛ, di kaa zum nɛr la n niŋ wa ɛɛu sɔsɔgɔ la.

ref: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
text: U ŋɔ, “Awiarɛ n ŋɔ ii be lugɔ nɛr maa wàá wer ba n be, di n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi lɛi tɛrguu ba n be la.”

ref: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
text: Denii banla n faa ra hiŋ Yeesu la, bakpila maa jaa bir har. Ba waa kaa ra hiŋuu.

ref: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
text: Yeesu pɛɛzi u hiŋra fidibanɛɛ la, “Ii ge gba daŋ giliŋ gɛɛ?”

ref: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
text: Saimɔn Pitta ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri, anɛɛ benii ya kaa la ga duɛi? I bɛnnɛ dɔɔ wiŋɔzi la n dɔɔ miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
text: Yaabuu sɛɛ i wiarɛ, di zum lugɔ hinuu Kɔraawiizi Biinaniinanii la.”

ref: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
text: Yeesu ŋɔ ba be, “Ii nɛra fidibanɛɛ naa, minuu lizi ia ii ɛɛ n hiŋra. Ka ii bɛl ɛɛ Sitaanii.”

ref: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
text: Uŋ ŋɔ Sitaani hiŋ naa wia la, Saimɔn Iskariɔt biibaal Judas wiarɛ u ŋɔ gunla. A Judas faa ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra fidibanɛɛ la bɛllɛ, ka waabuu niŋ ŋmɛnɛ wa ɛɛu sɔsɔgɔ la.

ref: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
text: Denii Yeesu ra gaagi Galilii hɛri bɛŋ. Waa kaa ra gaagi Juda hɛri, dikuubɛɛwiai, Jus hina la n faa du de la ra nyiŋŋuu ba kpuu.

ref: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
text: Jus hina Pampannizi Hɔpizizeŋ la n waa dugli,

ref: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
text: Yeesu niuna ŋɔ u be, “Izi ɛŋ di la Juda hɛri, ií hiŋra wer na wizenaa la hinna ɛɛ la.

ref: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
text: Di i ra nyiŋŋi nɛra zum i wia, bɛɛ wiarɛ i kaa suahzi ra ɛɛ i wiai? Di gunnɛ i ra ɛɛ, amɔ, í lii chaaŋ dúrnya maa wer zum i wia.”

ref: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
text: Ba gba wɔɔ yardɛɛ. Awiarɛ ba ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “N saŋa haa waa helle mɔɔ. Iawaa daŋ wer la saŋa la maa n par ia.

ref: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
text: Durnya waa wette hah iawaa. Minuu ba hah, dikuubɛɛwiai, minuu ɔɔ ra ŋɔ lugɔ ba wiɛɛlaa waa wer.

ref: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
text: Awia, ií tɔ see ra la gaa di Hɔpizizenaa la. Miŋwaa haa wàá la mɔɔ. N laŋaa saŋa haa waa helle.”

ref: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
text: U ŋɔ guŋ, ka haa du Galilii hɛri. Yeesu n la Pampannizi Hɔpizizeŋ dii bɔr wia

ref: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
text: Baŋ wa kaalɛɛ tuŋ, u ge izi suahzi la de.

ref: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
text: Jus hina la n chaalɛɛ bá di ba Hɔpizizenaa la, faa ra binni u ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ, di ra pɛɛzi u wia dɔŋa be, “Lee a baal duɛi?”

ref: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
text: Nɛkpila la maa ra munni u wia de, ka ba waa nuukpaŋ dɔɔwɛ dɔŋa ni. Baŋhina ŋɔ u ɛɛ nɛnaniirɛ. Baŋhina ge ŋɔ, “Akai! Waa nɛnanii ɛɛwɛ. U ra dar nɛraa.”

ref: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
text: Ba maa ra munni u wia, dikuu banna ɔm Jus hina la wia.

ref: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
text: A Hɔpizizenaa baambaaŋ, Yeesu jaa izi di ga zuu Kɔraawiizi Dia, di ra bagli nɛra Kɔraawiizi wia de.

ref: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
text: U baglaa la tir Jus hina werge maa. Ba ŋɔ, “Baal naa waa Hɔnzunni ɛɛwɛ. Ka lee u lii zum wia naa kennei?”

ref: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “N baglaa naa, n himmaa hor lɛi. Unla n humiŋ la baglaarɛ.

ref: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
text: Di nɛr la maa wetto ra sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kipar hiŋaa, u daŋ wer zum wibii n baglaa naa biini, di a ɛɛ n himmaa wiarɛ gɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wiarɛ.

ref: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
text: Nɛr la maa n kpa u himmaa hor di ra bagli, sɔnnɛ u nyiŋŋi ra tɛɛ u hiŋ. Ka nɛr la n nyiŋŋi sɔŋ ra tɛɛ nɛr la n humuu la, u wia dɔɔ wibiire. Daraa waa hoo u be.

ref: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
text: Ii faa na Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgnii Moosis be, ka ii bɛl maa wàá ra hiŋ. Bɛɛ wiarɛ ii ra nyiŋŋi ií kpunnɛi?”

ref: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
text: Nɛra la ŋɔ, “Di kpuinɛi? Tinnanchɔgii hinnɛ hiŋ! U bɛliirɛ n na nyiŋŋi ú kpuinɛi?”

ref: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “Wizenkpannɛ n ɛɛ a tir ia.

ref: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons
text: Moosisii dau hɛŋ teŋaa tɛɛ ia, ka ii naabaala faari guŋ. Awia, ii ɔɔ teŋ ii biibaal hɛnnɛ Heezaa Hɔpizii gba.

ref: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
text: Denii Jɛrusalɛm hina baŋhina jaa ra ŋɔ, “Baal la banna nyiŋŋi u bɔr bá kpu la, waa lɛi keŋŋ?

ref: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
text: Ka u ra bagli wiarɛ bɔchaaŋ, ba waa wiimaa ŋɔwɛɛ tɛu. Amɔ, yaa nabɔnzi gba jaa sɛɛu lugɔ u ɛɛ Kristoo gɛɛ?

ref: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
text: Ɛrɛɛ? Yaa zum baal naa ni u liiribɔr maanii. Di Kristo himmaa wa ballɔ, nɛr maa wàá zum u liiribɔr.”

ref: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
text: Banna ŋɔ kennaa, Yeesu jaa chi Kɔraawiizi Dia la di ra ŋɔ wia ni bɔkpega, “Wibiire. Ii zumimbuu di zum n liiribɔr gba. Ka n himmaa sɔŋ lɛi n kpa ba. Unla n humiŋ la du denii di ɛɛ wibii hiŋ. Ii waa waabuu zummɛ.

ref: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
text: Miŋwaa zumuubuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, u benii n lii. Waabuu humiŋ n ba.”

ref: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
text: Denii ba jaa ra ɛɛ ania maa bá lawuu, ka lawuu huhzi, dikuubɛɛwiai, u saŋa faa haa waa helle.

ref: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
text: Nɛkpila la bakpila maa yardi Yeesu, di ŋɔ, “Wizenaa la baŋ faa ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ Kristo daŋ wa ɛɛa la, a daŋ wa ɛɛ wizenaa kaali annii baal naa n na ɛɛ naaa?”

ref: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
text: Farisizi n wa nuu gunla a nɛra n na munni u wia di ra tɛɛ dɔŋa la, ba ni Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Nabɔnzi hum Kɔraawiizi Dia balaa, bá la ga lawuu.

ref: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
text: Ba la, di Yeesu haa ra ŋɔ wia, di ra ŋɔ, “Màá ka birgi ii be. N daŋ du ii be tama bɛŋ, ka jaa bir la unla n humiŋ la be.

ref: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
text: Ii daŋ nyiŋŋi n bɔr, ka nyiŋŋiŋ huhzi. Bɔr la minna la la, ii ge wàá wer la de.”

ref: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
text: Jus hina jaa ra pɛɛzi dɔŋa, “Lee ú la, yá wa nyiŋŋuu huhzi naanɛi? U ŋɔ ú lau ga du yaa banla n yaarɛɛ, di du Giris hina biini la benii, di ra bagli a Giris hina gɛɛ?

ref: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
text: Kennaa unna ŋɔ lugɔ yaa daŋ nyiŋŋi u bɔr, ka nyiŋŋuu huhzi naa, di kaa ŋɔ lugɔ bɔr la unna la, yaa ge wàá wer la de naa, guŋ zɛɛrɛ ɛrɛɛ?”

ref: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
text: Denii ba Hɔpizizenaa la tuna hiŋ la n ɛɛ ba Hɔpizizeŋ himmaa la hɔl, Yeesu izi di chi di ŋɔ bɔkpega ni, “Hinla maa n na wii niinyɔgzi, í ba n be di wa na nii nyɔɔ.

ref: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
text: Hinla maa n niŋ yardiŋ, i daŋ wa ɛɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ n ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ nii la n dɔɔ miibɔɔ, daŋ ɔɔ lii i ni saŋa maa alugɔ muu n na pal la.”

ref: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
text: Nii naa wia uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ naa, Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii la un niŋ wa kpa di du banla n yarduu ni la, wiarɛ u kpa ra mɛgzi nii. A saŋa, ba faa haa waa u Dumnanii la nawɛɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, Yeesu faa haa waa u girme nawɛɛ. A nɛra n bargɛɛ wia

ref: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
text: Yeesu n wa ŋɔ kennaa, a nɛra baŋhina ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛrɛ keŋ.”

ref: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
text: Baŋhina ge ŋɔ, “Kristoo.” Ka baŋhina waa sɛɛwɛ, ka ŋɔ, “Di Kristo wa ballɔ, u daŋ ɛɛ Galilii hinuurɛ naa?

ref: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
text: Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ baglɔɔrɛ lugɔ Kristo daŋ ɛɛ Deevid naana bɛllɛ, di lii u bol Bɛtlihɛm. Awia, waa lɛi.”

ref: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
text: Ba waa wette dɔɔ nuukpaŋ dɔŋa ni.

ref: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
text: Baŋhina faa ra nyiŋŋi bá lawuu, ka lawuu huhzi. Jus hina nabɔnzi yarda nyaai wia

ref: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
text: Kɔraawiizi Dia balaa la bir la Farisizi ni Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Nabɔnzi la be. Ba ga pɛɛzi baa, “Ɛrɛɛ ii wɔɔ lauwɛ banɛi?”

ref: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
text: Farisizi la pɛɛzi, “Amɔ, u wettoo dar ii ge gbaa?

ref: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
text: Ii na yaa nabɔnzi bɛl maa n na sɛɛ u wiaa? Ii kaa na yaa Farisizi ge bɛl maa n na sɛɛ u wiaa?

ref: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
text: Ka nɛdumazi la n waa Moosis Hɔŋ zummɛ la, baabuu ra sɛɛ u wia. Kɔraawiizi see baabuu nua.”

ref: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
text: Ba bɛl ɛɛ Nikɔdɛmus la n faa la Yeesu be labuu. U ge ŋɔ,

ref: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
text: “Ka Moosis Hɔŋ la biini, ba baglɔɔrɛ lugɔ ya gilɛɛ feli di baal maa seriya u chol, di yaa haa waa u be nuuwɛ, di zum u wiɛɛlaa maa nɛnnɛ mɔɔ.”

ref: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
text: Ba ŋɔ, “Amɔ, i gba ɛɛ Galilii hinuurɛa? Pigzi Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ maa na. Waa baglɛɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛ bɛl maa daŋ wa lii Galilii hɛri.”

ref: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
text: Denii Yeesu izi kaali Ɔlivizi Bizeŋ la nyuu.

ref: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
text: Chɔɔzimpikke ni, u kaa ba Kɔraawiizi Dia. Nɛkpila la kaa chaali ba u be. U so di ra bagli baa Kɔraawiizi wia.

ref: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi Hɔnzunna ni Farisizi baŋhina kpogli haaŋ bɛl di ba u be, di gil u chi ba maa baambaaŋ. A haaŋ ge ni baal bɛl faa ra sɛmuu, ba lawuu.

ref: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
text: Farisizi la ŋɔ Yeesu be, “Yaa Nabɔma, haaŋ naa ni baal bɛl faa ra sɛmuu, yaa lawuu.

ref: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
text: Moosis Hɔŋ biini, u bagli yaabuu lugɔ di nɛr maa ra ɛɛ guŋ, bá paa bia lɔɔzuu kpu. Ka ɛrɛɛ i ge ŋɔ u wiai?”

ref: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
text: Ba pɛɛzuubuu guŋ bá ɛɛu na, di wer na u cholli bɔr, di ŋɔ u wia. Yeesu siigi ba ni ka togni di kpa u nonibii di ra sɛbi hɛri.

ref: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
text: Ba haa vɛɛ ra pɛɛzuu guŋŋ, u jaa izi chiŋ di ŋɔ ba be, “Hinla maa n waa wichɔgaa dɔɔwɛ, hìŋ́ niŋ feli kpa bii lɔu.”

ref: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
text: Uŋ wa ŋɔ guŋ tuŋ, u kaa togni di ra sɛbi hɛri.

ref: The people left one by one, beginning with the oldest. Finally, Jesus and the woman were there alone.
text: Uŋ ŋɔ gunla, ba maa biine ra tɛɛ baa chɔgri, ba nabɔnzi izi kaali kpaŋkpaŋa guŋŋ di wa hel bichalli, ba maa kaali ka ka Yeesu ni haaŋ la n faa chigɛ ba maa baambaaŋ la.

ref: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
text: Yeesu izi chiŋ, di a haaŋ bɛnnɛ chigɛ u see. U pɛɛzuu, “Lee ba maa duɛi? Bɛl maa waa kaa hoo ú tɛi chɔgri gɛɛ?”

ref: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
text: U ŋɔ, “Bɛl maa waa hoo, n Dɔɔri.” Yeesu ŋɔ, “N gba wàá tɛi chɔgri. A la, ka gilɛɛ kaa wàá ɛɛ i wichɔgaa hiŋ, di haŋ lii zinaa di ra la.” Yeesuu durnya fintina

ref: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
text: Yeesu kaa ra bagli nɛra la, di ra ŋɔ, “N ɛɛ fintinaa di ra chaani durnya. Hinla maa n niŋ hiŋiŋ, hàá ka vol bɔbiri. I daŋ du bɔchaaŋ, di dɔɔ miibɔɔ.”

ref: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
text: Farisizi baŋhina du de, di ŋɔ, “Hinuu ŋɔ i wia. Hinuu kaa di i himmaa daansɛɛ. Awia, karaa i ra kanni.”

ref: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “N di n himmaa daansɛɛrɛ, ka kara lɛi. Wibiire, dikuubɛɛwiai, n zum bɔr la miŋ liwɛɛrɛ, di kaa zum bɔr la minna la. Iabuu waa zum n liiribɔr. Ii waa kaa zum n laŋribɔr ge.

ref: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
text: Durnya zumaarɛ ii kpa di ra binni n wia biini. Miŋwaa waa nɛra wia biini ra binni.

ref: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
text: Ka di n vii ra ŋɔ ba wia, n daŋ wer ŋɔa a deŋli, dikuubɛɛwiai, n bɛŋ lɛi niŋ ŋɔ ba wia gunla baŋ duwɛɛ. N ni n Mɛɛ la n humiŋ labuu niŋ ŋɔ ba wia guŋ.

text: “Ií gil n ŋɔ wibii maa tɛɛ ia. Nɛr la maa n wàá sɛɛ ga pelig dominua zuu peeza biini, ka ga bɔduma di tinni tuu de, ŋmɛɛnnɛ a hiŋ.

ref: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
text: Di penɔɔni himmaa wa ballɔ, a pelig binni daŋ pilli dominua tɛu, ú zuu. A peeza ge daŋ zum u loobii, u ra yir anla n ɛɛ u hora sɔna, á hiŋuu ra lii.

ref: When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice.
text: Di u wa lizi anla n ɛɛ u hora tuŋ, ɔɔ tɔ a seere, a ra hiŋuu. A zum u loobiire. Awiarɛ a ɔɔ ra hiŋuu la.

ref: The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.
text: Di penɔɔniduma bɛl wa yiraa, a wàá sɛɛ hiŋ a hiŋ. A daŋ chɔ u be, dikuu aŋ waa nɛdumazi loobee zummɛ wia.”

ref: Jesus said: I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep.
text: U kaa ŋɔ ba be, “Ií gil n ŋɔ wibii maa tɛɛ ia. Minuu pelig dominua la.

ref: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.
text: Banla n faa feliŋ ba la, ba ɛɛ ŋmɛɛnaa. Peeza la waa nuuwɛ tɛɛ baa.

ref: I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.
text: N bɛnnɛ ɛɛ dominua. Gunla peeza n ɔɔ ba dominua di wa zuu, ka bir lii ra nyiŋŋi kooree á di la, gunnɛ nɛ́r la maa n niŋ ba n be wer na lɛɛi n be.

ref: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
text: Winanaa wia lɛi ŋmɛɛŋ ɔɔ ba. U ɔɔ bau wer ŋmɛɛ peeza di ra kpu, di ra chɔgaa. Miŋwaa ballɔɔ nɛ́ra wer na miibɔɔnanii, di kaa wer dɔɔ wia la maa n niŋ gil ba di suma.

ref: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep.
text: Minuu penɔɔninanii. N daŋ kuu n peeza wia siu.

ref: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.
text: Nɛr la n waa penɔɔni himmaa ɛɛwɛ, ka ra nɔɔni peeza la n waa u himmaa hora ɛɛwɛ di ra lɛɛ kebee la, di a hiŋ wa na saŋkarahiŋ n na ba, ɔɔ gil a peezaa ka ra chɔ, a saŋkarahiŋ ba di wa lauri a peeza aŋhina kaali, anla n kawɛɛ la ge maa yaari.

ref: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
text: Kebee wiarɛ a hiŋ ra nɔɔni a peeza. Waa a bila dɔɔwɛ. Awiarɛ ɔɔ chɔ la.

ref: I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and they know me.
text: Minuu penɔɔninanii la. N zum n peezaa, a ge zumiŋ.

ref: Just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I give up my life for my sheep.
text: Gunnɛ n ni n mɛɛ gba. N zumuubuu, u ge zumiŋ. N daŋ kuu n peeza wia siu.

ref: I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.
text: N peeza aŋhina haa du liga aŋhina biinii. N daŋ nyiŋŋi a ge bɔr di tɔ a see. A gba daŋ zum n loobii di hiŋiŋ, á maa wa ɛɛ kpaŋ, á binni ge jaa ɛɛ nɛkpaŋ.

ref: The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again.
text: N mɛɛ nɔŋŋi n wiarɛ dikuu min niŋ kuu n peeza la wia siu, ka kaa izi siu biini wia.

ref: No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.
text: Nɛr maa lɛi niŋ firiŋ ń siu. N himmaanii niŋ siu. N dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa min niŋ wer siu, di kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa min niŋ kaa wer izi siu biini. N mɛɛrɛ ŋɔ ń ɛɛ guŋ.”

ref: But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!” Jesus Is Rejected
text: Baŋhina ge ŋɔ, “Wiŋɔzi naa, tinnanchɔgii hiŋ wiŋɔzi lɛi, di kaa pɛɛzi, Tinnanchɔgii hiŋ daŋ wer pilli nɛra siweaa?” Jus hina n vɛɛ Yeesu wia

ref: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.

ref: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,

text: di ra tɛɛ baa miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ. Ba wàá siu maa. Nɛr maa wàá wer foozi baa n nonee biini.

ref: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,

text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, ba sɛbɔɔrɛ, ‘Ii bɛl maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi.’ Ii haa waa de karmɛɛa?

ref: You can't argue with the Scriptures, and God spoke to those people and called them gods.
text: Di u wetto yir banla um bagli baa u wia la kɔraawiizizi, Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ ge waa guŋ vɛɛwɛ,

ref: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.
text: Di u wiɛɛlaa lɛi n na ɛɛ, amɔ, ií gilɛɛ sɛɛ n wia.

text: Ka di u wiɛɛlaarɛ n na ɛɛ, ií sɛɛ n wia. Di ii wàá wer sɛɛ tɛɛ miŋwaa himmaa, ka ií sɛɛ di ra tɛɛ n wiɛɛlaa waa. Denii ií wer zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi du n ninɛɛ, n ge du u ni.”

ref: Again they wanted to arrest Jesus. But he escaped
text: Ba kaa ra nyiŋŋi bá lawuu. U kaa foozi ba nonee di lii,

text: di kaa gi Jɔɔdan muu la di la bɔr la Jɔɔn n faa ra sɔ nɛra Kɔraawiizi nii la, di ga du de.

ref: When Jesus heard this, he said, “His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.”

ref: But he stayed where he was for two more days.

ref: Jesus answered, “Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble.
text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “Di hɔɔ wa pizɔɔ guŋŋ di wa hel wiizi cholaa saŋa la, karfizi fidaanɛɛ lɛiyaa? Di hinla maa ra vol bɔchaaŋ, hàá lɔ i naa dikuu wiizi n na chaani bɔr wia.

ref: But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.”
text: Ka hinla maa n na vol hamuŋa ni daŋ lɔ i naa, dikuu bɔr n waa chaanɛɛ wia.”

ref: Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
text: Uŋ wa ŋɔ guŋ tuŋ, u kaa ŋɔ, “Yaa dammu Lazarɔs a chɔɔ dɔɔrɛ. N ŋɔ ń la ga lalluu.”

ref: They replied, “Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.”
text: U hiŋra ŋɔ, “Yaa Dɔɔri, di u ra chɔɔ dɔɔ, amɔ, u daŋ nyaagi.”

ref: Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.
text: Baawaa faa zumɔɔ lugɔ dɔɔ himmaanii Yeesu ŋɔ. Ka siu wiarɛ u ŋɔ gunla.

ref: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
text: Ii daŋ yardiŋ jaa di lii wia naa biini. Awia, n bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ miŋ faa waa hoo de. Ka ií izi ya la u be.”

ref: Thomas, whose nickname was “Twin,” said to the other disciples, “Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.” Jesus Brings Lazarus to Life
text: Yeesu hiŋri bɛl sɔnnɛ Tɔmas, ba kaa ra yiruu Biinɛɛri. U ŋɔ u dɔŋa Yeesu hiŋra la be, “Ií gil yaa nuu maa la, di ba gaa kpuu, yaa nuu maa siu.” Yeesu n tig Lazarɔs niuhambizi bampiree wia

text: N Mɛɛ dia dɔɔ diinii kpilaa werge, wibii maa. Di u vii waa guŋ dɔɔwɛ, n daŋ faa bagli ia guŋ? N na la denii ń gaa ɛɛ a diini sirya di ra dau ia ií ra ba.

ref: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
text: Di n wa laŋŋɔ di ga ɛɛ a sirya maa wa tuŋ, n daŋ kaa bir ba di wa chaali ii maa di la de yáa maa ga wer du bɔkpaŋ de.

ref: You know the way to where I am going.”
text: Ii ge zum bɔr la minna la ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ.” Yeesuu ɛɛ ŋmɛnɛɛ

ref: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
text: Tɔmas ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri, yaa waa zum bɔr la hinna la. Ka ɛrɛɛ ya ɛɛ zum u ŋmɛnɛɛi?”

ref: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “Minuu ŋmɛnɛɛ, minuu wibii, minuu miibɔɔ. Nɛr maa wàá wer la Kɔraawiizi be di waa n be ballɛ lɛi.

ref: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
text: Di ii vii zumimbuu nɛnnɛ, ii daŋ vii zum n Mɛɛ gba. Filaŋkeŋ ii jaa zumuubuu di ra nau.”

ref: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
text: Filip ŋɔ u be, “N Dɔɔri, gil ya na yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la ka á jaa par yaa.”

ref: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “Filip, miŋ du ii be birgi kennaa, ka i haa wan zummɛa? Nɛr la maa n naŋ, u na n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi gbaa. Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ i kaa ŋɔ ń gil i na i mɛɛ Kɔraawiizɛi?

ref: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
text: Haa sɛɛwɛ lugɔ n du Kɔraawiizi ninɛɛ, u ge du n nii? Wii la maa minna ŋɔ, n be lɛi a lii. N Mɛɛ la n du n ni la, waabuu ɔɔ ra hum u huma guŋ.

ref: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
text: Ií yardiŋ alugɔ n du Kɔraawiizi ninɛɛ, u ge du n ni. Di ii wàá wer kuu n wiŋɔzi naa wia sɛɛ, ka ií sɛɛ dikuu n wizenaa naawaa wia.

ref: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
text: Ií gil n ŋɔ wibii maa tɛɛ ia. Nɛr la maa n niŋ sɛɛ n wia, wizenaa la miŋ ɔɔ ra ɛɛ la, a hiŋ gba daŋ ɛɛa di kaa ɛɛ anla n kpekke di kaali annii gba dikuu minna la n Mɛɛ be wia.

ref: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
text: Di ii wa suŋŋiŋ wii la maa, n daŋ ɛɛu tɛɛ ia, dikuu iiŋ kpa n sɔŋ di suŋŋi la wia ń wer na girme tɛɛ n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi.

ref: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
text: Di ii kpa n sɔŋ di suŋŋiŋ wiimaa, n daŋ ɛɛu tɛɛ ia. Yeesu n ŋɔ nua u Dumnanii wia

ref: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
text: Di ii nɔŋŋiŋ, amɔ, ii daŋ hiŋ n nuuzi.

ref: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
text: N daŋ suŋŋi n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ú kaa tɛɛ ia Nɛhiini bɛl n niŋ wer du ii be di ra la.

ref: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
text: U Dumnanii labuu ń suŋŋi tɛɛ ia. U daŋ bagli ia wibii. Durnya wàá wer sɛɛ u Dumnanii la wia, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba siwee wàá wer nau, bá zumuu. Ka iawaa zumuubuu dikuu uŋ ɔɔ du ii be wia. U daŋ wa du ii biine.

ref: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
text: Màá gil ia ha ii birgi lugɔ lalbiizi. N daŋ bir ba ii be.

ref: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
text: Di a wa ɛɛ tama, durnya wàá ka naŋ. Ka iawaa daŋ haa ra naŋ. N daŋ haa ra nyiŋ. Ii gba daŋ na miibɔɔ dikuu miŋwaa miibɔɔ la wia.

ref: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
text: Di n saŋa wa hello, ii daŋ jaa zum nɛnnɛ lugɔ n du n Mɛɛ ninɛɛ, ii ge du n ni, n ge du ii ni.

ref: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
text: Nɛr la maa n sɛɛwɛ tɛɛ n nuuzi naa di ɔɔ ra hiŋaa, waabuu nɔŋŋiŋ nɛnnɛ. N Mɛɛ daŋ nɔŋŋi unla maa n nɔŋŋiŋ guŋ. N gba daŋ nɔŋŋuu di kpa n hiŋ bagluu.”

ref: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
text: Judas jaa pɛɛzuu wii bɛl, “N Dɔɔri, bɛɛ n baani i ŋɔ i daŋ kpa i hiŋ bagli yaa ka hàá sɛɛ bagli durnya maa waai?”

ref: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “Di ii nɔŋŋimbuu wibii, amɔ, ii daŋ ɔɔ ra hiŋ n baglaa. Denii ń mɛɛ nɔŋŋi ia ń nuu maa ba ii be di ɔɔ wa du ii ni.

ref: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
text: Nɛr la maa n wan nɔŋŋɛɛ, wàá ra hiŋ n baglaa. Ka wiŋɔzi la iin nuuwɛ n be la, n hora lɛi. N Mɛɛ la n humiŋ la benii a lii.

ref: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
text: Miŋ haa du ii be naa, minuu ra bagli ia.

ref: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
text: Ka di n wa kaalɔɔ, Nɛhiini la, Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii la un niŋ hum ú ba wa lɛɛ n bɔr la, waabuu niŋ waa bagli ia wiimaa di ra liizi ia wii la maa miŋ bagli ia la.

ref: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
text: Minna kaali naa, n tɛɛ iabuu bampirsɔna. N himmaa bampirsɔnaa n kpa tɛɛ ia la. Durnya bampirsɔna lɛi. Awia, ií gilɛɛ gil wiimaa kaa tir ia di gilɛɛ ra ɔm.

ref: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
text: Ii nuuwɔɔ miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ n daŋ la ka bir ba. Di ii vii nɔŋŋimbuu nɛnnɛ, ii bɔra daŋ vii sɔɔni ia lugɔ miŋ ŋɔ minna la n Mɛɛ benii naa. N Mɛɛrɛ dɔɔ zenni kaaliŋ.

ref: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
text: N feloore di ra ŋɔ wia naa ii be ka á haa wa ɛɛ, di a wa ɛɛwɔ ií jaa wer yardiŋ.

ref: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
text: N ni ia wàá ka ŋɔ wia werge filaŋkeŋ. Durnya koori ra bau. Waa n wiimaa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ ú firiŋ.

ref: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
text: Ka u ra bau dúrnya maa wer zum lugɔ n nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizii di ra ɛɛ u kipar la uŋ faa ŋɔ ń na ɛɛ la maa di ga tuŋ. Ií izi, ya kaali.”

ref: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
text: “Minuu grepu daa himmaa. N Mɛɛ genii ra par u biini di ra binnuu.

ref: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
text: Di u kel bɛl maa waa kaa ra nɔŋ, ɔɔ teŋuu ha. Ka anla n na nɔŋ la, ɔɔ teŋri a nuuzii ha, ka á wer hel di nɔŋ nɛnnɛ.

ref: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
text: Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kela la n Mɛɛ n kɛuri a nuuzi ha labuu dikuu n baglaa la miŋ ɔɔ ra bagli ia la wia.

ref: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
text: Ií gil n ni ia kpau nɛnnɛ ń miibɔɔ wer du ii ni, ií ge wer du n ni. Grepu daa kel wàá wer nɔŋ di waa u lau ni duwɛɛ. Gunnɛ ii ge gba wàá wer ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kipar di ii waa n ni duwɛɛ la.

ref: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
text: Minuu grepu daa la. Ii ge ɛɛ u kela. Di hìŋ́ kel sɛɛwɔ di du n ni nɛnnɛ, n ge du i ni, i daŋ wer nɔŋ werge. Di haa n ni duwɛɛ, hàá wer nɔŋ.

ref: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
text: Di hinla maa waa sɛɛwɛ du n ni, i daŋ ta lugɔ kel la baŋ teŋŋe ha u hil ba kpau ha niŋ biini u fuuh la.

ref: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
text: Di ii ɔɔ du n ninɛɛ, n wiŋɔzi ge du ii ni, ii danna suŋŋi wii la maa iin niŋ suŋŋi di nau.

ref: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
text: N nɔŋŋi iabuu gunla n Mɛɛ n nɔŋŋi n ge la. Ií ɔɔ du n nɔŋŋaa la biini.

ref: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
text: Di ii ɔɔ ra hiŋ n baglaa, ii daŋ ɔɔ du n nɔŋŋaa la biini. N gba hiŋ n Mɛɛ nuuzii di du u nɔŋŋaa biini.

ref: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
text: N bagli iabuu wia naa ń bɔsɔna wer du ii ni, ií ge bɔra wer sɔɔni ia werge di ga tuŋ.

ref: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
text: N widauliirɛ keŋ. Ií nɔŋŋi dɔŋa gunla miŋ nɔŋŋi ia la.

ref: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
text: Nɛr la n wette kuu u dammuzi wia siu, u nɔŋŋaa labuu kannɛ kaali nɔŋŋaa maa.

ref: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
text: Di ii ɔɔ ra hiŋ n nuuzi la, amɔ, ii ɛɛ n dammuzii.

ref: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
text: Màá kaa ra yir ia n balaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, balii waa ɔɔ zum u dɔɔri wikpoglaa. Ka n bagli iabuu wii la maa miŋ nuuwɛ n Mɛɛ be. Awia, n dammuzii jaa ia.

ref: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
text: Ii wan lizɛɛ. Minuu lizi ia di kaa ra hum ia ií wer di ra ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kipar wia werge maa alugɔ kel la n nɔnnɛ di ra la saŋa maa la. Di ii wetto ɛɛ guŋ, wii la maa iin niŋ kpa n sɔŋ suŋŋi n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, u daŋ tɛɛ ia.

ref: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
text: Wii la miŋ ŋɔ ií ra ɛɛ la, waabuu lugɔ ií nɔŋŋi dɔŋa. Durnya hahzi wia

ref: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
text: Di durnya hina hah ia, ií zum lugɔ minuu ba feli hah mɔɔ.

ref: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
text: Di ii ni baa vii ɛɛ kpaŋ, ba daŋ vii nɔŋŋi ia. Ka miŋ lizi ia tɛɛ n hiŋ la, ii waa kaa hoo ba be. Awiarɛ ba hah ia la.

ref: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
text: Ií ɔɔ ra liizi wii la miŋ faa bagli ia lugɔ balii waa u dɔɔri ra kaali la. Di ba faa tɔɔrimbuu, ba daŋ tɔɔri ii ge gba. Di ba faa hiŋ n nuarɛ, ba daŋ hiŋ ii ge gba nuuzi.

ref: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
text: Ka wii la maa ban niŋ ɛɛ ia dikuu n wia, baŋ waa unla n humiŋ la zummɛ wiarɛ bá ɛɛ ia guŋ.

ref: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
text: Di n faa waa ba be ballɛ di wa bagli baa, ba vii wàá dɔɔ chɔgri. Ka baŋ nuuwɛ ka vɛɛ la, ba waa kaa dɔɔ nua ban niŋ ŋɔ di lii a biini.

ref: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
text: Nɛr la maa n hahŋ, n mɛɛrɛ u hah.

ref: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
text: Di n faa waa ba be ballɛ di wa ɛɛ wizenaa la baŋ faa haa waa a dɔŋa nawɛɛ, di ɛɛa ba baaŋ la, ba vii wàá dɔɔ chɔgri. Ba na a maanii ka haa vɛɛ hah n ni n Mɛɛ maa la.

ref: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
text: Keŋ ɛɛwɔɔ dikuu wii la baŋ sɛbɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini yembɛl, di ŋɔ, ‘Ba hahmbuu pɛɛpɛɛ.’

ref: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
text: Ka n daŋ hum Nɛr lii Kɔraawiizi be ú waa hiini ia. Waabuu Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii la n na bagli u wibii la. Kɔraawiizi benii ú lii. Di u wa ballɔ, u daŋ ɛɛ n daansɛɛ hiŋ.

ref: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
text: Ii gba ɛɛ n daansɛɛ hinaa dikuu iin du n be lugli la guŋŋ di wa hel zinaa la wia.”

ref: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
text: Yeesu kaa ŋɔ, “N bagli iabuu wia naa, wii maa gilɛɛ wa wer bir ia har.

ref: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
text: Ba daŋ duŋŋi ia ba jaamaa diini biini zuui. Wibii maa, ŋmɛnɛbɛl ba danna binni lugɔ di ba kpu ia, Kɔraawiizi kiparuu ba ra ɛɛ guŋ.

ref: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
text: Annii maanii bá ɛɛ ia dikuu baŋ waa n ni n Mɛɛ zummɛ la wia.

ref: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
text: Ka n bagli iabuu a wia, di a wa ɛɛwɔ, ií wer liizi di zum lugɔ n faa bagli iabuu guŋ. Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii huma wia N faa waa ia baglɛɛ wia naa saŋa la dikuu miŋ ɔɔ faa du ii be la wia.

ref: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
text: Ka filaŋkennaa, n daŋ bir la unla n humiŋ la be. Ii bɛl maa waa kaa ra pɛɛziŋ bɔr la minna la,

ref: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
text: Ka ii gillɔɔ ii biine chɔgi dikuu n wiŋɔzi naa wia.

ref: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
text: Ií gil n ŋɔ wibii maa tɛɛ ia. Minna kaali naa, u guŋ daŋ lii suma tɛɛ ia. Di maa haŋ kaali, Nɛhiini la ge wàá ba ii be. Ka di n wa kaalɔɔ, n daŋ humuu tɛɛ ia.

ref: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
text: Di u wa ballɔ, u daŋ di wibii tɛɛ durnya, di bagli unla hor n waa sum ani unla hor n summɛ ani gunla Kɔraawiizi seriya dii n duwɛɛ.

ref: The Spirit will show them that they are wrong about sin, because they didn't have faith in me.
text: U daŋ di wibii tɛɛ baa, bá sɛɛ lugɔ ba hor waa sum, dikuu baŋ waa sɛɛwɛ tɛŋ wia,

ref: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
text: di kaa bagli lugɔ n hor summɔ dikuu minna la n Mɛɛ be ii wàá ka naŋ wia,

ref: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
text: di kaa bagli gunla Kɔraawiizi seriya dii n duwɛɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u teŋ di durnya naa koorii seriya u chol.

ref: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
text: N dɔɔ wikpila min niŋ ŋɔ ii be. Ka a daŋ du kpol ii be iin niŋ wer zum a zɛɛ filaŋkeŋ.

ref: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
text: Ka di Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii la n ɔɔ bagli wibii la wa ballɔ, u daŋ pilli wiimaa ni u zɛɛ di tɛɛ ia. Wàá kpa u himmaa hor bagli ia. Gunla un nuuwɛ Kɔraawiizi be, gunnɛ ú bagli ia di gil ii zum wia la n niŋ haa ba la.

ref: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
text: U daŋ tɛɛ n ge sɔŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u daŋ kpa n wia bagli ia.

ref: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
text: N Mɛɛ wia la maa ɛɛ n gba wiarɛ. Awiarɛ n ŋɔ u Dumnanii daŋ kpa n wia bagli ia la. Biinichɔg ni Bɔsɔna wia

ref: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
text: Di a wa ɛɛ tama, ii wàá ka naŋ. Di a kaa wa ɛɛ tama ge, ii daŋ kaa naŋ.”

ref: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
text: U hiŋra baŋhina pɛɛzi dɔŋa, “U wiŋɔzi naa zɛɛrɛ ɛrɛɛ? U ŋɔ di a wa ɛɛ tama yaa wàá ka nau, di a kaa wa ɛɛ tama ge, yaa daŋ kaa nau, di kaa ŋɔ yaa wàá nau dikuu unna la u mɛɛ be wia.”

ref: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
text: Ba maa ra aani u wiŋɔzi la zɛɛ di ŋɔ, “A ka tama naa, u zɛɛrɛ ɛrɛɛ? Yaa waa zum wii la maa wia unna bagli keŋ.”

ref: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
text: Yeesu zum lugɔ ba ra nyiŋŋuu ba pɛɛzuu guŋ. U ge pɛɛzi baa, “Miŋ ŋɔ a ka tama ii wàá ka naŋ, a kaa wa ɛɛ tama, ii daŋ kaa naŋ naa, ii ra aani u zɛɛrɛ gɛɛ?

ref: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
text: Ií gil n ŋɔ wibii maa tɛɛ ia. Ii biine daŋ chɔgi werge maa ii ra wii, ka durnya waa bɔra sɔɔni baa. Wibii maa, ii biine daŋ chɔgi. Ka di a kaa wa ɛɛ tama, ii bɔra bir sɔɔni ia werge maa.

ref: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
text: Di haaŋ na nyiŋŋi u lul bie, di u saŋa wa hello, a ɔɔ ra nuubuu, u biini chɔgi. Ka di u wa luluu tuŋ, u bɔra ɔɔ kaa sɔɔnuu dikuu uŋ wette lul bie du durnya wia. Waa kaa ra liizi gunla aŋ faa nuuu la.

ref: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
text: Gunnɛ ií ge du. Ii biine chɔkkɔɔ filaŋkeŋ, ka n daŋ kaa na ia. Denii ií bɔra sɔɔni ia werge maa nɛra chɔg ii bɔsɔna hiŋ huhzi.

ref: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
text: Ii wàá ka pɛɛziŋ wiimaa a saŋa. Ií gil n ŋɔ wibii maa tɛɛ ia. N Mɛɛ daŋ kuu n wia tɛɛ ia wii la maa iin niŋ suŋŋuu.

ref: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
text: Ii faa waa kummaa ra suŋŋi ani n sɔŋ. Ka filaŋkennaa, ií ra suŋŋi. Di ii ra suŋŋi, ii daŋ na ií bɔra sɔɔni ia werge maa di ga tuŋ.

ref: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
text: N faa ta sɛɛliizii ra bagli ia. Ka saŋa bɛl daŋ wa hel, di a saŋa wa hello, màá ka ta sɛɛliizi ra bagli ia n Mɛɛ wia, ka ra bagli ia u wia la kaiih.

ref: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
text: Di ii wa kpa n sɔŋ di suŋŋi wiizi a saŋa, a wàá ka ɛɛ lugɔ min niŋ suŋŋuu tɛɛ ia.

ref: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
text: U himmaa nɔŋŋi iabuu dikuu iin nɔŋŋiŋ di yardiŋ lugɔ n lii u benii wia.

ref: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
text: U benii n lii di ba durnya. Filaŋkeŋ n jaa ra nyiŋŋuu ń gil durnya ka bir la u be.”

ref: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
text: Denii u hiŋra ŋɔ u be, “Filaŋkeŋ i wiŋɔzi jaa ra lii bɔchaannɛ. A waa kaa du kpol lugɔ sɛɛliizi la.

ref: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
text: Yaa jaa zum lugɔ i zum wiimaanii. A waa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ nɛr daŋ pɛɛzii wia mɔɔ ka i haa zum a wia biini. Awia, yaa yardiibuu lugɔ i lii Kɔraawiizi benii.”

ref: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
text: Yeesu pɛɛzi baa, “Ii jaa yardimbuu naa?

ref: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
text: Saŋa bɛl daŋ wa hel, u duglɔɔrɛ gba, ií maa yaari, di kaali ii diini. Ka n bɛŋ lɛi. N Mɛɛ ɔɔ du n benii.

ref: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
text: N bagli iabuu wia naa ií wer dɔɔ bampirsɔna dikuu n ni ia n ɛɛ kpaŋ wia. Durnya daŋ tɛɛ ia tɔɔrɔɔ, ka ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm. N kpegli durnyaa.”

ref: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
text: Yeesu n wa ŋɔ anniizi maa wa tuŋ, u binni chiŋ ka ŋɔ, “N Mɛ, n saŋa hello. Jaa kpa girme tɛɛ mìŋ́ i Biibaal ka ń ge wer kpa girme tɛi.

ref: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
text: I tɛmbuu fɔŋŋa newee maa ni ń wer kpa i miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la di du banla maa hiŋ tɛŋ la ni.

ref: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
text: Banla n zumii di zum lugɔ i bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa la di kaa zumiŋ miŋ ɛɛ i huŋhunni di zum lugɔ n ɛɛ Kristoo la, baabuu niŋ wer na i miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
text: Miŋ du durnya naa be, i na girmee n be, dikuubɛɛwiai, i huma la maa hiŋ faa tɛŋ ŋɔ ń hum la, n hum a maanii wa tuŋ.

ref: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
text: Baala la hiŋ lizɛɛ durnya hina biini tɛŋ la, n gillɔɔ ba zumii nɛnnɛ. Ba faa ɛɛ i horaa, i bir kpa baa tɛɛ n ge. N bagli baabuu i wiŋɔzi ba ra hiŋaa.

ref: They know that you gave me everything I have.
text: Filaŋkeŋ ba jaa zum wii la maa hiŋ tɛŋ labuu nɛnnɛ, dí, wibiire, i benii a maa lii.

ref: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
text: I wiŋɔzi la hiŋ bagliŋ la, a maanii n kpa bagli baa, ba sɛɛ di jaa wer zum lugɔ n lii i benii. Hinuu humiŋ.

ref: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
text: N na suŋŋiibuu ra tɛɛ baa. Durnya hina maa lɛi n suŋŋii ra tɛɛ. Banla hiŋ lizɛɛ ba biini tɛŋ labuu n suŋŋii ra tɛɛ dikuu baabuu n ɛɛ i hora wia.

ref: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
text: N kummaa ɛɛ i hotte. I kummaa ge ɛɛ n hor. N na girmee dikuu ba wia.

ref: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
text: Miŋwaa, ra ba i benii. Màá ka du durnya. Ka bannii waa daŋ haa du durnya. Awia, n Mɛ, a binni ba ni ani i fɔŋŋa la hiŋ tɛŋ la biini bá maa wer ɛɛ kpaŋ gunla yaa ge n ɛɛ kpaŋ la.

ref: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
text: Miŋ faa du ba be la, n wettoo binni baa ani i fɔŋŋa la hiŋ tɛŋ la. Ba bɛl maa waa tawɛɛ. Unla wia baŋ faa sɛbɛɛ i Hɔŋ biini, di ŋɔ waabuu niŋ ta la, u bɛnnɛ tawɛɛ, í Hɔŋ la wer ɛɛ wibii.

ref: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
text: Filaŋkennaa, n na ba i benii ń wa du i be. Ama, miŋ haa du durnya biini naa, n na ŋɔ wia naabuu bá wer dɔɔ n bɔsɔna werge di wa tuŋ.

ref: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
text: Miŋ bagli baa i wiŋɔzi la, ba waa kaa ɛɛ durnya hora alugɔ n ge n waa durnya hor ɛɛwɛ la. Awia, durnya hah baabuu.

ref: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
text: Maa ŋɔ í lizi baa a durnya biini. Ka í lizi baa Sitaani be.

ref: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
text: Maa durnya hor ɛɛwɛ. Ba ge gba waa durnya hora ɛɛwɛ.

ref: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
text: Gil í wibii la lizi doŋa maa ba ni di ha bá wer ɛɛ i bɛmbɛŋ hora. I wiŋɔzi la ɛɛ wibiire.

ref: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
text: Gunla hiŋ faa humiŋ durnya la, gunnɛ n ge hum baa durnya.

ref: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
text: N kpa n hinnɛ tɛi di ɛɛ i bɛmbɛŋ hor ka bá ge gba wer birgi i bɛmbɛŋ hora guŋ dikuu i wibii la banna hiŋ la wia.

ref: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
text: Bannii bɛŋ lɛi n suŋŋii ra tɛɛ. N na suŋŋiibuu ra tɛɛ banla maa n niŋ haa yardii dikuu bannii wiŋɔzi wia.

ref: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
text: N na nyiŋŋi ba maa wer ɛɛ kpaŋ. N Mɛ, gunla hiŋ du n ni, n ge du i ni la, n na nyiŋŋuu bannii ge wer du yaa ni guŋ, dúrnya maa wer sɛɛ lugɔ hinuu humiŋ.

ref: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
text: Gunla hiŋ gillɛ n dɔɔ girme, n gillɔɔ ba ge dɔɔ girme guŋ bá maa wer ɛɛ kpaŋ gunla yaa ge n ɛɛ kpaŋ la.

ref: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
text: N na nyiŋŋuu n du ba ni, i ge du n ni, bá maa wer ɛɛ kpaŋ nɛnnɛ, dúrnya ge wer zum nɛnnɛ lugɔ hinuu humiŋ di zum lugɔ i nɔŋŋi baabuu gunla hiŋ nɔŋŋiŋ la.

ref: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
text: N Mɛ, hiŋ kpa baa tɛŋ naa wia, n na nyiŋŋuu ba ge wer du n be bɔr la min niŋ wa la la, di wer na n girme la miŋ dɔɔwɛ i be la. I nɔŋŋimbuu guŋŋ di durnya faa haa waa hoo gba, di tɛŋ girme.

ref: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
text: N Mɛɛnanii, durnya faa wɛɛ zummɛ, ka n zumii. Bannii gba wettoo zum lugɔ hinuu humiŋ.

ref: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
text: N faa gillɔɔ ba zumii nɛnnɛ. N daŋ gil ba haa zumii di ra jaa. N daŋ du ba ni bá wer zum nɔŋŋaa la hiŋ nɔŋŋiŋ la gunla un duwɛɛ di wer zum lugɔ i nɔŋŋi ba ge gbaa guŋ.”

ref: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
text: Baal la Pitta n ŋmɛŋ u digni kpɛlli la lulli bɛl ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Maa Nabɔma la balii bɛllɛ. U ge du de di pɛɛzi, “Miŋ faa du daazi bɔr la, mɛɛ nawɛɛ dee?”

ref: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
text: U kaa pɛɛzi baa, “Anɛɛ ii ra nyiŋŋi gunnɛi?” Ba kaa ŋɔ, dí Yeesu Nazarɛf labuu ba ra nyiŋŋi.

ref: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “Maa ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ minuu keŋ? Di minuu ii ra nyiŋŋi, amɔ, ií gil bannii waa ra la.”

ref: Then everything will happen, just as I said, ‘I did not lose anyone you gave me.’ ”
text: Yeesu n faa ŋɔ u mɛɛ be dí banla maa un tɛu la, bɛl maa waa tawɛɛ la, awiarɛ u ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
text: Saimɔn Pitta dɔɔ u tokobi. U pamuu di ŋmɛŋ Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Maa Nabɔma balii bɛl nodig digni kpɛlli. A baal sɔnnɛ faa Malkus.

ref: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.
text: Denii soojazi la ni ba nabɔma ni Jus hina balaa la wa lau Yeesu di vɔɔzuu di kpau kaali.

ref: Peter stayed outside near the gate. But the other disciple came back out and spoke to the girl at the gate. She let Peter go in,

ref: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.

ref: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.
text: Gunnɛ ba ɛɛ ka gunla Yeesu n faa bagli siu la un niŋ siu la wer ɛɛ wibii.

ref: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
text: Pailɔt kaa zuu u seriya diiri dia di yir Yeesu. U ba u be. U pɛɛzuu, “Hinuu Jus hina koori laa?”

ref: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
text: Yeesu ge pɛɛzuu, “I himmaa nfɛrɛ biinii i pɛɛziŋ guŋ gɛɛ nɛraa baglii n wia gunnɛi?”

ref: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
text: Pailɔt pɛɛzi, “Jus hinuurɛ miŋ? I himmaa nɛra ni ba Kizeehina nabɔnzii kpai ba n be. Bɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ i ɛɛi?”

ref: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “N dɔɔ kora bɛllɛ, ka durnya kossi dee lɛi n kora la. Di u faa ɛɛ durnya kora bɛllɛ, n balaa daŋ faa yoo nɛra la bá gilɛɛ wer lawiŋ di du Jus hina la nonee biini keŋ. Ka n kora naa waa durnya hor ɛɛwɛ.”

ref: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”

ref: Pilate asked Jesus, “What is truth?” Jesus Is Sentenced to Death (Matthew

ref: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
text: Ka n ni ia dɔɔ nuukpaŋ bɛllɛ lugɔ minuu niŋ ɔɔ lizi nɛr di lii nɛra tɔi dia, di tɛɛ ia ii Hɔpizizenaa naa biini. Ii ra nyiŋŋuu ń lizi ii Jus hina koori la tɛɛ ia gɛɛ?”

ref: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
text: ka ra hel u be di ra ɛɛu chɛɛtɛ bunɛɛgaa, di ra ŋɔ, “Jus hina koori, jaanjaamɔ,” di ra chɛ u lia.

ref: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
text: Pailɔt kaa lii di la Jus hina la be bossee di ga ŋɔ ba be, “Ií na u ni. Baal labuu ba kpa lii di ra bagli ia la. Maa wiimaa nawɛɛ ń tɛu.”

ref: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
text: Yeesu wa lii di sɔɔhri kahuro la ani tagta aahmu la haa du u ni. Pailɔt ŋɔ, “Waabuu keŋ.”

ref: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
text: Kɔraawiizi Kizeehina Nabɔnzi ni ba balaa n wa nau la, ba izi di ra pogzi, “Gil ba kpuu! Gil ba kpuu daakaŋlii ni!” Pailɔt ŋɔ, “Amɔ, ií himmaa kpau la ga di u kpui seriya ka kpuu daakaŋlii ni. Miŋwaa waa wichɔgaa maa nawɛɛ u ni ń di u kpui seriya.”

ref: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
text: Jus hina la ŋɔ, “A baal faa ŋɔ u ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biere. Yaa kiire u chɔgi guŋ di dɛg kpui.”

ref: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
text: U kaa zuu seriya diiribɔr di kaa wa pɛɛzi Yeesu, “Lee i lii naanɛi?” Yeesu waa wiimaa ŋɔwɛɛ.

ref: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
text: Pailɔt ŋɔ u be, “Hàá sɛɛ bagliŋ bɔr la hiŋ liwɛɛ? Amɔ, haa zummɛ lugɔ n dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa lugɔ min niŋ wer pillii i ra la, di kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa min niŋ di i kpui seriya bá kpui daakaŋlii la nii?”

ref: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
text: Yeesu ŋɔ, “Di Kɔraawiizi faa waa guŋ sɛɛwɛ, i faa waa fɔŋŋa maa dɔɔwɛ n ni. Ama nɛr la n ɛɛŋ sɔsɔgɔ di kpaŋ du i nonee biini naa, u wichɔgaa kannɔ kaali i hor.”

ref: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
text: Denii Pailɔt jaa ra ɛɛ ania maa ú wer tɛu ŋmɛnɛɛ ú ra la, ka Jus hina la ra pogzi di ra ŋɔ, “Di i tɛu ŋmɛnɛɛ u ra la, amɔ, i ɛɛ Koorizeŋ Siiza dɔmnɛ. Di nɛr haŋ ŋɔ lugɔ waabuu koori, amɔ, a koraa u ra foozi la.”
