ref: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
text: di jaami n lulli Hɛrɔdiɔn ni Nasisus diahina n ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra la,

ref: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
text: di kaa jaami Traifina ni Traifɔsa la n na hum Kɔraawiizi huma la ani Pɛsis la miŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ, u ge ra hum yaa Dɔɔri werge la.

ref: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
text: Ií jaami Rufus la n ɛɛ yaa Dɔɔri hiŋripa bɛl ni u maa la miŋ kpawɛɛ birgi n ge gba maa la.

ref: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
text: Ií jaami Asinkritus, Filɛgɔn, Hɛmɛs, Patrobas, Hɛmas ani yaabalaa la n du ba be la.

ref: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
text: Ií jaami Filɔlɔgus, Julia, Nɛrɛyus ni u niuhambie la, Ɔlimpas ani Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la maa n du ba be la.

ref: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
text: Ií jaami dɔŋa nɛnnɛ. Kristo hiŋra la maa ra jaami ia.

ref: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
text: N na suŋŋi ia, yaabalaa, ií ra du tau di zum banla n na vɛɛ baglaa la baŋ faa bagli ia la ka ra bargi nɛra di ra dar baa ba leu ŋmɛnɛɛ la. Ií zum baa di gil baa ha.

ref: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
text: Nɛra naa dizi waa yaa Dɔɔri Kristo ra hum. Ba himmaa hizii ba ra hum, di ŋɔ wisuma ra du nɛra nyuuni bá wer dar banla n waa tau ra du.

ref: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
text: Ii dɔɔ sɔnnɛ yemmaa dikuu gunla iinna hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nuuzi wia. Awia, n bɔra sɔɔnimbuu. N na nyiŋŋi ii ɛɛ winanaa zunna ka ɛɛ gɛnaa ni wichɔgaawaa zumaa biini.

ref: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
text: Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ bampirsɔna hiŋ la, di a wa ɛɛ tama, u daŋ gil ii chɔgi Sitaani huma alugɔ iiŋ kpa naa fɛruu. Yáa Dɔɔri Yeesu hiini ia.

ref: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
text: N dɔŋhiŋ Timoti la n nuu n na hum la ra jaami ia. Lusiɔs, Jasɔn, Sɔsipatɛr ani lulla la gba ra jaami ia.

ref: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
text: Mìŋ́ Tɛtiɔs la Pɔɔl n gillɛ n sɛbi hɔnnaa, n na jaami ii banla n na hiŋ yaa Dɔɔri la.

ref: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
text: Too. Ií kpa girme ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n wette gil ii dɔɔ bɔkpega, amaniyesuma la miŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ ia lii Yeesu Kristo wia biini la ni. Amaniyesuma la miŋ lizɛɛ la ɛɛ wia la n faa suahwɛ faala la maanii.

ref: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi la n du de saŋa maa ŋɔ á maa pilli tɛɛ yaa filaŋkeŋ, di bagli a wia lii hɔna la u dɔgtɛɛzi n faa sɛbɛɛ biini. U ɛɛ gunnɛ bánla n waa Izrɛl hina ɛɛwɛ maa wer sɛɛ a wia di yardi Yeesu Kristo.

ref: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
text: Kɔraawiizi bɛnnɛ dɔɔ nunzuma maa. Ií kpa girme ra tɛɛ Yeesu Kristo ú wer kpa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi saŋaa saŋa maa! Ami.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
text: Mìŋ́ Yeesu Kristo huŋhunni Pɔɔllɛ ra sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛɛ ia. A par Kɔraawiizii u tɛŋ a huma. N ni n dɔŋhiŋ Sɔstɛnis labuu ra jaami Kɔraawiizi hiŋra la n du Kɔrint la,

ref: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia, di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Kɔraawiizi jaantɛɛi wia

ref: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
text: N ɔɔ ra chɔli Kɔraawiizii dikuu ii wia uŋ suŋ ii ni di hiini ia werge dikuu ii ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ wia.

ref: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
text: dikuu Kristo wia la yaa n faa bagli ia n zuu ii bampiree nɛnnɛ la wia.

ref: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
text: Awia, iinna kpaŋ yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo balaa naa, ii waa u wiɛɛlaa bɛl maa u Dumnanii n ɔɔ tɛɛ la fɔŋŋa nyaawɛ.

ref: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
text: Waabuu niŋ gil ii hiŋ nɛnnɛ di ra la, di yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo Hɔpizii la wa hello, bá gilɛɛ wa wer na wiimaa chug ia.

ref: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
text: Kɔraawiizi wia dɔɔ wibiire. Waabuu yir ia ií ni u Biibaal wa du sum. U Biibaal hinnɛ yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo la. Kɔraawiizi hiŋra dɔŋa bargaa wia

ref: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
text: Ka yaabalaa, n kpa yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo sɔnnɛ di ra suŋŋi ia, ií maa ra ŋɔ wikpaŋ di gilɛɛ waa bargi dɔŋa ni ka dɔɔ nuukpaŋ ani ii wiŋɔzi ni ii nfɛssi maa biini.

ref: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
text: Yaabalaa, n nuu ii wiarɛ Kiloi nɛra be lugɔ ii ra di dɔŋa hɔɔzii.

ref: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.
text: N ŋɔ kenne, dikuubɛɛwiai, mìŋ́ Pɔɔllɛ ii baŋhina ŋɔ ii ra hiŋuu. Ii baŋhina ge ŋɔ Apɔlɔs, ii baŋhina ge ŋɔ Sifas, baŋhina ge ŋɔ Kristoo ba ra hiŋ.

ref: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
text: Nau! Kristo dɔɔ bargaarɛa? Mìŋ́ Pɔɔllɛ ba faa kpaahzi mari daakaŋlii ni tɛɛ ia laa? Ba sɔ iabuu nii ií ra hiŋiŋ? Akai.

ref: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
text: N na jaami Kɔraawiizii, dikuubɛɛwiai, miŋ faa du ii be la, Krispus ni Geyus bɛnnɛ n sɔ Kɔraawiizi nii.

ref: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
text: Awia, ii bɛl maa wàá wer ŋɔ lugɔ n sɔ iabuu nii ií ra hiŋiŋ.

ref: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
text: N sɔ Stɛfanas ni u diahina ge gbaa nii. Maa tamɛɛ miŋ kaa sɔ nɛr maa nii di jaa bannii ni.

ref: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
text: Kɔraawiizi nii sɔi wia lɛi Kristo humiŋ. U humimbuu ń gaa lizi amaniyesuma la di ra tɛɛ nɛra. Waa nyiŋŋi ń kpa newee nunzuma di ra lizaa, ka Krísto siwaa daakaŋlii la ni wia sɔŋ wa tɔ di bir pɛɛ. Yeesuu nunzuma ni Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa

ref: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
text: U daakaŋlii hiŋ wia ɛɛ wipɛɛrii banla Kɔraawiizi n waa lɛɛ, ba ra leu la benii. Ka yaa banla unna lɛɛ la, a ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa wiarɛ yaawaa be.

ref: As God says in the Scriptures, “I will destroy the wisdom of all who claim to be wise. I will confuse those who think they know so much.”
text: Ba sɛbɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, di ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘N daŋ gil nunzunna nunzuma bir pɛɛ.’ ”

ref: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
text: Awia, bɛɛ núnzunni wer kuarɛi? Unla n zum wiŋɔzi, lee u ge na a zumaai? Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ newea nunzumazi bir pɛɛ,

ref: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ba nunzuma labuu gillɛ ba waa Kɔraawiizi ra zum. Kɔraawiizii gillɛ guŋ ɛɛ u nunzuma biini, ka ŋɔ ú lɛɛ banla n yardi amaniyesuma la yaa n ɔɔ ra lizi, ba ra binni lugɔ wipɛɛrii la. A par Kɔraawiizii u dau guŋ.

ref: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
text: Jus hina ra nyiŋŋuu ya bagli baa wizenaa wia. Giris hina ge ra nyiŋŋi ya bagli baa nunzuma.

ref: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
text: Ka Kristo siwaa daakaŋlii ni wiarɛ yaa ɔɔ ra ŋɔ. U ɛɛ kunla Jus hina n na gbɛlluu, di gil ba ra leu ŋmɛnɛɛ, di kaa ɛɛ wipɛɛri Giris hina ge be.

ref: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
text: Ka Jus hina ni Giris hina la maa Kɔraawiizi n lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ la, a Kristo wia ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa ni u nunzuma wiarɛ baawaa be.

ref: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
text: Kɔraawiiziwaa wipɛɛri bɔmbɔ newea nunzumaa. U gɛrga ge wia du kpeg kaali newea kpegzi.

ref: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
text: Yaabalaa, Kɔraawiizi lizi iabuu tɛɛ u hiŋ. Ka ií na. Ii galga maa waa nunzunna ɛɛwɛ nɛra be. Ii galga maa ge waa kaa ɛɛ nɛzenaa nɛra be. Ii waa kaa ɛɛ nabɔnzi ge biizi.

ref: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi kuttɔɔrɛ lizi banla newea n na yir gɛnaa la, ú du nunzunna la hiihzi, di kaa lizi banla newea n na yir gɛrga la, ú du kpeglega la ge hiihzi,

ref: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
text: di kaa lizi kundumazi ani kuna la nɛra n na gbɛlli ani kuna la newea n waa a wia zummɛ gba, ú chɔgi kuna la newea n na maŋkuri la,

ref: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
text: néwee maa gilɛɛ dɔɔ barabara Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ ii ni Yeesu Kristo kpau. Awia, filaŋkeŋ, u nunzuma ɛɛ yaa nunzumaa, u winanaa ge ɛɛ yaa winanaa, u lizi doŋa maa yaa ni di ha, di yau yaa ha.

ref: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
text: Awia, ií ra nuu gunla Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ n ŋɔwɛɛ, “Gil nɛr la maa n na jigsi, ú ra jigsi dikuu uŋ zummɛ lugɔ minuu Kɔraawiizi wia.”

ref: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
text: Awia, yaabalaa, miŋ faa ba ii be di waa ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii di ra tɛɛ ia la, maa nuusum ni newee nunzuma kpawɛɛ ra bagli ia.

ref: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
text: N faa waa nyiŋŋi n du ii be di kaa lizi nunzuma maa jaa Yeesu Kristo siwaa daakaŋlii la ni wia ni.

ref: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
text: N baglaa hiŋ ni n wiŋɔzi maa faa waa newea nunzuma ɛɛwɛ, á du sum ii be. Ka Kɔraawiizi Dumaa di n wiŋɔzi hiŋ daansɛɛ, a dɔɔ fɔŋŋa.

ref: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
text: N faa ɛɛ gunnɛ ii gilɛɛ sɛɛ dikuu newee ni u nunzuma wia, ka ií sɛɛ dikuu Kɔraawiizi ni u fɔŋŋa wia. Kɔraawiizi nunzuma wia

ref: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
text: Ama, yaa ɔɔ ra ŋɔ nunzuma wiarɛ ra tɛɛ banla siwee n chaanɛɛ, ba dirmi la. Durnya ni ba fɔŋŋa dɔɔra nunzuma lɛi. Ba fɔŋŋazi la ra birgi pɛɛrɛ.

ref: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
text: Kɔraawiizi nunzuma wiarɛ yaa ra ŋɔ. A faa suahwɔɔ nɛra be. Ka a ɛɛ wia la Kɔraawiizi n felee di lizi dau yaabuu, ka haa ta durnya, á lii suma tɛɛ yaa.

ref: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
text: Durnya nɛzenaa faa waa a wia zummɛ. Di ba faa zumaa, ba faa wàá kpu yaa Dɔɔri la n dɔɔ girme werge maa la daakaŋlii la ni.

ref: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
text: Ka wia naa wiarɛ ba faa feli sɛbi di ŋɔ, “Wia la Kɔraawiizi n dauwɛ tɛɛ banla n nɔŋŋi u wia la, nɛr maa siwee haa waa a dɔŋa nawɛɛ, nɛr maa digna ge haa waa a wia nuuwɛ. A kaali ba nfɛssii.”

ref: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
text: Ka filaŋkeŋ, Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ u Dum bagli yaa a wia. U Dumnanii ra pigzi wiimaanii di ra zum Kɔraawiizi wolli gba.

ref: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
text: Newee waa u dɔŋhiŋ biini zummɛ. A hiŋ duma bɛnnɛ zum u biini nfɛrɛ. Gunnɛ newea wàá wer zum Kɔraawiizi biini nfɛrɛ la. Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii bɛnnɛ niŋ wer zum u biini nfɛrɛ.

ref: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
text: Too. Newee duula lɛi yaa ra hiŋ. Kɔraawiizi kpa u Dumnanii du yaa bampiree, ya wer zum wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋazi la dee maa un sunzi yaa, yaa dɔɔ dikuu am paruu wia.

ref: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
text: Yaa n na ŋɔ wia naa, yaa waa ɔɔ ra ŋɔa ra lii yaa himmaa zumaa biini. Kɔraawiizi Dumaa ra bagli yaa gunla yaa n niŋ ŋɔ. U wiŋɔzii yaa ɔɔ kpa ra bagli u wia.

ref: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
text: Nɛr la n waa Kɔraawiizi Duma dɔɔwɛ ra vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Duma wiarɛ. A ɛɛ wipɛɛrii u be. Wàá wer zumaa. Kɔraawiizi Duma n waa hoo u bampirii wia, wàá wer zum a zɛɛ.

ref: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
text: Ka nɛr la n dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi Duma daŋ wer zum wiimaa ŋmɛnɛɛ ni u wibii. Ama, nɛra la n waa Kɔraawiizi Duma dɔɔwɛ la wàá wer zum a hiŋ ge wibii.

ref: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
text: Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini ba pɛɛzɔɔrɛ, “Anɛɛ n zum Kɔraawiizi nfɛrɛ, ú wer bagluu wiai? Ka yaawaa dɔɔ Kristo nfɛrɛɛ.”

ref: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
text: Yaabalaa, n faa waa wette n bagli ia gunla minna bagli banla Kɔraawiizi Duma n du ba ni nɛnnɛ la. Ii faa haa ra hiŋ newea mannii di faa haa ra ɛɛ bichal wia Kristo hiŋaa biini.

ref: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
text: Illɛ n faa tɛɛ ia dikuu iiŋ faa haa waa diwee dii helle wia.

ref: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
text: Ii haa waa guŋ gba helle filaŋkeŋ, dikuu iiŋ haa ra hiŋ newea manni la wia. Iin dɔɔ bɔwii di ra di dɔŋa hɔɔzi naa, newea manni lɛi ii ra hiŋaa? Kɔraawiizi Duma manni lɛi ii ra hiŋ guŋ.

ref: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
text: Ii baŋhina n na ŋɔ, dí mìŋ́ Pɔɔllɛ ii ra hiŋ, ii baŋhina ge ŋɔ di Apɔlɔsii ii ra hiŋ, newea manni lɛi ii ra hiŋaa?

ref: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
text: Beedee Apɔlɔs ni Pɔɔllɛi? Kɔraawiizi balaa lɛiyaa? Yaabuu ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wiarɛ tɛɛ ia, ii sɛɛ, ka Kɔraawiizii tɛɛ yaa bɛl maa yaa huma yaa ra hum.

ref: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
text: Unla n na duu ani unla n na mizi nii la, baabuu maa ɛɛ kpannɛ. Ka Kɔraawiizii niŋ turgi bɛl maa ani gunla uŋ hummɛ.

ref: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
text: Kɔraawiizii dɔɔ yaa, yaa nuu kpau ra hum, di kaa dɔɔ ii ge. Ii ɛɛ u koore un dauwɛ, di kaa ɛɛ u dia unna ma.

ref: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
text: Kɔraawiizi faa suŋ n ninɛɛ di hiiniŋ, di tɛŋ nfɛrɛ n wer chiŋŋi u dia zɛɛ tɛu. Bɛl ge wa ma hɔŋ. Ka bɛ́l maa ra dazi gunla um mawɛɛ ra hɔŋ la ni.

ref: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
text: Ama, di Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizii la wa hello, ba daŋ na gunla bɛl maa huma n duwɛɛ. Ninne niŋ ɛɛa na a hɔl, di a wesso gɛɛ a waa wer, yá zum.

ref: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
text: Di niŋ wa haahri bɛl maa huma na, ka a haa du de, Kɔraawiizi daŋ turguu u huma hiŋ kim.

ref: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
text: Ka di niŋ wa dia, Kɔraawiizi daŋ lɛɛ a hiŋ bɛŋ, ka wàá ka na kinturgaa. U daŋ ɛɛu lugɔ kunla baŋ toowe niŋ biini, ú gilɛɛ fuuh.

ref: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
text: Ii waa zummɛ lugɔ ii ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi duuribɔttɛa? U Dumnanii du ii ninɛɛ.

ref: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
text: Nɛr la maa n niŋ chɔgi Kɔraawiizi Dia, Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔgi a hiŋ ge, dikuubɛɛwiai, u bɔr ɛɛ bɔnaniinaniirɛ. Iabuu u duuribɔr hiŋ.

ref: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
text: Ií gilɛɛ gil bɛl maa waa dar u hiŋ. Di u ra binni lugɔ u dɔɔ nunzumaa durnya naa biini, ú gil u nunzuma la ha, ka kpa u hiŋ birgi “gɛnii” ka jaa wa dɔɔ nunzuma himmaa.

ref: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
text: Durnya naa nunzuma ɛɛ kumpɛɛrɛ Kɔraawiizi be. Ba sɛbɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, di ŋɔ, “U ɔɔ lau nunzunnaa, bá zumaa biini,”

ref: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
text: di kaa sɛbi yembɛl ge, “Kɔraawiizi zum nunzunna nfɛrɛɛ. A ɛɛ wipɛɛrii.”

ref: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
text: Pɔɔl, Apɔlɔs, Sifas, chiŋ, hɛri, miibɔɔ ani siu wia la maa n du de filaŋkeŋ ani wia la maa n niŋ haa ba la, a maanii ii dɔɔ.

ref: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
text: Kristo genii dɔɔ ia. Kɔraawiizi ge dɔɔ Kristo.

ref: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
text: A dɛkkɔ iinna kpa yaa lugɔ Kristo balaa. Kɔraawiizi bagli yaabuu u wisuahlaa, di ŋɔ ya kpaa ra bagli nɛra. Awia, u balaarɛ yaa.

ref: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
text: Too. A dɛkkɔɔ balii n na hum u dɔɔri nɛnnɛ, ú dɔɔri ŋɔ lugɔ u wia dɔɔ wibiire.

ref: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
text: Miŋwaa be, di ii ra ŋɔ n huma naa wia, ka a wan titte. Newea lɛi niŋ di n huma naa seriya. N gba himmaa lɛi niŋ di n seriya.

ref: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
text: N biini wanna tɛɛ wiimaa. Ka a gba ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ. Aa lɛi niŋ gil ń wer lii. Kristoo niŋ di n seriya.

ref: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
text: Awia, ii gilɛɛ feli ra di wiimaa seriya. Ií gil Kristo ba mɔɔ. Di u wa ballɔ, u daŋ lii bɔbiri wia la maa baŋ suahwɛ ɛɛ la ni baŋgia, di bagli newea biini wikpoglaa maa. Denii Kɔ́raawiizi jaa chɔli nɛr la maa un niŋ chɔli.

ref: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
text: Yaabalaa, n kpa gunla iinna ŋɔ n ni Apɔlɔs wiarɛ, di ŋɔ ń chi de di bagli ia wii naa, ií wer zum u zɛɛ nɛnnɛ. “A wii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ a waa dɛkkɛ iinna tɔgzi nɛr maa di kaali gunla Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ n baglɛɛ la.” Awia, ii gilɛɛ ra lizi nabɔnzi di kpa baa ra mɛgzi dɔŋa, di ra nyiŋŋi zenni dɔŋa ni.

ref: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
text: Anɛɛ n gillɛ i kur i dɔŋhiŋ ninɛi? Kɔraawiizi be lɛi i na kunla maa hiŋ dɔɔwɛɛ? Waabuu tɛɛ ia wii la maa iin dɔɔwɛ. Too. Di Kɔraawiizi benii i naa, amɔ, bɛɛ wiarɛ i kaa ra chɔli i hiŋ alugɔ i himmaa fɔŋŋa biinii i naawɛi?

ref: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
text: Ii teŋ nawɔɔrɛ di hel ii kipar, di ɛɛ dɔɔna di feli ra di kossi ka ka yaa. Di ii vii ra di a kossi, u guŋ vii bɔ. Yaa ni ia maanii niŋ vii nuu suma ii kora dii hiŋ biini. U guŋ daŋ vii du wer,

ref: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, miŋwaa be, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ yaa banla n ɛɛ u huŋhunna la tɔ har, di ɛɛ lugɔ banla baŋ di ba kpui seriya, di kpa baa la bá ga kpu la. Durnya ni mɛlikazi maa ra binni yaabuu.

ref: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
text: Yaa ɛɛ gɛnaarɛ nɛra be dikuu Kristo wia, ka iabuu ɛɛ nunzunna u hiŋaa biini. Yaa ɛɛ gɛrgaa nɛra be, ka ii ɛɛ u kpeglega. Ba ra gbɛlli yaabuu ka ra chɔli ia, di ra maŋkuri ia.

ref: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
text: Yaawaa ɔɔ ra chɔɔ lɔzii. Niinyɔgzi ge ɔɔ ra kpu yaabuu haali ni zinaa. Yaa ɔɔ laali kuŋkɔssii. Nɛra ɔɔ ra lɔɔzi yaa. Yaa waa ɔɔ kaa dɔɔ diiduulii.

ref: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
text: Yaa ɔɔ ra di yaa himmaa kuuhni biinii. Nɛra ɔɔ ra chagzi yaa, ka yaa suŋŋi wiizi ra tɛɛ baa. Ba ra tɔɔri yaa, ka yaa ɔɔ gil la tɛɛ baa.

ref: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
text: Ba ra gbɛlli yaa sɔŋ, ka yaa ŋɔ winanaa ra tɛɛ baa. Yaa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kpaga ani doŋa durnya be, haali ni zinaa.

ref: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
text: N biinɔŋŋaa, maa wia naa sɛbɛɛ tɛɛ ia ń du ia hiihzi. Ka n ŋɔ ń karfi iabuu nɛnnɛ.

ref: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
text: Di ii dɔɔ nɛkpila maa ban niŋ bagli ia Kristo wia, ka nɛkpaŋ bɛnnɛ ii mɛɛ. Minuu felee lizi amaniyesuma la tɛɛ ia, ii sɛɛ, di lul ia Yeesu Kristo fɔŋŋa biini.

ref: and I want you to be like me.
text: Awia, n na suŋŋi iabuu, ií ra hiŋ kennaa minna hiŋ naa.

ref: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
text: Awiarɛ n hum Timoti ii be, ú wa bagli ia guŋ hiŋaa. U ɛɛ n biinɔŋŋiirɛ. U wia dɔɔ wibiire Kɔraawiizi hiŋaa naa biini. Waabuu niŋ ɔɔ liizi ia gunla miŋ ɔɔ ra hiŋ di ra hum Yeesu Kristo la. A hiŋaarɛ n ɔɔ ra bagli Yeesu hiŋra yemmaa, bá ra hiŋ la.

ref: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
text: Ii baŋhina dɔɔ barabaraa werge, di ra ŋɔ dí màá ba ii be.

ref: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
text: Ka n daŋ ba. Di Kɔraawiizi sɛɛwɔ, n daŋ ba filaŋkeŋ di wa zum barabara hina la. Bɛɛ wiŋɔzɛi? Di ba dɔɔ fɔŋŋa gɛɛ ba waa fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ, gunnɛ n na nyiŋŋi ń zum.

ref: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
text: Kɔraawiizi Kora wia waa wiŋɔzi ɛɛwɛ. Fɔŋŋa wiarɛ.

ref: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
text: Too. Ií bagliŋ gunla min niŋ ba ii be. Virmaa ii ŋɔ ń kpa ba di wa viiri ia gɛɛ nɔŋŋaa ni sisɔna mannii ii ra nyiŋŋi ń kpa ba ii benei?

ref: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
text: N kaa nuu ii wiarɛ lugɔ ii ra ɛɛ sɛnsɛŋ wiarɛ, haali ii bɛl foozi u mɛɛ haaŋ. Banla n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ gba a kii gunnɛ.

ref: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
text: Ka ii du de di ra ta barabara. Nau! Di ii faa gillɔ ii biine chɔgi, di lizi unla n ɛɛ wichɔgii naa ii biini, a guŋ faa waa bɔɔ?

ref: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
text: ií kpa a baal du Sitaani nonee, ú tɔɔruu di chɔgi u bɔrahɔŋ, ka ú wer na u duma yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu hɔpizii la biini.

ref: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
text: Awia, ii barabara hiŋ waa wer. Amɔ, ii waa zummɛ lugɔ di yiisi tama du paanuu sau ni, aa fuu a sau maaniiyaa?

ref: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
text: Awia, ií lizi wichɔgɛɛri la ii biini, ú wichɔgaa la gilɛɛ waa buu ia. Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ paanuu la n waa yiisi dɔɔwɛ la, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kristo siuwɔɔ tɛɛ yaa, di lizi mbusu tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi gunla baŋ ɔɔ kpu pebii Gillikaali saŋa, di lizi mbusu tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la.

ref: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
text: Awia, di yaa ra hiŋ Kristo, a waa wer yaa n kaa ra ɛɛ yaa wibinaa la, di ra ɛɛ wijagazi ani wichɔgaa. Ií gil ya lizi wia naa maa ha. A ɛɛ yiisii. Ya ra di wibii bɛŋ, di dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu nɛnnɛ. Aawaa waa yiisi dɔɔwɛ.

ref: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
text: Miŋ faa sɛbi hɔŋ tɛɛ ia di ŋɔ ii gilɛɛ gil ii ni nɛkuna ra kpau la,

ref: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
text: banla n waa Yeesu hiŋra ɛɛwɛ la lɛi n faa ŋɔ. Di ii ŋɔ ií bargi iihinaa banla maa n na sɛm be, banla n dɔɔ kuna kɛkɛluu be, banla n na foozi nɛra be ani banla n na kuari vuga be, ii wàá wer ɛɛ guŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, bɔr maanii ba du.

ref: Why should I judge outsiders? Aren't we supposed to judge only church members?
text: Banla n waa Yeesu hiŋra ɛɛwɛ la, min lɛi dɔɔ ba seriya dii. Kɔraawiizii niŋ di baa seriya.

ref: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
text: Ka banla n ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋrawaa, iabuu dɔɔ ba seriya dii. Awia, ií lizi wichɔgɛɛri la ii biini.

ref: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
text: Anɛɛ darii lugɔ di i ni i dɔŋhiŋ Yeesu hiŋri bɛl dɔɔ wii, í la banla n waa Yeesu hiŋra ɛɛwɛ be, bá di ii seriya ka gil banla n ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra be laŋaai? Guŋ waa ŋmɛnɛɛ dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
text: Ii waa zummɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi biinanaa daŋ ŋmɛnɛ di durnya maa seriyaa? Di ii daŋ ŋmɛnɛ di durnya maa seriya, amɔ, ii waa wijigzi naa seriya dii dɛkkɛ filaŋkeŋŋ?

ref: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
text: Ii waa zummɛ lugɔ yaa daŋ ŋmɛnɛ wa di mɛlikachɔgaa la gba seriyaa? Di ii daŋ ŋmɛnɛ di mɛlikazi seriya, amɔ, ii waa durnya naa wia seriya dii helleaa?

ref: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
text: Ka di i ni i dɔŋhiŋ bɛl dɔɔ wii bɛl, i ɔɔ ra la banla Yeesu hiŋra n na gbɛlli la benii, bá di ii seriya ra tɛɛ ia.

ref: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
text: Nau! Guŋ dɔɔ ŋmɛnɛaa? Ii waa nunzunni maa dɔɔwɛ ii biini, ú wer kuari ii wia tɛɛ iaa?

ref: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
text: Iinna sami dɔŋa guŋ hiŋ gba, ii leuwoo. Di i ni i dɔŋhiŋ dɔɔ wii, di u ŋmɛɛi gba, ka í gil tɛu. U gunnɛ niŋ vii bɔ iin sami dɔŋa.

ref: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
text: Ii waa zummɛ lugɔ nɛchɔgaa wàá du Kɔraawiizi Kora biiniaa? Ii ra dar iihinaarɛ. Banla n na ɛɛ wikuna, banla n na kuari vuga, banla n na sɛm, banla n na ɛɛ wikuna ba dɔŋa haana gɛɛ ba dɔŋa baala be,

ref: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
text: banla n na ŋmɛɛ, banla n dɔɔ kuna kɛkɛluu, banla n na nyɔɔ siŋ di ra dɛɛzi, banla n na ŋɔ wiŋɔchɔgaa ani banla n na foozi nɛra, bannii bɛl maa wàá du Kɔraawiizi Kora la biini.

ref: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
text: Ii baŋhina faa ra ɛɛ gunnɛ, ka filaŋkennaa, ii sɔ a doŋa maanii ha. Kɔraawiizi lizi iabuu tɛɛ u hiŋ, di gil ii wia deŋli u be dikuu yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo ani yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii huma la wia. Sɛnsɛŋ wia

ref: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
text: “Wiimaa ɛɛi waa kii.” Ka wiimaa ɛɛi ge lɛi wesse. “N daŋ wer ɛɛ wii la maa minna nyiŋŋi.” Ka a maa lɛi wesse tɛŋ. Maa kummaa ra kii. Ka màá sɛɛ kummaa dɔɔ n fɔŋŋa.

ref: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
text: “Hizi wiarɛ diwee du de. Dii ge wiarɛ hia du de.” Ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ ŋmɛnɛ chɔgi a maa. Sɛnsɛŋ wia lɛi bɔrahɔŋ du de. Yaa Dɔɔri wiarɛ bɔrahɔŋ du de. Yaa Dɔɔri ge du denii, yá ra humuu ni yaa bɔrahɔna.

ref: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
text: Kɔraawiizi lalli yaa Dɔɔrii siu biini. Gunnɛ ú wa kpa u fɔŋŋa lalli yaa ge gba.

ref: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
text: Ii waa zummɛ lugɔ ii bɔrahɔna ɛɛ Kristo yeŋaawaa? Aŋ ɛɛ gunla, di n kpa Kristo yembɛl di ga birgi hahsɛnsɛnni yeŋ, u guŋ wessoaa?

ref: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
text: Gɛɛ ii waa zummɛ lugɔ nɛr la ni hahsɛnsɛnni n na chɔɔ, u nuu maa bɔrahɔŋ ɛɛ kpannɛaa? Kɔraawiizi Hɔnnɛ bagli guŋ, di ŋɔ, “Bá nɛra banɛɛ hiŋ daŋ ɛɛ bɔrahɔŋkpaŋ.”

ref: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
text: Ka nɛr la maa ge ni yaa Dɔɔri n kpauwɛ, ba dunzi ɛɛ kpannɛ.

ref: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
text: Awia, ií ra chɔ sɛnsɛŋ bɔr. Wichɔgaa la maa nɛra n na ɛɛ, ba bɔrahɔna lɛi ba ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa la. Ka nɛr la maa n na sɛm, u bɔrahɔnnɛ u ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa la.

ref: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
text: Ii waa zummɛ lugɔ ii bɔrahɔna ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii duuribɔttɛaa? Kɔraawiizi kpa u Dumnanii tɛɛ ia u du ii biine. Ia lɛi dɔɔ iihinaa,

ref: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi yau iabuu tɛɛ u hiŋ. Awia, ií ra dazi, ka gil u na girme ii bɔrahɔna biine.

ref: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
text: Ii faa sɛbi hɔnnɛ pɛɛziŋ alugɔ di baal gil haaŋ kpai, guŋ wessoa?

ref: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
text: Guŋ wessoo. Ka sɛnsɛŋ wia n kannɛ werge wia, a dɛkkɔɔ baal maa n dɔɔ u haaŋ, haaŋ maa ge dɔɔ u jaari.

ref: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
text: Haaŋ lɛi dɔɔ u bɔra fɔŋŋa. U jaarii dɔɔ u bɔra fɔŋŋa. Baal ge gba gunnɛ. Waa lɛi dɔɔ u bɔra fɔŋŋa. U haannɛ dɔɔ u bɔra fɔŋŋa.

ref: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
text: Awia, ii gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ dɔŋa wia. Di baal ni haaŋ ɛɛ nuukpaŋ di ŋɔ ba gilɛɛ ka chɔɔ dɔŋa be hɔpizaa anɛɛ mɔɔ, ka bá wer suŋŋi wiizi ni nfɛrkpaŋ ka kaa ba dɔŋa be, guŋ wesso. Ka di guŋ lɛi, ii gilɛɛ ra bargi dɔŋa be, Sitaani gilɛɛ wa wer dar ia, ií ɛɛ wichɔgaa, dikuu iiŋ waa wette ra lau iihinaa nɛnnɛ wia.

ref: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
text: Ka miŋ ŋɔ kennaa, Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔkpeg bɛl lɛi. Ka n ŋɔ gunnɛ, á gilɛɛ du kpol ii be werge.

ref: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
text: Miŋwaa be, a wesso baala la n haa waa haana kpawɛɛ, n gil haana kpai alugɔ miŋ gil haaŋ kpai naa, haana la ge janna n siuzɛɛ la, bá gilɛɛ kaa ra nyiŋŋi janna.

ref: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
text: Ka di ba wàá wer lau bahinaa, bá ra kpa haana di ra yuu baala. U guŋ bɔ baŋ gillɛ ka di nyitti huhzi.

ref: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
text: Ka n na ŋɔ haaŋ la n teŋ dɔɔ jaari la benii, ú gilɛɛ waa vɛɛ u jaari. N himmaa bampirii wiŋɔzi lɛi. Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔzii.

ref: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
text: Too. Annii min niŋ ŋɔ filaŋkennaa, Kɔraawiizi lɛi bagliŋ guŋ. N himmaa bampirii wiŋɔzii n ŋɔ ń ŋɔ tɛɛ banla n kawɛɛ. Di baal ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋri di dɔɔ haaŋ la n waa Yeesu hiŋri ɛɛwɛ, ka di ba dui par haaŋ la, ú jaari gilɛɛ waa vɛɛu.

ref: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
text: Di haaŋ ge ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋri, ka u jaari ge waa Yeesu hiŋri ɛɛwɛ, ka di ba dui la par u jaari ge, ú haaŋ gilɛɛ waa vɛɛu.

ref: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
text: Ka di unla n waa Yeesu hiŋri ɛɛwɛ ra nyiŋŋi u gil u jaari gɛɛ u haaŋ la n ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋri la, a waa chummɛ. Ú tɛu ŋmɛnɛɛ ú ra la. An du kennaa, firaa lɛi. Kɔraawiizi n yir yaa, yaa ba u be la, nuukpannɛ u yir yaa ya wa dɔɔ la.

ref: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
text: Haaŋ, di i jaari daŋ na lɛɛi Kɔraawiizi be dikuu i wia, i zummɔaa? Baal, di i ge haaŋ daŋ na lɛɛi Kɔraawiizi be dikuu i wia, i ge zummɔaa?

ref: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
text: Ií bɛl maa kpogli gunla yaa Dɔɔri n tɛɛ ia la. Gunla maa Kɔraawiizi n yir ia ií ra hiŋ, ií ra hiŋ guŋ. Gunnɛ n na bagli bɔr la maa Yeesu hiŋra n duwɛɛ.

ref: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
text: Di ba teŋ u hɛŋ, pɛɛrɛ. Di ba waa u hɛŋ teŋŋe ge, pɛɛrɛ. Ka Kɔraawiizi nua hiŋaarɛ ɛɛ wizeŋ.

ref: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
text: Awia, ií haa du gunla iiŋ faa duwɛɛ, saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n yir ia la.

ref: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
text: Di i faa ɛɛ yonne ka Kɔraawiizi yirii, gilɛɛ gil a guŋ zuu i nyuu. Ka di ba kaa ŋɔ bá tɛi ŋmɛnɛɛ, í sɛɛ,

ref: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛr la n ɛɛ yom ka Kɔraawiizi yiruu la, u ɛɛ nɛr la n dɔɔ u hinnɛ Kɔraawiiziwaa be. Nɛr la n dɔɔ u hiŋ ka Kɔraawiizi yiruu la, u ɛɛ Kristo yonne.

ref: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
text: Waabuu yau ia. Awia, ii gilɛɛ ra binni newea, bá dɔɔ ia.

ref: Stay what you were when God chose you. Unmarried People
text: Yaabalaa, gunla maa iiŋ faa duwɛɛ, ka Kɔraawiizi yir ia la, ií haa du guŋ. Ii ni Kɔraawiizii du de.

ref: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
text: Kɔraawiizi haa wam baglɛɛ suŋgure la n haa waa yuuwɛzi wia. Ka u suŋ n ninɛɛ di hiiniŋ, n wer di ra hum u huma ani wibii. Awia, n danna ŋɔ gunla miŋwaa n nawɛɛ.

ref: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
text: Filaŋkeŋ, tɔɔrɔɔ du denii di ra nuu yaa. Awia, miŋwaa be, a wesso gunla maa baal n soge, ú so guŋ.

ref: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
text: Di i dɔɔ haaŋ, gilɛɛ waa vɛɛu. Di haa haaŋ dɔɔwɛ ge, gilɛɛ waa nyiŋŋi haaŋ.

ref: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
text: Di i kpa haaŋ, a waa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ i ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ. Di toloori yuu baal ge, waa wichɔgaa ɛɛwɛ. Ka a daŋ ɛɛ tɔɔrɔɔ tɛɛ baa bá de dui naa saŋa. N ŋɔ ń lɛɛ iabuu a tɔɔrɔɔ biini.

ref: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
text: Yaabalaa, yaa wàá ka birgi durnya naa biini. Awia, filaŋkeŋ, a dɛkkɔ lugɔ ii banla n dɔɔ haana la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ ii waa haana dɔɔwɛ,

ref: It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke.
text: ií banla n na wii ge ɛɛ lugɔ ii biine waa chɔkkɛ, ií banla bɔra n sɔɔnɛɛ ge ɛɛ lugɔ ii bɔra waa sɔɔnɛɛ, ií banla n na yauzi kuna ge ra ɛɛ lugɔ ii waa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
text: Wia la maa iinna ɛɛ durnya naa biini, ii gilɛɛ waa ɛɛa ra bɛri, dikuubɛɛwiai, durnya naa ra ba tunaarɛ. Wàá ka birgi.

ref: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
text: Maa nyiŋŋi durnya naa wia zuu ii nyuuni. Baal la n waa haaŋ dɔɔwɛ la ɔɔ aah siwiire dikuu Kɔraawiizi huma wia, di ra nyiŋŋi u wia par Kɔraawiizi.

ref: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
text: Ka baal la n dɔɔ haaŋwaa, ɔɔ aah siwiire dikuu durnya wia, ú wia wer par u haaŋ.

ref: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
text: U du wia anɛɛ biinii. Haaŋ la n waa jaari dɔɔwɛ ni toloori, Kɔraawiizi huma wia ɔɔ aah ba siweere. Haaŋ la n waa jaari dɔɔwɛ ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ u bɔrahɔŋ ni u biini maa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hora, di ɛɛ kunnanaa u be. Haaŋ la n yuuwɛ ge ɔɔ aah siwiire dikuu durnya wia, ú wia wer par u jaari.

ref: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
text: N na nyiŋŋi ń hiini iabuu. A bɛŋ wiarɛ n na ŋɔ guŋ. Maa ŋɔ ń tɔ ia bɔr. N na nyiŋŋuu ií ra ɛɛ wia la n dɛkkɛ, di wer aah siwii nɛnnɛ di ra hum yaa Dɔɔri huma, wií maa gilɛɛ waa tɔ ia ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
text: Di baal bɛl dɔɔ u biihambie u hel haaŋ tuŋ, di ŋɔ lugɔ nɛr maa wàá kpau, ka bir binni lugɔ wɔɔ ɛɛwɛ nɛnnɛ, ú ɛɛ gunla maa unna nyiŋŋi. Wichɔgaa lɛi. Ú gil baal bɛl kpau.

ref: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
text: Awia, unla n kpa u biihambie tɛɛ baal, u ɛɛ nɛnnɛ. Ka unla n waa u biihambie kpawɛɛ tɛɛ baal la, waabuu ɛɛ nɛnnɛ werge.

ref: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
text: Di haaŋ yuuwɔ, di u jaari haa du de, u jaari hinnɛ dɔɔu. Ka di u jaari siuwɔ, waa kaa dɔɔu. U daŋ jaa wer lii di kaa ga yuu baal la maa unna nyiŋŋi. Ka a waa wer uŋ yuu baal maa, di Yeesu hiŋri lɛi.

ref: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
text: Ka miŋwaa be, di u gil yuui, gunnɛ niŋ ɛɛ bɔsɔna tɛu kaali un niŋ yuu. N himmaa bampirii wiŋɔzii guŋ, ka Kɔraawiizi Duma du n gba benii.

ref: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
text: Too. A ka vuga kuaraa ola la wia. Yaa zummɔ lugɔ yaa maanii zum wia. Ka newee zumaarɛ ɔɔ gil u ra nyiŋŋi sɔŋ. Nɛnɔŋŋaawaa dɔɔ hiinaare.

ref: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
text: Nɛr la maa n na binni lugɔ u zum wiarɛ, u haa waa wia zummɛ nɛnnɛ alugɔ un niŋ vii zum la.

ref: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
text: Ka nɛr lawaa n nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi, Kɔraawiizi zunnii.

ref: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
text: Awia, yaa n ɔɔ ŋɔ vuga kuaraa ola wia naa, yaa zummɔ lugɔ vug maa waa hoo durnya di ra nyiŋ. Wiizizi gba waa hoo, di kpaŋkpaŋ bɛŋ lɛi. Waabuu Kɔraawiizi.

ref: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
text: Kuna la newea n na yir ba wiizizi ni ba dɔɔra la, a kpillɔɔ werge chiŋ ni hɛri biine.

ref: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
text: Ka yaawaa be, Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ kpaŋkpannɛ. Waabuu yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la. U fɔŋŋa wiarɛ yaa maa du de la. Yaa Dɔɔri ge ɛɛ kpaŋkpaŋ. Waabuu Yeesu Kristo la n ta kummaa, di kaa tɛɛ yaa miibɔɔ la.

ref: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
text: Ka nɛr maa lɛi zum guŋ. Nɛra baŋhina faa ra ɛɛ vuga wiarɛ a ra mani baa. Awia, haali ni zinaa, di ba hee ol la nɛra n kpuwɛɛ tɛɛ vuga la, ba ɔɔ haa ra sɛɛu lugɔ vuga la du denii di ra nyiŋ. Awia, ba biine ɔɔ chɔgi di ra tɔɔri baa, dikuu baŋ haa ra aani la wia.

ref: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
text: Yaa kundiwee lɛi niŋ gil yaa wia par Kɔraawiizi. Di yaa vɛɛ a dii, a wàá la yaa ni harbɔɔ. Di yaa haa ra dia, a wàá la yaa ni see.

ref: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
text: Ama, ií ra dazi, ii gilɛɛ gil ii guŋ ɛɛi wer dar banla n haa ra aani la, bá chol,

ref: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, di ii zum wia naa zɛɛ, ka la vugkuari bɔr di gaa hee ola la, ii dɔŋhiŋ la n haa ra aani la wa na ia de, u ge daŋ dɔɔ bampirii di kutti zuu de di ge ra heea. Ka uŋ haa ra aani la, u biini daŋ chɔgi di ra tɔɔruu.

ref: Then what you know has destroyed someone Christ died for.
text: Ii chɔg ii dɔŋhinnɛ la. Kristo siuwɔɔ dikuu u wia, ka ii bir chɔguu dikuu ii zumaa wia. Nau!

ref: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
text: Di ii ra ɛɛ ii dɔŋahina kennaa, ba biine chɔgi di ra tɔɔri baa, dikuu baŋ haa ra aani wia naa, Kristoo ii ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa la.

ref: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
text: Awia, di diwee la min niŋ di, daŋ bir n dɔŋhiŋ harbɔɔ, màá ka di a diwee di hanna la, ń dɔŋhiŋ la gilɛɛ waa bir harbɔɔ.

ref: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
text: Miŋwaa waa Yeesu Kristo huŋhunni bɛlhiŋ ɛɛwɛa? Maa n hiŋ dɔɔwɛɛ gɛɛ? Kennaa ii gba n sɛɛwɛ di ra hiŋ Kɔraawiizi naa, n huma la miŋ hummɛ Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini wiarɛ ii sɛɛ di ra hiŋ gunla.

ref: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
text: Di baŋhina waa sɛɛwɛ lugɔ n ɛɛ Kristo huŋhunnii, ka iawaa daŋ sɛɛ. Hiŋaa naa iinna hiŋ naabuu, Kɔraawiizi kpa bagli lugɔ n ɛɛ u huŋhunnii wibii maa.

ref: When people question me, I tell them
text: Di nɛra ra pɛɛziŋ wia, kennaabuu n ɔɔ ŋɔ n hor.

ref: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
text: Di nɛra ra hiini yaa ani diwee ni kunnyɔɔlaa yaa waa guŋ dɛkkɛa?

ref: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
text: Kristo huŋhunna la, yaa Dɔɔri niuna ani Sifas la maa kpa haanaa, ba ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra, ba ni baa ra vol. Yaabuu waa guŋ fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛaa?

ref: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
text: Gɛɛ n ni Banabas bɛnnɛ ninna di yaa hinaa kuuhni biinei?

ref: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
text: Di i ɛɛ sooja di ra la laal, i dɔɔra kebee lɛi i ra dia? Di i par koo, hàá di u biini diweea? Di i ra nɔɔni nauna ge, hàá nyɔɔ a nailaa?

ref: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
text: Moosis sɛbɔɔrɛ, “Ií gilɛɛ waa vɔɔ navarga la n na fɛrgi mia, a bii ra lii nua.” Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ Moosis sɛbi guŋ dikuu nauna wia, ú wer hiini nauna gɛɛ newea hiinaa wiarɛ u gil u sɛbi gunnɛi?

ref: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
text: Yaa wiarɛ u gil u sɛbi guŋ, wibii maa, ya zum alugɔ nɛr la maa n na par, ú ra par ni tamii, nɛr la maa n na kum ge, ú ra kum ni tamii.

ref: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
text: Yaa n duu yaa kuna naa, amɔ, yaa wàá kumaawaa? Yaa n bagli ia Kɔraawiizi wia di hiini ii dunzi kennaa, amɔ, yaa wàá na kummaa ii be di hiini yaa hinaa?

ref: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
text: Ii ɔɔ ra tɛɛ baŋhinaa guŋ. Di ba dɛg guŋ, amɔ, yaawaa waa guŋ dɛkkɛ werge kaali baa? Ka yaa faa waa guŋ fɔŋŋa ra bagli ii ni, ka ra di kanyitti wiimaa biini, yá gilɛɛ waa teŋ amaniyesuma wia ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
text: Ii zummɔ lugɔ banla n na hum Kɔraawiizi Dia huma ra di a huma biinii. Banla n na hum mbusu lizibɔr, na mbusu lizaa yeŋaa ra di.

ref: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
text: Gunnɛ yaa Dɔɔri ge dau tɛɛ banla n ɔɔ ra lizi amaniyesuma la, di ŋɔ bá ra di a huma biini.

ref: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
text: N dɛg guŋ maanii, ka maa gunna lɛɛ ii be. Maa wia naa sɛbɛɛ filaŋkeŋ, di ra nyiŋŋi ŋɔ ii tɛŋ guŋ. N siu bɔ miŋ ɛɛ guŋ, nɛ́ra gilɛɛ wer duŋŋiŋ n hinchɔlaa naa wia biini.

ref: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
text: Màá wer kpa amaniyesuma lizaa naawaa di nyiŋŋi sɔŋ tɛɛ n hiŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n biini ɔɔ ra firimbuu, n na ŋɔa. Di màá ŋɔwɛɛ, wiarɛ. A daŋ nuuŋ.

ref: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
text: Di n himmaa kipar wiarɛ n na ɛɛ guŋ, a dɛkkɔ minna na kinturgaa. Ka Kɔraawiizi kpa amaniyesuma naabuu tɛŋ ŋɔ ń lizi ra tɛɛ nɛra. Awia, min lɛi tɛɛ n hiŋ guŋ, n na hum.

ref: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
text: Beedee n ɛɛ n huma hiŋ tɔnai? N tɔnaa min niŋ lizi amaniyesuma la tɛɛ nɛra pɛɛpɛɛ, ka maa baa ra bagli fɔŋŋa la min niŋ faa bagli ba ni, dikuu miŋ lizi amaniyesuma tɛɛ baa la wia.

ref: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
text: Nɛr maa lɛi dɔɔ n fɔŋŋa, ka n kpa n hinnɛ di birgi balii, di hum ra tɛɛ ba maa, ń vii wer na baa werge tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi.

ref: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
text: Di n ni Jus hina kpauwɔ, aŋ kpa n hinnɛ birgi ba bɛl, di ra hiŋ ba Gbɔgni la. A waa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ Gbɔgni la hiŋaa dɔɔmbuu, ka n na hiŋaabuu gunla ba ge n na hiŋ la, ń wer na baa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi.

ref: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
text: Di n ni banla n waa gbɔg la ra hiŋ ge kpauwɔ, aŋ kpa n hinnɛ birgi lugɔ baa, ń wer na ba ge tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. Ka a waa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ maa Kɔraawiizi nua ra hiŋ. N na hiŋuubuu gunla Kristo n bagli yaa, yaa ra hiŋ labuu.

ref: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
text: Di n ni banla ge n na aani Kristo hiŋaa biini la ge kpauwɔ, aŋ kpa n hinnɛ di birgi ba ge bɛl, ń wer na baa. Gunla maa nɛra maa n duwɛɛ, aŋ kpa n hinnɛ birgi guŋ, ń vii wer hiini baŋhina, Kɔ́raawiizi lɛɛ baa.

ref: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
text: Annii maanii n kuu amaniyesuma la wia ra ɛɛ, ń ge vii wer nuu suma a amaniyesuma lizaa biini.

ref: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
text: Ii zummɔ lugɔ di nɛkpila ra chɔ bá di kumbɛl, ba maanii ɔɔ chɔ, ka kpaŋkpannɛ ɔɔ wa diu. Awia, kennaa iinna hiŋ Kɔraawiizi naa, ií aah siwii di ra hiŋ guŋ di wer wa na lɛɛi.

ref: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
text: Awiarɛ n ɔɔ deŋli ra chɔ guŋŋ ń ga hel u maga. N kaa ɛɛu lugɔ abuloosi lɔɔri Kɔraawiizi huma biini. Maa ɔɔ ta ra kirgi.

ref: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
text: Anna tɔɔri n bɔrahɔnnɛ di ra lau n hiŋ nɛnnɛ, ń himmaa gilɛɛ wa hiŋ wia naa minna bagli nɛra naa huhzi.

ref: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
text: Yaabalaa, n ŋɔ ń liizi iabuu lugɔ Kɔraawiizi baama la faa tɔ yaa naabaala la maa ninɛɛ. Ba maanii ga muu la biini kaali.

ref: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
text: Ba maanii faa na diwee Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini di ra di,

ref: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
text: di kaa na nii u fɔŋŋa biini di ra nyɔɔ. Bii ninɛɛ a nii faa lii. Kristoo ɛɛwɛ lugɔ bii la, di ɔɔ faa hiŋ baa ra la, ba na nii u be di ra nyɔɔ.

ref: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
text: Ka ba galga maa wia faa waa Kɔraawiizi pattɛ, ba siuzi bɔkpila maa hɛribɔduma la biini.

ref: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
text: Wia naa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ sɛɛliizi, ya kpa ra mɛgzi di ra chaani nɛra siwee, ya gilɛɛ dɔɔ kunchɔgaa kɛkɛluu gunla baŋ faa dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
text: Ya gilɛɛ ra kuari vuga alugɔ baŋhina n faa ra kuari vuga la. Moosis sɛbɔɔrɛ, “Ba so di ra di, di ra nyɔɔ sinni, di sa, di ra ɛɛ sɛnsɛŋ wia.”

ref: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
text: Ya gilɛɛ ra sɛm lugɔ baŋhina n faa ra sɛm, Kɔraawiizi kpuuzi ba nɛra kagboŋa tokko ni ahoro hɔpizikpaŋ biini la.

ref: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
text: Too. Miŋwaa be, “Wiimaa ɛɛi waa kii.” Ka wiimaa ɛɛi ge lɛi wesse. Ka wiimaa ɛɛi ge lɛi dɔɔ hiinaa.

ref: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
text: Ya gilɛɛ ɛɛ Kristo na gunla baŋhina n faa ɛɛu na, u gil hɛrikuna dunzi baa, ba siuzi la.

ref: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
text: Ya gilɛɛ nuumi ra du Kɔraawiizi alugɔ ba baŋhina n faa nuumɛɛ di ra duu, u gil siu mɛlika wa kpuuzi baa la.

ref: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
text: Too. Wia naa maa wa ɛɛ baabuu, á chaani ba siwee. Moosis sɛbi a wiarɛ, á chaani yaa ge bannii n du durnya tunaa hɔpizaa biini naa siwee.

ref: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
text: Awia, nɛr la maa n na fɛ lugɔ u chigɔɔ chigigi, ú ra dazi ú gilɛɛ waa chol.

ref: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
text: Nɛr maanii ra di tɔɔrɔɔ. Awia, di hinla ra di tɔɔrɔɔ guŋ, i bɛŋ lɛi haa faarɛɛ ra di a tɔɔrɔɔ dɔŋ. Ka Kɔraawiizi wia dɔɔ wibiire. Wàá kpa wifittii la n kaali i fɔŋŋa ɛɛi na í chol. U daŋ baglii gunla hin niŋ vɛɛ a wii, di wer lii u biini. Vuga diwee ni yaa Dɔɔri Diwee wia

ref: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
text: Awia, n biinɔŋŋaa, ií gil vuga kuaraa wia ha, di ra dazi a ni.

ref: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
text: Ii ɛɛ nunzunnaa. Awia, ií pessi n wiŋɔzi naa nɛnnɛ na.

ref: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
text: Kristo siŋ la yaa n suŋŋi wiizi di du u ni ka nyɔɔu, di ra liizi u wia la, yaa maa kpauwɔɔ guŋ, ú chal wia biini. Yaa n ɔɔ mɔnni paanuu la ge la, yaa maa kpauwɔɔ ú bɔrahɔŋ wia biini la.

ref: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
text: Yaa ɔɔ du kpil ninɛɛ ka hee a paanuukpaŋ. Awia, yaa ɛɛ bɔrahɔŋkpannɛ, dikuu paanuukpaŋ la yaa maa n kpauwɛ hee la wia.

ref: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
text: Ií ra binni Jus hina wia la. Banla n na di mbusuzi la, ba waa Kɔraawiizi mbusuzi lizibɔr wia biini duwɛaa?

ref: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
text: Minna ŋɔ kennaa, maa ŋɔ lugɔ vug ɛɛ kummaanii gɛɛ mbusu la baŋ lizɛɛ tɛu la ɛɛ kumbɛllɛ.

ref: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
text: N na ŋɔu lugɔ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ n ɔɔ ra lizi ba mbusuzi la, tinnanchɔgaarɛ ba ɔɔ lizaa ra tɛɛ la. Kɔraawiizi lɛi ba ɔɔ lizaa ra tɛɛ. Maa nyiŋŋi ii ni tinnanchɔgaa waa kpau wikpaŋ biini.

ref: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
text: A waa wer iin nyɔɔ yaa Dɔɔri siŋ la, ka kaa la ga nyɔɔ tinnanchɔgaa hor la. Gunnɛ a waa kaa du wer iiŋ hee yaa Dɔɔri paanuu la, ka kaa la ga hee tinnanchɔgaa ol la. Akai!

ref: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
text: Yaa ŋɔ ya fuuh yaa Dɔɔri baannɛ gɛɛ? Yaabuu kpekke kaaluuwaa?

ref: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
text: Di ba ra yoo ol, olyoori bɔr, di ii ra nyiŋŋi ol, ií yau ra hee di gilɛɛ ra aani lugɔ a waa wer iin niŋ heea,

ref: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, “Kɔraawiizii dɔɔ hɛri ani kunla maa n du u biini.”

ref: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
text: Di banla n waa Kɔraawiizi wia sɛɛwɛ bɛl yir ia, ií ba ií nuu di, di ii ra nyiŋŋi guŋ, ií la. Diwee la maa un niŋ tɛɛ ia la, ií di, di gilɛɛ waa pɛɛzi a wia, di ra aani alugɔ a waa wer iin niŋ dia.

ref: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
text: Ii himmaa biine wia lɛi n ŋɔ ií gil. Ka unla hiŋ biini wiarɛ n ŋɔ ií gil. Ii daŋ pɛɛzi, “Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ maa gunna kii, ka ń lau n hiŋ dikuu nɛbɛl n na aani wiai?”

ref: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
text: Di n jaami Kɔraawiizi ka ra dia, bɛɛ wiarɛ ba kaa gbɛlliŋ dikuu diwee la miŋ jaami Kɔraawiizi un tɛŋ la wiai?

ref: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
text: Ka wii la maa iinna ɛɛ, di diire i ra di, di niirɛ ii ra nyɔɔ, ka ií ra kpa Kɔraawiizi girme a maa biini.

ref: I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.
text: N gba ra hiŋ gunnɛ, ń wia wer par nɛr maa. Màá sɛɛ gil n bɛmbɛŋ wia tiriŋ. Nɛr maa wiarɛ ninna tiriŋ, ń wer na baa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi.

ref: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
text: Awia, n na nyiŋŋi lugɔ ii ɛɛ n hiŋra, di ra hiŋiŋ gunla miŋ ge n ɛɛ Kristo hiŋri, di ra hiŋuu la. Haana nyuuni tɔi jaamibɔr wia

ref: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
text: N na chɔli iabuu dikuu iinna liizi n widaulaa la maa miŋ faa bagli ia la, di ra hiŋ wia la maa Kɔraawiizi n bagliŋ, n ge kpa bagli ia la.

ref: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
text: N na nyiŋŋi ii zum lugɔ Kristoo ɛɛ baal nabɔma, baal ge ɛɛ haaŋ nabɔma, Kristo ge nabɔmaa Kɔraawiizi.

ref: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
text: Di baal maa ra suŋŋi wiizi gɛɛ u ra ŋɔ wia Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, ka kuŋ tɔ u nyuu, Kristoo u ra gbɛlli la.

ref: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
text: Di haaŋ maa ge ra suŋŋi wiizi gɛɛ u ra ŋɔ wia u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, ka kummaa waa u nyuu tɔwɛɛ, u jaarii u ra gbɛlli la. U ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nyugbala hiŋ.

ref: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
text: Di wàá sɛɛ kpa kummaa tɔ u nyuu, amɔ, bá fuŋ u nyuu. Di a waa wer baŋ fuŋ u nyuu gɛɛ baŋ gbaari u nyuu ha, amɔ, ú kpa kuŋ tɔ u nyuu hiŋ.

ref: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
text: A waa dɛkkɛ baal ge n kpa kuŋ tɔ u nyuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, waabuu du Kɔraawiizi duulaa. Haaŋ genii ra bagli baal girme.

ref: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
text: Baal faa waa haaŋ be liwɛɛ. Haannɛ lii baal be.

ref: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa waa baal tawɛɛ dikuu haaŋ wia, ka u ta haannɛ dikuu baal wia.

ref: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
text: Awia, a dɛkkɔ haaŋ n na sɛɛ baal dɔɔra, di kpa kuŋ ra tɔ u nyuu. U gunnɛ ra bagli lugɔ baallɛ dɔɔ u fɔŋŋa. Mɛlikazi a binni iabuu. Awia, ií ra ɛɛ guŋ.

ref: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
text: Ama, báal gilɛɛ ra binni haaŋ pɛɛ yaa Dɔɔri hiŋaa naa biini, háaŋ ge gilɛɛ ra binni baal pɛɛ.

ref: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
text: Haaŋ faa lii baal ninɛɛ, ka haannɛ jaa ra lul baal. Kummaa ge lii Kɔraawiizi benii.

ref: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
text: Ií pessi na ka bagliŋ. A wesso haaŋ n na jaami Kɔraawiizi, di waa kuŋ kpawɛɛ tɔ u nyuuwaa?

ref: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
text: Ka di haaŋ waa nyuhuna hello werge, a guŋ wessoo. A ɔɔ giluu u du wer. Kɔraawiizii tɛu guŋ, ú ra tɔ u hiŋ.

ref: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
text: Di nɛr la maa ra nyiŋŋi hɔɔzi dii, ka gunnɛ yaa ni Kɔraawiizi hiŋra la maa gba ra hiŋ. Yaa Dɔɔri diwee dii wia (Mat

ref: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
text: Wia la minna nyiŋŋi n jaa ŋɔ tɛɛ ia ií ra hiŋ lawaa, màá chɔli ia aawaa wia. Ii dɔŋa be chaalaa waa ia ra hiini, ka ra nyaŋŋi ia.

ref: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
text: A luglii keŋ. N nuu ii wiarɛ lugɔ iiŋ ɔɔ chaali ií jaami Kɔraawiizi la, ii waa ɔɔ dɔɔ nuukpaŋ. N na binni lugɔ wibiire ba ra ŋɔ.

ref: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
text: Dɔŋbargaa daŋ du ii baaŋ, ií banla Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛwɛ na, ii wia paruu la wer lii bɔchaaŋ, ya zum ia.

ref: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ii bɛl maa ɔɔ hahzuu ra di u bɛŋ diwee. Baŋhina wàá na, baŋhina ge na werge di ra dɛɛzi.

ref: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
text: U ŋɔ gunnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, saŋa la maa iin niŋ ɔɔ ra hee paanuu la, di ra nyɔɔ siŋ la, yaa Dɔɔri siu wiarɛ ii ɔɔ ra bagli guŋ, di ra la saŋa la un niŋ kaa bir ba la.

ref: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
text: Di guŋ lɛi, ka unla maa ra heea di ra nyɔɔa, u ra ba ú wa zuu Kɔraawiizi seriya dii biinii, dikuu uŋ waa pessee nɛnnɛ lugɔ yaa Dɔɔri bɔrahɔnnɛ, ka ra ɛɛ guŋ wia.

ref: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
text: Gunnɛ baŋ wa diwee tuŋ, u kpa libee ni siŋ, di ŋɔ, “Siŋ naa ɛɛ n challɛ un niŋ kuu ii wia di lii, di kuari ii ni Kɔraawiizi nuukpaŋfalii dɔɔi. Saŋa la maa iin ninna nyɔɔu, ií ɔɔ ra nyɔɔu di ra liizi n wia.”

ref: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu benii n nuu wia naa, di faa bagli ia gunla uŋ faa ɛɛwɛ hamuŋa la baŋ faa ɛɛu sɔsɔgɔ la. U kpa paanuu bɛllɛ a hamuŋa ni

ref: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
text: di suŋŋi wiizi du u ni, ka lawuu mɔnni mɔnni, ka ŋɔ, “N bɔrahɔnnɛ keŋ n na chɔgi dikuu ii wia. Ií ra heea di ra liizi n wia.”

ref: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
text: Awia, ií bɛl maa ɔɔ fɛ nfɛrɛ nɛnnɛ na mɔɔ, ka haa hee a paanuu di nyɔɔ a siŋ.

ref: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
text: Awiarɛ ii nɛkpila maa gɛrgi ra wii, baŋhina ge siuzi la.

ref: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
text: Di yaa faa pessi yaa biine wiarɛ mɔɔ, Kɔraawiizi faa wàá di yaa seriya, di ra tɔɔri yaa.

ref: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
text: Ka yaa Dɔɔri n ɔɔ di yaa seriya di ra tɔɔri yaa naa, ɔɔ ɛɛ gunnɛ, ya gilɛɛ waa jaa banla un niŋ di ba seriya, di vɛɛ baa la biini.

ref: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
text: Awia, yaabalaa, di ii ɔɔ wa chaali dɔŋa ií di diwee naa, ii gilɛɛ hahzi ra dia. Ií ɔɔ ra kpaŋ dɔŋa.

ref: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
text: Di lɔzi ra kpu unla maa, ú ɔɔ di u dia mɔɔ ka ra ba. Ií gilɛɛ waa di a diwee gunla n waa dɛkkɛ, Kɔraawiizi wa di ii seriya, ií chol. Wia la maa n kawɛɛ, di n kaa wa ba, n daŋ bagli ia.

ref: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
text: Ii zummɔ lugɔ saŋa la iiŋ faa waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ la, Sitaani faa dar iabuu, ii leuzi di ra hiŋ vuga. A waa wette ra ŋɔ wia, ka ii faa ra hiŋaa.

ref: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
text: Awia, n na nyiŋŋuu ii zum lugɔ nɛr la maa n na ŋɔ wia Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, a hiŋ wàá wer gbɛlli Yeesu. Nɛr la maa ge n na ŋɔ lugɔ Yeesu ɛɛ yaa Dɔɔrii la, Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biinii u wer zum guŋ di ra ŋɔ.

ref: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
text: Too. Wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋazi la Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii n sunzi yaa la kurgɔɔrɛ. Ka Kɔraawiizi Dumkpannɛ du yaa maa ni di ra ɛɛa.

ref: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
text: Humazi la yaa Dɔɔri n bɔnni yaa la kurgɔɔrɛ. Ka yaa Dɔɔri ɛɛ kpannɛ, yaa maa ra humuu.

ref: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
text: Fɔŋŋazi la Kɔraawiizi n bɔnni yaa la kurgɔɔrɛ, ka Kɔraawiizi kpannɛ ra hum yaa maa biine, di ra ɛɛ a wiimaa.

ref: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
text: Kɔraawiizii ra tɛɛ bɛl maa ni u wiɛɛlaa, ú ɛɛ u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini di wer hiini ii maa.

ref: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
text: Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii gillɔɔ baŋhina ra ŋɔ wia, a dɔɔ nunzuma, di kaa gil baŋhina ge dɔɔ sichaana. Kɔraawiizi Dumkpaŋ hinnɛ tɛɛ bɛl maa a guŋ fɔŋŋa,

ref: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
text: di kaa gil baŋhina ge dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi yarda nɛnnɛ u fɔŋŋa biini, baŋhina ge dɔɔ fɔŋŋa bá wer chaa nɛra,

ref: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
text: baŋhina ge dɔɔ fɔŋŋa bá wer ɛɛ wizenaa, baŋhina ge dɔɔ fɔŋŋa bá wer lizi Kɔraawiizi amaniye, báŋhina ge wer zum fɔŋŋa dizi la nɛra n dɔɔwɛ, baŋhina wer mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi, baŋhina ge wer bagli a mɔɔdumazi zɛɛzi ra tɛɛ nɛra.

ref: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
text: Ka annii maa, Kɔraawiizi Dumkpaŋ labuu ra ɛɛ a maa, di ra bɔnni bɛl maa ni u wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋazi gunla n paruu. Bɔrahɔŋkpaŋ ka dɔɔ bɔkpila wia

ref: The body of Christ has many different parts, just as any other body does.
text: Ií na gunla yaa bɔrahɔŋ n duwɛɛ. U ɛɛ kuŋkpannɛ ka dɔɔ bɔkpila. A bɔkpila choŋŋi dɔŋaa di ɛɛ bɔrahɔŋkpaŋ. Gunnɛ Kristo ge du la.

ref: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
text: Yaa ɛɛ Jus hinaa di kaa ɛɛ Giris hina, yaa baŋhina ge ɛɛ balaa, yaa baŋhina ge dɔɔ yaa hinaa. Ka Kɔraawiizi kpa u Dumnanii du yaa maa ni, yaa maa birgi bɔrahɔŋkpaŋ. Kuŋkpannɛ u gil yaa maa na di du yaa biine. U Dumaa yaa maa na la.

ref: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
text: Newee yeŋa waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛ. A kpillɔɔ.

ref: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
text: Di i naa ŋɔwɔɔ, “Maa nonii ɛɛwɛ, awia, maa hoo i bɔrahɔŋ ni, u leuwoo.” Waa nonii ɛɛwɛ ka u gba du i bɔrahɔŋ ninɛɛ.

ref: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
text: Di i digni ge ŋɔwɔɔ, “Maa siwii ɛɛwɛ, awia, maa hoo i bɔrahɔŋ ni, u leuwoo.” Waa siwii ɛɛwɛ, ka u gba du i bɔrahɔŋ ninɛɛ.

ref: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
text: Di i bɔrahɔŋ vii ɛɛ siwii bɛnnɛ, ka digni waa hoo, i daŋ wer nuu wiaa? Di i bɔrahɔŋ ge vii kaa ɛɛ digni bɛnnɛ ka miizi waa hoo, i daŋ wer nuu sɔaah?

ref: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
text: Ka guŋ lɛi Kɔraawiizi ta yaa. U tɛɛ yaabuu yaa bɔrahɔna yeŋa maa, di dua gunla unna nyiŋŋi.

ref: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
text: Di a yeŋa maa vii ɛɛ kuŋkpannɛ, u daŋ vii wer ɛɛ bɔrahɔnnaa? Akai!

ref: It takes many parts to make a single body.
text: Ka a kpillɔɔ. A maa ɛɛ bɔrahɔŋkpaŋ.

ref: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
text: Siwii wàá wer ŋɔ nonii be, “N daŋ wer hum huma n bɛŋ, di haa hoo.” Nyuu ge wàá wer ŋɔ naazi be, “N daŋ wer hum huma n bɛŋ, di ii waa hoo.”

ref: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
text: Akai. Yeŋa la n gɛrgɛɛ la, a wiarɛ kpolle werge.

ref: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
text: Anla n waa girme dɔɔwɛ la, aabuu yaa ra tɔgzi werge, anla n chummɛ la ge, yaa ɔɔ ra binni a ni.

ref: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
text: Ka anla n wesse la, a waa kaa ɛɛ lugɔ ya kaa ra binni aawaa ni. Gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi gil yaa bɔrahɔna yeŋa kpau, yaa ra tɔgzi anla n waa girme dɔɔwɛ la,

ref: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
text: bɛl maa gilɛɛ lau u hiŋ bargi u dɔŋa be, ka a bɔkpila maa nuu ra tɛɛ dɔŋa.

ref: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
text: Di bɔrahɔŋ yembɛl waa alaanfia dɔɔwɛ, amɔ, bɔra maanii waa alaanfia dɔɔwɛ la. Di ba wa chɔli yemmaa, a bɔrahɔŋ maanii ɔɔ sɔɔni.

ref: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
text: Too. Ii maanii ɛɛ Kristo bɔrahɔŋ la. Ii bɛl maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ u yembɛl.

ref: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
text: Ii maa lɛi Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna. Ii maa lɛi wette ra ŋɔ wia Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini. Ii maa lɛi kaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wibagla. Ii maa lɛi kaa wer ra ɛɛ wizenaa.

ref: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
text: Ii maa lɛi kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa, ií wer ra chaa wiila hina. Ii maa lɛi wette ra mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi. Ii maa lɛi kaa wer ra bagli a mɔɔdumazi zɛɛzi.

ref: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
text: Ka ií aah siwii ra nyiŋŋi Kɔraawiizi wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋazi la n wesse werge a biini. Ama, ií gil n bagli ia hiŋaa la n wesse werge maa di wa bɛri la.

ref: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
text: Di n wetto ra mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi ani mɛlikazi mɔɔri gba, ka maa nɛra nɔŋŋɛɛ, n na kɔɔu alugɔ baŋ ɔɔ ra lɔ lugbii ani bɛɛl, a ra kɔɔ nyɛgɛgɛ gunla.

ref: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
text: Di n wetto ra bagli Kɔraawiizi wia nɛnnɛ u fɔŋŋa biini, di dɔɔ sichaana werge maa, di zum Kɔraawiizi wisuahlaa maa, di kaa dɔɔ yarda u fɔŋŋa biini lugɔ min niŋ wer ŋɔ bizeŋ be lugɔ ú izi kaali yembɛl, u izi kaali, di n wetto di ɛɛ annii maa ka maa nɛra nɔŋŋɛɛ, maa nɛnanii maa ɛɛwɛ.

ref: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
text: Di n wetto kpa n kummaa tɛɛ nyaara bá di, di kaa wer sɛɛ bá kpa niŋ fuuh n maa, ń siu dikuu Kɔraawiizi wia, ka maa nɛra nɔŋŋɛɛ, pɛɛrɛ.

ref: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
text: Wichɔgaa ɛɛi wàá ra sɔɔni i bɔra. Wibii wiarɛ ninna sɔɔni i bɔra.

ref: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
text: Nɔŋŋaa waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ. Wiŋɔzi du denii banna ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini. Ka a daŋ ŋmɛnɛ tuŋ. Mɔɔdumazi gba du denii banna mɔɔ u fɔŋŋa biini. A gba daŋ ŋmɛnɛ tuŋ. Sichaana du denii baŋ dɔɔwɛ u fɔŋŋa biini. Ka annii gba daŋ ŋmɛnɛ tuŋ,

ref: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
text: Di a bɔzeŋ la wa ballɔ, annii daŋ tuŋ.

ref: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
text: Miŋ faa ɛɛ bichala, n faa ra ŋɔ bichal wiŋɔzii, di ra ɛɛ bichal wia, di ra fɛ bichal nfɛrɛ. Ka miŋ wa hel baal tuŋ, n gil a bichal wia ha.

ref: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
text: A ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ yaa n na binni digii biini, ka waa na nɛnnɛ filaŋkeŋ. Ka di saŋa bɛl wa hello, yaa daŋ na wiimaa nɛnnɛ siwii ni. Zumaa la maa yaa n zummɛ filaŋkennaa, ka a bɔzeŋ haa du harbɔɔ. Ka di a saŋa wa hello, n daŋ jaa zum wiimaa gunla Kɔraawiizi n zumiŋ la.

ref: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
text: Awia, wia ahorobuu du de di ɛɛ wizenaa. Aabuu keŋ, yarda, tamii ani nɔŋŋaa. Ka nɔŋŋaa labuu ɛɛ wizeŋ kaali a maa.

ref: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
text: Awia, ií aah siwii dikuu nɛnɔŋŋaa dɔɔi wia di kaa ra nyiŋŋi Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋazi la. Ka unla iin ninna nyiŋŋi werge, waabuu lugɔ iin niŋ wer ra ŋɔ wia Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini,

ref: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛr la n na mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi la, newea lɛi u mɔɔ ra tɛɛ. Kɔraawiizii u mɔɔ ra tɛɛ. Wisuahlaarɛ u ra ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, ka nɛra waa nuu.

ref: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
text: Ka nɛr la n na ŋɔ wia Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, neweare u ŋɔ ra tɛɛ, di ra hiini baa, bá wer zum Kɔraawiizi wia di ra du baa bɔkpega, di ra tig ba bampiree.

ref: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
text: Nɛr la n na mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi la, u himmaanii u ra hiini Kɔraawiizi wia biini. Ka nɛr la n na ŋɔ wia Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini, Yeesu hiŋra maanii u ra hiini bá wer zum Kɔraawiizi wia la.

ref: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
text: Di ii maa wetto ra mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi, n na nyiŋŋi guŋ. Ka di ii maa wetto ra ŋɔ wia Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini, gunnɛ n na nyiŋŋi werge, dikuubɛɛwiai, di nɛr ra ŋɔ wia Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini, a guŋ wesso kaali nɛr n na mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi di waa a zɛɛ baglɛɛ á hiini Yeesu hiŋra Kɔraawiizi wia biini.

ref: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
text: Yaabalaa, di n ba ii be di waa mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi, ɛrɛɛ ń wer hiini iai? Di Kɔraawiizi wam baglɛɛ wii bɛl ń kpa bagli ia gɛɛ di wan tɛɛwɛ sichaana, gɛɛ di maa wiŋɔzi dɔɔwɛ ń ŋɔ tɛɛ ia u Duma fɔŋŋa biini gɛɛ maa u baglaa bɛl dɔɔwɛ ń bagli ia, ɛrɛɛ ń wer hiini iai?

ref: If all musical instruments sounded alike, how would you know the difference between a flute and a harp?
text: Kuna la n waa nyiŋ gba ra bagli wia naabuu. Di ba ra huuh tiitorii gɛɛ ba ra lɔ janjalaŋ, ka a waa lii nɛnnɛ, ɛrɛɛ nɛ́ra wer nuu gunla banna lɔuwɛi?

ref: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
