text: Di ba ŋɔ bá huuh bɛŋkuna nɛ́ra nuu di ɛɛ sirya la laal, ka di ba wɔɔ ra huuh nɛnnɛ, ɛrɛɛ bá wer zum di ɛɛ siryai?

ref: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
text: Ii ge gba, di ii wiŋɔzi waa wette ra chaani, ɛrɛɛ bá ɛɛ nuuawɛi? A daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ ii ra kɔɔu ii bɛmbɛŋ.

ref: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
text: Ka di maa nɛbɛl mɔɔri ra nuu, n daŋ ɛɛu lugɔ bambuguu a hiŋ be, u ge ɛɛ lugɔ bambuguu n be.

ref: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
text: Awia, iiŋ aah siwii ra nyiŋŋi Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋazi naa, ií ra nyiŋŋi anla n niŋ wer gil ii wer ra hiini Yeesu hiŋra werge la.

ref: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
text: Awia, nɛr la n na mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi la, ú suŋŋi wiizi ú tɛu fɔŋŋa ú wer di ra bagli nɛra a zɛɛzi.

ref: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
text: Di n na jaami Kɔraawiizi ani mɔɔduma, n dumaa ra jaamuu ka n nfɛrɛwaa waa wiimaa zummɛ la.

ref: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
text: Too. Ɛrɛɛ ń ɛɛi? N danna jaami ni n duma di kaa ra jaami ni n nfɛrɛ ge. N danna yir yira ani n duma di kaa ra yir yira ni n nfɛrɛ ge.

ref: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
text: Di guŋ lɛi, di i ra jaami Kɔraawiizi ni i duma, nɛ́r la n waa nuu la wàá wer ŋɔ, “Ami,” dikuubɛɛwiai, waa gunla hinna jaami la ra nuu.

ref: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
text: I jaamɔɔrɛ nɛnnɛ, ka waabuu waa hiinaa maa nawɛɛ a biini.

ref: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
text: Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ jaannɛ uŋ gillɛ n ge gba ra mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi di mɔɔa kaali ii maa gba.

ref: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
text: Ka di n wa du Yeesu hiŋra be di ŋɔ witama n mɔɔri biini di wer hiini baa, gunnɛ bɔ min niŋ ŋɔ wikpila maa mɔɔdumazi biini.

ref: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
text: Yaabalaa, ii gilɛɛ dɔɔ bichal nfɛssi. Ií ra fɛ nfɛrɛ lugɔ nɛra la n dirmɛɛ ba nfɛssi biini. Di wichɔgaa ɛɛi waa biinii, amɔ, ií dɔɔ bichal nfɛssi.

ref: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
text: Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, u ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ gil banla n na mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi ŋɔ n wia tɛɛ n nɛra naa, ka ba daŋ haa vɛɛ. Ba wàá nuu tɛŋ.” Kɔraawiizii ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
text: Too. Banla n waa Kɔraawiizi wia ra sɛɛ wiarɛ u gil nɛra ra mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi la bá zum u fɔŋŋa. Banla n sɛɛwɛ wia lɛi. Banla n sɛɛwɛ ge wiarɛ u gil nɛra wer ra ŋɔ u wia u fɔŋŋa biini. Banla n waa sɛɛwɛ wia lɛi.

ref: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
text: Awia, di Yeesu hiŋra maa wa chaali bɔkpaŋ di ra mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi, di nɛdumazi ni banla n waa Kɔraawiizi wia ra sɛɛ la wa zuuwɔ, ba wàá ŋɔ lugɔ ii ra chugluuwaa?

ref: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
text: Ka di ii maa ra ŋɔ wia Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini, di unla n waa Kɔraawiizi wia ra sɛɛ gɛɛ nɛduma bɛl wa zuuwɔ, u daŋ nuu di sɛɛ lugɔ u ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛrii. Ii maa wiŋɔzi la daŋ zuu u bampirii a tiruu,

ref: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
text: u biini wolo maa lii, u chol Kɔraawiizi naazi di suŋŋuu, di ra ŋɔ nɛra be lugɔ Kɔraawiizi du ii benii, wibii maa. Yeesu hiŋra jaamaa ŋmɛnizi hiŋaa wia

ref: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
text: Iiŋ ɔɔ chaali dɔŋa la, bɛɛ ii ɔɔ ra ɛɛ denei? Kɔraawiizi yittɛ bɛl ɔɔ yir, bɛl ge ba baglaa bɛl ni, bɛl ge ba wiŋɔzi ni un nuuwɛ Kɔraawiizi be, bɛl ge kpa mɔɔduma di ba wiŋɔzi ni, bɛl ge bagli a wiŋɔzi zɛɛ. Ií gil ii wiimaa ɛɛi la wer ra hiini dɔŋa ii wer zum Kɔraawiizi wia nɛnnɛ.

ref: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
text: Banla n niŋ mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi la, ií gil ba ɛɛ nɛra banɛɛ gɛɛ bahoro bɛŋ di gil ba ra ŋɔ ka ra tɛɛ dɔŋa, di ɔɔ gil bɛl bagli a zɛɛzi.

ref: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
text: Di unla maa sogo Kɔraawiizi wa bagluu wii bɛl, ií gil unla n na ŋɔ wia la siigi ka tɛu bɔr.

ref: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
text: Ií maa ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wia ka ra tɛɛ dɔŋa nɛ́ra maa wer na hiinaa ani bɔkpega a biini.

ref: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
text: Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii waa banla n na ŋɔ u wiŋɔzi la ra fir. Ba daŋ wer ra lau bahinaa.

ref: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
text: Kɔraawiizi waa basabasa ra ɛɛ. U du bɔɔiihrɛ.

ref: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
text: Di haana ra nyiŋŋi ba pɛɛzi wia, bá ɔɔ la diini mɔɔ ka pɛɛzi ba janna. A waa wer haana n na ŋɔ wia de.

ref: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
text: Ii benii Kɔraawiizi wia faaria? Ii bɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi bagli u wiaa?

ref: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
text: Di bɛl maa ra ŋɔ lugɔ u wettoo ra ŋɔ wia Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini gɛɛ u dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii labuu, ú zum lugɔ wia naa min sɛbɛɛ tɛɛ ia naa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi widauliirɛ.

ref: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
text: Ka nɛr la maa n waa nyiŋŋi u zum wia, ií giluu.

ref: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
text: Yaabalaa, ií aah siwii ra nyiŋŋi fɔŋŋa Kɔraawiizi be, ií wer ra ŋɔ u wia. Ka ii gilɛɛ ra teŋ banla n na mɔɔ mɔɔdumazi la ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: But do everything properly and in order.
text: Ií ra ɛɛ wiimaa gunla n dɛkkɛ di gilɛɛ ra ɛɛa basabasa.

ref: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
text: Too. Yaabalaa, ií gil n kaa liizi ia amaniyesuma la miŋ faa lizɛɛ tɛɛ ia ii sɛɛ di haa ra hiŋ, a lɛɛ ia la.

ref: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
text: Di ii sɛɛ amaniyesuma la di yardaa wibii maa, di ra hiŋaa nɛnnɛ lugɔ ii wàá vɛɛ a hiŋaa maa, ka lawaa nɛnnɛ gunla miŋ faa bagli ia la, amɔ, aabuu lɛɛ ia la.

ref: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
text: N faa bagli iabuu wia la Kɔraawiizi n bagli n ge la. Wii la n tɔ see labuu keŋ. Yeesu Kristo siuwɔɔ dikuu yaa wichɔgaa wia gunla Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ n faa bagli u wia la.

ref: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
text: Ba huguubuu, ka Kɔraawiizi lalluu siu biini hɔpizaa ahoro hɔl gunla Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ n faa baglɛɛ la.

ref: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.
text: Pittaa felee nau. U hiŋra fidibanɛɛ la ge nau jaa.

ref: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
text: Denii u harbɔɔ hiŋra kpila maa n chaalɛɛ, ba maa nau. Ba faa du nɛra kalfaanue ka ra sag. Ba galga maa haa du de filaŋkeŋ ka baŋhina ge siuzi.

ref: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
text: A saŋa Jems gba faa naubuu. Denii u huŋhunna la maa ge kaa nau.

ref: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
text: Ka n ge jaa wa ɛɛ tuna hiŋ di nau. Maa nɛnanii ɛɛwɛ lugɔ bannii ka ɛɛ lugɔ bie la maa hia n waa helle ka u luluu la.

ref: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
text: N ɛɛ u huŋhunna la maa tuna hinnɛ. Maa dɛg ban niŋ yiriŋ u huŋhunni gba dikuu gunla miŋ faa tɔɔri Yeesu hiŋra la wia.

ref: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi nɛsunaa ni u hiinaa du n be. Uŋ hiiniŋ wiarɛ n wer du kennaa min duwɛɛ naa la. Ka u nɛsunaa la uŋ suŋ n ni la, waa tawɛɛ. Akai. N izoore ra hum u huma werge di bir kaali ba maa gba. Ka n himmaa fɔŋŋa biini lɛi n na humaa. Kɔraawiizii ra hiiniŋ n wer ra humaa gunla.

ref: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
text: Awia, di yaabuu gɛɛ baabuu faa bagli ia, kenne yaa maa faa bagli ia ii sɛɛ la. Lalaa siu biini izaa wia

ref: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
text: Too. Di yaa faa bagli Yeesu Kristo wia lugɔ Kɔraawiizi lalluubuu siu biini, bɛɛ wiarɛ ii baŋhina ra ŋɔ dí nɛra wàá izi siu biinei?

ref: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
text: Di nɛra wàá izi siu biini, amɔ, guŋwaa, Kristo waa siu biini izee.

ref: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
text: Di Kɔraawiizi waa Kristo lallɛɛ siu biini, amɔ, yaa baglaa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ, ii ge sɛɛi ɛɛ pɛɛ.

ref: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
text: Di gunnɛ, yaa ra dar iabuu, yaa n na di Kɔraawiizi daansɛɛ la, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa ɔɔ ra bagli iabuu lugɔ u lalli Kristoo siu biini. Ka di nɛra wàá izi siu biini, amɔ, karaa yaa kanni. Wɔɔ lallɛɛ.

ref: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
text: Di nɛra wàá izi siu biini, amɔ, Kɔraawiizi wɔɔ lallɛɛ siu biini.

ref: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
text: Di Kɔraawiizi wɔɔ lallɛɛ siu biini, ii sɛɛ u wiarɛ pɛɛ. Ii wichɔgaa haa du ii ninɛɛ.

ref: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
text: Banla ge n sɛɛ Kristo wia ka siuzi la tawɔɔrɛ.

ref: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
text: Di yaa miibɔɔ naa bɛŋ biinii yaa dɔɔ Kristo tamii, amɔ, yaa wia dɔɔ sinyɛnaa werge kaali nɛr maa wia.

ref: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
text: Ka guŋ lɛi. Kristo izi siu biinii. Waabuu felee izi lii banla n siuwɛ la biini ka bá ge haa izi.

ref: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
text: Nɛkpannɛ ba siu ni. Nɛkpaŋ genii kaa ba siu biini izaa ni.

ref: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
text: Yaa ni Andama la n ɛɛ kpaŋ wiarɛ yaa ra siuzi la. Gunnɛ yáa banla maa ge ni Kristo n ɛɛ kpaŋ la na miibɔɔ di izi siu biini.

ref: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
text: Ka yaa danna izuu ka ra tɛɛ dɔŋa. Kristoo izee mɔɔ, ka bánla n ɛɛ u hora la ge wa izi a hɔl la un niŋ kaa ba la.

ref: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
text: Denii durnya tunaa saŋa wa hel, Kristo jaa kpegli kossi ni nabɔnzi ni fɔŋŋadɔɔra maa di gil a maa sɛɛ u mɛɛ dɔɔra.

ref: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
text: Kristoo niŋ dɔɔ durnya fɔŋŋa mɔɔ guŋŋ u wa kpegli u dɔma la maa.

ref: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
text: U dɔma tuna hinnɛ siu.

ref: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
text: Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ u ra di kora u kuŋkuaraa maa ni. Ka uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ u dɔɔ kummaa fɔŋŋaa naa, waa ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ u dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi la n kpa kummaa kora maa tɛu la gba fɔŋŋaa.

ref: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
text: Di Kɔraawiizi Biibaal la wa lɛɛ kummaa fɔŋŋa tuŋ la, denii ú sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n kpa kummaa fɔŋŋa tɛu la ge dɔɔra, Kɔraawiizi bɛmbɛŋ jaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa maa.

ref: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
text: Nɛra baŋhina ɔɔ lɛɛ lalaa bɔttɛ di gil ba sɔ baa Kɔraawiizi nii. Bɛɛ wiarɛ ba ra ɛɛ gunnɛi? Di lalaa wàá izi siu biini, bɛɛ wiarɛ bá ɛɛ guŋ tɛɛ baai?

ref: And why do we always risk our lives
text: Bɛɛ wiarɛ yaa ge ɔɔ ra zuu siu biini saŋa maanɛi?

ref: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
text: Di karaa n na kanni, di maa ɔɔ zuu siu biini guŋ, amɔ, min lɛi ɔɔ ra jigsi dikuu gunla iinna hiŋ yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo wia la. Wibii maa, n himmaa ɔɔ zuu siu biinii hɔpizibii maa.

ref: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
text: Ka ii gilɛɛ ra dar iihinaa. “Ii ni nɛchɔgaa kpawaa daŋ chɔgi ii dunanaa.”

ref: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
text: Awia, ií izi di kazi ii bɔra di ra ɛɛ winanaa ka gil wichɔgaa ɛɛi. Ii baŋhina haa waa Kɔraawiizi wia zummɛ nɛnnɛ. A guŋ waa ia ɛɛwɛ hiihzia? Siu biini izaa bɔrahɔŋ wia

ref: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
text: Ka ii bɛl daŋ pɛɛzi, “Ɛrɛɛ lálaa wer izi siu biinei? Ɛrɛɛ duulaa bá bɔra duɛi?”

ref: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
text: Ii gɛnnɔɔ werge. Kumbii la maa iiŋ ɔɔ kpa duu ɔɔ liiu ka pɔɔh.

ref: Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up.
text: Kunla maa iiŋ ɔɔ kpa duu, di miarɛ gɛɛ di kundee bɛllɛ, a himmaa lɛi ɔɔ lii. Aa birgi paŋhoorii di lii.

ref: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
text: Kɔraawiizii ra birgaa gunla am paruu la di gil a maa ra du a duula.

ref: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
text: Bɔrahɔna maa waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛ. A maa ni a dizii. Newea hora du de di kur sela hora ni. Nyinni ge hora kur zumbizi hora ni.

ref: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
text: Chiŋ kuna du de, hɛri ge kuna du de, ka a wessi kurgi dɔŋa ni.

ref: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
text: Wiizi wessi kuttɔɔ baagu wessi ni. Chinchiŋwilaa ge chaani kaali dɔŋa.

ref: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
text: Gunnɛ nɛra siu biini izaa gba du. Bɔrahɔnnaa yaa n dɔɔwɛ naa, di yaa wa siuzɔɔ, waabuu daŋ chɔgi. Ka bɔrahɔŋ la yaa n niŋ wa izi siu biini di dɔɔ la, waabuu wàá chɔgi maa.

ref: These ugly and weak bodies will become beautiful and strong.
text: Kumpɛɛrɛ ba ɔɔ hug, ka Kɔraawiizi lalluu u ɛɛ kunnanii. Kuŋgɛrgii ba ɔɔ hug, ka Kɔraawiizi lalluu u ɛɛ kuŋkpeg.

ref: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
text: Kunla baŋ hukke la, bɔrahɔŋ himmaanii. Ka kunla Kɔraawiizi n niŋ lalli la, waabuu duma kuŋ. Bɔrahɔŋ himmaa du denii. Bɔrahɔŋ la ge n ɛɛ duma kuŋ la, u ge du de.

ref: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
text: Ba sɛbɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini di ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi faa ta lugli nɛr la banna yir Andama labuu u dɔɔ miibɔɔ.” Ka harbɔɔ Andama la ɛɛ duma kunnɛ di ra tɛɛ nɛra miibɔɔni. Waabuu Kristo.

ref: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
text: Ií zum lugɔ bɔrahɔŋ la n ɛɛ duma kuŋ la lɛi yaa feli dɔɔ. Bɔrahɔŋ himmaanii yaa feli dɔɔ mɔɔ ka haa waa dɔɔ duma ge hor.

ref: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
text: Hɛrii lugli newee la lii di ɛɛ hɛri nɛr. Ka Kɔraawiizi benii nɛɛhiŋ la ge lii.

ref: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
text: Gunla unla n lii Kɔraawiizi be la ge n duwɛɛ la, gunnɛ u ge nɛra maa du.

ref: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
text: Yaabalaa, ií gil n ŋɔ ii be, “Bɔrahɔnnaa dee wàá wer la Kɔraawiizi be. Kunla n dɔɔ pɔɔih wàá wer du bɔr la kuna la n waa pɔɔih dɔɔwɛ n duwɛɛ la.”

ref: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
text: Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. N daŋ pilli wisuahlii bɛl bagli ia. Yaa maa lɛi niŋ siuzi. Haali di yaa siuzɔɔ gɛɛ yaa waa siuzɛɛ, ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ birgi yaa maa bɔrahɔna kakpaŋ

ref: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
text: alugɔ siwee kamzaa saŋa la Kɔraawiizi bensuno n niŋ keezi wa wii la. Di u bensuno hiŋ wa wiiwo, Kɔraawiizi daŋ lalli lalaa bá dɔɔ bɔrahɔna la n waa pɔɔih dɔɔwɛ la di birgi yaa nyinee ge bɔrahɔna,

ref: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
text: Awia, di unla n dɔɔ pɔɔih wa liwɔɔ ka unla n waa pɔɔih dɔɔwɛ zuu, di unla ge n dɔɔ siwaa wa liwɔɔ, ka unla n waa siwaa dɔɔwɛ ge zuu, gunla baŋ sɛbɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini la daŋ wa ɛɛ, dí, “U kpa fɔŋŋaa kpegli siu.”

ref: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
text: “Siu, lee i fɔŋŋa kaa duɛi? Ɛrɛɛ í kaa ɛɛ tɔɔri yaai?”

ref: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
text: Wichɔgaarɛ ɔɔ gil siu wer ra tɔɔri yaa. Gbɔg la ge ɔɔ gil wichɔgaa na fɔŋŋa yaa ni.

ref: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ jaannɛ werge un tɛɛ yaa fɔŋŋa di lii yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo be ya kpegli siu.

ref: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
text: Awia, yaabalaa la min nɔŋŋɛɛ werge, ií chi chigigi di ra hiŋ, di gilɛɛ wa gil kummaa waa bir ia har. Ií zum lugɔ wii la maa iin niŋ ɛɛ tɛu la wàá ta pɛɛ. Ií ɔɔ haa vɛɛ ra hum yaa Dɔɔri huma werge maa.

ref: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
text: Too. A ka kebee la yaa n na kɛɛ ya tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la. Ií ra ɛɛ gunla miŋ faa ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra la n du Galesia hɛri lugɔ bá ra ɛɛ la.

ref: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
text: Alaadi maa ií bɛl maa ɔɔ lizi gunla maa iin niŋ wer, di lii kuna la Kɔraawiizi n hiini ia ii dɔɔ la biini dau. Ií ra ɛɛ guŋ, di n wa ballɔ, ii wàá ka kɛɛ.

ref: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
text: Di n wa ballɔ, n daŋ sɛbi hɔna di kpa tɛɛ nɛra la iiŋ yardɛɛ, di hum baa bá kpa ii sunzaa la di la Jɛrusalɛm.

ref: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
text: Di a wa dɛkkɔ lugɔ ń du baa la, n daŋ la. Pɔɔl jinazi wia

ref: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
text: N ŋɔ ń la Masɛdɔnia hɛrii, ka di n wa lii de ba, n daŋ ba ii be

ref: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
text: di wa du ii be di birgi tama. Aŋhinabe, n daŋ du ii be, waari saŋa wa tuŋ, ka ií jaa taŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ ń la bɔr la maa min niŋ la.

ref: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
text: Di n ŋɔ ń ba wa na ia filaŋkeŋ, màá wer birgi ii be. Ka di n wa wetto ba saŋa bɛl, di Kɔraawiizi sɛɛwɔ, n daŋ birgi ii be.

ref: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
text: Ka n daŋ haa du Ɛfɛsus mɔɔ ka Pɛntikɔs Hɔpizizeŋ la wa hel,

ref: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, n na bɔttɛ ɛŋ ń wer hum Kɔraawiizi huma werge á lii tɔna di tɛu. Ka banla n na nyiŋŋi bá tɔ n huma ŋmɛnɛɛ la su denii werge.

ref: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
text: Di Timoti wa ba ii be, ií sɛɛ u wia nɛnnɛ ú gilɛɛ waa ɔm, dikuubɛɛwiai, u gba ra hum Kɔraawiizi humaa lugɔ miŋ ge n na humaa kennaa.

ref: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
text: Awia, ii gilɛɛ waa binnuu pɛɛ, ka ií wa hiinuu ú wer kpa u ŋmɛnɛɛ ani bampirsɔna di bir ba n be. N na binni u ni yaabalaa ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ.

ref: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
text: Ka yaa dɔŋhiŋ Apɔlɔs waa, n fɔrguubuu ú du yaabalaa la di ba ii be, ka de laŋaa wɔɔ pattɛ filaŋkeŋ. Di u wa na ŋmɛnɛɛ, u daŋ la.

ref: Show love in everything you do.
text: Ií ra ɛɛ wiimaa ni nɛnɔŋŋaa.

ref: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
text: Yaabalaa, ii zummɔ lugɔ Stɛfanas ni u diahinaa felee sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wia Akaaya di ɔɔ aah siwii di hum ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinanaa.

ref: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
text: Awia, n na suŋŋi ia, ií ra sɛɛ ba ni banla maa n na hiini baa di ra hum la dɔɔra.

ref: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
text: Stɛfanas ni Fɔtunatus ni Akayikus balaa sɔɔni n bɔraa werge, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii himmaa waa wette ba ń na ia, ka ba lɛɛ ii balaa ba,

ref: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
text: di wa duŋ bɔkpega werge, di du ii ge gba bɔkpega. Ií ra tɔgzi nɛra naa dɔŋa.

ref: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
text: Yeesu hiŋra la n du Eesia hɛri la ra jaami ia werge. Akuila ni Pirsila ani Yeesu hiŋra la n ɔɔ chaali ba dia la gba ra jaami ia werge ani yaa Dɔɔri sɔŋ.

ref: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
text: Yaabalaa maa ra jaami ia. Ií jaami dɔŋa nɛnnɛ.

ref: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
text: Mìŋ́ Pɔɔl ge sɛbaarɛ keŋ n himmaa n sɛbɛɛ di ra jaami ia.

ref: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
text: Nɛr la n waa yaa Dɔɔri nɔŋŋɛɛ, Kɔraawiizi seeubuu nua. Yaa Dɔɔri ra bau.

ref: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo, u nɛsunaa ani u hiinaa du ii be.

ref: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
text: Ii banla maa ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ la, n na jaami ia ni nɔŋŋaa. Ami.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
text: Mìŋ́ Yeesu Kristo huŋhunni Pɔɔllɛ ra sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛɛ ia. A par Kɔraawiizii u tɛŋ a huma. N ni yaa dɔŋhiŋ Timotii ra jaami ii banla n ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra du Kɔrint ani Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la maa n du Akaaya la.

ref: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
text: Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Pɔɔl n tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ wia

ref: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
text: Ií ra tɛɛ yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la sɔŋ. U ɛɛ mɛɛ la n na na nɛra sinyɛnaa werge maa di kaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n na tig nɛra bampiree werge.

ref: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
text: Waabuu ra tig yaa bampiree. Saŋa maa, di tɔɔrɔɔ haŋ wa huuzi yaa, ɔɔ ra tig yaa bampiree ka yáa ge wer tig yaa dɔŋahina la n na di tɔɔrɔɔ maa bampiree, gunla un tig yaa ge bampiree la.

ref: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
text: Yaa n na di tɔɔrɔɔ werge lugɔ Kristo n faa diwee la, gunnɛ yaa kaa ra na bampirsɔna werge dikuu u wia.

ref: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
text: Di yaa ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, ii hiinaa wiarɛ yaa ra dia, yá wer tig ii bampiree di lɛɛ ia. Di Kɔraawiizi kaa wa tig yaa bampiree la, ii hiinaa wiarɛ u kaa tig yaa bampiree, ka ya wer hiini ia ií wer dɔɔ kanyitti saŋa la iin niŋ waa di yaa tɔɔrɔɔ la dɔŋ.

ref: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
text: Yaa dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi tamiirɛ werge maa dikuu ii wia, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa zummɔ lugɔ di yaa ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, yaa ni ii maanii niŋ na bampirsɔna la.

ref: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
text: Yaabalaa, yaa ra nyiŋŋuu ii zum tɔɔrɔɔ la yaa n faa diwee Eesia hɛri la wia. A tɔɔrɔɔ faa siili yaa ninɛɛ werge maa, di lɔ yaa dau. Yaa faa waa tamii ɛɛwɛ lugɔ yaa daŋ lii u biini ani miibɔɔ.

ref: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
text: Yaa faa zumɔɔ lugɔ yaa daŋ faa siu de gba. Ka guŋ ɛɛwɔɔ ya gilɛɛ dɔɔ yaa hinaa tamii, ka dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi la n wette lalli nɛra siu biini la tamii.

ref: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
text: U faa lɛɛ yaabuu siuchɔgii biini, di haa ra lɛɛ yaa. Yaa dɔɔ u tamiirɛ lugɔ u daŋ haa lɛɛ yaa gba.

ref: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
text: A dɛkkɔ ii gba n niŋ hiini yaa di ra suŋŋi wiizi, di Kɔraawiizi wa nuuwɔ, nɛ́kpila wer tɛu jaam dikuu ba suŋŋaa la ba maa n suŋŋɛɛ tɛɛ yaa u nuu di hiini yaa la wia. Pɔɔl n bir u jinazi wia

ref: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
text: Wii la yaa n niŋ kpa chɔli yaa hinaarɛ keŋ. Yaa zummɔ yaa biine lugɔ yaa wiɛɛlaa maa wessoo wa tuŋ. Yaa ɛɛabuu biinihuŋŋu la Kɔraawiizi n tɛɛ yaa la ni. Newea nunzuma lɛi yaa kpa ɛɛa. Kɔraawiizi hiinaa biinii yaa ɛɛ a wia maa durnya maa ani ii be.

ref: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
text: Yaa n sɛbi hɔna ra tɛɛ ia naa, wiimaa waa hoo a biini iiŋ waa wette ii karmi zum a zɛɛ maa nɛnnɛ di wa tuŋ.

ref: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
text: Ii faa zum yaabuu tama. N kaa ra nyiŋŋuu lugɔ ii wer zum yaa nɛnnɛ, di zum lugɔ yaa danna jigsi dikuu ii wia, ii ge ra jigsi dikuu yaa wia, yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo Hɔpizii la hɔl.

ref: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
text: Miŋ faa dɔɔ ii tamii gunla wiarɛ saŋa la miŋ faa ra la Masɛdɔnia hɛri la n faa ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ n feli ba ii be mɔɔ ií wer na hiinaa bunɛɛ la.

ref: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
text: N faa ra nyiŋŋuu lugɔ n ga ii be ra la. Denii di n kaa waa nyiŋŋi lugɔ ń bir ba, ń kaa ga ii be di wer du ii be ka ií kaa taŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ ń la Juda hɛri.

ref: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
text: Too. Miŋ faa ra fɛ u guŋ nfɛrɛ la, maa guŋ kpawɛɛ fugzi. Newea daŋ wer ŋɔ nua ka vɛɛ guŋ, ka miŋwaa waa guŋ duwɛɛ.

ref: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
text: Kɔraawiizi la wia n dɔɔ wibii la di yaa daansɛɛrɛ lugɔ yaa wiŋɔzi waa guŋ ɛɛwɛ. Yaa waa ɔɔ ra sɛɛ wia ani nua ka ra vɛɛa.

ref: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
text: Kɔraawiizi Biibaal Yeesu Kristo la n ni Timoti ni Silvanus n bagli u wia tɛɛ ia la dɔɔ wibiire. Waa dɔɔwɛ lugɔ ŋmɛnɛbɛl ú ŋɔ “ɛɛh,” ŋmɛnɛbɛl ú kaa ŋɔ, “Akai.” Di waabuu haŋ ŋɔ wii, u ŋɔwɔɔrɛ.

ref: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
text: Nuuzi la maa Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ yaa la, Yeesu Kristo ninɛɛ yaa chi zum lugɔ a ɛɛ wibiire. U wiarɛ ya wer ŋɔ, “Ami!” Kɔraawiizi wer na sɔŋ.

ref: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
text: Kɔraawiizii gillɛ yaa ni ii maa wer lau Yeesu Kristo nɛnnɛ di ra hiŋ di kpa u Dumnanii du yaa ni,

ref: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
text: u ra bagli lugɔ yaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi horaa, di kaa ra bagli lugɔ u daŋ ŋmɛnɛ lɛɛ yaa di wa tuŋ.

ref: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
text: N na yir Kɔraawiizi la n zum n biini maa la sɔnnɛ ú ɛɛ n daansɛɛ hiŋ ani wiŋɔzi naa biini. Miŋ faa waa Kɔrint ballɛ la, ii tɔɔraarɛ n faa waa nyiŋŋi wiarɛ maa ballɛ.

ref: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
text: A waa lugɔ yaa ra nyiŋŋuu ya bagli fɔŋŋa ii ni ii hiŋaa naa biini. Guŋ lɛi. Ii himmaa lauwɔɔ di ra hiŋ nɛnnɛ. Ka yaa ra nyiŋŋi ya wer hiini ia ií wer dɔɔ bɔsɔna.

ref: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
text: Miŋ faa ra nyiŋŋi ii be balaa la, n bir ŋɔ a waa wer min niŋ ba ii be ani biinichɔg di wa chɔg ii biine.

ref: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
text: Di n wa chɔg ii biine, anɛɛwaarɛ du de ban niŋ gil mimbuu bɔra sɔɔni, di ii banla min chɔg ii biine la lɛiyɛi?

ref: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
text: Gunnɛ n faa sɛbi hɔŋ la biini di ŋɔ lugɔ n faa waa nyiŋŋi n ba wa chɔg ii banla n niŋ faa sɔɔni n bɔra la biine. N dɔɔ ii maa tamiirɛ lugɔ n bɔsɔna ɛɛ ii maa bɔsɔnaa.

ref: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
text: Awia, hɔŋ la miŋ faa sɛbɛɛ tɛɛ ia la wia tɔɔrimbuu werge, di tiriŋ werge maa, n na wii gba ka faa ra sɛbuu. N faa waa a hɔŋ sɛbɛɛ ií biine chɔgi. Ka n sɛbuubuu ií faa wer zum gunla min nɔŋŋi ia werge la. Giltɛɛi tɛɛ wichɔgɛɛri wia

ref: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
text: Nɛr la n ba biinichɔg la ni la, n bɛŋ biini lɛi u chɔgi. Ii maa biinee u chɔgi. Maa nyiŋŋi n tɔɔruu werge. Ka a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ u chɔgi ii maa biine waarɛ.

ref: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
text: Ka gunla iiŋ ɛɛ nuukpaŋ di tɛr u digni dikuu u wichɔgaa wia la mɛgzɔɔrɛ.

ref: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
text: A wesso iin niŋ gil tɛu filaŋkeŋ di duu bɔkpega, u biínichɔg la gilɛɛ waa du kaŋ werge, di siili u ni.

ref: You should make them sure of your love for them.
text: N na fɔrgi iabuu, ií kaa nɔŋŋuu gunla iiŋ faa nɔŋŋuu la.

ref: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
text: N faa sɛbi a hɔnnɛ tɛɛ ia, ń wer ɛɛ ia na, di ii daŋ sɛɛ tɛŋ ani wiimaa bɔr, gɛɛ ii wàá sɛɛ tɛnnɛi?

ref: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
text: Too. Nɛr la maa iin niŋ gil wia tɛɛ, n gba daŋ gil tɛɛ a hiŋ. Kristo ɛɛ n daansɛɛ hinnɛ. Di a hiŋ ɛɛŋ wii bɛl lugɔ min niŋ gil tɛu, n daŋ gil tɛu dikuu ii wia,

ref: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
text: Sitaani gilɛɛ wa na u ŋmɛnɛɛ di wer chɔgi yaa wia. Yaa zum u nɛdaraa wiarɛ. Pɔɔl biinichɔg wia Troas biini wia

ref: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
text: Miŋ faa la Troas ń ga lizi Kristo amaniyesuma la, n na ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ de lugɔ ń hum n Dɔɔri,

ref: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
text: ka n bampirii faa waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛ, dikuu miŋ faa waa n dɔŋhiŋ Taitus la nawɛɛ de wia. Awia, n gil baabuu ka la Masɛdɔnia hɛri.

ref: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
text: Ama, Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ jaannɛ. U ɔɔ kpegli u dɔmaa, di kpa yaa ra vol u bɔsɔna volaa la biini, dikuu yaa ni Kristo n kpauwɛ wia, di ɔɔ gil yaa zumuu, u zumaa du yaa ni alugɔ daahɛgsɔɔhsuma aŋhina, nɛ́ra wer nuu a sɔɔh bɔr maa.

ref: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
text: Nɛkpila ɔɔ kpa Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii lugɔ kumbɛl di yoo ra di. Yaa ni baa waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛ. Yaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi huŋhunnaa. U benii yaa na a wiŋɔzi. U benii yaa ra ŋɔa ani biinihuŋŋu, Yeesu Kristo fɔŋŋa biini.

ref: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
text: Ii himmaanii ɛɛ yaa hɔna, di ra bagli hunnanaa la yaa n hummɛ. Yaa bampireere ba sɛbi ia du, nɛ́r maa wer naa ra karmi.

ref: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
text: Ii ɛɛ Kristo hɔnaa uŋ gillɛ yaa hiinuu sɛbi. Iŋki lɛi ba kpa sɛbaa. Kɔraawiizi Dumaa ba kpa sɛbaa. Bii ni lɛi ba sɛbaa. Ii bampiree biinee ba sɛbaa.

ref: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
text: Yaa dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi tamiirɛ guŋ, dikuu Kristo wia.

ref: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
text: A waa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ yaa wiimaa du denii yaa n niŋ tami u ni. Di yaa dɔɔ wiimaa yaa n niŋ ɛɛ u tamii, amɔ, Kɔraawiizi benii u lii.

ref: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
text: Waabuu gillɛ yaa wer u nuukpaŋfalii dɔɔi huma humaa. U nuukpaŋfalii naa waa Gbɔg la baŋ sɛbɛɛ dau wia ɛɛwɛ. U Dumnanii wiarɛ. Gbɔg la baŋ sɛbɛɛ dau la ra kpuu. U Dumnanii la ge ra tɛɛ nɛra miibɔɔ.

ref: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
text: Moosis Gbɔg la, Kɔraawiizi faa sɛɛh a nambazii a chɔɔ bii ni. Uŋ faa kpaa tɛɛ Moosis la, u gillɔɔ u na u girme. U girme n chaani Moosis siwee ni la, u siwee ge bir ra nyɛgzi werge maa. A faa waa nyɛgzɛɛ werge guŋ di ra la, ka a faa ra tunuu. Anna tuŋ la, ka Izrɛl hina faa waa wette ba binni u siwee dikuu unna nyɛgzi la wia. Too. Di wia la n faa ra kpu labuu dɔɔ girme guŋ,

ref: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
text: amɔ, Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii wia wàá dɔɔ girme werge kaali guŋ?

ref: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
text: Di wia la n faa ra tɛɛ nɛra chɔgri, faa dɔɔ girme werge guŋ, anla n ɛɛ wideŋlaa wia wàá dɔɔ girme werge maa kaali guŋŋ?

ref: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
text: Wia la n faa dɔɔ girme werge la, ka filaŋkeŋ a waa kaa dɔɔ girme, dikuubɛɛwiai, a falaa girme la kaalaabuu werge.

ref: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
text: A binaa la n na tuŋ la, a faa ballɔɔ ani girme. Ka a falaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la, dɔɔ girmee kaalaa.

ref: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
text: Yaa n dɔɔ a falaa la tamii naa, yaa dɔɔ bampiriire werge.

ref: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
text: Moosis la siwee n faa ra nyɛgzi werge ka ra dim tama tama la, u faa kpa saata bɛllɛ tɔ u siwee hiŋ ni, Ízrɛl hina gilɛɛ na guŋ.

ref: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
text: Izrɛl hina siwee faa tɔwɔɔrɛ. Filaŋkennaa gba, a haa tɔwɔɔrɛ. Banna karmi nuukpambinii wia la, ka a haa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ saata la haa tɔ ba siweere, dikuubɛɛwiai, di ba waa Kristo wia sɛɛwɛ, wàá wer lii ba siwee.

ref: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
text: Banna karmi Moosis hɔna la, saata la tɔ ba nfɛssii haali zinaa.

ref: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
text: Ka unla maa n niŋ binni u Dɔɔri, u Dɔɔri hiŋ daŋ lizi saata la u siwee.

ref: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
text: Kɔraawiizi Dumaa ɛɛ u Dɔɔri la. Di Kɔraawiizi Duma du de, kummaa wàá wer tɔ bɔr.

ref: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
text: Kɔraawiizi suŋ yaa ninɛɛ di tɛɛ yaa huma naa. Awia, a waa yaa bɔra ra huah.

ref: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
text: Yaa vɛɛ wia la baŋ ɔɔ suah ra ɛɛ, a dɔɔ hiihzi labuu. Yaa waa nɛra ra fugzi. Yaa waa Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii ra bir di ra kanni u nua. Yaa ra ŋɔ wibiire a chaani nɛnnɛ, nɛ́r maa wer zum u biini lugɔ yaa wiŋɔzi dɔɔ wibiire, Kɔraawiizi siibɔɔ.

ref: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
text: Di amaniyesuma la yaa n na lizi la suahwɔɔ baŋhina be, banla n leuwe ra siuzi benii a suah la.

ref: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
text: Sitaani la n dɔɔ durnya naa, ba ra tɔgzuu lugɔ Kɔraawiizi la tɔ ba nfɛssii. Waa nyiŋŋi amaniyesuma la n lii Kristo la n dɔɔ girme werge du alugɔ Kɔraawiizi n duwɛɛ la be wia wer chaani ba ni, bá zumuu.

ref: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
text: Yaa himmaa biine wia lɛi yaa ɔɔ ra ŋɔ. Yeesu Kristo wiarɛ yaa ra ŋɔ. U ɛɛ yaa maa Dɔɔrii, yaa ge ɛɛ ii balaa dikuu u wia.

ref: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
text: Kɔraawiizi la n faa ŋɔ bɔ́r chaani, bɔbiri la maa chaani la, waabuu chaani yaa ge biine, di chaani yaa siwee yaa wer zum u girmezeŋ la yaa n nawɛɛ Kristo ni la.

ref: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
text: Yaa ɔɔ ra di tɔɔrɔɔ kpila maanii, ka a waa ɔɔ wer gɛrgi yaa wa tuŋ. Wia ɔɔ ra tir yaa, ka a waa ɔɔ wer ra chɔg yaa biine ga tuŋ.

ref: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
text: Nɛra ɔɔ ra ɛɛ yaa wichɔgaa, ka Kɔraawiiziwaa waa yaa gillɛ ta. Ba lɔɔzi yaa dau. Ka ba waa wette bá kpu yaa.

ref: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
text: Yaa n haa dɔɔ miibɔɔ naa, siu biinii yaa ɔɔ haa du dikuu Yeesu wia la, ka nɛ́ra wer na u miibɔɔ yaa bɔrahɔnsiwaa la biini.

ref: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
text: A ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ yaawaa ra siwuu, ka iawaa ra na miibɔɔ yaa siu la biini.

ref: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
text: Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ, “N yardɔɔrɛ. Awiarɛ n ŋɔ a wia.” A guŋ yardaa yaa ge dɔɔ ra ŋɔ wia la.

ref: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
text: Yaa zummɔ lugɔ unla n lalli yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo siu biini la daŋ lalli yaa ge gba, yáa ni ia maa wer chi u be.

ref: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
text: Ii wiarɛ yaa ra ɛɛ a maa. Di nɛra ra sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nɛsunaa la, ba wa du kaŋ ra jaa, jaaŋ la Kɔraawiizi n niŋ wa na de la daŋ wa du kaŋ jaa, ú na girme nɛnnɛ.

ref: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
text: Awia, a huma waa yaa bɔra ra huah. Yaa bɔrahɔna ra gɛrguu, ka yaa biine ra du kpeg hɔpizibii maa.

ref: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
text: Tɔɔrɔɔ tama naa n dɔɔ tunaa yaa ra di naa, ka u daŋ gil ya ŋmɛnɛ na girme u du kaŋ, di siili tɔɔrɔɔ naa ni werge maa wa bɛri, di du de di ra la.

ref: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
text: Kuna la yaa siwee n na na lɛi yaa ra binni. Ka anla yaa siwee n waa na la, aabuu yaa ra binni. Kuna la yaa n na na la daŋ ŋmɛnɛ tuŋ. Ka anla yaa n waa na lawaa daŋ du de, di hanna la.

ref: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
text: Bɔrahɔna naa yaa n dɔɔwɛ naa ɛɛ yaa durnya biini diinii. Di ba chɔgaa tuŋ, ka yaa dɔɔ diinii Kɔraawiizi be um mawɛɛ. A daŋ ɔɔ du u be di ra la. Yaa Kɔraawiizi be bɔrahɔnaa a diini.

ref: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
text: Awia, yaa ɔɔ ra himuu dikuu yaa n ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi yaa Kɔraawiizi be bɔrahɔna la werge maa, ú kpa laali yaa wia.

ref: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
text: Di yaa wa naa, yaa wàá ka nyaa bɔrahɔna.

ref: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
text: Yaa n du bɔrahɔna naa biine naa, yaa ɔɔ ra himuu anna tɔɔri yaa. A waa lugɔ a lizaarɛ yaa ra nyiŋŋi werge. Ka anla laalaarɛ yaa ra nyiŋŋi werge. Denii anla n waa siu la, á lɛɛ anla n na siu la bɔr.

ref: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
text: Kɔraawiizii gillɛ yaa wer dɛg guŋ, di kpa u Dumnanii tɛɛ yaa, di ra bagli lugɔ u daŋ tɛɛ yaa u miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
text: Awia, yaa ɔɔ dɔɔ bampiriire, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa zummɔ lugɔ di yaa du yaa bɔrahɔna naa biine, yaa durnya biini diinii yaa du. Yaa waa hoo yaa Dɔɔri be,

ref: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, siwee lɛi yaa ɔɔ kpa zum yaa ŋmɛnɛɛ. Yardaa yaa ɔɔ kpa zumuu.

ref: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
text: Awia, yaa ɔɔ dɔɔ bampiriire di ra binni lugɔ di yaa gil bɔrahɔna naa n ɛɛ yaa diini naa, ka la ga du yaa Dɔɔri be, u gunnɛ bɔ.

ref: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
text: Awia, di yaa du bɔrahɔna naa biine gɛɛ di yaa du yaa Dɔɔri be, ka yaa ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋuu yáa wia maa wer paruu,

ref: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa maa daŋ wa chi Yeesu Kristo seriya diiribɔr, bɛ́l maa na u wiɛɛlaa kinturgaa. Di a faa wesso gɛɛ di a faa waa wer genii, ka u daŋ na a maa kinturgaa. Yaa ni Kɔraawiizi dammunaa dikuu Kristo wia

ref: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
text: Too. Yaa n zum kafɔŋ la n niŋ wa lau banla n niŋ chi yaa Dɔɔri be la wiarɛ yaa ra suŋŋi nɛra la. Ama, Kɔraawiizi teŋ tɛɛ yaabuu wibii. N na nyiŋŋi ii ge maa wer tɛɛ yaa wibii, ii biine.

ref: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
text: Yaa waa ŋɔ ya kaa chɔli yaa hinaa. Yaa ra nyiŋŋuu ya tɛɛ ia bɔr, ií wer chi de chɔli yaa banla n na chɔgi yaa la be. Ba ra binni wia la newea n na maŋkuri labuu, di nyiŋŋi sɔna ra tɛɛ bahinaa. Ba waa bampiree wia ra binni.

ref: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
text: Di ba ŋɔ yaa ra chugluu, Kɔraawiizi wiarɛ yaa ra chugli. Di ba ŋɔ yaa dɔɔ nfɛrɛ genii, ii hiinaa wiarɛ yaa dɔɔ nfɛrɛ la.

ref: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
text: Nɔŋŋaa la Kristo n nɔŋŋi yaa labuu ɔɔ gil yaa aah siwii. Gunla yaawaa n nawɛɛ, di nɛkpaŋ lɛɛ nɛr maa siu di siu, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ nɛr maa siuwɔɔ.

ref: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
text: U lɛɛ ba siurɛ siu, bá gilɛɛ kaa du ba himmaa dui, ka jaa du unla n siuwɛ, Kɔraawiizi lalluu tɛɛ baa la dui.

ref: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
text: Awia, filaŋkeŋ, yaa waa kaa ra binni nɛra gunla newea n na binni baa, di ra maŋkuri baa la. Yaa faa ra binni Kristo gbaa guŋ, ka yaa waa kaa ra binnuu guŋ.

ref: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
text: Nɛr la maa ni Kristo n kpauwɛ, u birgi nɛfaliirɛ. U wibinaa la tunnɔɔ, ka u wia maa birgi wifalaa.

ref: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
text: Kɔraawiizi benii wia naa maa lii. Waabuu kuari yaa wia, yaa nuu wer dɔɔ nuukpaŋ dikuu Kristo wia, di kaa tɛɛ yaa huma naa, ya nyiŋŋi nɛra ra tɛu bá nuu wia wer kuari, bá wer dɔɔ nuukpaŋ.

ref: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa ra kuari u ni durnya wiarɛ Kristo huma la biini. Waa baa ra pɛɛzi ba wichɔgaa wia. U kpa u wiŋɔzi labuu tɛɛ yaa, yá ra bagli gunla uŋ kuari ba maa wia la.

ref: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
text: Yaa ɛɛ Yeesu Kristo dɔgtɛɛzii durnya naa biini. Yaa n na suŋŋi ia naa, Kɔraawiizii ra suŋŋi ia la, ií gil ii nuu wia kuari.

ref: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
text: Yaa ni Kɔraawiizi n na hum huma naa, yaa gba ra suŋŋi iabuu, ii gilɛɛ gil Kɔraawiizi nɛsunaa la un suŋ ii ni la bir pɛɛ.

ref: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N nuuwɔɔ tɛɛ ia, saŋa la miŋ suŋ ii ni la, di hiini ia, ii na lɛɛi.” Too. Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. Zinaa ɛɛ u nɛsunaa hɔpiziirɛ, di kaa ɛɛ u nɛlɛɛi hɔpizii. Pɔɔl tɔɔrɔɔzi wia

ref: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
text: Yaa n na hum huma naa, yaa ɔɔ ra dazuu ya gilɛɛ waa ɛɛ wii la maa n niŋ bir ɛɛ wichɔgii, nɛ́ra gilɛɛ wer gbɛlli yaa huma.

ref: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
text: Yaa ra ɛɛ wiimaanii gunla an dɛkkɛ Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna n ninna ɛɛ. Wikpega ɔɔ huuzi yaabuu, ka yaa kpa kanyitti kpoglaa. Yaa zum tɔɔrɔɔ, witittii ani siaahmu wiarɛ,

ref: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
text: aabuu banna lɔɔzi yaa, banna tɔ yaa dia, banna du dɔm. Yaa hum humkpegaa kuuh. Saŋa bɛl, yaa wàá na dɔɔ chɔɔ, saŋa bɛl ge, yaa wàá na diwee di.

ref: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
text: Yaa ɔɔ ra dazi doŋa maa gilɛɛ waa pɛli yaa, di ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi nunzuma, di ɔɔ haa vɛɛ ra di kanyitti, di ɔɔ ra hiini nɛra, di dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii la yaa ni, di nɔŋŋi nɛra ani biinihuŋŋu,

ref: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
text: di ra ŋɔ wibii wia, di ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wia maa Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini, di ɔɔ kpa yaa nomɛɛla ni yaa nodige lau wideŋlaa, di ra yoo Sitaani.

ref: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
text: Nɛra baŋhina ra tɔgzi yaabuu, baŋhina ge ra gbɛlli yaa, baŋhina ra zɔɔzi yaa, baŋhina ge ra chɔli yaa. Ba ra yir yaa kara hina, ka yaa ɛɛ wibii hina,

ref: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
text: di ra yir yaa nɛdumazi, ka baŋhina ge zum yaa wia nɛnnɛ. Yaa ɔɔ du siu biinii, ka dɔɔ miibɔɔ. Ba ra tɔɔri yaabuu, ka ba waa yaa kpuwɛɛ.

ref: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
text: Biinichɔg ɔɔ du yaa be, ka yaa bɔra sɔɔni. Yaa ɛɛ nyaara, ka wer ra hiini nɛra werge maa. Yaa waa kummaa dɔɔwɛ, ka dɔɔ kummaa ge.

ref: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
text: Ee, Kɔrint hina, yaa biine maanii yaa pilli tɛɛ ia. Ii wia du yaa bampireere werge maa.

ref: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
text: Yaawaa biine waa luŋ. Ka iawaa biine du luŋ yaa be. Ii waa yaa wia kpawɛɛ du ii bampiree.

ref: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
text: N na ŋɔ wia naabuu alugɔ n ni n biizii. Yaa nɔŋŋi iabuu. Ií ge bir ii bampiree di nɔŋŋi yaa. Ií gilɛɛ ra hiŋ banla n waa yardɛɛ

ref: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
text: Ií gilɛɛ gil ii ni banla n waa Kɔraawiizi yardɛɛ kpau ɛɛ kpaŋ. Wideŋlaa ni wichɔgaa waa wiimaa dɔɔwɛ. Bɔchaaŋ ni bɔbiri daŋ wer kpauwaa?

ref: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
text: Kristo ni Sitaani daŋ wer ɛɛ kpaŋaa? Unla n sɛɛ Kristo wia ni banla n waa sɛɛwɛ wàá wer ɛɛ kpaŋ.

ref: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
text: Kɔraawiizi Dia ni vugkuari bɔr daŋ wer kpawuu naa? Yaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa la jaami bɔttɛ. Ba faa sɛbi u wiŋɔzi, dí, yaa Dɔɔri ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ wa du ba be, di ɔɔ ra vol ba biini. N daŋ ɛɛ ba Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, bá ge ɛɛ n nɛra.

ref: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
text: Awia, n ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, ‘Ií lii a nɛdumazi biini du ii bɛŋ, di gilɛɛ ra gbɔgzi kunla maa n doŋŋe. Denii ń wer lɛɛ ia du n be,

ref: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
text: n daŋ ɛɛ ii mɛɛ, ií ge ɛɛ n biizi.’ Gunnɛ yaa Dɔɔri la n ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ŋɔ. Mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hinnɛ ŋɔ guŋ.”

ref: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
text: Awia, n nɛnɔŋŋaa, Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ nua tɛɛ yaa kennaa, a dɛkkɔɔ yaa n ninna lizi doŋa maa yaa bɔrahɔna ni yaa biine maa ra ha, di ra ɛɛ ania ya wer dɔɔ winanaa wa tuŋ, di ɔɔ ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi wiimaa biini. Pɔɔl bɔsɔna wia

ref: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
text: Ií pilli ii bampiree tɛɛ yaa. Yaa waa ii bɛl maa ɛɛwɛ wichɔgaa. Yaa waa bɛl maa chɔkkɛ. Yaa waa kaa dar nɛr maa ge.

ref: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
text: Maa ia ra jugmi. N faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ ii du yaa bampireere. Di siurɛ gɛɛ miibɔɔrɛ, ka yaa ni iabuu.

ref: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
text: N dɔɔ ii tamiirɛ werge maa, di ra chɔli ia werge gba. Ii sɔɔni n bɔraa werge maa wa bɛri. Ba ra tɔɔri yaa, ka n bɔra sɔɔniŋ werge maa.

ref: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
text: Yaa n faa ba Masɛdɔnia hɛri la, yaa biine faa waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛ. Tɔɔrɔɔ faa huuzi yaabuu bɔr maa. Naari la nɛra n na naa yaa la du de. Wia kaa du yaa biine di ra tir yaa, yaa ra fɔŋ.

ref: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
text: Ama, Kɔraawiizi la n ɔɔ tig biinichɔg hiŋ bampirii la, u tig yaa bampireere Taitus balaa la biini.

ref: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
text: U balaa la bɛŋ wia lɛi tig yaa bampiree. U wa bagli yaabuu gunla uŋ wa na ia, u himmaa bampirii tig, guŋ kaa tig yaa ge bampiree. U bagli yaabuu lugɔ ii ra kɛlli n ninɛɛ werge, di ŋɔ lugɔ ii biine chɔkkɔɔ dikuu gunla miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la wia, di kaa ŋɔ lugɔ ii aah siwiire dikuu n wia. N bɔra kaa sɔɔniŋ jaa.

ref: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
text: Miŋ faa sɛbi hɔŋ tɛɛ ia, ii biine chɔgi la, a faa tirimbuu. Ka a waa kaa tiriŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii biinichɔg la faa waa birgee.

ref: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
text: N bɔra sɔɔnimbuu. Miŋ chɔg ii biine wia lɛi n bɔra sɔɔni. Ka ii biinichɔg la gillɔɔ ii bampiree bir. Biinichɔg la dee Kɔraawiizi n na nyiŋŋi labuu. N chɔgi ii biinee, ka ii gilɛɛ wa chol bɔna dikuu yaa n gillɛ wia.

ref: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
text: Biinichɔg la dee Kɔraawiizi n na nyiŋŋi la ɔɔ bir bampiriire, Kɔ́raawiizi wer lɛɛ a nɛra. A guŋ waa biinichɔg ɛɛwɛ. Ka durnya biinichɔgwaa ra kpu nɛttɛ.

ref: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
text: Ií na gunla biinichɔg la dee Kɔraawiizi n na nyiŋŋi la n gillɛ ii siwii aah, ii ra kazi bɔra ií wia wer lii nɛnnɛ, di huuhzi ii biine, ii baana fuuh wichɔgaa ni, ii ra ɔm, di bir ra kɛlli yaa ni werge, di kaa aah siwii werge maa, haali di turgi wichɔgaa la kim. Ii lii a biinii. Ii waa wichɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ a wii biini.

ref: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
text: Min sɛbi hɔŋ la, unla n ɛɛ wichɔgaa la wia lɛi n sɛbuu, unla uŋ ɛɛ wichɔgaa la gba wia lɛi. N sɛbuubuu ií wer zum nɛnnɛ Kɔraawiizi be gunla iin nɔŋŋi yaa.

ref: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
text: A wia du yaabuu bɔkpega. Yaa kaa dɔɔ bɔsɔna werge dikuu Taitus bɔsɔna wia. Ii maa duubuu bɔkpega nɛnnɛ.

ref: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
text: N faa ŋɔ ii wiarɛ tɛu, di tɛɛ ia sɔŋ. Too. Ii wan duwɛɛ hiihzi. Gunla maa yaa n ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ ia ɛɛ wibiire. Too. Gunla yaa n ŋɔ ii wia tɛɛ Taitus di tɛɛ ia sɔŋ la, a gba ɛɛ wibii.

ref: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
text: U jaa dɔɔ ii bilaa werge, di ra liizi gunla iin lɛɛu du ii be, di ra fɔŋ di ra hiŋ gunla maa um bagli ia la.

ref: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
text: N bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ min dɔɔ ii tamii wiimaa biini.

ref: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
text: Yaabalaa, yaa ra nyiŋŋuu ii zum gunla Kɔraawiizi n hiini Yeesu hiŋra la n du Masɛdɔnia hɛri, ba wer dɔɔ bunya werge la.

ref: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
text: Tɔɔrɔɔ werge maa ɛɛ baabuu na, ka ba bɔra n sɔɔni baa werge maa la, ba wettoo lizi kebee werge, bá kpa sunzi nɛra. Ba faa ɛɛ nyaaraa werge,

ref: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
text: ka n wettoo ŋɔ ba wia lugɔ ba lizi gunla maa baŋ wettee, di bir lizi jaa gba. Ba himmaa kipattɛ guŋ.

ref: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
text: Ba suŋŋi yaabuu werge lugɔ ya lɛɛ ba kebee la, bá ge gba wer ɛɛ winanaa la di ge wa hiini ba dɔŋa hina Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la.

ref: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
text: Ba winanaa la kaali gunla yaa n faa binnɛɛ labuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba hiŋ Kɔraawiizi kipattɛ, di kpa bahinaa tɛɛ ba Dɔɔri ni yaa mɔɔ, ka haa lizi kebee la.

ref: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
text: Awiarɛ yaa suŋŋi Taitus, ú la ii ge gba be ga tuŋ hunnanii la uŋ faa faarɛɛ ii be la.

ref: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
text: Iin dɔɔ yarda werge ani wibaglaa ni nunzuma, di ɔɔ aah siwii werge di kaa nɔŋŋi yaa ge naa, ií ɛɛ ania di wer dɔɔ winanii naa ge gba werge.

ref: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
text: Maa ŋɔ ń fir ia ii ra hiŋ kennaa miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ naa. Ka baŋhina n ɛɛ ania werge, di ɛɛ winanaa naa, n na nyiŋŋuu ń zum ii dɔnnɔŋŋaa la gunla un duwɛɛ, di u dɔɔ wibii gɛɛ waa wibii dɔɔwɛ.

ref: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
text: Ii zum gunla yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo n suŋ yaa ni di hiini yaa labuu. U faa dɔɔwɔɔ ka gil a maa ta dikuu ii wia, ka birgi nyaari, ka ií ge wer dɔɔ werge dikuu u nyaari la wia.

ref: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
text: Awia, n daŋ bagli ia gunla min nawɛɛ. Iabuu felee ŋɔ winanaa naa wia, di faari ra kɛɛ a kebee diila maa.

ref: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
text: Filaŋkeŋ, a dɛkkɔɔ lugɔ iin tuŋ a huma. Gunla iin faa aah siwii ŋɔ ií kɛɛa la, ií kaa aah siwii guŋ, di sissi a kebee ii kebidɔɔlaa biini.

ref: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
text: Di ii bampiree teŋ tɛɛ ia lugɔ ií tɛɛ kebee la, gunla maa iin dɔɔwɛ iin niŋ tɛɛ, guŋ daŋ par Kɔraawiizi. Waa ŋɔ ií tɛɛ di kaali gunla iin dɔɔwɛ.

ref: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
text: Maa ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ ií kpa ii kummaa tɛɛ baa ka birgi nyaara ra di dɔgnya. Ka a wesso ií maa n dɔɔwɛ mɛgzi.

ref: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
text: Di ii dɔɔwɔ filaŋkeŋ, ii daŋ wer hiini banla n waa dɔɔwɛ. Di ŋmɛnɛbɛl ba ge wa dɔɔwɔ, ka ii ge nyaa, bá ge wer hiini ia, ií maa wer ɛɛ kpaŋ.

ref: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
text: Gunnɛ ba faa sɛbi Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini di ŋɔ, “Unla n paa diwee werge la waa diwee ka ka, unla ge n paa tama, waa diwee nyaawɛ.” Baŋ hum Taitus bolzeŋ Kɔrint wia

ref: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
text: N na jaami Kɔraawiizi ani uŋ gillɛ Taitus dɔɔ ii wia u bampirii gunla yaa ge n dɔɔ ii wia yaa bampiree la.

ref: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
text: Wii naa yaa n na suŋŋi ŋɔ ií ɛɛ naa paruubuu werge. U himmaa kipattɛ ú la ii be.

ref: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
text: Yaa kaa hum yaa dɔŋhiŋ la Yeesu hiŋra maa n du bɔr maa n na chɔli amaniyesuma huma naa biini labuu tɛɛ ia.

ref: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
text: Yeesu hiŋra la lizuubuu ŋɔ ú du yaa la ya ga hum hunnanii naa, di kpa ii sunzaa la ga tɛɛ baa. U guŋ daŋ gil yaa Dɔɔri himmaa na girme, di kaa bagli gunla u wia n du yaa bampiree werge la.

ref: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
text: Yaa waa nyiŋŋi nɛr maa wer na bɔr ŋɔ yaa wichɔgaa wia, dikuu gunla yaa n kpogli ii kebee naa n ɛɛ sunzinanii naa wia.

ref: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
text: Yaa ra nyiŋŋuu a wia maa wer deŋli nɛra be, di kaa wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi ge be.

ref: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
text: Yaa kaa hum yaa dɔŋhiŋ bɛllɛ jaa banla ni. Baal naa, yaa ɛɛubuu na saŋakpila maa, di zum lugɔ ɔɔ aah siwiire ra hum huma la maa. U dɔɔ ii tamiirɛ werge. Awiarɛ u siwii kaa aah werge huma naa wia.

ref: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
text: Taitus ge, u ni yaabuu ra hum huma naa biini, di ra hiini ia. Banla n jaa u ni ge ɛɛ yaa dɔŋahina di lii Yeesu hiŋra la n du ɛŋ biini. Kristo ra na girmee dikuu ba wia.

ref: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
text: Awia, ií gil ba zum lugɔ nɔŋŋaa la iin nɔŋŋi nɛra la ɛɛ nɔŋŋaa himmaanii, Yeésu hiŋra la maa zum lugɔ yaa faa waa barabara ra ta, di ra ŋɔ ii wia la.

ref: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
text: A waa kaa ɛɛ wizeŋ min niŋ kaa sɛbi kebee la iin niŋ sunzi Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la wia.

ref: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
text: N zummɔ lugɔ a wia teŋ aah ii siwiire. N ŋɔ ii wiarɛ ra tɛɛ Masɛdɔnia hina di ra chɔli ia, di ra ŋɔ lugɔ Akaaya hina teŋ ɛɛ siryaa diila maa gba. Gunla iiŋ aah siwii la gillɔɔ bakpila maa ge aah siwii dikuu a wia.

ref: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
text: N hum yaa dɔŋa hinaa ii be filaŋkeŋ, nɛ́r maa gilɛɛ wer di ra ŋɔ lugɔ yaa ta barabaraa di ra ŋɔ ii wia, ka wibii waa hoo a biine. N ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ ii teŋ ɛɛ a maa siryaa tuŋ. Awiarɛ n hum baa, ií wer ɛɛ sirya la tuŋ.

ref: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
text: Ka di n ni Masɛdɔnia hɛri hina wa ballɔ, di ii haa waa ɛɛwɛ tuŋ, di ii waa hiihzi diwee, ka yaawaa daŋ di hiihzi dikuu tamii la yaa n dɔɔwɛ ii ni la wia.

ref: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
text: Awiarɛ n binni lugɔ a dɛkkɔɔ min suŋŋi yaa dɔŋahina, bá tɔ see ra la ii be ga lɛɛ ii sunzaa la iiŋ faa ŋɔ nua lugɔ ii daŋ sunzi baa la maa wa tuŋ, di yaa wa tɔ har ra ba, á jaa du de. Denii a wàá ka ɛɛ firaa, ka á ɛɛ kipar sunzaa.

ref: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
text: Ií ra liizi lugɔ nɛr la n dɔɔ kpossii di duu tama, tamaa ú bir na. Ka unla n duuwe werge, u daŋ na werge.

ref: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
text: Gunla maa an du ii bampiree lugɔ ii tɛɛ, ií ra tɛɛ guŋ ani biinihuŋŋu. Ií gilɛɛ gil a ɛɛ firaa sunzaa ii be. Nɛr la n na sunzi nɛra ani biinihuŋŋu, u wiarɛ ra par Kɔraawiizi.

ref: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ wer hiini ia werge maa, ií ɔɔ wer dɔɔ kunla maa iin niŋ dɔɔ di kaa jaa, ií wer dɔɔ ra hum hunnanaa.

ref: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
text: Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, di ŋɔ, “U bɔnni u kunaa ra tɛɛ nyaara. U winanaa wàá tuŋ maa.”

ref: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
text: Kɔraawiizi la n ɔɔ tɛɛ ia kuna bee ií wer duu la, u daŋ kaa tɛɛ ia diwee ii di, di kaa gil ii na bee werge maa, di gil ii winanaa ge wer jaa.

ref: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
text: U daŋ hiini ia ií na kummaa ra jaa, ka ií ge wer dɔɔ bunya ra hiini nɛra. Di yaa hum huma naa tuŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ na jaaŋ nɛkpila be,

ref: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, iinna hiini nɛra naa, Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la daŋ jaa dɔɔ kuna la baŋ waa dɔɔwɛ la. Ka a bɛŋ lɛi niŋ lii a biini. Kɔraawiizi daŋ na jaaŋ werge maa lii nɛkpila be.

ref: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
text: Ii huma naabuu niŋ bagli lugɔ ii hiŋaa dɔɔ wibiire. Nɛkpila daŋ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ, dikuu iinna hiŋ amaniyesuma hiŋaa ŋmɛnizi nɛnnɛ wia ani iiŋ hiini ba ni nɛr maa werge wia.

ref: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
text: Ba ge daŋ suŋŋi wiizi tɛɛ ia ani nɔŋŋaa ni, dikuu baŋ nawɛɛ Kɔraawiizi n du ii bampiree werge, di hiini ia wia.

ref: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
text: Mìŋ́ Pɔɔllɛ ra fɔrgi ia ni Yeesu Kristo sisɔna ni u kanyitti ni. Ba ŋɔ n wiarɛ lugɔ di n haŋ wa du ii be anna ɔm iabuu, ka di yaa waa kaa waa na dɔŋa, n ɔɔ biruu dɔɔ bampirii.

ref: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
text: N na fɔrgi iabuu filaŋkeŋ, di n wa ba ii be, ń gilɛɛ waa bagli fɔŋŋa ii ni alugɔ min niŋ bagli banla n kpa yaa ra yir nɛra la n na ɛɛ ba wia, ba bɔrahɔna fɔŋŋa biini la.

ref: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
text: Yaa laal kuna waa newea hora ɛɛwɛ. A dɔɔ kpegzii Kɔraawiizi be, di wer ra purgi diikpega.

ref: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
text: N ɛɛ siryaa, di ii wa sɛɛwɔ tuŋ, ń tɛr nɛr la maa n vɛɛwɛ digni.

ref: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
text: Ii siwee waa na gɛɛ? Di nɛr la maa zummɔ lugɔ u ɛɛ Yeesu Kristo hiŋrii, ú kaa fɛ nfɛrɛ di zum gunla uŋ ɛɛ u hiŋri la, gunnɛ yaa gba ɛɛ u hiŋra.

ref: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
text: Di n na chɔli n hiŋ werge ani fɔŋŋa la yaa n dɔɔwɛ ii ni la, ka guŋ wàá ɛɛŋ hiihzi. Yaa Dɔɔri tɛmbuu a fɔŋŋa ń wer bagli ia. Wan tɛɛwɛ guŋ ń wa chɔgi ia.

ref: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
text: Ka maa nyiŋŋi ii ŋɔ n wia lugɔ n ɔɔ sɛbi hɔnaa ra ɔnzi nɛra.

ref: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
text: Ba ra ŋɔ, “U wettoo ra sɛbi hɔŋkpega. Ka di i wa nau, gɛrgii. Di u ra ŋɔ wia ge, u ŋɔ ra huhzi.”

ref: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
text: Nɛr la maa n na ŋɔ guŋ, ú zum lugɔ gunla yaa n sɛbɛɛ hɔna la biine la, gunnɛ ya ɛɛ saŋa la yaa n niŋ wa na dɔŋa la.

ref: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.
text: Yaa wàá kpa yaa hinaa mɛgzi banla n na tɔgzi bahinaa la. Yaa wàá kpa yaa nyuuni lɔ baa. Baabuu ɔɔ binni ba dɔŋahina wiɛɛlaazii, di ra ŋɔ dí ba horaa wesse. Banna ɛɛ kennaa, ba waa nfɛrɛ dɔɔwɛ.

ref: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
text: Yaawaa wàá chɔli yaa hinaa ani wii la maa n waa hoo anla Kɔraawiizi n gillɛ yaa ɛɛ la biini. Gunla maa um mɛgzɛɛ tɛɛ yaa, yaa daŋ ɛɛ guŋ bɛŋ. Ii gba du huma la un tɛɛ yaa la biinii.

ref: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
text: Yaa waa yaa hinaa ra chɔli ani huma la baŋhina n ɛɛwɛ, ka a waa hoo anla Kɔraawiizi n mɛgzɛɛ tɛɛ yaa la biini. Ka yaa dɔɔ tamiirɛ lugɔ di ii wa yardi Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ kaa lizi huma aŋhina tɛɛ yaa jaa a ni werge, dikuu ii wia,

ref: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
text: ya wer la see di gaa lizi amaniyesuma la ra tɛɛ banla n du see la, di gilɛɛ ra chɔli yaa hinaa dikuu huma la nɛbɛl n teŋ ɛɛwɛ mɔɔ, ka yaa ba waa lɛɛa u be la wia.

ref: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
text: Nɛr la n na chɔli u hiŋ, waa lɛi Kɔraawiizi tɛɛ wibii. Ka unla Kɔraawiizi n na chɔli, waabuu ú tɛɛ wibii.

ref: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
text: N na nyiŋŋuu ii di kanyitti tama ka nuu gɛnii wiŋɔzi. Ií ɛɛ ania ka diŋ kanyitti,

ref: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, n bɔra ra wiiu dikuu ii wia. Kɔraawiizii gillɛ n dɔɔ bɔwii guŋ. N gillɔɔ ii ɛɛ bakpaŋ bɛŋ hahjiga, di ra nyiŋŋi n wer kpa ia tɛɛ ii jaari Kristo alugɔ toloori la n waa baal zummɛ.

ref: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
text: Ka n na fɔŋuu Sítaani gilɛɛ wa na ŋmɛnɛɛ di wer bir ii nfɛssi lugɔ ii wàá ka nɔŋŋi Kristo nɛnnɛ ani biinihuŋŋu. Maa nyiŋŋi u wer dar ia alugɔ hɛrikuŋ la n faa fugzi Haawa, di wer daruu la.

ref: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
text: Ii ra tɔgzi baabuu kaali Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna gba. Ɛrɛɛ bɔirɛ ba bɔnnɛi?

ref: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
text: N wiŋɔzi nyaa yomaa, ka a waa zumaa waa nyaawɛ. Wia la maa yaa n zummɛ ge, yaa gillɔɔ a chaani nɛnnɛ, ií wer zum a maa nɛnnɛ.

ref: I robbed other churches by taking money from them to serve you.
text: Yeesu hiŋra la n du yeŋa la kebeere n lɛɛ. Baabuu tɛŋ kebee ka ń wer hum ia.

ref: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
text: Miŋ faa du ii be la, n faa waa kebee dɔɔwɛ, ka maa guŋ wia kuuwɛ tɔɔri ii bɛl maa. Ka Yeesu hiŋra la n faa lii Masɛdɔnia hɛri ba la, faa hiinimbuu ani kuna la miŋ faa waa dɔɔwɛ. N faa ɛɛ aniaa ń gilɛɛ tɔɔri ia wiimaa wia. N daŋ ɔɔ haa ɛɛ guŋ ra la.

ref: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
text: N na ŋɔ ii benii ani wibii la Kristo n gillɛ n dɔɔ la. Wii naa minna ɛɛ di wer ra chɔli n hiŋ dikuu u wia naa, màá gil u ɛɛi Akaaya biini maa.

ref: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
text: Ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ n ɛɛ gunnɛi? Maa ia nɔŋŋɛɛrɛ gɛɛ? Aa! N nɔŋŋi iabuu gɛɛ. Kɔraawiizi gba zummɔ.

ref: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
text: Ka n daŋ ɔɔ ɛɛ guŋ, nɛ́ra la n na nyiŋŋi ba ta barabara ŋɔ lugɔ ba ni yaa ɛɛ kpannɛ la, gilɛɛ wer na bɔr di wer ra ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
text: Nɛra naa dizi waa Kristo huŋhunna himmaa ɛɛwɛ ka ra dar nɛra, di ra hum a huma, di ra yir bahinaa u huŋhunna, di ra fugzi nɛra.

ref: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
text: Mhmm. Sitaani gba ɔɔ weruu birgi u hiŋ di li mɛlikananiinanii bɛl, di ge wer ra fugzi nɛra.

ref: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
text: Awia, di u balaa ra yir bahinaa banla n na ɛɛ wideŋlaa di wer ra fugzi nɛra, a waa witittii ɛɛwɛ. Ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ turgi baa ani gunla ba huma n duwɛɛ. Pɔɔl n na ta barabara u tɔɔrɔɔ dii wia

ref: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
text: Too. N kaa ra ŋɔ ii benii. Ií gilɛɛ waa yiriŋ gɛnii, dikuu wia naa min niŋ ŋɔ naa wia. Di n gɛnnɔ gba, ka ií ra nuu n be, ń ge gba wer chɔli n hiŋ tama.

ref: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
text: Wia naa min niŋ ŋɔ naa, yaa Dɔɔri lɛi ŋɔ ń ŋɔa. N himmaa chugla wiŋɔzii n na nyiŋŋi n ŋɔ, dikuu nɛra hinchɔlaa naa wia.

ref: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
text: Bakpila n na chɔli bahinaa ani ba bɔrahɔna wia kennaa, n gba daŋ chɔli n hiŋ,

ref: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, nunzunnaa ia. Ii ɔɔ weruu ra tɛɛ gɛnaa sisɔna, di gil ii bɔra sɔɔni, ii ra nuu ba be.

ref: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
text: Baŋhina ɔɔ kpa iabuu birgi ba yoma, di ra foozi ia, di ra di ia, di ra bagli fɔŋŋa ii ni, di ra chɛ ii liizi, ka ii ra tɛɛ baa sisɔna.

ref: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
text: Yaawaa ɛɛ gɛrgaa. Yaawaa waa ia tɔɔrɛɛ guŋ. Ka di wichɔgaarɛ yaa ɛɛ ia guŋ, amɔ, ii gaafura. Ka wii la maa baŋ dɔɔ barabara, di wer ra chɔli bahinaa dikuu u wia la, n gba dɔɔ barabaraa lugɔ ń ge gba wer chɔli n hiŋ, dikuu a wii wia. Too. N gɛnni wiŋɔzi labuu n ŋɔ la.

ref: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
text: Ba ɛɛ Jus hinaa gɛɛ? N gba ɛɛ bɛllɛ. Ba ɛɛ Izrɛl hinaa gɛɛ? N gba ɛɛ bɛllɛ. Ba ɛɛ Abraham naannaa gɛɛ? N gba ɛɛ u naana bɛllɛ.
