ref: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
text: Ba ɛɛ Kristo balaarɛa? Ií ra nuu chugla hiŋ wiŋɔzi. N kaali baabuu. N hum u humaa kuuh werge maa kaali baa, di kaa du nɛra tɔi diini biine werge maa di kaali baa. Ba lɔɔzimbuu saŋakpila maa. Maa kaa zum a maga gba. N kaa du siu biini saŋakpilakpila.

ref: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
text: Baŋhina lɔɔzimbuu ni daazi saŋazi buhoro maa. N bia ge lɔɔzaa bukakpaŋ. N faa kaa zuu muugbera u wa purgi ŋmɛnɛɛ, a saŋa bɛl n kaa zuu bɛl u ge kaa puri, a guŋ buhoro. A saŋa hiŋ bɛl, n wa ta nii biinii hamuŋa ni guŋŋ hɔɔ wa pizi, bɔr kaa wa biri.

ref: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
text: N gaagɔɔrɛ werge di na siaahmu deekpila maa. N na siaahmu nii n suwee biini, ŋmɛɛna be, n himmaa nɛra be ani banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ ge be. Siaahmu huuzimbuu bola biine, bɔdumazi ani muuzeŋ biini. N kaa na siaahmu banla n waa Yeesu hiŋra himmaa ɛɛwɛ be.

ref: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
text: N zum kuuhni ni dɔgnya. Maa dɔɔ nawɛɛ ra chɔɔ saŋakpila maa, di zum lɔzi ni niinyɔgzi. Diwii maa waa n nua zuuwɛ hɔpizikpila maa biine. N zum waarii. Maa ɔɔ dɔɔ laala nɛnnɛ ń tɔ n hiŋ.

ref: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
text: Di bɛl maa waa kpeg nɛnnɛ, a guŋ ɔɔ tirimbuu n ge gba gɛrgi. Di ba dar bɛl maa u leu ŋmɛnɛɛ, n baaŋ ɔɔ ra fuuh u wiarɛ.

ref: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
text: Di a wesso minna chɔli n hiŋ, n gɛrgaa wiarɛ ń na chɔli.

ref: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi zummɔ lugɔ maa kara ra kanni. Ií ra tɛu sɔŋ saŋa maa di ra la.

ref: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
text: Miŋ faa du Damaskus la, nabɔma la ba koori Arɛtas n gillɛ u dɔɔ fɔŋŋa de la, faa ra nyiŋŋuu u lawiŋ, di gil ba ra daaziŋ a bol maa, bá lawiŋ.

ref: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
text: Hinchɔlaa waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ. Ka n daŋ haa chɔli n hiŋ. N jaa ba wia la min nawɛɛ lugɔ deeza biini yaa Dɔɔri bagliŋ la ninɛɛ.

ref: I know about one of Christ's followers who was taken up into the third heaven
text: Yeesu hiŋri bɛllɛ du de, binni fidaanaazuu zinaa, Kɔraawiizi n toou zuu u be chinchiŋ himmaa la.

ref: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
text: Minna ɛɛ sirya ń ba ii be filaŋkennaa, n buhoro balaarɛ niŋ ɛɛ guŋ. Màá binni ii be ii tɛŋ diwee. Ii kuna lɛi n na nyiŋŋi. Ii himmaanii n na nyiŋŋi. Biizi lɛi niŋ nyiŋŋi dau ra tɛɛ ba mɛɛ ni ba maa. Ba mɛɛ ni ba maarɛ niŋ nyiŋŋi ra tɛɛ baa.

ref: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
text: Di u ni u bɔrahɔnnɛ zuu de gɛɛ u duma bɛnnɛ zuu de, maa zum. Kɔraawiizi bɛnnɛ zummɛ.

ref: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
text: Ka kenne n zum. Minuu a hiŋ. Kɔraawiizi kpambuu ga zuu u be, n nuu wiŋɔzi aŋhina n kaali newee ŋɔi. Kɔraawiizi wàá gil newee ŋɔa.

ref: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
text: Di n ŋɔ ń chɔli nɛr, waabuu ń chɔli. Ka miŋwaa wàá chɔli n hiŋ ani wiimaa, di n gɛrgaa wia lɛi.

ref: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
text: Di n na nyiŋŋi ń chɔli n hiŋwaa, a wàá ɛɛ gɛnni wiŋɔzi, dikuubɛɛwiai, a maa ɛɛ wibiire. Ka màá ŋɔ. Maa nyiŋŋi nɛr maa kpa wiimaa tɔgziŋ, di anla un nawɛɛ ani anla un nuuwɛ bɛŋ lɛi.

ref: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa waa nyiŋŋi n ge ra tɔgzi n hiŋ werge, dikuu wikpilakpila uŋ gillɛ n chɔɔ ra na deeza biini wia. Awia, u gillɔɔ wii bɛl du n ni di lii Sitaani be, u ra tɔɔriŋ alugɔ sɔɔh n du n ni, ń gilɛɛ wer ra tɔgzi n hiŋ werge.

ref: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
text: Buhoro maanii n suŋŋi wiizi, ú lizuu n ni.

ref: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
text: Ka waa sɛɛwɛ ú lizuu. U ŋɔ, “N hiinaa naa min niŋ suŋ i ni di hiinii naa daŋ kukkii. Nɛra gɛrgaa biinii ń fɔŋŋa wer du wer werge wa tuŋ.” Awia, n daŋ gil n bɔra sɔɔniŋ dikuu n gɛrgaa wia di chɔlaa, ka Krísto fɔŋŋa wer du n ni.

ref: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
text: Awia, di n gɛrgɔɔ, di nɛra ra gbɛlliŋ, di n na di dɔgnya di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, di ra na siaahmu dikuu Kristo wia, u guŋ parimbuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, di n gɛrgɔɔ, denii ń kaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋa nɛnnɛ. Kɔrint hina wia n tir Pɔɔl

ref: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
text: N ɛɛ gɛnni wiarɛ. Ka iabuu gillɛ n ɛɛ guŋ. Iabuu niŋ faa chɔliŋ. Maa kummaa ɛɛwɛ, ka nɛra la iinna tɔgzi di kaali Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna la bɛl maa wam bɔwɛɛ wiimaa biini.

ref: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
text: Miŋ faa du ii be la, n faa ɛɛ wiɛɛlaa la n gillɛ ii zum lugɔ n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi huŋhunnii, di ɛɛa ani kanyitti. Witittaa, wizenaa ni nuukpuuri wiarɛ n faa ɛɛ la.

ref: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
text: Ii ni Yeesu hiŋra n du yeŋa la, maa ia ɛɛwɛ ii ɛɛ kpaŋaa? Maa ii be binnɛɛ ń na n diwee. Guŋ bɛnnɛ maa ɛɛwɛ. Di wichɔgaarɛ n ɛɛ ia guŋ, amɔ, ii gaafura.

ref: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
text: Di n kebee maa ani n fɔŋŋa maa gba tunnɔ dikuu ii wia, ka n bɔra daŋ sɔɔni. Ii wia n du n bampirii werge maa wiarɛ ii ge lizi n wia ii bampiree gɛɛ?

ref: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
text: Baŋhina daŋ sɛɛ lugɔ maa ia duwɛɛ tɔɔrɔɔ dikuu n diwee wia. Ka ba daŋ ŋɔ lugɔ n ŋmurgi iabuu di wer dar ia gunla.

ref: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
text: Banla miŋ faa hum ii be la, ii daŋ wer ŋɔ ba bɛl maa wia lugɔ u dar iabuu lɛɛ ii kebeea?

ref: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
text: Miŋ faa suŋŋi Taitus ú la ii be, di gil yaa dɔŋhiŋ duu la la, a Taitus dar iabuu lɛɛ ii kebee gɛɛ? N nuu manni waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛa? Yaa maa wiɛɛlaa waa kpaŋ ɛɛwɛa?

ref: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
text: Yaa n na ŋɔ wia kennaa, ii ra binnuu lugɔ yaa ra ŋɔabuu di ra nyiŋŋi yaa hor wer du sum ii be gɛɛ? Yaa ɛɛ Kristo hiŋraa di ra ŋɔa Kɔraawiizi be. N biinɔŋŋaa, ii hiinaa wiarɛ yaa ra ŋɔ a maa, ií wer lau nɛnnɛ,

ref: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, n na fɔŋuu lugɔ ń gilɛɛ wa ba ii be, ií wia wa chɔg n biini, ń ge wia wa chɔg ii biine, ń wa na lugɔ ii ra di dɔŋa hɔɔzii, di dɔɔ bɔwii, baaŋfuuih dumazi, bɛnsɔnnyiŋŋaa ni nɛgbɛllaa, nɛzɔɔzaa, barabara ani basabasa wia.

ref: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
text: Maa nyiŋŋi n kaa wa ba ii be ń Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi wa duŋ hiihzi, dikuu ii wia. Di n wa ballɔ, di wichɔgɛɛra kpila du ii be, ba biine haa waa chɔkkɛ dikuu sɛnsɛŋ wia ni wichɔgaa naa dee baŋ ɛɛwɛ naa wia, n ge biini daŋ chɔgi.

ref: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
text: Ii be balaa buhoro hinnɛ keŋ. “Di n wa ballɔ, bɛl maa daŋ nyiŋŋi u daansɛɛ hina banɛɛ gɛɛ bahoro, ka ú wiŋɔzi wer ɛɛ wibii.”

ref: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
text: N faa ŋɔ ii benii n bunɛɛ balaa la biini, di kaa ra ŋɔ ii be miŋ waa hoo ii be filaŋkennaa, ii banla n faa ɛɛ wichɔgaa ani ii banla maa n kawɛɛ, di n kaa waa ba ii be, màá gil ia.

ref: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
text: Ii faa ra nyiŋŋuu ií zum nɛnnɛ lugɔ Kristo du n ninɛɛ di ra ŋɔ wia la. Too. Ii daŋ zum. Wàá nyaa fɔŋŋa ii be. U daŋ bagli ia u fɔŋŋa.

ref: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
text: Baŋ faa kpuu daakaŋlii ni la, u gɛrgaarɛ faa. Ka u jaa dɔɔ miibɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini. Yaa gba nuu maa gɛrgɔɔrɛ. Kaa filaŋkeŋ, yaa nuu wettoo na miibɔɔ Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini, di wer du ii be ani a fɔŋŋa.

ref: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
text: Ií pessi iihinaa di zum lugɔ ii yarduubuu nɛnnɛ gɛɛ ii wɔɔ yardɛɛi? Ií ɛɛ iihinaa na. Ii waa zummɛ lugɔ Yeesu Kristo du ii biineewaa? Di ii waa nɛfugze ɛɛwɛ, amɔ, u du ii biinee.

ref: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
text: N na tamuu lugɔ ii daŋ zum yaa n waa nɛfugze ɛɛwɛ.

ref: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
text: Ama, yaa ra suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii lugɔ ii gilɛɛ dɔɔ wichɔgaa maa. Yaa n na nyiŋŋi ya wer lii dɔɔ wibii ii be wia lɛi yaa ra suŋŋuu guŋ. Ii winanaa ɛɛirɛ yaa ra nyiŋŋi. Di guŋ gillɔ ba ra ŋɔ lugɔ yaa waa wibii dɔɔwɛ, ka gunnɛ yaa ra nyiŋŋi.

ref: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
text: Yaa wàá wer yoo wibii. Yaa daŋ hiinuubuu.

ref: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
text: Di ii dɔɔ fɔŋŋa ka yaa gɛrgi, yaa bɔra daŋ sɔɔni. Yaa kaa ra suŋŋi wiizi lugɔ ú kuari ii wia maa, á du wer wa tuŋ.

ref: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
text: Awiarɛ n na sɛbi wia naa miŋ waa hoo ii be naa, ń gilɛɛ waa jugmi ia saŋa la min niŋ wa ba ii be la. N Dɔɔri tɛmbuu fɔŋŋa. Ka ii hiinaa wiarɛ u tɛŋ a fɔŋŋa, ń wer hiini ia, ií wer lau nɛnnɛ. Ii chɔgaa wia lɛi u tɛŋ a fɔŋŋa.

ref: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
text: Too. Yaabalaa, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni, di gil Kɔraawiizi kuari ii wia maa á du wer wa tuŋ, di sɔɔni ii bampiree, di gil ii maa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ nɛnnɛ, di du dɔŋa be pɛrɛtɛ. Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ nɔŋŋaa ni bampirsɔna hiŋ la daŋ ɔɔ du ii be.

ref: From the apostle Paul and from all the Lord's followers with me. I was chosen to be an apostle by Jesus Christ and by God the Father, who raised him from death. No mere human chose or appointed me to this work. To the churches in Galatia:
text: N ni Yeesu hiŋra la maa n du n be bɔnnaa la ra jaami ii banla maa n ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra, di du Galesia hɛri la.

ref: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia, di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna.

ref: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri la sɛɛ yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kipattɛ, di siu dikuu yaa wichɔgaa wia, ú wer lɛɛ yaa durnya ni u wichɔgaa fɔŋŋa biini.

ref: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
text: Ií gil u sɔŋ dɔɔ girme di hanna la, saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami. Amaniyesumakpaŋ wia

ref: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
text: A tirimbuu werge maa, miŋ nuuwɛ lugɔ ii teŋ vɛɛ amaniyesuma labuu, ka bir a hiŋ duma bɛl. Kristo n faa suŋ ii ni di hiini ia la, Kɔraawiizi yir iabuu ii ba u be. Ka ii bir vɛɛu manamanaŋ kennaa.

ref: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
text: Maa sɛɛwɛ lugɔ amaniyesuma maa kaa du denii, di kaa jaa anla yaa n na lizi la ni. Ka baŋhina du ii benii di lawaa ra birgi, di ra bugmi ia.

ref: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
text: Di n himmaa wa lizi amaniyesuma maa tɛɛ ia a kur anla miŋ felee lizi tɛɛ ia la ni, Kɔ́raawiizi seeŋ nua. Di Kɔraawiizi mɛlika bɛl ge gba wa liwɔɔ di wa ɛɛ guŋ, Kɔ́raawiizi see u ge gba nua.

ref: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
text: Ií gil n kaa ŋɔ gunla miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la ií nuu nɛnnɛ. Di nɛr la maa wa lizi amaniyesuma tɛɛ ia, a kur anla iiŋ faa sɛɛwɛ la ni, Kɔ́raawiizi see a hiŋ nua.

ref: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
text: Miŋ ŋɔ wia naa kennaa, neweare n na tɔgzi gɛɛ Kɔraawiizii n na tɔgzɛi? Neweare n ŋɔ ń wia par gɛɛ Kɔraawiizɛi? Di n vii haa ra nyiŋŋi n wia par nɛra, n vii wàá wer ɛɛ Kristo balii. Gunla Pɔɔl n wa birgi Kɔraawiizi huŋhunni wia

ref: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
text: Yaabalaa, ií gil n kali ia nɛnnɛ ií zum. Amaniyesuma la miŋ faa lizɛɛ tɛɛ ia la, newea wiŋɔzi lɛi.

ref: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
text: Newee be lɛi n zumuu. Newee lɛi bagliŋ. Yeesu Kristoo kpa a maa bagliŋ, n wer zumaa.

ref: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
text: Ii faa ra nuu n wiarɛ saŋa la miŋ faa ra hiŋ Jus hina hiŋaa la, di faa nuu gunla miŋ faa aah siwii werge maa, di ra tɔɔri Yeesu hiŋra, di ra nyiŋŋi n chɔgi ba wia maa la.

ref: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
text: N tɔ n saara galga maa seere Jus hina hiŋaa la biini, dikuu miŋ faa ra tɔgzi yaa naana wiazi werge maa wia.

ref: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
text: Denii a paruu lugɔ ú gil n zum u Biibaal nɛnnɛ, ń wer bagli u wia tɛɛ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la. Uŋ wa liziŋ gunla, n ni nɛr maa waa dɔŋa nawɛɛ, yá ŋɔ a wia mɔɔ.

ref: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
text: Maa kaa la banla n feliŋ ɛɛ u huŋhunna Jɛrusalɛm la be gba. N izoore la Lɔrbizi hɛri di ga du de mɔɔ, ka jaa bir ba Damaskus.

ref: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
text: Binni ahoro n wa bɛrɛɛ, n jaa izi la Jɛrusalɛm, ń wer zum Pitta la banna yir Sifas la. Hɔpizaa fidaanuere n faa du u be a saŋa.

ref: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
text: U bɛnnɛ n na. Maa Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna la bɛl maa nawɛɛ, di Sifas la ni yaa Dɔɔri niwee Jems bɛŋ lɛi.

ref: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
text: Wibii maanii n sɛbi guŋ. Kɔraawiizi zummɔ lugɔ wibiire n na ŋɔ. Kara lɛi.

ref: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
text: Denii n izi de di la Siiria ni Silisia hɛssi.

ref: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
text: Yeesu Kristo hiŋra la n du Juda hɛri la faa wan zummɛ siwee ni. Ba siwee faa haa waa n ni chaanɛɛ,

ref: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
text: ka ra nuu n wia lugɔ unla n faa ra tɔɔri baa labuu jaa ra bagli nɛra hiŋaa la uŋ faa ra nyiŋŋi u chɔgi la.

ref: And because of me, they praised God.
text: Ba ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi dikuu n wia.

ref: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
text: Denii binni fidaanaazu n kaa wa bɛri, n kaa kuari la Jɛrusalɛm. N ni Banabas kpauwɔɔ la, di ga lau Taitus jaa yaa ni di la de.

ref: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
text: Kɔraawiizii faa bagliŋ lugɔ ń na la. N la ga bagli baa gunla maa miŋ ɔɔ lizi amaniyesuma la di ra tɛɛ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la. Ba nabɔnzi benii n feli la ga bagli ba bɛŋ mɔɔ, ń nuu ba be lugɔ n baglɔɔrɛ nɛnnɛ gɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛrɛ n faa aah siwii ra bagli a wia gunlai?

ref: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
text: Ba faa zummɔ lugɔ Taitus la ɛɛ Giris hinuurɛ, u hɛŋ waa teŋŋe. Ka ba faa waa nyiŋŋi bá firuu lugɔ bá teŋ u hɛŋ.

ref: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
text: Baŋhina faa du de di ra dar nɛra lugɔ ba ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋraa. Ba ba wa suahzi zuu yaa biini, bá zum yaa hinaa dɔɔi Yeesu Kristo hiŋaa biini, di faa ra nyiŋŋi ya kaa birgi yoma.

ref: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
text: Ka yaa waa sɛɛwɛ bá fir yaa tama maa, bá gilɛɛ wer bir Kɔraawiizi wibii lii amaniyesuma la biini, ka ú haa wer dɔɔ wibii tɛɛ ia.

ref: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
text: Banla banna yir nabɔnzi la faa du de. Ka maa ba wia kpawɛɛ su siwii. Kɔraawiizi waa yaa newea nabɔmuu ra binni. Ba wam baglɛɛ wiimaa,

ref: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
text: ka sɛɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi humimbuu ń lizi amaniyesuma la di ra tɛɛ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ gunla uŋ faa hum Pitta ge ú lizaa tɛɛ Jus hina la.

ref: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
text: Kɔraawiizi la n na hum Pitta bampirii biini, u wer di ra hum Jus hina be la, waabuu ra hum n ge bampirii biini, n wer ra hum banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ be la.

ref: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
text: Awia, baŋ wa zummɛ lugɔ Kɔraawiizii ra hiiniŋ la, banla banna yir ba nabɔnzi la, Jems, Sifas ani Jɔɔn la, ba kpa n ni Banabas di birgi ba dɔŋahina, di gil yaa maa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ lugɔ yaawaa danna bagli banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, ka bá ge ra bagli Jus hina la.

ref: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
text: Wikpaŋ bɛnnɛ ba ŋɔ, dí ya ɔɔ ra liizi ba nyaara wia, di ra hiini baa. Gunnɛ n gba faa ra nyiŋŋi. Pɔɔl n hau Pitta ni Antiɔk wia

ref: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
text: Denii Sifas ba Antiɔk, n pɛɛzuu wii bɛl, dikuubɛɛwiai, u hor faa waa sum.

ref: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
text: Miŋ wa na guŋ, di zum lugɔ ba wiɛɛlaa n waa deŋlee, ba waa amaniyesuma la ŋmɛnɛɛ ra hiŋ gunla n dɛkkɛ, n izi di ŋɔ Sifas be, ba maa see, “Hiŋ ɛɛ Jus hinuu ka ra chɔg ba Gbɔgni, di ra hiŋ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ ge hiŋaa la, ka bɛɛ n baani i kaa ŋɔ bánla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, jaa ra hiŋ Jus hina hiŋaa naanɛi?

ref: But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
text: Ka yaa zummɔ lugɔ nɛr n ɔɔ ra hiŋ Gbɔgni la wia lɛi u wia wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi be. Ka uŋ yardi Yeesu Kristo wiarɛ u wia wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi be. Awiarɛ yaa gba faa yardi Yeesu Kristo la. Yaa n faa ra nyiŋŋi yaa wia deŋli u be la, yaa waa Gbɔgni hiŋaa la binnɛɛ, ka yardi Yeesu Kristo. Nɛr maa waa hoo ú wia n niŋ wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi be, dikuu unna hiŋ Gbɔgni la wia.

ref: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
text: Too. Yaa n faa yardi Yeesu, yaa wia wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi be la, yaa birgi banla n waa Gbɔgni la ra hiŋ la baŋhinaa, di birgi lugɔ wichɔgɛɛra la baŋhina. Di gunnɛ, amɔ, Kristoo gillɛ nɛra ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa? Akai!

ref: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
text: Ka di n na nyiŋŋi n kaa tɔgzi Gbɔgni la miŋ faa gil a hiŋaa la, n daŋ birgi wichɔgɛɛri,

ref: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Gbɔgni labuu gillɛ n zum wia di gil a hiŋaa. N siuwɔɔ Gbɔgni hiŋaa la be ka ń wer dɔɔ miibɔɔ Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
text: Màá sɛɛ gil Kɔraawiizi nɛsunaa ni u hiinaa bir pɛɛ. Di nɛr faa wetto gil u wia deŋli Kɔraawiizi be dikuu Gbɔgni hiŋaa la wia, amɔ, Kristo faa siuwɔɔ pɛɛ.”

ref: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
text: Ee, Galesia hina! Gɛnaarɛ ia. Yaa faa bagli iabuu Yeesu Kristo wia, di gil u siu daakaŋlii la ni wia wer chaani ii be. Ka beedee n dar ia ii kaa ra leu filaŋkennei?

ref: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
text: Iiŋ faa na Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii u be la, iiŋ hiŋ Gbɔgni wiarɛ ii nau gɛɛ iin nuu amaniyesuma la di sɛɛ wiarɛ, ii nauwɛi? Ií bagliŋ bɛl.

ref: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
text: Ii gɛnnɔɔ werge. Di ii faari Kristo hiŋaa naa u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, bɛɛ wiarɛ ii kaa ŋɔ ií tunaa ii himmaa fɔŋŋa biinei?

ref: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
text: Amɔ, tɔɔrɔɔ la maa iin diwee Kristo hiŋaa naa biini naa, pɛɛpɛɛrɛ ii di a tɔɔrɔaa? Maa sɛɛwɛ.

ref: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
text: Kɔraawiizi n ɔɔ kpa u Dumnanii ra tɛɛ ia di ra ɛɛ wizenaa ii baambaaŋ la, u ɛɛ gunnɛ ra tɛɛ ia dikuu iinna hiŋ Gbɔgni la wia gɛɛ u ɛɛ gunnɛ ra tɛɛ ia dikuu iiŋ faa nuu amaniyesuma la di sɛɛ la wiai?

ref: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
text: Awia, ií zum lugɔ banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi, baabuu Abraham biizi himmaa la.

ref: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa feloore bagli Abraham amaniyesuma naa, di ŋɔ, “N daŋ ŋmɛnɛ kissi banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, bá nuu suma dikuu i wia.” Denii ba sɛbi guŋ du Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba faa wettoo zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi daŋ ŋmɛnɛ kuu banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la n yarduu wia di gil ba na hiinaa lii u be.

ref: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
text: Awia, nɛra la n yardi Kɔraawiizi lugɔ Abraham n faa yarduu la, baabuu Kɔraawiizi gil ba ra nuu suma la gunla uŋ gillɛ Abraham nuu suma la.

ref: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
text: Banla ge n ɔɔ binni lugɔ ba Gbɔgni hiŋaa la daŋ lɛɛ baa la, baabuu du Kɔraawiizi nuuseelii la biinii, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Nɛr la maa n waa wette ra hiŋ gbɔg la n du hɔnnaa biini naa, n daŋ seeu nua.”

ref: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
text: Yaa wetto zum lugɔ Gbɔgni hiŋaa wàá wer gil nɛr maa wia deŋli Kɔraawiizi be. U guŋ waa aana dɔɔwɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, dí, “Nɛr la wia n deŋlee, yardaa niŋ ɛɛ u miibɔɔ.”

ref: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
text: Yeesu Kristo lɛɛ yaabuu lii Kɔraawiizi nuuseelii la uŋ see banla maa n waa wette hiŋ Gbɔgni la maa biini. Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Nɛr la maa baŋ kpawɛɛ sag daa ni di kpu, Kɔraawiizi seeubuu nua.” Awia, Kristo n sag daa ni la, Kɔraawiizi nuuseelii labuu u kpa chi di siu, di wer lɛɛ yaa Kɔraawiizi nuuseelii la biini la.

ref: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
text: U ɛɛ gunnɛ, bánla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ wer kuu Yeesu Kristo wia di nuu suma, di lii suma la uŋ faa ŋɔ nua lugɔ u daŋ gil Abraham wa nuu la biini. Kɔraawiizi Duma la uŋ faa ŋɔ nua lugɔ u daŋ kpa tɛɛ nɛra labuu u ŋɔ ya na, dikuu yaa n yardi Yeesu Kristo wia la. Gbɔg ni nua ŋɔi wia

ref: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
text: Yaabalaa, ií gil n kpa yaa newea wii bɛl di mɛgzi wia naa minna bagli naa. Di i ni nɛbɛl ɛɛ nuukpaŋ bɛl di gil u du kpeg i bɛl maa wàá wer vɛɛu, ii wàá wer biruu ge.

ref: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
text: Too. Kɔraawiizi n faa ŋɔ nua la, Abraham ni u naana bɛllɛ u ŋɔ a nua tɛɛ. Uŋ ŋɔ u naana bɛl wia naa, waa nɛkpila wia ŋɔwɛɛ, nɛkpannɛ u ŋɔ. Kristo wiarɛ u faa ŋɔ la.

ref: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
text: Di yaa Kɔraawiizi kapɛttɛ dii faa ra lii Gbɔgni hiŋaa la biinii, amɔ, waa nua la Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔwɛɛ la ge ni ra lii. Ka guŋ lɛi a du. Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ a ra lii u nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ Abraham la biini.

ref: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
text: Amɔ, bɛɛwiarɛ Gbɔgni ge lii naanɛi? A liwɔɔrɛ á wer bagli yaa wia la n waa wer. Kɔraawiizi kpaabuu jaa u nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la ni, á du de mɔɔ ka Abraham naana la uŋ faa ŋɔ a nua tɛɛ la ba. Gbɔgni la n faa liwɛɛ la, Kɔraawiizi mɛlikazii faa ba a ni di wa bagli sitɔɔri hiŋ bɛl, u ge kpa bagli nɛra.

ref: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
text: A sitɔɔri n faa du de la, nɛkpaŋ lɛi kpa Gbɔgni wia la ba. Ka Kɔraawiizi bɛnnɛ du de saŋa la uŋ faa ŋɔ nua lawaa.

ref: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
text: Amɔ, Gbɔgni ni Kɔraawiizi nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ Abraham la ra yoo dɔŋaa gɛɛ? Akai! Di gbɔg bɛl faa du de ban niŋ hiŋ di wer na miibɔɔ, amɔ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ faa gil ba wia deŋli u be, dikuu gbɔg la hiŋaa wia.

ref: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ ra tɛɛ durnya maa chɔgrii, ka yárda wa wer ɛɛ ŋmɛnɛɛ bá kpa di lii wia biini, di na nua la Kɔraawiizi n faa ŋɔwɛɛ la. Banla n dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo yarda labuu niŋ na di lii Kɔraawiizi nuuŋɔɔlii hiŋ biini.

ref: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
text: Saŋa la yarda la wia n haa waa liwɛɛ la, yaa faa haa du Gbɔgni la noneere, ka yarda la wia haa wa lii.

ref: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
text: Gbɔgni la faa ɛɛ yaa binnii mɔɔ ka Kristo ba, yá jaa yarduu ka Kɔ́raawiizi wer gil yaa wia deŋli u be.

ref: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
text: Yarda n liwɛɛ naa, Gbɔgni la waa kaa ɛɛ yaa binni di dɔɔ yaa fɔŋŋa. Kɔraawiizi biibaala wia

ref: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
text: Ii maa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biizii, dikuu iiŋ yardi Yeesu Kristo wia.

ref: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
text: Ii banla maa baŋ faa sɔ Kɔraawiizi nii ii ni Kristo kpau la, ii lɛɛ Kristoo di du ii ni gunla.

ref: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
text: Awia, a waa kaa ɛɛ lugɔ Jus hinuurɛ keŋ, unla n waa Jus hinuu ɛɛwɛ genii keŋ. A waa kaa ɛɛ lugɔ baliirɛ keŋ, unla n dɔɔ u hiŋ genii keŋ. A waa kaa ɛɛ lugɔ baallɛ keŋ, haaŋ genii keŋ. Ii maa du Yeesu Kristo biinii, di ɛɛ kpaŋ.

ref: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
text: Di ii ɛɛ Kristo hora, ii ɛɛ Abraham naannaa, di ɛɛ banla n niŋ wer na u kapɛttɛ di di gunla Kɔraawiizi n faa ŋɔ nua la.

ref: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
text: N wiŋɔzi hiŋ zɛɛrɛ keŋ. Nɛzeŋ bie daŋ ŋmɛnɛ di u mɛɛ kapɛttɛ la maa. Ka di u haa ɛɛ bichala, u wia ni u mɛɛ balaa wia haa ɛɛ kpannɛ,

ref: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
text: Gunnɛ yaa ge gba faa du. Yaa faa haa waa helle ka du de, di ra hiŋ durnya wia, a dɔɔ yaa.

ref: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi saŋa n wa helle, u hum u Biibaal durnya, haaŋ bɛl luluu u du de, di ra sɛɛ Gbɔgni la dɔɔra,

ref: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
text: ka ú ŋmɛnɛ wa wer lɛɛ durnya lii a Gbɔgni biini, ya gilɛɛ kaa ɛɛ balaa, ka Kɔraawiizi wer ra dɛɛzi yaa, yá ɛɛ u biizi.

ref: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
text: Iiŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biizi la, u hum u Biibaal Dumaa u du ii ni yaa maa biine di ra yir Kɔraawiizi, “Mmɛ! Mmɛ!”

ref: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
text: Awia, ii bɛl maa waa kaa ɛɛ balii. I ɛɛ u biere. Hiŋ ɛɛ u bie la, Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil í wer na u kapɛttɛ gba di. Galesia hina wia n tir Pɔɔl wia

ref: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
text: Saŋa la ii faa waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ, ka ra hum kundumazi la n waa Kɔraawiizi ɛɛwɛ la, di ra sɛɛ a dɔɔra.

ref: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?
text: Ka filaŋkennaa, iiŋ wette di zum Kɔraawiizi naa, gɛɛ iiŋ ɛɛ u zunna naa, ɛrɛɛ a kaa ɛɛ ii ŋɔ ií kaa bir a hiŋ durnya wiazi lai? A waa fɔŋŋa ni hiinaa maa dɔɔwɛ, ka ii ŋɔ á kaa dɔɔ iai?

ref: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
text: Ii ra tɔgzi hɔpizizenaa, baagufalaa, saŋazi ani binni aŋhinaa.

ref: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
text: Ii wia tirimbuu. Amɔ, huma la miŋ hummɛ ii be la, pɛɛpɛɛrɛ n humaawaa?

ref: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
text: N na fɔrgi iabuu, yaabalaa. N faa gil Gbɔgni tɔgzaarɛ ka birgi gunla iin duwɛɛ la. Awia, ií ge gil a tɔgzaa filaŋkeŋ, ka birgi gunla miŋ ge n duwɛɛ naa. Miŋ faa du ii be la, ii faa waŋ ɛɛwɛ wichɔgaa.

ref: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
text: Ii zummɔ lugɔ miŋ faa waa kpeg wiarɛ n faa du ii be, di wer di ra lizi amaniyesuma la ra tɛɛ ia lugli la.

ref: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
text: N gɛrga la wia faa kpolloo ii be, ka ii faa waŋ gbɛllɛɛ dikuu a wia. Ii faa waŋ vɛɛwɛ ka lɛɛŋ dau ii be lugɔ Kɔraawiizi mɛlikaa miŋ gɛɛ Yeesu Kristoo miŋ.

ref: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
text: Ii bɔra faa sɔɔni iabuu werge. Ka ɛrɛɛ a bir du filaŋkennei? Di ii faa wetto, ii daŋ faa lizi ii siwee gba tɛŋ. N zum ii wiarɛ guŋ.

ref: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
text: Ka ɛrɛɛ wiarɛ minna ŋɔ wibii ra tɛɛ ia, ii jaa kpaŋ birgi ii dɔm filaŋkennei?

ref: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
text: Banla minna ŋɔ ba wia naa, ba aah siwiire ií ni ba wer du sum, ka bá wer dar ia. Ba ra nyiŋŋi ba lau iabuu bargi ii bɛŋ, ka ií wer aah siwii dikuu ba ge wia.

ref: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.
text: N biinɔŋŋaa, n lul iabuu di du Yeesu Kristo hiŋaa biini. Ka lulaa hiwiila kaa lɔŋ dikuu ii wia, n aah siwii ií wer du Kristo duula.

ref: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
text: Oo! N vii wetto du ii be filaŋkeŋ, n daŋ vii wer bir n nua. Ii wia tirimbuu werge maa. Maa kaa zum ii wia siwee filaŋkeŋ. Haga ni Saara wia

ref: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
text: Ii banla n na nyiŋŋi ií ra hiŋ Gbɔgni la, ii waa nuuwɛ gunla Gbɔgni la n na bagliaa?

ref: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
text: Ba faa sɛbi Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biinii lugɔ Abraham lul biibaala banɛɛrɛ. Yoŋhaaŋ labuu lul bɛl. Haaŋ la n dɔɔ u hiŋ la ge lul bɛl.

ref: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
text: Abraham ni yoŋhaaŋ la lul ba biere ba himmaa fɔŋŋa biini. Ka unlawaa, Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ nua tɛu lugɔ u daŋ lul la wiarɛ u wer lul u bie.

ref: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
text: Too. N bagli ia ba wia, ií wer kpa mɛgzi Kɔraawiizi ni newea nuukpaŋ dizi anɛɛ la. Yoŋhaaŋ la sɔnnɛ faa Haga. Waabuu ya kpa ra mɛgzi nuukpaŋ la baŋ ɛɛwɛ Bizeŋ Sinaai, bɔr la baŋ faa na Gbɔgni la. U biizi ɛɛ yoma.

ref: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
text: Haga la ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Bizeŋ Sinaai la n du Lɔrbizi hɛri la, di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ Jɛrusalɛm, dikuubɛɛwiai, Jɛrusalɛm ni u hina maa ɛɛ yomaa.

ref: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
text: Ka Jɛrusalɛmzi la du anɛɛrɛ. Unla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hor du de. Waabuu dɔɔ u hinnɛ. Waabuu yaa ge maa la.

ref: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
text: Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ, “Gil i bɔra sɔɔni, hìŋ́ haaŋ la n waa lullɛ la, gil i bɔra sɔɔni, i ra chaasi, dikuubɛɛwiai, haaŋ la u jaari n faa vɛɛwɛ la daŋ haa dɔɔ biizi kaali unla n haa du u jaari dia la.”

ref: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
text: Yaabalaa, Abraham bie Aizik la un lullɛ dikuu Kɔraawiizi nuuŋɔɔlii la wia la, u ni yaa wia ɛɛ kpannɛ.

ref: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
text: Gunla bie la baŋ lullɛ ba himmaa vaaŋ ni n faa ra tɔɔri bie la baŋ lullɛ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini la, gunnɛ a kaa wa ɛɛ filaŋkennaa.

ref: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
text: Ií ra nuu gunla baŋ faa sɛbɛɛ di ŋɔ, “Duŋŋi yoŋhaaŋ la ni u biibaal la. A waa wer yoŋhaaŋ biibaal ni haaŋ la n dɔɔ u hiŋ la biibaal n kpauwɛ di ra di ba mɛɛ kapɛttɛ.”

ref: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
text: Awia, yaabalaa, yaa waa yoŋhaaŋ biizi ɛɛwɛ. Haaŋ la n dɔɔ u hiŋ la biizii yaa.

ref: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
text: Yaa maa dɔɔ yaa hinaarɛ. Kristo lɛɛ yaabuu ha, yaa waa kaa ɛɛ yoma. Awia, ii gilɛɛ ra binni iihinaa dɔɔi la pɛɛ, ka lau guŋ nɛnnɛ. Ií gilɛɛ gil ba kpa yoma wia di kaa ra vɔɔzi ia.

ref: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
text: Ií gil mìŋ́ Pɔɔl ŋɔ ii be. Di ii gillɔ ba teŋri ii hɛna, ii wàá wer na tɔna maa Kristo hiŋaa naa biini.

ref: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
text: Ii banla n kpa Gbɔgni hiŋaa ŋɔ ií gil ii wia deŋli Kɔraawiizi be la, ii lau iihinaarɛ bargi Kristo be. Ii waa kaa hoo u nɛsunaa dɔɔi la biini.

ref: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
text: Yaa zummɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi Dumaa niŋ gil yaa wia deŋli Kɔraawiizi be, dikuu yaa n yarduu wia. Awia, yaa ra kpaŋ gunnɛ ani tamii.

ref: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
text: Yeesu Kristo hiŋaa naa biini, di ba teŋ i hɛŋ, di ba waa i hɛŋ teŋŋe, ka a waa wizeŋ maa ɛɛwɛ. Wii la n ɛɛ wizeŋ, waabuu Kɔraawiizi yarda la n ɔɔ hum nɛra biine, di gil ba nɔŋŋi dɔŋa la.

ref: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
text: Ii faa ra hiŋuu nɛnnɛ. Ka bɛɛ n baani ii waa kaa ra hiŋ wibii naanɛi? Bɛɛ n teŋ ia ŋmɛnɛɛi?

ref: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
text: Kɔraawiizi la n yir ia ii ba u be la be lɛi nfɛrɛ naa lii.

ref: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
text: “Yiisi tama daŋ wer fuu paanuu kpila maa.” Awia, ií ra dazi nfɛrɛ naa dee ni.

ref: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
text: Ka n dɔɔ ii tamiirɛ dikuu yaa Dɔɔri la yaa maa n na hiŋ la wia lugɔ ii wàá ka dɔɔ nfɛrduma bɛl maa wia naa biini. Nɛr la maa n na koozi ia, haali di u ɛɛ nɛzeŋ gba, Kɔraawiizi daŋ kpa u wichɔgaa kim turguu.

ref: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
text: Yaabalaa, di n vii ra ŋɔ lugɔ nɛra ra teŋri ba hɛna, ba vii waa kaa ra tɔɔriŋ kennaa. Di n vii waa kaa ra bagli Kristo siwaa daakaŋlii la ni wia, baŋhina vii wàá ra vɛɛ n wiŋɔzi di ra leuzi ŋmɛnɛɛ kennaa.

ref: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
text: Nɛra la n na koozi ia di ŋɔ ií teŋri ii hɛna la, bá vii vari bahinaa.

ref: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
text: Yaabalaa, Kɔraawiizi yir iabuu ií wer dɔɔ iihinaa. Ka ii gilɛɛ kuu guŋ wia di ŋɔ ii daŋ jaa wer ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa la maa ii bɔrahɔna n na nyiŋŋi ii ra ɛɛ la. Akai. Ií kpa dɔnnɔŋŋaa di ra hum dɔŋa,

ref: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Gbɔgni la maa du widaulikpaŋ biinii. Waabuu hiŋ nɔŋŋi i dɔŋhiŋ gunla hin nɔŋŋi i hiŋ la.

ref: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
text: Ka di ii ni ii dɔŋahina ra naa, di ii waa tau ra du, ii daŋ chɔgi dɔŋa ni. Miibɔɔ ni Duma wia

ref: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
text: Ií ra ɛɛ ii wiimaa Kɔraawiizi Duma fɔŋŋa biini. Denii ii wàá kaa ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa la ii bɔrahɔna n na nyiŋŋi la. Gunnɛ miŋwaa ŋɔ.

ref: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
text: Ii bɔrahɔna la ɔɔ izuu ra yoo Kɔraawiizi Duma la n du ii biine la, Kɔraawiizi Duma ge ra yoo ii bɔrahɔna. A wàá wer dɔɔ nuukpaŋ maa. Awia, ii waa ɔɔ wer ra ɛɛ wii la iinna nyiŋŋi.

ref: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
text: Ka di Kɔraawiizi Duma kipattɛ ii ra sɛɛ, Gbɔgni la wàá ka dɔɔ ii fɔŋŋa.

ref: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
text: Newea bɔrahɔŋ wiɛɛlaarɛ sɛnsɛŋ wia ni a dee maa,

ref: They worship idols, practice witchcraft, hate others, and are hard to get along with. People become jealous, angry, and selfish. They not only argue and cause trouble, but they are
text: vuga kuaraa, hiri dii ni tagbizi ɛɛi, dɔŋhahzi, hɔɔzi dii, bɔwii, baaŋfuuih dumazi, bɛnsɔnnyiŋŋaa, nuukpaŋ vɛɛi dɔŋa ni, dɔmbargaa dɔŋa be,

ref: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
text: zoma, sindɛɛza ani basabasa wia ni a dee maa. N faa karfi iabuu wia naa wia. Ka ií gil n kaa karfi ia. Banla maa n na ɛɛ wia naa, wàá wer du Kɔraawiizi Kora biini di di u suma la.

ref: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
text: sisɔna dɔɔi ani hinlawaa. Annii bɛl maa waa gbɔg chɔgaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
text: Banla n ɛɛ Yeesu Kristo hora la kpa ba bɔrahɔŋ wichɔgaa ni ba nfɛrchɔgaa maanii di kpu daakaŋlii la ni.

ref: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
text: Di ii dɔɔ miibɔɔfalii di lii Kɔraawiizi Duma fɔŋŋa biini, amɔ, ií nuu ra tɛu di ra hiŋ u nua.

ref: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
text: Ya gilɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi zenni dɔŋa ni, di ra nuu dɔŋa nuuzi, di ra ɛɛ dɔŋa bɔwii.

ref: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
text: Yaabalaa, di ii dɔŋhiŋ bɛl ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa, ba wa lawuu a wichɔgaa ɛɛi biini, ií banla n dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi Duma nɛnnɛ la, daŋ lɛɛu u wichɔgaa la ɛɛi biini. Ií ɔɔ ra ɛɛ guŋ ka ra dazi, di gilɛɛ waa nyɛg u ni, wíchɔgaa gilɛɛ waa ɛɛ ii ge ra na, ii ge wa sɛɛa.

ref: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
text: Ií lɛɛ dɔŋa bunni di ra chi ra di dɔŋa tɔɔrɔɔ. Di ii wetto ra ɛɛ guŋ, ii ra hiŋ Kristo widaulii la maanii nɛnnɛ la.

ref: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
text: Di nɛr la maa ra yir u hiŋ nɛzeŋ, u ra dar u hinnɛ. Waa nɛr maa ɛɛwɛ.

ref: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
text: A dɛkkɔ nɛr maa n na binni u himmaa wiɛɛlaa ni, di gilɛɛ kpaa bɔ babalaa wiɛɛlaa, di nyiŋŋi sɔŋ a tɛɛ u hiŋ. Ií gil u sɔŋ dɔɔi la lii u bɛmbɛŋ wiɛɛlaa biini,

ref: We each must carry our own load.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛr maa ni u bunnii un niŋ chi.

ref: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
text: Di nɛr ra bagli ia Yeesu Kristo wia, ii daŋ hiinuu ni ii kunnanaa maa.

ref: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
text: Gilɛɛ ra dar i hiŋ. Hàá wer dar Kɔraawiizi. Wia la hiŋ duuwe, aabuu í kum.

ref: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
text: Di i kuu i bɔrahɔŋ wia di duu wichɔgaa, i daŋ kum chɔgaa lii i bɔrahɔŋ wia biini. Di i kuu i duma wia di duu winanaa, i daŋ kum miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ lii Kɔraawiizi Duma la be.

ref: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
text: Ya gilɛɛ gil winanaa ɛɛi kuuhni ra biri yaa siwee, ka ya haa vɛɛ ra ɛɛa. Di yaa haa vɛɛwɔ ra ɛɛa, di saŋa bɛl wa hello, yaa daŋ na tɔna a biini.

ref: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
text: Awia, di yaa wa na ŋmɛnɛɛ lugɔ ya ɛɛ winanaa, ya ra ɛɛ guŋ. Ka ii dɔŋahina Yeesu hiŋra wiarɛ kpolle. Karfaa tuna ni jaamaa wia

ref: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
text: N himmaanii sɛbɛɛ ɛŋ. Na gunla n sɛbaa n kannɛ werge.

ref: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
text: Nɛra la n na fir ia di ra ŋɔ lugɔ ií teŋri ii hɛna la, nɛra wiarɛ ba ra ɛɛ guŋ, bá wia vii wer par baa, á nɛra ge gilɛɛ kuu baŋ sɛɛ Yeesu Kristo ni u siwaa daakaŋlii la ni wia di ra tɔɔri baa.

ref: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
text: Banla n gillɛ ba teŋri ba hɛna la, ba himmaa waa Gbɔgni la maa ra hiŋ. Ka ba ra nyiŋŋi ba teŋri ii ge hɛna nɛ́ra ra chɔli baa dikuu a wia.

ref: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
text: Miŋwaa wàá sɛɛ chɔli n hiŋ ani wiimaa, ka ra chɔli yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo siwaa daakaŋlii la ni la bɛŋ. U siwaa la gillɔɔ durnya wia birgi wipɛɛri n be. A siuwɔɔ di gil n ge siu di wer lii a durnya wia fɔŋŋa biini.

ref: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
text: Yeesu Kristo ge hiŋaa biini naa, di i teŋ i hɛŋ, di haa i hɛŋ teŋŋe, ka u guŋ lɛi ɛɛ wizeŋ. Wii la n ɛɛ wizeŋ, waabuu lugɔ yaa n birgi nɛfalaa.

ref: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
text: Banla maa n ninna hiŋ gunla miŋ baglɛɛ ani banla maa n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nɛra di ɛɛ Jus hina himmaa la, Kɔ́raawiizi tɛɛ baa bampirsɔna di suŋ ba ni.

ref: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
text: Filaŋkeŋ, nɛ́r maa gilɛɛ kaa ra tɔɔriŋ. N dɔɔ pɛlaa dikuu yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo wia.

ref: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
text: Yáa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia, yaabalaa. Ami.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
text: Mìŋ́ Yeesu Kristo huŋhunni Pɔɔllɛ a sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛɛ ia. A par Kɔraawiizii u tɛŋ a huma. N na jaami ii banla n du Ɛfɛsus, di ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinanaa di ra hiŋ Yeesu Kristo ani wibii la.

ref: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
text: Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia, di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Suma nuui lii Kristo be wia

ref: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa feloore lizi yaa tɛɛ u hiŋ, saŋa la uŋ faa haa waa durnya gba tawɛɛ la, di ŋɔ u daŋ gil yáa ni Kristo kpau, ya wer ɛɛ u biinanaa di gilɛɛ dɔɔ doŋa maa u be, ka nɔŋŋi dɔŋa ge.

ref: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
text: ya ŋmɛnɛ wer chɔli u nɛsunaa dɔɔi ni u hiinaa la n wesse werge la. U Biinɔŋŋii hiŋ wiarɛ ú suŋ yaa ni di hiini yaa la.

ref: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
text: a wa ɛɛ saŋa la un dauwɛ la. U faa dau u wiarɛ lugɔ u daŋ wa gil chiŋ ni hɛri kummaa kaa birgi kpaŋ, di sɛɛ Kristo dɔɔra.

ref: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
text: nɛ́ra wer chɔli u zenni lii yaa banla n felee dɔɔ Kristo tamii la wia biini.

ref: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
text: Baŋ faa bagli ia wibii di lii amaniyesuma la n dɔɔ lɛɛi ii be la biini, ii gba sɛɛwɔɔ tɛu, Kɔraawiizi kpa u Dumnanii la tɛɛ ia gunla uŋ faa ŋɔ nua la. U Dumnanii la gillɔɔ ii birgi Kɔraawiizi hora.

ref: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
text: U Dumnanii labuu ya feli dɔɔ mɔɔ lii kapɛttɛ la Kɔraawiizi n dauwɛ tɛɛ yaa, ka ya ŋmɛnɛ wa dɔɔ a maa, saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n niŋ wa lɛɛ u kuna la maa ha tuŋ, di na sɔŋ tɛɛ u hiŋ ni u zenni la. Pɔɔl wiisuŋŋaa wia

ref: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
text: Awia, miŋ nuuwɛ gunla iin dɔɔ yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo yarda, di nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la maa la,

ref: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
text: n jaa ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizii jaaŋ saŋa la maa minna suŋŋuu di ra tɛɛ ia la.

ref: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n dɔɔ girme werge maa la, ú hiini ia ií wer zum u wia ra jaa saŋa maa, á birgi nunzuma ni sichaana tɛɛ ia,

ref: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
text: di pilli ii siwee, ií wer zum tamii la dee Kɔraawiizi n yir ia ií wer dɔɔ la ani gunla u biizi kapɛttɛ n kannɛ werge di ɛɛ kunnaniinanii bɛl werge maa la,

ref: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
text: di kaa zum fɔŋŋa la dee Kɔraawiizi n dɔɔwɛ, ú hiini yaa banla n yarduu, gunla aŋ ɛɛ fɔŋŋazeŋ werge maa wa bɛri la. Ií liizi gunla uŋ faa ɛɛ Kristo u fɔŋŋa biini, di zum lugɔ a fɔŋŋa himmaanii ú kpa hiini yaa.

ref: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
text: U lalluubuu lii siu biini di kpau la u be, u ga so u nabɔmbɔr u be de,

ref: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
text: di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge maa kaali fɔŋŋa dɔɔra lugɔ tinnanni ni vuga dee maa, di dɔɔ nyuu kaali nɛr maa n du de filaŋkennaa ani banla n niŋ haa wa du de durnya naa harbɔɔ la.

ref: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
text: Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ kummaa sɛɛ u dɔɔra, di gil u ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra la maa nyuu,

ref: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
text: ba ge ɛɛ u bɔrahɔŋ. Unla n kannɛ werge di wer su durnya naa maa gba la, ka waabuu du Yeesu hiŋra la biine.

ref: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
text: Ii faa ɛɛ kunsiwaarɛ. Ii wichɔgaa kpa iabuu birgi guŋ.

ref: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
text: Ii faa ra hiŋ durnya naa ni u wichɔgaa wiarɛ, di ra hiŋ unla n ɛɛ kunchɔgaa yaa siwee n waa na la dɔɔri. Waabuu ɔɔ ra hum dignikpega hina bampiree biini. Yaa maa ni a dignikpega hinaa faa.

ref: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
text: Yaa maanii faa ra hiŋ baa, di ra ɛɛ wia la maa yaa bɔrahɔŋ n tɛɛ yaa ŋɔ ya ra ɛɛ la, di ra hiŋ yaa kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa ni yaa nfɛrchɔgaa. Yaa ni durnya maa ninɛɛ Kɔraawiizi baaŋ faa du, dikuu yaa machɔgaa la wia.

ref: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.
text: di lalli yaa siu la yaa n siuwɛ dikuu yaa wichɔgaa la wia biini, yáa ni Kristo maa wer kpau dɔɔ miibɔɔ. Kɔraawiizi n suŋ ii ni wiarɛ ii wer na lɛɛi u be.

ref: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
text: Un lalli yaa ni Yeesu Kristo maa siu biini la, u tɛɛ yaabuu sognibɔra u be, dikuu yaa ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ wia.

ref: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
text: Kɔraawiizi n lɛɛ ia ha la, ii winanaa ɛɛi wia lɛi u lɛɛ ia ha. U nɛsunaa ni ii yarda wiarɛ u lɛɛ ia ha. Pɛɛpɛɛrɛ u lɛɛ ia ha, di tɛɛ ia miibɔɔ la.

ref: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
text: Yaa hunnanaa biini lɛi a lii, nɛ́r maa gilɛɛ kuu guŋ wia ra chɔli u hiŋ.

ref: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
text: Kɔraawiizii ma yaa. Um ma yaa la, hunnanaa humaa wiarɛ u ma yaa, yá wer humaa Yeesu Kristo fɔŋŋa biini. U feloore dau a hunnanaa tɛɛ yaa saŋa maa, ya ŋmɛnɛ wer humaa. Yaa ɛɛ kpannɛ Yeesu Kristo wia

ref: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
text: Awia, ií ra liizi gunla iiŋ faa duwɛɛ la. Ii waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, awia, ii waa ii hɛna teŋree. Banla n teŋri ba hɛna la faa ra gbɛlli iabuu dikuu guŋ wia. Ka ba hor la ɛɛ bɔrahɔŋ mɔnnaa bɛnnɛ.

ref: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
text: Ii faa waa Kristo wia zummɛ. Ii faa waa wiimaa dɔɔwɛ Jus hina wia biini. Ii faa waa Kɔraawiizi nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ kuari u ni u nɛra nuukpaŋ dɔɔi wia zummɛ. Ii faa waa tamii maa dɔɔwɛ ka du de. Ii faa waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ ú wer hiini ia.

ref: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
text: Ka filaŋkeŋ, ii banla n faa du bɔɔnɛɛ bɔɔnɛɛ la, Kɔraawiizi kuu ii ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ la wiarɛ, di kpa ia dugli u be. Yeesu chal wiarɛ guŋ wer ɛɛ.

ref: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
text: U gillɔɔ yaa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ, di gil yaa banla n faa bargi dɔŋa be birgi kpaŋ. Gunla yaa n faa hah dɔŋa la faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ koŋlii, di teŋ yaa baaŋ. U jaa purgi a maanii ta.

ref: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
text: U himmaa bɔrahɔŋ ninɛɛ u ɛɛ gunla, di lizi Moosis Gbɔgni hiŋaa la yaa be, á widaulaa gilɛɛ kaa ra bargi yaa, ka ú wer kpa yaa maa birgi kuŋfalii ni kuŋkpaŋ, dikuu yaa maa nuu n kpauwɛ wia. Gunnɛ u ɛɛ di gil yaa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ.

ref: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
text: Wia la maa n faa bargi yaa, yaa hah dɔŋa la, u chɔgi a maanii ha daakaŋlii la ni, di gil yaa maa birgi kpaŋ, di kaa kuari yaa ni Kɔraawiizi wia tɛɛ yaa gunla,

ref: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
text: ka wa bagli ii banla n faa du bɔɔnɛɛ ani banla n faa duglɛɛ la maa lugɔ nuukpaŋ jaa du denii.

ref: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
text: U wiarɛ yaa maa wer hel yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi be. Yaa maa dɔɔ u Dumnanii. U Dumnanii la ɔɔ giluu yaa wer ra hel u be.

ref: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
text: Awia, ii waa kaa ɛɛ hɔɔhra. Ii ɛɛ bol biizii, di ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nɛra.

ref: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
text: U gillɔɔ ii ɛɛ u dia koŋlaa. U huŋhunna ni u dɔgtɛɛzi ɛɛ u zɛɛ. Yeesu Kristo ge ɛɛ binanii la baŋ kpawɛɛ chiŋŋi a dia zɛɛ.

ref: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
text: Banla maa ba nuu n kpauwɛ la choŋŋi u ni, dia la ra hel di ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia, dikuu yaa Dɔɔri la wia.

ref: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
text: Ii gba du denii di ɛɛ dia la Kɔraawiizi n na ma ú ɛɛ u duuribɔr la, dikuu u Duma n du ii ni la wia.

ref: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
text: Ii daŋ faa nuu gunla Kɔraawiizi n suŋ n ni, di hiiniŋ werge ni u fɔŋŋa ka ń wer hiini ia.

ref: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
text: U himmaanii pilli u wisuahlii tɛŋ. N faa feloore sɛbi guŋ wia bagli ia.

ref: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
text: Di ii karmi gunla miŋ faa sɛbɛɛ la, ii daŋ zum lugɔ n zum Kristo wisuahlii wiarɛ.

ref: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa waa u wolo wia pillɛɛ tɛɛ faala hina la. Ka filaŋkeŋ, u Duma bagli u wiarɛ tɛɛ nɛnanaa la n ɛɛ u huŋhunna ni u dɔgtɛɛzi la,

ref: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
text: di gil ba zum lugɔ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ daŋ jaa di suma Jus hina wia biini, bá ni baa ɛɛ kpaŋ di wer ra di suma Kɔraawiizi nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la biini. Yeesu Kristoo gillɛ Kɔraawiizi nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la wer ɛɛ, bá maa wer di suma la dikuu amaniyesuma la wia.

ref: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
text: Amaniyesuma huma labuu Kɔraawiizi lizi tɛŋ. Un suŋ n ni werge wiarɛ u tɛŋ a huma, di hiiniŋ werge u fɔŋŋa ni.

ref: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
text: N ɛɛ biijagaa u biizi maa biini. Ka minuu u lizi ŋɔ ń lizi amaniyesuma la tɛɛ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, bá ge wer zum sunnanii la n waa maga dɔɔwɛ, di du Kristo wia biini la.

ref: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
text: Kɔraawiizi la n ta kummaa la, u bɛnnɛ faa zum wisuahlii naa guŋŋ wa hel zinaa. Ka filaŋkeŋ, u ŋɔ ń pilli gunla un dawuu ni u ŋmɛnizi, tɛɛ nɛra bá zum.

ref: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
text: Mɛlikazi ni kundizi la maa n du Kɔraawiizi be gba daŋ binni Yeesu hiŋra wia, di jaa zum gunla maa Kɔraawiizi nunzuma n faa ra hum la.

ref: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
text: A maanii u dau saŋa maa la ka á wer ɛɛ filaŋkennaa, yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo n ballɛ naa.

ref: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
text: Yaa n yardi Yeesu, u ni yaa kpau la, yaa jaa dɔɔ bampiriire lugɔ yaa n niŋ hel Kɔraawiizi be. Yaa waa kaa ra ɔm.

ref: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
text: Awia, n na suŋŋi iabuu. Ií gilɛɛ gil ii bɔra huah ia dikuu tɔɔrɔɔ naa miŋ kuu ii wia di ra di naa wia, ka zum lugɔ ii ra na sɔnnɛ n tɔɔrɔɔ naa biini. Yeesu Kristo nɔŋŋaa wia

ref: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
text: Awia, n na giŋŋi n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi seere.

ref: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
text: N na suŋŋuubuu ani un dɔɔ girmezeŋ himmaa la, ú gil u Duma hiini ia ni fɔŋŋa werge maa ii biine,

ref: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
text: ií wer dɔɔ yarda nɛnnɛ, Krísto wer na duuribɔr du ii bampiree, di ra suŋŋuu, ií bampiree wer du u ni, di lawuu nɛnnɛ.

ref: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
text: N na suŋŋuubuu ií ni Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la maa wer zum Kristo nɔŋŋaa la, gunla un duwɛɛ, u kanni, u wassi ani u luŋzi maa.

ref: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
text: U nɔŋŋaa la un nɔŋŋi yaa la kaali yaa zumaarɛ. Ka n na suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii ií wer zumuu nɛnnɛ, di wer dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi himmaa ii biine werge maa di wa tuŋ.

ref: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
text: Ií gil u na girme dikuu Yeesu hiŋra ni Yeesu Kristo wia, saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami.

ref: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
text: Mìŋ́ Pɔɔl n du nɛra tɔi dia dikuu yaa Dɔɔri wia la, n na suŋŋi iabuu, ií ra hiŋ gunla an dɛkkɛ banla Kɔraawiizi n yittɛ n ninna hiŋ la.

ref: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
text: Ií ra kpa iihinaa fugzi, di dɔɔ sisɔna ni kanyitti dɔŋa ni, di ɔɔ gil ra tɛɛ dɔŋa dikuu iin nɔŋŋi dɔŋa wia,

ref: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
text: di aah siwii, ií ni ii dɔŋahina wia kuari saŋa maa, ii gilɛɛ chɔgi nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la Kɔraawiizi Duma n tɛɛ ia la.

ref: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
text: Yeesu bɔrahɔŋ ɛɛ kpaŋkpaŋ bɛnnɛ, u Dumnanii ge ɛɛ kpaŋkpaŋ, tamii la yaa maa n dɔɔwɛ la kaa ɛɛ kpaŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi yir yaa maanii.

ref: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
text: Yaa maa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi gba ɛɛ kpaŋ. Waabuu ɛɛ yaa maa Dɔɔri di ra hum yaa maa biine, di du yaa maa ni.

ref: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
text: Ba sɛbɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, di ŋɔ, “U kaali chinne. Banla un lauwɛ la hiŋuu kaali. U kaa sunzi nɛraa kuna.”

ref: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
text: Baŋ ŋɔ lugɔ uŋ kaali chiŋ la, u zɛɛrɛ lugɔ u feloore tuu hɛri.

ref: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
text: Nɛr la n tuuwe la, a hiŋ liwɔɔrɛ kaali chiŋ, di du chinchiŋ himmaa, di kaa su bɔr maa.

ref: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
text: ka yáa maa ŋmɛnɛ wer dɔɔ nuukpaŋ dɔŋa ni nɛnnɛ hiŋaa naa biini, di kaa wer zum Kɔraawiizi Biibaal la nɛnnɛ ga tuŋ, di wer hel werge lugɔ nabɔnzi, di dirmi u hiŋaa biini. Kristo labuu yaa kpa ra mɛgzi yaa hinaa la, di zum gunla yaa n niŋ hel.

ref: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
text: Kɔraawiizi ra nyiŋŋi ya lau wibiire, di ŋɔa ra tɛɛ dɔŋa ani nɔŋŋaa ni, ka ya wer hel nɛnnɛ di wer du gunla Kristo n duwɛɛ la. Waabuu yaa Nyuu.

ref: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
text: Yaa ge ɛɛ u bɔrahɔŋ. U gillɔɔ u kpuŋe lauri dɔŋa nɛnnɛ, u yeŋa maa ge hiini dɔŋa, á bɔrahɔŋ wer hel u maga maa. Dɔnnɔŋŋaarɛ ɔɔ gil Kristo bɔrahɔŋ wer ra hel guŋ di wer du kpeg. Miibɔɔfalii dikuu Yeesu Kristo wia

ref: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.
text: N wiŋɔkpeg bɛllɛ keŋ minna ŋɔ ii be ani yaa Dɔɔri sɔŋ. Ií gilɛɛ kaa ra hiŋ gunla banla n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ n na hiŋ la. Wipɛɛrii ba fɛ ra hiŋ.

ref: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
text: Wiimaa waa kaa tir baa. Ba jaa kutti ra hiŋ ba kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa, di ra ɛɛ sɛnsɛŋ wia ni wikuna dee maa ra nyaŋŋi.

ref: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
text: Di ii nuuwɔ tɛɛ Yeesu, saŋa la baŋ faa bagli ia wibii lii u wia biini la, di zum u hiŋaa, ii wàá hiŋ guŋ.

ref: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
text: Ka ii daŋ lizi ii miibɔɔbinii la maa ha, gunla maa iiŋ faa ra hiŋ la. Ii kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa dar iabuu, di chɔgi ii miibɔɔbinii la. Awia, ií lizuu ha,

ref: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
text: di gil Kɔraawiizi kuari ii biine ni ii nfɛssi maa, á birgi a falaa.

ref: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
text: U daŋ tɛɛ ia miibɔɔfalii bɛl dee uŋ kuarɛɛ tɛɛ ia, ií wia maa wer deŋli nɛnnɛ, ií wer ɛɛ winanaa bɛŋ alugɔ u wibii wiŋɔzi n na bagli la. Awia, ií kpa miibɔɔfalii la du iihinaa ni.

ref: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
text: Ií lizi daraa maa ii ni ha, ka ŋɔ wibii bɛŋ ra tɛɛ dɔŋa, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii maa du bɔrahɔŋkpaŋ biinii, di ɛɛ kpaŋ.

ref: and don't give the devil a chance.
text: Gilɛɛ gil Sitaani na bɔr darii.

ref: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
text: I faa ra ŋmɛɛu gɛɛ? Gilɛɛ kaa ra ɛɛ guŋ, ka kpa i nonee la di ra hum hunnanaa, í wer na ra di, ka wer na aŋhina ge ra tɛɛ nyaara bá ge ra di.

ref: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
text: Ií gilɛɛ gil wiŋɔkuna maa waa lii ii nuuzi, ka gil ii wiŋɔzi ɔɔ ɛɛ anla n dɛkkɛ, di dɔɔ tɛɛ hiinaa banla n na nuu be, bá wer lau nɛnnɛ.

ref: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
text: Ií gilɛɛ chɔg Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii biini. Kɔraawiizii gillɛ u du ii biine di ra bagli lugɔ ii ɛɛ u horaa un niŋ ŋmɛnɛ wa lɛɛ ha la.

ref: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
text: Ií gil nyɛgzi, nuukpol, baaŋfuuih, naari, basabasa wia, dɔŋgbɛllaa ani miisɔɔh wia maa,

ref: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
text: ka ra ɛɛ dɔŋa winanaa di ra na ba sinyɛna. Di ba ɛɛ ia wichɔgaa, ií gil tɛɛ baa alugɔ Kɔraawiizi n kuu Kristo wia di gil ii wichɔgaa tɛɛ ia la.

ref: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
text: Ii ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinɔŋŋaarɛ. Awia, ií du u duula.

ref: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
text: A wesso iin dɔɔ dɔŋa bila, di ra ɛɛ dɔŋa nɛnnɛ lugɔ Kristo n dɔɔ yaa bila di siu tɛɛ yaa, di lizi mbusu lizaa la sɔɔh n summɛ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, a paruu la.

ref: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
text: Ka sɛnsɛŋ wia, wikuna ani kɛkɛluu dɔŋa kuna ni, ii gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ a wia gba. A dɛkkɔɔ banla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinanaa n gil annii maa.

ref: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
text: Ií gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ wiŋɔkuna, gɛnni wiŋɔzi ani wiŋɔjagazi. A guŋ waa dɛkkɛ. Ií gilaa, ka ra jaami Kɔraawiizi ani u huma.

ref: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
text: Ií zum nɛnnɛ lugɔ banla n na sɛm di ra ɛɛ wikuna di dɔɔ kɛkɛluu, wàá na bɔr Kristo ni Kɔraawiizi Kora biini. Kɛkɛluu ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ vuga tɔgzaa.

ref: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
text: Ií gilɛɛ gil nɛr maa ŋɔ wipɛɛri di wer ra dar ia. Wia naa wiarɛ Kɔ́raawiizi baaŋ wa fuuh, ú hau dignikpega hina ni.

ref: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
text: Awia, ií gilɛɛ gil ii ni baa ra kpau.

ref: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
text: Ii wia maa faa ɛɛ bɔbirii. Ka filaŋkeŋ, a ɛɛ bɔchaannɛ dikuu yaa Dɔɔri wia. Awia, ií ra hiŋ gunla bɔchaaŋ hina n ninna hiŋ la.

ref: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
text: Bɔchaaŋ wiarɛ winanaa, wideŋlaa ani wibii wia.

ref: as you try to please the Lord.
text: Ií zum wia la iin niŋ ɛɛ, á par Kɔraawiizi,

ref: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
text: ka gil bɔbiri wia. A waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ. Ií pilli a wolli nɛ́ra zum a zɛɛ.

ref: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
text: Wia la baŋ ɔɔ suahzi ra ɛɛ la chummɔɔ werge. A baglaa gba dɔɔ hiihzi.

ref: But the light will show what these things are really like.
text: Ka di bɔchaaŋ wa chaani kummaa ni, u duula ɔɔ lii chaannɛ.

ref: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
text: Bɔchaannɛ ɔɔ gil kummaa chaani. Awia, ba ɔɔ ŋɔu, “Hinla n siuwɛ chɔɔ, izi! Kristo bɔchaaŋ daŋ chaani i ni.”

ref: Act like people with good sense and not like fools.
text: Awia, ií ra hiŋ ka ra du tau. Ií gilɛɛ gɛŋ ka ɔɔ dɔɔ nfɛrɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
text: Ií gil ii nfɛrnyaai la, ka zum gunla Kɔraawiizi kipar n duwɛɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
text: Ií gilɛɛ ra nyɔɔ siŋ werge ra dɛɛzi. U gunna chɔgi nɛraa. Ka ií gil Kɔraawiizi Dumawaa du ii ni werge,

ref: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
text: di ɔɔ ra yir yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo sɔŋ ni, di ra tɛɛ yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ ani wiimaa. Haana ni janna wia

ref: Honor Christ and put others first.
text: Ií maa ra sɛɛ dɔŋa dɔɔra dikuu iinna ɔm Kristo wia.

ref: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
text: Haana, ií ra sɛɛ ii janna dɔɔra alugɔ iinna sɛɛ ii Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi dɔɔra la,

ref: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, baal ɛɛ u haaŋ nyuurɛ alugɔ Kristo n ɛɛ u hiŋra maa nyuu la, u hiŋra ɛɛ u bɔrahɔŋ un lɛɛwɛ ha.

ref: Wives should always put their husbands first, as the church puts Christ first.
text: A dɛkkɔ haana n na sɛɛ ba janna dɔɔra wiimaa biini alugɔ Kristo hiŋra n na sɛɛ u dɔɔra la.

ref: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
text: Baala, ií nɔŋŋi ii haana nɛnnɛ gunla Kristo n nɔŋŋi u hiŋra di siu dikuu ba wia la.

ref: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
text: U siuwɔɔ tɛɛ baa, ú wer gil ba wer ɛɛ u bɛŋ hora, di gil ba doŋa maa wer lii ba ni dikuu u wiŋɔzi la baŋ nuuwɛ, ni nii la baŋ sɔ baa la wia.

ref: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
text: U ɛɛ gunnɛ ú wer kpa u hiŋra birgi u hahnaniinanii la n waa bɔdoŋa ni bɔchɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ, ka du kpeg di du wer werge maa wa tuŋ la.

ref: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
text: Gunnɛ a kaa dɛg baala ge n nɔŋŋi ba haana gunla baŋ nɔŋŋi ba himmaa bɔrahɔŋ la. Baal la maa n dɔɔ haaŋ di nɔŋŋuu guŋ, u himmaanii u nɔŋŋi la.

ref: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ sɛɛ hah u hinnɛi? Nɛr maa ɔɔ ra binni u hiŋ ninɛɛ di ra dɛɛzi u hiŋ gunla Kristo n na binni u hiŋra ge ni la.

ref: because we are each part of his body.
text: Yaa maa du u bɔrahɔŋ biinii.

ref: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
text: Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ, “Awia, a wesso baal n gil u maa ni u mɛɛ, ka la u haaŋ be, bá nɛra banɛɛ kpau ɛɛ bɔrahɔŋkpaŋ.”

ref: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
text: Wisuahliizeŋ bɛllɛ la. Miŋwaa be, Kristo ni u hiŋra wiarɛ ba bagli guŋ.

ref: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
text: Ka ií bɛl maa ɛɛ ania di nɔŋŋi u haaŋ lugɔ u hiŋ. Háaŋ ge ra tɔgzi u jaari.

ref: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
text: Biizi, ií nuu ra tɛɛ ii maawaa ni ii mɛɛwaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, u guŋ deŋloore yaa Dɔɔri hiŋaa naa biini.

ref: and you will have a long and happy life.”
text: Waabuu keŋ, “Di ii ra ɛɛ guŋ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ hiini ia, di tɛɛ ia miibɔɔjaŋ durnya naa biini.”

ref: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
text: Mɛɛwaa, ii gilɛɛ ra tɔɔri ii biizi, á ɛɛ baa baaŋ. Ií ra kpogli baa nɛnnɛ, di ra bagli baa ŋmɛnizi ani wia la maa n wesse yaa Dɔɔri be. Yoma ni Dɔɔra wia

ref: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
text: Balaa, ií nuu ra tɛɛ ii dɔɔra la n du durnya naa biini, di ra ɔm baa, di ra hum baa ani biinihuŋŋu alugɔ Kristoo ii ra hum la.

ref: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
text: Ií gilɛɛ ra hum fɔŋŋa ni saŋa la iiŋ wa du nɛra baaŋ dikuu sɔŋ wia, ka ɔɔ ra hum nɛnnɛ gunla Kristo balnanaa n ninna hum, di ra ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kipar la ani ii biine maa.

ref: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
text: Ií kpa bɔsɔna ra hum. A nɛra lɛi ii hum ra tɛɛ. Ii Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizii ii hum ra tɛɛ.

ref: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
text: Waabuu niŋ turgi bɛl maa ani hunnanii la maa uŋ hummɛ. Di baliirɛ, di nɛr la n dɔɔ u hinnɛ, ka ba maanii nin na ba hunnanaa kinturgaa Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
text: Dɔɔra, ií ra ɛɛ ii balaa ge guŋ, di gilɛɛ ra ɔnzi baa. Ií zum lugɔ ii ni baa maa dɔɔri ɛɛ kpannɛ. Waabuu Kɔraawiizi. Waabuu waa baŋhina ra tɔgzi ra kaali baŋhina. Kɔraawiizi laal kuna wia

ref: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
text: Ií ɔɔ gil yaa Dɔɔri fɔŋŋa du ii ni, ií wer dɔɔ kpegzi ii hiŋaa biini, di lii u fɔŋŋazeŋ la biini.

ref: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
text: Sitaani dɔɔ daraarɛ werge maa. Awia, ií kpa Kɔraawiizi laal kuna maa laali,

ref: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, newea lɛi yaa ra yoo. Vuga ni tinnanchɔgaa la maa n dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge ni bɔbiri naa koora ni kunchɔgaa la yaa n waa na, ka a dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge maa, di du kpil la, aabuu yaa ra yoo.

ref: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
text: Awia, a dɛkkɔ iiŋ kpa Kɔraawiizi laal kuna la maa laali nɛnnɛ, di kunchɔgaa la wa ŋɔ á yoo ia, ií wer chi nɛnnɛ di yooa guŋŋ ga tuŋ, ka haa wer chi.

ref: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
text: Kenne ií ɛɛ di wer chi. Ií kpa wibii kirsi, di kpa wideŋlaa di tɔ ii sezi ni ii hara,

ref: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
text: di kpa amaniyesuma la n dɔɔ bampirsɔna baglaa la du ii naazi.

ref: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
