text: Denii ií lau yarda di kpa teŋ ii bampiree. U daŋ wer bir hobee la maa Sitaani n kpawɛɛ choŋŋi niŋ, ka kpa ta ia la.

ref: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
text: Denii ií kpa ii miibɔɔ lɛɛi la hi lugɔ kahuro, di kaa kpa Kɔraawiizi Duma tokobi kpogli. Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔliirɛ a tokobi.

ref: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
text: Ií ɔɔ ra suŋŋi wiizi werge maa u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, di ra fɔrguu saŋa maa. Ií ra kazi ii bɔra di ra ɛɛ sirya, ií wer suŋŋi wiizi tɛɛ u biinanaa la maa,

ref: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
text: ani n ge gba ń wer zum wiŋɔzi la n wesse saŋa la maa min niŋ bagli u wia, di wer dɔɔ bampirii ń wer pilli u wisuahlii la lii amaniyesuma la biini.

ref: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
text: Miŋ ɛɛ amaniyesuma bagli wiarɛ ba tɔŋ dia. Awia, ií ra suŋŋi wiizi ń haa wer dɔɔ bampirii, di ra lizaa gunla an dɛkkɛ min niŋ lizaa. Pɔɔl nɛra jaamaa tuna

ref: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
text: Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo tɛɛ ii ni yaabalaa la maa bampirsɔna, nɛnɔŋŋaa ni yarda,

ref: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: di hiini ii banla maa n nɔŋŋi yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo ani nɔŋŋaa himmaa la.

ref: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
text: Yeesu Kristo balaa Pɔɔl ni Timotii ra sɛbi hɔnnaa ya tɛɛ ia. Yaa ra jaami Yeesu hiŋra nabɔnzi, ba huŋhunna ani banla ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinanaa di du Filipai la.

ref: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
text: Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Jaantɛɛi ni wiisuŋŋaa wia

ref: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
text: N na liizi ii wiarɛ saŋa maa di ra jaami n Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi dikuu ii wia,

ref: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
text: di ɔɔ suŋŋuu ra tɛɛ ia. Miŋ ɔɔ suŋŋuu ra tɛɛ ia la, n bɔra ɔɔ ra sɔɔnimbuu,

ref: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa ni iabuu kpauwɛ ra hum amaniyesuma naa huma guŋŋ di wa lii zinaa.

ref: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
text: N kaa dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi yardaa gunla uŋ wette di faari u hunnanii ii biine la, u daŋ haa wer di ra humaa guŋŋ ii wa birgi nɛnanaa di wa tuŋ, saŋa la Yeesu Kristo Hɔpizii la n niŋ wa hel la.

ref: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
text: Màá ŋɔ ii wia guŋŋ? Ii maa wia du n bampiriire werge maa. Di ba tɔmbuu dia gɛɛ di n wettoo dɔɔ n hiŋ di vol ra lizi amaniyesuma la, di ra di nɛra wibii lii wiŋɔzi la biini, ka n ni ii maanii Kɔraawiizi ra hiini la.

ref: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ n daansɛɛ hinnɛ lugɔ n na kɛlli ii ninɛɛ werge maa dikuu nɔŋŋaa la Yeesu Kristo n kpawɛɛ du n bampirii la wia.

ref: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
text: Anna suŋŋuubuu lugɔ ú gil ii ge wer dɔɔ nɛnɔŋŋaa werge di ra jaa di kaa dɔɔ zumaa ni nfɛrɛ di jaa a ni,

ref: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
text: ií wer zum wia la maa n dɛkkɛ. Denii ií wer dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu. Wiimaa wàá ka du de bá kpa chug ia Kristo hɔpizii la biini.

ref: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
text: Ii daŋ wer dɔɔ mananaa werge maa Yeesu Kristo fɔŋŋa biini, nɛ́ra ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ di ra chɔluu dikuu ii wia. Pɔɔl yɔlɔzi dui n gillɛ amaniyesuma yaari wia

ref: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
text: Yaabalaa, n na nyiŋŋi ii zum lugɔ wia la maa n faa ɛɛŋ la, winanaa lii a maa biinii, amaniyesuma wia wer yaari.

ref: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
text: Baŋ vɔɔziŋ di tɔ dia bɔnnaa naa, koori soojazi ni nɛra la maa n du ɛŋ, ba maa zum n wiarɛ di zum lugɔ minna hum Kristo wiarɛ ba kuu tɔŋ dia.

ref: Now most of the Lord's followers have become brave and are fearlessly telling the message.
text: Yaabalaa Yeesu hiŋra maa ge jaa yardi Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ n dia tɔi naa wia biini, di jaa dɔɔ bampirii di ra bagli Kɔraawiizi wia nɛnnɛ. Ba waa kaa ra ɔm.

ref: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
text: Baŋhina dɔɔ bɔwiirɛ di ra ŋɔ a wia. Baŋhina ra ŋɔa bá wer koozi yaa. Ka baŋhina ge ra ŋɔ Kristo wia ani biinihuŋŋu.

ref: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
text: Ban nɔŋŋiŋ di kaa zum lugɔ amaniyesuma humaa Kɔraawiizi liziŋ ń hum di di u dɔma wibii la wiarɛ ba ra ŋɔ Kristo wia la.

ref: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
text: Banla ge, ba himmaa sɔnnyiŋŋaa wiarɛ ba ra ŋɔ Kristo wia. Ba waa biine huuhzɛɛ ka ra ŋɔa di ra nyiŋŋi ba duŋ tɔɔrɔɔ di jaa n yɔlɔzi vɔɔi naa ni.

ref: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
text: Ka pɛɛrɛ. Di ba ra dar nɛra di ra ŋɔa, gɛɛ ba ra ŋɔabuu ani biinihuŋŋu, ka Kristo wiarɛ ba ra ŋɔ, n bɔra sɔɔni. U daŋ haa sɔɔni di ra la,

ref: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, n zummɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi daŋ lɛɛŋ dikuu ii wiisuŋŋaa ni Yeesu Kristo Duma hiinaa la wia.

ref: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
text: N na ɛɛ tamiirɛ ani n biini maa lugɔ hiihzi wàá diŋ maa. N daŋ haa wer dɔɔ bampirii nɛnnɛ filaŋkeŋ gunla miŋ faa dɔɔ bampirii la, Krísto wer na girme n bɔrahɔŋ wia biini. Di ba gillɔ n du de di dɔɔ miibɔɔ gɛɛ di ba kpuŋ, ka Kɔraawiizi daŋ haa na girme a maa biini,

ref: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, di n dɔɔ miibɔɔ, n wiimaanii haŋ Kristo. Di n wa siuwɔ ge n di tɔnaa.

ref: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
text: Ka di n haa du de, n daŋ haa wer hum huma a haa wer dɔɔ hiinaa werge. Awia, maa zum unla maa n wesse n be min niŋ lizi.

ref: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
text: N na nyiŋŋi werge maa lugɔ n siu di wer du Kristo be. U gunnɛ bɔ werge maa miŋ haa du ɛŋ.

ref: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
text: Awia, n zummɔ lugɔ n daŋ haa du ii maa be di wer hiini ia, ií wer la see di wer dɔɔ bɔsɔna Yeesu hiŋaa naa biini.

ref: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
text: Denii ií wer dɔɔ wikpila ii kpa di ra chɔliŋ di kaa ra chɔli Yeesu Kristo ani gunla uŋ hiiniŋ n wer bir ba ii be la.

ref: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
text: Ka ií ɔɔ du de ni mananaa gunla an dɛkkɛ banla n sɛɛ amaniyesuma la n niŋ du de la, di n wa ballɔ di wa du ii be gɛɛ maa hoo ii be, ka ń wer nuu ii wia lugɔ ii maa wettoo dɔɔ bampirkpaŋ di ra hiŋ nɛnnɛ, di kaa ɛɛ nuukpaŋ di kpau ra hum, Yeesu Kristo amaniyesuma la iin sɛɛwɛ la wer la see,

ref: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
text: di ka dɔɔ bampirii ge ii waa ii dɔma ra ɔm tama maa. Ii bampirii dɔɔi la biinii bá chi zum lugɔ baabuu ba waa kpu ka iawaa na lɛɛi Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
text: Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ ii wer sɛɛ Kristo wia di kaa wer di tɔɔrɔɔ dikuu u wia. Wizenne u ɛɛ tɛɛ ia ií wer di a tɔɔrɔɔ la.

ref: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
text: Ii gba ra yoo laal la dee iiŋ faa na miŋ faa ra yoou, di kaa nuu n wia filaŋkeŋ lugɔ a laallɛ n haa ra yoo la.

ref: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
text: iin dɔɔ annii naa maa naa, amɔ, ií ɛɛ wii bɛl ra jaa ń bɔra sɔɔniŋ werge maa di wa tuŋ. N na nyiŋŋuu lugɔ ii ɔɔ gil ii maa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ, ií nfɛssi ni ii dɔnnɔŋŋaa ni ii jina maa wer ɛɛ kpaŋ.

ref: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
text: A waa wer ii bɛl maa n ɛɛ wiimaa dikuu u bɛŋ sɔnnyiŋŋaa ani zenni wia. Ií kpa iihinaa fugzi di ɔɔ kpa ii dɔŋahina di bɔ iihinaa.

ref: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
text: Ií gilɛɛ ra binni ii bɛmbɛŋ wia biini, ka ɔɔ ra binni ii dɔŋahina wia biini ií wer hiini baa.

ref: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
text: U faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizii di du Kɔraawiizi ge duula. Ka u faa waa guŋ kpawɛɛ su siwii

ref: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
text: di gil Kɔraawiizi duula la ka kpa u hiŋ birgi balii di wa du yaa newea duula.

ref: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
text: Awia, Kɔraawiizi jaa tɛubuu nabɔmuu werge maa di wa bɛri, di tɛu sɔŋ kaali kummaa sɔŋ.

ref: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
text: di sɛɛ lugɔ waabuu ɛɛ ba maa Dɔɔri, ya Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wer na girme. Yaa ɛɛ fintinazii di ra chaani durnya

ref: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
text: Awia, n nɛnɔŋŋaa, gunla iiŋ faa ɔɔ ra hiŋ n nua saŋa la miŋ faa du ii be la, a kaa ɛɛ wizenne werge maa lugɔ miŋ waa hoo ii be naa, ka ií haa ra hiŋ guŋ di kpa siaahmu ra hum ni ɔnsii ni bɔsai maa ií wer na ii lɛɛi di wa tuŋ Kɔraawiizi be,

ref: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizii ɔɔ du ii biinee di ra hum ii wer sɛɛ u kipar la di wer a humuu nɛnnɛ gunla iin ninna humuu á paruu la.

ref: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, a wessoo iiŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biizi la n waa wichɔgaa maa dɔɔwɛ ka dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu bɛŋ, ii wiimaa deŋli. Filaŋkeŋ hina dɔɔ wichɔgaarɛ werge, ba waa ŋmɛnizi ra hiŋ. Ka iawaa du ba biini di ra chaani alugɔ chinchiŋwilaa n du chiŋ di ra chaani hamuŋa la.

ref: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
text: Ií gil Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii la n dɔɔ miibɔɔ la du ii bampiree nɛnnɛ di ra la ń wer chɔli ia Kristo hɔpizii la biini alugɔ maa kuuhwɛ pɛɛ, ń huma la maa miŋ hummɛ ii be la wa lii tɔna tɛŋ.

ref: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
text: Di ba ŋɔ bá kpuŋ ka n bɔra daŋ sɔɔni. N chal daŋ ɛɛ lugɔ mbusu lizaa niitaalii, ii Kɔraawiizi yarda ge ɛɛ lugɔ mbusu lizaa. Di ba kpuŋ ka ií mbusu lizaa la wer kuari nɛnnɛ, u guŋ daŋ sɔɔni n bɔra. Ii bɔsɔna daŋ ɛɛ n gba bɔsɔna.

ref: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
text: Gunnɛ ií ge gil n bɔsɔna sɔɔni ii ge bɔra la. Timoti ni Ɛpafrɔdaitɔs wia

ref: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
text: Di n Dɔɔri Yeesu sɛɛwɔ, n daŋ hum Timoti ii be filaŋkeŋ, ú wa na ia ka ba di wa ŋɔ ii wia tɛŋ, ń wer dɔɔ bɔkpega u amaniye la biini.

ref: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
text: N nuu bɛnnɛ dɔɔ nfɛrkpaŋ werge ii wia. Awia, n zummɔ lugɔ ii wia daŋ du u bampirii ani wibii, ú binni ii wia ni nɛnnɛ.

ref: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
text: Di Timoti bɛŋ lɛi, banla maa ra binni bahinaa wiazii. Ba waa Yeesu Kristo wia ra binni.

ref: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
text: Ii gba zum gunla u wia n dɔɔ wibiire. N nuu kpauwɔɔ ra hum amaniyesuma huma naa alugɔ biibambie ni u mɛɛ.

ref: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
text: Awia, di n wa zum gunla ban niŋ dawiŋ ɛŋ, n daŋ humuu ii be.

ref: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
text: Di n Dɔɔri sɛɛwɔ, a wàá birgi ka n ba ii be.

ref: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
text: N kaa binni lugɔ a dɛkkɔ miŋ hum yaa dɔŋhiŋ Ɛpafrɔdaitɔs ii be. U hiinimbuu di ra hum huma naa di ra naa Kɔraawiizi naari. Waabuu ii faa hum n be ú waa hiiniŋ la. N ge kaa ŋɔ ń humuubuu ii be,

ref: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, u ra kɛlli ii ninɛɛ werge maa. A kaa tiruu werge lugɔ ii nuu u wiila la wiarɛ.

ref: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
text: U faa wiiwɔɔ werge di faa ra nyiŋŋi u siu gba, ka Kɔraawiizi na u sinyɛna di suŋ n nuu maa ni. Di u faa siuwɔ, n daŋ faa dɔɔ biinichɔg di kaa jaa n biinichɔg la ni.

ref: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
text: Awiarɛ n faa ra nyiŋŋi werge maa lugɔ n humuu ii be, ií nau di gil ii bɔra sɔɔni, ií wia gilɛɛ kaa zuu n nyuu werge.

ref: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
text: Awia, ií lɛɛu ani bɔsɔna dikuu yaa Dɔɔri la iinna hiŋ la wia. Ií ra tɔgzi nɛra naa dizi.

ref: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
text: Kristo huma wiarɛ u kuu di faa kpa u miibɔɔ chɛr siu la, ú wer lɛɛ ii naazi di ba wa hiiniŋ.

ref: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
text: Yaabalaa, n wiŋɔzi la n kawɛɛrɛ keŋ. Ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni ia yaa Dɔɔri fɔŋŋa biini. Miŋ ɔɔ ŋɔ wia naa ra tɛɛ ia naa, ka a waa n bɔra ra huah. A daŋ hiini ia.

ref: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
text: Ií ra du vazi tau. Banla n na maŋkuri hɛŋ teŋaa di ra ŋɔ dí nɛr maa chɔgi u bɔrahɔŋ mɔɔ ka hiŋ Kɔraawiizi la wiarɛ n ŋɔ ií ra du tau la, bá gilɛɛ wer dar ia.

ref: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
text: Yaa banla n ɔɔ ra jaami Kɔraawiizi u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, di ɔɔ ra tɛɛ Yeesu Kristo ge sɔŋ, yaa waa bɔrahɔŋ wiazi la a maŋkuri la, yaabuu zum teŋaa himmaa la.

ref: although I could. Others may brag about themselves, but I have more reason to brag than anyone else.
text: Di bɔrahɔŋ wia daŋ faa wer lɛɛ yaa, minuu niŋ faa dɔɔ tamii werge. Di nɛr maa ŋɔwɔɔ lugɔ u wia uŋ ɛɛwɛ dɔɔ tamiirɛ, ka mìŋ́ dɔɔ tamii kaali a hiŋ.

ref: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
text: N ɛɛ Izrɛl hinuurɛ. N hɔpizaa ŋmantannaazi hinnɛ ba teŋ n hɛŋ. Bɛnjamin dee biinii n lii. Awia, n ɛɛ Hibru hinuu himmaanii, di faa ɛɛ nɛra la bɛl n na hiŋ Gbɔgni la hina hiŋaa la di ɛɛ Farisii.

ref: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
text: A wia faa ɛɛ siaahmu wiarɛ n be werge maa. Awia, n izi di ra tɔɔri Yeesu hiŋra. Di ba kaa ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni hiŋaa ge, n wia maa deŋloore. Maa u kii bɛl maa chɔkkɛ.

ref: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
text: Ka wia la maa min niŋ faa kurgi á ɛɛ tɔna wii tɛŋ Kɔraawiizi hiŋaa biini la, a maanii n yir wipɛɛri dikuu Kristo wia.

ref: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
text: Wibii maa, kummaa ani wiimaanii n vɛɛ di ra yiraa wipɛɛri ka ń wer zum n Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo. U zumaa labuu ɛɛ wizeŋ kaali kummaa. N kuu u wiarɛ di gil wiimaa ha di ra yiraa wijagazi ka ra nyiŋŋi n wer lau Kristo nɛnnɛ,

ref: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
text: ya wer kpau Kɔ́raawiizi ŋɔ lugɔ n wia maa deŋloore. Wàá ŋɔ guŋ dikuu miŋ hiŋ Gbɔgni la wia. Miŋ yardi Kristo wiarɛ ú ŋɔ guŋ. A wideŋlaa dee ɔɔ lii Kɔraawiizi benii u ra tɛɛ banla maa n yardi Yeesu.

ref: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
text: N wiimaanii ń wer zum Kristo, di wer zum fɔŋŋa la uŋ izi siu biini dɔɔ la, ni u tɔɔrɔɔ dii, ń nuu maa wer kpau di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, ń wa wer birgi di wa du gunla uŋ faa duwɛɛ ka siu la,

ref: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
text: ka ń vii ŋmɛnɛ wer izi siu biini gunla u ge n izee la. Huma humaa siaahmu ni wia

ref: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
text: A waa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ n teŋ wettoo ɛɛ annii maa di ɛɛ nɛnanii di wa tuŋ. Akai. N haa aah siwiire di ra nyiŋŋi n wer ɛɛ wia la maa Yeesu Kristo n faa liziŋ ń ɛɛ la.

ref: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
text: Yaabalaa, maa binni lugɔ n tuŋ wiimaanii. Kenne n na ɛɛ. Aŋ suuh harbɔɔ wiarɛ ka kpa nfɛrkpaŋ di ra la see ń wer na anla ge n haa du see la

ref: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
text: di aah siwii ń wer hel a tuna di na kinturgaa. Kɔraawiizi yirimbuu ń ba wa du u be dikuu Yeesu Kristo wia. Awiarɛ n aah siwii ń wer na guŋ la.

ref: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
text: A wessoo yaa banla maa n dirmɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wia biini la n na fɛ guŋ nfɛrɛ. Di ii baŋhina ge waa guŋ sɛɛwɛ, Kɔraawiizi daŋ haa chaani ii siwee.

ref: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
text: Ama gunla maa yaa n wette zum, ya lau guŋ di ra la see.

ref: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
text: Yaabalaa, ií ra chanzi gunla minna hiŋ di zum banla ge n na hiŋ gunla yaa n bagli ia la,

ref: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛkpila waa gunna hiŋ. N ɔɔ bagli ba wiarɛ saŋa maa di ra tɛɛ ia di kaa ra bagli ia filaŋkennaa di wii ra ŋɔ, Ba ɛɛ Kristo ni u daakaŋlii wia dɔmaa.

ref: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
text: Ba tuna daŋ ɛɛ chɔgaarɛ. Ba kpa ba hizi wiarɛ di kaali Kɔraawiizi. Wia la n niŋ faa ɛɛ baa hiihzi, aabuu ba jaa ra chɔli werge. Ba nfɛssi maanii du durnya wia biini.

ref: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
text: Ka durnya naa lɛi yaa bol. Yaawaa bolle Kɔraawiizi bol la. Yaa n du ɛnnaa, yaa ra kpaŋ yaa Lɛɛri la n niŋ ŋmɛnɛ lii de ba labuu. Waabuu yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo.

ref: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
text: Awia, yaabalaa, ii banla n ɛɛ n nɛnɔŋŋaa la minna kɛlli ii ni, di kaa ɛɛ n bɔsɔna wia ani n huma tɔna la, ií lau nɛnnɛ di ra hiŋ yaa Dɔɔri hiŋaa.

ref: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
text: N na suŋŋi Yuodia ni Sintiki lugɔ bá kuari ba wia di dɔɔ nuukpaŋ yaa Dɔɔri hiŋaa naa ba maa n kpauwɛ ra hiŋ naa biini.

ref: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
text: N dɔŋhinnanii, n na suŋŋii, í hiini haana naa. Ba faa ɛɛ aniaa werge maa di hiiniŋ di ra hum amaniyesuma huma naa. Ba ni Klɛmɛnt ani nɛkpilaa faa kpauwɛ di hiiniŋ di ra hum a huma. Ba sɔna du Kɔraawiizi Miibɔɔ Hɔŋ la biinii.

ref: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
text: Ií gil ii bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔni ia yaa Dɔɔri fɔŋŋa biini. Wibii maa. Ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni ia.

ref: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
text: A wesso nɛr maa n zum ii wia lugɔ ii siwee pɛssɔɔrɛ. Yaa Dɔɔri balaa duglɔɔrɛ.

ref: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
text: Ií gilɛɛ gil wiimaa tir ia, ka kpa wiimaa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di ra suŋŋuu a wii wia ka ra jaamuu ani u huma.

ref: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
text: Denii ú ge tɛɛ ia u bampirsɔna la n kaali bampirsɔna dee maa newee n zummɛ. U daŋ wer tig ii bampiree di kuari ii nfɛssi tɛɛ ia dikuu iiŋ yardi Yeesu Kristo wia.

ref: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
text: Wii la maa iin nuuwɛ n be di sɛɛ ani wii la maa iin nuuwɛ di kaa na minna ɛɛ la, ií ge ra ɛɛ guŋ. Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛ bampirsɔna hiŋ la, waabuu niŋ du ii be. Sunzaazi jaantɛɛi wia

ref: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
text: N bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ werge maa yaa Dɔɔri hiŋaa naa biini, dikuu n wia n kaa tir ia wia. Ii faa ra hiinimbuu ka wa gil. A waa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ ii faa waa kaa ra binni n wia ni. Ka ii faa waa bɔr nawɛɛrɛ ií hiiniŋ.

ref: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
text: Maa nuumi lugɔ n nyaa kunaa. Akai. N wettoo helli bɔsɔna dɔɔi alugɔ di n du wii la maa biini, ka a guŋ ɔɔ kukkimbuu.

ref: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
text: Di n nyaawɔ, ka n zum u guŋ duirɛ. Di n kaa dɔɔ werge genii, ka n zum guŋ gba duirɛ. Di wiimaa wa huuziŋ, di diwee du de n di di piŋ, di diwee waa hoo n chɔɔ lɔzi, di n dɔɔwɔ werge gɛɛ dɔgnyaa n na di, ka aŋ wer kpogli bɛl maanii.

ref: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
text: N daŋ wer ɛɛ wiimaa unla n na hiiniŋ la fɔŋŋa biini.

ref: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
text: Ama, iiŋ kpa n wia di birgi ii maa wia di hiiniŋ n tɔɔrɔɔ dii naa biini la, ii ɛɛ nɛnnɛɛ.

ref: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
text: Ii gba zummɔ lugɔ saŋa la min lii Masɛdɔnia hɛri di feli lizi amaniyesuma di ra tɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra la n chaalɛɛ bola la, ba maa lɛi hiiniŋ. Ii Filipai hina bɛnnɛ birgi n hiine di ra hiiniŋ ni kebee dikuu gunla miŋ ge n wette hiini ia wia.

ref: Even when I was in Thessalonica, you helped me more than once.
text: Miŋ faa du Tɛsalɔnika la, ii faa wettoo di hiiniŋ. Kakpaŋ lɛi gba. Bunɛɛ maanii ii wer di tiliŋ kebee.

ref: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
text: Ka hiinaa lɛi n na binni. Tɔna la iin niŋ di dikuu iiŋ hiiniŋ la wiarɛ n na binni.

ref: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
text: N jaa na kunla maa min niŋ vii dɔɔ labuu di wa bɛri. N na ii sunzaa la maa iin sunziŋ labuu lii Ɛpafrɔdaitɔs be, di jaa dɔɔ kummaa. Ii sunzaa la ɛɛ mbusu lizaa la sɔɔh n summɛnɛ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di paruu.

ref: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
text: N Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi daŋ hiini ia ani kunla maa iin nyaawɛ di lii u daama la biini dikuu ii ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ la wia. U daama ge kannɔ di dɔɔ girme werge maa.

ref: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
text: Ií gil yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi na girme saŋa maa. Ami. Tuna jaamaa wia

ref: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
text: Too. Ií ra jaami banla maa n ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra di ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la. Ii balaa la n du n be bɔnnaa la ra jaami ia.

ref: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
text: Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la maanii ra jaami ia. Ka banla n du Koorizeŋ Siiza dia labuu hanna jaami ia werge.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
text: Yáa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo nɛsunaa ni u hiinaa du ii be. Ami.

ref: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
text: Mìŋ́ Yeesu Kristo huŋhunni Pɔɔllɛ ra sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛɛ ia. A par Kɔraawiizii u tɛŋ a huma.

ref: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
text: N ni yaa dɔŋhiŋ Timotii ra jaami yaabalaa la n du Kɔlɔsi di ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biinanaa di ra hiŋuu ani wibii la. Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hiini ia di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Jaantɛɛi ni wiisuŋŋaa wia

ref: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Yaa ɔɔ ŋɔ ii wiarɛ ra tɛɛ yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la, di ɔɔ ra jaamuu dikuu ii wia werge maa,

ref: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa nuuwɔ lugɔ ii dɔɔ Yeesu Kristo yardaa nɛnnɛ di kaa nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la maa nɛnnɛ,

ref: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
text: dikuu iin dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi bol ani suma la maa un dau ia de la tamii wia. Ii faa nuu Kɔraawiizi bol suma wiarɛ lii saŋa la Ɛpafras n felee ba ii be wa lizi amaniyesuma la n ɛɛ wibii tɛɛ ia la.

ref: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
text: Amaniyesuma wia ra yaaruu, nɛra ra sɛɛ a wia bɔkpila maa di jaa ra ɛɛ winanaa gunla ii ge n faa sɛɛ a wia di ra ɛɛ winanaa saŋa la iiŋ felee nuu a wia ii siwee pilli ii zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi suŋ ii ninɛɛ di hiini ia wibii maa la.

ref: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
text: Ɛpafras la n faa lizi amaniyesuma la tɛɛ ia la, u ni yaabuu kpauwɛ ra hum huma naa biini. Yaa nɔŋŋuubuu werge. U ɛɛ Kristo balii bɛl wia n dɔɔ wibiire di ra hiini yaa.

ref: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
text: Waabuu bagli yaa gunla Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii n na hiini ia ii wer nɔŋŋi dɔŋa.

ref: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
text: Awia, uŋ wa bagli yaa ii wia la, yaa ɔɔ jaa suŋŋi wiizi ra tɛɛ ia, di lii a saŋa hiŋ alugɔ ú Duma ra bagli ia u wia maa nɛnnɛ, di haa ra pilli ii siwee, ií wer zum wia la maa n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kipar,

ref: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
text: di wer ra hiŋ gunla n dɛkkɛ yaa Dɔɔri hiŋra n ninna hiŋ la, ií wiimaa wer paruu ií wer ra ɛɛ winanaa nɛnnɛ, di ɔɔ wer zum Kɔraawiizi ra jaa,

ref: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
text: di wer tɛɛ yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaam. Waabuu gillɛ yaa dɛg lugɔ yáa ni u biinanaa maa wer kpau di di u kapɛttɛ, saŋa la yaa n niŋ zuu u bolnanii la n na chaani la biini.

ref: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
text: Kɔraawiizi lɛɛ yaabuu lii bɔbiri fɔŋŋa be, di kpa yaa ga du u Biinɔŋŋii kora biini.

ref: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
text: Yaa waa wette ra na Kɔraawiizi. Ka gunla Kɔraawiizi n duwɛɛ, gunnɛ u Biibaal ge du. U Biibal hiŋ faa du denii ka kummaa haa wa du de.

ref: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
text: Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ kummaa lii u Biibaal la fɔŋŋa biini. Kuna la maa n du hɛri ani kuna la maa n du chiŋ, anla yaa n na na ani anla yaa n waa na, aliizinakpega ani fɔŋŋazi ni a dizi maa. A maa maanii u ta a du de ú ɛɛa u kipar.

ref: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
text: Saŋa la annii bɛl maa faa waa hoo ka u du de. U fɔŋŋa wiarɛ a maa haa wer du de filaŋkennaa la.

ref: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
text: U kaa ɛɛ u hiŋra maa nyuu. Ba ge ɛɛ u bɔrahɔŋ. U ɛɛ kummaa luglii. Waabuu feli nɛra maa di izi siu biini, dikuubɛɛwiai, a dɛkkɔɔ un niŋ tɔ see di ɛɛ nabɔma wiimaa biini.

ref: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
text: Kɔraawiizi kipar wiarɛ Yeesu ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa, u maa wa du u ni.

ref: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
text: U ɛɛ gunnɛ Yeésu wer kuari u ni kuna la maa n du chiŋ ni hɛri wia. U gillɔɔ u Biibaal Yeesu siu daakaŋlii la ni, ú chal wer kuari a wia maa, néwee ni Kɔraawiizi wer dɔɔ nuukpaŋ.

ref: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
text: Ii faa waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ ka ɛɛ u haahra dikuu nfɛrchɔgaa la iiŋ faa fɛwɛɛ ra du u ni la ani wichɔgaa la iiŋ faa ra ɛɛ la wia.

ref: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
text: Ka filaŋkeŋ, Kɔraawiizi Biibaal n siuwɛ naa, u kuari ii nuu wiarɛ, ií wer ɛɛ nɛnanaa la n waa doŋa maa dɔɔwɛ, di dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu bɛŋ, bá nyiŋŋi wichɔgii maa huhzi bá chug ia, ka ú ŋmɛnɛ wer kpa ia zuu Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
text: Di ii haa vɛɛwɔ dɔɔ ii hiŋaa fɔŋŋa, di lau kiŋkiŋ di ra hiŋ, kummaa waa ia ra bir har, ka ii ɔɔ dɔɔ tamii lii amaniyesuma la baŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ ia, ii nuu la biini alugɔ nɛr maa waa wette ú chɔg ii tamii la, amɔ, ii daŋ zuu Kɔraawiizi be. Ba ra lizi amaniyesuma naabuu bɔkpila maa. N gba ra ɛɛ gunnɛ dikuu Kɔraawiizi n tɛŋ a huma wia. Pɔɔl kuuhni dikuu Yeesu hiŋra wia

ref: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
text: N lɛɛ ii bɔttɛ ra di tɔɔrɔɔ filaŋkeŋ, ka n bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ. Tɔɔrɔɔ du de Kristo n niŋ haa di tɛɛ u hiŋra la n ɛɛ u bɔrahɔŋ la. Awia, n bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ min niŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ la n kawɛɛ la aŋhina á wer tuŋ.

ref: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
text: Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ n hum ra tɛɛ u hiŋra, á wer lii suma tɛɛ ia. U himmaanii tɛŋ a huma di ŋɔ ń na bagli u wiŋɔɔlaa la maa wa tuŋ.

ref: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
text: U wiŋɔzi hiŋ zɛɛ faa ɛɛ wisuahliirɛ faala hina maa be. Ka filaŋkennaa, Kɔraawiizi pilli a maanii tɛɛ u biinanaa

ref: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
text: gunla uŋ faa ra nyiŋŋi u ɛɛ la, bá wer zumaa di na gunla anna hum banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la biini, di ɛɛ winanaa werge maa la. U wisuahlii labuu keŋ. Kristo du ii biinee. Un du ii biine la, ii dɔɔ u tamiirɛ lugɔ ii daŋ ŋmɛnɛ wa na girme u be.

ref: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
text: Yaabuu wiŋɔzi maanii Kristo la. Yaa ra karfi nɛr maanii di ra bagli baa ani nunzuma maa, ya ŋmɛnɛ wer kpa baa bagli Kɔraawiizi ani baŋ dirmɛɛ nɛnnɛ ga tuŋ, dikuu ba ni Kristo n kpauwɛ wia.

ref: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
text: Awiarɛ n aah siwii ra hum di ra ɛɛ ania werge maa, Kristo ge ra jaaŋ fɔŋŋa werge maa n wer ra hum guŋ.

ref: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
text: N na nyiŋŋuu ii zum gunla miŋ aah siwii werge dikuu ii ni Laudisia hina ni banla n wan nawɛɛ wia

ref: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
text: ń wer du ii maa bɔkpega, ií maa wer nɔŋŋi dɔŋa di ɛɛ kpaŋ, di kaa wer zum Kɔraawiizi wia maa nɛnnɛ alugɔ ii waa kaa dɔɔ aanaa tama maa, di wer zum Kɔraawiizi wisuahlii la biini maa nɛnnɛ. U wisuahlii la ɛɛ Kristoo.

ref: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
text: N na bagli iabuu guŋ, nɛbɛl gilɛɛ wa kpa nuusuma dar ia.

ref: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
text: Maa hoo ii be ka n nfɛrɛwaa du ii benii. Awiarɛ n bɔra sɔɔni dikuu gunla ii maa n yardi Kristo nɛnnɛ, di lau chigigi di ra hiŋ la wia. Ií gil ii ni Yeesu kpau nɛnnɛ

ref: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
text: Awia, ií ra liizi gunla iiŋ felee sɛɛ Yeesu Kristo dɔɔra la, di haa ra hiŋuu ani guŋ yarda,

ref: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
text: di gil ii nuu kpau nɛnnɛ di ɔɔ ra helli u wia, ií wer yardi u wia maa nɛnnɛ gunla bam bagli ia la, di gil ii bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔni u wia, ií wer ra tɛu jaaŋ saŋa maa.

ref: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
text: Baglaa aŋhina du denii baŋhina ra bagli, di ra yiraa nunzuma, ka wipɛɛrii ba ra bagli di ra dar nɛra. Newea naana wiazi ani durnya nunzumazii ba ra bagli la. Awia, ii gilɛɛ gil ba kpa ba wiŋɔzi hiŋ lauri ia. Kristo wia lɛi annii.

ref: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
text: Di ii ni Kristo kpauwɔ, ii dɔɔ wiimaanii. Kristo ɛɛ fɔŋŋazi ni dɔɔra maa dɔɔrii.

ref: Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body.
text: Ii ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ la, u teŋ ii dubinii labuu ha. U ge hɛŋ teŋaare la. Awia, ii teŋaa la waa newea hor ɛɛwɛ.

ref: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
text: Baŋ faa sɔ ia Kɔraawiizi nii la, a guŋ faa baglɔɔrɛ lugɔ ii ni Yeesu maanii ba kpau hug. Ka Kɔraawiizi n lalli Yeesu la, di ii yardi Kɔraawiizi ni u fɔŋŋa la, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ii ni Yeesu maa kpauwɔɔ izi siu biini di wa dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi miibɔɔfalii la.

ref: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
text: Ii faa ɛɛ kunsiwaarɛ. Ii wichɔgaa ni ii dubinii la n faa waa teŋŋe ha la wiarɛ ii faa siu di ɛɛ kunsiwaa la. Ka ii ni Kristo n wa kpauwɛ la, Kɔraawiizi tɛɛ ii maanii miibɔɔfalii. Yaa wichɔgaa maanii u gil tɛɛ yaa.

ref: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
text: Nua la yaa n faa ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ yaa danna hiŋ u widaulaa ka yaa bir hiŋaa huhzi a tir yaa la, a maanii u duŋŋi ta. Wàá ka pɛɛzi yaa a wia. Kɔraawiizi kpa a maanii kpaahzi Yeesu daakaŋlii la ni a maa tuŋ.

ref: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
text: Yeesu n siuwɛ la, u chɔg kpeglega maa fɔŋŋazii ka jaa lɛɛ kpegzi dɔɔ, di kpa guŋ bagli nɛra baaŋ, bá zum alugɔ u gillɔɔ kpeglega la maa jaa bir pɛɛ.

ref: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
text: Awia, filaŋkeŋ, ii gilɛɛ kaa gil nɛr maa pɛɛzi ia ii diwee aŋhina dii, ii siŋ nyɔɔi ani ii hɔpizizenaa la dii, ii baagufalaa dii ani ii Heezaa Hɔpizii dii wia.

ref: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
text: Kristo la n ɛɛ yaa nyuu la lɛi u ra hiŋ. Yaa ɛɛ Kristo yeŋaa di ɔɔ na fɔŋŋa ani hiinaa u be di ɛɛ kpaŋ dikuu u wia di ra hel gunla n par Kɔraawiizi.

ref: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
text: Di ii ni Kristo kpauwɔ siu, amɔ, ii ni durnya wiazi la waa kaa dɔɔ wiimaa. Too. Bɛɛ wiarɛ ii ɔɔ ra hiŋ durnya wiazi alugɔ ii ni durnya haa dɔɔ wia aŋhinaawɛi? Bɛɛ wiarɛ ii ɔɔ haa ra kii newea widaulaa lai,

ref: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
text: “di ra ɔm kuna gbɔgzaa, di kaa ra ɔm aŋhina diiyei”?

ref: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
text: A kuna ɛɛ bɛɛwɛi? Di ii ɛɛa, a waa ɔɔ tunaa? A waa ɔɔ siuwaa? Di ii ra hiŋ guŋ, newea naana wia ani durnya nunzumazii ii ra hiŋ la.

ref: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
text: Nɛra danna tɔgzi banla n na hiŋ guŋ alugɔ ba ɛɛ nunzunnaa di ra binni lugɔ wiijaamaa n du ba bampiree werge wiarɛ ba kpa bahinaa fugzi di ra tɔɔri ba bɔrahɔna. Ka annii maa pɛɛrɛ. A wàá wer gil nɛr maa wer lau u hiŋ di wer gil wichɔgaa ɛɛi.

ref: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
text: Di ii ni Kristo maanii kpauwɛ izi siu biini, amɔ, ií aah siwii ra nyiŋŋi Kɔraawiizi bol wia. Kristo du Kɔraawiizi nabɔmbɔttɛ de.

ref: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
text: Ií gil ii nfɛssi maa du Kɔraawiizi bol la wia ni, di gilɛɛ kaa gil a kaa du durnya wia biini,

ref: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ii siuwɔɔ. Filaŋkeŋ ii du Kristo ninɛɛ. Waabuu ɛɛ ii miibɔɔ. Kristo ge du Kɔraawiizi ni.

ref: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
text: Kristo n ɛɛ yaa miibɔɔ la, di u kaa wa ba durnya, denii ií nuu maa kpau ba a saŋa di dɔɔ girme u balaa la biini. Dubinii ni ufalii wia

ref: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
text: Awia, ií gil ii dubinii la maa siu. Ií gilɛɛ kpa ii bɔrahɔna ra sɛm di ra ɛɛ wikuna, di ra hum hunchɔgaa dikuu ii kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa wia la, di dɔɔ kuna kɛkɛluu. Kuna kɛkɛluu ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ vuga tɔgzaa.

ref: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
text: Kɔraawiizi baaŋ du wia naa ninɛɛ. U daŋ ŋmɛnɛ tɔɔri banla n ɛɛ dignikpega hina di ra ɛɛ gunla.

ref: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
text: Ii ni baabuu faa kpauwɛ ra ɛɛ a wichɔgaa.

ref: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
text: Ka filaŋkeŋ, a dɛkkɔ iiŋ jaa gil a wia maa ha. Ií gil baaŋ wia la maa di gilɛɛ dɔɔ nuukpol nɛra ni, ni miisɔɔh, di gilɛɛ ra gbɛlli ii dɔŋahina, di gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ nuuchɔgaa ra du dɔŋa,

ref: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
text: di gilɛɛ ra kanni kara. Iin lizi ii dubinii la ha la, annii maanii ii lizi ha la.

ref: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
text: Dufaliirɛ ii jaa du filaŋkeŋ la. Kɔraawiizi la n tɛɛ ia dufalii la, waabuu ra kuaruu saŋa maa, ú wer ɛɛ dunanii gunla u hor n duwɛɛ la, ií wer zum Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ wa tuŋ.

ref: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
text: Banla n dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi dunanii la, ba waa kaa ra binni nɛra wijigzi biini. Ba waa kaa ra binni lugɔ unnii ɛɛ Jus hinuurɛ, ka unnii waa Jus hinuu ɛɛwɛ. Ba waa kaa ra binni lugɔ unnii teŋ u hɛnnɛ, ka unnii waa u hɛŋ teŋŋe. Ba waa kaa ra binni lugɔ unnii ɛɛ hɔɔhrii, ka unnii waa hɔɔhri ɛɛwɛ. Ba waa kaa ra binni lugɔ unnii ɛɛ yonne ka unnii ɛɛ nɛr la n dɔɔ u hiŋ. Akai. Kristo du u hiŋra la maa biinii. U guŋ bɛnnɛ bá ra binni.

ref: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
text: Di ii bɛl maa ni u dɔŋhiŋ dɔɔ wii, ú di kanyitti ka gil tɛu. Kɔraawiizi faa gil ii wichɔgaarɛ tɛɛ ia. Awia, ií ge gil ra tɛɛ ii dɔŋahina.

ref: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
text: Ií ra ɛɛ annii maa ka kpa dɔnnɔŋŋaa su siwii. Dɔnnɔŋŋaa labuu niŋ gil ii wer ɛɛ anniizi maa nɛnnɛ ga tuŋ.

ref: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
text: Ií gil Kristo bampirsɔna dɔɔi du ii bampiree di kuaraa nɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizii yir ia ii maa ɛɛ kpaŋ di wer dɔɔ bampirsɔna la. Ií gil ii biine sɔɔni, ií ɔɔ wer ra tɛu jaaŋ.

ref: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
text: Ií gil Kristo wiŋɔzi la du ii bampiree nɛnnɛ di baglaa ra tɛɛ dɔŋa, di ra ŋɔ dɔŋa be bá ra dazi wichɔgaa ɛɛi. Ií ra bagli baa guŋ ani nunzuma biini di yir yira ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di ra jaamuu werge maa dikuu u jaamaa n du ii bampiree wia.

ref: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
text: Wii la maa iin niŋ ɛɛ ani wii la maa iin niŋ ŋɔ, ií ra ɛɛa ani yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu sɔŋ di ra jaami yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ani Yeesu sɔŋ. Yeesu hiŋra diini hina widaulaa wia

ref: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
text: Haana, ií ra sɛɛ ii janna dɔɔra, dikuubɛɛwiai, a dɛkkɔɔ Yeesu hiŋra n na ɛɛ guŋ.

ref: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
text: Baala, ií nɔŋŋi ii haana nɛnnɛ, di gilɛɛ ra ɛɛ baa nuukpol.

ref: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
text: Biizi, ií nuu ra tɛɛ ii mɛɛwaa ani ii maawaa wiimaa bɔr, dikuubɛɛwiai, gunnɛ ra par ii Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi.

ref: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
text: Mɛɛwaa, ii gilɛɛ ra nuu ii biizi nuuzi ba biine ra chɔgi.

ref: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
text: Balaa ge, ií ra hiŋ ii dɔɔra nuuzi wiimaa bɔr di gilɛɛ ra hum fɔŋŋa ni saŋa la iiŋ wa du nɛra baaŋ dikuu sɔŋ wia, ka ra hum ni bampirkpaŋ dikuu iinna ɔm ii Dɔɔri Kristo wia.

ref: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
text: Wii la maa iin niŋ ɛɛ, ií ra ɛɛu ani ii fɔŋŋa maa ra tɛɛ ii Dɔɔri Kristo. Nɛra lɛi ii hum ra tɛɛ.

ref: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
text: Ii Dɔɔri Kristoo ii hum ra tɛɛ la. Ii daŋ ŋmɛnɛ na ii kinturgaa un dau ia.

ref: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
text: Nɛr la n wɔɔ ra hum nɛnnɛ ka ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa, u daŋ na u wichɔgaa ge kinturgaa u be. Kristo waa baŋhina ra tɔgzi kaali baŋhina.

ref: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
text: Ii banla n dɔɔ balaa, ií ra ɛɛ baa nɛnnɛ di dɔɔ wibii ba be. Ii gba dɔɔ dɔɔrii Kɔraawiizi bol. Baglaazi wia

ref: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
text: Ií aah siwii ra jaami Kɔraawiizi saŋa maa di gilɛɛ ra ɛɛ u guŋ bɔhuaih, ka ɔɔ gil u wia dɔɔ jaaŋ ii biine.

ref: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
text: Ií suŋŋi wiizi ra tɛɛ yaa gba ú pilli ŋmɛnɛɛ tɛɛ yaa ya wer bagli u wiŋɔzi di wer bagli u wisuahlii wia. Waabuu Kristo wia la. A wiŋɔzi wiarɛ ba lawiŋ tɔ dia naa.

ref: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
text: Ií ra suŋŋuu ń wer ra baglaa nɛnnɛ gunla n dɛkkɛ min ninna bagli, á maa chaani nɛnnɛ.

ref: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
text: Ií ra du ii nuuzi tau ka ií wiŋɔzi maa wer du wer di du sum, di ba wa pɛɛzi ia wii la maa, ií wer na u ŋmɛnɛɛ tɛɛ baa. Tuna jaamaazi wia

ref: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
text: Too. Tichikus daŋ bagli n wia maa tɛɛ ia. Yaa maa nɛnɔŋŋiirɛ a Tichikus. U ra hiini yaabuu, yaa Dɔɔri huma naa biini. U wia dɔɔ wibiire.

ref: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
text: N humuubuu ú wer bagli ia yaa wia maa, di wer du ia bɔkpega.

ref: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
text: U ni Ɔnɛsimus maanii ra ba. Ɔnɛsimus hiŋ ɛɛ ii bɛllɛ. U gba ɛɛ yaa nɛnɔŋŋiirɛ. U wia dɔɔ wibiire. Nɛra banɛɛ naabuu niŋ bagli ia wia la maa n ɛɛwɛ bɔnnaa.

ref: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
text: Ba tɔ n ni baal bɛllɛ dia ɛŋ. U sɔnnɛ Aristakus. U ni Banabas niwee Maak la ra jaami ia. N faa ŋɔ a Maak wiarɛ tɛɛ ia lugɔ di u ŋmɛnɛ wa ba ii be, ií dawuu nɛnnɛ.

ref: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
text: Jisɛs la banna yir Justus la gba ra jaami ia. Nɛra bahoro naa bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Jus hina di sɛɛ Yeesu wia di ra hiiniŋ ani Kɔraawiizi Kora huma wia bɔnnaa. Ba ra hiinimbuu werge.

ref: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
text: Ɛpafras gba ɛɛ ii bɛllɛ. U ra jaami ia. U gba ra hum Yeesu Kristo humaa di ɔɔ suŋŋi wiizi werge maa ra tɛɛ ia ú gil ii wer lau nɛnnɛ di zum u wia nɛnnɛ ga tuŋ, Krísto wia gilɛɛ kaa dɔɔ aana maa ii be ka ií wer ra sɛɛ u kipar la maa nɛnnɛ.

ref: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
text: Ɛpafras hummɔɔ ra tɛɛ ii ni banla maa n du Laudisia ni Hiɛrapɔlis biini werge maa gba.

ref: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
text: Nɛchaari Luuk la yaa maa n nɔŋŋɛɛ la ni Dɛmas gba ra jaami ia.

ref: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
text: Ií jaami Yeesu hiŋra la n du Laudisia tɛɛ yaa ni Nimfa ani Yeesu hiŋra la n ɔɔ chaali u dia la.

ref: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
text: Di ii wa karmi hɔnnaa tuŋ, ií gil ba la ga karmuu tɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra la n du Laudisia la. Ba gba daŋ bir kpa hɔŋ bɛl tɛɛ ia ií ge karmi.

ref: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
text: N ŋɔ ií ŋɔ wii bɛllɛ tɛɛ Aakipus, dí, ú ra hum huma la maa Kɔraawiizi n tɛu la ga tuŋ.

ref: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
text: N himmaanii sɛbɛɛ bɔnnaa ra jaami ia. Ií ra liizi n wia nɛnnɛ lugɔ ba haa tɔmbuu dia. Kɔ́raawiizi hiini ia.

ref: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
text: Mìŋ́ Pɔɔl ni Silvanus ni Timotii ra sɛbi hɔnnaa ra tɛɛ ii banla n ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra di du Tɛsalɔnika di ra sɛɛ yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo dɔɔra la. Kɔ́raawiizi hiini ia di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Tɛsalɔnika hina de dui ni ba yarda wia

ref: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
text: Yaa ra tɛɛ yaa mɛɛ Kɔraawiizii jaaŋ saŋa maa dikuu ii maa wia di ɔɔ ra suŋŋuu ra tɛɛ ia

ref: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
text: di ŋɔ ra tɛu gunla iiŋ ɔɔ ra hum u huma dikuu iiŋ yarduu wia, di ra kuuh u kuuhni dikuu iin nɔŋŋuu werge wia, di ra hiŋuu ni kanyitti dikuu iinna ɛɛ yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo tamii wia.

ref: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
text: Yaabalaa, ii banla Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋɛɛ la, yaa zummɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizii lizi ia tɛɛ u hiŋ,

ref: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, a hɔl la iiŋ faa nuu yaa amaniyesuma la, a faa waa wiŋɔdumazi ɛɛwɛ ii be. A dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa. Kɔraawiizi Dumnaniirɛ tɛɛ a wiŋɔzi hiŋ fɔŋŋa. Ii bɛl maa waa wette ú kaa aanaa tama maa. Ii faa ra na yaa wiɛɛlaa maa yaa n faa ra ɛɛu di ra bagli ia,

ref: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
text: di hiŋ yaa ni yaa Dɔɔri. Iin sɛɛ a wiŋɔzi la wia, ba tɔɔri ia werge. Ka Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii gil ii bɔra sɔɔni ia werge maa.

ref: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
text: Awia, banla maa n yardi Yeesu di du Masɛdɔnia ni Akaaya la ra hiŋ gunla iinna hiŋuu.

ref: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
text: Ii benii ba nuu yaa Dɔɔri wia. Ba bɛŋ lɛi nuu yaa Dɔɔri wia ii be. Yemmaanii nɛra du di ra nuu ii wia lugɔ ii yardi Kɔraawiizii. A waa kaa ɛɛ lugɔ ya ŋɔ ii wia tɛɛ nɛra.

ref: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
text: A nɛra maa ɔɔ ra bagli yaabuu gunla iin nuu yaa be di gil vuga kuaraa ka bir ra hiŋ Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa di dɔɔ miibɔɔ la ra hum u huma

ref: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
text: di ra kpaŋ u bie la n niŋ wa lii chiŋ ba la. Waabuu Yeesu la uŋ faa lalli siu biini la. Waabuu niŋ lizi yaa Kɔraawiizi baaŋ la n niŋ ŋmɛnɛ wa fuuh di chɔgi nɛra la biini.

ref: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
text: Yaabalaa, ii himmaa zummɔ lugɔ yaa n faa ba ii be la, yaa faa waa ii be ballɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.

ref: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
text: Ii zum gunla baŋ faa ɛɛ yaa wichɔgaa di gbɛlli yaa werge maa Filipai mɔɔ ka yaa hel ii be Tɛsalɔnika labuu. Baŋ faa tɔɔri yaa werge la, ka yaa faa dɔɔ bampiriire Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini di wer lizi amaniyesuma tɛɛ ia la.

ref: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
text: Yaa wiŋɔzi la yaa n faa ŋɔ ii be di ra fɔrgi ia ŋɔ ií nuu la, a maa deŋloore. Wikuna wia lɛi yaa faa ba. Yaa faa waa nyiŋŋi ya dar nɛr maa di ra ŋɔ a wiŋɔzi la.

ref: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
text: Ii zummɔ lugɔ yaa n faa ra bagli wia la, yaa faa waa ii nyuuni a du di ra dar ia. Yaa faa waa nɛra a fugzi dikuu kuna kɛkɛluu wia. Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ yaa daansɛɛ hiŋ.

ref: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
text: Ka yaa n faa du ii be la, yaa faa pɛssɔɔrɛ di ra kpogli ia gunla haaŋ n ɔɔ ra kpogli u bie la.

ref: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
text: Yaa nɔŋŋi iabuu werge. Kɔraawiizi amaniyesuma bɛŋ wia lɛi faa aah yaa siwii. Ii wiarɛ du yaa bampiree werge, yaa faa hum ra tɛɛ ia ni yaa biine maa.

ref: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
text: Ii waa liizi gunla yaa n faa ra hum saŋa maa di ra kuuh werge maa laa? Yaa faa ra ɛɛ gunnɛ ya gilɛɛ waa du ii be di lizi amaniyesuma la di ra tɛɛ ia ka ra du ia tɔɔrɔɔ dikuu diwee wia.

ref: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
text: Ii banla n yardi Yeesu la ɛɛ yaa daansɛɛ hinaa. Kɔraawiizi ge ɛɛ yaa daansɛɛ hiŋ. Yaa ɛɛ wia la n na par Kɔraawiizi bɛnnɛ. Yaa wiimaa faa waa leuwe.

ref: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
text: Yaa faa kpogli ii maanii lugɔ ii mɛɛwaarɛ yaa. Yaa faa bagli iabuu ŋmɛnɛɛ di ɔɔ faa du ia bɔkpega

ref: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
text: di ra karfi ia ŋɔ ií ra ɛɛ wia la n niŋ par Kɔraawiizi. Waabuu yir ia ii ba wa du u kora biini di dɔɔ girme.

ref: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
text: Wii bɛllɛ haa du de n na liizi di ra jaami Kɔraawiizi alugɔ yaa n faa ba ii be di wa ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wia ii nuu, ii waa binnɛɛ lugɔ newea wia la. Ii sɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ a lii Kɔraawiizi benii. Wibiire. Kɔraawiizi wiarɛ yaa faa ra ŋɔ la. U wettoo hum u huma ii banla n yarduu la ni.

ref: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
text: Yaabalaa, wia la n wa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaama la n du Juda hɛri di ra hiŋ Yeesu Kristo la, a wia himmaanii wa ɛɛ ia la. Ii himmaa hɛri hina tɔɔri iabuu gunla Jus hina n faa ra tɔɔri ba ge Yeesu hiŋra la.

ref: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
text: Jus hinaa faa kpu Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi la. Baŋhina kpu yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu. Baŋhina kaa duŋŋi yaa ge. Nɛra naa wia waa Kɔraawiizi a par. Ba ɛɛ newea maa dɔmaa,

ref: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa faa ra nyiŋŋi ya ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔzii tɛɛ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ Kɔ́raawiizi lɛɛ baa ha, ka ba faa waa sɛɛwɛ. Ba wichɔgaa keeziŋkee guŋ. Kɔraawiizi baaŋ kannɔɔ ba ni filaŋkeŋ. U daŋ jaa du baa tɔɔrɔɔ. Pɔɔl n na nyiŋŋi ú kaa na Tɛsalɔnika hina wia

ref: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
text: Yaa ge, baŋ faa bargi yaa lii ii be la, yaa waa kaa wer na dɔŋa a hɔpizaa anɛɛ biini, ka yaa nfɛssiwaa faa haa du ii be. Yaabalaa, yaa faa ra kɛlli ii ninɛɛ werge maa, di ra ɛɛ ania maa ya wer na ia.

ref: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
text: Iabuu niŋ ɛɛ yaa tamii di gil yaa bɔra sɔɔni, yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu balaa saŋa.

ref: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
text: Denii ii wia n tir yaa werge di wa bɛri la, yaa sɛɛ lugɔ ya hum yaa niwee Timoti ii be ka ra kpaŋuu Atɛns.

ref: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
text: Yaa nuu maanii kpauwɛ ra hum Kɔraawiizi huma di ra lizi amaniyesuma la di lii Kristo wia biini. Yaa humuubuu ú wa du ia bɔkpega di ra hiini ia ií wer yardi Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ

ref: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
text: di gilɛɛ waa bir har dikuu banna tɔɔri ia wia. Tɔɔrɔɔ ɛɛ yaa widauliirɛ. Ii gba zum guŋ.

ref: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
text: Yaa faa feloore karfi ia saŋa la yaa n faa du ii be la alugɔ ba danna tɔɔri yaa. Ii zummɔ lugɔ gunla yaa n faa ŋɔwɛɛ la, guŋ himmaanii wa ɛɛwɛ. Timoti bɔkpega wiŋɔzi wia

ref: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
text: Awia, ii wia n tiriŋ werge la, maa wette ń suuh ii wia. Awiarɛ n lau Timoti hum ii be ŋɔ ú wa binni ia na, di ii haa yardɔɔ gɛɛ, gɛɛ ii waa kaa yardɛi, Sitaani gilɛɛ wa ɛɛ ia di na ií sɛɛ u nua, yaa huma chɔgi di bir pɛɛ.

ref: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
text: U la ii be ka bir ba yaa be filaŋkeŋ. U amaniye uŋ wa lizɛɛ tɛɛ yaa summɔɔ werge. U wa ŋɔ yaa benii gunla iin yardi Kɔraawiizi di nɔŋŋi nɛra, di kaa ŋɔ lugɔ ii haa ra liizi yaa wiarɛ ni nfɛrnanaarɛ, di ra nyiŋŋi ií na yaa siwee gunla yaa ge n na nyiŋŋi ya na ii siwee la.

ref: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
text: Awia, yaabalaa, haali yaa n du tɔɔrɔɔ ni dɔgnya biini filaŋkennaa, ka yaa bampiree tikkoo dikuu ii wia. Ii yarda labuu tig yaa bampiree la.

ref: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
text: Di ii lau nɛnnɛ ra hiŋ yaa Dɔɔri, yaa ge daŋ dɔɔ bampirkpaŋ ii ni.

ref: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
text: Yaa waa zum gunla yaa n niŋ kaa jaami Kɔraawiizi dikuu ii wia. Di yaa ŋɔ ii wia ra tɛu, yaa bɔra ɔɔ sɔɔni yaabuu werge maa di wa bɛri.

ref: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
text: Yaa ra suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii saŋa maa ni yaa bampiree maa, ú vii gil yaa himmaa siwee vii kaa na ia, ya wer keezi hiini ia ií kaa yardi jaa.

ref: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
text: Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo tɛɛ yaa ŋmɛnɛɛ ya wer ba ii be.

ref: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
text: Yáa Dɔɔri hiini ia ií wer nɔŋŋi dɔŋa ni nɛr maa di ga bɛri alugɔ yaa ge n nɔŋŋi ia kennaa.

ref: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
text: Denii ii wer dɔɔ bɔkpega ii hiŋaa biini, di yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu ni banla maa n ɛɛ u hora wa ballɔ, ií wer chi yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi be ani biinihuŋŋu, doŋa maa wàá ka pɛli ia.

ref: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
text: Yaabalaa, ii nuuwɔ lii yaa be gunla an dɛkkɛ iin ninna hiŋ á ra par Kɔraawiizi. A guŋ hiŋaarɛ ii ra hiŋ la. Ka yaa ra ŋɔ ii benii di ra suŋŋi ia ani Yeesu sɔŋ, ií ra hiŋ guŋ di haa ra jaa.

ref: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
text: Ii zum wibaglaa la yaa n bagli ia ani yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu sɔŋ labuu.

ref: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
text: Kɔraawiizi ra nyiŋŋuu ií maa wer ɛɛ nɛnanaa la n waa doŋa maa dɔɔwɛ, di gil sɛnsɛŋ wia maa ha kɔrai.

ref: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
text: Ií gilɛɛ ra sɛm di ra kpa haana lugɔ banla n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ n na ɛɛ la.

ref: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
text: Ií gilɛɛ gil báal maa waa ɛɛ u dɔŋhiŋ wichɔgaa ani hahkpai bɔr. Yaa faa kali iabuu wia naa di faa karfi ia werge maa lugɔ banla maa n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa kennaa naa, Kɔraawiizi daŋ turgi baa a wichɔgaa kim.

ref: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
text: Kɔraawiizi waa yaa lizɛɛ ŋɔ ya vol di ra ɛɛ wikuna. U lizi yaabuu ŋɔ ya ra ɛɛ winanaa bɛŋ.

ref: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
text: Awia, nɛr la maa n niŋ vɛɛ baglaa naa, newee nua lɛi u vɛɛ. Kɔraawiizi la n kpa u Dumnanii du ii ni la nuarɛ u vɛɛ.

ref: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
text: A waa wizeŋ ɛɛwɛ min niŋ sɛbi tɛɛ ia gunla iin niŋ nɔŋŋi ii dɔŋa Yeesu hiŋra. Kɔraawiizi bagli iabuu dɔnnɔŋŋaa,

ref: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
text: ii nɔŋŋi yaabalaa la maa n du Masɛdɔnia hɛri la. Ama yaa ra suŋŋi iabuu ií haa ra ɛɛ guŋ di ra jaa.

ref: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
text: Ií ra ɛɛ ania di ra hum ii huma bɔɔiih, di gilɛɛ ra zuu ii dɔŋahina wia biini. Ií ra di ii himmaa kuuhni biini gunla yaa n faa bagli ia la.

ref: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
text: Di ii ra ɛɛ guŋ, banla n waa Kɔraawiizi yardɛɛ la danna tɔgzi ia. Ii wàá ra binni nɛr maa ni ú tɛɛ ia kummaa. Yaa Dɔɔri balaa wia

ref: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
text: Yaabalaa, n na nyiŋŋi lugɔ ií zum wibii di lii banla n siuwɛ la wia biini á gilɛɛ ɛɛ ia biinichɔg werge lugɔ anna ɛɛ banla n waa tamii dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
text: Yaa sɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ Yeesu siuwɔɔ ka bir izi siu biini. Awia, yaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizii yarda lugɔ u daŋ lalli banla n faa sɛɛ u wia ka siuzi la gunla un lalli Yeesu la, ka kpa baa ba saŋa la un niŋ kaa ba la.

ref: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
text: Kɔraawiizi baglaarɛ yaa ra bagli la. Yaa Dɔɔri daŋ ŋmɛnɛ bir ba. Yaa banla n niŋ haa du de di ra nyiŋ a saŋa, yaa wàá tɔ banla n siuzɛɛ la see di hiŋuu kaali.

ref: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
text: Nɛra daŋ ŋmɛnɛ nuu yaa Dɔɔri pogzaa ni u mɛlikazi nabɔma loobii ni u bensunoniina gbɔga. Denii ií na yaa Dɔɔri himmaa n lii chiŋ di ra tuu. Denii ú jaa lalli banla maa n faa sɛɛ u wia ka siu la,

ref: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
text: ka jaa too yaa banla ge n kawɛɛ di ra nyiŋ la kakpaŋ yáa maa kpau izi chiŋ di zuu baama biini di ga huuzi yaa Dɔɔri chiŋ di ga du u be saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
text: Yaabalaa, a waa wizeŋ ɛɛwɛ min niŋ sɛbi wia naa ni a saŋazi tɛɛ ia,

ref: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ii himmaa zummɔɔ nɛnnɛ lugɔ yaa Dɔɔri hɔpizii la daŋ ba gunla ŋmɛɛŋ n ɔɔ ba hamuŋa ni la.

ref: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
text: Saŋa la ban ninna ŋɔ lugɔ ba nuu sumaa filaŋkeŋ, ba waa kaa ra ɔm wiimaa la, kakpaŋ, di wia jaa ba, ba maa siuzi. Ba bɛl maa wàá lii a wia biini. A daŋ pirgi baa lugɔ haaŋ n ɔɔ kpogli hia u wiii wa pirguu la.

ref: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
text: Ka yaabalaa, ii waa bɔbiri duwɛɛ á hɔpizii wa pirgi ia lugɔ ŋmɛɛŋ.

ref: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
text: Ii maa ɛɛ bɔchaaŋ hinaa di du hɔpizaa biini. Yaa waa hamuŋa ni bɔbiri hina ɛɛwɛ.

ref: People sleep during the night, and some even get drunk.
text: Hamuŋa biinii nɛra ɔɔ ra chɔɔ dɔzi, baŋhina ge ra dɛɛzi.

ref: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
text: Ka yaabuu n du bɔchaaŋ biini la, ya lau yaa hinaa wiimaa biini di ra du tau. Ya kpa yarda ni nɛnɔŋŋaa teŋ yaa bampiree, di kaa kpa yaa lɛɛi tamii di guu yaa nyuuni.

ref: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Kɔraawiizi waa yaa lizɛɛ ya waa di tɔɔrɔɔ u baaŋfuuih biini. U lizi yaabuu ya wer na lɛɛi dikuu yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo wia.

ref: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
text: Waabuu siuwɛ tɛɛ yaa, di u kaa wa ba, di yaa haa ra nyiŋ gɛɛ di yaa siuzɔɔ ka yaa maa wer du u be di dɔɔ miibɔɔ.

ref: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
text: Awia, ií ra tig dɔŋa bampiree di ra hiini dɔŋa ií maa wer lau nɛnnɛ gunla iiŋ ɔɔ ra ɛɛ la. Tuna baglaazi wia

ref: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
text: Yaa ra suŋŋi ia, yaabalaa, ií ra tɔgzi banla yaa Dɔɔri n lizɛɛ ba ɛɛ ii nabɔnzi di ra hum u huma werge di ra bagli ia ŋmɛnɛɛ la.

ref: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
text: Ií ra kpa baa girme nɛnnɛ di nɔŋŋi baa dikuu huma la banna hum la wia. Ií maa dɔɔ nuukpaŋ dɔŋa ni.

ref: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
text: Yaa ra ŋɔ ii benii ií ra karfi yaara hina, di ra hiini banla ge n na ɔm la, bá wer dɔɔ bampirii di ra hiini gɛrga di dɔɔ kanyitti nɛr maa be.

ref: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
text: Ií gilɛɛ gil nɛ́r maa kpa wichɔgaa turgi wichɔgaa kim. Ií ɛɛ ania di ra ɛɛ ii dɔŋahina ni nɛr maa winanaa bɛŋ.

ref: and never stop praying.
text: di ra suŋŋi wiizi saŋa maa

ref: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
text: di ɔɔ ra tɛu jaaŋ wii la maa biini iin duwɛɛ. Gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi ra nyiŋŋi ii ra ɛɛ, ií maa wer lau guŋ nɛnnɛ, di ra hiŋ Yeesu Kristo.

ref: Don't turn away God's Spirit
text: Ií gilɛɛ ra teŋ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii la huma,

ref: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
text: Ií pessi wiimaa di ra na. Di u wesso, ií lawuu kpogli.

ref: and don't have anything to do with evil.
text: Ií gil wii la maa dee n waa wer.

ref: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
text: Kɔraawiizi la n ɔɔ ra tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna la, ú lizi doŋa maa ii ni ha, ií nfɛssi ni ii dunzi maa wer du wer di ra la saŋa la yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo n niŋ wa ba la.

ref: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
text: Waabuu yir ia ii ba u be. U wia dɔɔ wibiire. Awia, waabuu niŋ gil a maa wa ɛɛ.

ref: Friends, please pray for us.
text: Yaabalaa, ií ra suŋŋi wiizi di ra tɛɛ yaa gba

ref: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
text: di ra jaami yaabalaa la maa nɛnnɛ.

ref: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
text: N na ŋɔ i benii ni Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ, ií wa karmi hɔnnaa tɛɛ yaabalaa la maa.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
text: Yáa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo nɛsunaa du ii be.

ref: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Mìŋ́ Pɔɔl, Silvanus ani Timotii ra sɛbi hɔnnaa ra tɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra la n du Tɛsalɔnika, di ɛɛ yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hora la.

ref: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
text: Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Jaantɛɛi ni wiisuŋŋaa wia

ref: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
text: Yaa ɔɔ ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizii jaaŋ dikuu ii wia, yaabalaa. Ii dɛg gunnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii yarda la iiŋ yardi Kɔraawiizi la ra jaau werge maa. Nɔŋŋaa la ii bɛl maa n nɔŋŋi dɔŋa ge gba ra jaa werge.

ref: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
text: Yaa himmaa ɔɔ ra ŋɔ ii wiarɛ Yeesu hiŋra la n du bɔr maa la be di ra chɔli ia di ra ŋɔ gunla baŋ tɛɛ ia tɔɔrɔɔ kpila a nuu ia werge maa, ka ii di kanyitti ka haa vɛɛ ra hiŋ di yardi Yeesu la.

ref: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
text: Ii wiɛɛlaa naa ra bagluu nɛnnɛ lugɔ seriya la Kɔraawiizi n diwee tɛɛ ia la deŋloore. Iinna di tɔɔrɔɔ dikuu u kora wia filaŋkennaa, guŋ daŋ gil ii dɛg u Kora la biini zuui.

ref: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
text: Ka banla n na tɔɔri ia lawaa, Kɔraawiizi daŋ turgi baa a kim. U guŋ deŋloore. U tɛɛ baa ge tɔɔrɔɔ,

ref: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
text: ka gil ií ge heezi. Yaa ni ii maanii niŋ na heezaa u be saŋa la un niŋ gil ya na yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo la n niŋ lii chiŋ ni u mɛlikakpega ni ninlau ba la.

ref: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
text: Un niŋ wa ba la, u daŋ turgi banla n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ, ba waa sɛɛwɛ bá nuu yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo amaniyesuma la ba wichɔgaa kim

ref: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
text: di bargi baa u be. Ba wàá na u girme ni u fɔŋŋazeŋ la, ka u daŋ kpa chɔgaa la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ ta ba ni

ref: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
text: u hɔpizizenzeŋ la un niŋ ba wa na girme u biinanaa be la. Banla maa n faa yarduu, ii ni ba maanii niŋ nau di chɔluu a hɔl, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa n faa bagli ia u wia la, ii faa sɛɛ yaa daansɛɛ la yaa n diwee tɛɛ ia labuu.

ref: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
text: Yeesu balaa naa wiarɛ yaa ɔɔ ra suŋŋi wiizi ra tɛɛ ia, ú hiini ia ií wer dɛg hiŋaa naa uŋ yir ia ii ra hiŋ naa, di tɛɛ ia fɔŋŋa ií wer ɛɛ winanaa la maa n du ii bampiree ani wii la maa iiŋ ŋɔ ií ɛɛ dikuu iiŋ yardi Kɔraawiizi wia.

ref: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
text: Yaa ra suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii guŋ yáa Dɔɔri Yeesu sɔŋ wer na girme lii ii wia biini, ií ge gba wer na girme lii u ge wia biini. Yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo n suŋ yaa ni, di hiini yaa wiarɛ annii maa wa wer ɛɛ la.

ref: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo balaa wia naa ni gunla yaa maa n niŋ chaali u be naa, n na suŋŋi ia, yaabalaa,

ref: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
text: ií zum a wia nɛnnɛ. Maa nyiŋŋi nɛr maa wer ŋɔ witama keŋ ii banchulli tenna lɔ ii ra fɛ lugɔ yaa Dɔɔri hɔpizii la teŋ ballɔɔ. Di ba ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi Dumaa bagli baa guŋ ba ra ŋɔ, di ii nuu guŋ nɛr maa be, gɛɛ di ii na hɔŋ bɛl ba dar ia lugɔ yaabuu sɛbuu, ka ii gilɛɛ sɛɛ di gil u guŋ tir ia.

ref: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
text: A hiŋ daŋ naa kunla maa nɛra n na tɔgzi di ra jaami la, di kpa u hiŋ bɔ a maa, di kaa kpa Kɔraawiizi Dia la birgi u sognibɔr, di ŋɔ lugɔ waabuu Kɔraawiizi.

ref: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
text: Ii waa liizi miŋ faa ɔɔ ra bagli ia guŋ saŋa la miŋ faa du ii be laa?

ref: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
text: Ii zum kunla n na teŋuu ŋmɛnɛɛ ú gilɛɛ wer lii mɔɔ ka ú saŋa wa hel tuŋ labuu.

ref: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
text: Ama, gbɔg chɔgaa wia teŋ du denii, ka a wàá wer tɔ see mɔɔ, di ba waa kunla n na teŋaa ŋmɛnɛɛ la lizɛɛ lɛi.

ref: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
text: Di ba wa lizuu, denii gbɔgchɔgrizeŋ hiŋ ge lii chaaŋ ya zumuu. Ka di yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu wa ballɔ, u daŋ chɔg u ni u huma la maa manaŋ. U heeza bɛŋ daŋ wer kpuu, ú balaa chaanaa la ge chɔg u huma la.

ref: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
text: Sitaanii niŋ du a hiŋ ni ra hiinuu werge maa, ú wer dɔɔ fɔŋŋa werge di wer ra ɛɛ wizenaa, witittaa ani nuukpuuri wia ra dar nɛra,

ref: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
text: di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa maa dee n du de, di wer ra dar banla n niŋ siu. Kɔraawiizi daŋ chɔgi baa dikuu baŋ faa waa sɛɛwɛ bá nɔŋŋi wibii la ú faa wer lɛɛ baa wia.

ref: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
text: Awia, u daŋ hum kundattaa ra tɛɛ baa á tɔ ba siwee bá sɛɛ kara wia,

ref: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
text: ka ú wer di banla maa n waa sɛɛwɛ tɛɛ u wibii la ka ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa a zuu baa suma la seriya bá chol. Ií chi chigigi

ref: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
text: Awia, a dɛkkɔɔ yaa n na jaami Kɔraawiizi saŋa maa dikuu ii wia, yaabalaa. U nɔŋŋi iabuu werge di lizi ia tɛɛ u hiŋ durnya faaraa la maa, ka ii wer wa na lɛɛi filaŋkennaa. U Dumnanii gillɔɔ ii doŋa maa lii ii ni ii ge sɛɛ u wibii. Awiarɛ u lɛɛ ia la.

ref: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Yaa n faa lizi amaniyesuma la tɛɛ ia ii sɛɛ la, Kɔraawiizii faa ra yir ia ií wer dɔɔ girme yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo be.

ref: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
