text: Awia, yaabalaa, ií haa lau chigigi di ra hiŋ. Baglaa la maa yaa n kpa nua bagli ia ani anla yaa n sɛbɛɛ tɛɛ ia hɔŋ biini la, ií gil a maa du ii bampiree nɛnnɛ.

ref: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo himmaa ni yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n nɔŋŋi yaa werge di suŋ yaa ni di hiini yaa di du yaa bɔkpega la n waa tuŋ ani taminanii la,

ref: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
text: bá du ia bɔkpega di gil ií lau nɛnnɛ, ií ɔɔ wer ɛɛ winanaa dee maa di wer ra ŋɔa ge.

ref: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
text: Yaabalaa, ií ra suŋŋi wiizi ra tɛɛ yaa gba, yáa Dɔɔri wiŋɔzi wer yaari nɛnnɛ di wer na girme, nɛ́ra sɛɛ ra tɛɛa gunla ii ge n faa sɛɛwɛ tɛɛa la.

ref: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
text: Ií suŋŋuu ú lɛɛ yaa miisɔɔh hina ni nɛchɔgaa be. Nɛr maa lɛi yardi Kɔraawiizi.

ref: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi wia dɔɔ wibiire. U daŋ gil ii dɔɔ bɔkpega ii hiŋaa naa biini, di lɛɛ ia lii Sitaani be.

ref: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
text: Yaa n yardi yaa Dɔɔri wiarɛ yaa sɛɛ lugɔ ii ge ra hiŋ gunla yaa n faa bagli ia labuu, di kaa sɛɛ lugɔ ii daŋ haa wer hiŋ guŋ ra la.

ref: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
text: Yáa Dɔɔri hiini ia ií wer zum ii bampiree biini nɛnnɛ nɔŋŋaa la dee Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋi ia ani kanyitti la dee Kristo n faa diwee u tɔɔrɔɔ biini la. Yaara hina karfaa wia

ref: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
text: Too, yaabalaa, yaa ra ŋɔ ii benii ani yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo sɔŋ. Di ii bɛl maa ɛɛ yaara hiŋ, waa sɛɛwɛ ú hum gunla yaa n baglɛɛ la, ii gilɛɛ gil ii nuu kpau.

ref: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
text: Yaa n faa du ii be la, yaa faa waa yaara hina ɛɛwɛ. Awia, ií zum gunla iin niŋ ɛɛu di hiŋ yaa.

ref: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
text: Yaa faa waa nɛr maa diwee diwee pɛɛpɛɛ. Yaa hummɔɔ saŋa maa di kuuh werge, ya gilɛɛ waa tɔɔri ia dikuu diwee wia.

ref: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
text: Yaa faa dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa lugɔ ya faa di ii diwee la pɛɛpɛɛ. Ka yaa faa waa guŋ ɛɛwɛ ya wer bagli ia gunla iin ninna hiŋ.

ref: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
text: Yaa ra nuu ii wiarɛ lugɔ ii baŋhina waa sɛɛwɛ ra hum ka gaagi ra zuu nɛra wia biini.

ref: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
text: Yaa ra ŋɔ nɛra naa benii ani yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo sɔŋ, dí ba ra hum ba himmaa huma bɔɔiih, di ra di ba himmaa kuuhni biini.

ref: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
text: Too, yaabalaa, iáwaa ɛɛ winanaa hanna la di gilɛɛ ra kuuh.

ref: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
text: Di nɛr maa waa sɛɛwɛ ú hiŋ gunla yaa n ŋɔwɛɛ hɔnnaa biini, ií zum a hiŋ. Ií nuu gilɛɛ kaa kpau ra ɛɛ wiimaa hiíhzi wer lawuu.

ref: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
text: Maa ŋɔ ií kpau birgi ii dɔm. Ka ií karfuu nɛnnɛ gunla iin niŋ karfi ii maa bie. Tuna wiŋɔzi wia

ref: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri la n dɔɔ bampirsɔna werge la, ú tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna saŋa maa wii la maa biini iin duwɛɛ, di ɔɔ du ii maa be.

ref: I always sign my letters as I am now doing: PAUL.
text: Mìŋ́ Pɔɔl sɛbɔɔrɛ bɔnnaa ra jaami ia. Kenne n ɔɔ ra ɛɛ n hɔna maa biini ií wer zum lugɔ n hɔnaa.

ref: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to all of you.
text: Yáa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo nɛsunaa du ii maa be.

ref: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
text: Mìŋ́ Yeesu Kristo huŋhunni Pɔɔllɛ a sɛbi hɔnnaa. Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ yaa Lɛɛri ni Yeesu Kristo la n ɛɛ yaa Tamii Hiŋ la, baabuu ŋɔ ń na hum a huma.

ref: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
text: N biibaal Timoti, n na jaamii. Mìŋ́ faa baglii Kɔraawiizi wia i sɛɛ di birgi n biibaal himmaa Kɔraawiizi hiŋaa naa biini. Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiinii di suŋ i ni di tɛi bampirsɔna. Baglikara tau dui wia

ref: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
text: N na nyiŋŋuu i ɛɛ gunla miŋ faa baglii saŋa la miŋ faa ra nyiŋŋi n la Masɛdɔnia hɛri la. N faa ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ a wesso hiŋ haa du Ɛfɛsus mɔɔ í wer ŋɔ nɛra baŋhina be lugɔ bá gilɛɛ kaa ra bagli wia aŋhina n waa deŋlee,

ref: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
text: di gilɛɛ aah siwii dikuu kara wia ni banla n lul ba naabaala ni ba naabaala ge naabaala kusu kusuu maa la wia. Wiŋɔzi naa dee dɔɔ bilaarɛ. A wàá wer lii tɔna maa tɛɛ yaa Kɔraawiizi huma naa biini. Yarda waa dɔɔ tɔnaa di wer ra hum Kɔraawiizi.

ref: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
text: Baŋhina waa kaa ra hiŋ guŋ ka leu di ra ŋɔ wia aŋhina n waa tɔna dɔɔwɛ.

ref: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
text: Ba ra nyiŋŋuu ba ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni bagla di ra baglaa fɔŋŋa ni, ka ba waa a wia ni a zɛɛzi zummɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
text: Yaa zummɔ lugɔ di yaa zum Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni zɛɛzi nɛnnɛ di ra hiŋaa, a wessoo werge,

ref: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
text: di kaa zum lugɔ nɛnanaa wia lɛi gbɔg la du de. Banla n ɛɛ dignikpega hina, nɛvɛɛɔnna ani nɛkuna wiarɛ a du de. Banla n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa, wikuna di ra gbɛlli Kɔraawiizi di ra kpuuzi ba maawaa, ba mɛɛwaa, ba dɔŋahina,

ref: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
text: banla n na sɛm, banla n na ɛɛ wikuna ba dɔŋa baala gɛɛ ba dɔŋa haana be, banla n na ŋmɛɛ nɛra di kpa baa ra kaali, banla n na kanni kara, banla n na hɛɛhzi Kɔraawiizi ka ra kanni kara ani banla n na ɛɛ wii la maa n waa deŋlee gunla yaa n bagli ia wibii la.

ref: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
text: N na jaami yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo. Waabuu hiiniŋ ani fɔŋŋa n wer ɛɛ guŋ. N na jaamuubuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, u binnimbuu lugɔ n wia dɔɔ wibiire di kpaŋ du u huma naa biini.

ref: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
text: Faala la n faa ra gbɛlluubuu, di ra tɔɔri u hiŋra, di ra yoo baa werge maa. Ka u wettoo suŋ n ni, di na n sinyɛna, dikuubɛɛwiai, n faa waa zummɛ ka ra ɛɛ guŋ. N faa haa waa u wia sɛɛwɛ.

ref: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri suŋ n ninɛɛ werge maa di hiiniŋ werge n wer dɔɔ u yarda ni nɛnɔŋŋaa dikuu n ni Yeesu Kristo n ɛɛ kpaŋ la wia.

ref: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
text: Wiŋɔɔlii bɛllɛ du de di ɛɛ wibii lugɔ nɛr maa n niŋ sɛɛ u wia. Waabuu keŋ, Yeesu Kristo ba durnyaa ú wa lɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra ta. Minuu wichɔgɛɛri werge ba maa biini.

ref: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi kuu guŋ wia di suŋ n ni werge, ú wer kpa n wia bagli banla n niŋ haa sɛɛ u wia, di na u miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la, bá zum gunla u kanyitti dii n duwɛɛ. Waa maga dɔɔwɛ.

ref: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
text: Ií ra tɛɛ unla n ɛɛ saŋa maa hina koori, di haŋ du de ra la la sɔŋ. Waa siwaa dɔɔwɛ. Ba wɔɔ ra na. U bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. Awia, ií ra tɔgzuu di ra kpau girme saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami.

ref: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
text: N bie Timoti, n ŋɔ ń ŋɔ wia aŋhinaa tɛi í ra ɛɛ di ra hum Kɔraawiizi. Ba faa bagli i ni Kɔraawiizi huma naa wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini. Gil gunla baŋ faa ŋɔwɛɛ la dui bɔkpega í wer yoo i hiŋaa naa yoori nɛnnɛ. Laalnaniirɛ i ra yoo gunla.

ref: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
text: Ɔɔ́ yardi Kɔraawiizi di dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu. Baŋhina faa waa biinihuŋŋu dɔɔwɛ, di hiŋ huhzi. Ba waa kaa ra sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wia.

ref: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
text: Haimɛnius ni Alɛgzanda ɛɛ bannii baŋhinaa. N gillɔɔ Sitaani tɔɔri baa bá wer zum lugɔ a waa wer banna gbɛlli Kɔraawiizi.

ref: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
text: Kenne n na nyiŋŋi Yeesu hiŋra ra hiŋ. Lugli hotte keŋ. Ií ɔɔ suŋŋi wiizi di jaamuu ra tɛɛ nɛra maa.

ref: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
text: Ií suŋŋuu ra tɛɛ koora ni nabɔnzi maa, yáa maa wer so bɔɔiih, wií maa gilɛɛ waa tir yaa, ka ya wer hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ, di ra ɛɛ wia la n dɛkkɛ.

ref: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
text: U guŋ suŋŋaa wessoo werge di ra par yaa Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi.

ref: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
text: U ra nyiŋŋuu nɛr maa wer na lɛɛi di wer zum wibii.

ref: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
text: Kɔraawiizi kpaŋkpaŋ bɛnnɛ du de. Nɛkpaŋ ge bɛnnɛ du yaa ni Kɔraawiizi baambaaŋ di ɛɛ yaa newea ge sitɔɔri. U gba ɛɛ neweere. Waabuu Yeesu Kristo la.

ref: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
text: Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ n ge ɛɛ u daansɛɛ hiŋ di kaa ɛɛ u huŋhunni. Wibii maanii. Kara lɛi. U gillɔɔ n na bagli banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ u wia bá ge wer zum hiŋaa naa wia di sɛɛ Kristo wia di zum a wibii.

ref: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
text: Awia, n na nyiŋŋuu lugɔ bɔr la maa nɛra n chaalɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi ba jaami Kɔraawiizi, baala gil baaŋ wia ni aanaa, doŋa maa gilɛɛ waa pɛli ba ni ka ba ra jaami.

ref: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
text: N kaa ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ haana ge ra laali laala la n dɛkkɛ, di gilɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi sɛnsɛŋ laala, ka ɔɔ ra laali laala la n kukkɛɛ, di gilɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi nyukuarinanaa, saliŋ ni binanaa la yoola n kpolle kuna dui ani wɛjɛnanaa yoolazi n kpolle werge nignaa, bá wer du wer.

ref: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
text: Ka bá ra ɛɛ winanaa bá wer du wer. U guŋ dɛkkɔɔ lugɔ haana la n na jaami Kɔraawiizi n ninna ɛɛ.

ref: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
text: A wesso haaŋ n ɔɔ siigi ka ra nuu Kɔraawiizi wia di ɔɔ nuu di ra tɛɛ baala.

ref: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
text: Màá sɛɛ lugɔ háaŋ na bagli baala di ra lɛɛ nabɔnzi ba ni. Bá ɔɔ siigi di so.

ref: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
text: Andamaa Kɔraawiizi feli ta mɔɔ ka haa ta Haawa.

ref: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
text: Andama lɛi Sitaani faa dar la. U haannɛ u faa dar u ɛɛ wichɔgaa la.

ref: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
text: Ba ɔɔ ŋɔ lugɔ nɛr la n na nyiŋŋi u ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra nabɔma di ra binni ba ni, hunnaniirɛ a hinna nyiŋŋi. Wibiire ba ɔɔ ŋɔ guŋ.

ref: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
text: Ú gilɛɛ ɛɛ nɛr la n na nyiŋŋi siŋ nyɔɔi werge, di gilɛɛ dɔɔ miisɔɔh, ka ú pɛssi nɛra ni di gilɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi kalu, di gilɛɛ kpa kebinyiŋŋaa su siwii.

ref: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
text: Ú ɛɛ nɛr la n wette di dɔɔ u diahina nɛnnɛ, ú biizi ge ra sɛɛ u nua di ra tɔgzuu.

ref: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
text: Di waa wette ú dɔɔ u diahina, ɛrɛɛ ú kaa wer ɛɛ di kpogli Kɔraawiizi hiŋrai?

ref: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
text: Gil u ɛɛ nɛr la n sɛɛ Yeesu wia di birgi tama, di guŋ lɛi, u danna nyiŋŋi sɔŋ werge, Kɔraawiizi wa tɛu chɔgri gunla uŋ faa tɛɛ Sitaani chɔgri la.

ref: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
text: Gil u ɛɛ nɛnanii banla maa n waa Yeesu hiŋra ɛɛwɛ be. Di guŋ lɛi, ba daŋ ɔɔ ra ŋɔ u wia di ra zɔɔzuu, Sitaani wer na bɔr lawuu.

ref: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
text: Gil ba ɛɛ banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ di ra hiŋ wia la um pillɛɛ tɛɛ yaa la maa nɛnnɛ ani biinihuŋŋu.

ref: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
text: A wesso ban niŋ ɛɛ bannii gba na mɔɔ. Denii di nɛra waa ba wichɔgaa maa ŋɔwɛɛ, bá ra hum a huma.

ref: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
text: A wesso ba haana gba n ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wia la n dɛkkɛ. Bá gilɛɛ ɛɛ nɛzɔɔza. Bá ra lau bahinaa wiimaa bɔr. A wesso bá wia maa dɔɔ wibii.

ref: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
text: A wesso Yeesu hiŋra huŋhunna la n dɔɔ hahkpaŋkpaŋa bɛŋ di wer dɔɔ ba biizi ni ba diahina maa nɛnnɛ.

ref: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
text: Banla maa n niŋ wer hum huma naa nɛnnɛ di ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra huŋhunna, ba daŋ na sɔnnanii di kaa wer dɔɔ bampirii nɛnnɛ Yeesu Kristo hiŋaa naa biini.

ref: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
text: Miŋ sɛbi wia naa di ra tɛi naa, n na nyiŋŋuu lugɔ n wer ba i be filaŋkeŋ.

ref: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
text: Ka di maa wette ba manaŋ, n ŋɔ ń sɛbi wia naabuu tɛi, í wer zum gunla iin ninna ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Diahina wia biini. Ii ɛɛ unla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa la jaami bɔttɛ. U kpa u wibiire du u jaamibɔr la biini, ií wer binni u ni.

ref: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
text: Yaa hiŋaa naa dɔɔ wisuahlaarɛ werge, ɛnɛ maa. Aabuu keŋ. Kɔraawiizi birgi neweere di dɔɔ bɔrahɔŋ yaa nau, u Dumnanii ge faa baglɔɔrɛ lugɔ u wiimaa deŋloore, mɛlikazi faa ra binnuu. Nɛra bagli u wiarɛ tɛɛ banla n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la, nɛra sɛɛ u wia durnya biini. Kɔraawiizi kpau kaali chiŋ ú ga na girme.

ref: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
text: Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii ra bagli yaabuu a ra chaani nɛnnɛ, lugɔ durnya tuna hɔpizaa biini, Yeesu hiŋra baŋhina daŋ vɛɛ ba hiŋaa naa ka nuu tɛɛ tinnanchɔgaa aŋhina n na dar nɛra, di ra hiŋ Sitaani huŋhunna ge baglaa.

ref: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
text: Nɛra baŋhina daŋ kanni kara di ra fugzi nɛra guŋ. Guŋ wàá tir baa, dikuubɛɛwiai, wichɔgaa daŋ mani baabuu, ba biine ɛɛ lugɔ bɔrahɔŋ la kuŋwema n baaree guŋŋ, waa kaa ra wii la.

ref: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
text: Ba daŋ ŋɔ lugɔ hahkpai ra kiiu di kaa ŋɔ lugɔ diwee aŋhina dii a kiiu. A diwee, Kɔraawiizii taa, di ŋɔ banla n yarduu di zum u wibii la bá ra dia di ra jaamuu.

ref: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
text: Kunla maa Kɔraawiizi n tawɛɛ wessoo. Gilɛɛ vɛɛu. Di i jaami Kɔraawiizi di du u ni, u wessoo dii.

ref: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
text: Kɔraawiizii ɔɔ gil a ɛɛ kunnanaa dikuu u wiŋɔɔlii ni i jaamaa la wia.

ref: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
text: Di i ra bagli i dɔŋahina guŋ, amɔ, i ɛɛ Yeesu Kristo balnanii bɛllɛ di dɔɔ kpegzi u hiŋaa biini dikuu hiŋ gillɛ wiŋɔzi la maa n bagli u hiŋaa ni u wibii la du i bampirii wia.

ref: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
text: Ka í gil kara kannaa wiŋɔzi, ka lau i hiŋ di ra hiŋ Kɔraawiizi winanaa ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
text: Awiarɛ yaa ɔɔ aah siwii ra hum kpegzi ni, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa dɔɔ unla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa la tamiirɛ. U ɛɛ nɛr maa Lɛɛrii. Ka yaa banla n yarduu la, u ɛɛ yaawaa Lɛɛrii werge maa.

ref: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
text: A bagli wia naa maa di ŋɔ bá ra hiŋ guŋ.

ref: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
text: Gilɛɛ nɛr maa kuu hiŋ haa ɛɛ biipɔllii wia di ra gbɛllii. Ka í ra du i wiŋɔzi ni i wiɛɛlaa maa tau di ra du i himmaa tau lugɔ í wer dɔɔ nɛnɔŋŋaa ni Kɔraawiizi yarda nɛnnɛ, doŋa maa gilɛɛ waa pɛlii, Yeésu hiŋra maa wer na gunla hinna hiŋ di ge wer ra hiŋ guŋ.

ref: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
text: Haa aah siwii di karmi Kɔraawiizi wia ra tɛɛ baa ń na ba. Bagli baa ŋmɛnizi ani Kɔraawiizi wia.

ref: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
text: Aah siwii werge maa di ra hum Kɔraawiizi huma naa ani bampirkpaŋ nɛ́r maa wer zum nɛnnɛ lugɔ i ra la seere hiŋaa naa wia biini.

ref: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
text: A du i hiŋ tau di ra du i baglaa la tau di ɔɔ vɛɛ ra hiŋ nɛnnɛ. Di i wetto ɛɛ guŋ, i daŋ lɛɛ i hiŋ di kaa lɛɛ banla n nuuwɛ ra tɛi la.

ref: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
text: Gilɛɛ waa nyɛg nabɔma ni di ra diu wibii. Fɔrguu alugɔ hin niŋ fɔrgi i mɛɛ la. Di biipɔllaa genii, ɛɛ baa alugɔ hin niŋ ɛɛ i kpɛɛnzi ni i niuna la,

ref: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
text: di kaa ra ɛɛ haana la ge n ɛɛ nabɔnzi alugɔ i maawaa, di ra ɛɛ suŋgure ge gba alugɔ i niuhambinaa, wichɔgaa maa gilɛɛ waa pɛli i ni.

ref: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
text: Luhaana la n waa nɛra dɔɔwɛ la, ii danna binni ba ni.

ref: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
text: Ka di unla maa dɔɔ biizi gɛɛ naanna, a wesso u nɛra la zum gunla ban niŋ kpogluu, dikuubɛɛwiai, a wessoo banla n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi n ninna ɛɛ winanaa guŋ di ra hiini ba lulla gunla baŋ faa kuuhwɛ dikuu ba wia la. U guŋ wessoo Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
text: Ka haaŋ la n ɛɛ haŋkii, waa nɛr maa dɔɔwɛ la, waabuu ra tami Kɔraawiizi ni di ra jaamuu di ra suŋŋuu saŋa maa.

ref: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
text: Ama di haŋkii bɛl du de di ra di u hiŋ di ra nyiŋŋi u bɛŋ suma, u teŋ siuwɔɔ tuŋ.

ref: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
text: Ɛɛ́ ra bagli baa guŋ, nɛ́r maa gilɛɛ wer ra chagzi baa ani wiimaa wia.

ref: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
text: Di nɛr maa waa sɛɛwɛ ú kpogli u nɛra gɛɛ u himmaa diahina, u ra gbɛlli Yeesu hiŋaa naa unna hiŋ naabuu. Di u faa waa Kɔraawiizi wia sɛɛwɛ gba bɔ.

ref: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
text: Di ii ŋɔ ií zum luhaana la Yeesu hiŋra n niŋ kpogli la sɔna, ií nyiŋŋi banla n hel binni tokkoahorgaa ka ra sag, di faa ɛɛ bakpaŋkpaŋa haana,

ref: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
text: di dɔɔ sɔŋ lugɔ ba ra ɛɛ winanaa la. Pɛɛzi ba wia nɛnnɛ alugɔ, haaŋ naa, u faa dɛɛzi u biizii nɛnnɛ ba wa helaa? Ɔɔ ra lɛɛ hɔɔhraawaa? Ɔɔ ra binni u dɔŋa Yeesu hiŋra ninɛɛwaa? Ɔɔ ra hiini banla n du tɔɔrɔɔ biini labuuwaa? Ɔɔ aah siwiire di ra ɛɛ winanaa?

ref: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
text: Ka gilɛɛ sɛɛ lugɔ ba sɛbi banla n haa waa zɛŋŋɛ sɔna, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba daŋ kaa waa nyiŋŋi baala lugɔ bá yuu ka gil Kristo huma la.

ref: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
text: Bannii n ɔɔ ra di fɔɔra di ra la nɛra diini naa, ba daŋ birgi yaara hina di kaa birgi nɛzɔɔza jaa, di ra zuu nɛra wia biini, di ra ŋɔ wiŋɔzi la n waa dɛkkɛ.

ref: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
text: Awia, banla n haa waa zɛŋŋɛ la, a wesso lugɔ bá kaa yuu di ra lul biizi di dɔɔ ba himmaa nɛra di ra binni. Di ba ra ɛɛ guŋ, Yeesu hiŋra dɔma wàá na ŋmɛnɛɛ di ra gbɛlli baa.

ref: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.
text: Ka baŋhina teŋ bir hattɛ tuŋ di ra hiŋ Sitaani ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
text: Di haaŋ du de di ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋri, u nɛra baŋhina ge ɛɛ luhaana, a dɛkkɔɔ u kpogli baa, ba wia gilɛɛ ka tir Yeesu hiŋra, ka bá ge wer ra hiini banla n waa nɛr maa dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
text: Yeesu hiŋra nabɔnzi la n na binni ba ni nɛnnɛ la, bá ra tɔgzi baa di ra turgi baa bunɛɛ. Banla n ɔɔ aah siwii di ra ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wia di ra bagli nɛra labuu bá ra hiini werge la,

ref: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ba sɛbɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, dí, “Gilɛɛ waa vɔɔ navarga la n na fɛrgi mia, a bii ra lii nua.” Di kaa sɛbi yembɛl, dí, “Huŋhunni dɛg u huma kinturgaare.”

ref: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
text: Gilɛɛ wa gil ba waa di Yeesu hiŋra nabɔma seriya, di nɛra banɛɛ gɛɛ bahoro lɛi du de di wer ra bagli u wichɔgaa.

ref: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
text: Di baŋhina vɛɛwɔ ka ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa, i daŋ bagli ba wichɔgaa la Yeesu hiŋra maa baambaaŋ bá dɔŋahina na di ge ra ɔm wichɔgaa la ɛɛi.

ref: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
text: N na ŋɔ i benii, Kɔraawiizi ni Yeesu Kristo ani u mɛlikazi uŋ lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ la sibɔɔ, a ɛɛ wia naa maa, di gilɛɛ kpa nɛr maa wia su siwii kaali baŋhina, ka ra ɛɛ ba maa wikpaŋ.

ref: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
text: Gilɛɛ hahzi di kpa i nonee sag nɛr maa ni ú hum a huma. Di i ra ɛɛ guŋ, u wa ɛɛ wichɔgaa, i nuu maanii niŋ dɔɔ chɔgri. A du i wia maa tau, doŋa maa gilɛɛ waa pɛlii.

ref: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
text: Gilɛɛ ra nyɔɔ nii bɛmbɛŋ. A nyɔɔ siŋ tama tama di ra jaa, ú wer kuari i hia i gilɛɛ ra wii werge guŋ.

ref: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
text: Nɛra baŋhina wichɔgaa ɔɔ ra lii bɔchaannɛ nɛr maa zum a wia. Baŋ hanna la seriya diiribɔr la, di nɛra maa teŋ zummɔ lugɔ ba ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ. Baŋhina ge wichɔgaa, di harbɔɔ lɛi, nɛra wàá zum a wia.

ref: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
text: Gunnɛ winanaa gba ɛɛi ɔɔ ra lii bɔchaaŋ. Aŋhina waa lii manaŋ, ka a ge wàá wer suah di ra la.

ref: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
text: Banla maa n ɛɛ balaa, bá ra tɔgzi ba dɔɔra, nɛ́ra gilɛɛ wer na ŋmɛnɛɛ di ra gbɛlli Kɔraawiizi ni u baglaa la.

ref: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
text: Di balaa baŋhina du de di ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra, ba dɔɔra ge ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra, bá gilɛɛ kuu ba ni ba dɔɔra la n ɛɛ dɔŋahina hiŋaa naa biini wia di ra binni baa pɛɛ. Bá ra hum baa werge dikuu baŋ zummɛ lugɔ banla n niŋ di tɔna ba huma la biini n ɛɛ babalaa Yeesu hiŋra ni ba nɛnɔŋŋaa la wia. Baglikara ni daama himmaa wia Ɛɛ́ ra ŋɔ wia naa di ra baglaa nɛnnɛ.

ref: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Di nɛr maa wa izoo ra bagli Kɔraawiizi wia a kur, waa yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo wibii wia ani u hinnanii naa wia sɛɛwɛ,

ref: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
text: amɔ, sɔnnyiŋŋii. Waa wia zummɛ. U wiimaanii dɔmbilaa. U ni u dɔŋahina a naa dikuu wiŋɔjigzi wia. Bɔwii ni hɔɔzi dii ni dɔŋgbɛllaa ni nfɛrchɔgaa maa ra lii dɔmbilaa naa biinii.

ref: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
text: Nɛra naa nfɛrɛ maa bittɔɔ. Wibii waa kaa hoo ba be. Ba jaa ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ bá wer na tɔna aŋhina ba hiŋaa biini di wer dɔɔ kebee.

ref: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
text: Ama nɛr la maa n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi, u siwee kaa sɔɔni jaa, waabuu daŋ na tɔna werge maa.

ref: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
text: Ban lul yaa, yaa waa kummaa kpoglee di ba. Di yaa wa siuwɔ ge, yaa wàá wer kpa kummaa kaali.

ref: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
text: Awia, di yaa dɔɔ diwee ya di, di kaa dɔɔ laala ya laali, amɔ, ya gil guŋ kukki yaa.

ref: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
text: Ka banla n aah siwii dikuu kebee wia daŋ chol. Kebee nyiŋŋaa la daŋ dar baa, di du baa kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa kpila biini, a gil ba ra ɛɛ wia lugɔ ba nyuuni n waa hoo, di kaa ra ɛɛ bahinaa wichɔgaa, bá wia maa bir pɛɛ.

ref: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
text: Kebee nyiŋŋaa wiarɛ nɛra ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa dee maa. Yeesu hiŋra baŋhina faa dɔɔ kebee nyiŋŋaare ba bampiree werge. Baŋ faa ra hiŋ kebee la, ba gil Yeesu hiŋaa ka ra tɔɔri bahinaa ni biinichɔg werge. Timoti karfaa wia

ref: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
text: Ka hiŋwaa n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi hiŋri naa, a dɛkkɔ hiŋ gil wia naa maa ha, ka aah siwii ra hiŋ wia la n deŋlee di du wer Kɔraawiizi be, di kaa dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi yarda ni nɛnɔŋŋaa ni kanyitti ni sisɔna.

ref: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
text: Hinna yoo i hiŋaa naa yoori naa, laalnaniirɛ i ra yoo gunla. Haa vɛɛ di ra yoo. Lau miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la nɛnnɛ. Kɔraawiizi faa yiriibuu i ba u be, di wa na miibɔɔ la saŋa la hiŋ faa sɛɛ u wia, di hiŋuu nɛnnɛ nɛkpila baaŋ la.

ref: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
text: N na yir Kɔraawiizi la n na tɛɛ kummaa miibɔɔ la sɔnnɛ ani Yeesu Kristo la n wette chi Pɔntiɔs Pailɔt see, di di daansɛɛnanii la ge sɔŋ di ra ŋɔ i be.

ref: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
text: Di u saŋa wa hello, Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil u bir ba. Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ sɔnnɛ. U bɛnnɛ du de di ɛɛ Koora Maa Koori, di kaa ɛɛ dɔɔra maa dɔɔri.

ref: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
text: U bɛnnɛ dɔɔ miibɔɔ la n waa luglaa dɔɔwɛ, waa kaa dɔɔ tunaa ge, di du bɔr la n na chaani werge maa í hel de huhzi la. Nɛr maa haa wɔɔ nawɛɛ. Nɛr maa wàá nau ge. Waabuu niŋ dɔɔ girme ni fɔŋŋazeŋ hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami.

ref: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
text: Ŋɔ banla n ɛɛ dɔɔna durnya naa biini be lugɔ bá gilɛɛ ra chɔli bahinaa, di gilɛɛ gil ba daama ɛɛ ba tamii. A waa yarda dɔɔwɛ. Ŋɔ bá gil Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ ba tamii. Waabuu ra tɛɛ yaa kummaa werge, a du sum yaa be.

ref: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
text: Ŋɔ bá ra ɛɛ winanaa werge á wa du kaŋ di birgi ba daama, di ŋɔ bá dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu lugɔ ban niŋ wer ra hiini nɛra di ra tɛɛ baa kuna.

ref: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
text: Bá ra ɛɛ anniizi maa di ra dau alugɔ daama, á wer hiini baa saŋa la n niŋ wa hel, bá wer na miibɔɔ himmaa la.

ref: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
text: Timoti, a binni huma la maa Kɔraawiizi n yardii di tɛi la ni nɛnnɛ, di bir i har kpu wiŋɔpɛɛri la baŋ ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi ba kpa di ra dii hɔɔzi la. Ba ra yiraabuu nunzuma, ka nunzuma maa lɛi.

ref: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
text: Aabuu baŋhina sɛɛ di leu Kɔraawiizi ŋmɛnɛɛ la. Ba waa kaa ra hiŋ. Kɔ́raawiizi nɛsunaa du ii be.

ref: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
text: Mìŋ́ Yeesu Kristo huŋhunni Pɔɔllɛ ra sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛi. A par Kɔraawiizii u tɛŋ a huma. Nua la uŋ faa ŋɔwɛɛ lugɔ u daŋ gil ya wer na miibɔɔ Yeesu Kristo be la wiarɛ u gil n birgi u huŋhunni la.

ref: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
text: N biinɔŋŋii Timoti, n na jaamii. Yáa mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiinii di suŋ i ni di tɛi bampirsɔna. Kɔraawiizi jaamaa ni bɔkpega dui wia

ref: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
text: Saŋa maanii n na liizi i wia di ra suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi la minna hum ani biinihuŋŋu gunla n naabaala n faa ra humuu la, di ra jaamuu dikuu i wia.

ref: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
text: Anna liizi gunla hiŋ faa wiiwe la di ra kɛlli i ni lugɔ ń wer nai ń bɔra sɔɔni werge.

ref: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
text: N na liizi gunla hiŋ yardi Kɔraawiizi ani biinihuŋŋu alugɔ i naa Lɔis ni i maa Yunis n faa yarduu la. N dɔɔ i tamiirɛ lugɔ ba Kɔraawiizi yarda dɔnnɛ i ge gba dɔɔ.

ref: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
text: Awia, n ŋɔ ń liiziibuu í kaa izi ra hum ani wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋa la Kɔraawiizi n faa sunzii, saŋa la miŋ faa kpa n nonee sag i ni la.

ref: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
text: Kɔraawiizi waa yaa tɛɛwɛ duma la n niŋ gil ya ra ɔm nɛra. U tɛɛ yaabuu duma la n gillɛ yaa dɔɔ bampirsi ni nɛnɔŋŋaa ani hinlawaa.

ref: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
text: Awia, gilɛɛ gil hiihzi lawii yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo wia baglaa biini, di gilɛɛ wa gil n wia naa waa ɛɛi hiihzi, baŋ kuu u wia tɔŋ dia naa. Ka í ge ra di tɔɔrɔɔ dikuu u amaniyesuma la wia gunla Kɔraawiizi n niŋ hiinii ni fɔŋŋa í wer dia la.

ref: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
text: Waabuu lɛɛ yaa ha di yir yaa, yaa ba waa hiŋ u hinnanii la. Yaa hunnanaa wia lɛi u yir yaa. U nɛsunaa, u hiinaa ani gunla un dauri yaa wia saŋa maa la wiarɛ u yir yaa di hiini yaa dikuu Yeesu Kristo wia.

ref: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
text: U dau yaa wiarɛ guŋ saŋa maa ka yaa jaa wa zum a wia saŋa la yaa Lɛɛri Yeesu Kristo n wa ballɛ la. Um ballɛ la, u chɔgi siu fɔŋŋaa di kaa gil miibɔɔ la n waa tuŋ la wia ra chaani nɛnnɛ lii amaniyesuma la biini.

ref: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
text: Amaniyesuma hiŋ wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi liziŋ n ɛɛ u siiri di sii ra ŋɔa, di kaa ɛɛ u huŋhunni ni u wia bagli.

ref: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
text: Amaniyesuma wiarɛ n na di tɔɔrɔɔ filaŋkeŋ, ka u guŋ wanna ɛɛ hiihzi, dikuubɛɛwiai, n zum Kɔraawiizi la miŋ yardɛɛ labuu di dɔɔ u tamii lugɔ u daŋ wer du u wia la maa uŋ gillɛ n ɛɛ la tau di ra la ú hɔpizii la wa hel.

ref: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
text: A liizi gunla maa miŋ faa baglii wibii a deŋli la, di ɔɔ ra hiŋ guŋ, di yardi Kɔraawiizi di nɔŋŋi nɛra. Yaa ni Yeesu Kristo n kpauwɛ wiarɛ yaa wer yardi Kɔraawiizi di wer nɔŋŋi nɛra la.

ref: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
text: A du winanii la Kɔraawiizi n gillɛ i dɔɔ la tau. U Dumnanii la n du yaa biine daŋ hiinii í wer du u tau.

ref: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
text: I zummɔ lugɔ Eesia hina la maa gilimbuu ta. Haali Faijɛlus ni Hɛmɔgɛnɛs la gba gilimbuu.

ref: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
text: Ka Ɔnɛsifɔrus waa, Kɔraawiizii niŋ suŋ u ni u diahina ni dikuu uŋ ɔɔ wer ra hiiniŋ n siwee ba hɛri wia. N ɛɛ nɛr la baŋ tɔ diarɛ, ka n wia wɔɔ ra ɛɛ hiihzi.

ref: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
text: Uŋ wa hel Room la, u ɛɛ ania maa di wer zum n bɔr ba n be.

ref: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
text: Di yaa Dɔɔri hɔpizii la wa hello, ú suŋ u ni. Gunla uŋ faa hiiniŋ Ɛfɛsus la gba, i zum a wiarɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
text: Awia, n bie, lɛɛ hiinaa la Yeesu Kristo n suŋ i ni di hiinii la, di du i hiŋ bɔkpega,

ref: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
text: di bagli wia la hiŋ nuuwɛ miŋ faa baglɛɛ nɛkpila baaŋ la, di ge ra bagli baala baŋhina wia n dɔɔ wibii nɛnnɛ, bá ge wer kpa bagli baŋhina jaa.

ref: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
text: A di tɔɔrɔɔ ni kanyitti gunla sooja la wia n dɔɔ wibii n niŋ dia la. Yeesu Kristo soojaa hiŋ.

ref: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
text: Di sooja ra nyiŋŋi u wia par u nabɔma, waa ɔɔ kaa ra ɛɛ bol wiɛɛlaa, á gilɛɛ waa tɔ u sooja wia ŋmɛnɛɛ.

ref: No one wins an athletic contest without obeying the rules.
text: Nɛr la n na yoo yoori bɔr, di waa yoori ŋmɛnizi ra hiŋ, wàá wer di.

ref: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
text: Nɛr la n kuuhwɛ par koo, waabuu niŋ di koo la lugli kuna.

ref: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
text: A pessi n wiŋɔzi naa nɛnnɛ. Yaa Dɔɔri daŋ hiinii, i wer zum wiimaa nɛnnɛ.

ref: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
text: A liizi gunla miŋ baglii Yeesu Kristo wia lii amaniyesuma la biini. N baglɔɔrɛ lugɔ u ɛɛ Deevid naannaa di izi siu biini.

ref: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
text: Miŋ ɔɔ ra bagli guŋ wiarɛ ba yiriŋ wichɔgɛɛri di tɔŋ dia gba. Ka Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii lawaa, ba wàá wer tɔa. A daŋ ɔɔ na bɔr ra hum.

ref: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
text: Awia, n daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ maa gba ani kanyitti dikuu banla Kɔraawiizi n lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ wia, bá ge gba wer na lɛɛi Yeesu Kristo be, di kaa na girme la n waa tuŋ la.

ref: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
text: Wibiire ba ŋɔ keŋ, “Di yaa nuu maanii kpauwɛ siu, amɔ, yaa nuu maanii niŋ kpau dɔɔ miibɔɔ.

ref: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
text: Di yaa di tɔɔrɔɔ filaŋkennaa, ka yaa daŋ ŋmɛnɛ wa hiinuu ra di kora. Di yaa hɔɔ yaa nuu wia, u ge gba daŋ ŋmɛnɛ wa hɔɔ u ni yaa wia.

ref: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
text: Di yaa wia waa wibii dɔɔwɛ, ka waabuu wia daŋ dɔɔ wibii di hanna la. Wàá ka wer bir u hiŋ di kaa nyaa wibii.” Huŋhunni la wia n su Kɔraawiizi siwii wia

ref: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
text: A liizi baa wia naa wia, di karfi baa ni Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ lugɔ bá gilɛɛ ra bil dɔŋa dikuu wiŋɔpussi wia. U guŋ waa wikuarii maa dɔɔwɛ, ka gil banla n na nuu la ra leu.

ref: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
text: Ɛɛ ania maa i ŋmɛnɛ wer chi Kɔraawiizi be, ú ŋɔ lugɔ i wia maa su u siwiire, hiíhzi gilɛɛ waa dii dikuu huma la hiŋ hummɛ wia. Ɛɛ́ ra bagli Kɔraawiizi wibii wiŋɔzi la nɛnnɛ ú deŋli.

ref: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
text: Bɔr la maa banna ŋɔ wiŋɔdumazi ani wiŋɔpɛɛri, gilɛɛ ra la de. A wiŋɔzi dee ra chɔgi nɛraa, ba ra vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi di ɛɛ wichɔgaa ra jaa.

ref: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
text: Ba wiŋɔzi la ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ zallaa, di hee ra jaa. Haimɛnius ni Failitus ɛɛ nɛra naa baŋhinaa.

ref: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
text: Ba ta wibiire kir, dikuubɛɛwiai, baabuu ɔɔ ra ŋɔ lugɔ nɛra siu biini izaa la teŋ bɛrɔɔrɛ, di dar nɛra baŋhina ba waa kaa yardi Kɔraawiizi.

ref: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
text: Ama, Kɔraawiizi nua wiŋɔzi dɔɔ wibiire. Waa birgaa maa dɔɔwɛ. Ba sɛbɔɔrɛ, “Yaa Dɔɔri zum banla n ɛɛ u hora labuu, di kaa sɛbi, dí, nɛr la maa n na yir u hiŋ Kɔraawiizi hor, ú gil wichɔgaa ɛɛi.”

ref: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
text: Nɛzeŋ dia biini, saliŋ viini ni lugbinanaa viini ɔɔ du denii. Chuuri viini ni daazi hora gba du de. Aŋhina dɔɔ girme, aŋhina ge waa girme dɔɔwɛ.

ref: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
text: Gunnɛ, di i lizi wia la miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ la doŋa ha i ni, i daŋ wer dɔɔ girme la. I Dɔɔri daŋ lizii í ɛɛ u hor, di gil i wer dɛg u huma. I daŋ ɔɔ dɔɔ wikuarii, ú kpai ra hum hunnanii maa.

ref: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
text: Haa bir i har ra kpu kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa la n ɔɔ ra tɔɔri biipɔllaa la, ka aah siwii ra nyiŋŋi gunla hin niŋ wer ɛɛ, í wia wer deŋli nɛnnɛ, í wer yardi Kɔraawiizi di nɔŋŋi nɛra, di dɔɔ nuukpaŋ i dɔŋahina ni, di ra hiŋ banla maa n na jaami yaa Dɔɔri ani biinihuŋŋu la.

ref: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
text: A waa dɛkkɛ yaa Dɔɔri balii n ɛɛ kalu hiŋ. A wesso uŋ ɔɔ pɛssi nɛra maa ni, di kaa wer ra bagli baa nɛnnɛ di wer ra di baa kanyitti,

ref: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
text: di dɔɔ sisɔna ra deŋli banla n na yoou. Di Kɔraawiizi daŋ bir ba bampiree, di pilli ba siwee bá zum wibii, yaa waa zum.

ref: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
text: Aŋhinabe, u daŋ hiini baa guŋ bá nfɛrɛ ba, bá wer foozi bahinaa Sitaani la n lauri baa, di fir baa ba ra sɛɛ u kipar la nonee biini.

ref: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
text: Zum wii naa lugɔ durnya tuna hɔpizaa biini, wiarɛ niŋ wa huuzi nɛr maa.

ref: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
text: Nɛra danna nyiŋŋi ba bɛnaa wia, di ɛɛ kebinyiŋŋe ni barabara hina, di yir bahinaa nɛzenaa di ra gbɛlli nɛra, di ɛɛ dignikpega hina di ra vɛɛ ba maawaa ni ba mɛɛwaa nuuzi. Ba bɔra wàá sɔɔni banla n hiini baa la ni. Ba daŋ ɛɛ nɛchunzi.

ref: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
text: Ba wàá dɔɔ ba himmaa nɛra bila. Ba siwee wàá sɔɔni ba dɔma ni. Ba danna zɔɔzi nɛra di kpoŋ werge, di dɔɔ miisɔɔhchɔgaa di hah winanaa,

ref: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
text: di ɛɛ sɔsɔgɔ hina, siwema hina ani sɔnnyiŋŋe, di ra nyiŋŋi bahinaa dii kaali Kɔraawiizi.

ref: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
text: Ba daŋ ɛɛ wiijaama, ka ba hiŋaa wàá wer lizi baa dikuu baŋ vɛɛ u fɔŋŋa wia. Gilɛɛ ra hiŋ nɛra naa dɔŋa.

ref: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
text: Ba baŋhina ɔɔ ra zuu nɛra diinii ra dar haana la n waa nfɛrɛ dɔɔwɛ la. Haana naa dizi wichɔgaa siili ba ninɛɛ. Ba kunnyiŋŋichɔgaarɛ ra fir baa.

ref: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
text: Ba ɔɔ ra helli wiarɛ ka zum wibii himmaa huhzi.

ref: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
text: Gunla Janɛs ni Jambrɛs n faa ra yoo Moosis la, gunnɛ nɛra naa ɔɔ ra koozi banla n na bagli wibii la. Ba nfɛrɛ maa ɛɛ nfɛrchɔgaarɛ. Kɔraawiizi vɛɛ baabuu u hiŋaa biini.

ref: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
text: Ka ba wàá wer la see. Nɛra maa daŋ zum ba huma la zɛɛ, di zum lugɔ a ɛɛ wipɛɛrii. Gunnɛ ba faa wer zum Janɛs ni Jambrɛs huma zɛɛ la. Pɔɔl baglaazi tuna wia

ref: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with
text: Ka i zum baglaa la miŋ faa baglɛɛ labuu, di na n wiɛɛlaa la miŋ faa ɛɛwɛ, di zum wia la n baani n ɛɛa la, di zum gunla miŋ yardi Kɔraawiizi ani gunla wiimaa n haŋ wa ɛɛŋ ka n ɔɔ haa vɛɛ ra hiŋ la, di zum n nɛnɔŋŋaa ni n kanyitti dɔɔi,

ref: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
text: di zum wichɔgaa la nɛra n ɛɛŋ ni tɔɔrɔɔ la miŋ diwee Antiɔk, Aikonium ani Listra maa biine la. Ba tɔɔrimbuu werge, ka yaa Dɔɔri lɛɛŋ a maa biine.

ref: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
text: Wibii maa, banla maa n na nyiŋŋi ba ɛɛ winanaa di ra hiŋ Yeesu Kristo, ba daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ.

ref: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
text: Ka wichɔgɛɛra ni sɔsɔgɔ hina wichɔgaa daŋ nyaŋŋi ra la, ba ra dar nɛra, nɛra ge ra dar baa.

ref: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
text: Ka híŋwaa ra hiŋ wia la hiŋ hellee di wa zum lugɔ a ɛɛ wibiire la. I zum banla n baglii labuu,

ref: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
text: di kaa zum wia la n du Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini i bichalli maa wa lii zinaa. A wia daŋ gil i dɔɔ nfɛrɛ, di zum gunla hin niŋ yardi Yeesu Kristo, di wer na lɛɛi.

ref: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
text: Wiŋɔzi la maa n du Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ la biini, a maanii Kɔraawiizi faa kpa du nɛra baŋhina nuuzi ba sɛbaa dau. A maa wessoo alugɔ á ra bagli wia di ra karfi nɛra ni wichɔgaa ɛɛi, di ra deŋli ŋmɛnizi di ra bagli winanaa ɛɛi.

ref: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
text: A maanii du de, á wer hiini Kɔraawiizi hiŋri, ú wer hum hunnanii dee maa.

ref: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
text: N chigɔ Kɔraawiizi ni Yeesu Kristo la n niŋ wa di nyinee ni lalaa maa seriya la ani un niŋ wa di kora la sibɔɔrɛ, di ra ŋɔ i be siaahmuu ni lugɔ dí,

ref: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
text: ɛɛ ra ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wia. Gil a su i siwii i ra ŋɔa baglaa saŋazi ni saŋadumazi maa. Dɔɔ kanyitti ani Kɔraawiizi wibii di ra bagli nɛra, bá zum wichɔgaa la banna ɛɛ, di ra jugmi baa di kaa ra bagli baa gunla ban ninna hiŋ,

ref: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, saŋa bɛl daŋ wa hel, í wibii wiŋɔzi naa ra biri ba siwee, bá nyiŋŋi nɛra la n niŋ bagli baa wia la n niŋ par baa di zuu baa suma la,

ref: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
text: di vɛɛ wibii nuui ka bir ra nyiŋŋi kara wia.

ref: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
text: Ka híŋwaa ɔɔ lau i hiŋ wiimaa biini, di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ ni kanyitti, di ɔɔ lizi amaniyesuma la wia ra tɛɛ nɛra, di ra hum i huma la Kɔraawiizi n tɛi la maa.

ref: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
text: Miŋwaa, ba jaa ra nyiŋŋuu ba fugiŋ alugɔ niitaalii ra tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. N saŋa helloo min niŋ siu kaali.

ref: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
text: Awia, nɛnanii huma tɔna du denii. Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ Seriya Diiri, u wia dɔɔ wibii la lizuubuu dawiŋ, dikuu miŋ ɛɛ annii maa tuŋ la wia. Di u hɔpizii la wa hello, u daŋ jaa kpau tɛŋ, di kaa kpa aŋhina ge tɛɛ banla maa n na kɛlli u ni, di ra binni u ŋmɛnɛɛ, bá wer nau la. Pɔɔl wiŋɔɔlaa tuna tɛɛ Timoti wia

ref: Come to see me as soon as you can.
text: Ɛɛ ania maa di ba n be manaŋ.

ref: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
text: Dɛmas la gilimbuu ta dikuu durnya kuna nyiŋŋaa wia, ka kaali Tɛsalɔnika. Krɛsɛns la kaali Galesiarɛ. Taitus ge kaali Dalmasia.

ref: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
text: Luuk bɛnnɛ du n be bɔnnaa. Gil Maak gba hiŋii ba. U wettoo ra hiiniŋ werge huma naa biini.

ref: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
text: N hum Tichikusii ú kaali Ɛfɛsus.

ref: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
text: Di i waa ba n be naa, kpa n wɛjɛ la miŋ gillɛ Kapus la n du Troas la be di ra ba, di kaa kpa n hɔna la ge ra ba. Ka hɔna labuu n na nyiŋŋi werge.

ref: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
text: Luuri bɛl du denii ba ra yiruu Alɛgzanda. U faa ɛɛmbuu wichɔgaa werge maa. Yaa Dɔɔri daŋ turguu u wichɔgaa la kim.

ref: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
text: A dazi ú waa nai ra tɔɔri. U faa ra koozi yaa baglaa naabuu werge maa.

ref: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
text: Nɛr maa faa waa n har chigɛ n lugli seriya dii la biini. Ba maanii faa giliŋ ta. Kɔraawiizii niŋ gil ba wichɔgaa la tɛɛ baa.

ref: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
text: Ka n Dɔɔri waa chigɔ n hattɛ di duŋ bɔkpega, n wer di ra ŋɔ u wiŋɔzi la maa ra tɛɛ banla maa n waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ, bá maa nuu. U lɛɛmbuu lii siu biini.

ref: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
text: U danna liziŋ wichɔgii maa biini, di kpogliŋ guŋŋ, ń wa zuu u kora la n du Kɔraawiizi be la biini. Gil u sɔŋ dɔɔ girme filaŋkennaa di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami. Tuna jaamaa wia

ref: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
text: Jaami Pirsila, Akuila ani Ɔnɛsifɔrus diahina la tɛŋ.

ref: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
text: Ɛrastus haa du Kɔrint. Trɔfimus ge faa ra wiiu, n giluu Mailitus.

ref: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
text: Ɛɛ ania maa ba n be manaŋ, ka waári saŋa wa hel. Yubulus, Pudɛns, Linus ani Klaudia ra jaamii. Yeesu hiŋra la maa ra jaamiibuu.

ref: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
text: Yáa Dɔɔri du i be. Ú nɛsunaa du ii be.

ref: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
text: Mìŋ́ Pɔɔllɛ ra sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛi. N ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi baliirɛ di kaa ɛɛ Yeesu Kristo huŋhunni, ń wer hiini banla Kɔraawiizi n lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ la, bá wer yarduu di kaa wer zum u wibii la maa n du yaa hiŋaa naa biini,

ref: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
text: di wer dɔɔ miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la tamii. Kɔraawiizi la n waa kara ra kanni la, waabuu ŋɔ a miibɔɔ wia saŋa la uŋ faa haa waa durnya tawɛɛ mɔɔ la.

ref: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
text: N bie Taitus, n na jaamii. Mìŋ́ lulii hiŋaa naa yaa maa n na hiŋ naa biini. Awia, i ɛɛ n bie himmaanii. Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Lɛɛri Yeesu Kristo hiinii, di tɛi bampirsɔna. Huma n dɛkkɛ Taitus hum Krit hɛri wia

ref: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
text: Miŋ gilii Krit la, n faa ra nyiŋŋuu lugɔ i wer tuŋ wia la n faa haa kawɛɛ de la, di la bola la maa di ga lizi nabɔnzi Yeesu hiŋra la maa biini gunla miŋ baglii la, bá wer ra binni ba ni.

ref: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
text: Miŋ ŋɔ í lizi nabɔnzi naa, ɛɛ́ lizi banla n waa wichɔgii maa dɔɔwɛ nɛra n niŋ ŋɔ ba wia, ba kaa dɔɔ hahkpaŋkpaŋa bɛŋ la. A wesso ba biizi ge n na sɛɛ Yeesu wia, nɛ́ra gilɛɛ wa wer ŋɔ ba wia alugɔ ba kpoŋŋoo di ɛɛ dignikpega hina,

ref: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, a dɛkkɔɔ nɛr la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra ni n ɛɛ nɛnanii, nɛ́r maa gilɛɛ wer ŋɔ u wichɔgaa ɛɛi maa wia. Kɔraawiizi baliirɛ. Ú gilɛɛ ra na u hiŋ, di gilɛɛ dɔɔ baasi werge, di gilɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi siŋ nyɔɔi, di gilɛɛ dɔɔ miisɔɔh, di gilɛɛ ra fini nɛra ú na kebee.

ref: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
text: Ú ɛɛ hɔɔhrilɛɛri, di ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi winanaa wia. Ɔɔ́ dɔɔ nfɛrɛ nɛnnɛ, di gil u wia maa ra deŋli, doŋa maa gilɛɛ waa pɛluu. Ɔɔ́ ra lau u hiŋ nɛnnɛ,

ref: They must stick to the true message they were taught, so their good teaching can help others and correct everyone who opposes it.
text: di ɔɔ ra hiŋ Kɔraawiizi wibii gunla baŋ faa bagluu la, ú ɔɔ wer ra ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wia ŋmɛnizi gunla anna hiŋ di ra tɛɛ nɛra, di kaa wer ra di banla n na di hɔɔzi la wibii, bá zum.

ref: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
text: Nɛkpila du de di ɛɛ dignikpega hina, di ra ŋɔ wia pɛɛpɛɛ di ra dar nɛra. Banla n na teŋri hɛna labuu ra dar nɛra werge.

ref: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
text: A wesso nɛra n tɔ ba nuuzi bá siigi. Ba ra chɔgi nɛra ni ba diini hina maanii, di ra bagli wia la n waa dɛkkɛ bá na kebee a biini.

ref: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
text: Ba bɛl ɛɛ dɔgtɛɛrɛ di faa ŋɔ ba wia keŋ, “Krit hina maa ɛɛ karkanna ani wichɔgɛɛraa, di dɔɔ kɛkɛluu ni yaara.”

ref: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
text: Wibiire u faa ŋɔ gunla. Awia, a di baa wibii bá zum, ka bá jaa ra hiŋ Kɔraawiizi ŋmɛnɛɛ ani wibii.

ref: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
text: Gilɛɛ ra hagzi Jus hina kara la ni wia la banla n vɛɛ wibii n na ŋɔ bá ra ɛɛ la.

ref: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
text: Di i himmaa biini wesso, kummaa wessoo tɛi. A waa kii. Ka banla n dɔɔ wichɔgaa ba biine, ba waa yarda dɔɔwɛ la, kummaa ra kiiu. Ba biine nfɛssi ni ba biine wia maa doŋŋoo.

ref: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
text: Ba ŋɔ ba zum Kɔraawiizii. Ka ba wiɛɛlaa biinii i chi zum lugɔ ba waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ. Ba ɛɛ nɛjagazii. Ba waa wia ra nuu. Ba wàá wer ɛɛ winanaa maa.

ref: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
text: Ka híŋwaa ra bagli Kɔraawiizi wibii ni u ŋmɛnizi, á ra deŋli nɛnnɛ.

ref: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
text: Ŋɔ bazɛŋzi be, dí bá ra lau bahinaa wiimaa biini, di ra ɛɛ wia la n dɛkkɛ, di dɔɔ nfɛrɛ di ra hiŋ yaa hiŋaa naa nɛnnɛ, di dɔɔ nɛnɔŋŋaa ni kanyitti.

ref: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
text: Hazɛŋzi ge, ŋɔ ba be, dí bá ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi di ra hiŋuu, di gilɛɛ ra zɔɔzi nɛra di gilɛɛ gil siŋ dɔɔ baa, ka bá ra bagli winanaa ɛɛi.

ref: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
text: Di ba ra ɛɛ guŋ, ba daŋ wer bagli suŋgure gunla ban niŋ nɔŋŋi ba janna ni ba biizi,

ref: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
text: di dɔɔ nfɛrɛ nɛnnɛ, doŋa maa gilɛɛ waa pɛli baa. Bá ra hum ba huma ba diini, di ɔɔ ra ɛɛ nɛra winanaa, di ɔɔ ra sɛɛ ba janna dɔɔra. Bá ra ɛɛ guŋ, nɛ́ra gilɛɛ wa kuu ba wia di ra gbɛlli Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii la.

ref: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
text: Ŋɔ biipɔllaa ge be lugɔ bá dɔɔ nfɛrɛ nɛnnɛ wiimaa biini.

ref: Always set a good example for others. Be sincere and serious when you teach.
text: Hìń niŋ ɔɔ ra hiŋ nɛnnɛ, bá wer zum hinnanii hiŋaa i be. Ɛɛ́ gil i baglaa ra deŋli, di ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wia la n dɛkkɛ.

ref: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
text: Gil i wiŋɔzi ɔɔ dɔɔ wibii nɛnnɛ, bá bilaa huhzi. Di gunnɛ, yaa dɔma wàá na wichɔgii maa di wer ŋɔ yaa wia, ka á ɛɛ baa hiihzi.

ref: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
text: Ŋɔ balaa be lugɔ bá ra sɛɛ ba dɔɔra dɔɔra, wiimaa biini. Bá gil ba wia par baa nɛnnɛ di gilɛɛ ra gbirgi ba nuuzi,

ref: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
text: di gilɛɛ ra ŋmɛɛ ba kuna. Ka bá gil ba wia ɔɔ dɔɔ wibii nɛnnɛ ba be. Di ba ra ɛɛ guŋ, yaa Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi wia naa yaa n na bagli naa daŋ na sɔŋ dikuu ba wia,

ref: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ u nɛsunaa ni u hiinaa lii bɔchaaŋ filaŋkeŋ, nɛ́r maa wer zum a wia di wer na lɛɛi.

ref: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
text: Awia, gunna bagluu lugɔ a wesso yaa n vɛɛ wichɔgaa maa ani kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa la maa, ka dɔɔ nfɛrɛ di ra ɛɛ wia la n deŋlee, di dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu filaŋkeŋ hina naa be,

ref: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
text: di ra kpaŋ saŋa la Yeesu Kristo n niŋ ba ni u girme, ya nau la. Waabuu Kɔraawiizizeŋ ni yaa Lɛɛri la. U balaa tamii dɔɔi ɛɛ yaa bɔsɔnaa werge.

ref: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
text: U siuwɔɔ dikuu yaa wia, ú wer turgi yaa kim di lɛɛ yaa lii biinikpola wia maa biini, di wer sɔ yaa doŋa maa ha, ya wer birgi u bɛŋ hora, di wer aah siwii ni winanaa ɛɛi.

ref: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
text: Bagli wia naa maa di ŋɔ bá ra hiŋ, di hau ba ni. A ɛɛ guŋ maa ani fɔŋŋa. Gilɛɛ gil nɛr maa waa gbɛllii.

ref: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
text: Liizi baa lugɔ a dɛkkɔ banna sɛɛ ba hɛri nabɔnzi ni ba nabɔnzi maa dɔɔra, di ra hiŋ ba nuuzi, di feli ɛɛ sirya dau bá hum hunnanii maa,

ref: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
text: di gilɛɛ ra gbɛlli nɛra, di gilɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi kalu, ka pɛssi ba ni, di dɔɔ sisɔna nɛr maa ni,

ref: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa gba faa gɛnnɔɔ guŋ. Yaa faa waa wia ra nuu. Ba faa dar yaabuu yaa faa birgi yoma, di faa ra hiŋ yaa kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa, di ra di yaa hinaa jagajaga. Miisɔɔh ni bɔwii mannii yaa faa dɔɔ di ra la. Nɛra faa hah yaa, yaa ge hah nɛra.

ref: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
text: Denii yaa Lɛɛri Kɔraawiizi nɛhiinaa ni u nɛnɔŋŋaa dɔɔi n wa liwɛɛ yaa zum a wia la,

ref: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
text: u lɛɛ yaa ha. Un lɛɛ yaa ha la, yaa winanaa ɛɛi wia lɛi u lɛɛ yaa ha. Un suŋ yaa ni wiarɛ u lɛɛ yaa ha la, di sɔ yaa nii yaa wer dɔɔ miibɔɔfalii di kpa u Dumnanii tɛɛ yaa, ú wer kuari yaa biine.

ref: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
text: Uŋ kpa u Dumnanii tɛɛ yaa la, u tɛɛ yaabuu werge maa dikuu yaa Lɛɛri Yeesu Kristo wia.

ref: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
text: A Yeesu n suŋ yaa ni di hiini yaa wiarɛ yaa wia wer deŋli Kɔraawiizi be la, yaa kaa dɔɔ u miibɔɔ la n waa tuŋ la tamii lugɔ yaa daŋ wa nau.

ref: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
text: Wia naa maa ɛɛ wibiire. Ɛɛ́ ra baglaa siaahmu ni, di ra tɛɛ banla n sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wia di yarduu, bá aah siwii di ra ɛɛ winanaa. Guŋ dɔɔ tɔna ni hiinaare werge.

ref: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
text: Ɔɔ́ gil hɔɔzi dii la n ɛɛ gɛnni wia la, di gilɛɛ kpogli wiŋɔzi ani ii naabaala ni Gbɔg hiŋaa wia. Annii waa tɔna maa dɔɔwɛ. A ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ.

ref: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
text: Nɛr la n na di hɔɔzi guŋ, karfuu ú ra dazi. Di u haa ra di a hɔɔzi, kaa karfuu. Di waa i karfaazi anɛɛhiŋ nuuwɛ, giluu,

ref: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, i zum baal naa deere gunla un duwɛɛ. U nfɛrɛ bittɔɔ, u ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa. U himmaa zummɔ lugɔ u ra ɛɛ wichɔgaarɛ. Tuna wibaglaa wia

ref: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
text: Di n wa hum Aatɛmas gɛɛ Tichikus i be, ɛɛ ania di ba n be Nikɔpɔlis a saŋa, dikuubɛɛwiai, n daŋ ga du de waári saŋa wa tuŋ mɔɔ.

ref: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
text: Ɛɛ ania maa di hiini gbɔgzunni Zɛnas ni Apɔlɔs la, bá wer la ba laŋribɔr la di gilɛɛ waa nyaa kummaa ban niŋ kpa di ra la.

ref: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
text: Banla maa n du n be bɔnnaa ra jaamii. Jaami banla maa yaa ni baa n summɛ dikuu hiŋaa naa yaa maa n na hiŋ naa wia. Kɔ́raawiizi nɛsunaa du ii be.

ref: From Paul, who is in jail for serving Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is like a brother because of our faith. Philemon, you work with us and are very dear to us. This letter is to you
text: Mìŋ́ Pɔɔl la n du nɛra tɔi dia dikuu Yeesu Kristo wia la ni yaa dɔŋhiŋ Timotii ra sɛbi hɔnnaa di ra tɛɛ yaa nɛnɔŋŋii Failimɔn la n ɔɔ ra hiini yaa huma naa biini la.

ref: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
text: Yaa ra jaami i ni Yeesu hiŋra maa n ɔɔ chaali i dia biini, yaa niuhambie Afia la ani Aakipus la n ɛɛ yaa dɔŋhiŋ laallɔɔri.

ref: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
text: Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo hiini ia di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Jaaŋ tɛɛi ni wiisuŋŋaa wia

ref: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
text: Saŋa maa, di n waa nyiŋŋi n suŋŋi n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, aŋ suŋŋuu tɛi di ra jaamuu,

ref: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, n nuu i wiarɛ gunla hiŋ nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la maa, di yardi yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu nɛnnɛ la.

ref: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
text: Awia, n na suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii lugɔ ú gil nuukpaŋ dɔɔi la i ni Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la n dɔɔwɛ dikuu ii Kɔraawiizi yarda wia la ú wer lii tɔna tɛɛ ia, ií wer zum suma la maa iin dɔɔwɛ Kristo hiŋaa naa biini.

ref: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
text: N niwee, i nɛnɔŋŋaa naa gillɔɔ n bɔra sɔɔni werge di ra tig n bampirii, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi biinanaa ra na hiinaa ni bɔsɔnaa werge lii i be. Suŋŋaa tɛɛ Ɔnɛsimɔs wia

ref: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
text: Miŋ nɔŋŋii keŋ wiarɛ n ŋɔ n daŋ gil guŋ ka ra suŋŋii wii naa. Minuu Yeesu Kristo huŋhunni Pɔɔl la baŋ tɔ dia dikuu u wia la. Ka màá kuu guŋ wia di di kpegzi i ni.

ref: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
text: N na suŋŋiibuu di ra tɛɛ n bie bɛl. U sɔnnɛ Ɔnɛsimus. Minuu luluu Kristo wia biini di n du nɛra tɔi dia biini.

ref: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.
text: U faa waa wikuarii maa dɔɔwɛ i be. Ka filaŋkennaa, u dɔɔ wikuariirɛ werge maa i be, di dɔɔ wikuarii n ge gba be.

ref: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
text: Ka n humuubuu ú bir ba i be filaŋkeŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, n bampirii lawuubuu.

ref: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
text: N faa ra nyiŋŋuu u du n be, ú wer lɛɛ i bɔr di hiiniŋ nɛra tɔi dia naa baŋ tɔŋ dikuu amaniyesuma la wia biini.

ref: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
text: Ka n faa waa nyiŋŋi n ɛɛ wii naa di maa nuuwɛ lii i be mɔɔ. Di i himmaa biini tɛi lugɔ í hiiniŋ guŋ, amɔ, í hiiniŋ. Ka maa nyiŋŋi i ɛɛ winanaa dikuu miŋ firii wia.

ref: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
text: Onɛsimus n lii i nonii biini tama naa, aŋhinabe, guŋ ɛɛwɔɔ ka í kaa wer nau, ú du i be saŋa maa di ra la.

ref: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
text: Ama, filaŋkennaa, wàá ka ɛɛ lugɔ i yom bɛnnɛ. U jaa ɛɛu lugɔ i maa bie ni i nɛnɔŋŋii. Miŋ nɔŋŋuu naa, ka hiŋwaa daŋ nɔŋŋuu werge dikuu uŋ ɛɛ i yom di kaa ɛɛ i dɔŋhiŋ yaa Dɔɔri hiŋaa naa biini wia.

ref: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
text: Di n nii ɛɛ kpaŋ, amɔ, í lɛɛu gunla hin niŋ lɛɛŋ la.

ref: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
text: Di u faa ɛɛi wichɔgii maa gɛɛ di u di i kinnɛ, gil tɛu ka kpaa ra pɛɛziŋ.

ref: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
text: Mìŋ́ Pɔɔllɛ sɛbɛɛ bɔnnaa. N daŋ turgii. Ama, i ge gba di n kinnɛ, dikuu min lɛɛ i miibɔɔ wia.

ref: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
text: Awia, n niwee, gil n ge na hiinaa tama i be yaa Dɔɔri huma naa biini. A duŋ bɔkpega dikuu yaa maa ni Kristo n kpauwɛ wia.

ref: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
text: Minna sɛbi naa, n dɔɔ i tamiirɛ lugɔ i daŋ ɛɛ gunla maa miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ naabuu di kaa jaa gba.

ref: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
text: N ni Ɛpafras maanii ba tɔ dia ɛŋ dikuu Yeesu Kristo wia. U ra jaamii.

ref: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
text: Maak, Aristakus, Dɛmas ani Luuk la n ni baa n na hum la, ge gba ra jaamii.

ref: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
text: Yáa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo nɛsunaa ni u hiinaa du i be.

ref: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
text: Faala la, Kɔraawiizi faa ŋɔ wiarɛ ra tɛɛ yaa naabaala saŋakpila maa. Gunla um bagli baa a wia gba kpillɔɔ. U dɔgtɛɛzii u gil ba ŋɔ a wia ra tɛɛ nɛra la.

ref: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
text: Ka tuna hɔpizaa naa biini waa, u Biibaallɛ u gil u ŋɔ wia tɛɛ yaa. U Biibaal hiŋ, u gillɔɔ u dɔɔ u kummaa. Uŋ faa ta chiŋ ni hɛri la, waabuu u faa gil u taa la gba.

ref: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
text: Kɔraawiizi girme du u ninɛɛ. Gunla Kɔraawiizi n duwɛɛ, gunnɛ u ge du. U li u himmaanii sooo. U wiŋɔzi dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa. A fɔŋŋa biinii kunla maa n du de wer du de. Kɔraawiizi Biibaal hiŋ n wa lizi wichɔgaa doŋa nɛra ni, u la ga so Kɔraawiizi nabɔmbɔr.

ref: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
text: U kaali mɛlikazi la werge maa, dikuu sɔŋ la Kɔraawiizi n tɛu u du wer kaali a sɔna wia.

ref: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
text: Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ u wiarɛ keŋ, “N Biibaallɛ hiŋ, zinaabuu n lulii,” di kaa ŋɔ, “N daŋ ɛɛ u Mɛɛ, ú ge ɛɛ n Biibaal.” Mɛlika bɛlii wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi haa ŋɔ kennei?

ref: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
text: Uŋ wa gillɛ u biinabɔma zuu durnya la, u ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi mɛlikazi maa danna jaamuu.”

ref: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
text: Uŋ ŋɔ u mɛlikazi ge wia, u ŋɔ, “U gillɔɔ u mɛlikazi ɛɛ lugɔ peu ni ninlau.”

ref: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
text: Ka uŋ ŋɔ u Biibaal wia, u ŋɔ, “I kora daŋ chiu di hanna la saŋa maa. Kɔraawiizi wideŋlaa ɛɛ i koori daŋkpalaa, í kpa ra dɔɔ nɛra.

ref: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
text: I nɔŋŋi wideŋlaare ka hah wichɔgaa. Awiarɛ Kɔraawiizi la hinna hum la lizii, di tɛi bɔsɔna kaali i dɔŋahina la.”

ref: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
text: Ba kaa ŋɔ, “N Dɔɔri, hinuu chiŋŋi hɛri zɛɛ, chiŋ ge gba ɛɛ i nonee humaa.

ref: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
text: A chiŋ ni hɛri daŋ ŋmɛnɛ chɔgi, ka hiŋwaa du de ra la. A daŋ siuzi lugɔ wɛjɛ n ɔɔ siu la.

ref: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
text: I daŋ kpɛwaa di dau alugɔ wɛjɛ, A wàá ɔɔ kaa wer du wer lugɔ a falli la di hanna la. Ka hiŋwaa daŋ ɔɔ du gunla hiŋ faa duwɛɛ la. I binni waa maga dɔɔwɛ.”

ref: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
text: Mɛlika bɛlii benii Kɔraawiizi faa ŋɔ, “Wa so n nabɔmbɔr, ka ń gil i dɔma birgi i yomai?”

ref: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
text: Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna lɛi aawaa? U ɔɔ humaabuu á hiini banla un niŋ lɛɛ la.

ref: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
text: Awia, a dɛkkɔɔ yaa n niŋ keŋŋi digna nuu ra sɛɛ wia la yaa n nuuwɛ, ya gilɛɛ wa fori ra bir har,

ref: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, wiŋɔzi la mɛlikazi n faa baglɛɛ la faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ gbɔgkpeg bɛl. Unla maa n faa vɛɛu, ba faa ɔɔ tɛubuu kim.

ref: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
text: Di mɛlikazi hora kpekko guŋ, ka di yaa vɛɛ yaa lɛɛi naa n ɛɛ wizeŋ werge maa kaali mɛlikazi wiŋɔzi la kennaa, ɛrɛɛ ya ge ɛɛ di wer liiyɛi? Yaa Dɔɔri himmaanii felee bagli yaa a wia. Denii banla n nuu a wia u be la kaa ra bagli yaa, di di u wiŋɔzi la daansɛɛ ra tɛɛ yaa.

ref: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
text: Kɔraawiizi ge gba di u daansɛɛrɛ, di ɛɛ witittaa, wizenaa ani nuukpuuri wia deekpila, di bɔnni nɛra wiɛɛlaa fɔŋŋazi gunla maa am paruu lii u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini. Yeesu n li u niuna wia

ref: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
text: Mɛlikazi lɛi Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ ú tɛɛa fɔŋŋa, á dɔɔ durnya hina la n niŋ wa du de, saŋa la yaa n na ŋɔ u wia la.

ref: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
text: Nɛbɛl sɛbɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ yembɛl, di pɛɛzi, “Newee ɛɛ kumpaa i ra binni u nii?

ref: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
text: I gillɔɔ mɛlikazi bɔu tama, di kaa gil u dɔɔ girme ni sɔŋ,

ref: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
text: di tɛu kummaa fɔŋŋa.” Uŋ ŋɔ kennaa lugɔ u tɛubuu kummaa fɔŋŋa la, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kummaa waa hoo uŋ waa u fɔŋŋa dɔɔwɛ. Ka yaa haa waa nawɛɛ lugɔ kummaa fɔŋŋa du u benii.

ref: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
text: Ka Yeesuwaa, Kɔraawiizi faa gillɔɔ mɛlikazi bɔu tama, ka filaŋkeŋwaa, u jaa giluu u nɛsunaa ni u hiinaa du u be, di tɛu girme ni sɔŋ, dikuu uŋ wette di tɔɔrɔɔ siu la wia. Kɔraawiizi nɛsunaa wiarɛ u kuu nɛr maa wia zum siu la.

ref: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
