text: Ii gil ii wiŋɔzi ni ii wiɛɛlaa maa du wer, dikuubɛɛwiai, Gbɔgni la n dɔɔ hiinaa, di lɛɛ nɛra bá wer dɔɔ bahinaa labuu, bá wa kpa di di ia seriya.

ref: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
text: Nɛr la maa n waa u dɔŋahina ni ra suŋ, di u seriya dii wa hello, Kɔraawiizi wàá suŋ u ge ni. Ka nɛr la n na suŋ u dɔŋahina ni, wàá ɔm u ge seriya dii. Yarda ni wiɛɛlaa wia

ref: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
text: Yaabalaa, di nɛbɛl ŋɔ lugɔ u yardi Kɔraawiizii, ka waa winanaa ra ɛɛ, pɛɛrɛ. U yarda hiŋ wàá gil ú na lɛɛi Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
text: Di i dɔŋhiŋ bɛl waa kunlaalii dɔɔwɛ ú tɔ u bɔra, waa diwee dɔɔwɛ ú di, ka ba i be,

ref: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
text: i ŋɔ u be, “Kɔ́raawiizi la i ni di ga tɛi kuna la hinna nyiŋŋi í tɔ i bɔra, di kaa tɛi kuna la hin niŋ di.” Ka hiŋwaa waa sɛɛwɛ í tɛu kuna la maa unna nyiŋŋi, yarda naa hiŋ yardi Kɔraawiizi naa, bɛɛ wikuariirɛ u dɔɔ naanɛi? Kumpɛɛrɛ.

ref: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
text: Di i yardi Kɔraawiizi ka haa winanaa ɛɛi maa dɔɔwɛ jaa i yarda la ni, ka dɔɔ yarda la bɛŋ, amɔ, kumpɛɛrɛ i dɔɔ la.

ref: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
text: Aŋhina be, ii bɛl daŋ ŋɔ lugɔ bɛl hotte Kɔraawiizi yarda dɔɔi, bɛl ge horuu winanaa ɛɛi. Ka hàá wer bargaa guŋ. Hinla n ŋɔ i yardi Kɔraawiizii la, ɛrɛɛ í ɛɛ bagli i Kɔraawiizi yarda dɔɔi la, di haa winanaa maa ɛɛwɛi? Ka n ge daŋ ɛɛ winanaa, ń winanaa la ɛɛi baglii lugɔ n yardi Kɔraawiizii.

ref: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
text: I yardɔɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi kpaŋkpaŋ bɛnnɛ du dee? Mhmm. Tinnanchɔgaa gba yardi gunnɛ, a bɔra a sa.

ref: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
text: Haa na gunla u Kɔraawiizi yardaa la n gillɛ u ɛɛ winanaa, u winanaa ɛɛi hiŋ gil u yarda dɔɔi wer du wer di wa tunaa?

ref: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
text: Gunla baŋ faa ŋɔ u wia Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini la ɛɛ wibiire. Ba ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Abraham yardi Kɔraawiizii. Kɔraawiizi gil u wia deŋli u be, ba jaa ra yiruu Kɔraawiizi dammu.”

ref: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
text: Awia, di nɛr yardi Kɔraawiizi ka ra ɛɛ winanaa, Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil u ɛɛ nɛnanii u be. Un yarduu bɛŋ wia lɛi ú ɛɛ guŋ tɛu.

ref: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
text: Ií kaa binni Rahab ge wia biini. A Rahab faa ɛɛ hahsɛnsɛnnii, ka uŋ faa wette lɛɛ huŋhunna la dau, di kaa hiini baa ba wer kpa ŋmɛnɛɛ bɛl di suahzi kaali la wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi faa gil u birgi nɛnanii u be.

ref: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
text: Yaabalaa, a waa wer iiŋ kpillɛ di ɛɛ bagla di ra bagli ii dɔŋahina. Ií zum lugɔ yaa banla n ɛɛ bagla, yaa ge seriya dii daŋ du kaŋ kaali baŋhina.

ref: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
text: Nɛr maanii ɛɛ wia ra leu. Nɛr la maa n du de u haa waa wiimaa ŋɔwɛɛ leu, amɔ, a hiŋ ɛɛ nɛnaniirɛ. Di u wetto ra lau u nua, amɔ, u daŋ wer lau u himmaa gba.

ref: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
text: Di i ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ zagu ra ɔmii, i daŋ kpa kabarga du u nua, di wer bir u maa ú ra la i kipar bɔr.

ref: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
text: Ií binni muugberzenaa la gba na. A kannɔzii werge. Pekpega ge ɔɔ taa ra kaali. Ka kunjiga bɛl ɔɔ wer deŋlaa a ra la bɔr la maa a muugbersaara nabɔma n na nyiŋŋi.

ref: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
text: Gunnɛ nuuzuŋŋi ge gba du. Waa kaŋ ka wer ra ɛɛ wizenaa. Ii waa nawɛɛ ninjiga n ɔɔ wer fuuh daakpila maa?

ref: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
text: Nuuzuŋŋi ge ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ a niŋ, di wer ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa werge maa, di wer kpa doŋa ra du yaa ni, di wer ra chɔgi yaa mananaa maa alugɔ niŋ n ɔɔ ra chɔgi kuna gunla. Sitaani ninne choŋŋuu la.

ref: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
text: Pir sela, zumbizi, kunjigzi ani muu biini kuna maa, newee wettoo ra dɛɛzi a maa, a ra pɛssi.

ref: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
text: Ka nuuzuŋŋiwaa, ba ɔɔ lau waabuurɛ di pɛssuu huhzi. U kuttɔɔrɛ dɔɔ wichɔgaa, di kpoŋ werge. U siri ge du kpeg lugɔ ú wer kpui.

ref: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
text: Ii haa na gɔŋ maa n na bul niinanii ni niikpɛlɛkpɛlɛ maa?

ref: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
text: Fig daa waa ɔlivizi ra nɔŋ. Huu ge waa suula ra nɔŋ. Gunnɛ gɔŋ la n na bul niisum wàá wer bul niikpɛlɛkpɛlɛ la. Nunzuma la n lii chiŋ wia

ref: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
text: Anɛɛ dɔɔ nunzuma ani sichaana ii biinei? Di i dɔɔ nunzuma, i danna kpa i hiŋ fugzi ka ra ɛɛ winanaa, í winanaa ɛɛi la bagli lugɔ i dɔɔ guŋ nunzuma ni sichaanaa.

ref: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
text: Ka di i dɔɔ bɔwii werge di ra nyiŋŋi i bɛŋ sɔŋ, gilɛɛ ra chɔli i hiŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, i ra dar i hinnɛ. Haa wibii dɔɔwɛ.

ref: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
text: Kɔraawiizi be nunzuma lɛi. Durnya nunzumaa. Newee ni Sitaani benii u lii.

ref: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
text: Bɔwii ni sɔnnyiŋŋaa haŋ wa zuu nɛra baaŋ, too, ba wiimaa a chɔguu, hunjagazi ni a dee maa ra lii.

ref: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
text: Bɛɛ n ɔɔ ra koozi ia, ii ra di dɔŋa hɔɔzi di ra naai? Ii himmaa kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa biini lɛi a ra liiyaa? Ii kunnyiŋŋichɔgaarɛ ɔɔ ra yoo ia.

ref: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
text: Kuna la ii kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa la n na nyiŋŋi ka ii waa dɔɔwɛ la wiarɛ ii kuu ra kpu dɔŋa. Ii dɔɔ kuna kɛkɛluurɛ ka ii waa wette ra naa. Awiarɛ ii ra di dɔŋa hɔɔzi, di ra naa la. Ii waa a kuna suŋŋɛɛ Kɔraawiizi be wiarɛ ii waa dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
text: Di ii suŋŋaa, ka ii waa nawɛɛ, ii biine n waa huuhzɛɛ ka ii suŋŋaa wiarɛ ii waa nawɛɛ la. Iihinaa dii wiarɛ ii suŋŋaa.

ref: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
text: Ii ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ hahchɔgaa la n ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi badumazi la. Ii waa zummɛ lugɔ di ii ni durnya summɔ, ii hah Kɔraawiiziiyaa? Awia, nɛr la maa n lau durnya dammu, u ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi haahrii.

ref: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
text: Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ n baglɛɛ lugɔ duma la Kɔraawiizi n kpawɛɛ du yaa ni la dɔɔ bɔwiirɛ la, pɛɛrɛ u bagli guŋ gɛɛ?

ref: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra hiini yaabuu werge. Awiarɛ ba kaa sɛbi, di ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi ni banla n na yir bahinaa nɛzenaa la ra naau. Ka u ra suŋ banla n ɛɛ sisɔna hina ninɛɛ, di ra hiini baa.”

ref: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
text: Awia, ií ra sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dɔɔra. Di Sitaani ra nyiŋŋi ú dar ia, ií vɛɛ. Di ii vɛɛu, u daŋ chɔ.

ref: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
text: Ií ra dugli Kɔraawiizi. U ge daŋ ba ii be. Ii banla n ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra, ií ra sanzi ii nonee! Ii banla ge n ɛɛ nfɛssi anɛɛgaa hina, ií lizi ii biine doŋa ra ha.

ref: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
text: Ií gil ii biine chɔgi ii ra wii, di gil ii mamaa birgi wiraa, ií bɔsɔna la ge birgi biinichɔg.

ref: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
text: Ií ra kpa iihinaa tama ii Dɔɔri be, ka ú ge wer tɛɛ ia sɔŋ.

ref: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
text: Yaabalaa, ii gilɛɛ ra gbɛlli dɔŋa. Nɛr la maa n na gbɛlli u dɔŋhiŋ Yeesu hiŋri, di kpa wichɔgaa ra sag u ni, u ra gbɛlli Kɔraawiizi ni Gbɔgni labuu, di kpa wichɔgaa ra sag Gbɔgni la ni. Di hinla maa ra ɛɛ guŋ, haa Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgni a hiŋ ka bir kpa i hiŋ di birgi a Gbɔgni ge seriya diiri.

ref: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
text: Unla n ɛɛ Gbɔgduuri ni Seriya Diiri, di ra lɛɛ nɛra ka kaa ra kpu baa la, a hiŋ ɛɛ nɛkpaŋkpaŋ bɛnnɛ. Waabuu Kɔraawiizi. Anɛɛ hiŋ, í wer tɛɛ i dɔŋahina chɔgrɛi? Karfaa dikuu barabara tai wia

ref: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
text: Ii baŋhina ɔɔ ŋɔ, “Zinaa gɛɛ kɛrɛ, yaa daŋ la bol bɛl di ga du de bina, di ra yoo kuna di ra na kebee.”

ref: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
text: Ii zum kɛrɛa? Ii zum ii hɔpizaa magaa? Ii miibɔɔni ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kɔɔl. A kɔɔl ɔɔ tɔ bɔruu tama. Di ii kaa ŋɔ ií binni di waa kaa hoo. Gunnɛ newee miibɔɔ du.

ref: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
text: Di ii vii ɔɔ ŋɔ, “Di Kɔraawiizi sɛɛwɔ di tɛɛ yaa miibɔɔ, yaa daŋ ɛɛ kennaa ni keŋ.”

ref: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
text: Ka guŋ lɛi ii ra ɛɛ. Ii ɛɛ tamiirɛ lugɔ ii zum wiarɛ di ra ta barabara. Barabara naa dee waa wer.

ref: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
text: Awia, nɛr la maa n zum wia la n deŋlee ka waa guŋ ɛɛwɛ, wichɔgaarɛ u ɛɛ la.

ref: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
text: Daama hina, ií feli ra wii di ra lɔɔgi wile. Wia ra bau á wa huuzi ia.

ref: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
text: Ii daama la chɔkkɔɔ, ii laala la ge chɔgi,

ref: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
text: ii kebee kaa nyɛɛsi. Ii kebee n nyɛɛsɛɛ la, a daŋ ɛɛ ii wichɔgaa daansɛɛ di tɔɔri ia alugɔ niŋ. Ii chaali ii daamaa di dau durnya tunaa hɔpizaa biinii la.

ref: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
text: Ií ra nuu ɛŋ! Ii paahdiire la n par ii kooni ii di baa, ii waa sɛɛwɛ ii turgi baa la, ba wiiwoo ra du ii ni. A paahdiire nuumaa ra zuu kummaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi dignaa.

ref: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
text: Ii na bɔnaniirɛ di so hɛri naa biini di ra di iihinaa, di dɔɔ werge, di ɛɛ lugɔ nau la baŋ varɛɛ u hel werge di pɔl bá kpu labuu.

ref: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
text: Ii ɔɔ di nɛnanii kpui seriyaa di kpuu. Waabuu waa ɔɔ wer ú ɛɛ wiimaa lɛɛ u hiŋ. Kanyitti dii ni wiisuŋŋaa wia

ref: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
text: Yaabalaa, ií ge ra di kanyitti. Yaa Dɔɔri daŋ ba. Gunla patti n ɔɔ haa vɛɛ ra di u diwee wia kanyitti guŋŋ, hɛhchaandooŋ ani yuulindooŋ maa wa ba la,

ref: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
text: gunnɛ ií ge ɔɔ haa vɛɛ di ra di kanyitti, di ra du iihinaa bɔkpega la. Yaa Dɔɔri balaa ra dugluu.

ref: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
text: Yaabalaa, ii gilɛɛ nuumi di ra du dɔŋa, Kɔ́raawiizi gilɛɛ waa ŋɔ ii ge wia, di ŋɔ ii hor waa sum. Ií na! Seriyadiiri la duglɔɔrɛ ú zuu.

ref: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
text: Yaabalaa, ií ra liizi gunla Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi la n ɔɔ faa kpa u wiŋɔzi di ŋɔ ra tɛɛ nɛra n faa di tɔɔrɔɔ werge la. Ií ge ra hiŋ baa guŋ.

ref: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
text: Yaa ra yir baabuu bɔsɔna hina, dikuu baŋ wette di kanyitti wia. Ii faa nuu Joob wiarɛ gunla uŋ faa di kanyitti werge la, di zum gunla Kɔraawiizi n wa turguu u kanyitti dii la kim, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi dɔɔ nɛsunaa di ra na nɛra sinyɛnaa werge.

ref: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
text: Ama, yaabalaa, ií ra dazi wii naa ni werge lugɔ ii gilɛɛ ra hɛɛhzi chiŋ ni hɛri ni kummaa. Di ii ra sɛɛ, ií ŋɔ, “Ɛɛh” gɛɛ “Akai,” ií kpogli guŋ maga, á gilɛɛ waa birgi wichɔgaa ra tɛɛ ia. Wiisuŋŋaa ni yarda wia

ref: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
text: Di ii bɛl du tɔɔrɔɔ biini, ú ra suŋŋi wiizi. Di bɛl bɔra sɔɔnuu, ú ra yir yira di ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi.

ref: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
text: Di bɛl bɔra waa haŋ wa du sum, ú yir Yeesu hiŋra nabɔnzi, di gil bá kpa nuu tama faau, di yir Yeesu sɔŋ di du u ni, di suŋŋi wiizi tɛu.

ref: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
text: Di ba suŋŋuu ni yarda, a wiila hiŋ daŋ na alaanfia. Yaa Dɔɔri daŋ chaau. Di u faa ɛɛ wichɔgaa, u daŋ gil a wichɔgaa tɛu.

ref: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
text: Awia, a wesso iiŋ ɔɔ bagli ii wichɔgaa ra tɛɛ ii dɔŋahina Yeesu hiŋra, bá wer suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi ú tɛɛ ia alaanfia. Nɛnanii Kɔraawiizi suŋŋaa dɔɔ fɔŋŋaa werge.

ref: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
text: Ɛlija faa du yaa ge duula naabuu. U suŋŋi wiizi werge lugɔ dooŋ chi. Dooŋ la chi binni ahoro ni keza.

ref: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
text: U kaa suŋŋi wiizi ŋɔ ú pilli dooŋ. Dooŋ pilli. Diwee wer ra ɛɛ.

ref: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
text: Yaabalaa, di bɛl maa wa leuwo, waa kaa ra hiŋ wibii, ka ii bɛl wer hiinuu u kaa ra hiŋ, u hum hunnaniirɛ werge maa.

ref: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
text: Ií zum lugɔ nɛr la n wette hiini wichɔgɛɛri u gil u wichɔgaa la ka ra hiŋ ŋmɛnɛɛ, a hiŋ dumaa u lɛɛ siu biini di dinzi wichɔgaa kpila maa u ni la.

ref: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
text: Mìŋ́ Yeesu Kristo huŋhunni Pittaa ra sɛbi hɔnnaa di ra tɛɛ banla n yaarɛɛ di du Pɔntus, Galesia, Kapadosia, Eesia ani Bitinia hɛssi di ɛɛ hɔɔhra, di kaa ɛɛ banla yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi n lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ la.

ref: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
text: U wettoo feli zum ii wia di lizi ia. U Dumnanii ge gil ii birgi u hora, ii wer sɛɛ Yeesu Kristo dɔɔra, u wer gil ii wichɔgaa ra tɛɛ ia, dikuu un siuwɛ tɛɛ ia la wia. Kɔ́raawiizi nɛsunnaa dɔɔi ni u hiinaa tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna werge maa. Tamii la n waa tuŋ wia

ref: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
text: Ií gil yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi na sɔŋ. U suŋ yaa ninɛɛ werge maa, di lul yaa, yaa ɛɛ nɛfalaa di wer dɔɔ tamii la n waa tuŋ di lii Yeesu Kristo izaa lii siu biini la,

ref: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
text: di kaa wer dɔɔ kapɛttɛ la un dau yaa u be la. A kapɛttɛ wàá chɔgi maa, waa doŋa maa dɔɔwɛ, waa sizaa gba dɔɔwɛ. Kɔraawiizi dawuubuu u bol

ref: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
text: tɛɛ ii banla uŋ ɔɔ ra du ii tau ani u fɔŋŋa, dikuu iiŋ yarduu wia, ka ií wer na lɛɛi la un teŋ ɛɛ u sirya dau, ka ú lɛɛ ia durnya tuna saŋa la.

ref: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
text: A gunnɛ niŋ ɛɛ ii bɔsɔna. Filaŋkeŋ, ii daŋ haa di tɔɔrɔɔ tama mɔɔ, ka ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni ia.

ref: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
text: A tɔɔrɔɔ daŋ gil ii yarda la iin dɔɔwɛ di ra hiŋ Kɔraawiizi la ra lii bɔchaaŋ lugɔ baŋ ɔɔ kpa saliŋ di du niŋ a himmaa ra lii la. Saliŋ dɔɔ chɔgaarɛ. Ii Kɔraawiizi yarda ge ɛɛ kumpaa werge di kaali a saliŋ. Di tɔɔrɔɔ wa ɛɛ ii yarda la di na u dɔɔ wibii, ii daŋ na chɔlaa ni sɔŋ ani girme, saŋa la Yeesu Kristo n niŋ bir ba ya nau la.

ref: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
text: Ii haa wɔɔ nawɛɛ ka nɔŋŋuu. Ii siwee wɔɔ ra na ka ii yarduu, di dɔɔ bɔsɔna werge maa. Ii waa nua dɔɔwɛ iin niŋ wer ŋɔ bɔsɔna la Kɔraawiizi n tɛɛ ia la wia.

ref: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
text: Ii yarda tɔnaa Kɔraawiizi n niŋ lɛɛ ii dunzi ha.

ref: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
text: Ii lɛɛi naa, Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi faa ra bagli gunla Kɔraawiizi n niŋ suŋ ii ni di lɛɛ ia labuu, ka faa aah siwii di ra pessi Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii la, bá zum a wia biini nɛnnɛ,

ref: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
text: di zum wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ mɔɔ ani saŋa la Kristo Duma n faa du ba biine n faa ra bagli lugɔ u daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ mɔɔ ka wa na girme la.

ref: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ ba zum lugɔ ii filaŋkeŋ hinaa ba faa ra hum, di ra ŋɔ wia la. Ba himmaa wia lɛi ba faa kuu ra ŋɔ wia la. Banla n faa lizi amaniyesuma la Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii uŋ faa hummɛ tɛɛ baa fɔŋŋa biini la, ba pilli a wia maanii tɛɛ ia. Mɛlikazi gba ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ a ge wer zum a wia biini werge. Ií ɛɛ nɛnanaananaa

ref: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
text: Awia, ií ɛɛ sirya di lau iihinaa wiimaa ni, di dɔɔ tamii nɛnnɛ, di gilɛɛ ra aani nɛsunaa la Kɔraawiizi n niŋ suŋ ii ni, di hiini ia saŋa la Yeesu Kristo n niŋ kaa ba ya nau la.

ref: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
text: Ií ɛɛ biipazi, di ra sɛɛ ii Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nua, di gilɛɛ ra hiŋ ii kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa la iiŋ faa waa wia zummɛ ka ra hiŋ la.

ref: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
text: Ka ií gil ii biine doŋa maa lii, ií wiimaa du wer parata alugɔ Kɔraawiizi la n yir ia ii ba u be la wiimaa n wesse parata la,

ref: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ba faa sɛbi Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔzii, di ŋɔ, “Ií ɛɛ nɛnanaananaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, mìŋ́ Kɔraawiizi la iinna hum la ɛɛ naniinaniirɛ.”

ref: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
text: Ii ɔɔ ra yir Kɔraawiizii ii mɛɛ. U ge ɔɔ ra di nɛr maanii seriya ani wibii. Waa baŋhina ra tɔgzi kaali baŋhina, ka ra di ba maa seriya di lii ba wiɛɛlaa biini. Awia, ií ra ɛɛ wia la maa iin niŋ ɛɛ ka ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi, saŋa la maa iiŋ ɛɛ hɔɔhra di du durnya naa biini,

ref: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ii zummɔ lugɔ iiŋ faa ra ɛɛ wipɛɛri la ii mɛɛwaa n faa ra ɛɛ, di faa ɛɛ Sitaani yoma, ka Kɔraawiizi wa turgi ii kim di lɛɛ ia ha la, kunsiwaa lɛi u kpa turgi ii kim di lɛɛ ia ha la. Kebee ni saliŋ lɛi.

ref: You were rescued by the precious blood of Christ, that spotless and innocent lamb.
text: Kunnaniinaniirɛ. Waabuu Yeesu Kristo chal. Yeesu faa siuwɔɔ lugɔ pebinanii n waa gardama maa dɔɔwɛ, baŋ lizɛɛ bá kpu lizi mbusu tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la.

ref: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
text: Kɔraawiizi feloore di lizi guŋ dawuu mɔɔ, ka haa ta chiŋ ni hɛri. Denii durnya tunaa hɔpizaa n waa hel, u gil u ba dikuu ii wia, ií wer zumuu.

ref: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
text: U wiarɛ ii wer yardi Kɔraawiizi. Waabuu lalluu siu biini di tɛu girme. Awia, Kɔraawiizii ɛɛ ii yarda ni ii tamii hiŋ.

ref: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
text: Filaŋkeŋ, iin sɛɛ wibii la, di jaa wer lizi doŋa maa ha ii ni, di wer dɔɔ ii dɔŋahina bila ani wibii la, ií jaa nɔŋŋi dɔŋa werge maa ani ii biine maa,

ref: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
text: Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ, di ŋɔ, “Newea maa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ kooree. Ba wessi maa ɛɛ lugɔ kooree nyuuni. Kooree la ɔɔ du de ka wa yɔl di siu, a nyuuni chogli.

ref: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii lawaa, ɔɔ haŋ du denii di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.” Waabuu ɛɛ amaniyesuma la baŋ faa lizɛɛ tɛɛ ia la.

ref: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
text: Awia, ií lizi wichɔgaa maa ii be di ha, miisɔɔh, nɛdaraa, nɛfugzaa, bɔwii ani nɛzɔɔzaa maa,

ref: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
text: ka ra nyiŋŋi Kɔraawiizi Wiŋɔɔlii nuui alugɔ biifula n na wii dikuu il wia la, guŋ gil ii wer hel di na lɛɛi.

ref: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
text: Awia, ií ba u be. U ɛɛ bii la n dɔɔ miibɔɔrɛ. Newea yiruubuu kumpɛɛ, di vɛɛu. Ka Kɔraawiizi lizuu, u ɛɛ kunnaniinanii u be.

ref: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
text: Gunnɛ ii gba ɛɛ bia la n dɔɔ miibɔɔ la. Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ ii maa kpau dɔŋa, ií wer ɛɛ u jaamibɔr di kaa ɛɛ u kizeehina la n waa doŋa maa dɔɔwɛ, di wer ra lizi mbusuzi la n niŋ par Kɔraawiizi, u lɛɛa dikuu Yeesu Kristo wia.

ref: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
text: Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini, di ŋɔ, “Ií ra nuu ɛŋ! N kpa binanii bɛllɛ chiŋŋi Ziɔn zɛɛ. N lizuubuu u ɛɛ binanii. Nɛr la maa n niŋ yarduu wàá di hiihzi maa.”

ref: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
text: Awia, u ɛɛ kunnaniirɛ tɛɛ ii banla n yarduu la. Banla ge n wɔɔ yardɛɛ la, ba faa sɛbi ba ni a bii wiarɛ, di ŋɔ, “Bii la maara n faa vɛɛwɛ ha labuu jaa ɛɛ bikpeg la baŋ kpawɛɛ ra faari dia zɛɛ.”

ref: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
text: Ka iawaa ɛɛ u nɛra un lizɛɛnɛ, di kaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kizeehina n ɛɛ nɛnanaananaa, di kaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa hora labuu. U kpa iabuu birgi guŋ, ka ií wer bagli nɛra winanaa la Kɔraawiizi n ɛɛ ia, di yir ia ii lii bɔbiri di wa zuu bɔchaaŋ la n wesse werge maa la biini.

ref: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
text: Ii faa ɛɛ nɛdumazii, ka filaŋkeŋ, ii ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nɛraa. Ii faa waa Kɔraawiizi sinyɛna dɔɔi wia zummɛ, ka filaŋkeŋ, u suŋ ii ninɛɛ.

ref: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
text: N nɛnɔŋŋaa, n na ŋɔ ii benii. Iiŋ ɛɛ hɔɔhra durnya naa biini, ii wàá birgi ɛŋ la, ií vɛɛ bɔrahɔŋ kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa la. A ni ii dunzi ra naau.

ref: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
text: Ií gil ii wiɛɛlaa maa ɔɔ du wer nɛra la n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ la be. Denii di ba ra nyiŋŋi ba gbɛlli ia di ŋɔ ii ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛraa, ka di ba wa na ii winanaa la, bá bir kpa sɔŋ tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, saŋa la u ni baa n niŋ na dɔŋa la. Koora n nabɔnzi dɔɔra sɛɛi wia

ref: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
text: Ií ra sɛɛ ii nabɔnzi dɔɔra dikuu ii Dɔɔri wia, di ra sɛɛ ii hɛri koori la n ɛɛ ii maa nyuu hiŋ

ref: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
text: ani nabɔnzi la uŋ gillɛ ba du de di ra tɛrgi wichɔgɛɛra digna, di kaa ra chɔli banla n na ɛɛ winanaa la maa dɔɔra.

ref: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
text: Ií ra ɛɛ alugɔ nɛra la n dɔɔ bahinaa. Ka ii gilɛɛ kpa iihinaa dɔɔi la birgi wɛjɛ tɔ wijagazi ni. Ií kpa iihinaa birgi Kɔraawiizi yoma.

ref: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
text: Ií ra tɔgzi nɛra maa, di nɔŋŋi ii dɔŋa Yeesu hiŋra, di ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi, di ra tɔgzi ii hɛri koori.

ref: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
text: Balaa, ií ra sɛɛ ii dɔɔra, dɔɔra, di ra tɔgzi baa. Di ba ɛɛ nɛnanaa di pɛssi gɛɛ di ba ɛɛ nɛchunzi, ka ií ra sɛɛ ba dɔɔra.

ref: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
text: Di bɛl tɔɔrii dikuu wichɔgii bɛl hiŋ waa ɛɛwɛ wia, ka ii kuu Kɔraawiizi wia di di a tɔɔrɔɔ ni kanyitti, u gunna par Kɔraawiizii.

ref: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
text: Di i ɛɛ wichɔgaa ba ra tɔɔrii dikuu u wia, ka i haa vɛɛ ra di kanyitti, bɛɛ sɔnnɛ i kanyitti dɔɔi la dɔɔ naanɛi? Ka di i ɛɛ winanaa ba ra tɔɔrii i di kanyitti, a guŋwaa ra par Kɔraawiizii.

ref: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
text: Gunnɛ Kɔraawiizi yir ia ií ra ɛɛ la. Kristo di tɔɔrɔɔrɛ dikuu ii wia. Guŋ bagli ia gunla iin niŋ hiŋ, di wer ɛɛ gunla uŋ ɛɛwɛ la.

ref: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
text: “Kristo faa waa wichɔgaa maa ɛɛwɛ, u wiŋɔzi ge faa waa daraa maa dɔɔwɛ.”

ref: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
text: Ba faa chagzuubuu, ka waa sɛɛwɛ u ŋɔ wiimaa, di tɔɔruu, ka waa baa ɔnzɛɛ. U kpa a maa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la n na di nɛr maa seriya ani wibii la.

ref: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
text: U himmaa lɛɛ yaa wichɔgaarɛ chi, di siu daakaŋlii la ni. U ɛɛ gunnɛ, ya wer siu wichɔgaa be ka ra nyiŋ winanaa be. Ba faa lɔɔzuubuu ya wer na alaanfia lii u lɔɔzaa la biini.

ref: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
text: Ii faa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ peeza di di fɔɔra kaali. Ka filaŋkeŋ, ii bittɔɔ ba ii binni la n na du ii dunzi tau la be.

ref: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
text: Haana, gunnɛ a dɛg lugɔ ií ra sɛɛ ii janna dɔɔra. Di ba waa Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii sɛɛwɛ, ka di ba wa na ii wiɛɛlaa, bá sɛɛ. Ii wàá ŋɔ wiimaa,

ref: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
text: ka di ba ra na ii wiɛɛlaa gunla an deŋlee ii ra tɔgzi baa, ba daŋ bir sɛɛ.

ref: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
text: Di ii ŋɔ ií du wer, ii gilɛɛ ra nyiŋŋi kuna la siwee n na ií wer du wer. Nyuhuna vɔɔzaa ni saliŋ kuna dui ni kunnanaa laalaa lɛi niŋ gil ii du wer.

ref: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
text: Ií gil wia la n du ii biine, siwee n waa na la kuari ia ii du wer. Di ii dɔɔ sisɔna manni di ra ɛɛ wia bɔɔiih, annii waa siwaa dɔɔwɛ ka ɛɛ kunnanaa werge maa Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
text: Aabuu hahpazi la n faa du de di dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi tamii la faa ra nyiŋŋi, bá wer du wer di faa ra sɛɛ ba janna dɔɔra.

ref: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
text: Gunnɛ Saara la faa sɛɛ u jaari Abraham dɔɔra di ra yiruu u dɔɔri. Di ii ra ɛɛ wia la n deŋlee, ii waa wiimaa ni ra fɔŋ, ii birgi a Saara biizii.

ref: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
text: Gunnɛ baala, ií du ii haana be ani nunzuma di ra kpa baa girme, dikuubɛɛwiai, baabuu ɛɛ gɛrga, ii maa kaa kpau dɔɔ miibɔɔ la Kɔraawiizi n sunzi ia la. Di ii wetto ra ɛɛ guŋ, ii wàá suŋŋi wiizi ra huhzi. Tɔɔrɔɔ dii dikuu winanaa wia

ref: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
text: Too. A wesso ii maa n dɔɔ nuukpaŋ dɔŋa ni, ií chal ra nyiiri dɔŋa ni. A kaa du wer lugɔ iin nɔŋŋi ii dɔŋa Yeesu hiŋra, di ɔɔ ra suŋ dɔŋa ni, di ra kpa iihinaa fugzi.

ref: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
text: Di nɛr ɛɛi wichɔgaa, gilɛɛ bir ɛɛu wichɔgaa. Di nɛr gbɛllii, gilɛɛ bir gbɛlluu. Suŋŋi Kɔraawiizi tɛu. Kɔraawiizii yir ia, ií wer ɛɛ guŋ di wer na hiinaa u be.

ref: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
text: Ba faa sɛbɔɔrɛ, di ŋɔ, “Nɛr la maa n na nyiŋŋi miibɔɔjaŋ, di ra nyiŋŋi ú wer nuu suma, guŋwaa, ú ra dazi u nua ni, di gilɛɛ ra ŋɔ wichɔgaa, di gilɛɛ ra dar nɛra.

ref: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
text: Ú ra vɛɛ wichɔgaa ɛɛi, ka ra ɛɛ winanaa, di aah siwii ra nyiŋŋi nuukpaŋ dɔɔi.

ref: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
text: Kɔraawiizi ra du nɛra la wia n deŋlee taurɛ, di nuu ra tɛɛ baa baŋ ɔɔ ra suŋŋuu la. Ka wichɔgɛɛra ra fuuh u baannɛ.”

ref: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
text: Di ii aah siwii ra nyiŋŋi winanaa ɛɛi, anɛɛ n niŋ kaa ɛɛ ia wiimaanɛi?

ref: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
text: Ama, di ba tɔɔri ia dikuu ii winanaa wia, bɔsɔna hinaa ia. “Ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm baa di gilɛɛ gil a tir ia.”

ref: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
text: Ka ií ra kpa Kristo girme ii biine, di gil u ɛɛ ii Dɔɔri. A wesso iiŋ ɔɔ ɛɛ sirya dau, di nɛr maa wa pɛɛzi ia tamii la iin dɔɔwɛ la wia, ií wer ŋɔa nɛnnɛ.

ref: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
text: Ka ií ra ɛɛ guŋ ani sisɔna di ra ɔm. A wesso iiŋ ɔɔ dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu wiimaa biini. Denii di baŋhina waa gbɛlli ii winanaa la iinna ɛɛ di ra hiŋ Kristo la, a daŋ bir ɛɛ baa hiihzi.

ref: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
text: Di ba tɔɔri ia dikuu ii winanaa wia, di Kɔraawiizi kipattɛ guŋ, a guŋ bɔ baŋ tɔɔri ia dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia,

ref: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Kristo gba kuu nɛra wichɔgaa wiarɛ siu. U ɛɛ nɛnaniirɛ ka lɛɛ nɛchɔgaa siu di siu, ú wer kpogli yaa ba Kɔraawiizi be. Un siuwɛ la, wàá ka siu maa. U bɔrahɔŋ siuwɔɔ ka u duma waa na miibɔɔ.

ref: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
text: U duma la lalaa la Kɔraawiizi n vɔɔ baa bɔr labuu di ga ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wia tɛɛ baa.

ref: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
text: Faala hina la n waa Kɔraawiizi wia sɛɛwɛ di du de saŋa la Noowa n faa ra kuari u muugberzeŋ labuu u ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wia tɛɛ la. Kɔraawiizi faa di baabuu kanyitti guŋŋ, Noowa wa kuari a muugberzeŋ la tuŋ, nii la ba. Nɛra ŋmantannaazi bɛnnɛ wette na bahinaa nii la biini.

ref: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
text: Ii daŋ wer kpa nii la di mɛgzi yaa ge Kɔraawiizi nii sɔi la n ɔɔ lɛɛ yaa la. Nii sɔi la, bɔrahɔŋ doŋa lizaa wia lɛi. Suŋŋaarɛ yaa ra suŋŋi wiizi a guŋ, Kɔraawiizi gil ya wer dɔɔ biinihuŋŋu, wíchɔgaa maa gilɛɛ kaa du de di ra tir yaa. Nii sɔi la wettoo lɛɛ yaa dikuu Yeesu Kristo n izi siu biini la wia.

ref: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
text: U izoore la Kɔraawiizi be di ga so u nabɔmbɔr de, mɛlikazi ni fɔŋŋa dɔɔra lugɔ tinnanni ni vuga maa ra sɛɛ u dɔɔra.

ref: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
text: Kristo di tɔɔrɔɔrɛ u bɔrahɔŋ ni. Awia, ií ge hahrgi ii bɔra ani guŋ nfɛrɛ. Nɛr la maa n di tɔɔrɔɔ u bɔrahɔŋ ni, wàá kaa ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa manamanaŋ.

ref: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
text: Saŋa la maa un niŋ haa du de ni u bɔrahɔŋ la, ka wàá ka sɛɛ ra tɛɛ u bɔrahɔŋ kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa la. U daŋ jaa ra sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kipar.

ref: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
text: Faala la iiŋ faa ra ɛɛ wia la banla n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ n na nyiŋŋi a ɛɛi la, a waa ia kukkɛɛa? Ii faa ra ɛɛ wikunaa di ra hiŋ ii kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa, di nyɔɔ siŋ di ra dɛɛzi, di ra ɛɛ wijagazi di ra kpau sinnyɔɔra be ii maa ra dɛɛzi, di ra tɔgzi vuga Kɔraawiizi n kiiwe.

ref: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
text: A tir baa lugɔ filaŋkeŋ, ii waa kaa ra hiŋ baa di ra ɛɛ wijagazi la. Ba jaa ra gbɛlli ia.

ref: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
text: Ka Kɔraawiizi la n ɛɛ sirya ú di lalaa ni nyinee maa seriya la, u daŋ ŋmɛnɛ pɛɛzi baa nuuzi.

ref: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
text: Awiarɛ Kɔraawiizi gil lalaa gba wer nuu amaniyesuma la. U faa di ba bɔrahɔna seriyaa a siuzi lugɔ newee n ɔɔ siu la, ka ra nyiŋŋi bá dunzi ge wer na miibɔɔ lugɔ u ge n dɔɔ miibɔɔ la.

ref: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
text: Wiimaa tunaa jaa ra dugluu. Awia, ií lizi zumaa lau iihinaa wiimaa ni, ií wer ra suŋŋi wiizi nɛnnɛ.

ref: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
text: Wii la n ɛɛ wizeŋ werge genii lugɔ iin dɔɔ dɔŋa bila, dikuubɛɛwiai, dɔŋa bila dɔɔi daŋ tɔ wichɔgaa kpila maa.

ref: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
text: Ií ɔɔ lɛɛ ii dɔŋahina ra du ii diini, di gilɛɛ ra nuumi ba wia.

ref: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
text: Gunla maa Kɔraawiizi n suŋ ii ni di hiini ia, ií wer hiini nɛra, ií ra hiini dɔŋa guŋ. Kɔraawiizi n gillɛ ii dɔɔ u hiinaazi kpilakpila la, a wesso iiŋ kpaa ra humuu alugɔ balnanii n ninna hum u dɔɔri la.

ref: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
text: Nɛr la maa Kɔraawiizi n hiinee u wer ra ŋɔ u wiŋɔzi, ú ra ŋɔa di ra liizi lugɔ Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔzii u ra ŋɔ la. Nɛr la maa uŋ hiinee u wer ra hum u dɔŋhiŋ, ú ra humuu ni fɔŋŋa la Kɔraawiizi n tɛu la, ka Kɔ́raawiizi wer na sɔŋ wiimaa biini dikuu Yeesu Kristo wia. Waabuu dɔɔ sɔŋ ani fɔŋŋa maa saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami. Tɔɔrɔɔ dii dikuu hiŋ ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋri wia

ref: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
text: N nɛnɔŋŋaa, ií gilɛɛ gil tɔɔrɔɔ la iinna di la wia ra tir ia. A tɔɔrɔɔ ɛɛ iabuu di ra na alugɔ niŋ n ɔɔ ɛɛ kuna di ra na gunla. Awia, ií gilɛɛ ra yiruu witittii,

ref: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
text: ka gil ii bɔra sɔɔni ia. Gunla Kristo n di tɔɔrɔɔ la, gunnɛ ii ge gba nuu ɛɛ kpaŋ di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ la. Awia, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni ia ka, á kaa wa sɔɔni ia saŋa la un niŋ wa ba ii na u girme la.

ref: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
text: Di nɛra ra gbɛlli ia dikuu Kristo wia, ii nuu sumaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii la n dɔɔ girme werge la du ii ninɛɛ.

ref: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
text: Ka a waa dɛkkɛ ii bɛl maa n ɛɛ nɛkpuuri gɛɛ ŋmɛɛŋ gɛɛ wichɔgɛɛri gɛɛ wigbaari, bá ra tɔɔruu dikuu a wia.

ref: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
text: Ama, di ba tɔɔrii dikuu hiŋ ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋri wia, gilɛɛ gil guŋ ra ɛɛi hiihzi. A tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi jaaŋ dikuu baŋ kpa Yeesu sɔŋ di yirii la wia.

ref: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
text: Saŋa la Kɔraawiizi n niŋ faari nɛra seriya dii la helloo. U diahina seriyaa ú feli di. Di u daŋ feli di yaawaa seriya, bɛɛ n niŋ wa ɛɛ banla n waa u amaniyesuma wia ra sɛɛ lai?

ref: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
text: Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Di a daŋ du kpol ka nɛr la wia n deŋlee wer lii Kɔraawiizi seriya dii la biini, unla n na gbɛlli Kɔraawiizi, di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa, u wia wàá nyaŋŋia?”

ref: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
text: Awia, ii banla n na di tɔɔrɔɔ dikuu Kɔraawiizi kipar wia, ií kpa ii dunzi du unla n ta chiŋ ni hɛri di dɔɔ wibii la nonee biini, ka haa vɛɛ ra ɛɛ winanaa.

ref: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
text: Awia, n na nyiŋŋuu ń ŋɔ wia aŋhina, ii banla n ɛɛ nabɔnzi hiŋaa naa biini be. N ge gba ɛɛ nabɔma bɛllɛ yaa hiŋaa naa biini, di faa du de di na Kristo tɔɔrɔɔ la un diwee la. N gba daŋ ŋmɛnɛ na girme la saŋa la un niŋ wa bir ba ya nau la.

ref: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
text: Awia, n na ŋɔ ii benii. Ií ra binni Kɔraawiizi peeza la n du ii be la ni nɛnnɛ, di gilɛɛ ra ɛɛ guŋ dikuu firaa wia, ka ra ɛɛ guŋ dikuu iinna nyiŋŋi guŋ wia, di ra ɛɛ guŋ ani siaahmu. Ka á gilɛɛ ɛɛ lugɔ tɔna la iin niŋ na a huma biini wiarɛ ii siwii aah la.

ref: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
text: Ií gilɛɛ kaa ra bagli fɔŋŋa banla iiŋ ɛɛ nabɔnzi ba ni la, ka gil ii wiɛɛlaa ɔɔ du wer lugɔ ba ge n ninna hiŋ guŋ.

ref: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
text: Denii di pebinna maa nabɔma wa ballɔ ú wa tɛɛ ia ii huma tɔna, ií na girme la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
text: Ii banla n ɛɛ biipɔllaa ge, ií ra sɛɛ nabɔnzi la dɔɔra. Ií maa maa dɔɔ sisɔna dɔŋa ni, di sɛɛ ra tɛɛ dɔŋa, dikuubɛɛwiai, “Kɔraawiizi ni banla n na yir bahinaa nɛzenaa ra naau. Ka u ra suŋ banla n waa bahinaa ra tɔgzi la waarɛ, di ra hiini baa.”

ref: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
text: Awia, ií ra kpa iihinaa tama di ra sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni u fɔŋŋa wia, ka ú ŋmɛnɛ wa tɛɛ ia sɔŋ saŋa bɛl n na ba.

ref: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
text: Wia la maa n na tir ia, ií kpaa ra bagli Kɔraawiizi, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii wiimaa du u bampiriire.

ref: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
text: Ií ra lau iihinaa wiimaa ni di ra du tau, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii dɔm Sitaani du denii. Gunla bunyiŋ n ɔɔ ra pogzi di vol ra nyiŋŋi ola ú hee la, gunnɛ u ge vol di ra nyiŋŋi nɛra ú lau.

ref: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
text: Awia, ií yardi Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ, di ra yoo Sitaani, di zum lugɔ tɔɔrɔɔ naa iinna di naa, ii dɔŋahina n du yemmaa ge gba ra di a tɔɔrɔɔrɛ.

ref: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
text: Di ii wa di tɔɔrɔɔ a wa ɛɛ tama, Kɔraawiizi la n na suŋ nɛra ni, di ra hiini nɛra werge maa, di faa yir ia ii wer ba u be, ií ni Kristo wer kpau di wa na girme la n waa tuŋ la, u himmaa daŋ gil ií siwee wer ba hɛri. Di gil ií wer lau nɛnnɛ di dɔɔ ii hiŋaa fɔŋŋa.

ref: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
text: Waabuu dɔɔ fɔŋŋa saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami. Tuna jaaŋ wia

ref: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
text: N gillɔɔ yaa dɔŋhiŋ Silas la wia n dɔɔ wibii n be la sɛbi hɔŋkpurii naa tɛɛ ia, ń wer bagli ia gunla iin ninna hiŋ, di di daansɛɛ lugɔ miŋ faa bagli ia Kɔraawiizi nɛsunaa ni u hiinaa wia la. U himmaanii n bagli ia gunla. Awia, ií lau guŋ chigigi.

ref: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
text: Banla n du Babilɔn di ɛɛ ii dɔŋa Yeesu hiŋra la Kɔraawiizi n lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ la, ra jaami ia. N biibaal Maak gba ra jaami ia.

ref: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
text: Ií ra jaami dɔŋa nɛnnɛ. Ii banla maa ni Kristo n kpauwɛ la, Kɔ́raawiizi tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna.

ref: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
text: Mìŋ́ Saimɔn Pitta la n ɛɛ Yeesu Kristo balii, di kaa ɛɛ u huŋhunni labuu sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛɛ ii banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi la wia n deŋlee, di ra hiŋuu la. Yeesu Kristo la n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni yaa Lɛɛri la wia deŋloore. Awiarɛ u gil ii wer yarduu, ii Kɔraawiizi yarda la du wer u be alugɔ yaa hor n wesse la.

ref: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
text: Kɔ́raawiizi hiini ia di gil ii dɔɔ bampirsɔna werge maa di ra jaa, dikuu iin zum u ni yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu wia nɛnnɛ la wia. Kɔraawiizi yiraa ni kipar wia

ref: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
text: Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa tɛɛ yaabuu kuna la maa yaa n na nyiŋŋi, ya wer du de di ra ɛɛ winanaa. U gillɔɔ yaa wer zum unla n yir yaa, ya wer dɔɔ u himmaa girme ni u winanaa la.

ref: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
text: U ŋɔ nuuzii tɛɛ yaa annii wia. U nuuŋɔɔlaa la ɛɛ wizenaare di ɛɛ wisuma werge maa yaa be. U ŋɔ gunnɛ tɛɛ ia, ií wer du Kɔraawiizi ge duula la, di wer lii chɔgaa la n du durnya, dikuu kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa wia la biini.

ref: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
text: Di ii wetto dɔɔ mannizi naa nɛnnɛ di ra jaa, ii wàá nyaa yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo wia zumaa. Ii wàá zum u wia huhzi.

ref: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
text: Nɛr la n waa mannizi naa dɔɔwɛ ɛɛ nyuŋŋii. Waa wette ra na bɔr. U ra suuh gunla Kɔraawiizi n lizi wichɔgaa la uŋ faa ra ɛɛ la doŋa u ni di ha labuu.

ref: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
text: Yaabalaa, Kɔraawiizi yir iabuu di lizi ia tɛɛ u hiŋ, ií wer na lɛɛi. Awia, ií aah siwii ií wer na guŋ u be. Di ii ra ɛɛ gunla miŋ baglɛɛ la, ii wàá hiŋ gbulli maa.

ref: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
text: Kɔraawiizi daŋ pilli yaa Dɔɔri ni yaa Lɛɛri Yeesu Kristo kora la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ maa la zuui tɛɛ yaa, ya zuu, ú jaami yaa nɛnnɛ. Kɔraawiizi wia baŋ sɛbɛɛ du u dɔgtɛɛzi hɔna biine wia

ref: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
text: Ii zum wibiire di dɔɔ bɔkpega ii hiŋaa ni. Ka n daŋ ɔɔ ra liizi ia wia naa wia.

ref: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
text: Miŋwaa be, di n haa du de ni miibɔɔ, a dɛkkɔ min niŋ ɔɔ ra liizi ia di gil ii ra du tau,

ref: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, n zummɔ lugɔ a wàá birgi ka ń wir n bɔrahɔnnaa ha. Yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristoo ŋɔ guŋ tɛŋ, a chaani nɛnnɛ.

ref: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
text: N daŋ aah siwii lugɔ, di n ŋmɛnɛ wa kaalɔɔ gba, ka ii daŋ haa ra liizi wia naa.

ref: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
text: Yaa n bagli ia yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo fɔŋŋa ni u balaa wia la, yaa waa sɛɛwɛ ya lizi zumaa di kanni karazi tɛɛ ia. Yaa himmaa siwee na u ni u zennii.

ref: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
text: Yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi faa gillɔɔ u dɔɔ girme, saŋa la Yeesu n nuu loobii bɛl chiŋ, Girme maa Hiŋ la be, n ŋɔwɛɛ, “N Biinɔŋŋiirɛ keŋ. U wia ra parimbuu werge.”

ref: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
text: Yaa himmaanii faa du de di nuu loobii la, saŋa la yaa nuu n du bizennaniinanii nyuu la.

ref: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
text: Awia, guŋ gillɔɔ wia la dɔgtɛɛzi n faa sɛbɛɛ la wer dɔɔ wibii jaa. A dɛkkɔ iiŋ keŋŋi digna nɛnnɛ di ra nuu a wia, dikuubɛɛwiai, a ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ fintinazi baŋ kpawɛɛ chiŋŋi bɔbiri, á ra chaani ka hɔɔ́ wa pizi la. A dɔgtɛɛzi hɔna daŋ chaani ii siwee, ka Kɔ́raawiizi gil ii liize chaani lugɔ naanyɔɔ n ɔɔ chaani chɔɔzimpikke ni la.

ref: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
text: Ka ií zum wii naa nɛnnɛ lugɔ wia la baŋ faa sɛbɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi hɔna biine la, a wii bɛl maa faa waa nɛbɛl nfɛrɛ be liwɛɛ.

ref: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
text: Akai. Ban sɛbaa la, ba waa sɛbɛɛ di lii ba himmaa kipar biini. Kɔraawiizi Dumaa faa wa izi nɛnanaa baŋhina ni, ba jaa ŋɔ wiŋɔzi la uŋ kpawɛɛ du ba nuuzi la.

ref: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
text: Dɔgtɛɛkara hina ge gba faa du nɛra la benii. Gunnɛ nɛ́ra baŋhina n wàá waa bagli wibii ŋmɛnɛɛ wa izi ii gba be, di suahzi bagli ia wia la n waa deŋlee, di ra hɔɔ ba Dɔɔri n turgi ba wichɔgaa kim di lɛɛ baa ha la wia. Ba daŋ gil Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la baaŋ fuuh ba ni, ú chɔgi baa manaŋ.

ref: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
text: Nɛkpila daŋ hiŋ baa di ra ɛɛ wikuna la banna ɛɛ la, nɛra jaa ra ŋɔ lugɔ yaa hiŋaa naa n dɔɔ wibii naa waa wer dikuu ba wia.

ref: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
text: Ba kuna kɛkɛluu dɔɔi wiarɛ bá kanni kara di di ia. Ka unla n niŋ wa turgi baa ba wichɔgaa kim la ra duŋŋi ba lugee lii saŋa maa. Waa dɔɔ ra chɔɔ. U daŋ lau baa di chɔgi baa.

ref: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
text: Kɔraawiizi waa mɛlikazi la n ɛɛ wichɔgaa la gillɛ, ka dua Sitaani bɔr la n ɛɛ bɔluŋ ni bɔbiri, á du de di ra kpaŋ seriya la un niŋ wa dia la.

ref: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
text: Waa faala hina gillɛ, ka gil nii wa su di tɔ durnya ni u nɛchɔgaa maa ni ba siuzi. Noowa ni u nɛra baniidaanɛɛ bɛnnɛ u lɛɛ. A Noowa faa ra bagli wideŋlaa wiarɛ.

ref: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
text: Sɔdɔm ni Gɔmɔra hina la ge, Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ ba daŋ tuŋ kɔrai, di gil niŋ fuuh baa ba tuŋ. U gillɔɔ ba wia ra bagli nɛra gunla un niŋ ɛɛ banla maa n niŋ ɛɛ wichɔgaa la.

ref: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.
text: U faa ɛɛ nɛnaniirɛ di du ba be, di ra na ba wichɔgaa hiŋ. Hɔpizii biimaa ge u ra nuu ba wichɔgaa wia. A wichɔgaa ɔɔ faa ra tɔɔruubuu.

ref: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri zum gunla un niŋ lɛɛ nɛnanaa ba tɔɔrɔɔ biinii, di kaa zum gunla un niŋ vɔɔ nɛra la wia n waa deŋlee di dau, di wa di ba seriya di tɔɔri baa labuu.

ref: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
text: Banla n na hiŋ ba bɔrahɔna kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa, di ra gbɛlli nabɔnzi labuu ú tɔɔri werge. Ba siwee hillɔɔ werge. Ba ra na bahinaarɛ werge. Ba waa mɛlikazi ni aliizinazi gba ra ɔm, ka ra gbɛllaa.

ref: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
text: A mɛlikazi dɔɔ fɔŋŋa ni zennii kaali baa. Ka a wàá sɛɛ ra hau dɔŋa ni, di ra chagzi dɔŋa a Dɔɔri be.

ref: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
text: Nɛra naawaa, ba ra ɛɛ wiarɛ gunla maa. Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ pir sela n du de, nɛ́ra wer lawaa kpu la. Ba ra gbɛlli wia la baŋ waa zummɛɛ. Ba daŋ siuzi alugɔ sela n na siuzɛɛ gunla.

ref: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
text: Ba wichɔgaa daŋ bir wa di baa di tɔɔri baa. Ba ra ɛɛ ba wikuna labuu bɔchaaŋ. Guŋ ɔɔ ra par baa. Ii ni baa n ɔɔ kpau ra di naa, ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ doŋa ii baambaaŋ. Ba nɛdaraa ra zuu baabuu suma.

ref: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
text: Sɛnsɛŋ su ba nfɛssii. Ba waa wichɔgaa ɛɛwɛ ra piŋ, di ra da banla n waa lauwɛ nɛnnɛ la zɛɛ, ba ra leuzi. Ba dɔɔ kuna kɛkɛluurɛ birgi. Kɔraawiizi see baabuu nua.

ref: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
text: Ba vɛɛ ŋmɛnideŋliire ka leuzi di ra hiŋ Bɛɔ bie Balaam ŋmɛnɛɛ la uŋ faa ra hiŋ la. A Balaam faa nyiŋŋi wichɔgaa kebeere.

ref: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
text: Kɔraawiizi faa jugmuubuu dikuu u wichɔgaa wia. Kawee n waa wia ra ŋɔ naa, ka u faa kpa newee loobiire ŋɔ wia ra tɛɛ a baal lugɔ u gil chugla wia la uŋ faa ra nyiŋŋi ɛɛi la.

ref: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
text: Nɛra naa ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ gɔŋa la n hillɛ, di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ baama la peu n duŋŋɛɛ kaali labuu. Bɔbiri duirɛ Kɔraawiizi lizi dau baa.

ref: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
text: Ba ra ŋɔ wizenaare, ka a maa ɛɛ wipɛɛrii. Ba ŋɔ wikuna wiarɛ banla n haa ra lɛɛ bahinaa nɛchɔgaa be dui la be, di wer ra dar baa ba ra leuzi dikuu ba kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa wia.

ref: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
text: Ba ɔɔ ŋɔ nua lugɔ a nɛra daŋ wer dɔɔ bahinaa. Ka ba himmaa ɛɛ yomaa. Ba wichɔgaarɛ kpa baa birgi a yoma, dikuubɛɛwiai, wii la maa n wette kpegli nɛr, a wii kpaubuu birgi u yom.

ref: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
text: Banla n zum yaa Dɔɔri ni yaa Lɛɛri Yeesu Kristo, di wer lɛɛ bahinaa lii doŋa la n du durnya biini la, ka di ba kaa bir gil wia la kaa vɔɔzi baa di kpegli baa, ba tuna wia daŋ nyaŋŋi kaali ba lugli wia la.

ref: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
text: Di ba faa waa wideŋlaa ŋmɛnɛɛ la zummɛ, u guŋ faa bɔ baŋ zumuu, ka bir vɛɛ widaulinanaa la Kɔraawiizi n dauwɛ, bá ra hiŋ la.

ref: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
text: Sɛɛlii naa ɛɛ wibiire. “Nuahiŋ ɔɔ uguu ka bir dia,” bɛl genii “Di ba sɔ pereku nii, ka u daŋ bir billi kpɛchɛgaa.” Ba wia zɛɛrɛ la.

ref: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
text: di ra liizi gunla Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛnanaa la n faa ŋɔwɛɛ ani yaa Dɔɔri ni yaa Lɛɛri Yeesu Kristo widaulaa la u huŋhunna n bagli ia la.

ref: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
text: Ií feli zum lugɔ nɛra baŋhina daŋ lii durnya tunaa saŋa di ra hiŋ ba kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa, di ra ɛɛ ia chɛɛtɛ

ref: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
text: di ra ŋɔ, “Uŋ ŋɔ nua lugɔ u daŋ bir ba la, u du lee? Yaa mɛɛwaa maa wa siuzɔɔrɛ ka u haa waa ballɛ. Gunla durnya n duwɛɛ u faaraa la, gunnɛ u haa du haali ni zinaa.”

ref: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
text: Nɛra naa kuttɔɔrɛ tɔ ba siwee. Di guŋ lɛi, ba daŋ vii liizi lugɔ Kɔraawiizi n faa ŋɔ wia saŋa maa chiŋ ni hɛri maa lii la, nii biinii hɛri lii di kaa du de dikuu nii wia.

ref: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
text: Ama, niirɛ Kɔraawiizi kaa kpa chɔgi durnya saŋa la nii n faa suwee la.

ref: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
text: Filaŋkennaa ge, ninne Kɔraawiizi ŋɔ ú kpa fuuh chiŋ ni hɛri. U dawaabuu guŋ, ka gil a du de mɔɔ, ka hɔ́pizii la un niŋ di durnya seriya, di chɔgi nɛchɔgaa la wa hel.

ref: Dear friends, don't forget that for the Lord one day is the same as
text: Ama, ii gilɛɛ waa suuh wia naa, n nɛnɔŋŋaa. Hɔpizikpaŋkpaŋ ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ binni kagboŋ Kɔraawiizi be, binni kagboŋ ge ɛɛ lugɔ hɔpizikpaŋkpaŋ u be.

ref: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri wàá gil u nua la uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ yaa la lizaa birgi alugɔ nɛra baŋhina n na ŋɔ u wia la. Akai. Kanyittii u haa vɛɛ ra di ia la. Waa nyiŋŋi u chɔgi nɛr maa, ka u ra nyiŋŋuu ba maa biine chɔgi dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia di gilaa ha.

ref: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
text: Ama, yaa Dɔɔri hɔpizii daŋ ba alugɔ ŋmɛɛŋ n ɔɔ suahzi ba la. A saŋa, chiŋ maa daŋ gbɔgzi hibibibibi di tuŋ kɔrai. Kummaa daŋ ŋmɛɛri dikuu wenzaa la wia, hɛri ni u kummaa fuuh di tuŋ.

ref: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
text: Kummaa n niŋ wa tuŋ kennaa, ii danna dazi nɛra la dizi iiŋ ɛɛwɛ. Ii daŋ aah siwiire di ɛɛ nɛnanaa di ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi,

ref: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
text: di ra kpaŋ Kɔraawiizi Hɔpizizeŋ la chiŋ n niŋ fuuh tuŋ, hɛri ge kummaa fuuh di ŋmɛɛri tuŋ la ani tamii ni bɔsɔna, di ra hum ú wer hel manaŋ.

ref: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
text: Chiŋfalii ni hɛrfaliirɛ yaa ra kpaŋ, dikuu nua la Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔwɛɛ tɛɛ yaa la wia. Wideŋlaa bɛnnɛ niŋ wa du de.

ref: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
text: Awia, n nɛnɔŋŋaa, iinna kpaŋ wia naa, ií ra ɛɛ ania ii gilɛɛ waa dɔɔ doŋa maa, ka du wer, ií nuu wer dɔɔ nuukpaŋ.

ref: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
text: Ií zum lugɔ yaa Dɔɔri ra di kanyittii, ka ií wer na lɛɛi. Gunnɛ yaa nɛnɔŋŋii Pɔɔl la ɔɔ ra bagli ia di lii nunzuma la Kɔraawiizi n tɛu, u dɔɔ la biini.

ref: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
text: U ra ŋɔ wia naa wiarɛ u hɔna maa biine. U wiŋɔzi aŋhina kpolloo werge. Banla n waa wia zummɛ ba waa kaa lau nɛnnɛ la, baabuu ɔɔ ra birgi a wia ni Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ wiŋɔzi aŋhina di ra jaa. Ba ra ba Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuih ninɛɛ bahinaa ni, ú chɔgi baa.

ref: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
text: Awia, n nɛnɔŋŋaa, iiŋ felee zum wia naa, ií ra dazi, nɛ́chɔgaa gilɛɛ wa wer bagli ia wia la n waa deŋlee, di dar ia ii leu. Ii lauwɔɔ nɛnnɛ filaŋkeŋ. Awia, ii gilɛɛ gil ba dar ia ii chol.

ref: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
text: Ií ɔɔ ra nyiŋŋi hiinaa ni zumaa yaa Dɔɔri ni yaa Lɛɛri Yeesu Kristo be di ra jaa. Waabuu niŋ dɔɔ sɔŋ filaŋkeŋ ani saŋa maa! Ami.

ref: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
text: Wiŋɔɔlii bɛllɛ du de di lii lugli la, di dɔɔ miibɔɔ. Yaa faa wettoo nuu u loobii di kaa wer nau, di faa ra binnuu, di wer kpa nonee gba ra gbɔgzuu.

ref: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
text: Kɔraawiizi kpa u Wiŋɔɔlii la n dɔɔ miibɔɔ labuu bagli yaa, yaa nau di di u daansɛɛ ra tɛɛ ia, di ra ŋɔ u wia ii be lugɔ Kɔraawiizi Miibɔɔ la n waa tuŋ, di du u be saŋa maa la jaa ba yaa benii, yaa nau.

ref: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
text: Yaa ŋɔ ya bagli iabuu u wiɛɛlaa la maa yaa n nawɛɛ ani gunla maa yaa n nuuwɛ ge, yáa ni ii maa wer ɛɛ kpaŋ wia naa biini. Yaa ni Kɔraawiizi ni u Biibaal Yeesu Kristo maanii ɛɛ kpaŋ.

ref: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
text: Yaa ra nyiŋŋuu yaa maa bɔra sɔɔni werge maa di ga tuŋ. Awiarɛ yaa sɛbi wia naa ra tɛɛ ia. Kɔraawiizii bɔchaaŋ

ref: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
text: Kɔraawiizi wia la um bagli yaa, yaa ge ra bagli ia la, aabuu keŋ. Kɔraawiizi maa ɛɛ bɔchaannɛ. Bɔbiri waa hoo u ni.

ref: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
text: Di yaa ŋɔ yaa nuu dɔɔ nuukpannɛ, ka ɔɔ ra hum bɔbiri huma, karaa yaa ra kanni. Yaa waa wibii dɔɔwɛ.

ref: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
text: Ama, di yaa ɔɔ huuhzi biine di ra la alugɔ kennaa Kɔraawiizi n ɔɔ chaani naa, yaa ni yaa dɔŋahina daŋ wer dɔɔ nuukpaŋ, Kɔraawiizi Biibaal Yeesu chal wer sɔ yaa wichɔgaa maa yaa ni di ha.

ref: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
text: Di yaa ŋɔ yaa waa wichɔgaa maa dɔɔwɛ yaa ni, yaa hinaarɛ yaa ra dar. Yaa waa wibii dɔɔwɛ.

ref: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
text: Ka di yaa ra sɛɛ chɔgri, Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil yaa wichɔgaa tɛɛ yaa, di lizi a doŋa maa yaa ni ha. Yaa zummɔ lugɔ u daŋ ɛɛ guŋ tɛɛ yaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, u wia dɔɔ wibiire. U wia maa ge kaa deŋli.

ref: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
text: Di yaa ŋɔ yaa waa wichɔgaa maa ra ɛɛ, amɔ, yaa ra yir Kɔraawiizii kara hiŋ. U wiŋɔzi waa hoo yaa bampiree.

ref: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
text: N biizi, n na sɛbi wia naabuu n tɛɛ ia, ií ra ɔm wichɔgaa ɛɛi. Ama, di ii wa foroo ɛɛ wichɔgaa, yaa dɔɔ nɛr la n niŋ fɔrgi yaa mɛɛ Kɔraawiizii tɛɛ yaa. Waabuu u biinanii Yeesu Kristo la.

ref: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
text: Waabuu siuwɛ dikuu yaa wichɔgaa wia, ú lizi Kɔraawiizi baaŋ yaa ni. Yaa bɛŋ wichɔgaa wia lɛi u kuu siu. Durnya maa wichɔgaa wiarɛ u kuu siu.

ref: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
text: Kenne ya wer zum nɛnnɛ lugɔ yaa zum Kɔraawiizii. Di yaa wetto ra hiŋ u nuuzi la, yaa zumuubuu.

ref: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
text: Hinla maa n niŋ ŋɔ lugɔ i zum Kɔraawiizii, ka haa u nuuzi la ra hiŋ, karaa i ra kanni. Haa wibii dɔɔwɛ.

ref: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
text: Ka hinla n wette ra hiŋ u nuuzi la, hinuu zum Kɔraawiizi di nɔŋŋuu nɛnnɛ ga tuŋ. Di yaa ra hiŋ guŋ, yaa daŋ zum lugɔ yaa nuu ɛɛ kpannɛ wibii maa.

ref: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
text: Di hinla maa ŋɔ i ni Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ kpannɛ, a hiŋ gunla Yeesu Kristo n faa ra hiŋ la.

ref: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
text: N biinɔŋŋaa, widaulifalii lɛi n sɛbi ra tɛɛ ia filaŋkennaa. U binii la iiŋ faa nuuwɛ lugli labuu haa.

ref: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
text: Ka a kaa ɛɛu lugɔ widaulifaliirɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, Yeesu gillɔɔ ii zum u wibii, ii ge zum. Bɔbiri saŋa jaa ra tunuu, ka bɔchaaŋ himmaa jaa ra lii.

ref: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
text: Hinla maa n ŋɔ i du bɔchaannɛ ka hah i dɔŋhiŋ, bɔbirii i haa du.

ref: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
text: Ka hinla maa n nɔŋŋi i dɔŋhiŋ, bɔchaannɛ i du. Hiŋwaa waa cholaa maa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
text: Ka hinla maa n hah i dɔŋhiŋ, hiŋwaa ra vol bɔbirii. Haa bɔr zummɛ. Bɔbiri la tɔ i siweere, i ɛɛ nyuŋŋi.

ref: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
text: Bichalli, n sɛbi wia naabuu ra tɛɛ ia, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi kuu Yeesu wiarɛ di gil ii wichɔgaa tɛɛ ia.

ref: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
text: Nabɔnzi, n sɛbi wia naabuu ra tɛɛ ii ge, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii zum unla n du de saŋa maa labuu. Biipɔllaa, n sɛbi wia naabuu ra tɛɛ ia, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii kpegli Sitaanii. Bichalli, ii zum yaa mɛɛ Kɔraawiizii. Awiarɛ n sɛbaa tɛɛ ia.

ref: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
text: Nabɔnzi, ii zum unla n du de saŋa maa labuu. Awiarɛ n sɛbaa tɛɛ ia. Biipɔllaa, ii dɔɔ kpegzii di kaa dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii ii bampiree, di wer kpegli Sitaani. Awiarɛ n sɛbaa tɛɛ ii ge.

ref: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
text: Ií gilɛɛ kpa durnya ni u kuna nyiŋŋaa wia du ii bampiree. Hinla maa n na ɛɛ guŋ, yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nyiŋŋaa waa hoo i bampirii,

ref: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa la bɔrahɔŋ ni siwee n na nyiŋŋi ani kuna la newee n na nyiŋŋi, di ra nyiŋŋi zenni la, aabuu waa yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi wia ɛɛwɛ. Durnya wiarɛ aabuu.

ref: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
text: Durnya ni ba kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa naa maa daŋ wa tuŋ. Ka nɛr la maa n na ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi kipar lawaa daŋ du de di hanna la. Yeesu Kristo haahri wia

ref: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
text: N biizi, durnya tunaa saŋa helloo. Ii faa nuuwɔ lugɔ Kristo haahri bɛl daŋ wa ba. Too. Bakpila maanii teŋ ballɛ filaŋkeŋ. Awiarɛ yaa wer zum lugɔ durnya tunaa saŋa jaa heluu la.

ref: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
text: Baŋhina faa du yaa benii, ka ba faa waa yaa be hina ɛɛwɛ. Di ba faa ɛɛ yaa be hinaa, ba daŋ vii haa du yaa be. Ka ba chɔwɔɔrɛ, yaa zum lugɔ ba faa waa yaa be hina ɛɛwɛ.

ref: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
text: Ka iawaa, Kɔraawiizi kpa u Dumnaniirɛ du ii ni, ii maa dɔɔ nunzuma.

ref: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
text: Maa wia naa sɛbɛɛ ra tɛɛ ia alugɔ ii waa wibii la zummɛ. Ii zum a wibiire nɛnnɛ. Awia, ii daŋ wer zum lugɔ kara wia waa wibii ɛɛwɛ.

ref: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
text: Nɛr la maa n na hɔɔ lugɔ Yeesu waa Kristo la n niŋ faa ba la ɛɛwɛ, kara hiŋ lɛiyaa? Nɛr la n na hɔɔ yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni u Biibaal Yeesu wia, Kristo haahrii.

ref: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
text: Nɛr la maa n na hɔɔ Kɔraawiizi Biibaal wia, waa Kɔraawiizi gba zummɛ. Nɛr la maa ge n na sɛɛ u Biibaal wia, waabuu zum u Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi gba.

ref: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
text: Ií gilɛɛ ra suuh wia la iin nuuwɛ lugli la. Di ii ɔɔ gil a wia du ii bampiree, ii daŋ du ii Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni u Biibaal Yeesu ni.

ref: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
text: N sɛbi banla n na nyiŋŋi ba dar ia ii leu la wiarɛ tɛɛ ia.

ref: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
text: Ka iawaa waa kaa ɛɛ lugɔ nɛ́r maa ra bagli ia, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii la uŋ kpawɛɛ du ii ni la, haa du ii ninɛɛ. Waabuu niŋ bagli ia wiimaa ŋmɛnɛɛ. U baglaa la maa ɛɛ wibiire. Kara waa hoo a biini. Awia, ii du Yeesu ni nɛnnɛ gunla u Dumnanii n na bagli ia la.

ref: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
text: N biizi, ií du u ni. Di u wa ballɔ, yaa nau, wiimaa wàá ka tir yaa, ya ra ɔm. Hiihzi wàá lau yaa a saŋa.

ref: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
text: U wia maa deŋloore. Di ii zum guŋ, ií zum lugɔ nɛr la maa n na ɛɛ wideŋlaa ɛɛ u biilulliirɛ.

ref: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
text: Ií na gunla yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋi yaa werge, di ra yir yaa u biizi. Yaa n ɛɛ u biizi wiarɛ durnya waa yaa zummɛ nɛnnɛ la, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba waa u gba zummɛ.

ref: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
text: N biinɔŋŋaa, yaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biizii filaŋkeŋ. Ka gunla yaa n niŋ haa wa du, Kɔraawiizi haa waa yaa baglɛɛ guŋwaa. Ka di u wa bagli yaa, yaa daŋ zum lugɔ yaa daŋ wa du gunla u ge n duwɛɛ la, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa siwee daŋ ŋmɛnɛ wa nau gunla un duwɛɛ.

ref: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
text: Nɛr la n ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa ra chɔgi Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgnii. Wichɔgaa maa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Gbɔgnii chɔgaarɛ.

ref: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
text: Ii zummɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi gillɔ Yeesu ba, ú wa lizi wichɔgaa ha. Waabuu waa wichɔgaa maa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
text: Nɛr la u nuu n kpauwɛ la waa wichɔgaa ra ɛɛ. Nɛr la n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa, waabuu haa wɔɔ zummɛ. U siwee gba waa u ni chaanɛɛ.

ref: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
text: N biizi, ií gilɛɛ gil nɛr maa dar ia. Nɛr la n ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wideŋlaa ɛɛ nɛnaniirɛ gunla Yeesu n ɛɛ nɛnanii la.

ref: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
text: Nɛr la n ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa ge ɛɛ Sitaani biere. Sitaani zum wichɔgaarɛ di ra ɛɛa saŋa maa, di wa lii ni zinaa. Awiarɛ Kɔraawiizi gil u Biibaal ba durnya, ú wa chɔgi Sitaani huma.

ref: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
text: Nɛr la maa n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biilullii waa ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa. Un dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi miibɔɔ di ɛɛ u biilullii wiarɛ waa wette ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa.

ref: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
text: Kennaabuu ií wer zum banla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biizi ani banla n ɛɛ Sitaani ge biizi. Nɛr la maa n waa wideŋlaa ra ɛɛ ani nɛr la maa n waa u dɔŋahina nɔŋŋɛɛ waa Kɔraawiizi bie ɛɛwɛ. Ií nɔŋŋi dɔŋa

ref: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
text: Widaulii naa, ii feloore nuu guŋ lugli la alugɔ yá nɔŋŋi dɔŋa.

ref: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
text: Ií gilɛɛ ɛɛ lugɔ Keen la n faa ɛɛ Sitaani kuŋ, di kpu u niwee la. Ii zum wii la n baani u kpuuwaa? U himmaa n na hum hunchɔgaa, ka u niwee ra hum hunnanaa wiarɛ u kuu kpuu.

ref: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
text: Awia, yaabalaa, ii gilɛɛ gil a tir ia dikuu durnya n hah ia wia.

ref: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
text: Ka yaa ge n nɔŋŋi dɔŋa wiarɛ yaa wer zum lugɔ yaa lii siu ninɛɛ di zuu miibɔɔfalii biini. Hinla maa n waa nɛra nɔŋŋɛɛ, i haa siuwɔɔ.

ref: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
text: Hinla maa n hah i dɔŋhiŋ, i ɛɛ nɛkpuurii. Ii zummɔ lugɔ nɛkpuuri waa Kɔraawiizi miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la dɔɔwɛ.

ref: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
text: Yeesu n kuu yaa wia siu la, u gunnɛ a bagli nɔŋŋaa himmaa. A wesso yaa ge n nɔŋŋi yaa dɔŋahina alugɔ yaa daŋ wer kuu ba wia siu.

ref: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
