text: Hinla n dɔɔwɛ ka na i dɔŋhiŋ bɛl ge n na di dɔgnya, ka i dɔɔ sikpegii u ni, amɔ, Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa du i benii naa?

ref: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
text: N biizi, ya gilɛɛ nɔŋŋi dɔŋa ani nuuzi. Ya nɔŋŋi dɔŋa ani winanaa ni wibii ɛɛi.

ref: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
text: Di yaa ra ɛɛ guŋ, yaa daŋ wer zum lugɔ yaa ra hiŋ wibiire, di wer dɔɔ bampiree Kɔraawiizi be. Yaa wàá ra fɔŋ.

ref: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
text: Gunla maa yaa biine n na tɔɔri yaa alugɔ wichɔgaa du yaa ninɛɛ la, ka Kɔraawiizii kaali a maa di zum wiimaa.

ref: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
text: N biinɔŋŋaa, di yaa biine waa yaa ra tɔɔri ani wichɔgaa maa, yaa daŋ wer dɔɔ bampirii di hel Kɔraawiizi.

ref: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
text: Di yaa suŋŋuu kunla maa, u daŋ tɛɛ yaa dikuu yaa n ɔɔ ra hiŋ u widaulaa, di ra ɛɛ wia la n paruu la wia.

ref: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
text: U widauliirɛ keŋ. Dí ya yardi u Biibaal Yeesu Kristo, ka kaa nɔŋŋi dɔŋa gunla uŋ ŋɔ ya ra ɛɛ la.

ref: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
text: Nɛr la n na hiŋ Kɔraawiizi nuuzi, Kɔraawiizi du u ninɛɛ, u ge du Kɔraawiizi ni. U Dumnanii la uŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛ yaa la wiarɛ yaa wer zum lugɔ u du yaa ninɛɛ.

ref: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
text: N biinɔŋŋaa, di nɛra ŋɔ ba ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzii, di ra ŋɔ wia u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini, ii gilɛɛ ra yardi ba maa manaŋ. Dɔgtɛɛkara hina kpila gba liwɔɔrɛ filaŋkeŋ. Awia, ií ɔɔ ɛɛ baa na.

ref: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
text: Nɛr la maa ge n na hɔɔ Yeesu wia guŋ, Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii waa u ni duwɛɛ. Kristo haahrii. Ii faa nuuwɔɔ lugɔ Kristo haahri bɛl daŋ ba durnya. Too. U teŋ ballɔɔ.

ref: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
text: N biizi, ii ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi horaa di kpegli a dɔgtɛɛkara hina la, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii la n du ii ni la kpekko kaali Sitaani la n du ba ge ni labuu.

ref: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
text: Dɔgtɛɛkara hina la ɛɛ durnya naa horaa. Awiarɛ ba ra ŋɔ durnya wiŋɔzi a durnya nuu ra tɛɛ baa.

ref: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
text: Yaawaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi horaa. Nɛr la ge n zum Kɔraawiizi nuu ra tɛɛ yaa. Nɛr la ge n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ waa nuu. Gunnɛ ya zum banla n ɛɛ wibii hina ani banla n ɛɛ kara hina. Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ nɔŋŋaarɛ

ref: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
text: N biinɔŋŋaa, ií gil ya nɔŋŋi dɔŋa. Nɔŋŋaa lii Kɔraawiizi benii. Nɛr la maa n nɔŋŋi u dɔŋhiŋ, ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biilulliirɛ, di zumuu.

ref: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
text: Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ nɔŋŋaarɛ. Awia, nɛr la maa n waa u dɔŋhiŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ, waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ.

ref: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
text: Kɔraawiizi hum u biikpaŋkpannɛ durnya, ya wer na miibɔɔ dikuu u wia. U gunnɛ ra bagli nɔŋŋaa la dee Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋi yaa.

ref: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
text: Yaawaa nɔŋŋaa naa yaa n nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi naa ɛɛ pɛɛrɛ. Ka Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa naa un nɔŋŋi yaa naa, waabuu nɔŋŋaa himmaa. U hum u Biibaallɛ durnya, u ba wa siu, ú wer lizi u baaŋ yaa ni.

ref: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
text: N biinɔŋŋaa, Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋi yaa kennaa, a dɛkkɔ yaa ge n nɔŋŋi dɔŋa guŋ.

ref: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
text: Nɛr maa haa waa Kɔraawiizi nawɛɛ. Ka di yaa nɔŋŋi dɔŋa, Kɔraawiizi du yaa ninɛɛ di ra hiini yaa, ya wer nɔŋŋuu nɛnnɛ di wa tuŋ.

ref: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
text: Yaa zummɔ lugɔ u du yaa ninɛɛ, yaa ge du u ni dikuu u Dumnanii la un tɛɛ yaa la n ɔɔ du yaa biine, di ra bagli yaa gunla wia.

ref: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
text: Yaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi daansɛɛ hinaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, yaa na u Biibaal la uŋ hummɛ durnya, ú ɛɛ durnya Lɛɛri.

ref: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
text: Nɛr la n yardi Yeesu, di sɛɛ lugɔ u ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Biibaallɛ, Kɔraawiizi du a hiŋ ninɛɛ, u ge du Kɔraawiizi ni.

ref: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
text: Awia, yaa wettoo zum nɛnnɛ di yardi Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ lugɔ u nɔŋŋi yaabuu. Kɔraawiizi ɛɛ nɔŋŋaa hinnɛ. Nɛr la n nɔŋŋi nɛra du Kɔraawiizi ninɛɛ, Kɔraawiizi ge du u ni.

ref: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
text: Un du yaa ni la, yaa wettoo helli u nɛnɔŋŋaa la nɛnnɛ. Yaa waa kaa ra fɔŋ hɔpizii la un niŋ wa di durnya seriya la, dikuubɛɛwiai, gunla Yeesu n duwɛɛ la, gunnɛ yaa ge du durnya naa biini.

ref: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
text: Di i nɔŋŋi nɛr, u wia wàá dɔɔi ɔnsii. Di yaa nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi nɛnnɛ di ga tuŋ, u gunnɛ niŋ lizi yaa ɔnsii maa. Ka di yaa ra ɔm alugɔ Kɔraawiizi daŋ haa tɔɔri yaa dikuu yaa wichɔgaa wia, amɔ, yaa haa waa Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋɛɛ nɛnnɛ ga tuŋ.

ref: We love because God loved us first.
text: Kɔraawiizi n felee nɔŋŋi yaa, di bagli yaa dɔnnɔŋŋaa wiarɛ yaa wer nɔŋŋuu.

ref: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
text: Nɛr la maa n niŋ ŋɔ lugɔ u nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizii ka hah u dɔŋhiŋ, karaa u ra kanni. Di waa wette ú nɔŋŋi u dɔŋhiŋ la u siwee n na na la, ɛrɛɛ ú ɛɛ nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi la u siwee n waa na lai?

ref: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
text: Kɔraawiizi widauliirɛ keŋ. Dí nɛr la maa n nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi, ú nɔŋŋi u dɔŋahina jaa.

ref: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
text: Hinla maa n yardɛɛ lugɔ Yeesu ɛɛ Kristoo, i ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biere. Di i nɔŋŋi nɛr, i daŋ nɔŋŋi u bie gba jaa.

ref: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
text: Di yaa nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi di ra hiŋ u nua, yaa zummɔ lugɔ yaa nɔŋŋi u biizi gbaa.

ref: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
text: Hinla maa n nɔŋŋi Kɔraawiizi, i danna hiŋ u nua. U nuuzi la ge waa kpol alugɔ á ɛɛ yaa tɔɔrɔɔ,

ref: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi biilullii bɛl maa wettoo kpegli wiimaa n du durnya di ra fir yaa. Yarda la yaa n yardi Kɔraawiizi labuu gillɛ yaa wer kpegli durnya wiimaa.

ref: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
text: Anɛɛ n niŋ wer kpegli durnya wia naanɛi? Nɛr la n yardɛɛ lugɔ Yeesu ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Biibaallɛ la, waabuu niŋ wer kpegli a durnya wia.

ref: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
text: A Yeesu Kristo ni nii ni challɛ ballɛ. U ni nii bɛŋ lɛi ballɛ. Ba wɔɔ sɔwɛɛ nii bɛŋ. Ba kpuubuu jaa. Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii ra di u daansɛɛrɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u ɛɛ wibii hinnɛ.

ref: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
text: Kuna ahoroo ra di guŋ daansɛɛ.

ref: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
text: Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii, Yeesu nii sɔi ani u chal. A maa daansɛɛ ɛɛ kpannɛ.

ref: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
text: Yaa ɔɔ ra sɛɛ newea daansɛɛrɛ. Ka Kɔraawiizi daansɛɛ labuu ɛɛ wizeŋ kaali a maa. U daansɛɛ la uŋ diwee u Biibaal wia labuu keŋ.

ref: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
text: Hinla maa n sɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Biibaal wia, Kɔraawiizi daansɛɛ du i biinii, i wer zum Kɔraawiizi wia nɛnnɛ. Hinla maa n waa Kɔraawiizi daansɛɛ ra sɛɛ, i ra yiruubuu kara hiŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, haa u daansɛɛ la uŋ diwee u Biibaal wia la sɛɛwɛ.

ref: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
text: A daansɛɛrɛ keŋ. Kɔraawiizi tɛɛ yaabuu u miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la. A miibɔɔ du u Biibaal la benii.

ref: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
text: Hinla maa Kɔraawiizi Biibaal n du i ni dɔɔ a miibɔɔrɛ. Ka hinla maa Kɔraawiizi Biibaal n waa i ni duwɛɛ, haa waa u miibɔɔ dɔɔwɛ. Miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ wia

ref: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
text: N sɛbi wia naabuu tɛɛ ii banla n yardi Kɔraawiizi Biibaal, ií zum lugɔ iabuu dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ labuu.

ref: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
text: Yaa yarduubuu lugɔ di yaa suŋŋuu kunla maa n paruu, ɔɔ nuu tɛɛ yaa.

ref: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
text: Di yaa zummɔ lugɔ ɔɔ nuú tɛɛ yaa, yaa daŋ zum lugɔ kunla yaa n suŋŋɛɛ la, u daŋ tɛɛ yaa.

ref: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
text: Di ii wa na ii dɔŋhiŋ bɛl n na ɛɛ wichɔgii bɛl, ii daŋ suŋŋi wiizi tɛu ú na miibɔɔ. Di waa wichɔgaa la un niŋ siu dikuu a ɛɛi wia la ra ɛɛ, ii daŋ suŋŋi tɛu. Wichɔgii bɛl dee du de, di nɛr ɛɛu, u daŋ siu dikuu u wia. Maa ŋɔ lugɔ ií suŋŋi wiizi wichɔgii naa dɔŋ wia.

ref: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
text: Wii la maa n waa deŋlee, u ɛɛ wichɔgiirɛ, ka aŋhina ge waa ɛɛwɛ lugɔ iin niŋ siu dikuu a wia.

ref: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
text: Yaa zummɔ lugɔ nɛr la maa n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biilullii, waa ɔɔ ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa. Kɔraawiizi Biibaal la ɔɔ ra du u taurɛ, Sitaani gilɛɛ wer ɛɛu wiimaa.

ref: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
text: Yaa kaa zum lugɔ yaa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biilullaarɛ. Ka banla n waa Kɔraawiizi biilullaa ɛɛwɛ la ge maa du Sitaani nonee biini.

ref: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
text: Yaa zummɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi Biibaal ba durnyaa di wa pilli yaa siwee, ya wer zum unla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi himmaa. Yaa du a Kɔraawiizi ninɛɛ, di kaa du u Biibaal Yeesu Kristo ni. Kɔraawiizi himmaanii la. U ra tɛɛ yaabuu miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
text: Mìŋ́ nabɔma labuu sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛɛ haaŋ la Kɔraawiizi n lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ ani u biizi la miŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ dikuu n ni baa maa n ɛɛ kpaŋ, Kɔraawiizi wibii biini wia la. N bɛŋ lɛi nɔŋŋi baa guŋ. Ka banla n zum Kɔraawiizi wibii maanii nɔŋŋi baa guŋ,

ref: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
text: dikuu a wibii n du yaa maa bampiree wia. A wibii daŋ haa du de di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa.

ref: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
text: N na jaami ia. Yáa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ani u Biibaal Yeesu Kristo hiini ii maa di suŋ ii ni, di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna, di gil ii dɔɔ wibii ani nɛnɔŋŋaa. Wibii ni nɔŋŋaa wia

ref: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
text: N bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ werge ani miŋ wa zum i biizi baŋhina wia lugɔ ba ra hiŋ wibiire, gunla yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi n ŋɔ ya ra hiŋ la.

ref: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
text: Ka filaŋkeŋ, n na suŋŋiibuu í ra hiŋ u widaulii naa. Widaulifalii lɛi. U faa dawuubuu saŋa maa ya ra hiŋ. Waabuu keŋ, ií nɔŋŋi dɔŋa.

ref: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
text: Di yaa ra hiŋ u widaulaa, yaa daŋ nɔŋŋi dɔŋa. U widauliirɛ lugɔ ií nɔŋŋi dɔŋa, gunla iin nuuwɛ lugli la. Awia, ií ra ɛɛ wiimaa ni nɔŋŋaa.

ref: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
text: Nɛfugze kpilakpila maa liwɔɔrɛ filaŋkeŋ. Baabuu waa sɛɛwɛ lugɔ Yeesu Kristo ba durnyaa lugɔ newee. Nɛr la maa n na hɔɔ guŋ, u ɛɛ a nɛfugzi bɛllɛ, di ɛɛ Kristo haahri.

ref: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
text: Ií ra du tau nɛnnɛ, yaa huma la gilɛɛ waa bir pɛɛ, ka ií wer na a tɔna maa wa tuŋ.

ref: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
text: Nɛr la maa n na bagli Kristo wia, ka kaa ra bagli wia lii u himmaa nfɛrɛ biini di ra jaa, Kɔraawiizi waa hoo a hiŋ ni. Nɛr la maa n zum Kristo baglaa la, di ɔɔ ra bagli guŋ maga bɛŋ, Kɔraawiizi ni u Biibal Yeesu du a hiŋ ninɛɛ.

ref: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
text: Di nɛr la maa wa ba ii be di ŋɔ ú bagli ia, ka waa Kristo wia ra bagli guŋ, ii gilɛɛ lɛɛ a hiŋ dau ii be, di gilɛɛ waa jaamuu.

ref: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
text: Nɛr la maa n na maŋkuri a hiŋ guŋ, u ge gba du u wichɔgaa hiŋ biinii.

ref: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
text: N dɔɔ wikpilaa min niŋ ŋɔ ii be, ka màá sɛbaa dau hɔŋ ni. N na nyiŋŋuu ń ba ii be ya wer na dɔŋa, ń ŋɔ a wia tɛɛ ia. Denii yaa bɔra sɔɔni yaa werge maa.

ref: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
text: Ii niwee la Kɔraawiizi n lizɛɛ tɛɛ u hiŋ la, u biizi ra jaami ia werge.

ref: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
text: Mìŋ́ nabɔma labuu sɛbi hɔnnaa ń tɛɛ n dammunanii Geyus la miŋ nɔŋŋɛɛ, dikuu yaa maa n ɛɛ kpaŋ Kɔraawiizi wibii naa biini wia.

ref: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
text: N nɛnɔŋŋii, n na suŋŋi Kɔraawiizii ú hiinii, i wer dɔɔ alaanfia nɛnnɛ, í wiimaa ge wer lii siwee alugɔ i ni Kɔraawiizi baambaaŋ wia n lii siwee gunla.

ref: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
text: Yaabalaa baŋhina ballɔɔ di wa ŋɔ i wia tɛŋ, dí i ra hiŋ wibiire. I wiimaa ra bagli gunnɛ. Awia, n bɔra sɔɔnɔɔrɛ werge.

ref: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
text: Saŋa la maa miŋ ɔɔ ra nuu n biizi wia lugɔ ba ra hiŋ wibiire la, a gunnɛ a sɔɔni n bɔra kaali wiimaa.

ref: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
text: N nɛnɔŋŋii, gunla hiŋ ɔɔ lɛɛ yaa dɔŋahina Yeesu hiŋra di gaa dau, haa ɔɔ zum baa ka wer lɛɛ baa di ra hiini baa la, i ra hiŋ ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ nɛnnɛ.

ref: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
text: Ba ŋɔ i wiarɛ tɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra bɔnnaa, di tɛi sɔŋ ani gunla hiŋ nɔŋŋi baa la. Awia, di ba waa nyiŋŋi ba kpa ba ŋmɛnɛɛ kaali, i daŋ kaa hiini baa gunla maa hin niŋ ɛɛ, á par Kɔraawiizi,

ref: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, Yeesu wiarɛ ba kuu lii ra vol guŋ. Ba waa kebee ra lɛɛ nɛra la n waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ la be.

ref: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
text: Awia, a wesso yaa n niŋ ɔɔ ra hiini nɛra naa dɔŋa. Di yaa wetto ra hiini dɔŋa guŋ, yaa maa kpauwɔɔ Kɔraawiizi wibii la huma biini.

ref: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
text: N faa sɛbi wia aŋhinaa tɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra de, ka Diɔtrɛfɛs la waa yaa wia ra sɛɛ. U ra nyiŋŋi nabɔmuurɛ.

ref: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
text: Awia, di n wa ballɔ, n daŋ kpa u wia di ŋɔ gunla unna ŋɔ wia pɛɛpɛɛ, di kpa wichɔgaa di ra chugiŋ. A bɛŋ wichɔgaa lɛi u ra ɛɛ. Waa ɔɔ sɛɛ ú lɛɛ yaabalaa ra dau. Di baŋhina ge du de di ra nyiŋŋi ba lɛɛ baa dau, ka waa ɔɔ gil ba lɛɛ baa dau, ka ɔɔ ra duŋŋi baa Yeesu hiŋra wiijaami dia la biini.

ref: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
text: N nɛnɔŋŋii, gilɛɛ ra hiŋ banla n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa. A ɛɛ winanaa bɛŋ. Nɛr la n na ɛɛ winanaa, u ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi biilulliirɛ. Nɛr la ge n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa haa waa Kɔraawiizi zummɛ.

ref: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
text: Dimitrius lawaa ɛɛ nɛnaniirɛ. Nɛra maa ra ŋɔ u wia guŋ. Wibii la unna hiŋ la ge ra di u daansɛɛrɛ guŋ. Yaa ge gba ra di u daansɛɛ guŋ. I zummɔ lugɔ yaa wiŋɔzi ɛɛ wibiire.

ref: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
text: N dɔɔ wikpilakpila maanii di ra nyiŋŋi n ŋɔ i be. Ka maa nyiŋŋi n sɛbaa dau hɔŋ ni.

ref: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
text: N na nyiŋŋuu lugɔ n ba i be di wa nai filaŋkeŋ, ya wer na dɔŋa di ŋɔ a wia.

ref: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
text: Kɔ́raawiizi tɛi bampirsɔna. I dammuzi la n du bɔnnaa la ra jaamii. Jaami yaa ge dammuzi maa tɛɛ yaa.

ref: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
text: Mìŋ́ Juud la n ɛɛ Yeesu Kristo balii, di kaa ɛɛ Jems niwee labuu ra sɛbi hɔnnaa, di ra jaami ii banla yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi n yittɛ ii ba u be, di wa ɛɛ u nɛnɔŋŋaa, Yeesu Kristo ge ra binni ii ni la.

ref: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
text: Kɔ́raawiizi suŋ ii ni, di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna, di nɔŋŋi ia werge ra jaa. Baglikara hina wia

ref: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
text: N nɛnɔŋŋaa, n faa ra nyiŋŋuu werge maa lugɔ n sɛbi hɔŋ bɛl tɛɛ ia, á hɔŋ bagli ia yaa lɛɛi wia maa ani gunla yaa maa n ninna hiŋ la. Denii n bir binni lugɔ a dɛkkɔɔ min niŋ sɛbi hɔnnaa, di ŋɔ ii be lugɔ ií maa ra naa ii hiŋaa naa naari. Kɔraawiizi faa bagli u biinanaarɛ gunla ban niŋ hiŋ. Gunla uŋ faa ŋɔwɛɛ la waa birgaa dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
text: N na fɔrgi iabuu, dikuubɛɛwiai, nɛra baŋhina suahzɔɔrɛ zuu ii biini. Ba waa Kɔraawiizi ra hiŋ, ka ra ŋɔ lugɔ nɛra daŋ wer ra ɛɛ wikuna, dikuu Kɔraawiizi n na suŋ nɛra ni wia. Ba kaa ra hɔɔ yaa Nabɔma Yeesu Kristo wia. U bɛnnɛ ɛɛ yaa Dɔɔri. Ba sɛbi nɛra naa wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi Hɔŋ biini saŋa maa, di ŋɔ lugɔ Kɔraawiizi daŋ di baa seriya, bá chol.

ref: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
text: Ii teŋ zum wia naa min niŋ ŋɔ naabuu, ka n ŋɔ ń liizi iabuu lugɔ Kɔraawiizi faa lɛɛ Jus hina la maanii, di kpa baa lii Ijip hɛri. Ka baŋhina waa u wia sɛɛwɛ, u bir kpu baa.

ref: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
text: U mɛlikazi aŋhina gba du denii uŋ vɔɔzi yɔlɔzi, di tɔa bɔbiri biini, á du de ú Hɔpizizeŋ la wa hel. Denii ú dia seriya, á chol. Aŋ vɛɛ huma la uŋ kpawɛɛ tɛɛa di kaa gil a duuribɔr la wiarɛ u vɔɔzaa yɔlɔzi la.

ref: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
text: Nɛra la n faa du Sɔdɔm ni Gɔmɔra ani boljigzi la n du a kɛraa la faa ra sɛmuu, di ra ɛɛ wikuna dizi n chummɛ werge. Awiarɛ Kɔraawiizi faa kpa niŋ di du ba ni, ú tɔɔri baa di hanna la, nɛ́ra zum lugɔ Kɔraawiizi ɔɔ ra tɔɔri nɛchɔgaarɛ dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia.

ref: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
text: Ka gunla faala hina la n faa ɛɛwɛ Kɔraawiizi tɔɔri baa la, gunnɛ nɛchɔgaa la n du ii biini haa vɛɛ ra ɛɛ la. Ba waa nfɛrɛ dɔɔwɛ, di kpa ba bɔrahɔŋ ra ɛɛ wikuna, di kaa ra vɛɛ nabɔnzi nuuzi, di ra gbɛlli mɛlikazi.

ref: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
text: Kɔraawiizi mɛlikazi maa nabɔma Maikil la ni Sitaani n faa ra di hɔɔzi alugɔ unla n niŋ kpa Moosis bɔrahɔŋ la, a Maikil faa waa bampirii dɔɔwɛ ú wer hau u ni di chagzuu, ka ŋɔ, “Yaa Dɔɔrii niŋ jugmii.”

ref: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
text: Ka nɛra naa ɔɔ ra gbɛlli wia la baŋ waa a biini zummɛɛ. Ba waa nfɛrɛ dɔɔwɛ di ɛɛ lugɔ sela. Wia la ba ni sela maa n zummɛ labuu ba ra ɛɛ manaŋ, a ra chɔgi baa.

ref: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
text: Wia daŋ wa huuzi baa. Ŋmɛnɛɛ la Keen n faa hiŋŋɛ labuu ba ge ra hiŋ la. Gunla Balaam la ge n faa aah siwii dikuu kebee wia di ɛɛ wichɔgaa la, gunnɛ ba ge kuu kebee wia di ra ɛɛ wichɔgaa la. Gunla Kɔra la n faa dɔɔ sikpegii di vɛɛ nabɔnzi la, gunnɛ ba ge gba dɔɔ sikpegii di ra ɛɛ la, Kɔ́raawiizi wa kpu baa gunla uŋ faa kpu Kɔra la.

ref: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
text: Iiŋ ɔɔ chaali di ŋɔ ií di ii Dɔɔri diwee la, nɛra la du ii biinii lugɔ doŋa di ra chɔgi ia. Ba waa hiihzi ka ra di, di ra binni ba bɛŋ wia. Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baama la n waa dooŋ dɔɔwɛ, peu taau ra kaali la, di kaa ɛɛ kumpɛɛri ni kunsiwaa lugɔ daazi aŋhina nɔnaa saŋa n ɔɔ wa hel ka a waa nɔŋ, ka du de pɛɛ ba wigzaa a siuzi jaa la,

ref: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
text: Andama naanatɛɛ ge naanatɛɛ bie Ɛnɔk la faa ŋɔ ba wiarɛ Kɔraawiizi fɔŋŋa biini saŋa maa, di ŋɔ, “Ií nuu ɛŋ, yaa Dɔɔri daŋ ba ni u mɛlikananaa kpila maa,

ref: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
text: di wa di nɛra maa seriya. Banla n ɛɛ wichɔgɛɛra di vɛɛ Kɔraawiizi nua labuu ú di seriya bá chol, ú tɔɔri baa dikuu ba wichɔgaa la baŋ vɛɛu ka ɛɛ la ni ba wiŋɔzi la maa baŋ ŋɔwɛɛ di gbɛlluu la wia.”

ref: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
text: Nɛra naa ɔɔ nuumuu ra du dɔŋa, di ra ɛɛ wii la maa ba kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa n tɛɛ baa bá ra ɛɛ la, di ɔɔ ra chɔli bahinaa, di kaa ra du nɛra ge nyuuni, bá wer na ba kipar ba be. Karfaazi ni baglaazi wia

ref: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text: Ka n biinɔŋŋaa, ií ra liizi wia la yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo huŋhunna la n faa ŋɔwɛɛ u fɔŋŋa biini la.

ref: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
text: Ba faa ŋɔ ii benii “Di durnya tuna wa hello, baŋhina daŋ lii di ra ɛɛ ia chɛɛtɛ, di ra ɛɛ wia la ba kunnyiŋŋichɔgaa n tɛɛ baa bá ra ɛɛ la.”

ref: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
text: Nɛra naa dizi ra chɔgi nuukpaŋ dɔɔirɛ, di ra bargi ia dɔŋa ni. Durnya wiarɛ ba ra hiŋ. Kɔraawiizi Duma waa hoo ba ni.

ref: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
text: Ka, n nɛnɔŋŋaa, iáwaa aah siwii di du iihinaa bɔkpega ii hinnaniinanii naa biini. Ií ɔɔ ra suŋŋuu u Dumnanii fɔŋŋa biini,

ref: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
text: di gilɛɛ waa ɛɛ wiimaa di ra lizi iihinaa Kɔraawiizi nɔŋŋaa la biini, ka ɔɔ ra hiŋuu ani tamii la yaa n na ɛɛ yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo la lugɔ u daŋ wa suŋ yaa ni, yá wer na u miibɔɔ la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la.

ref: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
text: Ií ra na banla n na aani la sinyɛna, di ra hiini baa,

ref: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
text: di kaa lɛɛ baŋhina lugɔ baŋ ɔɔ too kuŋ niŋ biini, á niŋ gilɛɛ waa diu la. Baŋhina ge, ii danna na ba sinyɛna, di ra hiini baa ka ra dazi, bá wichɔgaa la gilɛɛ waa buu ia. Chɔlaa wiisuŋŋaa wia

ref: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
text: U bɛnnɛ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. Waabuu lɛɛ yaa ha dikuu yaa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo wia. Ií ra tɔgzuu di ra tɛu sɔŋ, di ra sɛɛ u fɔŋŋa ni u dɔɔra. A maanii u dɔɔ saŋa maa la. U daŋ haa dɔɔa saŋa maa di ra la. Ami.

ref: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
text: Wia naa n du hɔnnaa biini naa, Kɔraawiizi pillaabuu bagli Yeesu Kristo, ú bagli u balaa, bá wer zum wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ filaŋkeŋ. Yeesu Kristo gillɔɔ u mɛlika bɛl ba u balii Jɔɔn be di wa bagluu a wia.

ref: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
text: Jɔɔn bagli wia la maa un nawɛɛ. Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii ni Yeesu Kristo ge baglaa daansɛɛrɛ u di, di sɛbi a wia dau.

ref: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
text: Nɛr la n niŋ karmi hɔnnaa nɛra nuu, nuu sumaa. Banla ge n niŋ nuu banna karmuu di ra sɛɛ wia la a hɔŋ n baglɛɛ la, ba ge gba nuu sumaa. Saŋa la a wia n niŋ wa ɛɛ la ra dugluu. Chɛchizi aniidaanɛɛ jaamaa wia

ref: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
text: Mìŋ́ Jɔɔnnɛ sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra la n ɔɔ chaali dɔŋa bola aniidaanɛɛ, Eesia hɛri la. Kɔraawiizi la n du de filaŋkeŋ, di faa du de saŋa maa la, unla n niŋ haa wa ba la, ú hiini ia di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Dunzi aniidaanɛɛ la n ɔɔ du u be u sognibɔr

ref: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
text: ani Yeesu Kristo n faa ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi daansɛɛ hiŋ ni wibii, di kaa ɛɛ unla n felee izi lii lalaa biini, di kaa ɛɛ durnya koora maa nabɔma la, bá maa hiini ia, di tɛɛ ia bampirsɔna. Ií ra tɛɛ unla n nɔŋŋi yaa di siu, ú chal wer lɛɛ yaa ha, yaa wer lii yaa wichɔgaa biini la sɔŋ.

ref: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
text: U gillɔɔ yaa kpau ɛɛ u kora hina di ɛɛ u kizeehina, di ra hum u Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi. Awia, ií ra tɛu sɔŋ. Waabuu niŋ dɔɔ fɔŋŋa saŋaa saŋa maa. Ami.

ref: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
text: Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. U daŋ ba. Baama ninɛɛ ú ga ba. Nɛruu nɛr maa daŋ nau unna ba. Banla n faa kpa kandaa di yag u loŋŋi la, ba gba daŋ nau. Durnya dee maa daŋ nau di ra lɔɔgi wile. Too. Ú ra ba! Ami.

ref: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
text: Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la n ɔɔ du de filaŋkeŋ, di faa du de saŋa maa la, unla n niŋ haa wa ba di ɛɛ Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la, u ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “Minuu lugli, minuu tuna.” Yeesu nai lugɔ deeza biini wia

ref: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
text: Mìŋ́ ii dɔŋhiŋ Jɔɔn n na sɛbi hɔnnaa, n ni ii maa ɛɛ kpannɛ di ra di tɔɔrɔɔ, di ra hum Kɔraawiizi Kora wia, di ra di kanyitti dikuu yaa ni Yeesu n kpauwɛ wia. Ba faa kpambuu ga ta nii baaŋ hɛri bɛl, ba ra yir de Patmɔs, dikuu miŋ faa bagli Kɔraawiizi wia di kaa di Yeesu daansɛɛ la wia.

ref: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
text: Yaa Dɔɔri hɔpizii Alaadi bɛl hɔllɛ n faa du de. Kɔraawiizi Dumnanii izi n ni, n nuu loobii bɛl n har lugɔ bensunoniina.

ref: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
text: U ŋɔ, “Wia naa hinna na naa, sɛbaa du hɔŋ biini di tili Yeesu hiŋra la n chaalɛɛ du bola aniidaanɛɛ la, banla n du Ɛfɛsus, Simirna, Pɛgamum, Tayataira, Sadis, Filadɛlfia ani Laudisia la.”

ref: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
text: N bir ń na nɛr la n ŋɔ wia n be la. Mim bittɛ, n na saliŋ fintina daazi aniidaanɛɛ,

ref: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
text: di na nɛbɛl lugɔ “Newee Biibaal” n chigɛ a fintina daazi baambaaŋ. Tagtajaŋ la un laalɛɛ hel u naapezi. Saliŋ belenti ge vɔɔ u bampirii.

ref: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
text: U nyuhuna huuhzi alugɔ gonni. U siwee ge ra nyɛgzi lugɔ ninlau.

ref: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
text: U naazi ge aah lugɔ baŋ kpa danyɛ du ninzeŋ u aah la. U loobii ge ra gbɔgzi lugɔ gɔnzeŋ nii n na chuuri.

ref: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
text: Chinchiŋwilaa aniidaanɛɛ du u nodig. Tokobii bɛl n dɔɔ nuuzi anɛɛ di ra di werge ra lii u nua. U siwee paga ge chaani werge alugɔ wiizi n na lɔ fɔŋŋa ni.

ref: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
text: Miŋ wa nau la, n chol u see lugɔ min siuwɛ. U kpa u nodig sag n ni, ka ŋɔ, “Gilɛɛ ra ɔm. Minuu tɔ see di kaa tɔ har.

ref: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
text: Minuu unla n na nyiŋ la. N faa siuwɔɔ ka filaŋkeŋ, n kaa dɔɔ miibɔɔrɛ di ra nyiŋ saŋa maa! N dɔɔ siu ni lalaa bol saafiibee.

ref: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
text: Awia, sɛbi wia la hiŋ nawɛɛ, wia la n du de filaŋkeŋ ani anla n niŋ wa ɛɛ wia naa harbɔɔ la.

ref: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
text: Chinchiŋwilaa aniidaanɛɛ naa n du n nodig ni saliŋ fintina daazi aniidaanɛɛ naa, n daŋ pilli a zɛɛ tɛi. Chinchiŋwilaa aniidaanɛɛ naa ɛɛ mɛlikazi la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n chaalɛɛ bola aniidaanɛɛ biini labuu. Fintina daazi naa ge ɛɛ Yeesu hiŋra la.”

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
text: U kaa ŋɔ, “Jaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra n chaalɛɛ Ɛfɛsus la, di ŋɔ, ‘Unla n kpogli chinchiŋwilaa aniidaanɛɛ u nodig, di ra vol saliŋ fintina daazi aniidaanɛɛ la baambaaŋ, waabuu ra ŋɔ wia naa.

ref: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
text: N zum ii huma, ii kuuhni ani ii kanyitti dii wiarɛ, di zum lugɔ ii waa nɛchɔgaa wia ra sɛɛ. Ii faa ɛɛ banla n faa ra yir bahinaa Kɔraawiizi huŋhunna, ka ba waa u huŋhunna ɛɛwɛ labuu di na, di zum lugɔ ba ɛɛ kara hinaa.

ref: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
text: Ii kaa dɔɔ kanyitti di di tɔɔrɔɔ guŋŋ dikuu n wia, ka ii bɔra waa huahwɛ.

ref: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
text: Ama, ka wii naabuu du de wanna par. Gunla iiŋ felee nɔŋŋiŋ la, ii waa kaa nɔŋŋiŋ guŋ.

ref: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
text: Awia, ií ra liizi gunla aŋ faa duwɛɛ la, di gil ii biine chɔgi dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia, ka kaa kpa ii lugli wiɛɛlaa la. Di guŋ lɛi, di ii waa sɛɛwɛ ii biine chɔgi dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia, n daŋ ba ii be di wa lizi ii fintina la lii u duuribɔr la.

ref: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
text: Ama, iiŋ hah banla banna yir Nikolatan hina huma la, u guŋ wesso. N gba hah ba huma labuu.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
text: Nɛr la maa n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la. Nɛr la n wette di kpegli Sitaani, n daŋ gil u di miibɔɔ daa la n du Kɔraawiizi bɔnanii biini la nɔna.’ ” Amaniye tɛɛ Simirna Yeesu hiŋra wia

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
text: “Kaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Simirna la. ‘Unla n tɔ see di kaa tɔ har, unla n faa siuwɛ ka bir izi siu biini di dɔɔ miibɔɔ la, waabuu ra ŋɔ wia naa.

ref: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
text: N zum ii tɔɔrɔɔ dii ani ii nyaari wiarɛ, ka ii ɛɛ dɔɔnaa. N kaa zum gunla banla n na yir bahinaa Jus hina ka ɛɛ Sitaani hiŋra la n na gbɛlli ia.

ref: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
text: Ií gilɛɛ ra ɔm tɔɔrɔɔ la iin niŋ wa di la. Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. Sitaani daŋ gil ba lauri ii baŋhina tɔ dia, bá wer ɛɛ ia di na. Ba daŋ tɔɔri ia guŋŋ hɔpizaa fi. Di siurɛ gba, ka ií haa vɛɛ di ra hiŋiŋ ka ń wa tɛɛ ia miibɔɔ, ú ɛɛ ii tɔna.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
text: Nɛr la n dɔɔ digna ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la. Nɛr la n wette kpegli Sitaani, siu bunɛɛhiŋ la wàá dɔɔ fɔŋŋa u ni.’ ” Amaniye tɛɛ Pɛgamum Yeesu hiŋra wia

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
text: “Kaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Pɛgamum ge la. ‘Unla n dɔɔ tokobizeŋ la n dɔɔ nuuzi anɛɛ di ra di werge la, waabuu ra sɛbi wia naa.

ref: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
text: N zum ii duuribɔttɛ. Sitaani sognibɔttɛ ii du la, ka ii haa vɛɛ di ra hiŋiŋ. Saŋa la baŋ faa kpu Antipas la n di n daansɛɛ ni wibii ii be Sitaani sognibɔr la, ka ii waa hɔɔwɛ lugɔ ii wanna hiŋ, ka haa vɛɛ di ra hiŋiŋ.

ref: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
text: Ama, wia aŋhinaa du de, a wanna par. Baŋhina du ii biinii di ra hiŋ Balaam baglaa. Waabuu faa gillɛ Balak dar Izrɛl hina ba hee ola la baŋ kpuwɛɛ tɛɛ vuga, di kaa ra sɛm la.

ref: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
text: Banla n na hiŋ Nikolatan hina baglaa gba du ii benii.

ref: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
text: Awia, ií gil ii biine chɔgi dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia. Di guŋ lɛi, n daŋ ba ii be manaŋ di wa kpa tokobi la n du n nua la di yoo ia.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
text: Nɛr la maa n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la. Nɛr la n niŋ wer kpegli Sitaani, n daŋ tɛu paanuu dee bɛl nɛra n waa u wia zummɛ ú hee, di kaa tɛu bihuŋŋu bɛl miŋ sɛbi sɔŋfalii bɛl di du u ni. Nɛr maa waa a sɔŋ zummɛ di unla min niŋ kpau tɛɛ la lɛi.’ ” Amaniye tɛɛ Tayataira Yeesu hiŋra wia

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
text: “Kaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Tayataira ge la. ‘Unla n ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Biibaal di kaa dɔɔ siwee alugɔ ninlau, di dɔɔ naazi a ra nyɛgzi lugɔ danyɛ la, waabuu ra ŋɔ wia naa.

ref: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
text: N zum ii wiɛɛlaa, ii nɛnɔŋŋaa, ii Kɔraawiizi yarda, ii huma iinna hum ani ii kanyitti diire. Ii filaŋkeŋ wiɛɛlaa wesso kaali ii lugli wiɛɛlaa gba.

ref: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
text: Ama, wii naabuu du de wanna par. Haaŋ la n na yir u hiŋ n dɔgtɛɛ bɛl, u sɔŋ di Jɛzɛbɛl la, ii giluubuu u du ii be di ra bagli ia, di ra dar n balaa ba ra sɛm di ra hee ola la baŋ kpuwɛɛ tɛɛ vuga.

ref: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
text: N tɛubuu hɔpizaa ú gil u biini chɔgi dikuu u wichɔgaa wia, ka waa sɛɛwɛ.

ref: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
text: Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. N daŋ duu wiila, ú ni banla u ni baa n na sɛm la chɔɔ di ra wii. Di ba waa sɛɛwɛ bá biine chɔgi dikuu ba wichɔgaa wia, di gil u huma la, ba maa daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ werge maa.

ref: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
text: N daŋ kpu u biizi. Denii Yeésu hiŋra maa zum lugɔ minuu ra pigzi newea biine la. N daŋ turgi ii bɛl maa gunla uŋ hummɛ.

ref: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
text: Ka ii banla n kawɛɛ ii waa u baglaa la sɛɛwɛ, ii waa wia la banna yir Sitaani wolo wia la zummɛ la, màá ka chug ia bunni maa.

ref: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
text: Ama, wia la iin lauwɛ nɛnnɛ di ra hiŋ la, ií haŋ lawaa guŋŋ ń na ba.

ref: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
text: Nɛr la n wette kpegli Sitaani, di wer hum n huma guŋŋ di wa hel a tuna la, n daŋ tɛu fɔŋŋa durnya nɛra ni.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
text: Nɛr la maa n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la.’ ”

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
text: U kaa ŋɔ, “Kaa sɛbi wia naa di tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Sadis ge la. ‘Unla n dɔɔ Kɔraawiizi dunzi aniidaanɛɛ ni chinchiŋwilaa aniidaanɛɛ la, waabuu ra ŋɔ wia naa. N zum ii wiɛɛlaarɛ. Nɛra zumɔɔ lugɔ ii dɔɔ miibɔɔrɛ, ka ii siuwɔɔ. Ii hiŋaa la fɔŋŋa la iin dɔɔwɛ la ra tunuu. Ií ra duu bɔkpega, ú gilɛɛ waa tuŋ kɔrai.

ref: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
text: Ií ra du tau, di ra kuari wia la n haa kawɛɛ di ra nyiŋŋi a siuzi la, á wer chi nɛnnɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, maa ii wiɛɛlii bɛl maa nawɛɛ uŋ wesse werge di wa tuŋ n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi be.

ref: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
text: Awia, ií ra liizi gunla baŋ faa bagli ia ani wia la iin nuuwɛ la, di ra hiŋ ba nuuzi guŋ, di gil ii biine chɔgi dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia. Di ii waa sɛɛwɛ ii du tau, n daŋ ba alugɔ ŋmɛɛŋ n ɔɔ ba di wa pirgi ia. Ii waa zum saŋa la min niŋ wa ba ii be.

ref: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
text: Ama, ii dɔɔ nɛra tama de baŋ waa gillɛ wichɔgaa doŋ ba wɛjɛzi. N daŋ tɔ baa wɛjɛhuŋŋa, n ni baa ra vol. Ba dɛg gunnɛ.

ref: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
text: Nɛr la n wette kpegli Sitaani, n daŋ tɔu wɛjɛhuŋŋu. Màá dinzi u sɔŋ miibɔɔ hɔŋ la biini maa. N daŋ ŋɔ u wia lugɔ n nuubuu n Mɛɛ ni u mɛlikananaa la be.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
text: Nɛr la maa n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la.’ ” Amaniye tɛɛ Filadɛlfia Yeesu hiŋra wia

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
text: “Kaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Filadɛlfia ge la. ‘Unla n ɛɛ naniinanii, di ɛɛ wibii hiŋ, di dɔɔ Deevid saafiibii la, di u pilli dominua, nɛr maa wàá wer tɔu, di u kaa tɔu, nɛr maa wàá wer pilluu labuu ra ŋɔ wia naa.

ref: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
text: N zum ii wiɛɛlaarɛ. Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. N pilli ŋmɛnɛɛrɛ tɛɛ ia. Nɛr maa wàá wer tɔu, dikuubɛɛwiai, ii fɔŋŋa waa kaŋ, ka ii wer ra hiŋ n nua. Ii waa n wia hɔɔwɛ di gil n hiŋaa.

ref: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
text: Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. Sitaani hiŋra la n na kanni kara di ra yir bahinaa Jus hina, ka ba waa Jus hina ɛɛwɛ la, n daŋ gil ba wa giŋŋi ii see di ra jaami ia. Denii bá zum lugɔ n nɔŋŋi iabuu.

ref: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
text: Iin nuuwɛ tɛŋ di di kanyitti la, n ge daŋ lɛɛ ia tɔɔrɔɔ la n niŋ jaa ba durnya maa nɛra be di wa ɛɛ baa na la biini.

ref: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
text: N daŋ ba manaŋ. Ií lau wia la iin zummɛ la chigigi nɛ́r maa gilɛɛ wa wer dar ia di lɛɛ ii lii tɔna ii be.

ref: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
text: Nɛr la n wette kpegli Sitaani, n daŋ gil u ɛɛ ligii bɛl n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Dia biini. Wàá ka lii de maa. N daŋ sɛbi n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi sɔŋ di du u ni, di kaa sɛbi n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi bol sɔŋ di du u ni. Jɛrusalɛmfalii la n niŋ wa lii n Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi be di tuu ii be la sɔnnɛ ń sɛbi du u ni, di kaa sɛbi n sɔŋfalii di du u ni.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
text: Nɛr la n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la.’ ” Amaniye tɛɛ Laudisia Yeesu hiŋra wia

ref: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
text: “Kaa sɛbi wia naa tɛɛ mɛlika la n na binni Yeesu hiŋra la n du Laudisia ge la. ‘Unla n ɛɛ Ami, di ɛɛ daansɛɛ hiŋ la wia n dɔɔ wibii, kummaa ge Kɔraawiizi n faa tawɛɛ lii u fɔŋŋa biini la, waabuu ra ŋɔ wia naa.

ref: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
text: N zum ii wiɛɛlaarɛ. Ii waa sɛɛwɛ ií hiŋ nɛnnɛ. Ii waa kaa vɛɛ ge, ka ɛɛ lugɔ nii n waa wenzee, waa kaa sɔɔni ge, ka ɛɛ hɔlɔhɔlɔ. Di ii daŋ hiŋ, ií hiŋ. Di ii daŋ vɛɛ ge, ií vɛɛ.

ref: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
text: Ka iiŋ waa hiŋ, ii waa kaa vɛɛ ge ka ɛɛ lugɔ nii la n ɛɛ hɔlɔhɔlɔ naa, n daŋ puuzi ia ha.

ref: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
text: Ii ŋɔwɔɔrɛ lugɔ ii jaa nau di birgi dɔɔna. Ii waa kummaa nyaawɛ. Ka ii waa zummɛ lugɔ ii ɛɛ nyaaraa, ii wia dɔɔ sinyɛna werge. Ii waa kummaa dɔɔwɛ. Ii nyuŋŋɔɔrɛ. Ii waa laala gba dɔɔwɛ ií laali.

ref: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
text: Ií gil n ŋɔ ii be. A wesso iin nyiŋŋi saliŋ la miŋ du niŋ, di lizi u doŋa maa ha la di yau n be, di kaa yau wɛjɛhuŋŋa ií wer tɔ iihinaa, hiíhzi gilɛɛ waa di ia dikuu iiŋ waa kummaa tɔwɛɛ wia, di kaa nyiŋŋi tagzi n be di yau di du ii siwee, ií wer di ra na.

ref: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
text: Banla min nɔŋŋɛɛ, baabuu n ɔɔ jugmi di tɛrgi ba digna. Awia, ií aah siwii di gil ii biine chɔgi dikuu ii wichɔgaa wia.

ref: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
text: Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. Mìŋ́ chigɛ ii dominua di ra lɔ kɔkɔ. Di nɛr la maa wa nuu n loobii di pilliŋ, n daŋ zuu u be n nuu di.

ref: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
text: Nɛr la maa n wette kpegli Sitaani, n daŋ gil u so n be n sognibɔr la. Gunnɛ n ge faa kpegli Sitaani, di wa so n Mɛɛ be u sognibɔr la.

ref: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
text: Nɛr la maa n dɔɔ digna di ra nuu wia, ú ra nuu wia la Kɔraawiizi Duma n na ŋɔ Yeesu hiŋra be la.’ ”

ref: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
text: Denii n binni di ga na dominua bɛl n pillɛɛ Kɔraawiizi bol, di nuu unla n felee ŋɔ wia la loobii lugɔ bensunoniina la. U ŋɔ, “Tinni ra ba ɛŋ, ń baglii wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ wia naa harbɔɔ.”

ref: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi Duma izi n ni, n binni di koorikara bɛl chigɔ Kɔraawiizi bol, nɛbɛl ge so u ni.

ref: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
text: Nɛr la n soge de la ra nyɛgzi pilpilpil lugɔ binanaa la banna yir jaspɛr ni karnɛliɔn la. Kɔraawiizi kizee bɛl bar u kara la, u ge lugɔ binanii la banna yir ɛmɛrald n na nyɛgzi gunla.

ref: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
text: N kaa na koorikassi tokko ni anaazu n bar u kara la wa kaali. Nabɔnzi tokko ni banaazu tɔ wɛjɛhuŋŋa, di hi saliŋ kahurozi di so kassi la ni.

ref: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
text: Kara la n du a baambaaŋ la ra lizi kuna aŋhina lugɔ dooŋ n na nyɛgzi, pilpilpil, di kaa ra gbɔgzi gbigbigbi lugɔ dooŋ. Nine aniidaanɛɛ ge du kara la see di ra chaani. Kɔraawiizi dunzi aniidaanɛɛ labuu.

ref: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
text: A kara see paga ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ muuzeŋ n ɛɛ yelemm di chɔɔ lugɔ digii. Kunnyinee anaazu du u sognibɔr la di baruu. A dɔɔ siweere a sezi ni a harbɔɔni maa.

ref: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
text: A kunnyinee bɛl ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ bunyiŋ, bɛl ɛɛ lugɔ nabii, bɛl siwee li newee siwee, bɛl ge ɛɛ lugɔ chig n na zaah.

ref: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
text: Bɛl maa dɔɔ keeri anumbɛl, siwee tɔ a bɔra maa ni a keeri biine gba. A ɔɔ du u be saŋa maa, di yir yira di ra ŋɔ, “Kunnaniinaniirɛ yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi la. Waa doŋa maa dɔɔwɛ. Fɔŋŋa maanii u dɔɔ di faa du de di haa du de filaŋkeŋ. U daŋ haa wa ba.”

ref: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
text: Gunnɛ kunnyinee la ɔɔ ra ɛɛ di ra jaami unla n soge koorikara la ni, di ɛɛ unla n niŋ ɔɔ ra nyiŋ di ra la la. Saŋa la maa aŋ ɔɔ ŋɔ á jaamuu, di kpau girme di tɔgzuu gunla,

ref: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
text: “Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi, girme, zenni ani fɔŋŋa ɛɛ i horaa, dikuubɛɛwiai, hinuu ta kummaa. I kipar wiarɛ i taa, a du de.”

ref: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
text: Denii n binni di na lugɔ unla n soge koorikara ni la kpogli hɔŋ bɛl u nodig. A hɔŋ keŋkerezi anɛɛhiŋ maa ninɛɛ ba sɛbi. U bɔra la baŋ kpa kel margi ge du aniidaanɛɛ.

ref: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
text: N kaa na mɛlikakpeg bɛl n na ŋɔ wia fɔŋŋa ni, “Anɛɛ n dɛg hɔnnaa kel naa bɔra aniidaanɛɛhiŋ lallaa, á hɔŋ pilli tɛɛ yaai?”

ref: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
text: Nɛr maa waa hoo chiŋ, hɛri ani hɛri zɛɛ gba maa un niŋ pilli a hɔŋ di binni u biini.

ref: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
text: Denii n jaa ra wii werge maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba waa nɛr maa nawɛɛ u dɛg hɔŋ la pillaa, ú wer binni u biini.

ref: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
text: Denii Nabɔma la bɛl ŋɔ n be, “Gilɛɛ ra wii. Na! Unla n lii Juda dee biini, ba ra yiruu bunyiŋ di kaa ra yiruu Deevid naana la, u wettoo kpegli u dɔma. Awia, waabuu dɛg hɔŋ la kel bɔra aniidaanɛɛ la lallaa.”

ref: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
text: Denii n kaa binni, di Pebii bɛl n chigɛ koorikara la bɔr baambaaŋ, kunnyinee ni nabɔnzi la baruu. U li peezi baŋ kpuwɛɛ. Nyigzi aniidaanɛɛ lii u nyuu. U dɔɔ siwee ge aniidaanɛɛ. A siwee ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi dunzi aniidaanɛɛ la uŋ hummɛ a la durnya maa biini labuu.

ref: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
text: A pebii ga lɛɛ hɔŋ la koori la hiŋ nodig.

ref: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
text: Ba yir yirfalii bɛl keŋ, di ŋɔ, “I dɛg hɔŋ la bɔpɛglaa la lallaarɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba faa kpuibuu. I chal la wiarɛ i wer turgi nɛra wichɔgaa kim, di lɛɛ baa ha lii nɛdeere dee maa n du hɛri naa yenne yemmaa biine,

ref: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
text: di gil ba ɛɛ yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi Kora hina ni u Kizeehina. Ba daŋ dɔɔ durnya maa.”

ref: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
text: N kaa ŋɔ n binni di bɔr maa ra gbɔgzi werge maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, mɛlikazi kpilakpila maa ballɔɔ di wa bar koorikara la ni kunnyinee ni nabɔnzi la maa chem. A du kagboŋa kagboŋ kpila maa,

ref: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
text: di ra ŋɔ bɔkpega ni, “Pebii la baŋ faa kpuwɛɛ la dɛkkɔ nɛr maa n kpa fɔŋŋa daama, nunzuma, kpegzi, girme, sɔŋ ani chɔlaa maa ra tɛu.”

ref: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
text: N kaa nuu kuna la maa Kɔraawiizi n tawɛɛ chiŋ, kuna la maa n du hɛri ni muu biini maa n na ŋɔ, “Ií ra chɔli unla n soge koorikara la ni ani Pebii la, di ra tɛɛ baa sɔŋ ni girme ani fɔŋŋa maa, di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa.”

ref: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
text: Kunnyinee anaazu la ŋɔ, “Ami.” Nabɔnzi la ge chɔɔ di ra jaami.

ref: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
text: Denii n na Pebii la n lalli kel bɔmargaa aniidaanɛɛ la bɛl. Uŋ wa lalluu la, n nuu kunnyinee la bɛl loobii alugɔ dooŋ n na gbɔgzi. U ŋɔ, “A ba!”

ref: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
text: N binni di zaghuŋŋu bɛl liwɔɔ. Nɛr la n tinnuu la kpogli hoo. Ba kpa koorikahuro tɛu, u kaali di dɔɔ fɔŋŋa di kpegli nɛra, di haŋ kpegli baa ra la.

ref: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
text: Denii Pebii la kaa pilli kuŋpɛglaa nɛɛhiŋ la. Uŋ wa pillɛɛ, n nuu kunnyinii nɛɛhiŋ n ŋɔwɛɛ, “A ba!”

ref: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
text: Zagu bɛl kaa lii, u maa aah yorotototo. Ba tɛɛ nɛr la n tinnuu la fɔŋŋa, ú chɔg nuukpaŋ dɔɔi durnya maa biini, nɛ́ra ra kpuuzi dɔŋa. Tokobizeŋ bɛllɛ ba kpa tɛu u la.

ref: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
text: Pebii la lalli kumpɛglaa horohiŋ la. Uŋ wa lalluu, n nuu kunnyinii horohiŋ la n ŋɔwɛɛ, “A ba!” N binni di zagdoŋ bɛl liwɔɔ. Nɛr la n tinnuu la kpogli kunla baŋ kpawɛɛ ra zum tɔgzi la bɛl.

ref: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
text: N nuu gbɔga bɛl lugɔ loobii di lii kunnyinee anaazu la baambaaŋ, uŋ ŋɔwɛɛ, “Hɔpizibir kinturgaa maanii bá kpa yau mia libikpaŋ. Baali libizi ahoro ge guŋ. Ka nuu ni siŋ lawaa, gilɛɛ chɔgi aawaa.”

ref: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
text: Denii Pebii la kaa lalli kumpɛglaa naazuhiŋ la. Uŋ wa lalluu, n nuu kunnyinii naazuhiŋ la n ŋɔwɛɛ, “A ba!”

ref: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
text: N binni di zaghulahula bɛl liwɔɔ. Nɛr la n tinnuu la ge sɔnnɛ Siu. Bɛl ge hiŋ u ni. U ge sɔnnɛ Lalaa Bol. Ba gil bá bargi hɛri bɔra anaazu. Baŋ barguu bɔra anaazu la, ba tɛɛ baa fɔŋŋa, bá kpa tokobizi, lɔchɔgii, wiilchɔgii ani sechɔgaa di kpu a bɔra anaazu la bɛl nɛra.

ref: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
text: Denii Pebii la kaa lalli kumpɛglaa nuehiŋ la. Uŋ wa lalluu, n binni Kɔraawiizi mbusu lizibɔr zɛɛ di na lalaa la baŋ faa kpuwɛɛ, dikuu bam bagli Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii di di u daansɛɛ tɛu la wia.

ref: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
text: Ba lɔɔgi wile werge maa, di ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi La N Kaali Kummaa la wia n dɔɔ wibii, saŋa bɛɛ í di banla n du durnya biini naa seriya, di turgi yaa kpui la kimɛi?”

ref: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
text: Denii ba tɛɛ bɛl maa wɛjɛhuŋŋu ú tɔ, di ŋɔ bá haa heezi tama mɔɔ, ka bá dɔŋa Kɔraawiizi yoma ni babalaa la ban niŋ haa kpu alugɔ baŋ faa kpuuzi baa la wa jaa ba ni, bá maga su.

ref: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
text: Denii n na Pebii la n kaa lalli kumpɛglaa numbɛlhiŋ la. Un lalluu la, hɛri ra zigli werge maa, wiizi bir biri alugɔ wɛjɛdoŋ, baagu bir aah lugɔ chal,

ref: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
text: chinchiŋwilaa ge lii chiŋ di chogli hɛri alugɔ nɔŋhuuri la pezeŋ n zigli daa a chogli hɛri la,

ref: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
text: chiŋ maa kaali lugɔ bam piŋŋi kalaŋ. Bizenaa ni muuzeŋ baaŋ hɛrjigzi maa tugzi lii a bɔra.

ref: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
text: Durnya kora ni nɛzenaa, soojazi nabɔnzi, dɔɔna, fɔŋŋa dɔɔra, nɛdee maa, banla n ɛɛ yomaa ani banla n dɔɔ bahinaa maa maa chɔ ga suahzi bia bɔɔni ni giŋgimee bɔra,

ref: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
text: di ra ŋɔ giŋgimee ni bia la be, “Ií ra chogli yaa ni di tɔ yaa ni, únla n soge koorikara ni la gilɛɛ wa wer na yaa, Pébii la gilɛɛ wer tɔɔri yaa dikuu u baaŋfuuih la wia,

ref: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, ba Hɔpizizeŋ la ban niŋ zum Kɔraawiizi baaŋ n niŋ fuuh ba ni la helloo. Anɛɛ n niŋ wer lɛɛ u hiŋ u baaŋ hiŋ biinei?”

ref: After this I saw four angels. Each one was standing on one of the earth's four corners. The angels held back the four winds, so that no wind would blow on the earth or on the sea or on any tree. These angels had also been given the power to harm the earth and the sea. Then I saw another angel come up from where the sun rises in the east, and he was ready to put the mark of the living God on people. He shouted to the four angels,

text: Tɔɔrɔɔzenaa anɛɛhiŋ la bɛrɔɔrɛ kaali, ka horohiŋ la ra ba manamanaŋ. Bɛnsuno aniidaanɛɛhiŋ la wia

ref: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
text: Mɛlika niidaanɛɛhiŋ la huuh. Uŋ huuhwɛ la, baŋhina n du Kɔraawiizi bol a ŋɔ fɔŋŋa ni, “Durnya kossi jaa birgi yaa Dɔɔri ni u Kristo la kossii. U daŋ dɔɔ baa saŋa maa di ra la.”

ref: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
text: di ra ŋɔ, “Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, hinla n du de filaŋkeŋ, di du de saŋa maa la, yaa ra jaamii, dikuubɛɛwiai, i kpa fɔŋŋazenne jaa dɔɔ kummaa.

ref: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
text: Durnya ni u dee maa baana fuuhwoo. Ka i ge saŋa la i baaŋ n niŋ fuuh ba ni la helloo. I daŋ jaa di lalaa seriya, di turgi winanaa la i balaa dɔgtɛɛzi, i biinanaa la ani banla maa n faa ɔmii la, nɛdumazi ni nɛzenaa maa kim, di kaa chɔgi banla n na chɔgi durnya la.”

ref: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
text: Denii Kɔraawiizi Dia la n du chiŋ la pilli, ba na Kɔraawiizi Ni U Nɛra Nuukpaŋ Dɔɔi Dakka la. Dooŋ a nyɛgzi pilpilpil, loobee ra kɔɔ, nazaa ra pozi pababababa, hɛri ra zigli, dobizenaa ra chogli hɛri katikati.

ref: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
text: A haaŋ kpogli hiarɛ di jaa ra nyiŋŋi ú lul, a ra ɛɛu tɔɔrɔɔ werge, u ra chɛɛhgi.

ref: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
text: Denii n kaa na wii bɛl Kɔraawiizi bol. Nyugaa bɛl dee lii. U du kaŋ werge maa, di aah di dɔɔ nyuuni aniidaanɛɛ ni nyigzi fi. Koorikahuro hi u nyuuni la bɛl maa ni.

ref: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
text: U diŋ ge gbaari chinchiŋwilaa lugɔ di i bargaa bɔra ahoro, u bɔkpannɛ u gbaari hɛri la. Nyugzenzeŋ la chi haaŋ la n na nyiŋŋi u lul la be, di ra nyiŋŋi lugɔ di u wa lullɔ, ú kpa u bie la hee.

ref: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
text: U lul biibaal. U bie hinnɛ niŋ wa dɔɔ nɛra maa, di kpa lugbii daŋkpala di ra duŋŋi baa lugɔ penɔɔni n na duŋŋi u peeza la. Uŋ wa luluu la, ba toou kaali Kɔraawiizi ni u koorikara la be.

ref: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
text: Haaŋ la ge chɔ zuu hɛribɔduma. Kɔraawiizi faa ɛɛ bɔr siryaa tɛu, bá wer kpogluu hɔpizaa kagboŋ ni kalfaanɛɛ ni tokkoahoro maa biini.

ref: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
text: Denii laal izi Kɔraawiizi bol. Maikil ni u mɛlikazi kpa laal di ra yoo nyugzenzeŋ la ni u ge mɛlikazi,

ref: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
text: ka a waa wette kpegli Maikil ni u hora la. A waa kaa wer á du Kɔraawiizi bol la.

ref: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
text: Kɔraawiizi kpa nyugzenzeŋ la n faa ɛɛ hɛrikuŋ saŋa la, unla n na gbɛlli nɛra, ba ra yiruu Sitaani, u ɔɔ ra dar durnya maa la ni u mɛlikazi maa, di ha hɛri.

ref: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
text: Denii n nuu loobizeŋ bɛl de, n na ŋɔ, “Filaŋkeŋ, yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi durnya lɛɛi helloo. U fɔŋŋa ni u kora saŋa helloo. U Kristo daŋ jaa lɛɛ fɔŋŋa di ra di, dikuubɛɛwiai, unla n faa ɔɔ ra zɔɔzi yaabalaa saŋa maa yaa Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi be la, Kɔraawiizi kpaubuu ha.

ref: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
text: Ba kpegluubuu dikuu Pebii chal la ni daansɛɛ la baŋ diwee tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la wia. Ba waa ba miibɔɔni wia kpawɛɛ su siwii ka sɛɛ lugɔ bá kpu baa gba.

ref: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
text: Awia, chiŋ ni banla maa n du de la, ií gil ii bɔra sɔɔni ia. Ii banla n du hɛri ni muuzeŋ la ge la, wia daŋ wa huuzi ia, dikuubɛɛwiai, Sitaani tuu ii benii. U baaŋ na fuuh werge maa, dikuubɛɛwiai, u zummɔ lugɔ u saŋa waa kaa du kaŋ.”

ref: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
text: Kɔraawiizi n kpa nyugzenzeŋ la ha hɛri la, a nyugzenzeŋ izi di ra duŋŋi haaŋ la n lul biibaal la.

ref: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
text: Ba tɛu chigzeŋ keeri anɛɛ ú kpa zaah kaali hɛribɔduma, bɔr la baŋ ɛɛ sirya tɛu ú du de bá ra binni u ni binni ahoro ni keza, ú wer na u hiŋ di lii nyugzenzeŋ la be.

ref: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
text: Nyugzenzeŋ la n na duŋŋi haaŋ la luge la, u pilli u nua di ta nii lugɔ muu, ú vii ɛɛ guŋ, á nii kpa haaŋ la kaali.

ref: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
text: Ka hɛri hiini haaŋ la, di pilli u nua di nyɔɔ nii la maa a nyugzenzeŋ n tawɛɛ lii u nua biini la.

ref: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
text: Denii nyugzenzeŋ la baaŋ fuuh werge maa dikuu haaŋ la wia. U kpa kaali ú ga yoo u nɛra la n ɔɔ ra hiŋ Kɔraawiizi widaulaa di sɛɛ Yeesu wia nɛnnɛ la.

ref: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
text: Ka a nyugzenzeŋ chi a muuzeŋ nua.

ref: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
text: Denii n na sechɔgii bɛl n na lii muuzeŋ la biini. U dɔɔ nyigzi fi ni nyuuni aniidaanɛɛ. Koorikahuro hi u nyigzi fi la bɛl maa ni, sɔnchɔgaa ge du u nyuuni la maa ni, a bɛl maa ra gbɛlli Kɔraawiizi.

ref: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
text: A sechɔgii li amanii, ka u naaziwaa li sinsiri naazi, u nua ge li bunyiŋ nua. Nyugzenzeŋ la kpa u fɔŋŋa, u kora ani u nabɔmuu la maa un dɔɔwɛ werge la tɛɛ a kuŋ.

ref: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
text: A kuŋ nyuu bɛl ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baŋ faa lɔu di kpu. Ba faa kpuubuu ka u wer izi di nyaagi di ra nyiŋ, u wia tir durnya nɛra maa ba ra hiŋuu,

ref: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
text: di ra tɔgzi nyugzenzeŋ la alugɔ Kɔraawiizi, dikuu un tɛɛ sechɔgii la fɔŋŋa wia, di kaa ra jaami a sechɔgii, di ra ŋɔ, “Sechɔgii naa dɔŋ waa hoo. Anɛɛwaarɛ n niŋ wer lɔu laallɛi?”

ref: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
text: U pilli u nua di ra gbɛlli Kɔraawiizi ni u sɔŋ, u bɔnanii ani banla n du u be la.

ref: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
text: Kɔraawiizi gillɔɔ u yoo u biinanaa di kpegli baa, di gil u dɔɔ fɔŋŋa nɛdee maa n du hɛri naa yemmaa ni.

ref: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
text: Durnya hina la ba sɔna n waa hoo Pebii la baŋ kpuwɛɛ lii durnya luglaa la, miibɔɔ hɔŋ la biini, ba maa danna jaamuu alugɔ Kɔraawiizi.

ref: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
text: Di Kɔraawiizi dau nɛr maa alugɔ bá lawuu, ba daŋ lawuu. Di nɛr maa kpa tokobi di kpu nɛr, tokobii bá kpa kpu u ge. Denii bá chi zum kanyitti ni yarda la dee Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la n dɔɔwɛ ani gunla un duwɛɛ.

ref: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
text: Denii n kaa na sechɔgii bɛl n na lii hɛri biini. U dɔɔ nyigzi anɛɛ lugɔ pebii nyigzi, di dɔɔ loobii lugɔ nyugzenzeŋ loobii.

ref: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
text: Lugli sechɔgii la kpa u fɔŋŋa la maa di du u ni, u ra ɛɛ wizenaa u sɔŋ biini, di gil banla maa n du durnya ra jaami lugli sechɔgii la baŋ faa lɔwɛɛ di kpu ka u kaa nyaagi la.

ref: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
text: U wettoo ɛɛ wizenaa, haali di gil niŋ lii chiŋ di chol hɛri, nɛra na.

ref: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
text: Uŋ wette ra ɛɛ wizenaa la sechɔgii la fɔŋŋa biini gunla, nɛra sɛɛ u wia, u wer dar baa di ŋɔ bá ma kumbɛl, ú li sechɔgii la baŋ faa kpa tokobi di boŋŋi ka u haa ra nyiŋ la.

ref: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
text: Baŋ wa mau tuŋ, Kɔraawiizi kaa tɛu fɔŋŋa u wer du kunla bam mawɛɛ la heeza, u wer ra ŋɔ wia. A kuŋ ŋɔ, dí banla maa n wàá sɛɛ ra jaami kunla bam mawɛɛ la, bá kpu baa.

ref: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
text: U gillɔɔ ba pii nɛr maa, nɛdumazi, nɛzenaa, dɔɔna, nyaara, banla n dɔɔ bahinaa, yoma, nodige gɛɛ ba hilli.

ref: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
text: Nɛr la maa n waa guŋ piiwɛ wàá wer yau kuna, wàá wer yoo kuna ge, see banla bam piiwɛ la bɛŋ. A sechɔgii sɔŋ gɛɛ u nambaa ba pii la.

ref: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
text: Di i dɔɔ nunzuma, í nuu ɛŋ. Nɛr la n dɔɔ zumaa daŋ wer zum sechɔgii la namba la zɛɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u ɛɛ newee sɔŋ bɛllɛ. Waabuu keŋ, kalfaanumbɛl ni tokkoahoro ni anumbɛl,
