text: N nuu kɔɔi bɛl lii Kɔraawiizi bol, u lugɔ muu n na pal werge, di kaa ɛɛ lugɔ nazaa ge n na pogzi werge. A kaa ɛɛ lugɔ janjalaŋ lɔɔra n na lɔ ba janjalanzi.

ref: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
text: Nɛra la chi Kɔraawiizi koorikara la ni kunnyinee anaazu ni nabɔnzi la be di ra yir yirfalii bɛl. Nɛr maa waa wette u zum yir la, di nɛra kagboŋa kalfa ni tokkoanɛɛ ni banaazu la Kɔraawiizi n turgi ba wichɔgaa kim, di lɛɛ baa ha di lii durnya nɛra la maa biini la bɛŋ lɛi.

ref: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
text: Ba ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ baala la n waa haana zummɛ, dikuu baŋ faa gil hahwia la wia. Ba ɔɔ ra hiŋ Pebii la bɔr la maa un niŋ la. Baabuu ɛɛ banla baŋ felee yau ha newea biini, di kpa tɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni Pebii la.

ref: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
text: Daraa maa waa hoo ba nuuzi. Ba waa wichɔgaa maa dɔɔwɛ. Mɛlikazi ahoro aŋhina wia

ref: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
text: Denii n kaa na mɛlika bɛl n na zaah chiŋ. U kpogli amaniyesuma la n waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ la, ú lizi tɛɛ nɛdee maa n du hɛri naa yemmaa,

ref: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
text: di ra ŋɔ fɔŋŋa ni, “Ií ra ɔm Kɔraawiizi, di ra tɛu sɔŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, saŋa la un niŋ di nɛra seriya la helloo. Ií ra jaami unla n ta chiŋ, hɛri, muuzeŋ ani bulli maa la.”

ref: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
text: Mɛlika bɛl hiŋ unla ni, di ra ŋɔ, “U cholloo, u cholloo! Babilɔn, bolzenzeŋ la n faa gillɛ durnya nɛra maa ra nyɔɔ u siŋkpega, di kaa gil nɛra ra sɛm werge la cholloo.”

ref: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
text: Mɛlika horohiŋ kaa hiŋ anɛɛ la ni, di ra ŋɔ fɔŋŋa ni, “Di unla maa sɛɛwɔ ra jaami sechɔgii la ni kunla bam mawɛɛ u liu la, di kaa gil ba pii u hile gɛɛ u nonii,

ref: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
text: u daŋ nyɔɔ Kɔraawiizi siŋ. U baaŋ la n ɛɛwɛ lugɔ siŋ la baŋ waa hulle, ka fuguu guŋ di du libee biini labuu, bá tɛu, ú nyɔɔ la. U daŋ di tɔɔrɔɔ werge maa niŋ ni jilbi biini, mɛlikananaa ni Pebii la see.

ref: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
text: Nyɔɔzi daŋ tinni lii bɔr la banna di tɔɔrɔɔ la saŋa maa, di ra la. Banla n jaami sechɔgii la ni kunla bam mawɛɛ ani banla baŋ kpa u sɔŋ pii la, ba wàá lii tɔɔrɔɔ la biini maa, ka ɔɔ ra di a tɔɔrɔɔ hɔpizaa ni hamuŋa maa di hanna la.”

ref: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
text: Denii bá zum kanyitti la dee Kɔraawiizi biinanaa la n na hiŋ u widaulaa di yardi Yeesu la n dɔɔwɛ.

ref: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
text: N nuu loobii bɛl n lii Kɔraawiizi bol n ŋɔwɛɛ, “Sɛbi wia naa ra dau lugɔ banla n yardi yaa Dɔɔri ka siu filaŋkeŋ, di hanna la, nuu sumaa.” U Dumnanii la ŋɔ, “Wibii maa. Ba daŋ gil ba huma ka heezi. Ba winanaa sɔŋ ge daŋ hiŋ baa.” Durnya kuna kumaa wia

ref: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
text: Mɛlika bɛl kaa lii Kɔraawiizi Dia di ŋɔ fɔŋŋa ni di ra tɛɛ unla n soge baama ni la, “Kpa i kizee di ra kum. Kuna kumaa saŋa helloo. Durnya pattikuna biiwɔɔ lugɔ í kumaa.”

ref: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
text: Unla n soge baama la ni la kpa u kizee di ra kum durnya pattikuna la.

ref: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
text: Mɛlika bɛl kaa lii Kɔraawiizi Dia la n du u bol biini la. U gba kpogli kizidiilii.

ref: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
text: Bɛl ge lii mbusu lizibɔr la. Unla n dɔɔ niŋ fɔŋŋa ge lii mbusu lizibɔr di pozi di ŋɔ kizidiilii hiŋ la be, “Kpa i kizidiilii la ŋmɛnni grepuzi la di chaalaa. A biiwɔɔ.”

ref: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
text: U lalli u kizee hɛri ni di chaali durnya grepuzi la, di dua kunla baŋ ɔɔ kpa nɔna di du di ra fɛrgi a nii ra lii la biini. Kɔraawiizi baannɛ a kuŋ.

ref: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
text: Ba fɛrgi nɔna la bol baŋgia, bɔr la banna fɛrgi nɔna a nii ra lii la, chal pal lii kunla biini di su di la chiŋ lugɔ nogumzi anɛɛ, di kaa pal guŋŋ lugɔ kilomitazi kalfa ahoro di wa hel zagra kabargazi.

ref: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
text: N kaa na witittizeŋ bɛl Kɔraawiizi bol. N na mɛlikazi aniidaanɛɛ n kpogli tuna wiilchɔgaa aniidaanɛɛ. Di annii wa ɛɛwɔ, Kɔraawiizi baaŋfuuih tunaa guŋ.

ref: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
text: di ra yir Kɔraawiizi balii Moosis ani Pebii la yir la, di ra ŋɔ, “Oo, yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ, i wiɛɛlaa ɛɛ wizenaare werge maa, di ra tir yaa. Durnya maa koori, i ŋmɛnizi maa deŋloore di ɛɛ wibii.

text: Denii mɛlikakpeg bɛl lalli bikpeg bɛl u lugɔ namzeŋ di kpau ha muuzeŋ la biini ka ŋɔ, “Gunnɛ bá wa kpa bolzeŋ Babilɔn la ha kpegzi ni kakpaŋ. Ba wàá ka nau maa.

ref: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
text: Ba wàá ka nuu nɛra n na lɔ janjalanzi i biini. Ba wàá ka nuu banla n na huuh tiitoraa ni bensunozi i biini maa. Ba wàá ka na banla n na sɛɛh di ra suah kuna di ra hum a huma dizi i biini. Ba wàá ka nuu nam ge gbɔga de.

ref: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
text: Fintina maa wàá ka chaani de. Ba wàá ka nuu baal ni u haŋfalii loobee de maa. Banla n yoo kuna i biini la faa ɛɛ nɛzenaare ba dɔŋahina la n du durnya maa be. I wettoo kpa i biiri di dar durnya nɛra maa.

ref: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
text: Kɔraawiizi dɔgtɛɛzi ni u biinanaa ni banla maa baŋ kpuwɛɛ durnya naa biini la, ba challii bá na a bol biini.”

ref: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
text: Denii n nuu kɔɔi bɛl Kɔraawiizi bol, alugɔ nɛkpila werge maa n na pogzi. Ba ra ŋɔ, “Tibaarikala! Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi kpegli u dɔmaa, di dɔɔ sɔŋ ni fɔŋŋa werge,

ref: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.”
text: dikuubɛɛwiai, wiazi la seriya un diwee la ɛɛ wibiire di deŋli. U di hahsɛnsɛnnizeŋ la n faa ɛɛ wikuna di chɔgi durnya labuu seriya u chol, di turguu u balaa kpui la kim.”

ref: Then the crowd shouted, “Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.”
text: Ba kaa ŋɔ, “Ií ra chɔli Kɔraawiizi! U nyɔɔzi ra tinnuu saŋa maa, a waa tunaa dɔɔwɛ.”

ref: From the throne a voice said, “If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.”
text: Loobii bɛl lii koorikara la ni di ŋɔ, “Ii banla n ɛɛ u balaa la, nɛdumazi ni nɛzenaa maa, di ra ɔmuu la, ií ra chɔli yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi.”

ref: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, “Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.
text: N nuu nɛkpila werge maa n ŋɔ wia alugɔ nii n suwee werge di ra pal, nazaa ge ra pogzi werge maa. Kenne ba ŋɔ, “Ií ra chɔli yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la n di kora!

ref: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.
text: Ií gil yaa bɔra sɔɔni yaa werge maa. Yaa daŋ chɔluu, dikuubɛɛwiai, Pebii la haaŋ kpai helloo. U haaŋ ge ɛɛ u hiŋ siryaa.

ref: She will be given a wedding dress made of pure and shining linen. This linen stands for the good things God's people have done.”
text: Ba gillɔɔ u kpa gessihuŋŋunanaa wɛjɛ n na nyɛgzi di bɔg.” A wɛjɛnanii ɛɛ winanaa la Kɔraawiizi biinanaa n ɛɛwɛ labuu.

ref: Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
text: Mɛlika la ŋɔ n be, “Sɛbi wia naa ra dau. ‘Banla baŋ yittɛ bá ba wa di Pebii haŋfalii diuzenaa la nuu sumaa.’ ” U kaa ŋɔ, “Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔzii guŋ, a ɛɛ wibiire.”

ref: I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.” The Rider on the White Horse
text: Denii n chɔɔ u see ń jaamuu. U ŋɔ, “Gilɛɛ ɛɛ guŋ. N nii ni i dɔŋahina la maa n na di Yeesu daansɛɛ la ɛɛ u balaarɛ. Kɔraawiizii í jaami. Yeesu wia labuu ɛɛ dɔgtɛɛzi wiŋɔzi la maa zɛɛ.” Zagtinni la n tinni zaghuŋŋu la wia

ref: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.
text: N na Kɔraawiizi bol n pillɛɛ, zaghuŋŋu bɛl lii. Nɛr la n tinnuu la, ba ra yiruu Yarda ni Wibii Hiŋ, dikuubɛɛwiai, u ra di nɛra seriyazii ni wibii di ra yoo laal ni wibii.

ref: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
text: U siwee ɛɛwɔɔ lugɔ ninlau. U hi koorikahurozi kpilakpila u nyuu. Sɔŋ bɛl ge chɔɔ u ni. Nɛr maa waa a sɔŋ zummɛ di u himmaa lɛi.

ref: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.”
text: U sɔŋ bɛllɛ kaa Kɔraawiizi Wiŋɔɔlii. U laali tagtajaŋ bɛl baŋ kpawɛɛ lii chal.

ref: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.
text: Kɔraawiizi bol soojazi laali gessihuŋŋa laala, di tinni zaghuŋŋa di hiŋuu kaali.

ref: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.
text: Tokobidiilii ra lii u nua, ú ŋmɛnni durnya nɛra. “U daŋ kpogli lugbii daŋkpala, di ra binni baa,” di ra fɛrgi grepu daa nɔna, á nii ra lii, bɔr la banna fɛrgi nɔna a nii ra lii la biini. Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la baannɛ a nii.

ref: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
text: Sɔŋ bɛl chɔɔ u wɛjɛ ni u naapɔg ni, KOORA MAA KOORI, DƆƆRA MAA DƆƆRI.

ref: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast!
text: N kaa na mɛlika bɛl n chigɛ wiizi ni. U ŋɔ zumbizi la maa n na zaah chiŋ be, fɔŋŋa ni, “Ií ra ba. Ií chaali wa di Kɔraawiizi diuzenaa.

ref: You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.”
text: Koora ni soojazi, nabɔnzi, nɛzenaa, zagra ni a tinna, banla n dɔɔ bahinaa, yoma, nɛdumazi ani nɛzenaa maa daŋ siu. Awia, ií chaali wa di baa.”

ref: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
text: Denii n na sechɔgii la ni durnya koora ni ba laallɔɔra n chaalɛɛ bá yoo unla n tinni zagu la ni u ge laallɔɔra.

ref: But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur.
text: Ba lauri sechɔgii la ni dɔgtɛɛkara hiŋ la n faa ra ɛɛ wizenaa u be di ra dar banla bam pii sechɔgii pii ba ra jaami kunla bam mawɛɛ la maanii. Ba waa baa kpuwɛɛ ka kpa baa di ha bɔr la niŋ n suwee lugɔ muu di fuuh ra sɔɔhri jilbi la.

ref: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
text: Banla ge n kawɛɛ, tokobi la n na lii unla n tinni zagu la nua la ge kpu baa zumbizi wa di baa, di piŋ.

ref: I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for
text: N na koorikassi aŋhina nɛra baŋhina n soge a ni. Kɔraawiizi tɛɛ baa fɔŋŋa ba ra di seriyazi. N kaa na baŋhina dunzi, baabuu banla baŋ faa teŋri ba nyuuni, dikuu baŋ faa di Yeesu daansɛɛ, di faa ra ŋɔ Kɔraawiizi wiŋɔɔlii la wia, ba faa waa sɛɛwɛ ba jaami sechɔgii la ni kunla bam mawɛɛ la. Ba faa waa kaa sɛɛ ba pii ba hilli gɛɛ ba nonee sechɔgii la pii. Ba izi a nyiŋ. Ba ni Kristo kpau di ra di kora binni kagboŋ la biini.

ref: These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for
text: Unla maa n niŋ izi lalaa lugli izaa la biini, nuu sumaa werge, nɛnaniirɛ a hiŋ. Siu bunɛɛhiŋ wàá dɔɔ fɔŋŋa u ni. Ba daŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi ni u Kristo Kizeehina, di kpau ra di ba kora binni kagboŋ la biini. Sitaani kpeglaa wia

ref: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
text: U daŋ lii di ba ú wa dar nɛra la maa n du hɛri tuna maa, Gɔg ni Magɔg la, di chaali baa bá yoo laal. Ba daŋ du kpil werge maa alugɔ muuzeŋ nua hɛɛhriichaa.

ref: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.
text: Kenne n na ba wia. Ba izoore di ba di wa tɔ hɛri maa di bar bol la Kɔraawiizi n nɔŋŋɛɛ u biinanaa chaali de la. Denii niŋ lii chiŋ di chol ba ni di fuuh ba maa nyaamm.

ref: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever. The Judgment at the Great White Throne
text: Ba lau Sitaani la n faa ra dar baa la ge di ha bɔr la niŋ ni jilbi n suwee di chɔɔ lugɔ muu la, bɔr la sechɔgii ni dɔgtɛɛkara hiŋ la n duwɛɛ la. Ba maa daŋ haŋ di tɔɔrɔɔrɛ di ra la saŋaa saŋa maa. Tuna seriya dii wia

ref: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
text: N na koorikara bɛl n kannɛ werge di huuhzi. Nɛr la n soge u ni la, chiŋ ni hɛri n wa nau a chɔ kaali. A waa wette na bɔr suah.

ref: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
text: Denii n na lalaa maa, nɛzenaa ni nɛdumazi maa, n chigɛ koorikara la zɛɛ. Ba pilli hɔna aŋhina di kaa pilli unla n ɛɛ miibɔɔ hɔŋ la. Denii Kɔraawiizi di lalaa la ni ba huma la maa n du hɔna biini la maa seriya.

ref: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
text: Nɛra la nii n faa diwee la lii de, banla n du lalaa bol la ge lii. Kɔraawiizi di bɛl maa wiɛɛlaa seriya.

ref: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
text: Denii ba kpa siu ni lalaa bol maa di ha bɔr la niŋ n suwee di chɔɔ alugɔ muu la. Siu bunɛɛ hinnɛ a niŋ.

ref: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
text: Di ba haŋ wa nyiŋŋi nɛr maa sɔŋ huhzi miibɔɔ hɔŋ la biini, amɔ, ba kpaubuu ha a niŋ biini la.

ref: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.
text: Denii n na chiŋfalii ni hɛrfalii. A lugli hora lawaa wia tunnɔɔ. Muuzeŋ maa waa kaa hoo.

ref: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.
text: N nuu loobii bɛl n lii koorikara la be di ra la bɔɔnɛɛ, n na ŋɔ, “Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. Kɔraawiizi duuribɔr jaa du newea benii. U ni baa daŋ jaa du de. Ba daŋ birgi u nɛra, ú ge ɛɛ ba Mɛɛ Kɔraawiizi, di du ba be.

ref: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
text: U daŋ fiizi ba sinii maa. Siu ge wàá ka du de. Biinichɔg ni kalu ni bɔwii wàá ka du de. Lugli wia la tunnɔɔ.”

ref: Then the one sitting on the throne said: I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted.
text: Unla n soge koorikara la ni la ŋɔ, “Na! N gillɔɔ kuna maa birgi a falaa.” U kaa ŋɔ n be, “Sɛbi a wia dau, dikuubɛɛwiai, n wiŋɔzi naa ɛɛ wibiire. A waa daraa dɔɔwɛ.”

ref: Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty.
text: Denii u ŋɔ, “A tunnɔ! Minuu lugli, minuu kaa tuna. Minuu ra faari wia, minuu kaa ra tunaa. Di nɛr maa ra wii niinyɔgzi, n daŋ gil u la bɔr la miibɔɔ nii n na bul di ga nyɔɔ a nii pɛɛpɛɛ.

ref: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
text: Nɛr la n wette kpegli Sitaani, u daŋ na wia naa maa. N daŋ ɛɛ Kɔraawiizi la unna hum, ú ge ɛɛ n biibaal.

ref: But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death. The New Jerusalem
text: Ka banla n na ɔm ani banla n waa yardi, banla n doŋ bahinaa ani banla n ɛɛ nɛkpuura ni sɛnsɛnna ni ziŋgaabo hina ni vugkuara ni banla maa n na dar nɛra, ba hotte bɔr la niŋ n suwee lugɔ muu di fuuh di ra sɔɔhri jilbi la. Siu bunɛɛ hinnɛ guŋ.”

ref: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
text: Denii mɛlikazi aniidaanɛɛ la n faa kpogli hɛnni ni wiilchɔgaa tuna aniidaanɛɛ la bɛl wa ŋɔ n be, “Ba ń baglii Pebii haŋfalii la.”

ref: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
text: Kɔraawiizi Duma izi n ni, u kpaŋ kaali bizenzeŋ bɛl nyuu. A bii faa la chinne werge. Denii u bagliŋ Jɛrusalɛm la n lii Kɔraawiizi be di ra tuu di ɛɛ bolnanii la.

ref: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.
text: Kɔraawiizi girme ra chaani u maa u ɛɛ lugɔ binanii la banna yir jaspɛr la n wesse werge maa di du yelemm lugɔ digii la.

ref: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
text: Koŋliizeŋ bɛl n la chiŋ werge baruu. U dominuuzi du fidaanɛɛ. Mɛlikazi fidaanɛɛ ge chi a dominuuzi. Ba sɛbi Izrɛl hina dizi fidaanɛɛ la sɔna dau dominuuzi la ni.

ref: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
text: U wiifurii paga la, dominuuzi ahoroo du de. U wiifurii nomɛɛl wiikakag paga ge, dominuuzi ahoro du de. U wiicholii paga, dominuuzi ahoroo du de ge. U wiifurii nodig wiikakag ge dominuuzi ahoro du de.

ref: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
text: Bia la baŋ chiŋŋɛɛ di ma a koŋlii hɔŋ a ni la ge du fidaanɛɛ. Pebii la huŋhunna fidibanɛɛ la sɔna ge du a bia ni.

ref: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
text: Mɛlika la n nuu n na ŋɔ wia la kpogli saliŋ daa ú kpa ra mɛgzi bol la ni u dominuuzi ni u koŋlaa la.

ref: The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about
text: A bol du kɔŋlɔnnɛ. U wassi ni u jaŋzi maa mɛgzi. U kpa saliŋ daa la di ra mɛgzi. U jaŋzi ɛɛ kilomitazi kagboŋa anɛɛ ni kalfaanɛɛ. U jaŋzi ni u wassi ni u chiŋ laŋaa maa ɛɛ kpannɛ.

ref: Then the angel measured the wall, and by our measurements it was about
text: U kaa mɛgzi koŋlii la. U chiŋ laŋaa ge ɛɛ nogumzi kalfa ni tokkoanɛɛ ni anaazu. Newee mɛgzaarɛ guŋ. Aabuu u kpa di ra mɛgzi.

ref: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
text: Jaspɛr labuu ba kpa ma u koŋlaa. A bol himmaa ge, saliŋ himmaa n du yelemm alugɔ digiire ba kpa di mau.

ref: Each of the twelve foundations was a precious stone. The first was jasper, the second was sapphire, the third was agate, the fourth was emerald,
text: Binanaa la baŋ kpawɛɛ faari a koŋlaa zɛɛ la ge sɔnaa keŋ. Lugli hiŋ ɛɛ jaspaa, nɛɛhiŋ ɛɛ saafaya, horohiŋ ɛɛ aget, naazuhiŋ ge ɛɛ ɛmɛrald,

ref: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.
text: nuehiŋ ɛɛ ɔnigs, numbɛlhiŋ ɛɛ karnɛliɔn, niidaanɛɛhiŋ ɛɛ kuats, ŋmantannaazihiŋ ɛɛ bɛril, kabɛlhiŋ ɛɛ topaz, fihiŋ ɛɛ kalsidoni, fidikpaŋhiŋ ɛɛ turkɔis, fidaanɛɛhiŋ ɛɛ amɛtis.

ref: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
text: Dominuuzi fidaanɛɛ la ge, kunnanaa la banna yir pɛɛl labuu tɔ a maa. A bol ŋmɛnizi ge ɛɛ saliŋ himmaa n du yelemm alugɔ digii.

ref: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
text: Maa Kɔraawiizi jaamidia nawɛɛ de, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi Fɔŋŋa Maa Hiŋ la ni Pebii la ɛɛ jaamidiarɛ.

ref: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
text: A waa kaa ɛɛ lugɔ wiizi ni baaguu ninna chaani a bol, dikuubɛɛwiai, Kɔraawiizi girmee ninna chaani de. Pebii la genii ɛɛ a bol fintina.

ref: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
text: Durnya nɛra danna vol u bɔchaaŋ la biini, durnya koora ni ba girme ge maa wa zuu u biini.

ref: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
text: U dominuuzi ŋmɛnɛ maa waa tɔi dɔɔwɛ, dikuubɛɛwiai, hamuŋa waa du de.

ref: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
text: Durnya nɛra girme ni ba daama maanii bá kpa zuu de.

ref: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
text: Ka kunla maa n doŋŋe waa wer zuu de maa. Nɛra la maa n na ɛɛ wikuna di dɔɔ daraa maa wàá wer zuu de. Banla baŋ sɛbi ba sɔna di du Pebii miibɔɔ hɔŋ la biini la, bɛnnɛ niŋ zuu de.

ref: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
text: Denii u bagliŋ muu bɛl n lii Kɔraawiizi ni Pebii la koorikara la be. A nii dɔɔ miibɔɔrɛ di du yelemm,

ref: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
text: di chɔɔ a bol ŋmɛnɛɛ baambaaŋ di ra pal. Miibɔɔ daa bɛl chi u keŋkere bɛl. Bɛl ge chi u keŋkere bɛl hiŋ. A ɔɔ nɔŋ nɔnaa naa bufidaanɛɛ bina maa. Baagu maa a ɔɔ nɔŋ nɔndee kpaŋ. A paŋhoori ge ra chaa durnya.

ref: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
text: Kunla maa Kɔraawiizi n see nua wàá du a bol. Kɔraawiizi ni Pebii koorikara la daŋ du de. U balaa daŋ ɔɔ ra jaamuu.

ref: and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people.
text: Ba daŋ ɔɔ ra binni u siwee, ú sɔŋ ge du ba hilli.

ref: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
text: Hamuŋa wàá du de. Ba wàá kaa ra nyiŋŋi fintina ni wiizi gba, dikuubɛɛwiai, ba Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi daŋ ɔɔ ra chaani ba ni. Ba danna di kora di hanna la saŋaa saŋa maa. Yeesu balaa wia

ref: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.
text: Denii mɛlika la ŋɔ n be, “Wiŋɔzi naa ɛɛ wibiire. A waa daraa maa dɔɔwɛ. Yaa Dɔɔri Kɔraawiizi Duma la n faa izi dɔgtɛɛzi la ni la, waabuu hum u mɛlika u balaa be ú bagli baa wia la n niŋ wa ɛɛ filaŋkeŋ.”

ref: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
text: “Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. N daŋ ba manaŋ. Unla n niŋ hiŋ wia naa baŋ sɛbɛɛ hɔnnaa biini nuu sumaa.”

ref: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
text: Mìŋ́ Jɔɔnnɛ nuu wia naa maa di naa. Miŋ wa nuua di naa la, n chɔɔ mɛlika la n bagliŋ a wia see ŋɔ ń jaamuu.

ref: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
text: Ka u ŋɔ, “Gilɛɛ ɛɛ guŋ. N gba ɛɛ u balii bɛllɛ alugɔ i ni i dɔŋahina dɔgtɛɛzi la ni banla n na hiŋ wia la n du hɔnnaa biini la. A jaami Kɔraawiizi.”

ref: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
text: Nɛr la n na ɛɛ wichɔgaa, ú haa ra ɛɛ a wichɔgaa. Nɛr la n na ɛɛ wikuna, ú haa ra ɛɛ a wikuna. Nɛr la n na ɛɛ winanaa, ú haa ra ɛɛ winanaa la. Nɛr la n waa doŋa maa dɔɔwɛ u ni, ú haa du guŋ.”

ref: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
text: “Ií ra nuu ɛŋ. N daŋ ba manaŋ. Kinturgaa la du n benii. N daŋ turgi nɛr maa ani gunla uŋ hummɛ.

ref: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
text: Minuu lugli. Minuu kaa tuna. Minuu tɔ see di kaa tɔ har. Minuu ra lugli wia. Minuu kaa ra tunaa.

ref: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
text: Banla n chag ba tagtajaŋra la ka bá wer di di miibɔɔ daa la nɔna, di ɔɔ wer ra zuu a bol biini ba kipar la, nuu sumaa.

ref: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
text: Nɛkuna, tagɛɛra, sɛnsɛnna, nɛkpuura, vugkuara ni banla maa n na nyiŋŋi nɛdaraa di ra kanni kara la, ba maa du bosseere.

ref: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
text: Mìŋ́ Yeesuu hum n mɛlika la ú wer baglii wiŋɔzi naa í bagli n hiŋra la. Minuu Deevid Dee Faaraa, minuu kaa ɛɛ u Naana Bɛl. Minuu Naanyɔɔ la n na chaani werge la.”

ref: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
text: Kɔraawiizi Duma ni haŋfalii la ŋɔ, “A ba!” Hinla maa n nuuwɛ, í ge ŋɔ, “A ba!” Nɛr la maa n na wii niinyɔgzi, ú ra ba. Nɛr la maa n na nyiŋŋi lugɔ u ba wa nyɔɔ miibɔɔ nii la pɛɛpɛɛ, ú ra ba.

ref: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
text: N ŋɔ ń karfi nɛr la maa n nuu wia naa n du hɔnnaa biini, di ra bagli wia la n niŋ haa wa ɛɛ labuu lugɔ, di bɛl maa wa jaa wiimaa a ni, Kɔraawiizi daŋ gil wiilchɔgaa la wia miŋ ŋɔwɛɛ hɔnnaa biini la, chol u ni.

ref: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
text: Di bɛl maa kaa wa mɔŋ wiŋɔzi naa ni ta tama maa, Kɔraawiizi wàá tɛu miibɔɔ daa la nɔna ú di. Wàá tɛu bɔr u bolnanii la biini. Wàá zum anniizi min bagli a wia hɔnnaa biini naa.

ref: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
text: Unla n ɛɛ wia naa maa daansɛɛ ŋɔwɔɔrɛ, “N daŋ ba manaŋ.” Ami. N Dɔɔri Yeesu, a ba manaŋ.

ref: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
text: Yáa Dɔɔri Yeesu Kristo nɛsunaa dɔɔi ni u hiinaa du ii maa be. Ami.
